You can face players from around the world, sharpen your strategy against the computer opponent, or sit down for a head-to-head game with a friend on the same device.

The game keeps the familiar checkers rules but adds a modern feel to the board and the play. Whether you want a quick round or a longer battle of tactics, it gives you a way to enjoy the timeless game in a fresh digital form.
100-doors-escape-from-prison: Step into the role of Beren, a prisoner who has lost all memory of his past. Your job is to examine unusual cells, work through tangled puzzles, and slowly uncover pieces of your own history. Each chamber presents its own set of clues that must be untangled before you can move on.

Success depends on sharp observation, because every room hides a route to freedom that is not obvious at first glance. Look closely at your surroundings, notice the details others would overlook, and use what you find to plot a way out. Your journey through the prison blends exploration and careful deduction as you search for the exit.
christmas-girls-dress-up: Christmas Girls Dress Up invites you to get into the holiday spirit by styling four friends for a festive Christmas celebration. Each girl has her own seasonal theme: one is a gingerbread-inspired sweetie, another has Nutcracker-style elegance, a third is a Santa-loving charmer, and the last goes for playful Grinch-inspired glam. You can combine tops, dresses, hairstyles, shoes, and accessories in many ways to build cozy, cheerful outfits. Let your imagination lead each design and enjoy the sparkly, stylish mood of the season.
On a computer, use your mouse to play. On a phone or tablet, tap the screen. Browse through the category items and choose the pieces you like best.
mazean-com: Mazean drops you into a cybernetic battlefield as a robotic fighter in fast, real-time first-person shooter combat. You can plan your approach using a range of laser weapons, while enemies keep coming at you without letting up. Teaming up with your squad is part of the fun, and moving through shifting arenas helps you slip past opponents and gain the upper hand. It is a multiplayer game packed with adrenaline from start to finish.
stickman-rescue-draw-2-save: Think of your mind as the stickman's only protection in this relaxed puzzle game. Stickman Rescue - Draw 2 Save is a very easy-going puzzler where you sketch lines with a finger to pull the little figure out of harm's way. Each level puts him in a jam, whether rocks are tumbling down, arrows are zipping through the air, or he's about to fall into a deep hole.

Your job is to decide what to sketch. You might draw a protective shield, lay down a bridge, or build some clever contraption that keeps him safe and finishes the rescue mission. Controls are simple: click with a mouse or tap the screen to play.
tractor-trial: Take the wheel of a tractor in this off-road racing game. Your goal is to get across the course by passing every obstacle and trap in your path, all while keeping your machine balanced. It is listed as an HTML5 racing title with obstacle challenges, and it is built to be played on mobile too.

On a computer, drive with the arrow keys or with W, A, S and D. If you are on a phone or tablet, tap the on-screen buttons to drive. Either way, you steer the tractor directly as you cross the rough ground ahead, so keep an eye on your balance at every bump.
robot-attacks: Protect your city in this arcade game, where robot invaders arrive in waves that grow harder as you go. You fight back by clicking or tapping quickly to take down the mechanical monsters before they reach you. Careful planning matters too, since you can strengthen your base and collect power-ups that help you survive the attacks.

Your reflexes are tested from start to finish. Every second counts, so you need to stay sharp and react fast as the pressure builds. Robot Attacks is a fast-paced title that rewards quick thinking and steady focus, and it suits players who enjoy a demanding challenge.
gladiators-merge-and-fight: Build up your fighter by combining materials into stronger gear, which improves your hero's weapons and equipment. Each match is a one-on-one duel in a harsh arena, and you can change your approach as the fight goes on. Look for your rival's weak points and press them to win. Every choice you make steers your champion's path toward glory.
The game sits in the Action category and is tagged Fighting. Its tone is rough and gripping, so expect a tense fight from start to finish.
challenge-the-zombies: Challenge the Zombies is a fast-paced shooter where you face off against dangerous undead foes. You play as a brave survivor who uses a range of weapons to help save the world from a zombie apocalypse. As you move through each stage, the zombies grow stronger, so you need to plan your moves and rely on quick, sharp shooting to stay alive.

Expect demanding missions and nonstop action from start to finish. The game will appeal to fans of zombie survival, shooting action, and offline zombie attack titles. Use your mouse to click any button.
the-escape-series: The Escape Series is an adventure title tagged with escape, brain, and puzzle games, and it puts your reasoning and analytical skills to the test. You search detailed environments for clues and objects that can help you get out. Each space has its own distinct puzzles and riddles to work through.

Everything is controlled with the mouse, which you use to select and interact with objects. You solve codes and apply logic and problem-solving to find a way out of each room. The game works on both mobile and desktop, so you can play on whichever device you have.
modern-strike-shooting-game: Modern Strike Shooting throws you into fierce fighting, where accuracy, quick reflexes, and smart tactics decide the outcome. You step onto the battlefield, take careful aim, and play through a first-person shooter (FPS) experience made for people who enjoy action and combat titles. Each shootout tests your skills, and every encounter gives you a chance to sharpen your aim. Fans of gun games, military combat, FPS shooters, and tactical action adventures should find plenty to enjoy here.

Movement uses W, A, S, and D, or the arrow keys. W or Up moves you forward, S or Down moves you back, A or Left shifts you left, and D or Right shifts you right. To click any button in the game, use your mouse.
pirates-tiles-challenge: You play as a bold pirate captain in this tile-matching puzzle. Each board is a grid of pirate icons, including flags, treasure chests, swords, anchors, pistols, compasses and more. Your job is to spot identical pairs and link them with a path of no more than three straight lines, as long as nothing blocks the way. Clear every tile to finish a board and earn up to three stars.

The game offers hundreds of levels that grow harder over time, all set in a colorful pirate world with a treasure-hunting feel. On desktop, click one tile, then its match, and a valid route connects automatically. The lightbulb icon gives you a hint, and the pause button stops play when you need a break. On mobile, you tap the tiles instead. Power-ups add extra variety, and the mix of simple rules and tricky boards suits players of all ages.
paper-doll-diary-chibi-dolls: Paper Doll Diary - Chibi Dolls is a free game for Android. Players design their own personalized dolls, then use them to take photos or make videos. Each doll can be dressed up in whatever style the player chooses.

The game also lets you build the setting around your dolls. You can pick from a selection of backgrounds, then add props and stickers to enhance the scene. These extras help each picture or video look more complete, and they give you plenty of room to get creative.
alchemist-lab-jewel-crush: Step into an alchemy workshop in this match-three puzzle game. Your job is to line up three jewel elements so they vanish from the board. Lining up four or five chips creates bonus pieces, and each bonus must be matched with a gem before it activates. You can also join two bonuses together to forge a philosopher's stone.
The lab holds more than 100 challenging levels, so there is plenty to keep you busy. Control is simple: swipe across the board to match the colorful gems.
robbie-draw-your-sword: Robbie: Draw your Sword is an online adventure that runs right in your browser. You collect swords, finish challenges, and gain levels to change how your character looks and performs. Along the way, you can unlock new outfits, pets, and abilities. The game works on both mobile devices and desktop computers, and it is free to play.

On a computer, use W, A, S, and D to move and left-click to swing and draw your sword. Press the spacebar to jump, and hold the right mouse button while moving the mouse to rotate the camera. On a smartphone, drag the joystick on the left side of the screen to move, slide a finger across the right side to turn the camera, and tap the screen to swing and draw your sword.
noob-vs-zombie: You wind through twisting, labyrinth-style terrain in this action title, where careful fighting and clever puzzle-solving both play a part. Stronger gear comes from upgrades, and deadly traps must be dodged along the way. Collecting coins helps you expose a betrayer hiding among the population.

Journey across a range of distinct biomes, uncover secrets that stay locked until you find them, and talk with villagers to learn more about the mystery. Expect a steady stream of tough obstacles and surprises as you press onward.
d-copter-reloaded: Take the controls of a strong helicopter and fly high above the city as you join fierce gangster battles. The game mixes airborne dogfights with precise long-range sniping, so you'll need to weigh each move carefully while dodging incoming threats. Between missions, you can improve your weapons and your chopper to get ready for harder assignments. This immersive 3D shooter gets tougher as you progress.

Each mission asks you to think on your feet and use clever flying to stay alive. Keep your wits about you, pick your moments to attack from a distance, and push through the rising challenge one stage at a time.
realistic-car-destruction-sandbox: Realistic Car Destruction Sandbox turns every drive into a crash test. You can explore steep downhill courses, dirt roads, cliffside routes, and winter terrain, or send your vehicle into giant presses, swinging hammers, and grinding machines. Car bodies crumple and parts break away during jumps, impacts, and crushing sequences. Fences and trees can be smashed through too.

Repair your car with R whenever you want another attempt. Choose any available vehicle and location, set your own goals, and explore at your own pace or join multiplayer sessions. On desktop, drive with WAS
snake-2048-io: Snake 2048.io combines a snake game with number puzzles. You steer your snake around a bright three-dimensional arena, chomping cubes that carry numbers and merging matching ones to help it grow. Each move asks for a bit of planning and a bit of math, so think ahead before you turn.

Rival snakes share the arena, so you will need to stay alert and outwit them. Patience and a sneaky approach can carry you to the top. Your target is the 2048 cube, so keep merging and see how far your snake can climb.
grow-empire: In Grow Empire, you can choose to hold your fortress or go on the attack. Improve your walls, towers and fighters with careful choices as you go. Your city faces elephants, siege guns and waves of hostile troops, while arrows and flames fill the sky above. You clash with Egyptian, Italian, Gallic, Iberian and Carthaginian warriors as your empire spreads across Europe and Africa.

Release your troops and they will fight on their own. Use various abilities and keep upgrading your warriors to turn the tide. Conquer enemy cities to collect chests full of gems, gold, potions and maps, and defend your colonies to refill your bank with gold. It is a strategy game that blends tower defense and army management. Aim to be the leader that R
fail-run-online: Fail Run Online is a funny, tough trek where each careful step tests your balance and patience. You need precise footwork to move along tricky paths while avoiding comedic stumbles along the way. Bright, colorful visuals add to the game's pull, making it hard to put down once you start.
Your aim is to walk the whole way without a single wobble. Each move asks for focus and patience, so take your time with every step. It sits in the Arcade category and carries the Arcade tag.
loaf-clicker: Loaf Clicker is a puzzle-style game in which you build up a stash of bread by clicking. Each tap adds more loaves to your inventory. As your pile grows, you can spend what you have on automatic generators that make loaves for you, plus upgrades that help you plan your growth. The game also tracks achievements you can earn along the way, and it carries a strategy tag, so careful choices matter. Your aim is to become a bread mogul and rise to the top of the dough-based economy.

Think of it as a race to build the biggest bakery empire through steady clicking and smart spending. Keep an eye on which generators and upgrades give you the best return, and watch your achievement list fill up as your loaf count climbs.
super-motocross: Saddle up on a dirt bike in Super Motocross, a sports game that sends you over demanding courses packed with ramps, jumps, and obstacles. Your goal is to keep your balance, build speed, and reach the finish line without taking a spill. The pace is quick, making it an arcade-style ride that suits players of all ages.

Controls are simple: a mouse click or a tap is all you need. Built with HTML5, the game runs right in your web browser. If you enjoy motocross or two-wheeled racing, this title delivers plenty of fast, bumpy action.
pixel-flow: Pixel Flow is a quick puzzle game about reacting fast and getting your actions in the right order. Each cannon fires only at pixel blocks that match its color, and every hit breaks a block, so the board empties one piece at a time. To win, you manage the flow of shots, keep the conveyor from overloading, and build combos. It is easy to pick up, yet lining up the right sequence keeps you coming back.

Tap a cannon to send it onto the conveyor. Once it completes a full cycle, it moves into a spare slot. Slots are limited, so watch the order closely. Shoot in the right sequence and the whole board will clear.
red-stickman-vs-monster-school: In this 2D fighter, you control a red stickman who takes on fearsome monsters in a pared-down version of the Minecraft world. Quick reflexes matter just as much as skillful combat and clever jumping across platforms. You will need to push through waves of tireless creatures and bring down oversized bosses along the way.

Every foe you defeat helps you move forward, and you can strengthen your abilities as you go. The pace is quick, so you have to stay alert and react fast. Whether you are landing blows or navigating tricky ledges, each battle asks you to sharpen your skills.
words-and-bubbles: Words and Bubbles is a calm word game built around association. Your goal is to spot words that share a meaning and group them together. When you tap a set of bubbles that fits, they fuse into a larger bubble labeled with the category they form. Those new categories can then serve as ingredients for later combinations, so each finished group may open up fresh possibilities.

The game holds thousands of stages, and the links grow subtler as you move forward, so obvious pairings give way to hidden ones. Achievements and helpful boosters are on hand for tricky moments. Go at whatever speed suits you, and you may find your attention getting sharper along the way. Before moves run out, make sure to clear every combination that remains open.
screw-out-jam-puzzle: Screw Out: Jam Puzzle centers on nuts and bolts puzzles that test your problem-solving. Each stage presents a tangled jam maze to work through, and there are 1000 levels in total, so there is plenty to keep you busy. You can play on either a smartphone or a computer, and the game is offered free online.

As you advance, you earn rewards and can use boosters to help with tricky spots. Keeping a winning streak going is part of the fun. Controls are simple: on a desktop you use the mouse, and on a mobile device you tap the screen with your finger.
boxing-stars: In Boxing Stars, you begin in an underground boxing scene and work your way up toward the championship, aiming to become a boxing star. Rewards along the way help you sharpen your skills, which opens the door to stronger tournaments. The game sits in the sports category and carries the boxing, fighting, and management tags.

Each match is won by knocking your opponent out. You can throw a variety of attacks, block incoming blows, and move around the ring, so you can plan your own approach and shape your own story. Keep training your abilities so you are ready for the tougher competitions ahead.
natural-disaster-survival-obby: Moving through dangerous terrain in this adventure title, you rely on fast responses to stay alive as disasters keep striking. Rising water, molten rock, and twisting storms all test how long you can last, while demanding obstacle routes keep you moving forward.

You can join forces with players from around the world, collect stylish outfits for your character, and bring home charming companion animals. Each run blends survival with course progress, and the main goal is to see how long you can hold out against the chaos.
super-onion-boy-2: Super Onion Boy 2 is a platformer that sends you on a journey through colorful stages with a classic, nostalgic feel. Your mission is to save a companion who has been captured by a mighty monster. Along the way you can gain special powers, search out hidden treasure, and get past foes by thinking ahead rather than just charging in.

Expect tough bosses waiting at the end of various stages, and keep an eye out for concealed routes that lead to extra areas. Each part of the game is built to keep you moving and curious about what lies just beyond the next screen.
dop2-draw-love: In this puzzle title, you guide a goofy pair of lovers out of awkward jams. Each stage shows a scene, and your job is to sketch the piece that is absent so the situation can be resolved. Along the way, you also uncover little secrets hidden in the artwork. The aim is to help the guy get out of trouble while making sure his partner stays by his side. Mobile players can enjoy it too.
Start by studying the picture carefully, then draw the missing element on screen. Once you finish the detail correctly, the couple's reaction plays out, showing how they respond to what
color-coin-merge: Color Coin Merge is a puzzle game built around sorting coins. You can try out several ways to arrange them, and as you play, you start to notice patterns that repeat across the board. When obstacles get in the way, you can call on special power-ups to push through, and each level grows trickier than the one before.

Your task is to place colored coins into slots and merge them until the board is cleared. Power-ups such as the Hammer, Free Move, Shuffle, and Time Slot help you along, and unique coins appear that change how each round unfolds. Later levels speed up and race you against the clock, so quick thinking matters. Fans of match-3 and logic puzzles will find plenty to work through here.
baby-bear: Baby Bear lets you experience both the happy and the tricky sides of raising a child, this time with a family of bears. You help Mummy Bear and Daddy Bear get ready for their little one's arrival, then look after the baby once it is here. The characters are full of charm, you can customize things in creative ways, and each scenario brings its own situations to work through.

The game is played entirely with clicks, so it is easy to pick up and start. As you move through the story, you follow the highs and lows of bear parenthood, with plenty to keep you busy along the way.
truck-transport-simulator: Truck Transport Simulator puts you behind the wheel of a truck in a driving game designed with boys in mind. Your job is to finish transport missions across a variety of landscapes. You'll haul cargo such as boxes and barrels, then park the truck in the designated locations.

Uneven, rocky roads make the job harder, so you'll need to watch the terrain closely. Driving slowly helps make sure your cargo doesn't fall off, because a lost load means you fail the mission. Controls are simple: just mouse click or tap to play.
santa-city-run: Santa has a stack of presents to get to the right homes, and you control his dash through a busy city. Sprint down the streets while dodging every obstacle in your path, and try to rack up as many points as you can before you run out of room to move.

You steer with the arrow keys on a keyboard, or by tapping the screen if you are playing on a touch device. The game is fast and chaotic, so quick reactions matter as much as careful timing. It is a festive, holiday-themed runner that is easy to pick up and hard to put down.
penalty-kick: Penalty Kick puts you on the spot in tense football showdowns. Each shot calls for careful aim and well-timed kicks. The goalkeeper and defenders are always trying to stop you, so you need to keep them guessing and find the gap that gets the ball past them.

Every goal you score earns points, and those points help you unlock new balls. There is no time limit, so you can take your time with every kick and plan each shot without a clock hurrying you along. Practice at your own pace and sharpen your skills until you feel confident on the penalty spot.
one-bit: One Bit puts you in control of a pixel character who must make its way along a series of tracks. This single-player 2D platform adventure asks you to push through each obstacle, and you can set a checkpoint along the way so you do not have to start over from the beginning. Clearing every obstacle is how you win.
Movement uses W, A, S and D or the arrow keys, while C sets your checkpoint. Players on mobile devices can rely on the touch controls displayed on the screen to get around.
drawrider: Drawrider combines sketching with racing. Before each run, you draw the wheels your rider will use, and then the race begins. Each new challenge needs a fresh pair, because every one asks for a different wheel shape, so you will need to vary your designs as you move forward.

Speed counts, so race fast to get through all the levels successfully. The wheels you draw are what decide each race, so think about the shape before you start drawing. Drawing the right wheels is how you win.
neon-shot: Neon Shot puts you in a neon-lit universe where you use a catapult to hurl vividly colored projectiles. Your goal is to hit precise spots and shatter the targets. Each level tests your strategy, because you have to adjust the trajectory of your shots. Stages begin with easy targets and grow into tough challenges, all in a bright arcade style.
Along the way, you can collect coins. Keep your aim true and you can reach victory with plenty of glowing style.
offroad-jeep-hills-driving: Take a bumpy trip over rugged hills while thick fog rolls across the scenery. You sit behind the wheel of a powerful jeep and steer it over tough ground, threading your way past rows of palm trees. The physics feel lifelike, and the surroundings are built to pull you in, so the terrain feels real. Nature throws plenty of obstacles your way, and getting past them is what this genuine offroad drive is all about.
Use WASD to drive the jeep.
fastlane-road-to-revenge: Fastlane: Road to Revenge is an online racing game with a strong combat side. You choose your fastest vehicle and the most powerful weapon to go with it. Your goal is to clear the barriers blocking the street while you battle a fierce, cruel wanted man. Speed matters, but so does staying alive as you race along the road.

The game is played with the mouse. It belongs to the Action category and is tagged Arcade, Racing, and Shooting, which reflects how it mixes driving with gunfire. If you enjoy fast pursuits with plenty of firepower, this title covers both sides of that appeal.
obby-keyboard-run-1-speed: Hop and sprint across giant keyboard keys in this 3D parkour challenge. Your pace climbs with every stride, so the longer you keep moving, the faster you get. Courses full of hurdles test your timing, and each win you gather can be spent on upgrades for your character. Two separate worlds are waiting, and you can wander through either one whenever you like. Your progress is saved, so you can pick up where you left off.

Controls are simple. Press W, A, S, and D to move and the Space bar to leap. Hold the right mouse button to turn your view. On a phone, a joystick handles movement, dragging rotates the camera, and tapping Jump makes you hop. Reach the trophy at the end of a course to finish it.
blocky-combat-swat-original-2026: Step into the blocky, pixel-filled fighting of Blocky Combat Swat Original 2026, a newer take on the voxel shooter you may already know. Tactical battles take place in environments that can be broken apart as you fight through them. You can storm enemy strongholds in single-player missions, or compete in quick multiplayer arenas where the goal is to top the leaderboard.

This year's version brings sharper gameplay, a broad range of blocky guns to pick from, and bright, low-poly visuals. Use Tab to open the in-game menu, WASD to walk, and the mouse to aim and shoot. Scroll the wheel to swap between weapons. Gather
eatable-birds: Eatable Birds puts you in the air, gliding over colorful scenery where staying alive depends on agility and fast reactions. Your flight path brings you close to dangerous creatures such as furious eagles and bees, so you must steer clear of them. The controls are straightforward and easy to pick up, which keeps the focus on movement and timing.
Each stage takes you on a journey past many different kinds of birds, giving the game a varied feel from one level to the next. It is a lighthearted pick that people of every age can enjoy.
wall-of-riddles: Wall of Riddles is a free escape room game you can play right in your browser. You face a wall with nine locked chests, and each one conceals a gem. Some chests hold useful objects, such as a desk calendar, a grey film, a scroll covered in symbols, a wooden disc, and a brass key, and you will need these to open the others. Along the way you will work through padlocks, a stopped clock, rows of flags, spinning wooden discs, and a compass to decode.

You can go it alone or invite friends to share a single screen. Tap a chest to start its puzzle, then turn the padlock dials to enter a code. Items you discover collect in the bag along the bottom. Tap one to take a closer look, then drag it onto the chest it belongs to. Each chest offers up to three hints if you get stuck. Gather all nine gems and the wall is yours.
idle-zoo-tycoon: Run your own zoo from humble beginnings in this clicker tycoon game. You start with a modest park and gradually grow it into a large destination packed with creatures from every corner of the globe. Along the way, you can unlock scarce species, refine the habitats they live in, and add new areas for visitors. Hiring staff and keeping guests happy also matters.

Gameplay is easy to pick up and calm to enjoy. Tap your zoo to bring in money and move ahead faster. Spend your earnings on fresh animals and exhibitions, which draw in more people and raise your zoo's popularity and income. The more animals and exhibits you own, the more coins flow in automatically, including while you are away from the game. Keep adding to your collection as you go.
capy-cafe: You are a hardworking capybara barista running a cozy idle café. Pick strawberries and tea leaves, brew fragrant teas, shake up bubble tea and boba, and blend creamy smoothies for a steady line of happy guests. Walking up to a station is all it takes, since your capy handles the work on its own, though some stations need you to stay put while they run.

Spend your earnings on new drinks and stations, and hire helper capybaras to keep the café running as it grows. A small tea stand can expand into a large boba operation, one cup at a time. Desktop players move with the arrow keys or WASD, while mobile players touch and hold anywhere to bring up a floating joystick and drag to steer. The controls stay simple, and the progression stays satisfying.
crowd-runner: Crowd Runner is played with a single finger. You begin with a small band of little jelly folks and steer them down a track by dragging left or right. Choose your gates carefully: green ones add runners or multiply them, while red ones subtract or divide. Hazards such as saws, hammers, crushers, flame jets, lasers, boulders and TNT will knock runners out, but none of them can end a run on its own.

Reach the finish and your jellies climb the victory stairs, with more survivors meaning a higher spot and a bigger payout. Some levels close with a boss instead, where your numbers go up against his. Levels are generated endlessly across eight themes. Coins unlock permanent upgrades, one-run boosts and fifteen jelly skins, and a seven-day login reward plus a chest that opens every three wins add more to collect.
soccer-drop-game: Soccer Drop Game mixes football with physics-based puzzles. Each level asks you to release the ball at exactly the right moment so it travels into the goal. The aim is straightforward, but reaching it takes careful timing, smart thinking, and quick reactions to get past the obstacles in your way.

You play with mouse clicks or taps. Choose your moment, let the ball fall, and watch the physics carry it toward the net. The brain-teasing setups keep you thinking as you work through each level. It suits players who enjoy puzzles as much as sports.
block-bloom: Block Bloom is a relaxed block puzzler set in a garden. Three flower-shaped pieces sit beside the grid, and you move each one onto an open square of your choice. Whenever a full row or column forms, it blooms and disappears, freeing up space on the board.

Nothing counts down, so the real test is planning a few moves ahead. Each piece needs a place to land, and a grid cluttered with awkward holes brings the round to a close. Clearing several lines with a single piece earns the highest score, and the garden level climbs as you advance. Pastel tones and short rounds make it a comfortable choice for a few minutes on a computer or a phone.
tile-match-explorer: Tile Match Explorer mixes classic tile matching, much like mahjong-style play, with fresh puzzle ideas. Matching becomes a journey across many boards. As you advance, the game shifts and brings new hurdles that call for different strategies. Landing three identical tiles and clearing a board feels rewarding and makes the next puzzle hard to resist.

To play, tap any open tile, and it moves to the tile bar at the bottom. Gather three matching tiles to remove them from the bar. Keep going until the full board is cleared. Since the bar holds only so many tiles, plan ahead, because filling it completely can cause the level to fail. When you get stuck, boosters and shuffle options can help. Finish a level to unlock new puzzles.
jigmerge-puzzles: Jigmerge Puzzles asks you to rebuild pictures that have been cut into scrambled tiles. Every level presents a fresh photo in fragments that you can shift, trade places and join together. Study the small details, spot shapes that belong together, and watch the scene slowly take form.
Themes include animals, nature, food, winter, cars, landscapes and more, and each level has its own
steal-a-pet: Aim to become the wealthiest and quickest racer around. Sneak eggs away from strong guardians, then hatch them to grow your own collection. Boost your running speed on the treadmill so you can leave faster and faster guardians behind. There are six guardian stages to get through, and each one demands more pace than the last. Equipped trails add speed bonuses that help you keep accelerating.

Every creature you hatch can be placed in your pen, where it brings in cash each second. Use that money to unlock better upgrades. On a computer, move with WASD or the arrow keys and press E to interact. On mobile, use the on-screen touch controls to move and interact.
tap-3d-wood-block-away: Tap 3D Wood Block Away is a free online puzzle game that asks you to use both creativity and logic. You turn wooden blocks around and tap them so that intricate three-dimensional designs slowly come into view. The levels grow more demanding as you go, which keeps your mind busy, and you can play on a phone or a computer.

The controls are simple to learn. Swipe to rotate the structure, then tap cubes to remove them in the correct order. Each level is trickier than the last, so your spatial thinking gets sharper over time. There is no rush, so you can take the puzzles at whatever pace suits you.
kindergarten-kids-learning-games: This learning collection is designed for toddlers and preschoolers, roughly ages two to six, and teaches the alphabet, shapes, counting, tracing, and body parts through play. Because young children have short attention spans, the lessons come as quick, colorful activities such as shooting arrows at apples, building a car, playing basketball, guiding a hopping dog, and dodging an elephant. Kids pick up lessons without feeling they are studying.

Children can trace letters and numbers in English, Spanish, and Hindi, and explore charts covering fruits, vegetables, sports, animals, professions, and the solar system. Printable coloring pages with stickers, shape and color practice, phonics with flash cards, and a word games section round things out. It is free and operated with mouse touch controls.
stickman-gun-shooter-3d: Stickman Gun Shooter 3D puts you in the role of a stickman who hunts other stickmen across a fully three-dimensional level. Be ready for plenty of gore, since the game is packed with blood effects and enemies fall in ragdoll-style physics deaths. You need to snipe and gun down rivals first, because hesitating means they will take you out.

Your arsenal includes a shotgun, a machine gun, an MP5, an M16, an AK-47 and an Uzi. The controls are simple: WASD or the arrow keys move you, CTRL shoots, Space jumps and G throws a grenade. The aim is to stay alive as long as you can. The soundtrack is "Global Mechanization" by dem0lecule.
kitty-grid-puzzle: Kitty Grid Puzzle is a relaxing logic game where cats wait for their perfect space. Each cat carries a number showing how many squares its room must cover. Sweep across the board to shape rectangles of the right size, giving every cat a room of its own and leaving no empty squares. The puzzles start simple and grow harder, so you'll need to think carefully and plan each move. Cute cat reactions and clever levels add pl
spooky-racing: Spooky Racing is a Halloween kart racer played in full 3D. You can pick from eight classic monsters, including Dracula, the Mummy, the Witch and Jack Pumpkin, and each one comes with a kart of its own. Courses wind through pumpkin patches, haunted swamps, a neon ghost town and a vampire castle. Along the way you grab item boxes, throw slime potions and launch homing ghosts. Drifting charges blue, orange and purple boosts, and the Grand Prix runs from 50cc up to Mirror, where you can win gold trophies. Gamepad support is included.

On desktop, the arrow keys or A and D steer, Up, W or Shift boosts, Down or S brakes, Space drifts, E or Enter uses an item, and P or Esc pauses. On mobile, the kart speeds up on its own. Tap the big arrows to steer, use T for boost, and press the round button on the left to use your item.
code-breaker-deluxe: Step into the shoes of a master codebreaker in this digital take on the classic Mastermind puzzle. Set against a rich wooden backdrop, you must work out a hidden row of four colored pegs drawn from yellow, green, red, white, blue, and pink. Each guess returns black or white markers: black for a peg that is right in both color and position, and white for a right color in the wrong spot. Time is ticking and your attempts are limited, so think carefully before each move.

Solve the code in as few guesses as possible to earn a high score and climb the leaderboards. On desktop, drag pegs from the bottom row into the slots, then click the green check to submit. On mobile, tap to select and place each peg, then tap the check. Hints marked by a lightbulb, a shop, and a restart option
vikings: Vikings is a card game built around growing your collection and taking over new lands, with plenty of adventures to chase. Each hero fights with 8 cards in battle, drawn from four types: Warriors, Berserkers, Hunters, and Shamans. Basic Warriors attack only with swords. Other attack methods unlock as you raise the star count on the map, and chests help you gather those stars. Higher stars also make your attacks hit harder.

A card's level can never exceed your hero's level. Experience banks are needed to level cards up, but they work only on simple cards. Equipping items raises your hero's health, and wearing all six items lifts your hero's rank, adding even more health. Running low on silver? Click the silver from above to use the wheel.
survival-sandbox-for-99-nights: Four children have wandered into a vast forest, and you have 99 nights to find them. The woodland is alive and reshapes itself at every sunset. The kids are scattered across its most dangerous zones, and each one must be led to safety.

Gather weapons, sidestep traps, and find shelter while you fight off wolf packs and rogue bears. Keep an eye on your health and hunger. The Deer guards the forest's secrets and treats the children as its property. Ordinary weapons cannot kill it, so you must drive it away, deceive it, or briefly restrain it. Days are for exploring, gathering, and crafting, while nights bring the hunt and the Deer. On a computer, WASD or the arrow keys move you, space jumps, shift sprints, and I and U use abilities. On a phone, the left joystick moves you, dragging the screen turns the camera, the person-icon button jumps, and the
biryani-cooking-indian-super-chef-food-g: This cooking game lets you prepare biryani, a rice dish that blends traditions from Hyderabad and Mumbai in India with those of Lahore and Karachi in Pakistan. It is widely enjoyed across the Indo-Pak region and often appears at lunchtime and at Indian and Pakistani weddings. The game also covers fried rice, and both dishes are presented as traditional games from the two countries. Chicken biryani was a favorite of the Mughals and remains one of the most eaten meals in Pakistan, India,
find-the-frog-hidden-objects: Search for hidden frogs in black-and-white scenes that range from cozy farms and murky swamps to busy cities, enchanted forests, sunny beaches, and pirate islands, with plenty more places beyond them. Each world has three levels, and each one holds frogs you won't find anywhere else. Gathering every frog fills your album, which gives you a good reason to keep searching until the collection is complete.
Tap a frog with your finger on mobile, or click it with your mouse on PC, to bring its bright colors to life. Find
epic-battle-simulator: This game blends careful planning with nonstop combat on a busy battlefield. You can build up and sharpen your army while aiming for record-breaking levels. Your goal is to wipe out enemy forces before they break into your base, so you'll release powerful units and time each attack with care. Prove who rules the field.

Idle gameplay runs alongside the action, which keeps the experience engaging over long sessions. Construct your defenses, call on mighty heroes, and protect your castle from waves of relentless invaders. Whether your lines hold or the enemy breaks through depends on the choices you make in this immersive battle simulator.
hatch-that-egg-tap-and-crack: This bright, cosy clicker is all about cracking eggs open. Each run is a sprint against a countdown: tap the egg quickly, break its shell, and a tougher egg appears straight away. Every hatch rewards you with shell and gems, and the number of eggs you open in one run becomes your score. Between runs, spend your earnings in an egg-shaped skill tree with five branches (Tap, Nest, Luck, Crack and Egg). It unlocks powers such as Gold Strike, Lightning, Hot Streak, Lucky Block and Gold Magnet. Pets hatch from portals to peck for you, and a collection of hammers changes how each hit looks and bursts.

Finish all 30 campaign eggs to open NEW GAME +, which adds endless eggs in 60 fresh designs, the Armory where hits on the anvil sharpen your hammer, and Rebirth for a lasting bonus. Play with mouse or touch, and press Esc or the pause button to pause. Then see how your best egg ranks on the leaderboard.
crazy-aunty-slap-and-punch: Crazy Aunty is a 3D hypercasual game built around blowing off steam after a rough day. You find yourself at a chaotic family get-together, where an overbearing aunt keeps nagging you about your love life, your diet, and the potential you supposedly keep wasting. Instead of sitting through the lecture, you fight back. Throw punches, kicks, and slaps, smash things apart, hurl eggs and tomatoes, splash water balloons, shoot paintballs, or launch flying chappals. Unlock power-ups and costumes along the way.

Controls are kept simple. A single tap throws a punch, so anyone can start playing right away, though mastering it takes a bit more practice. Smooth controls keep the action quick. Whether you want to unwind after work or just enjoy a light, silly game, this one offers a stress-busting break.
toolbox-sort: Toolbox Sort has you sort workshop parts, merge them into golden tools, and build machines. Matching pieces snap together into one bigger tool. Each win earns stars toward a Robot, a Go-Kart, a Rocket, and more, and finished machines keep producing coins while you're away.

Tap a tray to lift its top parts, then tap another tray to drop them there. Parts can only go onto an empty space or onto the same kind of part, and long tools need more room. Fill every tray with a single kind of tool to clear a level, and finish in fewer moves for three stars. Chests, a card album, a Daily Puzzle, Rival Duels leagues, and challenge codes that let a friend chase your score on the same boards round out the fun. Controls work with mouse or touch.
number-sums: Number Sums is a math puzzle designed to sharpen mental arithmetic. Your aim is to make the totals of every row, column, and colored zone match the figures printed along the board's edges and inside each zone. Each puzzle has just one answer, so all the lines must agree at the same time.

Circle the digits that belong to the answer and cross out the ones that do not, switching between the two actions with the toggle. Boards range from small 3x3 grids up to 10x10, with puzzles of varied difficulty. Regular practice with adding numbers can build your arithmetic and logic skills, and the game suits adults who enjoy number puzzles.
jelly-links: Jelly Links is a puzzle game built on Sudoku logic with a twist. Each row, column, and connected line needs every value from 1 to N, with no repeats. Beads joined by a line form a group of their own. There are no timers and no lives, so you can take your time.

Three modes are available. Tutorial offers three short boards that teach the line rule. Normal has 1000 stages, growing from 4x4 to 12x12, with fewer clues as you progress. Sandbox provides 500 open boards with a single clue and no guidance. Tap a bead to cycle its number. Only beads with a gold ring can be changed; the rest are fixed. Pinch to zoom on larger boards, or use the mouse wheel over an empty area on desktop. HINT fills in one bead, and RESET clears your entries but keeps the clues.
screw-master-3d-pin-puzzle: Screw Master 3D: Pin Puzzle is a single-player logic game set in a three-dimensional world. You work through puzzles by turning screws and gathering mechanical parts. Each level presents its own challenge, so you must pick the right pieces carefully and quickly. The controls are simple, and the game suits both kids and adults who want some brain training.

On a computer, you press a chosen color with the left mouse button and can move closer to the wheel. To turn the model, press and drag toward the sides. On a smartphone, press your finger on a screw to take it, then slide to the sides to rotate the model. As you advance, you grow more skilled at handling the screws.
voxel-playground-ragdoll-noob: Voxel Playground: Ragdoll Noob is a chaotic sandbox built around blocky, pixel-style worlds. You can set off big blasts, then toss the ragdoll character around, lift it high and send it flying, and watch its body bend into silly shapes. Buildings crumble, and the surroundings respond to whatever you do.

Saws slice through objects, dynamite goes off, and one reaction sets off the next. The colorful voxel visuals make every collapse look dramatic, while detailed physics keep each experiment believable and entertaining. To move the character or objects, hold the left mouse button or keep a finger pressed on your phone screen, then drag. Throw the character into obstacles or blow it up until it breaks into pieces to clear the level.
this-is-blast: This is Blast is a free puzzle game built around blasting colorful balls into a board full of targets. It blends bright layouts with chain reactions and ball-blast mechanics. The game is simple to pick up, yet it offers plenty of depth. Whether you have a few spare minutes or a long evening, the intuitive controls and smooth visuals keep things easy to enjoy.

Aim by dragging or adjusting your direction, then release the balls toward the puzzle area and try to hit the right blocks, balls, or targets. Matching and merging similar items creates larger blasts that clear more space, and one shot can set off several blasts at once. Each level's goal is to clear the required targets. If a stage becomes tough, boosters or power-ups can help you clear difficult sections. Later levels reward careful strategy, good timing, and smart aiming.
anime-girl-high-school-simulator: Step into the role of an anime high school girl in this 3D simulator set in a cherry-blossom campus. Attend lessons, chat with classmates, and finish school missions. Join sports day events, handle surprise quizzes, and visit the cafeteria or library. Some school activities are demanding. Customize your schoolgirl with different outfits, hairstyles, and hair colors.

Anime-style love-story missions with your classmates let you develop a crush and share memorable moments with friends. For a change of pace, drive a sports car and explore areas beyond the school. Controls are simple: WASD moves your character, the mouse moves the camera, Shift sprints, and F performs actions. P pauses, N skips a level, I shows the controls, and Ctrl opens settings. On mobile, use the joystick to move.
core-rush: Guide your rover through 48 rooms in this 3D sliding puzzler. Your goal in each room is to gather every core and reach the exit. Along the way you can smash crates, set off chain reactions, open gates, and master the portals. Mapping out efficient paths earns you three stars, and you can also find relics and unlock new looks for your rover. Hints are free, and undo lets you give any attempt another go.

On desktop, move with WASD or the arrow keys, drag with the mouse, or press the direction buttons. Press Z to undo, R to restart, and Esc to pause or resume. On mobile, swipe or tap the direction buttons to slide, tap UNDO to reverse a move, or tap HINT for help. Remember that your rover keeps sliding until something blocks it.
baby-supermarket: Set in the largest grocery store in town, this game follows Baby Panda and Mommy Panda on their shopping trip for the day. You can team up with friends and family and guide your favorite panda through an animal-run supermarket. The game is listed under Girls and carries tags for kids, family, fun, makeovers, and education.

Controls are simple: use your mouse or tap the screen to play. Whether you go shopping alone or with loved ones, the focus stays on the panda family's errands and the fun of exploring a busy store together.
zombie-apocalypse-now-survival: Zombie Apocalypse Now Survival is a free 3D shooter where you play as a terminator holding back a flood of the undead. Stay alert, aim carefully, and keep firing as the walking dead close in. Success depends on planning and steady aim, because these creatures keep coming until they are wiped out. Don't try to chase them. Take them down as soon as they appear.

Pick the guns you like and upgrade them, since higher levels mean shorter reload times. Your goals include destroying the enemy base and taking out zombie supervisors in special missions. Deadly weapons improve your chances of razing the base. Controls: WASD moves your character, the mouse aims and shoots, Space jumps, Q applies camos, E opens attachments, and Tab opens the menu, which also lets you change guns.
4-color-card-game: Four Color Card Game is a quick card game that is simple to pick up, so players of any age can jump right in. Everyone races to get rid of their cards first by pairing them up by color or number. Action cards can suddenly change how the game flows, so no round plays out the same way twice. You can sit down with friends or family, or take on opponents online for short, lively matches.

On a desktop, you only need your mouse. Your hand sits along the bottom of the screen. To play a card, move over a matching one and left-click it to place it on the discard pile. If nothing matches, click the draw pile to take a new card. Wild cards are played with a click, and then you click the color you want. When you have one card left, press the TAP button to avoid a penalty. Your turn ends automatically after each action.
color-sorting-rooms: Color Sorting: Rooms is a calm puzzle game about pouring colorful liquids into the right flasks. Each stage tests your logic and your eye for detail, and the challenge grows as new colors and layouts appear. It is simple to pick up, yet it becomes more absorbing the further you go. Complete color-based quests across many levels to earn rewards, then spend them on unique rooms that you can decorate.

To play, tap a flask to lift its top color, then tap another flask to pour. Liquid can only go onto a matching color or into an empty flask, and the goal is to leave every flask holding just one shade. Space is limited, so think a few moves ahead. When you get stuck, bonuses can add an extra flask, undo a move, or remove a color. You can also personalize the look with flask skins and visual styles, and the gameplay stays smooth and relaxing throughout.
world-destroyer: Set on a toy-like city viewed from an isometric angle, World Destroyer gives you a short countdown and a small kit of destructive tools. The real skill is triggering chain reactions: a blast at a fuel tank rolls its explosion into the next block, and the one after that.

Each city comes with its own briefing and defenses to eliminate first. Three stars are available per city, so a level you barely scraped through invites a cleaner replay. Ten cities unlock one by one, and new tools appear as you advance. Choose a tool from the bottom bar, then tap or click the spot you want to hit. Strike fuel tanks and anti-aircraft guns early, and clear enough of the city before time runs out to earn stars and open the next.
chime-blast: Chime Blast mixes classic match-3 puzzling with a musical theme. You sail across ten islands of the Melody Isles alongside Daming the donkey and his friends. The game offers 100 hand-crafted stages, and each one sets a goal while limiting how many moves you can make.

screw-and-pin-puzzle-levels: Screw & Pin: Puzzle Levels tests your reasoning in a pin-pulling challenge. chess-online-playing: Chess Online Playing is a free chess game for both casual players and experienced pros. The classic rules stay the same, now in a sleek, modern style. word-finder: Word Finder is a new word search puzzle game with a shape-shifting twist. It's designed to help you relax, give your brain a workout, and build your vocabulary. pregnant-mother-simulator: Pregnant Mother Simulator lets you experience the full course of a pregnancy in an anime-style game. Keeping both mother and child in good shape is central to the gameplay, so you track their health and well-being. Brisk walks and other exercises made for expectant mothers are part of the routine. Controls are smooth and easy to learn, using touch and swipe on a mobile device or the left mouse button on a PC. After the birth, the game continues with the mother handling her daily activities.
word-cross: Word Cross is a calm puzzle game that helps you unwind while growing your word knowledge. It blends the familiar crossword format with a fresh spin, and it suits players of every age. cozy-coloring: Cozy Coloring is a color-by-number game built around gentle, unhurried creativity. Pick a picture from the collection, then choose a shade from the palette. epic-sword-battle-fight-in-the-ragdoll-a: Step into a 3D sword fight where knights and gladiators clash in a gaming arena. face-breaker: In Face Breaker, quick reflexes get a real workout inside an arcade-style puzzle. You slide a paddle to keep a playful square-faced ball in motion, smashing blocks as it goes. The game spans 45 levels, and each one grows harder than the one before it.

bubble-pop-fairyland: Bubble Pop Fairyland is a bubble shooter where you aim and fire colorful bubbles from blasters to clear the board and collect coins. Expect hours of enjoyment as you line up and match bubbles of the same shade, with thousands of distinct levels to work through.

To play, move your mouse or swipe on a phone to point the shooter where you want. Click or tap to launch a bubble. Whenever it strikes a cluster of three or more bubbles sharing a color, that group bursts and vanishes from the screen.
1-speed-escape-prison: Break out of a jail cell in this obby, where +1 Speed boosts keep you moving faster as you go. club-guard: Club Guard casts you as a nightclub bouncer. fiva-26-soccer: Fiva 26: Soccer is a quick arcade-style football title that runs right in your web browser. Pick a nation, build your squad and face rival teams in short matches. Touch or keyboard controls let you sprint, pass and shoot from the first minute.

ragdoll-racing-extreme-downhill: Take charge of a ragdoll stickman as he tears down steep slopes and tight bends in this arcade racer. Your goal is to reach the finish line before every rival, and quick reactions help you stay upright. Push too fast and you may tumble, so timing matters.

cat-clicker: Cat Clicker is a clicker game built around an endless supply of cute cats. Each tap you make produces a new cat bubble, and the more you gather, the more your little feline universe grows. The pace is fast, so progress comes quickly. Its charm is easy to enjoy, and every session feels light and cheerful. If you like clicker adventures, this one offers a sweet, bright take on the genre.
word-solitaire: Word Solitaire swaps the usual playing cards for word cards and category cards. You match words by their meaning and look for hidden connections between them. Play follows the rhythm of classic solitaire. You draw one card at a time from the deck and decide where to place it. To build a category stack, put the category card down first, then add all the related word cards until the set is complete. Every level tests how well you can spot word associations and plan where each card belongs.
fashion-princess-dress-up-for-girls: Fashion Princess - Dress Up for Girls is a free game all about fashion and style. It is offered in Russian and suits girls of every age. realistic-car-crash-king: Step into a crash-test game where every hit, roll, and fast impact leads to serious wreckage. truck-slam: Truck Slam is an arcade game about truck battles in arenas, where physics and destruction shape every crash. obby-mini-games-vs-1000: Compete against 1,000 players in this Squid Game-inspired obby, where the goal is to outlast everyone and claim the grand prize. Only the strongest players last. jewel-coloring: Jewel Coloring is a puzzle game where gems fill the board to form bright mosaics. Each gem belongs in a cell of its matching color. Select a gem, then choose where it should go. word-associations-solitaire: Word Associations Solitaire is a relaxing card puzzle that blends classic solitaire mechanics with word associations. Furnish waiting halls and other spaces to make your station more inviting. Daily and regular tasks offer rewards that help you grow your train collection. As the station develops, more platforms, destinations, and trains become available to unlock. Plan your routes carefully so each visitor brings in as much profit as possible, and spend technology points on different parts of the station to strengthen it.
burger-restaurant-simulator-3d: Build a burger restaurant from scratch in this 3D simulation. Take orders and cook in a realistic kitchen, preparing burgers, fries, nuggets, drinks and coffee. Spend your earnings on better equipment, new chefs, trained staff and a restaurant design that is all your own. Later, discover milkshakes, desserts and snacks.

Handle your finances and hire employees while growing into a network with car-service branches. You can also launch a trendy cafe or a food truck. On desktop, WASD moves, E interacts and the mouse rotates the camera. M opens the shop, J shows daily tasks, H claims the daily reward, P pauses, and Tab shows or hides the cursor. Happy customers bring tips and reputation.
let-s-kill-jeff-the-killer-jeff-s-reveng: This three-dimensional action game from 2020, Let's Kill Jeff The Killer - Jeff's Revenge, lets you choose between two roles. As a soldier, you lead a battlegroup into a deserted town where a rumored killer may be hiding. Your task is to track down 8 Rusty Knifes and then go after him. Playing as Jeff, you are the one being hunted. You must fight off the incoming soldiers and gather 8 hearts, which open a gate to the Mystic dimension so you can escape.
Movement uses W, A, S and D, and the mouse lets you look around. Left-click fires, right-click aims, and the mouse wheel switches weapons. Press G for grenades, R to re
draw-action: Draw Action lets you clear foes by sketching lines with your mouse. It suits anyone who wants to unwind and blow off some steam. The shape you draw decides which attack your fighter performs, so you have several moves to pick from. Enemies launch a desperate counterattack, and your challenge is to win every fight without taking damage.

Each level is cleared once all of its enemies are defeated. You can wear an opponent down until its health reaches zero, or push it out of the area so it falls into the water. To strike, tap the arm or leg of the blue character, then draw your pattern. Plan your hits carefully, since foes grow tougher, quicker, and more numerous as you advance. Improving your fighter's stats is worthwhile, and deadlier combo attacks unlock over time.
master-of-riding-a-pet: Hop onto a pet and explore a colorful 3D open world. Search meadows, forests, deserts, snowy peaks, a waterfall cave, and a volcano for hidden eggs, then hurry them back before they crack. Faster pets can reach rarer eggs. Eggs hatch in the nests, which you can trigger with E or by tapping Hatch.

Collect 30 rideable pets, from a tiny snail to a mighty dragon. Feed and age them, grow your ranch, and survive lightning storms that mutate your animals. Earn cash by placing pets on your ranch, then spend it on radars, upgrades, food, and rebirths for bigger rewards. Move with WASD, the arrow keys, or a joystick on mobile, drag to look around, press R or the Ride button to mount, and use Space to jump or fly.
scary-rooms-idle-horror: You run a horror-themed venue where visitors arrive hoping for a fright. Grow the business by upgrading spooky rooms, adding creepy decorations and equipment, and hiring actors and staff. Your goal is to scare as many guests as possible and make each visit memorable. Keep rooms clean and repaired, watch the reviews, and your earnings will climb.

Along the way you will find unusual panic room setups, a large pool of performers, and tools for decorating, cleaning, repairing, and rescuing frightened guests. Hire assistants, serve customers for profit, and clean rooms on time to keep satisfaction high. On PC, move with WASD, the arrow keys, or hold the left mouse button and drag. On mobile, press a finger on the screen and drag it in the direction you want. Walk close to a guest and your hero selects them automatically.
nitro-kick: Nitro Kick mixes soccer with driving, so your car is the player and a huge ball is the target. Launch into the air, fly around the field, and slam the ball toward the rival net. You can take on bots in 1v1, 2v2, or 3v3 matches, and the bots come in three difficulty levels. Racing along the arena walls and bumping opponents are both part of the fun.

Between matches, head to the garage to personalize your car with new paint, wheels, boost trails, and goal explosion effects. Gaining levels moves you up the ranking ladder, starting at Bronze and reaching Nitro. Each match lasts 6 minutes; the team with more goals wins, and if the score is tied the next goal decides it. On keyboard, use W, A, S, and D to drive, Space to jump (tap twice to dodge), Shift to boost, C to switch the ball camera, and Esc to pause. On mobile, use the joystick plus the JUMP, BOOST, and BALL buttons, and gamepads are supported too.
jump-to-the-rhythm-of-songs-musical-ball: This arcade rhythm game asks you to guide a ball across tiles so that each jump lands on the beat of the song. Every level takes you to the end of a music track, and the playlist features popular hits and trends from 2025. The game draws on well-known rhythm hopping titles and presents bright, three-dimensional visuals.

Controls are simple. On a phone, slide your finger left or right to move the ball. On a computer, hold the left mouse button and move the mouse. Complete as many levels as you can to earn points and unlock new tracks. You can play online for free on mobile or PC, and a leaderboard lets you compete with friends and climb to the top.
park-perfect-car-simulator: Parking tight spots is harder than it looks, and this 3D game tests that with realistic car physics. You steer through narrow lanes lined with cones, take sharp bends, and crawl over speed bumps before easing into the yellow space between parked cars. Stop inside the slot and hold still to clear the level. A single touch on a cone, barrier, or parked car ends the attempt.

On a keyboard, W or the up arrow drives forward, S or the down arrow reverses, and A and D or the arrows steer. Space applies the brake, C switches between a view behind the car and a top-down view, R restarts, and Esc pauses. On mobile, choose a steering wheel or arrow controls in Settings on the left, then use the GAS, BRAKE, and REVERSE buttons.
super-cute-cat: You take the role of an appealing cat making its way through risky stages overrun by mutated felines. Success depends on careful steering, and along the way you can gather candies that grant special abilities. You also need to locate keys to move forward through the levels.

The game has a retro pixel-art style that will bring back fond memories for many players. Challenges grow tougher as you advance, so you must outmaneuver foes and stay alive through agility and quick reflexes.
jigsaw-puzzles: Jigsaw Puzzles offers more than 13,000 free, high-definition pictures to assemble on mobile. There are no points to chase and no extras, and no pieces go missing, so you can build images at your own pace and unwind. The game also gives your short-term memory and concentration a workout. It takes up far less space than a physical puzzle, and millions of puzzle fans around the world already play it.

Begin by choosing a game mode and your favorite category, then set how many pieces your picture will have. You can also switch on rotating pieces, which is recommended because it makes play more enjoyable. Drag each piece onto the board and place it where it belongs. If a piece won't fit, tap it and rotate it until it does.
ultimate-horse-simulator: You play as a wild Arabian horse in a savanna jungle, finding a mate and raising a family in the wilderness. Keep your young ones fed and safe while you search for food and water, and shield your family from lions, tigers, wolves, and bears. Finish survival and fighting missions using special attack powers and energy ball strikes, then collect coins to unlock new horses and upgrades.

Explore the forest, find secure places for your herd, and work toward becoming the strongest horse in the jungle. Expect detailed 3D surroundings and realistic animal sounds. On desktop, Shift sprints, E attacks, V and X trigger special attacks, F performs actions, and N skips a level. P pauses, Ctrl opens settings, and I shows info. On mobile, drag the on-screen joystick in any direction to move.
bs-simulator: Open Brawl Boxes to find new fighters, coins, and gems, then power up your roster and add skins to your collection. Climb the Trophy Road by earning trophies, which move you into new leagues and unlock rewards along the way. The Brawl Pass offers more than 140 prizes, and finishing daily quests gives you the tokens needed to progress through it.

Check in every day to claim bonus rewards, and keep an eye on the shop, where special deals refresh several times a week. Go head to head with players from around the globe on the leaderboards. Personalize your profile with an icon, a name, and a name color, and if you own a Brawl Pass you can use a gradient. Mini-games offer another way to earn good rewards.
blackriver-mystery-hidden-objects: You take on the role of a mystical detective, chosen to bring a ruined town back to life and uncover the secrets of its past. Along the way you tackle engaging quests, collect unique sets of objects, and try mini-games such as three-in-a-row and the wheel of fortune. The riddle of Black River is yours to solve.

Your tasks include rebuilding the city, hunting for objects across beautiful locations, and following a gripping storyline. Expect monsters, puzzles, and strange anomalies, and search for items the way a real investigator would. Explore each area, track down the trickiest finds, and use boosters during three-in-a-row. The fate of the whole city rests in your hands. To finish, complete every quest, mini-game, and part of the plot. Controls: left mouse button on PC, touch on mobile.
magic-action-gun-game: Magic Action Gun Game drops you into a world built around action and firearms. It blends a run-and-shoot format with weapon crafting and evolution, so you merge gun parts into new firearms as you race through the run. Expect fast, rapid-fire clashes with enemies while you keep moving and shoot your way forward.
Along the way, you clear and shoot obstacles to unlock a range of powerful weapons. Shooting down targets and enemies also tests how accurate your aim is. The only control is a left mouse click.
ragdoll-revenge-throw-at-annoying-people: Ragdoll Revenge lets you take out your frustration on the people who test your patience, like the person who cuts in line, the loud speakerphone caller, the gym bro, and the boss who never stops talking. Each throw takes only a single tap. Across 200 levels you can hurl baseballs, water balloons, tomatoes, and rubber chickens at them, or use a button, rope, or cannon to spring a trap that sends them flying as ragdolls. Some targets dance around just to irritate you.

Some levels include traps, so you may need to hit whatever a target is standing on to set one off. Knock everyone down before the clock runs out to earn three stars, and keep throwing at anyone who dodges. Clearing boss levels unlocks new things to throw. Tap a person to aim, use the item button to switch projectiles, and use the level button to replay any stage you have already opened.
watermelon-game: Start with small fruits and merge matching pairs so they swell into bigger versions. Whenever two identical fruits meet, they fuse into a new, larger kind. Your aim is to keep everything from spilling over the edge of the container as you work upward.

The challenge lies in planning ahead and making room for the top fruit, a huge watermelon. Think about where each piece will land, since one clumsy drop can leave you with no space. Careful stacking lets you squeeze in more fruit without the box overflowing. Plan your moves well, and you might grow that giant melon.
swing-obby-for-brainrots: Swing Obby for Brainrots puts you in an obstacle course where you ride and upgrade your Obby to save the Brainrots. To grab a hook and fly, tap the spacebar. While you are in the air, use W, A, S, and D to steer and control your movement more precisely.

The game is built around swinging from hook to hook, so timing and positioning matter as you move through each stage. Pick it up whenever you want a quick, lighthearted run through the course and a chance to rescue a few Brainrots along the way.
marnyl-silence-the-haters: Silence the haters in MARNYL, a top-down shooter built around music. You play as YBORG, fighting endless waves of haters, critics, and failed musicians. Collect XP to level up as you survive. Over 10 music weapons are in play, including vinyl discs, a microphone, a guitar, drums, a saxophone, and an amp. Boss battles raise the stakes.

Six maps are available: Arena, Studio, Festival, Rooftop, Club, and Concert Hall. More than 30 enemy types and dynamic upgrades keep each run changing. Pick up health, XP magnets, bombs, and freeze. The soundtrack is original YBORG music, the game runs at 60 FPS, and mobile controls are included. Move with WASD or the arrow keys, aim with the mouse, and weapons fire automatically. Survive the chaos and grow into a true musician.
brutal-battle-royale: Brutal Battle Royale is a single-player 3D shooter set on a map where you hunt for weapons. Your aim is to shoot every enemy and come out on top in this battle royale match. It is a fast action game built around shooting, so every weapon you find matters.

Move with the WASD keys and fire with the left mouse button. Scroll the mouse wheel to switch between weapons, and press R to reload. The F key handles use, Space makes you jump, and P pauses the game.
find-part-in-love-story: Find Part in Love Story is a puzzle game built around a romantic adventure. You can play it free in your browser, with nothing to install, and it is available on iOS, Android, and desktop. Its mood blends mystery with humor as a loving couple gets caught up in everyday life's funny troubles, and their bond is put to the
obby-1-click-wall-breaker: Obby: +1 Click Wall Breaker is a kicking simulator where you train your legs and make every strike hit harder. Every tap speeds up your progress, and smashing through powerful barriers opens new worlds and challenges. Gather wins to unlock stronger kicks, find pets with big boosts, and equip auras that multiply your strength. You can also level up your character and rebirth for lasting b
zombie-horde-build-and-survive: Hold your ground in this Halloween-themed survival strategy title, where waves of undead surge toward your base. You fight back by firing a range of weapons at the attackers, while also setting up turrets, barricades, and traps to slow them down and keep them away from your home base.

Moving around works on both platforms. On mobile, drag your finger across the screen and your character will head in that direction. On a computer, use the WASD keys or the arrow keys to move your character around the game area.
pixel-color-quest: Pick any artwork that catches your eye and watch an empty grid turn into a colorful pixel scene. Each cell contains a number, and matching it to the numbered swatch tells you which shade belongs there. Start with straightforward designs or push your focus with large, intricate boards. Themes and difficulty tiers help you find a quick, soothing piece or a demanding creative puzzle.

On a computer, click a picture or swatch with the left mouse button, then click any cell to paint it. On phones and tablets, tap a picture or color to choose it, then tap the cell you want to fill. The job is finished once every section shows its proper color. Take your time, since the pace is calm and nothing rushes you.
bricks-balls-breaker: Bricks Balls Breaker is a brick game that is hard to put down yet genuinely tough. It offers a soothing way to clear your head while you concentrate on smashing blocks. The puzzles get tricky, so you swipe to line up each shot and fire your balls. Crushing as many bricks as you can in one shot earns stars, gems, and power-ups.

Hold a finger on the screen and move it to aim. Look for the best positions and angles so you can hit every brick. A brick is destroyed once its durability drops to zero, but if any brick reaches the bottom, the game ends. There are no time limits, so you can enjoy it at your own pace.
2-player-games-mini-games: Pick a title from the menu and jump straight into tennis, air hockey, tic-tac-toe, curling, billiards, or one of several other quick competitive modes. Everything plays out on one screen, and the on-screen controls are arranged so two people sharing a single device can compete side by side. Solo players can also face a built-in AI opponent to practice before taking on a friend.

Every match is decided by points. After you press start, hit the ball, place your marks, or guide the puck according to the rules of the mode you chose. Whoever has the highest score when the round ends wins. Rounds are short and the rules stay simple, but the difficulty rises as you go, so you can enjoy quick duels or settle into longer sessions. The clean visuals and easy-to-follow mechanics suit players of every skill level.
fall-boys-ultimate-knockout: This 3D action game pits you against other players as you head for the end of the map. Your goal is to be the one who comes out on top. It belongs to the .io games family and is listed under the 1 Player tag, so the focus stays on competing toward that finish line.
The only input you need is a mouse, and the left click is the control that matters. Keep your eyes on the route and your rivals as you go. Victory goes to whoever reaches the end of the map first.
3d-chess-arcane-edition: Step into a mystical, enchanted garden and sit down to chess in a fully three-dimensional setting. The classic strategy game comes alive with copper and gold pieces that were hand-crafted to look the part, and the fairytale mood wraps around every match. Your opponents, known here as spirits, come in three difficulty levels, from relaxed fun to a demanding test of your skill.

Newcomers learning the game and experienced players wanting a quick match will both find something to enjoy. You can also create a private room and share its code so a friend can join and play the other colour. The whole experience is available in 21 languages.
crosswords-big-collection: Crosswords: Big Collection is a traditional word puzzle built for people who enjoy a good mental workout. It offers more than 800 levels, over 30,000 distinct clues, and a new daily crossword each day. Collectible items come with quests and rewards, and the game is available in Russian, English, German, Spanish, French, and Italian. You can pick a soft green or dark brown theme, and the layout works equally well on a computer or a phone.

To begin, choose a level from the list or open the daily crossword. Each clue points to one word in the grid, so type its letters into the empty squares. Words intersect, meaning every answer you fill in gives you clues for the rest. If you get stuck, a hint will reveal a single letter. Your progress is saved automatically, so you can return to unfinished puzzles whenever you like. Each solved word adds points that move you up the leaderboard, where you can compare your standing with players around the world.
squidgame-io: SquidGame.io is a multiplayer game built around the Squid Game theme. Your main task is to collect gems so your character grows, and you can also go after smaller players. Along the way, you can personalize your character with different hats and colors.

Steering is handled entirely with your mouse: move it to guide your character, and click to activate your boost. Since other players share the same game world, you will need to watch who is around you and choose carefully when to grow and when to hunt.
aquapark-surfer-race: Aquapark Surfer Race drops you into sea competitions as a surfer. You ride the swells, get past rival surfers who want the same finish line, and speed through acceleration zones that grant invincibility boosts. The water around you keeps changing, so you need to weave past obstacles while keeping an eye on the clock.
Every race tests how well you handle the waves and how quickly you react. Winning means proving your surfing skill and taking the title of champion.
battlecross: Battlecross places you in a troubled realm where any mentor might teach you something. Blend a knight's shield with a pyromancer's flames, summon royal guards, halt time, or call down a beam from the sky. Face goblins, treants, and demons, and gather weapons and armor until you stand as an army of one. Walk up to an enemy and your hero strikes automatically, while you manage your skills and drink health potions.
Each zone is cleared by defeating every
i-am-monkey: You play as a speedy, clever monkey in a zoo, living in your own enclosure. Jump and dash around, gather assorted items, and put up with pesky guests who keep getting in the way. The wise elephant hands out silly jobs, and finishing them unlocks new abilities. Expect plenty of laughs, fast-moving action, and the busy feel of a real zoo.

On PC, use W, A, S and D to move, Space to leap and climb, and the left mouse button to hit visitors. E picks things up, R drops them, and F throws them. Walk up to the elephant and press to get a task, and steer the camera with your mouse. On mobile, a joystick handles movement, while buttons for jump, attack and interact do the rest. Swipe the screen to adjust the camera angle.
ant-colony-idle: Ant Colony Idle is a relaxing incremental clicker where you grow a small ant nest into a busy underground colony. Tap the dirt to uncover food, then send workers out to gather supplies. Expanding chambers boosts your income over time. Start small, manage your nest wisely, and build the strongest colony you can.

Unlock new food slots and upgrade rooms like Food Storage, Nursery, and Queen Chamber. Powerful upgrades, cosmetic skins, achievements, and prestige bonuses give you plenty to aim for, and progress keeps going even when you step away. On desktop, left-click the soil, buttons, and upgrade cards, use the tabs to open Upgrades, Prestige, Skins, Achievements, and Settings, and scroll lists with the mouse wheel or by dragging. On mobile, tap those same things instead.
crash-test-simulator-3d: Crash Test Simulator 3D is a lifelike take on steering and crashing cars. Every vehicle is different, and parts break off depending on what you hit, with very real part loss. You can see how sturdy your cars really are. Speed matters, since the faster you go, the more gets destroyed. A unique time dilation system adds its own twist.
