Slaps also serve as the game's currency, so each hit brings you closer to stronger gloves that make you more powerful in combat. The game takes its inspiration from Slap Battles.

There are three modes to choose from. Arena is a free-for-all where every player fights everyone else. Ring challenges you to stay on the platform without falling off. In 67, you must reach the far end while avoiding hazardous heads. Every match is full of action and rivalry, and it becomes a contest over who can collect the most slaps.
hospital-doctor: Take on the role of a hectic hospital physician who sees a wide range of patients in situations modeled on real medical work, all presented in a child-friendly way. You will need to keep track of the clock, learn to use different medical instruments, and enjoy eye-catching graphics. Each new level brings harder cases to solve, making this a good pick for young fans who dream of becoming doctors.
obunga-nextbot-spot-difference: Obunga Nextbot Spot Difference is a brain game that mixes challenging puzzles with lively characters. Your job is to study two images and pick out the subtle differences between them. Each level tests your observation skills and your speed. Search carefully but swiftly, because quick and accurate spotting is how you score high.
The game features familiar faces and captivating gameplay, which keeps the searching feeling f
crazy-kick-ball: This 3D football game puts you in control of a ball that you must carry past a line of defenders. Fake out the keeper, then take your shot. Dodge incoming tackles and hunt for the gap in the defense, scoring to beat your previous high score.
Many player skins can be selected, so you can choose the look you like best. Playing is simple: a mouse click or a tap is all it takes to get going. Pick the skin that suits you and show it off
piano-master: Piano Master is a music game in the style of Piano Tiles, so it will feel familiar if you already enjoy that kind of title. Pick the song you want to play, then start the gameplay. Touch every tile at the right moment to play the song.
Missing a single tile ends your run, so timing matters from start to finish. Controls are simple: tap or click. The game is filed under Hypercasual, with the tags Arcade, Casual, Clicker and Music.
bumper-car-demolition-race: Bumper Car Demolition Race brings the fun of arcade bumper car play to your screen. Battles unfold in pixel-style arenas where every collision feels intense. You can pick Arena Mode or Custom Mode, depending on the kind of test you want. Your goal is to ram rival cars until they are knocked out of the ffight.

Along the way, open treasure chests to grab items that breathe fire, boost your damage, or freeze foes. Keep winning and you will work your way toward the championship. Controls are simple: click the mouse or tap the screen to play.
real-car-pro-racing: Race through a modern city in this 3D driving game, where you take the wheel of one of 15 sports cars across 36 race tracks. Strong visuals and convincing vehicle physics make every corner feel real, and road obstacles keep you on your toes. You compete against AI opponents, and each level is tougher than the last.

Buying and developing cars is a core part of the experience. After every race, you can upgrade or customize your machine or buy a new one. When a race gets tricky, hit nitro for a burst of speed and prove you're the top driver. To reach the next level, you must finish in the top three once the race ends. Steer with the arrow keys or WASD, use N for nitro, C to change the camera, and SPACE for the handbrake.
football-rumble: Football Rumble is a quick-moving soccer game where every second on the field calls for fast decisions and clever plays. You guide your squad to a win while the clock keeps ticking, and you need to plan ahead to get past the other team and take control of the match. The controls feel smooth and responsive, so you can focus on your tactics instead of fighting the interface.
The game sits in the Sports category and is tagged under Sports as well. If you enjoy matches that reward sharp thinking as much as quick reflexes, this one puts both skills to the test on the pitch.
snail-odyssey-hardest-game: In Snail Odyssey, you steer a snail through a colorful world packed with traps. A computer rival with a sharp mind stands in your way, so you'll need to find smart ways to get ahead of it. Along the route, you must dodge a variety of obstacles, and every stage calls for good timing and careful planning.

The game is a puzzle adventure, so progress comes from figuring out the right moves rather than simply rushing forward. Each level tests both your timing and your wits. The goal is to complete the full journey and overcome the challenges along the way.
the-elevator-clicker: Mr. D. finds himself in a funny elevator adventure, and you guide him through it in The Elevator Clicker. Your main tool is tapping, so timing and planning each tap matter as you race the clock. Along the way, upgrades sharpen your clicking, helping you push further through the escapade.

This game gives the familiar clicker style a charming new twist. The journey leads to a definitive conclusion, so you get the satisfaction of seeing it through to the end. It is a light, cheerful pick for anyone who enjoys tapping games with a bit of humor.
tap-hunters: Tap Hunters is a bright, colorful clicker about hunting monsters. You begin by tapping or clicking monsters to defeat them, then collect the coins you earn. You can grab a coin by tapping it or passing your mouse over it, and any coins you leave behind gather on their own after a few seconds. Spend your coins on upgrades, or recruit new heroes and improve them as you go.
Collected weapons can be powered up as you play. When you reach zone 50, a portal opens to a new world. Entering it h
super-car-driving-3d-simulator: Super Car Driving 3D Simulator puts you behind the wheel of a sports car, powered by an advanced physics engine that makes every turn feel true to life. It is free, and you can drive, drift, and get a feel for a racing machine across a sprawling open-world city. Traffic and rival racers never force you to slow down, so you can attempt illegal stunts and hold full speed without police cruising after you.
Drifting at high speed and laying down burnouts are a big part of the experience. Tear up the tarmac wherever you like, and use your keyboard to steer, accelerate, and brake as you explore the city.
stickman-gun-rush: In this 3D runner, you dash down colorful tracks while your weapon grows larger. Gather stickmen and gun parts along the way, then combine them into large, hard-hitting guns. Watch out for hazards that shrink your arsenal or sap its strength, and grab cash bundles to fund new upgrades. Swiping left or right is all it takes to steer your character.
Each level brings tougher enemies, bigger rewards, and fresh challenges. Your aim is to reach the finish line with the strongest gun you can build, then defeat the final en
football-io: Football.io is a sports game in the .io style that is easy to pick up and hard to put down. Your goal is to beat three other players and knock them out to claim the win. Matches are fast and competitive, so every move counts.

To play, you can steer with your mouse or use the arrow keys, whichever feels more comfortable. Start with simple moves, then build your strategy as you learn how the other players react. Each round offers a new chance to outplay your rivals and come out on top.
defend-military-base: Defend Military Base puts you in charge of stopping enemy tanks before they can get through your lines. You tap the screen to control your shots, so accuracy matters as you fire off long chains of balls and trigger helpful bonuses. Because each shot can change how the fight goes, you need to plan ahead to keep your base safe.

The game is built around careful thinking as much as quick reflexes. Every move you make counts, and strategy is what keeps your defenses standing. If you enjoy war-themed games where precise aiming and smart choices decide the outcome, this one offers a focused challenge.
call-of-modern-world-war: Call of Modern World War is a 3D first-person shooter that puts you in charge of the fight. You rely on surprise and powerful guns as you move quietly through the map and get around much larger enemy numbers. Think on your feet, plan each move, and shoot with accuracy to finish your missions and win the battle.

The game is built around stealth, quick decisions, and careful timing. Each mission asks you to stay one step ahead of your opponents and hit your targets cleanly. Keep your wits about you, adapt to whatever comes next, and push through to victory.
obby-1-jump-per-click: In this arcade obby, every click adds to your jump power, so you build strength for leaping across huge gaps. Your main goal is to climb as high as possible and become the king of the obby. Parkour courses bring moving platforms, traps, and puzzles to solve along the way. Upgrades boost jump strength, jump height, and flight speed, while pets raise your jump power and grant special abilities. Rebirthing multiplies your jumping power, and the visuals follow a blocky sandbox style.
On a computer, use WASD to move and the Space bar to jump. On mobile, drag the joystick to move, tap the jump button in the lower right corner, and swipe the screen to rotate the camera.
guns-n-glory-zombies: Guns'n'Glory Zombies puts you in charge of a daring team of four women who are fighting back against a zombie outbreak. You place your squad carefully across the map, improve their equipment as you go, and hold off waves of attackers that keep coming. Each character can use a range of weapons and plans, so you will need to mix things up to keep the city safe.

This is a defense game built around tense, nonstop action. Your job is to hold your position, push back the undead, and slowly change the course of the fight. Every choice you make about placement, gear, and tactics can decide whether the city survives the night.
deep-in-the-lab-chapter-1: Step into this two-dimensional horror game, which takes its look and feel from the 1990s. Scenes appear against old-fashioned backdrops made in advance, and you'll need to solve puzzles, track down keys, and get by with scarce supplies. A monster lurks in the lab, and you decide whether to avoid it or defeat it. Expect sudden jump scares along the way.

Saving your progress is limited, so each choice carries weight. Full-motion video sequences help tell the story. The lab spans five floors waiting to be explored, and you can play solo. The controls are explained inside the game itself, so you can learn them as you go.
poppytile: Set off on a trip through the village of PoppyTile, where puzzles blend match-3 and mahjong styles. Along the way, the charming girl Poppy stays by your side throughout your journey. Your job is to match three identical tiles to slowly clear the board, which frees the tiles beneath them. Each map stage brings harder levels, so you can keep moving further ahead.

When a level gets tough, boosters can help you finish it quickly and comfortably. The classic set includes one that adds an extra slot, one that cancels your last action, one that mixes the tiles on the board, and one called an idea. To play, tap or click three matching tiles to select them. Clear the whole board to complete a level, and see how far you can get.
zombie-reform: Zombie Reform is a 3D survival shooter where you fight off waves of undead. Each level brings tougher zombies than the one before, so you need to keep adapting as you progress. The game has six different maps, and you move to a new one every 12 levels. Before each level change, you face a "FULL BOSS" battle. The zombies in this game are extremely powerful, and you must defeat them to unlock the next map.

Move with W, A, S and D, and aim and fire with the left mouse button. Right-click switches the camera view, while U brings out the bazooka and R reloads. Press C to crouch, and use keys 1, 2 and 3 to swap between weapons.
space-war-symphony: Space War Symphony is an arcade shooter built around music, so your spaceship moves in step with the rhythm. You steer side to side by sliding the mouse, and a left-click launches shots. Hold the button down and firing continues automatically. Landing shots on the beat gives extra damage, more points, and wider spread patterns, and it also builds up combos.
Enemies arrive in waves and change as your score climbs. Bosses step onto the stage with their own bullet patterns and health bars that glow. You must dod
hill-racing: Hill Racing sends you across rough ground, where every uphill stretch calls for focus and steady balance. The controls are simple to learn, so you can concentrate on guiding your vehicle over bumpy slopes. Along the way, collect coins and spend them to upgrade your ride.

The course keeps changing, with a variety of scenery and unusual obstacles to get past. Physics drive every run, so momentum and tilt matter as much as speed. Each race tests how well you handle the terrain beneath your wheels.
tiny-chick: Tiny Chick puts you in charge of young chicks eager to hop over hurdles. The game has a blocky, voxel-style look and runs as an endless runner. Your job is to judge when to jump, since these chicks cannot fly and must spring up into the air to clear each obstacle. Time your launches well and steer through the openings between obstacles to rack up points.

Chasing better scores is the main draw, and every attempt gives you a fresh shot at beating your previous best. You can also change how your chick looks to make it your own. Small gains add up over time, so you can enjoy watching your progress build slowly.
line-of-defense: Line of Defense: Tanks asks you to rely on fast reactions as it mixes shooting with puzzle play. Enemy tanks roll in, and you must fire shells that match their colors, because a mismatch ends the round immediately. If the field gets crowded, you can set off chaotic purple bombs that sweep the battlefield clear. The game keeps the action moving quickly, so every choice counts toward holding your position.
sorting-nuts-and-bolts-by-color-home-rep: Sorting Nuts and Bolts is a free puzzle game where you arrange colorful nuts onto bolts to form neat color chains. With over 15,000 levels and no time limit, you can work at a relaxed pace. Click a bolt to pick up a nut, then click another bolt to move it there. Each bolt holds only so many nuts, so plan your moves carefully. Some nut colors stay hidden beneath question marks until you uncover them.
Three tools help when you get stuck: extra bolts, undo, and restart. Finishing levels earns rewards that go toward building your dream home. Soothing ASMR-inspired sounds and haptic
gloom-gargoyle: Gloom: Gargoyle is a one-player adventure seen from a third-person view. It serves as the first act of the larger Gloom story and takes place across three separate areas. Your journey relies on three special auras. The fiery aura draws energy from your mana pool and lights up the surroundings, while the time aura quickens the flow of game time so you can travel more swiftly. The magic aura trades your life force for a refill of your mana reserves.

To advance, you must explore two magical dungeons and recover the divine artifacts you find there. The controls are simple: use W, A, S and D to move, hold Shift to walk, press Space to jump, and click the left mouse button to act. Switch between the three auras with keys 1, 2 and 3.
thief-puzzle: Thief Puzzle asks you to test your wits, since every level calls for clever planning. You move through carefully built settings and use swipe gestures to reach the goal. Your task is to get past complicated security setups and slip away the way a skilled burglar would. Accuracy and fast decisions will help you most as you work through this puzzle adventure.

Each stage gets trickier, so you will need to think a few moves ahead. Patience pays off when you study the layout before acting. Whether you enjoy logic games or simply like a good sneaky challenge, this title offers a steady flow of problems to solve.
mineguy-unblockable: MineGuy: Unblockable is a quick first-person shooter set in a world inspired by Minecraft. You battle computer-controlled mercenaries and zombies in intense fights, and the pace stays fast the whole time, so you have to keep moving.

Mouse 1 fires and Mouse 2 aims, with a separate block action also available. Use W, A, S and D to walk, hold Left Shift to sprint, and press Space to jump. Left Ctrl crouches and X drops you prone. F uses an item, R reloads, and H holsters your weapon. G throws a grenade, V performs a melee attack, and T activates slow motion.
mosquito-bite-3d: Mosquito Bite 3D lets you take on the role of a mosquito, flying through a variety of environments to track down your target. Your aim is to find the perfect moment to sneak up on her and bite. Depending on the task, you might go for a person's head or their legs. Watch out, though, because your target can swat at you at any time.
The game sits in the puzzles category and is tagged with fly, fun and simulator. To play, you just click the mouse or tap the screen.
the-space-mover: The Space Mover is a puzzle game built around brain-teasing challenges. You guide a resourceful robot through levels that feel like outer space, using a magnetic force to push and pull boxes. Each mission asks you to set a target block in its correct place, so careful planning and sharp logic are essential. Timing matters too, which makes this a strategy-driven adventure.

On PC, move with W, A, S and D, jump with the Space bar, and press E to interact. On mobile, tap the on-screen Operate button. The game is listed under Puzzles and carries the tags Casual, Logical, Robot and Space.
one2one: In One2One, you tap the squares of a grid in order, either counting up through numbers or running through letters, and try to finish as quickly as you can. Choose a grid size and whether you want numbers or letters, then start the timer and begin tapping. Correct taps turn green and lock in place, while wrong ones flash red. The clock stops on the last tile and shows your completion time.

Each run gives you a chance to beat your own best record. The game is designed to train focus, visual perception, and cognitive agility, so it works as a brain exercise. Regular practice may help sharpen your speed and concentration. Play with a mouse click or a tap.
mr-shooter: Mr Shooter stars a desert plant with a knack for bursting balloons, and his mission is to clear every balloon in the world. Winning is straightforward: burst them all. As you move forward, you can unlock fresh, powerful cards and pick the ones you want to use. With hundreds of inventive, varied levels, there is plenty here to hold your attention for hours.
Controls are simple: tap anywhere on the screen and
flip-master: Flip Master is a sports title built around acrobatics and parkour. You pull off impressive stunts and wild somersaults while getting past tough obstacles. Once you are airborne, you steer your character and refine your jump timing so you can touch down cleanly. As you go, you can improve your abilities and visit different settings.

The game is played with a mouse click or a tap on your screen. Its tags include jumping, levels, obstacles, stunts, and mobile play, so it suits both quick sessions and longer runs. Aim to master extreme flips one landing at a time.
steal-and-catch-obby-mini-games: Step into this arcade title, which takes its cues from Roblox-style play and offers several modes. Each one revolves around earning money, upgrading your base, and planning your next move. You buy creatures of different value, carry them back to your own territory, and collect passive income over time. The rarer and pricier a creature is, the bigger your profits and the faster your base develops.

On a PC, WASD moves your character, Shift lets you run, and Space makes you jump. Press Q to punch, use keys 1 through 5 to choose a weapon, and tap Tab to show or hide the cursor. On mobile devices, touch and swipe gestures handle both movement and control of your character.
pop-us: Pop Us turns bubble popping into a game you can play on your own, in the same spirit as the fidget toy clips people share online. Your job is to build a toy of your own design, pop bubbles as you go, and take a moment to relax. You can browse a wide range of colors and shapes to customize your creation.

Along the way, you will merge parts together and work through puzzles that take some thought. The goal is to pop every bubble, and once you do, a new toy is revealed. Playing is easy, since you only need to use your mouse or tap the screen.
get-10-ultimate: Counting up to ten was once a real hurdle for young learners, but this game turns that idea on its head. Here, reaching 10 and beyond is where the real struggle begins. The game is pleasant to look at and enjoyable to play, and its number puzzles span a variety of levels, each one offering a fresh experience.

Your aim is to build the highest number you can by matching neighbouring numbers that share the same colour. The difficulty rises each time you create a new number, so every step up asks a little more of you. Action, logic and matching all play a part, making it a mix of quick reactions and careful thinking.
airport-clash-3d: You take charge of the Bloodhounds, a raider gang with a mission to seize an abandoned airport from the rival Vipers. Your main weapon is a heavy military minigun, and it delivers plenty of punishing firepower. For the final blow, you can wipe out the enemy goons by blasting their base with a large bomb.

Movement uses the WASD keys, while SPACE makes you jump and C lets you crouch. Hold the right mouse button to zoom in, and press TAB to open the score table. It is a 3D multiplayer shooter, so you face other players online as you fight for control of the airport.
attack-and-dash: Slice through short arenas as a nimble stickman ninja armed with a blade. You pick a heading and launch a rapid dash that sends your fighter straight at foes. Each stage is brief but calls for careful thinking and quick reflexes. Plan your route, dodge hazards, and chain the right strikes so that no opponent stays standing.

Controls stay simple. On desktop, hold the left mouse button, aim, and release to dash. On a phone or tablet, swipe across the screen in your chosen direction. Study enemy and obstacle positions before each move, because one wrong direction can leave the hero exposed. Every level demands defeating all opponents and reaching the end, rewarding agility and precision.
truck-simulation: Truck Simulation lets you live the everyday routine of a professional trucker. You begin behind the wheel of an aging, modest truck and work your way toward owning a large trucking company of your own. The game is built around long-haul trips, with realistic handling and a large open world packed with tasks and chances to get ahead.

Steer with W, A, S and D, and use the mouse to look around. Space pulls the handbrake, while C switches the camera view. Press H to sound the horn, T to shift up a gear, and G to shift down. Hit Esc whenever you want to pause.
swipe-swoosh: In this quick basketball title, every throw counts. You line up your shot, decide how hard to push, and try to drop the ball through the net. Levels get tougher as you go, and some hoops move, so timing and precision both matter. Power-ups help when a stage gets tough.

Daily challenges and achievements add extra goals. Progress raises your rank and unlocks a range of unusual basketballs. On a computer, click and drag from the ball to aim and set your power, then let go to shoot, and use left click to pick buttons and power-ups. On mobile, swipe from the ball, release to shoot, and tap to select options and activate power-ups. Keep an eye on your remaining attempts so you don't run out.
igi-commando-mission-cover-the-fire: You play as a lone commando moving through a range of missions in this first-person shooter. Strategy plays a big role, so you need to plan each mission carefully. Stealth and precise shots help you overcome enemy forces, and choosing the right loadout before you head out can make a real difference to how things go.

The action unfolds across dynamic 3D environments where you must move with tactical agility. Quick reflexes come in handy when enemies show up. The game combines careful planning with fast, hands-on action.
moto-x3m-winter: This winter special of the bike stunt series, Moto X3M 4: Winter, puts you in control of a two-wheeler. Your job is to guide it across demanding courses packed with deadly traps, jumps, explosive charges and other hazards, and reach the finish line in one piece. The faster you clear each stage, the more stars you collect, and those stars can be spent to unlock new ri
jigsaw-collections: Jigsaw Collections lets you put together a variety of puzzles while giving your concentration and attention a workout. You can pick from a large selection of puzzles, use a handy zoom tool to get a closer look at the pieces, and see scattered bits gradually form detailed pictures. It suits fans of jigsaws regardless of their age.
money-cutter-idle: Begin with a few small bills and work your way up in this idle game about building cash flow. Combining identical bills creates more valuable currency, which lifts your overall profit. Your earnings grow one row at a time as you expand your income setup, turning a modest start into a quick-paced money machine that keeps climbing.

Tapping anywhere on the screen boosts your production and pays out right away. Use mouse clicks to upgrade rows, unlock higher-value bills, and widen your income system. Plan your upgrades carefully, since they keep your money flowing and raise your idle earnings even when you step away from tapping.
super-pop-it: Super Pop It blends calm play with quick reflexes, asking you to be both precise and fast. Your goal is to pop a range of different bombs before time runs out. Colorful, lively visuals fill each round, and you can adjust the difficulty to match your skill.

The game is built to be enjoyable for players of every age. It can keep you occupied for a long stretch while still feeling relaxing. Everything is controlled with taps: simply tap to destroy the bombs and enjoy the adventure.
ramp-race: Become a skilled driver on fast tracks in this racing game. You can buy cars and tune them to your taste, choosing spoilers, changing the paint color, and upgrading every part of the vehicle. Each day brings gifts and fresh bonuses that can help you progress faster. Many different levels are filled with unexpected obstacles, so no two runs feel the same. Leap off ramps, take sharp turns, and race against other players to climb the leaderboard and show who is the best.

On a computer, use WASD to drive forward, reverse, and steer left or right. Press R to restart a level, H to return to the main menu, and Space to stop the car. Mobile devices use the game's own interface.
pocket-league-3d: Pocket League 3D is a car soccer game for one or two players. If you like, you can add AI bots, and they will help you during matches. Jumping lets your car land harder hits, and a double jump sends it flipping through the air for an even stronger strike. Pick the flag of a country you care about, then aim to score more goals than your rival before the clock runs out.

Solo players steer with the arrow keys, press Space to jump, and tap Space twice to flip. For two players, the first player uses the arrow keys, L to jump, and a double tap of L to flip. The second player moves with W, A, S and D, jumps with G, and flips with a double tap of G.
repeat-pixel-arts: Pixel art fans can try this 2D puzzle, where the goal is to copy pixel drawings. Each level presents a picture with its own mix of colors and pixel layout, and a wide palette gives you plenty of shades to work with. To play, study the pattern on the canvas beside the board, choose the color you need, then click the matching pixels on the game board to recolor them.
Your copy should match the drawing on the neighboring canvas in full. The game is tagged for Android and is endless, and it sits under puzzle, creation, design, and drawing titles.
truck-jam-puzzle: Truck Jam Puzzle is a 3D sorting game about a colorful traffic jam of trucks. Send them out in the correct order, pair each one with cargo of the same color, and keep your limited loading slots clear. Later levels bring locked, frozen, hidden, and overheating trucks that make things tougher.

Click a truck that has a clear route, or tap it, then click or tap an empty slot to park it. Fully loaded trucks leave, opening space for your next move. Clear the trucks before the timer runs out, and never fill every slot with trucks that cannot collect cargo. On-screen booster buttons offer help when you need it. Finish quickly to earn more stars, aim for three on every level, and unlock the next puzzle. Menus work with mouse clicks or touch, so no keyboard is needed.
rage-road-online: Hop behind the wheel beside a fearless cowboy in this intense car shooter. Your goal is to blast every rival on the road, wreck their vehicles, and keep the rampage going as you race ahead. Along the way, collect coins and use them to unlock a range of hat costumes, each one granting its own special ability.

Aiming is simple: move the mouse to line up your shot and click to fire, or tap the screen if you are playing on a touch device. Stay on the road, clear out every enemy you meet, and enjoy the chase. It suits anyone who likes a bit of adventure and a lot of chaos.
dino-dash: Dino Dash puts you in control of a young dinosaur caught in fast, action-packed chases. The game is easy to pick up, and you weave through colorful scenery while steering clear of predators. Your goal is to get away from danger, and simple controls make the escape easy to manage.

Quick reactions decide how well you do. The pursuit never really ends, so every dodge and turn matters as you try to stay ahead of the threats chasing your little dinosaur across the landscape. It's a game built around speed, timing, and staying one step in front.
fight-trivia: Fight Trivia blends battles with brain-teasing quiz questions. Each round gives you a question and four possible answers. Pick the right one to move forward and face your opponents in a duel. A wrong pick sends you back to the beginning, so you must start over.

A reward button can be used to raise your odds of success. Your mind and your fists both matter, so you need to think as well as fight. The result is a tense challenge that tests how well you know your facts under pressure. Every answer counts, so keep your wits sharp from the first duel onward.
planet-escape: Planet Escape asks you to fly a rocket across colorful alien worlds. Success depends on fast reflexes and on choosing wisely which minerals to gather along the way. You move through tough landscapes, pick the difficulty that suits you, and make your getaway before time runs out. Every planet has its own valuables to discover, so there is always new ground to explore and the action stays gripping from start to finish.
sokoban-puzzle-game: Push the Box is a puzzle game that can be both hooked and tested by its challenges, and it is designed to give your mind a workout. You control a character who pushes crates around, and you win once every box has been moved onto its designated spot. Using the four arrow directions, up, down, left, and right, you steer the pusher through each layout.

If you enjoy matching-style puzzles, this one should suit you well. It keeps your thinking sharp while also being relaxing, entertaining, and a good way to ease stress. It is a Sokoban-style puzzle, and it is free to play in your browser as a single-player game.
subway-santa-princess-runner: Subway Santa Princess Runner is a never-ending runner where you guide Princess Santa past oncoming trains while a policeman chases her. Along the subway tracks you gather power pieces and coins, and the challenges help you level up as you go.

Steering needs only one finger. Swipe from right to left or left to right to switch tracks, swipe upward to jump, and swipe downward to slide. Double-tap to activate a skateboard, which protects you from collisions. Keep an eye out for surprise boxes and jump boots, and grab the jet-pack to collect as many coins and gifts as you can.
asmr-keyboard-escape-classic: ASMR Keyboard Escape Classic is a three-dimensional parkour adventure set across an oversized keyboard. You hop from key to key, and each press produces pleasing ASMR clicks that make every jump feel tactile. Watch out for traps along the way, and use the money you earn to purchase helpers that you can then build into your run. Your goal is to make it all the way to the finish line.

Move your character with WASD, leap with Space, and swing the camera around with the mouse. Press F to attack and E to buy or build. Phone players can use the on-screen joystick and buttons instead. Every keyboard course must be completed by reaching its end without falling off.
mad-racing-hill-climb: Mad Racing: Hill Climb takes you off-road, where careful timing and precision matter a great deal. The game offers 15 demanding levels, and you need to keep your speed up while handling the controls with care. Its bright, colorful visuals pair well with fast, intense action, so the game blends thrills with thoughtful driving over uneven, rugged ground.

Every run calls for planning, so you will need to decide when to speed up and when to ease off across each hill. Whether you prefer quick reflexes or a steady, measured approach, this racer rewards patience and clear judgment on every climb.
build-your-dream-car: Assemble the car of your dreams and fine-tune its engine and nitro boost as you go. Each race is a head-to-head drag contest where you need to nail your gear changes at exactly the right moment to pull ahead. Take your upgraded machine out onto the streets and show off your shifting skills against the competition.

To play on a computer, use the arrow keys together with the mouse to steer and shift. On a phone or tablet, press a finger to the screen and slide it left or right to guide the car. Controls are straightforward, which leaves you free to concentrate on building, upgrading, and racing.
targetter-game: Step into Targetter, where you line up your shots carefully and send objects flying toward targets based on sports such as golf and archery. Weaving past obstacles along the way, you sharpen your aim to rack up a higher score. The controls are easy to pick up, while the levels grow trickier as you advance, making for a fast and absorbing experience that suits everyone who enjoys a bit of action.
Every round asks you to judge angle and power with care, so each launch matters. Whether you are just starting out or chasing top marks, the game keeps the pressure on and the fun coming.
flappy-twist: Flappy Twist puts you in control of a flying character that moves through a winding, zigzag route packed with obstacles. Each tap makes your character flap upward, so you need to time your presses carefully to keep from crashing. The course keeps changing as you go, which makes reflexes and precision matter. Your aim is to beat your best score while enjoying its bright, colorful visuals. It suits casual players who enjoy quick, skill-based action.
Controls are simple: click the mouse or tap the screen to play. The responsive handling keeps every flap feeling smooth, even as the path gets trickier. Think you can see how far you can get?
air-force-commando-online-game: Set in 1945, this shooter puts you in the cockpit of a powerful warplane for aerial dogfights. Your rivals are sharp, so you will need to stay one step ahead with tactical maneuvers that catch them off guard. Precision attacks and quick reflexes are key when you want to land your shots.

Every battle in the sky is intense, and staying alive depends on both your skill and your plan. The game pushes you to test your own limits as you chase victory and work toward total dominance over the skies.
decorate-my-dream-castle-home-design: A little princess is getting ready to host a grand ball in her castle, and she wants the whole place redecorated before the guests arrive. You are the one who transforms it. Your goal is to make the castle look gorgeous and beautiful. Put your creative touch on it and see how far your taste can take you. With enough practice, you might even become a famous designer.

Controls are as simple as it gets: just tap or click, so there is nothing to learn before you begin. The game suits anyone who enjoys decorating and wants a light, cheerful session. Every change you make brings the castle closer to being ready for the royal celebration, and that is a lovely feeling to chase.
super-droid-adventure: You set out as a brave robot in Super Droid Adventure, a platformer where dangerous traps lie in your path. Getting forward means dodging those hazards and fighting off enemies along the way. Your robot can unleash firepower, and breaking blocks reveals hidden surprises. Be sure to grab the power-ups and coins you come across.

Careful planning matters here, since each move should be thought through before you make it. The journey builds toward a final showdown with the most powerful boss, and defeating it lets you reclaim your castle. Think ahead and plan well to see the quest through.
fragen: Combat Strike FPS drops you into intense gunfights from a first-person view. Switch between dynamic game modes that keep every match fresh, and unlock rewards as you go. Build your loadout from a large arsenal of weapons, customizing each one to suit your style.

Plan your approach on well-designed maps, where strategy matters as much as aim. The controls feel smooth, and the immersive graphics pull you deeper into every battle. You can fight alone or join a team, and in the end, only the best shooter will prevail.
brick-breaker-chipi-chipi-chapa-chapa-ca: This brick-breaking title is a silly meme game built around bouncing balls and a cast of goofy characters. Your goal is to break bricks, and grabbing power-ups makes the smashing even more entertaining. Along the way, you can watch Chipi Chipi Chapa Chapa Cat and El Primo dance. The levels vary in difficulty, so you can keep passing them and try to set a personal record.

You steer a paddle along the bottom of the screen and bounce the balls upward into the green blocks. Clear every green block and the level is complete. Catch the bonuses that fall from above to add more balls to the field and gain an extra life.
real-truck-fire-drive-sim: Your fire engine is the most important vehicle in this browser game, since it carries you through every mission. It needs to be ready for emergencies and loaded with enough water. Filling it takes more care than you might think. You must park the truck precisely under the water tank and hose nozzle, and avoid going past the maximum water level. Overfilling makes the truck hard to handle on the highway and can make the roads dangerous.

Firefighters are often the first responders, and they protect people, animals, valuable plants and goods stored at the fire station. Their work is demanding, and they regularly risk their own safety to save others. Because they receive specialized training and use professional equipment, this is far from a casual pastime. Here, you can experience many aspects of firefighting from your computer, and you can put out fires during your play. Use WASD to drive and SPACE to brake.
bazooka-boy: Bazooka Boy is a clicker where you blast through each stage by taking out every foe in sight. You collect a variety of weapons, each with its own qualities, and learn how to master them. Your shots can send enemies flying, blow open their bases, and bring their buildings crashing down. The ragdoll foes tumble when hit, and the blasts fill the screen with bright explosions. Each level works like a physics puzzle, and you win by wiping out all the enemies. Watch your aim, because a careless shot can hurt you too.
On a computer, right-click to aim and shoot. On phones and tablets, touch the screen to aim and fire.
red-and-blue-snipers: This sniper shooter asks you to sharpen both your accuracy and your calm under pressure. Drawing on popular competitive titles, the game offers several map types, each with its own tactical openings and combat conditions. Its sniper modes take cues from CS and Standoff 2, so the action stays precise, balanced, and driven by careful planning.

Study the layouts and how rivals move, then face players from around the world in tense duels. Successful matches earn experience that raises your rank on the overall leaderboard, along with in-game currency for buying new deadly weapons. The controls are simple: WASD to move, left click to shoot, right click to aim, R to reload, and Esc to pause. Train your reactions and aim so every shot lands cleanly.
knee-surgery-clicker: Knee Surgery Clicker is a silly clicking game where you tap your way through odd knee operations. You keep the pace up by balancing your taps against upgrades you pick out, and along the way you can unlock boosts that draw on internet memes. As your knee surgery empire expands at a rapidly accelerating rate, you collect funny tools and enjoy a steady stream of jokes.

Success here depends on planning ahead. Every purchase needs thought, since the right choices help your operations run as smoothly as possible. The game rewards players who think strategically about each upgrade and aim for the best surgical results.
fishing-online: Fishing Online puts you on the water with a focus on the craft of angling. Start by choosing the spot where you want to fish, then lower your hook and wait for a nibble. When a fish takes the bait, you work to bring it in, and the game lets you land many different kinds of catch. Throughout, the mechanics are designed to feel lifelike.
cadillacs-dino-riot: Pick either Kira or Bo and set out to halt a convoy smuggling dinosaurs in this colourful 2D rescue adventure. The story runs across eight chapters, passing through several combat zones, dusty roads, and dangerous compounds. You can chain punches, jump, grab enemies to throw them, pick up weapons you find, and free dinosaurs from their cages. Rescued animals can turn a fight in your favour. Checkpoints, illustrated scenery, and an original funky soundtrack keep things moving on desktop or mobile.

Controls: WASD or the arrow keys move, J performs the combo attack (left click), Space jumps (right click), K grabs and throws, and L picks up items, fires, or frees a cage. Esc pauses and M mutes the sound. On mobile, use the direction pad and action buttons.
beach-volley-clash: Step onto the sand in this beach sports title, where every rally unfolds in a busy seaside arena. Your opponents are powerful, so you will need quick reflexes and solid skill to land each shot with accuracy and take the win in every match.

Controls are kept simple: a single mouse click or tap is all you need to play. Filed under Sports, it is tagged with ball, matching and skill, so it suits players who enjoy testing their abilities against tough rivals.
mother-simulator-beach-party-games: Pack your bags, gather your virtual family, and set off on a holiday with beach fun, off-road driving, and camping. You can explore beaches, snowy mountains, parks, and picnic spots, taking part in beach races, sightseeing, and outdoor games with your virtual mom, dad, siblings, and friends. Drive powerful 4x4 jeeps across rough tracks, host family picnics, and complete missions to unlock new rewards and challenging objectives.

The 3D environments feature realistic animations and sound effects, and the controls are designed to feel smooth for players of all ages. On desktop, use WASD to move, hold Left Shift to sprint, press F for actions, and press I for instructions. Ctrl opens settings, and P or Tab pauses the game. On mobile, drag the on-screen joystick to move in any direction.
launch-the-dummy: Give a crash test dummy a shove down the slope, hop aboard, and tap when he reaches the ramp to send him soaring. Along the way he bounces and tumbles through bowling pins, dominoes, crates, and balloons, so there is plenty of mayhem to cause. Your payout depends on how far he travels and how much destruction he leaves behind, and that cash goes toward better hills, faster rides that start with a shopping cart and end with a rocket sled, extra rockets, an eject spring, and a wingsuit for longer flights.

Holding your finger or mouse button opens the wingsuit glide, while passing through boost rings and smashing objects in quick succession builds combo chains. New characters unlock as you go. Your mission is to reach the lake at 1500 meters.
pictures-by-numbers-nubik-and-mobs-mine: Pictures by Numbers - Nubik and Mobs Mine is a coloring game built around scenes inspired by Minecraft. Each picture is revealed through number-based puzzles, so you fill in areas that match the numbers you see. The controls are simple to pick up, and the bright graphics make the artwork pop on screen. It is a calm way to unwind while your favorite characters gradually take shape.

Think of it as a relaxing creative session where every stroke of color brings a familiar face or block-built world into view. Nothing is rushed, so you can work at your own pace and enjoy the slow reveal of each finished image.
chaotic-spin: In Chaotic Spin, you steer a white ball that circles around a track. Your job is to guide it forward or backward across the stage while dodging flying objects. Collect the white dots and keep away from everything else. Some objects can rotate, so you will need to watch them closely. Hitting any object ends the game right away.
Tapping the screen is how you play. The more dots you catch, the more points you earn, and the longer you can keep the ball moving, the better your run becomes.
chicken-charge-race: Chicken Charge Race is a free online arcade game made for kids, though players of any age can enjoy it. Your job is to guide a chicken to the finish line while dodging the obstacles along the course. The controls are simple: hold down the jump button with your mouse to build up power, then let go to launch the chicken forward.

Timing is what matters most, because each leap has to be judged carefully so the chicken avoids hazards and keeps moving. The game is a light, cheerful adventure. Since everything is played with the mouse, there is little to learn before you start. Help your chicken reach the end of the course.
mary-run: Mary Run is an adventure game built around quick, nonstop movement through scenery that keeps changing. Your job is to dodge shadows, hunt down treasure, and take on enemies along the way. Coins you pick up can be spent on upgrades and special powers, which help you handle the tougher stretches of each run.

Each sprint takes you across terrain that shifts as you go, and every route hides new secrets and obstacles to uncover. The pace is fast, so you need to stay alert and keep moving. Expect a mix of striking landscapes and steady action from start to finish.
mining-rush: Mining Rush asks you to dig for valuable minerals underground and spend what you collect on building up a busy city above. Getting more out of each dig is the main goal, so you can improve how fast you mine and open up stronger tools along the way. Rare treasures are hidden in the rock, and the further down you go, the bigger the payoff tends to be. The core loop is easy to pick up and keeps pulling you back for one more round.

Under the surface, every trip down is a chance to plan your next upgrade and decide how far to push. The game sits in the Puzzles category and carries the Strategy tag, which fits its focus on choosing the right moves. Its mix of digging, collecting, and building makes for a relaxed but engaging session.
monster-makeup-3d: This 3D makeup game asks you to disguise monsters as humans so they can avoid prying eyes. You work with a range of tools to reshape their features smoothly, but one careless move could backfire. The game is free to play online and runs on any device.

The art style is polished and detailed in three dimensions, and the characters move in funny ways as you work. When things go wrong, the failures are genuinely entertaining to watch. Each step is accompanied by soothing, ASMR-style sounds that feel calming and satisfying. The finished result is designed to earn a strong reaction at the very end.
happy-gunman: Your survival depends entirely on your aim. Enemies are hunting you from every direction, and the pursuit is so fierce that even dinosaurs have been sent after you. Line up your shots carefully and keep firing to stay alive.
Controls are simple: click the mouse or tap the screen to play. It is a 3D shooter with an arcade feel, and it sits in the hypercasual group, so it is easy to pick up and jump straight into.
spra-racing-cars-speed: Speed Racing Cars puts you behind the wheel of fast machines in a browser racing game. You start by picking from some of the best cars, then unlock powerful supercars as you go. Visit the customization menu to tune your vehicles, boost their performance, and grow your garage by buying new rides.

Once you are ready, head out onto the track and race through beautiful surroundings. Your goal is to push your driving to the limit and come out on top of the competition. Drive with W, A, S and D, and press C to switch between camera views.
knights-vs-dragons-battle-simulator: Take command of a group of knights in this web game, where your goal is to outsmart and defeat fierce monsters. Build your forces with care, making use of what each unit does best, and arrange them into formations that suit the fight. Managing your resources is just as important as where you place your troops.
The action unfolds in 3D battles, where every choice you make affects whether you win and whether your
simple-words: Simple Words blends the falling-block action of match-three games with a word puzzle. You tap or click letters to spell words, and each word you form darkens the letters you used. Your aim is to clear an entire row by using every letter in it, so think carefully about which letters to pick next while the blocks keep dropping.
The game offers four ways to play. Daily Challenge asks whether you can climb to the top, while
rogue-runner: You are a wanted runaway in Rogue Runner, a driving simulator where every move keeps the chase going. The police keep sending more officers after you across a wide open city. Your skill behind the wheel decides whether you escape or end up in handcuffs. Slip through crowded city traffic, pull off risky moves, and make the most of your surroundings.
Each barrier you smash and each close call pushes the pursuit harder. SWAT units join the hunt, laying down spike strips and deploying tactical te
simulator-gt-motorsport: Take the wheel of GT-inspired cars right in your web browser. Choose the vehicle you want, improve it over time, and grow your abilities through a skill tree that shapes how you progress.

Four modes are waiting: Circuit, Short Race, Drag Race, and Drift, so you can try different styles of driving. Movement is handled with the WASD keys. This simulator suits fans of both racing and drifting.
penalty-superstar: In this soccer game, you play the goalie and try to stop shots coming your way. Your reflexes need to be sharp, because the kicks grow more skilled as you go. Pick up water bottles to get bigger, and steer clear of shrinking potions that would make you smaller. The challenges keep coming, so there is always another penalty waiting for you.

Your aim is to rise to the top and prove you are the best keeper in this unusual soccer showdown. The action moves quickly, so you have to react fast and stay one step ahead of every shooter. It is a fresh take on the goalkeeping role, with power-ups and hazards that shake up the usual rules.
shoot-some-fish: In this shooter, you guide a worm who sets out on a mission after fish from the water take his family. Hanging from a fishing hook and carrying a harpoon, he pushes through 10 demanding stages. As the stages go on, the fish grow quicker and cleverer, so staying alive takes real thought and fast reactions.

Fire your harpoon by swiping with the mouse, and watch closely so you can dodge incoming attacks. You start with 5 lives and face 7 distinct fish, each swimming at its own speed. The underwater scenes shift between day and night. Plan your moves carefully and react quickly to teach the fish a lesson they will remember.
hidden-sniper-camo-hunter-3d: Hidden Sniper: Camo Hunter 3D is a three-dimensional shooting game built around sniping. You comb through detailed scenes looking for targets that blend into their surroundings, then zoom in with a scope and take careful shots. It rewards sharp eyes and steady aim across demanding stages.

Each level is cleared once you have found and hit the required targets. On a computer, hold the left mouse button and drag to look around, then move the cursor onto the scope button and hold it to open the scope. Keep moving the mouse to aim, and release the left button to fire. On mobile, swipe the screen to look around, press and hold the Scope Button to open the scope, swipe to aim, and release the button to shoot.
brawl-simulator-3d: Brawl Simulator 3D is an action shooter that recreates the feel of Brawl Stars in full three-dimensional battles. You defeat opponents, gain levels, and prove how good you are. Collect brawlers by opening regular boxes, trophy boxes, and Starr Drops. Each brawler can be inspected up close thanks to detailed, attractive graphics, and several game modes keep the action varied.

Personalize your fighter with rare avatars and unique skins that help you stand out. On a phone, use the blue joystick on the left to move and the red joystick on the right to aim, then let go of the red joystick to fire. On a computer, use the arrow keys or WASD to move, move the mouse to aim, and press the left mouse button to shoot.
1-tongue-escape: In this 3D obstacle course, your tongue works as a grappling hook. Start in the lobby to train and extend its reach before heading out. Once you're ready, aim at a surface to latch on and pull yourself over gaps, swinging past dangerous platforms while steering clear of hazards. Along the way, gather trophies and work through tough stages to reach the end of each one.

Progress unlocks new tongues and trails, and rebirthing grants stronger bonuses. Competing for the highest scores is another goal. On desktop, use WASD to move, the right mouse button to look around, E or the left mouse button to use your tongue, and Space to jump. On mobile, rely on the on-screen joystick and action buttons. Play in landscape orientation.
slice-and-soar: Slice & Soar is an arcade game where you fly across the sky and cut through whatever floats into your path. Your score climbs with every object you slice, so the goal is to rack up as many points as you can. Swiping or dragging on the screen handles all the cutting, and you need to pick the right moment so you hit the targets and steer clear of obstacles.

Strategy matters here as much as speed. Some levels and patterns demand careful aim, because missing a target or touching a forbidden item can cost you. New stages bring fresh obstacles that test your cutting skills, and you can also race other players to see who comes out on top. The game is easy to pick up, which makes it fun for all ages, and you can play either online or offline wherever you happen to be.
runner-soldiers: Runner Soldiers puts you in command of your army as it pushes through obstacle courses and tactical battles. Precision and planning matter here, so you need to multiply your forces as you go and aim for victory over tough opponents. The game offers several modes and a range of challenges, so there is always something new to try.

Fans of the runner genre will find constant motion and plenty of action, backed by enough strategy to keep you engaged. Each stage asks you to think ahead while your troops keep moving. This mix of fast-paced running and tactical depth can hold your attention for a long stretch.
drift-city: Drift City puts you behind the wheel of a lifelike drifting experience across a busy city. Burn through rubber on the streets and earn drift points with every slide. Spend those points on new cars as you work toward the title of drift king. Six vehicles are available, and 30 achievements are there to unlock as your fame grows around town.

Watch for drift bonuses that appear in the city for limited periods, and collect them to raise your drift score. You can switch between four camera views to see your slides from different angles. Steer with W, A, S, D or the arrow keys, use Space for the handbrake, C to change camera, F for nitro, and L for lights. Cut through the traffic and become a real nightmare for every driver on the road.
knightbit-far-lands: KnightBit: Far Lands continues the long clash between knights and Vikings with a fresh take on the conflict. You join big battles along the frontier, where every win moves you nearer to fame. The map has been redesigned, taking you from icy fjords to kingdom borders glowing with fire. To win, your side must reach a set point total by seizing flags and taking down the opposing team.

As you fight, your rank climbs from recruit toward the crown. Higher ranks open special abilities and give access to stronger weapons. Fresh challenges and unexplored territories wait ahead, with more chances to fight for control. Move with WASD, jump with Spacebar, sprint by holding Shift, and use the interact
allpeopletug: You land on a map with empty hands, since no weapons are handed out at the start. Scattered across the terrain you will find plenty of guns and gear, and the more you gather, the better your chances of staying alive and fighting well. Each match places several players in random spots, and the goal is to be the one still standing when the rest are gone.

As time passes, the safe zone keeps contracting and pushes everyone toward the middle, so run-ins become far more frequent. On mobile, a virtual joystick handles movement. On desktop, use W, A, S and D to get around, then click the on-screen icons to fire, sprint, heal or reload.
car-rush-game: Car Rush is a racing game that takes you down tracks styled after classic retro games. Each course is packed with a variety of obstacles that you need to steer around while you drive. Your job is to keep a careful hand on the wheel, balancing how fast you go against how well you can keep the car under control.

As you progress, the terrain grows tougher, so you will need to stay sharp. The whole challenge revolves around the countdown, since every moment matters when you are trying to beat the clock. Overall, it feels nostalgic and fast.
mike-lost-in-desert-hidden-object: Mike's small plane suffers an engine failure, and he has to land in the middle of a vast desert. The aircraft is wrecked, his supplies are dwindling, and dangerous bandits are on his trail. As he wanders under the scorching sun, he searches for anything useful, examines mysterious ruins, and tries to stay alive. Each find moves him either toward rescue or toward disaster.

You guide him through five hand-painted desert locations, hunting for 10 hidden objects in each before moving on. The clock gives you about eight minutes, and if it runs out, the bandits catch up. Find everything in all five areas in time and Mike escapes the desert alive. The mood stays calm yet tense, and the story centers on survival and determination. Search carefully, stay focused, and move quickly, because his life depends on it.
fishdom: Step into an underwater setting in Fishdom, a puzzle game with a large collection of levels to work through. Along the way you will meet plenty of charming fish and pets, and a range of special events keeps the sea feeling lively. Each level gives you a chance to rescue fish, and as you progress you can unlock new aquariums.
Control everything with your mouse, or use touch if you are playing on a touch device. Dive in and explore the many underwater scenes, saving fish as you go.
traffic-jam-escape-3d: In this 3D traffic puzzle for mobile, you untangle crowded city streets by tapping vehicles and steering each one along its arrow-marked route. Your aim is to free every car from gridlock while avoiding crashes and obstacles. Vehicles range from tiny cars to big trucks, so each one needs its own plan. The controls are easy to pick up for players of any age, and the game features bright visuals and realistic sounds.
Dozens of levels grow harder as you go, with narrow alleys and busy crossings adding new challenges
subway-winter-vacation: Subway Winter Vacation is a free online game based on the Subway Surfers World Tour: Winter Holiday edition. Its winter adventure takes place across open subway areas, where your character runs forward on its own along snow-covered rails. Those rails form a three-lane railway track, and danger can reach the runner from every direction.

Listed under Racing, this title is tagged with subway and Subway Surfers, which points to its link with the series. It offers a snowy dash through the underground, with the focus on keeping the runner moving ahead along the tracks.
kuli: In KULI, you spend your days planning and building defenses to hold off the undead. When night arrives, you switch to attack mode and unleash your firepower on the zombies. Short mini-challenges stand between you and the next stage, and your building skills come into play in each one. Every structure you raise matters when the zombie apocalypse keeps pushing forward.

The goal is to stay alive for as long as you can. Success depends on balancing careful preparation during the day with focused shooting after dark. Use what you build, take on each challenge, and see whether you can make it through the night.
playground-ragdoll-sandbox: Here you can take part in a wide range of activities. Hop into a car and go for a drive, bring down buildings, take on hostile foes, and tackle mission objectives. Pick from several weapons, assemble items with the tulgan, and test how things break apart. Your core aim is to wipe out the city with a nuclear bomb, and the route to that outcome is entirely your call.

You can follow the story missions step by step or simply roam a boundless sandbox full of options. On a computer, move with WASD, fire with the left mouse button, and press F to climb into a vehicle. Touch screens are simpler still, since every needed control appears on screen so nothing gets overlooked.
animal-impossible-track-rush: Step into the hooves of a brave animal in this arcade parkour challenge, where every run tests your nerve. Animal Impossible Track Rush asks you to race with your animal across a track and perform stunts that seem to defy belief. The whole experience unfolds in 3D, with a bouncy, playful feel as you charge forward through the most demanding animal rush on offer.
This hypercasual title centers on running and stunts, so each track gives you a fresh chance to show off. The controls are simple: a mouse click or a tap is all you need to play.
humans-playground-sandbox: Humans Playground Sandbox lets you let your imagination run wild inside a physics-based virtual lab. You can build things, smash them apart, and push around a range of objects and ragdoll characters using a large selection of tools. Controls are simple to pick up, and you can adjust the settings to suit how you like to play. The result is a lively, interactive world where you can keep inventing new scenarios.
alien-shooting-survival: You are dropped into a post-apocalyptic woodland and a wrecked town, both taken over by alien creatures and invading soldiers. Equipped with weapons, you must hold off successive waves of hostile foes, ranging from frightening alien beasts to heavily armored troops. Nonstop fighting keeps you on your toes at every turn.

Hop behind the wheel of vehicles to cross dangerous areas, reach your objectives, and stay alive through constant combat. Your mission is complete only once every threat has been eliminated. Move with WASD, which also drives vehicles, and use the mouse to aim and fire.
killmaster-secret-agent: You play a secret agent who sprints through snow-covered streets to take out masked men and capture hostages, which can earn rewards. Watch closely, because the levels contain bosses that are very hard to eliminate.

Steer your agent and aim each shot at the spot where enemies or barrels are standing. Barrels can explode and wipe out nearby foes, so positioning matters. You can also buy other avatars to strengthen your agent's skills. Right-click the mouse to shoot, or touch the screen on mobile devices.
mud-truck-simulator-game: Mud Truck Simulator Game puts you in control of trucks for off-road driving. You can steer your vehicle along muddy roads and explore challenging off-road environments that test your driving skills. Each route crosses rough terrain, so you need to handle difficult paths from start to finish.

The game is a truck simulation built around navigating these demanding routes. Move forward with W or the Up Arrow, reverse with S or the Down Arrow, and turn left or right with A and D or the Left and Right Arrows. Use your mouse to click any button on screen.
top-shootout-the-saloon: Step into the Wild West and aim to become the finest gunslinger the frontier has ever seen. Outlaws have taken a group of hostages and locked them inside The Saloon, and only you can free them. This 3D arcade action game puts you right in the middle of the standoff.
Your task is to reload your weapon and take down every bandit in the building, along with the bosses who lead them. Controls are simple: click or tap to fire, and click or tap to recharge your gun.
fighter-car-shooting: Fighter Car Shooting throws you into high-speed vehicle combat. Pick from a lineup of cars and weapons, customize them to suit your style, and blast your rivals across a variety of explosive modes. Each battlefield rewards careful planning, so you will need to map out your route and think a few moves ahead. Grab power-ups along the way to gain the upper hand.

You can compete against other players in multiplayer or face AI opponents when you prefer to play alone. The pace is quick, and the dynamic challenges keep every round moving from start to finish with plenty of nonstop action.
bridge-builders: Bridge Builders puts you in a timed race where both speed and planning count. Gather materials along the way, then construct bridges as quickly as you can so you can keep moving. Watch out for tactical traps that can slow you down, and stay ahead of your rivals from start to finish.

Customize your avatar to make your character your own, then aim to cross the finish line before anyone else. Finishing first wins you the victory along with rewards. Getting ready, setting off, and building your route all matter here.
soccer-heroes: Soccer Heroes lets you lead your own football team in a game that blends careful planning with quick reactions. Matches move at a brisk pace, so you need to get past rivals by timing your moves well and making fast swipes across the screen. Your aim is to put the ball in the net while stopping the other side from scoring, and the controls are easy to pick up.
The graphics are impressive and pull you into every match. Listed under Sports, the game combines tactics with speed on the pitch.
stunt-planes: Imagine piloting a heavily modified warplane built purely for destruction. This survival plane racer sends you through intense 3D environments high in the sky. You fly custom aircraft inspired by World War II designs through high-stakes races and challenging levels. Power-ups add extra twists, and realistic 3D physics shape how every plane handles.

Player one steers with the arrow keys, using left and right to turn and up and down to control the nose. X activates the booster, C performs a break, Space uses a power-up, and N changes the camera view. Press P or Escape to pause. A second player can join using W, A, S and D, and every key can be changed to suit your preference.
xmas-rooftop-battles: Pull on your Santa hat and get ready for a lively round of holiday fun. This Christmas-themed shooter puts you against an opponent on a rooftop, and your goal is to shoot them off the edge. It's a two-player battle with a sniper flavor, so every shot matters and every move counts.

Controls are simple to pick up. You can tap the on-screen controls, or use the keyboard, where the W, E, O and P keys handle shooting and jumping. Keep your footing, line up your shots, and aim to send your rival tumbling off the roof.
window-jump-guy: Window Jump Guy is a jumping game in which you control a character who tosses himself out of tall windows. Each drop from a great height brings in cash, and you spend that money on upgrades. While falling, you have to steer around obstacles, so every leap takes some care.

The game has a goofy, offbeat style that keeps the mood light. Its real challenge is timing, since getting your jumps just right takes patience and practice. It mixes humor with fast, high-flying action in a way that feels distinctive.
super-traffic-racer: Super Traffic Racer is an endless arcade racer that puts you behind the wheel on a busy highway. Weave through the cars around you, collect cash as you go, and spend it on upgrades or on entirely new vehicles. Your goal is to climb the global leaderboards and prove you are among the quickest drivers out there.

You can steer with touch controls on your screen or with the arrow keys on your keyboard. The game is built for a single player and features 3D visuals, so the road feels like it stretches on forever. It is a fresh take on endless racing that keeps the pace high and the traffic coming.
vector-parkour: Vector Parkour puts you in the shoes of a talented free runner who refuses to be held down by the system. This arcade-style game builds its movement on parkour, the urban ninja sport, so running, jumping and climbing are all part of the challenge. All the while, Big Brother is hot on your heels.
You can play with either the keyboard or the mouse, so choose whichever suits you best. Whether you are running, jumping or climbing, your aim is to stay ahead of Big Brother's pursuit.
open-city-suv-car-stunts: Take the wheel of a lifelike SUV simulator where road rules are optional. Launch off ramps, pull off stunts, and power over obstacles across a large open city. Free Ride Mode gives you total freedom, with plenty of ramps, jumps, and obstacles to test your moves. Prefer a slower pace? Cruise the streets, uncover hidden locations, and hunt for new spots to leap, crash, and show off.

Your main job is delivering illegal packages across town while staying ahead of the police. Take risky drops, dodge chases, hide from officers, and get away before they catch up. Choose detailed SUVs and tune their looks and performance to build a capable off-road machine. Controls: W or Up Arrow to accelerate, S or Down Arrow to brake, A or Left Arrow to steer left, D or Right Arrow to steer right, Space for the handbrake, and ESC to pause or open options.
tile-sort-color-columns: Tile Sort: Color Columns is a logic puzzle built around bright, colorful tiles. The aim is to rearrange them so every column ends up holding only one color. Each turn, you choose a column and drop the tile you are holding onto its top. The tile at the bottom of that column then becomes the one you must place next, so every choice shapes the moves that follow.

Nothing here is timed, and you cannot lose, so you can think through each move at your own speed. Levels begin simply and grow into puzzles that call for planning several steps ahead. Boards change shape, extra colors join in, and some stages add hidden tiles or other mechanics. If a solution isn't obvious, try a different order of moves.
archer-ro: Archer.ro blends strategy and arcade action. You grow your own empire by constructing a variety of buildings, then take control of your heroic archer to hold back waves of zombies that never seem to stop coming. Levels keep going without an end, and you can improve your defenses and abilities through upgrades as the battle goes on.

Move your archer with the W, A, S and D keys, and fire by clicking the left mouse button. Every choice about where to place structures and when to strengthen them matters, so planning ahead is just as important as quick aim. It is a 2D, WebGL-powered game that combines shooting with strategic building.
jump-up-3d: Jump Up 3D is a basketball game where precise timing decides how well you do. You shoot from a position that never stops bouncing, so every release has to be carefully judged. Along the way, you must dodge moving obstacles and outscore the opponents you face.

The action takes place in varied environments, and the courses defy the normal laws of physics. Refine your technique, beat your competitors, and conquer each course to unlock rewards. Your goal is to rise to the level of a basketball legend.
arrow-survival-15-seconds: You play as an archer in this 2D pixel-art game with quick action. Your goal is to last 15 seconds on each of its 40 levels while avoiding dangerous hazards and firing arrows at the right moments. Each stage brings something different, such as platforms that bounce your arrows back in new directions, sharp spikes, and mechanics that change as you advance.

The controls work like this. Use A and D or the left and right arrow keys to move, and W, the up arrow, or Spacebar to jump. Press J or X to shoot. R restarts the current level, and P pauses the game.
spooky-boxing: Step into a haunted boxing ring and face twelve monsters, each with abilities of their own. Fight through spooky arenas, and beat each fighter to unlock their comic ending. You can throw quick jabs, crossing punches and charged uppercuts, while blocking incoming hits or slipping out of their way.

On desktop, A and D or the Left and Right arrows move you, W or Up moves upward, and holding S or Down guards. Z dodges, J jabs, X or K throws crosses, and C or L throws uppercuts. P or Esc pauses the game. On mobile, use the on-screen buttons: hold the movement or guard buttons, and tap the attack and dodge buttons. When you are knocked down, tap repeatedly to get back up.
roar-of-city: Roar of City throws you into messy street brawls, where you play a single fighter holding off endless rounds of foes. The game leans into an old-school feel, with punchy sound effects and a catchy soundtrack that keeps the energy up. Timing matters here, since you can pick the right moment to launch strong special attacks that deal heavy damage and open up room to breathe. Fans of classic retro games should find plenty to enjoy.
fashion-foot-shop-game: Fashion Foot Shop is a well-liked makeover game in which you run your own foot shop and serve a steady stream of customers. Each visitor arrives with a different foot problem, such as overly long nails, dirty nails, or wounds. You are far more than a manicurist here, because you also work as a nail artist who can create striking nail styles.
Your sense of style gets a real workout, since every nail design you create should match the traits of the person in your chair. Play with a mouse or by tapping the screen.
cricket-mania: Grab your bat and face the bowler in this browser cricket title, where good timing, accuracy, and high-score goals drive every match. Fans of regular cricket, stick cricket, or doodle cricket should feel right at home. It is easy to pick up but tough to master, and it suits both relaxed players and those aiming for top results. Matches move quickly, the animations look lifelike, and every ball depends on your skill.

Your aim is to rack up as many runs as you can before the wickets fall. Watch the bowler's run-up to guess what is coming, then read the visual cues that show whether the delivery will be Straight, Slow, or Fast. When the ball reaches the sweet spot, press Left or Right. Hit it cleanly for boundaries, but one mistimed swing and you are out, since a late shot leaves you bowled.
car-chase-parking: Car Chase Parking puts you behind the wheel with police cars hot on your tail. Your job is to weave past them at breakneck speed while threading through crowded streets. Timing your brakes matters, because a well-judged stop lets you slip into an open parking spot.

Success takes quick reflexes and smart planning, so you'll need to think a few moves ahead while watching the traffic around you. Staying out of the police's reach is how you score big. It's an arcade-style game built on sharp driving and a chase that keeps the pressure on from start to finish.
1-monkey-escape-speed-obby-mode: You play as a monkey that bounces off walls while sprinting through obstacle courses. Each stride you take builds up your speed, so the longer you keep moving, the quicker you get. Clearing obstacles earns you wins, and you can unlock new auras as you progress. When you feel held back, you can rebirth to carry on past your previous limits.

Hatching pets is another way to rack up extra trophies. On a computer, move with the W, A, S and D keys, and hold the right mouse button to swing the camera around. On mobile, use the joystick in the bottom-left corner to move and swipe across the screen to adjust the view.
nubik-vs-herobrin-s-army: Nubik is the hero of this pixel-style adventure, set in a dangerous land where every step could bring trouble. You craft new weapons from materials you collect, then upgrade them so they shift and adapt as you move forward. Your main foe is Herobrine, whose army stands in your way as you try to rescue your brother.

Success depends on careful planning and quick, precise moves. Along the way you will face a wide range of challenges, each asking for a different approach. Explore the terrain, adjust to whatever comes next, and stay alive through battles against enemies that keep evolving.
grand-city-missions: Grand City Missions drops you into a large urban setting packed with tall buildings and broad streets, along with a big stunt arena. You can choose between two modes, racing and career, so you can pick the style of play you want.

Before you head out, visit the garage to choose from seven cars, each with its own special features. The customize menu lets you change the paint and wheels to make your ride look just right. Two players can share the keyboard: Player 1 drives with W, A, S and D, uses F for nitro, T to look back and R to restart. Player 2 steers with the arrow keys, uses K for nitro, L to look back and O to restart.
noob-saves-a-girl-a-story: Noob Saves a Girl is a free online rescue game with a strong story at its heart. You take on the part of a devoted hero whose sweetheart has been seized by a sly villain, and it's up to you to bring her home. Along the way you face fierce battles and strategic challenges, all set in eye-catching locations. The game is made to run on both phones and desktop computers.

Your controls depend on the device you use. On a computer, move your character with the mouse and keyboard. On a mobile device, steer with the joystick. Your main goal is to defeat every boss you meet, which brings you one step closer to rescuing her.
