racing-project-kit: Racing Project Kit is a sports game that blends fast driving with creative building. You can craft your own circuits and adjust your car's setup for top performance. When you want company, you can challenge friends in split-screen mode.

Stretching what a track can be is a central part of the experience, and speed and creativity work side by side throughout. Each race tests both your skill behind the wheel and your imagination as a designer. Fans of racing games who also enjoy building will find plenty to explore here.
diggy: Diggy sends an eager astronaut deep beneath the lunar surface in search of wealth. Moving through the rock takes some getting used to, since the controls are tricky and will test your focus. Along the way you gather valuable minerals and upgrade your gear as you go. There is no real end to the digging, so you can keep descending into new areas. Keep an eye on the timer, because it runs down while treasure waits farther below. Only by digging ever deeper can you hope to uncover what the Moon is hiding.
bank-robbery-puzzle-shooter: Bank Robbery Puzzle Shooter is a 3D strategy game where you guide a character from one spot to another, heading toward the money counter. Once there, you collect the cash and watch your score rise. The route is not always safe, since obstacles can get in the way, but you have a chance to defend against them as you move.
Playing is simple: click the mouse or tap the screen to get going. Keep an eye on the path ahead and think about where each move will take you, because every step brings you closer to the counter.
snake-2077-glitch-war: Snake 2077: Glitch War takes the familiar snake formula of .io games and gives it a futuristic twist. You slither through a glowing cyberpunk arena where staying alive is the only thing that matters. Gobble up energy pellets to grow longer, and use quick bursts of speed to trap rivals. When you take down an opponent, you can claim the coins and remains they leave behind.

The visuals lean into distorted glitch art, and each AI bot has its own personality, so no two encounters feel the same. A large set of skins can be unlocked as you play. Steer with your mouse, and hold the left button to surge forward, though this burns mass. On mobile, use the joystick to move and tap the lightning button to boost. Work your way up the global leaderboard to claim the top spot.
rider-online-pro: Rider Online Pro is a racing game built around daring stunts in a never-ending world. You steer a futuristic motorcycle and try to keep it from flipping while you rack up points. The more points you earn, the more motorcycles you can unlock, and there are 16 to find in total.

The controls are simple. Left click moves your bike forward, and holding left click while in the air makes you perform a cartwheel that adds to your score. Collect diamonds, chain together combos, and try to beat your high scores as you spin wildly from one jump to the next.
dusk-warz: Dusk WarZ is a tense survival shooter built around combat, gunfire, and strategic upgrades. You play as a brave warrior in a dangerous world overrun by zombies. You face battle after battle, relying on your firearms and your wits to hold your ground against a constant stream of foes.
The game is played with a mouse click or a tap. As you go, the number of enemies keeps climbing, so every fight calls for careful thinking and quick decisions.
pop-pop-kitties: Pop-Pop Kitties is a puzzle shooter built around the match-three idea, with plenty of adorable feline challenges. Your job is to line up matching cats with careful planning, since they keep creeping downward and the clock is always ticking. Quick reactions help you keep up as the pace picks up.

Along the way you can gather stars and keep chasing a flawless run, all while making sure not a single kitty gets hurt. The game offers more than 100 stages to work through, so there is plenty to explore for anyone who loves cats and clever puzzles.
sniper-hero-urban-strike: Sniper Hero: Urban Strike is a shooting game where you line up careful shots and work through a set of city missions. Keep an eye on your targets, steer clear of civilians, and make the most of the small amount of ammo you have, since each bullet matters. Clear a stage to advance and show off your accuracy.

To aim, press and hold the left mouse button. When your crosshair is lined up, let go of the button to take the shot. It is a single-player title with a battle theme, and players who enjoy sniper-style precision will find plenty to focus on.
subway-surfers-havana-2021: In this 3D hypercasual title, a grumpy inspector and his dog are hot on your trail as you race along a city subway in Havana. You must dodge barriers, trains, trams, and other hazards while pushing your distance as far as you can in this endless running challenge. Build up your speed and clear every obstacle in your path.

Collecting coins unlocks bonuses, and those bonuses help you unlock new characters in Subway Surfers. Controls are simple: the arrow keys steer your runner, and the space bar activates your skateboard or any other bonus you have picked up. It is an HTML5 game built for play on a PC.
bobb-s-world: Bobb's World is a retro adventure with pixel art graphics. You guide Bobb through 30 exotic levels spread across diverse planets. Along the way, you collect tasty treats, which help satisfy Bobb's enormous appetite. Be careful of sneaky traps, and bounce on enemies to deal with them.

The controls are easy to pick up, so you can focus on clever obstacles and playful challenges instead of complicated inputs. Each stage asks you to think a little differently, adding variety from world to world. The whole game captures the feel of classic old-school platforming.
cricket-championship: Step up to the crease in Cricket Championship, a quick 2D sports title that rewards accurate, well-timed mouse clicks. You'll learn batting methods and smart field placement to send the ball a long way and rack up runs. Keep practicing, and you'll be able to protect your wicket and take control of the pitch.

Every swing counts, so timing is everything. The more you play, the better you'll get at reading the delivery and choosing where to put the ball. Soon you'll be batting with confidence on the cricket field.
number-run-3d-casual-game: Number Run 3D is a casual game presented in three dimensions and tagged with 3D Games, unity games, and Unity3D. It is built around testing your skills and reflexes as you make your way through a world filled with obstacles that stand in your path.

Playing takes nothing more than a mouse click or a tap, so the controls are easy to pick up. Your task is to keep navigating and respond to whatever the surroundings put in front of you, using quick timing and careful attention.
crazy-flying-car: Take the wheel of a car fitted with wings and soar over deep chasms while racing against rivals. Your aim is to cross the finish line before anyone else. You can stay on the road and shove opponents aside as you go, or leave the track and take to the air to cut the distance short. Whether you chase the bold shortcut or rely on skillful maneuvers is entirely up to you.
On a computer, press the A and D keys or the arrow keys to adjust the car's angle. On a phone, touch and hold the screen to do the same. Your goal is simple: get to the finish first.
cs-upgrade-gun: In CS Upgrade Gun, you take control of a cannon that operates on its own while you steer it. Your task is to track down targets across a bright, lively arena. As the action builds, you can improve your setup with strong boosters, pushing your abilities as far as they will go.

Expect loud, fast-moving chaos and explosions that keep the pace high from start to finish. The game asks how long you can hold out against the nonstop assault. Quick reactions and smart use of each upgrade will help you last.
noob-vs-stickman-zombies: You play as Noob, standing guard over a quiet wooden cabin while waves of stickman zombies press in. This arcade-style adventure centers on action. Your main tool is a bow, and you need to line up each shot carefully to take down tougher enemies that refuse to go down easily.

The game mixes in puzzle elements that reward careful planning. Its visuals use retro pixel art, giving the whole experience a nostalgic feel. Expect gameplay that keeps going with no set finish, keeping you busy defending your home.
world-of-military-tanks: Pick a tank and head into battle in this 3D shooting game. Your main goal is to complete each mission by destroying enemy tanks. The game offers several modes, including standard missions, base defense, survival, and 5v5 battles.

You can buy and upgrade tanks from a large selection, and completing missions brings rewards. To aim, move the scope onto an enemy tank and right-click. When the target is captured, the scope turns red, and you should fire once a red circle appears inside it. Anyone interested in military topics should find plenty to enjoy here.
sworded-io-spin-and-rub: Sworded io - Spin and Rub is a fast arcade duel built around swordplay. You test your reflexes, planning, and sense of timing as you face wave after wave of tough rivals. Strengthen your fighter, cast spells, and take over arenas by relying on skill and smart choices. Weapons range from swords to axes, knives, and more, and power-ups can quickly shift the outcome of a fight.

The game offers two modes, Domination and Battle Royal. Spinning drives much of the action, keeping every match moving at a rapid pace. On PC, move with WASD, the arrow keys, or by dragging with the left mouse button. On mobile, use the in-game joystick. Compete hard and rise as a warrior.
snack-sort: Snack Sort is a puzzle game set around vending machines. Your goal is to group matching snacks together until each machine's shelves are cleared. Tapping a snack sends it to an empty slot along the bottom, and with only five slots to use, every move counts, so plan ahead to avoid getting stuck. Hundreds of levels await, and the tasty-looking snack art keeps things cheerful.

Simple taps are all you need, yet the puzzles can be surprisingly tricky to solve. Finishing a level unlocks the next one, and later stages bring more snack types and busier arrangements. Whether you want a quick round or a long puzzling session, the game fits both.
goal-io: Goal.io is a free football-style io game that runs right in your web browser. It's a fast soccer experience where your reflexes, timing, and accurate shooting decide how high you climb the leaderboard. You have three minutes to score as big as you can.

Movement uses the W, A, S, and D keys to guide your player across the field. Keep an eye on the clock, since the round is short, and aim your shots carefully to outscore the competition. Whether you're a casual fan or a quick-thinking striker, this browser title offers a lively way to test your skills.
chess-master-3d: Chess Master 3D takes the familiar game of chess and presents it in a three-dimensional setting with eye-catching graphics. You move your pieces carefully, planning ahead as you go, and face off against a computer opponent in a battle of tactics. The goal is to trap and capture the enemy king, so each turn matters.

Fans of board games and puzzles will find plenty to think about here. The game is filed under Puzzles and carries the Board tag, which fits its focus on strategy and careful thinking. Every decision you make on the board can shape how the match unfolds, right up to the final checkmate.
how-many-mice: Test how sharp your perception is in How Many Mice. Your goal is to work out how many mice are hidden in the scene. Each touch may reveal more of them, but be careful, because too much curiosity will lower your score. Every move is a balancing act between caution and curiosity.

This game rewards careful observation and sharp intuition more than quick reflexes. Think ahead about where you touch, weigh the risk of each discovery against what it could reveal, and trust your instincts about what to explore next. It suits anyone who enjoys studying a scene closely and making thoughtful choices along the way.
the-green-mission-inside-a-cave: You play as a cucumber that can change color, exploring a dreamlike underground world hidden beneath the ground. Deep in the mysterious cave, you will crack puzzling riddles, track down secret recipes, and find ways around the enemies lurking there. The gameplay is engaging and the challenges are charming, making this a playful journey that rewards creative thinking.

Levels are navigated aboard the Buddy Rocket, which carries you from one stage to the next. The whole experience feels whimsical from start to finish, giving you plenty of room to unleash your creativity along the way.
trash-master: You step into the role of a recycling plant director, where accidents have no place. Every item that passes through the facility, from bottles and tires to rolls of toilet paper, depends on how well you handle the process. Trash Master is a recycling simulator built for players who would rather design and arrange machinery than chase profit.

The plant is a complete operation with conveyor belts, presses, shredders, and sorting lines, modeled on how real industry works. Your goal is to process materials as fast as possible, keep losses to a minimum, and keep the conveyor running without pause. Controls use the WASD keys or the mouse on a computer. On a phone, you simply use your finger.
happy-color-sort-puzzle: Happy Color Sort Puzzle is a game where you separate colors and place each matching group into its correct container. Every level calls for careful observation and clear thinking as you work out what to do next. The stages grow more complex as you advance, so your reasoning is tested again and again.
The game offers a steady stream of addictive fun and colorful challenges that can keep you playing for a long time. It is made for players of all ages who enjoy sorting puzzles.
whiskers-adventures: Guide a clever cat through a series of 3D puzzle levels in this mobile adventure. Each stage is packed with obstacles, challenges, and rewards to collect along the way. Its engaging scenery invites you to explore new worlds, where you work toward goals while enjoying its distinctive graphics and sound effects.

Getting started is simple: click or tap to play. Press Q and E to rotate, and use W, A, S, and D to move your feline around. The casual pace and block-based puzzles make this cat-led journey easy to pick up, with a fresh challenge waiting in every level.
web-shoot-1: Web Shoot +1 is a 3D arcade game that mixes obby, running, and idle play. Each time you move, your speed rises by one point, and you pick up extra web shooters to swing around. Train to build your pace, unlock new suits, and gain improved web shooters that carry you farther and faster through the air.

Higher speed lets you finish challenges more quickly. Race friends or other players, then check the leaderboards to see who holds the top spot on the server. Be careful, though: one misstep can wipe out your progress and send you back to the start.
your-queen-destiny: Step into a regal world where you uncover the royal persona within you. A series of questions reveals which queenly traits define you, so every answer shapes your final identity.

Along the way, you gain access to a large collection of outfits that can be combined in countless ways. Part fashion show and part strategy, the game asks you to weigh both style and planning. Because each run can turn out differently, you can reshape your royal destiny again and again.
merge-cats-2048: Merge Cats: 2048! has a sweet, cozy feel. Cat-themed balls drop into a play zone, and any two of the same kind join together when they touch. Your goal is to link as many as you can to create the largest cat possible while collecting points. You can also compete with friends and coworkers, and a leaderboard lets you aim for the top spot.

At the start, pairing the cat balls is easy. Over time, though, more and more of them appear, so the zone fills up and takes more care to manage. It is a relaxing puzzle that rewards patient, thoughtful play.
fruit-merge-mania: In this relaxing 2D puzzle game, cute vegetables drop into a box, combine with their twins, and grow into bigger ones. Smooth physics keeps the action flowing, and each merge feels satisfying. Your aim is to drop vegetables with care, pair up the matching ones, and keep merging until you reach the biggest of them all, the Pumpkin.

Move your mouse to line up each vegetable, then click or tap to let it fall. Think ahead about where it will land, since good placement is what keeps the space open. Watch the box closely and don't let it overflow. Plan your drops wisely and aim for a high score.
crazy-bus-station: Crazy Bus Station! lets you drive buses through bright, colorful parking lots, where you work through tricky puzzles and help passengers reach their own cars. Each level presents a fresh set of challenges to figure out. Along the way you can collect a range of stylish, distinctive vehicles, including cars, taxis, and buses. The game suits all ages, with stages that run from easy to advanced. Its graphics are cheerful and immersive, filled with appealing cars and characters.

The goal is to match every car with its passenger and clear the lot. Clicking a car sends it moving in the direction of the arrow, but only if its path is free. If the way is blocked, the car stays where it is. When a level becomes difficult, you can use two helpers: a queue sorting booster and a car shuffling booster.
fast-ball-jump: Guide your ball through colorful three-dimensional obstacle courses in Fast Ball Jump. Success depends on rolling with precision, grabbing coins along the way, and knocking down pins when you reach the finish line. Short play sessions make it easy to pick up and put down, and you can earn rewards and personalize your ball. Staying balanced is the key to keeping your run smooth from start to end.
city-driver-destroy-car: Set loose in a large metropolis, you take part in a demolition-style contest where smashing vehicles is the whole point. Slam into other cars, cause heavy damage, and collect money for every spectacular crash you pull off. Your car can be reset as many times as you like, so you can keep causing mayhem without ever facing real penalties.

Wander the streets to find different events and take on missions that test your control behind the wheel. Every run helps you sharpen your driving skills, while the city's roads serve as the battlefield for the whole experience.
draw-bridge-puzzle: Draw Bridge Puzzle asks you to think carefully and test how well you solve problems. Your job is to sketch routes that let a car cross hazards and arrive where it needs to go. Each attempt is a bit like building a bridge, and the goal is to draw roads that rescue the car that has become stuck.

Follow the on-screen instructions to learn how drawing works before you start. The game is filed under Racing and is tagged with car, draw, physics, and puzzle, so expect physics to shape how your roads behave under the vehicle.
moto-x3m-halloween: Climb aboard a motorbike in this racing game packed with wild stunts, lethal obstacles, and crashes that go off with a bang. Challenges are spread across a range of levels, and the high speeds make every ride thrilling yet risky. The whole experience is built around these bold, fast-paced moments.

This special Spooky Land edition gives the bike stunt action a Halloween twist, and it is the sixth entry in the Moto X3M series. Your bike is steered with the arrow keys, so you can focus on timing your jumps and staying upright. Moto X3M 6 Spooky Land offers a spooky spin on high-speed bike stunts.
bloxdhop: BloxdHop is a parkour game where you move through detailed worlds, running and leaping across tricky obstacles while working past any fear of falling. Along the way you collect gold and can improve your avatar's agility to make jumps easier. An built-in chat lets you talk with other players. The goal is to learn every move and control well enough to reach the top of the rankings.

Because the description gives no separate instructions, the controls are not spelled out here, so you will pick up how to sprint and jump as you play. Expect plenty of challenging routes that reward careful timing and steady practice. It is a fun pick for anyone who enjoys skill-based platforming in the Arcade category.
bus-simulator-game-2026: Take the wheel of a large bus in this 2026 title, where your route runs over uneven ground and patches of mud. If you enjoy driving games and want something different, this one may suit you. Each stage brings its own mix of adventure and new challenges as you cross hills, dirt tracks, and rocky trails.

The surfaces are far from smooth, so you need to steer carefully to avoid tipping over or crashing. Watch for obstacles and avoid hitting them as you go. Press W or the Up Arrow to move forward, S or the Down Arrow to move back, A or the Left Arrow to move left, and D or the Right Arrow to move right. Use the mouse to click any button.
cliff-crash: Cliff Crash sends your car racing down a steep hill toward the finish line. Your aim is to reach that line while leaving as much blast and wreckage behind you as possible. The game is listed under arcade and carries tags such as driving, action, 3D, car, and funny.

Use the arrow keys or WASD to steer your car and control its flight through the air. Press E to set off an explosion whenever you want to cause some destruction. Press Space to use nitro and give your car a burst of speed on the way down.
pixel-differences: Pixel Differences is a puzzle game that tests your observation skills. You are shown two pictures that appear nearly the same, but each one holds items that do not match the other. Your job is to find every one of them. A counter at the top of the screen shows how many items you still need to find, so you always know how much is left.

To play, simply click or tap on the spots where you notice a difference. Because the two images look so alike, it helps to scan each side slowly and compare small areas one at a time. The game suits anyone who enjoys hidden object challenges or calm brain teasers that reward patience and sharp eyes.
real-car-parking-and-stunt: Real Car Parking And Stunt is a challenging driving simulation game that puts you in control of a car. Your parking and stunt abilities get tested here. Before you begin, choose either stunt mode or parking mode, since each one gives your driving a different focus.

Every level sets a goal: park your car accurately while you perform stunts along the way. Doing both at the same time is what makes each stage demanding. To play, use a mouse click or tap, and you are ready to start driving.
hidden-objects-recipe-collection: This hidden object puzzle asks you to rely on sharp eyes and careful looking. You step into a warm kitchen filled with many items tucked between pots, plates, mugs, and spices. Your goal is to spot every listed item as fast as you can to earn the highest score. Some things are only partly visible or resemble their neighbors, so take your time.
hole-feast: Guide a glowing hole across bright, low-poly scenes like picnics, cities, and farms. You can move it by dragging anywhere on the screen, or by using WASD or the arrow keys. Anything smaller than your hole drops in and makes it grow, so snacks, cars, cows, and whole buildings disappear as you get bigger. Chain quick gulps together to build combos, and watch out for larger holes that could swallow you.

Each round lasts 90 seconds against three rival holes, and you can try to outgrow them all. You can also aim to clear 100% of the map. Swallow smaller rivals, avoid bigger ones, and finish first or clear the map to earn coins. Spend those coins on upgrades to your starting size, speed, and time, and unlock eight rim skins to change how your hole looks.
tanks-battle-royale: Tanks Battle Royale puts you in control of a tank for fierce, tactical showdowns. As the playing area steadily shrinks, you need to steer around the map while picking up strong loot. Staying one step ahead of your rivals matters just as much as firepower, so keep your wits sharp.

Improve your arsenal and change your approach whenever the situation calls for it. The goal is simple: be the last tank left rolling. The game blends action and survival, so every match asks you to fight hard and think carefully.
knight-launch: Knight Launch puts you behind a trebuchet, where you choose the moment to let go and hurl your knight skyward. Haystacks bounce you back up, cows send you ricocheting, and powder kegs can be blasted mid-air. Once airborne, open your royal cape to drift even farther. Every meter pays out gold.

Spend that gold between launches on a heavier counterweight, polished armor, more kegs or a longer-lasting cape. Your route runs from the Castle through the Village, Dark Forest, Mountains, Frozen Peaks and Dragon Lands to the Edge of the World. Launch by holding and releasing with a mouse, touch or Space, timing it in the gold zone for a PERFECT shot. Tap in the air to blast a keg, hold to glide, and press R or the restart button to start over.
connect-line: Connect Line asks you to turn small line segments until they all join into one continuous network. Every piece has to meet its neighbors so that no loose ends remain. The look is simple, which makes it easy to start, but the challenge builds as the board fills with more pieces, a wider mix of shapes, and trickier connections to work out.

Clicking a piece rotates it, usually by a quarter turn, though some pieces may use another fixed step. Turning one segment can change how it meets several neighbors, so you often need to think a few moves ahead. Segments may be straight, curved or other shapes, but they all share the same goal of forming a single unbroken structure.
draw-save-puzzles: Draw Save Puzzles is a creative puzzle game in which you sketch lines or shapes to lead a Stickman to safety. Every stage brings a different obstacle, so you will need to think ahead and use your problem-solving skills. There are plenty of levels to work through, and your goal is to finish them all.
Playing is simple: tap the screen or click with your mouse to draw. Take your time with each puzzle, experiment with different routes, and see how far your logic can take you. Good luck!
red-coloring-book: Red Coloring Book is a drawing game where you color in your favorite cartoons. Its palette is built around shades of red, so every finished picture takes on that bold, warm look. Working within one color family pushes you to be inventive, and the results are lively, dynamic images that stand out.

The game is intuitive, which makes it a good fit for young artists who are just getting started. It also sharpens how closely you notice small details as you work through each part of a picture. Whether you are a beginner or simply enjoy coloring, it offers a fun way to spend time creating.
ragdoll-runner-run-but-don-t-break: Ragdoll Runner pits a floppy, accident-prone stickman against a rival in lively 3D races. Your goal is to dodge hazards, get past every barrier, and cross the finish line before your opponent to claim the championship. Along the way, you can grab bonus pickups. Because the body follows ragdoll physics, the tumbles and mishaps are often amusing to watch.

This free online casual race includes many levels packed with traps and obstacles, plus a leaderboard where you can compare your results. On a PC, hold the left mouse button to start running and move the mouse left or right to steer. On mobile devices, tap the screen to run and swipe
perfect-car-parking: Perfect Car Parking is a racing game built around careful driving. You steer a range of different vehicles through detailed levels, and each small movement tests how accurately you can park. The game aims for sharp visuals and believable handling, so every turn and stop feels grounded.

Success here depends on patience and paying close attention to your surroundings. The puzzles grow more involved as you move forward, asking you to read each layout before you act. If you enjoy slow, precise parking challenges that reward a steady hand, this one offers plenty to work through.
alex-whiskers: Step into the paws of Alex Whiskers, an adventurous town cat on the hunt for tasty fish. He races down crowded streets, bounces up high on springs, and weaves past speeding cars. Watch out for the big, mean bulldogs that would love to bring him to a halt. Nimble paws and sharp reflexes are his best tools in this 3D adventure.

Controls are simple. Use the arrow keys or WASD to move, slide the mouse left or right to look around, and press the spacebar to jump. A controller works too, handling movement, the camera, and jumping.
search-the-needle: Dig through an enormous haystack to track down one hidden needle. Gather straw until your bag is full, then bring it to Clara the chicken for cash. Along the way you can turn up rare straw and crystals, and spend your earnings on better tools and a larger bag so each search goes faster. A drone helper is also waiting to be unlocked.

Controls depend on your device. On a computer, use WASD to move, the mouse to look around, and hold the left button to collect. On a phone or tablet, use the floating joystick to move, drag your finger to look, and aim at straw to gather it automatically. Find the needle and you win the ranch's $1,000 in-game prize.
modern-sniper-gun-game-sniper-3d: Step into the role of a marksman who perches on rooftops and picks off enemies below. This 3D title is built around missions, challenges, and headshots. Each level in the city is packed with danger and fun, so you need to stay alert while you line up your rifle.

Take your time with every shot and keep your aim steady, because each mission calls for precise hits. The controls feel smooth and the gameplay is easy to pick up, while realistic effects make the whole experience feel real. Move with W, A, S, and D or the arrow keys, and use the mouse to click any button.
save-kitten: This is a rescue mission where you bounce on a trampoline to catch falling kittens before the clock runs out. Move through a colorful tower and personalize your hero's look as you go. Dodge bombs along the way, and pick up boosters and coins whenever you can.

Quick reflexes and smart planning are essential if you want to fill your basket with rescued cats. Every strong run can lift your name higher on the competitive leaderboard, so aim for a top spot. Keep an eye on the clock as you chase each kitten, because every second counts.
jungle-fury-mutant-rhino-mayhem: A tribal warrior sets out to clear a jungle overrun by mutant rhinos. Your mission is to free captured villagers, fight through hostile foes such as Rhino Brutes and Vampire Bats, and bring down massive rhino bosses. Twenty stages lead you through murky swamps, winding caves, and walled fortifications, and the final showdown is with the Apex Mutant
piano-kids-music-songs: Piano Kids , Music & Songs is a music box built for children and their parents. It helps little ones learn to play instruments, enjoy catchy tunes, hear a range of sounds, and build their musical ability. Players touch the screen with their fingers to make music on bright, colorful instruments, including a kids' xylophone, drum kit, piano, saxophone, trumpet, flute, and electric guitar. It runs on a phone or tablet, so kids can make music wherever they are.
Toddlers and older kids alike will enjoy sitting down to learn these instruments, which play with realistic sounds. Controls are simple: just tap or click to play.
noobik-parkour-in-a-cave: Noobik Parkour in a Cave! challenges you with 10 tough levels. Your goal in each one is to reach the finish line while getting past a range of obstacles and steering clear of traps along the way. On a phone, use the touch joystick on the left side of the screen to move, drag on the right side to turn the camera, and tap the button in the lower right corner to jump. On a computer, move with WASD, jump with Space, rotate the view with the mouse, and press Escape to open the pause menu.
slope-racing: Slope Racing is an addictive hyper casual racing game. You drive your car down a variety of slopes, collecting coins along the way. Those coins let you buy new cars or new surroundings, such as a desert. Its mix of racing and adventure makes it a title you can keep coming back to.

Steering works through the keyboard. Use W, A, S, and D or the arrow keys to move the car. These simple controls let you handle the changing slopes while you chase the coins you need for your next purchase.
paint-and-escape: Paint & Escape blends neon-lit stealth with action. Slip past watchful guards, lay down your graffiti artwork on the glowing spot, and make a getaway before anyone grabs you. Each stage takes place in a newly built house, school, museum or arcade, and the guards grow sharper as you progress. Keep an eye out for security cameras, guard dogs and armored guards.

You can splat guards with paint bombs, taunt them with dance moves, and collect spray cans to reach 3 stars. Unlock upgrades, outfits and hats, and return each day for gifts, quests and trophies. Movement uses WASD or the arrow keys, SPACE, E or F throws a paint bomb at a nearby guard, T dances, and ES
masquerades-vs-impostors: Your goal in this 2D arcade adventure is to help a character wearing a red and blue mask escape from a spaceship. You can play alone or team up with a friend in two-player mode. Impostors wearing red masks are the only ones who can kill red characters, and impostors wearing blue masks are the only ones who can kill blue characters. Anyone can also kill their own color.

Zombies are also out to get you, so you need to defeat them too. Move with WASD or the arrow keys, and double jump is available when you need it. Jumping on an enemy takes it out. Mobile players can use touch controls instead.
candy-sweet: Candy Sweet is a match-3 puzzle game where you swap and line up tasty treats. Each successful match sets off its own captivating effects, adding a fun layer to every move. Your aim is to plan ahead and build explosive combos. The levels vary from one another, so you will need to rethink your approach and find clever moves as you go.

Think of it as a puzzle adventure set in a bright, candy-coated world full of cheerful colour. Its gameplay is genuinely absorbing, so a single session can stretch on far longer than you expect. For anyone who loves puzzles that keep pulling them back in, this one offers plenty to hold your attention.
zombie-hell-shooter: Zombie Hell Shooter is a shooting game set in a brutal, ruined city. You have already fought hard to get this far, but the streets are still packed with mindless horrors, and getting out is far from certain. There is simply no other option. You have to keep going, and your weapon is the only thing standing between you and death.

Controls are simple: tap to shoot. Every shot counts when you are surrounded, so stay focused and keep firing your way through the chaos. With enough determination, you will make it through this ordeal.
jelly-bottle-sort: Jelly Bottle Sort is a puzzle game where your job is to move colorful jelly from one bottle to another. The aim is to end up with every filled bottle holding just one color. There are 500 puzzles to work through, and you can earn stars when you finish a level in fewer moves. If a level becomes tricky, you can ask for a hint, add an extra bottle, or skip a level by spending one star.

To pour, tap a bottle and then tap either an empty bottle or one whose top layer matches the color you picked up. Undo and Restart are there if you change your mind or want a fresh attempt. On a computer, the arrow keys move focus between controls, and the Space bar selects a bottle or completes a pour. The game is available in 10 languages.
school-stories-teacher-sim: Step into the role of a teacher in School Stories: Teacher Sim, a high school game built around running a classroom and the wider school day. You design the look of your own teacher character, then keep students in line by catching clever cheaters who hide phones or notes. Grading papers is part of the job too, so you will need to stay on top of your work.

Beyond the classroom, you can explore art rooms, basketball courts, and swimming pools, and join mini games that reflect different sides of school life. Fans of teacher and school simulators should find plenty to enjoy, since the game tests how well you manage people and tasks. Pass levels to move forward and unlock new activities. Controls are simple: use a mouse click or a tap.
style-senpai-anime-dress-up: In this anime fashion game, build your ideal look, then prove your taste in style contests. The wardrobe holds over 350 clothes, accessories and face options, from hairstyles, tops and skirts to wings, glasses, chokers, gloves and hairpins. Recolor hair and clothing from a large palette, pick a skin tone, adjust eyes, brows and lips, and place your character against a dreamy backdrop.

Press VS to enter a fashion battle. You get a theme, build your outfit step by step, and the crowd scores it against a rival stylist. Victories raise your place in the stylist ranking, unlock new items and earn hear
speed-pool-king: Speed Pool King is a billiards game built around precise play and clever planning, with you facing a rival across the same table. Your mouse moves the cue, so you can line up each stroke and study the angles before committing. Easy-to-read indicator lines help you judge where the ball will travel, and when the
the-adventures-of-big-joe: Big Joe is a pirate, and you guide him through a fun adventure set on sunny sandy beaches. He carries an old shovel and has to dig up buried treasure chests and unusual artifacts hidden deep under the sand. The story is light and funny, so expect a few silly moments along the way.

To move Joe, use the WASD keys, the arrow keys, or the on-screen joystick. You can shift the view of the map with WASD, the arrow keys, or the mouse cursor. When you stop somewhere, Joe starts digging the ground close by. Clear all the ground in a level to finish it.
my-little-park-3d: Start with a bare patch of land and shape it into a busy amusement park in this 3D idle tycoon game. You guide your character across the grounds, clearing the land and opening up new areas as you go. Put the money you earn into new rides such as swings and carousels, plus upgrades that improve the park's infrastructure.

Visitors arrive, enjoy the attractions, and buy treats, which generates income for you. A better park draws more guests and helps you unlock new opportunities faster. Movement uses a virtual joystick on both desktop and mobile. Walk up to trees, construction zones, upgrades, or income collection points, and the required actions happen automatically. Your aim is to build every attraction and turn a modest park into a well-liked destination full of happy guests.
fly-airplane-3d: Pilot a plane through a three-dimensional sky in this arcade flyer. Your goal is to gather rubies, diamonds, stars and fuel. The player who collects the greatest number of these items is declared the winner. Watch out for clouds, because each collision drains your fuel, and once the tank runs dry the game ends.
The scenery is lovely to look at, and the 3D view makes every flight feel lively. Steering is simple: press the spacebar, tap the touch screen, or click the mouse to make your aircraft climb.
merge-racer-stunts-car: Merge Racer - Stunts Car is an arcade racing game built around your driving skills. Its main feature is merging: joining cars of the same type creates stronger racing machines, and the end goal is a supercar. Each merge gives you a more powerful vehicle to show what you can do behind the wheel.

The game is played with a mouse click or a tap, so you only need one hand and a single input to get going. It belongs to the car, machine, racing and skills categories, and it suits anyone who enjoys car games and skill-based driving. Whether you want to build the most powerful machine or simply enjoy the stunts, the merging system gives every session a new direction.
circle-zombie: In Circle Zombie, you steer a leaping circle through a fast arcade challenge where accuracy and timing decide how far you get. Your task is to outwit undead obstacles along the way while learning the rhythm of each jump until you can time your leaps with confidence.

The graphics are minimalist, which keeps your focus on the jumps themselves. As you progress, the tension steadily rises, so every leap carries more pressure. Your results can be compared with players around the world on a global leaderboard, giving you a clear goal to keep sharpening your skills.
triangle-way: Triangle Way puts you in charge of a glowing neon plane that flies through arcade-style skies. Bright, colorful visuals and constantly changing obstacles test how quickly you can react. As the game gets harder over time, you need to stay sharp, weaving past enemy aircraft while grabbing power-ups that can be used tactically.

Your main aim is to rack up a high score, so every run is a chance to beat your last one. The loop is simple to pick up but tends to keep you coming back for another attempt. It suits quick sessions or longer stretches of play, and it fits neatly into the hyper casual category.
crazy-runner-boy: Crazy Runner Boy is an arcade game where you dodge obstacles and pull off bold flips. Speed matters most here. You run through a colorful world that keeps moving faster and faster. Quick reactions and smooth, nimble moves help you grab coins and push your score higher.

Every run gets more intense as the pace picks up. Stay sharp, time your jumps well, and keep the momentum going. The game is built around fast reflexes, so it rewards players who can stay focused as the action heats up.
amazing-sheriff: Step into the boots of a bold lawman who leaps from one rotating planetoid to the next in this offbeat space romp. Grabbing coins along the way is part of the fun, but you also have to dodge the hazards floating around each world. Linking several jumps in a row creates combos, so split-second timing matters.

Accuracy is everything here. One misstep and your cosmic quest comes to an end, so take care with every hop. Keep your focus sharp and your timing steady, because a single slip can cut the adventure short.
inkway: Inkway is a puzzle game where you sketch a road so a car can reach its target. Your job is to plan a route that gets the vehicle to the winning spot without running into obstacles or entering hazardous zones. Once you've finished drawing, the car sets off along the path you made. Keep an eye on your design, since a badly planned road may send the car into a crash or leave it stuck partway.

To play, just draw a line across the screen from the starting point to the finish. The line becomes the road, and the car will drive along it. It takes a bit of creativity and forward thinking to find a route that works, and that mix of imagination and logic is what makes each attempt feel rewarding.
chess-tactics: Chess Tactics blends chess-style turn play with shooting in a roguelike format. You command a single king equipped with strong guns, slide across the board, anticipate where enemies will strike, and wipe out hostile pieces. Each chamber gets harder than the last, and between runs you can open new weapons and pick upgrades, so every attempt can feel like a different plan.

To clear a chamber, remove every enemy piece on the board, then head onward. Your king moves by clicking or tapping a glowing square, or with WASD or the arrow keys. To shoot, select a target and click it again or press Space. R reloads your weapon, and Shift triggers a dash. Each move, shot, or reload uses up a turn, so study the enemy threats and think ahead before acting.
cannon-shot-online: In Cannon Shot Online, each stage is cleared by filling every bucket with balls. Instead of aiming straight, you move the various objects around the field to redirect where your shots go. Planning ahead matters, since every placement changes how the balls travel.

Completing levels unlocks new cannons, so each stage you clear gives you more options. The game is controlled with a mouse or by touch. Aim smart and think each shot through before you fire, because a new cannon may approach the challenges in a different way.
lost-adventure-new: A hypercasual adventure begins when a plane goes down in mid-air and scatters its passengers across an unfamiliar, wild land. You play the pilot, who must gather materials from the wreckage, build tools, mine resources, and solve puzzles while pushing through tall grass to reach people stranded on small islands.

Your goal is to bring everyone back together and find a way out of this strange world before the dangers hidden in the wilderness close in. On a computer, press W or the Up Arrow to move forward, S or the Down Arrow to move backward, and A or D, or the
kids-flurry-educational-puzzle-game: Kids Flurry Educational Puzzle sends players off on a detective-style adventure. The goal is to find animals hidden inside detailed patterns. Along the way, young players build their logic and observation skills. Bright, colorful graphics and challenges that grow harder as you go keep things interesting. To uncover the secrets, you look for subtle shifts in color and oddly shaped forms. It is designed as a learning experience that suits curious young minds.
ultimate-knockout-race: Stay on your feet and knock rivals off one at a time. You are up against 29 other players, and the aim is to keep your footing on the platform while everyone else tumbles away. This physics-driven free-for-all is messy and unpredictable, so every shove counts. Clear out opponents to move on to the next stage, take first place in each race, and claim the crown as the last one standing.

Move with WASD or the arrow keys, and press Space to jump. Matches run online with other people, so you will be competing live against a crowded field. Expect plenty of silly moments as bodies bounce and collide across each course. It is built for quick, lighthearted rounds where one wrong step can end your run.
bike-mania-2: Bike Mania 2 is a sports game built around careful, precise riding over many kinds of ground. Across 20 levels, you ride through different terrains while working to keep your bike balanced and under control. Obstacles appear along the way, so every run calls for careful thought and steady control.

It has the feel of the classic Flash games many players remember fondly. Progress comes from planning each route step by step rather than rushing through it. Patience and good technique are what carry you through the harder parts and lead to a win.
bullets-master: Bullets Master is a puzzle shooter where you need both accuracy and planning. You take the role of an assassin with exceptional gun handling, facing dangerous foes in physics-driven gunfights. Your surroundings matter here: ricochet shots off walls, set off explosive traps, and take enemies down in flashy ways.
You aim with the mouse and fire with a click. Think through each shot before you take it, because the angles and the environment decide how the round plays out.
sigma-boy-musical-clicker: Sigma Boy's free online clicker sends you on a beat-driven trip through varied scenery, from sandy deserts all the way out to space. Each tap earns points, and you can spend those points on upgrades that strengthen his skills. The game works across different devices, so you can take on its challenges wherever you happen to be.

Keep the rhythm going and guide Sigma Boy toward success. Music is at the center of the experience, so every tap is tied to the beat. Build up his abilities as the landscapes shift around him, and enjoy a clicker that puts the rhythm front and center.
army-commander: Army Commander puts you in charge of a military campaign played out across a battlefield. Your job is to collect troops and upgrade them over time, building up a strong force made of tanks, bazookas, and planes. You can predict when reinforcements will arrive and use them to outmaneuver your opponents. Each decision you make can tip the fight in your direction, so think carefully about where and when to strike.

The game rewards careful planning more than quick reflexes. Watch how the front line develops, decide which units to improve, and push your army toward a win. Success depends on steady command and making the right call at the right moment.
paper-flight-2: Paper Flight 2 is a casual clicker where you throw a paper plane and try to send it as far as possible. Each launch lets you upgrade your plane's speed and strength, so every flight can travel a little farther than the last. Collect rewards along the way and aim for the best score to show off your skill.

Your journey takes the plane around the world, from the wealthy streets of uptown London to a romantic garden in Paris and more. The farther you go, the more danger you meet, including polluted gas clouds, toy airplanes, and a UFO. Use your mouse or touch screen to control the launch and keep pushing forward.
mahjong-tide: Mahjong Tide is a take on mahjong solitaire, with traditional artwork sitting behind each board. Your job is to pair up identical tiles that you can reach until the whole layout is gone. A tile counts as reachable when nothing rests on top of it and either its left or right edge is open. Any two flowers form a pair, and any two seasons do too.

You can choose from four ways to play: an endless Flow mode, a single daily puzzle that everyone shares, a 55-stop trip along Japan's old Tokaido road, and Free Play, which offers hundreds of layouts. Paintings unlock as you progress. Every deal is built from a known solution, so each board can be finished. Quick successive matches build a chain, and hints and undo help when you get stuck. Use a mouse on a computer, or your finger on a phone or tablet.
gusano-io-worms-snake-game: Gusano.io drops you into a colorful arena where your worm keeps getting longer. You gobble up treats scattered across the field while trying to stay ahead of rival players. Strategy matters here, and the challenges grow as you go, so it pays to plan a few moves ahead.

Combat plays a big role. You can unleash attacks on opponents, slip past them unseen, and work your way toward conquering the battlefield. You can also customize the look of your snake, and the controls feel smooth from start to finish. The blend of classic snake ideas and newer twists should keep fans entertained for a long time.
evil-granny-city-terror: You are stuck in a city and need to get out. To do it, you must track down and collect eight keys. Evil Granny and her puppets are hunting through the city, so the job is harder than it sounds. This browser game mixes adventure, escape, and zombie shooting, and you can rely on a variety of weapons along the way.

Move with W, A, S, and D, and turn your view with the mouse. Left-click to fire and right-click to aim. Scroll the mouse wheel to switch weapons, press G for grenades, R to reload, and F to pick up items. Hold Left Shift to run.
robot-terminator-t-rex: Robot Terminator T-Rex sends you into a wild world where mechanical dinosaurs and undead zombies clash in an intense fight. You take command of a robotic Tyrannosaurus rex that carries strong weapons and a set of useful skills to help you survive the chaos.

Playing is simple: click the mouse or tap the screen to act. This arcade battle game focuses on fast action and robot combat, so stay alert and keep fighting as the clash unfolds. The game carries battle and robot themes, so you know what to expect from the start.
heroes-of-arena: Heroes of Arena puts you in a world where anyone can step up and act as a hero. You can battle alongside friends, grow your character's power, collect pets, and take part in clan wars. Expect plenty of adventures and risky encounters along the way. Shape a one-of-a-kind hero by picking the path you want to follow, then sharpen its skills and abilities as you go.
Team up with friends to form strong groups and take down foes. Your main aims are to rise to
nitro-racing-gear: Nitro Racing Gear is an arcade racer built around high speed. Its 40 stages span eight worlds, taking you along coastal highways, neon-lit cities, snowy mountains, and volcanic roads. You can enter races, sprints, drift challenges, and drag duels, working your way toward the final championship.

Between events, the garage lets you unlock new cars and upgrade their performance. Nitro boosts give you a burst of speed when you need to catch up. The game features lifelike 3D-rendered artwork, distinctive tracks, and an energetic soundtrack. Use W or Up to accelerate, S or Down to brake, and A and D or the Left and Right arrows to steer. Space triggers nitro in race and drift modes and shifts gears in drag mode, while N also activates nitro. Press Esc or P to pause. Touch controls are available on mobile, and landscape mode is recommended.
phone-case-diy: Phone Case DIY is a hypercasual game where you design your own phone case. You can add a range of customizing touches to give your handset a more glamorous look, and the whole idea is to let your imagination run wild with color. Every change you make helps your phone look bright, stylish, and attractive.

The controls are simple, and you play with a mouse or a single click. Choose the elements you like, add them to your phone, and watch it come alive with color. It is a playful way to make your device feel cool and beautiful.
one-level-stickman-jailbreak: Tommy has landed in a tough spot, locked up in a prison cell. He has no intention of serving a long sentence, so he sets his mind on breaking out. Early on, he manages to swipe a key, which unlocks the door and lets him slip out of his confinement. Winning his freedom, however, means working through brainy challenges, and that is where you come in as the one helping him.

This single-player adventure combines an escape theme with jumping and puzzle-solving. Play with the keyboard, or tap the on-screen buttons if you are on a phone or tablet. Either way, you guide Tommy through each puzzle until he is free.
capybas: Capybas is a relaxed logic puzzler that mixes the reasoning of Minesweeper with the rule-driven approach of Sudoku. Your job is to track down capybaras hidden on the board, using hints tied to colored zones, rows, columns, and neighboring squares. Pick Easy, Medium, or Hard, then open a board and start working through it. Finishing levels rewards you with coins, which let you unlock fresh capybaras and visual themes as you advance.

Each colored zone contains exactly one capybara, and no row or column may hold more than one. Capybaras can never sit next to each other, diagonals included. Tap a square once to mark it with an X if you believe it's empty, or double tap it if you think a capybara is there. Locate every capybara before your lives run out.
ticktock-puzzle-challenge: TickTock Puzzle Challenge asks you to beat the clock while you exercise your mind. The game is built to sharpen your creativity and your problem-solving skills. You can pick a classic level or switch to challenge mode, and every puzzle has its own twist that calls for fast thinking, clear logic, and a bit of imagination. Expect familiar styles such as classic mazes and line-drawing games, among others.

Controls are simple: just click with your mouse or tap your screen to play. Whether you are warming up with a relaxed level or pushing yourself through a timed challenge, the game keeps the pace lively and the puzzles fresh. It is a playful pick for anyone who enjoys brain teasers, drawing-based challenges, or a good dose of humor along the way.
stick-hero-tower-defense: Take on the role of a brave stickman in this tower defense game that blends action with strategy. Combat runs on drag-and-drop controls, and you'll need smart tactics to outwit your enemies. Gathering allies gives you extra power, so you can strengthen your side as the fight goes on.

Expect dangerous clashes with monstrous bosses that you must defeat to come out ahead. Stick Hero Tower Defense is filed under Action and tagged Fighting, and it mixes hands-on combat with careful planning from start to finish.
granny-returns-haunted-house: This 3D horror title picks up where the well-known Granny series left off. Blending escape, shooting, and item collection, it drops you into an abandoned asylum where you must use clues to finish your goals and stay alive. They can find you at any moment, so you need to keep moving. If you run short on time, you can hide in a closet and stay quiet until the danger passes.

Movement uses W, A, S, and D, while the mouse lets you look around. Left click fires, right click aims, and the mouse wheel changes weapons. Press G for grenades, R to reload, and F to pick up items. Hold Left Shift to run, Left Ctrl to crouch, and X to go prone. Use V for melee attacks and Space to jump.
washing-toilets: Grime rules this cleaning game, and every dirty spot is waiting for you to step in. Pick up scattered trash, scrub away messy patches, and turn grimy places into gleaming rooms. Your goal is to tidy up every corner, and each finished stage pays you money as you move forward through the levels.

Controls are kept simple. On a computer, press W, A, S, and D to move your character. On a phone or tablet, tap the screen and steer with the joystick. The game offers different locations to clean, a satisfying cleaning process, and many levels to work through.
gn-ninja-run: Ninja Run puts you in control of a ninja who leaps across wooden bridges while gathering coins and avoiding bombs. The further you travel, the higher your score climbs. It belongs to the Adventure category and features click-based play with a ninja theme.
To play, simply press or touch the screen to make your ninja jump. Keep your timing sharp so you can reach new distances and build up your total. Enjoy your time with the game.
skip-love: Skip Love is a puzzle game with a playful take on romance. You guide a small stickman who is determined to win over the one he adores, and he must slip past many hazards along the way. Each stage presents its own brain-bending puzzle, so you will need to think carefully while also chuckling at the silly situations. The hero also has to get around his wife and her lover, which calls for some clever schemes. Try disguising him as a clown, causing confusion, or stirring up chaos to get ahead.

Controls are simple: click or tap with your mouse or finger to play. The game blends adventure, humor, and a good mental workout in one lighthearted package. Think ahead, experiment with different ideas, and see which approach brings the stickman closest to his goal.
baby-hazel-bathroom-hygiene: Baby Hazel needs your help keeping her bathroom in good shape while she learns the basics of hygiene. Each task is interactive and played with simple point-and-click controls, so young players can get started right away. A bright, cheerful mood keeps the whole experience light as you work through each job.

Along the way, you guide Hazel through cleaning, clearing a clogged drain, and scrubbing away dirt. Every step aims to stop germs before they spread, so the game also works as a gentle lesson in staying clean. It is designed as an engaging learning experience for young children who are just starting to understand why washing and tidying matter.
street-freekick-3d: Step into the shoes of a street soccer player in Street Freekick 3D, a 3D sports game built around free kicks. Your job is to time each strike so the ball gets past the goalkeeper. Along the way you will need to get around tricky obstacles, and every accurate kick earns you points.
The game is set in street-style matches where you chase glory with soccer action. It is free to play and quite addictive, so it is easy to keep coming back for more.
funny-rescue-carpenter: Leia is a skilled carpenter who has been hurt in an accident, and it's up to you to help her get back on her feet. Your job is to tend to her injuries, then have fun picking out stylish outfits for her. The game mixes creative dress-up play with simulation-style tasks, so each new step brings something to do.

Tending to Leia's wounds is one part of the fun, while choosing her looks is the other. Switching between caring for her and dressing her up keeps the pace lively from start to finish. It's a relaxed pick for anyone who enjoys nurturing a character and then showing off her wardrobe.
evil-granny-must-die-ch1: Granny has knocked you down, and now she has tossed you into her bunker. You know where she lives, but you can't leave the house. To escape alive, you must track down 8 books. It's a shooting game that mixes action, collecting, and escape, with zombies and plenty of weapons along the way.

Move with W, A, S, and D, and look around with the mouse. Left-click to fire and right-click to aim. Scroll the mouse wheel to change weapons, press G for grenades, R to reload, and F to pick up items. Hold Left Shift to run and Left Ctrl to crouch.
trick-or-treat-candy-carnival: Step into a moonlit Halloween fair hosted by Count Boo and his monster pals. Seven different games are waiting for you: popping ghosts, assembling 24 jigsaw pictures with 4, 9, 16 or 25 interlocking pieces, matching pairs, exploring a talking alphabet, catching falling sweets, spotting shadows, and sorting groups of monster faces.

You can keep things relaxed or switch to a harder challenge. Collect candy as you play, unlock four baskets, and fill your collection with 24 cartoon friends. On a computer, click to pop ghosts, flip cards, and choose letters or bubbles, then drag puzzle pieces and the candy basket. Arrow keys or WASD steer the basket and menu cursor, Enter or Space confirm a choice, and Esc pauses. On mobile devices, tap to pop, flip, and select, and drag to move pieces and the basket.
daddy-rabbit: Your job is to lead Daddy Rabbit through a maze hidden underground and bring his little bunnies back to safety. You need to blend careful sneaking with quick reactions. Stay near the young ones, because wandering off can draw the attention of nearby zombies.

Tap controls let you launch carrot punches to deal with the danger. Every baby bunny has to be kept safe along the way. The game pairs cute rabbits with a creepy atmosphere, so it feels both sweet and eerie.
runaway-toad: In this game, you guide a toad trying to slip away from a princess who refuses to give up the chase. Success depends on timing your jumps, since you control how hard each leap is and must steer across dangerous ground. Along the way, you can also feast on flies.

The journey carries you through enchanted landscapes, all aimed at one goal: winning your freedom. As you press on, new toads become available to unlock. Each hop brings you closer to getting away, so think ahead and see how far your jumping skills can take you.
master-of-numbers: Master of Numbers is a quick online puzzle that mixes arithmetic with strategy. Your aim is to reach the finish line while typing the largest number you can manage. Blue numbers smaller than yours can be absorbed to help your total grow, but a red number bigger than yours will wipe out your number and send you back to the start. Levels become harder as you advance, and you can play on either a phone or a computer.

Along the way, you need to avoid electric saws, cross bridges, and leap over ditches. Once you reach the finish line, a large group of walls is waiting for you to smash through. It works as a mental workout that sharpens both your math and your planning.
shape-connect: Shape Connect is a charming little puzzler where children guide two teddy bears toward each other. The road linking them has broken apart, so players must fill each missing section with the correct shape taken from the row along the bottom of the screen. Once every gap is filled properly, the path is whole again, letting the bears cross and finally be together.

Controls are simple. On desktop, use the mouse to click and drag each shape into place on the road. On mobile, touch and drag does the same job. Along the way, young players learn about shapes and practise problem-solving as they work out where each piece belongs.
dinosaur-game: In this endless runner, you guide a brave little dinosaur through a colorful prehistoric world. Ancient landscapes are packed with danger, surprises, and tough challenges. Your aim is to cover as much ground as you can, avoid every obstacle in your path, and keep the run going for as long as possible. As the speed picks up, your reflexes get tested while the scenery rushes past.

Use the arrow keys or swipe to jump over hazards or duck under barriers. Every run feels fresh, whether you want to beat your best distance, collect more coins, or fine-tune your timing to last longer. The controls are easy to learn, so quick casual sessions are simple to start, and the rising difficulty keeps things interesting for players chasing high scores. Choose from Endless, Levels, or Challenges modes.
pull-mermaid-out: A little mermaid is heading home when she tumbles into a lost ancient city. The city has fallen apart, and the only parts still intact are its drainage pipes. Your task is to help her pull out the pins in the correct order so she can continue on her way and stay safe.
battalion-commander-1917: Command your squad through the confusion of World War I in Battalion Commander 1917. The game blends cartoon-style bullet-hell shooting with strategy. You can free fellow soldiers, improve your weapons, and push through enemy trenches on a battlefield that keeps changing. Staying alive depends on fast reactions and careful planning.

Every round asks you to balance aggressive advances with smart positioning, since the frontline never stays the same for long. Your reflexes will be tested as bullets fill the screen, but so will your judgment about when to hold ground and when to strike. It is a shooter for players who enjoy thinking ahead while dodging the chaos.
bee-rise: Bee Rise is an idle game about building a colony around a queen bee. Gather nectar and pollen, then hatch worker bees to haul these resources back to the hive. Train guard bees to defend against wasps and hornets that threaten your home.

Honey pays for upgrades, while quests and daily gifts are also on offer, and prestige lets each fresh colony begin stronger. On a computer, steer the queen with WASD or the arrow keys. On a phone, drag the joystick on screen. Press Space or J, or tap Gather beside a flower, to harvest nectar. Click or tap the tabs and buttons to expand, and press Esc or the gear icon to open Settings.
blocks-shooter-3d-run-shoot-merge-weapon: Blocks Shooter 3D! Run, Shoot, Merge Weapons! is an arcade title for fans of action, shooting, and runner games with a Roblox-like look. You race along a track, pick up weapon pieces, join them together, and take on large groups of stickmen. Traps stand in your path, so you have to dodge them while you keep your guns improving.

The game blends shooting, running, and merging, and every new part you attach makes your weapon stronger. Swipe left or right to steer your hero and destroy enemies along the way, aiming to reach the finish line alive. Foes grow tougher as you advance, so head to the workshop between rounds to refine your gun. It runs online and works on any device.
dr-psycho-hospital-escape: Dr. Psycho - Hospital Escape drops you into a frightening nightmare where your cleverness decides whether you live. You wander a bleak, deserted hospital, slipping past threats that lurk in the shadows. Along the way you gather vital items, and only those can unlock the way out.
You have no weapons at all, so staying hidden and moving quietly becomes your only real defense. Each footstep might be the mistake that ends your run, which keeps
money-fest: Money Fest runs directly in your web browser. Your aim is to grow your cash by picking up coins scattered across the level. Some math operations boost your money, but dividing or subtracting takes it away. If your balance sinks below zero, the game ends, so every step calls for care. Discounts, taxes, and many other ways to gain or lose money can appear along the way.

This 3D hypercasual title rewards careful thinking and quick calculations. Use your mouse or touchpad to play. On desktop, you can also steer with W, A, S, D or the arrow keys. It blends fast action with a bit of brain work, making it an easy pick for a short, fun session.
beauty-salon-and-makeover-game: You run your own hair salon in this simulation title, where every customer arrives with a personality of their own. Some are sweet, some are a little offbeat, and each one has a particular style in mind. Your job is to turn that picture into reality.

Each visit moves through several steps: washing hair, styling it, and then adding jewelry and makeup accessories for a finished look. There is always something to do. The game offers a broad selection of hairstyles and makeup pieces, so you can get creative and shape a look that suits each client individually.
dinoz: Clever dinosaurs that were kept in a research facility for scientific study break out of the lab after a surprising error. During their escape, they take several scientists hostage and head into a forest with them. Along the way, the dinosaurs set up a variety of traps. You can rescue the captives alone in single player, or team up with a friend in 2 player mode.

Player 1 moves with W, A, S and D, strikes with F, drops bombs with H, jumps with W, and switches weapons with Q. Player 2 moves with the arrow keys, strikes with L, drops bombs with J, jumps with the up arrow, and switches weapons with U. Both players can wall jump by pressing W or the up arrow.
asmr-spa: ASMR Spa is a simulation game centered on relaxation and makeovers. You step into a calm, peaceful spa where the focus is on pampering yourself, with treatments meant to feel soft and tranquil. Begin by choosing one of four concepts: Wednesday Makeover, Puppy Rescue and Makeover, Skincare, or Makeup. Each offers its own spa and beauty experience, so you can pick whichever suits your mood.

Once you're inside, explore the spa and settle in with ASMR. Soothing soundscapes and whispers accompany the various experiences you can enjoy. Depending on your choice, you might get a full makeover, rescue and groom adorable puppies, pamper your skin, or let your creativity loose with makeup. Along the way, you can try different hairstyles, colors, and accessories to customize your look.
roller-coaster-simulator: In Roller Coaster Simulator, you take control of rides that wind through beautiful landscapes. Your task is to keep each twisty track balanced while making sure the passengers stay safe. Loops are part of the route, so you will need a steady hand as you guide every run from start to finish.

The worlds are presented in vivid 3D, so the scenery feels full and lively around the track. The gameplay is engaging and pushes your skills further with every attempt, which makes it easy to keep returning for another go.
final-freeway: Final Freeway is a fast-paced racer that brings back the feel of classic 16-bit driving games. You can race across eight varied courses, from sandy deserts to crumbling ruins. The controls feel responsive, and the gameplay stays smooth from start to finish.

The game offers three modes and a difficulty level you can adjust to suit your skill. Its scenery is eye-catching, and both seasoned racers and beginners will find something to enjoy. If you like testing your own limits behind the wheel, this retro-style ride is worth a try.
mathtest22: MathTest22 mixes mental workouts with learning. Each round asks you to work through math puzzles, and the problems get harder the further you progress. You are racing the timer the whole time, so you need to be both careful and quick with your answers.

Over time, the game helps you improve how correct and how fast your answers are, making it a learning experience that's hard to walk away from. It's a good fit for anyone who wants to keep their math skills in shape while still enjoying a rewarding time playing.
arrow-free-3d: Arrow Free 3D is a logic puzzler played on a 3D cube dotted with arrows. Its simple look hides real tactical depth, so each move matters. The game unfolds in a calm, lovely setting built to test your mental agility, your sense of space, and your focus.

To play, spin the cube so you can inspect all six faces. Study how the arrow paths run and think ahead about the chain reactions each tap will set off. Tap the arrows in the right order so they clear without leaving you stuck. Your goal is to remove every arrow on the stage to finish the challenge.
color-tower-2-drop-the-boxes-3d: Stack bright, colorful blocks as high as you can in this three-dimensional arcade title. Your planning and quick reactions both matter, since every drop has to land well if your structure is going to keep rising. The goal is to climb to greater heights and see how your scores compare with players around the world.

The controls feel smooth, and the graphics are bright and eye-catching throughout. Each tower you build ends up looking a bit like a painting in progress, with color layered on top of color. It is a compelling pick for anyone who enjoys the arcade style of challenge.
ghost-runaway: Ghost Runaway is an arcade platformer that sends you across spooky terrain. Quick reactions and clever planning both matter here, since you need to get past hidden threats. The controls are simple to pick up, so you can focus on the action rather than memorizing inputs.

Each stage is packed with obstacles and tricky sections that test your timing. Precision matters at every step, since a small misstep can cost you. Your aim is to flee a closing danger and push forward through each challenge.
parkour-world: Parkour World brings a Minecraft-inspired look to a course of thrilling jumping challenges. Each level has its own distinct layout and features, so every play session feels fresh. The early levels are fairly simple, but after you conquer the first ten, the obstacles become noticeably more demanding. Running and leaping your way forward is the heart of the game.

Controls are straightforward: use W, A, S and D to move, hold Shift to run, and press Space to jump. Press E to open a chest, and ESC to pause or resume. The game also includes an in-game tutorial to help you learn the basics.
niko-and-dino-run: Niko and Dino Run is an endless runner where you avoid dangerous obstacles while dinosaurs chase after you. The game has a clean, modern HTML5 look. You can jump, dash, and collect power-ups to stay ahead of the pack. It tests your reflexes and keeps you alert the whole time, since quick moves are what keep you alive.

Every run pushes you to think on your feet. Nothing about it is slow or predictable for long, so your focus needs to stay sharp from start to finish. If you enjoy games where agility decides everything, this one puts that skill to work.
tps-shooting-zombie-apocalypse: An undead outbreak has spread through the city, and a soldier is sent to check on the residents, get through the chaos, and wipe out every zombie, monster, and creature in sight. This third-person horror shooter blends survival and action, offering a large arsenal of weapons, several playable characters, and many levels to fight through. Expect a wide range of dangerous zombies and animals, each with its own behaviors and abilities.
You can also team up online in multiplayer matches. Arena
speed-evolution: Speed Evolution sends you racing along a sky-high track split into eleven stages, and the farther you travel, the faster you go. Each level you gain transforms your ride, beginning with a humble skateboard and moving up through a shopping cart, a monster truck, a shark-shaped car, and finally a space racer. Along the way you must leap over spikes and avoid whirling saws, spinners, lasers, and lava.

Rebirth to earn bigger multipliers, and doing so unlocks the desert and the stars as new places to race. Steer with WASD or the arrow keys, press Space to jump, and use P to pause. On later rides, the E, Q, and R keys bring in a shield, a dash, and a hover. On touch screens, a joystick on the right handles driving and a round button handles jumping.
agent-sniper-city: You play as a top-tier marksman working from the rooftops of a busy city. Your job is to take out dangerous criminals with carefully placed shots. You line up each target, zoom in for a closer look, and take the shot when you are ready, all while watching the streets for any new threat that shows up.

Every action uses the mouse. Hold the right button to bring up your scope, roll the scroll wheel to zoom in or out, press the left button to fire, and drag the mouse to look around. The safety of the city depends on how steady you stay, so keep your focus sharp from start to finish.
stickman-bros-in-fruit-island-2: Three stickman brothers have arrived in Fruitland Adventure in this new two-player 2D game, the second chapter of the Stickman Brothers In Fruit Island series. Your task is to collect strawberries and apples while you move around the island. Each brother has a set of controls, so the group can share the adventure.

Player one moves with A and D and jumps with W. Player two has its own move and jump controls, and player three moves with J and L and jumps with I. Gather the fruit with your brothers and go exploring the island together.
parking-master-urban-challenges: Step into busy city streets in this 3D simulator built to sharpen your parking. You steer realistic cars through crowded urban layouts, aiming to reach your spot without hitting anything and finishing as fast as you can. Arrows on screen point the way to the free space, so you always know where to head. It runs on both mobile devices and desktop computers.

Your progress is stored once you complete a level, and each stage unlocks only after the one before it is cleared. Drive with W, A, S, D or the arrow keys, and use the space bar as a handbrake. Press E or the tilde key to bring up the menu, and press M to change the camera view.
downhill-christmas-dash: Snow is falling, and Santa has decided to ride the slopes on a pair of skis. As he zooms down the hill, he gathers gift boxes wherever he can. Your aim is to reach the bottom while grabbing as many presents as possible. Watch out for the wicked snowmen, who want to derail his Christmas errand. Touching one of them sends Santa tumbling, and the run is over.

Keep an eye out for power-ups along the course. Winged boots boost Santa's speed and make the gifts he collects worth more points. A golden star makes him unbeatable for eight seconds. The game tests your reflexes and brings plenty of Christmas spirit. Steer with the left and right arrow keys, or tap the on-screen arrows if you are on a touch device.
path-puzzle: Path - Puzzle challenges you to roll a ball through intricate puzzles. You turn and shift the pieces until they form a clear route for the ball to follow. The controls feel smooth, so repositioning pieces stays easy to manage.
