The atmosphere stays calm and colorful, with brain-teasing challenges mixed into the artwork. It is more than a simple coloring session, since the puzzles give you something to think through as you go.
geometry-neon-dash-world-2: This is the second chapter of Geometry Neon Dash, bringing a brand new adventure with fresh levels, a different soundtrack, unfamiliar monsters, and plenty of other changes. Your quick clicking gets a real workout as you leap, glide, and spin through dark caves and sharp, spiky hazards.

Along the way you can pick up stars, unlock new characters, and work toward the best scores you can manage. Controls are simple: a right mouse click makes your character jump, so keep your timing sharp.
mad-joker: Mad Joker is a free, comic-style 2D adventure from the indie scene, built around an engaging story and a joker-style role. You move through a city ruled by the police, facing intense fire battles along the way. The game mixes platforming and shooting, and it offers Ultra HD visuals, fresh gameplay, original levels, and a range of weapons.

On a PC, the W, Q and D keys handle movement and jumping, the mouse aims and fires your attacks, and the F key activates your shield. On mobile, a virtual joystick controls movement, while touch keys handle attacking, kicking, jumping, and shielding.
slides-and-climbs: Slides And Climbs is a relaxed browser game inspired by the English board game that shares its name. That older game also helped shape the American favorite Chutes and Ladders. You can play it free, either alone or with friends nearby.

Roll the dice, move your piece along the board, and try to reach the finish first. Hope you steer clear of the snake. Each player can pick their own color, and up to six people can take part. Rolling a 6 gives you an extra roll. You can invite up to six friends or compete against AI opponents.
commando: Commando is a shooting game with one clear mission: kill everyone. The game is spread across 15 levels and gives you a selection of different weapons to handle them with. Its visuals are part of the experience too, and fans of gun and weapon themes will feel right at home.
Movement uses WASD or the arrow keys. The left mouse button fires, while the right button a
flip-bird: Flip Bird is an arcade game about keeping a bird aloft while dodging tough obstacles. Every tap sends your bird upward, so you need sharp timing and careful control to guide it through the openings. As you slip between the gaps, you rack up points and try to see how far your abilities can stretch.

Fast reactions and steady focus matter most here, since the pace keeps picking up and one mistake ends the run. It is easy to pick up but hard to put down. The big question is whether you can soar through the sky without ever hitting an obstacle.
baby-injection: In Baby Injection, you guide a baby through its health journey. Your choices carry real weight, since each one affects how the baby is doing. Along the way you solve puzzles, all within a puzzle-adventure setup.

The game blends challenging play with educational fun, so you learn as you go. Every decision leads to its own consequences, and the arcade-style exploration suits anyone who enjoys puzzles with a learning twist.
the-sort-agency: You step into the role of running a sorting agency and aim to make it the top one anywhere. Your job is to organize fruit, cakes, and toys across the board. When you spot three of a kind, select them and they vanish from the playing field. The game spans 1000 levels set in a colorful, three-dimensional world.

Each stage shows a list of items along the top of the screen, and you must clear every entry to pass the level. Pick out three of a kind to remove them from the field. Its bright 3D design keeps the sorting visually lively from the first level to the thousandth.
counter-craft-2-zombies: Get ready for nonstop waves of zombies across a world made of pixels. Survival depends on combat skill, so you'll need to pick your weapons carefully and aim for headshots. Each wave gets tougher than the last, so you'll have to move through changing surroundings with sharp timing and accuracy. Only players who stay watchful and can adjust quickly will make it through this fight to survive.
birdy-trip: Birdy Trip sends you across the sky on a migration toward sunnier lands. You are never truly alone, since you can pick up cute feathered friends along the way. Watch out, though, because many dangers can knock you off course during the journey.

Controls are simple: one touch is all you need, and you can play with either a mouse or touch input. The game offers an original atmosphere and colorful graphics. Discover and catch more than 8 birds, complete dozens of missions, and beware of eagles.
slime-color: Slime Color is a fast arcade game where speed and creativity work together. You race through bright, colorful levels and collect paint spots that bring back the hues of a world that has faded to gray. Obstacles stand in your way, so you need to keep moving and sharpen your running skills to get past them.

Every paint spot you gather adds to the scene, so your artistic side becomes part of the fun. The game blends quick movement and creative expression into one colorful arcade adventure, with plenty of vivid moments to enjoy along the way.
noob-rocket-punch: Noob Rocket Punch sends you on a journey around the boxing ring, where you can show off your glove fighting skills. If you enjoy boxing games, this one is made for you. It also trains your mind and agility, so every match feels both entertaining and sharp.

To win, study where the monsters stand in each level and spot the objects you can use to eliminate them. Touch your fist, then draw the path your punch should take to hit the monsters. You get three attempts, so plan carefully and try not to fail. The money you earn from completing levels can be used to unlock new gloves and upgrade your fighting abilities.
popit-vs-spinner: Popit vs Spinner is a puzzle game that calls on your strategic skills. Your goal is to clear popits by creating matches on the board. When you run out of moves, you can activate spinner mode, which refreshes the board so the challenge keeps going.

The game is made up of three dynamic levels, so the experience stays lively from start to finish. It is a colorful, upbeat title that suits a relaxed puzzle break. It belongs to the Fun category and carries the Fun tag.
click-and-idle-slimes: Click & Idle - Slimes! is a clicker where you tap a wobbly slime to earn income and grow your empire. You can unlock and enhance a range of skills, and each one brings its own perks beyond simple click boosts. Some skills give instant rewards, while others offer long-term advantages, so you shape your own progress. Collect charming slimes, customize your background, and keep going through an endless adventure toward becoming a true slime master.
On PC, use your mouse to click on things and move through menus. On mobile, tap and swipe to engage with the slime, unlock upgrades, and explore the different options.
snow-drifting-3d-champ-2024: Snow Drifting 3D Champ 2024 lets you tackle a beautiful wintry course right in your browser. You sit behind the wheel of a slick, contemporary Japanese sports car and practice sliding through corners. Your route takes you over rolling hills and onto a smooth asphalt road. Visit the garage to give your car a bright new paint job. Switch between several camera views and soak in the detailed 3D scenery as you aim to become a drifting star.
Driving is handled with the arrow keys, while the spacebar pulls the handbrake to help you slide. Press C to cycle through the camera angles, and hold E to glance behind you.
wall-painter: Wall Painter combines strategy with creativity in a drawing game built around a brush. You steer it through intricate structures and turn every surface you reach into bright, colorful artwork. As the levels grow more complex, the challenge rises, so you will need foresight and precision to get through them.

Your goal is to repaint an entire world, one wall at a time. Each stage asks you to plan ahead and paint carefully, and the tougher layouts test how well you think before every stroke. It is filed under Drawing, so it suits anyone who enjoys mixing puzzle thinking with a creative touch.
city-car-stunt-4: City Car Stunt 4 is the fourth episode in the series and comes with a batch of updates. The newly added cars are more powerful and eye-catching than before. On the huge Free Driving map, you can collect diamonds to unlock new vehicles, and keep an eye out for bonus boxes that hide surprises. Blue teleport points help you reach the hills more quickly, while driving to the tops of the buildings is the way to collect every diamond.

The game supports two players. Player 1 steers with the arrow keys, uses N for nitro, and presses B to look back. Player 2 drives with W, A, S and D, activates nitro with T, and looks back with C. Press R at any time to restart the current level.
knight-bolts-merge-edition: Orcs have launched an assault on the realm, and you must rally the defenders. Recruit knights and combine them to forge tougher warriors who can push back the gloom. This Merge and RPG title sits in the Puzzles category, blending merging with role-playing.

To place a knight, grab it with your mouse or finger, drag it over the spot you want, and release it there. Once your force has built up enough power, click the lock on the left side of the screen to send your knights into battle.
drive-zone: Drive Zone is a 3D racing game that sends you across city streets, rally tracks, and rough off-road terrain. Feel the force of the engine beneath you, master each turn, and let your racing instincts take over. It is about more than speed, too, since freedom, challenge, and the rush of the unknown play just as big a part.
Steer with A and D, accelerate with W, and slow down or reverse with S. Press C to change the camera view and Esc to pause. On mobile, the on-screen contro
car-chase: Car Chase is a two-dimensional racing game where you steer a car while collecting points and dodging police cars. It stays simple, with one small twist to shake things up. The goal is to see how long you can survive out on the road.

Play is controlled entirely with a joystick, which you move to guide the car. Every turn matters when you are gathering points and keeping clear of the police. Each run is a straightforward test of endurance, so the aim is always to last a little longer than before.
target-gun-game-fps-shooting: Target Gun Game puts you in a 3D first-person view where the main job is to sharpen your aim. You knock down targets while weighing both accuracy and tactics, with the goal of racking up a high score. A variety of challenges await, and you can unlock new guns as you progress.

The gun range setting means every round you fire carries weight, so careful shots pay off. It is a precise shooter that rewards patience and sharp focus. Think about each trigger pull, because in this FPS shooting game every bullet can make a difference.
mini-tennis: Mini Tennis is an arcade sports title that anyone can learn quickly, though getting high scores takes real practice. As in a traditional tennis match, you need quick reactions and accurate timing to send each ball back, since a single mistake ends the round. Rallies grow more intense the longer you last on the court, with the balls moving faster and faster. You must return every ball while also avoiding bottles that fall through the air. Reaching the Platinum medal is a serious challenge meant only for players with outstanding reflexes.
Controls are simple: click the mouse or tap the screen to play.
leaf-blower-tycoon: Run a leaf-clearing company in messy autumn yards. Your blower pushes bright, colourful leaves onto blue tarps, and you carry the full bags to the truck and drop them at the sell point. Put your earnings toward stronger blowers, larger bags and helpful workers.

Seven different areas wait to be cleaned, each with quests to finish and new equipment to unlock. When you start a fresh season, you keep permanent bonuses. Leaves react with pleasing 3D physics against cartoon scenery, and you choose your own pace. On desktop, use WASD or the arrow keys. On mobile, drag anywhere to steer the floating joystick, since the blower works automatically as you move. Stand on the upgrade and helper pads to invest, and clear an area to open the next. In Settings, you can switch sound, music or optional mouse movement. Optional videos give extra bonuses, and every area can be reached without paying.
city-taxi-driving: Slide behind the wheel of a taxi and drive through a busy city. Your job is to pick up passengers and deliver them to their destinations while navigating roads, heavy traffic, and a range of driving challenges. The game suits anyone who enjoys realistic driving, relaxed car games, or passenger transport simulators, since your driving skill shapes how each trip goes.

The controls are easy to pick up. Press W or the Up Arrow to accelerate, and S or the Down Arrow to brake or reverse. Use A or the Left Arrow to steer left, and D or the Right Arrow to steer right. You begin as a new taxi driver and work your way toward becoming a skilled professional, one passenger at a time.
stickman-jailbreak-story: In this story-driven game, you guide an innocent stickman who has been trapped in a jail. Your goal is to break free by solving tricky puzzles while avoiding watchful guards and a range of obstacles. The adventure runs on both mobile and desktop, and it puts your strategy and quick thinking to the test.

Controls are simple. Use your mouse or tap the screen to select items, interact with objects, and work through each puzzle. You will need to make fast decisions and choose the right options to outsmart the guards and find your way to freedom.
bridal-race-3d: Bridal Race 3D is a hypercasual game played on a towering runway. You sprint forward, collecting as many bridal elements as you can to improve your outfit's look. Dressing up along the way, you overtake every rival in the race and eventually meet the handsome partner you want to marry.
Moving around is simple because you only need to slide to move. Keep grabbing pieces as you go, since each one adds to your style. The 3D setting keeps the race lively from start to finish.
truck-cross-country-game: Truck Cross Country puts you behind the wheel of a truck in a 3D driving simulation. It suits anyone who enjoys wild, fast-paced racing. Your job is to steer the truck, pass through every checkpoint, and reach the finish line to complete the challenge.
Keep an eye out for coins as you go. You can spend them in the store to unlock new truck skins. The game also lets you bring friends along so you can start the racing adventure side by side.
bounce-up: Bounce Up! is a vivid arcade roguelite inspired by pachinko and peg-style games. You drop balls onto the board, knock pegs around, and set off chain reactions that pile up points and coins. Every attempt starts fresh, so you can test different builds and uncover surprising effects along the way.

Coins come from striking pegs and landing in scoring slots. Between runs, you spend them on upgrades that refine your ball setup and open the door to stronger combos. Your aim is to gather as many points and coins as you can within a single run. Move the mouse and left-click, or press Space, to launch a ball. On phones, tap the main play area. Press Esc to pause.
fun-sorting-through-the-shelves: Step into a calm, tidy puzzle where logic and order matter most. Your job is to hunt down matching objects and set them carefully onto shelves. When three identical items sit side by side, they merge into a triplet, clearing space for fresh pieces to appear. Every set of three you gather adds to your virtual corner, making it a peaceful place to unwind.
Moving items is as simple as d
tangled-rope-fun: Tangled Rope Fun is a puzzle game that gives your brain a good workout. Your task is to sort the colored ropes and loosen the knots by working through them in the right order. Since it is a color puzzle, you need to think about how each strand connects to the others. The 3D graphics add depth to every tangle you face.
The game asks you to focus closely on each rope challenge, which makes it a good way to pass some spare moments. To start, simply tap and begin untangling.
army-truck-simulator-2024: Climb into the cab of a cargo truck used by the army and haul senior soldiers to their base. Working as a driver for the military is tough, especially if you hold an officer's rank. The roads are full of dangers and barriers, yet you still need a steady hand and sharp skills as you move ammunition and personnel to a different military post.

Your missions take you around the army bases, and each level brings its own objectives. You will pick up passengers, reach each stop on time, and carry weapons from one place to another. Drive with W, A, S and D, tap the spacebar to brake, and press F to interact.
funny-rescue-pet: Two pets, Lica and Purry, are in trouble. A fire has broken out in Lica's home, and Purry is soaking wet after playing inside the wall. Your job is to rescue both of them right away, then give them a fresh new look with a makeover.

The game works on all devices. On a desktop, use the mouse to click items, tools, and buttons. On mobile, tap the screen to select things and apply your choices. It is a funny girls' game with a cat theme.
ninja-hero-cats: In this game, you lead a team of nimble cat warriors who have trained in the ninja arts. Your journey takes place in an enchanted land overrun by demons. Position your feline fighters carefully, weaving past incoming projectiles while unleashing strikes that can take down foes.

Collect fish along the way to earn stronger upgrades for your squad. When danger closes in, leap through magical portals to slip out of hostile territory. Learn the cat ninja style and see how far your team can go.
monster-truck-dirt-rally: Monster Truck Dirt Rally is a browser game about off-road racing with big, powerful trucks. You take the wheel and tear across rough dirt tracks, crushing obstacles in your way. Along the route, you can pull off daring stunts while competing in rally events.

The game uses realistic physics, so jumps and landings feel grounded, and the surroundings change dynamically as you go. You can also customize your trucks to match your taste. Use the WASD keys to drive.
fidget-spinner-creator: Fidget Spinner Creator lets you get inventive by designing your own custom spinner. Every spin earns you coins, and you can use them to boost your spinner's performance. Over time, you shape a fidget toy that is truly your own.
Creativity and fun go hand in hand here, with room to experiment and tinker for as long as you like. The game works on any device, so you can pick it up wherever you happen to be.
tug-of-heads: Tug of Heads is a wrestling game for one or two players. It includes more than 50 hand-built levels, and many of them will catch you off guard. Your job is to keep the characters' heads out of harm while the grappling continues. The rules shift with every new level, so you never quite know what to expect. Take on a friend or the CPU, and choose how many sets you want before the match begins.
Player 1 controls the action with W, A and D, while Player 2 uses the UP, LEFT and RIGHT arrow keys. On a phone or tablet, you can play with touch controls instead.
battleship-infinity-war: Battleship - Infinity War is played on a 14 by 14 grid. Success depends on where you place your ships and how you move during a match. Your opponents can be sharp, so you will need special tools such as air strikes to get ahead. Global multiplayer battles let you compete against players around the world, and your results push you up the leaderboards. Adapting your plans as the game unfolds and staying a step ahead are the keys to winning.
arrowgami-arrow-puzzle: In this arrow puzzler, your aim is to empty the playing field by pulling apart a tangle of bright, twisting arrows. Clicking or tapping an arrow sends it sliding off the edge of the screen in whatever direction it faces, but only when nothing blocks its route. Thinking a few moves ahead helps you avoid crashes and finish each stage.

Every cleared level uncovers a finished pixel art picture, such as a hot-air balloon. Coins earned along the way let you unlock new visual themes, and if a pattern stumps you, hints are available. Controls are simple: use a left mouse click or a tap to select and fire an arrow. It works in
juicy-run: Juicy Run sends you racing through a colorful world at full speed. Using shadow powers, you slice through fruit and set off a burst of juice. Success depends on precision and timing, because you must dodge obstacles to keep advancing.

Expect eye-catching visuals and an engaging soundtrack that accompany every run. Careful control is what lets you move further through the game, and the blend of quick reflexes and pleasing sights keeps each attempt enjoyable.
blockivo: Blockivo is a straightforward puzzle with bright shapes that you fit onto an 8 by 8 grid. Each completed row or column earns points, so your goal is to build the highest total you can while thinking ahead about every placement.

Drag one of the three pieces on offer into an open cell, and once all three are used, a fresh set arrives. When the board starts to crowd, Line Breaker lets you clear two chosen rows or columns, and Undo takes back your last move. Boosters are there to help when you get stuck. The round ends once none of the remaining shapes can fit. Chase your personal best and see how far you can climb on the global leaderboard.
mega-fall-ragdoll-simulator: If you want to unwind, this physics-based title asks you to smash as many bones as possible on a ragdoll dummy by tossing it off lofty rooftops and other spots across a range of levels. Each drop from a towering building can cause heavy damage, and the impacts feel true to life. Sound effects and modern visuals make every fracture easy to notice.

Thinking ahead matters here, since the levels grow more complicated and obstacles call for inventive approaches. Coins you collect let you boost your throwing power, flight distance, and cash bonus, which in turn opens new stages. You can also unlock fresh skins to change how your ragdoll looks. To begin, just click anywhere on the screen to launch your dummy.
doctor-teeth: Doctor Teeth puts you in the dentist's chair, or rather behind it. You work with a set of handy tools while racing through quick mini-games that keep you on your toes. Your job is to push back nasty germs that threaten your patients, and every round tests how quickly you can react.

This puzzle adventure rewards sharp thinking as much as fast hands. Each patient you help walks away with a perfect smile, and the game's polished gameplay and eye-catching visuals make every visit feel smooth. By the end, you have earned the title of a dental hero.
clawler-fight: You play as an ordinary person trying to survive a zombie outbreak through a series of tough levels. Your main tool is a crane with a claw. Swipe to aim it, then release your finger to drop the claw onto objects. Whatever it grabs is applied automatically, and you can launch those items at the undead.

Progress runs through a set of cards that unlock upgrades for your character. You can strengthen the claw's grip or widen how many items it can store, so you collect faster. Between enemy waves, pick new abilities that boost your grabbing power even further. Expect a range of zombies, each with its own abilities and strengths. Staying alive is the core goal, and the game blends action, strategy, and role-playing elements.
tomb-of-the-dash-game: Tomb Of The Dash is a classic puzzle title that drops you into an endless series of vertical labyrinths, each one built at random as you go. Exploring a tomb, you gather coins and three stars scattered on the ground, facing traps, assorted game mechanics, and power boosts along the way. The clock keeps ticking, so make the most of every second.
Controls are simple: use your mouse or tap the screen to play. Its tags point to avoiding hazards, collecting items, and chasing a high score, and it is available for Android and HTML5.
ping-pong-3d: Ping Pong 3D is a sports game that moves quickly and rewards accuracy and talent. Its controls feel smooth and simple, and the way you move your paddle changes how each shot travels. You will need to beat rivals across several different modes, so being adaptable helps. The ball follows physics that feel lifelike, so every rally depends on how you handle it.

Winning takes more than fast hands. You need to keep your reflexes ready while also planning a few moves ahead, since clever tactics can matter as much as speed. Each match asks you to stay focused and think carefully about where to send the ball next.
squid-games-escape: In Squid Games Escape, your task is to help someone get away, and it falls to you to keep the player alive. You need to move quickly while staying careful as you travel along this demanding track. Speed and caution both matter if you want to succeed.

This single-player 2D arcade action game is made for Android and mobile devices. You can play with a left click or with touch controls. It suits players who enjoy fast-paced arcade play, so keep your focus sharp from start to finish.
light-it-rush: In this stickman game, you guide a small acrobat through a gloomy world by swinging, leaping, flipping and sliding from one glowing neon shape to the next. Each shape you touch brightens and lights up, turning the dark surroundings into a colorful scene. Your tiny flip master has plenty of ground to cover, so every move matters.

The world is murky, and your little stickman needs to make the colors shine. Controls are simple: click the mouse or tap the screen to play. Keep flipping and bring the neon back to life one shape at a time.
noob-vs-guys: Noob vs Guys asks you to outpace experienced rivals, where nimble movement and fast reactions give you the edge. You move through a pixel-style world filled with obstacles that keep changing, so you need to make smart choices and adjust as you go. The goal is simple: fight hard to be the final player left in this fast, heart-racing survival race.

Every run tests how well you can read the course and respond on the spot. Staying ahead means picking your moves carefully and adapting when the layout shifts under you. If you enjoy action games that reward quick thinking and steady nerves, this one offers a tense challenge from start to finish.
glossy-garage-car-asmr: Glossy Garage is a relaxed 3D simulation where you clean and repair cars in a calm, sensory setting. Scrub away heavy dirt, mend damaged engine components, and buff bodywork until it shines. Working with proper mechanic tools, you bring rusted, forgotten vehicles back to a like-new state, turning worn-out wrecks into high-end cars.

Along the way you swap out broken parts, boost how your vehicles perform, and pick a custom paint finish. When a car is fully restored, sell it for in-game money and grow your own body repair shop. Whether you enjoy gentle cleaning chores or planning out the business side, the game covers both. On PC, hold the left mouse button and drag to clean. On mobile, touch the screen and drag to clean.
formula-car-race: Formula Car Race is a racing game where you take the wheel of an open-wheel formula car. You decide how fast you go, aim for the win, and show what you can do on the track. Every corner is a chance to prove your driving, and the action moves quickly from start to finish.

Controls are simple. Press the Up Arrow to speed up, and the Down Arrow to slow down or go in reverse. Use the Left and Right Arrows to steer through the bends. Keep your pace under control while you push toward the front of the pack.
hide-and-seek-friends: Take the classic game of hide and seek and jump in as either a seeker or a hider. Hiders can build shelters out of cars or office desks, or slip into the water, a hay pile, the cornfield, or the boss's office. The clever move is pushing other players into a seeker's field of vision, though you should try to be kind about it.

This online version drops you into real-time multiplayer matches across interactive 3D worlds, as seen in Hide & Seek 3D. Choose to be a sly hider or a persistent seeker, then outwit rivals, rely on stealth, or track players with precision. Expect non-stop action and plenty of strategy, with players from around the world joining in.
sumo-fury: In Sumo Fury, you can recruit wrestlers with stronger attributes and face opponents from all over the world. Test your combat skills in every bout, and each win rewards you with in-game currency. Spend it to unlock tougher fighters and take control of the arena. Every victory brings both fame and fortune, making this a game about steady growth in the ring.
extreme-drift-racing: Extreme Drift Racing is all about sliding your car through sharp bends and tight turns. Each corner and squealing tire challenges how well you handle the wheel. You need to keep a careful balance between going fast and staying in control, while timing your drifts just right. The game invites you to test how far you can push yourself on the track.

Along the way you can tune and personalize your vehicles, collecting coins as you go. Your goal is to grow into a top-level drift racer. Keep in mind that the original text gives no details on specific controls, modes, or levels, so none are described here.
archery-hero: Archery Hero asks you to sharpen your aim and concentration while the weather shifts around you and targets keep moving. Your job is to time each shot well and hit the bullseye, and the levels get harder as you go. The game aims for a sense of realistic atmosphere, and its controls are simple to pick up. Every round tests how steady your hands and focus can be.

If you enjoy archery and want to work on your timing, this title gives you plenty to practice. Each level adds new difficulty, so there is always a reason to try again and improve your score. Over time you will see how much your precision has grown. Aim for the center and see how far your skill can take you.
the-unleashed-hunter: The Unleashed Hunter is a shooting adventure where sharpening your aim is the key to success. Each good shot helps you collect trophies, and those rewards let you unlock new weaponry to try.

Between hunts, head to the shop to pick up powerful upgrades. A visit to your trophy cabin is also worth it, since looking over your prizes gives you a reason to keep going. The game suits players of all ages and keeps offering fresh challenges, so you'll need steady precision and speed to keep up.
prado-car-driving: Prado Car Driving puts you behind the wheel of a vehicle in a world built with detailed 3D graphics. The handling feels true to life, so every turn and bump matters as you race along demanding routes. You can tune your car to get the most out of it on the track.

The game includes offline modes, which means you can enjoy a race without needing a connection. It also receives regular updates, so there is always something new to look forward to. Whether you have a few spare minutes or a longer stretch of time, you can jump in and drive whenever suits you.
riddlemath: Sharpen your thinking with RiddleMath, a collection of logic puzzles built around math. Work through several levels of math challenges that push your mind further as you go. Each brain game follows the style of an IQ test, so you get a feel for that kind of reasoning while you play.

To play on a computer, click any of the numbers shown in the available list, then click an empty spot in the puzzle to place it there. On a phone or tablet, drag a number from the list and drop it into the empty space instead. Both methods let you fill the grid one piece at a time until each puzzle is solved.
spa-with-daddy: Jessica's birthday wish is simple: a day at the spa with her dad. He happily agrees, since he would grant her anything she asks for. The catch is that Dad has no idea what a spa visit really involves, so he is in for a huge surprise, and the hope is that he enjoys it.

This girls' game is a pampering session for a father and daughter at a beauty salon. Nails, hair, skin, and the mind all deserve some indulgent care from time to time. To play, just click the mouse or tap the screen.
metal-shooter-brother-squad: In this shooter, you lead a team of tough metal troopers through heavy firefights against waves of enemies and powerful bosses. The side-scrolling view keeps the pace quick, and the retro-style graphics give it an old-school look. Every character in the squad has a unique style of their own.

As you play, you can unlock new weapons and upgrade your abilities while working toward victory in each mission. To control the action, move the joystick with your mouse, press S to fire your gun, press D to throw a grenade, and press SPACE to jump.
multi-surgery-hospital-games: Multi Surgery Hospital Games is a quick-moving arcade simulation where accuracy and skill matter most. You work through detailed surgical puzzles, learning each stage as you treat patients in a hospital adventure that is tough but satisfying to master.

There is no clock ticking in the background, so you can take your time. The real aim is to refine your technique and show what you can do as a surgeon. Each patient you help is a chance to sharpen your medical know-how.
rider-2: Rider 2 lets you pull off wild stunts as you ride through a world that never seems to end. Hop on your motorcycle and begin flipping it to rack up unlimited coins. Launch big jumps and compete against other players to see who can post the highest scores. You can also purchase a motorcycle of your own choosing and work your way up to becoming a top rider at bike flips.
Controls are simple. On a PC, use the mouse to drive, accelerate, and stop. On a phone or tablet, tap the screen to speed up or come to a halt.
noob-rush-vs-pro-monster: This action game follows a tiny, desperate fellow in shorts who keeps running and needs your help to hop over obstacles and aim at the foes trying to wipe him out. Some enemies attack from the air, others from the ground, and a few are especially dangerous, constantly throwing objects that could eliminate him. He is running for his life, so every dodge and every shot matters.

Your goal is to take him as far as you can without losing, knocking out as many enemies as possible. Each one you eliminate earns points and gold, which you can use to improve your skills. Move with the arrow keys or WASD and jump with the spacebar. On mobile devices, tap the game buttons to move and shoot.
open-floor-plan: Armed with a sledgehammer, you climb an office tower one floor at a time, battering your way up. Swing, parry, stab, pound, and hurl your hammer, smashing desks, glass, and walls until the space becomes an open floor plan. To reach the next lift, dismiss every worker on the floor and crack its safes. Safes yield gold, each lift offers an upgrade, and that gold can be spent at the Company Store on new outfits and hammers.

Controls: WASD moves you, the mouse looks around, and left click or SPACE swings, slashing along your mouse movement. Right click or F parries, wheel up stabs, wheel down delivers an overhead blow, E throws or picks up, Q feints, SHIFT sprints, V jumps, and C crouches.
bubble-trouble: Bubble Trouble brings back old-school arcade shooting. You play as a devil in a trench coat, firing a spike gun at bouncing bubbles. Every hit splits a bubble into smaller, faster threats, so the screen fills up quickly. Dodge and shoot through levels that grow more chaotic, and clear the screen before the bubbles overwhelm you. Fast reactions are your strongest asset.

Fire your spike gun straight up and pop the biggest bubbles first, working down to the smallest to clear each level. Touching any bubble costs you a life, so stand directly beneath them for the best shooting angle. Player 1 moves with the left and right arrows and shoots with the spacebar, while Player 2 uses A and D to move and Q to fire. Controls can be changed in the settings. It is presented as the original arcade classic that started it all.
island-puzzle: Island Puzzle sends you on a playful journey alongside an inquisitive cat, across a bright and lively landscape full of intriguing tests. Your main tools are matching and linking mechanics, and the puzzles are hard to predict, so each one keeps you thinking. As you advance, you uncover the secrets of the island one at a time.
There is no pressure here. You can take things at your own pace, collect the prizes that your progress earns, and enjoy the soothing, charming surroundings from start to finish.
bubble-merge-2048: Bubble Merge 2048 blends the number-merging logic of 2048 with bubble shooting. You swipe to aim and launch a ball at bubbles that share a matching number or colour. Joining bubbles creates higher numbers, and your goal is to reach the target value on each stage. Along the way, you smash through barrels and boxes that block your path.

Each level brings new puzzles, obstacles, and surprises, so the challenge keeps shifting. When a stage gets tough, you can use boosters and power-ups such as dynamite and rockets. Collect stars on every level to unlock Star Chests containing rewards. The bubbles bounce and interact with realistic physics, mirroring how things behave in real life.
stand-on-the-right-color-robby: *Stand on the Right Color, Robby!* is an arcade game where you race toward the finish line by hopping onto colored tiles. The tiles switch colors at random, so you must react quickly and land on the correct one. Each stage gives you only a limited amount of time, and a slip means falling behind your rivals. Your reflexes, precision, and skill all get tested as you
spin-and-collect: Spin and Collect is a clicker where every turn of the wheel can pay out coins, gems, or rare items. Finishing sets unlocks lasting bonuses and multipliers, and you can also aim for jackpots. Items range from Common all the way up to Legendary. Your collection keeps growing even while you're away, thanks to AFK rewards. You get two wheels: a Basic wheel for steady progress and a Premium wheel built around big jackpots.

It plays with a single tap, so it works well for quick sessions on a phone. Tap SPIN to spin, open the Inventory button to review your items and completed sets, and use the audio toggle to control music and sound effects. If you want faster progress, you can optionally watch ads, which speed things up without interrupting play. It suits casual players as well as anyone hoping to complete every collection.
2-minutes-to-escape: A careless mistake at a nuclear facility has spiraled out of control, and an explosion is closing in. Your task is to guide the main character through a series of rooms, completing each level in order to get out of the complex. Look for the red button, since pressing it opens the doors that lead onward. Speed matters here, because you have just two minutes before the rocket can explode and destroy everything.

This casual arcade game works on mobile phones, tablets, and desktop computers alike. You steer your character with the on-screen arrows or the arrow keys on your keyboard. Think quickly and move with purpose, because the clock keeps ticking the whole time.
tap-away-block-puzzle-3d: This relaxing logic game gives your brain a satisfying workout in 3D. Your goal is to clear the screen by tapping blocks until none remain. Watch out, because these blocks can only slide in one direction. Swipe to turn the puzzle, figure out the correct sequence, and then see the pieces vanish into the distance.
slalom-ski-simulator: Carve your way down a snow-covered slope in Slalom Ski Simulator, weaving skillfully through a line of gates while the timer runs. Your goal is to finish before the clock runs out. Before you set off, select the skier you want to use and choose a level to tackle.

Every run is a race against time, and you need to steer clear of penalties and avoid taking a fall into the snow. Crashes are always a possibility on the mountain, so careful control matters as much as speed.
your-silver-wife: Step into an anime-inspired adventure where every click helps nurture a bond with your virtual partner. As you move through engaging storylines, you will need to plan your choices carefully, and you can upgrade your interactions to bring the two of you closer together.

The game mixes clicker mechanics with relationship-building, so tapping and story progress work side by side. Thanks to the Autoclick feature, your progress keeps going steadily even when you are not clicking nonstop. It is a blend of two styles that sits comfortably together.
spinning-cat-clicker: Spinning Cat Clicker puts a silly new spin on the classic clicker genre. Your goal is to boost the speed of a wildly rotating feline, and every improvement pushes you to beat your earlier scores. It is a race against yourself rather than anyone else.

The game blends comedy, skill, and strategy into a cheerful challenge. Packed with internet memes, it is made with cat fans in mind, so anyone who adores felines should feel right at home. Each attempt gives you another chance to beat your best result.
ramp-car-stunts-impossible: Ramp Car Stunts Impossible is a free 3D racing game built around daring car jumps. You take part in endless races over demanding tracks, and you can perform stunts on several ramp tracks. The courses are long and tough, with rooftop jumps high in the sky that keep the action going nonstop. Fans of sports and driving simulators should find plenty to enjoy here.

The controls are easy and smooth, so you can start driving right away. The game also includes some challenging missions in its car simulator. Because it works offline, you can enjoy the racing with no wifi connection. The whole game is played with the keyboard.
war-v-path-of-the-survivor: Set in a world overrun by the undead, this story-driven first-person shooter begins with a man-made catastrophe that infected most of humanity with a deadly virus, turning people into zombies. Survivors have banded together into paramilitary units, and your path may lead to the antidote that could save what remains of mankind. Along the way you buy firearms and attach different modules to them, while a leveling system tracks your progress.

Expect a gripping plot and crowds of undead that range from basic zombies to mutated monsters. The arsenal is built from real-world guns. Controls are simple: WASD moves your character, Left Shift switches to running, and Spacebar jumps. Fire with the left mouse button, aim with the right, press T to inspect a weapon, and tap R to reload.
super-sergeant-2: Super Sergeant 2 is a 3D shooter built around constant gunfire. Across five stages, you need to locate the exit in each one while fighting off large groups of foes, and you can pick from three different guns to handle them. It is made for a single player.

Movement uses W, A, S and D, and jumping is handled by the Space bar. Left click fires, while right click lets you aim down the sights. Scroll the mouse wheel to swap between weapons, press R to reload, and press G to toss a grenade. You can pause at any time by hitting P.
dop2-delete-part-in-love-story: DOP2 Delete Part in Love Story is a whimsical puzzle adventure about helping a couple find their way to romance. Your job is to notice the unnecessary details scattered around each scene and remove them, which takes a keen eye and good observation skills. The path forward depends on what you choose to delete.

Every level brings unexpected twists along with light-hearted humor, so the journey stays fun from start to finish. Romantic surprises are waiting along the way. It's a cheerful puzzle experience that rewards careful looking.
tornado-67: Play as a twister that starts as a tiny whirl able to swallow only small bits of debris. Each object you pull in makes you heavier and more powerful, so you can soon lift bigger and bulkier items. Your path runs through three settings: a sunny shoreline, a lively metropolis, and a quiet housing area. Along the way you'll sweep up sandals, parasols,
staircase-to-heaven: Staircase To Heaven is an adventure where you start at the very bottom and work your way up toward the sky. The climb has no checkpoints, so a single stumble can cost you hard-earned progress. When you slip, you need to catch yourself quickly to keep the height you have already gained. Whether you reach the summit or give up under the challenge is up to you.
Controls are simple. Use W, A, S and D to move forward, use Shift to run, and use Space to jump. If you need to free your mouse, press L to lock or unlock the cursor.
slicetall: SlicetAll is an arcade game where you tap to flip a knife and cut through a variety of obstacles. Good timing and accuracy are the keys to doing well. Each slice puts your skill to the test, and the game keeps pushing you to beat your previous scores.
The challenge is easy to pick up but takes practice to master. Can you slice them all?
wordaire-word-solitaire: Wordaire mixes classic solitaire with word association. Captioned picture cards are dealt into piles, and your job is to sort every word into its category, such as Fruit, Pets, or Kitchen, along with hundreds of others. To begin, drag a category card onto an empty foundation slot, then move matching words onto it. A counter shows how many are still left to collect.

There is no timer, and the challenge builds gradually. Tap the deck to draw new cards, stack words from the same category in the columns to uncover hidden ones, and double-click or double-tap a card to send it straight to its category. Each level has a limited number of moves, so the Hint, Undo, and Star wild card boosters are available for trickier boards. Daily rewards and 13 languages are also included. Use a mouse on desktop or touch on phones and tablets.
princess-ready-for-christmas: Get Anna and Elsa ready for their big Christmas party in this dress-up game. You can pick hairstyles, outfits, and accessories for the two princesses and mix them in whatever way you like. Because there are so many choices, you can keep experimenting for as long as you want. The castle is filled with holiday cheer, and your goal is to make the sisters shine as brightly as the festive lights around them.

There are no written instructions for this title, so you can simply start choosing looks and see what combinations suit each princess. Try bold styles or cozy winter pieces, and enjoy the cheerful seasonal setting while you work on your designs.
balloon-smash: Balloon Smash tests how well you can judge your aim and time your moves. You launch a thorn ball at colorful balloons to burst them, and each balloon behaves in its own lively way, so every shot takes some thought.

As you move on, the levels grow more complex and demand careful planning and precision. One useful trick is ricocheting your shot off the walls to reach balloons you could not hit directly. The game works on both mobile and PC, so you can play on whichever device suits you, and it stays entertaining for a long stretch.
catch-the-snowmen: Step into a snowy holiday world where you take on the role of a Santa-style hero, building a large crowd of cute snowmen. Collect gifts to recruit new snowmen, and at the end of each level, earn a New Year's toy to hang on a magical Christmas tree. Finished levels make your snowmen stronger and add new heroes to your team. You also get to decide whether you are Santa or the Grinch.

Gather magical items to unlock special abilities before facing the final challenge, a giant, evil Santa boss. Attack enemies below your level, but run away from any that are higher than you. The more snowmen you have, the higher you rank on the player leaderboard. On a computer, use WASD or the arrow keys. On a phone, tap the screen to bring up a virtual joystick.
classic-car-parking-2025: Classic Car Parking 2025 puts your accuracy and driving ability to the test through lifelike parking challenges. You take control of vintage cars and steer them through cramped gaps, narrow lanes, and awkward obstacles. To clear each level, you must park neatly and avoid crashing along the way.
Controls are simple: use the W, A, S, and D keys to drive the car. Beyond the driving itself, this is
category-match: Category Match is a relaxing brain teaser where you sort cute memoji cards into the groups they belong to. Study each card, notice the style of every character, and decide which category suits it. Each level offers a new puzzle that rewards sharp eyes and simple logic. Early stages feel gentle, but later ones bring more categories, tighter space, and trickier card layouts.

Bright visuals and smooth gameplay make every match satisfying, and the controls are easy to pick up. Tap a card and move it into its correct group. Keep an eye on your open space, since some levels leave little room, and one poor move can block your next match. Plan each placement carefully, then fill every group to win the level. Fans of matching, sorting, card, emoji, and relaxing brain games should feel at home here.
grapple-grip: Grapple Grip is a puzzle platformer where your grappling skills are put to the test. Its adaptable hook lets you climb through demanding levels by latching onto platforms, pulling yourself higher, and getting past tricky obstacles. Each stage asks you to solve puzzles and locate the exit. If you get stuck, a hint button is available to help you move forward.

You can play it on a computer or a mobile device. Move left and right with A and D or the arrow keys, and press W or the up arrow to use your grapple. Press R to reset, or Esc to go back. It is a single-player game, so your focus and timing are what carry you through every level to the end.
hide-n-seek: Trapped in a maze alongside the other matchmakers, you can choose between two distinct challenges. In the first, you are the one fleeing: dodge your captors for a set amount of time while gathering diamonds along the way. In the second, the roles flip and you become the captor, hunting for escapees who are concealed somewhere in the labyrinth, even though you cannot spot them directly.
Only luck and a mighty brain will carry you through. The hope is that you stay for more levels. You steer by sliding across the screen.
construction-simulator-lite: Construction Simulator Lite is a casual game for young players who dream of running heavy machinery. You can take the controls of excavators, cars, cranes, and more, each suited to a different kind of site work. The robotic arm stands out because it demands careful, precise handling throughout.

Your jobs on the site include digging, moving materials from one spot to another, and filling the foundation. Each task is a separate piece of construction work you complete in turn. Playing is simple, since a single mouse click or tap is all you need to get going.
car-mechanic-simulator-2025: Bring old cars back to life in Car Mechanic Simulator 2025. Your job is to find vehicles that have been left behind, uncover hidden finds, and carefully rebuild their engines one piece at a time. Hunt for hard-to-get parts, and take your time applying paint so every coat turns out clean and exact.

Start with rusty wrecks and shape them into eye-catching showpieces. Pay attention to the small details, because each one shapes the final result. By the end, you will have earned the title of a skilled restorer. The game is tagged as a simulation and sits in the arcade category.
rings-untie: Rings Untie is a simple puzzle title that is hard to put down. It works as a brain workout and features bright, colorful rings with easy controls. Players touch the screen to spin a circle, lining up its gap or pattern with the center target before time runs out. Each correct match raises the score and opens a tougher level. Players of all ages can pick it up quickly.

The rings differ in how they move: C lock rings turn easily, D rings only rotate within a limited range, and S rings are more flexible. Obstacles and other ring locks add more to figure out, and a large number of levels are ready to explore. Watch the clock and steer clear of wrong moves. Like other rescue-style games, it rewards careful planning, so think about your next move before you act.
basket-random: Basket Random turns basketball into a silly, unpredictable challenge. You only need a single key to try to sink a shot, yet each round can look and feel different. The courts change, the players change, and so do the balls, so you never quite know what to expect. You can go head to head with the computer or invite a friend to play two player mode. The first person to reach 5 points takes the win.
Player 1 uses the W key, while Player 2 uses the up arrow key. On phones and tablets, you can control the game with touch.
stick-box-ragdoll-slowmo: Step into a fast-paced brawl with a bendy blue ragdoll that you can pull by the body and arms. Your job is to fight through crowds of red stickmen, get past obstacles, and take down bosses along the way. Each level presents a new challenge, so you will need both quick reflexes and careful planning to get through.

Collect weapons as you go, from boxing gloves, knives, and bats to pistols, along with odd objects that turn into powerful weapons. The realistic ragdoll physics are funny and spectacular to watch. Controls are simple: click and drag the body to move, drag the arms to strike, touch a weapon to pick it up, and use items to deal extra damage.
obby-rainbow-tower: Climb a frosty tower in this winter-themed racing platformer, where timing is everything and one misstep can cost you as much as a quick move gains. Each floor is loaded with shifting platforms, slippery ice tiles, spinning lava bars, sudden snowstorms, and snowball portals that can send you tumbling into the abyss.

Run the tower as often as you like, aiming to shave seconds off your personal best, or challenge a friend in two-player mode and race them side by side. Player one uses WASD to move, Shift to sprint, and Space to jump, with a second Space press for a double jump. Player two uses the arrow keys, K to sprint, and L to jump or double jump. Mobile players can use the on-screen buttons.
funny-nose-surgery: Funny Nose Surgery is a silly browser game where you help a girl named Mia with a runny nose. You carry out lighthearted medical jobs in a simple, hands-on way. Once her nose is cleaned up, you can decorate it with goofy stickers and let your imagination run wild. The game has bright, cheerful visuals and a playful feel from start to finish. Along the way, you pick up a few basic healthcare routines without any pressure.
circuit-master-2: Circuit Master 2 is a puzzle game where you position wires, fans and machines on a board in their proper spots. Every piece has its own traits and only works in the place it is meant to go. Once the layout is complete, switch on the power to watch electricity move through the circuit. Only parts that are linked correctly will make the green light illuminate.

Controls are simple. On a desktop, grab each component with the mouse, drag it onto the grid, and click the red power button to energize the circuit. On a mobile device, drag pieces with your finger and tap the same red button. If you get stuck, a hint is available for extra help.
leftover-screw: Leftover Screw asks you to build flat-pack furniture from a heap of loose parts. The fifty levels climb from a simple stool to a bunk bed, with one piece per level. Parts lock together wherever their holes meet, so it is easy to assemble something the wrong way. Every screw becomes a timing test: tap when the needle sits in the green zone, or the panel cracks.

To move through a level, drag one part onto another and release once the green ghost appears. You can rotate pieces with the buttons beside them, or press R and F on a keyboard. Collecting stars unlocks three bonus pieces, each with mechanics of its own. A level is complete once every part is attached.
orbadrone-robot-escape: OrbaDrone - Robot Escape puts you in control of a round, orb-shaped drone that can push objects away or pull them closer. You wake up inside a strange, cave-like structure in a world that has already fallen apart. Your job is to find odd materials with unusual properties and use them to find your way through this dangerous, mysterious place.

The game offers 50 levels across three difficulty settings, along with four mini-games to try. You can give your drone different skins, and each one comes with its own abilities. Expect physics-based movement in 2D, along with glowing light effects and varied environments. Controls can be adjusted to suit how you like to play. On mobile, a joystick moves the drone and two buttons trigger your abilities. On desktop, the arrow keys move you, A attracts objects, and S repels them.
vehicle-stunts-sky-sim: Vehicle Stunts Sky Sim raises the action well above the ground. You take the wheel of powerful cars, motorbikes, and trucks on tracks built high in the air. Your job is to pull off stunts that seem to ignore gravity, leap across open gaps, and speed through loops suspended in midair.

Challenges appear throughout, and the scenery from up high is a sight to see. Use the W, A, S, and D keys to steer your vehicle across the stunts map. Keep your nerve steady up there and see how far you can push through the skies.
mommy-pregnant-caring: Sofia is expecting a baby, and on this particular day she happens to be alone at home. She has booked a hospital check-up, so the job is to look after her from start to finish. First you help her freshen up before she heads out, then you go along with her to the hospital for her examination. Once she is back home, the final task is to whip up a tasty dinner for the two of you.

The game is played with a mouse click or a tap on the screen. Everything is handled with simple taps, so it works well for younger players who are just getting started. Tags on the page point to cooking, dressing up, makeover and doctor themes, all wrapped up in a cheerful girls' game.
penalty-challenge: Penalty Challenge puts you on the spot in an online football game where you can take the kick or stop it. Pick the striker or the goalkeeper role and test your nerve against computer opponents or players from around the world. It costs nothing to join in, and every match earns you experience points that move you up the global leaderboard.

Choose a team from Europe's top clubs or its national sides, then enter a high-level competition. Your footballer can be a man or a woman, and the stadium is filled with smoke and a cheering crowd. Show what you can do while the whole arena is watching.
tall-and-rush: Tall and Rush is an arcade game built around a quest for height and victory. As your character grows taller, you leap into the air to snatch power-ups and unleash high-powered kicks against a robot foe. Timing each jump is the key to getting ahead.

Your aim is to leap as high as you can and to survive as many rounds as possible. The challenge is designed to make you want one more attempt, with each run offering a fresh chance to climb a little higher.
weapon-run-3d-gun-shooter: Weapon Run - 3D Gun Shooter is a runner where you race down futuristic courses while blasting whatever stands in your path. Obstacles must be destroyed accurately as you keep moving forward, and you can improve your guns along the way to handle tougher moments. The game moves quickly, so you need sharp reactions to stay ahead of the chaos.

Expect plenty of hostile foes and bosses that keep coming back at you without letting up. Each encounter tests both your reflexes and your planning, since you have to decide when to fire and how to make the best use of your upgrades. The whole adventure takes place in a sci-fi setting that looks striking on screen. Every run gives you a chance to see how far you can get.
collect-the-gift: This festive puzzle game sends you into a magical workshop, where your task is to guide gifts into Santa's bag. Each stage asks you to work out the right approach: cut ropes, launch slingshots, and trigger switches so that every package reaches its destination. Think through each layout carefully before you act.

The thrill and challenge will remind you of beloved classics, yet everything unfolds in a delightful holiday setting. It offers a cheerful way to enjoy some seasonal fun whenever the holidays are in the air.
toy-soccer-cup: Toy Soccer Cup is a quick table football game where you flick toy players to smash the ball into the net. Grab any of your players and drag to line up a shot, then let go to send them flying. Score more goals than your rival before the timer runs out. On phones and tablets you touch and drag, and on a computer you click and drag with the mouse, with no keyboard needed.

Battle through tournaments and world leagues, earning coins from each win to unlock new teams and gear. Customize your side with kits, balls and pitches, then challenge real players in one-on-one online matches. It is simple to pick up, but tricky to put down.
my-bakery: Open your own sweet business in this relaxed café simulator, where you bake tasty treats and serve guests. Decorating your shop is part of the fun, so you can give it a look that feels like yours. The core loop is straightforward: customers arrive, you bake their pastries, and you serve them quickly. Every satisfied customer helps your confectionery empire grow.

The bright, warm visuals create a calming mood that suits a break from everyday life. As you progress, you unlock new recipes and expand your dining area. The gameplay is easy to pick up, which makes it a good choice for unwinding and easing stress. Controls are simple as well: use the WASD keys or a mouse on a computer, or your finger on a phone.
asmr-pet-treatment: ASMR Pet Treatment invites you into a calm, gentle world where you look after cute puppies and kittens. Your tasks include bathing your animals, tending to their injuries, and putting them into adorable outfits. The game is built around soft, soothing sounds and warm little interactions, so every playful moment feels restful and enjoyable.
It is a relaxing pick for anyone who enjoys pampering animals at their own pace. Take your time with each pup or kitten and enjoy the gentle rhythm of the care routine from start to finish.
coins-rush-run: Coins Rush Run is a three-dimensional game in which you steer a group of coins down a track that keeps changing shape. Your aim is to help the coins grow in worth as they travel. Along the way, you weave past brightly colored barriers and pick up coins spread across the route.

The journey ends in a finale inspired by Pachinko, where you can chase large multipliers. Fast reactions help you get through the obstacles, while planning ahead helps you build up points. The more careful and quick you are, the higher your score climbs.
3d-super-rolling-ball-race: Speed fans will find plenty to enjoy in this 3D racing game, where you guide a rolling ball along a course of platforms. It asks for quick reactions, careful timing, and a competitive spirit to get through each stretch. The controls are straightforward, but the challenges build up, making it a good match for anyone who likes running games and arcade-style play.

Your main task is to keep the ball rolling across tricky platforms without tumbling off the edge. A multiplayer option lets you race against others, adding another layer to every run. Everything works with a simple mouse click or tap, so you can jump in quickly.
super-count-masters: Super Count Masters is a light, casual game that runs right in your web browser, whether you're on a desktop computer or a mobile device. It costs nothing to start playing. Its stickman theme gives it a playful feel, and it's built to be hard to put down once you begin.

Steering your stickman is simple. On a computer, you play with the mouse and move the stickman with it. On a touchscreen, just tap the screen to move the stickman. Either way, you can get started right away.
crazy-cone-sweeper: Crazy Cone Sweeper places your car among 50 cones arranged all around it. Your goal is to clear the field by hitting the cones until every one has been pushed out of the area. Keep moving and aim each hit with care, because you also have to keep your own car inside the area while you work.

Steering uses the Z and X keys on your keyboard. On a mobile screen, tap the left or right side to turn. This racing game focuses on drifting and skill, so careful handling is the key to sweeping the whole course.
color-parking-drifter: Color Parking Drifter is a racing game where you send your car sliding into parking spaces that match a requested color. Precision is key, since parking in the wrong color is a miss, and driving out of the arena is another way to fail. Watch out for other cars passing through, because they can get in your way.
To play on a keyboard, press Z or X. On a mobile screen, press the left or right side of the display. Each slide needs careful timing so that you end up in the correct colored space.
sky-city-riders: Sky City Riders puts you on a motorbike high above the city, where every course runs across the tops of skyscrapers. Each track must be finished before the timer reaches zero. Complete 10 races in time to earn 10 different bike skins. Save your NITRO boost for the long ramps, because it is what helps you clear those big jumps.

Play alone or choose the 2 PLAYER option to take on a friend and settle who is the stronger rider. Player 1 steers with the arrow keys and uses left shift for nitro, while Player 2 moves with W, A, S, and D and uses N for nitro. In Free Driving mode, collect 30 diamonds to unlock the Multi-Color Skin.
arsenal-online: Arsenal Online is a 2D shooter that puts your aim and reflexes to the test. It includes a variety of game modes, and each one rewards experimenting until you master it. Weapons can be unlocked, so you can try different options and find what suits your style. A firing range is also available for honing your skills.

You can play alone or team up with others in cooperative multiplayer battles. Whether you prefer quiet practice or shared action, the game gives you room to improve at your own pace. Keep trying new gear and modes to get better over time.
brrbrr-patapim: In this 3D first-person shooter, you take on BrrBrr Patapim, a strange and mighty foe. The map is yours to explore, and along the way you can grab powerful weapons and throw grenades at the enemy while you fight to survive the chaos.

Expect fast, constant action powered by meme-style energy and plenty of silly fun. Everything here is loud, odd, and pushed to the extreme. Controls are simple: click the mouse or tap the screen to start playing.
field-of-blooms: Your plot has withered, but it can still be saved. Drag a watering can across the land and parched shoots burst open along the path behind your pointer. Fertilizer then turns them into plump golden flower heads, and a basket gathers the whole crop. Sell what you collected to afford a wider spray and a longer timer, then head back out.

Clear the entire map and the season restarts, though the garden keeps its extra wealth for good. With a mouse, just move to steer your tool; nothing needs clicking or holding. Push toward a screen edge to scroll the view. On touch devices, hold and drag your finger, and drag near an edge to scroll. Space, Esc, or Tab pauses, and keys 1, 2, 3, or the bottom buttons switch tools.
archers-io: Archers.io asks you to think like a tactician, where accuracy and planning decide who lasts. You start out alone with a bow, then gather archers you meet along the way until you command a strong force. The battlefields are full of rival teams, and you can unleash powerful shots to hit them hard. Head into head-to-head PvP fights to take control of the map.

The game is a browser title in the .io genre, so it is easy to jump in and see how your army grows. Each match rewards careful choices about when to recruit, when to strike, and when to pull back. Keep your focus on the terrain and the enemies around you, and you will find a steady rhythm in every battle.
leap-and-avoid-2: Return to the white ball's adventure, now with more cave and laboratory stages than before. New mechanics, solid sound and a pleasing visual style round out the package. The main addition is coins and secret passages. Hidden routes leading to coins can be found across the entire world. Grabbing coins gives you a speed boost for the ball and a shield that survives one hit from a hazard. The more coins you collect, the higher you climb on the leaderboard, so challenge your friends and hunt down every hidden coin.

Your aim is to push through every hazard in your way and escape. Move right, hopping onto the white platforms and steering clear of the black ones. Now and then you must head left to jump toward the exit.
shoes-outlet-game: Shoes Outlet Game is an idle clicker where simplicity comes first. You tap your way forward, starting with a mini outlet and working up to a mega one, and you get to watch your mall grow over time. Little effort is needed, so the fun comes from seeing the whole place develop bit by bit.

You run the mall by hiring staff and choosing your next moves. Your workers handle displaying merchandise, tidying the fitting rooms, and helping customers check out. You can assemble your own team and manage it well, turning setbacks into chances to grow and making sure every coin you earn is put to good use. Every button is clicked with the mouse.
halloween-2024-fps-shooter: Halloween 2024 FPS Shooter is a free first-person game where you blast your way through hordes of zombies. Each zombie you take down helps you open up new levels. When your magazine runs dry, you'll need to scour the ground for spare rounds so you can carry on fighting. It's a creepy, fast-paced good time for the Halloween season.

Move around with the W, A, S, and D keys, and aim and fire with your mouse. Thanks to its 3D first-person view and simple controls, it's easy to pick up and play. Expect plenty of frightful action as you push deeper into the undead-filled night.
city-car-stunt-3: City Car Stunt 3 is the third game in the series, featuring refined physics and cars that look more lifelike and eye-catching. Your aim is to finish six different routes before time runs out. Each level you clear unlocks a new car with more power for the stages ahead, and the challenge is a race against the clock to become the owner of the fastest machine.

Free Driving gives you a huge, newly designed map where you can show off your skills. Here you can play darts, soccer, and bowling with your car, or simply perform cool stunts without any time pressure. Use the ramps to launch your car into the air. Player one drives with the arrow keys, uses N for nitro, and B to look back. Player two uses W, A, S, and D to move, T for nitro, and C to look back. Press R to restart a level.
get-10: Get 10 is a puzzle game built around numbers, played on a five by five grid. Your job is to join boxes that carry the same number so they merge into a bigger tile. The goal is to reach the number 10, and you need to think a few steps ahead before each choice.

Because each move can change what becomes possible later, you will need to plan carefully rather than rush. The game asks you to use both logic and math skills, and it tests your patience as much as your cleverness. Every turn is a small challenge of wit, so take your time and look at the whole board before you act.
lisa-s-world-paper-doll-story: Lisa's World: Paper Doll Story is a dress-up game built around a girl named Lisa and the everyday events in her life. Each day brings something new, whether she is heading to school, spending time at the beach, or marking a holiday. Your choices decide how she appears and which clothes she puts on for each moment.

Select from a wide range of outfits suited to each occasion, so there is always something fitting for the day ahead. Once the look is set, you can write in Lisa's personal diary to record what happened and tell the stories behind each day. You can also combine clothing, accessories, skin tone, eye color, hairstyle, and makeup in endless ways until Lisa looks exactly the way you want.
draw-bridge-brain-game: Draw Bridge is a brain game that tests your problem-solving skills. Your job is to sketch routes that help a stranded car get past obstacles and reach its destination. Each puzzle works like building a bridge, and every road you draw helps rescue the car within a physics-driven world. To begin, touch the screen, hold and drag to shape the path you want, then lift your finger and watch the car roll along it.

Progress depends on skill rather than stat upgrades. Clearing distinct levels earns soft currency, which you can spend on vehicle cosmetics, skins, and animated exhaust effects. The controls are easy to pick up, so you can jump in quickly. The HTML5 game uses an SDK for instant login and saves that carry over between PC and mobile, and it runs steadily whatever your internet speed. Its classic 2D art stays clear and simple, and multi-stage levels accept many creative solutions, which encourages replaying.
intergalactic-battleship: Set in deep space, this game pits you against an alien force in a battle of wits. Your task is to track down the enemy ships hidden across the grid and destroy them, using strategy at every turn. It keeps the familiar rules of the classic board game while swapping the ocean for a starry backdrop.

The result is a modern spin on a well-loved favorite, with strategic battles that feel fresh yet familiar. The game is built to run on any device, so you can jump in wherever you happen to be. Your mission is to save Earth, one carefully chosen target at a time. Puzzle lovers who enjoy board-style play should feel right at home.
fire-ring: Fire Ring is a quick, heated test of timing and reflexes. Your fiery ball has to pass through spinning rings, gaps that keep changing position, and burning hazards. A single misstep ends the run immediately, so every jump matters. Your aim is to keep rising and push your score as high as you can.
drifting-car-master: Drifting Car Master is a racing game built around fast speeds and sharp, risky corners. You compete against top drifters from around the world in races on wide-open tracks, where winning depends on skill, well-timed moves, and a controlled slide. The physics are arcade-style, which keeps drifting approachable while still rewarding precision. You can choose from a range of cars and upgrade or customize them to match your driving style.
Be careful, because police patrols roam the roads and go after drivers caught speeding through town streets and on the highway. The goal is to shake off the chase before the cops catch you.
blocky-dude-gangster-auto-city: In Blocky Dude Gangster Auto City, you take on risky criminal work in a city called Auto City. You control a blocky character who moves through a messy, unpredictable streetscape. Building your abilities matters, and so does finding clever ways to use whatever surroundings you come across. Your climb through the criminal underground keeps you on edge, since every move pairs excitement with real peril.

Expect plenty of driving, brawling, and scheming as you work to become the one in charge. Everything happens in a blocky sandbox adventure, so the world is open to experimentation. Keep an eye on how thrills and dangers mix as you push toward control of the scene.
cool-escape-obby-man: Cool Escape Obby Man drops you into a prison break where every move counts. You must outwit the guards, leap over dangerous platforms, and avoid deadly traps. Along the way, you will face clever riddles that need to be solved before you can move on.

Searching around the prison uncovers hidden clues, and you can use makeshift tools to carve out your route to freedom. The game blends jumping across platforms with brain-teasing puzzles, so careful thinking matters as much as quick reactions.
knife-slice-3d: Flip a blade from ledge to ledge in this arcade game full of obstacles. Lifelike knife physics govern each jump, and you slice through stacks of objects, gather apples for rewards, and dodge deadly traps. Time your flips well to reach the portal and push through steadily tougher stages. Scenes include forests, castles, and other unusual places, all rendered in colorful low-poly 3D, and new knives unlock as you progress.

A single tap or click handles every move, so the game is easy to pick up, but landing perfectly upright is hard enough that only the most skilled players will master every level. Relaxed play and fast precision challenges both fit here, and it runs in desktop or mobile browsers. Land upright to keep moving forward, and reach the finish platform to complete each level.
popular-hair-salon-game: Popular Hair Salon puts you in charge of a busy barber shop that welcomes a steady stream of customers each day. Many of them have been waiting a long time, so you need to work quickly and get them looking their best. Every visitor starts with a hair wash, after which you can shape a haircut in the style you choose. Once the hair looks right, you move on to dressing them, picking from a large selection of fancy outfits to find the looks that help each person stand out.
You control everything with a mouse or by tapping. The order matters: wash the hair first, design the hairstyle next, and finish by matching the clothes.
darkhood: In this dark platformer, your own glow is the only light around you. You guide a young hero in a shadowy hoodie through candle-lit caves, past sleeping monsters and along hidden passages. On each level, your goal is to collect every shining gem and reach the gate that unlocks the exit.

Watch out for bombs, pits, and traps along the way. On desktop, move with the arrow keys or A and D, and jump with Space, W, or Up. On mobile, the on-screen touch buttons let you run, jump, and interact. It is a relaxed adventure built for short sessions, whether you are at home or on the go.
final-christmas-run: This is the final run before Christmas morning, and Santa still has 100 gifts left to deliver. You climb aboard his sled and fly through the winter sky with him. Your task is to drop presents down chimneys and get them to kids waiting at their windows, one house at a time.

Steer the sled with the arrow keys and release presents with the space bar. On city levels, you can use the mouse to throw gifts instead. On-screen controls are also available, so you can play on a phone or tablet.
sustainable: Step into a busy museum and help defend its halls from eco-terrorists bent on damaging valuable artwork. You patrol the galleries, pick out suspects, and use your reliable tonfa to put a stop to their plans. Along the way, you piece together clues through intense interrogations while the clock keeps ticking to keep the masterpieces safe.
The game blends action and fighting with a mystery to solve, so every move counts. Your job is to find the person responsible before the damage is done and rescue the art from harm.
military-vehicle-driving-simulation: Step behind the wheel of this military vehicle driving simulation, where high-pressure missions put you in control of armored trucks, tanks, and tactical vehicles.
