Each mission asks you to cross rough ground, move through fighting zones, and follow planned paths. Accuracy and ability matter at every turn, so each move you make counts toward finishing the job.

Everything runs from the keyboard, with the WASD keys controlling how your vehicle moves. Keep your focus on the terrain ahead and on each choice of route, since careful driving is what carries you through
zombie-parade-defense-3: Zombie Parade Defense 3 continues the fight with a third episode. The zombies now arrive in waves and hit much harder, so the game is best played with two or three players. Solo players can still manage. Avoid hitting the newly added medic characters and let them support you, which helps your base survive for longer. A newly added spider web defense system is also available, so use it. You win by surviving a total of 10 waves.

Each player has their own controls. Player 1 moves with W, A, S and D, switches guns with Q, and goes in or out of the base with E. Player 2 moves with the arrow keys, and Player 3 moves with Y, G, H and L, with their own keys for switching guns and entering the base. Weapons and power-ups are activated with the mouse.
aliens-hunter: Aliens Hunter puts you in the role of a hunter tracking down extraterrestrials that have slipped into a city. Your job is to put your skills to work, seek out the hidden invaders, and take them down with your gun to earn rewards. Every round scatters the aliens across new spots, so you can never quite predict where the next one will be.

Success depends on precision. You need to pick your targets carefully, line up each shot, and fire accurately to finish the mission for that level. It is a shooting game with a sniper-style feel, built around patience, careful aiming, and steady timing.
robbery-duel: Set in a bank robbery, this shooter asks you to pick the right moment to fire. A red laser traces your path, so you line up your target and squeeze the trigger at just the right angle. The physics feel solid, and every shot carries real weight. Its more than twenty levels are each hand-built, giving you plenty of showdowns to work through.

As you go, the money you earn can be spent to upgrade your gunslinger and your weapon. Your aim is to defeat every opponent in town and earn the title of the most feared robber around. The look blends modern design with classic western duels. Everything is controlled with a simple left mouse click.
dunk-up-basketball: Dunk Up Basketball challenges you to climb a towering wall, where accurate aim meets the laws of physics. You launch a ball off trampoline nets, and each successful hoop helps you climb higher. Clean, seamless shots score big, but one miss sends you tumbling back down.
This arcade skill game puts precision at the centre of every throw. Its mix of tough shots and steep falls makes it hard to put down and full of thrills.
food-run-and-battle: You sprint through bright 3D courses where food is scattered along the way, but so are traps and rivals trying to slow you down. Every portion you collect makes your heroes stronger, so gather as much as you can while choosing a safe route and saving your energy for the finish line.

When you reach the final clash, you'll face your opponents in a dramatic battle, and winning it shows that your team earned the victory. Controls are simple, with one move at a time. On a computer, use WASD or the arrow keys, or hold the left mouse button and drag the pointer where you want to go. On a phone or tablet, swipe left or right to steer toward food and away from hazards.
scary-halloween-adventure: Scary Halloween Adventure sends you on a spooky journey through eerie scenery, where ghosts and ghouls lurk among frightening surprises. Your route takes you through haunted houses, creepy forests, and dark caves. Along the way you'll solve puzzles and escape from monsters. The whole game follows a Halloween theme, and the aim is to survive the night.

It's a hypercasual point-and-click title, so the controls stay simple. You play with a mouse click or a tap. The game is designed to test your courage and see whether you have what it takes to make it through.
one-line-drawing-mini-games: One Line Drawing Mini Games brings a range of line drawing gameplays together in one place. You can take things easy with the relaxing versions, where the focus is on calm play, or challenge yourself with the puzzle-style versions that ask you to think through each drawing. Both sides of the collection build on the same basic idea of sketching a picture in one continuous line.

The easy one line drawing gameplay is a good choice when you want to ease stress. It offers a soothing, enjoyable session that lets you unwind and enjoy some relaxed game time. Whether you want to wind down or sharpen your thinking, the collection has a mode that fits your mood.
flames-and-fortune: Flames & Fortune combines card battles with fiery strategy. You push through dungeons that never stay the same, relying on sharp tactics to win each fight. Along the way, you gather spells and abilities that can turn the tide when you need them most.

Because the challenges are hard to predict, no two runs feel alike. Each attempt puts your skill and your ability to adapt to the test, and the game offers plenty of strategic depth for players who enjoy planning their moves carefully.
break-the-candy: Break the Candy is an arcade game where careful aiming pays off. You line up each shot, fire, and watch sweet blocks crumble. Well-timed hits can set off chain reactions that wipe out larger groups of candy at once, which is how you build a high score.

You can play alone to beat your own best or invite friends to see who scores highest. The game spreads you across a range of levels, each asking you to plan your moves carefully. Your shots are limited, so every choice matters, and you need smart tactics to finish each stage with a sweet win.
poopy-shooting-survival: You play as a poop hunter behind the wheel of a super car in a modern city where diseased poop has been let loose. Your job is to clear out the large infected monsters and end the harm they have done to innocent people. Run them over, crash into them, and squish the creatures that burst from the ground to attack your vehicle. Every one you flatten earns the respect and admiration of the citizens, who see you as their only hope.

The poopy creatures keep wandering the streets, so the fight never really stops. In the Attack Monster Car Survival derby, you face the whole super squad and find out how far you can last. Use WASD to walk and drive, F to get a weapon, and Enter to exit the vehicle. Scroll the mouse to show your weapon, hold Shift to run, press Space to jump, and press Ctrl to jump forward. Tab opens the menu.
mini-games-calm-and-puzzle: Mini Games: Calm And Puzzle is a collection of playful, inventive small games for anyone who likes both unwinding and a bit of a mental workout. It packs in eight different minigames. A few are soothing and simple to pick up, while others push your thinking and take real focus to solve.

Everything is controlled with a mouse click or a tap, so you can jump straight in on a computer or a phone. The mix of gentle, easygoing rounds and sharper brain teasers keeps the experience varied from one moment to the next.
baby-hazel-at-beach: Baby Hazel is heading off on a beach vacation, a treat from her parents. Once she arrives, she can soak up the sunshine under a bright sky, stroll across golden sand, and swim in the blue sea. She can also sip unusual drinks, take it easy, and try other seaside activities.

In this game, you spend the day at the beach with Baby Hazel. Your job is to help her pack the important accessories and gear she needs, then take care of everything she requires along the way. Click or tap to start playing.
hungry-rabbit: Hungry Rabbit asks you to rely on quick reflexes and good timing. Your job is to guide lively bunnies as they hop and sprint through a range of mini-games, all in pursuit of carrots. The pace is brisk, so every moment keeps you on your toes, and the cheerful artwork gives the whole experience a warm feel.

Designed to appeal to players of every age, it offers a fast-moving, bouncy experience for anyone who enjoys a quick challenge. There is plenty of motion on screen to keep your attention from start to finish.
putt-party: Putt Party is a relaxed mini-golf puzzler with a bold, retro poster style. You line up a shot, pull back on the ball, and release to send it rolling. Your ball can ricochet off walls, slip past water, and roll into the cup. Every course is laid out differently, with bends, narrow funnels, and crossing paths, plus boosters and portals to figure out as you go.

Your aim is to finish each hole in as few strokes as possible. Fewer strokes earn up to three stars, and you can unlock new balls as you progress. A leaderboard lets you see how your scores compare. Pull back farther for a harder hit, and keep an eye on walls, water, and sand. If you get stuck, Ball Back undoes your last shot, and Aim Line shows a longer preview of the ball's path. The controls work with a mouse or touch: drag back from the ball and release.
cube-drop-puzzle: Cube Drop Puzzle is a strategy game built around planning. You drag furniture-shaped blocks and line each cube up with the matching color, pairing it with the stick figure of the same shade. Because the space is tight, every move needs some thought, and the levels grow harder as you progress, starting with easy layouts before moving to tangled ones. The game blends block puzzles with color matching.

The visuals are bright and colorful, which helps each board stand out. Controls are simple: move the holes across the board by dragging them, then let the glasses drop smoothly into their hole. Work through each puzzle step by step, using logic and strategy. A level is finished once every coffee cup has landed in the right spot. It suits brain-teaser fans.
buttocks-time: Buttocks Time is a hypercasual 3D game that puts your reflexes to the test. At first glance the idea seems simple, but the fun comes from how it plays out inside its unusual gym setting. You take on the role of a fitness coach and team up with a fellow team member to get through a set of tough tasks.
The challenge comes from reacting quickly and steering clear of obstacles along the way. Getting started is easy, since you only need to tap to play.
color-blast-puzzle: Color Blast Puzzle challenges you to tap groups of same-colored blocks and clear them from the board, as long as each group has at least two blocks. Every level comes with its own goals and only a limited number of moves, so each tap deserves careful thought. Bigger clusters bring greater rewards, and smart clicks can set off chain reactions that clear many blocks at once. Boosters that you unlock along the way can sweep through tough areas and wipe out several blocks in a single action.

Expect bright graphics, satisfying popping effects, and unique objectives on each level, with layouts that grow more demanding as you advance. The game is simple to pick up yet takes real skill to master. Tap or click matching blocks to make your move, and use planning and strategy to get through every stage.
blockgunner: BlockGunner is a 2D war game that runs in your browser using HTML5. It is built for two players who share the same screen. Face off against a friend across three different maps, and choose from three different weapons as you fight. Whoever comes out on top is the winner.
Player one uses the W, A, S, and D keys along with R. Player two uses the arrow keys and O. Touch controls are also available for playing on a mobile device.
halloween-merge-mania: Halloween Merge Mania is a spooky puzzle game for anyone who enjoys a bit of Halloween flair in their brain teasers. It takes its inspiration from the well-liked Suikagame style, and the goal is to join creepy characters together so that higher-level creatures appear. You begin with small figures such as pumpkins and bats, then keep combining them until you reach famous monsters like Frankenstein and Jack Skellington. Every new merge reveals more of the eerie world waiting inside the game. Fans of spooky puzzles will find it a fun way to pass the time.
Controls are simple: just click with your mouse or tap your screen to play.
funny-walk-fail-run: Funny Walk Fail Run is an arcade action title that blends silly humor with a touch of magic. You guide a villain through a set of challenges, but he has no interest in walking neatly. He trips, wobbles, and bumps into things in all kinds of comical poses. Your task is to help him get safely through each step of the shaky road.

Controls are handled with a mouse click or a tap, so you can start right away. The game is listed in the hypercasual category and carries the tags action, funny, and run. Watching him stagger through each challenge is a large part of the fun.
mini-stilts: Step into the shoes of a green slime who gets around on a pair of stilts. Your goal is to get past every obstacle in your path, which means keeping your balance steady and timing each move carefully. The action unfolds in small chambers crowded with quirky hazards that keep you on your toes.
Quick reflexes and smart use of your stilts lead to success, so every choice matters. For bold players who want a bigger test, speedrun mode is waiting. It is built for those who dare to push harder.
bricks-breaker-deluxe: Bricks Breaker Deluxe is an arcade game with a glowing, neon look, where careful aiming and momentum both matter. You use your mouse to launch shining balls at bricks that move down the screen, and each shot is meant to take them out. Collecting sparkling diamonds unlocks power-ups that can boost your play.

The game also includes an endless mode, so you can keep going without a set finish. Its hypnotic rhythm keeps the action flowing as you play. Over time, you can sharpen your timing and grow into a skilled brick breaker.
crazy-car-driving-3d-simulator: Crazy Car Driving 3D Simulator puts you behind the wheel of a sports car, powered by an advanced real physics engine. You can drive and drift, getting a real feel for a racing machine, and it costs nothing to play. The entire map is an open world city that you can roam freely.

Traffic and rival vehicles never force you to slow down, so you can pull off illegal stunts and keep your speed up without the police giving chase. Drifting fast and doing burnouts are the main draw here. Everything is controlled from the keyboard, so you can jump in and start tearing through the streets right away.
little-pumpkin-online-game: Little Pumpkin Online Game puts you in charge of a small pumpkin on a journey built around gathering candy. As you guide it along the way, you'll need to dodge hazards and keep an eye on your resources, all while aiming for a top score. The controls are simple to pick up, so you can focus on the route ahead rather than memorizing complicated inputs.

Beneath the cheerful look sits a blend of lighthearted fun and careful planning. Each run asks you to weigh your choices and improve your approach as you go, which makes it a rewarding test of skill. Along the way it also teaches a few useful habits, so it works as both a pastime and a learning experience for players who like to sharpen their thinking.
traigon: Traigon unfolds in a retro world made of chunky pixel art. You move through rough, demanding landscapes, timing each jump carefully so you can slip past deadly hazards. The levels grow tougher as you progress, so each new stage asks a little more of you.

Success depends on planning your moves and keeping your nerve instead of rushing ahead. Thoughtful strategy and steady patience carry you through the whole adventure, and the game rewards players who take their time. Expect an engaging journey across its pixelated terrain, one that tests your precision from beginning to end.
solitaire-card-sort-puzzle: Solitaire Card Sort Puzzle challenges you to match colors and sort cards while testing your organization and problem-solving skills. Your goal is to move the cards across the board until each one sits in perfect color order. The early moves may look easy, but every new level demands more, so you will need careful planning and strategic thinking to get through. You control the game by tapping and dragging cards into place.

Color Card Sort is easy to pick up and offers a wide range of colors to work with. It appeals to fans of matching games and sorting challenges, and it serves as a fun brain teaser that anyone can enjoy.
fps-shooting-survival-sim: The zombie outbreak has spiraled out of control, and the undead are adapting and mutating into bigger threats that could take over the planet. You are a specially trained commando, and your job is to fight the zombies and save the world. The mission works like an assassination-style hunt: you must eliminate every zombie while building your combat survival experience.

Pick from a wide range of weapons and head into battle against the undead in varied, creepy locations across the globe. Move with WASD, jump with Space, and hold Shift while pressing W to run. Use the mouse to look around, aim, and shoot.
crazy-buggy-demolition-derby: Take part in classic Crazy Buggy Demolition Derby rounds inside an arena. Every driver begins facing away from the others, and your aim is to crash into rival cars until you are the only one still running. Keep smashing and banging your way into first place in this demolition racer, which draws its spirit from Crazy Buggy Demolition Derby events held around the globe.
Steer with the WASD keys. The game is built for one player and uses 3D graphics, so you can enjoy the chaos of a demolition derby from the driver's seat.
noobcraft-house-escape: Noobcraft House Escape is a pixel-style adventure in which you play an underdog noob whom everyone overlooks. You must think your way through a house, search out objects tucked away in its corners, and crack a series of brainy puzzles. Finding the golden key and a gold coin powers up a magical portal, which carries you off into a fresh and unfamiliar world.

Success depends on careful searching and smart thinking, so take your time as you move from room to room. Each puzzle you solve brings you a step closer to the portal and the adventure waiting beyond it.
run-clicker-tap-muscle-up: Run Clicker: Tap Muscle Up is a clicker game where you keep running to build strength and earn money along the way. The more you run, the stronger your character becomes. Spend your earnings on stamina and speed upgrades so each tap carries you farther and quicker across the track.

Races pit you against tough rivals who test your timing and determination. Winning a race rewards you with a key, and keys unlock new outfits that come with bonuses to boost your running. To get ahead, tap the screen rapidly to build burst speed and overtake other runners. Each victory also brings cash for stat boosts and bulkier muscle tiers, helping you cross the finish line first.
tung-tung-sahur-lol-face: In this game, you reshape the wooden face of a legendary drummer into all kinds of goofy expressions. Pull and stretch his features into comical shapes and see how many silly results you can create. Each new twist keeps the laughs coming, so the fun seems to go on without end.

The game blends creativity and humor in a playful way. You can give him a silly grin or push his face into an exaggerated, shocked look. Every funny shape adds to the entertainment, keeping the experience light and enjoyable from one moment to the next.
butterfly-coloring-pages-kids: Butterfly Coloring Pages Kids offers a set of butterfly-themed drawings ready to be filled in. Each one begins as a plain line drawing, and it is up to you to bring it to life with color. You can try a wide range of hues and different brush textures, so every page can have its own look.

This game is designed to be a calm, relaxing way to pass the time. Take your time with each stroke and enjoy watching a basic outline slowly become a finished picture. Whether you want to be creative or simply unwind, the focus is on your own artwork.
cs-command-snipers: CS Command Snipers is a first person shooter that puts you in the role of an elite sniper. Success depends on careful aiming and working well with your squad. You move through tough missions set in changing battle zones, where you need to outwit enemies as well as shoot them. The game mixes tactical planning with precise long-range shooting.

Each mission asks you to think before you pull the trigger, since the environments shift and the opposition is always watching for an opening. Your choices on positioning and timing shape how each engagement plays out. If you enjoy shooters where patience and planning matter as much as reflexes, this one offers a focused challenge built around the sniper's craft.
jigsaw-puzzle-game: Fit the pieces together in this traditional jigsaw title, made for anyone who enjoys a quiet, considered pace. As a brain teaser, it aims to sharpen focus, recall, and reasoning through gentle, unhurried challenges. You can explore a set of puzzles that run fully offline, so you never need a connection. Controls respond smoothly, and the graphics stay tidy and uncluttered, which suits short sessions in everyday life.
Every button is operated with your mouse, so moving through menus and options takes only a click. Filed under puzzles, it carries tags for brain training, logic, and classic-style play.
shotwildwest: ShotWildWest is a fast action game set in a vivid wild west setting. Your task is to shoot targets that appear rapidly, so precision and speed both matter. The surroundings are immersive, pulling you into the frontier from the first round.

Each attempt is scored, and you can try to beat your last result. Aim to earn the title of top gunfighter by proving you have the sharpest aim. Every click counts, and the pace stays brisk from start to finish.
gangsta-duel: Gangsta Duel takes you into a street showdown filled with fights. You square off against a street gangster and must push through a big wave of foes. Your job is to rely on your abilities to strike and wipe out every opponent in your path. Along the way, you can call on strong fighting moves that hit hard and leave enemies reeling. It sits in the Adventure category and carries the tags Battle, Fight, and Fun.

Controls are simple: click with your mouse or tap the screen to play. Both mouse clicks and taps work, so you can use whichever suits your device. Keep your focus on the waves coming at you and use your combat skills at the right moments.
cave-escape: Climb out of a cave in this adventure by leaping higher and higher to help Rudy reach open air. Falling bricks drop in unpredictable ways, so you must dodge them with care. Those same bricks can also serve as stepping stones that carry you upward.

Along the way, grab diamonds to boost your score. The controls are easy to pick up but take practice to handle well. Fast reflexes and careful planning will help you stay alive, and the game is hard to put down once you start. Rudy's freedom is in your hands.
cargo-truck-simulator-2025: In Cargo Truck Simulator 2025, you take the wheel of a strong truck and head out on demanding routes. Your job is to collect a car that has broken down along the way and carry it safely to where it needs to go. The roads are rough, and the landscape looks true to life, so you will need to steer around hazards as you go.
Each stage asks for careful, exact driving to finish it. Movement is handled with the W, A, S, and D keys, so you can control the truck as you travel from one point to the next.
build-a-road: In Build a Road, you put together your own obstacle course and see how large you can make it. Pick up blocks, walls, ramps, lava, and more, then arrange them piece by piece. Run through your finished obby to earn money from it. Spend that money to upgrade your plot, so you can build even bigger courses. The game is a clicker with idle and tycoon elements, and it is built around obbies.
Move your character with the WASD keys, or use the joystick if you are on a phone. To interact with objects on the map, click with your mouse or tap the button on screen.
mandala-coloring-book: Mandala Coloring Book is a calm drawing game where you can relax and get creative with detailed patterns. Filling in the designs is easy thanks to a simple interface, and you decide every color you use. The setting is low-pressure, so you are free to experiment with bold shades and enjoy the process.

Each stroke you make adds a lively touch to your artwork, letting you produce colorful pieces at your own pace. The game is all about unwinding and exploring your own artistic style without any stress.
real-motor-race-master: Real Motor Race Master is a motorbike racing game that runs right in your web browser. Speed through cityscapes glowing with neon lights, and customize your bike to match your own style. When you need extra speed, trigger a nitro boost, and perform stunts with little effort along the way.

Keep progressing to unlock new bikes, and come back each day to compete in races. The game is easy to pick up, so you can jump in and start racing right away. Every race is a fresh chance to show what your rider can do.
bowmaster-tower-attack: This tower defense shooter puts you in charge of protecting your tower by aiming and firing arrows at a crowd of odd attackers. In an age when wars are at their height, a mixed army of enemies has joined forces to bring your castle down. They must first destroy your towers, so you are the one standing in their way.

Pick off the invaders one by one with careful aim. After each level you can improve and strengthen your weapons, which you will need, since the enemies become much tougher as you advance. To play, use the mouse on a PC, or touch the screen on a mobile device.
starship-troopers: Take on the role of a bold soldier facing enemy forces at a base on the Moon. You carry a wide range of weapons, among them flamethrowers and rocket launchers, and you'll move through tense firefights. Keep your eyes open, use your health carefully, and pick up essential supplies to stay alive through this thrilling story.
The game sits in the shooting genre and is tagged as a shooter. Its setting is a lunar installation under attack, and every encounter tests how well you handle your gear and your resources.
blocks-merge: Blocks Merge is a puzzle game where you must remove every block before the timer runs out. Blocks of the same color burst apart when they land near each other, so the order you place them in matters. To reposition a block, grab it and drag it to any open spot it can reach.

You only need the mouse to play, so every move is a click and a drag. Plan ahead, because each placement changes which colors end up next to each other. The game blends logic with quick thinking, making it a casual brain teaser for players who like matching colors.
happy-obby-land: This cheerful title is designed for the very youngest gamers and draws its inspiration from well-loved stories for children. Each young player gets the chance to step into the role of a brave hero and work their way up to the loftiest summits.

Moving around is simple: press W to head forward, S to step back, and A or D to slide left or right. Tap SHIFT to switch the mouse lock on or off, which lets you lock or unlock the camera. Press ESC to open the settings menu.
bounce-td: Bounce TD blends the familiar feel of tower defense with physics-driven puzzle play. Your job is to keep your base safe as enemies keep arriving in a never-ending stream. The catch is that towers stay dormant until a special energy ball strikes them. You plan the path of each shot, make the ball ricochet off surfaces, and set off deadly chain reactions.

The controls are straightforward to pick up, yet there is plenty of tactical depth hidden underneath. The game offers hundreds of levels, and each stage brings higher difficulty along with fresh challenges. You only need a mouse or a touchscreen to play.
fruit-madness: Fruit Madness is a puzzle game built around cute, cartoon-style fruits that bump and fuse together. When two matching fruits meet, they blend into a new one that tastes even better, and your goal is to rack up as many points as you can. The rules are easy to pick up because they follow the logic of many merge games.

Boosters give you extra options. You can level up a fruit, shrink fruits so they take up less space, or clear an entire cluster from the board. Each round starts with four boosters, and you earn another random one for every 500 points. To play, aim with your finger or mouse, check your target, then release to drop the fruit in. If the board gets crowded, a booster is there to help. The longer you keep going, the more fruity combinations you will discover.
archery-king: Archery King lets you train as a skilled bowman, where accuracy, well-judged timing, and concentration all matter. You move through changing surroundings while gusts of wind shift from one moment to the next, so each arrow you release calls for careful refinement before it flies.

You can head out on your own to sharpen your technique, or invite a friend into head-to-head contests. Matches demand a calm, consistent aim while also adapting to the surprises the environment throws at you. Whether you have what it takes to reach the top of the archery ranks is up to you to find out.
thief-puzzle-long-hand-game: Thief Puzzle Long Hand Game is a puzzle title about a sneaky burglar whose arm stretches far past normal length and bends with ease. You guide this crook toward valuable targets, extending the limb to snatch each one without getting caught. Along the way, you must steer clear of traps, obstacles, guards, and other dangers.

Every button in the game is activated with a mouse click, so pointing and clicking is all you need to get started. Take your time to study each reach before you commit, since a single misstep can set off a hazard and ruin the attempt.
career-rush: Career Rush lets you picture the job you have always wanted. It blends a collecting arcade experience with a vertical running challenge, where dodging is just as important as grabbing things. The whole adventure is built from animated 3D cartoon artwork, and each stage has you guiding a girl toward her chosen profession.

Your job is to gather the green money bags along the way and pick a career as you go. Watch out for the red money bags, since touching them is something you want to avoid on every level. Movement is handled by sliding your finger, so steering stays simple. Take things easy and enjoy the ride at your own pace.
furious-speed: Furious Speed is a racing game where you weave through traffic, slide around corners, and escape police cars chasing you. Quick reactions matter, since every decision has to be made in a split second. As you succeed, you earn access to a range of fast sports cars to drive.

The clock is always running, and the police never stop coming after you. Each moment on the road counts, so stay sharp and keep your foot down. Tagged under Driving, this one is built for players who enjoy high-speed chases.
let-me-in: Let Me In puts you in charge of busy city transit, where the streets are crowded and things can get messy fast. Your job is to plan ahead so each bus leaves with a full load, and you need to time your moves carefully so that nobody ends up stuck at the stop. It is a puzzle game built around strategy, and you have to make the most of the limited resources you are given.

Keeping a crowded city route moving smoothly takes patience and foresight. Think through every move, watch the lines grow, and work to keep everyone on the move while making do with what little you have.
puzzledom-one-line: Puzzledom: One Line is a brain teaser built around drawing. This casual puzzle minigame looks easy at first, but each level is tougher than it seems. Six different ways to play let you pick the style you like best. In one example, you draw lines to guide boys and girls to the right restroom so they don't bump into each other.
You play with a mouse click or a tap. Every stage asks you to plan your lines carefully, since drawing is the main tool for solving each challenge.
containment-protocol-roguelike-deckbuild: Take charge of a combat android in this sci-fi roguelike deckbuilder. Link cards together, read what enemies plan to do next, and find ways to outwit dangerous bosses. Three Operators each fight in their own style, and every run lets you shape a deck around your approach while uncovering new card pairings.

Campaign mode sends you through ten areas of the Atlas to learn what caused the containment breach, and along the way you raise your Operator Rank and collect permanent Modules. Classic offers three-act runs across ten difficulty levels, where earned Chips help you refine your starting deck. Breach brings branching weekly maps with shifting anomalies, plus daily Operations and monthly milestones. Play with mouse or touch, in portrait or landsc
gun-blast: Gun Blast is a fast arcade shooter where each tap fires your weapon and pushes you through the air, so the recoil becomes your way of moving. You bounce around the screen, bank shots off walls, and string together accurate hits in chaotic, skill-based fights. You can swap between weapons such as SMGs and shotguns, and each one handles differently and calls for its own approach. Pick up rockets for explosive blasts or shields for protection, and adjust as the round unfolds.

The goal is simple: shoot down the other guns in the arena, and the last one standing wins. On PC, press SPACE to fire. On mobile, tap the screen to fire. Every shot adds recoil that moves you across the space, so take aim, get ready, and enjoy the action.
american-block-sniper-survival-online: This first-person shooter places you in a blocky world inspired by Minecraft, where every stage must be cleared of hostile figures before time expires. Each round starts with only a rifle, but you will find and switch to many other guns along the way. A single round lasts roughly two to five minutes, with the exact length tied to how well you score. Your goal is to take down every enemy that appears on the map.

Roam the city by moving from building to building and picking up weapons so you can knock out foes spread across the streets. Use WASD to walk, move the mouse to look around, left-click to shoot, and right-click to aim. Scroll the mouse wheel to swap weapons, and note that the G key also has a function.
drawing-online: Gather up to four players, mixing in friends or bots, for a light-hearted sketching contest. Each round you receive a word and sketch it with your finger while the game tries to guess what you have drawn. The quicker it names your picture, the more points you collect. Within three minutes you'll tackle five drawing challenges, then climb the podium to see where you rank. Matchmaking is quick, so getting into a game takes little time.

Controls stay simple, visuals carry a hand-drawn look, and touch drawing feels smooth, all backed by cheerful sounds. Nobody goes home empty-handed: every player gains points and experience, though only one claims first place. Unlock cute animal avatars along the way. If a word stumps you, watch what others are drawing or press Skip.
baby-monster-jump: You control a small, adorable monster as it moves through dangerous stages full of hazards. The controls are easy to pick up, so your focus goes to timing each leap and moving quickly enough to avoid whatever stands in the way. Every stage asks you to react fast and stay calm.

The game looks colorful and cheerful, and a sweet storyline gives the arcade action some heart. Challenges keep coming with no clear end, and well-hidden power-ups reward players who look closely. It's a lighthearted run that rewards sharp reflexes.
99-nights-in-the-forest-survival-simulat: In this survival simulator, you set out on forest trips to gather food and materials, battle monsters, and search for missing kids. Three areas hold a mix of calm creatures and aggressive foes, and you will also find chests and resources along the way. Rescuing the children means defeating hidden bosses. To begin a trip, click Hike and choose the area you want to explore.

Combat depends on timing. To attack, click when the triangle sits over the center of the attack bar. To defend, hold to stop the heart, then release it so it moves in the other direction. A skin merchant sells upgrades you can buy, and each achievement you earn pays out diamonds.
johnny-jump-challenge: Johnny Jump Challenge sends you on a climb built around bold hops that seem to ignore gravity. Your route is dotted with obstacles that move in ways you cannot predict, so you have to stay watchful at all times. Every carefully chosen jump lifts you a little higher, and your aim is to reach the top of the leaderboard. The game takes only a moment to pick up, but it takes real practice before you can play it well.

Quick reactions are at the heart of the challenge, so you need to stay alert and plan a few steps ahead. One badly timed move can send Johnny crashing down, which means every decision matters. If you enjoy testing how fast you can respond and how carefully you can think, this title has plenty to keep you busy.
unblock-ball-slide-puzzle-2: Unblock Ball: Slide Puzzle 2 is a classic sliding puzzle that puts your thinking skills to work. Solving each puzzle gives you a real sense of accomplishment. You slide the board to carve out a channel, letting the ball roll smoothly to the end. Along the way, you use logic to move blocks cleverly, avoid obstacles, and find the answer to every puzzle.

Control is simple: a mouse click or a tap is all you need. Take your time with each arrangement, think a few moves ahead, and work through the board one step at a time. Careful reasoning is what opens the path for the ball, and watching it roll to the finish makes every solved puzzle worth the effort.
3-warrior-team-force: Gather a squad of courageous fighters in this adventure title. Your journey takes you across dangerous lands as you work to liberate a realm held under a wicked ruler. Along the way, companions stand beside you at every step, so the battles are never yours alone. The game mixes action, defense, and fighting, giving you plenty of variety as you push forward.

Controls are simple to pick up. Use W, A, S, and D or the arrow keys to get around. Press Space to unleash a special move, and tap C to swap between heroes. Z is your attack button, so keep it handy when enemies close in.
car-care-repair-dudu-mechanic: Car Care Repair DuDu Mechanic puts you in the role of a capable mechanic in a relaxed simulation game. Customers arrive with all kinds of trouble, including smashed windows, split doors, flat tires, motors that no longer run properly, and missing parts. It is up to you to work out what each vehicle needs and get it back in shape.
Everything is handled with a single mouse click or a tap, so the controls stay simple from start to finish. Take your time with each client and enjoy the easygoing pace of the repairs.
zombie-derby-2: Zombie Derby 2 puts you behind the wheel in a world overrun by the undead. Your goal is to plow through zombies and keep driving for as long as you can. Fuel matters here, so manage it carefully, because once you run dry, the zombies will catch up. Along the way, you can gather upgrades and unlock new cars.

Nitro boosts give you a burst of speed, letting you leap over hills or smash through large crowds of zombies. The controls are simple: press W or the up arrow to accelerate and the spacebar to shoot your gun. Use Left Shift or N for nitro, and the left and right arrows or A and D to tilt forward and backward.
funny-angela-haircut: Angela needs a fresh look, and you get to decide what it becomes. Her hair can be shaped with a range of professional tools, including curling irons, blow dryers, and scissors, plus a magic spray that makes it grow. You can also dye it in whatever colors you like.

Once the hair is done, move on to clothing. Mix and match pieces to build outfits, then dress Angela up so she looks more stylish. The game runs on desktop and mobile. On a computer, use the mouse to control everything, and on a phone or tablet, just tap the screen to start and keep playing.
gun-clone: Gun Clone is a free arcade runner where you can upgrade and duplicate strong guns. Expect quick action as you push through a set of levels, defeat enemies, and fine-tune your weapon collection. The game features both genders, and its pace suits short breaks as well as longer sittings.
Movement works with your finger or mouse cursor, and shooting happens automatically. You can upgrade weapons during a level or from the main menu.
save-the-galaxy: Save the Galaxy is an arcade game set in a lively cosmos, where alien invaders are closing in on your worlds. Each quick tap wipes out one of them. The fight grows harder with every new wave, so you will need both speed and careful precision to keep up. Chasing a better score gives you a reason to keep coming back.

The battlefield is a chaotic clash of cosmic warfare, rendered in bright, vivid graphics. Your goal is to hold back the invaders and defend the galaxy from their attack. Each wave brings more intensity, so stay sharp and keep your determination strong from start to finish.
tank-craft-2: Tank Craft 2, also called TankCraft 2: Hell Bosses War, is a 2D tank battle game with a crafting element. You take on the role of a tank engineer, combining thousands of part combinations, including hulls, turrets, cannons, and tracks, to build a machine suited to firepower, armor, and speed. Experimenting is central, so you can swap pieces, tweak your design, and see what works best.

Once your tank is ready, you enter fast, side-scrolling fights against an invasion of hellish bosses pouring out of a volcano. Waves of corrupted enemy tanks and huge demonic bosses fill lava-soaked, rocky arenas full of explosions. Parts dropped by defeated foes can be added to your build, so your tank grows stronger as the battles become harder. Each level is cleared by destroying every enemy and boss within it. The cartoonish visuals and cute tank characters keep the mood light, even during the intense action.
zombie-killer: Zombie Killer drops you into a world overrun by the undead, where staying alive is the whole challenge. Begin by choosing your character, then work through an arsenal of weapons at your disposal. Accuracy is central here, since landing headshots is how you cut through relentless hordes that keep coming at you.
Coins earned along the way can be spent on upgrading your gear, which boosts your chances of surviving each encounter. The adventure unfolds in a chaotic, post-apocalyptic setting full of danger.
456-survival-squid-challenge: In this survival title, you step into a tense contest of nerve and wits. Its games include well-known tests such as Green Light, Red Light and the Dalgona Challenge, so you will need fast reactions and clear thinking to get through each one. Quick choices count for a lot here.

Each level asks for close attention and careful planning, since every move needs to be precise. Your goal is to push through the challenges and come out victorious. If you can keep your cool under pressure and stay one step ahead, you may just be the last one standing.
archery-shooting: This tiny archery game is easy to pick up and built for a single player. Your aim is simple: send each arrow toward the center of the target. The closer your shot lands to the middle, the more points you collect. Every time you strike right in the center, you earn bonus arrows.
It is a small, short game that works well for a quick round of target practice with a bow.
season-wiping-window: Season Wiping Window is a fun HTML5 browser game that promises plenty of enjoyment. To begin, choose one of the seasons, then set to work wiping the window. It is a light, playful pick for anyone looking to relax for a while.

You can handle everything with a mouse or by tapping, so you can play with whichever input suits you best. The game's puzzle style and funny touches make it a good fit for younger players and grown-ups alike. Everything about it feels cheerful from start to finish.
king-of-ball: A conversation between two friends kicks off Carter's journey. One of them suggests heading to a marvel of adventure, a place Carter has tried to reach many times without success. Even so, his friend firmly believes Carter can finally pull it off. Hidden traps and dangers lie in wait along the way. You take control of Carter, complete every level, and collect gold coins as
tractor-simulator-farming-game: Tractor Simulator puts you in charge of a working farm. You plant, gather, and sell crops while steering your tractor across scenic fields. Beyond raw produce, you can also turn ingredients into finished goods such as tomato ketchup and dairy snacks. As you advance through the levels, fresh chances to make money open up, so your farm grows steadily with every season of effort.

The game focuses on the steady rhythm of country life, where each small harvest builds toward bigger results. Every step you take, from working the soil to moving your goods, adds to the overall progress. It is a relaxed yet rewarding experience for anyone who enjoys watching a homestead flourish over time.
offroad-4x4-driving-simulator: Tackle rough, uneven ground in OffRoad 4x4 Driving Simulator, a game built around off-road driving. You navigate challenging mountain trails, and the driving physics are designed to feel realistic. Every trip across the rugged terrain tests your skills behind the wheel.

Off-road adventures are at the heart of the experience, so the game suits anyone who enjoys demanding routes and wild landscapes. It sits in the Arcade category and carries the Simulation tag, blending accessible play with realistic handling. Expect a ride with plenty of steep climbs and rocky paths to keep you moving across the hills.
run-giant-3d: Run Giant 3D is a hypercasual browser game that blends running with fighting. As you dash forward, grab as many items of the same color as you can. Each item you collect adds to your strength, and the more you gather, the bigger your hero becomes. Once you reach the finish line, that growing strength is what you need to knock out the opponent waiting there.

The core idea is simple: a bigger collection means a bigger giant, so you can see just how large your hero can get. Control is easy, since you only need to slide your finger or mouse to steer. Tags include 3D, Avoid, Collecting, Highscore, HTML, Mobile and Online.
kofi-adventure: Kofi Adventure is a platformer that follows Kofi through enchanted woods and mysterious caves. Along the way, you face magical creatures and rely on clever strategies and well-timed moves. Your goal is to uncover the secrets of Dreamland.

The world is colorful and full of bright scenery, and the puzzles are challenging, so you will need to think carefully before each move. Your choices shape the story, and each one leads to a different ending. It is a heartwarming quest from start to finish.
zumba-quest: Wander through a colorful landscape where every chapter brings its own setting and a fresh batch of puzzles. Each stage pushes you against the clock, and special marbles appear to give you a hand when you need one. As you move forward through the levels, you gain access to new marble shooters to try.

The gameplay centers on marble matching with no real end. Aim your shooter and fire to line up three or more marbles of the same hue, which then vanish from the board. Your target is to clear every marble that shows up or finish the level before time runs out. Three boosters are available to help you progress.
interceptor-police-pursuit: Climb into a police cruiser in this 3D chase game with bold, comic-style visuals. Track down suspects through traffic, dodge road hazards, and stop them before time runs out. Sprint mode focuses on speed and boosts, Heavy mode lets you ram enemy vehicles, and Interceptor mode asks you to line up pulse shots. Complete cases, earn rewards, and upgrade your police cars for tougher pursuits.
Your car accelerates on its own, so steering is your main job. Use A, D, or the Left and Right arrows to steer, and S, Down, or Shift to brake. Space gives you a boost, and F fires a
quarantine-rush: The virus is spreading quickly, and your mission is to rescue as many people as you can. Send everyone safely back home, then use power-ups to cure those who have already been infected. Collect coins along the way to unlock new items, which will help you save even more people in the fight against the outbreak.
Quarantine Rush is an arcade action title that carries a clear message: stay home. Getting started is easy, since a click or touch is all you need to begin playing.
jim-s-world-adventure-games: Jim's World lets you return to the games you loved as a kid, with a princess rescue at its heart. It is an old-school running title with carefully built stages, a range of foes, and tough bosses. The gameplay stays simple, the graphics look polished, and the music and sounds are calm and soothing.

Ever since the princess was carried off into the jungle, the land has felt bare and lifeless. Now you guide Jim through the mysterious greenery, leaping over obstacles and dodging dangerous monsters until you reach the final destination where she waits. Use the buttons to jump, move, and fire. Eat mushrooms and items to grow stronger and defeat every monster, and collect coins and bonus items for more points, which you can spend on extra items in the store.
kitten-rescue: A small cat has been tied up with ropes and locked inside a room, and it's up to you to set him free. On a phone or tablet, swipe your finger across the screen to slice through the cords holding him. Watch out for dangerous traps along the way, and guide the little feline toward safety.

Each stage is tougher than the last, and you can rescue and collect more cute cats as you go. The game is easy to pick up and keeps you hooked. On a computer, simply move your mouse or touchpad to cut the ropes. The kitty's fate rests entirely with you.
tom-runner: Tom Runner puts you in the paws of Tom, a quick-footed raccoon sprinting through a busy metropolis while the cops chase close behind. The game is built around fast action, so you keep moving forward and reacting to what lies ahead. Touch controls handle every move as you weave through the city's streets.
euro-truck-parking: Drive a heavy-duty truck through a single-player parking challenge set in city streets. You'll weave through crowded roads, cramped lots, and lifelike surroundings, aiming to bring your rig into the marked bays. Each stage brings fresh hurdles, so you'll need to handle steering, backing up, stopping smoothly, and managing a trailer.

Dodge hazards, keep to lane markings, and line up your parking precisely to rack up bigger scores. Good results open up additional trucks, stages, and upgrades. Controls: press W, A, S, D or the arrow keys to drive and steer.
glow-halloween-nails-game: This glow-in-the-dark manicure game brings a realistic salon experience to your screen as Halloween approaches on October 31st. Ghosts, zombies, bats, and vampires all appear in spooky holiday outfits. Switch off the room lights, then paint on luminous polish and glowing ornaments the way a professional nail technician would.
Begin by picking a skin tone, giving your nails a shine, and trimming them to the length you like. Next, choose from a large range of polish shades and start building a lovely pi
tarantula-clicker: Tarantula Clicker is a clicker game where you build a fortune one click at a time. Every press adds to your earnings, and you can raise your income further by choosing upgrades that fit how you like to play. As your money grows, you can also unlock skins that change how your spider looks.

The game includes a competitive side, so you can aim to rise to the top and earn the title of the leading spider mogul. It's a playful, hard-to-put-down experience where planning your purchases and keeping up the clicking are the main things to focus on.
red-and-blue-cat: Red and Blue Cat are two alien felines who set off on a space adventure. You guide both of them through a dangerous spacecraft packed with monsters and traps. Along the way, you solve puzzles and gather valuable gems. Each stage asks you to find the key before you can make your escape.

You can tackle the journey alone or team up with a friend in co-op mode. Controlling both cats at once means you must plan each move carefully. Thoughtful strategy about where each cat goes is the key to getting out of every level.
dont-be-angry-with-match-man: Dont be angry with match man puts you in control of a match man character as it makes its way through a set of levels. Each level is packed with unexpected traps, and the way they are laid out has to be discovered by playing through them. Getting past them takes plenty of patience.

Movement is kept simple: you walk forward, walk backward, and jump. Since this is a one-player game, every challenge depends on your own timing and judgment. Staying calm while you work out each trap layout will help you get through the stages.
ball-connect: In Ball Connect, you join pairs of matching balls by drawing routes across a knotted grid. Plan each move carefully, since lines cannot cross and you must leave enough room to finish every connection. The controls are simple, and smooth animations make each successful link feel rewarding. Hundreds of hand-built levels are included, and they grow more demanding as you move forward.

Whether you are new to puzzles or already an experienced solver, the gameplay offers a calm yet engaging pace. Collect rewards and open colorful themes as you go. It also works as a way to train your brain while you have fun. Play with a mouse on a computer, or use your finger on a touchscreen device.
jig-snap-puzzles: Jig Snap Puzzles takes you through photos from around the world. Each jigsaw shows a famous landmark, an exotic animal, tasty cuisine, or a view of outer space. You start with 3x3 boards and move up to 4x4 and then 5x5 grids as you progress. Drag pieces into place, or drop one onto another to swap positions. Neighboring correct pieces merge automatically.

Finishing puzzles earns stars and coins. Collect enough stars to unlock new themed packs, and replay levels for more coins, though only the first clear of each level grants stars. The hint button places pieces for you, but it costs coins or is limited per level. Begin with corners and edges, and group similar colors or patterns. The game works on mobile, so you can play anywhere, anytime, and it suits puzzle fans of all ages.
pull-the-thread-puzzle: Pull the Thread is a brain-teasing puzzle game built around guiding a piece of thread through a series of challenges. It blends straightforward ideas with layered difficulty, so each stage looks simple at first but grows more involved as you go. Across thirty detailed levels, you navigate your thread and wind it around key nodes to solve each one.

Every level you finish sharpens your strategic thinking for what comes next. The controls are easy to pick up, which keeps the game approachable, yet the puzzles stay tough enough to hold the attention of players of any age.
time-of-adventure-ice-king: Step into the world of Adventure Time in this arcade game, where your journey takes you across a frozen land. The Ice King's soldiers are posted all over the snowy terrain, so you will need to stay alert as you move forward. Along the way, gather the crystals you come across and keep going until you reach the end of the game.

The adventure is split into 15 demanding chapters, each one a fresh test of your skills. The game works with mobile controls, and on a computer you can use WASD or the arrow keys, with Shift as an extra key. A how-to-play guide is available if you want a quick rundown before you begin.
drop-dunks: Drop Dunks has you bouncing balls into baskets by steering a platform that deflects them toward the hoops. Every successful shot scores points. Three dispensers keep releasing balls, putting your reflexes to the test. Choosing when to upgrade to new balls and cannons is a strategic part of the challenge.
It is basketball with a clever twist, where quick thinking and precision act as your best allies. Aim carefully, keep your timing sharp, and see how well you can handle the court.
robby-the-lava-tsunami: Robby The Lava Tsunami is a free online game where you race ahead of a wave of flowing lava. The bright, colorful setting is easy on the eyes, and you can call on unique skills and customize your character in countless ways. It suits players who enjoy speed and acrobatic moves, and it works on iOS, Android, and desktop.

On a computer, use W, A, S, and D to move, drag the mouse to look around, press Space to jump, and hit Tab or Escape to pause. Keys 1 through 5 activate your abilities. On a phone, you control the game through the on-screen interface, move freely in any direction, and adjust the camera view. Your aim is to stay ahead of the lava and win.
repo-and-repo: Repo and Repo is a pixel-style puzzle platformer where you switch between characters to pick up all the gems. It belongs to the Puzzles category and offers brain-teasing challenges with a funny, lighthearted tone. Working out when to change characters is the core of the fun, so think each move through before you act.

The controls are simple. Press the Up arrow to jump, the Right arrow to move right, and the Left arrow to move left. Press X whenever you want to switch characters. These few keys are all you need to get going.
aidol-k-pop-adventure: Step into the bright world of K-pop in Aidol K-pop Adventure, where your job is to steer a group of performers toward fame. Refine your group's style through detailed dance routines, trendy outfits, and flawless makeup. Creativity gets plenty of room here, with endless melodies and fashion possibilities to explore.

number-quest: Number Quest takes you on a journey through a series of levels, each filled with number puzzles that put your math to the test. Every stage brings its own set of problems, and you'll need quick thinking and clever problem-solving to get past them. The puzzles grow more complex as you advance, so there is plenty to explore and learn along the way. Designed for players of all ages, it blends entertainment with education and aims to make math enjoyable for everyone.

With a mouse, left-click to select numbers or interact with objects in the game, then drag and drop numbers or pieces to the spot you want. On mobile devices, tap to select and interact, and swipe to move numbers around.
anime-girl-fashion-make-up: Anime Girl Fashion Make Up is a dress-up game where your imagination is the main tool. You start with a calming spa visit, then move on to building eye-catching looks with trendy makeup. Next, you can try on fancy outfits from a designer-style collection. Mix and match pieces to see what works, and get better at styling anime-inspired beauty and fashion.

The game sits in the Girls category and is tagged as Dress Up. There are no instructions, so you can simply explore the spa, makeup, and clothing options at your own pace and experiment freely with each look.
catch-cats: Catch Cats is a fast action game where you tap to catch small, speedy kittens and rack up points. The bright, colorful setting keeps things lively while your reflexes and quickness get a real workout. Challenges never seem to run out, and the game gives you a friendly way to compete, whether you love cats or just enjoy a good reflex test.

Every tap counts, so the aim is to keep catching as many kittens as you can and push your score higher each time you play. It is a simple, easy-to-pick-up game that suits anyone looking for a quick round of fun with a bit of competition on the side.
idle-influencer-simulator: Idle Influencer Simulator puts you in charge of a social media channel as you work your way up the online ranks. You make videos, keep an eye on what's trending, and watch your numbers climb over time. Your home studio is where your brand takes shape. As you build it up, you can spend on upgraded gear that helps more people find your content. Most of the progress happens on its own, so you rarely need to press much, yet careful planning still shapes how fast your channel grows.
Your aim is to reach full influencer stardom with very little hands-on effort. Choosing the right upgrades and planning each step with care is how you get there.
pop-and-splat-squishy-merge: Welcome to a cozy bakery full of the squishiest jelly characters around. Their soft, bouncy bodies respond to every touch, so you can poke them, squish them, or toss them across the room. Watch them splat against walls or stick to the ceiling, where they slowly sag. Each one wobbles, pulls goofy faces, blinks, and follows your finger with its eyes. You start with a tiny Dumpling and can discover 100 quirky characters, including rare golden masters.
Tap squishies to collect coins, and quick taps send them into a fiery jiggle frenzy. Drag matching ones onto each other to merge them into the next cute tier. To fling a squishy, swipe toward the
sportbike-drive: Sportbike Drive is a motorcycle simulator that puts your riding skills to the test. You can pick from three different bikes and explore two locations, and you are free to push each machine as far as you like. Choose a ride, cruise around the map, or attempt wild stunts whatever your mood.
Steer with WASD or the arrow keys, press 2 to accelerate and X to brake with the rear wheel. Press R to restart, and use Esc or Tab to get back to the main menu.
combine-pickaxes: This hypercasual title starts you with basic pickaxes that are fairly weak. You merge them to build far stronger versions. Planning ahead matters, because you decide which tools to combine and how to grow your collection of gear. Each upgrade helps you break through barriers faster and bring in larger earnings.

Every level asks you to clear obstacles with the tools you have built, so both your skill and your reasoning count. Gather new equipment as you advance and keep refining your set until you have beaten each stage. It is a casual game for players who enjoy steady progression.
battle-simulator-police-prison: Take charge of a police team as they carry out escape missions inside complex prison layouts. You plan the moves for every officer and make the most of each one's special abilities across fast, puzzle-style levels. Your job is to stay a step ahead of clever inmates while keeping your squad in solid tactical formation. Each battle simulation is packed with action and tension, so you'll be hooked from start to finish.
thorn-and-blast: Thorn and Blast is a hypercasual action puzzler that rewards quick decisions and careful aim. The goal is easy to grasp: pop the colorful thorns by lining up your shots and firing powerful balls at them. Each level must be cleared of every thorn, and you only get a limited number of shots to do it.

As you move through the stages, the challenge builds and asks more of your timing, planning, and aim. Fast-paced rounds and enjoyable wins keep things moving. On a phone, drag your finger to set your aim, then lift it to launch a Fruit at the thorns. On a computer, press and hold the mouse to aim, then let go to blast Fruits toward them.
feeding-a-black-hole: You play as a black hole that grows by devouring asteroids. Steer it with your cursor or finger to smash rocks and gather resources. Spend coins and skill points on upgrades such as more damage, new asteroid types, and new abilities, moving through a deep progression path and a wide skill tree. After each level, you pick one of three random rewards.

When progress starts to crawl, hit the Prestige button, which wipes all your progress. In return, you gain a lasting boost to asteroid value, so your next run goes much faster. Prestige also brings permanent progress multipliers that carry into every future run.
vlinder-girl-fashion-story: Vlinder Girl Fashion Story is a dress-up game in the Girls category, with tags that include makeover, hair, and cleaning. Fashion matters to every girl, and it should shine for any event. Choosing among a dazzling wardrobe can feel overwhelming, but the secret is simply pairing the right pieces with a good eye. This fashion guide walks you through matching step by step so you can grow into a true style expert.

Dress your characters in different outfits, then work on their hair, makeup, and overall design. You will face a range of situations and need to pick looks that suit each one. Don't overlook hats, necklaces, and earrings, since a wide range of trendy accessories is waiting for you. When your style is complete, snap a picture of the final look. Controls are simple: click or tap with your mouse to play.
obby-but-you-re-on-a-motorcycle: Obby, but you're on a motorcycle puts you on a bike racing through obby-style courses. Expect crashes, daredevil jumps, and gravity-defying tricks as you push toward the finish. The faster you ride, the livelier things get.

Worlds are packed with tracks, and beating one unlocks the next map full of ramps, loops, and surprises. Roads can turn slippery, ramps may slant, and turns keep you guessing, since no two courses are alike. On PC, steer with WASD or arrow ke
football-champ-3d: Football Champ 3D combines careful planning with lifelike football action. You handle your own maneuvers, fine-tune your tactics, and aim to guide your team to victory. Everything takes place in a three-dimensional setting, so the action on the field feels grounded and immersive.

Use the game to sharpen your skills on the pitch and experience how intense competitive football can feel. It rewards strategic thinking as much as quick play, making it a good pick for anyone who enjoys sports games with a tactical side.
bucket-ball: Bucket Ball is a puzzle game where your goal is to roll a ball into a bucket. To begin, tap the gate so it swings open and the action can start. Some obstacles can be pushed out of the way, while others can be used in clever ways to steer the ball where it needs to go. Each stage gives you different items that help you get through it.

my-dentist: My Dentist puts you in a dental clinic where your job is to care for virtual patients. The game has a lighthearted, cheerful feel. You learn to use a range of dental tools and face different kinds of problems as you go, which gradually sharpens your abilities. Its colorful visuals keep the experience pleasant while you pick up useful knowledge about looking after teeth and gums.

Players of every age can enjoy this one, since it teaches oral health in a way that feels playful and satisfying. Each patient gives you a fresh task to work through, and getting it right brings a real sense of accomplishment. If you have ever been curious about what goes on behind the dentist's chair, this game offers a light, friendly way to find out.
gt-championship-arcade: GT Championship Arcade drops you onto glowing, fast-paced race circuits where sleek futuristic GT cars battle it out on winding tracks. You can go flat out for thrilling top speeds, practice clean, controlled drifts through the corners, and race against rivals that adjust to how you drive. As you progress, you open up fresh tracks and new vehicles to try.

Every race brings varied obstacles and plenty of tense moments, giving you a constant jolt of excitement from start to finish. It is a fast, flashy racer for anyone who enjoys pushing a car to its limits.
bubble-foxy: Step into a bright bubble-popping game starring a fox who travels through enchanting realms full of cute animal bubbles and clever puzzles. Your aim is to group three or more bubbles of the same color so they vanish and the board clears. Chain them together for large combos, and work past tricky obstacles along the way. Each stage takes you through lovely scenery, and finishing the goals opens new magical worlds.

Aim by dragging across the screen, then let go to fire. Bouncing shots off the walls helps you reach hard-to-get spots, and rescuing the animals is part of clearing every level. The game offers hundreds of levels, one-touch controls, 3D visuals, smooth animations, and daily rewards. It also works offline, so you can unwind or sharpen your puzzle skills whenever you like. Plan each shot carefully and use boosters wisely.
escaping-arrows: Escaping Arrows is a calm, minimalist puzzle built around tangled routes and directions. Every arrow sits on the board and must be cleared away, one at a time, until the field is empty. Each choice carries weight, so careful thinking pays off.
The adventure spans 100 levels, starting with simple layouts and growing into intricate mazes. Every fifth stage raises the challenge, offering a sharper test along the way. Its
cannon-blast-3d: This 3D arcade puzzler has you line up a cannon and fire at structures made of boxes, cans, stones, and ice. Physics controls how every piece tumbles, so your task is to spot the weakest spot, work out the angle and power, and bring the whole build down. Blowing up TNT can set off chain reactions that take out several targets at once.

Later stages add moving platforms, obstacles, portals, and tougher constructions. Every puzzle can be tackled in more than one way, and sometimes a single well-placed shot does the job. Your shots are limited, so study each structure before you fire. Destroy all the required objects to finish a level and advance to the next challenge.
cardivo-adventure: Cardivo Adventure is a calm card-sorting puzzle. Each card belongs to a themed collection, and you shift cards between stacks, uncover hidden matches, and arrange colorful sets before your moves run out. Well-built level layouts, smooth animations, and helpful boosters for tough boards keep things interesting, while the challenges grow steadily so every round feels like a fresh little journey.

Your aim is to sort every card onto its matching themed stack and clear all required cards to finish a level. On desktop, use the left mouse button to select and move cards. On mobile and tablet, tap or drag cards with one finger. Completing a level unlocks the next challenge. If you run out of moves, retry the level and plan a different sequence.
join-clash-3d: Join Clash 3D is an arcade game that combines dodging, gunfire, item gathering, and monster battles. The idea is easy to grasp. You start with a single soldier and must blast barrels to bring more troops into your group. Keep watching for hazards, because hitting them costs you soldiers.

Toward the end, monsters burst out of caves, and you need a big enough squad to take them on. Along the way, remember to boost your soldiers' firepower. Sliding your finger across the screen handles both shooting and dodging.
pin-puzzle-love-story: Put your thinking cap on, because this puzzle game asks you to rely on sharp logic to bring romance back on track. You move through a series of tricky stages, and in each one your job is to pull out pins in the correct order. Get the sequence right and a pair of lovers is reunited.

Every stage presents a fresh logic challenge, and only one specific latch will open the way forward when pulled. Playing is simple: click with your mouse or tap your screen to make your moves. Its romantic theme and brain-teasing design place it under puzzle, love, and girls games.
obby-swing-for-brainrots-steal: Obby Swing for Brainrots Steal mixes grappling movement, timing-based skill, and idle tycoon growth. You aim your harpoon, hook onto points, and fly from one spot to the next across the map. Jumps and swings keep the pace quick, and getting through a level depends on good timing.

Your goal is to swing around, steal Brainrots, and collect them while you upgrade your base and build your Brainrot empire. The game is more than a simple runner. It offers long-term progression, competitive elements, and upgrades that feel rewarding. Brainrot Hook Obby is built around smooth movement, so every harpoon shot matters
drifting-mania: Drifting Mania lets you leave your own skid marks across the asphalt. There are no second chances here, so you need to stay sharp. Skilled drivers love the tight bends on the racing track. To keep your car on the road, you tap, hold, and release the rope at the right moments.

Each drift earns you money, which you can spend to unlock and personalize your car from 13 options. Earning all 30 achievements gives you goals to work toward. The road stretches on endlessly and is full of bright colors, so you can keep sliding as long as your focus holds.
broom: Broom is a sports racing game that pushes your speed and quick reactions to the limit. You steer past obstacles that grow more numerous as you go, on a track with no end. The goal is to chase the highest score you can reach.

You can play alone or take on friends in multiplayer mode. Either way, the race runs along a nonstop highway, so there is always more road ahead. It is a fast, endless test of focus for anyone who enjoys racing games.
farm-mart: Farm Mart puts you in charge of your own shop, where the goal is to manage the whole operation. You grow crops, tend to animals, and make sure the shelves never run empty. As your business grows, you can improve the store, bring on employees, and open up new resource sources so customers find a bigger range of products.

Moving around works with WASD, the arrow keys, or by dragging with the left mouse button. To gather a harvest, stand beside it. Carry your goods to the shelves to restock them, then head to the cashier and wait there to collect payment from shoppers. The game has no pause option, so while you handle one task, others keep moving along without you.
snowy-adventures-with-noob-and-pro: Snowy Adventures with Noob and Pro! is a 2D game where you grow and decorate your own Christmas tree. You can go solo or team up with a friend on one screen. Mini-games earn you Bucks, which you spend on upgrades. Collect toys ranging from common to ultra-rare, combine items to craft legendary ornaments, and climb the leaderboard as your tree and collection improve.

The premise is saving Christmas and helping Santa, though there is not really a storyline. Expect Minecraft-style references, mini-games like catching Bucks while dodging bombs, and snowball battles. Daily gifts, a wheel of fortune, and character skins add variety. Player 1 moves with A, S,
tac-tac-way: Tac Tac Way puts you in control of an agile little ball that moves across eye-catching terrain. Your main task is to alter its path so it slips past dangerous ledges and burning pits. Staying composed and planning your moves carefully is the key to getting ahead in this brightly colored puzzle setting.

You can play by yourself or set up multiplayer matches against others. Either way, the game offers rewards for taking on its challenges. It is a skill-focused arcade title, so quick reactions and patient thinking both matter.
fantasy-star-pinball: Fantasy Star Pinball takes you on a magical pinball adventure. By working the flippers skillfully, you open up hidden worlds. Along the way you'll play on enchanted tables, uncover secret scenarios, and build up your score.
The game's otherworldly landscapes and engaging challenges keep things lively, and you can enjoy it wherever you feel like playing.
air-space-shooter: In this action-packed arcade shooter, your mission is to protect the galaxy from ruthless alien invaders. Blast enemies in air battles, upgrade your ships, and work your way toward conquering the universe. It is a one-player game that you can play online.

The spaceships you command are powerful, and as you upgrade them, your weapons grow stronger, letting you launch devastating attacks during dynamic combat. Controls are simple: tap and drag to move your ship and shoot at the same time.
wild-manager: This bright 3D simulation puts you in charge of your own zoo. You walk the grounds as the keeper, building habitats, caring for the animals, and improving roads and facilities. Your aim is to grow a small zoo into a busy destination for wildlife.

Moving around is simple. Use WASD or the arrow keys on a computer, or use the on-screen joystick or tap to move on mobile. Head to the highlighted areas to build and upgrade habitats, collect income, look after your animals, and complete park projects. Once every upgrade is finished, your park reaches 100% completion.
bike-mania-3-on-ice: Bike Mania 3 On Ice takes you across twenty icy stages where precision and balance matter most. Each course has its own tricky layout, and the slick surfaces make every ride feel unpredictable. You steer your rider with the arrow keys, so learning how much to press and when to ease off becomes part of the fun.

Every run you finish moves you a bit further along the path toward becoming a skilled ice biker. Progress feels rewarding, since each attempt teaches you something new about the frozen tracks. Keep riding, and each course will feel a little more familiar.
endless-siege: Your kingdom is under constant attack in Endless Siege, where invaders keep arriving in waves that seem to have no end. You place defenses wherever you think they will work best and upgrade them as the fight goes on. Each day the maps change, so the layout you learned yesterday may not apply today. Staying alive takes endurance, and you must balance your resources against where you put every piece.
tung-tung-super-sahur: Tung Tung Super Sahur combines platform action with adventure. You guide a small hero through a fantasy world to rescue a captured princess. Across many levels, you collect coins, use power-ups along the way, and defeat enemies on your path. Every castle is a goal, so keep moving until you reach them all.

Expect obstacles at every turn that test your movement and timing. The game is played with the keyboard, so you control the hero directly with your keys. Push through each challenge and see how far you can go, and by the end you may have become a hero yourself.
doomsday-shooter: Doomsday Shooter throws you into a world overrun by monsters that never stop coming. Your only option is to keep fighting until the very end.
