Send trains along your routes, open new stations, and collect the fares that passengers pay. As your network expands, more platforms, buildings, and locomotives appear on the map. The 3D scenery uses bright, blocky low-poly shapes, and the controls are simple enough to learn in moments.

Progress never really stops. Tap the upgrades on offer to improve your stations, trains, and routes. Gather your income, unlock new buildings, speed up your trains, and increase how much your railroad can carry. Keep raising your earnings, and your rail operation will steadily grow into a major transport business.
break-the-car-completely: Break The Car Completely is a crash test simulator that puts your extreme driving skills to the test. Your goal is to reach the finish line along a highway while avoiding dangerous obstacles scattered across the course. Any collision, even a small one, instantly destroys your car, so slow, calculated moves are your only real chance. Made for fans of BeamNG
block-puzzle-chuzzle-classic: Block Puzzle Chuzzle Classic is an arcade game built around colorful blocks that tumble down from above. Your task is to fit them together so that full lines vanish before the pile climbs to the top of the screen. The pieces come in many different shapes and drop at changing speeds, so you will need to plan a few steps ahead and stay alert.

The game is endless, which means there is no final stage to reach and you can keep stacking and clearing for as long as you want. It suits anyone who enjoys puzzles that reward careful thinking and a calm, steady approach. Its classic style and bright visuals make it an easy pick for a quick session or a longer run.
blob-man-run: Blob Man Run is a hypercasual runner where you collect diamonds as you move along. Doors appear on the way, and choosing the right one makes you stronger. The stronger you get, the easier it becomes to take out the boss and beat the levels.

The game mixes running, platforming, obstacles, and battles, with a focus on collecting and avoiding danger. Controls are simple: just swipe to move. Keep an eye on your path, grab as many diamonds as you can, and pick your doors carefully to power up for what comes next.
jewel-garden-story: Jewel Garden Story is a match-three puzzle game where you line up three or more gems of the same kind to clear each level. The puzzles never run out, so a fresh board is always waiting. You can push yourself to beat high scores, and the colorful gem combinations look impressive on screen. It suits anyone who loves puzzle games and wants plenty to play.

Six unique boosters are available to help you advance through the game more quickly. You can also earn rewards by logging in each day and by joining Garden Expeditions. Finally, the competition has rankings, so you can aim for a spot at the top.
car-battle: Car Battle puts you in control of an armored war machine, where your vehicle serves as both your main attack and your protection. You can work through solo campaigns against a variety of foes, or invite a friend to settle things in two-player matches. Each fight is split into five stages, and the battles grow tougher as you move forward.

Between clashes, you can upgrade your car and refine how you handle each encounter. Unlocking different avatars lets you give your fighter a personal look. To drive, press A or D, or the Left and Right arrow keys, and press Space to jump. Use your mouse or touch screen to interact with the game's menus and other interface elements.
3d-block-gladiator-sword-draw: Enter a gladiator arena where brute force alone won't keep you standing. This 3D action game rewards the warriors who think ahead. Rather than pressing buttons, you sketch your moves: every attack and every dodge is traced straight onto the screen, so your gladiator goes exactly where you point. Sweep across the display to strike, and weave between enemies to slip past their blows. Outwit your opponents and you can claim the win.
Your blade is only as good as your hand. Drawing lines on the screen sets how your fighter moves, lets you sidestep inco
money-pong: Money Pong is an arcade game where you drop cash blocks onto a field and watch balls ricochet around it. Every time a ball strikes something, you collect money. Tap or click to set blocks down, then drag matching ones onto each other to combine them into stronger versions. You can also send more balls into play and buy upgrades that remain with you permanently, which can set off critical hits and chain combos.

Keep an eye out for special moments such as Coin Rain, Golden Rush, Meteor Showers and Ball Frenzy, since catching them brings large rewards. Smashing gift boxes yields diamonds and rubies. Progress takes you through five worlds, beginning in Sunny Meadow and ending at Frozen Lake. Even when you step away, your piggy bank keeps gathering money.
master-craft: Master Craft is a 3D action game where the world never runs out, so there's always something new to explore. Your job is to stay alive in a charming, Minecraft-style landscape while putting blocks together to construct buildings of your own.

You steer with the mouse to look around and use the WASD keys to move through the world. Whether you're gathering materials or simply wandering, the game gives you plenty of room to build and keep going.
paint-with-diamonds: Paint with Diamonds lets your creative side shine while testing your skills. Themes such as Titanic and Tigers give you plenty to work toward, and the game blends careful painting accuracy with typing flair. Each diamond you place reflects your attention to detail, so every finished picture shows your own careful artistry.
The pace is entirely up to you, which makes the experience feel relaxed yet rewarding. Whether you work slowly or move more quickly, you can enjoy building each image at a speed that suits you.
battalion-commander-2: Battalion Commander 2 puts you in charge of a squad pushing through waves of enemy troops. Even though you control just one lone soldier, your job is to rescue captured allies and gather power-ups along the way. The action plays out in a 2D top-down view across a frozen, snow-covered battlefield. Shots never really stop, so you need to keep firing while weaving out of the path of enemy rounds.

Each choice you make can change how a fight turns out, which keeps this fast arcade adventure tense from start to finish. Expect a steady stream of gunfire and quick reflex decisions as you fight your way forward.
hungry-cats: In this casual puzzle game, you lead several cats at once as they hunt for their food. The twist is that you rotate the whole level, so each cat's route depends on the others. Working out how all of them move together turns simple steps into a playful brain teaser.

Picture a group of adorable cats wandering through tiny worlds, searching for snacks before they curl up for another cozy nap. Because you control every cat at the same time, you must plan ahead and turn the stage so each one reaches its meal safely. On desktop, W, A, S, and D move the cats while Q and E rotate the platform. On mobile, left and right buttons handle movement, rotate icons turn the platform, an up icon makes the cats jump, and a down icon interacts with items.
monster-truck-stunt-game-racing-games: Step into a world built around monster truck stunts, where you pilot powerful trucks made for daring leaps. Launch off giant ramps, pull off jumps, and speed through tracks that seem almost impossible to finish. Every run tests your timing and driving skill as you push for higher speeds across demanding courses.

Compete with other drivers, or head into the open free mode to roam among stunts and obstacles at your own pace. The most extreme stunt tracks are waiting for those who feel confident behind the wheel. Use W or the Up Arrow to move forward, S or the Down Arrow to move back, A or the Left Arrow to move left, and D or the Right Arrow to move right. Buttons on screen can be clicked with the mouse.
shadow-adventure: Step into the gloomy world of the dead in Shadow Adventure, a game that sends you traveling through its dark landscape. Your reflexes will be put to the test as you weave past moving hazards, time your jumps carefully, and plan your route across dangerous gaps. As you advance, every stage grows harder and presents its own kind of challenge, pushing both your thinking and your timing.
battleship-war-multiplayer: You command your fleet by placing your warships across the sea, then unleash torpedoes at rival players before they sink your ships. Every ocean battle rewards clever thinking, since you must read your opponent's moves and catch them off guard. Points earned during a match can be spent on power-ups that change how the fight unfolds, so timing and resource use matter as much as aim.
The game runs in your browser with
reckless-roller-fun-park: Welcome to a park where your characters ride a roller that you must handle with care. Your goal is to keep the passengers entertained while driving them to their destination. You can speed up or slow down the roller as needed, and you have to time those changes well so it does not crash.

The game sits in the Action category, with Simulation and Simulator tags, and runs on WebGL. Use your mouse to add speed or to change the camera's view. Take your time, enjoy the ride, and keep an eye on your pace.
ice-and-fire-twins: Ice And Fire Twins is a 3D arcade action game built around special ice and fire skills that you use to defeat opponents. A brand-new interface and an elimination shooting mode let you take on enemies with plenty of freedom. The shooting feels unusual in a way that is fresh and enjoyable.
Playing is as simple as tapping and sliding. It is an online HTML5 title that also works on mobile devices, so you can use your ice and fire powers on the go.
tank-stars-battle-arena: Tank Stars Battle Arena is a strategy game about designing tanks, shown with two-dimensional models. Across 14 levels, you build your own tanks to destroy every enemy tank. Defeating the enemy pilot is enough to win a battle, so you can focus on that target. Diamonds you collect can be used to open chests in the Shop, which hold new tank parts.

You can save up to three tank designs at once, so you can keep your favorite builds ready. Pay close attention to where each part sits on your tank, because every piece has its own function. Everything works with a simple mouse click or a tap.
mergetopia: Mergetopia is a pleasant two-dimensional casual puzzle game where evolution comes from combining things step by step. You wander through a Realm stocked with popular sea animal characters, each ready to be spotted, merged with others, and evolved. Your mission is to build and uncover the Creatures, and along the way you pop bubbles and keep merging. Every combination brings you closer to the next discovery, so progress feels steady and rewarding.

On a PC or desktop, press the left mouse button to click, then drag pieces together to merge them. On mobile, tap to click, then hold and drag to merge. Both setups let you jump straight into combining the sea creatures.
save-the-stick-draw-line: Save The Stick Draw Line is a puzzle game for players who enjoy testing their brains. It mixes drawing with brain teasers, so you work through each challenge by sketching your own solutions. You can pick one of two modes: Save Stickman or Love Story.

In either mode, you help a cute stickman by drawing lines. Mouse clicks control the game, and on touch devices you tap the screen to play. The drawing and teasing elements keep your mind busy from one puzzle to the next.
planet-blast-rockets: In this 3D physics shooter, you control a rocket arsenal and aim strikes at entire worlds, turning cities, continents, and whole planets into craters. Pick your impact point, then reshape your rocket and watch the design changes appear right away. Every attempt tests how well you balance fuel, mass, and blast power.

As you progress, you can upgrade your modules and increase the strike power of your rockets. New planets unlock along the way, taking you to the farthest corners of the galaxy. The controls are simple: hold the left mouse button to adjust the rocket, choose a target, and launch. On a phone or tablet, taps and finger gestures handle the same actions. After each launch, review what happened, improve the weaker parameters, and prepare your next rocket.
brazil-cup-2014: Brazil Cup 2014 blends football with the chaos of pinball. You work your way through qualifying stages and then knockout rounds, relying on fast reflexes as several balls storm the field at once. The game feels accessible yet stays engaging, and your goal is to claim tournament glory and leave your name in football history.

It is built in HTML5 and can be enjoyed unblocked, so you can start a match straight away. Every round calls for sharp timing and quick decisions as the balls scatter across the pitch, and the reward is the satisfaction of winning the tournament.
fire-hose: Fire Hose is a firefighting shooter. On desktop, aim with your mouse and click to release water, and press Q to toggle mouse lock. On mobile, move with the left virtual joystick and tap the button to send water from the hose. Your goal is to extinguish as many fires on screen as you can before your water supply runs dry.

Each level brings more flames, trickier layouts, and less room for error, and wasting water will cause you to fail. You can upgrade your water deposits to carry more, spray for longer, and get through tougher stages. Fast, challenging levels reward quick movement and careful aim, so conserving your supply is key.
muscle-run-io: Muscle Run io drops you into a lively race against quirky rivals, where bulking up is the secret to getting ahead. Plan out your workout, collect gains as you go, and barrel through every obstacle on the course as you charge toward victory.

The action is fast and the tone is playful, giving fitness a funny twist. Your path to the finish line is only as smooth as your muscle power, so every bit of strength you build shapes how well you perform. Whether you are racing for first place or just trying to keep up, each run rewards careful planning and a willingness to flex.
stickman-the-flash: Stickman The Flash mixes fighting and RPG elements in a 2D arcade game built around stickman warriors. Its Survival Mode challenges you to last as long as you can, steering clear of the red danger zones while dealing with enemies that keep coming at you. Defeating foes can yield different weapons, which you can collect and use.

Once you earn enough gems, you can unlock gear in the Equipment Store and equip it to boost all of your abilities. The whole game is controlled with a mouse click or a tap. Stay composed and clear out every opponent in sight.
crazy-supercars-stunt-2022: This driving title aims for handling that feels as true to life as possible, pushing your skills further. Parking tasks test you with an inside camera view, realistic sound effects, a range of cars, and huge cities. Playing the valet shows that you can earn the title of Parking Master, and sensors and signs help you once your car is parked.
liquid-sort-puzzle: Liquid Sort Puzzle is a color game where you pour colored water until each glass holds only one shade. A level is complete once every glass is filled with a single color. Pouring follows logical rules: the color on top of the source glass must match the color on top of the receiving glass, and the receiving glass needs enough room for the liquid.
To pour, tap or click one glass, then tap or click a second glass. Your goal is to finish each level in as few moves as possible, so each choice matters.
puzzle-match-kit: A long gray workday at the office can feel endless, especially when the view outside does little to lift your mood. Puzzle Match Kit offers a way to brighten the hours and add some color to your routine. Its concept is simple, and the controls are easy to learn within a few minutes. Your goal is to line up three figures of the same color in a row and earn as many points as you can. You could spend many enjoyable hours here.

The game runs well on modern Android tablets and phones, so you can play in whatever spot suits you. It takes up only a few megabytes, leaving plenty of room on your device. Dozens of unique levels, each with its own layout, keep the experience varied, and a thoughtful approach helps you reach the best results. Bright color combinations and smooth animations are easy on the eyes, even after long sessions.
a-day-with-masha-and-the-bear-fun-togeth: Rise and shine with Masha, because a full day of play is waiting. You spend the hours with her and her pals, trying out her favorite pastimes such as pedaling a bike, hunting for animals, casting a line to fish, taking on a round of checkers, and baking cakes. Everything runs on taps or clicks.

With over twenty mini games on offer, you get to have fun while picking up useful skills. Telling the time, adding numbers, tracing letters, sorting items for recycling, and several other learning tasks are all included. It is a good pick for anyone who already loves Masha and the Bear.
slpoing-path: Slpoing Path is a casual puzzle game where you sketch lines to help a ball roll down to the target block. The whole game runs on gravity, so you need to think about how the ball will move once your line is in place. It is built around quick, simple play that is easy to pick up.

Controls are simple: a mouse click or a tap is all you need. Use the lines you draw to guide the ball to its goal. Because the rules are light, it works well for short breaks as well as longer sessions. The game sits in the Puzzles category and is a 2D title with a hypercasual feel.
kingdom-defense: Kingdom Defense is an online tower defense strategy game set in a fantasy world. You command warriors, cast spells, and battle fantasy monsters while building up your army. As your forces grow, you also lead the conquest, blending strategy with action and adventure.

The main aim is to stop enemies from destroying your castle. You buy soldiers with in-game coins, and those soldiers can also be used to bring down the enemy castle. Guard your own walls, spend your coins with care, and push forward to claim victory in the war.
bus-rush: Bus Rush is an arcade game built around an endless format, so runs have no set finish. Your aim is to pull off bold stunts and tricks and show what you can do. Watch for power-ups, which give you a boost when you collect them. Several skateboard models are available, so you can test each one and see how it handles.
Movement is controlled entirely with the mouse. The game is tagged as action, adventure, and running, which reflects its focus on constant motion and showing off your moves.
mountain-bike-challenge: Ride through rugged mountain landscapes and tackle winding trails in this bike game. The terrain keeps shifting beneath your wheels, so you need to read each stretch of ground as you go. The controls are intuitive, and you must find the right balance of speed and precision to keep your rider on course.

Your main goal is to beat the clock while sharpening your technique and getting past every obstacle on the route. Physics shapes how your bike behaves, so every run feels grounded and true to motion. Each ride brings a fresh test, so no two attempts feel quite the same.
astro-digger: Astro Digger sends you on a treasure hunt across the sky. You move through an alien landscape to gather gold and minerals, and you have to push past various obstacles along the way. Teleportation lets you jump to new spots, while carefully placed bombs help you clear the path and secure your haul.

The game has a striking look and controls that are easy to pick up, so you can start digging right away. It is a space adventure that should keep you busy for a long time, and it runs in any web browser or on whatever device you happen to use.
pawky: Pawky is a platform game that puts your reflexes and planning to the test. You guide a lively creature across shifting scenery, weaving past hazards with quick, accurate moves. Good timing is essential, since the platforms move in unexpected ways and you need to react on the spot.

Each run asks you to think fast and keep your movements smooth from start to finish. The game rewards players who stay sharp and make clean, confident jumps. Because the layout keeps changing, every attempt feels a little different and keeps you alert.
truck-simulator-power-slider: Truck Simulator Power Slider is an arcade game with a simulation feel. Each puzzle shows a broken-up picture of a big truck, and you move the tiles around until the whole vehicle is back in one piece. The challenges are based on realistic trucking, and the puzzles are detailed and polished.

Solving them takes a good sense of space and shape, so the game puts your spatial thinking to work. Watching a powerful rig come together one tile at a time is satisfying. By mixing life on the road with puzzle play, it becomes a fun, brain-teasing experience for anyone who enjoys a mental workout.
real-survival-not-fake: Set in a frozen, snow-covered land, this 3D survival adventure challenges you to stay alive in the cold. You collect materials, cut down trees for wood, and turn what you gather into tools and gear. Polar bears are a serious threat, so you will need to fight them off when they come near.

Your main job is to build a base that keeps you protected through the chilly nights. As you go, you can roam the surrounding snowy terrain and see what it holds. Players on a computer can move with the WASD keys or the arrow keys, while those on a phone or tablet use touch controls. The game also includes simulation and management elements.
top-shootout-the-pirate-ship: An old pirate ship loaded with golden treasure and lovely hostages sails through the Caribbean Sea. In Top Shootout, an arcade game, you fire your cannon to take down every pirate aboard. Your goal is to earn as many points as you can along the way.
Controls are simple. Click or tap to shoot, then click or tap to recharge your cannon for the next shot. Pick your moments carefully, since you need to recharge before you can fire again.
ticktock-egg-run: Ticktock Egg Run is an adventure game in which a courageous little egg must push through a series of obstacles while steering clear of monsters. In its adventure mode, you guide this adorable egg along a journey that passes through various levels.

Controls are kept simple: a mouse click or a tap is all you need to play. The game is listed under Arcade and tagged with egg, obstacle, and running, so it fits well with players who like those themes.
tactical-response-team: You play as a top-tier sharpshooter in Tactical Response Team, where every bullet can change how a fight turns out. Your job is to take out high-value targets from far away, giving long-range support to your squad. Enemy forces must be suppressed before they can wipe out teammates who are pinned down in the open.

Success depends on steady aim, careful waiting, and well-timed shots. Move your view with the mouse, scroll the wheel to zoom in or out, hold the right button to aim, and left-click to fire. This first-person sniper shooter runs in your browser, so you can jump straight into the action.
raven-estate: You play as a bold crow determined to win back your old home, an estate now overrun by spooky creatures. This fast shooter has you tearing through swarms of monsters while enemy fire fills the screen. Your weapons sit at set spots on the map, and each one keeps the direction it was facing when you grabbed it, so where you pick things up really counts. Keep moving, slipping past attacks and weaving through the chaos as you unleash a storm of gunfire.

The game blends shooting with an adventure story and leans into bullet-hell action. To get started, use the arrow keys or WASD to move and to browse the menus. To confirm a choice in a menu, hold down the Space bar.
jelly-run-in-2048: Steer a bendy jelly cube across bright, animated landscapes in this mix of 2048 puzzling and platform running. Your goal is to reach the 2048 tile by joining matching blocks together, while avoiding pointed spikes and swinging maces along the way. Swipes call for planning ahead, and fast reactions keep you safe.
Each colorful stage presents its own challenge, and clearing them opens up odd new block types to try. Every move matters, so plan each merge before you commit to a swipe.
boom-stick-bazooka-2-puzzles: Boom Stick Bazooka 2 is a free online shooter where you blast platforms and enemy stickmen with a bazooka you can customize. Your job is to knock out the towers that hold the black stickmen. Hesitate too long, and some of them will fire back, costing you one of your three lives. Each level gives you three shots, but you can restart whenever you like or purchase extra ammunition. Exploding nearby barrels is a quicker way to bring down towers, and heavy objects can also strike the stickmen directly.

Coins earned from each cleared level can be spent on new skins and weapons with better characteristics. The goal is to eliminate every enemy using only your three rounds of ammo. You aim and fire with the mouse, and tapping the screen is part of the controls too.
fallingman-io: Fallingman.io drops you into a long fall where speed matters most. As you tumble downward, you steer your character through a series of obstacles while players from around the world fall alongside you. Everyone is aiming for the same destination at the bottom, so your aim is to reach the ground before the others.

The controls are simple, which makes the game easy to pick up, but staying on course is harder than it looks. Rivals can get in your way, so you need to dodge them while handling the unpredictable chaos of the descent. Each run feels different, and you have to adapt quickly in this free browser game built for multiplayer play.
matching-tiles-3d: Matching Tiles 3D is a puzzle game where you pair up tiles that share the same picture and remove them from the board. Pick two tiles that look alike and they vanish. Keep going until the whole board is empty to win. Along the way, the game works your memory and focus, yet it is cal
rabbit-shooter: Aim carefully at rabbits in this 3D shooter, where you play as a young hunter. The game pushes your marksmanship as far as it can go, so every hunt tests your skill. It is built with HTML5 and WebGL.

Left-click to fire and hold the right button to aim. Scroll the mouse wheel to switch weapons, and press R to reload. The game is made for anyone who loves rabbit hunting and wants a serious challenge.
zombie-city-polygon-survival: Step into a blocky, low-poly shooter set in a city that has been swallowed by zombies. You carry firearms and must hold out against endless rounds of attackers. Success depends on planning your moves carefully and reacting fast enough to clear every district you enter.
The stripped-down visuals keep your attention on fierce fights and tense survival from start to finish. Controls are simple: use W, A, S and D to move, and aim and fire with the mouse.
pizza-maker-food-cooking-games: In this cooking title, you assemble pizzas in a bright kitchen. You take on the role of a virtual cook who picks the toppings and must please diners with particular tastes. Each order may ask for something different, so you need to pay attention to what every customer wants.

Building food works through drag-and-drop, so moving ingredients onto the base feels natural. Challenges change as you go, pushing you to get pies out the door quickly while racking up high scores. It's a lively, creative cooking experience full of tasty ideas.
stacky-bird: Stacky Bird asks you to rely on good judgment and well-timed moves. You control a bird that piles eggs into tall columns while gliding past obstacles in its path. The scenery is charming, and you move through a series of levels filled with cheerful birdhouses along the way. Every tap gives your bird another push upward, so your tower climbs higher as you progress.

Each stage asks you to keep your stack steady while you choose the right moment to act. Picture a tall structure that must also soar over difficult hurdles. Skill and timing work together here, so every run feels fresh. Each successful climb shows how far your creation can reach.
abyss-muncher: Abyss Muncher is a pixel-art underwater roguelite where every bite helps your creature evolve. Hunt smaller animals, dodge giant predators, and choose upgrades as you grow. Gather mutations, active skills, and relics, then combine them to survive dangerous enemies in ocean caves that change from one dive to the next.

Essence and Crystals earned during each dive can be spent on lasting upgrades and new creatures. Desktop players swim with WASD, use Space for the innate skill, and press J, K, or L for acquired skills, clicking buttons for upgrades, menus, and pausing. On mobile, drag across the gameplay area to swim and tap the skill buttons. A Guided Dive teaches the basics and can be replayed from Settings, and optional reward videos give bonuses after a full viewing.
organizer-master: Organizer Master drops you into a hypnotic 3D puzzle space where you put your spatial reasoning to work by arranging objects in tricky setups. Your job is to locate matching pairs and fit each one neatly into its slot. The game features a large number of levels, and every layer you clear raises the challenge a notch. Its look is striking, and it's easy to get pulled into a few rounds more.
bounce-dunk-frvr: Bounce Dunk Frvr lets you enjoy the thrill of slamming the ball through the hoop. The game uses a realistic physics engine, so every bounce feels like a real basketball hitting the floor. Expect several players dribbling at once, with obstacles placed in the middle of the action. Try not to get blocked. The obstacles don't add to your score, so you can smash them just for the fun of dunking.
Play is simple: click or tap to control your moves. The question the game leaves you with is what else basketball might offer a player beyond the dunk itself.
bouncy-motors: Your car wobbles around like a piece of jelly as you race toward the finish line. Watch out for red zones, because hitting one can knock your wheels right off. Icy stretches also call for careful driving, so take it slow when the road turns slippery.

The controls are straightforward. Press W or the up arrow to drive forward, and S or the down arrow to drive backward. Use A or the left arrow to rotate counterclockwise, and D or the right arrow to rotate clockwise. On mobile, the left stick moves the car forward and backward, while the right stick rotates it.
killer-io: Killer.io is a multiplayer game where you commit murders and then hide the bodies. Your goal is to eliminate as many partygoers as you can during a Halloween celebration, all while staying undetected. Every victim you take out brings you closer to a high count, but one slip could get you caught in the act.

You move around with the arrow keys, or by tapping the screen on touch devices. Tagged with escape, Halloween, and kill, the game fits players who enjoy sneaky, competitive rounds with a spooky theme.
wormpocalypse: Wormpocalypse drops you into a ruined world after disaster has swept across it. Success depends on fast reactions as well as careful planning, so you will need to think ahead while staying sharp. Along the way you can dig up hidden truths, face off against twisted foes, and stay alive by making use of a varied set of weapons.

The game is built around pixel graphics and an unsettling musical score that sets a grim mood. It mixes classic platform action with a dark, future-gone-wrong storyline that keeps pulling you forward. Each moment tests whether you can rise to meet what lies ahead.
magical-unicorn-grooming-world-pony-care: Find a unicorn that feels like your own and give her the care she needs. Start by clearing out the stable, then move on to bath time. After that, replace her horseshoe. Once she is clean and ready, dress her up and watch her become a magical unicorn.
Every action is handled with simple taps or clicks, so you can move through each step with just one finger or a mouse
obby-escape-from-lava-and-survive: Sprint along the course and grab the animals you pass on the way. Timing is everything, so react quickly and don't let a target slip by. Rising lava chases you from behind, so stay ahead of it. Each moment counts, which means you need to remain focused and keep pushing forward.

Rebirthing raises your jump height and opens new options, and every rebirth leaves you sturdier, speedier, and tougher. Upgrade your brainrots to bring in bigger earnings, and sharpen your abilities as you go. On PC, move with WASD, hold the right mouse button to turn the view, and use the scroll wheel to zoom. On phones, a joystick handles movement, a button makes you jump, and dragging with your finger rotates the camera.
silent-fear: In this first-person shooter, you are the last person left alive in a world full of the undead. The zombies keep chasing you, and nothing slows them down, so your best move is to keep running. You carry a smartphone, a saw, and a gun barrel to fight back. Now and then, animals step in to help, since the virus is deadly to them as well.

On a computer, use W, A, S, and D to run and click the mouse on your weapon to attack. On a phone or tablet, a dynamic joystick controls your running, and tapping your weapon launches an attack. Survival here is grim, so keep moving and stay alive.
car-games-car-racing-game: Speed through lively city streets in this fast-moving car racing game. Competitions take place at night, giving every race a different feel, and you can sharpen your skills across several racing modes. The 3D visuals are a highlight, so the scenery looks rich as you drive.

The game works on both desktop computers and mobile devices, so you can race on whichever you prefer. Its energetic pace is designed to keep the excitement high from one race to the next. Expect fast action from start to finish.
pop-the-ball: This 3D puzzle game asks you to pop balloons so they break into smaller ones, then steer each piece through a hole that matches it. Every balloon must make it through and come to rest in the basket waiting underneath. Before you start popping, think ahead about which balloons to burst, because that choice determines whether a level can be solved. Once the basket is filled, the puzzle is complete.

Controls are simple: click a balloon to pop it. Rolling balls through multiplier windows raises their number, so keep an eye out for those openings as you plan your moves. Physics plays a big part in how each piece tumbles and drops, which makes every round a fun test of foresight.
brick-breaker-classic-arcade-fun: Brick Breaker is back in this classic arcade take on the familiar formula. You keep a ball in play by bouncing it off your paddle, and every hit chips away at the rows of bricks above. Levels vary in layout, so each stage brings a fresh set of challenges to work through.

Along the way, you can catch power-ups that drop unexpectedly from broken bricks. Move your paddle with care and aim your shots precisely to reach awkward gaps and corners. The difficulty climbs with every level, and your goal is to clear the entire board.
walkers-attack: Walkers Attack is an action-adventure in which the end of the world is approaching. You pick your way through a dangerous landscape with one goal: staying alive. Weapons fire automatically, so your attention can go to where you move and how you position yourself. Gather resources along the way and push back hordes of zombies.

Finishing missions opens fresh levels with different themes, ranging from sci-fi to medieval and urban. Each new stage is harder than the last, so every victory asks more of you. The game asks you to become humanity's last hope. Control is simple: click or tap with your mouse or finger to play.
taxi-simulator-3d: Take the wheel in Taxi Simulator 3D, a 3D driving simulation built around the work of a cab driver. You drive your own taxi and carry passengers from where they are waiting to wherever they need to go. The game spans ten levels, and each one includes transport missions that you must finish on schedule.

Movement is handled entirely with the W, A, S and D keys, so four keys are all you need to steer your cab. Your goal is to deliver every passenger on time and complete each transport job you are given. It is a simulation that asks for careful, punctual driving from the first level to the last.
fall-cars-hexagon: Climb behind the wheel and try not to drive off the edge of the hexagon. This hypercasual 3D racing game with cars can be played alone or with a friend in its two-player mode. Player one uses the arrow keys to steer, while player two uses the WASD keys.

Whether you prefer a solo round or a shared session on the same keyboard, the goal stays the same: keep your car on the hexagon and avoid falling. Grab a friend, pick your mode, and see how long you can stay on the shape.
save-the-noob: Save the Noob is a puzzle game where you sketch a magical line to rescue Noob from danger. It runs online for free on many kinds of devices and offers numerous tricky levels that reward careful planning, making it a good way to pass some spare time.

Inside the marked zone, draw your line so it never crosses itself and stays within the borders. Once you lift your pen, the line drops down. As it falls, it must wipe out every enemy while keeping Noob untouched.
pixzombies: PixZombies is a fast arcade adventure where you smash waves of nonstop zombies. Speed is on your side here, so the quicker you tap, the better you can hold off the crowds. Zombies come at you from every direction, and the challenges grow harder as the round goes on.

Each swing or tap helps you beat back the undead, and you collect stars along the way. The action moves quickly from start to finish, and the game aims to turn you into a top-tier zombie slayer. If you enjoy frantic, reflex-driven fights with a steady rise in difficulty, this one should keep you busy.
dentist-doctor-teeth-surgery-hospital: Step into a playful take on dental work, where quirky characters and bright visuals set the mood. You run your very own clinic and look after each visitor with care, working precisely so every treatment is done properly. As your business expands, you will need to keep several jobs moving at once.

Keeping every visit smooth and satisfying is important, since it helps raise the reputation of your practice. The cheerful, colorful style turns this dental adventure into a lively place to spend time.
sprint-club-nitro: Sprint Club Nitro puts you at the back of the pack and challenges you to work your way up to first place. You need to pass 19 opponents while using nitro boosts for quick bursts of speed. The game features a variety of tracks that give you chances to sharpen your driving. Winning races earns you cash, which you can spend on upgrades for your car. Each high-speed contest tests how far you can push your machine. It delivers the thrill of Formula 1 racing without any time spent in the pits.
doctor-teeth-2: Doctor Teeth 2 is a 2D puzzle adventure where you treat patients with strange dental problems. Each visit asks you to carry out treatments carefully while keeping things light, since the situations are odd and often funny. Along the way you learn to handle a range of dental tools through short, playful mini-games.

Your aim is to finish every appointment flawlessly, and doing so is how you earn the top rating of three stars. Think of the game as a way to turn a usually nerve-wracking trip to the dentist into something lighthearted. Turning dental dread into fun sits at the heart of it.
bridge-builder-3d: You take on the role of a design engineer, where quick thinking and the ability to adjust matter as much as planning. Your job is to assemble structures from a variety of materials so they can hold up the vehicle crossing them. The physics feel realistic, almost like a true simulator, and the levels are spread across four different locations. The puzzles call for careful reasoning and logic, and if you get stuck, a built-in hint system offers guidance to help you sharpen your skills along the way.

On a computer, you build with a mouse or touchpad. On a phone or tablet, you use the touchscreen along with on-screen controls. Whichever device you choose, the goal stays the same: construct a bridge strong enough to carry the load.
knife-storm: Knife Storm offers a collection of distinct blades across three playing styles. You can enjoy each mode alone or team up for a two-player match. Classic mode asks you to land every knife on a spinning table or on targets such as fruit, and the blades will never strike one another. Shoot mode has you hurling knives at fruit in the air while dodging bombs and keeping an eye on the time left.

Ninja mode swaps throwing for slicing, using the mouse to cut through fruit as it flies past. Slicing several fruits at the same moment earns combo points. Watch out for bombs here too, because slicing a single one ends the game. Touchscreen and keyboard controls are both supported.
granny-the-game: Granny has locked you inside her house, and your aim is to find a way out. Every sound counts, so you must move carefully and stay quiet. She can hear even the smallest noise, and if something drops to the floor, she will rush over to see what happened. When things get tense, you can slip into a wardrobe or crawl under a bed to stay hidden.

You have five days to make your escape. The game is played with a touch pad, so every action you take is controlled through that input. One careless move could bring her running, so plan each step with care.
dancing-road: Dancing Road is a fast rhythm runner in which you steer a glowing ball along a neon track. Collect balls that match your color in time with the beat, and dodge the ones in other shades. Color gates can change your ball, so look ahead and move into the lane that suits it. Gather rewards along the way and work through several music tracks.

Controls stay simple. On a computer, hold the left mouse button and drag sideways. On a phone, touch the screen and drag left or right. No keyboard is needed. Vivid cosmic roads and music-synced challenges make each run quick to start but tough to perfect. Reach the end of the track and raise your score to unlock more balls, roads, and songs.
merge-cubes: Merge Cubes is a 3D puzzle game where planning ahead and thinking fast both matter. Your task is to combine cubes that share a number, producing a cube with a larger value. Because the grid shifts as the round goes on, every decision can change what comes next.

The sleek, futuristic design gives the game a polished feel, and its layered gameplay rewards careful thought. Aim for the highest score you can reach, and see how far your wits can carry you in this timeless challenge.
stick-bros-leave-prison: This newest entry in the stickman jail series lets you take charge of two prisoners at once. Your job is to track down the colored keys that open the door, then steer both escapees to the end of each level. Always stay a step ahead of the guards.

Grabbing the cash scattered across each stage unlocks better skins for your characters. Along the way, you will need to leap over and dodge obstacles to reach your destination safely. Find the key that lets you switch between characters, and get every stick figure to the door before time runs out.
abandoned-mansion: You step into this first-person horror game after answering a distress call that leads to an abandoned mansion. By the time you arrive, it is already too late to help. Along the way, you pick up and use items, work through tricky puzzles, and face frightening creatures.

The 3D visuals are tuned to run smoothly, and realistic sound effects and gripping music build the tension. Several levels test your abilities, and you will meet many kinds of enemies, along with boss battles. Explore the abandoned building, search for hidden rooms and items, and rely on your courage and survival skills. Use W, A, S, and D to move, E to interact, R to reload, C to crouch, Tab to open your inventory, and Space to jump. Click the left mouse button to attack or shoot.
camel-destroyer: A wandering camel has turned up in a city and is eager for adventure. You guide it as it searches for animals, chats with people, and roams the streets. Hidden across the map are machines, guns, cannons, and grenades that can bring buildings down and cause plenty of mayhem. Along the way, you can take the wheel of cars, pilot a helicopter, or climb onto a turtle or a cow for a ride.

On a computer, WASD moves the camel, the Space bar makes it jump, F attacks or fires a weapon, Shift accelerates, and E picks up items. On mobile, a joystick and pop-up buttons handle the controls. Expect silly antics and unpredictable situations as the camel makes its way through the city.
clucknrun: You drive a truck across rural scenery with one goal: bring a group of wandering chickens back to the farm they came from. As you cruise through colorful farm settings, collect more chickens and gasoline along the route. Watch out, though, because barrels lie scattered across the path and can throw your ride off track.
Steering is easy. Press A to move left and D to move right, or let your mouse guide the truck for a relaxed ride. This 3D endless runner keeps the road stretching ahead for as long as you keep going.
gravity-shift-sky-racers-gt: Gravity Shift: Sky Racers GT pushes speed and gravity past their usual boundaries. You drive cutting-edge grand tourer cars that ignore the normal laws of motion, and the action takes place both on asphalt and up in the air. Switch between sliding around corners on the ground and performing aerial moves without any break in flow, as you fight for the lead through futuristic metropolitan streets, hovering roadways, and circuits set high above the clouds.

This 3D racer blends arcade action with a touch of simulation. Steering is handled with your mouse: move it left and right to guide your car, including while it is soaring off the ground. Whether you are drifting through a bend or hanging in mid-air, the same simple control keeps you in charge of your machine.
tenkyu-ball: TENKYU BALL is a casual three-dimensional puzzle about rolling a ball across surfaces that tilt beneath it. Each stage is kept deliberately plain, so your attention stays on the ball and the route ahead. The core tension is between control and risk: leaning the stage further sends the ball faster, but pushing too hard will make it slide off the edge and end your attempt.

To steer, swipe or drag across the screen to tilt the surface the ball sits on, and the direction of your movement decides which way it rolls. Lean only as far as a turn, a gap, or a tricky manoeuvre demands. Your aim is to bring the ball to the goal point or exit on each stage. If it drops off, the level is lost and you must start that stage again. Patience and light, careful touches will help you most.
mydream-universe: In myDream Universe, you start as a modest asteroid and shape a cosmos that belongs to you. Navigating a space that is always changing, you absorb celestial bodies to grow. Each object you take in helps you swell into a massive being, though bigger rivals bring threats you must plan around.

One possible path leads toward becoming a powerful black hole. The game is a sandbox, letting you explore and decide how your universe takes shape. Either way, you end up with a universe that feels truly your own.
guns-n-glory-heroes: Guns n Glory Heroes puts you in charge of three heroes who must hold back waves of attacking enemies. Each hero brings a different set of abilities, so planning your moves matters. You can also set clever traps and build up your army as the battles grow harder, all to keep your kingdom safe from evil forces.

The action moves quickly, and the game mixes in a bit of classic tower defense style. It is a medieval game with plenty of chaos, where smart choices about your heroes and defenses help decide the outcome.
unreal-descent-2-race: Unreal Descent 2: Race follows on from a well-liked arcade title. You send your vehicle down fast downhill runs on newly added levels and tracks. The visuals have been sharpened, and the distinct vehicles make every run feel lively and dramatic. Each descent tests your nimbleness and resourcefulness as you aim to cross the finish line first. It offers a chance to feel the rush of high-speed drops, and it is a true survival race where quick speed and sharp reflexes decide the winner.

On a PC, press W or the up arrow to accelerate and S or the down arrow to brake. Use A or D, or the left and right arrows, to steer. Press C for nitro and F to change the camera view. On a phone, the game uses an on-screen steering wheel and on-screen buttons. You can switch between these control modes in the game settings.
glow-halloween-nails-polish-and-color: Give your nails a fresh look in this spooky makeup game with a monster and glow-in-the-dark theme. You can polish them, trim them, and add shine, along with plenty of other beauty steps. Then dress up your manicure with glowing decals and sparkly glitter stickers. The finished set is ready for a Halloween-themed party.

Think of it as a nail salon for players who enjoy a bit of ghoulish fun, whether they are girls or monsters at heart. Everything works with simple taps or clicks, so there is nothing complicated to learn. Tap to begin and start creating.
hill-climb-truck-transform-adventure: This two-dimensional adventure asks you to stay balanced through a series of stunts. You control one of three vehicles, and each can be transformed to handle the different terrain you cross. Keeping your ride steady is the key as you climb ramps and rough ground.

When a crash with an obstacle or the ground damages your vehicle, you can pick up repair plates to get back on track. Tougher stages demand more speed and control, so you can boost your trucks with four acceleration upgrades. Playing is simple: just click the mouse or tap the screen.
steal-meme-and-go: You play as a crafty burglar who slips into houses while the owners are away. Your aim is to swipe valuable treasures so your own property grows richer. Watch out, though, because rival NPCs are also prowling around, and they want to rob your home just as much as you want to rob theirs. The game is packed with trending characters and well-known memes, which add plenty of humor and personality to every break-in.

To win, you need to outsmart your rivals and grab the most valuable items before they do. Keep an eye on your own place as well, since this is a game about both stealing and defending. Quirky characters and iconic memes keep each heist lively.
blocky-gun-paintball-3: Blocky Gun Paintball 3 is a pixel-style shooter built around paintball fights. You can join matches against other players or play on your own, and your aim and reflexes get tested along the way. Opponents include computer-controlled AI foes as well as zombies that you need to take down.

Several modes keep things varied: team against team, free for all, and gun game. You move with the W, A, S, and D keys, while the mouse lets you look around and fire, and it also handles aiming. Press Tab to open the menu and Space to jump.
sheep-escape-farm-sorting-challenge: Sheep Escape: Farm Sorting Challenge is a light puzzle title set on a busy farm where animals need to get out. Sheep can only travel along straight lines, so every move needs some forethought. You work out the route each one should take so the whole flock can head toward the barn.

Levels grow over time, bringing extra sheep, more barriers, and tangled arrangements that demand careful thought. The sorting controls are straightforward, and the cute sheep and calm farm setting keep things relaxed. Tap any sheep with an open straight path, clear blockers out of the way, and keep going until the pen is empty.
brainrots-merge: Brainrots Merge is a puzzle game that combines merging, clicking, and auto-battling. Click on characters to earn currency. When you have two identical characters, drag one onto the other to combine them and get a new one. As you keep merging, you work toward unlocking every brainrot in the game.

From time to time, you'll face battles against other players. When you're attacked, you choose which characters to send into the fight. The game also supports multiplayer, so your team choices matter whenever a battle begins.
nyfw-street-style: Feel your inner trendsetter come out in NYFW Street Style. Combine fashionable clothing pieces and accessories to build eye-catching outfits fit for the catwalk. You only need the mouse to play, so you can try out combination after combination. Along the way you will find fresh looks and open up dreamy fashion ideas. It is a creative playground set in the lively world of high fashion.
millionaire-factory: Millionaire Factory is a clicker game about gathering Metal and turning it into a fortune. You tap a large Metal gear with your mouse to collect Metal, then convert it into Money, for example 1 Metal for 0.1 Money or 10 Metals for 1 Money. Your earnings can go toward upgrades that increase how much Metal each tap brings in, and toward automation systems such as the Basic Auto Robot, the Regional Robot Program, and the National Automatic Robot Fleet, which generate passive income every 5 seconds.

You begin with a single factory that you can upgrade, and you can add up to three more. The journey starts with one small piece of Metal and grows into a massive factory empire and an investment fortune that rises and falls. The game blends idle, simulation, management, strategy, and tycoon elements into one steady build-up.
turbo-racer-extreme: Weave through heavy traffic in this arcade racer, where the goal is to rack up as many points as you can while steering clear of other vehicles. Points climb the closer you cut to rival cars, so bold driving pays off. Before each run, you pick the difficulty and the look of the track, so every race can feel different.

Three modes are available: one way, two way, and time attack. Each mode includes sunny, night, and rainy stages. Avoid collisions, speed along the highway to reach your top speed, and work toward every achievement. High
scary-math: Scary Math drops you into a spooky realm full of monsters, where you work through math problems one after another. The equations get harder as you move along, so the challenge keeps climbing. Each level asks you to respond quickly and accurately, so both speed and precision matter.

Moving through the levels is a good way to sharpen your mental agility, since every round pushes you to think on your feet with numbers. The game blends learning with a creepy monster theme, so practice feels like part of the adventure. Whether you enjoy math or simply like eerie games, this title offers a playful way to test your skills.
hide-heist: This one-player title puts you in charge of two characters with very different talents. One is a clever planner who can pick locks and get past digital security. The other is a powerhouse who takes out guards and smashes through barriers. Winning means using both of them wisely, since each can do things the other cannot.

Your goal is to slip into corporate offices and banks, pull off the robbery, and escape without being spotted. The game mixes action with planning, stealth, and quick decisions. To play, tap and drag on a touch screen, use the A, S, D, and W keys on a keyboard, or click the left mouse button.
crazy-golf-iii: Crazy Golf III takes the feel of a real round of golf and moves it onto the hills. There are 23 levels in total. They may look easy when you first start, but every one is different from the rest. If you get stuck, the settings button in the upper-left corner offers help.
The game is designed for one player and sits in the sports category, with action and golf among its tags. To play, just click with your mouse or tap the screen.
pumper-crazy-defence: Pumper Crazy Defense puts you in a top-down view where your job is to wipe out foes that keep streaming toward you. Cash earned during the fight can be spent on your character, so you grow stronger as the battle goes on. Upgrades include more health, double damage, double bullets, and several other boosts. You can also choose from a range of talents to shape how you fight. Get ready for a tense war.

Move with the arrow keys or WASD, and your aim follows the mouse pointer. A left click fires your weapon. Press T to turn on auto fire, so your weapon keeps shooting on its own, and press Y to turn it off.
supa-tic-tac-toe: Supa Tic Tac Toe takes the familiar three-in-a-row grid and adds a card game on top. The cards you hold are your weapons against the opponent. You draft strong cards that can rearrange the board, sabotage the enemy, or break the usual rules. Each card works once, but its effect is powerful enough to turn a locked, drawn-out match into a decisive
rooftop-shooters: Rooftop Shooters is a shooting game where your goal is to knock your opponent off the edge of a rooftop. You can face rivals in online multiplayer, team up for a local two-player duel on one device, or sharpen your aim in a local practice mode. It is the newest entry in the .io series, and the gun and sniper-style combat keeps every round tense.

Winning matches unlocks new skins, so your character can look different as you progress. The controls are simple: use the W, E, O and P keys to shoot and jump. Whether you prefer testing yourself alone or challenging a friend, the three modes give you plenty of ways to play.
mini-springs: Mini Springs puts you in charge of a purple slime as it works through small, puzzle-filled levels. You only have a few controls, so each jump needs careful thought. Springs in different colors launch the slime into the air, and you must time and aim every bounce with precision. Along the way, avoid dangerous enemies and spikes.

Your reflexes and sense of timing will be tested as you lead the slime toward its new world. Each stage asks you to plan your route before you move. Keep your focus steady and your choices deliberate to reach the goal flag.
word-chef: Word Chef is a traditional word search style puzzler that helps you pick up new vocabulary in an entertaining way. The free game offers six levels of challenge, from Beginner up to Expert, with over 500 stages to work through. To play, you link letters together from the jumbled grid to spell out words and build up your vocabulary as you advance.

To make a word, press and hold the left mouse button, then drag across the letters in order. If the combination you have traced is a real word, it gets accepted and shows up in your list and score. Your aim is to uncover every valid word tucked inside the scramble to clear each stage. Higher difficulties bring longer and more challenging words to discover.
wood-bolts-nuts-screw-pin-puzzle: Wood Bolts Nuts Screw Pin Puzzle is a logic game where you solve pin-based puzzles. You tap screws to pull them out of a piece, which lets the metal plate beneath drop, and you need to release the plates in the right order. Each stage has tangled layouts of nuts, bolts, and plates to work through, and the game offers more than 100 of them to clear.

Take your time and think before each move. If you get stuck, you can use the hint button or remove a few random screws to move forward. Keep experimenting until you find the answer, and enjoy the clever puzzle-solving the game is built around.
bomb-is-in-the-air: Bomb is in the Air puts you in the cockpit and sends you across the sky. Your flying skill matters just as much as where and when you drop your bombs, so every strike needs planning. Landings are a real test here, and you will need steady hands to bring your plane down safely. Enemies are sly and will try to outmaneuver you, so you have to stay one step ahead.

The journey takes you around the world, and each leg asks for careful timing and clever decisions. Missions come with unexpected turns in the story, which means you must be ready to change your approach at a moment's notice. Keep your nerve, adjust to whatever comes next, and see each objective through to the end.
watermelon-falling-animals: Watermelon: Falling Animals is a puzzle game about joining cute animals to create bigger, rarer ones. Tap the screen to drop an animal into the container. When two identical animals touch, they fuse into a larger one and add to your score. Careful placement keeps the pile low, because the round ends if the container overflows.

Every merge you make raises your score and moves you up the leaderboard faster. You can compete with players around the world for the top spot. Plan each move, use powerful boosts and chain combos to earn extra points, and use bonuses to avoid losing when the pile gets tall. Unlock new animals, set records, and show how well you can guide evolution.
tangle-master-3d: Tangle Master 3D is a 3D decryption puzzle about untying wires that have been knotted together. Your job is to free every tangled wire by moving the plug. The basic idea is to move the plug from the right side toward the left. The early levels are fairly simple, but the levels in the second half are very hard, so they will test your patience.
Play by dragging to move the plug. Think through each move before you make it, because the goal is to clear all the levels with your wits and careful planning.
cat-rescue: Cat Rescue is a puzzle game where you free a poor kitty from the hazards blocking his path. Sketch a simple line to shield him from spiteful bees that keep trying to sting him. Each drawing you make works as a workout for your brain, because you can create whatever shape you like, whether it's a line, a loop, or a star. Every stage needs its own approach, so only players with sharp minds can solve every challenge and keep the kitty safe for his nap.
Controls are easy: touch and drag to draw, then use your drawing to protect the cat. A larger drawing earns you fewer stars, so try to get three stars on every level.
weapon-survivor: Weapon Survivor is an arcade action title built around constant gunfire. You take on the role of a resilient fighter trapped on a battlefield crowded with foes. The only route out is to keep firing and combine different guns, which strengthens your combat power. By fusing weapons together, you can unleash frenzied streams of bullets that cut down the enemies closing in around you. Survival and combat go hand in hand here.
Controls are simple: click the mouse or tap the screen to play. Merge your weapons, aim your shots, and stay alive as long as you can against the swarm.
paper-fighter-3d: Set in a throwback world built from layered sheets of paper, this fighting title lets skilled martial artists show off their moves. You can play alone or bring a friend for a two-player bout. Every match is brief and runs for three rounds, and whoever takes two of them claims victory. Timing matters, so land your punches and kicks when the moment is right. Once your power bar fills up, you can unleash a special strike.

Player one steers with W, A, S and D, throws a punch with F, a kick with G, and a special attack with R. Player two uses the arrow keys to move, L for punches, K for kicks, and O for the special attack.
street-mayhem-beat-em-up: Street Mayhem takes you on a long brawl through streets packed with thugs and mutants. Your journey runs through Dark City, a forest, City Town, and a final episode set in a castle. Edward, Jennifer, and Russell fight alongside you, and each one has his or her own abilities and style. Jennifer and Russell stay locked until you earn enough points to open them.

Prefer a face-off? The 2 Player section lets you and a friend trade classic blows, and whoever takes three rounds first wins the match. Player one moves with W, A, S, D or the arrow keys (arrows work only in story mode), jumps with space, attacks with F or G, and defends with H. Player two moves with W, A, S, D or the arrow keys, jumps with L, attacks with P or O, and defends with I.
extra-hot-chili-3d: Extra Hot Chili 3D is a spicy journey where the heat rises with every dish. The meals draw on flavors from around the world, so each stop brings a new fiery tradition to test you. Your task is to get through every tough round by reacting quickly and staying one step ahead of the spice.

Fast reflexes alone won't carry you far, because you also need strategic thinking to handle the stronger challenges. Each round checks whether you can keep your composure as the heat builds. It is a light, casual hypercasual game with a tasty culinary theme, and both your nerves and your focus matter as the spice climbs.
warrior-bee-apocalypse: Warrior Bee Apocalypse combines action with upgrades. You guide a brave bee through waves of hostile bugs, and staying alive is the main challenge. Each level is finished by wiping out the invading swarm. Gems you collect along the way can be spent to strengthen the bee and sharpen its skills.

On a computer, move with WASD or the arrow keys. Get close to an enemy and the bee attacks on its own, so your focus is on positioning. Press keys 1, 2 or 3 to use your special items. On mobile devices, tap and drag across the screen to steer the bee, and it will attack automatically when enemies are nearby. To use special items, tap them in the lower right corner.
bridge-fun-race: Bridge Fun Race is an arcade battle game in the .io style, and it is often compared to the Mr Bean series. You play as adorable three-dimensional characters in a run of elimination-style contests against several AI rivals. Only the three top finishers in each match move on to the next battle, so every round matters.

The game mixes two kinds of stages. In racing stages, you gather items as you go and shove obstacles out of the way to reach the finish line. In survival stages, you roll up snowballs, launch them at the other players, and try to knock them off the platform before time runs out. Everything is controlled with a simple mouse click or tap.
egg-hill-climb: Two partners have robbed a bank and must escape together. They work as a team, so they need to stay close to each other the whole way. Grab every coin along the route, empty the bank, and head for the finish line. At the end, collect the red and blue money boxes so that two safes are filled with cash and the level is complete.

Each player has their own set of keys. The W, A, S and D keys move the red player and adjust its balance, while the arrow keys move the blue player and adjust its balance in the same way. Mobile controls are available, so the game can also be played on mobile devices.
crossy-rails: Crossy Rails is a logic puzzle where you build a railway that carries a train safely to its destination. You move the rail blocks and arrange them in the correct direction until they form one unbroken line. Every piece has to meet its neighbours properly, so thinking a few steps ahead helps a lot. Once the track is finished, the train sets off on its own and completes the level.

The controls are simple: slide each block left, right, up, or down. The puzzles become harder as you progress, testing your planning and problem-solving. It is a relaxed game that suits anyone who enjoys a bit of careful thinking.
chess-online: Chess Online lets you explore the strategy of the game by facing players from around the world. If you'd rather sharpen your abilities first, you can practice against computer opponents at varied levels. The game offers diverse time controls, so matches can move at different paces, and interactive hints are available to help you strengthen your tactics.
Enjoy every move on boards you can customize, with real-time analysis along the way. You can also share lively cartoon emotions with your opponents during play.
kick-the-ball-and-shoot: Guide your character through a course full of barriers, keeping a ball in motion by bumping it with your head. This sports-themed arcade game asks you to time each bounce carefully so you can move forward without losing control of the ball.

Pick up weapons along the way and decide when to use each one so the route stays open. Earn achievements as you progress, and each one brings a reward. Quick responses matter here, and you will need to learn the recurring patterns to handle stages that grow harder over time.
bear-adventure-online-game: Bear Adventure Online Game sends you on a journey through green woodlands, where you look for bears to join you as companions. The controls are easy to pick up, and the graphics look great, which keeps the tense search moving. Every level brings its own kinds of obstacles, so you will need to adapt as you go.
Exploring the world is a big part of the fun, because poking around can uncover secrets and open the way to more thrilling adventures. The mood is charming and pulls you in fully.
blend-it-perfect: Blend It Perfect is a three-dimensional casual title centered on the fun of making juice. Its many stages push you to keep improving, while the sharp visuals make every moment pleasant to look at. Gameplay stays laid-back, so you can enjoy the process of mixing drinks whenever the mood strikes.

Controls are straightforward: slide to get going. The game also asks you to be careful not to hurt your fingers, so ease up instead of pressing too hard. Blend It Perfect suits short breaks just as well as longer, relaxing sessions.
escape-from-squid-island: Escape From Squid Island is a first person shooter set in 3D. Your goal is to flee a perilous island crowded with foes. Expect intense clashes, a range of different surroundings, and a storyline that keeps you invested as you battle for your liberty. The game is played directly on your device.

Steer your character with the W, A, S and D keys, and swing the camera around by rotating your mouse. A left click lets you shoot, while a right click lets you aim. When you need to recharge, press R.
squid-games-red-light: Every task in this game is tougher than it looks, and each one comes with a time limit you have to beat. If you miss the deadline, you are knocked out and cannot take on any more tasks. Those who make it through earn a prize pack and become challengers in the squid game. The squid players are prepared for a range of tests, including hair challenges and a blob squid run race.

Controls are handled entirely with the mouse. Hold down the left button to run, and steer by moving the pointer in the direction you want to go. Get ready for the squid challenges and see how far you can get in this Squid Games Red Light arcade title.
football-tricks: You take on the role of team captain in Football Tricks, a game set on a virtual football pitch. Your job is to pull off bold trick shots that send the ball in from tricky angles. Sharpening your technique is the key to finding the net in ways that look truly impressive.

As the match unfolds, every goal helps you guide your squad toward a win. The game is free to enjoy, so you can jump in whenever you fancy a kickabout and display your footballing flair along the way.
serial-cheaters: Serial Cheaters is a hectic dash where comedy and fast-paced action collide. Your job is to chase down a slippery cheater as they weave past wild obstacles. Each stage grows harder than the last, so quick reactions are key to keeping up.

The controls are simple to pick up, and the bright, colorful settings add to the fun of the pursuit. It's a light-hearted chase with plenty of energy, and it's easy to lose track of time while you play.
last-to-leave-circle-obby: This hypercasual title pits you against others in a contest that tests both stamina and agility. The circle closes in a bit more with every move you make, leaving less room to maneuver as the match goes on. Along the way you face shifting challenges, dodge dangerous traps, and try to outlast your competitors.

Winning depends on quick reflexes and clever strategy. Your goal is to stay in the game longer than everyone else and be the last one standing. Every decision matters as the circle keeps tightening around you.
fnf-music-3d: FNF Music 3D is a rhythm game built around music and beats. Players face off in battles against their girlfriend's dad, moving through a series of stages called "weeks," such as week 1, week 2, week 3, week 4, and so on. Each week bundles together three songs that must be cleared to move forward.

You control the action with WASD or the arrow keys, pressing them in time with the music. Keep your timing steady to move through each song. It is listed under hypercasual and tagged with music and rhythm.
doors-awakening: Doors Awakening is a tough online puzzle game built around solving tricky challenges. Its three-dimensional visuals let you wander through levels that were crafted by hand, so every space feels intentional. Visual effects add to the mood, and the realistic atmosphere pulls you deeper into each area. The camera moves naturally, so looking around never feels awkward.
Controls are simple: a mouse click or a tap is all you need. If you enjoy puzzles, this one offers a demanding test that is likely to bring you back for another session.
spider-solitaire-pro: Spider Solitaire Pro is a card puzzle played with two full decks. Your focus gets a real workout here, since the game asks you to think a few moves ahead. Unlike classic solitaire, you never move cards up to foundation piles. Instead, you build descending runs across the tableau, and the layout gradually takes on a web-like look. Suits don't matter, so any card can go on any card that is one rank higher.

Getting stuck is easy in this game, so plan carefully. When no moves are left, press the stock to deal another row onto the stacks. Your goal is to clear every stack to finish the round. The game works on phones as well as desktops and runs right in your browser.
sniper-king-2d-the-dark-city: Sniper King 2D: The Dark City places you in a shadowy city where you take on carefully planned sniping missions. Each bullet matters, so you need to think before you pull the trigger. Your job is to survey the area, line up your crosshairs on each target, and fire, all while making sure your ammunition lasts. You see everything through your own eyes, from a first-person view.

Success here depends on steady nerves and a patient approach. The game is built around stealth, so you need to stay out of sight and wait for the right moment rather than rushing in. It is a shooter with a tense mood that rewards careful, deliberate play over reckless action.
hair-do-design: Hair Do Design lets you explore your creative side across three stages. You begin with a calming spa treatment, move on to styling bright, lively hairdos, and finish by giving your character a striking makeup look. It is a good fit for young stylists who want a colorful, hands-on session in a bright and easy-to-use game world.

Every step puts you in charge of the look, so you can experiment freely and see how each choice changes the final result. The whole experience feels approachable and playful, making it a simple way to spend time doing salon-style work from start to finish.
animal-care-tycoon: In this idle tycoon game, you start with a single small treatment room and grow it into the city's biggest veterinary center. You heal cats, dogs, sheep, and exotic animals like zebras, and each one arrives with its own problem, such as colds, viruses, or fractures. Earn coins to unlock stronger medicine, upgrade your equipment, hire vet doctors and skilled staff, and open more rooms so you can help more animals and earn more gold.
On a computer, WASD or the arrow keys move your character, while mouse clicks let you work with animals, tools, and objects around the hospital. Phones and tablets use an on-screen joystick for mov
delivery-chaos: Delivery Chaos is a quick-moving driving game where blasts make every drop-off feel like a test of nerve. You weave through scenes full of explosive chaos, grabbing waypoints to collect coins and push your score higher. Outmaneuvering the destruction is part of the fun, and you can unlock stronger vehicles and fresh map areas along the way.

Driving works with WASD, the arrow keys, the right or left trigger, or the left stick. Hold the spacebar or press Triangle to use the handbrake. Press V to free your cursor, and use Tab or Circle to return to the menu whenever you need to pause and regroup.
2244-number-match: Sliding number tiles is the core idea in 2244 Number Match. You join identical tiles so their values grow, working toward 2048, 4096, and beyond. Tiles can move in eight directions, so each move takes some planning if you want to reach the highest score you can. A swipe in any direction shifts the tiles and merges the matching ones.

The game includes daily rewards, boosters, and timed challenges, along with global leaderboards for comparing results. You can customize the look with themes such as City, Jungle, Desert, Snow, and Aquarium. Whether you have a few minutes or want a longer brain-training session, the pace stays relaxed yet demanding. It is a good way to sharpen your logic and build better strategy as you see how far merging can take you.
funny-cubes-2048: Funny Cubes 2048 gives the classic 2048 formula a playful twist with lively physics. Your aim is to build the largest cube you can by combining matching ones. Drop a cube onto the pile, and when it lands on a cube showing the same number, the two fuse into one cube worth double the value: two 2s become a 4. Cubes with different numbers don't merge, so they pile up and can overflow the container, making the challenge harder and possibly ending your run.

To clear some of the clutter, you can use boosters that sort out a group of loose cubes. You earn them by collecting several cubes at a time. Along the way you can rack up achievements and compete with players around the world. The game is free to play online and works across devices, so merging cubes is easy to enjoy on the device you already have.
save-the-baby-home-rush: In this arcade game, your job is to bring a lost baby back home safely. You sketch out routes that guide the little one past dangerous hazards along the way. Each stage grows trickier than the last, so you'll need to think ahead and work through puzzles as you go.

The whole adventure has a sweet, family-friendly look and feel. Careful planning and a bit of creativity are the keys to clearing every level. Step into the role of a rescuer and help the little one find their way home.
max-the-secret-of-grandpa-s-letter: Max is a young wolf who dreams of adventure. One day a letter arrives from his late grandfather, who spent years posing riddles to his grandson, and that habit lives on even after his death. Inside the envelope are a treasure map and puzzling clues copied from the old man's notebook. Max packs his bag and sets off on a trip filled with simple but enjoyable challenges.
The trail leads to the mysterious Island of Lost Ships, where
noob-vs-choo-choo-charles: Noob VS. Choo-Choo Charles is an endless runner where you guide Noob away from frightening pursuers that never give up. You keep moving while weaving past obstacles and tricky spots that keep coming. Along the way, you can grab coins, and those coins help you unlock new characters to play as. Careful planning matters, since your choices affect how long you last in the chase.
