On PC, move with WASD, jump with Space, rotate the camera with the right mouse button, and attack with the left mouse button. On mobile, steer with the joystick, hold a finger on the screen to control the camera, and tap the screen to attack.
geometry-maze-maps-v2: This fast platformer puts you in charge of a cube as it moves through six demanding mazes. Your character keeps moving forward on its own, so your main job is timing your jumps well. Along the way you'll face spikes and moving platforms, and one touch of a deadly trap ends your run instantly. Yellow boosters can launch you onto higher ledges when you need extra height.

Speed is the main hurdle here, since the quicker pace makes every level harder to win, and that is much of the challenge. Each attempt tests your reflexes, and the more you practice, the sharper your reaction time becomes. On desktop, press the spacebar to jump. On mobile, tap the screen to jump.
buddy-and-friends-hill-climb: Buddy and Friends Hill Climb is a racing game where you drive a jeep up a range of hills. It suits both seasoned racers and players who are new to the track. Built with HTML5 in a hypercasual style, it puts the focus on the climb itself. Your goal is to conquer the slopes and come out on top.

Along the way you will be driving, jumping, collecting things, and steering clear of obstacles. Controls are simple: use W, A, S, and D to move the jeep around. Practice your line on each hill and see how far you can get.
poligon-war-zombie-apocalypse: Poligon War Zombie Apocalypse is an action shooter in which the world faces yet another polygon apocalypse. You move through a pixel environment designed to feel realistic, and you get to use a set of guns. Your job is to take out every enemy and complete all the levels to bring the apocalypse to an end.
Movement uses the WASD keys. The mouse lets you look around, aim, and shoot. Press G to throw a grenade. The remaining controls are explained inside the game itself.
woody-block-puzzles: Woody Block Puzzles is a puzzle game made with kids in mind, and it is easy to pick up. Your job is to fit each block into the right spot on the board. Movement works by dragging and dropping the pieces. The game is meant to sharpen your thinking skills while you have a good time, and it can also be shared with friends.

Nothing about the rules is complicated, so you can start right away. Each block simply needs to find its perfect slot. Keep trying placements and see how far you can go with this light, relaxing brain teaser.
tap-think-save-the-kitten: A colorful snake is sneaking up on a helpless kitten, and it is up to you to stop it. Tap the directional arrow boxes in the correct sequence to solve the puzzle and reload your colored gun. Each reload gives you a weapon in one color, so match the colors and fire your bullets at the serpent. Watch the beast shrink with every hit, because every second counts in this idle tap challenge.

This clicker game blends tapping, puzzle solving, and shooting into one arcade experience. Your goal is to shrink the snake until the kitten is safe. Think fast and stay sharp, because the serpent keeps closing in.
hexa-sort-3d: Hexa Sort 3D blends puzzle challenges with strategic matching and a pleasing merging system. Its clever brain teasers call for careful thinking and logical moves, so it works well as a workout for your mind.

As levels advance, the game feels both hard to put down and calming, finding a good middle ground between difficulty and downtime. Your tasks include sorting, stacking and combining hexagon-shaped tiles, and you can handle everything with a simple mouse click or a tap.
sprinter-heroes: Sprinter Heroes takes you to a worldwide running contest. You can team up with a friend and both act as the heroes, or race on your own. Your route passes through seven continents, and your aim is to become the champion with high scores. You will compete against your friend as well as against other runners.

Each new level you open is tougher than the one before, so the challenge keeps growing. The final race is a real test of speed and stamina. To keep your runner moving, tap the left and right arrow keys and the A and D keys in turn. The game is a 3D title that runs in the browser with WebGL.
need-for-drift: Take your car out onto the open roads for fast-paced street racing. Slide through tight bends, slip away from police pursuits, and drive your machine as hard as it will go. Finishing races and risky challenges earns rewards, which you can spend on upgrades that make your car faster and more powerful. Roam the city at your own pace, sharpen your driving skills, and leave the patrol cars behind.

Use WASD to drive, and press Shift to activate nitro for a quick burst of speed. Touch controls are available for mobile devices, so you can race on a phone or tablet too. Each run is a chance to improve your drifting and show what your car can do on the streets.
pics-2-word: Pics 2 Word gives you four images and asks you to work out the one word that connects them. Every picture is a clue, so study them closely and look for what they share. Levels run from simple words to tricky brain teasers, making it a good choice for quick mental training or a longer puzzling session.

To play, tap letters from the bottom of the screen and they will fill the answer boxes at the top. If you get stuck, the Hint button costs 40 coins and reveals one letter. You start with 50 coins, so use them wisely. Tap Back to remove your last letter, or Clear to start the answer over. Solving a puzzle earns you 25 coins and moves you to the next level. Think beyond the obvious,
mix-and-paint-3d: Mix & Paint 3D is a calm puzzle game about blending paints and coloring three-dimensional shapes. You select pigments and combine them on a palette until you match a target shade. Once the mix looks right, you apply it to an object and see how closely your painted surface matches the goal. Each stage mixes careful color work, satisfying brushwork, and an accuracy challenge.

To pass a level, you need at least 60% accuracy, and 90% or higher earns a perfect result. Click or tap a pigment to load your brush, then hold and drag across the palette to mix. On the object, hold and drag to move the brush or spray across its surface. The Clear, Hint, and Done buttons are all operated by clicking or tapping. The game works with a mouse or touchscreen, so no keyboard keys are needed.
would-it-smash: Build a machine made for crushing. Two strong wheels roll over blocks and flatten them while you gather money. Spend what you earn on upgrades that boost how fast and how hard your crusher works, so it can take on harder challenges. The game mixes clicker, idle, arcade, and physics elements.

Along the way, you can unlock new skins for the wheels and finish tasks to keep your machine growing. Tap or click the crusher to act on it, and use the upgrade buttons to raise speed and power. Collect your rewards, and start a challenge once you feel ready. On a desktop, the mouse works, and so do the arrow keys and the Space bar.
chain-cube-2048-3d-merge-game: Chain Cube 2048 is a merging puzzle game for fans of brain teasers and logic-based merge challenges. Joining 2048 cubes turns out to be harder than simply getting rid of numbers. When a cube fails to merge with the blocks around it, those blocks bounce off each other, so every move takes some thought. Keep playing, and you may eventually finish all 2248 number puzzles.
Controls are simple: a mouse click or a tap is all you need. The game sits in the Puzzles category and carries the tags 2048 and 3D.
kids-transport: Kids Transport is a playful educational game made for children in the early preschool years. Its main purpose is to help young players recognise vehicle names and the sounds they make. It works as a first step into kindergarten learning, with vehicles at the centre of every lesson.

You control the game with a mouse or by tapping the screen. The mood is light and cheerful, with the aim of making learning enjoyable. It is filed under racing and also carries tags such as Action, Adventure, bus and Hypercasual.
crazy-downhill-ragdoll-fall-down: Guide a floppy ragdoll hero as it tumbles down a steep slope in this 3D arcade racer. Your hero rolls, flips and crashes into everything along the way, so you need to dodge obstacles and reach the finish line. Every fall is bouncy and silly, and you can watch your character break apart and then pull itself back up. If you enjoyed Deadly Slide! or Ragdoll Crash Test: Throw and Break!, this one will feel familiar.

Steering is simple to pick up. On a phone, swipe left or right to change direction, and on a PC, use the arrow keys or your mouse. The skin shop lets you play as Hagi Wagi, Stickman, Noob, Obby and other popular meme heroes. You can also climb the leaderboard to see how your best result compares with other players. The game runs in a browser on smartphones, PCs and tablets.
jixora-jigsaw-solitaire-puzzle: Jixora turns jigsaw solitaire into a calm experience as you assemble pictures made of lovely artwork. A set of 100 levels grows harder as you progress, and Free Play mode lets you replay your favorites with grid sizes you choose. Each round has a countdown, so you must finish the picture in time to earn stars.

Drag pieces with your mouse on desktop, or with your finger on mobile. Pieces that belong together snap into place and lock when they touch. Three power-ups help when you get stuck: a Hint lightbulb that moves one piece to its correct spot, an Eye that briefly shows the finished image, and a Snowflake that pauses the timer for ten seconds. Soothing music and a cinematic mood complete the experience.
copy-the-drawing: Copy the Drawing is a drawing game with 300 levels spread across 18 categories, ranging from basic shapes to animals, vehicles, space, fantasy, and Japanese culture. You study the sample picture at the top of the screen, then reproduce it on the canvas below. The closer your lines match the sample, the higher your score climbs.

Each day brings a new drawing of the day, so you can build a streak and try to beat your own earlier results. Three brush sizes help with fine lines, while Undo removes your latest stroke and Clear wipes the canvas so you can start over. Hints are available if you get stuck. When you tap Check, you receive a match score and a medal: bronze for 50% or more, silver for 70% or more, or gold for 90% or more. Earning medals unlocks new levels and categories.
princess-dressing-up-game: In this game, you help a lovely princess who adores pretty clothes and makeup. She needs your assistance, so you choose outfits and beauty looks to suit her. The title is aimed at girls and kids, and its tags point to princess themes and cute characters.

Controls are simple: use your mouse, or tap the screen if you are on a touch device. Take your time with each choice and enjoy the cheerful, relaxed mood as you style her. It makes a sweet way to pass some free time.
arms-race: Arms Race moves quickly, and your job is to combine matching weapons into stronger ones. Every time you join two identical guns, you get a more powerful model, so your arsenal keeps growing deadlier as you go. The run never really ends, since there is always a bigger weapon to chase and more dominance to claim on the battlefield.

Controls are simple: just click to interact with the game and make your moves. Keep merging, watch your firepower climb, and see how far your combat potential can stretch in this hooked, nonstop challenge.
dop-fun-delete-one-part: DOP Fun: Delete One Part is a brain-teasing puzzler that puts your reasoning to the test. Each scenario shows a drawing with a hidden catch, and your job is to work out what looks wrong. Instead of choosing from a list of answers, you drag your finger across the picture to wipe part of it away and reveal what lies underneath. The trick is to erase only the correct piece, so you need to spot the faulty detail first.

Answers here are rarely the first thing that comes to mind, so expect to think sideways. Logic will get you far, but a bit of creativity and a willingness to laugh at the joke can help too. It is a casual, funny brain game. Use a mouse click or a tap to get started, then keep dragging to uncover what the scene is hiding.
save-her-tour: Save Her Tour is a puzzle game that is both demanding and calming to play. Your job is to work through brain teaser quizzes and rescue a young woman from trouble. Every level presents a new situation, and you need to rely on clever thinking to work out what to do. A wrong move can lead to a bad outcome for the heroine, so care matters throughout.

The game offers a wide mix of challenges for you to crack. Along the way you will solve intriguing puzzles, keep the girl out of danger, and enjoy the satisfaction of getting it right. Controls are simple: click with your mouse or tap your screen to play.
hard-puzzle: Hard Puzzle is a brain-teasing game that suits people of every age. Its huge number of levels means there is always something new to try, so boredom is unlikely. Many players find that returning each day is a good way to give their thinking a workout.

The goal is to fit bright geometric shapes together until they form a complete square. As you advance, harder difficulty levels open up. When a puzzle has you stumped, a hint is available to point you in the right direction.
pocket-drift: Pocket Drift is a racing game that seats you behind the wheel of one of five distinct cars, with five demanding tracks to tackle. Drifting is the core of the game: you deliberately break your tires loose and slide through corners, earning points for how far and how stylishly you drift.

The game is seen from above at an angle, giving every course an isometric look. Controls are simple and the game is easy to pick up, yet mastering it takes real practice. Steer using the A and D keys or the left and right arrow keys.
find-the-dog: Expect a light, cheerful hunt through black-and-white pictures packed with delightful small touches. Your job is to track down as many concealed dogs as you can. The pups are tucked into a variety of places, ranging from peaceful park corners to busy city roads, so every scene offers something new to check.

Nothing pushes you along here, so you can take your time. Move the cursor over the artwork and left-click whenever you spot a dog. Use the scroll wheel to zoom in for a closer look, and hold the left button while dragging to slide across the picture. If you get stuck, press the hint button at the bottom left to reveal where one of the hidden dogs is located.
drawer-and-race: Drawer And Race is a hypercasual drawing game where you compete to sketch a word or phrase you are given. Each round is a sprint against the timer, so you need to get your idea across quickly. Simple, easy-to-read drawings work best here, and the game rewards both speed and clarity. It asks you to think fast and communicate your idea in as few strokes as possible.
The game is tagged for animals, kids, and racing, and it runs in the browser on WebGL. To play, just click or tap with your mouse or finger to draw.
bonk-royale: Bonk Royale is a playful battle royale set in a party-style racing game. You dash through charming courses filled with obstacles, and you need to watch your footing, because some surfaces are slippery or simply unsafe. Your aim is to cross the finish line ahead of every other player.

On a PC, the arrow keys steer your character, Space makes you jump, and Shift lets you dive. Mobile players get a virtual joystick for movement, with on-screen buttons for jumping and diving. The race is won by whoever gets to the finish first.
knifeblades: KnifeBlades is a 2D action game you can play right in your browser, with online matches against other players. Your aim is to collect blades and wrap them around your character, then take on rivals inside the arena. Every battle rewards smart, deliberate play rather than rushing in blindly.

You can use both offensive and defensive modes, so you decide when to press the attack and when to protect yourself. Choosing the right mode at the right moment is how you outmaneuver your enemies. The game is built with HTML5, so it runs directly in your browser window.
war-robots-battle-mech-arena: Step into the cockpit of powerful robots in War Robots Battle: Mech Arena. Each battle takes place in demanding arenas, where you face off against rivals in intense clashes. The game blends careful strategy with fast, high-speed action, and every fight feels tense from start to finish. Several game modes, including Qualifying and Boss Challenge, offer different ways to test your skills.
Controls are simple. A mouse click or a tap is all you need to play. Each arena and mode keeps the pressure on, so your robot is always put to the test.
diy-joystick-game: You take on the role of a gifted designer who turns plain joysticks into stylish pieces. Each day a steady stream of visitors arrives at your studio, all hoping you can rescue their worn-out, unsightly controllers. Grab the spray gun and start transforming them into one-of-a-kind creations.

Some customers will describe exactly the look they want, so you can match their preferred styles. Other times you can simply follow your own imagination and build whatever design you like. The palette offers plenty of shades, the sticker collection gives you extra decoration options, and several production techniques are available to try. Expect a lot of fun along the way.
obby-1-to-spaceflight-altitude: Step into a space-themed obstacle course where you can customize your character and take rocket journeys in your browser at no cost. Wander across the galaxy while sharpening your spaceflight skills. Collect stars and charge up a slingshot, a stick of dynamite, or a full rocket with energy. Hatch pets from cases and eggs to gain more energy, earn money, and raise your hero through ranks.

Move with W, A, S, and D, and jump with the Spacebar. The mouse turns your view, and Tab hides or shows the cursor. The number keys open the rest of the features: 1 mutes or unmutes sound, 2 opens skins, 3 opens pets, 4 opens tasks, 5 claims the daily bonus, 6 opens the wheel of fortunes, and 7 opens promotion.
fight-club-simulator: Fight Club Simulator is a boxing game set in a neon-lit future, where high-tech upgrades meet traditional punching. You begin as a rookie and work your way up through the ranks of cybernetic combat sports. Along the way, you can strengthen your punches, unlock new combat abilities, and face a range of tough rivals in sci-fi arenas.

You can also customize your boxer's look, complete action-packed quests, and learn fresh punch techniques. Opponents test your reflexes, tactics, and timing, and you can chain together devastating combos as you progress through deep character upgrades. Move with W, A, S, and D, press Space to fight, use, or buy, or drag the on
bubble-tea-cocktail-maker-mix-drinks: Step behind the counter of Bubble Tea Cocktail Maker Mix Drinks, a food and simulation game where mixing drinks is the whole point. Try out a wide range of ingredients and combine them in fresh ways to invent cocktails that feel like your own. The game runs on any device, so you can practice your bartending skills wherever you are, turning your virtual bar into a spot to slow down and take it easy.

Your aim is to become a skilled drink creator who serves up tasty, original cocktails. Every ingredient is measured for you, so the balance of each drink comes out right without any guesswork. Bright visuals and a simple layout make the controls easy to pick up, and the experience is colorful and hard to put down as you craft one drink after another for your guests.
mathematics-frenzy: Mathematics Frenzy is a fast arcade runner where you must work out sums quickly to get ahead. Success depends on sharp thinking as well as fast reflexes. Your path winds through obstacle courses, and along the way you reach math gates that you must solve on the spot while the run continues. Each gate asks you to think fast, and the numbers you carry can grow as you pass through them.

The goal is to chase the highest score you can. Every run tests your speed and mental agility, rewarding players who stay calm and calculate under pressure. Controls are simple: mouse click or tap to play.
sea-legends-match-3: Sea Legends - Match 3 is a matching puzzle game built around the match-3 style. As you play, you explore mysteries of the deep and try to uncover the secrets hidden in sunken shipwrecks. The graphics are attractive, and the game can be played on mobile or desktop.

Each level asks you to clear blocks from the board and collect sea creatures. Form larger clusters of underwater blocks to earn stronger boosters, then activate them to reach your goals faster. Combining boosters can make difficult levels easier to get through. New stages are there to explore, so you can keep discovering the secrets of ocean treasures.
tankcraft-war-tank-battles: In TankCraft , War Tank Battles, you design your own war machine and then take command of it. Part builder and part commander, you shape the tank before leading it into fierce fights. The game mixes creative construction with tense warfare, so every choice you make carries weight once the battle begins.

Controls are easy to pick up, since a mouse click or a tap is all you need. The same simple input works on a computer or a touchscreen. Take your time crafting your tank, then see how it holds up when the fighting starts.
ragdoll-gangs: Gang fights break out between floppy Ragdoll brawlers in this game. It offers two modes. Adventure Mode is for one player and spans six stages, each with its own setup, such as brawls, knocking foes off a high spot, or open battles.

Arena Mode can be played alone or with a second person on the same computer. Solo players face a computer-controlled fighter, which is a bit tough. Two players can face off locally, and the first to reach three points wins. Player 1 moves with WASD, picks up or throws with C, punches with V, kicks with B, and runs with Left Shift. Player 2 moves with the arrow keys, uses I to pick up or throw, O to punch, P to kick, and Right Shift to run. L toggles the cursor lock, and P pauses.
fun-with-flags-ultimate-quiz-game: This brain-teaser puts your geography and trivia knowledge to the test with flags from around the world. Each stage shows a single country's flag beneath four possible answers, and only one of them is right. Pick carefully with your mouse, then advance through more levels as you learn flags from every continent. The colorful designs keep the challenge varied as you move forward.

If a flag stumps you, press the Hint button, which either crosses out incorrect options or offers clues pointing toward the correct country. Suitable for children, students, and grown-ups alike, the game works whether you are picking up geography for the first time or polishing what you already know about the globe.
obby-vs-noob-driver: Obby and Noob need your help on this road adventure. You take the wheel yourself and aim for the finish line, but a friend must join you so that you both drive the car together. The track is very tough, with a rough surface and obstacles that make driving difficult. Keep the car intact as you go, because it must reach the end in one piece. Your goal is to get Obby and Noob to the flag waiting at the finish line.

Controls are simple. Use the W, A, S and D keys to move the red character and adjust its balance, while the arrow keys move and balance the blue one. Mobile controls are also available for playing on your phone or tablet.
super-santa-adventures: Super Santa Adventures is a free holiday adventure with platform elements, made for players of all ages. Its gameplay is easy to pick up and full of fun, and Christmas music plays along to set the festive mood. Your job is to run with Santa as he delivers every gift. Speed up gently, and avoid bumping into other traffic along the way.

The game is inspired by the traditional Christmas story from the New Testament, which tells of Jesus being born in Bethlehem in line with messianic prophecies. When Joseph and Mary reached the city, the inn had no room, so they were offered a stable, where the Christ Child was soon born. Angels then announced the news to shepherds, who spread it further. Wishing everyone a happy holiday.
monster-truck-extreme-racing: Hefty monster trucks are lining up on the sand, each one eager to prove it rules the desert. Customize your ride as you go and enter races where you must finish in the top three to earn rewards. Daring stunt displays on the huge Free Drive map also bring in prizes. Between events, the Garage lets you purchase fresh trucks for upcoming challenges.

Play alone or team up with a friend in the two-player mode. Player 1 drives with the arrow keys, activates nitro with N, and looks back with B. Player 2 steers with W, A, S and D, activates nitro with T, and looks back with C. Press R at any time to restart the current level.
zombie-survival-blackout-127696: The city has gone dark, and a zombie horde now fills its streets. In this action roguelite shooter, your hero fires automatically, so you can focus on moving. Collect XP crystals to level up, and each new level lets you pick a power such as rockets, lightning, meteors or drones. Rescue survivors along the way and bring them to the helicopter to escape.

Between fights, equip and upgrade your gear, merge items, and grow your camp. The game has 15 stages across three districts, each ending with a boss to defeat, and you can also test your build in Endless mode. Move with WASD or the arrow keys, or drag anywhere on the screen on a phone. Press P to pause.
color-hole: Color Hole is a relaxed casual game in which you steer a hole that swallows things up. The goal is to guide it so it eats every white object while steering clear of the colorful ones. Each level brings more complicated obstacles, so the challenge grows as you advance. Good planning and fast reactions will help you get far.
To move the hole, simply swipe across the screen. Gobble up all the white items and be careful not to take in anything with another color.
emilys-hotel-solitaire: Picture arriving on a tropical island and then choosing between relaxing in a lounger with a cold drink or trying your hand at surfing. In this solitaire game, you follow Emily, who has come to this paradise to help turn her respected grandfather Douglas Kirby's long-held wish of owning a hotel into reality. Leave your worries behind and soak up the island's enchanting mood while working through card puzzles. Each round you win moves Emily one step nearer to her goal of opening the finest hotel anywhere.
This single-player title is presented in 2D. To play, simply click with your mouse or tap the screen.
smartphone-legends: This 3D runner blends in shop management. You start with a basic phone and work to transform it into a high-value device while building your own phone business. Along the way, pass through gates that raise its value, collect cash, and dodge hazards to keep upgrading it. At the finish line, you can sell the phone for instant cash or keep it to stock your shop and earn from customers.

Use A and D or the left and right arrow keys to steer during runs, and WASD or the arrow keys to move around the shop. Holding the left mouse button and dragging steers or moves you, while Space starts from the main screen or continues from the results screen. Left-click to press buttons and navigate menus. On mobile, drag to steer or move and tap buttons to interact.
army-commando: Army Commando puts you in the boots of a soldier racing to stop a violent group of terrorists bent on causing worldwide disruption. Viewed from first person, the game asks you to sneak into their hidden base and eliminate enemies one at a time while completing every mission goal along the way.

Controls are simple to pick up. Use the left mouse button to fire and the right button to aim, move with W, A, S and D, and toss a grenade with the G key. Press Tab whenever you need to pause the action.
bombaman-3d: Step into a three-dimensional world in BOMBAMAN 3D, where you work your way through tricky labyrinths and set off explosives to open new routes. Enemies roam the maze, so you will need to plan where each blast lands. Collect power-ups along the way, search for the secret exit, and prepare for tough bosses. You can play alone or team up with others, on whichever devices you use.

Movement uses W, A, S, D or the arrow keys, and you press Spacebar to drop a bomb. Each bomb explodes three seconds after it is placed, and bombs set side by side will set off one another. Every level gives you 99 seconds, but you can break open boxes to collect clocks that add more time. Power-ups raise the number of bombs you can place and how far their blasts reach. To defeat a boss, you must hit it with bombs three times.
satisroom-perfectly-organized: Satisroom invites you to step away from your daily routine with calm mini-games about sorting, tidying, packing, and arranging. Across many stages, you'll put things in order, from makeup and furniture to packing boxes and preparing food. Soft ASMR sounds fill the background, so each session feels quiet and peaceful. A fresh batch of stages arrives every week, giving you more reasons to keep going and sharpen your sense of organization.
Controls are very easy to pick up, and people of any age can enjoy
tankhit: TankHit pits you head to head against the computer or a friend in a 3D setting. Battles take place across maze-like labyrinths and open arenas. Each tank carries a magazine of 5 shells. Grab power-ups scattered around the map to gain an edge over your opponent. The first player to land 5 hits takes the win.

Player 1 drives with W, A, S and D and fires with T. Player 2 uses the arrow keys to move and presses P to shoot. Pick your tactics, weave through the walls, and aim carefully, because every shot counts in this tank showdown.
zombie-vacation: You play as a special forces soldier whose plane went down, leaving you stranded on a tropical island swarming with zombies. Instead of the holiday you expected, you must use a modern submachine gun to mow down thousands of the undead. Your objective is to get through each zombie wave and come out victorious.
Movement uses the WASD keys, and the left mouse button fires your weapon. Press R to reload, Space to jump, and P
draw-dot-picture-game: Draw One Miss Part is a puzzle game built around logic, drawing and brain teasers. Each scene is missing a piece, and your job is to spot what is absent. Once you find it, you sketch the missing part back into the picture with your finger. The task sounds easy at first, but these brain puzzles prove harder than they look.

Everything in the game runs on simple controls. Use your mouse to press any button you see on screen. If you enjoy checking small details and working things out step by step, this title offers a quick way to test your observation skills.
melodys-adventure-2: Melody returns for a longer journey in this sequel, which features 32 levels that are larger than ever. Each stage is framed in a 16:9 widescreen view. Melody, easy to spot with her bright yellow hair and pink hat, moves through these enhanced landscapes, where new challenges and surprises wait around every corner.

Your platforming skills will be put to the test as you cross the vast terrain and outwit foes along the way. Melody's headphones give the whole adventure a rhythmic feel. Move her with the arrow keys or with the W, A, and D keys.
bottle-breakshot: Bottle Breakshot is an arcade shooter that tests your aim and shooting skills. You knock down bottles by throwing one of ten balls, and each ball has its own look and feel, so choosing the right one matters. Move the aim smoothly to line up each target, then set the shot power to control how hard and how far the ball travels.

Each level asks you to smash as many bottles as you can and to finish with the best score you can manage. Smooth controls and satisfying bottle-breaking action keep every throw responsive. With practice, your accuracy improves and each shot becomes easier to master. Selecting a favorite ball and lining up the first throw is where every run begins.
fish-eat-grow-mega: Fish Eat Grow Mega dives you into a larger round of growing in a wide ocean. You begin as a small creature and work your way up, meeting new kinds of fish along the route. Some parts of the sea are more hazardous than others, so you will need to stay alert as you explore them. Pick the fish you want to control before you set off.

Two players can team up in the two-player mode and head out together. Player 1 steers with W, A, S and D and boosts with C, while Player 2 moves with the arrow keys and boosts with L. Keep eating and growing as much as you can until you are crowned the king fish of the ocean.
car-collision-master: Drive a customized blue jeep through a looping desert course walled in by sharp canyon cliffs. Your rivals pilot orange and black vehicles, and you face them one on one in wild arenas. Smoke streams behind the cars while starry arches overhead add to the mayhem. Hear the V8 engines roar as you go, then take on friends or aim for the top of the leaderboards.

Ram opponents at the right moment, go through loops, and avoid dangerous hazards along the way. Smashing a rival's vehicle can knock their driver out, and each knockout earns you a point. The first player to reach five points wins the match. Use the arena's physics and loops to set up hits, but keep your own car out of harm's way.
mojicon-meadow-rescue: Mojicon Meadow Rescue is a gentle puzzle adventure where you help bring a flowery field back to life. Your task is to join pairs of identical tiles with a route made of three straight segments or fewer, so the path can bend no more than two times. Each stage offers a colorful layout to work through, and the meadow slowly recovers as you advance. Power-ups can lend a hand, while obstacles add some extra challenge to the boards. The pair-matching pace feels calm overall, and the cheerful artwork keeps things pleasant throughout.
To play, tap or click two matching tiles to connect them and clear them from the board. Remove every tile to complete a level and collect the rewards you earn along the way.
help-tricky-story-a-complicated-story: Help Tricky Story: A Complicated Story is a free online puzzle adventure that you can play on a phone or a computer. Its brain teasers ask you to work through complex problems and reason your way forward. In its everyday settings, you join the characters and figure out how to connect objects, break things apart, put items together, and pull pieces out. Each level brings a new challenge, so you keep experimenting until you find a way to finish it.

The game is built around logic, decision making, and steady mental practice. Its mix of riddles and brain games is meant to sharpen your thinking with every stage you clear. Along the way, you help the characters get past obstacles that seem impossible at first, and each solved level moves their story forward.
turbo-stunt-racing: Turbo Stunt Racing is a fast 3D arcade racer where style matters as much as speed. You pull off daring tricks, challenge tough rivals, and work through levels that grow harder as you go. Sharp, careful driving helps you take tight bends and leap over large jumps while staying ahead of the pack.

Cash earned from races lets you upgrade your current car or buy a new one, and each vehicle handles differently with its own performance boosts. Expect shifting obstacles, traps, and ramps across every stage, all presented in a stylized look. The game is also playable on mobile, and it should suit both casual players and dedicated racing fans.
arcade-thief-runner: Arcade Thief Runner is a fast endless runner where you play as a bold thief who is always on the move. Race through vivid city streets, hop over obstacles, evade security, and grab valuable loot along the way. Each piece of loot you collect raises your score. Speed and difficulty keep climbing, so the challenge becomes how long you can keep going.

Unlock new characters, power-ups, and special abilities to improve your chances in this arcade chase. Click or tap to play, use the WASD keys for movement, and press space to dig. This 2D title is built with HTML5 and works on mobile devices, including Android, iPhone, and iPad.
stair-race-3d: Stair Race 3D throws you into a large arena where you compete against a range of tough enemies to see who can build stairs best. Your route forward depends on grabbing stair planks along the way and laying them down to climb up to the next platform.

Keep an eye on your opponents, though, because any enemy carrying more planks than you can knock you over on contact, and you will lose everything you have gathered. The reverse also works: if you hold more planks, you can knock enemies down and take a strong lead. Winning rounds br
dino-huntress: Guide Dino Huntress through this 2D adventure, where gathering every coin and egg along the way is part of the challenge. Dodge hostile creatures and put your weapon and any bonus pickups to use as you head for the finish zone. Birds can be stomped from above to knock them out, but some foes, the dinosaurs among them, cannot be defeated that way.

The game includes 8 levels, and two large bosses wait at the very end. Move with the left and right arrow keys, jump with the up arrow, and fire with the space bar. Desktop players can also use WASD or a gamepad, while mobile devices offer on-screen buttons. Hold the jump button to leap higher, or press jump twice to perform a double jump.
hexa-two: Hexa Two is a 3D running and jumping game for one or two players. Alone, you can go online and compete against a crowd of other characters. With a friend, you can share one computer in split screen mode and challenge each other directly. Your task is to stay on a floor made of hexagons, but be careful: each tile drops away as soon as somebody steps on it.
Movement is simple. Run with the arrow keys or WASD, then press Space or Q to jump. Whether you play solo or against a buddy, the goal stays the same: keep moving without falling through the floor.
phone-case-diy-2: Curious whether you have a knack for art? This game lets you find out. A young woman is getting ready for her sister's party and needs a fresh phone case, and you are the one who designs it. You can pick from a wide range of colors, plenty of stickers, and several phone case models to build the look you like.

There are three different ways to decorate the case. With Stencil art, you spray many attractive patterns across the cover. Choosing Pop it brings in a playful pop-it style. A third process is also included. No matter which colors you use or which method you pick, the final case turns out lovely. Mouse or tap controls are all you need to get started.
obbie-zombie-land: Set out on an adventure that pits you against hordes of zombies. The gameplay is straightforward, while the delightful graphics and amusing characters give the game its charm. The enemies are quirky, and the game works with Android controllers. It promises plenty of fun and excitement along the way.

Your character must make their way past obstacles, leap across platforms, and defeat foes. Twelve pre-designed levels give you a solid start, and the controls are intuitive and accessible for players of all kinds. Press A to move left, D to move right, W to jump, and Space to attack.
bouncy-arrow: Bouncy Arrow is a bright puzzle title where each arrow you launch bounces off surfaces on its way. Your job is to pick the right heading, then fire at the moment that lets the shot pop the colored orbs. The basics are easy to pick up, yet mastering it takes real concentration. Every stage asks you to think ahead and work out which orbs must go first.

Random shooting will not get you far. Study the color pattern, trace where the arrow will travel, and tap to release it when the timing feels right. Clearing a stage means meeting all of its goals, then moving on to the next challenge. With vivid graphics, smooth movement, and satisfying pop effects, it suits anyone who enjoys calm puzzles, arrow games, color matching, or tap-based brainteasers.
plugjoy: PlugJoy is a puzzle game where planning ahead is the main skill. Your job is to guide brightly colored cables along winding routes so that every plug reaches the socket it matches, all while the clock keeps ticking. The levels are challenging, and if a layout has you stuck, you can ask for a hint.

Along the way you earn coins and unlock new avatars for your player. A daily challenge gives you another reason to return. The game uses cheerful cartoon graphics and simple controls, so it plays the same way on a phone or a computer.
survival-rush: Survival Rush is a three-dimensional action adventure in which you battle through repeated waves of enemies. Each wave tests your attacking power, your defensive ability, and your skill at staying alive. Rather than standing still, you dash around a platform, spot the foes closing in, and rely on your abilities to destroy them.
Controls are simple: a single mouse click or tap starts play. Stay
merge-sesame: Merge Sesame is a puzzle game that nearly anyone can pick up quickly, which makes it a good choice for families. Sound effects and visual feedback respond to your moves, and chaining back-to-back combos can help you unwind. Landing a high combo on an object sends your score climbing sharply.

There is no pressure here, with no penalties and no clock, so you set the pace. Combination effects are designed to look attractive on screen, giving each match a bit of visual flair. Use a mouse click or a tap to play, and see how high a score you can reach.
catwalk-beauty: Many people dream of becoming a professional model, and this game is built around that goal for anyone who wants to shine on the runway. It has become one of the most popular puzzle titles this year, thanks to its gripping gameplay and 3D art style. Beyond dressing up a character, it also asks you to pick the right items from a selection of choices.

Your job is to choose suitable outfits and jewelry for the model so she can win more favor with the judges in the competition. Be careful, though: a poor fashion mix means the model loses her chance to walk the catwalk. Getting started is simple, since a tap is all it takes to begin.
jenny-s-math-puzzle: Jenny's Math Puzzle is an educational game that mixes arithmetic practice with logical thinking. Your task is to place number tiles on a grid so that the equations it forms are correct. Difficulty rises gradually, and the clean, attractive design keeps the game fun and mentally stimulating for players of all ages.

To win, drag tiles from the pool into the empty slots until every equation on the board is complete. Each equation must be correct, whether it runs horizontally or vertically. The entire grid has to be filled with no mismatches. You can move tiles with a mouse, or with your finger on a touch screen. If you put a tile in the wrong spot, drag it back to the pool and try again.
drill-the-snake: Drill the Snake is a casual arcade defense game where you guard the surface from giant segmented snakes that climb up through winding underground tunnels. Your only weapon is a drill that swings like a pendulum. Watch its arc, time each strike, and break the creature apart segment by segment before its head reaches the top. You can upgrade your drill along the way, and a roguelike card system reshuffles its options with every run.

It is simple to pick up but tough to master. The whole game runs on one button: tap on mobile, or tap or press the spacebar on desktop, to launch a drill attack. Aim with care, because you get only one chance to stop what is coming.
sneaky-draw: Smudge the raccoon loves pulling pranks on his grumpy neighbour, Mr. Crabtree. With one stroke of your marker, sketch a ramp, a bridge or a lever so that water balloons, flying pies and paint buckets sail straight toward him. Let go, and the physics takes care of the rest. The game offers 45 puzzles across three chapters: Backyard Beef, Kitchen Chaos and Garage Gags.

Using less ink earns you all three stars on each level. A fresh Daily Prank arrives every day to help you build a streak. Each prank adds a sticker to your collection, and the stars you earn unlock hats for Smudge and new marker colours. If you get stuck, tap the question-mark button for a hint, or skip the level after three tries. On desktop, drag the mouse to draw, press R to retry and P to pause. On mobile, swipe to draw and use the arrow and pause buttons. The game is available in 11 languages.
car-dealership: In this management simulation, you begin with a small car dealership and grow it over time. Your first job is to buy affordable vehicles, then inspect each one carefully before deciding what it is worth. To set fair prices, you weigh what buyers in your neighborhood might pay against what the wider car market shows.

Your earnings come from the profits you make, and you decide where that money goes. Put it back into expanding your car inventory, or spend it on improving your showroom. Watching a modest lot expand into a larger business is the heart of the game.
team-loyalty: Team Loyalty is a runner in which you lead a group that gets bigger as you go. You begin with a single unit and move it through gates that add more members to your side. Along the way you face obstacles and enemies, and your group's size is your main weapon against them. The aim is to gather a strong force that can win the day.
Controls are simple. On a desktop, press the mouse and swipe left or right to steer your characters. On a phone or tablet, swipe left or right with your finger to move them across the track.
hair-dye: Step into a cartoon hair salon where you choose the look for each client. Pick the hairstyle you like, select the colors you want, and apply them with the hair color changer. Mix and match dyes to give crazy hairstyles a fresh new look, then finish each design with beautiful decorations.
The salon is busy, with plenty of customers waiting for your unique hairstyles and hair dye. Each one is ready to see what you create, so keep the
brain-challenge: Brain Challenge is a puzzle game built to stretch your thinking. Rather than following the obvious path, you need to approach each problem from a fresh angle, and the answers often turn out to be surprising. The game offers 250 fun levels, each one packed with brain-teasing puzzles that suit kids who enjoy logic.

Playing is simple: you click, drag, and drop to move through each challenge. The gameplay is easy to learn, yet it is genuinely addictive, so one more level always seems tempting. Its cute, lighthearted style makes it a good pick for younger players who like a solid brain workout.
kung-fu-little-animals: Kung Fu Little Animals is a children's clicker game inspired by a favorite animated cartoon. You step into the role of a new assistant to a great master, and your job is to train a group of the funniest and most nimble kung fu animals. Each simple click helps your new students grow into skilled martial artists.

As you progress, you discover new comical animals and beautiful locations. The game is aimed at kids who enjoy learning martial arts with a lighthearted twist. Depending on your device, you play with a computer mouse click or a simple touch on a touch screen.
island-monster-offroad: Take your oversized truck into a world of mountains, coastlines, and wild natural terrain. Your goal is to show what you can do on rough ground, using special ramps built for monster trucks and climbing steep hills along the way. The game runs on realistic physics, so every bump and jump has weight to it.

You can play alone as a single player or bring a friend for split-screen action. Player 1 drives with W, A, S, and D and uses N for power. Player 2 steers with the arrow keys and uses L for power. Invite someone over and find out who has the better driving touch.
dream-supermarket-3d-shop: Dream Supermarket: 3D Shop is a simulation game that puts you in charge of your own supermarket. Your goal is to grow into a skilled store manager. Along the way, you help shoppers, refill empty shelves, and keep the store feeling lively. The whole experience takes place in a three-dimensional grocery setting.

You start out at the checkout, where you scan items and handle money in a cashier mode. Move customers along quickly, hand back the correct change, and make sure each person leaves happy with their visit. Once you step away from the register, the focus shifts to running the shop itself. Rearrange the layout, restock products, and keep the store ready for customers at all times.
zombie-last-guard: Hold back the waves of undead in this defense shooter. Your job is to keep the zombies away from three key servers. Turn on defensive turrets and upgrade them as you go. Spend the coins you earn in the Market section to improve your weapons or raise your health bar.

Play solo or team up with a friend in two-player mode. Player one moves using W, A, S and D, fires with F, throws grenades with G, and swaps guns with Q. Player two relies on the arrow keys to move, L to shoot, K for grenades, and P to switch weapons.
eat-to-evolve-2: Step into the wild world of Eat to Evolve, an arcade-style adventure where you begin life as a tiny worm. Gobble up whatever crosses your path to get bigger and tougher. Grubs, fruit, mushrooms and more all help you keep growing and changing into something new. Control is simple: just click or tap to move and feed.

Survival depends on steady eating, so keep munching to keep evolving. The game mixes adventure with battle and fighting elements, testing how well you can outlast rivals as you climb the food chain. Every meal brings you closer to the next stage of your creature's journey.
cute-princess-dress-up: Cute Princess Dress Up is a casual game for girls, sorted under puzzles and dress up. You look after a princess across four activities: spa, hair salon, battle, and makeup. A spa visit gives her whiter skin, while styling her hair adds to her charm and applying makeup lifts her whole temperament. As her stylist, you choose a beaut
gangster-crime-car-simulator-1: Take the wheel of fast crime cars and cruise a large open city, picking up gangsters and crime mob bosses who need a lift. Each fare has a secret destination you must reach before time runs out, while police cars chase you and the clock keeps ticking. You can also join a gang, help its members reach their destinations safely, and try to shake off the police. Finish many different driving missions to grow into a skilled professional and earn a fortune.

Traffic is busy and intelligent, so watch for oncoming cars, because a crash damages your vehicle and costs you the fare. The streets are also shared with ambulances, fire trucks, and ice cream vans. Making more pickups unlocks stronger sports cars with plenty of horsepower. The physics are realistic, and the controls are simple to learn with the keyboard, with touch and tilt options also available. The game aims to feel close to the work of a real taxi driver.
santa-stunt-racer-christmas-delivery: Santa Stunt Racer: Christmas Delivery is an arcade driving game set on wintry holiday courses full of ramps, obstacles, and tricky routes. Each level brings a fresh snowy course where you steer carefully, pull off stunts, and grab presents lying along the ramps. Your goal is to cross the finish line and hand the gifts over to children waiting for Santa. Quicker, tidier runs earn a higher delivery score.

As you advance, you can open several custom Santa cars, each with its own speed, handling, and look, which helps with the harder stages. Work through the tracks, avoid obstacles, and jump off ramps to finish Santa's route before Christmas ends. Steer with WASD or the arrow keys.
funny-snake-2: Funny Snake 2 is an arcade title where you steer a snake to gather apples while steering clear of fire hazards. Your route also involves melting a large block of ice with flames, which releases a key. Use that key to unlock a door and move on to the next stage.

Controls are simple: click or tap the screen, or press the left and right arrow keys on your keyboard to guide the snake. The game suits kids and anyone who enjoys collecting items while dodging obstacles.
space-rovers: Space Rovers puts you on the Red Planet, where your engineering skills determine whether you survive. Instead of following a set blueprint, you assemble vehicles from a broad selection of wheels and blocks. No two machines turn out alike, since each build reflects your creativity and problem-solving. Compact rigs and massive cargo haulers are both possible.

Your mission is to carry goods across harsh Martian landscapes, and the game's physics shape how each rover handles the journey. On desktop, the Up or Right Arrow moves you forward, while the Down or Left Arrow sends you backward. On mobile, the left pedal drives you forward and the right pedal reverses you. It is a hands-on way to experience interplanetary logistics.
king-of-fishing: King of Fishing takes you beneath the waves in a top-down arcade game where you aim and fire powerful fishing cannons. Timing, accuracy, and planning all matter as the action moves quickly. Cast nets at colorful fish, rare sea creatures, and huge ocean bosses, picking up coins and special rewards along the way. Bigger and rarer catches pay more.

Controls are easy to pick up: tap or click a fish to fire your net at it. Each successful catch earns coins, which you spend on upgrades for your gear and better odds of landing larger, rarer creatures. Upgrades also unlock stronger cannons. As your coin total and catch values grow, you climb the ranks and open new ocean zones full of unusual species and fresh challen
formula-rush-online: Formula Rush Online lets you take the wheel of a Formula car in a driving simulation. Twenty racers compete with you on each map, so every lap brings plenty of close battles. New maps stay locked until you finish in the top three across five laps on the current one. Be sure to slow down before you take the bends, since going into corners too fast can cost you.
Steering works with the WASD keys or the arrow keys. This 3D racing game uses HTML5 and can be played on mobile as well as on a computer. Each course you clear moves you closer to the next map.
solitaire-stars: Solitaire Stars brings a card game to your browser, and it is completely free. It is a version called Yukon Solitaire, which feels calm and is simple to pick up. You can enjoy it whenever you have a spare moment, in any place you like.

Your aim is to build each suit, namely hearts, spades, diamonds and clubs, into its own pile, climbing from Ace up to King. Stacks in the play area run downward from King to Ace and switch between red and black, so a red Queen sits on a black King. You can lift a group of c
shape-transform-shifting-rush: Shape Transform: Shifting Rush is a parkour challenge where you keep moving and changing form as you go. You race through a world full of speed and creative touches, and the running action is dynamic from start to finish. At the centre of it all is a character that can change its shape, so watching it reshape itself is a big part of the fun.

Controls are simple. A mouse click or a tap is all you need to play, so the same input works on a desktop computer or a touchscreen device. Keep your pace up, stay on course, and see how far your racing run can take you.
hockey-brawl: Hockey Brawl is a hockey game where messy physics take over once you start moving. Body checks can send helmets flying, and swinging sticks can shatter glass around the rink. A random modifier changes the rules each match, so every game can play out differently.

Work through three leagues to unlock new arenas and cosmetics, or invite a friend for local two-player action on the same device. Player one steers with WASD, while player two uses the arrow keys. On mobile, drag the touch joystick to move. Movement is the only thing you control, and everything else comes from the physics.
shred-the-meme: Cut through a stream of meme cards by dragging your mouse or swiping with your finger. Each slice earns points, and slicing several in a row builds a combo. Grab coins and power-ups along the way, and collect hearts to gain an extra life. Keep an eye out for bombs, since they are far from friendly. Try not to let any memes pass by.
Chase a higher score than your best and share your memes with others. Use the buttons by clicking or tapping them. To pause, click or tap the pause button, or press P or Esc.
van-rush: You take the wheel of a delivery van, driving around to pass a loading puzzle, collect packages, and drop them off for cash. Park on the orange platform and wait three seconds to start the loading puzzle. Once you finish it and press Finish, new jobs appear in the deliveries menu. Pick one to accept it, then follow the green circle on the map to the drop-off spot. If you need to, packages can be taken back out of the van.

Money you earn from deliveries can be spent on offers. Use W, A, S, and D to move on foot or steer the car, Space to brake, and E to pick up or deliver a package. M toggles the big map, O opens the offers menu, and Tab opens the deliveries menu. Press C to show or hide the cursor, which makes it quicker to switch between choosing orders and driving. P pauses the game. Playing in fullscreen is recommended.
city-bike-racing-champion: Hop on a bike and speed through Champions City in City Bike Racing Champion, a 3D racing game. You can ride solo against other riders, or bring a friend along for two-player mode. Pick from a large collection of bikes, along with bags, helmets, costumes, and plenty of other ways to customize your rider.

Enter races or cruise around the wide open free map, where you can pull off stunts. Player one uses W, A, S, D or the arrow keys to steer, Q to jump, R to respawn, C to change the camera, and Z to deploy a parachute. Player two uses the arrow keys, J to j
nutcracker-new-years-adventures: Step into a fairy-tale setting where two princesses are getting ready for a run of winter holidays. Each princess designs a New Year look that is all her own, drawing on the magical stories of Hoffmann and the classical ballet music of Tchaikovsky. Vivid hues, glossy materials, and carefully crafted touches give every outfit a polished, artistic feel.

Trying out different fashion trends is part of the fun. You can pick anything from refined evening gowns to cheeky costumes with a playful, innocent flirtatiousness. As you dress the princesses, you also sharpen your own sense of style while soaking up the enchanting mood of New Year festivities. Controls work with a mouse click on a computer or a tap on a touch screen.
cyber-arrows-brain-puzzle-game: Cyber Arrows: Brain Puzzle takes you into a future filled with glowing routes and neon arrows. You study each arrow's direction, plan your moves ahead, and work through logic puzzles that grow harder as you advance. Every stage brings a fresh test of your observation, timing, and problem solving. Though the early rounds seem straightforward, they turn into a rewarding workout for the mind.

Swipe to move the arrows, pick the right order, and clear the board without leaving blocked paths behind. The game offers hundreds of handmade levels, futuristic neon visuals, and smooth controls that are easy to pick up. Play whenever you like and go at your own speed, whether you want a calm puzzle session or a serious challenge for your reasoning.
angry-sharks: A shark has been exposed to radiation and has mutated. He drifts through the sea eating fish, and the more he eats, the more he grows. People fear him and are trying to destroy him, so he has to survive their attacks.

You steer him with your mouse cursor or by moving your finger across the screen. Fish swim toward you, and you can eat them to grow. Stay away from bigger fish and spiky ones, and watch out for dangerous barrels, mines, spears, and other obstacles.
monster-truck-stunt-racer: Monster Truck Stunt Racer puts you in fast, adrenaline-charged car races across off-road tracks. You can choose from eight different vehicles and race through maps where the weather keeps changing. The courses cover daytime and nighttime runs, forests, deserts, snowy landscapes, and more.
Money earned in races goes toward upgrading your vehicles and unlocking new ma
urban-military-strike: Urban Military Strike puts you in charge of tactical missions in tight, close-quarters fights. Weapons follow realistic ballistics, so aim and bullet travel matter. You work with your squad to carry out thermal breaches, and the objectives can shift as the mission goes on. The urban battlefield spans multiple levels, where good positioning, clear communication with your team, and quick decisions determine whether you survive.

The controls use W, A, S and D to move, and the mouse to aim and click. Scroll the wheel to switch to a third-person view. Hold Ctrl to crouch and press X to go prone. The NUM key switches your weapons, and F2 opens the c
ultimate-stunt-car-challenge: Step behind the wheel of a stunt-focused racer with striking visuals and detailed sound. You can play alone or team up in two-player mode, where you and a friend race head to head at the same time. Along the way, you pull off daring tricks and push through demanding tracks that test your driving.
Controls rely on the arrow keys on your keyboard. Press the up arrow to move forward and the down arrow to go back. Use the left and right arrows to keep your car balanced while you perform stunts.
fish-shooting-fish-hunter: Fish Shooting - Fish Hunter is a relaxed arcade fishing game. You play as a fishing expert, relying on sharp timing and fast reactions to bring in a wide variety of fish. Its simulation style gives the whole experience a calm, casual feel, so you can settle in and enjoy each catch without pressure.
Controls are simple: a mouse click or a tap is all you need, so you can play on a computer or a touchscreen device. Take things at an easygoing pace from start to
squidly-game-123-stop: Fans of the Squid Game series get a 3D hypercasual take on its challenges in this browser title. Your task is to knock down your rivals, and you must follow the instructions closely. Show up late and you are out of the match, but stay in until the end to claim the prizes.
The game is built with HTML5 and is tagged for escape-
hydro-racing-3d: Hydro Racing 3D is a speedboat game played on the water. Besides straight races, it offers plenty of free map activities and career mode chapters to work through. Each boat has a glossy finish and tries to outpace its rivals. Nitrous fuel boosts speed and toughness, helping your boat hold up better.

You can drop into the water parkour and either race or drive freely, alone or with a friend in two player mode. Player 1 steers with W, A, S and D, uses L-Shift for nitrous, presses R to restart, and C to change the camera view. Player 2 uses the arrow keys to move, O for nitrous, I to restart, and K to switch the camera.
classic-car-driving-game: Classic Car Driving Game puts you behind the wheel of charming vintage automobiles and asks you to park them with care. You'll weave through crowded lots, squeeze into narrow gaps, and take sharp corners while avoiding barriers, traffic cones, and other obstacles. Each mission requires you to drive forward, back up, and line your car up precisely in the designated spot, so patience matters as much as speed.

The game includes several parking levels, each one a real test, set in detailed surroundings. The controls feel smooth, and the cars move in a lifelike way that makes every maneuver feel earned. To drive and steer, use W, A, S, and D or the arrow keys.
shadow-stick-lightning-ninja: Shadow Stick - Lightning Ninja mixes two-dimensional fighting with role-playing elements. Across more than 120 levels, you will face tough bosses, customize your character, and unlock legendary gear. It is free to play online on a phone or a computer.

On a keyboard, the arrow keys move you left and right and make you jump. V performs a normal attack, and B triggers a special skill that boosts attack and defense by 30% for 15 seconds. F summons a dragon, while Z, X, and C unleash powerful attacks whose effects depend on the skill branches you chose. On touchscreens, a slider in the bottom-left corner controls movement, and the other buttons appear on screen.
angry-grandmother-run: Angry Grandmother Run is an endless 3D runner where you control a nimble granny who is free and takes no prisoners. Sprint through the sunny streets of Miami while dodging dinosaurs, robots, and dolphins. Leap over cars and surfboards, or slide beneath airships and other obstacles.
Collect as many gold coins as you can along the way, then spend them in the in-game store. Steer with the Left and Right arrow keys or the A and D keys, press Up to jump, and press Down to slide.
growwars-io: GrowWars.io drops superheroes into an arena where they grow stronger as the fight goes on. Each hero is part of an evolving roster, and your job is to step in and slash your way through rival fighters. Coins earned during battles can be spent in the shop on fresh gear or new heroes. You can take on the arena alone or team up with a friend for two-player matches.
Player 1 moves with W, A, S and D, attacks with F and dashes with G. Player 2 uses the arrow keys to move, presses K to attack and L to dash. Grab a buddy, pick your side, and battle it out together.
alchemy-elixir-of-life: Here you play the part of a true creator, combining things to save someone you love by finding the elixir of life. You start with fire, water, earth and air, and build everything else from those four. Choose one item, then a second to pair with it. When the mix produces something, a new element joins your list for further combining. Some pairings are obvious, like steam from fire and water, while others call for experimentation and logic.
Each element you open raises your alchemy level and brings victory closer. The same result can often be reached in several ways, so your own thinking shapes the route. Over
draw-pixels-heroes-face: Draw Pixels Heroes Face sits in the Action category and challenges you to copy the image shown below it. Your goal is to match that picture, using the right color for each spot. Every shade has to land in the correct place for your drawing to look like the original.
The game is played entirely with the mouse, which is the only control listed. It carries the tags Arcade, Boy and Girl. Careful placement of each color is what gets the job done.
halloween-stickman-2: Halloween Stickman 2 places you in a mischievous, spooky setting full of pranks. Your aim is to outsmart Stickman, your trickster friend, and get revenge in the middle of the holiday chaos. The game is free to play online, so you can jump straight into this Halloween adventure.

Use a computer mouse to control the game. On a mobile device, a stylus or your finger works just as well. Watch the story animation first, then choose a way to punish Stickman. To see every punishment he can receive, click the buttons until you have viewed all of them.
moon-potato-clicker: Moon Potato Clicker challenges you to build the largest potato economy anyone has ever seen on the Moon. Along the way, you have to keep your colonists safe from a range of dangers, including alien invasions, earthquakes, and other threats.
Controls are simple: tap or click to play. Harvest ordinary crops to expand your lunar colony, then gather golden potatoes to unlock special abilities and rare upgrades.
ice-cream-inc: Fans of frozen treats will enjoy Ice Cream Inc, a 3D hypercasual game with plenty of different tasty scoops to choose from. Your task is to recreate the ice cream shown in the picture at the top of the screen. Once you have matched it, press the number keys to whip up a sweet treat, then eat it.

Controls are simple. Press the number keys on your keyboard, or tap the screen to play. The game is built with HTML5, and its colorful, food-themed style makes it a light, cheerful way to pass some time while you test how closely you can copy each order.
happy-jelly: Happy Jelly is a sweet little online puzzle game built around jelly candies. Your job is to line them up to score points, and the game is meant to help you unwind when you need a break. The screen is bright and colorful, and a cheerful soundtrack plays along the way. Anyone can pick it up, and it runs on both phones and desktop computers.
To play, slide the candies around the board so that three or more form a row. Those candies then vanish from the board. Your aim is to destroy as many candies as you can.
dunkers-fight: Dunkers Fight 2P is a two-player basketball game with a funny edge. When the countdown ends, you and your rival race to grab the ball first. Your goal is to throw it into the pot. Be careful, though: if your opponent pulls the ball out of your hand, you need to resist and keep the pot protected.

Each player uses their own set of keys. Player 1 moves with A and D and shoots with W and S. Player 2 moves with the left and right arrow keys and shoots with the up and down arrow keys. It's a lighthearted game for two, and the time you spend playing with friends at school will pass pleasantly.
world-of-alice-footprints: World of Alice: Footprints is a puzzle game designed for children who want to recognize the tracks different animals leave behind. It runs on phones, tablets, and computers, so young players can pick it up on whichever device they have. Its cartoon style keeps the lessons light and enjoyable, so learning feels more like play.
Playing is simple: look at the footprint and click the animal that matches it. Animal and educational themes run throughout, so children can explore wildlife through a fun, playful challenge.
battle-of-tank-steel: Battle Of Tank Steel drops you into armored combat, where you pilot powerful tanks through fierce fights. The action is nonstop, and the shooting keeps things lively from start to finish. The battlefield is packed with challenges that call for strategy, so you will need to think about where to position your tank and when to fire.

As you play, you can unlock several types of tanks. Each one has its own abilities and weapons, so you can choose the machine that suits your style. Controls are simple: click the mouse or tap the screen to play.
draw-to-smash: Draw To Smash! is a free online puzzle that tests your logic skills. Your task is to sketch shapes that knock out the pesky bad eggs. The game blends imagination with planning and works on both mobile devices and desktop computers. As you move forward, the challenges change and grow.

To play, touch the screen and draw inside the box. When you lift your finger, your drawing falls down onto the field. Drop it onto the evil eggs to destroy them all, and be careful to keep the good eggs safe.
e-rickshaw-simulator: Take the wheel of an electric rickshaw and carry passengers around a busy city. Your jobs involve picking riders up and dropping them off at homes, schools, hospitals, museums, hotels, offices, and shopping areas. Stay on the route, weave carefully through traffic, and make sure every passenger arrives safely. Completed missions earn money, which you can spend in the shop to unlock new e-rickshaws.

Crashes can lower your health or cause a mission to fail, so keep clear of pedestrians, vehicles, and other obstacles. Press W or Up Arrow to accelerate, S or Down Arrow to brake or reverse, and A or Left Arrow and D or Right Arrow to steer. Follow the mini-map, destination markers, and distance indicator to reach each stop.
mtb-downhill-extreme: Riders who love rugged trails are gearing up for a steep descent in MTB DownHill Extreme. You can choose from four mountain bikes, and the game offers two modes: solo play for one rider or head-to-head action for two players.

Player one steers with W, A, S and D, applies the front brake with SPACE, and uses S for the rear brake. Press C to change the camera view and R to reset your position. Player two drives with the arrow keys, brakes at the front with R-SHIFT, brakes at the rear with the down arrow, switches cameras with O, and resets with P.
skincare-makeover-makeup-game: Take on the role of a makeover specialist who helps clients look their best through playful beauty sessions. Every visit begins with calming spa and skincare steps that cleanse and refresh the face. From there, you pick makeup styles, hairdos, outfits, and accessories to complete each new look. Each transformation presents fresh tasks that give you room to express your own creative flair.

Gameplay is handled with taps and drags. You move beauty tools across the screen to apply skincare products and makeup, select hairstyles, and choose outfits. Your goal is to finish every makeover task and send each client away happy with their new appearance.
slap-master: Slap Master is a relaxed arcade title that leans into silliness and giggles. You control a character with one goal: slap passersby while sprinting, let the frenzy grow, and make your getaway before anyone catches you.

Steering works with swipes, left or right, to change direction. You move through a crowded level or area, and whenever you swipe into a pedestrian or come near one, a slap lands. After slapping, you must dodge obstacles and pursuers while keeping your speed up and managing any hazards in your way. It's a game made for mobile play.
baby-taylor-tea-party-day: Today is the big tea party at Taylor's house, and her friends are on their way. You get to help Taylor and her mom get everything ready. First, brew a tasty pot of tea, then set up a tray of sweet treats for tea time. Mom is also making her own special snack, Petit Fours, for the kids, and you can help with that too.

Once the guests arrive, your job is to tend to the little ones and make sure they stay happy for the whole party. Play with the game by clicking or tapping your mouse, and enjoy every step of the day.
christmas-gift-jump: Santa is the star of this holiday arcade title, where he hops from one platform to the next to gather presents. Each jump must be timed well, since obstacles lie in his path and the goal is to climb as high as possible for a top score. Bright Christmas visuals and an upbeat soundtrack set a cheerful seasonal mood, and the easy controls suit players of all ages.

You can aim for a personal best or race friends to see who climbs highest and grabs the most gifts this winter. On a computer, click the screen to make the character leap, and time each click so he lands on a platform rather than falling. Gifts you collect add to your score, so keep an eye out for hazards. On phones and tablets, tap the screen instead to jump.
logo-quiz-master: Logo Quiz Master is a trivia puzzle that tests what you know about logos and gives your brain a proper workout. Across several categories, you meet iconic brands, famous companies, and unforgettable symbols, and your task is to identify them. Whether you are a casual player or a seasoned trivia fan, the game can keep you occupied for hours.

Each level offers a set of logo options, and you choose the one you think is correct. Click or tap the right answer to clear the level and move on. Finish every level and you earn the title of logo quiz master. Controls are simple: use your mouse or your finger to select the logo you believe is right.
soccer-strike: Soccer Strike is a relaxed soccer game built around simple controls. You drag backward to aim and set the shot's power, then let go to send the ball toward the net. It serves as a quick tribute to the world's favorite sport, mixing lighthearted fun with a bit of competition.
Your goal is to score by carefully placing shots past defenders and obstacles. Build your striker lineup and customize it to improve how your players perform.
moto-stunts-driving-racing: Moto Stunts Driving & Racing puts you on a motorbike in a cartoon style, with 2D riders zipping along side-scrolling platform courses. Your goal is to reach the finish line as quickly as possible in either Racing Mode or Level Mode, all while keeping your rider in one piece. Collecting coins lets you buy a better motorcycle, since the starter bike is only good enough to get you through the game and won't earn you top records or bigger rewards.

Be careful: hitting any traps or tumbling to the ground and losing your rider's body parts ends the run. To grab more coins for the bikes you like, try the Lottery and the Tasks. Steer with the WASD keys or the arrow keys.
cricket-smash-3d: Cricket Smash 3D is a quick-moving cricket title for fans who want realistic action, speed, and tense moments on the field. Its 3D visuals run smoothly, and lively animations plus match situations make the whole experience feel true to the sport.

You can pick a match as short as two overs or move up to longer tournaments, so the length is entirely your choice. Select the teams you like best and compete against friends, or try several cricket formats in a league-style run that brings extra difficulty. To strike the ball toward the leg side, tap A or the bottom-left button on screen. For shots on the off side, use D or the bottom-right button.
king-boxing-2024: Lace up and step into the ring in King Boxing 2024, then choose from eight boxer characters. Each fight takes place in an arena, and every win brings a tougher opponent through the ropes. Strategy matters here: you need to mix quick strikes with well-timed defense so you don't take too many hits. Keep fighting and you might work your way to the top and become champion.
Movement uses W, A, S and D. Press Z to attack and C to defend.
blind-boat-shooting-master: This 2D shooter lets you build your own raft and sail through a bright, eye-catching setting. Aim your cannon, fire at rivals, and gather treasure along the way. The visuals take their cue from comic books, and you can choose from a cast of more than thirty characters. Whether you are new to games or a seasoned pro, there is plenty here to keep you busy.
Battles play out in turns against pirates, thieves, and other raft fighters. As you travel across different lands, you uncover new territories to explore. To get started, just slide to play.
join-clash-epic-battle: This arcade runner throws you into a battle that is just about to begin. Before the fighting starts, you need to grow your forces by recruiting your own people into your ranks. Then you push forward through a thousand obstacles, steering clear of the ones that could prove fatal.
Once you get close to the enemy, you have to defeat them to claim victory. Controls are simple: just drag to play. Stay sharp as you run and dodge your way toward the win.
police-car-chase-prison-escape-game: Step into the shoes of a police officer and help protect the city in this 3D adventure. You will drive powerful police vehicles, chase dangerous criminals, and stop prisoners who have escaped from jail. Each mission brings plenty of action.
On desktop, use WASD to move and Space to brake. Shift gives you a boost, F handles action, and Q sounds the siren. P pau
