Controls are straightforward. Use the arrow keys to move the Jeep, and press the space bar to brake. It is listed as an HTML5 title that also suits mobile play, so it can be picked up on a range of devices.
mermaid-coloring-book-glitter: Mermaid Coloring Book Glitter is a coloring book built around mermaid artwork, and it adds a sparkly touch to the pages you paint. It offers many mermaid coloring pages, so anyone who loves mermaids will have plenty to work through. It fits the Girls category and suits fans of cartoon drawing, coloring, and decorating.

You control the game with a mouse or by tapping the screen. Choose a page and add glittery paint to bring each mermaid scene to life. It is a simple way for kids to draw, color, and decorate on their own.
summer-shore-hustle: You have spent all your cash this summer, so you turn to the sand and open a small stand on the beach. The goal is simple: earn enough money now so you can take it easy when the next summer arrives. Your work includes selling products, cooking meals, and bringing food out to waiting customers, all while collecting your earnings.

Walk with WASD, hold Shift to run, and press Ctrl to crouch. Use E to pick things up, Q to set them down, and F for other actions. P pauses the game, while X calls over nearby customers, raising the odds they will stop by your shop. The tutorial inside the game walks you through how to play and shows every control.
fruit-names: Fruit Names is a learning game for kids that teaches the names of different fruits through play. It works on phones, tablets, and computers alike. Your job is to click the picture that matches the fruit name shown to you. Along the way, little ones pick up fruit vocabulary in an enjoyable, hands-on way.

It serves as a helpful educational resource, and it shows that learning can be lots of fun. The game is a clicker, so every choice you make is a single tap or click. It is a good fit for young players who are just starting to build their word knowledge.
obby-pet-simulator-x: Obby Pet Simulator X lets you gather a range of one-of-a-kind pets. Crack open eggs to bring out scarce creatures, smash through obstacles in your way, and improve your abilities over time. You can play it online for free on either a phone or a computer.

On a computer, use W, A, S and D to move, the left mouse button to click, Space to jump, and Esc to go back or open the menu. On a phone, tap the screen to click, and use the on-screen joystick and buttons to move and take actions.
twisty-roads: Twisty Roads is a racing game where you steer down a winding route and clear checkpoints to rack up points. Along the way, grab coins to spend on new rides. The farther you travel, the harder the road gets, and your real test is to conquer the most dangerous stretch of all. Switch between a range of cars and karts to keep your long, seemingly never-ending drive interesting.
Instructions appear inside the game, so follow the in-game guidance as you play. Stay focused, because each new section of road brings fresh challenges.
riders-downhill-racing: Riders Downhill Racing puts you on a bike, an ATV, a cross bike, or a speed boat, and lets you fly over ramps while performing stunts. You can choose from free ride, race, and career modes in either one-player or two-player play. Costumes are also available to dress up your rider. In free ride, collect diamonds to unlock more items.

Player 1 moves with W, A, S, D or the arrow keys, jumps with Q, uses a parachute with Z, activates nitro with Shift, switches vehicles with Tab, changes the camera with C, and restarts with R. Player 2 moves with the arrow keys, jumps with K, uses a parachute with P, activates nitro with M, selects with Enter, changes the camera with K, and restarts with L.
world-of-alice-images-and-words: World of Alice: Images and Words is an educational puzzle game designed for children who want to learn vocabulary. Players pick up word meanings by connecting each term with a picture, so reading practice feels like play. It works on a cell phone, tablet, or computer, so kids can use it on whichever screen is nearby.

To finish a puzzle, drag the image that matches the word shown into its place. Each correct pairing helps young players recognize new words through what they see. It is a strong learning resource, and in Alice's world, learning is enjoyable.
light-stream: Light Stream asks you to bend a laser beam with mirrors so it reaches a gate and unlocks it. The game opens with a short scene in which a boy shows how the laser opens the door leading to the next level. Then it's your turn to solve the puzzle by aiming the beam at the correct position. Be sure to collect all three stars as you go.

This title will appeal to fans of physics-based games and laser puzzles, or anyone who just wants an enjoyable time. It offers high-quality graphics, a very small file size, and extremely simple controls. The quests are engaging and varied. On Android, use the on-screen touch controls to change the mirror's direction. On PC, a left mouse click controls the mirror.
sector-nine-lockdown: Sector Nine: Lockdown takes you through a research facility that has fallen apart. Your task is to fight your way across its halls and bring the power back on. Along the way you will find secret rooms hidden throughout the complex, so keep your eyes open for anything that seems out of place. The whole story is full of sci-fi action from start to finish.

The adventure unfolds across three separate sectors, each one pushing you further into the facility. Controls are kept simple: a mouse click or a tap is all it takes to get going. Whether you are at a desktop or on a touchscreen, you can jump in right away and work through the lockdown one area at a time.
obby-royal-races-in-flight: Obby Royal Races in Flight is an online racing game where you unlock quick cars and steer them through tough tracks. It runs on several platforms and has 3D visuals. You can upgrade your cars, and the game suits players of all ages, with extra options for premium members. It is also a lava racing simulator where you build up your Obby character over long sessions, buy new cars, and clear difficult parkour courses.

Open cases and boxes to find cool cars for the tracks, and collect stars along the way. Charge a slingshot, dynamite, or a whole rocket with energy. Hatch pets from cases and eggs to gain more energy, then earn money and raise your hero through ranks. On PC, use AWSD to run, Space to jump, Escape to show or hide the cursor, and the mouse to turn. On a smartphone, a joystick handles running and the Up arrow jumps.
rift-of-hell-demons-war: Rift of Hell - Demons War is a quick-moving action shooter set in a hellish world. Your task is to hold your ground against wave after wave of demons, staying alive through intense battles. The game blends first-person shooting with horror and survival themes, and a war theme runs throughout.

Along the way, you can pick up powerful weapons and boost your abilities, gathering gold to help you last through each fight. Everything runs online and costs nothing to access, so you can jump into the action whenever you like.
parking-boom: Parking Boom is a physics game built around flinging your car toward a parking space. You set the power, angle and direction of your shot, then let go to send the vehicle soaring. Along the way you smash through other cars, and your goal is to set down as precisely as you can inside the highlighted parking zone. Each stage brings its own hurdles and inventive twists, so no two runs feel quite the same.

Aiming works with either a mouse or your finger on a touchscreen. Adjust your settings, release to launch, and watch the wreckage pile up as you fly. Across a variety of cars and changing stages, you can sharpen your parking skills, move through level after level, and chase a perfect landing. Expect plenty of destruction and a wild ride where the crashing is half the appeal.
cooking-letters-word-search: Step into a kitchen where letters are scattered across the board, and each one works as an ingredient for building words. Your task is to track down every word on the list that is hidden in the grid. Finish sooner and your score climbs higher. You earn points for each word you uncover, and you can spend them on extra bonuses or fresh kitchen themes.

As you advance, new levels open up with longer words and tougher puzzles, so you will be cooking up dishes built from more complicated letter combinations. Connect letters by swiping with a finger or moving a cursor. Words can run horizontally, vertically, diagonally, or even in a zigzag pattern. The game also helps sharpen your focus, widen your vocabulary, and speed up your thinking.
king-simulator: You step into the role of a bold explorer setting out to conquer a fantasy realm. The road is full of challenges, and each city you reach hides its own secrets. Armed with weapons and guided by wisdom and courage, you open up new territories and uncover the mysteries behind the cities. Your goal is to become a leg
lumberjack-simulator: Step into a lumberjack's boots, pick up an axe, and wander through lush woodlands. Your job is to fell trees, gather the timber they yield, and trade that wood for coins. Each chop feels pleasing thanks to the way trees topple under your blade, and the scenery is bright and full of color, rendered in three dimensions.

Spend your earnings on sharper tools and upgrades that speed up your cutting, then unlock stronger gear that makes felling faster still. Venture into fresh patches of forest where more valuable trees grow, and watch your profits climb. You begin as a rookie woodcutter and, step by step, grow your logging operation into a sizable business.
idle-tower-defense: Your goal in this idle defense game is to keep your tower safe from waves of enemies that keep arriving without end. Merging is central to your approach, and upgrades let you strengthen your defenses as you go. It sits in the clicker and strategy categories and is also listed for mobile devices.
During a battle, collect the "meat" that appears to trigger temporary boosts for that fight. Between rounds, spend your coins on permanent improvements and unlock new features
ski-challenge-3d: Ski Challenge 3D takes you to a snowy world and throws you into a skiing match. Your goal is to reach the Top 1 rank, then find out how many times you can earn the No. 1 spot. Along the way, you must dodge snowballs rolling down the mountain and wooden stakes that suddenly appear in your path.

Success depends on flexibility, quick reflexes, and careful control of your speed, so every run tests your ski skills. Controls are simple: you slide to ski down the slope. This 3D arcade game has an icy, board-style theme and is designed for mobile play.
squadz: Jump into this fast shooter whenever you have a spare moment. It is a hyper-casual game built around short stages filled with constant action. Unlock new heroes, pick up strong guns, and eliminate foes in a flash. The controls are easy to learn and missions are brief, so a session can last one minute or run to twenty.

Whether you have only a few minutes or want to chase a top score, this high-impact shooter has something to offer on any schedule. On a computer, move your character in every direction with W, A, S, D or the Arrow Keys for smooth motion. On mobile devices, touch the on-screen joystick and drag it to steer through the game world.
squeeze-n-slide: You guide a jelly as it slides through a bright course full of obstacles. Its shape can be changed so it fits through each gate, and along the way you can gather crystals and fruit. You can also unlock new skins to change how your jelly looks.

Steering is done by dragging up or down with your finger or mouse to reshape the jelly. The speed keeps climbing, so you need to react quickly to get through each gate. Keep an eye out for fruit as you go, because catching it is part of the run.
world-of-alice-occupations: World of Alice Occupations is a learning game made for young children. It introduces many different jobs and the tools that go with each one. The lessons are presented in a playful way, so kids absorb the material while they enjoy themselves. It runs on a mobile phone, a tablet, or a desktop computer, so it works on whichever device is at hand.

To play, look at the tools on screen and click the profession they belong to. It is a valuable teaching tool for introducing children to the world of work, and in Alice's world, studying feels like play.
ball-run-2048-space: Send a ball racing along a glowing space track in this 3D runner that mixes number merging with obstacle dodging. Gather numbered balls that match your current value to build it higher. Pick lanes that keep you away from sharp spikes and other barriers, and keep your ball rolling smoothly from one level to the next.
The goal is to reach the finish with the largest number you can gather. On desktop, move the mouse left and right to steer. On mobile, touch the screen and drag left or right to change direction.
bus-jam-sort: Passengers are lined up at the stop, and your job is to group them by color so each bus fills with the right riders. The artwork is bright throughout, with colorful buses, a varied crowd of travelers, and a lively background that frames every round of this triple match puzzler. Motion is smooth, so each move feels satisfying to make.

Gameplay centers on shuffling passengers around until you can sort them and let the VIPs leave on time. The gameplay is simple, yet the clever bus matching keeps you thinking. This one-player title can hold your attention for hours if you enjoy sorting puzzles.
fruitsland-escape-from-the-amusement-par: Fruitsland is a horror adventure set in a bright amusement park, where performers dressed as fruit entertain families and school groups. One careless step through an old hatch drops you into a forgotten underground section once used for strange scientific experiments. Rusted rides and silent game rooms surround you, broken only by old machinery and the shuffling of mysterious creatures. Abandoned journals reveal the park owner's plan to bring fruit to life so it could entertain guests around the clock.

Your aim is to find a way out by solving puzzles, collecting useful items, and avoiding traps and monsters that look like harmless fruit. The first area is themed around apples, where a blind, zombie-like apple roams aimlessly. The banana section brings another monster that seems to invade your mind, and a third area is dedicated to the pomegranate. Move with WASD, crouch with C, and jump with Space.
ace-car-racing: Dodge traffic through busy city streets in this 3D racer, where you pilot modern sports cars across four settings: Seaside Roads, Exotic, City Racing, and Desert Trip. Grab lightning bolts to refill your fuel, then pick up coins that can go toward upgrades or a fresh ride. Diamonds are the key to unlocking special vehicles.
Right from the start, you can buy a stronger car and adjust
funny-dentist-surgery: Leah has a real weakness for sweets, and her love of candy has left her with some seriously bad teeth. Your job is to repair the damage and get her smile back in shape. Each problem calls for a hands-on approach, so you'll be busy grabbing tools and making picks as you go.

Once the dental work is finished, you can have some fun by adding silly stickers to her teeth as a finishing touch. The game runs on desktop and phones alike. On a computer, click items, tools, and buttons to act; on a touchscreen, tap to select and apply your choices.
coin-sort-puzzle: Coin Sort Puzzle is a free grid game where you sort and merge coins until the board is clear. Coins keep arriving in a steady stream, and your job is to place each one into the right row according to its denomination. The game blends arcade-style speed and accuracy with planning, so you need to think ahead while reacting quickly. You also earn coins and unlock new levels as you advance. It suits players of every age.

Every move asks you to make smart choices and keep your reactions sharp. Fans of 2048-style merging and sorting will feel right at home. The game is built to hold your attention for hours, offering a steady stream of entertainment whenever you have a spare moment to sort some coins.
fair-blocks: Fair Blocks is a wooden block puzzle that keeps things honest, since the pieces are never rigged against you. Drag each piece from the tray onto the 8x8 board with a mouse or your finger, then let go. Filling an entire row or column clears it, and chaining several clears together leads to big combos. Pieces cannot be rotated, so plan each placement carefully.

For a structured run, follow the Adventure trail with your Block Buddy through forests, caves and snowy peaks. Each level has its own goal, whether lines, score, gems or stones, and you must reach it within the move limit. For a relaxed session, Classic mode goes on endlessly. The Daily Challenge presents the same puz
the-dye-diy: Follow the latest fashion craze by dyeing your own clothing and beach gear. Your work includes T-shirts, bikinis, and beach bags, so there is plenty to choose from. Show what your hands can do by tailoring each dyed piece exactly the way you want it. Clients will send you requests, and you can paint their garments however you see fit.

Creating art here is simpler than it sounds: tie the fabric first, then add the dye. Let the colours flow, since the paint handles much of the heavy lifting. Everything is controlled with taps or clicks, and the fun starts right away.
1-speed-per-step-obby-mode: Every footstep makes your runner faster in this arcade obby. Clear the obstacle course across five levels to collect trophies, then rebirth to unlock bonuses. Use steps to upgrade your runner, or buy boosters, treadmills, instant experience, and colored trails that tag along as you sprint. Two leaderboards let you compare progress, one for trophies collected and one for time spent in prison, and climbing to the top is the goal.

On PC, move with WASD and hold the right mouse button to control the camera. Running builds experience and raises your level. On mobile, use the joystick in the bottom-left corner to move and swipe the screen to adjust the camera. The music fits the mood well, but you can finish every level without it.
rescue-my-love: Rescue My Love uses a simple, picture-based style, so it is easy to pick up, yet getting past each stage is far from simple. Every level is built differently, and the route to clearing it changes from one to the next, which keeps you guessing. Your brain does most of the work here as you test ideas and reason your way forward.

Expect a varied mix of puzzles that stretch your thinking and challenge you at every turn. The ways to play are fresh and keep changing, so there is always something new to try. Each challenge can be cleared through clever thinking, and the game offers a diverse set of entertainment for anyone who enjoys a good brain workout.
save-the-kingdom: This legendary castle defense game asks you to guard your realm against wizards, ghosts, demons, and many other monsters. Each foe you destroy earns you points. You can spend those points and your saved money on four general skills and on your castles, making both stronger over time. Build new castles as you progress to keep the kingdom safe.

The adventure includes 50 different levels, so you can keep playing without interruption. Save money and destroy monsters to afford every upgrade, working toward becoming invincible. To place a castle, grab it with your mouse or touch and drag it to the area where you want it to drop.
mine-obby-3d-minigame-world: Mine Obby 3D: Minigame World is a lively collection of minigames where you face rivals and aim for the top spot. Each win earns golden apples and coins, which you can spend on new rewards and upgrades. You can also unlock new skins and choose the looks you like, so your character feels truly your own.

Several modes are on offer, each testing a mix of agility, focus, luck, and quick thinking. Every match brings fresh challenges to overcome. On PC, use W, A, S, and D or the arrow keys to move, Space to jump, and the mouse to rotate the camera. On mobile, the left joystick moves your character, the right button jumps, and swipes on the right side of the screen rotate the camera.
crazy-merge-room: Crazy Merge Room is a quick puzzle game where wild disorder meets careful planning. You explore a strange room packed with odd objects, eccentric characters, and surprises you can't predict. Your goal is to join matching items so they become stronger and more outrageous versions, all while keeping the room from overflowing. You can slide, combine, and arrange everything, from ordinary household things to peculiar gadgets. Controls rely entirely on the mouse.

Each successful merge changes the room and opens new levels, strange challenges, and powerful boosters. Items keep appearing faster and faster, so your strategy needs to stay sharp. Players who enjoy chaotic fun, satisfying merges, and addictive progression should find plenty to enjoy here.
shortcut-run: Shortcut Run is a quick race where only first place brings a happy result, and winning is what opens up the games that follow. The rules stay simple. Along the track, you can pick up track boards. Use them to pave the road, or save them for a bonus added to your final score. Still, the real key is the shortcut.
To play, slide to start. The game is tagged as arcade, casual, collecting, platform, and racing, so it suits anyone who enjoys a fast race with a bit of collecting on the side.
paper-fold: Paper Fold is a puzzle game about folding paper to build pictures. The mechanics are very straightforward: you only need your left mouse button to tap and fold. Once you begin, it can be surprisingly hard to walk away, since each new fold invites you to keep going.

Many players find it especially calming. The controls never get in the way, so your attention stays on the shapes you are making and the picture slowly taking form. It is an easy game to settle into and enjoy.
offroad-driving-truck-transport: Offroad Driving Truck Transport puts you behind the wheel on rough ground, muddy tracks, and steep hills. You take charge of powerful trucks and haul heavy cargo across difficult off-road landscapes. Along the way, you sharpen your driving skills and find a way past every obstacle in your path.
The game is built to deliver a strong sense of thrill as you push through each tough route. Steer your truck with the W, A, S, and D keys.
halloween-merge: Halloween Merge is a puzzle game where you combine eerie objects to unlock hidden treasures and celebrate the holiday. Set in a mysterious world full of Halloween-themed puzzles and creepy challenges, it puts your merging skills to the test. Pumpkins, potions, and ghostly decorations can be joined together to reveal chilling rewards and slowly transform a haunted mansion.

Each level asks you to match and merge items to finish it and uncover secrets, and you can also claim daily rewards. On a computer, press and hold the left mouse button on an item, then drag it onto the target item to merge them. On mobile, tap and hold an item, drag it, and drop it onto another item to combine the two.
pinball-boy-adventure: Pinball Boy Adventure is a pinball game where physics and puzzle solving go hand in hand. The characters are rendered in 3D and have a cartoon style. Your job is to gather pinballs, aim at targets to cause destruction, and cause chaos with bombs and rockets. As you play, you can upgrade your skills, pick the tactics that suit you, and conquer each level with precision.
The controls work on both PC and mobile. Drag the wheel to move it. Swipe to aim your shot, then release to launch.
world-of-alice-daily-routine: World of Alice Daily Routine is a puzzle title for young learners who want to pick up everyday habits and tasks in an entertaining way. It runs on phones, tablets, and computers, so kids can play on whichever device they have nearby. Its cartoon style keeps the lessons light, and it stands out as a
pinata-color-smash: In this color puzzle, your goal is to break pinatas by tapping the bat that matches their shade. The bats line the top of the screen, so choose the one you need. Each pick reveals the matching bat along the bottom, which adds to your options as you go.

Five tile slots give you room to hold spare bats for later, which helps when a tougher pinata appears. The colorful look and relaxed feel make it a casual pick for players of any age who enjoy matching puzzles.
time-travel-tower-rush-td: Hop across history in this idle tower defense game and break the enemy bases you meet along the way. Your tower grows one level at a time, gaining guns, lasers, and traps, while you improve its toughness, firing rate, and damage. Ancient kingdoms, high-tech battlefields, and enchanted lands form the settings, and waves of demons, skeletons, and mythical beasts keep coming at you.

Every enemy you destroy drops gold, which you spend on new weapons, each with its own strengths. Combining weapons can lead to strong setups that deal heavier damage. Synergy effects add extra power, and exclusive styles and boosts let you personalize your fortress. Use the left mouse button to pick a target manually for priority attacks, which is especially helpful against elite enemies and bosses.
battleground-chicken-winner: Battleground Chicken Winner is a shooting game built around playing with others. Its team up feature lets you join forces with teammates, while room cards and clan modes make it simpler to keep playing with your friends. Whether you have a quick spare moment or a longer stretch free, you can reconnect with your group no matter the time or location.

All controls run through the touch pad, so every action in the game is performed with that single input method. Shooting fans who enjoy cooperating with a group will find the team and clan options a natural fit. It suits anyone who likes sharing a session with their crew.
draw-the-road: Draw The Road mixes freehand sketching with physics puzzles. You play three roles at once: designing the layout, building the route, and driving the vehicle. Your goal is straightforward. Sketch a path that gets your vehicle safely to the finish line.

Creativity is central here. You can sketch a ramp, a bridge, or a loop, and each line you draw instantly becomes a real road your vehicle can drive on. The physics engine is realistic, though, so your strokes need to be precise. A shaky curve or a steep climb may cause your vehicle to crash.
ultraman-monster-island-adventure-2: Ultraman Monster Island Adventure 2 is an HTML5 adventure game that runs right in your browser. Explorers have discovered a new island in the Pacific Ocean, and it is surprisingly rich in valuable sapphires. Many villagers rushed over to claim the treasure, but none of them ever came back.

Ultraman now sets out for this monster island to face its adventure alongside you. The game supports two players. The first player uses A, D and W, while the remaining keys J, L, I and P are assigned to the other controls.
awesome-tanks-3-game: Awesome Tanks 3 is the third entry in this top-down, 2D tank shooter series. It features fresh visuals, a physics engine that drives the action, and simple twin thumb controls for touch screens. War is breaking out, and your job is to destroy monsters, crush enemy tanks, and uncover extra areas hidden throughout the game.

The built-in Level Editor lets you design your own levels and share them with others. Money you collect can be spent on better weapons or used to boost your tank's stats. Move with WASD or the arrow keys, click to shoot, and on mobile devices, touch the on-screen buttons.
plane-crash-ragdoll-simulator: You step into the cockpit as a brave flyer whose job is to dodge a nonstop barrage of rockets aimed at your plane. Don't let the simple setup fool you, because the pressure builds fast. Fire back at your foes while weaving through hazardous skies, and feel your pulse race with every near miss.

The game includes three modes: Avoid Rockets, Destroy Enemies, and Low Fuel Landing. You can fly everything from planes to helicopters, and you can unlock new skins for both your pilot and your aircraft. The physics aim to feel realistic, and your pilot flops around like a ragdoll when things go wrong. Challenging levels and scenarios keep each run interesting. Press the joystick to add gas, and move it to steer your aircraft.
boys-battle-for-the-district: Boys - Battle for the District is an idle clicker where you tap your way through urban turf, taking on rival gangs one district at a time. Every tap lands a hit, and each opponent you bring down adds to your power as you build up your empire. There are no tricky controls to learn, so you can focus on the fights and watching enemies fall apart with every click.

Earnings from each kill can be spent on upgrades that strengthen your character and increase your damage. Prestige lets you start over with a stronger position on each run. Progress keeps coming through steady, incremental boosts, and you can compete for a place on the leaderboards as your district grows.
princess-escape-2021: Princess Escape 2021 puts you in charge of a princess who is trying to break out of a wicked castle. It is a lighthearted game that many players enjoy. You steer her with the WASD keys or the arrow keys, helping her find her way out of the stronghold.

The game fits the Girls category and carries the tags Escape, Girl, Mobile and Princess, so it suits players looking for a simple escape adventure that also works on phones and tablets. Grab the controls and see how far the princess can get.
tower-colour-crash: This 3D physics game challenges you to bring down every tower using a limited number of balls. Each ball can only destroy blocks that share its colour, so aim with care. Two power-ups, an earthquake and a shotgun, can trigger huge chain reactions that help collapse whole structures.

At the start of each level, swipe left or right to choose the angle for hitting the tower. Then throw the ball at blocks of the matching colour to break them, and work toward making the tower collapse. The levels feature attractive designs and a variety of shapes to work through.
grand-city-driving-2: Grand City Driving 2 is a single-player 3D racing game where you take the wheel of a selection of detailed supercars. The visuals are strong, and every car is modeled with plenty of fine detail. Your playground is a large city packed with pedestrians, so you can roam the streets at your own p
rumbox-designer: Rumbox Designer lets you build small rooms packed inside a box. You arrange furniture, combine objects, and piece together scenes one step at a time. The pastel, angled look uses simple shapes and gentle shadows, so each session feels calm and creative.

Gather rumboxes by collecting furniture, decor, and room details. Test different placements to find the most balanced arrangements, and add to your collection to unlock new sets and room themes. Complete levels and tasks to grow your rumbox studio. Move items until the layout feels neat and cozy. If something doesn't fit, remove it and try another. Finish a room to earn a reward and unlock new themes and sets for upcoming rumboxes.
legends-arena: Legends Arena is an online combat platform where top warriors face off in a shooter with no restrictions. You team up with a partner, and at minimum you take on a duo made of a rival and their partner. Players who want more action can pick 3v3 or 5v5 team deathmatches. The choice of mode is yours.
Controls are simple. Move with W, A, S and D, and jump with the Spacebar. Hold Left Shift to sprint and tap
dental-care-game: Players of any gender are invited to step into the dentist's chair and become professional dental practitioners. Your job is to examine a range of different patients, work out what is wrong with each one, and then treat their teeth. The patients are far from stiff, expressionless figures that simply open wide. They react with visible laughter and tears as you work, which keeps every visit lively.
Controls are simple: use the mouse or tap the screen to play. Whether you are curious about dental work or dream of a career in dentistry, this simulation gives you a chance to try it out.
transport-army-vehicle-truck-driving: Deliver essential cargo over harsh, uneven ground while driving through hostile areas and risky terrain. Each mission asks you to get through tough routes, steer around roadblocks, and improve your truck's armor and speed so you can push past whatever stands in the way. The controls feel true to life, you can customize your vehicles, and the levels are built to pull you into their setting. Only the most skilled drivers will manage to guide their convoy safely to its destination.
fruit-lane-cafe: Fruit Lane Cafe mixes colorful card sorting with a lively shop theme. Tap a lane and a card slides in from the bottom slot, while the card it pushes out drops into that slot. Think ahead about the upcoming card, handle the multicolored spare card, and unlock helpful boosters as the challenges grow. Smooth tap controls, satisfying chain reactions, and a steadily expanding level map give every order a fresh puzzle.

Click Play and choose any unlocked level. On desktop, use the left mouse button, and on mobile, tap the screen. Line up matching cards across an entire lane to clear it and fill a customer's order, but move the spare card out of that lane first. Finish every order before the timer runs out. Earn coins and stars, open new levels, and use boosters when you need a hand. Optional rewarded videos can offer extra coins or boosters, and the on-screen settings let you adjust music and sound. No keyboard shortcuts are needed.
2048-3d-merge-cubes: This puzzle game asks you to merge numbered cubes into bigger values, aiming for 2048. Blocks from 2 up to 2048 drop onto the field, and matching pairs combine into higher numbers while you rack up points. Some blocks are stones that cannot be merged, so they must be cleared another way.

Three boosters can help: X2 doubles any number block, Bomb destroys the blocks around it, and Flash removes every stone from the field. Don't let blocks stack above the top boundary for more than three seconds, or the game is over. You can tackle challenging levels or aim for high scores in endless mode. To move a block, swipe left or right on an empty area or drag with the left mouse button held, then release to drop it.
chibi-anime-princess-doll: Anime princess dolls are a well-loved toy around the world. In this game, you design your own princess and aim to make her the cutest character of all. Start by picking a skin color, then choose her hair, eyes, mouth, and costumes until she looks just the way you want.
When your doll is ready, you can play with friends and compare creations to see whose princess is the most beautiful. Everything is controlled with taps or clicks, so the game is easy to pick up.
hex-connect: HEX Connect is a puzzle game played on a large hexagonal grid. It takes the Mahjong Connect format and applies it to hexagon-shaped tiles. Your goal is to find pairs of identical colored tiles and link them, but only when the connecting path bends no more than twice. Each successful link removes both tiles, so you need to reason about spatial placement to empty the board.

To win, clear every tile from the grid. Each level gets more challenging than the last. On a computer, click the first tile of a matching pair, then click its partner. On a mobile device, tap the first tile, then tap its partner. If a valid path exists, the pair disappears.
my-puppy-daycare-salon: In this caring game, you rescue a stray pup covered in many wounds. Start by tending to its cuts, then give it a hot bath. Next, hurry to build a small nest for it, using your sense of style to create something one-of-a-kind.

Once the puppy's fur is dry, choose a fitting outfit so it doesn't catch a chill. The game offers over 30 stylish accessories to pick from. Controls: on PC, click and drag with your mouse; on mobile, click and drag with your finger.
basketball-street: Pick one of three players and put your free throw skills to the test. Each round gives you one minute and 25 shots, so your goal is to sink as many balls as you can before time or shots run out. Keep an eye out for the striped balls, since each one scores 2 points rather than the usual 1, making them worth aiming for when you want a bigger total.
The game is played with a mouse and keyboard together, so keep both within reach as you take your shots.
super-goin-up: Super Goin Up is an arcade game about climbing straight up. Your character jumps upward, and the game teases that the sky may not be the limit after all. Stomping on enemies and defeating others raises your stats as you go.

Steering is simple: use the arrow keys on a keyboard, or tap the screen on a touch device. Jumping is the core of the experience, so timing each bounce matters. Defeating foes is how you grow stronger, so see how far up you can go.
happy-birthday-party-game: It is the red panda's birthday, and your task is to prepare cakes and desserts for the celebration. Begin by picking a green tablecloth for the table. Next, choose between a fruit cake and a rainbow cake, then select a plate shaped like a panda. You can also serve popcorn, French fries, or cookies. Every decision is yours to make, and all of the cakes must be finished.
Once the table is ready, light the candles and sing a birthday song, wishing him a happy birthday. You can play with a mouse or by tapping the screen.
fashionista-christmas-eve-party: Fashionista Christmas Eve Party is a girls' game about getting dressed for a holiday celebration. You choose glamorous seasonal outfits and festive accessories, blending chic pieces into a look that fits the night. Every outfit is meant to make a bold statement, and each well-styled moment feels like a fashion win. The game brings the spirit of the season into a stylish, fashion-focused setting.

Controls are simple. On desktop, use the left mouse button to click and select outfits and accessories. On mobile, tap the screen to make your selections. As you go, the Christmas Eve glamour comes together one look at a time.
uber-sim-transport-2020: Welcome to this Uber simulator, where passengers are waiting and there is no time to waste. Your task is to hurry up and get your riders where they need to go. This time the game introduces a career mode, so you can follow a longer path and watch your progress build over time. It is a fresh take on the ride-hailing idea that keeps the pressure on.
Getting behind the wheel is simple. The W, A, S and D keys handle all of your driving, so you can focus on being quick and getting every passenger to their destination.
drift-rider: Drift Rider is a racing game centered on 3D drifting. Clever maneuvers and careful driving earn you points, and those points unlock a varied lineup of cars. You can also customize your ride in many ways.

Drift through busy city streets or along long, open highways. Steer with the WASD keys or the arrow keys, and tap Space to brake. Press R to reset the car, P to enlarge the screen, and C to switch camera views. Start the engine, test your driving skills, and drift your way up the ranks.
beach-volleyball-3d: Beach volleyball 3D is a sports game where each team has two players, but you control only one of them. Even so, your side's victory depends heavily on that single athlete. The match runs until one team scores three goals, and no more, so every point counts. Your opponents are far from amateurs and are not inclined to hand over the win without a real fight.

The game is played with a mouse click or a tap, which keeps the controls easy to pick up. It is a 3D arcade title that runs in the browser through HTML5, so there is nothing to set up before you start.
kaku-shikaku-logic-puzzle: Kaku is a calm logic game built around Shikaku, the rectangle-splitting puzzle. Your job is to divide the grid into rectangles so that each one holds a single number, and that number tells you how many cells the rectangle must cover. It is easy to pick up. The game offers 2,000 hand-built stages across four difficulty levels, plus a daily challenge that awards monthly trophies.

To play, press and hold the left mouse button, or swipe with a finger, to drag out a rectangle. Tap a placed rectangle to remove it. A stage is complete once the whole grid is filled with no gaps and no overlaps. If you get stuck, a hint reveals one correct rectangle.
marble-factory: Manage your own marble plant, where colorful marbles travel along a three-dimensional production line. Your job is to send each marble into the box that matches its color. The physics feel rewarding, the gameplay stays relaxing, and the puzzles grow harder as you go, so your thinking gets a proper workout.

Start by releasing marbles from the trays at the top and let the physics take over. Marbles then land on a belt that never stops spinning, so timing matters. Steer them into the boxes at the bottom, which hold three slots for each color. If the belt fills up and no matching box is available, the game ends, so stay focused and plan each drop carefully.
emoji-skill-puzzles: Emoji Skill Puzzles is a skill game whose levels are built entirely from popular emojis. It brings six different puzzle types into one package: link, memory, word quiz, related, shadow, and crop. Each type asks you to think in its own way, so the challenge keeps shifting as you progress.
The game suits people who enjoy brain teasers and want to put their problem-solving skills to the test. Playing takes just a mouse click or a tap, so it
mustang-city-driver-2024: Mustang City Driver 2024 is a racing game with a wide range of modes to try. At night the city turns into a glowing display of neon lights, and the views are stunning. Hit a pedestrian and the police will chase after you, which keeps every drive unpredictable. You can customize how your car looks and performs, and a cute puppy rides along through all the chaos. To get rich in the game, you need to finish all of its tasks.

Use W to accelerate and S to brake, with A and D for steering left or right. Space pulls the handbrake, and F gives you a boost. Move the mouse to rotate the camera, press C to change views, and hold G for slow motion. Press L to turn the lights on or off.
terminator-robot-uprising: Greyhaven's service robots have taken over the city, and you step into the boots of Mara Vale. This 2D side-scroller sends you through 20 missions, from a blackout depot to a hospital, a foundry and other locations. Aim with your mouse, shoot down machines as they advance, leap over low incoming fire, and trigger your EMP shove once enemies crowd in.

Movement runs on the keyboard. A and D, or the left and right arrows, carry Mara forward and back, while W and S, or the up and down arrows, shift her between road lanes. Space makes her jump. Left-click or J fires, R reloads, F unleashes the EMP shove, and E activates mission objectives. Press Esc to pause or resume.
100-hidden-capybaras: This seek-and-find title is a puzzle that is both charming and tricky. Your goal is to locate and gather 100 capybaras, each tucked away somewhere within a detailed scene. The journey takes you through green woodlands, cozy villages, hidden dungeons, and strange faraway worlds. Every animal you uncover puts your eyes to the test, so take your time and look closely at each corner.

The controls are simple. The scene appears in black and white, and the capybara you need is shown in the upper right corner of the screen. Click where you spot it, then move on to the next one. Bright visuals and a pleasant soundtrack play along the whole way, keeping you focused as you work through the search.
superhero-dentist-surgery-game-for-kids: Step into a clinic built for heroes, where you take charge as the dentist. Every patient is a superhero who spends their time fighting crime, protecting the public, and often battling supervillains, so their whereabouts must stay a secret. Your job is to treat their teeth with some unusual equipment, including a mouth spray, dental tweezers, and braces.
Controls are simple: just tap or click. The game is tagged as casual, cute, and educational, with a doctor theme running through every visit to the clinic.
stellar-style-spectacle-fashion: Get four close friends dressed and styled for a glowing, futuristic evening event. Pick outfits from a digital closet filled with shimmering holographic gowns and shiny metallic pieces, then try out hairstyles that seem to defy gravity. You can also apply makeup that glows in the dark and layer on unusual, forward-thinking accessories.

The game is all about imagination and fresh design, letting you build looks that feel like they belong to tomorrow. Navigating between screens and completing each task both rely on a left mouse click. It works on mobile as well as PC, so you can play on whichever device you have.
hook-wars: Hook Wars is a 3D combat game set across a river. Your goal is to avoid hooks thrown by rivals on the other side while trying to snag them and pull them over to your shore. Precise aiming matters a lot here. Each run gives you a chance to beat your earlier score.
Move with the WASD keys or the arrow keys. To hook an opponent, click the left mouse button, or press the space bar if you prefer the keyboard.
cubby-soccer-league: Step onto the pitch in this free browser soccer game, built with HTML5. You guide your player across the field, keep the ball away from rivals, and work your way toward the goal, all while managing your stamina. It suits both casual players and football fans.

On a computer, the arrow keys move your player left and right, and the spacebar sends them forward. The spacebar also shoots and takes penalties, and the arrow keys control the goalkeeper. On mobile, the on-screen direction keys move your player left and right, and the ball icon moves them forward. Tap the ball icon or the screen to shoot or take a penalty, and tap the colors on the goal to control the goalkeeper.
emoji-solitaire: Emoji Solitaire blends classic solitaire rules with word association. There are no hearts or spades here. Each card shows a word and an emoji from a category such as Animals, Food, Music, Space, Weather, Sports, or Nature. Move words onto the foundation pile that matches their theme, or stack related cards on the tableau to flip over hidden ones beneath them.
super-stickman-duelist: Think you can handle duels with spinning steel blades? In Super Stickman Duelist, a 2D arcade game, you fight stickman opponents on each level. Your job is to defeat your enemy by rotating your character and weapon to strike at the right moment. Stronger weapons can be unlocked, and you can also pick up new ones from fallen enemies or from platforms scattered around the stage.
Controls are simple: just drag to play. The game is tagged as an adventure, avoid, and fight title, so expect a mix of combat and dodging. Good luck, and have fun!
zombie-raid: Zombie Raid is a fast survival action game where hordes of undead keep pouring into a city. Your job is to hold your ground, take on tough missions, and make your gear stronger as you go. Only you stand between the monsters and the streets, so every fight matters. Missions come in several styles, including survival, cleanup, running, clown hunting, and other challenges, and each one gets harder as the enemies grow more dangerous.

Along the way you collect gold and crystals, which you can spend on new equipment, weapons, and characters. Your arsenal ranges from baseball bats and crossbows to lightsabers and blasters, so picking the right tool for each job is key. Keep moving and avoid letting the zombies corner you. On PC, press A to move left and D to move right.
baby-taylor-easter-fun: Easter is almost here, and Baby Taylor is thrilled to take part in the Easter rally with her friends. She has plenty of plans for the day and must get ready before the rally begins. First, though, she wants to create a beautiful Easter goody basket filled with colorful eggs.

You can join Taylor as she juggles her busy plans and enjoys this cheerful holiday. Control her by clicking the mouse or tapping the screen. Spend time with Taylor and help her enjoy a joyful day filled with Easter fun.
truck-driving-construction-transport: Here you become a capable driver working in construction transport. Your job is to cross different kinds of ground while picking up key building supplies and machinery and loading them onto your truck. Once everything is secure, you drive with care to the marked construction site. Expect busy roads you must weave through, dangers you need to dodge, and firm deadlines you have to hit. Steer with the W, A, S and D keys.

Along the way, every trip tests your patience and your focus. Keep your load safe, watch the road ahead, and keep an eye on the clock. The game suits anyone who enjoys vehicle simulators and hauling jobs, and it's a relaxed but demanding way to spend some time behind the wheel.
cube-shooter: Cube Shooter puts you in a three-dimensional battle where gunfire is the main way to get ahead. Pick up weapons as you go and use them to take down opponents. Your goal is to outlast everyone else, since the match is won by being the last player left standing. The matches move quickly, so you will need to stay alert and keep moving.

It is a first-person shooter with multiplayer action, so you face other people in every fight. The controls are simple: use W, A, S and D to get around, and click the left mouse button to shoot. Survival is the core idea, so focus on firing your way through each battle and staying in the fight until the very end.
blocks-move-hit-pro: Blocks: Move HIT PRO is a puzzle game for fans of blocky worlds and brain teasers. You play as a hero with a mission, but the route keeps changing as you go. The maze is packed with solid stone blocks that cannot be moved, and every collision knocks your block off its line. Sometimes you can angle off at 45 degrees and shoot across diagonally, and other times you must take a sharp 90-degree turn.

Your aim is to read each rebound, work out the shifting layout, and steer your block to its final destination. Find a path and hit the target to win. Expect a challenging run that rewards careful planning over quick guesses.
fruits-into-baskets: In this matching puzzle, you clear the playing field by tapping fruits so they drop into their correct places. When a fruit is blocked, you first need to remove the fruits sitting below it that are in the way. Each time you collect three fruits in a basket, a new basket opens up to help you sort the rest. If a fruit has no matching basket, it waits on a temporary plate.

There is no timer and nothing rushes you, so the game suits short breaks when you want to unwind and breathe. Sorting everything neatly brings a calm sense of order, and the level is complete once the field is empty. It is a gentle, easy-going way to relax with fruit.
super-zombie-driving: Set in a city after the apocalypse, where the dead have taken over every road, your job is simply to stay alive while driving. Streets are packed with zombies, smashed-up vehicles, and general mayhem. You pick a car, turn the key, and plow through crowds of the undead while working through missions aimed at clearing the roads and collecting rewards. Each stage asks you to flatten a set number of zombies before the clock hits zero, so quick reactions and sharp driving matter.
Controls are simple: use W, A, S, and D to move, hold Space to brake, press R to start the level over, and move the mouse to turn the camera around you.
call-of-bravery-shooter: Call of Bravery Shooter is a first-person shooter with detailed 3D guns that look and feel realistic. You can choose either the Catania or the Venado map and face off in five-versus-five matches. Each player carries a main weapon, a backup sidearm, and utility gear, so you can take on opponents at any point in the round. Classic shooter strategies work well here, and landing headshots can end fights quickly. The first team to reach 50 points wins.

On a computer, WASD moves your character while the mouse handles aiming and firing. Press R to reload and use keys 1 through 4 to switch between weapons. On a phone or tablet, drag the on-screen wheel to move around and tap the buttons to shoot.
emoji-guess: Put your knack for reading emojis to the test in this quick, lively puzzler. Each round shows a phrase, saying, or movie title, either written out or drawn, and your task is to choose the matching emojis from a mixed pile. The order matters, so you need to line them up exactly as the message reads. There are hundreds of compact, bright levels, many of them funny, and they keep coming.

Each puzzle works your logic, word association, and visual perception. Pick the sequence correctly on your first attempt and you collect all the stars for that level. If you miss, you get more tries along with guidance. When you feel stuck, hints gently point you toward the answer without revealing it. Although the idea is simple, the challenge suits smart players of every age.
dronner-3d: Dronner 3D puts you behind the wheel of a one-of-a-kind car that can take flight and become a quadcopter. You race across a series of tracks, collecting points and battery charges along the way. Crashes are a constant risk, and they are especially costly once you are airborne. Keep an eye on your damage level and how much battery power you have left.

As you move through the levels, you can improve your vehicle by increasing battery capacity and repairing damage. At the end of each level, a statistics table shows your results so you can judge how well you performed. On desktop, the arrow keys or the W, A and D keys drive the car, and the spacebar switches between car and quadcopter. The same movement keys steer you while you fly.
christmas-night-of-horror: In this action, adventure, and shooter game, the holiday season is under threat as monstrous beings invade and put Christmas at risk. Your job is to pick up a firearm and drive these fiends, among them Slenderman, Momo, and Siren Head, back to Hell, where they belong.
Move with WASD and use Shift to s
nexusorbiter: Nexusorbiter is a one-touch arcade defense game where a drone circles a fragile space station. Your satellite fires automatically, but only at nearby asteroids. A tap or click anywhere flips its orbit direction, and that is your only control. Each stage brings new threats: glue bombs you must shoot at range, seeking suicide drones that always find their target, EMP drones that silence your auto-fire on contact, and healing orbiters that protect bosses.

Six upgrade tracks help you shape your satellite through its upgrade buttons, and a rocket button launches consumable rockets when you need extra firepower. The game features more than thirty stages with multi-boss waves. A fresh daily challenge rewards you with bonus scrap every day.
carvivor-ops: Carvivor Ops puts you behind the wheel of a weaponized supercar. Your job is to keep ahead of police cars that arrive in increasingly intense waves, all within a limited amount of time. Along the way you can fire rockets, weave past the cops, and upgrade your gear to stay in the fight. The chases never seem to end, so the longer you last, the more the game asks of you.

Steering works with the arrow keys or the W, A, S and D keys on a computer, moving your car up, down, left and right. On a phone or tablet, the same movement is handled by the buttons that appear on screen. Keep your car moving and see how long you can outrun the police.
cubble-on-top: Cubble on Top is an unusual jumping game where your goal is to leap onto the cliff walls and climb toward the top, reaching the finish line. It will test your patience as you work your way up. This single-player arcade title belongs to the hypercasual category.

Controls work through drag and drop to make each jump. Think about where you want to land before you act, since steady patience is the key to getting to the finish. Tagged as 1 Player, Arcade, and jump, it suits anyone who enjoys a simple, challenging climb.
street-racer-2d: Street Racer 2D is a drag racing game centered on speed. Your aim is to win races, improve your vehicle, and purchase fresh cars to drive. The game brings together several play styles: classic drag racing, off-road courses, and light arcade-style fun. Every mode feels different, so you might be chasing top speed one moment and tackling bumpy, rough ground the next, or simply enjoying quick track battles.

Controls on a computer use A or the left arrow to reverse and D or the right arrow to accelerate. W or the up arrow shifts gear up, while S or the down arrow shifts gear down. Press Shift for turbo, P to pause, and R to restart. On mobile, simply tap the buttons displayed on screen to control the car.
impossible-bus-stunt-3d: Impossible Bus Stunt 3D is a simulation game built around giant ramps and bus stunts. Expect plenty of destruction as you send buses into wild jumps. You start by choosing your favorite bus, then drive it at full speed across the mega ramps. Along the way, you will face tricky challenges that test your patience, and beating them unlocks the huge vehicles you can play next.

Controls are simple: use the arrow keys or WASD. The game suits fans of driving, racing, and daring stunts, and it mixes all three in one place. Pick a bus, aim for the ramps, and see how far your driving can take you.
world-of-alice-animal-habitat: World of Alice: Animal Habitat is a learning game made for children. It teaches them what habitats are and which animals live in each one. Because it can be played on a cell phone, tablet, or computer, young players can enjoy it on whichever device they have nearby.

This game is a valuable educational resource that turns studying into play. To play, look at the animal shown on screen and click the habitat where that animal lives. Matching each creature to its home helps players connect animals with the places they belong, and the lesson is never dull.
endless-z-survivor: In this action shooter, a never-ending stream of hungry undead keeps coming at you in waves, and your job is to hold out. You have a range of guns to fend them off. Every time you fall, you return a little tougher, so each run builds on the last.

Cutting down zombies earns gold, which you can spend on fresh weapons to face the next horde. Move with W, A, S and D, press R to reload, and shoot with the left mouse button. Switch between your two weapons using the 1 and 2 number keys.
evo-city-driving: Step behind the wheel in EVO City Driving, a single-player 3D racing game with realistic graphics. The game offers a wide range of supercars, and each one is ready to carry you across the streets of EVO City. Your goal is to drive as fast as you can and try to explore every road in town.

Controls are easy to pick up. Use the WASD keys to drive, press the Space bar to brake, and press C to change the camera view. Whether you prefer quick runs or slower laps, you decide how to explore the city and which supercar to take out.
point-to-merge: Point to Merge is a puzzle game where you link numbered blocks to reach the highest value you can. Two blocks marked 2 appear at the start, and you point arrows to guide each one toward its match. Numbers combine in order, moving through 2, 4, 8, 16 and onward.

Accuracy matters here. One wrong move, or pointing an arrow outside the level, restarts the puzzle. The game has 50 levels that grow more challenging as you progress, testing both sharp thinking and steady direction. Plan each step carefully and work toward the largest number you can get.
save-the-puppy-remove-the-screws: Rescue a small pup in this puzzle game built around colorful screws. Your job is to take out screws, pair up matching colors, and push past obstacles until the puppy is free. Each choice matters, so it pays to think ahead before you act. As you advance, the levels grow harder and new structures appear to keep things interesting.

Tapping a screw removes it. To clear screws, line up two of the same color next to each other in the bottom area, and they will disappear. When a stage stumps you, helpful boosters are there to lend a hand. Work your way through every level to see the puppy saved.
gunner-pursuit: Gunner Pursuit pairs quick, nonstop action with a range of weapons. You shoot from a fast-moving vehicle while chasing down targets and dodging enemies. You can strengthen your gear to keep going and come out on top in each tough stage.

The game is free and runs on both phones and computers. Move the mouse to look around, left-click to shoot, and press L to lock or unlock the cursor. Each stage calls for sharp reflexes and a steady hand, so keep your focus on the chase.
zoo-run: Zoo Run is an action game set in an isometric world, and it has no fixed finish. You keep running through an endless course for as long as you can. Before you set off, choose one of eight animal characters to run as. Along the way, the background elements swap out every set number of seconds, and the challenge ramps up the longer you last.
Play is handled entirely with the mouse, so the controls stay simple from start to finish. Keep your focus on the changing scenery and respond as the difficulty builds.
gang-fall-party: Gang Fall Party is a fighting game set on high platforms, where your main aim is to punch your opponents off the edge. You can play alone or with another person. The 1vs1 mode pits you against a friend, while the Vs All mode lets you and a friend take on many online opponents together. There is also a 1P mode for fighting online friends.
Each online match includes 16 or 17 players. Player 1 moves with W, A, S and D, runs with C and punches with V. Player 2 moves with the arrow keys, runs with O and punches with P.
football-leauge: Football League is a soccer game played in a stadium, with quick rounds and plenty of action. You build your squad by choosing the players you want, then plan how they will move and play together. Scoring goals helps you climb the ranks until you reach the championship. It is a single-player game.

The controls are easy to learn, and the visuals and gameplay are lively, so players of any skill level can enjoy it. On a desktop, press the right mouse button to pass the ball to a teammate. On mobile, tap the screen to make the same pass.
fun-town-parking: Fun Town Parking is a simulation game that puts your driving and parking skills to the test. You guide your car along tricky routes, aiming to claim open parking spots while dodging obstacles along the way. As you advance, the difficulty climbs, helping you sharpen your abilities over time.
Controls are simple. Use W, A, S, D or the arrow keys to move your car, and shift gears to switch between forward and reverse. Press C to change
badlands-hero: Badlands Hero is an action game set in a harsh wasteland where threats appear around nearly every turn. Your job is to get through levels, which you clear by collecting experience points and unlocking new characters along the way. Gold you pick up can be spent on upgrading both your heroes and their weapons, and you can also discover fresh weapon types as you progress. Expect to face bosses at key points in your run.
Moving your character is simple. On a computer, press W, A, S and D or left-click to get around. On a phone or tablet, touch the screen and drag your finger to steer your hero.
ultimate-car-parking-sim: Car fans who enjoy careful, precise steering will feel at home in this realistic driving title. You pilot high-performance sports cars as well as upscale luxury models, and your job is to slot them into narrow parking spots. Busy lots give you crowded spaces to weave through, while a set of demanding driving courses tests your skill from start to finish. Each parking mission asks you to be accurate, so every move counts.

This is a single-player game. Drive and steer with the W, A, S and D keys or the arrow keys. Whether you want to refine your parking technique or simply enjoy handling impressive machines, this simulator is all about patience and accuracy.
match-3d-puzzle-mania: Match 3D Puzzle Mania takes the classic match-three idea and presents it in three dimensions. You line up matching objects to clear each board and move forward through the game. Collecting coins lets you buy power-ups that can help when a puzzle gets tough.

The game offers an endless number of levels, and every level comes in three difficulty settings. Four special abilities are available to help you get past harder challenges. Daily quests and rotating events give you extra chances to earn rewards along the way.
advanced-air-combat-simulator: Your goal in this air combat simulator is to bring down rival fighter jets and come out on top. Steer your plane with the W, A, S and D keys, and use the mouse to aim and glance around the sky. A left click lets you fire your weapons.

Expect tense dogfights where you need to outmaneuver opponents during high-pressure battles in the air. Everything happens fast in these air battles, so staying alert gives you a real edge. The TAB key opens the menu, and pressing C switches between camera views.
tank-fury-boss-battle-2d: Tank Fury: Boss Battle 2D mixes careful planning with intense combat. You take control of several different tanks, improving both your weapons and your defenses as you progress. Your main goal is to face off against tough bosses that put your skills to the test in this online game.

On a computer, use A and D to move, W and S to aim, and the Spacebar to attack. On mobile, simply press the buttons that appear on screen. Upgrade your tank whenever you can, then head back into battle. The game can be played on both mobile devices and computers.
2-3-4-player-games: Gather two to four people for this casual party title, which supports matches for two, three, or four players at once. The collection holds 21 separate games, and each one presents its own setup. In every game, you either aim to score points or race to the end line before anyone else. Speed matters, so react fast and outmaneuver the competition.

Controls are split across the keyboard so everyone can join in. Player 1 uses W, A, S, and D. Player 2 uses the arrow keys. Player 3 uses I, J, K, and L, while Player 4 uses T, F, G, and H. Grab your friends and enjoy a lively session together.
city-bus-parking: City Bus Parking puts you in the driver's seat of large city buses and tour coaches. Your job is to get them where they need to go across crowded streets, twisting mountain roads, and bridges, all while keeping steering, braking, and parking under control. You can wander through urban areas and quieter countryside scenery, stay on course with the road and traffic, dodge obstacles, and bring your bus to a stop inside marked spots. The controls feel grounded, the stages get harder as you go, and the 3D surroundings look sharp, so each run is a real test of your driving.
Use W, A, S, D or the arrow keys to drive and steer.
hit-and-knock-down: Hit & Knock Down is a casual arcade shooting and throwing game. You aim at targets using a variety of balls, and each successful hit either knocks the target down or makes it explode. To clear a stage, you must reach the required score or meet that stage's objectives, then move on to the next challenge.

Aiming is simple. Drag or swipe across the screen to line up your throw, then release to launch the ball. Cans, dishes, fruit, and other objects all serve as targets, and you earn points for every hit. The controls are easy to pick up, which makes the game well suited to playing on a phone.
masked-special-forces: Masked Special Forces: Virtual Combat puts you in the role of a brave soldier in a high-energy shooter. Your mission is to take down enemies in a lifelike virtual battle zone. A large selection of weapons and top-grade armor gives you room to test your skills and plan clever tactics to take control of the arena.

Move with WASD or the arrow keys, and hold left shift to run. Press space to jump, and tap Q to slide while running. Left click fires your weapon and right click aims. Use keys 1, 2, and 3 to switch weapons, and press E or F to pick up a weapon. Throw dynamite with G and use a medkit with H.
elemental-rescue-adventure: Elemental Rescue Adventure is an online platformer that pulls you into a digital world with hours of entertainment. Drawing inspiration from the film Elemental, you step into the shoes of Wade, whose mission is to free Ember from her captors by clearing a series of stages that grow steadily harder.

The game is free to play and blends Disney enchantment with lively gameplay. On a computer, use the WASD keys to move and jump. On touch devices, tap the on-screen buttons to move and jump. Whichever way you play, the controls are simple to learn.
dreamblox: DreamBlox is a online multiplayer game where you gather coins and then spend them on adorable pets and outfits for them. Your companions can be taken to a special school, where they learn a variety of tricks. Along the way you can wander through the game world, visit different spots, and find new things to do.

To get started, pick up coins as you roam around and head to the shops to buy pets and accessories. Bring your animals to the school to train them in different tricks. Each area you explore may reveal fresh fun, so take your time and see what you can uncover.
bubble-merge-2d: Bubble Merge is a calm puzzle title driven by physics. Players join bubbles of the same kind to form larger items, working through the goals listed for each stage. Careful planning helps, and special boosts are available when a level gets tricky. New item combinations appear as the puzzles grow harder.

Aiming works by pressing and dragging a bubble, then letting go to fire it. When you combine two identical bubbles, they form a higher-level piece. The items shown along the top of the display are the targets you must build. Clear every target before your moves run out.
groomy-island: Groomy Island is a realistic 3D horror-survival game set on a large island with many places to explore. Your goal is to survive and collect all ten Grimace Shakes, and a minimap helps you find your way around. Seen through first-person eyes, you sneak through the environment searching for hidden collectibles while staying clear of a predatory threat. The tension begins within the first minute, and the realistic visuals heighten the sense of dread.
Unlike typical genre titles, it uses a light touch of horror that blends tension with accessibility for a broader audience. It
golf-cars-simulator: Golf Cars Simulator is a browser-based stunt driving game built around cars. Players can tune up a variety of vehicles and choose from three separate game modes. The map was built with stunt driving in mind, so there is plenty of room to show off tricks. Drive with the WASD keys, pull the handbrake with Space, and pause or resume with Escape or Tab. Press C to switch camera views.
darts-pro: Darts Pro is an online precision game built around the sport of darts. Its scoring rules are inspired by those of the official Darts Regulation Authority, so the game feels like a real match. You can enjoy it on a phone or a computer at no cost, and it challenges both your aim and your skill.

Each round comes down to lining up your throw. Move the pointer with a mouse or slide your finger across a touch screen, then click or tap to release the dart. Your aim is to land as close to the center of the board as you can, where the bullseye waits. Keep an eye out for bonus symbols, because they can raise your score by a good amount. The game is easy to pick up but takes practice to master, and it tests your steadiness and precision.
merge-guns: Merge Guns combines tower defense with merging, all on one grid. You spend gold to buy weapons, then drag two guns of the same tier together to create a stronger one. Alien swarms approach from the right, and your task is to stop them from crossing the line. The game includes eight gun tiers, boss waves, achievements, and both English and Russian language options. Each run becomes its own layout puzzle, while progress carries forward between runs.

Click or tap BUY GUN to add a weapon. Select or drag any gun to move it, swap it, recycle it, or merge it with a matching tier. Press START WAVE, and your guns fire automatically. When heavy waves arrive, use Airstrike to help hold the line. Between runs, spend the cores and Salvage you earn on permanent upgrades.
lift-the-girl: Lift The Girl is a free online adventure game for kids. It offers rich levels in a 2D view with a fresh, cartoon style. Each stage combines its challenges in a random mix, so the route you take can change from one attempt to the next. Every level brings its own set of traps, so you need to stay alert as you go.

Your goal is to keep the little sister from getting hurt. If she is harmed, you must start the level over. To handle the weights, press the left mouse button, drag each one into place, and release it. On a mobile device, use the same touch action. To move the character, click on them.
100-monster-escape-room: Trapped inside a twisting maze, you must work through a series of cryptic puzzles and challenges while racing against the clock. A hundred menacing monsters are hunting you, so every decision matters. Use sharp thinking and teamwork to get past each obstacle, and piece together the secrets hidden in this room. The horror-themed action keeps the tension high from start to finish.

Controls are simple. Press W, A, S, and D to move your character, and move the mouse to look around. When you reach something you want to use, press the button inside the game to interact with it. Your aim is to outsmart the creatures and make your escape before time runs out.
push-the-frog: Guide your little frog so it eats every mosquito in sight. The key is learning how far the tongue reaches, then positioning the frog so each bug is within range. Mapping out your route before you move helps, since every step counts.

The style is simple and appealing, and the gameplay feels fresh while quietly teaching you about planning. It's a good pick for passing time. Move with W, A, S, and D or the arrow keys, and press the spacebar to shoot out the frog's tongue.
different-fashion-hairstyle: Sofia and Zoe are comparing which hairstyles are the most popular right now. Their debate centers on whether curly or straight hair is the better choice. Your job is to help each of them pick a favorite hairstyle and a matching dress, so they can settle the argument with a fresh look.

This dress-up simulation focuses on fashion, hair, and makeovers, and it is aimed at kids who enjoy styling characters. Click or tap to make your selections, and move through the choices at your own pace while you try different combinations.
wood-nuts-master-screw-puzzle: Wood Nuts Master: Screw Puzzle is an online brain teaser that tests your strategic thinking. You fit screws and nuts in order to topple wooden blocks. The game runs on several platforms, and it is aimed at players who want a new play-to-earn option.

The physics-based gameplay asks you to place each screw with care. Your goal is to bring down all of the wooden blocks, so look for the best spots among the empty holes. The holes are limited, and some may become covered by the wood blocks you release, so think ahead before every move.
swap-the-pictures: Swap The Pictures may look like a crossword at first glance, but it asks you to link concepts rather than fill in letters. Each image has to be placed where its row and column categories meet, so you read the clues, think through the connections, and slowly build the full grid. Some tiles belong to two groups at once, which adds a layer of challenge to the board.

To play, start by checking the categories along the rows and columns. Tap any two tiles to trade their spots, then keep testing arrangements until each picture fits its proper row and column. Overlapping tiles need extra thought because they carry two associations. Keep an eye on your remaining moves, since the puzzle must be finished before they run out.
madalin-stunt-cars-pro: Madalin Stunt Cars Pro is a racing game built around high-speed stunts and fast, intense driving. Its detailed 3D graphics bring every part of the scene to life. You can take the wheel of a sleek sports car or a tough police cruiser, then test your driving across three different map areas.
Steer with the Arrow keys or WASD, and use Space to handbrake. Hold Shift to use nitro, and press Ctrl to change your car. Press M to check the rearview mirror, and H to switch the police lights on.
christmas-nail-salon: Christmas Nail Salon is a free girls' game about nail design and polish. Its holiday theme makes it a festive pick for fans of makeover play. You spend a few hours creating nail art for your clients, and the game works well on a smartphone or tablet.

Working as a stylist here, you will feel like a true professional as you craft each look. Your goal is to leave every customer happy with their freshly designed nails. Control is simple: use your mouse or tap the screen to play.
cobraz-io: CobraZ.io Classic is a first-person shooter made for online play against other people. You design your soldier to your liking, then equip yourself with strong weapons and gear before you head into the fight. The game includes four modes. Team Deathmatch focuses on battles fought with your squad, Free For All throws every player into a free-for-all clash, and Capture The Flag rewards teamwork as you plan missions to take the enemy's flag.

Move with WASD or the arrow keys, and fire with the left mouse button. Right-click to aim, and press Space to slide while you move. Hold Left Shift to run, and use keys 1, 2 and 3 to swap weapons. Press E or F to interact with a gun, and press G to throw a grenade.
rolling-ball-halloween-escape: Rolling Ball Halloween Escape sends you on a spooky journey through a haunted world full of bright, vivid Halloween decorations. Your goal is to guide a ball across the eerie sky, slip past every hazard in its path, and break free from the creepy landscape. You can speed your ball up or back it up to get through tight spots.
Keep an eye out for swinging pendulums, shattering boxes, and many other obstacles along the way. Timing matters, so stay alert as you roll. The game is played with a mouse click or a tap.
car-cargo-ship-simulator-game: Step into the role of a professional car carrier in this ship simulator. You will drive vehicles, park them carefully, load them onto massive cargo ships, and steer those ships through deep ocean ports. Your routes take you across exotic islands and modern harbors, where every delivery counts. Your driving, parking, and ship handling are all tested, and your time management matters just as much.

Manage a high-tech fleet of jeeps, ships, and cars as you go. Move with W, A, S, and D or the arrow keys: W or Up to go forward, S or Down to go back, A or Left to move left, and D or Right to move right. Use the mouse to click any button.
super-frog-adventure: Super Frog Adventure is an arcade platformer that echoes the classic Super Mario style.
