create-your-robot: Build your own robot from the parts provided in this puzzle game. There is plenty of room for imagination, so let your creativity guide every choice you make. Your goal is to put together the finest robots you can think of.

Made with kids in mind, this game is all about robots and having a good time. Everything is controlled with your mouse, so you can start right away. Dress up your creation, try out different combinations, and enjoy the process as you go.
letter-layout-coloring: Letter Layout Coloring is an arcade-style puzzle game where you arrange colorful letters to form words. It challenges both your creativity and your thinking skills. The layout changes with every level, so each stage looks different from the last, and you can solve puzzles and unlock achievements as you go.

The game mixes word-building with a bit of strategy and artistic flair, which makes it a good fit for anyone who enjoys playing with language. Controls are simple: a mouse click or a tap is all you need to make your moves, and it is available for mobile play. Each puzzle reveals more of the bright range of language.
lady-rescue: Lady Rescue is a puzzle game built around drawing. You guide a courageous young girl named Lady through a series of tricky scenes, where honey bees, sharks, and crocodiles threaten to catch her. Each level presents a new situation, and the line you sketch has to pull her out of harm's way.

Speed matters here, since you have only five seconds to protect Lady. To draw, touch the screen and drag your finger across it. Once she is safe, you move on to the next level. Expect plenty of surprises along the way, and get ready to do some brain teasing as you work out the smartest route for her escape.
stickman-in-space: You play as Stickman, an astronaut lost on the moon, and your goal is to find a route back to Earth. Along the way you will overcome space obstacles, dodge falling meteorites, and battle aliens. Puzzles block your path too, and you must solve them to keep moving toward your escape.

The game is free to play on both mobile devices and desktop computers. There are two successful ways to leave the moon, so you will need to explore to find them. Controls are simple: use a computer mouse on desktop, or a stylus or your finger on a mobile device.
farm-business-saga: Farm Business Saga is a farming simulator where you set up and run your own farm. Plant and harvest crops to sell for profit, or raise cows, chickens, and other animals for milk, eggs, and more. Raw materials can be processed in your factory into higher-value goods, and trading helps you grow into a farming tycoon.

Nature fans and strategy players alike will find plenty to enjoy, and the visuals are designed to appeal to players of all ages. Shape your farm, village, and factory your own way, unlocking new land, decorations, and upgrades as your empire grows. Tap and drag to work with crops, animals, and buildings, use on-screen menus for inventory, sales, and upgrades, and balance resources to maximize profits and efficiency. It's a calm yet demanding adventure for casual and strategic players alike.
merge-happy-planets: Merge Happy Planets! brings back the classic merging style in a space setting. You toss planets into play, and when matching ones touch, they combine into larger worlds. Watch out for falling meteor showers and a few unpredictable, mischievous planets that can disrupt your plans. To get ahead, you can rely on special helpers: Big Bang Bombs, Rainbow Planets, and Black Holes. This one-player puzzle arcade game has a space theme and tests your thinking.

Controls are simple, since you just click the mouse to launch each planet. Every drop is a chance to set up a stronger chain of merges, so it pays to plan a move or two ahead. Your goal is to win and to aim for the number one spot. It suits anyone who enjoys brain-teasing puzzles with a bit of chaos mixed in.
save-your-girl: Robbers have snatched your sweetheart and locked her inside a cage. You need to use your wisdom to work out how to open the door. Once you are through, you must defeat the robber and his hound, then reach your girl and share a deep kiss online.

This hypercasual title blends puzzle play with match 3 mechanics and a superhero theme, and it is tagged as family-friendly. Your first move is simple: click the lock to open the door and begin your rescue.
good-and-evil-dressup: Step into the world of a young sorceress who studies at a magical school, and mix light and dark in your wardrobe choices. Each outfit combines elements of good and evil, so you can try looks made from glossy leather or smooth, elegant satin. This no-cost browser title runs on both smartphones and desktop computers, and it gives you room to express your imagination through an almost endless range of fashion ideas.
When you finish designing, you can store your final look as a PNG picture. Controls depend on your device: on a computer you click with the mouse, while on a touchscreen a simple tap does the job.
baby-snack-factory: The Baby Snack Factory is now open, giving children a chance to try their hand at making snacks. The game takes place in a little panda's kitchen stocked with plenty of ingredients, including fruits and sugar. Players follow the recipes provided to whip up their own treats.

Along the way, you combine items such as flour and eggs, then knead the blend until it forms a ball of dough. Next, use the machine to shape the cookies and put them into the oven. Controls are simple: use your mouse or tap the screen to play.
fairies-heart-style: Valentine's Day is almost here, and two best friends have agreed on a festive contest: they will both transform into cupid fairies. You can step in and assist them as they pick out breezy, lightweight outfits and glamorous gowns. Heart-shaped accessories, eye-catching hairdos, and charming makeup are all part of the mix, and there is a large selection of cosmetics and clothing to explore.
The game is played with a left mouse click or a tap on the screen. Simply select each item to dress up the girls and see how their looks come together.
loot-island-treasure-digger: Set out on a treasure hunt through the captivating landscapes of Loot Island, searching for crosses that mark spots worth digging. Dig deeper to uncover precious items, then pack each find into your backpack. Next, fit the loot together in a Tetris-style puzzle, stacking gems, coins, and more with careful planning.
Your objective is to collect as many val
paint-and-roll: Paint & Roll is a color puzzle game where every move spreads bright paint across the board. You steer linked paint rollers over the playing area, coating each surface and turning plain paths into colorful designs. Each level tests your timing, direction, and planning as you glide, rotate, and paint your way to victory. The controls are simple, but mastering a level takes skill and strategy.
freaky-monster-rush: Freaky Monster Rush is a 3D arcade game that kicks off a brand-new race. Your monster runner grows stronger as the DNA of each body part is fused in, one limb at a time. Every obstacle course asks you to dodge barrels, knock back the foes in your path, and charge through the right gates to clear it.

The controls rely on holding and sliding, so you keep your runner moving through each stage. The game sits in the Arcade category and carries tags such as 3D, avoid, collecting, hypercasual, monster, and obstacle, which hints at a game built around dodging hazards and g
wall-of-danger-dash: Jack's friend Lily has been taken by a villain named Shadow Loomed, who has dared Jack to come and rescue her. Jack accepts the challenge, and you guide him along the way. Traps and monsters stand in his path, and you must defeat every enemy to save his friend.

The game offers high quality graphics, a very small size, super simple controls, and interesting quests. On Android, on-screen touch buttons move the hero. On PC, the left and right arrow keys walk him from side to side, and the up arrow makes him jump.
stick-man-battle-fighting: Stick Man Battle Fighting is a relaxed fighting title where every move counts. You take on enemies in lively stickman clashes, and the game focuses on single-mode combat. Along the way, you can learn and practise several fighting styles to sharpen your technique.

Pick the weapon that suits you, then customise your hero to match your own taste. Controls are simple: click with a mouse or tap to play. Fans of battle, fight and superhero games should find plenty to enjoy here.
mr-tung-shoot-zombie: Mr. Tung needs your help to take down every zombie in sight, and precise aim is the key. Stay alert, because zombies can reach Ballerina Cappuccino at any moment. He is locked up in prison, so your job is to launch arrows and wipe out the undead to set him free. Mr. Tung is a skilled archer who can handle the zombies, but the rescue depends on your aim.

This shooter runs on both phones and computers. On PC, click a direction or a zombie with the mouse to fire an arrow. On mobile, simply tap the direction or the zombie you want to hit. Touch controls are available for phone players, so you can aim and shoot with your fingers.
fix-pizza-food-sorting: Sort toppings in this colorful puzzle, where every pizza is covered with a mix of food items. Your job is to spot the extra ingredients and send them to the plates that match. Start by checking the recipe sheet, which shows the items that must stay on the pizza. Everything else needs to go.

Watch your mistakes, because they are limited and running out means restarting the level. As you advance, the boards get busier, the object search grows tougher, and new recipes bring unusual ingredient combinations. Highlight reveals suitable ingredients, Mistakes clears filled markers, and Shuffle rearranges the items. The levels are short and the controls are simple, so it suits a quick break or a longer session at your own pace.
bird-quest-adventure-flappy: Bird Quest is a casual arcade adventure where you guide a bird through a world full of danger. Your task is to dodge obstacles and monsters while collecting coins, stars, and diamonds along the way. Every treasure you grab adds to your points, so it pays to gather as much as you can.

The points you earn can also be spent to buy new legendary birds, giving you fresh flyers to try. The hypercasual design keeps things easy to pick up, and the game is built around chasing high scores. To make your bird fly, simply click with a mouse or tap the screen on a touch device.
bottle-bottle: Bottle Bottle is a light jumping title that anyone can pick up quickly, yet it takes practice to get really good at it. You guide a bottle as it hops from one platform to the next. Controls are kept to simple taps, and each tap sends the bottle flipping and springing forward. Getting your timing and rhythm right is what lets you land safely and keep moving further along.

The visuals are clean and the animations flow smoothly, which keeps the experience calm and enjoyable. Every run gives you a chance to push your personal best distance higher. A single tap starts a jump, and tapping again while the bottle is airborne gives it a second jump. You can chain up to two jumps in a row, so plan each one carefully.
my-little-farm: This casual arcade title lets you tend a small farm with easy-to-learn controls. You start by collecting materials: felling trees for wood, breaking rocks for stone, and digging a well for water. Breeding animals produces fertilizer that keeps your plants healthy.

As your supplies build up, you can construct a mill, harvest wheat and turn it into flour, then bake bread and bring in helpers. To get around, steer with the on-screen joystick, walk up to a tree to cut it down, approach water to draw it out, and gather enough res
football-soccer: Football - Soccer is an online football simulator that puts you into professional sport and its championships. Its 3D graphics place you in realistic stadiums, recreating the feel of a real match.

Compete in tournaments against teams from around the world, pick a favourite side, and aim for the title. On PC, WASD moves your player. With the ball, the left arrow passes, the up arrow kicks toward the opponent's goal, and the right arrow accelerates. Without it, the left arrow switches players, the up arrow wins the ball, and the right arrow follows the carrier to keep up the challenge. Mobile players steer with a joystick and use labelled buttons for actions. It is a pastime for fans of sports games.
noob-vs-pro-drift-tag: Noob vs Pro: Drift Tag is a fast 3D car game where speed, sliding turns, and quick reactions matter most. The driver holding the bomb has to hand it off to a rival before the countdown hits zero. If time runs out while you still have it, your car blows up and you are knocked out of the round. Slide through narrow gaps, bounce off ramps, and dodge obstacles while you trick your opponents into taking the bomb. Choose from different cars, challenge your friends, and work your way up from Noob to Pro. Aim to be the last driver standing.
Steer with the WASD keys and press E to launch your car into the air. The game runs on both mobile and PC, and touch controls are available on mobile devices.
telekinesis-attack: Telekinesis Attack lets you use a magical gift for moving things with your mind. Thought becomes your weapon, so you can fling foes to any spot you choose, slam them into whatever is around, and handle each fight however you like. Your special power is the key to clearing every opponent, and you can also interact with various objects and snatch weapons away from enemies to turn the tables.

To control it, press and hold the mouse button on an enemy, then tug them in various directions. Let go with a throw in any direction to take them down. This 3D shooter has a stickman look and a superhero feel, and your goal is to defeat everyone and prove you are the strongest.
hide-from-school: Hide from School is a free online adventure that mixes hide and seek, escape, and quest play. You guide a young schoolboy who is trying to slip away from his teachers. Blend into the walls or disguise yourself as different objects so the teachers stop paying attention to you. Solve puzzles, open doors, and find your way out of each room to reach freedom.

Explore rooms, slip into the shadows, and use items to set up the perfect trap. Your main task is to leave the school without getting caught by the evil teacher. Hide, pick up, or activate objects as you go, and compete with players from around the world. On a computer, press WASD or hold the left mouse button and move the cursor. On a phone, slide your finger across the screen.
mini-boxing: Step into the ring as Nick-Joe, a boxer drawn with exaggerated, chibi-style proportions, as he fights his way toward the Boxer Championship Tournament crown. Your goal is to beat six different opponents, and each one has a quirky personality and a fighting style of their own. Despite the playful look, the game is very easy to pick up, since just three main moves cover your attacks.

Those moves are a classic light jab on Z, a medium straight punch on X, and a super heavy uppercut on C. Use the left and right arrow keys to move, and press the up arrow to block. Drawing inspiration from 1980s arcade classics, the game features charming super-deformed graphics and smooth animations.
funny-ear-surgery: Funny Ear Surgery puts you in the role of a skilled ear doctor whose job is to fix patients' ear troubles. This time, a sweet young patient needs your care. Take your time with each step, since patience is part of the fun. The game works on any screen size: on a computer, click on items, tools, and buttons to act, and on a phone or tablet, tap the screen to pick and apply your choices.
elip-adventure: You play as a small ellipse in this single-player platform adventure, moving through risky maps in search of stars. Collecting those stars is what unlocks the elliptical house. Every stage brings its own challenge, filled with obstacles and foes trying to slow you down. You can slip past them or fight them head on, so the way you handle each encounter is up to you.

Getting around is simple to learn. Press W, A, S, or D to move. Jump with the right mouse button or the X key, and use Space or Z for wall walking. Keep these controls in mind as you explore each stage.
charge-my-phone: Charge My Phone! is a hypercasual logic game for one player, where your goal is to connect every plug to the socket that matches it. You only need one finger to play, so the controls stay simple from the start. The challenge asks you to think about how the plugs line up, blending arcade-style play with logical thinking.

The game is easy to pick up but takes practice to master, so it suits anyone who enjoys a clever brain teaser. If you believe your mind is sharp, this one is worth a try. To play, drag each plug onto its socket using touch or a mouse.
halloween-is-coming-episode-10: Episode 10 of Halloween is Coming is a point-and-click escape puzzle game. You play as John, who is trapped in a snowy world and needs your help to get out. Along the way, you will work through a set of puzzles and search for hidden objects that can help you find a way free.

Everything is controlled with the mouse, so you interact with objects and areas on screen to move forward. Look carefully at what surrounds you, since each discovery brings you closer to escaping. Enjoy the challenge of this icy setting as you search for a way out.
foodhead-fighters: In FoodHead Fighters, you pick a character and steer their moves as you battle rivals on the street. Every opponent is tougher than the last, so you need to defeat each one to move ahead. Winning fights earns rewards that can sharpen your fighting abilities or let you purchase new skins for your fighter. Once you clear a level, the game ramps up its difficulty, and each new fighter brings unique skills, though the stages also become much more dangerous.
Controls are simple. Use WASD or the arrow keys to move, and press Spacebar to jump. Z lands a hit, X grabs, C kicks, and V lets you defend yourself.
spellbound-orbs: Spellbound Orbs is an arcade bubble-shooter puzzle game built around arcane magic. Its lively visual effects, bouncing orbs, and mystical challenges make each board feel different. Hundreds of levels grow steadily trickier, yet the game is easy to pick up. It runs well on both mobile and desktop browsers.

Drag your mouse or finger across the screen to aim at the descending clusters of orbs. A shot that lands on three or more matching colors bursts them. Orbs can also ricochet off the side boundaries to reach hidden bubbles. Large clusters and chained pops can trigger fireball runes, color bombs, and lightning spells.
business-go: Business Go is a board game for multiple players, centered on trading land and buildings. Participants purchase, sell, and lease properties as they work to grow their fortune and get ahead of their rivals. It falls into the board and management categories, and the multiplayer format means you compete directly against other people.

To begin, roll the dice and see where you land. Buy properties along the way, then collect rent to build your business empire. Each choice you make shapes how your wealth grows and how you stack up against the competition.
rotating-pomni: In this puzzle platformer, you change the stage itself. By turning the world around, you steer Pomni toward the stars he has misplaced. The game offers 40 challenge levels that put your logic to work, so each move takes some careful thought.

Grimace shows up on the board as well. The game suits younger players and doubles as a mind workout for the whole family. Its graphics are charming, and the controls respond with accuracy. Click with a mouse or tap the screen to play.
attack-super-hole: You control a hole that sits on the ground, and your goal is to swallow as many soldiers as possible before the timer runs out. Along the way, you will also take on monsters that get more dangerous as the round goes on, so you need to stay alert.

On a computer, you steer with the keyboard and attack by pressing the left mouse button. On mobile devices, joysticks handle movement, and you attack by tapping the matching button on screen. The game sits in the .io category and is tagged for mobile play.
fix-the-hoof: Fix The Hoof is a free online game about tending to animal hooves, with horses and goats among the animals you will care for. Your job is to clean, polish, and paint each hoof in a 3D setting designed to feel soothing, much like the ASMR videos it draws from. The money you earn along the way can be spent on improving your farm.

You can play on either a phone or a desktop computer, which makes it an easy choice for a quiet break. Cows are part of the mix too, so you are not limited to one kind of animal. Whether you come for the calm pace or the oddly pleasing cleanup work, the game offers a gentle way to unwind.
hugie-wugie-runner: Hugie Wugie Runner casts you as a helper for a silly creature who is about to learn how to ride a bicycle. The game opens with your character seated behind the handlebars on a bike, parked in a hilly landscape. When the start signal sounds, Hugie begins pedaling and picks up speed along the road. Keep your eyes on the screen, because he will launch over the crests of the hills and then drop down the other side. Your job is to keep him steady so he never tumbles off the bike. If he does fall, the round is lost and you have to begin the level again.
Control is simple: use the mouse or tap the touchscreen to play.
gold-miner-tower-defense: Gold Miner Tower Defense blends three styles into one game: tower defense, card-based strategy, and combat with upgrades. You play as a courageous miner whose job is to keep enemies away from the gold. Position a range of defensive towers wisely to guard your valuable haul.

Controls are simple: click with a mouse or tap the screen. Think carefully about where each tower goes, since smart placement is the key to keeping your gold safe. It suits fans of hypercasual games who enjoy strategy and tower defense.
advanture-of-tommy: Adventure of Tommy takes you through a world full of hidden traps and dangers. You play as Tommy, the main character, and must finish each level while collecting gold coins along the way. Fans of adventure, action, RPG, platform, or quest games should find plenty to enjoy, and anyone who just wants a good time is welcome too.

The game has high quality graphics and a small file size. Its controls are very simple to pick up. On Android, on-screen touch buttons move and jump your character. On a PC, use the left and right arrow keys to move and the up arrow key to jump. Along the way, you will also run into interesting quests.
draw-one-line-bridge-puzzle: Draw One Line Bridge Puzzle is a free game that asks you to think things through. Your job is to sketch bridges that carry vehicles safely across each gap. Every level brings its own tricky layout, and the ragdoll physics make the results unpredictable and fun to watch. Because it works offline, you can play whenever you like without an internet connection. It suits anyone who enjoys cars or puzzles and wants a fresh challenge to try.

To progress, you draw one single line to finish each stage. Watch out for other cars, cutters, and obstacles along the route. Avoid getting stuck on a level, since that slows you down. Handle your vehicle carefully, because any damage to the car means the attempt fails.
graveyard-wars-two-player: Two players face off in a head-to-head contest as either the Mummy or the Pumpkin King. Grab a friend, pick your character, and start hunting for floating pumpkins. Eating candy earns you coins, while catching balloons and carrying them to the treasure chest helps you gather more. The player who collects ten pumpkins the fastest takes the win.

Winning brings hats, and four different styles can be found in the shops to dress up your character. Use WASD or the arrow keys to move around. The game works on both mobile devices and PCs, so you can race from almost anywhere.
z-machine: Z Machine drops you into a bright, arcade-style world where you pilot a heavy tank against waves of undead. Your job is to wipe out the zombies, collect the cash they leave behind, and haul it back to the warehouse. Between runs, you can spend your earnings on upgrades that make your vehicle hit harder and take more punishment.

The controls are simple: just click or tap to play, so anyone can pick it up in seconds. It fits the hypercasual category and is tagged with car, survival, and zombie themes, so it's a natural pick if you enjoy vehicle combat against the undead.
wild-west-zombie-clash: This single-player 3D shooter places you in a western setting full of zombies. As a gunslinger, you fight off incoming hordes using a variety of modern weapons and grenades. Each round is a test of survival, and getting through them unlocks new guns for you to use.

Controls are simple. Use W, A, S and D to move and press Space to jump. Left click fires, while right click aims. Scroll the mouse wheel to switch weapons, press R to reload, and press G to throw a grenade. Press P to pause the game.
stickboys-xmas: StickBoys Xmas puts you in charge of a red stick boy and a blue stick boy as they celebrate the holidays. Your job is to guide the pair toward the door in a Christmas adventure that is more demanding than the usual fare. The two of them must stay alive together, so teamwork matters from start to finish.

Along the way, collect the keys and gather every candy you can find. Keep an eye out for obstacles that could slow you down. You only get through when both of you reach the door together. Move with the WASD or arrow keys, use a double jump when you need extra height, or use touch controls on mobile.
obby-prison-craft-escape: Obby Prison: Craft Escape is a survival adventure set inside a jail packed with hazards. After you are locked up, you have to deal with watchful officers, fellow inmates, and many traps scattered across the blocky grounds. Your task is to move through the tangled prison layout, slip past guards, and shut down security systems so you can break out.

Every corner of this block-built world gives you room to scout, plan, and try new tactics, and each area brings a fresh challenge. Test your survival instincts and creativity as you work toward freedom from a prison that cannot be destroyed. Move with WASD, jump with SPACE, look around with the mouse, and press P to pause.
funny-rescue-zookeeper: Today has been a rough one for Amia, a zookeeper at the zoo. Her job is to look after all the animals there, but things went badly this time, and she had a serious accident. Now the goal is to help her recover so she can get back to the animals she loves so much.

The game is responsive and works across all devices. On a computer, you click items, tools, and buttons to interact with them. On a phone or tablet, you tap the touchscreen to select options and apply your choices.
merge-13: Merge 13 is a puzzle game where you join numbered tiles to build up your score. It runs on a range of devices and blends logic with arithmetic. Your aim is to sharpen your reasoning enough to reach 13.
To combine tiles, drag two cells that share the same value so they fuse into a cell with a larger number. Keep merging to climb higher, but expect the puzzle to grow harder as the numbers get bigger.
digital-circus-parkour-game: In this 3D adventure for one player, you tackle parkour levels that are each unique. Caine has prepared these fun stages inside the circus, and your task is to escape from the Digital Circus. Keep watching for the exit, since finding it is essential. Along the way you are helping Pomni, so every track you conquer brings her closer to being saved from the circus.
Look around with the mouse or the right joystick, and move using WASD or the left joystick. Press Space or the jump button to jump. Right-click an
throttle-rivals: Weave through busy highway traffic, pick up speed boosters, and try to pass three competing drivers. You can unlock and tune 20 different cars over the course of 50 highway races, and once those are done, an endless mode lets you keep going. Your total coins earned decide where you sit on the leaderboard.

To drive, press and hold to speed up, then drag to steer. On a keyboard, keep Space or Enter held down and use A and D or the arrow keys to change lanes. Avoid other vehicles, grab boosters along the way, and aim to cross the line in first place. Coins you collect can be spent on new cars and upgrades for the ones you already own.
watermelon-fruit-2048: Watermelon Fruit 2048 is a simple, hard-to-put-down arcade puzzle. Your job is to bring two matching fruits together so they combine into the next, larger fruit. Each time a pair joins, you earn points. Click or drag fruits to any spot on the screen and let them drop onto a fruit of the same kind. When two identical fruits touch, they merge right where they meet.

The final goal is the watermelon, the biggest fruit in the game. Creating one lets you blast it and earn 1000 points. The game is played with the mouse alone, so you only need to point, click, and drag to drop each fruit.
bottle-battle: Bottle Battle is a single-player 2D puzzle game with a water theme. Each bottle holds a different volume, and every level tells you how much water you need to end up with. Your goal is to reach that required amount so the level can be cleared.

To play, click one water bottle to pour water into another. Each level sets its own required amount, so the goal changes as you move through the game. The game is hypercasual and is built for one player.
dirt-bike-trail-rider: Dirt Bike Trail Rider puts you in the saddle of a motorbike on tough, uneven off-road courses. Gas it over rocky ground, wrestle your way through bumps and jumps, and work to stay balanced while you head for the line. The game is a 3D trail-riding test built around a run of motocross stages.

Control your bike with the driving buttons shown on screen. Use them to speed up, slow down, and steer through each twisty section. Your aim is to reach the finish of every stage without tipping over.
cube-surf-online: Cube Surf Online is a hypercasual arcade game with a 3D style that runs right in your web browser. Your main aim is to grow a stack of cubes by collecting them while avoiding the walls in your way. Its tags, 3D, avoid, and collecting, sum up the core ideas well.

Steering is handled with your mouse or your finger, so the controls stay simple from the first moment you play. Each attempt is about keeping your stack growing as you dodge the walls. Its simple setup makes it an easy pick for anyone who enjoys quick arcade rounds.
prison-survive-break-escape: This survival game puts you in the middle of a prison break, where you must draw on every skill you have to stay alive in the city. You flee jail the way a crime boss would, teaming up with other inmates held in the same lockdown. Once you slip past the walls, your breakout is a success.

Think of yourself as a trained spy, ready to carry out risky operations. The controls are simple: WASD to move, Shift to run, the mouse to attack, and crouch to get low. It is a 3D action fighting game that runs right in your browser using HTML5 and WebGL, with escape and survival at its core.
fireball-and-waterball-adventure-3: Fireball and Waterball are brothers, and each has a special power. Waterball can freeze water into ice, while Fireball can set wooden materials on fire. Because they work so well together, the pair often sets off on trips side by side. This 2D adventure is made for two players, so you can team up with a friend and join them on the journey.

Controls are simple. Player one uses A and D to move left and right and W to jump. Player two has its own keys for moving and jumping. Bring a partner into the game quickly and head off on the adventure together.
snake-of-balls: Go after a serpent that looks like an easy target at first, but it quickly proves otherwise. This online multiplayer title follows the classic snake formula, with arcade-style action that also works on mobile devices. The creature picks up speed without warning and winds across the screen along unpredictable paths, so keeping track of it takes real focus.

Every slip you make gets handed to the snake as a meal, so precision matters as much as speed. Players who enjoy skill-based io games and quick reflex challenges should find plenty here to sink their teeth into. Think fast, stay sharp, and see whether you can outmaneuver the chaos.
power-ball-soccer: Power Ball Soccer gives you a top-down view of the pitch, where you can use special moves while chasing goals. The game has two modes, 16 characters, and 32 levels. Each opponent you face is stronger than the one before, so every match asks more of you. Challenge Mode offers the tougher matches, and you can unlock new characters as you keep playing.

Controls are simple. On a computer, press W to move up, A to move down, S to move left, and D to move right. Tap E to use your special ability. On mobile, drag the on-screen joystick to move in any direction, and tap the special ability control to activate it.
fat-hedgehog-boris: Fat Hedgehog Boris is a comical platformer with a clever twist: every hit Boris takes makes him fatter and changes the way he moves, so he becomes harder to control. Your goal is to run, jump, and fight your way through each level, defeating enemies and bosses while doing your best to keep Boris in good shape. Coins are there to collect, and traps are waiting for anyone who isn't paying attention.

Move left and right with the arrow keys or the on-screen controls. Press Space to jump, then press it again in mid-air to perform a downward attack. Land on enemies from above, break certain blocks, and steer clear of hazards as you make your way to the end of each level.
cake-master-shop: Cake Master Shop lets you bake the sweets you love most. Start by choosing which cake to make today, then take on challenge levels that unlock even more cakes to try. A large selection of ingredients is ready for your recipes. Add them to bowls, blend everything together, and move on to baking. You can also pick fresh fruit along the way.

More than 15 kitchen tools are available to help you turn each recipe into a sweet, tasty cake. The game is played with a mouse or by tapping, so you can start right away. Each step gives you a chance to practise your skills and see your creation come together.
offroad-truck-army-driving: Offroad Truck Army Driving takes you across rough mountain country and a range of different surroundings. You can choose from three kinds of military vehicles and tackle demanding missions spread across three separate packs. The action centers on off-road driving, with steep slopes, muddy tracks, and rocky ground standing between you and each army driving task.

Every mission pushes you to master the toughest terrain, so expect plenty of hard climbs and slippery routes. You steer and drive with the W, A, S, and D keys. It suits anyone who enjoys truck driving games with a military theme and a strong focus on off-road action.
world-of-alice-the-bones: World of Alice - The Bones is a puzzle title made for kids who want to get to know the bones of the human body. Players learn the names of the bones and where each one sits in the body, all through playful activities. It runs on a phone, a tablet, or a desktop computer, so it fits wherever your child happens to be.

Learning stays light and enjoyable throughout the game, which is part of what makes it useful for young learners. To play, look at the box with the missing bone and click the answer that matches it. Its cartoon look and cute style make studying anatomy feel like a pastime rather than homework.
zombie-virus-fps: Zombie Virus FPS is a survival shooter about fighting off a zombie outbreak. You battle through offline missions on a jungle map, and each campaign has its own difficulty level and a different number of enemies to destroy. Several game modes are available, and you can use guns from around the world.
The controls use W, A, S and D to move, and SHIFT to run. SPACE makes you jump, and TAB opens the menu. The mouse handles aiming, looking around, shooting, and changing your gun.
mystery-digger: Mystery Digger is an idle clicker in which you dig beneath the surface in search of buried treasure and tales from the past. Every click lets you improve your drill, which helps you reveal more interesting discoveries as you go. The game is relaxing to play and runs on whatever device you have at hand, so it suits quick breaks as well as longer sessions.

You play by tapping the buttons shown on screen, and this works the same way on both keyboard setups and mobile devices. Each find adds to your curiosity, so there is always another hidden item or story waiting to be uncovered below.
tung-tung-sahur-hidden-bedug: Step into a holiday-flavored search game where you hunt for objects in busy scenes. The job sounds straightforward, yet it proves trickier than it first appears. In every level, ten bedug, the traditional drums from Indonesia, are concealed among cheerful "Tung Tung" artwork that celebrates the sahur customs observed during Ramadan. Spotting them takes sharp eyes.

The visuals are bright and upbeat, and each stage grows harder than the one before. Depending on your style, you may also face a countdown, since the game can turn into a timed challenge. Controls are handled entirely with the mouse. Families and younger players looking for a Ramadan-themed evening of gaming should find it a good fit.
goodnight-my-baby: Curious about the little monsters and what their home is like after dark? This game lets you step inside their nursery once night arrives. Your job is to help a baby monster drift off to sleep.

Everything is played with a mouse click or a tap. Tags for the game are Monster and Panda, and it falls under the Action category. Settle the baby down and see the monster world at bedtime for yourself.
santa-dungeon-of-doom: Santa must find his way out of a series of dangerous dungeons in this Christmas puzzle adventure. The journey spans 100 levels filled with monsters, traps and plenty of peril. Bats swoop in to chase you, ghosts try to fool you, and monsters lurk around nearly every corner. Hazards such as spikes, guillotines, poison gas and more stand in your way.

Success calls for sharp thinking and quick reactions, since all 100 dungeons must be escaped. The game features a cute visual style, festive music and simple controls that make it easy to pick up, yet it is hard to put down. Move left with A and right with D, press W to go up, and use Space to jump. Touch controls are also available.
baby-panda-care: Many kids love make-believe, and copying mom and dad is one of their favorite kinds of pretend play. Most of them already know what it feels like to be looked after as a baby, so taking on the caring side feels natural. Trying out caregiver responsibilities lets children switch roles for a while.

In Baby Panda Care, children get to look after a cute baby panda, swapping the usual roles. Everything is controlled with a tap or a click. Parents may be pleasantly surprised by how much their little ones enjoy caring for this new arrival.
ten-link-number-games: Ten Link is a calm but mind-bending number challenge. Your goal is to empty the board by joining two numbers that match or add up to 10. Links can run across rows, columns, or diagonals, and they can also loop from the end of one line back to the start of the next. Each matching group shares its own color, so valid pairs stand out at a glance.

When you run out of moves, tap ADD to copy the leftover numbers to the end of the board and keep the chain going, or use HINT to reveal a pair. Filling an entire row makes it disappear. Choose from four difficulty modes, or join the Daily Challenge, which refreshes every day and awards monthly trophies. As you play, a level system grows your Calculation, Observation, and Focus skills. Everything works with mouse clicks or touch, so no keyboard is needed.
rolling-in-gears: Rolling In Gears is a puzzle physics platformer in which you steer a ball through a series of mechanical challenges. Your goal is to guide it to the target at the end of each stage. Much of the action depends on rotating gears and moving platforms, which you use to shape the route the ball takes. Precision and timing help you clear each obstacle.

On a desktop, press A and D or the Left and Right arrow keys to rotate the gears. On mobile devices, tap the Rotate Left and Rotate Right buttons instead. Both setups control the same gears, so the challenge stays the same either way. Take your time with each layout, because a small mistake can send the ball off course.
archery-master-castle-battle: Your archers fire from a tower as you defend the castle against an advancing army. You aim your bow carefully and must not miss, since the enemy may outnumber your troops, carry stronger weapons, and fire more destructive projectiles. Every arrow counts, so spend your shots wisely if you want to win the clash between castle and invaders.

Across the kingdoms you will face orcs, humans, monsters, and the undead. Upgrade your archers, recruit mercenaries, switch between different arrow types, and apply poisons to weaken foes. The game offers unique gameplay mechanics and simple controls, so you can focus on conquering each kingdom in turn.
home-run-infinity: Home Run Infinity is a never-ending arcade baseball game where your goal is to hit the ball as far as you can. Timing is everything. A moving marker sweeps across the playfield, and you can tap or click it, or press the Space bar, to stop the marker and swing. Stop it inside the green zone for a powerful hit. Smaller red and orange areas sometimes give rare distance multipliers.

Every hit earns coins, with one coin for each metre the ball travels. Spend those coins to unlock and equip any of 25 bats, which grow more powerful as the list goes on, or to pick from 10 distinctive fields. Then aim for the longest hit on the online leaderboard
cute-family-shopping: Cute Family Shopping is a playful shopping game made for little ones. Players wander through department stores packed with merchandise and supermarket aisles stocked with appealing food, letting babies enjoy the fun of grocery trips. Products are identified by their colors and appearance, which sharpens recognition ability. Along the way, young players learn how to sort things into categories.

One moment has players track down the baby's favorite car in the toy area, and a correct pick earns a cheerful confirmation. Another asks them to spot the area ahead, where toothbrushes and paper towels sit on the shelves, marking the daily necessities section. Through these moments, babies pick up how items are classified as they shop. More lessons are waiting inside. Use a mouse or tap to play.
sheep-sheep-duck: Sheep Sheep Duck is a casual multiplayer party game with a fresh feel. You decide how each battle plays out by mixing and matching scenarios to suit your taste. The game includes many different scenes, so every match can look and feel a little different. Tap directly on the screen to move your character flexibly. Defeat enemies to earn weapons, and build up enough strength to unlock new maps.

On a computer, use W, A, S and D to move and H, J or K to attack. On a phone or tablet, press the on-screen buttons to move and attack. Whichever setup you use, the goal is to keep pushing through tougher battles.
okay: Okay? is a stripped-back puzzler built from basic shapes that quickly become tricky. Each stage places blocks, lines, and other objects against a clean, abstract backdrop. The aim is to wipe out everything on screen with a single well-judged move. You touch the screen, drag out a line, and let go, and the line then ricochets across the board. If it lands correctly, it strikes each object until nothing remains.

Later levels demand more. Angles must be exact, timing matters, and logic plays a bigger role. Some boards are quick to solve, while others call for careful dragging and precise aim. With many levels to work through, the challenge steadily grows.
giant-rush: Giant Rush is an arcade game where you build up your strength to face a boss. Gather the people who share your color, because each one you absorb makes you stronger. Crowds in a different color will drain your power, so you must avoid them instead. Once you are strong enough, the level ends with a fight against their leader, and winning that battle completes it.
Play by dragging. Its tags point to action, collecting, avoiding and fighting, so expect a steady mix of
topbike-racing-and-moto-3d-bike-2023: Hop on your new ride in TopBike Racing & Moto 3D Bike 2023. You can race against players from around the world on trails that run through desert, swamp, and forest. Along the way you can team up with Red Bull athletes and get bikes and gear from real brands.

The story sends you racing against biker gangs that control the city. These outlaw racers, known as the 1%, live for crime and the rush of speed. They believe the best things in life are free if you take them by force, and that having fun is all that matters, though they also value power and money. Use your keyboard buttons to control your bike.
cozy-craft-co: Step into a warm 3D workshop and run your own small craft business. Stickers, postcards, pins and other handmade goods take shape through short, hands-on mini-games. As orders come in, you complete them, pack each parcel, send it off and collect the earnings. Over time you can unlock new workstations, bring in assistants and personalize your space.

Play with a mouse or a single finger. Tap the orders laptop to accept a job, pick a workstation and follow the crafting hints on screen. Spend your money on supplies and upgrades to expand the workshop. Optional rewarded videos and paid extras offer bonuses, but you can keep moving forward without spending anything.
fishdom-online: Fishdom Online is a light-hearted puzzle title that blends imagination with plenty of playful variety. Its gameplay mixes several styles, from puzzle solving and item merging to short mini-games and collecting, so each session feels fresh. Together these features keep the experience engaging from start to finish.

It suits quiet downtime as well as longer sessions, letting you unwind while sharpening your thinking. Expect a steady stream of tasks and challenges that build your planning skills and strategic judgment. Play is handled with mouse clicks or taps, so you can jump in on a computer or a touchscreen.
chu-choo-cake: Fans of cake will enjoy this one, since your job is to protect Chef Piggo's sweet creations from a gang of hungry mice. The rodents are relentless and will go to any lengths to get in the chef's way, so you need to stay alert. The game blends ideas from Pacman and Donkey Kong and is presented with a nostalgic retro look. Guide the chef through each level and send the cakes down to the bottom by standing on them. Every cake must be rescued before the level is complete, and you should steer clear of the mice along the way.
On a computer, use W, A, S and D to move and the SPACE bar to act or select. On phones and tablets, use the on-screen touch controls and buttons to move, select, and perform actions.
box-journey: Box Journey is a single-player platform game in the Action category. You guide a brave little box through a magical world, where the aim is to uncover its hidden secrets while the story unfolds around you. Each stage is packed with dangerous ledges, clever traps, and strange portals to find your way past.
Play with the keyboard arrow keys or by touching the screen. The levels are drawn with care and offer a challenge that rewards accurate jumps and movement.
jack-o-gunner: Jack-O Gunner is a casual action and survival game with a Halloween theme. Your aim is to destroy every skeleton you encounter, improve your abilities through upgrades, and keep going for as long as you can. It is a single-player 3D game set in an arena, and because it is endless, the challenge never fully stops.

The controls are easy to pick up. Tap the screen and move your finger to guide your character around. The game is available on Android, so you can take the spooky battle with you on your phone. Choose your upgrades carefully and see how long you can hold out against the skeletons.
offroad-cargo-truck-2024: Take the wheel of a 2024 offroad cargo truck as it rumbles along leafy forest tracks. The vehicle has a sophisticated suspension, tall wheels, and all-terrain tires that keep it moving over uneven ground. Steering it around twisting routes is your job, and the roomy cargo area holds the essential gear for the trip.

Everything around you is lush and green, and the quiet setting adds to the sense of adventure. Light filters through the towering trees overhead, making the woods a pleasant backdrop for off-road exploration.
besties-chinese-new-year-celebration: Besties Chinese New Year Celebration is a bright dress-up game about best friends getting ready for the Lunar New Year. Your job is to style them for the festivities, mixing traditional outfits with elegant modern looks. You can also add festive accessories inspired by Chinese New Year celebrations, so every look feels full of color and meaning.

The game is played with a left mouse click or a tap. It sits in the Girls category and carries tags such as Cute, Dress Up, and Fashion. Its focus is on tradition, friendship, and helping the characters look their best for the holiday.
pop-puzzle: Pop Puzzle is a block matching game with bright, colorful visuals and straightforward play that is easy to learn. Levels grow harder over time, so you will need to spot patterns to keep moving forward.
To play, tap any cluster of two or more blocks sharing the same color, and they will burst away. Your aim is to remove every block on the screen to complete each level.
fast-car-top-speed: Push your driving to the limit and aim for new speed records in this 3D car driving simulator. Every race is a battle against the clock, and the game offers 15 fast cars spread across 36 racetracks.

Turbo car city Stunt includes a system for buying and developing your vehicles. After each race, you can tune and personalize your car or purchase a different one. When the timer starts running low, press N to use nitro. Steer with the arrow keys or WASD, switch views with C, and pull the handbrake with Space.
parking-bike-3d-game: Bike Parking 2021 is a motorcycle parking simulator that its makers present as one of the most current and best titles of its kind. It is aimed at players who consider themselves skilled at realistic driving games. Many traditional driving simulators can feel dull and repetitive, so this one takes a fresh approach by asking you to park a bike under demanding conditions.

You ride a variety of machines, including police bikes and high-speed bikes, across different tense scenarios. Wide and heavy models are also part of the experience. The game blends racing and riding, and it is made for motorcycle fans. Tab opens the menu, WASD drives, R reverses, and C changes the camera. T resets the bike, 2 gives power acceleration, and Space applies the rear brake. Q, E, F, and V shift the rider's center of mass, and Enter restarts.
tank-arena-multiplayer: Take command of a tank in this multiplayer arena, where you can face opponents from around the world or test yourself against AI bots offering three difficulty levels. Live online matches support up to four players. Destroy your foes and collect power-ups such as Speed Boost, Shield, and Rapid Fire as you move across several arena maps. A level progression system keeps you advancing through the game.

Movement uses W, A, S, D or the arrow keys, while the mouse controls your aim. Left click fires your primary weapon and right click fires your secondary one. In the lobby, press R to get ready, and press ESC to pause. On mobile, the left joystick moves your tank and the right joystick aims it, and you can either tap the fire button or let auto-fire trigger while you
baby-sitter-merge-2: You step into the shoes of a young mother who is caring for a restless baby in this relaxing, colorful puzzle game. Your goal is to connect tiles and decorate the nursery while you keep the little one settled.

Two identical tiles can be joined when a route between them is clear. That route moves cell by cell, either to a neighboring column in the same row or to a neighboring row in the same column, and it may even travel outside the playing field. Any cell that still holds a tile blocks the route. To make a connection, click one tile and then click its partner.
vehicle-transport-police-simulator: Take the wheel of a range of machines in this driving title, including buses, jeeps, and heavy trucks. Your job is to carry soldiers to the places they need to be. Each run brings tough missions set across varied ground, and the driving feels grounded and true to life. Expect plenty of obstacles along the way, so you will need sharp judgment to get the troops there safely and on time. Throughout, you also help keep order while everyone is on the move.
Controls are simple: use W, A, S, and D to steer and drive.
impossible-cargo-track: Impossible Cargo Track puts you behind the wheel of a powerful cargo truck on a course that seems almost impossible to finish. It is regarded as one of the top truck driving games of the year. Your biggest hurdle is taking corners, since the vehicle is huge and every bend becomes a real test of control.

Balance matters just as much. Various cargo items are loaded in the back, and if the truck loses its balance, those goods may be destroyed. Use WASD or the arrow keys to play, and work carefully through each difficult stretch.
africa-jeep-race: Take the wheel and speed across rough, dusty tracks through Africa. The game features 12 separate racing routes, and you can compete against a friend or against the computer. Coins earned from races let you unlock different Safari Jeeps, while the gold you hold can be spent on new cars. To bring in a second driver, switch on Player 2 from the vehicle selection screen.

Controls are simple. Player 1 moves with W, A, S and D and uses power-ups with T. Player 2 moves with the arrow keys and triggers power-ups with P. A buddy can join in whenever you are ready, so pick your ride and head out on the road.
magnet-master-3d: You pilot a heavy industrial magnet and tidy up a scrapyard. Pick up loose metal pieces, haul them to the sell zone, and convert each load into money. Every trip adds to your earnings.

Spend your cash on upgrades to power, range, capacity, and value so the magnet can lift heavier items and pay out bigger rewards. New areas open as you progress, and some scrap is worth more than the rest. On a computer, steer with WASD or the arrow keys. On a phone or tablet, a virtual joystick does the job. Sell first, then upgrade, and boost power whenever you need to lift something bulkier. Keep improving until nothing feels too heavy to collect.
mushroomtarzan: Dive into the leafy jungle canopy in this one-player 3D hypercasual game starring Tarzan, the vine-swinging hero. You guide him across a dangerous landscape of huge mushrooms, hopping from one giant cap to the next while staying clear of the water below. Each leap tests your timing and agility as you move through the treetops.

As you progress, the mushrooms get smaller and harder to reach, so accuracy and quick reflexes become essential. Keep an eye out for mischievous monkeys, swooping birds, and other wild creatures sharing the jungle. Steer Tarzan by swiping with your mouse.
space-strike-galaxy-shooter: Space Strike: Galaxy Shooter is an action-packed arcade game centered on intense combat in space. You take on the role of a skilled pilot whose job is to protect planets from alien threats. The game is free to enjoy online, and its battles are built to be thrilling from start to finish.
On a computer, the arrow keys steer your ship, the up arrow gives you gas, Alt fires your
secret-parkour: Secret Parkour is an adventure built around Tower of Hell style obstacle climbing, full of hidden extras. You leap across lava while working through regions that range from easy to extremely demanding. A waterfall conceals secret platforms, and jumping into it leads to a hidden chamber with coins and trophies. Collect enough trophies and a secret wall opens, granting access to a new portal and a unique character skin.
moving-balls-going-sphere: Moving Balls - Going Sphere is a 3D arcade game where you steer a rolling ball across slopes, narrow tracks and tricky platforms. Balance matters, since one wrong move can send your ball tumbling off the edge. Jumps can carry you high into the air, and you must dodge obstacles while racing to the finish line as fast as you can.

Dozens of levels await, each packed with unique ramp puzzles. Swipe left or right to balance and move, grab power-ups, and look for hidden shortcuts. Your journey passes through varied worlds, from forest trails to futuristic sky cities. Smooth, realistic physics and a mix of puzzle-solving and racing put your reflexes, timing and precision to the test, and new levels unlock as you progress.
crusher-block: Crusher Block is an idle game centered on smashing blocks. Each strike brings in money, which you can spend on upgrading your tools. Your goal is to grow a humble setup into a machine built for crushing resources.

Controls rely on the left mouse button, which lets you interact with objects and interface elements. To work the pickaxe, hold the mouse over it and move the cursor. The game belongs to the Clicker and Idle categories, with tags for Blocks and Easy.
zombie-strike-2: You find yourself boxed in on a farmstead packed with the undead. Your aim is to last through five rounds of attackers, and each round gets tougher than the one before. A large selection of firearms is at your disposal, letting you cut down the hordes rushing toward you. Stay alive through every wave and you will complete the mission.

Controls are simple. Use W, A, S and D to get around, and the left mouse button to fire. Scroll the mouse wheel to switch weapons, press R to reload, tap C to crouch, and hit Space to jump. Press P whenever you need to pause the action.
robot-fighting-adventure: Robot Fighting Adventure is packed with challenges built around robot combat. Every bout is a meeting of hard metal and raw force, but it also rewards smart thinking as much as power. You step into the role of a robot warrior, wandering the map and unlocking new levels as you go.

Getting started is easy, since a mouse click or a tap is all the game asks of you. Whether you prefer a mouse or a touchscreen, you can jump straight into the action and keep moving through the stages.
match-story-animals: Match Story: Animals is a 3D puzzle game built around adorable animal objects. Your job is to spot three identical pieces, select them, and line them up together so they vanish from the board. The gameplay feels smooth, and the bright, colorful visuals make each stage easy on the eyes. With hundreds of levels to work through, puzzle fans can spend hours on it.

Boosters and power-ups help you clear tiles more quickly, so planning ahead matters when stages get tough. Keep an eye on the clock, since each level must be finished before time runs out. As you advance, you collect rewards and open new challenges. It suits casual players of every age.
stick-duel-battle: Stick Duel Battle is a silly, wild game where stickmen clash in combat. The weapons and physics feel believable, so every fight plays out in a grounded way. Battles take place on many maps, and each one calls for a different approach, so you'll need to adjust how you play from one to the next.
You can take on the game alone or team up with a friend in a two-player match. The first fighter to reach 5 points wins. Player 1 uses the arrow keys and L, while Player 2 uses WASD and F.
mini-grand-thef-city: Mini Grand Thef City is a free adventure game inspired by the well-known GTA series, but set in a minimalist world. You roam the streets on foot, walking or running as you like, and you can attack passersby to raise the money needed to construct new buildings. The city gives you the freedom to slip into homes or shops, take furniture, or sell those items to earn more cash for your next build.
The game runs in your favorite browser and can be enjoyed on whatever device you prefer. Controls are simple: use your mouse or touch the screen to move around and interact with the world.
mr-drifter-car-chase-simulator: Mr. Drifter: Car Chase Simulator drops you into a messy, low-poly city where you must keep your car moving fast. Weave past police, traffic, and total destruction as you try to get away. Grab power-ups mid-chase, such as Slow-Mo, Freeze, and EMP Blasts, to escape situations that seem impossible. Smash through obstacles and roadblocks, and unlock wild getaway cars as you go.

The world has a stylized look and a tilted top-down view, and the cops never run out. The one rule is simple: never stop. On a computer, steer with WASD or the Arrow Keys, collecting power-ups and dodging obstacles to stay alive. On a touch device, use the on-screen touch controls to steer.
neko-s-adventure: Meet Neko, a lively cat on a mission to rescue his girlfriend in this platform adventure. The journey includes 20 demanding stages, and once you unlock the Power Beam, Neko can shoot blasts of fire at the unusual creatures blocking his path. Expect a quick pace and a playful, cartoonish world throughout.

The controls are easy to learn. On a computer, use the left and right arrow keys to move, the up arrow to jump, and the spacebar to shoot fire. On a phone or tablet, use the touch screen buttons instead.
zip-me-up-halloween: Zip Me Up Halloween is a free, playful clicker with a Halloween theme. Your goal is simple: click the zippo lighter and discover what you are going to get for the holiday. It has a funny, crazy feel and is tagged as an arcade game that works on Android and HTML5.

Controls are easy because you only need your mouse or a tap on the screen. Each click keeps the fun going as you find out what Halloween surprise comes next. It makes a light, silly break for anyone in the mood for a seasonal laugh.
superhero-transform-change-race: Step into a racing game where you play a hero on the move. Your job is to run the course and transform as you go. The track is challenging, and each transformation lets you become a different superhero. Use their special abilities to dodge obstacles and pass your rivals.
To play, just click the mouse or tap the screen. Keep transforming, keep running, and aim to get ahead of the other racers.
city-rescue-forklift-simulator: You take the controls of a city rescue forklift in this 3D simulation game. Each mission sends you through crowded urban streets, where you transport damaged cars, answer emergency calls, and deliver every vehicle safely before the clock runs out. Steering is designed to feel realistic, and helpful map guidance points you toward your next goal. Across ten varied levels, the game blends driving, parking, transport, and rescue action.

Movement uses W, A, S, and D or the arrow keys. Press S or the down arrow to brake, hold Space for the handbrake, and use Shift for a speed boost. Press C to change the camera view, and follow the map to find your route. Touch controls are also available on mobile devices.
crowdgate: CrowdGate is a quick runner that tests both your reflexes and your planning. Your stickmen keep moving forward on their own, so your job is to steer them through the right gates, grow your group, and reach the big showdown waiting at the end of the road. The levels are bright and constantly shifting, and each session is short and lively.

Move left or right by dragging with your mouse or pressing the A and D keys. Passing through number gates adds to your crowd, while hitting obstacles costs you part of your army. Choosing which number gates to take adds a layer of strategy. When you enter an enemy zone, the bigger crowd always comes out on top. It runs instantly and for free in your browser.
yarn-factory: Sort colorful yarn in this calm three-dimensional puzzle. Tapping a basket sends its bobbins out onto the moving conveyor belt. Your goal is to gather three bobbins of the same shade into the target basket shown at the top of the screen. Blockers stand in the way, so you will need to clear them as you go. Watch the belt closely, because if too many unmatched bobbins build up on it, the round ends.

When you get stuck, you can call on four boosters: Undo, Shuffle, Picker, and Extra Basket. The game includes more than 160 handcrafted levels, each one offering a fresh arrangement of yarn to untangle. Everything is controlled with a tap or a click.
defenders-of-the-realm-an-epic-war: In this pixel-style arcade strategy game, you lead a group of knights and give them orders to protect your realm from monster attacks. An enemy force, full of strong creatures and magic spells, has already begun killing your people. Your job is to strengthen your defenses, build new units, and beat back your foes so you can remain king.

Set in a grim age of war, the battles are fought with troops you place around your castle. Enemies march in from the right, and they can arrive along any of five lines, so you need to watch every path. Keep your forces well positioned and hold firm against the deadly clash ahead.
archer-super-hero: Help an archer make his way across Monster Valley, where he runs into many different challenges. In every stage, your goal is to collect all of the stars. Archer Hero is a 2D side-scroller built in the same style as blockbuster games such as Super Mario, Donkey Kong and Sonic. Across its 30 levels, you will face plenty of tests that take real effort to beat.

The artwork is bright, colorful and very pleasing to look at. You control the archer with the keyboard: press D to run right, A to run left, and W to jump. Press K to attack. It is a single-player game with a strong focus on action and attacking from start to finish.
cowboys-duel: The rugged Wild West is the setting here, and precise aiming and fast reflexes make all the difference. You can take on solo missions or challenge friends to head-to-head showdowns. Customize your own cowboy, try the different game modes, and sharpen your skills as you work toward becoming the top gunslinger.

Start by opening the game from the menu. Click whenever you want to fire. Keep an eye on the clock, since you should shoot when it reaches 12, and firing early means you lose. Before time runs out, click the arrows to turn them in the direction shown. Take out 20 targets within the time limit, and the first player to score 3 wins.
vehicle-parking-master-3d: Vehicle Parking Master 3D is a demanding, lifelike parking simulator. Its 3D Challenge and Parking Mode modes test your driving, and the harder stages add a truck to handle. Each mode has 40 levels to work through. Finishing all three modes unlocks a secret mode to discover. Take your time, drive with care, and guide your vehicle into the parking area.

On a computer, use WASD or the arrow keys to move, and use the mouse or drag the screen to switch views. On mobile, press the gas pedal to move forward, press the brake pedal to stop or reverse, and hold the arrow buttons to steer left or right.
truck-cross-country: Take the wheel of a Jeep truck in this 3D racing simulation. Your goal is to pass through every checkpoint on each level, and the challenge continues across all of the stages. Steer and move your vehicle with the W, A, S and D keys.

Driving off the road and into the river is the main hazard, but you are given one free respawn. If you fall in, you return to the spot where you would otherwise have lost the game, and you can keep going from there.
mr-and-mrs-santa-christmas-adventure: The holiday season is almost here, and Mr. and Mrs. Santa are busy getting ready for the festivities. Sadly, Santa has been caught in an accident. He and his pet were badly hurt, and his sleigh was completely wrecked.
Your task is to help Santa and his pet recover quickly, so he can travel around the globe and bring his Christmas presents to children everywhere. The game is played with mouse clicks or taps.
telekinetic-pumpkin: This arcade game starts with a lab experiment meant to grow a huge pumpkin for Halloween, but it goes sideways and produces a pumpkin with psychic abilities. You play as that pumpkin, which can blink from one spot to another and shove objects around using only its mind. Smash drones to destroy them, and grab power-ups to keep yourself in the fight.

To teleport, double-click a location. To move something, click and hold it, then drag. Boxes, enemies, and power-ups can all be handled this way. Every 35 seconds, you receive a randomly chosen upgrade or ability, so choose carefully and aim to survive as long as you can.
car-makeup: In Car Makeup, you never take the wheel. Instead, you dress up a car by picking parts that match the style shown for each level. When you finish decorating, the game works out the score on its own. You face an opponent too, and whoever ends with the higher score wins.
Controls are simple: you tap to play, which makes it a good fit for kids and mobile devices. It sits in the puzzles category and carries the tags car, click, and platform.
nightmare-2d-shooters: Step into the boots of a hardworking builder whose job is to protect a red monster truck from a swarm of many-eyed alien monsters. This side-scrolling shooter sends hideous creatures your way, and your only answer is a minigun that breathes fire. Stay alive as long as you can, grab destructive power-ups, and dodge the dense curtains of bullets that fill the screen.

Moving your hero is simple. Use A and D or the left and right arrow keys to run, and press Space to jump. Fire forward with J, or aim upward with I. Keep the monsters away from your truck and see how long you can last in this arcade-style test of endurance.
monster-trucks-sky-stunts: Monster Trucks Sky Stunts is a racing game built around daring driving in the air. Huge trucks rev up, launch off enormous ramps, and travel across the sky before touching down with force. Once airborne, you can pull off flips, spins, and other mid-air tricks, so you need to balance quick speed with careful control. The game puts strain on both the machines and the people behind the wheel, and the show is meant to keep onlookers on the edge of their seats.

To drive, use the W, A, S, and D keys. Each jump is a chance to test your timing and try to land every trick cleanly. Whether you are going for flips or simply enjoying the jumps, the game asks for both bold moves and precise ste
rocketcar-cup: Rocketcar Cup is a quick 2D arcade soccer game in which cars powered by rockets compete. You can boost, leap, do flips, and pull off mid-air moves to hit impressive shots in one-on-one duels or team games. Success depends on timing, skill, and planning, since you need to outmaneuver rivals, guard your net, and climb to the top. It is simple to pick up but takes practice to perfect, and the action keeps going for players of every age.
Steer with the virtual joystick, or use W, A, S, and D, or the Arrow Keys. Tap the blue button or press Shift to boost, and hit the yellow button or press Q to perform a Hard Hit.
pirate-block-craft-monster-shooter: Pirate Block Craft Monster Shooter is a survival shooter that promises encounters unlike most games of its kind. It takes place in the Block Craft world, where your characters have been stranded on a treacherous river. The surroundings are full of monsters, and nothing about them feels certain.

Among the threats are Bambam and Chuu Chuu, sinister, bloodthirsty creatures that never stop hunting every survivor. You shoot your way through the danger to stay alive. Controls are simple: click the mouse or tap the screen to play.
coin-color-sort: Coin Color Sort is a calm puzzle game built around matching colors. Its gentle pace makes it a good choice for unwinding, and the many stages give your mind something to focus on. Fans of classic sorting titles such as Coin Sort or Ball Sort should feel right at home. Beyond being a pleasant pastime, the game also works your brain as you plan each move.

Your goal is to sort the colorful coins into neat stacks. Tap a coin and drag it to a new spot, but remember only coins sharing its color can be moved, and only one color can travel at a time. A coin may rest on another only when both match, so
flap-hero: Flap Hero is a single-player 2D arcade game inspired by the well-known Flappy Bird. Your job is to steer your character through challenging red pipes, where good timing and quick reflexes make all the difference. The game is simple to pick up, yet getting good at it takes real practice.

Controls are straightforward. On a phone or tablet, tap the touchscreen to flap. On a computer, press the spacebar instead. Keep your hero in the air, dodge every obstacle, and enjoy this endless clicker-style challenge.
car-park-simulator: Car Park Simulator is a hypercasual title that challenges how well you handle a car behind the wheel. Across 72 levels, you weave around obstacles and slide into cramped gaps, aiming to bring your vehicle into the marked target space. Blending arcade action with simulation, it rewards careful, precise steering.

Controls are straightforward. Use the cursor keys to move and steer, or tap the on-screen buttons to guide the car. Either way, the objective stays the same: park accurately in the target spot on every level.
princesses-of-quadrobics: Step into the world of current fashion with "Princesses of Quadrobics." Two lovely princesses, Eliza and the Little Mermaid, need your help putting together striking looks for Quadrobics sessions. Start by applying soft yet bold makeup to each girl and styling her hair into a cozy hairdo. Next, pick outfits, jewelry, and accessories to finish the outfits. The fun doesn't stop there: place animal-shaped masks on the princesses, since that's a must-have element of the Quadrobics trend. Control everything with a mouse click on a computer or a simple tap on a touch screen.
flag-coloring-puzzle: Flag Coloring Puzzle is an educational game that also tests your memory. As you work through hundreds of national flags, you'll put your geography knowledge to the test. The screen has a tidy, bright cartoon style that keeps the focus on the flags.

Each round, check the country name shown at the top of the screen. Choose the correct colors from the palette below the flag, then tap the empty sections to fill them in. You need to color the flag accurately to move up to the next level.
doodle-halloween-momo-cat-sea-magic: In this spooky Halloween doodle game, you guide Momo, a brave magical cat, beneath the waves to protect sea life and drive away mischievous ghosts. It continues her school adventure from the first game, and this time the ghosts have followed her underwater, hiding inside jellyfish, anglerfish, and other sea creatures. Your job is to sketch the shapes you see so Momo can cast spells that send them packing.

Each ghost shows one or more symbols above its head, and you need to draw them quickly and accurately before the ghost reaches Momo. You can draw with a mouse on a computer or with your finger on a touchscreen. As you dive into deeper zones, ghosts appear faster and in greater numbers, and each stage ends with a boss ghost that may require a long chain of symbols or repeated spells. The bright, colorful ocean and cute ghosts make it a playful choice for anyone who enjoys magic.
gravity-speed-run: Gravity Speed Run puts you in charge of a small character that runs along a track while you flip gravity to keep moving. Each tap sends your robot-like runner to the top or bottom surface, and you need to dodge deadly spikes and other traps along the way. A single hit ends the run and sends you back to the start of the level, so timing matters.
As you progress, the levels grow tougher, with more obstacles appearing and the speed increasing. Completing levels earns you coins, which you can use to unlock new skins for your robot avatar.
crazy-sheep: Crazy Sheep is a puzzle-platformer in which a bumbling sheep needs your help to get past barriers. Your job is to construct a bridge out of different objects so the animal can reach the far side. Its physics challenges are engaging. The game is free to play in a web browser, and it runs on whatever device you have. It suits people who prefer relaxed, lighthearted titles.

Playing well is not simple. You need quick reflexes and plenty of patience, since the bridge has to be built with care. Keep in mind that the sheep is quite awkward on its feet. Even a slight bump or uneven section on the bridge will stop it from crossing, so every piece has to sit just right.
penguin-adventure-2: Step into a 2D world as a penguin racing toward the castle at the end of every level. Across three worlds, you will meet different challenges and surprises, and you control every action the penguin takes. Collect stars and hearts along the way, since they affect your score and the rewards you earn. Yellow stars matter most, because you need enough of them to unlock the next world.

The controls are simple. On PC, the Up and Down arrow keys make the penguin jump and move down, and the J key throws bullets. On mobile, tap the buttons to move. The game tests both your reactions and your strategy, so plan each jump carefully as you head for the castle.
marvelous-girl-skate: Marvelous Girl Skate is an arcade game that puts you in charge of a fashionable superhero-style heroine gliding on futuristic skates. Pull off stunts that seem to mock gravity, dodge hazards along the way, and grab boosts to keep your speed up. Colorful races let you test your moves against others, and as you progress you can open new upgrades for your skates and character.

Set on ice and centered on skating, this adventure keeps the focus on girls and fast-paced arcade fun. Your goal is to work your way up until you are crowned the top skating champion. To play, simply click to interact with the
tile-farm-story: Tile Farm Story is an adventure built around collecting chips, and it takes familiar mahjong ideas and gives them a fresh feel. Your puzzle skills get plenty of use across hundreds of levels, while the tale of the Stone sisters unfolds with unexpected turns. Travel through bright locations from far-off corners of the world, meet playful animals with lively personalities and silly animations, and use helpful boosters when you get stuck.

The aim is to spot matching chips on the board and pick them up. Each chip you collect lands in the row of cells below the field. Three identical chips in those cells clear away, but if every cell fills up, the level is lost. To finish a level, remove every chip from the playing field. Controls are simple: just touch or click.
motorbike-drive: Motorbike Drive is a playful driving game in which you pick one of four different settings and ride one of three motorcycles. Steering is handled with the W, A, S and D keys. It sits in the racing category and is built with WebGL, so it runs in 3D right in your browser.
