Each ride gives you a chance to switch between the bikes and the environments before you head out. Whether you prefer a quick spin or a longer session, the mix of locations and vehicles keeps things varied. Everything you need is controlled from the keyboard, so there is nothing complicated to learn before you start.
red-and-blue-stickman-spy-puzzles: This action puzzle title casts you as a blue stickman on a bold adventure, with archery as your main tool. In every level, red monsters stand in your way, and your job is to defeat them. Use your agility to dodge enemies and look for chances to strike back.
Your archery is the key to each victory. You must keep adjusting your arrow's angle and distance until you hit the red monster. To play, just click with a mouse or tap the screen.
mole-dig-clicker: Guide a little mole on its tunneling trip toward the center of the world. This idle clicker rewards every press, since each tap knocks loose a chunk of soil. The dirt you collect pays for upgrades, so your digger gradually picks up better pickaxes, drills, and a larger cart.

Tapping is the main action: click or touch the ground to dig. Upgrades sit along the bottom of the screen and cover stronger taps, automatic digging, and extra room in the cart. Progress saves on its own, and the mole keeps mining even while you are away, so your earnings are waiting when you return.
pop-balloon: Pop Balloon is a quick arcade shooter that rewards both accuracy and fast reactions. Your job is to pop as many balloons as you can with a set of spikes that bounce around the play area. The goal is easy to grasp but hard to put down: line up your shot, release the spikes, and try to burst every balloon spread across the screen.

Aiming and launching are the core actions here. You choose the angle and timing of each launch so the spikes strike the balloons and bounce off to reach more of them. Each round tests how well you can plan a shot and react quickly when the screen gets busy.
chicken-and-crow-shoot: Chicken and Crow Shoot draws on the spirit of old-school bird hunting titles, but places the action in a contemporary first-person shooting arena. You can take down crows with either a pistol or a sniper gun, and the game is easy to learn. Each session combines target shooting adventure with animal hunting missions.

Left-click to fire, right-click to aim, and roll the scroll wheel to switch weapons. Press R to reload. Whether you prefer quick pistol shots or slower, more careful sniper aiming, the controls keep things simple to follow.
help-police: Help Police is a logic puzzle in which you lead a squad of officers trying to stop a thief from breaking out of jail. Every move needs careful thought, since one wrong step could let the crook slip away. A fresh officer joins your team every 10 levels, so the challenge builds as you progress. Look one step ahead and take your time with each decision.

The goal is to corner the thief by positioning your police so that the criminal has no free squares left to move to. Click a policeman to reveal where he can go, then click one of the highlighted spots to carry out the move. It is a single-player, turn-based game.
stickman-troll-thief-puzzle: Stickman Troll Thief Puzzle is a casual puzzle game full of silly moments and levels that are hard to put down. You guide a clever stickman who must sneak off with his target items, and he has many funny ways to get the job done.

The game world is rich and varied, packed with unexpected obstacles and traps that test your intelligence and logical thinking. Every level is a unique challenge, so you never quite know what waits next. Controls are simple: just click the mouse or tap the screen to play.
jumper: Climb ever higher in JUMPER, a relaxed arcade platformer where you hop from one platform to the next and reach dizzying heights. Chase new high scores, pick up special bonuses, and steer clear of tricky traps while enjoying sharper, upgraded visuals. You can also gather charming outfits for your character and unlock achievements along the way.

There is no rush, so move at an easy pace. On a computer, press A or the left arrow to move left, and D or the right arrow to move right. You can also click the left or right half of the screen to move in that direction. On a smartphone, tap the left half of the screen to move left and the right half to move right.
gears-of-war-beat-em-up: This fan-made arcade beat em up draws on the Gears of War universe. Across five chapters, you fight through enemies with a chain of melee combos, switch to a chainsaw when enemies get close, and fire the Lancer when you need range. Active reloads add a timing element to your combat.

Tagged as action, adventure, arcade, brawl, and fight, this game keeps its controls simple. A mouse click or a tap on a touch screen is all you need to get started, so it works well on a desktop or a touch device.
desert-city-stunt: Step behind the wheel in this driving simulation set in a desert city. Your goal is to finish six levels before the clock runs out. Each level you clear unlocks a new car and makes you more powerful for the challenges ahead. Armored vehicles let you roll over obstacles that would stop lighter cars, so you can push through rough terrain.

If you would rather skip the countdown, Free Driving mode lets you pull off stunts with no time pressure. Player 1 steers with the arrow keys, uses N for nitro, and presses B to look back. Player 2 drives with W, A, S, and D, uses T for nitro, and presses C to look back. Press R to respawn.
zombies-vs-special-forces: Step into the boots of a special forces soldier in this online third-person shooter. Your job is to sweep an area and wipe out every zombie hiding within it. Three difficulty settings are on offer, so both newcomers and seasoned shooters can find a challenge that suits them. You can roam through the levels with complete freedom.
Movement uses the keyboard: press W to advance, S to retreat, A to step left, and D to step right. Your aim follows the mouse cursor, and a click of the left mouse button fires at the undead.
not-before-bed-01: Not Before Bed 01 is a 3D matching puzzle and the first entry in a series of separate little games. Tap or click a monster that is currently available. On its own, it gathers blocks that share its color. Once it has collected three, it leaves and frees up a collection slot.

Your goal is to clear every block from the board to finish it, and planning which monster to choose and when is where the logic comes in. Each game in the series is different, but they all share the same idea: it is easy to keep playing just a little longer.
cube-arena-2048-merge-numbers: Cube Arena 2048 Merge Numbers combines the movement of Snake with the number-merging idea of 2048, all within a 3D io setting. You guide your piece around the arena, gathering loose blocks to raise your value. You can also swallow other players whose numbers are lower than yours.

When two of your blocks with matching values collide, they join into a single block worth the sum of both. Keep sliding, picking up pieces, and pairing up identical numbers to grow larger over time. Stay alert to rivals with higher numbers, since those can overtake you.
restaurant-tycoon: Grow a small eatery into a profitable business in this tycoon-style clicker. You open new kitchens, upgrade your equipment, and cook food faster. Chefs, waiters, and skilled managers can take over routine tasks and lift your income. Every department can be improved as you decide where your earnings go.

Pick the upgrades that raise your working speed and income, then improve your elevator, delivery system, and customer service over time. Managers handle food production for you, and their abilities along with temporary boosts help coins arrive faster. Diamonds unlock extra bonuses and quicker progress. Your restaurant keeps earning while you are away, and when you return, you can collect the accumulated income and reinvest it in further upgrades.
the-cargo: This single-player 2D driving game puts you in charge of a crane that loads cargo onto a truck. Once the load is ready, you drive to the destination warehouse to deliver it. Finishing each job quickly unlocks achievements and earns money, which you can put toward upgrading your truck.

On a computer, use the arrow keys or W, A, S and D to move the crane and drive the truck, then press the spacebar to attach or detach the cargo. On a phone or tablet, on-screen buttons handle both the crane and the truck. The game runs in your browser and is also set up for Android devices.
logical-ball-escape: Roll a ball toward its exit door with the help of a box in this physics-based puzzle. Each level asks you to reason through how objects push, drop, and balance against one another. Keep the ball from falling, because a single slip means game over.

Fans of logic games and mind games should feel right at home, and anyone who just wants a good time will find plenty to enjoy. The visuals are crisp and detailed, yet the small file size keeps things light and easy on your device. Controls are simple to learn: touch and tap the screen on Android, or left-click to tap on a PC. Engaging quests keep each new challenge fresh.
bounce-heroes: Bounce Heroes mixes together an idle RPG, a merge puzzle, and roguelite action. Your hero takes on savage monsters, a wicked empire, and old beasts while chasing loot and triumph. You fight with a dependable crossbow and with enchanted bouncing balls that fallen enemies leave behind, and you push through one wave of foes after another.

To play, collect balls by defeating enemies, then combine them on the grid to build stronger ones. Your reward is a valuable prize that you uncover by digging. Touch controls work on phones and tablets, and a mouse works just as well on a computer.
santa-soosiz: In this game you guide Santa through a world that appears to revolve around him. Gravity keeps his character clinging to the ground, so you can use that pull to your advantage and move from one platform to the next. Your task is to collect every missing gift and save Christmas.

This Christmas-themed title combines adventure and puzzle play across levels. Controls are straightforward: press W or Space to jump, A to move left, and D to move right. Touch controls are also available, so the game works on mobile devices too.
bridge-dash: Sketch a path across the gap and watch your little car roll toward the finish. In Bridge Dash, the physics puzzle centers on drawing the bridge yourself so your vehicle crosses without tumbling off. Every level presents a fresh layout, so you will need to dodge hazards and think creatively to work out a route that succeeds.

Mouse controls work on PC, laptop, and desktop computers, while touch controls are used on mobile devices. No matter which device you use, the goal stays the same: build a bridge that carries your car safely to the finish line.
slender-zombie-time: You find yourself lost in a cold, zombie-infested forest with one clear objective: locate the Slender Man and kill him. This 3D shooter is built for a single player, and expect plenty of action as you battle the undead.
Move around with W, A, S and D, and press the left mouse button to fire. Scroll the mouse wheel to change weapons, tap R to reload, and hit Space to jump. If you need a break, press P to pause.
3d-triple-match: Sort through a cluttered heap of colorful 3D objects in this puzzle that tests how well you notice and organize. Your goal is to find matching pieces and clear every target shown at the top before the countdown runs out. Smooth animations and natural-feeling physics make each move flow, and hundreds of levels keep the challenge growing.

The 3D items include toys, food, animals, and everyday household objects. Each round works your memory, focus, and ability to recognize shapes, which makes it a mental workout for players of every age. Tap three identical items to send them into the bottom tray, where they combine and vanish on their own. If every slot fills with mismatched items, the game ends. It runs offline, so you can take a short pause for your mind wherever you are.
rainbow-ice-cream-and-popsicles: Rainbow Ice Cream and Popsicles is a cooking and decorating game for anyone who loves frozen sweets. It covers a range of treats, including popsicles, ice cream bars, ice cream sandwiches, and other frozen desserts. Soft serve and the ice cream truck are part of the theme too, and the game draws on dessert recipes for its cooking fun.

You play with a mouse or by tapping the screen, so it works on both computers and touch devices. It suits kids and anyone who enjoys making desserts from start to finish. The focus is on the process itself, so take your time and enjoy each step of preparing your frozen creations.
1-grass-cutting-become-stronger: In this arcade adventure, you cut grass with a cutter to build up your strength and grow more powerful over time. Mow through wide fields, collect the loot you find, and sell it to earn money. With that money, you can buy new cutters and upgrade your stats. When you are ready, you can reincarnate to gain powerful bonuses and start a new run even stronger.

Your aim is to become the strongest and fully clear all the fields. On PC, use W, A, S, D or the arrow keys to move your character, and use the mouse to rotate the camera. On mobile, a virtual joystick moves the character, swiping the right side of the screen controls the camera, and a jump button helps you clear obstacles.
blast-ultra-block: Blast Ultra Block is a bright, colorful take on block puzzles. Grab a piece from the tray and drag it onto the board with your mouse or finger. Fill an entire row or column to wipe it away, and clear several lines in a row or across consecutive moves to build combos that rack up larger scores.

Adventure mode gives you levels with goals for points, lines, or gems, and you can earn up to three stars on each one. You can also choose Classic, Time Rush, Bomb Squad, Mini 6x6, or Giant 10x10. A round ends once no remaining piece fits. Three boosters help you out: Bomb clears a 3x3 area, New set replaces your pieces, and Undo takes back a move. Keyboard players can press 1 to 3 to pick a piece, use the arrow keys to move it, and press Enter to place it. Unlockable block skins, board themes, and blast effects add variety, and a daily gift and lucky wheel spin are available too. The soundtrack is "Cosmic Star" by JDSherbert.
brain-master-iq-challenge-2: Brain Master IQ Challenge 2 is a puzzle title built to make you think hard. Your mind gets a workout through parking tasks, line-connecting problems, and a range of different puzzle tests. Certain challenges may ask you to bend the usual rules and approach things from unexpected angles, so expect to pause and reconsider more than once.

The game is simple to pick up, and many players find it hard to put down. When you have a spare moment or feel restless, it works well as a quick way to pass the time. Controls are straightforward: just click or tap to get started.
army-bus-driving-2024: In this military transport simulator, you take the wheel of tough, all-terrain army buses. Your job is to carry soldiers and equipment through dangerous areas, whether you're crossing deserts or making your way through mountains. You'll need to keep to tight schedules while dealing with demanding conditions along the way.

The game uses realistic physics and highly detailed military vehicles, and it offers a range of different missions to complete. It aims to give an authentic feel for the pressures of moving army supplies by road. Drive with the W, A, S, and D keys.
car-stunt-ramp-challenge: Take the wheel of high-speed cars in this racing game built around stunt driving. Your task is to steer through steep ramps and obstacle courses that push your skills to their limit. Along the way you can attempt a range of tricks, from high-flying jumps to complex flips, across colorful and dynamic surroundings.

Timing and precision matter here, because each challenge is a race against the clock. The physics are realistic, which keeps every jump and landing grounded. Control is simple: use the W, A, S, and D keys to drive. Whether you love stunt driving or simply enjoy a tough course, this game offers plenty of ramps to tackle.
dino-merge-island: Dino Merge Island is a relaxed puzzle game played on an angled, isometric board. Tap a nest or a bush to produce eggs and plants, though each tap uses one energy. Drag three matching dinosaurs together to evolve them into rarer species. The game features six egg types, twelve dinosaurs and seventeen plants to discover, and tapping an egg twice hatches it.

Keep an eye out for glowing orders. Tapping one delivers it for cash and stars, and you can spend both to restore five prehistoric islands, one chapter at a time. Higher levels make better drops more likely. You can also compete on the Fossil Rush and Richest Players leaderboards. It works with a mouse or touch, using taps and drags.
crazy-driver: Crazy Driver puts you behind the wheel of blocky, three-dimensional vehicles that you can tune to suit your style. Your task is to smash through massive walls, collect rewards, and speed through wild stages until you earn a reputation as a true demolition driver.

On a computer, the Up Arrow or W accelerates, and the Down Arrow or S reverses. The Left and Right Arrows or A and D steer. Spacebar makes your car jump, Shift applies the brakes, and moving the mouse changes the camera view. On a phone or tablet, on-screen buttons handle steering, gas, braking, and jumping. Hold the brake button while stopped to reverse, and swipe across the screen to move the camera.
hotbath-simulator: You run a warm, inviting bathhouse and guide an adorable cat through its daily work. Gather hot and cold water, get the bathtubs ready, welcome arriving customers, and make sure every visitor leaves happy. The money you earn from guests can be put toward new bathtubs, useful upgrades, worker cats, a tea shop, and restroom facilities. Over time, you grow the venue piece by piece until it becomes a successful spa business.

Controls are simple. With a mouse, click and drag in the direction you want the cat to move. On a touch screen, touch and drag in any direction to steer. To use an interactive object, stand near it and wait for the progress bar to fill.
roll-king: Guide a gooey sphere across blocky, brightly colored settings, from busy city roads and garden picnics to sandy deserts, bakery kitchens, and deep space. Anything smaller than your sphere that you bump into, such as toys, snacks, and household furniture, clings to it and adds to its size. Your aim is to reach each size target, collect stars, and push through 50 stages before moving on to an unlimited endless mode.
super-girl-salon: In Super Girl Salon, you step into the shoes of a superhero alongside the Power Girls and their wonderful pets. Whenever Super City sends out a call for help, it is up to you to round up the monsters. Once they are caught, they can be transformed into friendly super citizens.
Controls are simple: use your mouse or tap to play. The game's tags point to dressing up, decorating, design, and makeover fun, so it suits young players who enjoy girls' games.
go-up: Go Up is a free arcade game for mobile devices. Your task is to keep a small balloon safe as it climbs higher and higher. Pointy and heavy hazards, such as blocks, beams, and triangles, drift into its path, and one touch from any of them ends the run. You guard the balloon with a shield, often a round protective plane, that you move around it to nudge those hazards aside.

To reposition the shield, you swipe or drag across the screen. Timing matters, because shoving an object too late or too hard can send it flying straight back at the balloon. The climb also grows harder, with obstacles appearing more often and becoming more complex and trickier to avoid. Sending too many blocks flying at once can make the balloon much harder to protect.
tsunami-race: Tsunami Race is an online adventure where you try to stay ahead of a looming tsunami. Choose your character, then make your way past the obstacles in your path. The game includes several modes, among them a challenge where you dodge falling fruit and a race down water slides. It runs across multiple platforms, so you can pick it up on different devices.
To move your character, tap and hold the screen. Keep your finger down while you play, since the wave never stops coming.
santa-and-the-chaser: Santa is in trouble and needs your help escaping from the Chaser. Your job is to avoid every obstacle in his path and keep going for as long as you can. There are 20 levels in total, and you must complete all of them to return to the North Pole.

This racing-style arcade game has a festive Christmas theme and is built with HTML5. Controls are simple: click the mouse or tap the screen to play, which also makes it easy to enjoy on a phone. It's a cheerful pick for the holiday season.
patagonians: Patagonians is a horror and mystery adventure in which you search for your missing daughter. Your path leads through creepy caves and gloomy mansions, where you battle monsters, solve puzzles, and survive deadly traps. Expect a tense mix of horror, mystery, and survival from start to finish.

On a keyboard, WASD moves your character, SPACE jumps, and SHIFT runs. Press E to take action, use the left mouse button to attack, and the right button to fire your secondary weapon. S or the Down arrow slides you down, and TAB pauses the game. On mobile, you can use the on-screen buttons instead.
big-wheels: Big Wheels is a 3D arcade game centered on a bicycle. As you ride, pick up the wheels lying along the way. Each one you gather makes the wheels on your bike grow, which lets you roll straight through obstacles that would otherwise stop you.

The game runs in your browser thanks to HTML5 technology. Controls are simple: a mouse click or a tap is all you need to play. Keep collecting wheels, grow your bike, and push through whatever lies ahead.
night-silk-dark-city-fashionistas: Step into a shadowy realm where style and suspense blend together. As the city drifts off to sleep, the noir ladies are only getting started. Two close friends call this moody town home, and tonight they are heading to a grand Gothic party in an old mansion. Your job is to put together striking holiday looks built around deep black, graphite shades, blood red, and dazzling silver. Here, dull routine has no place. Every look is about deadly beauty and bold flair.
Playing is simple. Just click with your mouse or tap the screen to make each picture come alive.
cat-escape-hide-and-seek: In this casual arcade game, you help a cat sneak away from a Great Dane and reach a sweet cake. Your goal is to dash directly toward the cat's preferred treat while staying out of the dog's sight. Keep an eye on the pup at all times, and move with skill to earn a prize at the finish.

The game stands out with its distinctive visuals and an endless mode made for competing. Gameplay moves through different levels of varied difficulty, with enough challenge to keep you engaged. The featured artwork shows a cat dressed as a banana, a cat meme designed to lift your mood and fill you with positive energy.
pop-them: Pop Them! is an emoji puzzle game built around matching colors. Your task is to link groups of emojis that share the same color, which makes them burst in a chain reaction that resembles a popping balloon. Any group of three or more matching emojis can be connected, and the links can run in any direction. The goal has to be reached within a limited number of moves, so every connection counts.

Popping the bubbles around boxes and evil emojis destroys them. Power-ups are available to help you complete your mission. The game is designed for all ages and works as a calming, stress-relieving pastime after a long day or while you are on the go. Finding new strategies to connect more emojis with fewer moves keeps this endless adventure free and enjoyable.
shrinkzone-io: Shrinkzone drops you into a fast, doodle-styled battle royale where your appetite decides how long you last. You begin as a small blob and gobble up food scattered around the map so you can get bigger and tougher. Rivals are chasing the same snacks, so keep your eyes open: dodge the larger players and go after smaller ones when the chance appears. Quick react
slime-clicker: Slime Clicker is an idle clicker that lets you unwind while you tap away at a cute slime. Each press adds to your point total, and those points unlock new levels, upgrades, and charming skins, starting with Bat Slime and moving up to Rabbit Slime. Keep an eye out for the Mini Slime that pops up now and then, since catching it quickly grants a bonus to
luna-and-the-magic-maze: Follow Luna as she wanders through an autumn woodland filled with magic. Your path winds through a series of mazes, and along the way you gather magical items and piece together hidden secrets. Each stage brings new challenges to overcome, and the game shows that determination can be just as powerful as sorcery.
The game works on both phones and computers, so you can play wherever you like. To guide Luna, use the WASD keys or the arrow keys.
jingle-jetpack: Help Santa get every present where it needs to go in this 2D adventure. You fly with a bullet-powered jetpack, steering around lasers, electric fields, and incoming missiles. Staying alive is the whole challenge, so keep your eyes on the danger ahead.

Grab coins as you go, then spend them on fresh power ups and outfits for Santa. Better gear helps you climb to higher scores and bring Christmas to the entire world. Control is simple: use your mouse or your touchscreen to play.
letter-ball: Letter Ball is an adventure game built around easy controls and clever puzzles that also give your brain a good workout. You guide a ball and strike letters to spell out words. The goal is to gather those words in the correct sequence. As you advance, every level becomes tougher than the last, so you have to work hard to reach the items you need. Along the way you will roll, jump, and dodge obstacles. Aim to become the top Letter Ball player.
Move with W, A, S, D or the arrow keys, and press Space to jump.
baby-penguin-fishing: Baby Penguin Fishing is a 2D puzzle game about fishing that tests your skill. Its charming look makes each outing feel like a small adventure, and it is hard to put down once you start. The game offers two play styles, called Fishing and Trawling.

In Fishing mode, click directly on a fish's body to cast your line and catch it quickly so you can move on to the next level. Trawling mode works differently. Tap the area you want, and the net drops there, capturing everything inside it. In both modes, you need to finish the objective quickly.
geometry-vibes-monster: Geometry Vibes Monster is a reaction-based arcade game where you steer a spaceship through a stream of hazards. Obstacles and spikes come at you, and you also face a range of distinct monsters. Each monster uses its own attack style, so you need to learn each pattern and dodge it with skill. The aim is to travel as far as you can while surviving the attacks.
To fly, press and hold the mouse
school-bus-simulation: School Bus Simulation puts you behind the wheel of a school bus in a parking-focused driving game with 3D graphics and animation. Your task is to steer the bus along a street and deliver it to the school. Built with HTML5, it runs in your browser and can also be played on mobile devices.

Move the bus with the W, A, S and D keys. There is no need to hurry, since the game is meant to be relaxed and fun from start to finish. It sits in the racing category and is tagged for driving, parking, and kids.
war-truck-weapon-transport: This rocket-transport simulation puts you behind the wheel of 3D military vehicles. Before any driving begins, you must match the different pieces together to build a complete rocket. Only then can you set off for the marked position, and you have to get there on time. The clock matters on every level, so keep an eye on it as you head for the target.
Steer with the W, A, S and D keys. Work through each mission in turn, and best of luck as you move your cargo across the map.
nail-stack: Nail Stack is a 3D arcade collecting game with a nail theme, a concept you don't see every day. Its characters and scenery have a cartoon style. Your goal is to gather white nails so that the finger you control grows longer. Along the way, you can also pick up colorful brushes and take part in decorating activities.

Skipping nails won't hurt your progress, because the game has no penalty system. Even so, it's worth collecting the colorful nails if you want to finish every level. To play, simply slide your finger across the screen to move.
frogy-ninja-2d: The calendar has turned to the Year of the Frog, and now the ninjas are the ones in danger. You play as a frog who was once living quietly, but after escaping those ninjas, you want payback. Your kung fu moves are the tools you need, and every choice happens in turns, mixing action with puzzle solving.

Work through hundreds of demanding stages using simple swipe gestures that feel natural to use. The pixel art look is bright and colorful, and each setting offers different surroundings you can use to outwit the enemy ninjas and finish your mission. Play with a mouse click or a tap on a touchscreen.
fit-in-the-wall: Fit in the Wall asks you to steer a floating block into the correct opening of walls that come toward you. Each wall has only one right gap, so quick reactions and good timing matter a lot. Hit the matching slot and you keep going, but a wrong move ends the run. Stay sharp and keep lining up the pieces.

Your goal is to rack up as many points as you can by moving the yellow cube so it matches each pattern. On a desktop, the arrow keys shift the cube. On a phone or tablet, tap the left or right side of the screen to nudge the cube in that direction.
heroes-vs-monsters-idle-rpg: Heroes vs Monsters: Idle RPG is a clicker game where you build a squad of heroes and send them into a battle that never stops. You tap monsters to hurt them, then hire heroes who join the fight on their own. Gold builds up as you go, and you can spend it to raise your heroes' levels so they hit harder. Skills give you strong boosts when you need them, and every fifth zone brings a boss you must defeat before moving deeper. Hundreds of zones lie ahead, and new artifacts offer lasting upgrades as you collect them.
Your progress keeps going even when you step away from the game. When you return, your rewards are waiting for you to collect.
pixel-dino-run: Pixel Dino Run is a casual endless runner where you keep a dinosaur running and jumping. Your score climbs as you play, and the more points you earn, the faster the dinosaur sprints. It's a hypercasual pick with a high score to chase.

Controls are simple. A tap or click makes the dino leap. If it's already in the air and high up, touch the screen again to drop back to the ground quickly. Jumping works with either a mouse or touch input.
christmas-land-adventure: Step into a wintry realm built around the Christmas season, where your mission is to lend Santa a hand. This two-dimensional adventure asks you to tackle a series of challenges spread across platformer levels. Snow covers the scenery throughout, giving every stage a cheerful holiday atmosphere.
Your controls depend on your device. On a computer, the arrow keys move your character, and pressing A throws snowballs. On mobile, on-screen buttons handle every move you make.
ragdoll-arena-2-player: Ragdoll Arena 2 Player offers 14 games built for two players, though you can also take them on solo in a one-player mode. Every match has its own objective, yet the shared aim is to reach three points before your rival does. Expect fruit slicing, hammer trials, chicken catching, rooftop shootouts, and several other contests along the way.
Your character can be customized from the
the-rings: The Rings is a puzzle game built to give your mind a workout. It rewards careful thinking and planning, so each move is worth considering before you make it. Your task is to place rings and rearrange them until each one sits in its correct position and the level is complete.

You control everything with the mouse, since every button in the game is selected by clicking. Keep your cursor handy and take your time working out the next arrangement. The challenge comes from testing your logic and strategy, and it keeps pulling you back to try just one more level.
mr-stickman: Mr Stickman is a wild shooting game where you take aim and fire at every enemy on screen. Dozens of tough stages await, and your goal is to clear each one. Enjoy yourself, but keep an eye on your ammo, since every bullet counts. To play, aim and shoot.

Mr Stickman is a wild shooting game where you line up your shots and take down every enemy in sight. The game offers a series of demanding stages, and your aim is to finish them all. Have fun along the way, but make each bullet count. Controls: aim, then shoot.
obby-weapon-rush: Sprint through a busy course of hurdles, jumping over obstacles and hitting targets as you go. Each run lets you upgrade your weapons to raise your damage per second, collect coins, and open tougher difficulty levels as you advance. Finish quests, grab useful perks, sharpen your rewards, and lean on prestige bonuses so every new attempt hits harder than the last.

Controls are simple. A single click or tap makes you jump, and holding it keeps you jumping on its own. Use your mouse or finger to move through menus and press interface buttons. Compete on the global leaderboard and see how close you can get to the top.
yummy-hotdog: Build a hot dog from nothing in this cooking simulator. First you collect the parts and ingredients you need, then combine them and prepare the batter. From there you manage each step yourself, adding sauce as a finishing layer and piling on toppings for extra flavor. Once your hot dog is complete, you can earn every achievement the game offers.

The game adjusts to any screen size, so it works on desktop and mobile alike. On a computer, click items, tools, and buttons to act on them. On a phone or tablet, touch the screen to pick things and apply your choices.
cavern-of-gears: Cavern of Gears is a two-dimensional action-adventure set in a steampunk underworld. Your route leads through caverns driven by turning gears, and as you push deeper you pick up new weapons to build your arsenal, along with power-ups. The story asks what became of the workers who disappeared down there, and it pits you against the forces that took their place.

Battle through each cavern, defeat the enemies you meet, and clear every stage and boss to reach the century-old secret being kept below. The controls are straightforward: WASD moves your character, SHIFT dashes, and J or K attacks. Press R to switch weapons and L to use a power-up.
command-strike-fps-offline: Command Strike FPS Offline throws you into a risky trip through a 3D shooting world. Your job is to survive by taking out each opponent you run into. Every enemy you bring down moves you nearer to clearing the map. You can aim at foes coming from any direction, much like a battle royale match, and you play as a quiet hunter who relies on precise long-range shots.

Across the various maps and levels, you must keep moving and shoot every enemy before they can shoot you. The controls are simple: left click fires, right click aims, WASD moves your character, Ctrl lets you run, and Spacebar makes you jump. Press R to recharge.
z-stick-duel-fighting: In this 2D fighter, you take on the role of a stick warrior facing rivals who have come from every corner of the cosmos. Each duel asks you to pick the right moves, combining various abilities and fighting techniques to wear down your opponent. Keep an eye on your mana, since spending it wisely matters, and slip past incoming blows before landing a finishing strike.

Experiment with different skills and fighting styles to find what suits you best. Your aim is to earn the title of stickman fighting king of the universe. Speed and planning both count, since the game tests your reflexes and your strategy. Control it with a mouse click or a tap.
idle-pong: Idle Pong blends clicker mechanics with a bouncing twist. Each tap sends a fast pong ball hurtling into a field of bright obstacles, which it knocks apart as it ricochets around. XP keeps building up even when you step away and simply observe the action.

You can buy and drop new balls by clicking or tapping, and drag across the interface to move up or down the screen. Boost your striking power, collect distinctive balls that come with special visual effects, and move through tougher stages while aiming for larger combos. Whether you prefer to keep tapping or just sit back and watch the pongs run wild, there is plenty to see.
polygon-flight-simulator: Take to the skies in this airplane simulator, where you can smoothly fly from one airport to another. Getting started is simple: press W, drag the mouse, and watch your plane climb. Along the way, you can steer through airborne checkpoints on the route to your next destination airport.

The controls are easy to pick up, and the experience feels immersive from the first takeoff. Use WASD to move the plane, drag the mouse upward to rise, and move it forward to descend. Left and right mouse movement also guides the plane, and TAB opens the menu. Whether you're a novice or an expert, the seamless interface keeps the journey enjoyable.
sausage-life: In Sausage Life, you control a sausage that must dodge hazards and be the only one left standing. The game mixes parkour-style movement with survival, so each stage tests your timing. Steer by dragging the mouse, and use it to navigate as well. Moving on means surviving each level, and the winner is the one who gets past every obstacle.
Along the way, you can unlock a range of skins, some referencing movies and games such as Harley Quinn
shadow-strike: In Shadow Strike, you finish each mission by defeating the foes in your way, and collecting stars opens the path to the next destination. You roam a hostile enemy world, taking down the dangerous opponents you meet and finishing them off, with further challenges waiting beyond them. Be careful, though. The enemies carry lethal weapons and deadly traps lurk around, and if either one catches you, the game is over.

This title suits fans of adventure, action, RPG, platform, and quest games, or anyone who just wants a good time. It offers high quality graphics, a small game size, super simple controls, and interesting quests. On Android, on-screen touch buttons control the player. On PC, press A to move left, D to move right, W to jump, J for the jet-pack, K for the shoe-jet, and use the fire control to shoot.
climate-activist: Explore a series of art galleries in this hypercasual adventure, where you need to sneak past the guards without getting caught. Your task is to head toward the artworks and set up little surprises for the visitors. Tagged as action, adventure, brain, casual, coloring, and decoration, it keeps things light from start to finish.

Use W, A, S, and D or the arrow keys to move, press space to jump, and hold left shift to sprint. Move the mouse to control the camera as you go, so you can keep an eye on the guards and the galleries around you.
shooterz-io: ShooterZ.io is a 3D multiplayer shooter built for playing with friends. You can set up your own lobby with the settings you want, or join one that another player has already opened. Battles here are fast and chaotic, and the game offers several different environments and good-looking graphics.

To play, hold the left mouse button to fire and the right mouse button to aim. Press R to reload, C to crouch, and P to pause. Number keys 1 through 9 let you swap weapons, and the T key opens chat, where you press Enter to send your message.
draw-cute-animals: Draw Cute Animals is a drawing game that mixes creative play with a little learning. Children can sketch and color a wide range of adorable animals, from cuddly kittens to playful pandas. Easy-to-follow guides and bright color options help each young artist make their own masterpiece while getting to know different creatures.

Designed for preschoolers and toddlers, the game aims to build artistic skills and improve hand-eye coordination. Whether a child loves to doodle or is only beginning to explore art, it offers a gentle place to start. To play, just click the mouse or tap the screen.
fever-cubes-drop-number-2048: Fever Cubes is a 3D puzzle game where you drop numbered blocks and keep merging past the 2048 mark. Every cube obeys realistic physics, so a single landing can shift the whole pile and trigger a run of linked merges. These chain reactions are where the fun builds, since one combination can lead into a combo.

Fans of 2048, number puzzles, block games, or calm merge games should feel at home here, because the title blends those styles into one experience. To play, swipe with your finger or move the mouse to slide the cube into position and aim it. Then drop it onto a cube of the same value, and the two will join to form the next grade up.
dark-war: Dark War drops you into a present-day setting where magic, adrenaline, and combat come together. Seen from above, this role-playing title casts you as a fighter from an old order of exorcists, someone who has dedicated their whole life to opposing evil forces. Your arsenal includes blades and firearms, and you can also call on magical powers.

As a member of the order of demon hunters, your job is to track down the gatekeeper demons and destroy them. A task system with written descriptions guides your progress, and the game explains its controls so you know how to move and act. Powerful demonic bosses wait for you in major battles, so you will need to plan your approach and use your unique abilities to win. The game works on both mobile devices and personal computers.
bus-school-park-driver: Slide behind the wheel of a school bus in this arcade driving game. The focus is on accurate parking, steady steering through traffic that feels true to life, and squeezing through cramped school zones. Other challenges ask you to handle tricky parking setups where every move counts, and each stage puts your handling to the test.
Practice your technique, finish the missions you are given, and aim to become a skilled school bus driver. Controls are simple: a mouse click or a tap is all it takes to get going.
car-stunt-races-mega-ramps: Car Stunt Races: Mega Ramps is a racing game built around a physics-driven stunt simulator. You can crash, leap through the air, slide through drifts, and pull off many other trick-filled moves with your car. The open free mode lets you roam a course full of stunts and obstacles in a sports car, and you can try to climb the mega ramp. Controls are handled from the keyboard.
The challenge races are designed to test your skills, with routes that send you over risky ramps as you work to beat each goal. Expect parkour-style stunts, realistic crashes with visible damage, and
hook-pin-jam: Hook Pin Jam is a puzzle game where you work through tangled setups by releasing hooks one at a time. Each tap on a hook frees it, and your aim is to untangle every hook using as few moves as you can. Every level offers a new arrangement, and the layouts grow trickier as you advance, so your planning and reasoning get a real workout.
crush-yard-tycoon: Crush Yard Tycoon lets you manage a junkyard in 3D while you squash old vehicles under a heavy hydraulic press. Each smash brings in cash, which you can spend to boost your press's Power, Speed and Value. Newly opened cars and extra yard space keep the scrapping going, with bigger payouts coming from each new vehicle you crush.

The whole game runs on simple clicks or taps, so you can jump in right away. Its clicker and idle elements make it easy to leave running and come back to. The question is how big a recycling business you can build.
soccer-championship-2023-html5: Step into the boots of a rising hero in this offline football title, where every match is played without needing an internet connection. You can take on the role of a world football team manager or act as a mobile football player on the pitch. Two competitions await: the Hero Tournament and the Club Football League Championship. Across both, you face rival teams in matches built around striking, passing, and scoring goals.

Controls are simple. Move with W, A, S, and D, and hold K to sprint. Press N for a short pass, M for a long pass, and SPACE to shoot. On a mobile device, use the buttons provided inside the game instead. This 2023 release brings football and soccer action to your screen.
my-little-kingdom: You rule a kingdom, and its future depends entirely on the choices you make. Monsters are attacking your territory from every direction, so your job is to defend the land and keep your subjects safe. Roam the map, buy new territory, and collect useful resources along the way. Trade what you gather for gold, then spend that gold on growing and reinforcing your holdings. Lead with confidence, beat back each danger, and shape a grand, lovely, thriving realm.
Move your character with the mouse, the WASD keys, or the arrow keys on a desktop computer. On a phone or tablet, use the touchscreen instead.
ice-dash: Ice Dash is a cheerful winter adventure in which you sketch icy routes that carry Santa through each stage. Your drawn paths become his slide, so you need to plan where he goes. Along the way he must dodge frozen hazards, hop on platforms that travel back and forth, and grab tasty cookies. Stay steady, because the difficulty rises as you progress.

To play, tap and drag on mobile, or click and drag on a PC, to draw an ice line. Santa then slides on his own along the lines you created. Tap the pause button whenever you want to take a break. Can you collect every cookie and get Santa across the finish line?
two-impostor-squid-challenge: Two Impostor Squid Challenge is a 2D adventure designed to be played with a friend. It offers two modes for two players: a green light red light game and a tug of war game, so you can pick whichever suits your mood.

Controls are split between the two of you. The blue player uses the A key, and the red player uses the P key. On mobile, each player can use touch controls instead, so you can jump in from a phone or tablet as well.
shark-rampage: Shark Rampage puts you in the fin of an apex predator beneath the waves. You cause chaos along the coastline, smashing through wooden boats and devouring swimmers who never see you coming. As you feed, you can upgrade your sharp jaws and build up explosive combo meters. Your aim is to rule the ocean's depths through pure destruction.
Controls are simple. Use W, A, S, and D or the arrow keys to move. Press the Space bar to perform a run attack and tear through whatever gets in your way.
marshmallow-world: The Chocolate Monster has locked a family of marshmallows in cages, and only you can set them free. Climb a tower of 100 candy-bar levels filled with conveyor belts, ice, seesaws, fireballs, and platforms that melt or crumble. Fire sticky webs to pull yourself upward, and stay ahead of the hot chocolate rising behind you.

Each trapped friend can be freed once you solve its puzzle. Collect strawberries along the way and dress your marshmallow in hats and outfits. Every world ends with a boss fight against the Chocolate Monster. On phones, slide a finger left or right to move and swipe up to shoot a web and climb. On PC, use A or D or the arrow keys to move, and W, Up, or Space to shoot and climb. It is a cute climbing adventure for all ages.
modified-hill-climb-2d: Modified Hill Climb 2D is a physics-based hill climb game about souped-up cars. Your goal is to get as far as possible before fuel runs out, so keep an eye on your tank while you collect coins and fuel cans. Landing cleanly or pulling off flips earns bonus coins.

The nine stages take inspiration from real places, from misty Black Sea villages to snowy mountains and city highways. Spend coins in the garage to unlock ten cars, tune their engine, speed, fuel and balance, and add liveries, rims, exhausts, horns and pedals, which also unlocks new levels. Every level includes an endless road mode for high scores. Hold D or the Right Arrow to acceler
happy-valentines-day-spot-the-difference: Two pictures that look almost identical are waiting for you in this Valentine's-themed puzzle. Your job is to hunt down every difference hiding between them. Take your time looking for the small changes, and see how many you can catch.
The game is played with a mouse or by tapping the screen, so it works on both computers and touch devices. Enjoy the search and have fun spotting what's different!
sniper-strike: Sniper Strike is a first-person shooter that throws you into tense, hard-to-win situations. You move through demanding missions where you need to stay alert and careful. Your sharp eyesight and accurate aim matter most, because each mission requires you to spot and take out high-value targets. Expect a fast-paced ride built around careful planning and sniper action.

On a desktop, left-click fires, right-click brings up the iron sight, and the scroll wheel zooms in and out. Press R to reload and Tab to pause. On mobile, you control everything through the on-screen UI buttons.
the-last-shot: Step into the mystical world of The Last Shot, a 2D single-player shooter where precision and strategy are tested. You guide a glowing orb through detailed levels filled with luminous platforms and obstacles, all set against a finely crafted twilight backdrop.

To play, drag your finger to aim the orb toward the platforms, then release to fire it. Your goal is to steer the orb onto the green platform. Avoid obstacles and use the blue platforms wisely to reach your target. Complete every level to earn the title of master of The Last Shot.
police-car-stunt-challenge: Take the wheel of a powerful police car and race across sky-high tracks lined with ramps, loops, spinning barriers, narrow platforms, and huge jumps. You can choose the patrol vehicle you like best, then work through challenging stunt levels. Collect the coins along the way and learn to master every obstacle, with the aim of becoming a police stunt champion.

Precise control is central to the game. Press W or the Up Arrow to accelerate and S or the Down Arrow to brake and reverse. Steer with A and D or the Left and Right Arrows, use Space for the handbrake, and use either Shift key for nitro. Press C to change the camera view, or Escape to pause. Touch controls are still available on mobile devices.
strategy-of-war-tanks-and-helicopters: This online strategy game puts you in charge of forces that must capture enemy strongholds. Tanks and helicopters are your core units, and each battle rewards tactical thinking. The military challenge tests your skill and runs smoothly on a range of devices.

Controls are simple. Select a base to move troops from or to attack with. One click sends half of your troops, while two clicks send all of them. Keep in mind that moving units between ground bases and air bases requires double the troops.
magic-water-sort: Magic Water Sort is a calm liquid-sorting game with bright shades and simple controls. Beyond standard color sorting, you prepare drinks in a café-inspired setting. Glasses roll along a conveyor, and you decide when and where each pour lands. Tapping a flask releases its layers from the top down, and the pouring runs on its own so the flow stays gentle. There is no clock and no pressure, so you can take your time.

Liquid that matches the color of a glass above drops straight in, while anything else collects in cups hidden under the counter. Glasses come in several sizes, and you can preview the upcoming ones to plan ahead. A fresh glass arrives after every pour. Fill each one before it reaches the exit line, and finish all the required mocktails to clear the level.
coloring-world-2026-animals-and-nature: Coloring World 2026 is a calm color-by-number game that suits every age. Browse a varied gallery of adorable cats and dogs, lovely blooms, ripe fruit, bright parrots, and plenty of other delightful scenes. Pick a scene, choose a shade from the palette, and paint each section marked with the matching number. Finishing a scene brings rewards and opens fresh images to add to your gallery.

Your points also count toward a leaderboard, where you can see how far you can rise against other players. On a computer, use your mouse to pick colors and fill in areas. On mobile devices, simply tap the screen to do the same.
jelly-matches: Jelly Matches is a puzzle game built around matching colors. Your goal is to break a set number of colored pieces on the board. Some pieces have special effects: an x2 piece doubles how many pieces you break, a -1 piece removes one from your total, and shield pieces offer protection.

To play, press and drag with your mouse or finger, then release to drop a piece. It falls into the board and gets matched with pieces of the same color, which breaks them. Special pieces can change your progress in either direction, so keep track of your total as you go.
money-factory-tycoon-idle-game: Money Factory: Tycoon Idle Game is a quick clicker with some strategy mixed in. Your aim is to grow a money empire by fine-tuning the lines that produce cash. You begin with a basic setup, then expand over time by improving your equipment, opening fresh production zones, and raising efficiency so your earnings climb sharply.

Upgrading a production line increases the profit it brings in, and enhancing machines makes your equipment work more efficiently. Unlocking new sections widens your factory and adds production capacity. Tap the screen to collect money more quickly and set off bonuses. Balancing upgrades against expansion is the key to building a large financial powerhouse.
extreme-thumb-wars: Turn the everyday contest of thumb wrestling into a digital match with this game. You choose one thumb character from a lineup of more than twenty, then test your skills against a friend or against the CPU. Each fight uses two bars: a health bar and a power bar. You can smash your opponent's finger until the power bar runs out.
The controls are easy to pick up. Touch controls work on touch devices, and on a keyboard you can use the W key or the UP ARROW key.
fish-stab-getting-big: Dive into the deep sea, where dangerous fish carry knives in their mouths and slash at one another. Your aim is to take out as many rivals as you can and grow your fish into the largest creature in the water. Every victory adds to your score, and both you and your blade get bigger as the points climb.

You can play alone in single-player mode or team up with a friend in two-player mode. Choose your mode and pick your fish before heading into the water. Player 1 steers with W, A, S and D and speeds up with C. Player 2 uses the arrow keys to move and the L key to boost.
precision-parking-pro: Precision Parking Pro puts your control, timing, and skill to the test. You take the driver's seat and try to show you can park cleanly every time. Challenges range from cramped city alleys to multi-level garages, and each one stretches your precision and patience. Realistic vehicle physics, quick steering, and smooth camera controls help you handle obstacles, tight corners, and changing surroundings.

As you play, you earn rewards and unlock new cars. Your rank climbs as you improve, starting as a rookie and working up toward the title of true parking professional. Use W, A, S, and D to move, and press R to shift into reverse.
killer-assassin: In Killer Assassin, you guide an assassin who takes out foes one at a time. Make use of the environment and dark corners to avoid beams from flashlights, then strike your targets. Move quickly when you attack, and slip away before anyone notices you.

This hypercasual HTML5 game is built around killing and skill. Each takedown depends on timing and careful positioning, so you will need to watch where the light falls and where the shadows are. It runs right in your browser and asks for a sharp eye and quick reactions.
save-the-monkey: Save The Monkey is a brain-teasing puzzle game that puts your intelligence to the test. A heavy boulder has landed on a little man, and you must design a machine to rescue him. Drag the pieces around to assemble a rescue machine and save everyone.
As you advance through the levels, the difficulty steadily rises, so each stage asks more of your th
robot-police-iron-panther: When alien monsters invade Earth, only a police robot can stop them. In Robot Police Iron Panther, you build your own Iron Panther robot and face the monsters in a fierce battle. The game is still a work in progress, so it is not fully finished yet.

Controls are simple and work across devices. On a desktop computer, click the buttons to interact with the game. On a phone or tablet, touch the screen to pick your choices. The layout adjusts to fit whatever device you use.
hide-and-seek-blue-monster: Step into a world full of mystery and fun with Hide And Seek: Blue Monster. The game turns the familiar idea of hiding and searching into a unique adventure. Casual play and puzzle challenges are woven together, so you will need to think as well as move around.

Controls are simple: a mouse click or a tap is all you need to play. The game's tags point to escape, hidden things, and running, so expect a mix of slipping away and dashing about. It sits in the Puzzles category, which suits players who enjoy brainteasers with a light touch.
bridge-wars: Bridge Wars is a mobile game that mixes creative drawing with strategy. You sketch a pattern on screen to call stickman soldiers into battle, but you have only 3 seconds to finish it. Once your soldiers appear, they attack enemy vehicles rolling toward a bridge packed with barricades, and your job is to keep every foe from getting across.
Between fights, you can visit the shop to upgrade your arsenal, such as armor and weapons. You can also upgrade and custom
clean-kitty: Clean Kitty is a physics puzzler built around sketching. Your cat is due for a bath, but the water from the tap won't reach the tub on its own. You draw lines with a finger or mouse to form ramps, walls, and funnels that steer the flow into the basin. Each stage is its own small brain teaser, and because your ink is limited, every stroke needs planning. Rubber ducks, soap bars, and pipes tumble the moment you finish a line, and glowing red plates turn water into steam. Some stages give you two taps to catch from at once.

Fill the tub with as little ink as you can to earn up to three stars and a "Purr-fect!" message. The game includes 100 handmade levels that start easy and grow trickier, and most puzzles have several possible solutions. The cozy look, short stages, and hints for when you get stuck keep things relaxed. It is available in eight languages. To play, hold the left mouse button, drag to draw, and release to finish.
dice-math: Dice Math is an educational game for children who want to strengthen their basic arithmetic with the help of dice. Kids can practice addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division while working on the skills behind each operation. The game is designed to keep learning lively and entertaining for young players.

Getting started is simple, as a mouse click or a tap is all that is needed. Your child can enjoy the fun of this math challenge while building confidence with numbers. The game keeps its focus on sharpening everyday math abilities from start to finish.
smash-the-blocks-puzzle-challenge: This casual logic game asks you to clear a board of blocks marked with arrows. Tapping a block makes it vanish, but only when nothing stands in its path. Work through the puzzles at your own pace, one level at a time. There are many levels to explore, and the difficulty rises gradually so the challenge stays fresh. Aimed at adults, it offers a calm mental workout.

The visuals are soft and easy on the eyes, and the controls are simple enough for anyone to pick up. It is built to help you unwind and take your mind off daily worries. Now and then a level will require some careful thought to avoid getting stuck. If that happens, changing the order of your taps often opens a path forward. Boosters are available whenever you need extra help.
pull-the-pin-much-money: Pull The Pin - Much Money is a traditional math puzzle with a pin-pulling twist. Your task is to choose the right pin to remove so that you collect more cash. The game challenges both how you reason through problems and how well you handle numbers. You play by clicking with your mouse or tapping the screen.

Think of it as a brain teaser where every pin counts. Each move asks you to weigh your options before you act, so careful thinking pays off. Whether you enjoy number puzzles or simply like a quick logic challenge, this title gives you a simple way to test your wits.
onigiri-demons-wrath: Take charge of a samurai clan in this tactical tower defense campaign. You construct barracks and improve them over time, then send Hatamoto, Yumi archers, mounted cavalry, and other fighters to hold the line. When enemy waves get past your defenses, strong spells can turn the fight around.

Between battles, pick your route across the campaign map, collect Honor, open new provisions, reinforce your wall, and get ready for harder clashes. Each run carries your army further into dangerous land, where tougher foes, boss battles, and lasting upgrades await. Use your mouse or touch screen to pick
moto-stuntman: Put your motocross skills to the test on courses that vary in ground type, scenery, and moving hazards. Your goal is to speed through one-of-a-kind terrain and get past natural barriers before crossing the finish. The bikes are powerful, and you can pull off stunts to shave off extra seconds and chase a personal best.

The journey takes you across the surface of the planet and then down into its underground layers, so expect a wild ride. Keep your wits about you, because rushing carelessly can cost you the win. Press W or the up arrow to accelerate and S or the down arrow to brake. Tap A and D, or the left and right arrows, to rotate your bike and flip into a somersault.
jhoney-revenge: Jhoney Revenge is a single-player shooting game with adventure and arcade elements and an army theme. You take on the roles of a hero, a spy, and a legend as you work through puzzling challenges. Precise aim matters here, so you will need to show off your accuracy while lining up enemies in your sights.

Your objective is to bring down the underground world of the mafia. Each part of the game combines tricky puzzles with shooting, so you must think carefully as well as aim well. The shooting theme runs throughout, keeping the focus on hitting your targets with skill.
idle-chicken-farm: Idle Chicken Farm is a merge and idle farming game that begins with just one hen. Your goal is to grow that single bird into a busy egg operation. Sell eggs to earn cash, combine chickens to open tougher breeds, and improve your henhouse, your production setup, and your delivery method. You can also add new facilities to your farm.

The hatchery adds a choice. You can sell eggs for profit you can count on, or incubate them and hope for a new chicken plus some bonus rewards. Controls are simple. On desktop, left-click handles everything, and click-hold-drag gathers and sells several eggs at once. On mobile, tap to interact and drag your finger across eggs to collect and sell them together.
happy-coloring-book: This browser-based coloring book lets you fill pages with your own palette. You pick any picture from a broad selection of playful sketches, then grab the virtual crayons and start shading. Your creativity sets the pace, so each page can turn out as wild or as neat as you like.

Feel free to test a wide range of hues and try different coloring methods to see what works best on each page. When your artwork is finished, you can store it and send it to your friends so they can see what you made.
slide-blocks-3d: Slide Blocks 3D offers a calm but mentally engaging sliding challenge. Bright images have been split into tiles and mixed up on the board. Your job is to move the tiles around until each picture is whole again, all before the clock hits zero. As you advance, the stages expand in size and become more demanding.

You control the tiles by dragging them with a mouse or your finger. If you get stuck, three boosters can help: Hint points out the correct spot, Undo takes back your previous move, and Magnet locks a tile into its place. Completing stages rewards you with coins, and you can also collect daily bonuses while chasing a higher score and a spot on the leaderboard.
planes-dodge-and-go: Planes Dodge & Go drops you into intense aerial dogfights. You take on the role of a fighter pilot in The Great War, weaving through enemy aircraft while dodging incoming fire. Your goal is to stay in the air for as long as you can.

The game can be played for free on a phone or a computer. To move your plane, hold the right mouse button and drag across the screen. Each run tests your reflexes, so see how long you can last before your plane goes down.
boat-merge-and-race: Steer your own boat through this 3D arcade racer, where joining two matching boats creates a quicker, tougher one. Each race pits you against AI rivals, and you must outpace them to finish every level. Along the course, you can grab gold coins. Your boat also has to stay afloat on the water the whole time.

Gather 50 boats in total and upgrade your vessel with any of 17 props. Success depends on both speed and strategy, so the game tests quick reflexes and careful planning. Everything is controlled with a mouse click or a tap.
santa-holiday-adventure-game: Santa Holiday Adventure Game is a festive arcade title where you guide Santa through the sky in his sleigh. Your job is to drop off presents in snowy towns, grab coins along the way, and spread a little holiday joy at every stop. Missions push you to reach each house before the sun comes up, so keep an eye on the clock.

The game is built for kids and grown-ups alike, with easy, family-friendly play. Steer with a Fire Stick remote or a touchscreen, and enjoy colorful 3D scenery full of sparkling lights, decorated trees, and falling snow. Coins let you unlock new reindeer, sleigh upgrades, and boosters. It also runs offline, so you can play whenever you like.
super-doctor-body-examination: Super Doctor Body Examination is a educational browser game built around the idea of a medical check-up. Plenty of people would rather skip a physical examination altogether, yet these routines exist to look after your health. The game turns that everyday experience into something you can explore while you learn.
Controls are straightforward, since a mouse click or a tap is all it takes to play. Nothing about the setup asks for complicated input, so your attention stays on the examination itself.
bunny-escape: Bunny Escape puts you in control of a little rabbit that keeps finding itself stuck in all sorts of tricky spots. Your job is to get it out of each one. Along the way you will need to run, attack, and jump across several different worlds, while avoiding the enemies that try to stop you.

Everything is handled with a single button, so you can start hopping right away. On a computer, press the spacebar or the left mouse button, or use the A button on a gamepad. On a phone or tablet, simply tap the screen. The aim stays the same throughout: break free from every trap.
car-driving-traffic-crazy-mobile: Tired of racing games that stick you behind the wheel in first person? Car 2: Racing offers a fresh angle by placing you above the car, looking down at the crowded, chaotic streets. It's a good pick if you feel like testing your luck. Your goal is to get where you're headed quickly while staying clear of traffic. Earn money along the way, spend it on new vehicles, and work toward reaching the top of success on a global scale.
This single-player 3D game is built for Android phones and computers. On mobile devices, use the button on the screen, and on PC, use the WASD keys.
city-cash-race: Speed through bright, busy city streets in this arcade chase game. Your goal is to collect cash while slipping away from the police. Spend the money you earn to upgrade your car, and work your way up to the title of City Cash King.

The game is made for one player and mixes 3D visuals with a top-down view. Controls are straightforward: press W or the up arrow to accelerate, and S or the down arrow to brake. Use A or the left arrow to steer left, and D or the right arrow to steer right.
extreme-rider-3d: Extreme Rider 3D is a straightforward bike riding simulator featuring three-dimensional bikes and ramps set on the rooftops of buildings. Your aim is to carry your bike to the finish line by getting over every ramp and staying on the track the whole way.
On a computer, you control the bike with the W and D keys or the arrow keys. On mobile devices, you slide your finger to move. It's a Web-based arcade game that rewards careful, steady riding.
flag-learn: Flag Learn is a geography quiz that helps you memorize world flags, US states, and capitals instead of relying on luck. A flag appears, you type its name, and you confirm. Three correct answers in a row master that flag and add it to your collection, while each mistake costs a life that returns over time. A spaced-repetition system keeps a record of the flags you've met and brings back the tricky ones until you know them all.

Beyond the learning mode, challenges include Daily Flagle, Blur Mode, Paint the Flag, and Border Guess, plus timed Highscore speedruns with a global leaderboard and real-time PvP battles against friends. The night-sky design, progress tracking, and quick roun
baby-taylor-bed-time: The moon has risen, stars are glowing in the night sky, and Baby Taylor is getting sleepy. Your job is to prepare her for bed. Help her brush her teeth and take a bath, then place her favorite toys along the sides as you make up the bed.

Before she sleeps, choose the story she wants to hear. Then watch her sweet dreams unfold as she drifts off. To play, just use a mouse click or tap. Say good night to Baby Taylor once her dreams begin.
perfect-piano-magic: Perfect Piano Magic is a light, casual game made for anyone who enjoys the Piano Magic series. Its gameplay closely resembles that earlier series, so longtime fans should find it familiar. It is a one-player title that blends music with shooting, and it sits in the hypercasual category.

You control it with a mouse click or a tap on the screen. That single input is all the game asks of you. It suits anyone who likes music-based casual play, whether or not they have tried the Piano Magic games before.
sky-stunts-rolling-ball-3d: Sky Stunts Rolling Ball 3D is an adventure driving game where you guide a ball to its destination. As you roll, you pick up coins, then keep going until you reach the goal and collect more coins there. Finishing a run earns coins that you can spend on new character balls.

On a computer, you steer the ball with the W, A, S and D keys. In a mobile browser, the game uses its own on-screen buttons instead, so you can control the ball by tapping them. The game is available for Android, iPhone and iPad as well.
weight-puzzle-3d: Weight Puzzle 3D is a puzzle game built around balance. Your task is to lift the weights and set each one into the correct section of the road. Once everything is balanced, the player can run ahead and reach the finish line. Along the way, the game puts your math and number skills to work in a three-dimensional setting.

Controls are easy to pick up, since a mouse click or a tap is all you need. The game suits anyone who enjoys working with numbers and testing their thinking through hands-on puzzles. Each weight you place brings you closer to the goal, so take your time and check where each one belongs.
dungeon-descent: Dungeon Descent is a blocky, voxel-built dungeon crawler with a brisk pace. You clear rooms full of monsters, smash open chests, and collect a growing stash of weapons, armor, upgrades, and artifacts as you travel further down. It blends adventure, RPG, survival, and action, with a player-versus-environment focus.

Battles are over fast and can end your run in a hurry, so you need to keep moving, dodge incoming attacks, and switch weapons mid-fight. When a battle starts going badly, you can call on your artifact powers. Each run tends to grow tougher, with harder biomes, merciless bosses, and Ascension modes for anyone wanting more heat.
friends-pug: Gather every snack with your canine partner, then guide both pups back to the nest. Each dog has its own food to collect, and you will need to get past obstacles so that you both reach the nest side by side. Catching the bone gives you special powers and a superpower.

Each pup is controlled separately: the brown dog moves with the arrow keys, while the grey dog moves with W, A, S, and D. The game works on both mobile devices and desktop computers, so you can play on whichever you have at hand.
cube-sort: CubeSort is a colorful 3D puzzle about tapping and sorting. Each level is a suspended sculpture made of patterned tiles, including cubes, spheres, stairs, arches, and many other shapes. Drag empty space to spin it around, and use the scroll wheel or a pinch to zoom in on any corner. Tap a tile that matches an open bucket and it flies in. If no bucket matches, the tile waits in the tray, and if the tray overflows, the level is lost.

Filling a bucket completes it, opens the next one, and pulls matching tray tiles in automatically. Watch for gray riveted tiles, which can never be removed, so you must work around them. Tiles marked with "?" keep their pattern hidden until you clear a tile right beside them. Fourteen patterns use distinct shapes to suit colorblind players. All 500 levels are verified to be solvable, and each one takes a minute or two.
guess-drawing: Guess Drawing is a quick arcade puzzle that challenges you to work out what a sketch shows in just seconds. It is light and speedy, and it puts both your powers of observation and your imagination to work. As each picture appears on screen, you choose the answer you think matches it.

You can also go head to head with other players and see who has the keenest eye. Subjects range from silly characters and sleek objects to strange, unexpected creations, so every round brings something new. Study the details, shapes, and clues, then pick your answer before the round ends. Make smart choices to earn rewards and stay ahead of your rivals on the way to becoming a true drawing master.
valentines-mahjong-deluxe: Valentine's Mahjong Deluxe is a classic Mahjong puzzle decorated with Valentine's Day items. Your aim is to spot identical tiles and remove them in pairs until you have collected every tile on the board. The game is split into levels, so you can work through the stages one after another.

Controls are simple. Tap a tile to select it, then pick its matching partner to clear the pair. The game is built with HTML5 and is set up for mobile play, so you can enjoy it on a mobile device as well.
princess-halloween-boutique: Princess Halloween Boutique is a dress-up game you can play in your browser for free. Halloween is the busiest time of the year, and the shop is packed with school visitors, ghostly costumes, parties, and trick-or-treating. Your girls head out to sweet dates, birthday parties, and auditions, all set against the holiday fun.

Your job is to make each girl look as frightening as you can. Out on the street, some people are dressed as pineapples, so the wilder the better. Let your imagination run and style the girls in spooky, one-of-a-kind outfits. On a desktop, click and drag with your mouse. On a phone or tablet, tap and slide your finger.
uno-online: Uno Online is a card game built around strategy. Your goal is to be the first player to empty your hand, because that player wins the round. Along the way, you need to work out which cards your rivals are holding, and you also have to arrange your own cards in a sensible order.

Every move is made with a mouse click or a tap, so you interact with the game using just one kind of input. The title is filed under hypercasual, with arcade and card tags, which places it in those groups on the site.
space-cleaner: Space Cleaner is a light arcade shooter set among drifting rocks. Your job is to tidy up the asteroids floating around your ship. Point your cursor at a target and blast it apart to collect money. Keep an eye on your fuel gauge, because once it empties the round is over.

Between rounds, head to the upgrade screen to strengthen your ship, then fly back out to keep working through the field. Wiping out every asteroid finishes the stage and opens the next one. The controls are easy to pick up, the destruction feels satisfying, and the steady stream of upgrades keeps things moving. It is a laid-back experience that suits fans of arcade and idle-style space games.
bullseye-idle: Bullseye Idle is a shooting range game where you tap targets to get things started. Your weapons keep firing on their own, and every coin you earn goes toward buying more of them. You can buy submachine guns, assault rifles, sniper rifles, and rockets, until the whole firing line is shooting at once.

Click or tap a target to shoot it, and press M if you want to mute the sound. Your guns handle most of the work, so spend your coins on more guns and more power. Keep tapping to fill the FEVER meter, which doubles your damage while it lasts. Push deeper for tougher targets and bosses, and win timed trials to earn permanent trophy upgrades.
planet-destroy-idle: In this clicker, you break apart whole worlds one blow at a time. Forge your own pickaxes, swords, axes, and arrows, then put them to work striking each planet while gathering the valuable materials it yields. Finish quests and earn achievements along the way, and keep sharpening your gear so every strike lands harder.
When you are ready to start over, the prestige system lets you reset and claim unique perks that make you stronger on your next run, so you can t
2048-x2-legends: This puzzle game centers on the 2048 block, which you work toward by shooting blocks onto the board. When you line up blocks with the same number, they combine into a higher one. Each merge raises your count, so you keep chasing bigger scores while sharpening your thinking along the way.

Your main goal is to reach the highest number possible before you run out of space. If the board starts to feel crowded, you can use boosters to make the challenge easier. It suits anyone who enjoys number puzzles and block-matching games.
el-clasico: El Clasico puts you in the middle of one of the most famous rivalries in sport. You can pick a side, either Real or Barca, and your goal is to win the El Clasico.

Shooting is handled with taps or clicks. Each one lets you set the direction of your shot, its height, and the amount of curve on it. Those three settings decide where the ball goes. Whichever team you back, the match is yours to shape once you start shooting.
