drifting-supercars-racing-3d: Drifting SuperCars Racing 3D raises the bar for car racing with lifelike friction-based driving and sharp, detailed graphics. Build a collection of high-end supercars, including La Ferrari, McLaren P1, and Königsberg One:1, plus many more. Customize your cars and trucks, then tune each ride for top speed so you can outpace tough rivals.

Take on racers from around the world in head-to-head drag races, or join international team events. You can also work to take over the city. Steer with WASD, drive forward with W, brake with B, look behind you with F, boost with the nitrous on Space, and use the handbrake when you need it.
twist-and-tug: Twist and Tug is a puzzle game built around ropes. You pull, link, and arrange them until they form the same shape as the target. Each node needs to be placed with care, and ropes must be kept from crossing one another. Once the pattern matches the goal, the level is complete.

As you move forward, the layouts become harder to solve, which keeps your thinking busy. The game calls on sharp eyes, clear reasoning, and steady problem-solving. It suits anyone who enjoys casual brain teasers and logic challenges. Everything is controlled with the mouse, so you only need to click and drag to get started.
hole-io-2: Hole Io 2 is a free arcade game in which you guide a black hole that devours everything it touches. It is so engaging that many players find it hard to stop once they begin. The game has gained a huge following around the world and is now one of the most talked-about titles of its kind. It is tagged as both an .io and a battle game.
Playing is simple: just click or tap to control the action. Because the controls are this easy to learn, anyone can jump in right away, whether on a computer or a phone.
obby-dumb-or-genius-iq-test: Obby: Dumb or Genius IQ Test is a game where smarts matter most. You take on mini-games, challenges, and PvP duels to collect IQ points and climb levels. IQ floats around the map for grabbing, winning mini-games gives extra boosts, and a spinning fortune wheel hands out random IQ prizes. As your IQ grows, so does your standing, and trophies can be traded for pets. Your aim is to become the sharpest player and reach the top of the leaderboard.
You can play with a keybo
counter-battle-strike-swat-multiplayer: Counter Battle Strike SWAT Multiplayer offers several game types. You can try gun game, survival mode with zombie waves, free for all, team versus team, or a mode where players fight each other's zombies. The enemies use smart AI and appear as soldiers or zombies.

The offline mode lets you battle enemies with different guns, and your ammo is limited. For online play, you can host your own server or join a match with friends. Controls are simple: use W, A, S and D to move, the mouse to look around and fire, and Tab to open the menu. Press Space to jump.
funny-ragdoll-wrestlers: Funny Ragdoll Wrestlers is a fighting game built around floppy ragdoll figures trading blows. You can play alone or invite a friend for a two player match. Each fight continues until one fighter scores five points, and that fighter wins the round.

Player one moves forward and back with W and S, punches with A and D, and lands head hits with E. The second player steps forward and back with the up and down arrow keys, punches with the left and right arrow keys, and lands head hits with the right Shift key. Each player has a separate set of keys for moving, punching, and head hits.
stacky-hero-master-game: Stacky Hero Master is a maze puzzle title that tests your thinking while keeping you occupied for a long stretch. You guide your hero through bright, colorful mazes, gather blocks along the way, and pile them into tall stacks. Your job is to work out the right route to the finish line. Each stage presents a different puzzle, so the challenge keeps evolving as you advance.
The game suits anyone who likes maze, puzzle, brain, stacking, or block-collecting titles, and
tile-match: Tile Match asks you to pair up matching tiles before they sink to the bottom of the screen. New tiles keep dropping in from the top and sliding downward, so you need to clear them quickly. If even one tile touches the bottom edge, the level ends and you must begin again. It suits people who enjoy puzzles and fast decision-making.
Keep watching the tiles as they descend and look for matches to remove them. The quicker you make each match, the more points you earn.
dino-meat-hunt-new-adventure: Winter is coming, so the dinosaurs have started their meat hunt once more. This time the adventure is tougher. The little dinosaur can jump up to high places, while the big dinosaur can destroy dangerous monsters. You and a friend must cooperate to finish levels filled with hard puzzles and prepare a meat stock for the dinosaurs.

The game is built for two players, with each dinosaur controlled separately. The big dinosaur moves with the arrow keys and attacks when you press L. The little dinosaur moves with W, A, S and D, and pressing W twice makes it perform a double jump.
fall-fu-panda: This rotating puzzler has the whole world spinning, and your little character must tumble onto whatever block comes next. The physics keep the turning scene lively. You can zoom out to see the full layout or keep your eye on your player as they move through the surroundings. Your aim is to land on objects to rack up points or to take out foes. Picture a hero trying to break out of a dungeon or a cave while the terrain keeps changing beneath them.

Playing is simple. Tap the left or right half of the screen to turn the world in that direction, which sends your character falling toward the next block. Miss a landing and drop off the edge, and the run is over. Players on a keyboard can use the matching left and right keys to do the same thing.
narutovsbleach: NARUTO vs BLEACH is a side-scrolling anime fighter built for mobile devices. Characters move smoothly through each match, and their signature skills are easy to recognize at a glance. Chaining attacks together flows without interruption, so combat feels more free. The pace is quick, each hit carries a strong sense of impact, and the controls feel almost like an art form in themselves.
Energy steadily gathers while you operate your characters and use their skills. Once that energy is full, you can release a super powerful skill to turn the fight.
kingdom-defense-mega: Kingdom Defense Mega is a tower defense game where you place towers to hold back invaders and keep your realm safe. Your job is to protect the people who live there and preserve the calm of the land. Along the way, you can cast magic to strengthen your defenses, and fans of strategy games should feel right at home.

The game spans 12 levels and throws many enemies at you, including orcs, goblins, witches, spirits, trolls, zombies, and giants. Spells can be summoned at any time when you need them. Each level ends with a boss, and every location closes with four super bosses. The journey takes you through forests, swamps, deserts, the frozen north, and volcanoes. Both your towers
music-note: You play as a music note hopping from one platform to the next. Each time you bounce, a splash of color spreads across the scene, slowly turning a gray, black-and-white world into something vivid and alive. Your route runs across a series of platforms, and every bounce keeps the color flowing forward.
Jump by clicking anywhere on the screen or pressing the Space bar. Your goal is to reach the final section, the Piano, to win. If you want to start over, press R to restart.
rope-push-game: Rope Push Game asks you to show both strength and good timing. You grip the rope and work to shove your rival toward the edge of the arena. Choose the right moment to pull or push, keep your own footing steady, and make clever moves that give you the upper hand. Each round aims to get you to the winning point, and the foes you face grow tougher as you go.
Playing is simple: a mouse click or a tap is all you need. Keep an eye on the arena and react quickly to how your opponent moves, since a well-timed action can decide the match.
rainbow-obby: Rainbow Obby is an arcade game where you guide a character through a series of obstacle-filled levels. Each level is set in its own distinct location with different barriers and traps. Your job is to cross the abyss, hop from platform to platform, and gather bonuses along the way.

Bonuses play a major role here. They let your character jump higher or fly short distances, which helps you get past tricky sections and avoid danger. On a computer, you move with WASD, jump with the spacebar, and steer the camera with the mouse. On mobile, two joysticks handle movement and the camera, and a separate button makes the character jump.
my-city-hospital: My City Hospital is a hypercasual game built around placing digital dolls, and its polished design gives the experience a refined feel. It also invites you to picture medicine from the inside, whether that means working as a doctor yourself or running a hospital dedicated to helping others.

Playing is straightforward, since every action comes from a mouse click or a tap. The game is tagged with doctor and simulation, so the medical theme and the management side sit at its core. If you have ever imagined caring for patients or keeping a hospital running, this title offers a fresh way to explore that idea.
ninja-rabbit: Meet the Ninja Rabbit, a superhero who steps up when trouble comes calling. One day, monsters took the children from the village, and the villagers placed their hopes on this brave bunny. Carrying their expectations, the rabbit heads out without hesitation on a journey to battle the monsters wherever they hide.
Filed under Arcade, this game carries the tags Arena, Arkanoid, King, Puzzle, and Superhero. Steering is simple: tap the screen to control the direction the rabbit moves.
burger-bay: In Burger Bay, you run a seaside burger stand where cooking patties, stacking burgers, and serving customers brings in cash. Spend that money on new stations, upgrades, and helpers, then extend your boardwalk along the coast to reach fresh beaches.

Every few minutes, a sea-creature boss turns up, either a Kraken, a giant crab, or a whale, with a massive order and a countdown. Deliver it before the timer runs out for a big payout. Walk to stations to cook and carry food. On desktop, use WASD or the arrow keys to move, T to toss the top item, and P to pause. On mobile, drag to walk.
sins-and-desires: You take on the role of Felicia, a detective who travels to West-Alben to look into the vanishing of an aristocrat named William. This visual novel mixes detective work with romance, and its story unfolds through narration and character dialogue. Shadowy mansion halls, a lake wrapped in fog, and a village guarding its own secrets give the game a moody atmosphere.

Your choices steer the plot toward different outcomes, and a relationship system also affects how the story ends. Romance routes with Albert, Felix, and Victor are available to explore. To move forward, read closely, gather clues, and speak with the villagers. Replaying the game lets you uncover every branch of the story, and each path may reveal something new. Whether you expose the truth or sink into the sins and desires of West-Alben is up to you.
mad-truck-driving: Mad Truck Driving is a 2D racing game where you take the wheel of a powerful truck and roll through a series of obstacles and tricky challenges. Cars ahead of you are fair game, since you simply smash through them. Nothing seems able to halt your truck, yet each level still asks you to get past different hurdles before you can finish it.

The visuals and sound effects give the action plenty of personality, and the crashes feel satisfying. Steering uses the WASD keys, which let you drive in four directions. Work your way through the levels and see how far your truck can go.
sticker-jam-peel-off-and-match: Sticker Jam is a free online puzzle title that blends collecting stickers with matching challenges. You can play it on a phone or a computer, and it offers a relaxed way to clear your head after a long day. Taking things slowly is part of the appeal, since you move through each board at whatever speed suits you.

The core action is simple: tap a sticker to peel it away from the board. Your job is to spot three identical stickers or matching colors and group them so they disappear. Clear every sticker on a level to finish it, and new levels open up with trickier peeling challenges waiting for you. The triple match puzzles are quick to pick up but take some practice to master.
mouse-survivor: Mouse Survivor is a 2D endless runner where you guide a brave mouse through worlds that keep splitting apart. The path is made of constantly shifting tiles, and some are weaker than others, so a single touch can be enough to end your run. Dodge, jump, and slide past obstacles, including explosive ones, while gathering c
coloring-book: Coloring Book is a drawing game that suits both grown-ups and kids. Pictures of animals, flowers and mandalas are waiting to be filled with color, and the game brings together a calming break, a chance to be creative and a way to unwind.

To begin, pick the mode you prefer. After that, browse the available coloring books and choose whichever one catches your eye. From there, you are free to color each page in your own way and make it your own creation.
space-survivor-shooting: Space Survivor Shooting is a tough online game that tests your nerves. You play as an impostor, so your job is to make a plan, move quickly, and aim well enough to take down foes while saving your allies. Clever thinking and sound tactics matter here, since the faster you eliminate your rivals, the better your chances.
Control is simple: click with your mouse or tap the screen to play. Stay sharp, keep your wits about you, and choose each move carefully so you can outmaneuver the enemies around you.
3d-ball-pool: Step up to a pool table shown in full three-dimensional view in 3D Ball Pool, a game of pocket billiards meant to be played the way it would be on a real table. The scene uses a true 3D perspective, so each shot looks much like it would in person. The game is built with HTML5 and runs right inside your browser.
You can play on a PC or on a mobile device, so the table is ready on whichever screen you have at hand. The game is controlled with the mouse, so you only need that one input to get going.
buildemup: In BuildemUp, you load a truck with blocks in many colors and shapes, then deliver them so that beautiful houses can be completed. Keeping those odd pieces on the cargo machine is the main challenge. Coins earned as you advance let you buy and unlock eye-catching new trucks, and you can also activate power-ups to move through levels more easily.

The game is made for players of all ages, with mind challenges that range from easy to difficult and that help build puzzle-solving skills. To play, drag each shape and drop it onto the truck. Arrange them carefully, because when the truck moves, every shape must stay on board instead of falling off.
indian-taxi-2020: Indian Taxi 2020 is a racing and driving game set in a open city where you can roam however you like. You take the wheel of a cab, collect passengers from pickup points, and deliver them to their destinations. Your aim is to prove you are the best cab driver in town.

Start in the parking area, find a car, and get it running. Drive to the marked spot to pick up a passenger, then head through the city streets to the drop-off point. Along the way you can change the camera view, and the roads wind past hills and mountains. Steer with WASD or the arrow keys.
dark-assassin: Dark Assassin is a hypercasual platform adventure set inside a shadowy castle filled with traps and mysteries. Your skill will be tested as you work out how to get past the dangerous traps in every level. Move through the darkness with smooth motion as you control Zenith. Watch your footing when crossing fixed spikes and spikes that move. If you slip off a platform, including one that travels, the run ends, so think carefully and steer your character as each stage demands.

Your main goal is to find the key. Once you have it, the castle door opens and you can head on to the next level. The game offers high quality graphics, a very small file size, and super simple controls. Use the arrow keys or the WASD keys to move your player.
wasteland-hunter-puzzle-rpg: Wasteland Hunter blends falling-block puzzling with turn-based fights and role-playing strategy in a world wrecked by disaster. Your building pieces are Tetris-style blocks that carry gear such as ammunition, medkits, protective shields, and grenades. Arrange them in clever patterns to unleash strong attacks, and reshape your layouts depending on which foes you face and what each situation calls for.

Between battles, you look after a small survivor settlement. You can repair and organize it, bring stranded people to safety, and assemble custom combat machines from blueprints you uncover. Explore the map to reach new areas, expect the challenge to climb as you progress, and enjoy a wide range of equipment that keeps every run different. On PC, you control everything with the mouse buttons, while on mobile you tap the on-screen buttons.
fishing-frenzy: Fishing Frenzy challenges you to haul in as large a catch as you can before the clock runs out. Staying sharp and reacting quickly matters, since every moment can make a difference. Bonuses appear along the way to help you: extra bait for continued catches, bombs that snag several fish at once, and added time that stretches your session. Planning your moves and choosing when to use these boosts will push your score higher.

On mobile devices, you control the game with buttons on the screen, while computer players use the arrow keys and the spacebar. The game blends quick reflexes, careful planning, and fishing skill into one arcade experience.
beautiful-toenail-salon: Summer is many girls' favorite season, since they spend their days at the beach soaking up the sun in pretty bikinis. It is easy to forget about foot care when getting dressed up, yet feet are hard to hide at the seaside. Nobody wants their feet to look rough or unsightly.

In this game, you begin with a foot care session, then apply nail polish and add accessories to finish the look. Your goal is to make the feet look beautiful. Controls are simple: mouse click or tap to play. Enjoy the fun along the way.
fluffy-jump: Fluffy Jump asks you to hop from one platform to the next while the screen keeps scrolling forward without pause. If you miss a platform, the run ends. Your pace picks up steadily as you go, so staying alive longer means a higher time-based score, and that is the real test here.

The controls are quick and easy to pick up, so you can focus on timing your jumps. The game grows harder the further you get, which keeps each attempt tense. It is a simple arcade platformer for mobile and skill-based play, where every extra second counts.
fishing-catch-the-moment: Step into this calm 3D fishing game, where each location has its own atmosphere and the weather and time of day change as you play. Your task is to drop your line, time your moves well in a short fishing mini-game, and search for rare fish. Each catch adds to your collection, and your goal is to land the heaviest trophy.

Aiming is simple: move your mouse or swipe left and right. Press and hold to prepare your cast, then release to send the line out. When you feel a bite, tap the screen or click to hook the fish, then keep the moving indicator inside the yellow zone. Well-timed critical catches can bring you heavier and rarer fish. Sell what you catch, improve your tackle, and unlock new locations as you progress.
noob-saves-the-village: Monsters with no mercy have swept into the village, and it is up to you to push them back. Step into the role of a true hero and take on the dangerous foes using your combat abilities.
On a computer, walk around with the keyboard and strike by pressing the left mouse button. On a phone or tablet, steer with the joystick and attack by tapping the matching button on screen.
rolling-cheese: A hungry little mouse needs dinner, and it is up to you to bring the cheese to him on every stage. Some obstacles in the way can be broken, so click them to clear a path. Each puzzle also lets you gather up to three strawberries for extra points. Your challenge is to earn all three stars across the full set of 24 stages.
Controls are simple: use your mouse, or tap the screen if you are playing on a touch device. This single-player puzzle game is built with HTML5 and has a cute animal theme.
angry-bird-vs-pig: In this puzzle game, a bird swoops down from the sky to take on Heel in a fight to the finish. Your job is to bring down the buildings in its path so the bird can drop straight onto its target and wipe it out with a fierce pursuit. Success demands high skill and strategic thinking.

The bird has its own abilities, which you can use to smash through different structures and move on to new objects. Each level presents its own puzzle, so you need to find answers quickly and aim with good precision. You play by using mouse clicks or taps.
robot-wars: Robot Wars is a casual duel game that has recently gained attention as a popular hand game with a touch of magic. It tests two skills at once: your offensive ability and your painting ability. Let your imagination guide your designs as you create your own fighters and bring them into the fight.

Start by drawing a chariot with your finger. Once it appears, you can use its fighting strengths however you like. Attacks come in many different forms, and you strike your enemy by clicking anywhere on the screen. You can also switch the level's background as often as you want, then fight within the setting you chose.
bike-stunts-2024: Pick the bike you want and head out in Bike Stunts 2024. Completing levels lets you buy a new bike, so there is always a next goal. The game now includes 40 extra levels. It can be played in a mobile browser, where it is better optimized for smaller screens.
Use the W, A, S and D keys to drive on a computer. On a mobile device, use the on-screen buttons to control your bike.
gang-brawlers: Gang Brawlers sends you onto dangerous city streets, where you can smash crates, grab items from the ground, and take on wicked foes. You can team up with a friend for a shared adventure or face them head-on in the two-player fighting mode. Keep an eye out for coins lying around, because the money you collect can be spent at the store to make your fighters stronger.

Player one moves with W, A, S, and D, jumps with Space, uses F to punch and pick up, G to kick, and T to defend. Player two uses the arrow keys to move, P to jump, K to punch and pick up, L to kick, and O to defend.
traffic-craft-rider: Hop onto a motorbike and weave through a crowded city filled with blocky, craft-style traffic. Steer left and right to slip past cars, trucks, and other bikes heading your way. Grab the coins scattered across the road as you ride, and try to keep going for as long as you can.

Spend your coins to upgrade your motorcycle, improving its speed, handling, and power. The farther you travel, the higher your score climbs. Stay alert, react quickly, and avoid crashes so you can beat your best distance.
car-sky-stunts: Car Sky Stunts is a free offline racing game where you drive several sports cars along impossible tracks packed with vertical mega ramps. Set in an extreme city environment, it mixes GT-style car racing with daring stunt driving. Endless racing keeps the action going, and supercar upgrades add another layer to the crazy driving adventure.

The game has a striking interface, and it aims for a realistic feel as you launch over the ramps and perform stunts. All of the controls use the keyboard, so you can get behind the wheel and take on the challenge.
plant-girl-defense-zombie: Plant Girl Defense Zombie is a tower-defense shooting strategy game that mixes careful planning with action. Its characters are 2D cartoon plant girls and zombies, and your mission is to defeat every zombie across 24 levels. Each stage asks you to think about how to defend your position while you aim and fire.

Controls are kept simple, since a mouse click or a tap is all you need to play. The same single input works on both desktop and touchscreen devices. The title sits in the hypercasual category and is tagged Defense, Plant and Zombie, which reflect its core themes.
sortilege-magic-shop-sort: Sortilege: Magic Shop Sort is a calm puzzle set in a magical shop. You move shimmering potions, sweets, clockwork toys, blooms and books from shelf to shelf, lining up groups of three matching pieces so they disappear. Tap an object at the front of a row and place it on an open slot elsewhere, or drag it there instead. When a front row empties, the items stacked behind step forward. Clear all shelves before your moves run out.

Animal visitors request particular sets, and delivering one earns a tip. Your stars pay for renovating five wings of an enchanted night shop. If you get stuck, reach for the Wand, Broom, Hourglass or Extra Drawer. It works with touch and mouse alike.
army-vehicle-transporting: This game centers on the logistics behind moving military vehicles from one location to another. The cargo can include tanks, armored personnel carriers, jeeps, and other ground vehicles, whether the route stays within a country's borders or crosses into another nation. Because these machines are large and heavy, and their security is a concern, every move calls for careful preparation.

Trips may serve different purposes, such as training exercises, deployments to conflict zones, or humanitarian operations. On a computer, you steer with W, A, S, and D, and press C to switch the camera view. On phones and tablets, the controls appear as buttons on the screen.
boxes-fright-night: Gather the missing pumpkins with the colorful Boxes in this Halloween puzzle adventure. Your job is to guide the characters through each stage by using your grasp of physics to move them, make them jump, and turn them. Every level brings tricky setups and obstacles that you need to work through one step at a time.

Each stage has its own clever mechanics, so you will need to think carefully about how to solve it. The charming art and spooky Halloween theme set a lively mood that players of all ages should enjoy. Controls rely on simple mouse clicks or taps. Expect to spend hours on the challenges as you lead the Boxes to find every pumpkin.
snow-track-racing-3d: Snow Track Racing 3D is a car racing simulation in which you drift across race tracks buried under heavy snow. Unlike many other snow drifting games, the snow here responds for real as you drive, so your car slides in a convincing way. You pilot new, luxurious formula cars around asphalt tracks that lie beneath the white cover.
The game is free to play in your browser and includes online racing against others. Your aim is to become the champion of the online car races. Use the WASD keys to move your car.
bike-rivals: Weave through busy roads in this 3D motorbike racer. Your goal is to dodge traffic and obstacles, pass rival riders and cross the finish line ahead of them. Collect coins as you ride, then spend them to unlock new bikes and improve the one you already own. Every race brings a fresh challenge, so you will need quick reactions to keep moving up the road.

To accelerate, press and hold the screen or the left mouse button, then drag left or right to steer. On a keyboard, hold Space or Enter and steer with A/D or the arrow keys. Release the control to slow down, and stay alert as traffic closes in around you.
cockroach-tower-defense: Cockroach Tower Defense is a top-down survival title in which you protect your base from nonstop waves of roaches. Your weapons fire on their own, so your job is to position and manage your defenses. Each bug you destroy earns currency that you can use during a run to buy upgrades that take effect right away.

Between runs, you convert the "Public Support" you collected into lasting stat improvements. These help you hold out against tougher enemy types and boss waves that show up as the game goes on. On PC, a left mouse click selects the on-screen buttons, and on mobile, a tap does the same job.
pc-cafe-simulator-3d: In this tycoon title, you take charge of a gaming club built around your own vision. Put together gaming computers from parts such as strong processors, high-end graphics cards, and accessories. Welcome visitors who play games, among them well-known characters, and collect cash from their sessions. When machines break, fix them so guests can keep playing their
cube-surfer-fun-and-run-3d-game: Cube Surfer is an adventure game where you guide a cube-shaped character forward without stopping. As it moves, you collect diamonds, and reaching for them often means taking chances. Quick reactions are important, because you need to respond fast to what comes next.
The game has many levels to progress through. You can also unlock a variety of skins to change your character's look. Controls are simple: tap or click to play.
shadow-ninja-rpg-enemy-legends: Shadow Ninja RPG: Enemy Legends is a quick web role-playing game in which renowned ninja fighters push through perilous stages crowded with sinister foes. You pick a warrior from three kinds: human ninjas, feline ninjas, or bear fighters. Your path leads through skeleton forces, devil ninjas, and strong bosses, and you improve your abilities and gain fresh powers along the way. Every stage brings different obstacles and tougher opponents.

Steer with your mouse to roam the surroundings and engage enemies. Watch out, because many foes carry weapons and will strike if you come too near. Stay nimble, time your attacks carefully, and clear every opponent to claim the role of shadow ninja hero.
squid-poopy-sniper: Step into the shoes of an assassin in this first-person shooter inspired by a famous Korean TV drama. Your job is to take out contestants who finish last in games like red light green light, tug of war, marbles, and the glass tile challenge. When someone sneaks toward the cookie in the playground, you must spot the culprit and fire your rifle before they get away.

Time is running out, and every competitor is chasing the big cash prize, so you will need real sniper skills to succeed. Work your way up the assassin ranks by taking shots, unlocking new guns and rifles, and customizing the guards' uniforms with fresh outfits. Play with the mouse, and eliminate every player who fails the tasks to become the finest sniper around.
sort-master: Sort Master is a puzzle game where each level is its own small challenge. You drag or tap objects to tidy them up. Some stages ask you to line things up by size, by shade, or by a specified order. Others have you pair or group matching items, or assemble a picture from pieces. Once everything is arranged correctly, the level ends and you can move on.
Because every stage plays differently, the game stays varied. You will need to spot patterns and make logical links to progress. Activities include unpacking boxes, filling a fridge
chicken-farm-3d: Chicken Farm 3D is a relaxing 3D farming simulator set on a plot of land you develop yourself. You begin with bare ground, build your first coop, buy a hen, and keep its trough full. Raise hens of different breeds, gather their eggs, and sell them at the market. With your coins you can add more birds, construct larger coops, improve your gear, and hire workers. Story missions and egg orders help your reputation grow along the way.

On desktop, move with WASD or the arrow keys, look around with the mouse, hold Shift to run, press Space to jump, and use E to interact. Esc pauses the game and M mutes the sound. On mobile, steer with the on-screen joystick, drag your finger to look around, and tap the action buttons to interact.
city-of-vice-driving: City of Vice Driving puts you behind the wheel of several supercars as you drive across a city's roads. The game uses next-generation graphics to give the city a modern, detailed look. It belongs to the racing category and combines 3D visuals with a simulation style.

Everything is controlled from the keyboard. Use W, A, S and D to steer and move your car, press Space to brake, and press C to change the camera view. You can switch between different supercars as you explore the streets.
pumpkin-fright-night: In Pumpkin Fright Night, you guide Mr. Jack Lantern on a hunt to recover every pumpkin that has gone missing. Physics controls how he moves and turns, so each action needs some thought before you make it. This Halloween puzzle rewards careful planning as you work out your route through each challenge.

The controls are simple. Press W to make Mr. Jack jump, A to rotate him left, and D to rotate him right. Built with HTML5, the game is also listed for mobile play. Your goal is to collect all the missing pumpkins.
xtreme-offroad-jeep-2019: Xtreme Offroad Jeep 2019 puts you behind the wheel of a jeep in this 3D car game. Many missions are waiting, including challenges, a free ride mode that lets you roam the map, and a time checkpoint mode. Each one tests your driving skills in a different way.

The controls are simple: use the W, A, S and D keys to drive. You can follow the missions one by one or head out on the map and explore at your own pace. It is an action driving game with plenty of ways to test your offroad skills.
air-warfare: In Air Warfare, you pilot a combat plane in a game that never really ends. Your job is to shoot down enemy aircraft, collect ammo along the way, and avoid incoming attacks so you can keep fighting for as long as possible. Every run is a chance to compete for a higher score.
Controls are simple: tap or click the plane to move it, and it fires at the same time. The gameplay stays smooth on both mobile and desktop devices, so you can play on whichever you prefer.
idle-pop-merge: Begin with one small cartoon fighter and build a squad of 32 different toon warriors. Combine two matching fighters to unlock new characters. Tapping speeds up your attacks, so enemies fall faster. Where you place each fighter on the 3x3 battle grid makes a real difference, so plan your layout with care.

Take your team into 120 enemies spread across several arenas. Arena fights come as single, double, or triple challenges. Every win moves you closer to new fighters. To combine characters, drag them into the open slots and merge them into new forms.
city-car-driving-simulator: In City Car Driving Simulator, you pick a car you love and chase it through a detailed open world. The city is filled with real traffic, so you share the roads with other vehicles as you drive. The 3D visuals look sharp, and the handling follows realistic physics, so every turn feels grounded.

The game is free to play and runs offline, so you can enjoy it without an internet connection. Steer your ride along the city streets and explore the surroundings freely. Use the W, A, S, and D keys to move your player around.
draw-and-save-the-stickman: This puzzle game puts your drawing skills at the center of every stage. Sketch lines, shapes, and barriers to shield the stickman from traps, falling rocks, sharp spikes, enemies, and surprise obstacles. Each level brings a different challenge that tests your logic, imagination, and problem-solving.

Plan your moves before you draw, since a single stroke can change the outcome. Use your sketching wisely to build a solid defense and keep him safe. As you advance, the puzzles grow tougher and call for sharper strategies and more inventive answers. The game is played with a mouse.
amigurumi-cozy-stitches: You run a small knitting studio where soft toys take shape, from bears and bunnies to dragons and dinosaurs. Pick a design from the catalog and choose the yarn color you like. Each toy moves through four steps. First, trace your finger along the spiral to knit each piece, looping stitches row by row. Next, tap to stuff it, watching the gauge so it lands in the perfect zone.

Then press and hold each part to sew on its paws, ears, or tails. Finish by placing the eyes, nose, and mouth, and add blush or a bow if you like. Sell your toys, complete customer orders, and display finished pieces in the shop window. Coins buy new materials, and leveling up opens new categories, colors, and yarn types. Your collection grows as you go, with fresh quests and bonuses appearing every day.
spaceman-escape-adventure: Spaceman Escape Adventure is an addictive 2D space game. You guide an isolated astronaut who must collect the key, unlock the door, and escape safely. Watch out for the current, because touching it sends you right back to where you started. The portal signals that you have reached your goal and can pass the level.
Controls are simple. Press the WASD keys or tap the screen to move the spaceman. Keep clear of the obstacles as you work toward the key and the door.
highway-car-shooting-3d-action-game-2025: Ride in the back seat of a fast car and shoot at enemy vehicles as they chase you along endless highways. This 2025 3D shooter blends driving and gunfire, with intense shootouts happening while you race at high speed. Destroy rival cars with powerful weapons and watch them explode.

Unlock new guns and upgrades to boost your firepower, strong enough to shatter cars. The game takes place across 3D environments that include highways, cities, and deserts. Controls are simple, relying on taps and aiming, so you can focus on the action. If you enjoy car shooting, highway chases, and explosive battles, this game is made for you.
dark-vs-light: Dark vs Light is a bright, three-dimensional game about leading a squad. You pick a side, guide your captain into fights against rival clans, and travel across enchanted worlds. Gathering souls and recruiting allies helps your group grow, and unlocking new heroes, gear, and abilities gives you more ways to fight. Your captain must stay alive, and each world has a soul target you need to reach before you can move on.

Move with WASD or the arrow keys, or drag the on-screen joystick. Your squad attacks nearby enemies automatically. Press 1 or 2, or tap the skill buttons, to use your equipped powers. Press P or tap Pause to pause the game and adjust music and sound separately.
music-line-2-christmas: Step into this festive arcade game, where you guide a line through snowy worlds while listening to the melodies of Christmas songs. Every movement follows the music, so the tunes and the action stay closely linked. This holiday edition belongs to the Dancing Line 2 series and is called Dancing Line 2: Christmas.

Getting started is easy, since you only need to tap to play. Tagged as both Christmas and Music, the game suits anyone who enjoys seasonal tunes. Its arcade format centers on rhythm as the line dances onward through each snowy scene.
chernobyl-zombie-hell: Not long after the Chernobyl disaster of 26 April 1986, radiation still affects every living thing near the reactor. Each week, a cleanup crew is sent into the zone to keep the monsters from being heard. This week, you are the one sent in, and your job is to clear out zombies, dogs, rats, and more.
The mission takes you through three areas: a regional hospital, the streets of Chernobyl, and finally the tunnels beneath the reactor.
mag-roller: You control Mag-Roller, a fast magnetic ball that draws nearby cubes into orbit around itself. As you roll through messy, unpredictable stages, those cubes gather into a thick block shell that shields you and lets you plow through whatever stands in your way. Your task is to use electromagnetic pull to get past every stage.

Move with the W, A, S, and D keys or the arrow keys. Keep rolling, collecting cubes, and breaking down obstacles until each level is cleared. It is an arcade ball game with adventure touches that runs right in your browser.
city-minibus-driver: You take the wheel of a minibus in a busy city. In career mode, you carry passengers to bus stops along each route and must arrive on time. Each successful mission pays you money, and you can earn more by entering the minibus racing tournament. Spend your earnings in the garage on faster minibuses or luxury models.

Solo players steer with W, A, S, D or the arrow keys. B looks back, R fixes the bus position, SPACE applies the handbrake, keys 1, 2 and 3 sound the horn, and C changes the camera. Player two steers with the arrow keys, looks back with B, fixes the bus position with O, and uses RIGHT-S for the handbrake.
hexa-jump-asmr: Hexa Jump ASMR is a classic arcade title. Your ball drops past colorful spiral platforms, and along the way you will meet traps and obstacles that put both your skills and your strategy to the test. A single misstep ends the run, since the ball breaks into pieces and you must begin once more.
It suits moments when you're waiting in line or simply want a short break. Playing is eas
bomb-pong-online: Bomb Pong Online is a timing-based multiplayer game where each successful strike ramps up the chaos on screen. When you are on your own, you can face computer bots, or you can challenge a friend sharing the same device. You can also open a private online room, or jump into Ranked matches to climb the worldwide leaderboard. It is easy to learn but takes practice to master, and the action grows wilder with every hit.
The goal is to strike the bomb at just the right instant so it sails back toward your rival. On a computer, press A or click the left mouse button. When two people play
wiggly-worm-snake-puzzle: Wiggly Worm is a relaxed snake puzzler set among bright underwater reefs. Your goal is to steer a hungry worm through hand-built mazes and reach the heart in every stage. Along the way you eat apples to grow, unlock number gates, shove rocks aside, and hold down buttons to open doors. Scissors split the worm in two, and P swaps which piece you control.

Use the arrow keys or WASD to move, or drag and swipe on a phone. Finish in fewer moves to earn up to three stars, and collect pearls as you go. Dress your worm in fun outfits, meet cute pets, and claim daily gifts. Stuck? Undo with Z, ask for a hint, or watch an optional video for extra undos, hints, or a level skip.
punch-superhero: This superhero shooter casts you as a secret agent on a dangerous assignment. Several flying adventures come before the final showdown. The battlefield is crowded with civilians, so you take on the roles of a stretchy heroine and a sharpshooting hero. Your job is to rescue city residents from criminal gangs and complete the D-Day mission.

Movement uses WASD, with Shift to run and Space to jump. The left mouse button fires your weapon, the right mouse button shoots a laser, and Ctrl lets you fly. The game is built in 3D with WebGL and tagged as HTML5, Action, Shooting, and Superhero.
halloween-shuffle: Halloween Shuffle is a seasonal puzzle built around matching pairs of cards, which sounds simple until the tricks begin. You move through a series of distinct levels, and each one brings new cards, with every card hiding its own small spooky surprise. As you advance, the game grows steadily more playful and devious, so the challenge changes along the way. The whole experience is designed to see whether you can outwit its mischievous opponents, known as Tricksters.
The game is played entirely with the mouse. Point and click your way through each level, matching pairs as the tricks grow more cunning.
sky-blocks-falling: Sky Blocks Falling is an idle game inspired by Arkanoid. Blocks drop from above, and your job is to catch them with a bar so that platforms fill up, which brings in money. Over time you can raise your catching speed and add more platforms to hold more blocks. Critical hits offer bonus rewards, and progressive upgrades push your income higher. Prestiging speeds up future progress.

Along the way, a range of achievements gives you goals to chase, and you can personalize the look with block skins and atmospheric themes. To move the bar, hold the left mouse button and drag. If drag mode is switched off, the bar follows your mouse
seafloor-racing: Imagine steering a vehicle along the bottom of the sea, with the ocean surface far above you. Each level puts you in a seafloor race against several computer-controlled rivals. Your task is to dodge every obstacle in your path while keeping your speed high the whole way.
Movement is handled with the W, A, S and D keys. The game is a fast 3D racing pick for players who enjoy driving with an underwater twist.
doctor-kids-3: Doctor Kids 3 opens the doors of a children's hospital, where medicine and kindness work side by side. You can take on the role of chief of medicine and learn how to offer more sympathy to the people who come to you. Patients pick this hospital for the experience it offers and the quality of its pediatricians. As the doctor, you provide professional treatment and take care of your little patients.
This is a puzzle and simulation game aimed at girls, and it runs in a web browser on both computers and mobile devices. You play with your
hungry-snail: Hungry Snail is a brain-teasing puzzle game in which you help an adorable snail make its way back home. Instead of steering it directly, you slide the ground tiles around so a route forms beneath it, all while avoiding tricky obstacles. Gathering as many stars as you can along the way is part of the challenge.

Each level brings harder setups that call for careful thinking, strategy, and problem solving. Plan every move ahead of time, collect all the stars, and get the hungry snail home. Everything is controlled with a mouse.
hole-and-collect: Hole and Collect is a hypercasual game about steering a charming black hole around an area. Your goal is to collect all the objects before time runs out, so keep an eye on the clock. Group items together and destroy them with smart moves to clear the area faster.

The money you earn along the way can be spent to buy new black holes. The game has a funny, fun feel and is all about collecting. Steer your hole with WASD or the arrow keys, and try to clear every object before the clock runs down.
roll-to-riches: Roll to Riches is a bright 3D arcade simulator. You start by training your rolling wheel on a treadmill to build up Energy. Then you enter races to see how far your wheel can carry you, earning Cash and Trophies as you go.

Spend your rewards on upgrades, new wheels and trails, and pets to collect. Daily and playtime rewards are waiting to be claimed. When you are ready, rebirth to move forward faster and work toward new worlds. On desktop, use WASD or the arrow keys to move, drag the mouse to rotate the camera, press E to interact, and press Space or tap to build speed during races. On mobile, use the virtual joystick to move, drag the screen to turn the camera, tap the Interact button near stations, and tap during races to build speed.
fashion-battle-dress: Good looks alone won't get you across the finish line in this game. Each outfit only suits the part of the track that matches its color, so you need to keep pairing your clothing with the right section as you race along. It's a 3D arcade title with a casual, fun feel, and it runs right in your browser using HTML5.

To play, just click or tap with your mouse or finger. Keep an eye on the color of your outfit and the section of track ahead, since a match is what makes an outfit work. It's a light, friendly pick for a quick break or a relaxed session.
lucky-dice: Lucky Dice is a physics-based merge puzzle where you fire dice across a board. Pull a die back like a slingshot, line up your shot, and let go to launch it in the direction you chose. When two matching dice touch, they combine into the next number and speed off to seek out a partner, starting chain reactions along the way. A single well-placed throw can clear much of the table.

Each level gives you a limited number of throws and a target score to reach, so plan your shots carefully. Aim for the biggest cascade you can to clear the board. On mobile, drag back to aim and release to launch.
rage-maze-master: Rage Maze Master is a puzzle game where you dash through winding mazes, coloring the floor as you go and launching strong attacks at foes blocking your path. You take on the role of a brave combatant and aim to take over the whole arena. Every tile you cross becomes yours, so the challenge lies in mapping out a clever route while knocking out each enemy along the way.

To move, use the arrow keys on a desktop computer. On a phone or tablet, swipe in the direction you want to go. Each level ends only when the entire playing field is painted and every enemy has been defeated, so no corner or foe can be left behind.
realistic-sim-car-park-2019: Realistic Sim Car Park 2019 is a racing title focused on parking. Its drive test is meant to feel like the real thing, and you can take several different cars through it. Steering wheel and button controls are both available, so you can choose the method that suits you best.

Getting moving is simple, since the W, A, S, and D keys handle driving. As one of the newer car driving games from 2019, it brings parking challenges and vehicle variety together in one place. Sharpen your precision behind the wheel and see how smoothly you can park.
ghostly-night-harvest: Ghostly Night Harvest blends the calm of farm life with tense fights against spectral intruders. You play a dedicated farmer who tends a pumpkin patch during the day, working to grow a plentiful crop. When night arrives, ghosts invade, and you must keep your pumpkins safe. Success takes careful planning and strong management skills.

Getting around is straightforward. Use the WASD keys to move, or a joystick on mobile devices. Shoot with the spacebar, or tap the slingshot button on your mobile device. To interact with certain objects, press the action button or the key that appears next to the object.
block-blast: Block Blast is a free puzzle game meant to challenge your thinking while you pass the time. The goal is to clear as many blocks from the grid as you can by fitting pieces together.

To play, drag the blocks onto the board with your mouse, or use your finger on a touchscreen. Line up pieces so they fill an entire row or column, and that line vanishes, opening up room for your next moves. Keep clearing lines for as long as you can before the board runs out of space. Every line you remove pushes your score higher.
halloween-fruit-slice: Halloween Fruit Slice takes the familiar fruit-cutting arcade formula and gives it a creepy holiday makeover. Eerie backgrounds, ghostly effects, and unsettling music fill the scene, while the action moves fast and rewards precise timing. Haunted fruits fly across the screen, and your task is to slice through as many as you can before the clock runs out.

Swipe your finger across the screen or move your mouse to cut the fruit mid-air. Slicing several fruits with one motion earns extra points, so quick, well-aimed strokes pay off. Watch out for bombs, because hitting one ends your game right away. Keep an eye out for glowing fruits, since cutting them grants bonus power-ups.
car-madness-3d: Car Madness 3D puts you and a friend behind the wheel of mini cars for side-by-side racing. Pick Quick Race to speed around a random track, or choose Season mode to take on a tournament of 10 races. Watch out for obstacles and black holes along the way.

Win the tournament by leading the races. Player 1 steers with the arrow keys, while Player 2 uses W, A, S, and D. On a slow computer, open the gear button to adjust the quality so the game runs more smoothly.
slinky-color-sort: Slinky Color Sort is a calming take on color therapy, built around a puzzle of colorful rings. It presents itself as a newer Color Sort game, designed to help you relax as you work through multiple levels. Your task is to sort the slinky rings so that each color ends up grouped together.

Moving rings is simple. You can drag a ring or tap it, but only rings of the same color can be moved at one time. A ring can sit on another only when both share a color, and every color should finish in a single stack. Each level is a logic puzzle that tests your color matching skills, mixing challenge with relaxation and keeping your brain engaged.
alphabet-kitchen: In Alphabet Kitchen, Chef Elmo invites players into his kitchen to shape letter cookies and decorate them. The game helps young children learn about vowels as they discover how letters join together to form words. Friends from Sesame Street pop in to lend a hand.

Your child combines letters to spell words with three or four letters, and each finished word is baked into a cookie. Players use a mouse or tap the screen, and the theme centers on cooking and decorating.
tower-platformer-3d: Tower Platformer 3D is a 3D platform adventure set on a huge, ruined tower standing in the middle of the sea. Your task is to climb it by leaping from one platform to the next. On the way up, you must avoid monsters and collect coins. Portal checkpoints mark your progress, so you can keep climbing without going back to the bottom.

The game is uncomplicated and controlled entirely by mouse clicks or taps. It is tagged as Adventure, Jumping, and Obstacle, so it suits players who enjoy timing jumps and working through hazards on the way to the top.
15-halloween-games: Celebrate the spooky season with this Halloween collection, which packs 15 mini-games into a single title. Each one arrives with its own graphics, and the order in which they are played keeps changing, so no two sessions feel quite alike. The lineup blends 2D arcade play, casual fun, and match 3 puzzles that feature monsters.

Controls are kept simple: a mouse click or a tap is all you need to play. The game follows a hypercasual style, so each round is easy to jump into and enjoy. Whether you are on a computer or a phone, you can move through the mini-games with ease.
doodle-boba-bubble-tea: Some people like their drinks tart and fruity, while others prefer something sweet and milky. In this arcade game, you can blend honeydew, matcha, raspberry, or mocha in countless ways. Add chewy bubbles made from fruit jelly or tapioca to finish each cup of boba bubble tea. Every drink you craft helps a line of thirsty customers.

The game is played by tapping, mixing, and shaking your way through each order. Every customer has a favourite drink, and you serve it by adding the correct amount of each ingredient. Get an order exactly right to coll
arrows-idle: Arrows Idle is a puzzle game built around merging arrows. Your aim is to clear the whole grid, and well-timed merges can set off large chain reactions. As you upgrade, the board moves toward a smooth, flowing state. The game is tagged merge, clicker, and idle.

Controls are simple. Click the arrows to interact with them, and click the upgrade buttons to strengthen your progress. You also have skill buttons, and each one gives you extra money to put toward your next step.
bump-i: Bump.io drops you into a competition with 16 cars, and your aim is to win by avoiding collisions with monsters and boundaries. Hitting other vehicles earns you energy, while destroying them makes your car grow in volume. Balancing the need to stay out of trouble with the chance to take down rivals gives every run its own rhythm.

Keep an eye on the monsters and the edges of the play area, because one wrong move can cost you the win. Build up energy, knock out vehicles, and watch your car swell as the match goes on. Whether you are chasing a rival or dodging a threat, every moment on the field matters.
bank-robbery-puzzle: This puzzle game puts you in charge of a bank robbery. Select the hero you want to play, then slip past security systems while keeping away from guards. Every heist is dangerous, so each move needs careful thought.

Your aim is to get inside the bank and leave with a large sum of money. Success depends on choosing the right characters and sending them off to handle their tasks in the correct order. Use your cleverness and planning to show that you have what it takes in the world of theft.
fristailo-granny: Forget relaxing on a park bench. Here, the heroine bounces across a crowded highway, leaps over passing trucks, pulls off ambulance stunts, and shows off her style at every turn. Freestyle is the core of the game. You improvise dance moves while the road keeps rushing by.

Keep moving to chain together crazy combos, since constant motion is what earns the biggest scores. The game has several levels, and each one grows harder and more mystical than the last. You can also challenge your friends to see who collects the most freestyle points. To start your routine, press A or D on your keyboard, or use the arrow keys on your phone. Keep practicing until you become a true freestyle master.
halloweem-pumpkin-adventure: Halloween Pumpkin Adventure is a playful browser game with a spooky October feel. Your job is to steer a pumpkin across the screen until it reaches the finish line. Controls are simple: a tap or mouse click makes the pumpkin rise, so you can time each press to keep it moving forward.

It works well for anyone who enjoys light puzzles and quick skill challenges, and it is built to be picked up in a few seconds. Try to finish the course and see how well you can handle the Halloween fun.
evil-granny-must-die-ch2: You are alone in a park, and your job is to find six keys and take down Evil Granny. Expect trouble, because she has help. Three weapons are available: a lead pipe, a Colt .45, and a shotgun. Scroll the mouse wheel to switch between them, and press G to throw grenades.

The game uses 3D graphics across a big map packed with horror and action. Jumpscares and scary sounds add to the tension as you explore. The controls are intuitive and easy to pick up: WASD moves you, the mouse lets you look around, left click fires, and right click aims. Press R to reload and F to pick up items. Left Shift and T are also assigned to controls of their own.
solitaire-match-puzzle: Solitaire Match Puzzle is a card puzzle with a food theme. Dishes and desserts from around the world appear on the cards, so you might come across hot pot, barbecue, custard tarts, or pasta, along with many other favorites. Each time a game starts, a large number of food cards appear, and they overlap one another.

Playing is simple: just click with your mouse or tap the screen. Because the food comes from many different places, every round offers a varied mix of dishes and desserts. It is a good choice for anyone who likes puzzles with a tasty twist.
balls-animal: Balls Animal is a brain teaser where you sort colorful balls into matching tubes to solve puzzles. The challenges grow harder as you go, and the game offers more than 500 levels, so there is plenty to work through over a long session. Each stage asks you to plan your moves carefully before you act.

Cute animal characters add charm to every puzzle, making the experience feel friendly and playful. The rules are simple to learn but take real thought to master, which suits puzzle fans of all ages. To play, click a bottle to choose the ball you want to move, then click the bottle where you want it to go.
idle-hotel-empire-tycoon: You take charge of a modest hotel as its manager. Your job is to build it up by opening and improving guest rooms, restaurants, leisure areas, and several cafes. Making the building look nicer, both outside and inside, draws in more guests. You can also hire staff to look after the rooms and open parking lots. Reinvesting what the hotel earns helps your income multiply over time.

This is an idle tycoon game, so expect to keep developing your business over a long stretch of play. Opening every room and leisure facility, such as halls, cafes, and parks, increases how much you earn from each visitor. To speed up service, tap the progress bars above the cashier desks and the reception. Watching short videos also grants temporary, instant boosts to your earnings. Everything you need is reachable from the main screen, and a left click handles every interaction.
world-war-iii: This 3D adventure challenges you to take down 50 robots, and defeating them all is how you win. The title points to a planned future conflict between humans and machines, and the story takes place on Mars, so the game could just as easily have been called Mars War I, a playful thought worth a smile.

Everything is controlled with a mouse and keyboard. Move with W, A, S, and D or the arrow keys, fire with the left mouse button, and use the right button to aim. Press Space to jump and Shift to speed up.
rescue-fairy-castle: Rescue Fairy Castle is a puzzle game that gives your brain a workout. Each puzzle asks you to tug the right pins, and you need to think ahead before you act. Your main mission is to save the fairy while steering clear of a range of tricky obstacles, so every choice matters.

Keep watch for goblins, since they may attack as you make your way forward. Each correct pin you pull can open a path toward the treasure hidden inside the castle. Tagged for kids and listed under puzzles, this game suits anyone who enjoys a brain-teasing rescue story.
doodle-guard-draw-to-save: Doodle Guard is a physics puzzle played on a sheet of notebook paper. You sketch one stroke with your finger, and it turns into a solid object that falls. Soon, water balloons, angry bees, tomato cannons, bowling balls, and watermelons start heading toward a cartoon hero who needs protection.

Your job is to keep the hero safe until the timer runs out. A dome shields the hero from bees and balloons, while a wall blocks cannon tomatoes. You cannot draw through the ground or through the hero. Save ink to earn up to three stars. Levels never end, and you can gather 11 heroes and 7 pens along the way. Mouse and touch both work, and pressing R restarts a level.
gears-of-war-platformer: This side-scrolling action platformer takes its style from classic Flash games. Your task is to fight through five wrecked districts, blasting whatever stands in your path. Your arsenal includes a Lancer, a shotgun, and grenades, and you will need to master active reloads to stay in the fight. Each weapon gives you a different way to handle the chaos around you.
The game mixes shooting, action, adventure, and platforming, so expect plenty of gunplay alongside jumping. Getting started is simple: click the mouse or tap the screen and the game begins.
paintball-gun-pixel-3d: Paintball Gun Pixel 3D is a multiplayer shooting game set in a pixel-style 3D world. You compete with players from around the globe, aiming to become the best player and win each match you enter. Every round brings a new group of opponents, so there is always a fresh chance to prove your skill.

Use the W, A, S and D keys to move your player, and use the mouse to aim and fire your paintball gun. The spacebar makes your character jump, and the Tab key opens the menu. Learning these controls well will help you keep up with faster rivals and push toward a win.
the-trendy-mermaid: Help Ariel stage a stylish return by choosing makeup, accessories, and outfits for her. The game offers a large range of clothing, cosmetics, and extras, so you can shape her into the most fashionable mermaid around. Creating a dreamy, glamorous look is the main fun here, and the game is free for any girl to enjoy. Everything is controlled with the mouse.

Ariel is the star of this single-player dress-up adventure, which combines fantasy and makeover play. Work through each step of styling to build a look you are proud of. Whether you like soft, romantic colors or bold, eye-catching outfits, there is room to experiment and try new combinations.
unicorn-chef-mermaid-cake: The game gives you a kitchen full of realistic cooking tools. You can use an oven, piping bags, a spatula, bowls, plates, a cream mixer, a food processor, an induction cooker, an ice cream dispenser, a knife, a cutting board, a slushy dispenser, straws, cake molds, and many more.

Your pantry is just as well stocked. Fruits, candies, sprinkles, milk, flour, salt, butter, eggs, chocolate, ice cream, cream, water, cotton candy, cookies, caramel, and plenty of other ingredients and decorations are all available. Your goal is to create a mermaid cake from start to finish. Play with a mouse or by tapping the screen.
cow-cow-run: A peaceful cow's life takes a sharp turn when a UFO nation arrives, determined to kidnap it. Dodge the saucers while collecting coins, which go toward buying the cow's freedom. The game plays much like a 3D take on Pac-Man: you are the cow fleeing alien pursuers, and a level is finished only after every coin on it has been gathered. Few games share this formula, and the voxel art looks cozy and pleasant.

Coins can be spent on upgrades and bonuses, and certain upgrades raise the chance of bonuses appearing. Achievements unlock as you progress and make use of the game's mechanics. Sound is optional, though the music and effects are very enjoyable. There are 10 levels in total. Steer the cow with WASD, the arrow keys, or the Control keys, and gather buffs so you can make the most of the strongest ones.
pumpkin-wheel: Steer a large pumpkin that rolls through 30 levels in this funny title. Its colorful, original graphics make each level a pleasure to look at. The gameplay is simple yet hard to put down, so it works well as a relaxed way to pass the time. You speed up, slow down, and keep your pumpkin under close control to finish every level.
Set during the magical Halloween season, the game also asks you to follow the stars along the way. Controls are easy to learn: just click the mouse or tap to play.
outside: OUTSIDE strips puzzling down to the basics. Your single-eyed hero sits on a grid, and you must grab the key to open the exit door and move on. Once your character starts sliding in a chosen direction, it keeps going until a wall stops it, so every step needs thought. Good routes avoid dead ends, and you can use the surroundings to your benefit.

On a computer, use the arrow keys or WASD to move, R to restart, Q to return to the menu, and M to mute. On mobile, swipe across the screen to move, and tap the on-screen buttons for restart, menu, or mute. A gamepad is also supported. Each new level keeps testing your logic and sense of space.
sneaky-fits: Sneaky Fits is a one-player 2D puzzle game with an arcade feel. You choose the right stance so your character slips into the gaps cut into a wall and stays out of sight. You can bend and twist your figure to match each tight opening, but you must finish before a guard's flashlight beam sweeps across your position. Every stealthy stage calls for quick reactions, a good sense of space, and well-judged timing.
Controls are simple. A single click changes the character's position, while holding the click lets you drag the character so it fits the cutout.
head-jump: Head Jump is an arcade runner where your hero keeps moving forward on its own, so your job is to react in time. Traps line colorful mazes, and some obstacles stay hidden until you're close. You will need to jump, slide, and climb past them while staying alert for every bend and turn. The maze layouts are tangled and packed with surprises, so memory alone won't get you far.
The game is casual at heart, but the pace is very quick and keeps you on your toes. Beautiful music plays throughout and can keep you hoo
don-t-touch-the-dots: This arcade maze rewards careful movement and good timing. You guide a small blue square through 30 levels crowded with red dots that follow set routes. Gather every coin, then head for the purple finish area. Purple areas double as safe checkpoints: if a dot catches you, you are sent back to the last one you entered, and any coins you grabbed since then reappear on the board. A death counter keeps track of your mistakes.

On desktop, steer with the arrow keys or WASD, and press P or the pause button to pause. Menus and buttons work with the mouse. On mobile, turn your phone sideways, touch the left side of the screen, and drag the on-screen joystick. Tap the pause button when you need a break. Clearing a level for the first time, claiming daily gifts, and finishing daily tasks all earn gems. Spend them on new skins and trails to style your square.
mahjong-3d-match: Step into a three-dimensional take on mahjong, where quick thinking and careful aim matter most. You can plan each move ahead, rotate the board to see tiles from every side, and choose which pieces to clear with care. Each stage grows harder than the last, and you can keep playing offline while an absorbing soundtrack runs in the background.

The goal is to tap three matching tiles and gather them before the clock runs out. Finish the board fast to collect more stars and coins, then spend them in the shop on four distinct skills. Daily events add fresh challenges, and helpful aids such as reshuffling the tiles or grabbing extra seconds can help you push further.
subway-surfers-cambridge: This installment, World Tour Tokyo, picks up where the earlier adventures of the beloved characters left off, now taking them to the faraway land of India. Winding through the scenic streets of Mumbai, the runners also get a fresh selection of dresses to wear. The title keeps the familiar feel while adding new scenery to explore.
The gameplay is engaging and easy to get into. Your goal is straightforward: dash as fast as you can. Keep up your pace and see how far you can get.
set-the-box: Set The Box is a physics-based puzzle game focused on stacking skill and precision. Your goal is to pile boxes as high as you can without knocking the tower over. The taller the stack grows, the more unstable it becomes, so every placement matters. Each level calls for careful planning and precise control. The game is easy to pick up, but it takes real practice to master.

Controls are simple. Tap and hold the screen to drop a box, and remember that holding longer lets you position it more accurately. Stack each piece carefully on top of the last to build the tallest tower possible. Keep an eye on balance throughout, because one careless drop can topple everything you have built.
neon-snake: Neon Snake is a quick-moving arcade game set on a dark grid, where you steer a glowing serpent. Every orb you eat makes it longer and adds to your score. Chaining eats together builds a combo multiplier that can climb as high as eight times, but one misstep ends the run. It's simple to learn yet hard to walk away from.

Along the way, you can collect speed boosts, which suit daring, high-risk runs with big rewards, or slow orbs that give you a little more room to think. Rare bonus stars can send your points soaring. Players can compete on global leaderboards, with separate all-time and weekly rankings.
hungry-warrior-fight: Hungry Warrior Fight is a street combat action game that runs in your web browser and is ready for mobile devices. Its striking visuals and well-built combat mechanics keep every fight feeling fresh. The control setup is simple to learn, and a joystick lets you steer your fighter in any direction.

Martial arts techniques are performed with straightforward button commands. On a keyboard, WASD or the arrow keys walk, Z throws a punch, X handles foot attacks, kicks, and grabbing and pushing, V blocks, and Space makes your fighter jump. On phones and tablets, use the on-screen buttons that come with the game.
pumpkin-blast: Jack the pumpkin is trapped in a gloomy dungeon and needs a hand getting out. Your task is to guide him onto the secure zone while using as few tries as possible. Each blast of explosive pushes him in a chosen direction, so plan every shot carefully. Keep clear of the dangerous spikes, since one wrong move can ruin an attempt.
Each level also challenges you to collect three stars. Controls are simple, since a mouse click or tap is all you need. It is a Halloween-themed puzzle game built with HTML5 technology.
furious-gt-drift: Furious GT Drift puts you behind the wheel of high-performance GT cars, where the goal is to slide through corners with control. Your routes wind through glowing city streets, twisting mountain roads, and highways bathed in sunset light. Each bend checks how precise your line is, how well you time your moves, and how stylish your slides look.

You can personalize your car and improve its handling to suit your driving. Every drift combo you complete can set a new record to beat. Rewards you earn along the way help unlock faster machines, and the aim is to keep your slides smooth and your angles sharp on every track. Steer left and right with the arrow keys or with A and D.
3d-pool-mania: Step up to a solo billiards table in this 3D pool game, where you test your skills across a range of challenges. The physics follow realistic rules, so every ball moves the way you would expect on a real table. Handling is smooth and easy to pick up, and you can master trick shots as you go.

To aim, drag to position the cue stick, then adjust the power meter to set how hard you hit. Release to strike the cue ball. Think carefully about angles and spin so you can line up better shots. The pace is relaxing, yet there is still a competitive edge, and the immersive visuals and customizable options let you shape the experience to suit you.
monster-slayer-merge-and-survive: Monster Slayer: Merge & Survive is a dungeon adventure built around combining items. You join pieces together in a grid to create strong weapons and potions, and you put your planning to the test as you make your way through each dungeon. The game is free to play online in your browser, on both mobile and desktop, and it invites you to embrace your heroic side.

Your adventure has two parts. In the lower section of the screen, you merge weapon parts into powerful weapons that damage enemies, combine potions to restore health and improve your survival, and merge keys to unlock chests hidden throughout the dungeon that hold valuable loot. You can also collect and merge coin pouches to buy new items from the shop, or buy travel bags from the merchant to expand your inventory. In the upper section, your character moves through the dungeon one level at a time.
tetra-challenge: Tetra Challenge is a Tetris-style reverse puzzle game that tests your skill as you move through its levels. The goal is to place each block in the correct position so it matches properly. A successful match brings a reward, but if you misplace a block, an automatically moving block fills the play area until the game ends.

The graphics are high quality, and the game takes up very little space. Controls are simple: on Android, touch and drop the blocks into place, and on PC, use the mouse to do the same. Interesting quests add variety to the challenge.
halloween-monster-traffic: With Halloween approaching, a group of little monsters has work to do, but the roads are crowded with cars. Your job is to guide them across by tapping at the right moment. Each crossing depends on timing, so patience matters.

Along the way you will meet a range of obstacles spread across several levels, so the challenge keeps changing. Controls are simple: a mouse click or a tap is all it takes. Under the hypercasual label, this Halloween title also carries tags such as car, monster, and kids.
randomation-racing-speed-trial-demolitio: Players take the wheel on smooth asphalt circuits and get a taste of the rapid speeds usually reserved for professional drivers. Picture yourself competing in the style of Indycar or high-speed circuit events. Once you pick the "Real Speed" option, you join a field of skilled racers who push their cars to the edge on demanding tracks. This game simulates Grand Prix racing, so it is a challenge that not everyone will enjoy. The main goal is to prove you have what it takes to become a world rally champion on asphalt.
Use the Tab key to open the menu and the arrow keys to drive. Press C to switch camera views and B for turbo. R restarts your run, and the WASD keys let you look around.
path-control: Path Control is a physics puzzle where you guide a ball into the target basket. Several platforms can be rotated at the same time, so you need to plan how each one moves to lead the ball through every level. The ball bounces when it hits surfaces, so its path can be hard to predict at first. There is no friction, so the ball keeps rolling after it touches a platform and may take an extra second to settle.

Click or tap the screen to rotate the platforms and reach the target. Many barriers stand in the way, so think ahead before each move and clear each level carefully. It is tagged as difficult and works on mobile too.
obby-build-an-asmr-keyboard-tycoon: In this Roblox-style simulator, you assemble your own ASMR keyboard and turn it into a money-making machine. Every key press earns cash, and your aim is to build the most profitable and satisfying keyboard you can. Upgrade your typing speed, boost the money from each press, and unlock new colors, designs, and effects. Hire workers to generate income automatically, even while you explore.

Compete on the global leaderboard to become the richest ASMR keyboard owner. Better upgrades make your income grow faster, bringing you closer to the top. The relaxing ASMR atmosphere and satisfying visuals complete the experience. On PC, use WASD or the arrow keys to move, Space to jump, and hold the right mouse button to rotate the camera. On mobile, use the virtual joystick to move and swipe to rotate the camera.
jelly-bros-red-and-blue: Meet the Jelly Bros, a pair of goofy red and blue siblings who are wild and very funny. Your job is to get both brothers to the royal crown right away. They are separate characters, but their souls are linked, so if either one is harmed, both of them die. Keep an eye on the pair and move carefully. Along the way, be sure to collect the ores you spot.

Movement uses WASD or the arrow keys, and you can perform a double jump. Touch controls are available for mobile players. This 2D action adventure sits in the Arcade category and is tagged for two-player play.
a-mimicry-of-life: In 2057, you join a small team of geologists and scientists from different fields on a trip to the North Pole. Your goal is to study a strange asteroid that landed there. Before long, some members of the group begin acting oddly, and the cause is not obvious. Something is off: there is no blood where you would expect it, and your memories from before the expedition are unclear.

This pixel-style, top-down game mixes puzzles, role-playing elements, interactive fiction and horror. Use the arrow keys to move and hold Shift to sprint. Press Z or Enter to interact, and press X to pause.
masterpiece-unharmed: You are a night worker in a closed museum, where a set of famous paintings has been ruined just before an inspector arrives. Your job is to hide the damage, match the original colors, and save the museum before anyone notices. Each canvas opens with a short, silly story about how the mishap happened.

Study the damaged spot, then pick a shade with the pipette or palette and set the brush thickness with the slider. Fill the gap, and use the eraser or cancel a stroke if you slip. The mouse wheel or side slider zooms in on small details, and dragging moves the canvas. Click "Check" before the timer runs out.
