mine-blogger-simulator-3d: Dive into blogging in this 3D simulator. Earn subscribers and cash with every win, and aim for the championship crown. Pick from a wide range of topics for clips and games, film at home or outside, and hunt for winning combinations to make standout content.

Film alongside other creators, chat with them, and form friendships and partnerships that help everyone rise together. Upgrade your character's abilities to grow into a skilled pro, since each upload brings fame, money, and chances to level up your hero. To start, press Record New Video, set the options, let production run, then hit Finish Creation to publish. Your target is to reach the top spot as the number one blogger and unlock every achievement.
even-odd-dice: Even Odd Dice supports between one and four players, who each bet on the result of a roll. Before every throw, each person picks either "even" or "odd." Then you press the dice and see how the numbers fall. The goal is to call whether the total of the dice will come up even or odd. The rules are simple, and the betting adds a gambling flavor, so it suits family nights, gatherings with friends, or a quiet game on your own.

Each round depends on chance, but thinking ahead still helps. You can look back at earlier rolls and try to judge when your luck might turn. A separate mode lets one player aim for the longest possible run of correct calls, facing fate alone with no opponents. It works on mobile devices and with a mouse, and it sits in the board and brain-teaser category.
zrist-dx: Zrist DX is a retro, pixel-style 2D arcade game built around endless running. You weave past one obstacle after another while the rules of play keep shifting, so you have to keep adapting as you go. It is an expanded and upgraded version of the original Zrist, which also centers on an endless runner whose rules change during play. This version adds a progression system, a shop, and a good deal more.

Here is how the controls work. On desktop, press X or left-click to jump, and press C or right-click to slide. On mobile, touch the right side of the screen to jump and the left side to slide. It is a single-player game.
arkanoid-for-painters: This online arcade title asks you to sketch a barrier that helps you control a ball, rather than steering a standard paddle. Your goal is to clear blocks and defeat foes. The game blends retro-style play with artistic touches, so it suits players who enjoy planning their moves in creative ways. You can play on iOS, Android, or desktop, which means its challenges are available wherever you happen to be.

Instead of moving a flat board along the bottom of the screen, you draw the obstacle for the ball yourself. Plenty of interesting upgrades are waiting for you to discover as you play. Use the left mouse button to draw, or use your finger on a touchscreen.
nutrition-school: Nutrition School teaches young players about eating well through four activities. Kids can explore a variety of foods, choose nutritious items while shopping, and feed their character. They can also take quizzes that reward them with game coins. The game aims to help children grasp why good food choices count, and it presents healthy eating in a light, enjoyable way. Players who want more coins can buy them through in-app purchases.

Controls are simple on any device. On a phone or tablet, tap the screen and drag to move items around. On a computer, hold the left mouse button and drag to move the elements. Either way, the focus stays on learning about healthy food.
luchaball: In Luchaball, you knock the different masks off each Luchaball, then equip every one of them with a green mask. Along the way, you can collect pickups, and the challenge is to see how far you can progress through this endless physics game. It sits in the shooting category and carries the arcade tag, so it fits fast, straightforward play.

Aiming works entirely with your mouse, and a left click fires your shot. The distance between your cursor and the mask matters: the further your mouse is from the mask, the harder the shot is fired. Keep that in mind as you line up each attempt.
escape-from-the-crypt: Slip out of a crypt one chamber at a time while necromancers chase you. They are quicker than you, yet they cannot step around obstacles, so lead them into dead ends to buy yourself space. On a computer, the arrow keys steer your character, Backspace takes back your last move, and pressing H brings up a hint. Phone and tablet players can use the on-screen D-pad and buttons instead.
red-impostor-guys-multiplayer-race: In Red Impostor Guys, you dash through dozens of racing courses while gathering crowns. Your aim is to claim the title of winner of the day. Each race pits you against 10 to 40 players. Purchased costumes change how your character looks, and the game includes 20 uniform costumes to try out across its 10 maps.

The game is set in the world of Fall Days and offers a completely different mechanic for players to discover. You can steer with WASD, ZQSD, or the arrow keys, and mobile touch controls are supported as well.
yasin-cengiz-game: Step into the shoes of TikToker Yasin as he scrambles to snag every bite of food that comes tumbling down during a hectic round. Each piece you miss and let hit the ground costs you one of your lives, so keep your eyes sharp. Bombs also drop into the mix, and you need to dodge them to stay in the game.

Along the way, you can gather cash and coins, which you spend on power-ups that raise your speed and grant special abilities. Every upgrade helps you push for the highest score. Controls are simple: just click or tap with your mouse to play. This one-player hypercasual game keeps the focus on quick reactions.
astro-shooter: Astro Shooter is an arcade shooter where threats arrive from every side. You pilot an advanced starfighter through nonstop waves of foes swarming in from all directions. During a run, grab power-ups for temporary boosts that make your ship far stronger, and battle huge three-dimensional boss vessels along the way.

Coins you collect can be spent in the permanent garage, where you can unlock new ships and raise your core stats so each attempt can reach further. When a run ends, the progress you have made in the garage carries over to your next attempt. Controls are simple: on desktop, steer your ship with the mouse cursor, and on mobile, use the on-screen joysticks.
snake-color-challenge: Snake Color Rush is a fast-paced arcade game where quick reactions and smart planning both matter. It takes the familiar idea of the classic snake game and adds a colorful spin. Set in a lively, ever-changing space, it throws obstacles at you that shift color as you go, so you have to keep an eye on every turn.

Playing is simple, since the game runs online in your web browser and you can start right away. It is free-to-play, so you can pick it up whenever you like and steer your snake through the shifting course without any setup to worry about.
coloring-and-learning: Coloring And Learning is a realistic coloring game with more than 250 pages of educational content, so people of all ages can find something to work on. It offers two creative settings. In Free mode, you can sketch, scribble, shade, and let your imagination run. Glow mode lets you make magic doodle artwork with neon paint.

The game suits the whole family, so parents and children can enjoy it together. Drawing and coloring work much as they do on paper, using a range of different tools. You can color alongside your kids or hold coloring contests with them. The possibilities are wide open, and everything is controlled by tapping or clicking.
hero-tower-wars-online: Hero Tower Wars Online is an action adventure with a tower defense twist. A brave little heroine sets out to take down the towers where a princess is held captive, and it is up to you to free her from a range of enemies. In each level, you move your character through the tower by working out addition, subtraction, and multiplication problems, which raises your level and helps you defeat every foe. Gather objects along the way, since they add coins you can use to unlock different skins. Finish levels to push your score higher.
To move your character onto the towers, right-click with the mouse. On mobile devices and tablets, touch the character and drag it across each tower.
capybara-hexasort: Capybara-HexaSort is a calm color-sorting puzzle with a cheerful capybara theme. Stacks of hexagonal tiles wait in a tray at the bottom, and you set them onto empty spots across the board. When neighboring stacks share a matching top color, they sort and merge on their own. Each level sets its own goal, and those goals grow tougher as you progress. Think through every move, collect rewards along the way, and enjoy the mix of strategy and cozy visuals.

Watch the free cells closely, since the level is lost if there is no room left for the next stack. On a phone, tap or drag a stack and release it over an empty board cell. On a desktop, hold the left mouse button, drag the stack, and let go over an open space. In-game buttons handle boosters, pause and settings, sound, music, and haptics.
moto-stunt-online: Moto Stunt Online is a motocross game with more than twenty-four stages to tackle. Each one opens up as you progress, and you can then pick from four different motorbike styles. Cash earned along the way lets you purchase new bikes and improve the ones you already own, while every stage throws fresh obstacles your way. The art uses bright, playful cartoon visu
rings-and-dot: Rings and Dot! takes the three-by-three grid from tic-tac-toe and swaps the marks for stacks of colored, nested rings. Each square holds layers instead of Xs and Os. Any three matching colors that sit in a straight run, across a row, down a column, or along a diagonal, disappear and earn points. The size of each piece doesn't matter, so a large outer ring, a smaller one, or the tiny center dot all count equally.

Pieces come from a tray. Drag one onto an open square or tap it, but it only fits where its rings have room. Clearing several lines with a single move multiplies your points, and chaining clears builds bigger multipliers. When moves run thin, the discard and eraser tools free up space. There is no winning moment. The run goes on until the board fills up, so your goal is to beat your best score.
road-fury-racing: Road Fury is a three-dimensional racing game where your main aim is to cross the finish line before anyone else. The course is packed with rivals, hazards, traps, and ramps, along with sharp corners that test your reactions and driving skill. Every collision wears down your car. The body can break apart, wheels may fly off, and the vehicle becomes harder to handle. Nitro delivers powerful speed boosts, which help you overtake opponents and get clear of danger.

You can upgrade your current car or buy new models as you work toward the front of the pack. On a phone or tablet, touch and swipe to steer. On a PC, use WASD to drive and double-tap W to activate turbo.
snow-race-3d-fun-racing: Snow Race 3D: Fun Racing is a single-player arcade game set around a snowy race. Your job is to gather the snow around you and pack it into huge snowballs. You can then use those snowballs to build ladders and climb up to higher levels of the course.

Your rivals are just as skilled, so you have to beat the clock while also outpacing them. The first runner to cross the finish line takes the win. Controls are simple: click the mouse or tap the screen. Aim to become a true snowball master as you go.
laser-slasher: This arcade puzzler lets you steer laser turrets that smash blocks, with each impact delivering satisfying ASMR effects. It is built for stress-free relaxation and uses easy one-tap controls. Progressive upgrades and turret customization add variety, making it a good fit for quick breaks or longer sessions.

Your mission is to destroy every block by aiming your lasers and reversing their direction. Blocks you break drop buffs such as +1 Count, +1 Damage, or +1 Speed. Gather these buffs to become stronger and finish the level faster. On PC, click the left mouse button or press Space to reverse the turrets, and hold either one to stop their movement. On mobile, tap and release to reverse direction, or tap and hold to stop movement.
tilt-and-tumble: Tilt & Tumble is a skill-based arcade game for mobile that gets you playing without extensive tutorials. You steer with either a joystick or your device's accelerometer, guiding the paddle with precision to keep the ball in play and earn points. The music is dynamic, and you can unlock several different paddles as you go.

Tilt your device left or right to roll the ball in the direction you want. Watch out for walls, spikes, and other traps, since avoiding them keeps your ball intact. Grab coins or gems along the way to raise your score. Each level has a time limit, so reach the finish line as quickly as you can while staying careful enough to win.
merge-gun-fps-shooting-zombie: Your job in Merge Gun: FPS Shooting Zombies is to take down every undead creature that charges at you before they can reach and kill you. Before heading into the fight, you can purchase additional firearms and combine identical ones to create stronger, more advanced weapons. Upgraded ammo that is more powerful and fires faster in each clip makes it easier to handle the waves of enemies.

Zombies and crows keep advancing toward you even while you are reloading, so timing matters. When needed, stay steady and shoot the explosive oil cans lying on the ground. Controls are simple: click or tap with your mouse to play.
clown-park-hide-and-seek: Clown Park Hide and Seek is an arcade game that pits one camp against another. It features attractive graphics and a three-dimensional space to play in. The two sides, Survivor camp and Chaser camp, each have their own goal.

Survivors must gather enough keys before the time limit runs out, then unlock the escape door and get out to win. Chasers have the opposite task: they need to slow the survivors down and stop them from getting away. Playing is simple, since a mouse click or a tap is all you need.
miner-dig-it-all: Your drill runs on a single tank of fuel, so the goal is to see how deep the pit will let you go. Drag with the mouse to lay a line of dynamite, or click once to plant a single stick. Set the charges off, then hold the drill on the loosened rock to grind it away. Clear a layer and it collapses beneath you into a richer one.

On the surface, sell your ore and buy a tougher bit, wider blasts, or a robot crew before diving again. Ten layers down waits a lava core. Crack it open and the whole pit starts over, permanently richer. Touch players tap to plant, drag to lay lines, and hold to drill, with charges firing on their own. Right click fires early, Space fires planted charges, and Esc or Tab pauses.
brain-crazy-iq-challenge-puzzle: Brain Crazy: IQ Challenge Puzzle is a hard-to-put-down brain game that tests your common sense, logic, and lateral thinking. Its hundreds of offbeat riddles, sneaky brain teasers, and funny scenarios push against conventional reasoning, so the answer you reach for first is often the wrong one.

Read each prompt closely, because clues can hide in word choice, punctuation, or phrasing. The most literal or absurd reading is often the right one. Tap, drag, swipe, shake, rotate, or hold things on screen, since many pieces can be moved, combined, or uncovered. Drag background items, peel off stickers, or shift obstacles to reveal hidden keys and solutions. When you're completely stuck, tap the lightbulb icon for step-by-step hints.
mini-car-room-parkour: Take the wheel of a tiny car and head into an ordinary house, where every piece of furniture becomes a towering obstacle. Each room you enter offers its own challenge. Race across the floor, then roll up ramps onto chairs and tables, picking out your own route through the furniture. Steering takes care, because steep climbs test your balance.

Drive with WASD or the arrow keys on your keyboard, or use the virtual controls on mobile devices. Your aim is to see how far you can get, and every room brings a fresh adventure as everyday objects turn into giant hurdles. Keep the car steady, move with patience, and enjoy the trip through the living space.
fake-ninjas: Fake Ninjas is an action game set in a town where impostors have shamed your master. Your task is to track down every one of these phony ninjas and win back your honour in the master's eyes. Click on the ground to move, or tap the screen if you're on a touch device. Each step takes you closer to an enemy, and you must reach every fake ninja to take them out.

The game rewards quick thinking and careful movement, since you need to reach each target to eliminate it. Every enemy you defeat helps you show the master what you are capable of. It is a simple, skill-based title that puts you in control of a single ninja on a mission to restore your reputation.
offroad-cycle-3d-racing-simulator: Offroad Cycle 3D Racing Simulator puts you on a bike in a lifelike take on cycling competition over rough terrain. The ride is meant to feel intense and full of thrill, and the visuals are one of the game's strongest points. Several different places to race add variety as you settle into the mood of a fast, bumpy event.

Controls are simple: use W, A, S and D to drive, press Space to brake, and press C to switch the camera view. Built with WebGL and HTML5, it runs right in your browser. It is a good way to see how well you cope with off-road racing.
monster-spaceship-shooter: In this fast-paced arcade bullet-hell shooter, you guide a ship through a glowing space arena filled with twisting laser trails and relentless projectiles. A fiery boss entity looms over the battle, and your task is to dodge everything it sends your way. The action never really slows down, so you must stay alert from start to finish.

Success comes down to precise movement and the ability to slip past attacks by the narrowest of margins. Lightning-fast reflexes are your best tool when the screen becomes a chaotic blur of light. Controls are simple: a mouse click or a tap is all it takes to begin.
cleaning-the-islands: Cleaning the Islands puts you in the shoes of a survivor living on a barren desert island. Your job is to gather materials scattered across the land and sell them for gold coins. With that money you can build your own island, shaping it into something you are proud of. Along the way, you can upgrade your tools so work gets done faster, and you can expand your backpack so it holds a larger stock of materials.
Everything is controlled with a simple mouse click or tap. It is a 2D casual arcade title that runs in the browser with HTML5. Keep gathering, selling, and building to see your island take shape.
my-clearn-robot: My Clean Robot is a side-scrolling action game in which you guide a brave robot through an apartment to fight off nasty viruses. Each level brings its own challenges, and upgrades help your robot grow stronger as you progress. The gameplay feels fluid, so it runs smoothly on whatever device you choose.
On a keyboard, use WASD to move and turn, press J for hand attacks, and press K for leg attacks. On mobile, move and turn with the joystick, then tap the hand button or the leg button to attack.
super-megabot-adventure: Super Megabot Adventure is a side-scrolling shoot 'em up with an adventure feel. You pilot robots that can switch between several armed forms, and as you go you can unlock stronger abilities and spend earnings on new weapons at the shop. The main path is Mission Mode, where your goal is to clear every level on each difficulty setting. Once that is done, you can test yourself in Survival Mode.
On a computer, press W to jump, A to move left, and D to move right, while Q and E let you swap weapons. On a phone or tablet, simply tap the on-screen buttons to play. Enjoy your time with the game.
456-challenge-jigsaw: Fans of a certain film will find 456 Challenge Jigsaw to be an unusual puzzle game built around jigsaw pieces. The game offers 12 images to assemble, and several background images add variety to the experience. Each picture is a matching challenge that tests how well you can fit the pieces together.

Mouse or tap controls let you work through the puzzles, so you can play on a desktop or a mobile device. It works as a brain-teasing pastime for kids and anyone who enjoys matching games. We hope you have fun with it.
classics-car-stunts-2020: Classics Car Stunts 2020 is an action driving game that puts you behind the wheel of a Jeep. It belongs to the crowded family of parking simulators, but this time the focus is on stunts high in the sky. The game was built with Unity3D and runs through WebGL, and it is filed under driving.

Controls are simple: the W, A, S and D keys handle all of the driving. The game gives the parking simulator formula a fresh spin, swapping tight lots for a Jeep that performs stunts in the sky. Enjoy the ride.
sandwich-runner-2: Sandwich Runner 2 is a fun racing game with a food theme. As you dash toward the goal, you collect ingredients, and the height they reach is part of the challenge. A very hungry diner is waiting, and he can hardly wait to tuck in. Grab steaks, chicken thighs, fried eggs, and sushi along the way.

Stay away from bad food such as mold and rot, because it will make the diner sick. Red peppers have the opposite effect and leave him fired up. Your task is to keep the diner happy and get through each level. To play, just click the mouse or tap the screen.
princess-fashion-makeover: Princess Fashion Makeover is a dress-up game all about creating a royal look. Your wardrobe includes many lovely princess gowns, plus sparkling tiaras, bracelets, high heels, magic wands, necklaces, and earrings. Combining these pieces leaves you feeling like a cheerful little princess. The game offers plenty of graceful outfits and accessories, so you can mix and match however you like and fulfill all your princess fantasies.
Once you've finished dressing up, choose a stylish pose and let the camera capture the moment. Controls are simple: just click with your mouse or tap the screen to play.
tcg-shop-dino-adventure: In this dinosaur-themed trading card shop, you face league rivals in three-on-three matchups. Each card does double duty: its strength determines how hard it hits, and that same number shows how much punishment it can absorb. You can steer the action with a mouse pointer or with your finger.

Victories bring coins, which you spend on packs at the shop and open with a tap. Every card you pull gives you a choice. Flick it left to sell it for coins, or flick it right to slide it into your binder. Keep cycling through this routine to strengthen your deck, move up the leagues, and work toward a full collection.
mosquito-fight-number-battle: Mosquito Fight: Number Battle is a fast-paced .io game where your size, your number, and your ability to survive decide who comes out on top. You zip across the arena, gather colorful energy dots, and watch your number climb as you collect more. Rival mosquitoes are always nearby, but one careless move can send you straight back to the start.

Steer with your mouse or your touch controls, which keep things simple. Circle around opponents, steal the resources they want, and outmaneuver stronger foes before they crash into you. A speed boost helps you escape danger, chase enemies, or grab valuable energy at just the right moment. Matches are quick and chaotic, and the higher your number and score, the higher you climb the leaderboard.
tiny-delivery: Tiny Delivery blends two familiar ideas: bringing food to customers and climbing hills in a car. You can personalize your vehicle and its wheels in the shop, then finish every level with the ride you like best. Before a run begins, you may switch on the truck rack, which holds the food in place and makes each level a little easier to complete.

To drive, press the left and right arrow keys on a computer keyboard, or tap the left and right buttons on the touchscreen when playing on a phone. These controls move your car forward and backward so you can reach the customer. Watch the cargo closely, because if any food tumbles to the ground, the level is lost.
jelly-bro: Jelly Bro is a single-player 2D arcade adventure with action elements, made for Android. You guide a sweet green jelly named Bro toward a crown. Her route is lined with thorns, and one touch means she dies, so you have to move carefully across every thorny road to reach the finish.
Controls are simple. Use W, A, S, and D or the arrow keys to move her. She can also jump a second time while in the air.
town-builder-inc: Town Builder Inc. is an arcade game centred on collecting cash and stacking your earnings. As you play, you unlock businesses across a growing town, raise how much your operation can hold, and hire workers to keep everything running. Progress comes step by step, so a small street operation can gradually expand into a large idle money-making tycoon empire.

You guide your stickman through the town using the W, A, S, and D keys or the arrow keys. Gather money as you go, then spend it on new businesses and capacity upgrades. The game also carries adventure and building elements, so you can shape the town around your growing financial empire one decision at a time.
exploring-the-galaxy-1-andora: Andora is a free browser game in the adventure genre where you build up your own planet. Move around the world, chop trees, break rocks, and pick up ore. Bring what you collect to processing sites and workshops to make materials for upgrades and crafting. Upgrading your tools lets you gather faster and reach tougher resources.

Spend your resources to push outward, opening new land tiles and unexplored areas. Travel through different biomes, track down new materials, and finish quests for rewards. Keep pesky creatures away or chase them off so construction can continue undisturbed. Building and speeding up facilities boosts your output. Tip: upgrade your tools before expanding, since that tends to make progress steadier. Controls: WASD and mouse on PC, joystick and touch on phones.
kiddie-farmers: Step into a bright little world where children run their own farm-to-table market. These young shopkeepers create a range of products and sell them to fellow kids. You play a budding business owner, responsible for overseeing the market and expanding what it does.

Your goal is to guide these young entrepreneurs as they grow their business, helping the supermarket thrive until it becomes the place every child in the community wants to visit. Use the arrow keys to move around, and use your mouse to make upgrades.
dead-target-zombie-shooter: Dead Target Zombie Shooter puts your patience and nerves to the test. Storms of zombies charge at you, so staying calm and taking a moment to study your surroundings matters as much as quick reaction. It is one of many zombie shooting games, but this one stands out with its horrifying dead enemies and fierce environmental effects that keep every fight tense.

The controls are simple to learn. Use W, A, S and D to move and the mouse to fire. Shift lets you run and Space makes you jump. Press keys 1 through 6 to switch between weapons, and press T to slow down time.
breakoid-game: BreakOid puts a fresh spin on the classic Arkanoid style of block-breaking. Its graphics, visuals, and sound give the game a lively look and feel. In normal mode, you work through the levels and see how many you can break through.

Endless mode challenges you to climb as high as you can using special abilities. Once the original stages feel too easy, open the level editor and design your own block-breaking challenges. Controls are simple: on a computer, move the mouse left and right to slide the paddle and hit the ball. On mobile, tap the paddle, then swipe across the screen to move it around.
run-rich: Run Rich is a simple hypercasual game that now runs in your web browser. Your goal is to grab coins all the way to the finish line so your character becomes wealthy. As your fortune grows, so does the style of your outfit. Keep clear of bottles, trash, and bad habits, since those will hurt your look. The controls are easy to pick up, and the visual effects help pull you into the action.
You can steer with your mouse or touchpad. On a desktop computer, the W, A, S, and D keys or the arrow keys work too. Have a good time with it.
yeti-run: Yeti Run is an arcade skiing game with no finish line. You race down a mountain that never ends, and you steer by sliding a finger or the mouse left or right. The game controls your speed, so your job is mainly carving turns. Trees, boulders, and lift poles are waiting on the slope, and hitting any of them ends the run.

Weave through paired gates to rack up points and build a combo, but a missed gate wipes out that combo. A yeti chases you throughout the run. He cannot end your run, but if he catches you, you are knocked into thick snow where you move slowly and lose your combo. Tapping once starts a new run right away. Collect snowmen along the way to unlock skins in the shop, or complete missions for bonus snowmen. Your goal is to ski past the flag from your best run and plant it farther down the mountain.
kick-the-teddy-bear: Kick The Teddy Bear is a lighthearted clicker made for easing stress. You get to kick a teddy bear around in this 2D, physics-driven game, which is built to be funny. Tap to start, and it runs on mobile devices too.

Along the way, you can buy a large selection of weapons and use them against the puppet. Options include guns and rockets, so you can keep trying new ways to work off your frustration. Expect endless entertainment, and it
capi-bar: Capi Bar blends idle play, business management and relaxing gameplay into one calm experience. You merge fruits such as watermelons, oranges and coconuts to save juice, then gradually upgrade your bar over time. Merging is simple to pick up, and its cheerful loop makes it easy to come back to again and again.

A capybara is the main character and your helper, so you manage the bar alongside it. As you progress, you can improve your equipment, buy new bars and counters, and add interior elements. The business side stays low-key, and every upgrade feels worthwhile. Your income keeps building even when you are away from the game, which suits anyone who enjoys slow progress and offline games. Bright graphics, smooth animations and pleasant sounds create a soothing, stress-easing mood.
cut-it-voxel-crusher: Picture a workshop built for demolition. You steer a high-tech robotic arm that carries a spinning chainsaw. Drag or swipe anywhere on the screen to move the saw, grinding into structures made from hundreds of bright voxels. As the blocks give way, they crumble, blow apart, and break down with realistic physics, accompanied by calming sound effects and clear visual feedback.
Keep an eye on the fuel bar, because moving the saw uses it up. You collect coins from destroyed voxels, then spend them in the main menu
rough-ball: Rough Ball is a physics-based platformer that is hard to put down yet genuinely tough. You guide a mischievous smiley ball through hazardous rocky caverns, rolling, bouncing, and sliding your way toward the red flag while steering clear of fatal pits. Slick slopes and awkward jumps stand in your path, and charming skull warnings flag the danger ahead. Every stage calls for careful precision and well-timed moves in this playful "do not fall" challenge.

On a computer, the left and right arrow keys roll the ball, and the spacebar makes it jump. On a phone or tablet, drag the on-screen joystick to roll left or right, and tap the jump button to bounce into the air.
kitty-unicorn-daily-care: Meet a kitten who is also a unicorn. In this animal game, you groom her and look after her day to day, keeping her looking her best. Along the way, you can try the built-in mini games for extra variety. Kate, the unicorn kitten, is your companion for the whole day, so there is plenty of time to spend with her and watch her routine unfold.
To play, just click with your mouse or tap the screen. Whether you want to groom her or try one of the mini games, you can spend the day with this cute unicorn kitten.
mega-ramp-car-stunts-gt-racing: Mega Ramp Car Stunts GT Racing is a high-speed driving game built around powerful sports cars. Your routes might run across tracks high in the sky, over massive ramps, along winding zigzag roads, or through tricky stunt courses. Pull off impressive jumps, dodge dangerous obstacles, and reach the finish line without tumbling off the track. The game sits in the racing category and covers car, drift, driving, simulation, and stunts.

On desktop, use the W, A, S, and D keys to move, press Space to brake, and hold Shift for a boost. P pauses the game and N skips the current level. On mobile, use the left and right buttons to steer, the race button to go, and the brake button to slow down.
walk-master-stilt-walker: This arcade game is all about stilt walking, and it puts your agility to the test. Your character starts out awkward, but every stretch of ground you cover makes your moves smoother and more confident. You wobble through woodlands and open meadows, building your skills until you become a true stilt expert. Along the way, you'll meet one-of-a-kind levels and unusual creatures.

On a computer, hold the spacebar or left mouse button to raise the stilt, then let go to lower it. Alternate your presses to take each step. On a phone or tablet, press and hold your finger on the screen to lift the stilt, then release to lower it. Tap in a steady rhythm to keep moving and stay balanced.
brutal-defender: Brutal Defender is a single-player 3D shooter packed with extreme violence and gore. Your job is to defend against every enemy force that comes at you, using a large arsenal of weapons to take them all down.

The controls are simple. Use W, A, S, and D to move, and left mouse button to shoot. Press R to reload, F to use, and Space to jump. If you need a break, tap P to pause. Blood and action are central to the game, so it suits anyone who likes gory shooters.
go-up-samurai: Go! Up! Samurai is a browser action game built with HTML5. You enter a lively samurai world where fast reactions and clever planning matter most. Your task is to move skillfully through a range of challenges and foes, and accuracy and ability count for a lot. The game is tagged as Action and Ninja.
Walk with A and D, or with the Left and Right Arrow keys. Press W or the Up Arrow to jump, and S or the Down Arrow to kick. Shift also makes you jump. Press R to restart the game, or Esc to exit.
arrows-disappear: Arrows Disappear puts you in front of a tall pile of 3D blocks, each one marked with an arrow pointing in some direction. Your job is to spot the blocks pointing up and remove them with a tap, while leaving alone any that point down, left, or right. Speed and accuracy both matter, because the tower will topple if it climbs too high before you clear it. Quick, accurate taps earn you a higher score.

The visuals are clean and three-dimensional, and the blocks react to each removal in a satisfying way. As you go, the pace picks up and the stack becomes more complicated, which keeps the tension rising. Controls are simple: click the upward blocks with a mouse on PC, or tap them on a touchscreen on mobile. It is easy to pick up, but it is always tempting to try just one more level.
popsy-blocks: Popsy Blocks is a relaxed block puzzle with a pop-it spin, set in a world of sweet, candy-toned bubbles. Drag colorful pieces onto the grid and complete a full row or column to make it vanish. The game never sticks with plain blocks for long. Trains roll along their tracks, safes conceal codes, soap dishes send out bubbles, locks hold golden keys, and frozen ice waits to be melted. Each campaign stage brings a new mechanic into the mix. When you run out of fresh ideas, marathon mode lets you keep going for as many rounds as you like. If a spot on the board gets tough, boosters can open up room so you can carry on.
warship-battle: Take charge of your own pirate vessel and set off on a daring voyage across open water. If you have ever wanted to be a seafaring raider and rule the sea, this game lets you try it. You begin with a small boat fitted with cannons, then sail out to battle your enemies and claim the treasure they carry.

The money you collect along the way can be spent on upgrades for your ship. You can also design your own flag and bring bandits onto your crew. The game is set up for multiplayer play. Controls are simple: click with a mouse or tap the screen to play.
motorcycle-stunt-racing: Stunt bike racing blends careful skill with bold, fast riding. Courses range from tangled obstacle layouts to wide, high-speed tracks, so each level asks for a different approach. The rival bikes are run by the computer, and they force you to plan each move and find smart ways to pull ahead of them on the course.

As you advance through the levels and win each race, you unlock new motorcycles with more power and better performance. The WASD keys control your driving, and pressing SHIFT activates nitro for an extra burst of speed.
gun-evolution: Gun Evolution blends two styles: it is a running shooter and a strategy game about merging weapons. Everything uses 3D cartoon-style models. On each level, you run along a track and must combine guns into a stronger one so you can win the battle waiting past the finish line. Shooting the numbered pillars is a good idea, since each one can hold money and items that you collect when they break.

Once you have gathered enough cash, you can spend it on upgrades for ATK and Speed. These boosts make it easier to knock down more pillars as you move along the track. Controls are simple: click with a mouse or tap the screen to play.
save-the-fruit-draw-to-save: Save The Fruit is a puzzle game that blends creativity, strategy, and fun. Your job is to sketch paths that guide stranded fruits safely back home. Each level brings challenges and obstacles, so the fruits depend on the lines you draw to find their way. Start a line by clicking on a fruit's leg, then draw a route that steers it around the obstacles. On the more difficult levels, villains get in the way, and if two fruits collide, the game fails. Careful planning keeps every fruit moving without getting stuck. You can also share your achievements and creative solutions with friends.
simulated-truck-driving: Step into the role of a truck driver with this simulation game, made for anyone who wants to try the job and simply enjoy driving. It is listed in the racing category and carries the truck tag, so big rigs sit at the heart of the experience.

Steering and movement rely on the mouse along with the W, A, S and D keys. When you need to back up, press R to shift into reverse gear. Together these controls cover what you need to take the wheel and enjoy the ride.
troll-rider: Troll Rider is an endless run down a mountain on an X-bike, where the road is never fully trustworthy. Keep descending as you leap across gaps and spin through backflips. Tap, click, or press space to jump, and hold while airborne to rotate backward. Land smoothly to keep your speed and grow your score. Golden Gears fill your Repair Meter and can restore lost hearts.

Expect traps almost everywhere: falling trees, vanishing ramps, snapping bridges, misleading signs, and a friendly-looking Gear trail that may lead to trouble. You start with three hearts, and each crash costs one, but you still get another chance. After a troll beats you, retry it instantly, learn its trick, and claim REVENGE. Deeper down, new biomes, traps, helpful surprises, massive set pieces, and shifting troll rules keep the mountain unpredictable. See how far you can ride before it catches you.
rope-skipping-3d-sports-game: Skipping rope is a sport that suits beginners and is considered safe, and it is also very effective for maintaining good health. In this casual 3D game, you guide a character as it jumps across different stages. Each jump is made by tapping the screen, so you need to find the right rhythm and keep from tripping over the rope.

Controls are simple: tap or click to jump. Focus on your timing and try not to trip as you move from stage to stage. The game is easy to pick up, and the tags 3D, Boys, and Kid hint at who it is made for.
infinite-stairs-online: Infinite Stairs Online is a casual, hypercasual climbing game where you try to see how far you can go. Guide your character up a seemingly endless set of steps, steering left or right so it reacts quickly and reaches the top. The game is free to play and so addictive that you may feel hooked after one round. Set new records with your agile moves, or challenge a friend to see who is faster.

You have a time limit to reach the top, and if the clock runs out, you lose your turn and fail the mission. Use the arrow keys to move and climb, and press the spacebar to turn and change direction. Climbing as high as you can tests your reactions and helps sharpen your reflexes. It is tagged as funny and jumpy, so expect a playful mood throughout.
flappycat-crazy-halloween: Flappy Cat returns in FlappyCat Crazy Halloween, this time dressed up for the spooky season. Like the earlier Flappy Cat titles, it keeps the same level of difficulty, so your skill will be put to the test. A light touch of horror runs through the game, adding a bit of creepiness to every run.

Your job is to guide the cat as it zooms back and forth while dodging the Halloween tower. The aim is to earn the highest score you can. Controls are simple: click and steer clear of the walls. That is all there is to it, and that is how you win.
summer-festivals-fashion: Festival season is back in style this summer, and this dress-up game for girls takes you to three famous parties. Create standout outfits for six best friends who are getting ready to dance the night away. It is a single-player game that runs in your browser.

To play on a desktop, use your mouse. On a mobile device, tap the screen. Get started whenever you like and enjoy styling each friend before the dancing begins. Every outfit you put together adds to the fun, so take your time and let your sense of style shine through.
fashion-makeup-nail-salon: Step into the role of a nail salon owner who creates a new nail look every day. You are free to build any design you like, choosing from several skin tones, nail shapes, and nail sizes. There is no rush, so you can test each option at your own pace. Whether you lean toward dark or sweet styles, you will find colors and accessories to match.
Patterns, stickers, and jewels are all available, and you can resize each one to fit your nails. After your masterpiece is
navesco-v: Captain Glorktar and his companions have stolen the plans for the definitive war machine. Your mission is to track them down and recover the plans before it is too late. Navesco V is a single-player 2D adventure with action elements, made for Android devices.
On mobile, you control the game by touch. On a keyboard, press A to move left, D to move right, W to move up, and S to move down. Press the space bar to start.
snow-drift-game: This extreme car drifting game is both addictive and enjoyable, and it offers plenty of challenge. You take the wheel and clear away all the snow on each track. As you progress, the levels get tougher, so every stage asks a little more of you. The graphics are clean and pleasing to look at.

Sound effects play whenever your car slides through a drift, which makes each turn feel more lively. The controls are simple, and you can play with one hand or with two, depending on what suits you. Follow the instructions shown on screen to get started.
mole-in-the-hole: You guide a mole burrowing down through alternating layers of rock and soil, and each kind of ground calls for a different digging tool. Solid stone must be cracked open with a pickaxe, while loose sand clears quickly once you swap to a shovel. Watch for special blocks containing gold. Smashing them opens your route and adds to your score.

Use the left, right, and down arrows or the W, A, and S keys to steer the mole. Tap Spacebar or Q to switch between tools, and press E or click the shop icon to open the shop. Roguelike gameplay lets you buy upgrades that raise the value of sand and stone tiles, which affects your final score. Perks are also available that change how the game plays and what each block is worth.
spore-guard: In Spore Guard, you protect a living spore core as it faces waves of moving microbes. The core shoots on its own, so your job is to tap the foes you want it to target first and gather the glowing biomass that appears on screen. Enemies include acid, shield, tank, fast, slime, and boss types, and each wave pushes harder than the last.

Once the meter is ready, use the defensive burst by tapping it, or press Space on desktop. Between runs, choose mutations as you unlock them and grow permanent upgrades for your next attempt. Survive each wave and keep the core alive to chase the highest score.
infinity-jump: Infinity Jump is an arcade game where you take on your friends in a jumping contest. It tests your nerve and strength, and the winner is the one who lasts longer than the rest. You can pick from several characters, and the leaps you make can be quite impressive.

Each jump is made with a click, but you can only get past a section when the colors match. Your main goal is to collect as many crystals as you can. You can spend those crystals on different skins to change how your jumper looks. Keep practicing and aim to become the most dexterous jumper around.
jigrot: In this relaxed puzzler, pieces begin scattered around, and your goal is to reassemble them into one image. Every piece you move can lock onto its neighbors, merging groups until the full wild brainrot picture appears. It is easy to learn and smooth to play, so you can settle into a laid-back rhythm, moving from one oddball pack to the next whenever you want to unwind without pressure.
On a computer, press and hold the mouse on any piece or group, carry it wher
ragdoll-football: Picture a game of soccer with no gravity at all. Your goofy, lovable ragdoll athlete drifts, spins and soars around the arena, trying to knock the ball into the opposing net. Each match lasts just one minute and is packed with silly physics, showy special shots and surprise twists such as a giant ball, a bouncy ball, oversized goals and moving currents.

You can collect cups in Tournament mode or face one opponent at a time in ranked 1v1 Duels and climb the ladder. Dozens of characters, balls and arenas are there to unlock, along with daily quests and leaderboards to compete on. Controls are simple: drag or use WASD or the arrow keys to fly, tap or press Space or J to dash-strike, and hold or press Shift or K to brake and trap the ball. Fill the meter to unleash your hero's signature power strike.
archer-clash: Archer Clash is a quick-moving io title in which a lone hero dashes across an arena of rolling, hill-like terrain. Recruiting allies, changing your approach on the fly, and facing challenges that keep shifting are all part of the fight for control. Every choice you make steers you toward victory, and the game mixes fast reactions with careful planning as you grow stronger.

When a match begins, enemy armies appear at random spots across the battlefield, so each encounter can unfold differently. While crossing the land, you can pick up boosters such as speed bursts and protective shields. Neutral wanderers also roam the terrain. Move your hero with WASD or the arrow keys, or use the mouse.
food-sort-3d: Food Sort 3D puts you in charge of your own food court, where every item must land in the correct category. The eateries you meet range from quick fast-food joints to upscale restaurants. Among the things you will sort are burgers, sushi, hot dogs, fries, pizza, and desserts.

The visuals are bright and colorful, and the levels are short, so each round feels satisfying and easy to pick up again. As you progress, your food court keeps expanding. To move an item, hover over it, hold the left mouse button, drag it to a new spot, and release the button to drop it in place.
stickdoll-2-revenge-of-flame: Stickdoll 2: Revenge of Flame follows on from Stickdoll God of Archery. This time the Fire Kingdom wants its old strength back, so Flame sets out to gather five elemental stones and bring every rival to their knees. He believes that fusing the main element stone with the others on the black magic book will make him unbeatable.
The story takes a turn when Gargle double-crosses Flame and runs off with the main element stone, so
stunt-car-racing-extreme: Stunt Car Racing Extreme puts you in the driver's seat of a strong car that handles much like a BMW, both in its looks and its performance. Customizing is a big part of the experience, and you're free to make the car distinctly yours by choosing from a broad range of paint colors and decals that show off your personal taste.
Stunts make up the other half of the game, letting you show what your customized ride can do. To drive, use the W, A, S and D keys.
traffic-racer-3d: Take the wheel of a fast sports car on a never-ending highway packed with vehicles. Slip between them with the pedal fully down, aiming to cover the greatest possible distance. Each run earns coins for your garage, where you can buy anything from nimble hatchbacks to heavy muscle cars and improve fuel, top speed, and armour.

Drag left or right to switch lanes. Passing oncoming cars closely without crashing triggers near-miss bonuses and builds a combo for extra coins. The longer you stay alive, the higher your score and payout. Complete challenge levels to earn stars for skilful driving, then see how long you last in endurance mode. A crash sends you back to the menu, but every attempt gives you a chance to top your previous record. Fast reactions count most here.
draw-and-destroy: Draw and Destroy is a hypercasual 2D battle game where you sketch the flight path of a weapon. Your job is to shape that line so it avoids obstacles and destroys every enemy. Grab coins along the way, because you can spend them to buy new weapons.

Play with your finger on a touchscreen or with a computer mouse. Guide the trajectory through enemies and coins while steering clear of obstacles. The game is built around drawing, so every shot starts with the line you create.
goblin-defense-merge: Goblin Defense Merge asks you to protect your village from the human invaders. Waves of enemies keep coming, so you need to grow your goblin force as the fight goes on. Click squares on the grid to pick out your goblins, then combine two goblins of the same rank to produce a tougher fighter.

Once your units are ready, place them on the battlefield to meet the incoming humans. Think about which goblins to merge and where to station them, since good choices make your defense stronger. Keep upgrading your army and holding the line until the invasion is over.
donut-art-puzzle-diamond-game: Donut Art is a puzzle game where sorting sweet treats slowly builds a picture. Each level begins with a shelf of mixed donuts waiting to be organized. Your job is to group donuts of the same color together, clearing room as you go. Every correct placement reveals a little more of a pixel-style image, so the artwork takes shape piece by piece in a diamond-art style.

Controls are simple: tap a stack to select it, then tap another stack to move matching pieces onto it. Sort every color into its own stack to finish the puzzle and uncover the scene. Hundreds of pictures are included, ranging from cute characters and playful treats to bright patterns and fun shapes. Early levels feel smooth, while later ones call for careful planning and smart use of the available space.
sniper-shooter: You play as a marksman in 3D action, tasked with protecting your homeland from hostile troops. Every weapon can be customized and upgraded in its own way, so you can sharpen your accuracy, cut down recoil, and boost firepower. Shape each gun into the exact tool you want and take control of the field.
Controls are simple. Press and hold the screen to shift your aim and line up the scope on a target. When you're ready, lift your finger to fire. Keep your shots steady and precise.
turtle-quest: A turtle and his master are the heroes of this story, until one day a foe named Tyfun poisons the master and leaves him ill. You play as the turtle, who sets out to explore a mysterious world. Using ninja abilities, he must defeat Tyfun and collect the yellow liquid needed to save his master. Watch out, because hidden traps are waiting across the platforms he has to cross.

On a phone, on-screen touch buttons handle movement and shooting. On a PC, the up arrow makes the turtle jump, the left and right arrows move him, A throws a boomerang, S spreads a rope, and D opens a parachute. The game offers high-quality graphics, keeps its file size minimal, and uses super simple controls. Interesting quests add to the adventure.
eat-to-evolve: You start as a tiny worm that is always hungry. Your goal is to attack and survive for as long as you can, devouring anything and anyone that gets in your way. Watch out for pesky enemies, because they want to make a meal out of you.

The whole game is played with a single mouse click or tap. It is a 3D arcade title with a casual feel, built with HTML5 and playable online in your browser. Each run tests how long you can keep eating and avoid being eaten.
warfare-area-2: Grab a rifle and head into this 3D first-person shooter, which runs on both phones and computers. Your goal is to eliminate every enemy in the area while staying alive through the fighting. Along the way, you can shoot foes and pick up first aid kits to keep going.

On a computer, move with the arrow keys or W, A, S and D, and use the mouse to turn, aim and fire. Press L to lock the pointer, R to reload, and P to pause. On mobile, an on-screen joystick handles movement, a fire button shoots, and you tap and drag on the right side of the screen to turn and aim.
obby-run-star-speed-and-pets: This runner simulator challenges you to become the fastest, most upgraded racer on the track. Click to build speed, and make every run count, since each attempt brings more rewards and new pets. Dash across vibrant courses and fly as far as you can to claim top prizes. Along the way, collect rare and meme pets that boost your earnings and speed up your progress.

When progress stalls, rebirth to restart your run with permanent speed bonuses that help you climb the leaderboards faster. Keep improving your stats to unlock new worlds. On PC, use WASD to move, hold the right mouse button to adjust the camera, and press Space to jump. On mobile, use the in-game interface, drag on the left
soccerlat-3d-football-online: In SoccerLat, a quick three-dimensional football title, you face real opponents live in your browser. Choose a position and take the pitch for a complete match, complete with fouls, free kicks, penalties, corners, throw-ins, and a referee tracking the diagonal. If the score is still level at full time, a penalty shootout settles it. Matches can range from 1v1 to 11v11, and bot goalkeepers can fill the goals when you are short on players.

Move sideways as you strike to bend the ball, or aim the camera upward to lift it. Dribble past defenders and slide in to win the ball back, but a late tackle counts as a foul. Customise your player's skin tone, kit, shorts, boots, hats, name and number, plus your team's name and three-letter tag. Pick the indoor stadium or the caged street court, switch
mechanic-simulator-car-repair: Mechanic Simulator: Car Repair puts you in charge of a service station, where your job is fixing a line of broken vehicles. Once a car runs again, you can take it onto the city streets, drift around, and wreck everything nearby. Choose from more than 17 cars, enjoy lively graphics, and join races. The cars feel true to life, and crashes look realistic too.

The controls are easy to learn. Move with WASD, use the left mouse button to deliver items, press E to lift and Q to drop them, and sit down with X. Space works the handbrake, R flips a car back over, and Right Shift uses nitro while you are in a vehicle. Esc pauses the game. On mobile devices, you play through the in-game interface.
math-crosswords: Math Crosswords swaps the words of a classic crossword for numbers. Equations run across and down the grid, and each shared cell must satisfy two of them at once. A correct entry turns both equations green, while a wrong one turns red. Choose from addition, subtraction, multiplication and division across many levels, from simple sums to large grids, with difficulty that climbs gradually. Every level has exactly one solution.

Numbers wait in a panel beside the board. Drag one into an empty square, or tap it and then tap the square. Tap a filled square to send its number back. If you get stuck, the light bulb places one correct number, but solving quickly without hints earns the most speed points. A daily puzzle with a streak, a leaderboard, achievements and light or dark themes add extra variety. It works as a five-minute brain warm-up for adults and helps kids practice mental math. Tip: start where two equations cross, since those cells have the fewest possible answers. Use a mouse on desktop or touch on mobile.
pixel-conquest: Pixel Conquest is a fast strategy match against AI rivals, where the goal is to seize more land than anyone else. You sketch paths out from your colored zone, and when you loop back to your own land, the enclosed patch switches to your color. Your city expands on its own inside your borders. Cutting off opponents is the key to knocking them out.

Use the arrow keys on desktop to steer. Stay clear of the outer walls and enemy territory, or you're out. Houses and skyscrapers appear automatically as you grow, adding points steadily over time. Taking land, tearing down rival buildings, and eliminating foes also raise your score. Power-ups like Speed, Shields, and Bombs pop up now and then on the grid, giving you an edge as you try to be the final player still standing.
steal-an-egg-farm: Snatch an egg from a basket and sprint, because the guard is hot on your heels. You need to reach the safe line before you get caught. If the guard tags you, the egg goes back to its basket. You can grab ordinary, golden, and rainbow eggs, then take a secured one to the incubator and wait for it to hatch. Each new animal gets carried to your pasture, where it starts earning coins every second.
Use the treadmill, which you step onto
mahjong-unlimited: Mahjong Unlimited brings the classic oriental tile puzzle to your screen, complete with tiles and dragons. Levels are generated endlessly and vary in difficulty, with four modes to choose from. You can play without a clock to stay relaxed, or race against time when you want more of a challenge.

To play, select two identical tiles to remove them from the board. Only tiles open on their left or right side and uncovered from above can be picked. Each tile appears four times, and clearing the whole field is your goal. Customize the tile look and background, or choose a child-friendly style for educational play. Hints help with tough spots, while dragon achievements and competition with other players give you more to aim for.
monster-cafe-idle-tycoon: Step into Monster Cafe, a cosy little spot on the edge of a haunted forest. Slimes, ghosts, vampires and zombies queue up for bat lattes and pumpkin muffins. Tap their order bubbles or the machines to serve them, gather coins and tips from the bags on the tables, and catch lucky bats for bonus coins.

Tabs along the bottom let you upgrade machines, buy tables and decor, invite monsters and hire waiters who serve on their own. The moon button opens your places, the Moon Shop and your trophies. Your aims are to unlock all five hand-drawn locations, from Crooked Cafe to Sunken Shipwreck, fill the 60-sticker album, and make Full Moon Moves to start over stronger. Golden level-100 machines and trophies are part of the progress too. The game is played with a mouse or touch
animal-evolution-simulator: Start as a humble worm and climb to the highest stage of evolution. Eat plants and mushrooms, grow stronger, and fight off predators. You choose your style: a stealthy hunter or a mighty defender of your territory. Each level-up turns you into a larger, more powerful animal, and you can upgrade your skills to keep up with a changing world. Explore the map as you go, and each new stage opens a fresh biome to discover.

Move with WASD, jump with Space, and attack with the left mouse button. Hold the right button to turn the camera and use the wheel to zoom. On mobile, use the left joystick to move, tap the jump and attack buttons, and swipe the left side of the screen to move the camera. Some animals want to win too, so dodge their attacks and strike back quickly. Defeating a stronger foe earns you more experience.
tangram-triangle: Tangram Triangle gives the classic tangram puzzle a fresh twist with triangular blocks in blue, yellow, red, and orange. You drag these pieces onto a grid and turn them until they cover an oddly shaped outline, leaving no gaps and no overlaps. Levels grow tougher as you progress, and finishing one can earn stars, with 3/3 being perfect, plus gifts.

The game sharpens spatial reasoning and problem-solving, and it suits players of every age as a family-friendly brain teaser. Clean visuals keep the focus on the shapes across hundreds of puzzles. For a clock-based challenge, a time-attack mode lets you chase high scores. Pinch or twist with two fingers to rotate a piece, tap to select it, and double-tap or use the rotate button, where one is available, for quick spins.
kingdom-defender-tower-defense: Protect your realm from waves of orcs, trolls, undead, and other grim creatures by setting up towers and triggering special powers. Battles take place in forests, mountains, and deserts, so you will need to adjust your plans to suit each setting. Upgrades and tower abilities give you room to try different approaches. You can summon flames beneath enemy feet, freeze foes in place, call in reinforcements, and face legendary monsters threatening your land.

Enemies range from goblins to mighty undead, and each kind has its own skills. Boss battles add a further challenge, and extra difficulty levels test your tactics even more. A built-in encyclopedia explains every tower and ability, which helps when you are planning. Place your towers with care, use abilities at the right moment, and make sure no enemy breaks through into the kingdom.
vials-asmr-sand-sort-puzzle: Vials is a relaxed sand-sorting puzzle where you pour coloured grains between glass vessels until each one holds a single shade. There is no clock, so you can take as long as you like over every move. Hand-animated sand flows smoothly alongside layered ASMR sounds and soft ambient music. The 1000 levels start gently and grow into real logic puzzles, with a tougher challenge roughly every twenty levels followed by an easier stretch. Warm, muted colours shift
ultimate-lawn-mowing-simulator-mower-mas: Mower Master is a calm grass-cutting simulator where you play a lawn care professional. Mow through gardens, parks, farms, and open lawns, handling tight corners and daily jobs with care. Smooth animations, lifelike grass effects, and the soft sound of freshly cut turf make every pass feel satisfying. Jobs range from home lawns to public parks, private estates, and farms.

You can pick from walk-behind mowers, ride-on machines, and robotic mowers, and unlock stronger models by upgrading. Controls rely on simple swipes, so players of any age can start quickly. Cover every patch of grass to finish a job, then switch to whichever mower suits the next task. Completing jobs earns rewards that open better equipment. HD visuals and realistic physics give the machines authentic movement.
geovex-daily-geography-challenge: GeoVex is a daily map game for people who love flags and world geography. Each day you get a fresh set of national flags, and your job is to work out which country each one belongs to and mark its spot on a globe-style map. You can choose Easy mode, which shows country names and borders, or Hard mode, where the map has no borders at all. The 10-round Daily Challenge lets you grow a streak of consecutive days and compare results with friends.

To play, identify the flag, locate the country, drop your pin, and press Submit to lock in the guess. A pin placed inside the right country earns up to 10 points. Missing the mark still gives partial credit: 5 points within 500km, 3 within 1000km, and 1 within 2000km. On a computer, drag to move the map, scroll the wheel to zoom, and left-click to place your pin. On a phone or tablet, swipe to pan, pinch to zoom, and tap to place the pin.
park-sort: Park Sort is a colorful parking puzzle where every move is easy to follow and every choice counts. Each vehicle has an arrow on its roof, and one tap sends it rolling in that direction. If the road is open, it leaves the lot for the garage of its color. If something blocks it, it bumps and returns. Garages open one after another and fill in order: big vehicles first, then cars, then bikes.
Cars with nowhere to park wait in the slots and drive in once their garage opens, but a full set of slots ends the game. When you get stuck, boosters like
curve-free-kick: Curve Free Kick is a 3D set-piece game where the ball moves in a lifelike way. Slide your player behind the ball, then choose your run-up. A wider angle makes the ball bend more, and a longer approach makes the strike harder. Curl the shot around the wall and past the keeper. The 12 stages move from central free kicks to tight angles near the corner flag.

A gust blows from the left or right on every stage and pushes the ball in flight. Curl with the wind for a big swerve, or against it to cancel it out. Both wind and spin can fool the keeper. You get 10 tries, and every goal returns one. Top corner shots earn bonus points. On desktop, move the mouse to position your player, click to shoot, or press Space. On mobile, drag to position and tap SHOOT.
lemonade-tycoon: Lemonade Tycoon is a calm, three-dimensional management game that begins with one small cart in a city park. Each day you blend ice, lemon and sugar to suit the weather, set your price, and watch customers form a line. Forecasts change daily, and occasional park events send extra crowds your way.

Earnings go toward stand upgrades, promotions and, eventually, new shops across the city. Daily tasks, a login streak reward and a chest for finishing every task give you reasons to return, and your stand keeps selling while you are away. Progress is saved, and everything runs in your browser. Open starts the day, Recipe adjusts the mix, and Upgrades, Promote and City cover the other areas. The Daily tab shows today's tasks and rewards.
hidden-objects-island-secrets: When a mysterious magical crystal switched on, objects were flung across time on a single island. You'll face riddles, hidden items, and temporal paradoxes, guided by a faithful companion whose hints help you move through different eras. Each visit shows the island in another age, and you hunt for key items and artifacts among ancient ruins.

Every location is a puzzle that tests your sharp eyes and quick thinking as you track down everything on your list. Move left and right across each scene and zoom in to study small details. If an item is too hard to find, use a hint to keep going. The game offers a calm feel, soothing music, and lovely graphics, designed for leisure on a computer or phone. It's a classic hidden object game for anyone who wants to feel like a true explorer.
hidden-object-street-of-secrets: You take on the role of lead detective in this moody seek-and-find adventure. A puzzling case awaits, and a sharp-eyed assistant offers hints and points you toward key clues. The storyline is absorbing as you move through scenic, secretive places, from evening-lit streets and cozy cafés to shadowy rooms where small clues make all the difference.
Pan left or right to survey each scene, zoom in to study fine details, and track down every object on your list
cage-ballers-football: Step into the cage for a fast, 3D small-sided football clash against the computer. Before kickoff, you pick the pitch, the team strip, the match length, the camera view, and how tough the CPU plays. Sprint, pass, tackle, and shoot your way toward victory. The match is played over two halves, and if the score is still level, it goes to golden goal.

Swap between players with Q or Tab, then check goal replays and match stats once the final whistle sounds. Move with WASD or the arrow keys, hold Shift to sprint, press E to pass, and press R for a through ball. Hold Space and release it to shoot, and press Space or F to tackle while defending. Press C to change the camera, or Esc or P to pause. Gamepad players can use the left stick to move, and both keyboard and gamepad controls are supported.
bridge-builder-cargo-transport: Step into the driver's seat of a utility truck packed with materials for fixing a damaged bridge. Your job is to haul tools, steel, cement, and other construction cargo to the site. The route winds over off-road tracks, dusty roads, factory zones, and rough ground, and you must keep the trailer steady and the load intact the whole way.

Every stage throws up different obstacles, such as tight lanes, sharp turns, shaky tracks, and a clock that keeps ticking. Press W or the Up Arrow to speed up, and S or the Down Arrow to brake or reverse. Use A or the Left Arrow to steer left and D or the Right Arrow to steer right. Your aim stays straightforward: get the repair materials to the broken bridge safely.
driver-club-highway-racing: Driver Club: Highway Racing puts you behind the wheel at high speed, where you weave past traffic, overtake vehicles, and test your reflexes. In each section, your goal is to pass other cars as quickly as possible. The Race mode adds a faster opponent to the mix. Wins earn money for new cars and upgrades, and you can unlock powerful cars, change their colors, and swap their rims.

Drive through a variety of dynamic settings with striking visuals and smooth, responsive controls. Few racing games offer races this realistic and high in quality. Winning races and upgrading your car also raise your level, and you can aim for the top of the highway leaderboard. The sound is excellent, though not required. Controls: W or up accelerates, S or down brakes, A or left moves left, D or right moves right, C switches the camera view, and P
favorite-puzzles: Favorite Puzzles offers jigsaw fun with a large gallery of attractive images for all tastes, and it suits both kids and adults. Choose a difficulty from 6 to 1200 pieces, with or without rotation. For help, request a hint, view an example, or display the grid. Browse 48 image categories, search the VIP image base, or build a puzzle from your own photo.

For a bigger challenge, turn on Realistic mode, where the pieces start scattered across the field, or play Classic mode. Compete on the leaderboard, earn achievements and Malachite, join weekly tournaments, and personalize the interface and background color. On
sudoku-online: Sudoku Online is a free puzzle game that runs right in your browser, so you can start playing at once. The classic mode has four levels: Easy for beginners, Medium for steady practice, Hard for experienced players, and Expert for a real test. Three other modes change the rules. X-Sudoku adds diagonal limits, Windoku adds extra highlighted regions, Killer Sudoku asks groups of cells to reach a target sum, and Kropki places ratio and difference markers between neighboring cells.

Your task is to fill the 9×9 grid with digits from 1 to 9 so each digit appears once per row, column, and 3×3 box. Start with cells that have the most filled neighbors, since fewer options make the right digit easier to spot. Notes let you list candidates and cross them off, which helps most on Hard and Expert. Every puzzle has exactly one solution that follows from logic alone, and if you get stuck, a missed step can be traced back
obby-mini-games: Compete against other players to collect Cups, and win each mode to earn a spot on the golden winner's pedestal. Parkour asks you to get through colorful levels on the parkour map and reach the end. In Colorful Floor, you must step only on tiles that match the color shown at the top of the screen. Glass Bridge has you pick a glass tile to jump onto, since one will break while the other stays intact. Falling Tiles keeps you moving, because any tile you have already crossed will drop away and vanish after a second. Rain of Blocks opens up as you progress through the game.

On desktop, use WASD to move, the Spacebar to jump, and Tab to bring up the mouse cursor. On a smartphone, the joystick on the left side moves your character, the button at the bottom right jumps, and sliding your finger across the right side rotates the camera.
vega-mix-2-adventure: Vega Mix 2: Adventure is a match-3 game built on the idea of lining up three or more colorful pieces in a row. Set on a mysterious island, it follows two brave girls on a quest to rescue Alice's husband from an ancient idol. You swap pieces to clear the board, break through obstacles, and move onward through the island's magical landscape.

Four pieces in a line create a Rocket that blows up the whole line, while four pieces in a square make a Spinner that destroys one target. A T-shaped match of five forms a Bomb for a massive explosion, and five in a row produces a Rainbow Flower that explodes pieces of the same color. Combining any two power-ups unlocks a variety of effects. Tricky puzzles and many obstacles call for different strategies, and your score climbs with every match as you complete levels.
cat-and-granny: You take on the role of a sharp-witted orange cat in this first-person action game. A new black cat has moved into Granny's house, and your aim is to outwit him. Make a mess by tipping over flower pots, scattering objects, and clawing at furniture, then arrange things so Granny blames the newcomer. Knock over lamps, plants, or chandeliers while he is nearby.

Sneak around the home, explore its breakable surroundings, and plan clever pranks. If Granny gets too close, hide in a box or risk a stern scolding. Outwit your rival, cause plenty of chaos, and win back your spot as Granny's favorite. On PC, WASD moves, the mouse turns the camera, Space jumps, F interacts, Q hides in a box, Tab opens the main menu, and R gives a hint. On mobile, use the in-game buttons.
stickman-ghost-online: You play as a stickman warrior determined to take control of his hometown. This action adventure blends fighting with battles against stickman ninjas who want you gone. Across Stickman City you will move through many locations, swinging a variety of powerful, unusual weapons and chaining together combos. Your goal is to get through each level, beat the ninjas who won't hold back, and reach the boss who threatens the world of the wicked stickmen.

Gather coins along the way and spend them to improve your fighter with fresh weapons, moves, abilities, and skins. Become the final surviving ghost and prove you are the top warrior. Controls are simple: use WASD to move, Spacebar to jump, and click to attack. On phones and tablets, tap the on-screen buttons instead.
my-castle-merge-and-story: Set in a gentle medieval realm, this merge 2 puzzler is about renewal, hidden secrets, and finding your true self. A young princess walks away from her father's royal court and heads for a distant castle that once belonged to her grandfather. Why she fled is a riddle, and piecing it together becomes part of the adventure. The building has sat empty for years. Time has worn it down, yet something of its spirit lingers.

Combine matching objects to craft better tools and resources, then restore and decorate the old stronghold piece by piece. Rare medieval items and hidden chains of pieces are waiting to be discovered. As the castle comes back to life, new crafting options open up. There are no timers or pressure, so you move at your own speed. It works offline and suits quiet, unhurried play.
make-a-dress: Make A Dress is a relaxed sewing game where you greet customers and stitch the gown they have in mind. Take their measurements, choose a silhouette, pick a fabric, and press it with the iron. Then lay out the pattern pieces, cut them out, and sew them on the machine before adding bows, flowers, and gems.

Each finished outfit earns stars and gifts for your next creation, and you can unlock shimmery premium fabrics, tools, and styles along the way. Play with a mouse or touch screen: tap or click to pick silhouettes and fabrics, drag materials and decorations onto the dress, and slide the tape, iron, scissors, and fabric under the needle to complete each step. Deliver the dress to your client to collect your rewards.
zombie-grave-yard: A quick-moving arcade shooter set among the graves of a haunted cemetery. You battle the undead in two ways. Campaign has you working through levels that grow harder, and each win opens the next one. Survival throws endless waves at you until you are overwhelmed, and your best wave gets recorded.
Equip a pistol, a shotgun and power-ups, then
popping-candies: Popping Candies is a puzzle game built around matching. You swap neighboring sweets to line up three or more, and they vanish for points. Each stage has its own goals, like reaching a target score, gathering certain candies, or clearing jelly, and you must finish them before your moves run out. Chocolate and blockers stand in your way.

Lining up four candies creates a striped candy that wipes out an entire row or column. A T or L shape of five forms a wrapped candy that blasts nearby sweets, while five matching candies make a color bomb that removes every candy of one color. Boosters can help when a level gets tough, and clearing stages unlocks new ones. The game is free to play online
break-a-lucky-egg-brainrots: Break Lucky Egg Brainrots is a quick collecting game that mixes action, risk, and planning. Smash brainrot eggs, gather rare Brainrot characters, and carry them safely to your base before time runs out. Each run tests both careful choices and fast reflexes. You can play solo or team up with a friend in 2 player mode. Skeleton enemies chase you while you carry Brainrots, and any you fail to bring to the safe zone in time will
needle-rush: Needle Rush is an idle clicker where one needle hides among ten million straws. You start by digging the stack yourself, and loose hay drops into bins and becomes coins. Spend those coins on a rake, pitchfork, shovel, vacuum, or dynamite, or hire farmhands and machines such as claw arms, fans, winches, hay robots, and drones that dig for you.

The hay acts like a real pile, sliding, caving in, and spilling into the bins. Earn achievements, and find the needle faster each time. Everything is drawn in hand-made pixel art. On a computer, hold the left button on the haystack to dig and click cards to buy.
