On a phone, hold a finger on the haystack or the strip under the barn when upright, tap cards to buy, and tap the uncovered needle to win.
obby-traps-and-jumps: Obby: Traps And Jumps is a 3D platforming game with 20 levels, each split into three stages with three stars to collect, for 60 stages in all. You can earn a star by finishing a stage, beating its time limit, or tracking down a hidden one. Levels 1 to 5 are basic, levels 6 to 10 bring vanishing platforms, levels 11 to 15 add traps, and levels 16 to 20 combine both. The further you progress, the tougher the precision jumps become.

Movement feels smooth and bouncy, and arrows point the way forward. Breakable walls give way when you complete a stage, and a progress bar shows how far you have come. Press R to restart quickly. On PC, use WASD to move, space to jump, Shift to sprint, and the right mouse button to look around. On mobile, a joystick handles movement while separate buttons handle jumping and sprinting.
car-parking-driving-game: Car Parking Driving Game is a racing title built around precise driving. Each level tests how well you can park and handle your vehicle. You drive a range of lifelike cars through detailed surroundings, dodge obstacles, and must park perfectly before the clock runs out. Missions range from tight city streets to tough parking lots, and they reward patience, accuracy, and smooth steering. As you advance, you can unlock new cars and take on harder parking challenges. The physics feel realistic and the controls respond quickly, so it suits both casual players and seasoned parkers.

Use W or the up arrow to accelerate, A or the left arrow to turn left, D or the right arrow to turn right, and S or the down arrow to brake. Press B to look back, C to switch camera views, and click the mouse to interact.
survive-the-disasters-obby: Step into this survival simulator, a tough obstacle-course game where catastrophic events keep trying to wipe you out. Maps throw floods, tsunamis, acid rain, meteor showers, thick fog, scorching lava and tornadoes at you. Your only aim is to last, whatever it takes. Each round brings a new mix of disasters, so every run plays out differently.

Get through with jumps, dodges and sprints borrowed from classic obby games. Starting power-ups and boosters give you a head start, while tamed pets, rebirths and growing power keep you climbing. Dozens of maps each bring their own disasters, so you will need different tactics to outsmart the elements. On a computer, use WASD to move and Space to jump. On mobile, steer with the joystick, tap the jump button in the lower right corner, and swipe the screen to rotate the camera.
car-smash-simulator-crash-and-tune: Crash cars across a huge open-world sandbox where smashing and customizing go hand in hand. Damage looks realistic: doors can tear off, hoods fold up, and wheels can pop loose after hard hits. Zones are stocked with destruction gear such as giant hammers, hydraulic crushers, and mega ramps. New cars roam the map, and you can tune any of them by repainting the whole body or single parts, changing wheel size, height, and camber. Break things, pull off stunts, or simply wander the map as you like.
Controls: WASD drives, Space pulls the handbrake, and Shift fires nitro. Tab pauses, C switches the camera, R flips your car upright, K repairs it, N j
tumble-tower-survival: Tumble Tower Survival puts you on top of a towering stack of wooden blocks, where staying upright is the whole challenge. Every round unleashes changing disasters that make the blocks slide, tip over, and plunge into the water below. Collect life-saving power-ups to keep your feet, earn points to level up, and unlock stylish hats and colors to customize your character. The game works on both desktop and mobile.

On desktop, use WASD or the arrow keys to move and Space to jump and climb. Click the game to capture the mouse, then move it to look around, use the mouse wheel to zoom, and press P or Esc to pause. On mobile, drag on the left side of the screen to move and on the right side to look, pinch to zoom, tap the JUMP button to jump and climb, and use the pause button in the top left. Anyone who falls into the water is out, and the last Tumbler standing wins.
roads-off-fury: There is no escape in this endless arcade racer, so you have to fight for your life. Pick a modified post-apocalyptic vehicle and roam freely through the deserted ruins of a wasted world. Motorized oil-cultist scavengers are hunting for your fuel and your flesh, and you must defend yourself while you drive.

Survive as long as you can against spiked buggies, armored flame-throwers, tank-cars, war rigs and more. Use high lines, ramps and hills to launch into evasive acrobatic jumps. Master dozens of vehicles, each with a very different feel, and unlock offensive and defensive gear to upgrade yours. Find the right mix of vehicle and gear, or test yourself in Smashy Mode, included in Fury Roads Survivor, where you smash enemies without any gear. The game is controlled with the keyboard and set in a gorgeous isometric 3
candy-mahjong-3d: Candy Mahjong 3D is a bright puzzle game played on a board of three-dimensional candy tiles. Your job is to pair up identical candies and remove each set until the board is empty. Start by tapping one candy, then hunt for its twin and select it to clear both. As levels advance, the layouts grow trickier, so you will need sharp focus and careful placement. Timing and awareness matter, especially when tiles sit under others or are partly covered.

On a phone, swipe to spin the board in any direction and pinch to zoom in or out for a clearer look. On a computer, click to choose tiles, drag the mouse to turn the board freely, and roll the scroll wheel to adjust the zo
obby-defend-your-base-from-67: Obby: Defend your base from 67 is a fast survival and base defense game. Zombie waves keep coming, and each one hits harder than the last, while the meme enemy 67, also called six seven, joins the attack. Auto shooting handles much of the firing, so your focus shifts to planning: buy weapons before attacks arrive, find rare guns, and open chests for random rewards.

Resources come from farming, where you hire workers to grow and harvest crops. Recruit shooters to guard your base, and upgrade towers so they deal more damage to enemies. You can also unlock skins to customize your hero. Controls are simple, sessions are quick, and the goal is to survive as long as you can.
bank-tycoon-simulator-money-empire: Start with a small local branch and grow it into the biggest bank in the city. Serve customers at the deposit and withdrawal desks, gather cash, lock it in the vault, and restock the ATMs. Profits fund new counters for loans, investments, and utility bills, plus new hires such as cashiers, loan officers, and security guards. Convert cash into gold along the way.

The idle design means your bank keeps earning while you focus on expansion. Dozens of upgrades improve the vault, security, reputation, and customer capacity. Move with WASD, look around with the mouse, right-click to drop or pick up cash, and hold Space to sprint. Use E for actions, Q for the shop, I for info, Ctrl for settings, and Enter to end the day. On mobile, drag the on-screen joystick to move in any direction.
zynpavo-rhythm-piano: Zynpavo puts you behind a piano to tackle well-known pieces by Beethoven, Mozart, and Chopin. It blends the pull of old-school arcade titles with soft classical melodies. Notes drop down the screen, and your job is to strike each one the instant it lines up with the keys along the bottom. Clean hits raise your score and keep your combo going. Five difficulty levels, from Novice to Sym
skate-1-speed: Skate through a fast, colorful world where your board starts you off with a +1 speed boost, and your pace keeps rising the farther you travel. Each parkour course throws traps and obstacles in your path, so you must jump clear and stay on the platforms. Higher speeds make the tracks harder to control, which turns every trial into a test of reflexes and agility.

On PC, right-click to rotate the camera, use WASD or the arrow keys to move, and press Spacebar to jump. On mobile, use the interface elements and swipe the right side of the screen to turn the camera. Finish levels to earn coins, spend them on upgrades, and unlock boards with different speeds and boosts. Look for secret paths and hidden rewards, challenge other players on the leaderboard, and aim to set new speed records.
dumpling-clicker: Dumpling Clicker is an idle game where you tap a dumpling in a bamboo steamer to make more dumplings. Spend them on 30 upgrades, from the ones Grandma sells all the way up to a Dim Sum Galaxy. Land critical hits, call down fire and lightning, and slip into a frenzy. The BEST DEAL badge in the right panel marks the most profitable upgrade.

Open steamers in the CASES tab for a slow, dramatic reveal of new dumplings. Over 100 can be collected, and each has its own passive ability you can wear in the wardrobe. Catch golden dumplings, claim achievements and daily gifts with two exclusive dumplings, and try the All or Nothing event for the 1% Rainbow Emperor. Ascending gives you a permanent income multiplier. Tap or click the dumpling, or press Space or Enter.
obby-theme-park-world: Splash around a bright water park packed with rides and slides. You can wander freely through an open world, sprint across the grounds, and uncover secret spots tucked away in corners. Gathering stars opens up new zones and extra features, and the more you gather, the sooner new attractions and levels become available. Slide down thrilling runs, test alternative paths, and work to beat your previous times.

The game blends free roaming with straightforward, absorbing play. Speed and movement are central to the experience, and it suits fans of obby challenges, parkour, and relaxing sessions built around collecting.
terrifying-zombies-tower-defense-ii: Terrifying Zombies: Tower Defense II runs directly in your web browser, so there is nothing to install. You build defenses to hold back a zombie horde during the apocalypse. Shooting zombies yourself earns the most experience, while kills made by your defenses earn less. Fences improve on their own every round, raising their maximum health and regeneration. Zombie damage grows the longer you survive.

The latest update adds hero cloning, which lets you spend Gold to revive your fallen hero and keep fighting. A countdown tracks how many days remain before the big boss fight. Two new day and night maps have been added, along with new soundtracks, rebalanced difficulty, varied zombie stats, and bug fixes. Move with WASD or the arrow keys, shoot with a left click, and select and place towers as needed. Press P to pause and open the save menu.
crazy-m1neworld: Crazy M1neWorld is a Minecraft-style block game that works offline. You can build a home and the land around it, then save your world and return to it another time. This version has no hidden links and no promotional links to other games, so the focus stays on the blocks.

Survival is a big part of the game. Zombies roam the world, and when night arrives you need to find shelter so they cannot knock you down. Walk with W, A, S and D. Press Tab or Escape to open the menu, and use the mouse to break a cube or add a new one.
spider-solitaire-silk-horizon: Spider Solitaire: Silk Horizon is a card puzzle where you build runs from King down to Ace. You can play with one, two, or four suits, depending on how tricky you want things. Daily deals and the Master's Path offer fresh layouts to work through. When you get stuck, hints, undo, and an optional magic wand can offer a different angle on the table.

To play, drag cards between columns or tap one to move it, but only ordered cards of the same suit travel together. Tap the stock to deal a new row. Finishing a full same-suit sequence removes it from the table, and clearing all eight sequences wins the game. The layout adjusts cleanly whether you're on a desktop or a phone, and your progress is saved between visits.
obby-warriors-of-the-sword: You step into the role of a hero who gathers powerful blades, defeats foes, and learns new abilities. Later, you can go through rebirth and become a legend. Each cycle makes you stronger, so you can keep building up your hero and aim to become the best.

Swords and artifacts can be bought, upgraded, and collected to craft a strong fighter. Recruit loyal allies, dress your character in skins, pets, and jewelry, and tackle missions and challenges for new levels and rare rewards. On desktop, use WASD to move, the left mouse button to take a hit, Space to jump, and right-click with mouse movement to rotate the camera. On smartphones, drag the joystick on the left, swipe on the right to turn the camera, and tap the screen to take a shot.
pocket-zone: Head into the Chernobyl nuclear power plant, where a legendary Performer of desires may grant your deepest wish. Or simply leave the dull routine of big cities behind and roam the world's deserts, alone with a hostile landscape that seems eager to swallow you. This hardcore mobile survival RPG takes its cues from Fallout and Stalker.

Random text events move your journey forward, and their outcomes depend on your decisions as well as outside factors that shape your chances of survival. A detailed mining system and more than a hundred random happenings await as you search the anomalous Zone and face its threats. More than 100 kinds of weapons, armor, helmets, backpacks and costumes are available, including legendary and mythical pieces. On PC, use a left click to interact and the mouse wheel to scroll lists. On mobile, tou
1-black-slime-evolution: In this Roblox-style evolution simulator, you guide a living black slime that latches onto your blocky hero and grows with every level gained. It first takes over an arm, then the head, then the torso, and at last the whole body, sprouting tendrils and spikes along the way. Train on goo stations in a busy lobby to gain slime and level up.

Walk through a portal to pick one of three arena worlds, where your slime attacks zombies and bosses in waves on its own. Stay close and dodge the red boss circles. Clear every wave, step on a win pad for wins, then evolve at the altar once you have enough level and wins. There are 10 forms, each unlocking a new area attack. Move with WASD or the on-screen stick, jump with Space, and rotate the camera with the right mouse button or a swipe.
castle-crashers-stolen-sun: Castle Crashers: Stolen Sun is a colorful 2D fantasy brawler set in a realm where the sun has been taken. You choose an elemental knight and work through 36 story stages, with optional routes, lively foes, and boss battles. Along the way you strike, jump, and use elemental skills while discovering paths, gathering salvage, and upgrading your tools and armor.

Controls are simple. Use WASD or the arrow keys to move, J for a strike combo, K for a skill, and Space to jump. Clear the guards, hit the red levers, and reach the exits to advance. Press Esc or P for options and M to mute. On mobile, touch buttons handle movement, jumping, skills, and strikes. Checkpoint retries keep you moving after a setback, your progress carries over, and an original fantasy soundtrack accompanies the quest.
animals-vs-zombies: Aliens have snatched the animals you care about, and it's up to you to go after them and teach those bullies a lesson. Along the way you can tame and befriend many kinds of creatures, from everyday cats and dogs to odd, rare wildlife. Companions can evolve into stronger guardians with their own skills, and rare resources help them grow even more capable. Your task is to assemble a squad that can handle t
city-constructor: You step into the role of a heavy machinery operator in City Constructor, where excavators, cranes, trucks, and other vehicles are all under your control. Your jobs include solving physics-based puzzles, hauling cargo, and finishing construction tasks. The mechanics feel true to life, the levels vary, and the difficulty climbs as you progress, so careful thinking and steady precision are key. You'll work on building sites, cross bridges, and navigate mountainous terrain.

On desktop, A and D move left and right, W and S move up and down, and the arrow keys control the arm. Spacebar grabs or releases, TAB switches vehicles, and ESC pauses the game. On mobile, use the on-screen controls. Whether you love vehicles or enjoy simulations, this game is built for players of all ages.
streetracer-realistic-destruction: StreetRacer: Realistic Destruction gives you a wide open world where you can go wherever you like. Crash your cars in dramatic ways and watch parts break loose, with realistic damage physics that lets wheels fly off during heavy impacts. You can customize your ride extensively, change its exterior, and fine-tune the wheels and suspension.

Along the way, you'll find a range of destruction tools, interactive press and ramp areas, and dynamic traffic moving around you. Drive with WASD, use Space for the handbrake, and hold Shift to boost. Press C to change the camera, R to reset your car, N for a new vehicle, K to repair, B for slow motion, and Tab to pause. On mobile, tap the on-screen buttons instead. Wreck, tune, and explore at your own pace.
homo-evolution: Homo Evolution is a free online puzzle game built around merging. You combine two individuals to produce a newer, more modern life form, gradually filling the planet with creatures ranging from basic animals to strange and unpredictable characters. It works on both phones and computers, and it lets you build your own small universe while exploring how humans evolved.

Your world can develop along four paths. BEGINNING follows animal life as it grows from spores into modern beings, FIRST PEOPLE traces the move from the ancient world to the first citizens, SPECTACLE covers a creative Bohemian scene with poets and wild party-goers, and BREAD shows civilization shifting from natural goods to modified products. Eight stages of world evolution are also included: Television, Internet, Sports, Science, Teleunity, Virtualization, Transformation and Power Cult. Explore each branch to unlock the next one.
tung-sahur-io: Up to 100 people can take part in this multiplayer game built around internet memes. You begin as a student at school, but a Tung Sahur infection is spreading quickly. Well-known TikTok memes like bombardino crocodilo and tung tung tung sahur come alive here, making for an infection match that has friends both giggling and yelling together.
You can try to survive as a schoolkid, or get infected and join the Tung Sahur army to hunt your former classmates. On a ke
single-dad-simulator-family-life: Step into the shoes of a busy single father in this family life simulator. You look after your kids, keep the house in order, and finish work tasks. Career Mode offers story missions alongside your daily duties. Adventure Mode brings family activities, driving missions, outdoor trips, and challenges. Free Mode lets you explore the city, spend time with your children, and drive around at your own pace.

Cooking, cleaning, grocery shopping, and driving the kids to school fill your days, along with picnics, park outings, and family trips. A detailed 3D city and home come with smooth controls and realistic animations. On desktop, use WASD to move, the mouse to turn the camera, and Shift to sprint. Ctrl opens settings, N skips a level, P pauses, F triggers actions, and I opens info
cake-shop-simulator-bake-and-sell: Run a small cake shop in this relaxed browser game, taking orders through the chat. Open the Chats tab, tap a customer, and read their request. Then build the cake step by step: pick a shape and tiers, add glaze and drips, spread cream, draw a design on top, and finish with decorations. Matching items on the order card turn green and raise the price. Send a photo to
2048-shoot-merge-number-3d: Here is a three-dimensional twist on the well-known 2048 puzzle. You aim and fire at numbered blocks, then join matching ones as they climb from 2 to 4 to 8 and onward toward 2048. Each merge brings a rewarding upgrade, raises your score, and frees up room on the board. One touch is all the controls need, so you can pick it up quickly, but you will still have to plan ahead so the board does not fill up.

Visuals are sharp and the animations run smoothly. The mode is endless, so you can keep going past 2048 whenever you like. The game runs offline, so you can open it at any time. It suits quick breaks, offers a workout for your brain, and gives logic fans a challenge to beat their own high score. Just click or tap to play.
snake-of-bullets-collect-and-shoot: Snake of Bullets: Collect and Shoot! mixes snake, shooter, and runner styles into one light, calming free online game. Its gun-and-ammo theme should appeal to men, and simple, smooth controls make it a relaxing break after work or study. Many levels keep things interesting for a long time.
Swipe a finger or move the mouse across the screen to steer your snake along the most
race-on-cars-in-moscow: Race On Cars in Moscow mixes the careful planning of checkers with fast driving through heavy traffic. Your aim is to cover as much highway as you can without crashing into other vehicles. In parking mode, finish missions across the open map to earn money, then spend it on upgrades or to unlock powerful new cars. Tuning goes deep: lower the body, swap the wheels, repaint, or turn the dorestyling into a sporty machine.

Multiplayer races let you compete against other players and climb into the TOP league, while Endless Drive tests how far you can get through crowded city streets. On PC, use WASD or the arrow keys to control the car, Z for emergencies, Q and E for turn signals, and C to switch cameras. On phones, choose on-screen buttons or an on-screen steering wheel in the settings.
i-am-crazy-bird: You play as a daring city bird who loves causing mayhem in a wide open world. Soar wherever you like, pull off silly aerial tricks, and swipe food from unsuspecting people. Grab strange, unexpected weapons, roam across rooftops and busy streets, and complete missions on your way to becoming a true urban legend. This sandbox adventure is built around freedom and surprise.

Expect plenty of laughs and chaotic moments with every flight. On a keyboard, WASD moves you, Spacebar takes off, and Shift boosts while flying. The left mouse button hits and interacts with the world, E picks up or drops items, and F handles Mem. On mobile, a joystick controls movement and dragging it upward boosts your flight. The right button takes off, hits, picks up or drops items, and handles Mem, while touching the screen interacts with the world.
stunt-witch-3: Take to the sky in a spooky Halloween romp where a small but determined witch sets out to win back the stars a sneaky ghost has taken. Steer your broom through glowing hoops, gather stars and potions along the way, and weave past bats across 24 scrolling stages. Be careful, though, because touching the edge of any ring brings your flight to an abrupt end.

Illustrated story scenes carry the tale forward, and storm effects add weather to the sky. Unlock outfits for your witch, or try the endless mode. Turn with the left and right arrow keys or A and D, use W to boost, and press S to brake. You can also guide the witch with the mouse or by touch, and on mobile, on-screen buttons appear for control. Press P or Esc to pause.
puzzle-parents-baby-s-path-home: Puzzle Parents: Baby's Path Home is a puzzle game with quirky helpers named nubik, haggy waggie, kisi misi, and rainbow friends, who assist you in winning each round. You sketch the quickest route back home with a baby in tow. Every stage presents its own brain teaser, complete with twisting routes, barriers, and prizes to collect. Your job is to bring the little one home safely, relying on sharp reasoning, clever problem solving, and a bit of imagination. Don't expect it to be a walk in the park.

The visuals are bright and playful, and the characters are charming to watch. The overall feel is calming and refreshing, which makes it a nice way to clear your head after a long workday. An optional mode asks you to locate the baby's favorite toy and hand it over. To play, click a helper to start drawing lines, then draw a path toward the child while steering clear of obstacles. Make sure every helper reaches their baby safely and guides them back home.
emergency-rush-city-ambulance-rescue: You step into the role of a real-life rescuer in this 3D adventure set on busy city roads. You drive a capable ambulance through crowded streets, answering emergency calls from people who badly need medical help. Traffic can be heavy and road obstacles pop up, so you must steer around them while carrying patients safely to the hospital. Each moment matters, so keep your attention sharp and rely on your driving skill to get there quickly.
The game offers driving challenges and fast-paced ambulance missions that test how you handle emergencies on the road. Press W or the
monster-escape-logic-puzzle-adventure: Monster Escape is a logic puzzle game in which every move counts. You spin the dungeon around your creature and steer it toward the key so it can break free. On the way, you must dodge falling boxes, sharp thorns, and other tricky obstacles across mysterious dungeon settings. The game has 60 levels, and each one is harder than the last, so you will need to plan ahead and react fast.

Controls are simple. Press the onscreen buttons to rotate the monster's world, or tap to the left or right of the monster to walk without turning the level. The rotation follows physics, which adds another layer to every puzzle. Fans of escape games, monster adventures, brain puzzles, and skill-based platformers should find plenty to enjoy.
obby-climb-up-and-slide-down-on-minecart: In this obby, you ride a cart upward through a series of levels, collecting money along the way. You can spend that money on a brand-new cart or upgrade the one you have. Each push higher makes the track harder, but the rewards grow too. New zones unlock as you go, so you can explore different locations and get stronger with every attempt.

Adorable pets travel with you, and you can collect many kinds, level them up, and use their unique abilities to clear stages faster and more efficiently. Compete with friends for the top score, sharpen your skills, and prove you are a skilled rising racer. On PC, use WASD to move and the mouse to control the camera. On mobile, use the on-screen controls and drag anywhere on the screen to adjust the camera.
dream-home-merge-story: Dream Home: Merge Story is a relaxed puzzle title where you join matching objects on a grid to build better ones. Each merge unlocks a higher tier, and those pieces help you fill the orders listed across the top of the screen. Finishing jobs earns stars, which you can use back in the house for repairs, furnishings, and decorative touches. Little by little, a weathered old place becomes a warm, inviting home.

Your energy runs down as you play, so think ahead before each move and keep some open cells on the board, since new items and future merges need room. Crystals speed up energy recovery, and extra rewards give you more chances to keep going. Keep completing tasks and discovering new items to watch each room change.
monster-card-shop: Build your own trading card shop and give it a name. Stock the shelves by tapping the button above each one to restock booster packs. At the till, serve every customer by swiping their card or handing over the right change. Clean up trash and spills, then spend coins on upgrades, new shelves, expansions and staff, including a cashier, a stocker and a cleaner.

Open packs to fill your album with 64 monsters from the Forest, Ocean, Volcano and Galaxy worlds, ranging from plain critters to shiny legendaries. Each new card and completed set raises your income. Join live auctions against collectors, send top cards to the grading lab for a GEM MINT 10, trade with visiting traders and battle in the Monster Cup when events open. Daily free gifts and quests add rewards, and your shop keeps earning while you are away.
choco-ball-draw-line-and-happy-girl: Steer falling chocolate balls toward a hungry girl so she gets her sweet treat. The main skill here is drawing lines that guide the balls safely past fireballs and ice cubes. Accuracy and careful planning matter, because each stage gets harder than the last. Think fast and adjust your approach as the obstacles change, since that is how you win.

The game is built around drawing paths on screen to move the candy where it needs to go. Every level brings new hazards to work around, so you must stay focused and keep a clear plan in mind. If you enjoy puzzle-style sports games that reward quick reactions and smart choices, this one is worth a try.
rescue-sharp-turn: Rescue Sharp Turn is a relaxed three-dimensional puzzle played inside a small 3D scene. You select the right objects to switch on devices, clear away obstacles, or set off a chain of events that meets each level's conditions and frees an injured character. The stages are short but inventive, asking you to cut the power, move rocks, release water to put out a fire, or combine items to make new props.

A wrong move means everyone loses, though a slip still gets a cheer from the crowd. The game works with both mouse and touch, and since you can pause and pick up where you left off, it fits well into brief gaps in your day. Control is simply a click or tap.
capitalist-hunter: Capitalist Hunter puts you in charge of a hunting business that grows over time. Roam the wilderness, track down animals, and gather the meat they leave behind. Then carry your haul back to town, where you can cook food for hungry villagers and sell it for cash. Use your earnings to upgrade your equipment and unlock new areas, animals, and stages of progress.

The game blends arcade action with idle tycoon and management play, so the pace is quick and the controls stay simple. Move with a joystick or the WASD or arrow keys, approach an animal to hunt it, and walk over
arrows-escape: Arrows Escape is a clean, stripped-back puzzle that asks you to think ahead. Every arrow must leave the board, and you have to manage it without any collisions. Tapping an arrow sends it gliding in the direction it faces until it exits the grid or runs into something in its path, so the real challenge is choosing a safe sequence.

The game includes thousands of handcrafted levels that grow more intricate as you advance, testing your planning and spatial reasoning. Its minimalist design keeps your focus on the puzzle, and there are no timers, so you can take your time. If you get stuck, a hint system is available. Clearing a board without losing any hearts earns a cleaner win.
cat-vs-granny-cat-simulator: You play as a sneaky cat who turns grandma's cozy home into a room-by-room mess. Smash pots, swipe fish from the aquarium, toss things around, and claw at anything within reach. It is a first-person simulator full of silly humor. Rooms are packed with objects to interact with, and grandma's patience wears thin after every prank.
deconstruct-cube-create-hotel: Drawing its inspiration from the USSR, this puzzle game blends a 2048-style cube challenge with hotel building. Your task is to take cubes apart, then connect and match the pieces as you go. Every successful match earns points as you move along.

The final aim is to build a pearl hotel, growing your lodging piece by piece through the cube puzzle. Each upgrade brings the property closer to the design you have in mind. Break the cube down, link the pieces, match them, and watch your hotel take shape.
event-horizon-black-hole-idle: You are a black hole drifting through space, swallowing rocks, moons and planets as you climb a ladder of cosmic scales. Your energy keeps building even while you are away. Spend it along a branching tree of upgrades, from gravity and the accretion disk to satellites and relativistic jets.

Steer by swiping or dragging, or use the arrow keys or WASD on desktop. Pulling in matter earns mass and energy. Large bodies arrive on a timer, and if you get close enough, tidal forces tear them apart so you can catch the debris. Fire jets with the round button, and pinch or scroll to zoom. When the time is right, press the Big Bang button to restart stronger, with permanent physics rules in place. Real ray-traced gravitational lensing and a catalog of real celestial bodies to collect round things out.
draft-arena-battle-cards: Draft Arena: Battle Cards is a fast strategy auto battler built around choosing cards. Each round, you pick one of three cards to add troops such as robots, cowboys, chickens, TNT, and tanks. After that, your army takes on the rival force without your input. Upgrading fighters to tougher ranks and dropping a bomb or lightning at the right instant can turn a losing fight around.

Win matches to advance along the Victory Road, unlocking 12 fighters and 3 arenas. You can open card packs, upgrade your fighters, and try to defeat the champion of each arena. Play with a mouse or touch. If you lose all your hearts, the match ends. Matches are short and easy to learn.
draw-bridge-puzzle-challenge: Draw Bridge: Puzzle Challenge is a puzzle game built around a stickman, drawn bridges, and connected paths. Each level tests your logic, and the ragdoll physics mean a wobbly design can send the stickman tumbling. You have plenty of room to be creative, the levels vary from one to the next, and accuracy challenges push your designs to their limits.

To play, swipe a finger across the screen to draw a path that guides your motorcycle to its destination. When open space separates you from the goal, draw a line across it and your vehicle will drive over that bridge. Each line can only be drawn once, so plan before you commit. You must touch the flag to win, and strong, balanced bridges give you the best chance of clearing every level.
yatzy: Yatzy is a dice game where you roll five dice over 13 rounds, trying to build the strongest scoring combinations and outwit your rivals. Casual players and experienced fans can both enjoy it. Related to Yacht and Yahtzee, it blends planning with chance, so it feels both challenging and entertaining.

Each turn gives up to three rolls, letting you choose which dice to keep and which to re-roll. After rolling, you pick a scoring box, and each box can be used only once. The upper section counts dice by face value, from ones to sixes, while the lower section rewards Full Houses, Straights, and Yatzy (five of a kind). Reaching 63 or more in the upper section earns a 50-point bonus, and an extra Yatzy adds 100 bonus points. When the rounds end, the highest total wins.
cooking-shawarma-idle-game: Run your own shawarma stand in this simulation game, where a busy kitchen and real-time customers keep you on your toes. You start small and grow by upgrading your slicing knife, lavash station, and cooking speed. Choose quality meat, marinate it with the right spices, and add extras like ketchup, mayo, fries, or pickles to suit each order.

Serve customers quickly and accurately. They order shawarma, fries, pasta, and cold drinks, and completing each order correctly earns rewards. On desktop, hold the right mouse button to fry chips, hold it and drag across the meat to slice, and click ingredients repeatedly to fill a shawarma. Hold the right button and drag a finished item to the customer to serve it. Mobile players tap and hold to fry.
steal-car-duel: Steal Car Duel is a competitive action game that turns the idea of Steal a Brainrot into a car-based contest. Expect head-to-head clashes, rare collectibles, and upgrades that keep coming. You race, collide, and steal your way up, building your own garage while earning coins and tickets. Outsmarting rivals is the key to proving who rules the arena.

Each match rewards skill, timing, and strategy. You can play Solo or face a friend in 2 Player mode. Player 1 moves with W, A, S, and D, jumps with Space, steals or buys with E, hits with F or the Left Mouse button, and sprints with Left Shift. Player 2 moves with the Arrow Keys, jumps with L, steals or buys with O, hits with K, and sprints with J.
snake-brawl-merge-arena: Glide through the arena and grow a snake that gets stronger as it goes. Every body segment carries a number, and collecting orbs that match it merges the two in a 2048-style way, powering you up. Drag anywhere on the screen to steer. Bite smaller snakes to steal their segments, and dodge the bigger ones. A green ring means a snake is safe to bite, while a red ring warns of danger.

Your goal is to defeat the target number of snakes or the crowned boss before the timer runs out. After that, the Power Smash bonus lets you tap quickly to break multiplier walls and collect coins. You can also upgrade power, speed and magnet, and unlock 8 snake skins.
pixel-feast: Pixel Feast is a colorful 3D pixel puzzle. You open a crate at the front of a column, and the hungry characters inside rush into the waiting slots. From there they travel to the picture and eat the pixels that share their color. Every crate you choose matters, so plan ahead, keep room in the slots, and keep going until the whole picture is cleared.

The game has 134 colorful levels, each with new obstacles. Boosters called Hand, Rainbow Cannon, and Extra Slot help you reach deeper crates, clear matching pixels from occupied slots, and make more room. Booster gifts come your way as you progress. Optional rewarded videos offer extra slots, boosters, and bonus coins. Play with touch or a mouse, and tap the pause button whenever you want to stop.
cube-zone-master: Cube Zone Master drops you into a three-dimensional world where you guide a cube through a fast-paced adventure. Good planning matters just as much as quick hands, since both shape how far you climb. Your cube grows by swallowing smaller cubes you meet along the way, while you slip past or outwit the rivals who want the same space.

The aim is to become the dominant force in a colorful land that keeps changing around you. Every moment asks you to think a step ahead and react the instant an opening appears. Keep your wits sharp, watch your rivals closely, and work your way toward the top of this shifting world of shapes.
color-by-numbers-anti-stress-drawings: Color by Numbers is a relaxing creative game built around anti-stress drawings. Each picture is split into numbered sections, and you match every section with the right color from the palette. A tap fills the section, and little by little an outline turns into a bright image. Playing this art therapy helps you leave your worries behind. It works online in a web browser and on Android.

The game suits the whole family. Children can learn colors and numbers while building their motor skills, and adults can unwind and enjoy being creative. No special skills are needed. You can choose from pixel art, flowers, animals, mandalas, landscapes, and more complex compositions, starting with large sections and moving on to smaller details. When a drawing is finished, you can save it or share it with friends.
boss-level-shootout: Billy is caught inside his own retro console world, and you follow him through its challenges. Your job is to sharpen your skills as you square off against tough bosses. Running and jumping are central to the action, and collecting power-ups lets you blast your way through each demanding level.
The whole experience feels like a classic arcade session, and it suits players of every age. It mixes plenty of straightforward fun with a warm sense of nostalgia for older games.
patch-garden: Patch Garden is a calm rectangle puzzle where each seed clue blooms into one neat garden bed. You sketch rectangles by sweeping across the grid, and each one must cover exactly as many cells as its clue asks for. The board has to be filled completely, with no empty squares and no pieces stacked on top of each other.

The game starts with easy tutorial gardens, then moves on to hundreds of trickier stages. Later levels add mystery seeds, clues that state exact sizes, bigger boards, and deeper deduction challenges. On desktop, use the mouse to draw patches, Ctrl+Z to undo, E to switch on erase mode, and H to highlight a helpful area. On phones and tablets, touch and drag to draw, and use the on-screen undo and erase buttons.
ball-io: Ball.io is a fun, addictive take on the io style. Your job is to remove the obstacles standing in the path of the ball so it can reach the finish line. It belongs to the hypercasual category, so the action stays light and simple from start to finish.
Everything is handled with the mouse, so there are no extra controls to learn. It also sits among other casual ball games, which makes it a good match for a quick break or a longer session.
naval-base: Run a shore-side base during quick, tactical sea battles. Assemble a balanced mix of warships, planes and submarines, which fight on their own once you buy them from the strip along the bottom of the screen. Pit them against enemy groups, boost your defenses, and face a different boss in each operation. Warships counter aircraft, aircraft go after submarines, and submarines put warships at risk.

Your goal is to destroy the enemy base before the clock runs out. On a computer, A and D or the screen edges pan the view, while W and S or the Up and Down arrows aim your coastal gun, and the number keys buy units. On touch devices, drag the battle view and use the on-screen controls.
don-t-splash: Fog drifts through the endless poolrooms of this 3D horror parkour title. You hop between floating tiled slabs above turquoise water, working through 10 large levels to reach the exit portal at the end of each one. Something blind lurks in the pool. It cannot see you, but it hears every splash. If you tumble in, swim to the nearest edge and pull yourself out before it closes in.

Draw it away with pebbles, bottles, a wind-up duck, or a flare, and get ahead of the bots racing alongside you. Along the way you unlock tools and upgrades and gather cosmetics. On desktop, WASD moves you, Space jumps or climbs out, and the mouse looks around. Keys 1-3 use tools, F pushes, R returns you to the checkpoint, and P pauses. On mobile, the left stick moves you, swiping changes your view, and on-screen buttons handle jumping and t
midnight-valet: Step into a 3D valet job on the night shift at the busiest club in the city, running from 22:00 to 04:00. Collect keys from arriving guests, park their cars in the lot, and hang each key on the key board. When a guest comes out, find the right key and bring the car back to the door.

Guests vary. Regulars wait patiently, hasty ones race a countdown, and tipsy ones give the wrong key number, so you must find their car by colour. The mafia boss wants his black-gold sports car kept in the VIP spot only, and scratches bring threats. Move with WASD or the arrow keys. Space takes keys, opens the board, gets in or out, and hands over cars. Shift runs on foot or pulls the handbrake while driving. Q closes the board, P or Esc pauses, and M toggles sound. Mobile players use a joystick.
fish-rain-2: Fish Rain 2 pulls you into a fishing game where authentic sounds set the mood and lively online interactions make each outing feel fresh. Your task is to reel in a wide range of fish across scenic places, switching up your bait to tempt them. With the right choice, you might land a legendary catch that stands out from the rest.

Once you hook a big one, you can share your trophies with others. The game also lets you take on the waters alongside friends, so your fishing trips can become a shared adventure. Whether you are chasing common catches or rare prizes, there is always another spot to try and another fish to pursue.
lovim-fishing-simulator-3d: Lovim is a 3D fishing simulator where you cast a spinning rod, float, feeder, or tip-up. Your goal is to find the spots that are biting, set the hook, and land pike, perch, zander, carp, bream, roach, or trout. Weather and the bite forecast decide which fish are active, so reading conditions matters as much as casting well. You can upgrade your tackle and open new waters as you progress.

Casting means holding the left mouse button or the Cast button until the power builds, then letting go. Retrieve speed is set with buttons on screen, and Strike is the key for setting the hook. When a fish is on, keep Reel pressed while loosening the drag to protect your line. A map shows depth and helps you travel to other waters. Phone players
deep-drill-run: Deep Drill Run is a fast 3D mining arcade game made for quick, intense sessions. Each descent drops you into a fresh mine, where your split-second decisions set how far you go and how much you carry back. Rock breaks in real time, and every block gives you a sense of impact, pressure, and contact. The farther you wander from base, the richer the resources, but the danger grows too, while heat and
zombie-barrage: This top-down zombie defense game asks you to hold a barricade as waves of undead grow tougher each round. Defeat mutated bosses, collect coins, and spend them on better weapons and gear between rounds. Careful aiming and smart ammunition use matter, because the attacks keep getting stronger and the barricade has to survive them. It runs directly in your browser on desktop or mobile.

On desktop, move the mouse to aim and click to shoot. On-screen buttons handle pausing, muting, and opening your gear. On mobile, tap the screen to fire, and use the same kind of on-screen buttons to pause, mute, and manage gear.
food-gang-run: Food Gang Run is an online game you can play on a PC, phone, or tablet. You take control of one of three small heroes: a tomato, a banana, or a broccoli. Your skill keeps your chosen character moving and pushes its score higher as a group of friends takes over a kitchen, racing to get as far as they can so they can escape.

Along the way they face flying police donuts, sushi swinging sabers, pizza slices with cannons, giant pumpkins with huge guns, and many other foes. You must dodge these threats and grab extra weapons to clear each level. The game also offers three quirky characters, more than 50 skills to unlock, and stars to collect for rewards. On a PC, the arrow keys move your character and the spacebar makes it jump. On mobile or tablet, touch the movement buttons on screen and use the jump control.
color-ball-escape: Here you match colours to clear a packed board of marbles that keep tumbling out of towers. Holes you move into place do the catching, but each one accepts only its own colour, so the sequence matters: the right order opens the board, and the wrong one leaves it jammed. Ice, crates, colour locks, one-way tiles and stacked marbles all change what counts as the right sequence.

Drag a hole across the board and align it under the marbles you're after, using the mouse on desktop or a tap-and-drag on touch. Tap a power-up to use it: Magnet pulls loose balls into a hole, Claw drops any single marble you tap
christmas-gift-unlock: Get into the holiday mood with this festive puzzle game, where you work through tricky brain teasers to unlock a Christmas present. Bright, holiday-themed graphics fill the screen, and a cheerful soundtrack plays as you go. The levels grow steadily harder, so there is always a new challenge waiting.

Your task is to clear a path for the gift box by moving the red blocks around the grid. Click and hold the left mouse button on a block, then drag it horizontally or vertically. Once the route is open, the gift box can slide out of the puzzle. The controls are smooth and easy to pick up, and the immersive Christmas setting adds to the atmosphere. Whether you want a relaxing way to pass some time or you are chasing a high score, this game mixes fun with a bit of mental exercise.
catrobot-idle-td-battle-cat: CatRobot Idle TD Battle Cat is a tower defense adventure set in a magical realm, where waves of mystical foes march toward your tower. Monsters have overrun your kingdom, so holding the line is up to you. Train your warrior cats to grow stronger, then build a massive robot to fight back against the invaders.

Play is simple and needs just one touch, yet it remains fun. Each level throws a crowd of enemies at you, along with new villains and bosses, so you must keep upgrading your tower. Aim carefully and shoot fast to stop foes before they reach you. Raise your score, unlock new gear, and play on PC, mobile, or tablet. On a computer, move the mouse to aim and left-click to fire arrows. On touch devices, tap the screen and move to shoot.
mr-racer-car-racing: MR RACER: Car Racing is a fast-paced driving game where you speed through traffic in sleek supercars. Car handling is simple to pick up, so the focus stays on the racing itself. Your main options are Challenge Mode, which offers 100 levels, and Chase Mode, which has no level limit. In Chase Mode you pursue rivals and try to prove you are the best.

Career Race Mode asks you to defeat your rivals and earn a legendary reputation. You can choose from 15 supercars, boost their performance through upgrades, and personalize them with eye-catching paint and wheels. The game features detailed 3D visuals, realistic lighting, and several camera angles. Controls use W to accelerate, A and D to steer, S to brake, and H to sound the horn, with the arrow keys as alternatives.
survev-io: Survev.io Battle Royale is a multiplayer match where you try to be the final survivor on an island that keeps getting smaller. You begin with only your fists, so you need to search for guns and supplies while staying inside the safe zone. You can choose solo, duo, or squad play, and your success depends on planning and skill as you work to outlast up to 50 rivals.

Move with W, A, S and D, and aim with the mouse. Left-click fires your weapon. Switch weapons with keys 1 through 4 or the scroll wheel, and press 3 or E to stow your guns and switch to melee mode. Q returns you to your previous weapon, T
obby-space-challenge-starships: Pilot starships through a cosmic world in this Obby title. Gather energy capsules during your flights, since the more energy you collect, the more trophies you earn once the flight ends. Spend those trophies on companions and new ships that help you gather energy faster. Switch between your vehicles, unlock new locations, and explore every one of them. Achievements and tasks give you extra goals, and many pet and ship skins with enhancements let you style your gear. Daily rewards depend on how much time you spend playing and refresh each day.

On PC, use WASD to move, Space to jump, and the right mouse button to control the camera. On mobile, a joystick moves your character, and holding your finger on the screen adjusts the view. Music adds to the atmosphere, though you can play without sound.
catdoku-sudoku-puzzle: Catdoku is a logic puzzle built around colorful regions and a handful of placement rules. Each colored territory needs exactly one cat, and no two cats may share a row or a column. Cats also need space, so they cannot touch, even at a diagonal corner. Every cat you add changes what is possible across the whole grid, so careful study pays off. The early boards are gentle and teach you the rules, while later layouts ask for deeper planning.

Wrong taps cost hearts, so it is best to reason through each move rather than guess. Controls are simple taps, the visuals are clean and bright, and the levels are short enough for quick sessions. Its cat theme keeps the mood light. The game suits fans of Sudoku, logic grids, and brain teasers who want a relaxing way to train their thinking.
dumplings-who-will-you-get: Dumplings: Who Will You Get? is an arcade merge and idle clicker where you open boxes to gather 12 cute dumpling squishies. Joining two identical characters creates a rarer, funnier one. Every seventh box is special and always holds a dumpling at level 2 or higher. Tap your dumplings for coins, then spend them on boxes, orders and kitchen upgrades. Your income keeps rising even while you're away.

Tap the steamer to receive a box, then tap the box to open it. Drag one dumpling onto a matching one to merge them. Your aim is to unlock all 12 levels. Use a mouse on desktop, or tap and drag with your finger on mobile. Fans of Merge Mansion, Suika Game, 2048 and other cute merge games may enjoy it.
merge-2048: Merge 2048 is a number puzzler where you combine matching numbered blocks to build higher values, with the rare 2048 block as the target. Pick Classic 2048 or Shape Mode for a different take on the action. Plan each merge as blocks drop so the container doesn't overflow. When you get stuck, the TNT Block clears unwanted tiles and makes room. Clean visuals and smooth controls support steady progress, and you can track your score and unlock titles. See how far you can go without touching the red line.

On desktop, hold the left mouse button and drag to move a block, then release it to drop. On mobile, drag with your touch screen, and the block drops when the drag ends. Quick sessions and long strategic runs both suit the game, which is easy to learn but takes skill to master.
magic-kingdom-hex-match: You are the third son of a great king in a magical land. Sent to a faraway territory, you must found a new kingdom and prove your ability to your parents. Gather hexes from six resources, which are food, water, stone, wood, diamonds, and metal, to raise new structures until every building is unlocked and your magical kingdom takes shape.
On the building screen, tap a scaffold to
wars-tanks-2022: Fresh tank clashes await in this free browser shooter. Pilot combat vehicles spanning World War II to the present day, each handled with realistic physics and set against polished, rich visuals. Pick your favorite tank, collect prizes, and upgrade it to become stronger, quicker, and more lethal in battle.

This massively multiplayer game lets you invite friends, face rivals across 12 maps in four game types, and enjoy new tank models added regularly. Build a clan or join an established one, then rise from cadet to generalissimo. Training comes first, followed by choosing, improving, and battling. Drive with WASD and fire with a left mouse click.
gun-baron: You run a weapons business as a red panda in a world ruled by raccoon bandits. Your job is to set up production with machines, then keep the shelves stocked with pistols, assault rifles, and dynamite. Shorter queues bring bigger profits, and customers arrive on their own, so you must watch demand, adjust your stock, and grow your funds. Every sale moves you closer to the rocket you want to build.

The raccoons do not stay away, though. Bandits raid your base often, so you will need to buy stronger weapons, improve your panda's abilities, and fight back in real-time battles to guard your conveyor belts and warehouse. Balance production with defense, and keep customers satisfied so your reputation holds. Save enough money and you can blast off and leave this harsh planet behind.
basketball-master-2: Basketball Master 2 invites you to play like a true hoops star. You line up accurate shots and also try bank shots that bounce off the backboard. Along the way you must work past tricky obstacles and defenders who change how they move.

The game runs smoothly on whatever screen you happen to use. Every throw comes down to aiming and pointing, so you need to plan your strategy carefully. It is a fun test of your aim and your game plan, with a point-and-shoot style that keeps you coming back for more.
wild-wolf-simulator-animal-games: You roam the wild as a powerful wolf in this arcade adventure. Travel through forests, mountains, snowy regions, plains, and deserts while hunting prey, guarding your territory, and taking on survival missions. Form your own pack and work your way up to Alpha. Hunt as a team, battle rival packs, defend your den, and face dangerous wild creatures.
Level-based challenges sharpen your wolf and unlock stronger powers. Pick
outpost-9: You are the last person left at Outpost 9, a first-person horror shooter where zombies keep arriving in endless waves. Fight back with everything you have. Collect points to open locked doors, buy powerful weapons and perks, restore the facility's power, and light the beacon.
On desktop, WASD moves you, the mouse looks and aims,
mech-battle-arena: Mech Battle Arena pits you against a rival in live, real-time combat fought with robot cards. Assemble a deck of eight robots, then place them on the battlefield to knock out the enemy towers. Your robots advance on their own and strike the closest foe, so you need to bring down the opposing towers before yours fall. Every card costs energy, and that energy slowly refills.

Win battles to open chests full of new cards and coins, then upgrade your robots between fights. The collection offers more than forty unique robots, six arenas, and a 30-mission campaign. A reboot system lets you start over with powerful bonuses. It is easy to learn and quick to play on a phone or desktop. Drag cards with a mouse or your finger, or tap one first to see its energy cost.
alchemy-store: Mix elements together to build up a whole world. Pairing water with fire gives you steam, and joining earth with water produces a plant. Run a shop by handing customers the items they request, which earns you coins. Those coins unlock heroes, and each hero gets a shelf of their own. The game includes 212 elements and 569 recipes, with regular townsfolk orders and quicker rush orders.

Press and hold an element, then drag it onto another to combine them. Tap the magic cauldron to receive a new element, and drop any spares into it. Tapping a customer gives you a hint. The heroes are a fox, a bear, a raccoon, a cat and a frog. There is also a collection book, an Alchemy Map and 11 achievements. The hand-drawn art feels cozy, and the pace stays relaxed.
sorting-ball-puzzle: This color-sorting game is built to be relaxing and hard to put down while sharpening your mind. Sorting colored balls so each bottle holds one shade eases stress and pulls your focus away from daily worries. It is simple to learn but takes skill to master. Thousands of puzzles vary in difficulty, and harder ones demand care with every move, since one misstep can leave you stuck. It is a solid work
sink-hole: Sink Hole puts you in charge of a hungry hole that swallows an entire city. As you grow, you can devour rivals and bring down skyscrapers, but you must keep away from larger foes that could take you down. Choose from four modes: Classic, Battle Royale, Solo Rush and Wipeout. Chain together x5 combos and collect powerful boosts to speed up your growth. The lifelike 3D city features buildings that crumble as you pull them in. Unlock new skins, finish missions for rewards, and check your stats to try to top your best scores.
On a computer, steer with the mouse or use WASD or the arrow keys, and press Esc or P to pause. On a phone or tablet, touch and drag to move, then tap pause
getting-over-it: In this puzzle game, you guide a determined cat sitting in a flower pot, gripping a trusty hammer. Your path leads through an infuriating world of towering junk, where every move has to be deliberate. Success depends on careful precision and patience, since each precarious swing could bring a triumphant moment or send you tumbling back to the start.

The game is listed under puzzles and tagged with strategy, which suits its focus on thoughtful, measured play. Each swing matters, because one poorly judged motion can undo your progress in an instant. Staying patient and planning your next move are the keys to getting anywhere.
edgefire-2: EdgeFire 2 is a large, many-sided game world that reworks the proven formulas of its genre. Fans of the classic Counter-Strike 1.6 will recognize its feel at once, and so will anyone who has followed the changes in CS:GO and CS 2 or enjoyed the fast mobile fights of Standoff 2. The game blends old-school charm with fresh ideas, combining real tactical depth and teamwork with lively, visually striking action. Each match is its own story.

Winning here means more than simply eliminating rivals, since you need to dominate every encounter. Quick reactions and sharp aim matter, and every shot and movement should be deliberate. Pairing skilled weapon handling with clever tactical thinking is what sets you ap
epic-race-game: Here, quick reflexes and careful planning go hand in hand as you race across courses that shift in unexpected ways. You will need to handle tight corners with precision, avoid surprise obstacles along the route, and search out hidden shortcuts that can give you an edge over your rivals.

Between races, you can customize and upgrade your fleet, and as you progress you unlock new vehicles. These machines help you face increasingly tough challenges on your way toward becoming the racing champion.
space-survivors-bug-swarm: A space crew lands on six alien planets swarming with bugs, and you must survive ten minutes on each. Keep moving to avoid the crowd, while your weapons lock onto the nearest bug and fire automatically. Collect the crystals bugs drop to gain levels, then choose one of three upgrade cards: a new weapon, a stronger weapon
build-obby-world: Build Obby World is an obby game where you jump, build, and explore to create a magical world full of pets, treasures, and surprises. You start on a small island, gather resources, and construct pieces of other islands to reach new areas. Tap tiny slimes to bring your world to life, and upgrade your tools to make your island big, colorful, and happy.
no-shorts: No Shorts is a ragdoll physics game that borrows the feel of short video feeds. You flick between levels with swipes, much like scrolling through a social network, or tap a virtual button if you prefer. Each stage gives you a range of tools for poking at ragdoll stickmen and setting off objects around the scene.

Your main goal is to cause as much damage as you can to the stickmen and their surroundings by firing from a cannon. Every action uses one-finger control, so a single click is enough to affect the stickmen or the environment. The graphics are simple and funny, and you can play online from a PC or phone whenever you have a spare moment. Use the level builder to design your own playgrounds, stories, and scenarios, then like the creations of other players.
meow-captcha: Meow Captcha: Virtual Cat blends tricky cat puzzles with a cute virtual kitty to look after. Each short level asks you to pick out cats, hunt for hidden objects, spot differences, sort mischievous kitties, clean up a scene, or drag items to the right place. Some puzzles test logic and observation, while others hide the answer in the scene or call for an unexpected solution. Even the smallest detail can matter.

Between puzzles, you care for your virtual cat by feeding it, petting it, giving it a bath, dressing it up, playing together, and tucking it into bed. Quick mini games add more variety. The controls are simple: tap, choose, find, sort, and drag. Purring and contented cat gazes serve as your rewards, and there is no pressure to hurry. You can also share your Humanity Scale with friends.
super-huggie-bros: Super Huggie Bros is a 2D platformer where you help the mischievous Huggy Wuggy break out of a burning place. Dangerous obstacles fill the route, and you can jump a second time in mid-air, so precise timing matters. Coins you collect let you give Huggy stylish transformations along the way.

Huggy runs forward automatically, so you are always on the move. Advancing flames close in from behind, and you must stay ahead of them through quick reactions and skilful manoeuvres. It is a fast, tense race that rewards sharp timing and nimble play.
king-of-mahjong-connecting-tiles: King of Mahjong: Connecting Tiles is a puzzle game built on the Mahjong style, and your goal is to pair up identical character tiles. The rules have been streamlined so that newcomers can start playing right away. Each pair must be linked by a route made of no more than three straight segments.

The game offers many levels, and you can adjust the board size to match your preferred challenge. Every level runs against a timer and includes a limited number of image replacements, and the round ends when either one runs out. You decide when to use hints and replacements on each level, and you can collect extra ones while you play. Controls are easy to learn, the graphics are bright, and the background music is pleasant, which makes it a relaxed way to pass the time.
lucky-clash: Lucky Clash is a 3D tactical tower defense game where you call forth powerful monsters and merge them to defend your kingdom from waves of attacking foes. Battles move quickly and are simple to pick up, yet there is plenty of room for planning. You can assemble capable teams, uncover relics, and chain together clever combinations to get through every fight. Monster merging, elemental synergies, and shifting clashes make each run feel distinct from the last.

Your goal is to defeat the enemy before it overwhelms you, surviving each round while collecting rewards that make you stronger. Success depends on careful strategy, good timing, and a little luck, along with sound decisions in every clash. Controls are handled with a mouse or touchscreen, which you use to press buttons, choose actions, and steer the game.
racing-destruction-and-chase: Crashes here look detailed, with doors, hoods, and wheels flying off and sparks scattering beneath the car. You can race, dodge the police, or simply roam the open world at whatever pace you like. Tune your ride with new paint, different wheel sizes, and adjustable suspension height to build a look that's all your own. Presses, hammers, and ramps let you test how durable each vehicle really is.

Police chases follow realistic physics, and AI-driven bots populate the game world around you. Instant repair fixes your car on the spot, so the action never has to stop. Controls: WASD to move, Space for the handbrake, Shift for nitro acceleration, C to change the camera angle, R to flip the car, K to repair, B for slow motion, and Tab to pause. On a phone, you use the buttons on the screen.
tsunami-steal-an-egg: In this obby, you sneak into guarded nests to take eggs and hatch rare pets. Each pet you own brings in cash, so your income grows with your collection. Move with the arrow keys or the on-screen stick. Hold the action key to lift an egg from a guard, then sprint back to your base before the guards catch you. Watch out for the giant wave.
my-new-poodle-friend: Sofia's birthday is just around the corner, and Jack wants to surprise her with a poodle as a present. Animals mean a lot to her, so she dreams of raising the dog in the yard behind her home.

Before the poodle arrives, though, she must fix the old pet house and decorate it so it's ready for her new companion. Come join her and take a look at what she does. The controls are simple: click the mouse or tap to play.
dreamy-home: Dreamy Home is a calm puzzle game about unpacking a life one box at a time. You open crates, pick out personal belongings, and find a fitting place for each. Room by room, you assemble mosaics of memories hidden in simple objects. There is no rush, so you can decorate, arrange, and let the space tell its story without words. Everything from small trinkets to treasured heirlooms carries a piece of life.

On a computer, click an item, hold the mouse button, and drag it to the right spot. On a smartphone, tap an item, hold your finger on the screen, and drag it into place. Three boosters can help: a light bulb hint sets an item in its correct location, a freeze pauses the timer for 60 seconds, and a compass reveals the location of any four items. Soft visuals, relaxing sounds, and thoughtful gameplay create a warm, nostalgic atmosphere.
reaper-s-graveyard-shift: Step into the role of the Grim Reaper and oversee a haunted burial ground in this three-dimensional idle manager. Your work involves felling eerie trees, crafting coffins, and laying restless ghosts to rest before their patience runs dry. Hire skeletal workers to take over the routine tasks, so the graveyard keeps going while you focus elsewhere.

Important guests such as the Vampire, the Mummy, and Frankenstein's monster also need looking after. As your operation grows, you expand from a single plot into a full cemetery. On desktop, move with WASD or the arrow keys; on mobile, drag anywhere on the screen. Walk over items to pick them up, and stand on marked spots to build, buy upgrades, and bury ghosts. Press P to open the men
mahjong-sweet-connection-easter: Mahjong Sweet Connection Easter mixes three-in-a-row matching with the tile layouts of mahjong. You work through a board filled with Easter candies, eggs, and chocolates in a bright, sweet-themed setting. The tiles have a glossy, 3D-style look, and the holiday styling and smooth matching make it a calm choice for quick breaks or longer sessions.

Your aim is to clear every sweet tile from the board. Link three or more identical treats in a straight line, either across or up and down. Chaining several matches together creates combos that help you finish a level faster. Each level must be fully cleared before you run out of moves. On a computer, click the tiles to select and connect them. On a touchscreen, tap the tiles to form your lines.
stickman-miners-wars: Stickman Miners Wars puts you in charge of a stickman king, where careful planning makes the difference. You raise a force of miners and warriors, then improve your units and yourself as you earn experience. Battles center on attacking enemy castles while keeping your own safe.

Start by choosing a region to reclaim on the global map, then press PLAY to enter the level. Move with the arrow keys, WASD, a joystick, or the mouse, and use left-click to interact with things in the game. Buy a few miners first, since they gather gold for you and you can dig alongside them. Once you have enough gold, visit the warrior zone to expand your army, then click the sword icon on the right or press E to send it into attack. Your aim is to destroy the enemy towers before their castle, while the opponent works to do the same to yours.
sword-play-chop-enemies-to-pieces: Sword Play: Chop enemies to pieces! is an action game about slicing foes with a blade. Your mission on each level is to defeat every enemy. Swipe a finger across a phone screen, or drag the mouse cursor on a computer, to cut each opponent in half. The game features a unique slicing mechanic, many enemy types and levels, and action-packed missions full of ninja assassins. Follow a ninja warrior's adventure as you battle sword masters on the path to becoming the greatest samurai of all time.

Enemies can strike you directly or hurl weapons, so stay alert. Slow down time to chop flying bullets, cut explosive barrels in half, and knock away giant shurikens. Fans of ninja and samurai titles such as
princess-dental-dentist-games: Step into a busy city dental clinic where royal patients arrive hoping for brighter, healthier smiles. You play the dentist, starting with a check-up on a princess of your choice. Look closely at her teeth to spot cavities, grime, and other trouble, then pick the right instrument for each job. Plaque has to be scraped away, and decay needs to be repaired.

Every princess comes in with a different issue, so no two visits feel the same. Work through each procedure one stage at a time, handling your tools with care. Once every problem is fixed, she leaves with a lovely smile. Finish treatments to welcome more patients and face fresh dental challenges, and keep caring for them so they remember you as their favorite dentist.
crash-skill-racing: Take the wheel in this fast street racer set on the crowded roads of Japan. Slip between heavy traffic, pull off bold stunts, and push your car to its edge while chasing speed, flair, and skill. Every moment calls for careful timing, since you are weaving through cars at serious pace.
Tune and upgrade your vehicle, unlock several other cars, and tackle skill-based challenges as you move through a stunt-filled journey. On keyboard, WASD or the arr
froggy-tower: Froggy Tower asks you to build upward by jumping and stacking, where good timing and accuracy make all the difference. The journey climbs endlessly toward the sky as you extend blocks in a smooth, balanced way so your frog can keep leaping to greater heights. Grabbing coins gives your frog a helpful boost to survive longer, and the game rewards you for settling into a steady rhythm.
Everything is presented in charming pixel art, and the whole adventure is built around careful jumps. Each well-timed hop brings your frog one step higher up the tower.
beach-defense-merge-tower: Beach Defense: Merge Tower is a seaside take on tower defense. Each run is about planning ahead, combining towers quickly, and lasting through as many waves as you can. You set towers on the board, then join two identical ones to form a sturdier version. New tower types appear as the waves advance, and the foes arriving grow harder to stop, so your setup needs regular rethinking.

Coins come from every enemy you defeat, and you can spend them on extra towers, upgrades, and bonuses between waves. Quick-buy tools help you act fast, while active powers unlock over time and sit on the bottom bar, ready for when enemies press too close. Mix different tower combinations, react to shifting pressure, and see how far your splash-filled defense can hold.
moon-clash-heroes: You begin as a rookie in the space forces and can build a career as a stealthy spy, eliminating enemies with a single shot from hiding. You can also take on the role of a towering Terminator whose mass destruction system lets you trample foes, a special forces soldier armed with a Tesla-style lightning gun, or a remote strike bot firing a photon weapon. Anything goes in the space squad.

Explore every nook of the abandoned lunar base, take in views of deep space, and defeat your rivals. Controls: WASD moves, SPACE jumps, G throws a grenade, C crouches, RMB aims, and TAB opens the score table. Command is counting on you, soldier.
superhero-fighting-game: Step into a world of superhero clashes where every move you make matters. You can train in kung fu, karate, and boxing as you work toward a reputation as a martial arts legend. The fights take place across colorful arenas, and every battle you win sharpens your abilities for the next one.

This title falls under the Action category and carries the Fighting tag, so combat sits at the heart of the experience. Your goal is to climb to the top and claim the champion title, with every clash helping you grow along the way.
city-pop-drive: Steer a pastel-coloured car through 1980s-style city pop scenery using just one thumb. The car speeds up on its own, so you only need to guide it left or right. Pass close to traffic to earn time bonuses and fill the Breeze meter. Once it is full, a Boost sends nearby cars flying aside. Reach each checkpoint before the timer runs out, and choose the scenic or express road at every fork.

Five maps await: Seaside, Midnight Expressway, Crossing City, Maple Pass and Snow Resort. Each has its own twist, and the music adapts to the route you take. Reaching a goal collects its record-sleeve cover, and there are 25 to find. Spend Miles on upgrades, cars and new maps. Tap to begin, steer with mouse drag, arrow keys or A and D, and press P to pause.
uncle-hit-punch-the-dummy: Uncle Hit: Punch the Dummy is a quick, relaxed action game where you vent frustration on dummies placed in all kinds of situations. Sharp reflexes and steady punches matter most, since each blow has to be strong enough to knock your target out.

You guide a floating arm wearing a boxing glove, aiming at every dummy and nearby object. Line up your swings and clear the scene to move on. Each level brings a new setup, such as a lone dummy on a bench, groups chatting, dancing with a rat, mimicking the Creation of Adam, typing at a computer, riding unicycles, or hauling a casket. Difficulty doesn't rise in a neat line, so some stages need more timing than others. Physics can send two or three dummies flying from one punch. There is no timer, no pressure, and no time limit. Click the screen to start punching.
car-racing: Car Racing puts you behind the wheel as you steer between other vehicles on tracks that keep getting faster. Your reflexes need to be sharp, since every crash is something you must avoid. If you make a mistake, you can start the level over and try again.
As you move on, the stages grow tougher, and you will need both speed and careful planning to get through them. You can also share your best achievements with friends, which adds to the fun.
cannon-balls: Your goal is to bring down buildings with a cannon, placing each shot so the structure collapses as efficiently as possible. Ammo is limited, so every shot matters. Later on, the cannon is pushed close to its limits, especially when the great bombs come into play.

On desktop, move the mouse to aim and click the left button to fire. On mobile, drag your finger or stylus to aim and tap once to shoot. Aim for weak spots like glass or foundation blocks. When TNT is present, hitting it sets off a chain reaction that clears several blocks at once. A bomb meter fills as you shoot shapes and earn points. Once it's full, tap the bomb icon to switch your cannonballs to bombs for a short time. You normally get three bombs per level, so save them for tough structures or large clusters.
people-blaster: Race down a track as a runner, picking up stickmen along the way. Each recruit you gather is transformed into a heavy-duty weapon, so your firepower grows as you go. Multipliers on the route boost your numbers, while dangerous city obstacles stand in your path and must be dodged. When the moment is right, unleash a stream of gunfire to blast through targets and push on toward the finish line.
Controls are simple: a mouse click or a tap is all it takes to play. Stay alert to the track ahead, gather as many allies as you can, and see how far you can get.
makeover-mayhem: Makeover Mayhem is a head-to-head cleaning contest with a soothing ASMR feel. You and a rival each try to restore five dirty objects to a gleaming finish, and the first to finish all five wins. Each object is cleaned in stages, and you wipe away the grime by dragging across the dirty surface to uncover the clean layer beneath.

The tools arrive one at a time, always in the same order: scraper, foam spray, scrub brush, then squeegee. When about 90% of the dirty area is cleared, the stage completes on its own and the next tool unlocks. The five items are a rug, a sneaker, a trophy, a teapot, and a watch. If the four-minute timer runs out first, the winner is whoever finished more items or made more overall progress.
swat-and-greens-vs-zombies: In this strategy title, you help defend humanity during a zombie apocalypse. You can play online and pick from more than 50 distinct guns while fending off an endless stream of undead attackers. Try several game modes, and aim for victory in player-versus-player clashes.

The core of the game is tower defense. You recruit and upgrade members of a SWAT squad along with plants, then send them against advancing zombie waves.
