Each soldier carries their own weapon, so position them carefully across the battlefield. Plants have a cooldown after each use, so time their powers wisely. Lose fewer units in each fight to earn a bigger reward when the level ends. To deploy a unit, hold down the left mouse button or touch the screen, then drag it onto the field.
usa-luxury-4x4-suv-offroad-driving-simul: You take the wheel of premium 4x4 SUVs, including Range-style models, G-Class and X-series vehicles, and head into muddy trails, rocky ground, rivers, snowy stretches and mountain paths. The physics account for suspension and how the wheels grip and slide across the terrain. High-definition visuals, shifting weather from rain and fog to sunshine, and a day cycle running from sunrise to midnight complete the scene.

Pick from Free Roam, Time Trial or Obstacle Challenges to test your skills. Steer by tilting your device, using a steering wheel or touch controls. Accelerate and brake for precise speed, switch on 4x4 mode for extra grip on m
grass-land: Grassland is an exploration game set in a green, thick meadow. With your grass cutter, you slice through the tall growth to reveal wood, coal, and other valuable items buried below. The materials you collect help you grow a small base into a larger settlement with markets, workshops, and storage rooms, all arranged to suit your own style.

Upgrades let you boost your cutter's power, speed, and fuel tank, and advanced gear makes cutting and searching more efficient. Resources also unlock new upgrades along the way. Wander farther to find hidden treasures and unusual places. The cutting feels satisfying, and the landscape looks rich and detailed. On desktop, use the arrow keys to move; on mobile, drag the on-screen joystick in any direction.
buggz-pop: Step into this bright bubble shooter puzzle adventure, where cheerful bugs with lots of character fill every bubble. Your job is to line up your shots, match colors, and pop the bugs to finish each tricky stage. Insects with lively faces, playful artwork, and strong boosters make every level feel lively. Plan each shot to keep the popping going.

Match three or more bubbles of one color to pop them and reach each level's goal. Swap the loaded bubble with the next one to get the color you need. Desktop: click the board to aim and shoot, and click the next bubble to swap. Mobile: hold the loaded bubble, drag backward to aim, release to shoot, and tap the next bubble to swap.
merch-rush: Begin with a modest clothing shop and grow it into the largest mall in town. Drag anywhere on the screen, or use WASD or the arrow keys, to walk around. Carry boxes from the stock room to the shelves, then walk over the cash customers leave at the checkout to collect it. Buy tiles let you hire cashiers, stockers, and a manager, and a visit to the manager's office upgrades your staff to work faster.

Eight store types are available: Clothes, Food, Sports, Toys, Jewelry, Furniture, Cars, and Luxury. A parking lot, a bus stop, and side entrances bring in more shoppers. Every two minutes Rush Hour fills the mall, so keep the shelves stocked or people will leave without buying. It is easy to play with one finger, progress saves automatically, and there is no end point.
burrow-balls: Point your drill cannon and watch glass marbles tumble down into the ground. They ricochet off stone, split it apart, and turn every fragment into gems. Strike a shiny gem vein for seven times the reward, and crack open glowing relics to uncover stickers. Spend gems in the Workshop on quicker firing, heavier balls, blast and acid types, double barrels, and other gear. Fresh upgrades appear as you tunnel through each of the six worlds.

Once the rock becomes too stubborn, Rebirth wipes your run and hands you fossils that permanently boost marble power. Thirty hand-painted biomes stretch from the Garden down to the Heart of the World, 2.4 km below the surface, and each one you reach becomes your new starting point. Collect 90 stickers in the album, chase missions and achievements, and claim the Daily Dig streak chest. Your progress is saved. Drag or move the mouse to aim, or use touch, let marbles fire while fuel lasts, and press Esc or P to pause.
merge-a-rocket: Merge a Rocket! is a puzzle game where you defend your city by building bigger rockets. Pick up a rocket, carry it to another of the same level, and combine them into a stronger one. Press Launch to fire a rocket at the enemy base before it destroys your town, or Drop to set it down. Coins you collect can be spent on upgrades that improve your rockets and let you carry more of them. Raise your shield when the enemy attacks, and use Rebirth to reset your progress for bigger in-game bonuses.

On a computer, move with WASD or the arrow keys, look around with the mouse, press Space to jump, and hold Shift to sprint. On a phone or tablet, use the on-screen joystick to move, swipe the screen to look around, and tap the Jump button. The on-screen buttons also cover Launch, Drop, Shield, Upgrades, Shop, Rebirth and the sound toggle.
obby-upgrade-your-lucky-machine: Skip the plain slot machines. Here you build your own lucky machine by adding reels, speeding up spins, and stacking multipliers and bonuses so every spin hits harder. You act as its creator. Upgrade spin speed from slow to lightning fast, grow the reel count from 1 up to 20, and earn symbol bonuses of 1 to 5 coins.

Test your build against a bot in battles to see who collects more winnings. The winner takes everything from both machines, and the loser gets nothing. Earn coins to buy upgrades and power up your machine. It suits fans of idle progression, system upgrades
heart-box: Professor Rat, a fan of physics puzzles and robots, built a little machine named Robby. Because the professor gave him a weak battery, Robby constantly needs to recharge and keeps getting pulled into wild experiments. Your job is to nudge the physical objects around him so he can make his way through every one of the professor's puzzle rooms and get free of his charger.

On a computer, use the left mouse button. On a mobile device, use your finger. Either way, you can pop, destroy or move objects to clear a path. To finish a level, place the square robot Robby in the red charging station. The game offers more than 180 levels, an online Community Levels database with over 10,000 player creations, and a Level Editor for building your own puzzles, plus a collection of QR levels. You can also choose from several robot skins, pick one of four game modes, and enjoy realistic physics, lots of cartoon touches, leaderboards and achievements.
numbers-match-2448: Numbers Match 2448 is a calm puzzle game where you pair up tiles of equal value and fuse them into larger figures. Every move gives you a chance to build longer runs, so it pays to think ahead about where each block should land. Your job is to reach the goal set for each stage before the grid runs out of room. It is easy to pick up, yet it has enough depth for anyone who enjoys number games, merge puzzles, or 2048-style challenges.

On a computer, click to select a block, hold, and drag it into place. On mobile, touch the screen and slide your finger to move and set down pieces. When you get stuck, tap a booster icon, such as swap, shuffle, or bomb, as soon as it becomes available. Complete the task to advance to the next level and keep building bigger numbers.
clean-up-mini-games: Clean Up Mini Games invites you into a gentle, cozy setting where everything has a home. The collection offers small puzzles in which you sort, tidy, pack, arrange, and organize various objects. It makes a calm change of pace from daily routines. Levels revolve around everyday tasks: straightening cosmetics, placing furniture, preparing food, packing belongings, and restoring cluttered rooms to order.

Soft graphics and gentle ASMR sounds keep the mood peaceful as you play. New levels arrive every week, so there is always more to try and new ways to sharpen your organizing skills. Controls are straightforward for players of any age: tap, hold
my-gym-manager-idle-tycoon: Run your own gym in My Gym Manager: Idle Tycoon, a 3D management game where you help members reach their fitness goals. Check newcomers in at reception, send them to treadmills, dumbbells, or yoga mats, and collect the cash piles that grow as they finish. Sweep up litter yourself or hire cleaners to keep the floor spotless. Watch member moods too: impatient people grow angry if they wait, while happy members pay extra and high-paying VIPs are worth keeping an eye out for.

Hire personal trainers to assist members, repair broken machines, and restock locker rooms and protein drinks. Spend your earnings to speed up workouts, enlarge locker rooms, and unlock advanced equipment. Stand on purchase pads to open new areas, such as heavy weightlifting beds and sauna spaces, as they react to each cash deposit
idle-magic-academy-tycoon: In this idle management game, you oversee a growing school of sorcery and help it become a renowned center of magic. You design classrooms, recruit skilled Magisters, and gather artifacts that shape every lesson. As headmaster, you lead students from basic theory to advanced combat spells while collecting Arcanum Spheres and researching magical technologies. The polished, beautiful look is paired with daily quests, tasks, and
grave-blast: Grave Blast is a 3D twin-stick survival shooter with a spooky Halloween theme. Zombies keep coming in endless waves, and they are built from simple blocky voxel shapes. You'll move through eerie spots dotted with pumpkins, tombstones, moonlight, and a creepy mood, racing around and firing in every direction. The goal is to last as long as you can while blasting enemies into chunky red pieces.

Controls stay simple. On a computer, use WASD or the arrow keys to move, aim with the mouse, and left-click to shoot. On mobile, use the left virtual joystick to move and tap and hold the right button to fire. The game is built for quick arcade action, and its colorful low-poly style keeps the zombie carnage bright.
bubble-crash: Bubble Crash brings a spooky Halloween twist to the shooting genre. It is a straightforward matching puzzle where you launch bubbles at the board and try to line up at least three of the same color. Once you make a matching group, those bubbles are cleared away, and your goal is to rack up as many points as you can.

Everything is played with a single left mouse click, so there is nothing complicated to learn before you start. Each shot adds to your score, and the main challenge is to reach a higher total than your previous best. Pick your moments carefully, keep an eye on the colors, and see how far your score can climb.
slime-heroes: Slime Heroes is a fast, top-down survival arcade game for one to four players. You choose a slime hero, defeat waves of enemies, and gather experience. Picking upgrade cards lets you assemble strong builds, and each run brings new ability combinations. Artifact chests show up along the way, and the foes get tougher as you go.

You can go it alone or team up with friends in online co-op, and see how long you can last. On desktop, move with WASD or the arrow keys, press Space to dash, and Esc to pause. Attacks aim automatically by default. Shift switches between auto-aim and manual aiming, left-click aims at the cursor, and right-click returns to auto-aim. Number keys 1 to 4 trigger manual abilities. On mobile, play in landscape: the left joystick moves your hero, the dash button dashes, dragging on the right side aims, and on-screen buttons fire manual abilities.
limited-defense: Limited Defense is a tower defense game where you place your own forces to hold back enemy attacks. You can recruit bandits, archers, and explosive towers to stop waves of slimes and orcs, along with bosses. As the battles go on, you can upgrade your defenses and unlock legendary heroes to add to your lineup.

To set up your army, drag a character onto the designated spot. Tap any character to open its sub menu, where you can upgrade it or sell it. Each decision affects how well you hold your ground, so the game puts your strategy to the test.
prison-ball: You play a prisoner armed with only a heavy iron ball on a chain while guards close in. Once it starts spinning, the ball keeps moving on its own and clears everything in its path. Steer with one finger on a phone, or hold the left mouse button and drag. On a keyboard, use WASD or the arrow keys. Chain knockouts together for combos and huge blasts.

Breaking out takes you through many different prisons, from a city lockup to a space station. Each one has its own traps and a boss waiting at the end. Collect coins as you run for the exit. In the arena, join duels or a free-for-all, earn cups, climb the leagues, and check the leaderboard. Collect new balls and outfits, upgrade your hero, swap balls between levels, claim daily rewards, and grow your gem savings in the piggy bank.
annoying-cousins-punch-game: Family get-togethers are usually pleasant, but when your cousins turn up in full pester mode, you can settle things in this quick, cartoonish arcade brawl. You face a line of mischievous, goofy relatives in punchy, tap-driven rounds. Timing matters: tap at just the right instant to send each cousin flying, and swipe to dodge their cheeky attacks before they land.

Every stage you clear unlocks tougher, sillier cousin battles, and the cousins grow faster, louder, and wilder as you progress. Expect over-the-top animations, playful reactions, and comical sound effects throughout. The controls stay simple, so short sessions are easy to enjoy, and the game works offline. It runs well on Fire tablets and Fire TV. Ride out the mayhem and see if you can earn the title of family boss.
the-upside-down: Set in December 1984, this tactical RPG blends strategy with an 80s feel. As winter solstice nears, a tear opens over Black Hollow and shadowy Gloom-Walkers begin prowling. While the town is evacuating, young Eddie Sinclair heads alone into the snowy ghost town to rescue his best friend, Buddy, a dog.

Explore the streets for upgrades, then head home to save and level up. Danger rises the farther you roam, so keep an eye on your Gloometer. You have four ways to fight: a boombox keeps shadows rooted in place, a camera flash blinds them, and fireworks blast Gloom-Walkers into oblivion. Home sits in the top-left corner, where you upgrade stats and drink potions to heal. The final showdown waits in the bottom-right corner, so avoid wandering too far until you are strong enough.
extreme-formula-racing: Take the wheel of a powerful formula car and speed down endless tracks crowded with rival racers. Passing other cars takes sharp reflexes and careful timing, and every new run asks you to push your handling a little further. Quick reactions and steady precision are what win races here.

Collect coins as you go to unlock new formula cars and explore varied scenery. The aim is simple: go as fast as you can, beat your best score, and become the fastest racer on the track. Controls feel smooth. Use the arrow keys or WASD to accelerate, brake and steer, and weave around obstacles on each map.
space-craft-ship-war: Pilot a cube-shaped ship through deep space, adding modules to expand it without limit. Along the map, you can gather new decks, close-combat and long-range weapons, boosters, and rare upgrades, slowly turning your vessel into a full battle station. The enemies grow stronger too, so every clash becomes a fight to stay alive.

Finish levels to boost your stats, unlock new skins, and test out different builds. Bright 3D visuals and plenty of effects fill the screen, while steady progression keeps each run moving forward. On PC, steer with the WASD keys. On mobile, swipe to move. Your goal is to destroy enemy ships by collecting modules, upgrading your craft, and outlasting everyone else.
shape-transform: Shape Transform is a 3D racing game where you change form to suit the road ahead. Tap once to switch between a car, a boat, and a plane, then match your vehicle to the land, water, or sky you are crossing. Quick reflexes and good timing matter as much as speed, since you must dodge obstacles and get past rivals to take the lead.

Every race can look different, because the tracks change each time you play. Sessions can be short or stretch into long runs, and the controls stay simple enough for anyone to pick up. Finish in first place to open new tracks and challenges. The 3D visuals add to the fun, and the gameplay is fast and smooth.
schoolboy-escape-from-parents: In this stealth adventure, your goal is to slip out of the house without your parents spotting you. You wander through rooms, gather objects, and work out how to use them to open new routes and crack puzzles. Ten separate endings can be reached, and each one depends on sharp thinking, careful watching, and planning ahead. There is no plot to follow. The aim is simply to get out unnoticed by distracting, hiding, and combining what you find. It is similar to the well-known game How to Annoy Your Neighbor.
roots-and-wheels: In Roots and Wheels, you take the wheel of a powerful military Ural and haul as many crates as possible across dangerous, unpredictable terrain to your destination. Success depends on skill, meaning how well you feel the vehicle and react to the road, and on wits, meaning how well you find solutions when facing mud, steep climbs, or destroyed bridges. Every box you deliver brings your reward closer.

Money earned from completed trips lets you upgrade the engine, suspension, and wheels, or buy new vehicle models that open up new types of missions and cargo. Controls are simple on any device. On a phone, touch the right pedal to go forward and the left pedal to reverse. On a computer, press D to drive forward and A to go backward.
love-archer-hero: Love Archer Hero is a shooting game about spreading romance. You play a cheerful, sneaky Cupid who uses a bow and magic love arrows to bring creatures together and form couples. Puzzles are part of the fun, and you choose which creature to aim at. Once an arrow strikes, that creature drops into a lovely garden and gets swept up in a spell of affection.

Your goal is to make two characters fall for each other, which might mean hitting one of them or both. Pull back with your finger on a phone or your mouse on a computer, then let go to fire. A dashed line shows where your shot will travel. Watch out for glass panels, ropes, and wooden planks, since these can be used to steer your arrows toward the right targets. Finish a level to open the next one, and each stage brings its own challenges and cast of characters.
neo-traffic-rider-championship: Hop onto a sportbike and face seven rivals across six locations, from coastal highways and rolling hills to busy city expressways and snowy mountain roads. You can enter 18 championship events, attempt Rider Trials, and upgrade your bike's engine and tyres. Timing is key: pick a clean line through the bends, draft behind rivals to build a slingshot, and fire your boost at the right moment. Photorealistic artwork and recorded sportbike sounds make the winding roads feel convincing.

If you want more open riding, Unlimited Run is available on any track. Traffic keeps getting denser, you complete rotating contracts, refill your boost, and try to beat your own distance record. Steer with A and D or the Left and Right arrows, and press W or Up to accelerate when Auto Throttle is off. Use S or Down to brake and Space or Shift to activate boost. Esc or P pauses and resumes the game, and on mobile you can use the on-screen controls.
paint-the-keyboard: You take charge of a keyboard and turn it into your own painting ground. Run across the keys, roll paint over them, and collect money for every press. Spend that cash on new colors, a faster stride, a wider roller, and a bigger paint supply. Open fresh sections of the board, and hire workers who will press keys alongside you.

When one round of growth ends, another begins, with fresh additions along the way. You can also find artists who paint on their own. Your small patch grows into a large, colorful keyboard workshop. On a computer, use WASD to move, hold the right mouse button and drag to turn the camera, and scroll the wheel to zoom. On a phone, use the joystick to move, swipe to rotate, and pinch two fingers to zoom. Visit the paint tank whenever your roller needs refilling.
escape-from-school-3d: You are trapped inside a wild, blocky high school and must break out. Push past angry teachers, bullies, principals, and headmasters to reach freedom. Anything you can grab becomes a weapon, from baseball bats and bricks to slingshots, so you must survive the mayhem while you plan your daring getaway.

The cartoonish graphics and smooth controls keep things moving through classrooms, hallways, gyms, and rooftops. Expect fast, addictive action with survival challenges along the way. On PC, WASD moves your character and the left mouse button uses your weapon. On mobile, a virtual joystick handles movement. Find the elevator on each level to pass through it, and collect money to purchase new escape heroes. It is easy to pick up and suits players of all ages.
never-by-color: A Japanese room has been buried under a heap of colorful pieces, and your job is to restore its peace. Tap the pile to scoop a handful onto your tray, or simply wait, since the tray fills by itself. Tap pieces that share a shape to select them, and several identical ones can be chosen at once. Then tap the matching box and they fly in. Sorting in a row with no mistakes builds a combo.

The one unbreakable rule is to group by shape rather than color, so cubes go with cubes and plates go with plates. The red trap box must stay empty. There are no timers and no way to lose, so you can take your time. Clear the entire pile and you earn a new model for your collection.
realistic-tanks-poopy-war: You command a tank in an offline campaign where rockets rain down on a fleet of enemy armor. Build your machine from a broad selection of weapons and tank models, then personalize it with a range of camouflage patterns. The pixel-style shooter runs without an internet connection, so you can keep fighting offline. Mines and crafts must be completed across every level and objective.

You take on the role of a tank commander piloting a custom war machine, shaping your strategy around recent upgrades, mastered talents, and gained experience. Each upgrade makes your metal beast stronger and more destructive against foes. Varied stages and mazes let you test different tactics to see what works for each set of objectives. Swarms of enemy tanks are always present, and you can tackle the campaign whenever you like. There are no energy or other limits. Logging in often increases the bonus resources you earn for each battle. Controls: Tab opens the menu, WASD drives, the mouse aims and fires, and the scroll wheel zooms the camera.
flippee-ball: Flippee Ball mixes pinball and basketball into one arcade game. Your goal is to flip the flippers so the ball lands in the basket. You can play against the computer or a friend sharing the same device. You control one set of flippers, either red or blue, and a single button flips all five at once.
The default settings use Amateur speed, the Easy computer opponent, and Aim Assist, which helps your shots land more accurately. Once you
cannon-ball-3d-big-boom-obby: Cannon Ball 3D: Big Boom Obby is a physics puzzle shooter with 100 hand-built stages. You aim a strong cannon and fire heavy cannonballs at towers, stacks, and blocky structures. The task is to push every block off the golden base plate before you run out of shots. Each level asks you to weigh angle, force, timing, and momentum. Some can be solved by sheer power, while others call for clever ricochets, chain reactions, and accurate hits on weak spots.

Later stages grow more complicated, with sturdier builds, awkward angles, and fewer chances to slip up. The controls are easy to pick up: tap anywhere on the screen to fire toward that point, and each cannonball follows real physics. Using fewer shots earns you more stars. Every shot counts, and the goal is to clear all 100 stages.
brain-line-connect: Brain Line Connect is a straightforward yet tricky logic puzzle. Your job is to sketch a single unbroken line through every dot on the board. At first the task seems simple, but the stages reward planning several moves ahead, especially when barrier lines get in the way. Begin a stage, study the layout, then press your finger onto a dot and drag it across the board without ever lifting it.

There is no clock, so you can take your time and play whenever suits you. The visuals are clean and uncluttered, and the game offers a large set of stages designed to sharpen concentration and reasoning. If your path crosses an obstacle line, that attempt counts as a miss. Once every dot is linked correctly, the stage is cleared and the next puzzle opens.
money-empire: Money Empire blends strategy with clicking and classic board play. You roll dice, hop across a game board, and gradually climb toward riches. Along the way you can open new businesses, put money into income that keeps arriving without effort, and improve the companies you already own. Rivals are also chasing the title of top entrepreneur, so every decision counts.
Several tools help you expand: casinos, stock markets, banks, upscale property, and company shares. Stop on a bank, casino, stock exchange, or headquarters tile to strengthen your hol
fishtopia: Swim through an undersea world full of bright fish and friendly pets in this adventure-style puzzler. Your goal is to match and gather items so you can clear each stage, rescue charming fish, and open new aquariums to decorate. Along the way, you can discover treasure hidden beneath the waves, and daily events, challenges, and bonuses give you fresh reasons to return.

Controls are simple: swap, click, and match items with your mouse or a touch screen. Plan each move carefully, save your power-ups for tougher moments, and aim for high scores to earn rewards. The game offers hundreds of levels that grow harder over time, along with fish and pets to collect and look after. It is easy to pick up for puzzle fans and casual players, yet it can be tough to stop playing.
transport-run: Transport Run is a 3D arcade runner about slipping through heavy traffic. You steer a colorful vehicle along winding highways lined with pink trees, while several lanes of cars and buses rush toward you. The aim is to reach the goal without a single crash, which depends on careful timing and precise driving. Its relaxed yet tense endless pace comes wrapped in isometric cartoon graphics and lively environments.

Your score grows with the distance you cover, and careful stops let you upgrade your car for better performance. Upgrades come easily through skilled play, so each run feels smoother and more satisfying. On PC, use the mouse or arrow keys to steer between lanes, and hold the mouse button or space to speed up, releasing to brake. On mobile, tap and hold to drive forward, release to stop, and swipe left or right to switch lanes.
garden-snakes: Garden Snakes is a calm logic puzzler set in a bright garden. Your job is to guide charming snakes so their heads pass over every open cell on the board. Obstacles and special tiles make each stage a fresh challenge, and new mechanics appear as you advance through 115 levels that were built by hand.

Steer with a mouse or by touch, sliding a snake's head across the empty spaces. A level is cleared only when the board is full and each snake has used all of its remaining moves. Undo takes back a move, Restart lets you try a stage again, and Hint offers a gentle push when you're stuck. You can pick between flat 2D visuals or a soft clay 3D look, and the pause menu holds your sound, language, and visual settings.
monster-tile-party: Monster Tile Party is a gentle puzzle game for all ages, built around matching triples. Pick uncovered tiles from the layered board to send them into the tray. Whenever three identical monster tiles land there, they vanish on their own. Your goal is to clear every tile from each level, but the round ends if the tray fills first.

Colorful original monsters, lively match effects, and helpful boosters such as Undo, Shuffle, and Extra Slot are there when a level becomes difficult. Daily rewards and a level map that keeps growing give you more to explore. On a computer, move the pointer and click with the left mouse button. On a phone or tablet, tap with one finger. No keyboard is needed.
rpg-idle-clicker: In this incremental game, you set off on a journey to defeat monsters. Clicking deals damage and gathers gold, which you can spend to unlock stronger swords that boost your strikes. You can improve your blades over time and hire heroes who attack foes automatically each second, continuing to fight even while you are offline.

Visuals are rendered with WebGL, and foes grow tougher as you advance, with bosses waiting along the way. You can play actively or lean on idle progress, and the game keeps growing without a limit. To eliminate an enemy, tap it directly. On-screen buttons let you raise sword levels, upgrade heroes, equip items, and access other features. It runs in your browser.
space-break: Space Break is a casual pixel space shooter with good-looking graphics and many locations to explore. You fight alien invaders, choose your ship, and upgrade it as you move through different galaxies. Each level brings randomly generated waves of enemies and ends with a boss battle. The levels never finish, so you can keep playing for as long as you like, and the unique ship skins add some variety. It makes a relaxed way to pass time, but it can be quite addictive.

Steering is simple. On a phone, slide one finger from side to side. On a PC, hold down the left mouse button and move to pilot the ship. Points build up as you play, and the farther you get, the higher your record climbs.
wild-camp: Wild Camp is a survival camp builder with a story at its heart. One night, the Alpha Wolf and its pack carry your villagers off into the mist, and only you and a kind witch manage to get away. Your task is to set up a camp in a forest clearing, tend the flames each night, and call more villagers to join you.

Move with the mouse, WASD, or the arrow keys, or drag anywhere on a phone. Walk up to trees and rocks to gather, and stand on a building spot to construct. Your spear strikes nearby animals on its own, so step aside whenever a wolf crouches. Feed the witch, then stand in her circle after dark to summon villagers, and press Follow to bring them along. Grow strong enough to defeat the Alpha and bring your people home.
catch-a-fish: Leap off the pier and chase fish with nothing but your hands. You move through five ocean areas: a sunny bay, a coral reef, a kelp forest, the open sea, and the dark abyss. Stun fish, stuff them into your bag, and hurry back up before your air gives out. Run dry and you pass out, losing part of your catch.

Sell your haul at the market, then spend the money on better air, a bigger bag, and stronger tools. Harpoons and nets help with the hunt, and a boat takes you to a hidden island with rare fish. There are twenty species to find, including golden ones, and four boats to own. On desktop, WASD moves you, the mouse looks around, and number keys or the scroll wheel switch tools. On mobile, a stick moves you, dragging looks around, and on-screen buttons handle swimming and catching.
supermarket-manager: Run your own grocery store in this management game. You start with bare shelves, so you must stock them by hand. Serving shoppers brings in cash, which you can spend on helpers such as stock workers and cashiers. Raising the quality of your goods builds your store's reputation. Later, pricier shelves let you carry a wider selection, and each customer you serve earns more. Your goal is to grow a store that matches your vision.

On a computer, use the left mouse button or the WASD keys to move. On a phone, press a finger to the screen and drag it toward the direction you want to go. Stand on the marked areas to buy shelves or registers. Collect products from the warehouse, then carry them to the matching shelf. The computer in the warehouse opens the management menu, where you can upgrade product quality or hire staff.
bubble-shooter-mega: In this arcade puzzler, you pop clusters of red, yellow, and blue bubbles set against a dark background. Each shot comes from a pair of upcoming bubbles shown to you, and you have 16 shots left to work with. Matching three or more colors pops them, and the chain reactions you trigger can clear the walls that are closing in on you.

Your goals include reaching a trophy score of 1100, collecting gems and stars (shown as 1/3), and using boosters to get through the levels. Aiming is simple. On desktop, drag the mouse to aim along the trajectory line, then click or release to fire. On mobile, drag your finger to aim and tap or lift to shoot.
supercar-battle-arena: Step into a 3D arena where bumper-style battles pit modified cars against each other. Your goal is to be the last car still running by destroying every rival. You can ram opponents at high speed to push them off the map, or launch rockets to blow them apart. Each match rewards coins, which you can spend in the garage on much stronger battle cars.

The driving feels smooth, but the combat is explosive, and jumping and mid-air dashing add extra options. On PC, steer with WASD or the arrow keys, jump with W or Up Arrow, fire with Spacebar, and double-tap the jump key to dash or fly. On mobile, use the virtual joystick to steer, single-tap the screen to jump, tap the fire icon for rockets, and double-tap quickly to dash or fly.
obby-saves-brainrots-from-tsunami: Obby Saves Brainrots from Tsunami blends a tsunami runner, an idle game, and an idle tycoon into one fast escape. You sprint, leap over hazards, and dodge giant waves while a massive flood closes in. Expect classic tsunami obby action that rewards quick reflexes, along with long-term progress, idle systems, and satisfying upgrades.

Brainrots are the core resource. Collect them during your runs, turn them into cash, and watch your empire grow. Craft them and chase the rarest finds as you build. On a computer, use WASD to move, E to interact with objects, G to throw a brain rot, and F to toggle the cursor. On mobile, the on-screen UI handles all the controls.
sugar-blast-snowy-pop: Snowy Pop is a candy-matching puzzle with 125 colorful levels. Tap groups of matching candies arranged horizontally, vertically, or diagonally to blast them away and earn points. Some candies hide bombs that cost one life each, and when your lives reach zero, the game ends, so think ahead with every move.

The upgrade menu lets you boost your tap rewards, raise your starting lives, or purchase candy bombs. A bomb clears every candy on the screen, grants their points, and lowers the number needed to win the level. If you have not cleared enough, new candies drop in until you claim victory. Difficulty climbs as you progress, nine achievements are waiting, and the game supports eight languages: English, Russian, French, Turkish, Spanish, German, Italian, and Portuguese.
obby-click-and-grow: Obby: Click and Grow is a 3D clicker where you grow your blocky character one tap at a time. Between clicks, take on tricky parkour trials, unlock achievements, and earn rewards. Obby pets boost your size with every click, and the rebirth system doubles your trophies while speeding up growth. New blocky locations bring unique challenges.

Compete with friends on the leaderboard and claim free daily gifts and bonuses. Dynamic platformer-style parkour, bright blocky graphics, and regular updates and events keep things fresh. On computers, use WASD to move and Space to jump. On mobile, steer with the joystick, jump with the button in the lower right corner, and swipe the screen to rotate the camera
city-pilot-plane-parking-jam: Set at a busy airport, this puzzle game puts you in charge of a crowded ground area full of parked and moving aircraft. Planes keep landing, rolling along taxiways, and taking off, so paths quickly get blocked. Your job is to untangle the traffic, guide each plane safely, and restore order to the runway. Cargo jets and many other aircraft types share the space with buildings, fences, and airport equipment.

You tap and drag an airplane to move it out of the jam, finding a route that avoids other aircraft and obstacles. Free the planes one at a time and plan each move like a traffic controller. Smooth controls, relaxing sounds, and clean visuals keep things calm. Finishing levels unlocks new puzzles and harder jams, with more planes, bigger jets, and tighter spots. It works offline, so you can play anytime.
wildkin-isles: Explore Wildkin Isles, a bright voxel world, and gather materials by hitting trees and rocks. You can carry up to five items at once, but heavy loads slow you down. Stand in the marked circles to deposit materials or craft sturdier axes once you meet the requirements. Rescue stranded specialists and escort them to camp, where each one brings a useful skill, from gathering to unlocking upgrades.

Night brings tougher monsters, and Cloudstep's tricky platforms test your timing. Every monster hit removes the materials you carry. If you lose all your hearts, you return to camp but lose some resources and weapons. Defeat the island guardian, bring your whole crew home, and reach the finish arch to earn
battle-of-banners: Battle of Banners is a turn-based medieval strategy game played on a hexagonal battlefield. You lead a group of knights, seize land, set up camps, and bend the front line one turn at a time. Each choice carries weight: when to push forward, which tile to hold, which enemy to drive back, and whether to lay an ambush by the forest or at a crossing. Victory goes to the player who spreads out faster than rivals and wipes out their forces.

You can play locally on one device with friends, train against bots, or head online for duels and multiplayer matches. Maps with different terrain shift the tactics, and each match stays lively and fair, with nothing but you, your opponent, and your decisions shaping the outcome.
pool-flow: Pool Flow is a colorful physics puzzler where every slice matters. You cut sections from a pool full of water so the liquid spills into the bucket below, all while keeping the playful sea creatures safe. Moving hazards add pressure, so timing your cuts is just as important as where you make them. Freeze, Puller, and Fish Net boosters can help you through 300 levels.

On desktop, hold the left mouse button, drag a straight line across the pool, and release to cut. On mobile, touch the screen, drag across the pool, and lift your finger to cut. Fill the bucket to 100% before the timer runs out, earn stars and coins, and unlock later levels. Boosters are optional, and on-screen buttons handle boosters, settings, and pause. Escape opens or closes the pause menu during play. Both portrait and landscape modes are supported.
rat-s-house-nonogram: Decorate a cozy tower full of stories, where fourteen residents with touching backgrounds move in. There's a shy book lover, a bold rocker, and even an alien guest, and each one hopes for a perfect corner. Rather than simply placing furniture, you get to know them. They assign tasks, request specific items, and share their thoughts in funny dialogues. Completing their requests unfolds the plot and opens new floors.

Cheese, earned by solving Japanese crosswords called nonograms, pays for furniture and decor from the shop, and the puzzles give your brain a solid workout. With more than 500 levels of varying difficulty, you fill cells by following number clues to reveal a hidden picture. Click or tap to paint, mark empty spots with an X, and press Spacebar to switch between painting and marking modes. Three mistakes cost a life, though hints are always available, and bright seasonal events add extra fun.
happy-fluffy-cubes: Happy Fluffy Cubes is a bright 3D arcade runner starring cute cube heroes. You steer your Fluffy through levels packed with fire, ice, lasers and whirling saws. Control takes one touch: hold the screen and slide your finger up or down. Hit a hazard or lift your finger, and the run ends.

Coins collected mid-flight can be spent on chests, which may contain eggs that hatch into new Fluffies. Each one has its own style, and rarities range from common to rare and hilarious. Upgrading the incubator makes hatching faster. In the main menu, a friendly drone guards the incubator, reacts to your actions, and can be recolored to match your taste. Fun music and colorful 3D visuals complete the cheerful, relaxed feel, which suits kids and casual players alike.
eggmental: Eggmental is a pixel-art defense game built around hatching and collecting. You use your spark pointer to strike eggs and bring out Motes, small elemental creatures that fight without your direct control. Your job is to keep the Prism Core safe from the Blight until each day ends. Between days, you spend Insight on the Lattice, a tree of over 300 nodes, and use it to buy eggs and charms or fill your Field Guide.

The game includes 36 Motes across seven elements, 57 charms, and 20 spells. Each chapter finishes with a Blight Heart, and once you clear them all, you can ascend and start over with new powers. Progress saves automatically. With a mouse, you move the pointer to strike and crack eggs, Space shows the stats of creatures under the pointer, P or Esc pauses, and holding R gives up the current try. On touch screens, drag a finger over the field or tap AUTO to let the pointer sweep on its own.
only-up-or-lava: Only Up Or Lava is a single-player adventure where you work your way through a series of levels packed with perilous obstacles. Hazards block your path, and you must keep away from the scorching lava. Each level calls for careful timing and accurate leaps, and the challenges grow harder as you advance, so you will need both bravery and determination to get through.

The controls are easy to pick up. Use W, A, S, and D to move, press Space to jump and climb, and hold Shift to walk or drop down to a ledge. Press R to open the pause and game menu, and tap Esc to bring your cursor back. Every move you make decides whether you reach the top or are caught by the lava.
dop-puzzle-displace-one-part: DOP Puzzle: Displace One Part invites you to test your IQ with a DOP game built around brain teasers. Each level unfolds as a silly little story, drawn in a bright cartoon style with lively motion. The game feels simple overall, yet several puzzles are genuinely tricky, so you'll need to think before you find the answer.

Your job is to drag the items you're given onto the picture and work out where they belong. Three parts must land in the correct spots and in the correct order. You don't have to use every item offered, so some may turn out to be unnecessary. On a phone, slide your finger across the screen; on a computer, swipe the cursor to shift one piece at a time. With more than 50 puzzles to work through, it's a pleasant way to get some brain training.
knife-vs-fruits: Knife vs Fruits Just Shoot It is a relaxed arcade title that puts you in the role of a wild, knife-throwing character. Your job is to take down the produce and sweets scattered around a kitchen. Launch your blades at targets sitting on the kitchen floor, and watch those spinning targets closely. Hit the
rune-reactor: In Rune Reactor, the runes you choose shape how your spells work, since each one changes your wizard's magic. You pick from elemental and modifier runes, then combine them into stronger spells. Your wizard attacks nearby foes on its own while the waves grow more dangerous. Gold and Arcane Dust drop during battle, but they disappear quickly, so grab them before they fade.

Between waves, you can spend gold on health, fresh runes, and upgrades. Mixing elemental runes with modifiers helps you uncover new spells, some of them rare. Defeating bosses and surviving as many waves as you can is the goal. After each run, Arcane Dust pays for permanent upgrades that carry into future attempts, and you can use the bonus wheel whenever it becomes available.
mine-block-breaker: This physics-based arcade game sends a sword-wielding hero flying into an arena full of breakable blocks and enemies. Drag to aim, release to launch, and bounce across the battlefield while your spinning blade does the fighting. Dashing at the right moment is part of the challenge.

Between runs, open chests, collect equipment, pick powerful buffs, and upgrade your hero to grow stronger for increasingly tough Arena waves. On desktop, hold the left mouse button on your hero, drag to aim, release to launch, and click the Dash button for a burst of speed. On mobile, touch and drag to aim, release to launch, and tap Dash. Buffs, equipment, and upgrades are chosen by clicking or tapping the on-screen buttons.
planet-404-episode-1: Planet 404, Episode 1 is a puzzle platformer that follows Alice, a fearless and inquisitive explorer who ends up stuck on a mysterious planet full of hidden secrets. Its strange, shadowy landscapes are packed with puzzles, and she must solve them to learn what lies beneath the surface. Each puzzle cracked or obstacle cleared moves her forward and unlocks a new chapter of her journey.

The game has bright, colorful artwork, and its music builds a mood of magic and mystery. On a computer, press D or the right arrow to run right, A or the left arrow to run left, and the space bar or up arrow to jump. On a phone or tablet, tap the right and left arrows at the bottom of the screen to run and the up arrow to jump. A fire icon button becomes available at a certain level and lets you shoot.
hill-ride-3d: Hill Ride 3D is a bright arcade racer built around realistic vehicle physics, where going fast is only part of the challenge. You need to stay balanced, time your landings well, and get through tough stretches packed with hills, ramps, bridges, steep drops, and awkward obstacles. Along the way you can pull off stunts, grab coins, and open up new options as you advance.

The game offers several characters, vehicles, and maps, each with its own mood, from grassy slopes and desert roads to snowy tracks and night routes. Coins can be spent on upgrades for your engine, suspension, grip, and fuel tank, or on bonuses that help with the harder runs. The deeper you travel, the quicker and riskier things get. Use W and S to accelerate or brake, A and D to tilt, N for nitro, and P to pause. Tilting helps you land smoothly and stay upright on steep or bumpy ground, and nitro is most useful when you pick the right moment to fire it.
moto-x3m-original: Moto X3M is a bike racing game with 25 levels to work through. You climb onto a motorbike, pull on a helmet, and head out onto rugged off-road tracks. Along the way you launch into the air to clear obstacles, all while racing against the clock.

Controls are simple: use the arrow keys to drive and keep your balance, and press the spacebar to respawn at your last checkpoint. Work through all 25 levels and try to beat the clock on every off-road circuit.
plop: Plop! Fruit Merge is a colorful HTML5 puzzle game where you drop fruit into a giant glass blender. Identical fruits fuse into larger ones, and there are 11 tiers to work through. Well-timed drops can set off chain reactions that boost your score, but you need to plan each placement so the blender does not overflow. The physics feel smooth, and the bigger the fruit gets, the tougher the puzzle becomes.

Three power-ups, Ice, Pepper, and Rainbow, help you handle crowded situations. Filling your BLEND meter lets you activate it to clear smaller fruit and open up space. Daily challenges and missions reward you with colorful fruit to collect and unlock different blender styles. You control everything with a mouse or touch screen, and your main aim is to beat your own high score.
ragdoll-rescue-physics-puzzle: In this funny physics puzzler, you rescue a clumsy ragdoll hero who has been knocked off a tall cliff by a sneaky villain. Your job is to build a rescue setup from mattresses, trampolines, booster springs, fans, ramps, and portals. Guide the hero's bounce so it avoids sharp spikes and other dangers, and bring them down safely with as much health left as possible.

Click or tap pieces in the palette to place them, then drag them anywhere in the arena. Use the rotate buttons or Q/E and A/D to turn an object, and remove items with the trash button, Delete, or Backspace. On PC, right-clicking deletes whatever is under the cursor, and the mouse wheel or a swipe scrolls the camera up and down. The number keys 1 to 9 pick palette items quickly, and Spacebar starts or resumes the physics.
paint-race: Paint Race is an online arcade game that tests how quick and accurate you can be. You move through bright circles while steering around dark barriers, and the adventure spans 50 levels.

You can play on a phone or a desktop computer, and the game is free. The controls are simple: click, tap, press the space bar, or hit W to jump. Each level mixes fast reactions with careful timing, offering a blend of fun and challenge.
find-a-legendary-needle: Step into a first-person farm sim set across a valley glowing in golden autumn light. A one-of-a-kind needle is buried deep within an enormous pile of hay, and your job is to dig it out. Gather straw by hand or pick up a rake, pitchfork, golden trident, or a loud Hay Vac. Haul your load to the Hay Press to turn it into coins.

Spend those coins in the workshop on the Seeker Compass, better gear, and larger backpacks, then follow its arrow to the spot where the needle sparkles through the straw. Along the way you can unearth shining
neon-billard-pool: Neon Billard Pool invites you to sit down for a round of pool with a friend. Players take turns, with one person on the yellow side and the other on the red side. It is a light, casual take on the table game, built around billiard-style play that will feel familiar to anyone who enjoys 8 ball pool.

The whole game runs on the mouse. You move the pointer to control the white ball and send it bouncing across the table to strike the balls. Each player gets one round at a time, so the back-and-forth stays friendly and easy to pick up. Grab a partner and enjoy a relaxed match together.
lorin-adventure: Lorin Adventure is an action RPG built around endless combos and the stories of its heroes. You set out to defeat the demon king Chaos and his three demons using combo attacks that are simple to learn yet lively to play. Forge and upgrade weapons at the blacksmith, and gather armor sets that boost your combat stats. Hunt down boss monsters to collect them, and discover artifacts that can dramatically change your journey.

Your champions grow stronger through continuous reinforcement and can be reincarnated along the way. Battles are fast-paced and seamless. On desktop, move with the Left and Right arrow keys or the A and D keys, or click the on-screen buttons. On mobile, tap the on-screen left and right buttons to move and attack.
ninja-platformer-rage: You control a ninja who moves with precise, careful steps through brutally short platform challenges. Throw your shadow to mark a spot, then teleport through danger to reach it. Climb walls, double-jump across gaps, and chase the quickest time on every stage. Across 50 levels, each layout tests your reflexes, timing, and patience.

On PC, move with A and D or the arrow keys, jump with Space, and press Shift to throw your shadow. Tap Shift twice to teleport to it. On mobile, use the left and right buttons to move, jump to hop, shadow to throw, and dash to teleport. Since failure comes quickly here, each retry is short, and every attempt teaches you something new.
unfamiliar-object: Unfamiliar Object puts you in first person during a night shift in an office where something is slightly wrong. Your job is to spot the single item that does not belong, read the rules, and wander a silent corridor. Ordinary office objects are twisted into something quietly impossible on each new shift.

Click to enter mouse look, then move with WASD or the Arrow Keys and turn your view with the mouse. Press Space to raise or lower the inspection camera, aim at the outlined object, and left-click to take a photo. Carry the evidence to the highlighted fax machine and left-click to submit it before time runs out. Reporting the wrong object, re-entering a photographed room, or ignoring the changing rules can cost you, so keep track of every new instruction.
bean-tower: Bean Tower is an arcade climber with no set finish. You run, jump, and bounce off walls to get as high as you can while the tower keeps scrolling upward behind you. Running faster lets you jump higher, and chaining jumps of two or more floors within 3 seconds builds combos that score big points. Every 100 floors the tower adds a new twist, from slippery ice to low gravity. Fall off the bottom of the screen and the run is over.
Pick a mode such as Classic, Daily Tower, Gh
fortress-of-the-sinister: Fortress of the Sinister is a 3D turn-based tactical strategy game. You guide a group of heroes across grid-based arenas as they defend a magical network from waves of foes. Enemy attacks are visible ahead of time, so you can plan each move carefully. Abilities can push enemies around and reposition them, and you collect artifacts during every run.

The journey spans four fortresses, each with its own enemies and obstacles, and each one has ten floors to conquer. Early on, your aim is to win fights with clever tactics and few losses. Over time, you recruit unique units, build a stronger team, and unlock new heroes and team combinations. The arenas vary from small 3x3 skirmishes to larger 7x7 clashes, and the final goal is endless survival.
bomb-royale-online: Bomb Royale Online brings a multiplayer battle royale inspired by classic bomber arcade games. Matches unfold in maze-like arenas full of traps, with fast-paced battles that test every decision. Your aim is to be the last player still standing. The characters are bears, and the PvP combat rewards good timing, smart positioning, and sharp tactics.

To play, move through the maze with your controls and drop bombs to blow up blocks and trap rivals. Open new paths, block escape routes, and eliminate opponents with well-timed explosions. Watch out for enemy blasts and chain reactions that can catch you off guard. Survive longer than everyone else to win the match and climb the leaderboard.
backslash-slash: Backslash Slash is a keyboard-first blade clicker where simple key presses replace tapping. Pressing /, \, P, or K strikes a human-shaped training dummy with knives, daggers, machetes, and other blades. Each key times its attack differently, so landing strikes in rhythm builds combo chains that multiply your damage and unlock special multi-hit moves.

As you level up, you gain access to new combos, weapons, and passive upgrades. Every blade has its own speed and combo patterns, so switching weapons changes how you play. You can also improve attack speed, combo window, crit chance, and weapon power. The focused, stylized visuals keep your attention on skill and progression. Whether you want quick rhythmic action or careful upgrade planning, the game rewards good key timing and steady growth.
wood-hexa-factory: Wood Hexa Factory! is a cozy matching puzzle set in a wooden factory, where you fill boxes with colorful hex pieces. Tap a color to send its pieces onto the conveyor belt and watch them fill the boxes. Simple to start but challenging to master, each level tests your strategy and puzzle-solving skills. Fill every box to advance.
There is no strict storyline, only a clear goal: sort the hexes into trays while managing your workspace. The graphics look appealing, the sound design is good, and finishing a task feels rewarding.
playmusic: PlayMusic turns your favorite songs into a living game world that reacts to every beat. Dodge obstacles, collect gems, and keep going as the rhythm grows more intense. You can run, jump, fly, drift, and shoot through surroundings that pulse with the sound. There is no storyline, just the music and your reflexes.

The collection holds many runners packed with licensed music, and the library is updated constantly. Each runner features one popular track and its own hero. Everything is open from the start, with no bosses, currencies, or purchases, and the difficulty adapts to the song and your skill. Leaderboards rank the points you earn by completing runner-songs. Controls use arrow keys, swipes, taps, the space bar, tilt, and holding to drift.
backyard-car-parking: Backyard Car Parking is about far more than squeezing into a tight spot. Its open world lets you explore on foot or behind the wheel, and its multiplayer mode brings in thousands of real people every day. You can race against them, trade cars with them, keep a friend list, and talk through voice chat. There is also a police mode.

Tune your ride by adjusting the suspension and wheel angle, swapping the engine, and fitting a new turbo, gearbox, or exhaust. You can also change how your car looks with dynamic vinyls and body parts. The world includes detailed surroundings, real gas stations, car services, and buildings you can step inside. Choose from 100 cars with real interiors and 16 player skins. Steer with the arrow keys.
knight-crown-idle: Knight Crown Idle is a pixel-art idle role-playing game where you keep taking on monsters and collecting gold and experience from each victory. You spend those rewards to sharpen your hero's stats and abilities, so the knight grows tougher as you go. New zones open as you advance, bringing fresh challenges to face. Along the way, you can also rescue trapped animals and earn achievements.

Controls are simple: just click or tap an enemy to defeat it. Enemies become more challenging as you move through the levels, so upgrading your hero regularly is important. The game works on mobile devices and desktop computers, runs straight in your web browser with nothing to install, and is free to play. If you want a bigger view, full screen mode is available.
sea-restore: A meteor smashed down and left a huge dry crater behind. Your task is to fill it with water and turn it into a living sea. Tap the pump to add water, then spend coins on a stronger pump, stations, and workers. Workers bring goods to collectors, who carry them to the store, while town buildings craft them into pricier items. Sell goods or fill truck orders for more coins.

Tap away trash to keep the water clear, and catch glowing eggs rising from the meteor to hatch 13 sea monsters, each with its own bonus. Fill the tide meter for a high tide with extra water. Your seaside town grows through seven ages, from the First Drops to the Ocean Age, and the sea keeps working while you are away. When it is full, start a new cycle and climb the leaderboard for all the water you have poured.
streamer-simulator-phone-challenge: Stream your way through this browser arcade game by flipping your phone to impress a crowd. You can attempt kick-flips and full 360° spins, then chain tricks into combos that add one like per trick. Watch the live chat to see your fans react in real time. Each trick earns likes, and the amount depends on how many viewers you have. Collected likes unlock phones, from vintage bricks to the latest foldables.

Good reflexes, agility, and rhythm will carry you far. To flick the phone, drag and hold the left mouse button or slide your finger across the screen. If you hit the phone without completing a combo, your combo counter resets. To change your name, tap the pencil icon next to your nickname on the in-game phone screen. Open the settings by selecting "Settings" or pulling down the panel. You can also battle friends for the crown of top hype master.
echo-rift: This pixel-art survival action game casts you as Echo, a small ninja. Kaede has been swept into a rift, and Echo must trail her across ten islands to bring her home. Your weapons fire automatically, so you focus on moving, dodging, and choosing a fresh power card at each level-up. Weapons can be evolved and merged into powerful supers.

Each island holds seven checkpoints, and every one has its own task, such as charging a shrine, herding lost echoes, riding a mine cart, or escaping a lava flow. Clear them all, then defeat the three-phase boss to lead Kaede to the door. The game includes 40 tasks, 12 bosses, 10 heroes, plus Boss Rush and Endless modes. On keyboard, use WASD or the arrow keys to move, Shift or Space to dash, 1-4
synthline-rush: SYNTHLINE RUSH is a neon synthwave arcade racer that's easy to pick up. You cruise an open paddock, drive onto any track you like, and aim for your fastest lap. Your best run returns as a ghost that you race against, so you can chase your own time. Each lap earns Watts, which unlock new tracks and buy faster cars you can customise.

To begin a lap, drive to a track and cross the green line. Beat your ghost to earn extra Watts, then spend them in the garage and shop. On desktop, use W A S D or the arrow keys to drive, Space to handbrake, Shift for nitro, and hold R to reset the car. G switches the guide line target, M mutes the sound, and P pauses. On ph
blocky-guns: Step into this blocky first-person shooter, where you gather colored blocks and assemble your own guns. Waves of foes will rush at you, and you must fight through each one. You can unlock several arms, including pistols, machine guns, rocket launchers, and grenades. Pick the right weapon for each clash, boost your firepower as you go, and survive tough battles across hazardous maps.

Every weapon you craft needs blocks in two different colors, so collect materials during missions to reach stronger gear. Keep moving, use your arsenal carefully, and wipe out all enemies to clear a level. On desktop, press WASD to move, steer with the mouse, and left-click to fire. On mobile, the on-screen joystick and buttons handle movement, aiming, switching weapons, and attacking.
find-capybara-valley-of-monsters: Find Capybara: Valley of Monsters drops you into a sprawling, wacky world where the goal is to track down and gather every capybara hidden across the map. The landscape is large and varied, and bouncy trampolines can launch you onto the tallest ledges. Watch out, though, because monsters patrol the territories, so avoid getting caught. You can fight back with silly but effective slaps, such as a giant hand, a roll of toilet paper, or a venerable bream fish that stuns foes so you can keep running.

Power-ups add more fun: a magic carpet lets you fly, a speed spring gives a quick dash, and a jump spring helps you reach out-of-the-way spots. Each capybara you find unlocks one of three unique skins for your character. Move with W, A, S and D, and press Space to jump, which combines well with trampolines for super jumps. Look carefully, since capybaras can hide in surprising places.
monster-truck-supra-race: Take the wheel of fire-breathing monster trucks and face rivals in close, head-to-head races across the rural United States. You can choose from several 4x4 off-road machines and pick the one that suits your driving. Tear over rolling hills, through valleys, past lakes and railways, and jump ramps while keeping an eye on the road, your opponents, and the next ramp. Use WASD to drive your truck.

The game offers Boss Battle Races, Ranking Races, Limited Races, Extreme Races, Single Contest, and Daily Race modes. You can also compete online against other monster truck drivers and climb the leaderboards. Your aim is to win as many races as possible and become the world's best new monster truck driver. Balance speed and performance with the design of your truck as the flames keep burning.
cat-robot-transform-war: Step into a city overrun by robots in this cat robot simulator, which blends survival hero action with car and robot transformation. Your mission is to clear the streets of enemies across a series of car and cat robot challenges. Robot shooting is combined with wild animal transformation, giving you nonstop action and abilities such as punching and jumping.

Controls are straightforward. Move with WASD, fire with the left mouse button, and hold the right button to aim. Press F to switch into the car and press F again to return to the cat robot, and press TAB to open the menu. On PC, WASD handles movement. On mobile, on-screen buttons control both the car and your movement.
pulse-of-fear: You are trapped in an abandoned place where something monstrous lives, and your survival hinges on illumination and quiet. Feed your flashlight batteries to reveal the building's eerie secrets, and repair generators to restore power and open a way out. Gather fuses for electrical panels, first aid kits for healing, and keys for locked doors. You can also swap fuses, cut wires, and hide from monsters in beds or lockers. Your goal is to fix the system and start the elevator, and above all, stay in the shadows.

On a computer, move with WASD, look with the mouse, run with Shift, and act with E. Press F for the flashlight, Tab to pause, Q to drop an item, and keys 1 through 5 to switch inventory slots. On mobile, an on-screen joystick handles movement, a touch zone controls looking, and buttons handle running, actions, the flashlight, pausing, dropping, and inventory changes.
quick-maths: Here, your brain is the controller for this arcade runner. Work out each math problem to clear the obstacle in front of you. The twenty levels mix addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division. Finish them all to unlock Endless mode, where your aim is to chase a high score.

Every problem comes with a countdown, so answer before time runs out. Tap or click your choice, or press 1, 2, or 3. Wrong answers take away stars, but a level keeps going either way. You earn one star for finishing, two for two or fewer mistakes, and three for making no mistakes while also landing enough fast PERFECT answers. In Endless, a single crash ends the run. Press Enter or Space to start and to continue.
tri-peaks-emerland-solitaire: Step into a fantasy realm where card magic shapes every turn of this solitaire game. Your path winds through a world home to dwarfs, elves, mermaids, and plenty of other fanciful beings, and you take on the role of the hero this land depends on. Expect bright, varied locations, many card combinations, friendly companions to lend a hand, and a long game to work through. Along the way you will face hazards hidden in enchanted woodlands, rugged cliffs, and other strange places.

Gameplay centers on the Tri Peaks layout. Pick a card that sits one rank above or below the card you have drawn to clear it from the field. Your goal on each level is to take every card off the board before your supply runs dry. Wild cards add surprises, and you earn stars based on how skillfully you play.
pizza-delivery-drive-and-deliver-hot: You play as a city courier who rides a scooter through traffic to pick up and drop off orders. Accept a job from your phone, head to the pickup spot, grab the package, and stow it in the scooter's storage box. Follow the route to the customer, take the package back out, and hand it over before the clock runs down. Keep an eye on your fuel and time as you go.

Each delivery earns coins, which you can spend to unlock new scooters and buy upgrades for them. Over time, you build your career toward becoming the city's quickest delivery driver. On desktop, press W to accelerate, S to reverse, A and D to steer, and Space to brake, using the mouse to control the camera and pick interaction buttons. On mobile, use the on-screen buttons for movement, steering, braking, interaction, the phone, and the scooter.
21-rush-ultimate-card-game: Fast-paced card game with a Blackjack twist

21 Rush mixes the excitement of Blackjack with the planning of Solitaire. Each round lasts only a few minutes, yet chasing better scores and flawless runs can keep you coming back for hours. Quick thinking and smart combos are rewarded, and one careless card can turn the whole game around. It's easy to pick up and takes real skill to master, so casual players and card-savvy fans alike can enjoy it at their own speed or push for the top spot on the leaderboard.

Each turn you choose one of four lanes for your card and try to build stacks that total exactly 21. A lane that goes over 21 busts, and three busts end the game. The TRASH button lets you discard risky cards to protect key lanes. Build streaks and lane bonuses, and finish the deck before time runs out for an extra time bonus. The game runs smoothly on Android phones and PC, and you can unlock new card backs and backgrounds as you play. Its built-in Help section also covers advanced strategies.
circle-car: Circle Car is a fast-paced traffic puzzle set at a busy 3D roundabout. You tap to send a steady line of cars into the circle without letting them collide. Each waiting vehicle has to slip into an open gap in the moving loop, so you need to track speeds, spacing, and rhythm. Quick reactions and well-timed taps matter most.

The controls use one touch and are simple to learn, but the challenge grows as more cars join the road. One mistimed tap can set off a chain of crashes and fail the level, so stay alert. Each level brings faster traffic, and you race the clock while working to beat your high score. Short, quick levels suit a few spare minutes or a longer skill challenge. The visuals are smooth and colorful, the game is fun for all ages, and it can be played anytime, anywhere.
ultimate-car-driving-simulator-3d: This driving game focuses on handling that feels true to life, since each type of vehicle, from a racing car to an off-road SUV, responds in its own way. You can build a personal ride using a wide range of vinyl designs and car parts, so the look is entirely up to you. The lineup includes racing cars, off-road vehicles, SUVs, tuner cars, muscle cars, and 4WD trucks.

The open world runs from city streets to desert landscapes, and an endless off-road area lets you explore in an SUV. Every car has engine sounds recorded from real vehicles, and the advanced 3D graphics aim for detailed scenery. Updates arrive regularly and are shaped by player ideas. Controls are set up for the keyboard.
chop-up: In this relaxing economy simulation, you begin with only an axe and slowly turn a small camp into a busy timber business. Hold the action button near a tree to chop it down, then cut the trunk into logs and carry them to the warehouse. Each delivery earns coins, which you can spend on stronger carrying, faster chopping and more warehouse room.

A tablet unlocks the orders system, where buyers offer time-limited deals for your logs. You can hire lumberjacks who chop on their own or collectors who gather loose logs, though every lumberjack needs a house first. Place buildings anywhere you like on the map, negotiate with business partners for bigger and more profitable trades, and watch the day-night cycle as the living world changes around you. Adjust music, controls and language to suit your taste.
zestful-match: Zestful Match is a bright, fresh tile puzzle where you match fruit to clear the board. Your job is to spot three identical fruit tiles and get them out of play. Each tap or click moves a tile into the tray at the bottom of the screen, and when three matching tiles sit together there, they vanish and you score points. The tray only holds seven tiles, so if it fills up before you find a match, the round is over.

Clearing every tile from the board finishes the level. When you get stuck, you can reach for Undo to take back your last move, Hint to reveal a possible match, or Shuffle to mix up the board. Your results also count toward the Global Leaderboard, so climbing it means clearing levels and posting high scores. The game plays smoothly on phones, tablets, and computers alike.
stalker-2033-the-path-of-the-survivor: Stalker 2033: The Path of the Survivor is a first-person 3D shooter set in a wrecked, post-apocalyptic world. You explore huge locations filled with many kinds of inhabitants, collect a range of deadly weapons, and battle the undead. Dark secrets lie hidden across the land, and staying alive in this harsh new reality is the constant challenge.

The story begins with the quiet routine of the middle lane, until a mysterious catastrophe starts turning people into living dead. Your character is away from the city when it strikes and only learns of the apocalypse two weeks after it started, landing him at the epicenter by chance. He must fight to survive while gathering clues bit by bit, trying to understand the nature of the disaster and how it affects the people around him.
recycle-game: Recycle Game asks you to bring order to piles of rubbish while helping protect the environment. It is a soothing sorting puzzle that blends entertainment with a real green purpose. Anyone who enjoys tidying-up titles or meditative brain teasers should find plenty to like here. It is also a relaxing way to unwind after a busy day.
You learn as you go, picking up how everyday recycling works with materials
steal-a-destruction-egg: Steal a Destruction Egg is a first-person voxel shooter where every object can break apart. Across 100 raids of rising difficulty, you blast through walls and watch physics-driven foes crumble piece by piece, with no blood. Seize the guarded egg from the altar, survive until the green evacuation portal opens, and carry the egg through it.

Eggs placed in your base nests earn money and hatch into one of 21 pets that double that income. Collect them in the codex, and step on cash pads to gather earnings. Spend your cash at the counters on 22 weapons, upgrades and cosmetics. PC: WASD moves, the mouse looks and sh
project-survival: Project: Survival is a fast zombie shooter where every shot and decision counts. You can head into the empty streets of Ghost Map City or explore the twisted halls of Zombie Hospital, and danger waits around almost every corner. Gather supplies, finish risky missions, and climb the ranks while enduring endless waves of the undead, from crawlers hiding in wreckage to spitters that eat through cover.

Pick up ammo and medkits from the enemies you defeat, and use your rewards to expand your loadout and unlock harsh new weapons. Rewarded revives let you get back up after a fall, and you can skip missions that seem impossible. On PC, use WASD to move, the left mouse button to aim and shoot, Spacebar to jump, P to pause, and X to switch guns. Tab, Delete, or unlocking the cursor also work. On mobile, you can choose from customizable control presets.
words-story: A wrongly accused man is locked away in prison, yet he refuses to surrender and is determined to engineer his own escape. Day after day and year after year, he keeps working toward freedom, but he needs your help to get there.

The rules are straightforward: type the correct word to clear a level. Every level is open to all players, and the new word gameplay is made for word fans. There is no time limit, so you can set your own pace on any level. With 2000 levels that never repeat, you can train your way to becoming a word master. It is a relaxed way to kill time, with no pressure at all. Along the way, collect useful tools to aid the man and upgrade them for faster progress.
adventure-crazy-ramp-bike-stunt-game: Adventure Crazy Ramp Bike Stunt Game puts you on a motorbike built for daring tricks. You can launch off towering ramps, flip through the air, and push your bike to high speeds across a range of tracks. Pick a stunt bike you like, upgrade its engine as you go, and unlock new tracks as you advance. Missions ask you to leap over obstacles, avoid traps, and sharpen your riding skills.

Here is how the controls work. Press the left arrow to lean back and the right arrow to lean forward, which keeps your balance in the air. The up arrow moves you forward, and the down arrow reverses when you need it. Collect coins during your ride to unlock stronger bikes. With lifelike physics, 3D graphics, and responsive handling, the game suits both casual players and hardcore stunt fans.
restorake-restore-the-ruins: This cozy idle clicker is about reviving a lost jungle palace, one sweep of the rake at a time. Drag it over the overgrowth and whatever it hits breaks into coins, including weeds, bushes, brambles, rocks, mushrooms, slimes, and crystals. Each day starts at 40 seconds and can be lengthened by the Longer Day and Long Summer elixir. Days always pay out, so you never lose anything.
Spend coins on 15 visible rebuilding steps, from pillars and guardian statues to groves and the roof. Finished steps keep earning coins even while you are away.
crosstile: CrossTile mixes crossword solving with jigsaw-style play. Each level presents a theme and a spread of letter fragments. Drag the pieces around the board and join the ones that belong together. Correct matches lock together and merge into one bigger cluster. Keep building out words and their crossing points until the whole crossword is filled in. The controls are simple, the visuals are clean, and there are no timers or lives, so it feels calm to play and rewarding to master.

Start by reading the theme at the top of the level. Next, move the fragments and place matching ones side by side. Correct connections join automatically, and linked pieces travel together as a single group. Use word intersections to reveal the full crossword, and connect every fragment to finish the level. If you get stuck, a hint is available to help you along.
highway-of-the-dead: You walk the last highway through a zombie wasteland, while your survivor battles on his own and you make the decisions that count. Gear dropped by fallen zombies can be equipped by swiping its card right or sold for gold by swiping left, and on desktop you drag it with the mouse. When the ability bar appears, tap it to land a power strike.

Use gold at the Tavern to train your hero, outfit your slots with weapons, armor, and trinkets, and keep moving forward as day gives way to night. Meet lost souls, pick good or evil to summon faction bosses from the Bosses tab, and survive elite special encounters. Raid rival shelters through PvP Raid for trophies that open new maps with stronger loot. Sessions stay brief, progress comes steadily, and the journey never stops.
kitty-kitty: You step into the role of a caring cat keeper in this relaxed idle simulation. Set in a snowy winter scene, you look after cute kawaii cats. Cat food is your core idle resource, and it builds up passively at +50 per second. Use it to level up your felines and raise their Sweetness stat, while daily check-ins and challenges unlock new features.
Customize cozy habitats and complete tasks as you build a feline paradise. Santa-hatted cats, decorated trees
jigsaw-puzzle-anime: Jigsaw Puzzle - Anime brings classic jigsaw fun to anime artwork. It blends relaxation, light entertainment and brain training into one experience. The collection includes both free and premium puzzles built around anime scenes. If you prefer something personal, you can make a puzzle from your own images or family photos.
