Every piece is unique and carefully made, and the range of beautiful anime pictures is wide enough to keep you exploring.

To begin, choose any puzzle from the collection. Scattered pieces then appear on the screen, and your task is to fit them together until the full picture is complete. Moving a piece is simple: tap or click and hold it, drag it to the right spot on the board, and release your finger or mouse button to drop it in place.
up-up-and-oops: Up, Up, and Oops! is a fast 3D arcade game about climbing floating paths. Study the route, pick the right move, and act before the tiles collapse. Jump forward when the path runs straight, or press the direction it turns toward. Make your choice before the gauge runs out.

Classic mode sends you through levels that grow tougher and longer, and you must clear every step to unlock the next one. Endless mode challenges you to climb as high as you can and beat your best score. Both modes give you three lives, and after they are all lost, one revive is available. Online Race pits two to six players against each other for two minutes, with the goal of reaching a higher step. Earn stars, unlock characters, tiles, and titles, and compete on the all-time leaderboards.
katana-fruits-cutting-fun: Step into the dojo, ninja, because the goal here is to grow into a true master of fruit slicing. This title takes its inspiration from Fruit Ninja, the original fruit-slicing game that started out as a mobile hit. If you have ever wanted to sharpen your blade skills, this version offers a fresh place to practice the art of cutting fruit.

Controls are kept simple, and a tap or a click is all it takes to make each cut. Every slice moves you a little closer to mastery, and the dojo sets the stage for that training from start to finish. Fans of the mobile original will likely recognize the core idea right away.
wrench-and-roll: Wrench and Roll is a garage puzzle where each stage brings a battered old car closer to running again. Tap crates that have a clear route to the road and they roll onto your workbench. Gather three matching crates to merge them into a repair part. The workbench holds only six crates, so choose carefully. Clear crates to open blocked paths and padlocked plates, use bomb crates to blast steel plates, and reach mystery crates to reveal what is hidden inside.
The game has 120 levels across six chapters,
merge-emoji-arena: Emoji characters come alive in this casual idle merge game and head straight into battle. You start by buying basic emoji fighters, then combine two matching ones to forge a stronger unit with more damage. The puzzle merging is satisfying, and it pairs well with hands-free combat. Deployed units keep fighting and collecting gold even while the game runs in the background.

Hold back endless waves of enemy emojis that keep growing tougher, plus challenging bosses. Each defeated foe pays out gold, which you spend on expanding and upgrading your army. Click Buy Unit to place a basic emoji on the merge board, then drag matching emojis together to evolve them. Move your best fighters into one of three battle lanes to start the attack. Everything is played with simple left-clicks, or with taps and drags on mobile.
chef-tycoon: This free online cooking game lets you run your own restaurant, cook meals, and get them to hungry guests before their patience runs out. Quick kitchen work and business decisions are blended together, so every shift becomes a practical test of your skills. You begin with a modest setup, and as sales bring in money, you gradually build a bigger food business.

Your chef takes orders and prepares them quickly, since customer satisfaction depends on serving speed. Completing level goals unlocks new recipes and improvements, and coins earned along the way pay for kitchen upgrades and expansion. Each stage raises the pace, so sharper time management becomes essential. Move with the arrow keys, or drag the on-screen joystick in any direction.
loopvival: In this moody survival game with roguelite touches, shadow has swallowed the world, and a single bonfire at the map's heart is the only light left. Each cycle resets everything, but your fire's progress and key upgrades carry over, letting you push deeper into the gloom. You are the last hope against the Darkness, though the reason the loop keeps restarting remains a mystery. Only the bonfire never changes.

Break the cycle by gathering resources, feeding your fire, opening new territories, and restoring ruins, which slowly reveal the story of a lost world. Battles with the Darkness's minions are straightforward, and the calm pace makes this a short, seamless adventure. On desktop, WASD moves you, LMB or Space attacks, E interacts, and Q switches the resource you add to ruins. On mobile, the left joystick moves you, while the A, E, and Q buttons handle attack, interaction, and resource switching.
nexus-override: In this 3D horde survival game, you play a rogue AI trying to escape the mainframe inside a cyberpunk arena. Waves of hostile programs keep coming, so you collect XP, level up, and pick new abilities as you go. Enemies grow more dangerous across six sectors, each with its own difficulty and boss. Your goal is to outlast the system.

You can play solo or team up with a friend in local two-player co-op. Build walls and deploy turrets in the middle of battle, and choose a powerful upgrade after every round. Several characters and skins can be unlocked, and credits earned between runs let you boost your stats. Player 1 moves with WASD and Player 2 uses the arr
dashmash-io: Imagine a fast running contest where up to ten players race at once, live, across a course full of hazards. Your aim is to reach the finish line before the others while dodging moving platforms, swinging hammers, crumbling blocks, and deadly spikes. Every round switches to a brand-new map, so you must adapt quickly. Cross the line first to take the leading position on the leaderboard, if the chaos spares you.

On a computer, use the arrow keys or A and D to move left and right, and press the up arrow, W, or Space to jump. A second jump in mid-air is allowed. Hold Shift for a burst of speed. On mobile, drag the on-screen joystick to move, tap J to jump, and tap D to dash forward.
bucket-brigade: Bucket Brigade is a cozy puzzle game with a toy theme. You steer a rescue convoy along a sunny beach where children have left behind toys and sandcastles. Before the summer heat melts your plastic vehicles, you need to clear the whole shore.

Keys 1, 2, and 3 pick the ambulance, crane, or dump truck, and X or Square switches vehicles on a gamepad. W and S drive, while Q and E turn the crane cabin. The mouse raises and lowers the arm, and the left and right buttons close and open the claw. Esc pauses the game or takes you back. Gamepad players can use the triggers, bumpers, left stick, and face buttons for the same actions.
demolition-tycoon-3d: Start with a small loader and gradually build your own demolition fleet. Press and hold to swing at structures, tearing them down while coins pile up. Every hit makes you stronger, and you can spend your earnings on power, speed, profit, and critical strikes, or save up for heavier equipment. The campaign includes 80 contracts spread across seven districts, moving from a backyard to a harbor and up into alpine terrain.

Seven machines can be unlocked, including the Titan crusher, and tougher jobs open up once the campaign is finished. Each building material, whether wood, brick, concrete, metal, or glass, reacts differently to impacts. Your progress is stored locally on your device. The game supports ten languages and works with mouse, keyboard, or touch. Hold Space to strike, press Escape to open settings, and click or tap menus to buy upgrades, pick machines, and explore districts.
robbie-tiktak-slot-machines: Robbie: TikTak Slot Machines drops you into an online arcade packed with different machines, and each one holds its own mini-games and challenges. Finish those challenges to collect tickets. You can trade tickets for rare pets or spend them to open up new machines. The Wheel of Fortune offers extra rewards on top of that, and searching for hidden secret machines can lead to exclusive prizes.

On a computer, move with W, A, S and D, jump with the spacebar, and turn the camera with your mouse. Press Tab to show or hide the cursor whenever you need it. On mobile, a virtual joystick in the bottom left handles movement, and a button in the bottom right makes your character jump.
prison-break-architect-tycoon: You start with a bare prison that cannot even hold regular inmates, and dangerous bosses are waiting too. Your job is to turn it into a secure facility. You can construct new cameras, reinforce the doors, install surveillance cameras, and recruit guards. Upgrades matter as well, and your chief overseer can become quicker, carry better weapons, and escort more prisoners at once.
quackventure: Quackventure is an arcade game that puts you in the shoes of Quack, a fearless duck trying to escape a huge purple monster. You wander through a magical forest where surprises wait around every bend and hidden treasures are tucked away. The scenery is bright and colorful, and the land is full of animals and playful mysteries to uncover.
You steer Quack with the WASD keys and use
stackitaire: Stackitaire is a card-sorting puzzle that mixes classic solitaire with satisfying brain work. You start with stacks of shuffled cards and aim to build complete suits, with each suit kept in its own stack. Every level deals a fresh layout, and the challenge grows as locked cards, hidden decks, and tighter stacks appear. The game includes hundreds of levels, daily bonuses, and helpful boosters for those hands that feel impossible.

To move a card, tap a stack to lift its top card, then tap another stack to place it. You can only set a card on a matching suit or into an empty stack. A stack is finished when it holds a full suit sorted from bottom to top, and you must clear every stack to complete a level. Keep one stack empty as a holding spot, and plan a few moves ahead to avoid getting blocked. Undo takes back your last move, Hint highlights the best next play, and Key unlocks a sealed stack so its hidden cards can be played.
dark-city-multiplayer: Dark City. Multiplayer is an online open-world horror game set in a shared city that has fallen into gloom. Players join one of two sides. The police work to bring order back, look after survivors, and win back seized neighborhoods. The bandits seize zones, lay traps, and slip through the shadows. Expect gunfights and brawls with rivals, and something much worse may be stirring below the streets.

Once the game starts, choose your faction and claim as many districts as you can. WASD moves your character, Space makes you jump, Enter opens the chat, and E opens your inventory. Every 30 seconds, you earn money for each district you hold, so keep control of your areas while repelling attacks and trying to outlast the horror slowly waking in the city's depths.
noob-slingshot-monsters: Noob, a clumsy hero, is loaded into a slingshot and launched at block towers that hide cartoon monsters. You pull back, follow the dotted aiming line, and release, all with one finger. Glass shatters on contact, wood needs a solid hit, and stone takes two. Each broken block earns points, but your shots are limited. TNT crates set off chain reactions that can topple half a tower, though a badly timed blast may leave the last monster sheltered.
Bonus cards hidden in the levels grant extra shots. The 50 levels feature
parking-journey-car-puzzle: Parking Journey: Car Puzzle asks you to think through logic, planning, and parking. Each car has to reach the bay with the same color, but the lot is packed, vehicles often block each other, and the right route isn't always easy to spot. You'll need to look ahead, clear a path by shifting other cars, and map out a route before the clock hits zero.

You control the route yourself. Hold a car and draw the line you want it to take, and it will follow that exact path. Tapping an open spot is another option when you want a shorter trip. Sometimes you may need to park a blocking car in an empty space or even in a different bay to open the way, and that temporary move is part of solving the puzzle. The game offers 5,000 levels across 50 chapters, with new layouts, lot shapes, colors, and tighter timers appearing as you go. Every board can be solved, so if a plan fails, you can try another route. Boosters include Valet, Extra Time, and Undo, and the lobby has rewards and extra activities.
gorilgo-fps-online-shooter: This 3D first-person shooter keeps the pace high, with fights that feel messy and fierce from start to finish. You pick from a wide range of strong firearms and charge into fast clashes with enemies. At any moment you can shift into a powerful gorilla, a change that gives you a surprise edge.

In human form you depend on firepower and careful aim. As a gorilla, you fight up close with raw strength and brutal melee strikes. Switch between guns and primal power to take over the battlefield and catch opponents off guard with moves they cannot predict. Master both shooting and gorilla power to beat rivals and gain control. Move with WASD, jump with Space, and press F to transform. Both PC and mobile controls are supported.
akagram: Akagram is a calm logic puzzle where you place light bulbs so that every empty square ends up lit. Light travels straight along rows and columns until a wall stops it, and no two bulbs may shine on each other. Numbers on walls tell you how many bulbs touch that wall from the side, while numbers along the edges give the bulb count for their row or column. These edge clues set it apart from classic light-up games.

The game includes a range of levels, daily challenges, and a Time Attack mode where you race the clock. Click or tap a cell to add or remove a bulb, and use the × tool to mark squares where no bulb belongs. On-screen buttons handle undo, redo, restart, and hints. On desktop, scroll the mouse wheel to zoom, or pinch on a phone or tablet. Drag or swipe to move around the board.
vizavi: VIZAVI is a dice puzzle that runs as an emulated link table, since the physical board it controls is missing. You stand on a die and roll it across a board of dice. Rolling into an empty cell carries you along, while stepping onto a neighbor takes no extra effort. Line up equal faces side by side, as many as the pips on the face, and that group sinks out of sight. Chains extend a group's exit, and a 1 brought to a leaving group clears every other 1 on the board.

The Levels mode offers forty-two boards across seven chapters. Clear every die to finish, earn stars based on your move count, and take back any move. Protocol is an endless session where dice rise from below and noise builds until the link is lost. Records keep every subject's results in one table. Controls work with keyboard or touch, and the game is available in seven languages. After a session, something may come through, though the program does not say what.
breinrot-bog: In Breinrot Bog, a strange substance called Brainroot devours the mind. It hides in the most perilous, hard-to-reach corners of the map, and gathering it keeps you alive and makes your character stronger. The real threat is the swamp that is waking up, its water level climbing higher and drowning the land. If it catches you, your character dies and reappears at base, but dying is simply part of the plan.

Head back into flooded areas for fresh resources, though familiar paths may become impassable. Spend collected Brainroots on upgrading shelters and stats: faster movement to escape the water, stronger jumps to reach high ground, or passive income that pays out even while you're idle. Move with WASD, search for glowing clusters, press Space to jump, and step close to a Brainroot or your base to collect or install a sample.
grimace-only-up: Grimace Only Up is a platform game where you guide Grimace, a likable and nimble hero, through a risky world of drifting objects, hazardous traps, and towering heights. Your task is to leap, avoid danger, and zigzag from one floating object to the next as you climb steadily toward the finish line at the top. The controls are easy to pick up, and the bright, eye-catching visuals help the game stand out.

Move with the W, A, S, and D keys, and press the spacebar to jump. Every leap takes careful timing as you work your way upward. Keep your eyes on the path ahead and climb one step at a time until you reach the goal.
zumbie-blocky-land-2022: Zumbie Blocky Land 2022 is a free online shooter set during a zombie apocalypse, where you can choose from a wide range of weapons to fight off undead foes. Battles take place across several maps at the same time, pitting you against Minecraft-style zombie bots. Other zombies also act as enemies, so you will need to watch your back. Everything you need to fight is within reach, which keeps the action easy to jump into. Playing with other people adds to the fun.

Hiding behind objects is a handy way to stay safe while you play. Move with W, A, S, and D, then use the mouse to aim, look around, and shoot. Every weapon in the game fires bullets. It suits anyone who likes online action with plenty of weapon choices.
bone-throne: You are the villain, and a party of paladins, rangers, and knights is marching toward your throne. Turn the dead into bone minions that fight alongside you. In Bone Throne, a horde survival roguelite, a single click handles everything: attack a nearby enemy or raise a nearby corpse. If both are in range, attacking takes priority. Tapping on mobile works the same way.
Each hero that falls swells your undead army. You face wa
edgefire: EdgeFire puts you into fast online shooting matches against people from all over the world. You can go it alone or team up with friends. Each round gives you a shot at showing who controls the battlefield, and you can earn rewards along the way. Sharpen your aim and react quickly to take down rivals, while clever plans and smart moves can turn the fight in your favor.

A wide selection of skins adds flair to your gameplay and suits both experienced shooter fans and newcomers to the genre. Every clash brings a fresh challenge full of tension and adrenaline. Controls: move with W, A, S, and D, reload with R, fire with the left mouse button, and open the pause menu with Esc.
obby-mine-crasher: In this obby game, you strike anvils with a hammer to build strength and smash through stone walls. Each block you destroy earns trophies, which you can spend on pets that boost your hits. Stronger pets break walls faster, so you can advance further through the obby levels. There is no storyline and no bosses. Instead, the walls grow tougher after each one falls.

Trophies also buy pet boxes, character skins, and new areas, while strength unlocks weapon skins. Daily rewards, a fortune wheel, and a pleasant visual style add variety, and VIP status or doubling your strength speeds up progress. You can fully customize your hero, weapons included. Controls: use WASD to manage your character, Space to jump, and the left mouse button to attack. On a phone, use the buttons shown on the screen.
offroad-jeep-driving-mountain-climb: Climb behind the wheel of a four-wheel-drive jeep and tackle rugged routes over mountains. Steep slopes, muddy trails, snowy ground, and large ramps line the way, along with sharp bends, bumpy stretches, and obstacles. Keep your vehicle under control on every course. Pick a favorite off-road machine, then tweak or upgrade it for tougher stages. Complete missions, pass checkpoints, and gather coins to unlock new vehicles and tracks.

Steer with tilt, buttons, or a steering wheel, and adjust the sensitivity to suit you. Choose among jeeps, SUVs, trucks, and other powerful off-road vehicles. On desktop, W or Up Arrow races, A or Left Arr
sheepdoku: Sheepdoku is a calm puzzle title for anyone who enjoys logic, planning, and gentle mental workouts. The aim is straightforward: place a single sheep into each colored region on the grid while following the rules. At first glance the boards look approachable, yet every stage asks for careful reasoning, precise choices, and accurate placement. Each board is split into separate colored zones, and every zone must hold exactly one sheep. Sheep also need room to themselves, so no two can share a row or a column, and none can sit beside another, including on a diagonal. Pause before each move, look for the spots that are safe, and finish the grid without a single error. As you keep playing, your reasoning tends to sharpen. It suits short relaxing breaks, daily brain practice, and fans of puzzles built on simple rules with plenty of depth.
block-master-gem-puzzle: Block Master Gem Puzzle is a block-fitting game played on an 8x8 grid, with a gem-themed look. You drag pieces onto the board and fill complete rows or columns to clear them and earn points. It is simple to learn, yet it takes real skill to master. Its fluid controls and pleasing visual effects make it a brain-training puzzle for players of every age. You can jump in whenever and wherever you like.

There are three modes to choose from. Classic mode has no end, so you can relax and keep chasing a higher score. Diamond Quest asks you to clear blocks with care so you collect every diamond and complete each level. Clear the Board limits your moves, so you must remove every block on the board before they run out.
cloudburg-sky-farm: Set on a single floating island that keeps getting bigger, this clicker lets you run a charming little sky farm. Tap ripe crops to collect coins, or tap crops that are still growing to speed them up. Fast tapping fills a tempo meter that brings in bonus helpers. Spend your coins on beds, buildings and upgrades to grow the island one quarter at a time.

You can build a windmill, a bakery, a coop and a balloon pier, research upgrades at the observatory, and catch fish leaping up the waterfall. Goose mayor Gosha has something to say about all of it. Tap falling stars, gift balloons and leaping fish for extra rewards, and tap greedy seagulls to scare them away. On a computer, drag with the mouse or press WASD to move around, and use the scroll wheel to zoom. On a phone, swipe to scroll.
blasting-marbles: Blasting Marbles is a two-dimensional puzzle adventure driven by physics. Your task is to guide a set number of marbles into a hole. Wander through the game world, bump into crates to add more marbles to your count, and find marbles that each have their own special abilities. Swapping between marbles lets you divide the effort, and some challenges require the marbles to work together.

The controls are simple. The required number of marbles appears in the upper left corner of the screen. Left-click near a marble to set off a blast that sends it rolling. Boxes hold extra marbles, and the number inside each one is shown on the box. Drive a marble into a box to claim them. When you have several marbles, press the arrow keys or the A and D keys to change which one is in focus. The game blends puzzle, physics, and skill throughout.
starving-lion: A hungry lion needs your help, and the solution takes a bit of clever thinking. Its meals hang on ropes just beyond its reach, and those ropes follow physics, so every cut changes how the food swings. Slice at the points marked by stars to collect them and raise your score. Make a bad cut, though, and the food drops out of the lion's range, ending the game.

The visuals are high quality, and the game stays small in size without losing any of that polish, which is good for your device's health. The controls are super simple, so it is easy to start playing. Interesting quests keep boredom away. On Android, touch the on-screen controls to cut the
military-vehicles-driving: Pick from a range of military vehicles and put your driving skills to the test in this 3D driving game. The action unfolds across a huge stretch of desert, giving you plenty of room to explore and practice your handling. The game is tagged as both a racing and a simulation experience, with cars and trucks among the options.
Steering uses the W, A, S and D keys, while the spacebar applies the brakes. Press C to switch between camera views as you drive.
watermelon-merge-fruit-drop: Stack fruit in a jar and watch the physics take over as they tumble and bounce. Matching fruits fuse into a bigger one, climbing from a small cherry to a giant watermelon. The rare Golden Seed fuses with any fruit and raises it by one level, which helps when a jar gets crowded or you want to build a long chain.

Slide your finger or mouse left and right, then release or click to drop. On a keyboard, use Left and Right or A and D, and press Space or Enter. Keep fruit below the dashed line, or the run ends. Boosters sit at the bottom: Hammer smashes a fruit, Upgrade advances one, and Shake rattles the jar. Fill the Fruit Album, earn 12 achievements, complete daily quests and 7-day rewards, unlock 5 skins, and clim
idle-cookie-tycoon: You start with nothing but a giant cookie button and a goal to build a sweet empire from scratch. Tap the button to bake cookies, spend them on upgrades that raise your click power, and convert them to money at a rate of 10 cookies per dollar. Simple ovens, regional ovens, and a national oven fleet can bake for you, and each one can be improved level by level.

Four shops are available to open, and each has a rotating bar on top that pays out money when it fills and then starts filling again. You can also make 15-second investments using green and red candlestick charts, buying or selling based on your prediction. A correct call can double your money, but a wrong one can cost you. Your progress is tracked in the Achievements panel. The game works completely offline, so your ovens and shops keep earning even when it is closed. Interactive tutorials explain each system separately, and the game is available in 16 languages.
block-sort-pirate-treasure: Ahoy, puzzle fans! Ready to sort a pile of treasure? Block Sort Pirate Treasure is a puzzle game built around logic, where you unlock big rewards by thinking ahead. Mixed stacks hold colorful loot such as sparkling gems, gleaming gold coins, and old relics. Your job is to rearrange them so each stack ends up holding just one kind of item. The game offers 5,000 unique levels, and both the puzzles and the treasure grow more impressive as you move through the campaign.

Each level asks you to picture how the blocks fit together and plan your moves with care. Along the way you will find helpful boosters for tricky spots: one adds an extra empty slot, and another undoes your most recent move. On a computer, click a stack to lift its top item, then click an empty space or a stack whose top item matches to drop it. On a phone or touchscreen, tap a stack to select its top block, then tap where you want it to go.
train-snake: Climb behind the controls of a train in this browser game and set off to collect every passenger waiting for a ride. Once they are on board, your task is to carry them all to the destination. Don't let any traveller slip your mind, and keep a sharp eye out for obstacles scattered along the road.

Train Snake borrows the feel of the classic Snake formula and applies it to train driving. It is a hypercasual HTML5 title, so the rules are easy to grasp at a glance. Your mission comes down to two things: gather everyone who needs a lift, and steer clear of anything that blocks the road ahead.
snow-rush-3d: Snow Rush 3D is a sledding game that tests your speed and reflexes, made for anyone who loves winter sports. You can play alone or go head to head with a friend in two-player mode. Your aim is to travel the longest distance possible down a snowy course filled with ramps and obstacles, while snowmen, sharp bends
magic-finger-puzzle-3d: Magic Finger Puzzle 3D is a casual puzzle game you can play right in your browser. You control a pair of magical hands that can fire a laser to break open the cages holding you. The hands can also hurl boxes onto barricades, letting you slip out of a cage without touching the spikes that would end your run. Clever thinking is the key, since you have to figure out how to make the most of those hands. Every difficulty can be solved with careful planning, and the game offers a journey full of adventure.
Controls are simple: click or tap with your mouse to play.
daring-jack: Jack is an adventurer whose small aircraft was flying over the sea when its engine failed above a jungle island. He got out before the plane crashed, and he landed safely on the island. Now he has to leave, and his only way off is by boat. He remembers an old boat house on the island but is not sure how to reach it.

Your job is to guide him through the jungle to that boat house. Along the way, help him gather the essentials he needs to survive, mainly food and shelter, while he works his way across the difficult terrain. You can control Jack with a mouse or by tapping the screen.
motorcycle-dirt-racing-multiplayer: Step into the fast-paced world of motocross, where speed and rivalry meet head-on. Races unfold across varied terrain, from tough dirt tracks to demanding off-road landscapes. Each powerful motorcycle has its own traits, so you can choose the one that suits your riding. Navigate daring jumps, tight corners, and dangerous obstacles as you push forward.

Multiplayer mode lets you take on other riders in this motorcycle dirt racing game. Win races to climb closer to the championship trophy and collect valuable rewards along the way. Steer your bike with the WASD keys.
only-up-forward: Jackie is a determined teen from rough city streets who dreams of leaving hardship behind. Driven by a strong inner fire, they set out to discover the wide world and who they truly are. Even as everything around them keeps shifting, Jackie spots an opening in the chaos, and the turmoil feels like a summons to take bold steps toward change.
Progress, though, carries risk, since every step forward could send Jackie several steps back. Controls rely on the WASD keys to run or walk, while the space bar makes Jackie jump.
dead-frequency: This fast-moving tower defense game puts you in charge of a signal tower powered by crystal, standing in a harsh red wasteland. Enemies arrive in successive waves, and your job is to stop them before they bring the tower down. Every wave tests how long you can keep it standing.

Spend the currency you collect, shown as ₮, to improve damage, maximum health, speed, bounce, and diamond yield. Managing your resources and leveling up your defenses are central to staying alive. Keep in mind that the longer you survive, the stronger the enemies become, so you will need to keep upgrading as the battle goes on.
hi-fi-snake-groove-driven-arcade-challen: Hi-Fi Snake places you on an angled, colorful dance floor where arcade play meets a pulsing disco mood. You steer a robot that never tires, and your task is to keep the party moving by gathering shimmering pellets. Each pellet lengthens your trail, so every turn needs careful planning. Meanwhile, a wall of molten lava creeps across the floor behind you, leaving only a few seconds to react.

The door shows how many pellets you need. Once you have collected that number, you must race to the exit and reach the next room. Each room brings a fresh layout, moving obstacles, environmental hazards, and robot foes that want you to crash. On a computer, the arrow keys control your robot's direction. It is a fast game that rewards skill, timing, and smart movement under pressure.
tick-tack-what: Tic-Tac-Toe fans, this version takes the classic idea and bends it out of shape. You face a computer opponent that ignores the usual rules whenever it suits, and the challenge grows as you move through boards with stranger, more uneven shapes. Its bag of underhanded moves includes wiping out your X's, locking squares so you cannot use them, dropping bombs onto the grid, and announcing wins it never earned.

To play, click any active square to place your X and aim for a row of three. Keep an eye on the cheating machine, because its shifting gravity, glitches, and rule-breaking changes can undo your plans at any moment. Adapting to boards that keep mutating is the core challenge, and the goal is to show that a person can still come out ahead of an opponent that never plays fair.
road-gunner-3d: Road Gunner 3D lets you assemble a vehicle that rolls down hazardous highways while blasting enemies along the way. Merge matching parts, then drag those upgrades onto your ride to strengthen it. Earn coins as you go and unlock new rides, and try to survive each intense run.

To begin, tap the screen. Hold your mouse button or finger down to fire, and drag left or right to aim. Rockets are your tool for clearing enemies that block the road, so you can push through to the finish.
we-not-survive: In this tower defense title, you are the lone guard of a base in a world overrun by the undead after everything has fallen apart. Your job is to hold off the waves of attackers that keep coming at you. The game can be enjoyed online at no cost. Along the way, you improve your arms and gather materials, open up new abilities, and face successive groups of zomb
toward-to-carrot: A hungry pig has one goal: reach the carrot in front of it. Hidden obstacles stand in the way, and you only discover them as you move forward, so you need to think ahead and work out how to get past each one. It is a 2D puzzle game with a cartoon look and an animal hero.

Along the way you can gather spare coins, which you can spend on costumes for your pig. Controls depend on your device. On a computer, move the character with the WASD keys, while mobile players tap on-screen buttons instead.
the-high-climb: The High Climb is a three-dimensional adventure with an arcade feel. You face a never-ending tower of vertical obstacles, and a single misstep sends you tumbling all the way back to where you began. Success depends on careful footwork, plenty of patience, and well-judged timing as you work toward the summit.

Controls are simple: use W, A, S, and D to move around, press the spacebar to leap, and move the mouse to survey your surroundings. Because every jump matters, take your time and think each step through before you commit to it.
bffs-kimono-fashion: Six princesses, Anna, Elsa, Moana, Ariel, Snow White and Jasmine, are getting ready to try out Japanese traditional style. They want to wear kimono fashion and show off their striking new looks. Your job is to browse each girl's wardrobe and pick a costume that suits her.

Selecting items is simple: click or tap on clothing pieces, accessories, hairstyles, and other elements to choose them. Each princess needs her own complete look, so take your time looking through the options before you decide. Every girl is excited to see how her outfit turns out.
anti-aircraft-3d-game: Anti Aircraft 3D is a shooting game that pairs addictive gameplay with a three-dimensional art style, and it counts among the more intriguing shooters released this year. Rather than firing ordinary shots from solid ground, you get to launch enormous rockets from tanks. These heavy weapons carry enough force to wipe out every aircraft in the sky.

Your job is to bring down the number of enemy planes the game sets for you. To get started, slide on the screen to play. The 3D visuals add to the experience, giving the battlefield a lively, detailed feel as you take aim at the skies above.
west-frontier-sharpshooter-3d: West Frontier Sharpshooter 3D lets you live out a cowboy fantasy in a setting inspired by A Fistful of Dollars. You play a Western-style sniper armed with a Winchester Model 1894, and your job is to take down every bandit in the area and bring justice to the land.

Timing and planning are key, since the order you choose for your targets matters, and you must avoid being hit by the gunfire covering them. Some encounters turn into open standoffs where every bandit is shooting at once, and that is when your M1873 gets to show what it can do. Controls are simple: click with your mouse or tap the screen to play.
final-night-zombie-street-fight: A year has passed since the outbreak turned the world upside down. Many good people have been lost, and more losses are expected, but the survivors are still standing and must take on the undead. Your story starts here, as the Zombie Street Fighter. Across five different areas, you can work through more than twenty levels, picking up a knife, a baseball bat, or a gun to strike back at the enemy.

The controls are simple to learn. Use the arrow keys to move, the spacebar to jump, Z or X to attack, and C to defend, then press Esc or Tab to pause whenever you need a moment. Expect intense, adrenaline-charged brawls, action-packed missions, detailed 3D visuals, and physics-driven gameplay that keeps things moving quickly.
moon-chess: Moon Chess pits you against the enigmatic Half Moon in a space-themed strategy match. You link the stages of the lunar cycle, beginning at Crescent and building toward Full Moon, to earn points while navigating the changing play of light and darkness. The game draws its ideas from real astronomical events, and each turn helps you get a better feel for the moon's natural rhythm.
Fans of chess-style boards, logic puzzles and brain teasers should find plenty to think about. The game can also be played on mobile devices.
resize-stickman: Resize Stickman is a 3D runner where your stickman moves forward on his own, and his size is your only tool. Grow him to smash through tall barriers, or shrink him so he can slide beneath low ones. It is easy to pick up and play, but the mix of casual fun and deeper strategy means quick decisions matter as much as fast reactions. Swipe down to shrink him, or swipe up to grow him.

Your aim is to carry him as far as possible, clearing as many levels as you can to push your high score. Coins you collect let you unlock new skins from a gacha-style shop and earn achievements across several tiers. The interface responds smoothly, the animations feel satisfying, and the game is localized for players around the world. Study each obstacle, find the rhythm of resizing, and try to beat your personal best.
car-stunts-2050: Car Stunts 2050 is a racing game that puts you in the driver's seat for a series of wild tricks. Your goal is to sharpen your driving by attempting stunts that seem to ignore gravity and common sense. Drive straight through flaming hoops, roll your car over in barrel rolls, and sail over ramps in mid-air jumps.
The game features several demanding levels, each made to test your control of the car and your willingness to attempt bold stunts. To drive, use the W, A, S and D keys.
space-painters-deluxe: Space Painters Deluxe mixes action with puzzle solving. Your job is to shape bright, colorful rings across the cosmos while steering clear of the paint trail you leave behind. Sharp timing and a good sense of space will help you clear the dark star systems that stand in your way.

Controls are handled with a single mouse click, which lays down paint as you move. Keep an eye on the line you draw, since avoiding it is just as important as building your circles. The game is filed under arcade, paintball, painting, and shooter, so expect a blend of those styles.
knight-s-arena-castle-defense: An enemy army has the castle surrounded, and only one warrior can hold them back. Dive into the crowd, land heavy blows, and make sure none of them reach the fortress. Every win leaves your hero tougher. Pick up weapons and armor along the way, keep upgrading your gear, and prepare for new, more dangerous foes.

Fights are fast, close-range clashes, so powerful weapons and durable armor matter. Pick your moment carefully before you strike. On a computer, move with WASD and use the left mouse button to attack and interact. On a phone, swipe across the screen to move and tap to attack and interact. The controls stay simple on both.
hatchfire-dragon-brick-breaker: Help a baby dragon escape its shell in this cute brick breaker. Drag with a mouse or finger to aim, and your dragon fires fireballs on its own. They ricochet around the egg, smashing blocks, setting off bombs and grabbing power gems. Break every glowing rune to crack the egg open, then send a fireball through the gap to hatch
kids-diy-stickers: Kids DIY Stickers is a relaxed game about making your own greeting card. You start with a see-through card and a selection of adorable stickers, including puppies, bunnies, calves, and pretty flowers. Pick the ones you like best and place them onto the clear card however you want. When your design is finished, you can save it and build up a collection of the cards you have created.
Controls are simple: use a mouse click or a tap to pick, place, and arrange the stickers.
silhouette-art: Silhouette Art lets you make pretty pictures from scratch. You begin with an empty canvas and build up your design by adding colors, stickers, and sparkly glitter. Whether you consider yourself a skilled artist or not, this game is easy to enjoy, since you can produce striking pieces that your whole family will be happy to show off.

Controls are simple: use your mouse or tap the screen to play. It runs in your browser and works on mobile devices too. It sits in the Girls category and is tagged for coloring, decorating, and kids, so it suits anyone who likes creative, hands-on fun.
timer-cannon: In Timer Cannon, the seconds on screen are closing in on you, and the only way to earn more life is to wipe out the clocks themselves. You aim, judge the moment to shoot, and then fire. One accurate tap sets off your heavy cannon, which sends explosive shells skimming across the playfield toward the closest clock still ticking in, aiming to stop it before its hand makes a complete turn.

Each clock you destroy opens up some breathing room and returns extra seconds to your run's master timer. If you fire too late, though, the swarm of ticking clocks catches up and gets right on top of you.
stick-arena-3d: Stick Arena 3D is a three-dimensional platform game with forty levels to work through. Along the way, you fight off enemies and explore a strange, mysterious world. The game looks striking, and its stages demand careful planning, so every step takes some thought.

Move your stickman with the arrow keys or the W, A, and D keys, and press the left mouse button to shoot. Action, shooting, and adventure all blend together here, which makes it a good fit for players who enjoy stick figure battles in 3D.
color-brawls: Color Brawls is an online multiplayer first-person shooter where you face off against rivals using bright colors to win. You can start playing right away on any device, and the fast-paced action moves through a variety of locations, each with its own unique challenges. It's a lively pick for anyone who wants an engaging experience wherever they happen to be.
On a computer, move with WASD or the arrow keys, shoot with a left-click, and press Tab to pause. On mobile, drag the joystick to move, swipe the screen to look around, and tap the button to shoot.
emoji-memory-find-a-pair: Flip over the cards and look for matching pairs of identical ones. When two cards that differ are revealed, they turn face down again automatically, which gives you a brief moment to remember where they were. A level ends once every pair on the board has been uncovered. Two more modes let you set records against other players: one for time, one for the fewest moves.

To reveal a card, click any face-down card with your mouse, or tap it if you're on a touchscreen. Opening two cards that match counts as one pair found. If they don't match, both flip back over, and then you can go on to open the next ones.
sky-block-bounce: Sky Block Bounce takes place high in the air and asks you to think ahead as well as move quickly. Your goal is to hop from block to block until you reach the teleporter. The catch is that no two blocks act the same way. Some vanish after a single jump, while others hold firm through two or more, so you need to plan which route will get you there.
To move, use the arrow keys or the WASD keys. Every jump counts, so take your time and pay attention to how each block behaves before you leap.
requiemnoire: RequiemNoire is a quick reflex game that rewards both speed and precision. Hit the right arrow keys before the clock hits zero to refill your timer and dodge a lethal blade. A single mistake or a delayed response pushes you nearer to losing. Keep your attention sharp, respond fast, learn every sequence, and see how long you can last in this tense test of reactions and timing. Use the arrow buttons to play.
shadow-node: Shadow Node is an idle hacking game set in a gritty cyberpunk world. You break into networks and servers to mine data fragments, climbing from small local systems toward government databases and a secret network that is only whispered about online.

Click EXECUTE to mine Data, then spend it in the Market on bots and power-ups that raise your hash rate automatically. Quests and Syndicate Ops in the Network earn you Intel and Dark Matter. Watch your Trace Level, since reaching 100% locks you out. Prestige to reset for permanent multipliers. Your scripts keep gathering data while
commando-adventure-assassin: Commando Adventure Assassin is a 3D war shooter that you can play offline. The mission is tough because you are the last soldier left from your force, so the fight rests entirely on you. Your job is to take out enemies before they take you out, and to win back your land so you can become a hero. The enemy already knows about your mission and is waiting for you, fully alert.

You get a variety of weapons to pick from, and good luck will go a long way toward completing the mission. Shoot with the left mouse button, aim with the right, and reload with R. Press C to change the camera, and Esc to pause whenever you need a break.
3d-bubble-rush-game: 3D Bubble Rush is a relaxed action game that works well when you have extra energy to burn. It offers a safe, cartoonish kind of combat, so you can let off steam without anything serious happening. Wave after wave of irritating foes keeps coming toward you, and your job is to push through every one of them.

Keep moving forward and stay bold as you cut your way through the crowd. The controls are simple: click with your mouse or tap the screen to play. This 3D battle game sits in the action category and carries tags for avoiding threats and fighting, making it a fit for younger players.
mirrors-and-rays: Rotate the mirrors to bend the beams and brighten every corner of the board. Mirrors and Rays is a calm puzzle game built around lasers, made for mobile play. Your job is to light up all the bulbs scattered across the field. Tap the mirrored pieces to change their direction, then watch a bright beam glide along the path you have set up, charging each cell in turn. It is a quiet space to unwind, and each puzzle you finish feels like a small step toward a clear, settled mind.
spartan-fruits: Spartan Fruits is a platform adventure where the heroes must push through hazards to reach each new stage. Every level hides chests full of coins, and opening them unlocks prizes. Gems are also scattered about, and collecting them opens up fresh fruit types to play as.

Move with A and D or the left and right arrows, and jump with W or the up arrow. Tap G to attack, or hold it to hurl your sword forward. Hold F to throw the sword so you can hang from it and swing, using A, D, or the side arrows. While hanging, press W or Up to climb higher and S or Down to drop lower.
pixel-paintball-ruins-fun: Pixel Paintball Ruins Fun is a multiplayer shooter played across arena-style maps. Five game modes are on offer, among them gun game, wave survival, and an offline mode in which you must clear more than 30 levels. Team deathmatch is the default setting, so you can team up with friends from anywhere in the world.
When playing offline, you start with three guns, and as your rank climbs
cartoon-football-games-for-kids: Masha and Bear have put together a fresh set of soccer games for young players. Each one is a free kick challenge starring familiar cartoon faces, so kids can take shots with characters they already know. Tiger and other pals are also on the field, waiting for a little player to crown them champion.

The gameplay centers on kicking a ball and bouncing it, which keeps the action light and playful. You control everything with a mouse or by tapping the screen. These kickball matches suit little players who enjoy football and their favorite animal characters.
shot-factor: Shot Factor is a free, relaxed online shooter made for boys. The gameplay centers on classic shooting, but it opens with a twist: before any battle, you upgrade your gun. By using tiles marked with numbers, you raise the gun's power, and your aim is to build the largest possible result from the numbers in your formula. A stronger weapon lets you wipe out enemies more quickly.

You can play with a mouse or by tapping the screen. Each challenge asks you to combine the tiles well, and you can show off your skills to everyone along the way. Keep working through the challenges and see how far you can go.
happy-unicorn-magic-leaps: Guide a small unicorn through a series of stages, flipping and leaping toward the goal. Timing matters, because you must dodge obstacles and tricky challenges along the way. Another unicorn waits on the far side, and that is the one you need to reach.

The controls are easy to pick up. On desktop, press and hold the left mouse button, drag to aim and set your jump power, then release to leap. On mobile web, touch and hold anywhere on the screen, swipe to aim and adjust your power, then lift your finger to leap. Magic Leaps blends arcade, adventure, puzzle, platform, and physics elements into a playful experience for players of all ages.
wheel-chair-driving-simulator: Speed and accuracy both matter in this driving simulator. You start by steering a wheelchair toward a waiting ambulance, weaving past obstacles along the way without bumping into them. Once you climb aboard, the job shifts to driving the ambulance itself, threading through heavy traffic so you can reach the destination as fast as possible.

The game offers realistic handling and tough scenarios, so every move needs care. Each scenario tests your focus. Your goal is to deliver patients safely to where they need to go. Both the chair and the car are controlled with the W, A, S, and D keys.
block-sculptor: In Block Sculptor, you take on the role of a sculptor working in three dimensions. Each block you face has a colorful figure locked inside, surrounded by plain gray cubes. Your task is to chip away every gray cube while leaving the colored shape untouched. As you advance, the figures grow larger and there is less room to slip up, so each choice matters more.

Spin the block by dragging with a finger or mouse, and look at it from all sides before you act. Tap a gray cube to clear it, but avoid tapping any colored cube, since that counts as a mistake. Once the last gray cube is gone, the hidden figure is revealed. Fewer mistakes earn you more stars and coins, so take your time and plan each move carefully.
furry-kung-fu: Players step into the shoes of Catsei or his apprentice, Kung Fu Cat, in this cartoon-style brawler with bright, cute visuals. The goal is to land as many punches on your foe as possible while steering clear of balls, comets, flames, and pots hurled your way. Battles pit you against waves of pigeons, rats, aliens, crocodiles, and other critters. Collect coins to unlock new player skins and weapons, pick up weapons mid-fight, and unlock every available map.
Controls are simple: use the arrow keys on a PC, or swipes and taps on the screen of a smartphone. Two characters are available, and the memorable cast is designed to keep you entertained.
santa-run: Santa has misplaced his presents, and it's up to you to guide the emu as it gathers them. Along the way, the emu has to keep the gifts safe from hazards such as mischievous elves, a menacing deer, rogue cookies, and snowmen. The whole game is played with the mouse.

This action adventure asks you to stay alert and keep the presents out of harm's way while you move through each stage. Every bit of progress depends on how well you handle the threats that come your way. Give it a try and see how many gifts you can bring back safely.
bowling-3d-2022: Bowling 3D 2022 lets you compete against your friends or join 1v1 duels with rivals from around the world. Among bowling titles, it is a highly regarded pick for fans of the sport. Choose from a range of distinctive balls and aim to knock down all ten pins in one roll for a strike. Player-versus-player battles reward winners with prizes.

As you level up your character, it grows stronger, so you can win more matches and work your way toward the top of this free multiplayer game. You can play with touch on a mobile device or with a mouse.
super-kick-boxing: Super Kick Boxing is a fast arcade fighter full of punches, kicks, dodges, and powerful special moves. In the ring, you need sharp timing and must manage your stamina as you face tough opponents on the road to the championship. It is easy to pick up but hard to master, and every bout is packed with knockout action.

On a computer, move with the arrow keys or A and D, punch with Z, kick with X, and throw a super kick with V. Hold C or the Up arrow to block, press S or the Down arrow to dodge, and use P or Esc to pause. On mobile, steer with the on-screen pad arrows, tap A to punch, B to kick, D for a super kick, and X to block. For best results, strike within 0.35 seconds of a block or dodge.
hungry-caterpillar: A hungry caterpillar had been storing its fruit on a tree branch, but a spider knocked everything down into a trapped underground area. Your job is to guide the caterpillar through that space and gather the fruit without getting harmed. Tricky traps fill the path, so one wrong move ends the game. Interesting quests keep the challenge fresh and stop things from getting dull.

The game pairs high-quality graphics with a small file size, so it stays light without losing visual detail. Controls are very simple, which makes it easy to start playing right away. On Android, on-screen touch buttons steer the character, while on PC the arrow keys move it up, down, left, and right.
clickdom: Clickdom is a clicker game where every tap moves your kingdom forward. Walk around your realm and tap the villagers who roam about to gather coins. Head to the shop to purchase lottery tickets, then scratch them open to uncover magical scrolls or new buildings. Scrolls can be spent in the upgrade menu to make your kingdom stronger and open fresh perks.

Buildings can be placed across your realm to keep progress running on its own. A Tower gathers villagers for you, a Bell Tower draws in more residents to tap, and a Laboratory produces coins over time. Keep tapping, keep buying tickets and spend your rewards carefully. Your aim is to unlock every upgrade and grow the kingdom to its largest possible size.
woof-foow: Woof Foow is an idle merge puzzler built around dogs. Combine young pups to discover new breeds and grow your pack over time. As you move through the levels, your companions transform into stronger and more distinctive dogs. The game has a light, friendly feel with endless upgrades to pursue, and it suits casual players and dog lovers. The artwork is pleasant to look at, and the cast of dog characters gives the game plenty of personality.
Gameplay is easy to pick up but still leaves room for planning. Tap or click a dog to select it, then drag it onto another
space-worm: Space Worm puts you in charge of a worm that grows longer as it cuts through crowds of hostile ships, with turrets sprouting along its body. Each time you gain a level, you can add new turrets and modules, and you can collect relics that shape how a run unfolds. The action takes place across four space arenas, where bosses await.

Soul Shards earned along the way go toward your lasting Worm Cortex, so later attempts can last longer than earlier ones. Beat the final boss and the game carries on in an endless survival mode. The worm moves forward on its own. Press A or D, or the left and right arrow keys, to turn, or point the mouse to aim and steer. On a touchscreen, drag the floating joystick. Destroy foes, grab experience and gold, and pick your upgrades. Enter pauses or resumes, and Tab brings up the map.
nightshade-archary: Nightshade Archery is a 2D adventure that blends archery with platform jumping, all wrapped in a smooth simulation. Obstacles stand in your way, so stay alert. You can only jump on top of your arrow to reach higher tiles. Each level brings a different set of enemies, and your arrows can attack and destroy them. Be careful, though: if your body touches an enemy, you die.

Your main goal is to find and collect the key in each level. Once you have it, head to the door at the end of the level to finish it. On Android, tap the left arrow on the left side of the screen to move left and the right arrow just beside it to move right. The jump button sits on the right side of the screen.
impossible-monster-truck-3d-stunt: Impossible Monster Truck 3D Stunt is a single-player racing game played on extreme ramps. Each track is designed to feel impossible, and your job is to steer your truck and hit the pedal to reach the finish. After every level, you earn money that you can spend on new trucks. Each truck has its own stats and performance, so you can pick the one that suits you.

The real draw is the stunts. Your truck can roll in mid-air, smash bumper-first into the ground, flip over, land upside down, or perform a barrel roll while flying, along with many other impossible tricks. The game offers plenty of reasons to keep coming back. Steer your Monster Truck with the W, A, S, and D keys.
obby-pizza-delivery: You play as a pizza courier working through a maze, collecting orders from the pizzeria and bringing them to residents. Renting a scooter helps you move faster, and choosing a bigger bag lets you carry more orders at once, so you can deliver more pizzas on each trip.
As you complete orders, your reputation rises, and that progress opens new zones with more residents to serve. The controls are simple, so the game is easy to pick up and start playing.
driving-test-simulator: Step behind the wheel of this parking-focused driving simulator, which runs on a 3D game engine. On every level, your goal is to bring the car into the marked parking spot without any crashes. With a good number of stages to work through, it puts your driving skills to a real test.
It is a solid pick if you enjoy car racing games and want a more careful challenge. Use the WASD keys to move your vehicle. Take it slow, keep your nerve, and see how cleanly you can park each time.
jelly-merge-dooper: Jelly Merge: Dooper is a puzzle game where you nudge colorful jellies around a board. Your goal is to combine every jelly into a single one, which completes the level. Each stage asks you to think a few steps ahead, since obstacles can block movement in certain directions and you need to find a way around them.

Movement is simple: swipe up, down, left, or right to slide the jellies. Your score improves when you use fewer moves, so the challenge is to reach the merged result in as few swipes as you can. Take your time, test different routes, and plan each move before you make it.
arrow-parking: Arrow Parking is a calm puzzle game that rewards careful planning. Your job is to lay down arrow tiles so the car has a clear path, steering it all the way into the garage. As you move on, the parking puzzles grow harder and need more thought.

To play, you simply drag arrow tiles and drop them onto the board, whether you're using a mouse on a desktop or your finger on a phone or tablet. Each tile you place shapes the route the car will follow, so it pays to look a few steps ahead before you commit.
brick-breaker-unicorn: Brick Breaker Unicorn is an action game in which you launch candy balls at a wall of sugary bricks. You swipe your finger across the screen to throw each ball, then watch it smash into the candy blocks. The game is filed under bubble shooter and shooting, so players who enjoy those styles will know what to expect.
Controls are handled with a mouse. Each throw is a chance to clear more of the candy wall, so take your time lining up your shots and enjoy the unicorn theme as you play.
sand-tap-sorting-puzzle: Sand Tap! is a sorting puzzle where you tap sand out of different sand objects, gather each color, and drop it into the matching boxes above. Think ahead before every move, use your temporary slots wisely, and try not to fill them too soon. The rules take little time to pick up, but each new stage adds more colors, shapes, and layouts that put your logic and sorting skills to the test.

The controls are simple, and the soft visuals and smooth sand movement make each level easy to settle into. Watch out for moves that block your next step. When a stage gets tricky, boosters are there to help you keep going. Many sand shapes, cute objects, and bright designs keep things feeling fresh, and while the game is easy to start, it takes real thought to master.
shoters: Shoters is a mobile shooting game with an action mode and a multiplayer option, so you can play on your own or with another person. It is a safe choice to enjoy with your family. As you keep playing, you unlock new characters to choose from.

Getting started takes only a mouse click or a tap, so there is little to learn before you begin. The game is tagged for 2 Player and Action, which points to its two-player support and action focus. It makes for a straightforward session whether you play alone or with a friend.
acox: Acox is a straightforward platform game in which you guide a character through a series of obstacles. Your aim is to clear all 30 stages by getting to the finish point in each one while steering clear of hazards. Finishing a stage opens the next, so you move steadily through the whole collection.

Movement is simple. Use the WASD keys or the arrow keys to control your character on a computer. If you are playing on a phone or tablet, the on-screen touch controls handle the same actions. The game is filled with platform-style challenges, making it a good pick for anyone who enjoys the Arcade and Platform genres.
kitty-kate-caring-game: Step into a charming cat-care adventure where you learn what a stylish feline needs each day. Several stages await, but before you begin, you have to figure out what your kitty requires. Icons lined up along the bottom of the screen act as your handy guide, and each one stands for a key need of your pet. Enjoy the experience!
Controls are simple: click with your mouse or tap the screen to move through the game.
night-order-pick-and-pack: Night Order: Pick & Pack is a puzzle where you collect the items requested in each night order and then pack them into a box. First, tap the items shown in the order on the shelf, and each choice lands on your tray. Once the tray holds everything you need, move on to the packing stage and drag each piece from the tray into the box.

If an item won't fit, try another spot or rotate it with the rotate button. Pieces that don't suit the box can go back to the tray, and you can restart the whole layout. When you're unsure what to do next, use a hint for help. The more compactly you fill the box, the more stars you earn.
tie-dye-explosion-of-color: This colorful dress-up title is made for girls who love vivid hues and fashionable clothing. You spend time with two friends, the self-assured Kaylee and the gentle Marie, in a world full of bright color. Together they aim to create striking looks using the tie-dye technique, moving from traditional prints to modern trend ideas.

Mix and match shades and patterns to craft one-of-a-kind, memorable portraits of both characters. You choose makeup, outfits and accessories, and your imagination guides every decision. When you are happy with your creation, you can save it as a PNG image.
draw-glow-christmas: Draw Glow Christmas invites you to sketch festive scenes using glittery brushes. No art experience is needed, because the game guides you through each picture one stage at a time. Along the way, you learn to draw Santa Claus, an elk, a Christmas tree, presents, and several other holiday subjects.

Coloring is part of the fun too, so you can add color to your drawings. Follow the drawing steps to finish your artwork, then share the joyful results with your friends. Controls are simple: use your mouse or tap to play.
dead-zone-sniper: Dead Zone Sniper puts you behind a sniper rifle with the job of taking down every hazmat soldier roaming a polluted zone. The clock is always ticking, so you need to stay alive and clear the area before time runs out to unlock the following stages. Move with WASD, fire with the left mouse button, and hold the right button to zoom in for a steadier aim. Press R to reload and P to pause whenever you need a breather.

This is a single-player 3D shooter in the action and shoot 'em up style, with a gun-focused, lethal feel. Each round rewards careful aiming and quick decisions as you pick your shots across the contaminated ground.
sponge-strike-clean-and-smash: Sponge Strike: Clean & Smash is a physics puzzler where every shot uncovers part of a hidden picture. Pull back to set your angle and power, then let go so the sponge glides across the board and scrubs away the dark coating beneath it. Walls can bounce it back, and along the way you can smash colorful block towers, spin moving obstacles, set off bombs, press buttons, and grab coins.

Clear each objective to reveal the full picture, then use your rewards to unlock new sponge skins. On a computer, hold the left mouse button, drag backward to aim, and release to fire. Click again when the sponge slows down to stop it and get ready for the next launch. On mobile, pull back with a finger, let go to shoot, and tap once the sponge loses speed to halt it and line up another shot.
connect-monsters: Connect: Monsters is a playful online puzzle title that sharpens your thinking through matching monsters. You can challenge friends to post the best scores on different platforms, and it suits quiet moments at home as well as time spent on the go.

Every link you form pushes your score higher. As the play area fills, things get harder, so you need to think ahead to keep from running out of room. When the highest-ranked monster makes a connection, it disappears and earns you a bonus. Be careful, though, because a crowded field ends the round. Aim, drop, and link your monsters to beat your friends' totals.
hexa-village-sort-and-match: Bring a village back from the mist in this cozy puzzle game. Hexa Village pairs two calm puzzle modes. In Hexa Tower, you place colored hexagon stacks on a board, letting matching neighbors join together, and a stack that grows tall enough disappears. Fill the goal bar before the board runs out of room. In Hexa Number, you trace a line across nearby number tiles so their total hits the target, and longer lines earn more points. Bomb, Shuffle, and God Hand power-ups are there when you get stuck.

Earned stars help you clear the fog, chop the forest, and rebuild houses, the forge, and bridges. On the village map, tap to build or upgrade, and drag to look around. Everything works with a mouse or touch, and the hand-painted fairy-tale world comes into view as your village takes shape.
towers-505: Towers 505 is a browser tower defense game where you stop hordes of monsters from breaking through your line. The enemies pour out of a dark purple abyss and march along a winding orange path. Each wave calls for new tactics, upgrades, and well-placed towers, such as wooden crossbows and stone fortifications. Spend gold coins to build and improve, and click to cast fireballs or frost blasts
angry-birdz: In this physics-driven hypercasual arcade title, you fling an assortment of odd, feathered characters at elaborate structures that mischievous pigs have built. Each bird has its own special power, so choosing the right one at the right moment matters. Your goal is to knock down the pigs' defenses and recover the eggs they stole.

Levels are varied and the puzzles are smart, giving a new spin on the old slingshot formula. The game is meant to keep players of every age entertained for hours. Controls are simple: slide your finger to aim, then release to shoot at the green pigs.
grand-escape: Grand Escape! is a free online platform game that you can play in your browser. Your character moves through a world full of odd creatures, and each stage presents its own challenges to overcome. The game is built for vibrant levels where you guide your hero toward success, and it runs on both computers and mobile devices.

Movement is handled entirely with the arrow keys, and your character can jump a second time while in the air. Pressing the K key restarts the current level from its beginning. Progress is saved when you open the level selection menu after completing a level.
fishy-trick: Fishy Trick is a clicker-style adventure with a funny, hypercasual feel. You guide a young fish as it grows and tries to survive the many hazards lurking in the sea. Start by picking the fish you like best, then set off through different oceans and rescue as many fellow fish as you can along the way. Watch out for dangerous sharks and other sea creatures, and grab the stars you come across to unlock new skins and boost your score.

Because the adventure never ends, your aim is to travel as far as possible while recruiting more allied fish to join you. Swim by pressing the right mouse button, which also keeps you from falling. On a phone or tablet, simply touch the screen to swim.
deep-freeze-fishing: Deep Freeze Fishing is an arcade game set under a frozen lake, where you catch fish by flicking your lure upward through their mouths. Sweep through several fish at once for a combo that multiplies your coins, then swipe up to the surface to bank your catch.

Across five zones, each deeper than the last, your goal is to fill the Fishdex, which tracks 60 species to collect. Finishing a zone's Fishdex opens its Zone Challenge, where schools of fish test your sharp aim. Beware mutant fish: tap one to scare it off, because flicking into its mouth makes it swim away with your lure.
baker-city-family-bakery: In this cozy cooking sim, you start a family bakery and aim to make it the most-loved place in town. Tap the oven and other generators to gather flour, dough, and other ingredients. Drag two identical items together to combine them into a richer treat. Serve customers by collecting what their orders call for, earning coins and fame along the way as your reputation grows.

Growth comes next. Open the city map to earn each neighborhood's trust, then send out delivery vans on timed runs and beat the clock. You can build new branches, upgrade your vans, and enlarge your bag so the kitchen keeps running faster. Decorate the shop, collect recipes, finish daily goals, and climb the weekly bakers' leaderboard.
feed-them-all: This casual shooter puts you in charge of a brave fighter who launches fruit at hungry monsters. Keep moving around the arena, slip past incoming attacks, and line up your shots on enemies. Wild bosses are tough, so you need to stay nimble as you work your way through each stage.

On a computer, use WASD or the arrow keys to move, or steer with the on-screen joystick using your mouse. On a phone or tablet, touch and drag the joystick to get around. To clear a level, fire fruit to feed the monsters, defeat every enemy, and survive the boss fight at the end.
crazy-counter-attack: Crazy Counter Attack is a browser-based title that mixes fast action with tactical puzzles. You fire at foes and flip through somersaults to dodge their chase. Gold earned along the way can be spent in the shop on different offensive guns. A spin wheel and a check-in feature also help you unlock extra game items.

To shoot, click the mouse or tap the screen. The game puts your problem-solving skills to the test and keeps your brain busy. As you move forward, new obstacles and enemies gradually appear, so each stage becomes more complex than the one before.
count-masters-crowd-runner-3d: Count Masters: Crowd Runner 3D blends puzzle solving with arcade running. You guide a group of 3D stickman characters along a track built on platforms. Your job is to get as many of them as possible across the finish line. Along the way, you pass through special gates that bring extra members into your crowd. Steer by sliding your finger, and work your way through every level.

The game is a fun mix of quick reflexes and simple strategy, so think about which gates will grow your group the most. Each stage asks you to keep your crowd moving and make smart choices about where to go. Good luck, and see how far your team can get.
railway-traffic-jam-untangle-the-trains: If you enjoy simple but challenging puzzles built around cars and trains, this one may suit you. Fans of mobile hits like Traffic Escape and Parking Escape will likely feel at home. The rules are easy to pick up, so you can start solving right away. Bright, pleasant visuals give the whole experience a relaxing feel.

The game offers various levels, and the difficulty rises as you go, so things stay interesting. You can play online wherever you are, on any device. A leaderboard lets you compare your results with friends and other players. Your goal is to sort all the trains. Each one shows the direction it can travel, so tap them in the right order to solve each train puzzle.
ninja-dash-cozy-tactic-puzzle: Ninja Dash: Cozy Tactic Puzzle is a free online game that mixes stealth with careful thinking. You play as a ninja strategist who takes down enemies by planning each step ahead and making smart use of the surroundings. You can play it on either a phone or a computer.

On a computer, hold the right mouse button and move the mouse to turn your character, then press the left button to act. Use the A and D keys or the mouse wheel to rotate and zoom the camera. On mobile, control your player with the screen buttons, swipe left or right to rotate the camera, and pinch to zoom.
single-stroke-line-draw: Single Stroke Line Draw is a puzzle game where your job is to trace one continuous line through every dot on the board. You cannot repeat any route, so each move needs careful thought. The rules are simple and easy to pick up, yet the game is designed to exercise your brain and help improve your IQ. The early levels are gentle, and the difficulty rises steadily as you progress.

There are two modes to choose from. Classic Mode offers a laid-back pace, while Timer Mode adds a clock for players who enjoy a tougher test. To finish a level, connect all the dots without going over any path twice. It suits anyone who likes brain teasers, logic games,
big-smash: Aim a cannon that fires tennis balls at stacks of cubes standing on a table, then knock the whole pile over. Each stack is built from stone, wood, ice, jelly, cardboard, or puzzle pieces, and every material reacts in its own way when struck.

Winning means toppling the entire structure rather than smashing every block. Find the cube that holds everything up and knock it free. You need to clear 69 towers to finish, and TNT blocks appear along the way, so watch for them. On a computer, click and hold, drag to pull back your aim, then release to fire. On a phone or tablet, tap and drag to aim, then lift your finger to shoot.
zigzag-snow-adventure: You guide a springy red ball as it rolls down the side of a snowy mountain. Your goal is to keep moving and avoid crashing into trees, rocks, and other hazards for as long as you can. The farther you travel, the faster you go, and the tougher the path becomes.

On a computer, press A or the Left Arrow key to move left, and press D or the Right Arrow key to move right. On a touchscreen, swipe left to move left or swipe right to move right. It sits in the Arcade, Adventure, and Skill categories, so it fits players who enjoy testing their reflexes.
slinger: Slinger is a puzzle game played on small grid boards, with a sparse, modern look. Your goal is to guide the little red square through each stage by clearing a path for it. Every yellow key on the board must be collected first. Once you have them all, the yellow door unlocks, and you can slip through it to win.

Each level pairs simple mechanics with a layer of subtle complexity, all presented in a clean, focused design. To move, drag with your mouse or use your finger on a touch screen to slide the blocks and the red square into place. Because the controls are this direct, the puzzles stay easy to pick up while still asking you to think a few steps ahead.
happy-zoo-mahjong-triple-match: Happy Zoo: Mahjong Triple Match is a relaxed mahjong-style puzzler built around lining up three matching animals. You send uncovered animal tiles from a stacked pyramid up into a tray. Whenever three identical animals gather in that tray, they combine and disappear, making room for more. Tiles hidden under others stay blocked until the ones on top are removed, and clearing the whole pyramid completes the level.

The game offers 130 handmade levels spread across four zoo themes, along with 30 animal species to discover and daily quests to finish. A collection album grows as you keep playing. If the tray fills with animals that don't match, you can rescue the run with coins, and undo and shuffle boosters help when you get stuck. Controls are simple: just tap or click with a mouse or touch screen, no keyboard needed. It's easy to start and tough to stop playing.
miami-super-drive: Miami Super Drive is a single-player racing game set on the streets of Miami. Its next-generation graphics make the city look sharp, and you can choose from seven supercars, each highly detailed. Your goal is to collect every checkpoint in order to win.

Steering uses the WASD keys, while the Space bar handles braking. Press C to switch between camera views and get a different look at the road ahead. The game gives you a straightforward way to tour the city at high speed in 3D.
fisherman-fortune: In this fishing adventure, you help Henry, a fisherman determined to bring a good catch home to his wife, Erica. Your ability is put to the test as you push through hard moments and work your way to the next stage. The game runs with smooth, simulated movement, letting you explore the sea and the several types of fish that swim in it.

Your goal is to gather as many fish as you can. Larger fish are worth more, so chasing them brings bigger rewards. Keep an eye out for obstacles, because a single bomb drifts through the water. Grab it by mistake and Henry dies, ending the game. On Android, tap anywhere on the screen to collect fish; on PC, click with your mouse.
balls-pixel-art: In this arcade game, you pop balloons against a painting until the whole picture breaks apart into individual pixels. Every image is built from tiny blocks, and your task is to take them apart one at a time. Success depends on cleverness and careful aiming, since each shot needs to count.
