A cannon launches a charge of 16 balls, and you have 15 attempts to wipe out the entire artwork. Breaking a picture completely is what lets you pass the level. The game offers several images to demolish, appealing graphics, and a large number of levels to finish. It suits mobile play and has a retro flavor.
jetflash-skyport-trials: Take the wheel of a jet-powered stunt car and race along tracks suspended high in the sky. Ramps send you into the air, where you must also manage your fuel. Reach the finish gate while staying on the course. Timed runs and stunt rings earn credits, which you can spend on upgrades in the garage.

On a keyboard, W and S accelerate or pitch in flight, A and D steer or bank, Space fires the jet, and Shift brakes or reverses. On a phone, use the left joystick, the JET button and the separate BRAKE button. Pause lets you retry from a checkpoint. This
wobble-run: Wobble Run is an arcade balance runner aimed at players 13 and up. Your stack of wet-ink cans moves forward on its own through three locations: Sky Docks, Slice Street, and Hive Yard. Every can you collect makes the stack taller, but a single tip ends the run, so staying upright is what really matters.

Each of the three worlds holds 16 levels. Use touch, drag, or the mouse to steer into the lean and recover, or on a desktop press A and D or the arrow keys. Catch every can and coin in a level to earn a Perfect. Cosmetic items unlock as you play, with no accounts and no in-app purchases required.
race-through-traffic: Race Through Traffic is a single-player arcade driving game set on a crowded highway. Pass other vehicles and keep going for as long as you can. The farther you travel and the bolder your passing moves, the higher your final score climbs. Pick a mode, keep your eyes on the lanes, and aim to beat your previous best with every run.
Steer with on-screen buttons or your keyboard. The A or left arrow moves you left, while D or right arrow moves you
connect-the-balls: Connect the Balls is a tough puzzle where you link objects of the same color together. Each level demands careful thought, so you will want to plan your moves rather than rush. The puzzles grow steadily harder, keeping your logic and problem-solving skills busy from start to finish.

Everything is controlled with a mouse click or a tap, so you can jump in on a computer or a phone. The colorful board is pleasant to look at, and the challenge is the kind that is easy to pick up and hard to put down.
dumb-riders: Dumb Riders lets you build your own tracks or try out levels that other players have made. You pick one of three riders and work your way toward the finish line while trying to avoid getting killed along the way. Steer with the arrow keys, press Z to jump, and tap X to brake. On a phone or tablet, the touch controls handle the same actions.

The game mixes racing with a silly, lighthearted tone, so expect plenty of goofy moments as your rider tumbles through each course. Whether you prefer designing a challenge for others or testing a stranger's creation, there is always a new layout to tackle. Keep an eye on your rider's survival, because a single bad landing can end the run.
garage-boss: Begin with one small repair bay and watch it expand into a complete garage, a supermarket, and a gas station, all linked together in a single shared world. Your workers keep the business earning while you are busy elsewhere. Your own actions still matter, though: tapping cars to fix them, walking over to workers to gather what they have earned, and reaching for new areas are what keep the numbers rising.

Controls are simple. On a computer, use the W, A, S, and D keys to move. On a touchscreen, touch anywhere and a joystick will appear that tracks your finger as you drag. Open the phone menu whenever you want to recruit staff or buy upgrades that improve your garage, supermarket, and gas station.
stickman-soccer: Stickman Soccer puts you on a large pitch where stick figures play a football match. You take aim, then kick the ball toward the other side. Hold the left mouse button to aim, and let go to take your shot. The ball zips quickly toward the opponent's net, and when it finds the back of it, a loud "GOAL" sound rings out.
Matches last 90 seconds, and whichever side scores the most goals in that time takes the win. If you would rather play with someone, switch on the 2 PLAYER mode and face a friend.
luca-jigsaw: Luca Jigsaw is a cartoon puzzle game made with kids in mind, especially girls who love the Luca movie and enjoy putting puzzles together. The game features twelve pictures taken from the film, so fans can rebuild scenes they already know. It is meant to be a light, cheerful way to spend time while following what happens to Luca.

Playing is simple: use your mouse or tap the screen, and move the pieces into place until each picture is complete. It is listed as a matching puzzle built with HTML5 and aimed at kids. Whether you are a longtime fan or someone curious about the film, the twelve images offer a relaxed chance to put the story together one piece at a time.
fireball-and-waterball-adventure-4: In this 2D adventure for two players, you guide Fireball and Waterball, a pair of brothers who each carry a special power. Waterball can freeze water into ice, while Fireball can set wood materials ablaze. Over time the siblings have become the best of partners and often set out on journeys side by side.
Your job is to call your partner quickly and accompany them through each adventure. Player one uses A and D to move and W to jump. Player two handles movement and jumping with its own set of keys.
basketball-tap: Basketball Tap is a quick, easygoing sports title where timing is everything. Each tap you make sends the ball soaring, and you need to hit the right moment to launch it upward and pull off powerful dunks. To play, touch the screen to steer the ball and aim it at the hoop. Keep your shots accurate and you will rack up points.

It is built for short sessions on a phone or tablet, and it fits the arcade and skill categories well. Tapping is the only control you need, so anyone can pick it up in seconds. Try to land clean baskets and see how many points you can score.
wheel-of-bingo: Wheel of Bingo has two parts. In the first, you spin the wheel to line up with bingo numbers, choosing either 15 or 25 spins. Colored marks show where your numbers sit. Each match scores points and gives you a colored ball for the second part, and completing a bingo line awards many extra bal
keepie-uppie-paddle-pong: Keep the ball bouncing in this arcade sports game. Every hit earns you coins, and the more you bounce, the closer you get to your next achievement. Collect coins and unlock achievements as you go.

Dress up your paddle with a favorite character to show off your own style. The game is all about soaking up the fun, having a few laughs, and finishing your collection. To steer on a computer, move your mouse. On a mobile device, slide your finger across the screen.
happy-swing: Happy Swing is a free online game where good timing decides everything. Your goal is to locate a missing soul, and getting there means swinging and leaping with careful accuracy. Each move needs planning, since one slip can throw you backward along your route. Progress comes from mastering the rhythm of your jumps and swings.

On a computer, press the mouse button to jump and to grab hold of swing points. Let go at the right instant to keep your momentum and keep moving forward. On a phone, tap the screen to leap and latch onto swing points, then tap and release at the correct moment so you don't fall. You can enjoy the game on both phones and computers.
sledding-hills: Sledding Hills is a whole world of sliding games spread across different settings. You can head through sandy deserts, snowy mountains, and wild forests, sending your sled down the hill in each one. New levels unlock as you progress, and the coins you collect let you upgrade your ride and personalize your adventure. Secret characters are also waiting to be unlocked.

Between runs, mini-games test your skills, and your best scores can land on the leaderboard. On a computer, use the on-screen joystick to push the sled at the start, press A to move left, and press D to move right. On mobile, the on-screen joystick handles both the starting push and the turns. More maps, mini-games, and content are on the way.
nomad-guardians: Nomad Guardians asks you to sketch a route with your finger, leading a herd of sheep, goats, horses and camels to a ger before wolves, bears, snow leopards and eagles can catch them. Drag from the animals to the ger, and any creature close to your line will trail along behind it. Your ink is limited, so keep your strokes short and smooth, and steer around rocks and trees. Save enough animals before time runs out.

Sixty levels take you across the steppe, taiga, Altai mountains and Gobi desert. A daily challenge and a survival mode give you more to try. Tap an eagle or a fox to chase it away. Extra coins can be collected in the barn.
baby-taylor-doll-cake-design: Jessica's birthday is just around the corner, and her best friend Taylor wants to give her a big surprise. Jessica loves dolls and lemon cakes more than anything, so Taylor decides to bake a delicious and beautiful doll cake just for her. Baking it is not simple, though, so it's up to you to help Taylor get the cake made.

This game for girls and kids mixes cooking, decorating, and dressing up. Everything is played with a simple mouse click or tap, so you can jump right in. Each step brings the cake closer to being ready for
baby-taylor-housework-day: Taylor's mother is planning a thorough clean of the house, and Taylor decides she wants to help with the housework alongside her. Because Taylor is still a little girl, many of the jobs are too much for her to tackle alone. Your role is to lend a hand and work through the chores with her.
Later, it's also time to bathe Taylor's dog, Oreo. You help Taylor give him a bath in this cheerful little game. Controls are simple: a mouse click or a tap is all you need to play.
radial-3d: Radial 3D casts you as a black hole drifting through space. Your goal is to absorb celestial bodies, avoid the dangers in your path, and ascend through the cosmos. Every object you swallow and every hazard you dodge shapes how far you can climb.

This free game can be played on mobile devices as well as on a PC, so you can jump in from many different setups. Controls are simple: move the mouse to steer your black hole. Its 3D look and arcade pace test your skills from start to finish, making it a fitting pick for anyone who enjoys space-themed games.
elves-bros-vs-zombies: Two elf siblings find themselves in a fantasy land overrun by the undead. Packs of zombies wander the streets and have already injured many of the locals. The brothers have been asked by the townsfolk to clear out the monsters, and you can join them in this two-player adventure to take on the task side by side.

Player one moves with A and D, jumps with W, and drops a bomb with S. Player two handles movement, jumping, and bomb dropping on their own set of controls. Bombs are the key tool here, since they can wipe out zombies in a single blast. Team up with a friend, time your jumps, and work together to make the fantasy world safe again.
crash-control: Crash Control asks you to keep traffic moving smoothly through crowded intersections. It's a free browser game that runs online, and you only need taps to play. A tap on any car either halts it or sends it on its way. Your job is to prevent collisions at crossroads and where trains pass through. Trains won't slow down for anyone, so you'll need to plan each move carefully.

The 3D visuals give the busy streets a lively look. As you clear each level, tougher traffic setups open up to test you further. Can you keep things under control as the pressure builds? Give it a go and see how sharp your reflexes and planning really are.
police-gangster-chase: Take the wheel of a police car and head into a bright, busy city where your job is to track down dangerous gangsters. Chase your targets through the streets, dodge other traffic, and pick up badges along the way. Finish action-filled missions before the clock runs out. The car responds quickly to your input, and the challenge grows across several levels.

Keyboard players can press W or the Up Arrow to speed up, S or the Down Arrow to brake or reverse, and A, D, or the Left and Right Arrows to steer. On phones and tablets, on-screen steering, accelerator, and brake buttons handle the same actions. Menus work with a mouse or touch. Give the game one click first so it is ready to take keyboard input.
hex-planet-idle: Hex Planet Idle combines role-playing adventure with survival idle gameplay, and it features three-dimensional models. You guide a stickman warrior as it explores the entire universe, gathering resources and opening up new zones along the way. Stepping onto the glowing white light areas reveals which resources the next zone will ask for. Move close to any item and it is collected automatically. Unlocking every zone is well worth it, since resources are abundant throughout the game.
To play, just click with your mouse or tap the screen.
cinderella-dress-up-girls: Cinderella needs your help getting ready for her big night. She is heading to the ball, where she hopes to meet Prince Charming, but first she visits a salon that serves princesses, fairies and new brides for a makeover. Your style talent and sense of fashion will come in handy as you work on her look.
Dressing up princesses is a fun way to try out the life of a fashion designer. Controls are simple: use your mouse, or tap the screen if you are playing on a touch phone.
parking-car-crash-demolition-multiplayer: Parking Car Crash Demolition Multiplayer is a racing game where you smash up vehicles. You can battle smart AI-controlled cars or take on other real players, either in multiplayer matches or through the campaign. Any car you spot on the maps is fair game for destruction. Before you start, you can personalize your ride with a paint color, Nitro, and a choice from 45 wheel designs and 12 car models. There's also a police option, complete with flashing lights.

This is the first version of the game, and more titles in the same style are planned for later. Controls are simple: use W, A, S, and D to drive, press C to switch camera views, and move the mouse to look around. Press Tab to see the player scoreboard.
night-racing-drag: Night Racing - Drag takes you onto after-dark roads for quick car battles. You can tune and personalize your vehicle, then line up for drag races where speed and well-timed gear shifts decide who crosses the line first. Your aim is to fight your way to the front of the pack.

Get off to a strong start and change gears at the right moments to keep your car accelerating. Watch out for traffic and rival drivers along the way. Grab the coins scattered across the track, and earn more for finishing in higher places, which lets you improve your garage.
mega-ramp-car-stunts: Mega Ramp Car Stunts is a tough, hard-core take on stunt driving that feels like a true simulation. Its tracks are packed with 3D obstacles, so every run calls for focus. You can take on 10 levels in Stunt Mode and 16 levels in the Giant Ramp mode. Whether you hit the checkpoints or skip them, your goal stays the same: bring the car safely across the finish line.
Save up enough green diamonds and visit the garage to buy better vehicles. Playing is simple, since you only need to click the mouse or tap the screen to get going.
winter-battle: Winter has settled in, and Santa Claus and the Grinch are clashing across a snowy field. Gift boxes tumble from the sky, and your job is to catch as many as you can. Some of them are dangerous, so watch what you grab. Collecting boxes makes your character grow larger, but grabbing the wrong one makes you shrink.
Keep an eye on the clock, because the player with the highest score when time runs out takes the win. Move around with W
money-factory-earn-a-billion: This strategy and puzzle title puts you in charge of a factory that produces money. You refine how it operates, get past obstacles, and unlock new levels while raising your income. It runs on any device, and it gives you a chance to build wealth and show what you can do.

Early on, making money comes easily, but keeping your factory growing takes creativity and a bit of luck. Buy boosters and fill the field to multiply your earnings. To handle them, keep a finger or mouse button held down to slide a booster around, then let go to drop it in place or merge two identical ones. Your goal is to become a billionaire.
braid-hair-design: In this hair styling game, a character named Brad is getting ready for a night out with Ken. She has already chosen a lovely dress and a pair of fashionable shoes, yet she cannot decide how to wear her hair. That is where you come in: your job is to create a hairstyle that suits her outfit and the occasion. Along the way, the process is meant to be fun.

Controls are simple, since everything works with a tap or a click. Use those actions to shape her look and see how the final style turns out. Keep experimenting until the result feels right for the evening ahead.
unblock-taxi: Unblock Taxi is a sliding car puzzle with a taxi theme, and it has a style all its own. It belongs to the taxi games family, but its tile-based setup puts the focus on puzzle solving. Players move vehicles around the board one slide at a time.

If you enjoy roll and unblock games, this tile puzzle should feel familiar and fun. Everything is controlled with a mouse, so there is nothing complicated to learn. Listed under Puzzles, it is aimed at both boys and girls who want a tile challenge.
grass-cutting-mowing-game: Take the wheel of a powerful mower in this relaxing lawn-mowing simulator. Your job is to trim the grass across different areas so they stay neat and attractive. You can roam the surroundings, mowing with care while you work through your tasks. The controls are simple: every button is selected with a mouse click.

The experience is calm and smooth, and each pass across the turf is pleasing to watch. Steer carefully, keep the mower on course, and complete each task. It is a gentle game for anyone who enjoys tidy outdoor work in a peaceful setting.
bomber-quest: Bomber Quest is a 3D puzzle game where you plan each move through demanding levels. Your main tool is explosives. You defeat monsters with bombs, but every blast carries risk, so you have to weigh your choices carefully before you act.

On a computer, move with the WASD keys and plant a bomb with the Spacebar. On a phone, use the virtual joystick to move and tap the bomb icon to plant one. The game is free to play on either a phone or a computer.
funny-virtual-pet: Picture having a marmot as a pet in your everyday life. Mister Grumpy is one of the crankiest and most amusing marmots you could meet. You can enjoy playing pranks on him and trying out silly games that bother and irritate him. Still, your marmot needs daily attention, so you feed him, give him a bath, and tuck him into bed. Waking him up is its own fun challenge, since you can do it in the silliest and most irritating ways, and he will grumble and t
tile-stack: Tile Stack suits anyone who likes puzzles and strategy. The rules are easy to pick up, yet the levels get harder as you go, so it is easy to keep coming back. Time slips away quickly while you work through the levels and fit tiles together.

Tiles drop in from the top of the screen. To play, click or tap a tile to pick it up, then send it toward another tile by following the arrow on screen. Matching tiles stack and vanish, and each one you clear adds to your score.
bus-jam-pick-up-them-all: Bus Jam is a traffic puzzle game set inside a crowded parking lot. Your goal is to help the bus escape, and to do that you must move the other vehicles out of its way. Every move takes some planning, so think ahead before you act. The game is built for puzzle fans who enjoy traffic escape challenges.

The colorful buses each collect passengers that share their color, so your task is to help every bus pick up all of its passengers. On desktop, click a bus to select it and send it into the slot. On mobile, tap the bus to do the same thing. Choose your order carefully, because each bus needs a clear path before it can leave.
snake-io-war: Snake io war mixes a bright pop look with the timeless rules of the old snake game. If you enjoy lively, fast-paced action, this arcade title lets you battle your way across the arena and crown yourself its champion. Gather tasty snacks and different power-ups, defeat your enemies, and grow into the biggest worm of them all.

Each run begins with a small snake, and your goal is to eat food to get longer on every level. Twist your snake through piles of food while trying to beat the scores of other players. The real challenge is seeing how long you can survive.
rotcalypse-idle: In this satirical idle tycoon, you turn low-quality online material into cash. You begin with simple RotToks and work your way up to a worldwide Brainrot VR machine. Nothing needs to be figured out here, so you just keep growing your operation. The aim is to wear down the internet completely, all in pursuit of endless figures.

Start by clicking to kick off production and build your first funds. Spend what you earn on Business Upgrades and Skill Improvements to make each action pay more. Open new Business Branches to spread out your holdings and lift your earnings cap. Hire Managers so production runs automatically, turning your clicks into a fast passive stream. When you are ready, a Prestige Reset wipes your progress in return for lasting Prestige Multipliers that help you reach far higher milestones on your next run. The game serves as a dark mirror of social media's pull, and it is a way to pass the time.
slendrina-must-die-the-house: Can Slendrina actually be killed, or is she bulletproof? Your goal is to collect eight pieces of a picture, and those pieces reveal the truth about her. This horror first-person shooter is built for fans of Slenderman Must Die and Let's Kill Jeff the Killer. You can use three weapons: a gun, a shotgun, and the DeathSword for melee attacks. The game features 3D graphics.
Movement uses W, A, S and D, while the mouse controls where you look. Left click
fruite-swipe: Fruite Swipe is a matching game where you drag across colorful fruit tiles to link identical ones and solve puzzles as you go. Each successful match moves you forward and unlocks rewards. The game offers hundreds of demanding stages, sharp visuals, and smooth gameplay. It is a match-3 title built to keep you entertained for hours.

Challenge friends to see who can get further, search for concealed treasures, and learn to use helpful power-ups. To play with a mouse, hold the left mouse button over a fruit, drag to connect matching fruits, and let go to make the match. On a phone or tablet, do the same thing with your finger.
ship-mazes: Set sail into fresh sea battles, where you stand as the final defender of the lighthouse. Plan your moves carefully to sink every enemy vessel, ride out the waves, and claim victory. Steer past jagged rocks, work with the currents, and take down rivals with skill.

Pick up bonuses that drop during fights to upgrade your boat and gain an edge. Guard the lighthouse so the enemy fleet cannot bring it down. Play alone or team up with a friend for a two-player naval showdown. Player one moves with W, A, S, D or the green on-screen buttons and fires with the Spacebar. Player two uses the arrow keys or blue on-screen buttons and fires with the Num 0 key.
voxel-master: Voxel Master blends puzzling and building in a 3D setting. You piece together volumetric models from colored blocks with the help of hints. Or you can head into an open space and build whatever you like.

Puzzle mode offers hundreds of levels that grow harder as you go. Each one shows a finished model, and your job is to rebuild it one block at a time. Sandbox mode gives you free 3D modeling on grids of different sizes
goal-quest: Goal Quest mixes soccer with puzzle solving in a 2D game where you guide a soccer ball. Stone cubes block the way, and touching them breaks them apart to open a path to the goal. Scoring is not the only aim, since each level also hides three stars that you must collect to unlock new challenges. Work through intricate mazes, use physics to your advantage, and explore visually stunning environments.
It is a one-player game with a strong puzzle focus. On desktop, press the left mouse button to explode cubes. On mobile, touch the screen and pop any cubes you like.
mine-jump: Mine Jump is an online arcade game built around leaping from one spot to the next. Each jump can reveal hidden treasure on an alien world, and you can enjoy it on any device. It asks you to combine quick reactions with careful thinking, so it keeps things from getting dull.

Your goals are to gather slugs, strengthen your hero, and track down the far edge of the planet. Tap the left or right side of the screen to hop diagonally onto the next cell. If you slip up, you can step back and try again. Keep moving forward to uncover every secret this mysterious planet holds.
dinoz-city: DinoZ City is the sequel in the DinoZ series. Dinosaurs have seized the metropolis and are holding people captive. Your mission is to rescue the scientists as well as the police officers. This version also lets you destroy the reptiles while driving armored vehicles. You can tackle the rescue alone or team up with a friend in two-player co-op.
Stay alert, because the clever dinosaurs set traps along the way. Defeat the boss at the end to claim victory. Player 1 moves with W, A, S and D, attacks with F, drops bombs with H, jumps with G
connect-words-2026: Connect Words 2026 bundles many word puzzles into a single game. You join letters from the circle at the bottom to form words and fill in the crossword grid. Other challenges include finding hidden words and tackling special tasks, with more than 1,500 levels to work through. When you are stuck, tapping the light bulb gives you a hint.

The game mixes several kinds of mini-games so sessions don't feel repetitive. It is meant to train memory, focus, and vocabulary, and its difficulty rises gradually, so newcomers can follow along while seasoned players still find it engaging. Because you set your own pace, it suits quiet moments at home or time spent away from home. Fans of crosswords, word searches, and brain teasers should find it a handy everyday pick.
pixel-kart: Pixel Kart brings back the blocky, old-school feel of kart racing from consoles of years past. Tiny pixel cars take to the track, and you can compete against a friend on either a mobile device or a desktop. Each race runs for five laps, and the winner is decided on the fifth lap.
Controls are simple. On touch devices, you play by touching the screen. On a keyboard, use the A and D keys or the left and right arrow keys to steer your car around the course.
3d-football-mania: Kick off a brisk 3D soccer match where the pace rarely slows. Your aim is to find the net more often than your rival before the two-minute clock runs out. You can win back possession by tackling opponents, and the game works for a quick break or a playful contest with a friend.

Movement uses the arrow keys. Press V to pass, SPACE to shoot, and SHIFT to sprint or tackle. Pressing F hands control to the teammate closest to the ball. On mobile, a joystick steers your player while PASS, SHOOT, SPRINT and CHANGE buttons appear on screen.
jelly-dash-3d: Jelly Dash 3D is a casual arcade runner where you guide a small, cute jelly along a three-dimensional course. Your little blob sprints across bright, multicolored lanes, dodging hazards and picking up prizes along the way. The track stretches into the distance, so you can always see the path ahead.
Each stage has a time limit and a goal number of people you must surpass before the clock runs out. Beat that target and you move on to the next
ashfall-industries: Ashfall Industries is a playful atompunk idle management game set in a run-down wasteland that you slowly turn into a busy industrial frontier. You begin with a modest Rustwater Pump and gather Scrap to fund a growing collection of bigger projects, including greenhouses, salvage yards, radio stations, caravan routes, drone workshops, refineries, and the Horizon Reactor, 15 original operations in all. Each one can be upgraded to pay out more and cycle faster. Quirky Crew Chiefs can take over production, and Retrofits boost output, speed, costs, and the rewards from Lucky Finds.

When your empire is ready for a reset, Reclamation lets you start over and earn Reactor Cores. Those Cores unlock permanent Recovery Protocols that give every rebuild a head start. Controls are simple: click with a mouse or tap on a touchscreen to run operations, collect rewards, buy upgrades, and move through menus.
heavy-crane-simulator-online: Take the wheel of a truck carrying a heavy crane in this 3D driving and parking simulator. It recreates the real process of transporting containers, so every job feels practical. Several skins can be unlocked as you progress, and you can follow the tips provided while working through each level to finish every mission.

Use the WASD keys to move the truck and the arrow keys to operate the crane. Press Q or E to switch between views. Each level presents its own set of missions, so keep working through them one by one until they are all complete.
super-car-wash-3d: Super Car Wash 3D lets you turn muddy vehicles into sparkling ones in a bright, colorful three-dimensional wash. You start by rinsing off the mud, then cover the panels and windows with suds. Next, you scrub each area with care, and finally you polish the car until its paint gleams.

You can play with a mouse or by tapping a touchscreen. Pick the tool you need and use it to clean the car. Each washing step has to be finished in order, and on-screen prompts show you what comes next. It is a casual simulation game tagged for kids and casual players alike.
steveman-and-alexwoman: Steveman and AlexWoman need an escort on a perilous journey from the house to the portal. Time is short, so you must hurry to reach it. Monsters and sharp thorns line the path, and poisonous water waits for anyone who slips.

Leap over the monsters and keep your footing to avoid the water. Move with WASD or the arrow keys, and use the double jump when available. Mobile players can use touch controls instead. This 2D action adventure arcade game supports one player or two players.
art-n-ball: Art'N Ball combines classic tennis with a 3D platform adventure. You keep a large Earth-ball in play with your racket as it rolls down a winding gallery hallway that narrows and widens with the mood. A boss waits at the end of every three Acts. Watch the ball's path closely so you can strike it
squad-goals-soccer-3d: Squad Goals is a straightforward 3D soccer match that can quickly turn into a wild ball scramble. There are no cards, fouls, or offside calls. Slide, tackle, dribble, kick, shoot, and score using just one finger. The first side to score wins the match, and you can climb the ranks as you play.

On touch screens, tap or click and drag to run, release to slide, and use the same controls to shoot or pass. Keyboard players use the arrow keys or WASD to run, let go and press SPACE to slide, and shoot or pass as well. A one-finger on-screen joystick is included, with mouse and keyboard support. Upgrade character traits, level up, buy cosmetics for your character, ball, and stadium, complete daily quests for coins, and collect daily and hourly rewards. Choose between ARENA and TEAM vs TEAM modes.
highway-traffic: Highway Traffic puts you behind the wheel for fast drives along a busy road. Your aim is to dodge the other cars without crashing while gathering as many points as you can. You can choose from a range of car models, and the single-player side offers four different game modes. The scene can change across three weather options, and the car controls feel smooth.
Controls are simple. Press W or the up arrow to accelerate, and use A and D or the left and right arrows to steer. Hold the space bar when you need the handbrake.
sort-puzzle: Sort Puzzle is a calm game designed to ease tension while sharpening your thinking. Each level offers a range of mini-games, from sorting tasks to arranging school supplies, and some of them include obstacles that make you rethink your moves. Every level brings its own mix of challenges, so you rarely repeat the same task.

The art is pleasing to look at, and the controls feel smooth and easy to pick up. Solving each small puzzle relies on quick taps, drags, and connections as you travel through the adventure. Along the way, the game aims to build your mental skills and creative abilities while helping you relax.
the-fill: This free puzzle game asks you to link a set of blocks in the style of connect-the-block titles. The rules are easy to pick up, yet it is hard to stop once you start. It doubles as brain training, since your mind gets more active the longer you play. It suits a commute, a quiet moment before bed, or any spare minutes in your day.

Your goal is to cover every block with a single path. Swipe or drag across the board without lifting your finger or mouse, and never backtrack, because each block must be filled in one go. If a layout feels too tough, tap the hint icon to reveal part of the solution. Hints are free too. As you complete puzzles, higher difficulty levels unlock more challenging ones.
squid-the-game-mobile-version: Squid Game Runner throws you straight into an obstacle course, and your journey starts today. Put your abilities to the test as you join a variety of Squid Game programs. Your goal is to reach the finish line ahead of your friends. These straightforward, enjoyable games are made to be played anywhere you happen to be, so you can take them along wherever you go.
The controls are simple. Press and hold the left mouse button, then drag upward to get your runner moving through the course.
echolocation-shooter: Echolocation Shooter is a first-person action game set in a dark, horror-style level full of glowing neon foes. You cannot see anything until you fire, since every blast sends out a soundwave that reveals the world. Your goal is to eliminate the neon enemies while surviving endless waves of many different monsters, pushing deeper into the horde as you go.

Your arsenal includes soundwave rifles, laser cannons, and grenades, and you can upgrade your gear along the way. On desktop, move with the arrow keys or WASD, jump with Space, and dodge with Shift. Left-click interacts with the environment and generates soundwaves, while right-click activates and fires your weapon. Switch weapons with keys 1 and 2 or the mouse wheel, throw grenades with 3, and press P for the menu.
coffe-merge-house: In Coffee Merge House, you run a coffee shop by combining ingredients into tastier drinks, snacks, and café treats. Clicking a generator produces a fresh item, which takes up an open square on the board, so you need to watch the limited space. When the board fills up, join two matching products to create a better one. Moving further along a merge chain unlocks more advanced creations.

Customers arrive with a request showing the product they want and the coins they will pay. Once you have made that item, drag it from the board onto the customer to complete the order. Earn coins from these sales, use
love-sheep: Love Sheep is a laid-back puzzler you can pick up wherever you are. You guide wobbly, jelly-soft sheep through physics-based levels, where squishing and stretching are part of the challenge. The puzzles reward careful thinking, yet the mood stays calm and cozy, so you can take your time.

Control is simple: tap, swipe, or drag to steer your sheep across each stage. Bounce over gaps, and slide or stretch your way through narrow passages. Watch out for traps and tricky obstacles, and keep your sheep on the safe route until you reach the end point. Along the way, you earn rewards that unlock new sheep and custom items.
emerland-solitaire: Step into Emerland, a realm at the center of a fairytale of old magic. Powerful mages are competing for the Source, the wellspring of the ancient magic held within the Cards. You travel through mysterious lands alongside a brave Knight, a skilled Elven archer, and a mystical Sorceress, all working to bring down the wicked Dark Master.

Along the way, you solve card puzzles and gather matching combinations to clear levels that are difficult and varied. Completing them earns rewards and lets you recruit new assistants. The game is simple to pick up, and everything is controlled with a mouse click or a tap. Its toughest trials wait at the card table for anyone ready to master the secrets of Solitaire.
tcg-shop-maps-toys-and-comics: Step behind the counter of your own shop in this trading simulator. You can sell trading card game packs, figures, comics, snacks, collectibles and toys, all aimed at hobby fans. Your daily duties include serving customers, restocking shelves, running the cash register and delivering orders. As business picks up, you can upgrade your premises, unlock new products, hire staff and keep expanding.

The title blends simulator, clicker and business game elements, so it should appeal to fans of economic strategy, management and TCG cards. Controls are simple and the graphics are bright. Click goods to place them on shelves, open new departments to improve the store, and create your own merch, comics and food. Your goal is to become the best merchant and grow your shop into a legendary marketplace. It is free to play online in your browser.
wedding-style-and-royal-style: Adella and Rebecca are big fans of regal fashion and beautiful gowns, and now they're ready to switch up their look by trying royal-themed outfits. This theme comes in two different versions, but the pair can't settle on which one suits them best. Your job is to step in and pick a lovely dress for them so they can finally make their choice.
The game is a dress-up and makeover title with a princess flavor, and it's controlled with a mouse click
zip-zap: Zip Zap is a physics puzzle game with a stripped-back, minimalist look. You steer odd little mechanical creatures through detailed stages using just one input: a press and a release. Pressing pulls the hinges in your contraption tighter, and letting go sets everything in motion. Momentum builds, parts tip over, and gravity pulls at the structure as it moves.

To clear a stage, touch every white circle or guide your creature into the targeted zones. Doing so completes the level and moves you forward. Since each tap and release is your only control, plan every move with care.
flag-merging-game-puzzle-game: Test your knowledge of world flags in this puzzle game. There are 75 demanding levels, and you can play in eight languages: English, Russian, French, Turkish, Spanish, German, Italian, and Portuguese. Flags fall from the top of the screen, and you can pick them up with your finger and drop them anywhere you like. Merging two identical flags clears them, and you need to clear the marked targets before the timer runs out to move on.

Each level is harder than the last, and along the way you can unlock 12 mysterious achievements. The coins you earn from merges can be spent on two upgrades: one increases the coins you get per merge, and the other gives you extra time at the start of each level. Your results depend on planning, speed, and quick reflexes. Plan carefully, move fast, and see how many of the hidden achievements you can uncover on your way to becoming a flag master.
rush-rivals: Rush Rivals is an arcade racer where you weave through traffic on the highway. Pick up useful power-ups along the way and leave rival drivers behind as you chase the lead. Coins you collect can be spent on garage upgrades, and each win can open a new ride to drive. The races come in a growing series, and you can play with your device held upright or turned on its side.

Controls are simple. On a touchscreen or with a mouse, press and hold to speed up, then drag left and right to steer. On a keyboard, hold Space or Enter to accelerate and use A and D or the arrow keys to steer. Your job is to dodge other cars, grab p
my-virtual-dog-care: Care for an adorable puppy in this gentle pet game made for young animal lovers. Its bright, charming artwork and smooth animations create a cozy, relaxing mood, and the simple gameplay is easy to pick up and hard to put down.

Your pup has four needs: a nap, a meal, a bath, and some playtime. Real puppy care takes a lot of effort, but here it is far less demanding. A few quick taps are all it takes to keep your virtual dog happy and healthy. Use a mouse click or a tap to get started.
catoom-bomb-barrel: Catoom! - Bomb Barrel swaps the usual running for rolling along inside a barrel. Rolling alone won't build the speed you need, so you toss bombs and let their blasts push you forward. Every move depends on good timing and planning. The game is packed with enemies to blow up, and you can break apart tiles to carve paths through the terrain.

Tap and release the screen to throw a bomb at the spot you touched. On PC, WASD controls your movement. On touchscreens, drag anywhere to bring up a virtual joystick. Set off a bomb close to your barrel to speed it up, then keep rolling yourself so the momentum carries on after the blast. It tests your reactions, resourcefulness, and problem-solving, and the physics works in your favor.
puzzle-fight: Puzzle Fight mixes a relaxed block puzzle with battles. You drop colorful shapes onto a grid and complete full rows or columns to clear them. Each cleared line gives experience to Fluffy, a small but brave cat knight who sets out to rescue her sister. The stronger she becomes during the puzzle, the easier she finds the foes ahead, including wolves, snakes, fire dragons, and powerful bosses.

Your journey leads through enchanted forests, scorching deserts, and icy mountains. Along the way you collect weapons, fuse them to gain fire, ice, or lightning power, unlock talents, and open chests full of loot. Shapes are simple to learn, but mastering them takes skill. Move blocks with a mouse or your finger, and win each puzzle before you run out of room. Between puzzles, Fluffy fights automatically. Spend coins and crystals on chests, manage your weapons and amulets in the inventory, and use the x2 button to speed things up.
parking-supercar-unlocking-skills: Parking a supercar well takes accuracy, practice, and a real feel for what the car can do. For fans of these fast machines, parking is more than a routine chore. It is a chance to show smooth handling and full command of the wheel. Parking Supercar Unlocking Skills is an Action browser game set in a forest, built with Unity3D and WebGL.
You drive with W, A, S, and D, and press Space to brake. Along the way you learn how to slip through tight spaces without trouble, and each run lets you prove your mastery of the supercar.
shikaku-puzzle: Shikaku is a brain-teasing logic game built on straightforward rules that still lead to tricky answers. Your job is to cut the board into pieces that are either rectangles or squares. Every piece must hold exactly one number, and that number tells you how large the area of that piece should be.

To make a piece, press the mouse button, drag across the grid, and let go to draw a rectangle. Work through the board until every section fits its number and the whole grid is covered. Think carefully about where each cut belongs, because the puzzle rewards careful planning.
gungame-poligon-battle-royale: GunGame Poligon Battle Royale hands you a collection of 24 guns, and every one of them delivers powerful fire. The mode you select determines your opponents, since you will face bot soldiers in some modes and enemy zombies in others. Beyond those, there is a survival game where you can take on friends from all around the world.
Movement is handled with the W, A, S and D keys. Your mouse lets you look around, aim, and fire. Press 1 or 2 to change your gun.
cargo-path-puzzle: Cargo Path Puzzle is a free puzzle-platformer built to challenge your reasoning and footwork. Its tricky stages include bottomless voids, blocks that crumble underfoot, bouncy trampolines, slippery ice slides, and blocks that send you in a set direction. To finish a stage, gather every key so the exit portal switches on, then step into the portal.
stumble-boys-party-royale: Stumble Boys Party Royale is a lively multiplayer game built around a set of messy mini-games. Players face off in rounds, and each round picks a different challenge at random, so you might be racing to a checkpoint, hunting for the correct door, or balancing on the final platform left standing. The bright, colorful visuals keep the pace quick and the mood silly. It suits anyone who likes competitive casual runners, short bursts of play, and goofy party-style rivalry. Try to last as long as you can.
Controls are simple. On PC, use WASD to move and the Space bar to jump. On mobile, tap the on-screen buttons to get moving.
assemble-factory-puzzle: Assemble Factory Puzzle is a free online game where you work through tricky production line challenges. Your goal is to set up a range of specialized machines in the right order so they produce flawless car components. Each stage presents a different arrangement, and the difficulty rises as you move forward. Along the way, you will need to plan ahead, sharpen your reasoning, and act quickly when a choice is required.

Every level asks you to design and fine-tune a complicated production line, deciding where each machine belongs. Because the puzzles keep getting harder, you will need clever fixes and fast calls to keep things running smoothly. Success depends on placing the equipment in the correct sequence, so every move matters.
stick-master-teleport: In this shooting title, you scale walls, hurl knives, and blink right up to your foes so that a single strike takes each one down. Your goal is to eliminate targets before they spot you, building a reputation as a stealthy ninja on the road to becoming a true assassin. The game blends stealth puzzles with teleport-based action, and you can pick from knives, swords, boomerangs, and clubs to suit each mission.

Expect challenging puzzles, many tricky stages, and combat with its own unique mechanics. On PC, hold the left mouse button and drag the cursor to aim, then release the button to shoot. On mobile, press a finger on the screen, slide it to aim, and lift it off to
city-taxi-simulator: Pick up passengers and carry them to their destinations in City Taxi Simulator, a 3D driving game with modern-looking graphics. Your job is to steer the cab through the streets, dropping off each fare where they need to go. Stay composed behind the wheel, but keep your speed up to get the job done.
Use the arrow keys to drive and the Space bar to brake. The game sits in the Action category and carries tags such as Car, Driving, Parking, and Simulation.
pizza-maker-cooking-2: Pizza Maker Cooking 2 is a kitchen game split into three parts. In each part you make a different style of pizza: Kawaii, Pirate, or Vampire. Choose the style you like most and work your way toward becoming a chef.

Every step of making the pizza is done with professional tools, so you can enjoy the process from start to finish. When your pizza is finished, you can top it off with a nice garnish. This casual game is for one player, and you play it with a mouse click or a tap.
tank-war-machines: Build your tank from dozens of parts, then team up with friends for 3 vs 3 player-versus-player battles. Pick the tank you like best, test different tactics, and aim to come out on top. Drive your tank onto the battlefield and go after an enemy target that keeps moving.

Four modes are included. Deathmatch is a classic, high-energy shooting contest. Brawl centers on gathering resources. Battle Royale continues until only one tank is left standing. Tank-O-Ball turns football into a match played with tanks. When facing tanks or airplanes, watch the angle of your attack, since the damage you deal changes with each approach.
origin: In this platform arcade game, your goal is to collect the orbs so the door unlocks and you can escape. Move and jump with the arrow keys or WASD. Every black orb must be gathered before the door activates, so make sure you find all of them. Steer clear of the spikes along the way.

Later levels add a double jump, which you trigger by pressing W or the up arrow twice. Your chances to use it are limited, and the JUMP counter in the upper left corner of the screen shows how many remain. Press R to restart, Q to return to the menu, or M to mute the sound. On mobile, on-screen buttons handle all the controls.
minimight-fantasy-rpg: MiniMight: Fantasy RPG is a relaxed role-playing game set in a fantasy world. You guide a modest band of heroes through floors crowded with monsters. Recruit warriors, archers, mages and other combatants, then sharpen their gear, teach them fresh abilities and take on tough bosses. Your job is to assemble the party, gather treasure, strengthen your characters and push further into the adventure.

Begin by picking your companions and heading out. In battle, choose a hero and order either a basic attack or a special skill to take down foes. When a fight ends, collect gold and items, then use them to upgrade equipment, purchase new skills and hire stronger fighters. Defeat a boss to open the next floor and keep moving forward.
karate-girl-vs-school-bully-game: Sophie has been picked on by bullies at school for far too long, and now she must face the biggest bully of all. Your help lets her tap into her girl power and train as a karate fighter. Together you can show the bullies who is in charge, and she can work her way up to a black belt. With you by her side, she might even become a karate master.
Nobody will call Sophie a nerd again, at least not without regret. Anyone who wants to test that will get a taste of what karate can do.
bouncepop-quest: BouncePop Quest puts you in control of Jumpo, a bright, jelly-like creature, as it moves through more than 150 lively stages. The path is full of hazards, and you will need to hop across platforms that slide back and forth. Along the way, you gather stars and take down foes while discovering fresh landscapes.

The game runs on both smartphones and desktop computers, and it is free to play. To jump, press, hold, then let go. If the double-side jump option is turned on, tap left or right to leap in that direction. Expect many hours of entertainment.
brawl-guys: Pick your fighter and step into the arena, where the goal is to finish each game's objective before anyone else. Every match you win earns you a trophy, and collecting more of them shows how strong a player you are. Keep stacking them up to see how high you can climb.
Controls are simple. Use the WASD keys to move around, then click to aim and shoot. On a touch screen, tap controls handle both moving and shooting instead.
hook-king-runner: Hook King Runner is a physics-based runner set in wild obstacle courses. You tap to throw a hook, then hold to keep swinging forward. Let go at just the right moment to leap off the rope and carry on past the obstacles. Ragdoll physics shape how your character tumbles, and the levels vary, so your agility and timing are tested in different ways.

Watch out for traps and enemies as you go, and collect the coins you pass. Keep your momentum building so you can reach the finish line. Precise timing and steady control are the keys to becoming the Hook King.
space-guardian: Defend our planet in this shoot-'em-up, where the goal is to stop an alien invasion before it reaches home. Your lasers switch on by themselves whenever an enemy floats above your ship, so you can focus on steering. Watch the red health indicator in the top-left, since every hit drains it, and your score drops too, with the amount depending on how hard you were struck. Music and sound effects have their own volume controls, and you can silence everything if you prefer.

On a desktop, click wherever you want the ship to go and it will glide to that spot. You can also fly with the WASD keys, the arrow keys, or a gamepad. To launch rockets, press Space, J, K, or Left Ctrl. Your aim is to defeat every alien invader in the game.
prasino: Prásino is a compact survival title set in a world buried under garbage. Trees are the only thing keeping the air breathable, so every sprout matters. Gather magic seeds, plant them to bring life back to barren patches of land, and open up new routes as you advance. Watch out, though, because creatures born from the waste roam the area and will try to halt your progress.

Manage your breath wisely, because it is your lifeline. On a desktop, use the arrow keys to move, press Z to plant a tree, and press X to attack or break loot boxes. On mobile, drag the on-screen joystick in any direction, tap the plant button to grow a tree, and tap the attack button to hit enemies or break loot boxes.
snakes: In this calm puzzler, you steer several multicolored snakes so that every open square on the grid ends up covered. The game offers a large collection of hand-built levels, each with a fresh layout, and the designs grow more demanding the further you go. Visuals are kept simple and uncluttered, so your attention stays on the logic rather than on anything flashy.

The plain art style and playful soundtrack suit players of any age. You can take your time with each board, or race a friend to see who finishes a puzzle first. Whether you enjoy brain teasers, logic challenges, or easygoing casual titles, this one should appeal to you.
trial-bike-racing-clash: Trial Bike Racing Clash puts you on a motorcycle built for tricks, with a rider ready for risky courses spread across several zones. You can race solo in single-player mode or challenge a friend in two-player mode. Against a friend, you can play both mission and skills modes, and either way you race to the finish line. Before you head out, you can customize your bike and rider, and the game offers a range of levels to tackle.

Speed matters here, but so does staying in one piece, since avoiding crashes is just as important as being quick. Player 1 moves with W, A, S and D and jumps with the spacebar. Player 2 moves with the arrow keys and jumps with the L key.
stair-ball: Stair Ball is a quick, stripped-back arcade game where you guide a small ball up a never-ending set of brightly colored steps. Every stair hides danger, with deadly spikes covering the surfaces and tricky gaps waiting for a careless move. One mistake ends the run, so you need to stay sharp the whole way. Collect the shiny rubies you pass to unlock new balls and styles. Chain together "perfect" moves to build huge combos and beat your high score. As you climb, everything gets faster and harder, so timing, reflexes, and focus are what matter most.

Controls are simple. Touch and hold the screen to move the ball left or right across the stairs, then release and press again to switch direction quickly. Your goal is to keep climbing without touching a spike. Some stairs carry black cone spikes, and hitting one ends the run instantly. Study the pattern and move early rather than at the last second.
magic-solitaire: Solitaire gets a fantasy twist in this one-player game. You can settle in wherever you like, whether that's a tavern table beside a warm fireside or the shade of an oak tree near a rushing waterfall. Either way, you lay out your card arrangements in a cozy, relaxed setting.

A fairy helper travels with you and offers guidance as you explore this enchanted world. Along the way, you'll uncover mystery and secrets from long ago. To play, simply click with your mouse or tap the screen.
pop-it-jigsaw-game: Pop It Jigsaw blends two kinds of puzzling: knocking out bubbles and piecing together jigsaws. You can choose from over 20 cartoon pictures, and each one comes apart into pieces that fit back together with ease. Every level you finish rewards you with gold. You can spend that gold to open new backgrounds and skins.

The game is played with a mouse or by tapping the screen. It runs in your browser and works well for kids who enjoy matching games with bright, playful artwork. Pop each bubble, assemble the picture, and see what new looks you can unlock along the way.
tap-the-crop: Tap the Crop is a bright, straightforward idle clicker. You start by growing wheat, then move on to corn, carrots, tomatoes, and other crops, all the way up to the rare Golden Crop.

Tapping is how you collect crops, which you can spend on upgrades and automations. Farmers and machines keep earning while you are away, and stacking taps into combos gives you bigger clicks. Watch for events, since they bring big boosts. Once your farm is valuable enough, you can sell it to buy meta upgrades, then climb toward the legendary Golden Crop.
car-stunt-games-mega-ramps-3d-2021: Mega Ramps 3D 2021 is a free racing game centered on daring car stunts. You face a steady stream of challenges on tracks that seem almost impossible, with ramps that launch your vehicle into the air. A large garage holds plenty of sports cars to choose from, and nitro gives your car a burst of speed on the ramp tracks. Stunt driving fans may enjoy it more than other offline titles, and it works well as a car simulator for anyone chasing a thrill.

Each mission is designed to sharpen your driving and stays interesting and challenging throughout. Complete them all safely to prove you are a stunt master, and aim for new records through careful, technical moves when hurdles appear. Customization lets you upgrade your car, and winning the car racing championship is the final goal. The game is controlled with the keyboard.
us-army-car-transport-truck: You take the wheel of a powerful military transport truck in this free browser game, playing an elite Army driver with a crucial job. Your task is to haul a range of military cars, jeeps, and armored vehicles across tough ground. The route winds through rugged landscapes, from treacherous mountain regions to dense forests and arid deserts. The graphics are designed to look lifelike, and the setting is built to draw you in.
Your goal is to deliver every vehicle safely, which means handling both the load and the rough terrain with care
cube-smash: Cube Smash is a free online game where you break apart bright, colorful cubes. Strategy plays a part, since you choose which projectile to use each time. The currency you earn can be spent on upgrades, and you can unlock several kinds of ammo. The challenges grow tougher as you move forward.

You can play on a phone or a computer. On a touchscreen, the screen handles both aiming and shooting. On a desktop, the mouse offers precise control and lets you select your projectiles. Each setup keeps the battles moving.
boba-blast: Two players go head to head, each facing a big, spinning ball made of colorful boba pearls. You fire matching pearls at your ball so they pop in chain reactions and gradually chip the cluster away. The first player to clear their ball wins. If both players run out of shots, whoever has popped more pearls takes the victory. Shots are limited and the clock keeps running while your rival plays too, so careful aim matters. Pearls of the wrong color bounce off instead of popping.

Aiming begins when you press anywhere on the play area. Dragging upward gives you a higher, lobbed arc, while dragging downward makes a flatter, line-drive throw. Dragging left or right steers your aim. Release to launch the shot along the glowing trajectory. To switch shots, tap the Swap balls button, which trades your active ball with the preview ball beside it.
kindergarten-school-teacher: Kindergarten School Teacher is a study game made for toddlers and young children. Little learners can practice their ABCs, work through math equations, and add artwork to charming pictures. Teachers in the game lend a hand with the daily educational tasks that young players face. Many free learning games are included, covering everything from math to painting your own drawings, along with matching activities and appealing puzzles.

Controls are simple: click the mouse or tap the screen to play. The game blends learning and entertainment in one place, so young players can build early skills while enjoying themselves. Each activity keeps lessons playful and easy to approach.
block-sort-puzzle: Block Sort Puzzle asks you to arrange stacks of colorful squares, putting your reasoning and focus to work. Speed matters here, since quicker sorting lets you build the tallest tower possible while raising your score. Tiles glide smoothly across the board as they shift, which makes every move satisfying to watch.

Controls are simple: grab a block and drop it onto whichever tile you choose. When matching hues end up side by side, they merge and add to your total. Each merge also boosts your multiplier, so chaining combinations carefully can push your points much higher.
poor-eddie-game: Poor Eddie has a rough time of it. One moment a trampoline launches him skyward, the next he's kicked while airborne, and at other points a bomb blows him up and throws him over large pits. You take control of this unlucky man and work out how to get him across the finish line on each level.

The levels are full of hazards such as spikes and TNT. Fortunately, you also have helpers like elevators and lifts to carry you where you need to go. You play with mouse clicks or taps, and your goal is to keep Eddie safe on the way.
pool-8: Pool 8 turns a pool table into a puzzle you solve with your head. Your job is to sink the balls in the right sequence so you can clear one challenge after another, and each stage grows harder than the last. The game offers many difficulty tiers, and you move up through them naturally, beginning with the gentle "rookie" tier.
When a difficulty level ends, you get a shot at extra
pimple-poper-rush: Pimple Poper Rush casts you as a beauty master whose job is to pop away every pimple and help the skin recover its health. To play, hold and tap, then tap and slide across the skin to pop each spot clean. It is a 3D hypercasual game that runs online in your browser, works on mobile, and is tagged with obstacle and platform elements.

The game is built around a new kind of satisfaction. Watching someone else carry out this kind of work can bring a cathartic rush, and the title aims to give you that same feeling as you clear each blemish. Every clean pop adds to the sense of relief, keeping the focus on the simple pleasure of finishing the job well.
beastforge-rival: BeastForge Rival is a real-time tower defense game where you face players from around the world or take on AI bots. You command an army of 20 units balanced in a rock-paper-scissors style, including archers, tanks, and spells. Battles last three to five minutes, and instant AI fillers keep matches moving when no opponent is ready. Climb global leaderboards in ranked arenas, and play on desktop or mobile.

The bots improve by playing themselves through more than 1000 simulated matches, learning counters and refining their tactics. Daily challenges offer upgrades, unlockable skins, and tournament entries. To play, drag powerups from your button deck into the arena, or touch and place them on a touchscreen, then watch the fight unfold. Time each placement carefully and manage your elixir to destroy enemy towers.
jelly-path: Jelly Path is a calm, low-pressure puzzle game where you steer a soft, squishy jelly one square at a time toward its cozy cushion. Each level is a brain-teasing layout that puts your logic and sense of space to the test. Every move leaves a solid line behind the jelly, and that line becomes a wall you can never cross, so you need to plan ahead.

The world is tidy, bright, and abstract, and nothing ticks down or drains a meter, so you can take your time. Collect stars along the way to raise your score, and look for the most efficient route without boxing yourself in. Use W, A, S, D or the arrow keys on a desktop, drag your mouse in any direction, or swipe on a touchscreen.
grass-defense: Grass Defense is a tower defense game set in the wild, where your task is to hold back fierce creatures that arrive in waves. You place and strengthen towers, keep an eye on your resources, and adjust your approach as the enemies grow tougher. The surroundings change as you play, the foes come in many kinds, and the levels get harder, so both planning and skill will be tested. Hidden mysteries are also waiting to be uncovered across the untamed land.

Controls are simple. Use the left mouse button to draw the path the enemies will follow, then click a tower to upgrade it. Stronger towers help you destroy the attackers before they reach your base, so keep your defenses sharp and your base protected.
mad-cars-racing-and-crash: Mad Cars: Racing & Crash is a free 3D car simulator with 35 vehicles to drive. Your garage can include an armored car, a truck, a fire truck, a monster truck, racing cars, and a working machine, along with many others. You can buy new vehicles and upgrade the ones you own.

The game offers 60 racetracks, a free drive area, and a battlefield area, plus a two-player mode. Player one steers with the arrow keys or WASD, uses nitro with Right Shift, and changes the camera view with C. Player two moves with WASD and activates nitro with Left Shift.
truck-racing: In Truck Racing, you take the wheel of a truck and haul your cargo toward a destination. The goal is simple: get the load there without dropping it along the way. It is a racing game centered on a fun driving challenge.
The controls are straightforward. Use A and D, or the left and right arrow keys, to move the tru
pop-sweet-fruits: Pop Sweet Fruits is a shooting game where you aim and fire at fruit. You start with just two fruits. Each time you pop enough of them, new fruits unlock and your strength grows. Along the way, you can upgrade how fast your bullets travel, how quickly you shoot, and how much you earn.

The game is available in seven languages: Turkish, English, German, Italian, Spanish, French, and Russian. It is built for quick reflexes and timing, and it runs on mobile devices. Level up as you go, and keep upgrading until you have collected every fruit in the game.
rabbit-adventure: Hop into the role of a rabbit in this arcade-style title. You bounce along walls, platforms and springs while clearing out the enemies in your path. Spikes can end your run, so keep away from them, and drift around inside a bubble when the level calls for it. Your goal is to find the button that unlocks the door, then make your way to the finish line.
Controls are simple. Use the left, right and up arrow keys to move and jump. On mobile, tap the on-screen buttons instead. The playful, animal-themed style and funny tone
granny-cursed-cellar: In Granny Cursed Cellar, your goal is to survive and get out of a house. You need to be careful and quiet, because Granny hears everything, as she always does. Grandpa doesn't hear very well, but he hits hard, so keep your distance from him.

The game falls under the shooting category and also covers action, adventure, and escape themes, so expect a mix of those styles. It is set up for a touch pad, so the controls work by touching the pad. Keeping the noise down matters most, since that is what Granny listens for.
move-emoji: Move Emoji is a puzzle game where you slide emoji tiles around the board to line up matching pairs. Each level gives you only a set number of moves, so every choice counts. If you run out of moves before the board is clear, the level is over and you need to try again. To pass a level, you must match every emoji box, which then opens the way to the next stage.

Controls are simple: swipe in a direction to shift an emoji box, and matching ones disappear from the board. Keeping an eye on your remaining moves is part of the challenge. This title suits anyone who enjoys puzzles and emoji artwork, and it gives your brain a workout in a lighthearted way.
greenlight-redlight: Survival games have become a real part of the modern world, and this title builds on that idea. The best competitor takes home a cash reward along with public recognition. Like many phone games centered on survival, it tests your luck, stamina, and physical condition, and in the end only one player comes out on top.

In the first level, you move forward while the light is green and freeze as soon as it turns red. You control your character with a mouse or by tapping the screen with a finger, and that same input handles both moving and jumping. The game is listed in the Action category and is also tagged Adventure and Shooting.
delivery-master: Delivery Master puts you in the seat of both a driver and a delivery boy, blending transport and delivery work into one 3D game. You pick up passengers and drop them at their destinations, and you also carry pizza and other parcels to the locations you're aiming for. Each job earns money, which you can enjoy as you move up through the levels.

Riding your motorbike takes care, because traffic cars share the road and you must avoid colliding with them. To ride, tap and hold to keep the bike moving, then pick up each passenger and drop them off at the right spot. Work through the levels and play like a true shipping master, handling one order after another. Mouse clicks or taps are all you need to start.
close-ads: Close Ads is a frantic arcade title where the whole job is to shut down ads as quickly as you can. Every few levels, the advertisements grow more irritating, so the chaos keeps building. To begin again, use the Restart From Level 1 button, which resets your progress.

On a computer, click the close buttons with the left mouse button, move the mouse to line up and chase ads, and double-click on certain levels where that is required. On phones and tablets, tap the close buttons, double-tap when a level calls for it, and move your finger to follow the ads as they travel across the screen.
toytopia: Toytopia is a puzzle merge game with a snug, relaxed feel. Your job is to combine art items so they turn into new supplies, and those supplies are what you use to repair damaged toys. Every toy brings its own challenge and level of difficulty.

To play, you fix whatever is broken on a toy by merging art pieces into the materials it needs. Drag and drop items around the board with your mouse pointer on a computer, or with your finger on a phone or tablet.
urban-sniper-3d: Urban Sniper 3D puts you behind a modern sniper rifle in a city setting. Your mission is to locate every enemy force across the urban streets and eliminate them with carefully placed shots. Take your time lining up each target before you pull the trigger, since every shot counts toward clearing the area.

All of the action is controlled with the mouse, so aiming and firing rely on that single device. The game is presented in 3D, which adds depth as you scan the streets for enemies. It fits anyone who enjoys shooting games built around patience, precision, and sniper-style action.
ace-moto-rider: Ace Moto Rider puts you behind the handlebars of a motorbike in a first-person 3D view. This racing game is really about skillful dodging: on every level you must reach the finish line without smashing into other vehicles traveling on the highway. Turning on nitro gives you a burst of speed that gets you through the stage quicker, but it also makes it trickier to steer clear of trouble ahead.

Use the arrow keys to steer your bike and press the spacebar to fire up the nitro boost. The game runs in HTML5, so it works on mobile devices as well as desktop browsers. Tagged for kids and built around driving and bikes, it is an easy one to pick up and enjoy.
cars-simulator: Cars Simulator is a racing game where you take the wheel of one of three cars and explore three different environments. You can pull off stunts or simply speed along and enjoy the drive. Steering and movement are handled with the W, A, S and D keys.

The game runs in 3D through WebGL, so the cars and surroundings are rendered right in your browser. Its focus is on stunts and high speeds, with a simulator feel that rewards careful control. If you enjoy driving games with a mix of tricks and fast laps, this one is worth a look.
chess-royale: This take on chess departs from the classic rules, because the kings here wield magic. Your aim is to take the rival king off the board. Victory comes from linking a sequence of planned moves with the spells your king can call on, so timing matters as much as position. It's a one-on-one match that also works on phone screens.

There are three kinds of magic available. One conjures an extra pawn, another places an obstacle that blocks squares, and the third transforms a piece into a different one. Using any of them is straightforward: drag the card onto an empty square for a new pawn or obstacle, or drop it onto a piece to change its type.
atv-ultimate-offroad: Step into an off-road ATV simulator with both racing and open free-roam driving. Take on races against a friend in two-player mode, or roam a vast open map however you like. Several ATVs are available, and some start out locked. You can unlock them by collecting money or gears earned through races and while exploring the free map.

Player 1 steers with W, A, S, D or the arrow keys, uses NOS on Left Shift, switches cameras with C, and resets position with R. Player 2 drives with the arrow keys, activates NOS with M, changes camera with K, and resets position with P.
miner-jam: Miner Jam is a puzzle game where you think ahead and make smart use of colored pickaxes to break boxes and move on through the levels. You can run it online in your browser at no cost, and its bright, lively visuals keep things engaging. As you progress, you unlock rewards and sharpen your skills while testing yourself against tougher challenges. The game works on iOS, Android, and desktop computers.
Controls are simple: click or tap to match each pickaxe with the right color, then use it to mine the ores. Lining up the colors correctly is the key to clearing the boxes and advancing.
emoji-merge: Emoji Merge is a puzzle game where you release emojis into the play area and join matching pairs to make new ones. Your goal is to plan each move carefully, discover different combinations, and push your score as high as you can. It is a matching game built with HTML5 and is listed as suitable for mobile play.

Controls are simple: tap the screen to drop an emoji from above. When two identical emojis meet, they merge into a new one and add points to your total. If the stage starts to fill with small pieces, use the Remove Smallest Item button to clear the tiniest emojis from the board. The instructions describe the whole experience as a fun journey that keeps going.
geek-escape-run-for-survival: Geek Escape: Run for Survival is an arcade game about a nerdy hero who must race away from a crowd of bullies. It can be played free online on several platforms. The game blends fast action with a bit of strategy, so you will need to dodge obstacles while keeping your run going.

Trash cans are your main weapon. Throw them at the bullies to fight back during the chase. Use the arrow keys to steer, press the spacebar to throw a trash can, and hold the Shift key for a speed boost when you need to pull ahead.
woody-tangram-puzzle: Woody Tangram Puzzle is a game built around logic. You slide each piece across the board and fit it into place, taking care that no pieces overlap, until you have formed bright, colorful shapes. Working through a puzzle feels soothing, yet it also gets your mind turning over possible arrangements. Because it is so easy to keep going, it works as a way to pass the time for both kids and adults.

Play is handled entirely with mouse clicks or taps, so there is nothing complicated to learn. Whether you want a calm break or a bit of mental stretching, this logic game offers a gentle way to pass a few minutes.
police-supercar-parking-mania: Forget the usual parking challenge. Here you play a police officer behind the wheel of a supercar, racing after outlaws at high speed and parking to catch them. Every pursuit carries high stakes, and the thrill is just as intense.

Your job is to park a supercar in a dense forest. The scenery is lovely to look at, but it can also pull your attention away from the road. Narrow paths and animals that suddenly cross your way keep you alert, so each parking attempt feels like a new adventure. To play, just click the mouse or tap the screen.
new-city-simulator: New City Simulator puts you in charge of a racing game powered by a real physics engine, and it also works as a simulator. Its main purpose is to put your driving skills to the test. Fans of cars, supercars, and racing will find the theme right up their street.
Everything is handled from the keyboard, so your keys are how you take part. Each session rewards careful handling, since the physics engine governs how the car responds to your input.
kids-hospital-doctor: Kids Hospital Doctor is a game designed to teach as you play. You have already gone on an airport trip with Hippo, visited the dentist together, and put together some lovely photo albums. Now you can also become a skilled surgeon alongside Hippo. Three patients arrive at the hospital today: a giraffe who needs an eye check, a young raccoon with a pollen allergy, and a little hippo with a stomach ache. Follow the on-screen prompts to treat each one with Hippo.
Friends can join in too, so you can compare and see who turns out to be the best doctor. Controls are simple: use a mouse click or tap the screen.
prisoners-run: Life behind these walls is harsh, and the guards show no mercy to anyone. You play as a strong prisoner who can smash through doors, trick the guards, and free other inmates while fighting your way toward the exit. The stages are laid out like a maze, so every move needs some thought.

Each level asks you to find the key and reach the exit elevator, which carries you on to the next one. Along the way, you can rescue fellow prisoners and escort them to freedom. On a computer, use the arrow keys or WASD to move. On mobile, drag the virtual joystick in any direction to get around.
driftbound-race-in-the-grip-of-drift: Driftbound is a fast arcade racer built around a magnetic drifting system. Hook onto glowing magnets beside the road, swing through sharp bends, and let go at the right moment to keep your line. Your car speeds up on its own, so your focus is on staying on the track, avoiding crashes, gathering cash, and mastering each corner. Procedurally generated routes bring bridges, intersections, shifting weather, and tough turns.

Solo mode asks you to travel as far as possible through steadily harder stages and beat your own distance record. In Rivals mode, overtake the AI drivers and reach the finish line first. Spend the cash you collect to upgrade your car and unlock new vehicles and control modes. Steer with an on-screen wheel or directional controls, chosen in Settings. On desktop, hold Spacebar or the mouse button to activate the hook and release it to
