farm-clash-3d: Farm Clash 3D is a shooter where you command a team of cowboys. Your task is to push back the wicked Apache raiders who keep sneaking onto the farm to steal the pumpkins that are ready to harvest. A powerful shotgun is your main tool, and a special weapon hidden deep within the level can also help you take down the enemy. As you move among the farmhouses, keep an eye out for useful secrets.
Controls are simple: use W, A, S and D to move, press C to crouch, and hit SPACE to jump. This 3D game also offers a multiplayer mode for playing with others.
blade-hit: In Blade Hit, you hurl knives at logs to break them apart. You also gather coins, which you can spend to unlock new knives. Your collection can grow to 96 weapons, from swords and staffs to tridents, shurikens, and plenty more. Set new records as you go and work your way up to the title of knife master.
To play, press the left mouse button or tap the screen to throw a knife. Your goal is to throw every knife you have without letting it strike any knife that is already stuck in the target.
galaxy-attack: You are humanity's final chance in this shooter. Pilot a single starship and stop an invading alien horde from overrunning the planet. The mission reaches beyond Earth, since the whole cosmos needs rescuing from merciless foes. Expect waves of opponents that keep growing in number as you fight through dangerous surroundings.

Your ship grows stronger as you advance, unlocking upgrades that boost its deadly firepower. Steer by touching the screen, and wipe out every adversary in sight. Pick up the items you come across to improve your guns or switch to a different weapon type.
animal-blocks: Animal Blocks combines the familiar feel of block puzzles with cute animal artwork. It is built for light, easygoing fun, and its bright colors make it a relaxing pick for brief visits or a moment to unwind. Each block carries a playful animal design, so every move adds to the cheerful look.

To score, line up three or more matching animals. Chain matches one after another and your points jump by a large multiplier, so consecutive combinations pay off well. As your score climbs, the challenge grows, so the game becomes more demanding the further you progress.
sniper-survival-squidy-game: Sniper Survival Squidy Game is a 3D arcade shooter for one player, where you step into the role of an undercover agent called Squid. You line up sniper shots, aim at enemies, and fire at exactly the right moment. Bullet time gives you a slowed-down window to tap and shoot. Each mission sets its own targets.

Bounce and ricochet your shots off walls to eliminate every opponent in a round. Try to cross each stage without being seen, since enemies who spot you will take you down and you could lose the mission. Levels grow harder as you go, so only the best players will make it through. Move the mouse to look around, hold Shift to freeze your sniper's movement, and click left or right to aim and shoot. Keep an eye on the warning above targets.
hatch-your-unicorn-idol: This game brings together several things young players tend to enjoy: charming kawaii-style unicorns, caring for virtual pets, and plenty of colorful rainbows. Your goal is to hatch ponies and gather them into a musical group. Every pony arrives with its own personality and look, yet they all share a passion for singing and dancing.
The controls are simple, since you only need your mouse or a tap on the screen to play. Each pony you hatch adds its own flair to the lineup, so every group you build can look a little different.
tiles-hop-3d: Tiles Hop 3D asks you to follow a rhythm and use quick musical reflexes to guide a ball from tile to tile. To make it jump, touch the ball, hold it, and drag to set the leap. Avoid missing any tiles along the path, since every hop has to land in time with the beat.
Music is a big part of the experience, and each song comes with challenges built around it. The whole game is played with a mouse, so no other controls are needed. Keep your timing sharp and en
prison-escape-stickman-story: Our stickman hero is a devoted admirer of Arsène Lupin, the imaginary gentleman burglar and master of disguise. Calling himself Lupin 19th, he treats breaking out of prisons around the globe as his pastime. Hurdles, tricky situations and hard tests are what draw him in, and no lock or wall can keep him behind bars for long.

Every prison has its own unique characteristics, so he relies on special skills to get past each one. You follow him as he visits many prisons from around the world. To play, just click or tap with your mouse or finger.
obby-up-parkour-run: Obby Up: Parkour Run is a bright 3D platformer where changing your size is part of the fun. You run and leap up a towering course, shrinking to slip through tight gaps and growing to handle bigger obstacles. Cross the platforms, dodge the traps, and activate checkpoints so a fall only sends you back to the last one you reached. Gather coins, try the side challenges, and customize your runner with outfits and pets. Choose your own route, time each jump, and see how high you can climb.

On a computer, use WASD or the arrow keys to move and Space to jump, pressing again in mid-air when a double jump is available. Drag the size slider to shrink or grow, and press E or the on-screen hammer button to strike once you have the hammer. Escape pauses or resumes the game. On mobile, drag the left joystick to move.
hungry-cars: Hungry Cars is a racing game where your car grows stronger by devouring the vehicles around it. Each run lets you power up and open new customization choices. To grow, steer toward cars with a lower power level and eat them. Stay away from cars that are stronger than you, since colliding with them will damage your car.

Move with the arrow keys on desktop: up, down, left, and right. On mobile, drag the on-screen joystick in any direction to steer. Keep an eye on the power levels and pick your targets carefully to build up your car over every run.
topsy-turvy: Topsy Turvy is an arcade puzzler with a spooky but cute feel. You operate a quirky little steampunk cannon and shoot orbs at creepy eyeballs and skull orbs before they wriggle their way down to the drain. Matching them lets you pop them and set off chains of combos, and your goal is to clear the track. Stay alive as the sinister snake keeps inching closer.

The game is simple to play but tricky to master, and it carries just enough creepiness to keep things lively. Fans of bubble shooter and Zuma-style games, along with horror lovers, may find it fitting. To aim, click or tap wherever you want the orb launched from the cannon.
fill-the-heart: Fill the Heart is an arcade game tagged for mobile play, so it can be enjoyed on both phones and computers. On a desktop, you steer with the arrow keys or with W, A, S, and D, moving up, down, left, or right as needed.

Keyboard shortcuts give you a few extra options. Press R to restart, Q to return to the menu, or M to mute the game. On mobile, there is no keyboard to rely on. Instead, you control movement by swiping across the on-screen area.
merge-mushroom: This puzzle game asks you to toss one mushroom onto another so the pair merges into a different variety. Your goal is to gather every possible mushroom, which means testing new pairings until your collection feels complete. Along the way, you can challenge mushroom pickers from all corners of the globe.
Controls are simple: drag with your finger or mouse cursor and release the mushroom wherever you want it to drop. Each drop is a fresh chance to create something new and keep your collection growing.
9-patch-puzzle-quest: Working through this logic game, you place numbered squares onto a grid until it is completely filled. Each square needs a careful spot, since none of them may overlap another. Difficulty ranges from beginner to expert, and the board comes in several different layouts, so the puzzles stay varied. The brain-teasing style can keep you thinking for a good while.
Along the way you'll sharpen your problem-solving skills and work toward earning the title of 9-Patch puzzle master. To adjust the squares, tap and drag to resize them.
sports-car-drift: Sports Car Drift is a racing game where you speed through a 3D world behind the wheel of a sleek sports car. You can pick whichever car you like best from the available options, then take it into fast, sliding drifts at high speed.
The controls are simple. Use W, A, S and D to steer and drive, press Space to pull the handbrake and kick your car into a slide, and hit Escape whenever you need to pause the action.
slap-kingdom-slap-race: Fancy yourself a slap master or a slap star? In this casual slapping challenge, you swing your oversized hand to knock rivals off their feet and send them flying out of the ring. Kicks and punches are part of the mix too, so you can fight off anyone who steps up. Your moves include hit and run, slap and run, and slap shots.

Losers get punched out, while winners stay alive and might earn the title of Slap King. Your goal is to defeat everyone and claim victory with a Super Smash. Controls are simple: mouse click or tap to play.
zombie-dead-ahead: In this adventure, you protect your bus from undead foes that are more terrifying than any demon you could imagine. Your job is to smash through barricades while cutting down the rotting corpses in your path. You assemble a crew of gladiator fighters and send them into the fray one at a time, using whatever means you can to hold back the pixelated horde of man-eating ghouls.

You can slash, shoot, or burn the dead, using explosive barrels, Molotov cocktails, and grenades. Go in loud and explosive, or stay quiet and take your enemies down with stealth. Controls are simple: click or tap to play, and tap a soldier to create a skill icon, then tap that icon to use it.
248-scribble: 248 Scribble is a relaxed mobile puzzle game inspired by 2048. Your job is to link neighboring dots that show the same number, drawing your finger across them horizontally or vertically. Matching numbers such as 2s, 4s, or 8s merge into higher values on a colorful grid. The goal is to reach a 248 tile while keeping enough room on the board, and you earn coins as you play.

The tiles have a hand-drawn, doodle-like look in bright colors, giving the whole game a distinct scribbled style. Controls are simple and touch-based: drag or swipe between matching dots to merge them. Four buttons are also available. Undo reverses your last move for 100 coins, Hint suggests a merge for 75 coins, Shuffle rearranges the tiles for 50 coins, and Boost offers a game-changing power-up for 200 coins.
king-dungeon: The cave collapses on the king at the very start of King Dungeon, and he must find his queen. To reach her, you explore, craft, mine, build, and survive in the dungeon. Along the way you gather resources, construct your own mine, and fight off dwarves and orcs in the struggle for power. The music suits the mood well, though you can progress without it.

Move with a joystick, WASD, or the arrow keys. Approach stones to gather resources, visit the forge to upgrade your character, and head to the shopping area to buy new buildings. You level up by exploring more areas of the dungeon and crafting more advanced tools that speed up resource gathering. Coins are the game's currency, and you spend them on special resources and items that move you forward. The variety of crafting, survival and defense, and atmospheric locations gives the game its appeal.
fallerz-io: Fallerz.io is a 3D io game inspired by the hit game Fall Guys. The main idea is to race other players to the end of the map, and whoever gets there first wins. As a classic-style .io title, it puts you in a crowd of competitors who are all aiming for the same finish line.
Getting started takes only a moment. Move with the W, A, S and D keys, use your mouse to look around, and press the space bar to jump. Those are the controls you need to know as you chase the win.
mononinja: In this single-player arcade title, you guide a determined ninja through a pixel-styled world where one misstep can end the run. Every leap must be carefully timed as you work your way past dangerous hazards toward the goal of each stage. The game offers more than 30 levels that blend fun with a real test of skill, making it a fitting trial for anyone hoping to earn the title of shinobi.

Controls are simple to pick up. On desktop, press and hold the SPACE key to jump. On mobile, tap and hold the screen to jump. The height of each jump depends on how long you keep the button held, so a longer hold sends your ninja higher.
slide-and-divide: Slide And Divide is a puzzle game built around numbers and quick thinking. You set a number beside another value that it can divide evenly. When the division works, the tile either vanishes or shrinks, depending on the result. Your aim is to keep clearing room on the board so it never fills up.

Your run ends once no new placement is possible. Smart positioning and planning decide how long you last, so choosing where each number goes matters as much as the one you place next. It is a logic challenge with a math twist, built for players who enjoy brain teasers.
steal-a-bird: Steal a Bird is a free 3D multiplayer game where you swipe birds from other players while customizing your own skins and base. Team up with friends or go head to head with rivals, and work your way toward the crown as the king.

Move with W, A, S, and D or the arrow keys, jump with Space, and swing with U. Press P to switch between first and third person, M to teleport to your base, H to buy the nearest bird, and X to sell one nearby. Use T for chat, E for emotes, G for the leaderboard, I for the skin shop, O for settings, R for rebirth, and J for the daily spin and rewards. Press V to invite friends and L to leave a lobby. Esc frees your mouse, and clicking empty space or the close button shuts any open menu.
blocky-zombie-and-vehicle-shooting: Head out to hunt zombies in this blocky, pixel-style browser shooter. Climb behind the wheel to drive and smash other vehicles, or leave your ride and move on foot. Destroying cars and players from around the world is part of the action in multiplayer, and a single-player campaign gives you a solo route through the game.
Use W, A, S, and D to drive or walk, and move the mouse to look around, shoot, or switch guns. Press E to enter or exit a car. Q changes the camo on your gun, and T swaps its attachments.
soldiers-runner: In Soldiers Runner, you run ahead with a group of troops and gather more soldiers along the way. Your army defeats enemies and collects rewards, and upgrades help your forces grow stronger. Your main goal is to destroy the great wall in your path and rescue the grand prize, which gets bigger with every level you reach.

The controls are simple to learn. On a computer, press A or D, or use the left and right arrow keys, to move. On a phone or tablet, swipe left or right to move and turn. Whichever device you use, the controls are quick to pick up, so you can focus on growing your squad and reaching the prize.
katana-upgrade: Forge your way to a stronger blade in this arcade game. Each attempt tests your luck as you sharpen your katana and push it as far as it will go. Be careful, though, because a single botched upgrade can wipe out all the progress you have made so far.

To improve your weapon, press the Upgrade button. Every success raises your katana's level, while a failed attempt can ruin the sword. Keep going and try to reach the highest level you can. Everything is controlled with the mouse, and a simple click handles both upgrading and interacting with the game.
cannons-blast-3d: Cannons Blast 3D blends tower defense with puzzle-style play, putting you in control of a heavy machine gun and a cannon. Your job is to knock out every enemy unit heading toward your castle before any of them get close. Keep an eye on your ammo, since your weapon holds a limited supply and reloads at a set pace. You also need to choose how wide each shot's fire coverage should be.

Gems you collect let you buy the other two weapons and upgrade the ones you already have. The controls are simple: a mouse click or a tap is all you need. It's a good way to put your shooting skills to the test.
real-car-driving-simulator: Fans of parking simulators may enjoy this one. Your task is to guide a sports car into the spot marked on the minimap, and there is no countdown pushing you to rush. Drive calmly, keep the car steady, and do your best to avoid crashing into anything along the way.

Movement is handled entirely with the W, A, S and D keys. Keep an eye on the minimap to follow where your target sits, and line up your final approach with care. Patience and smooth driving are the keys to success here.
royal-elite-archer-defense: Picture a battle of bows where two sides defend castles manned by 3D stickman archers. This strategy puzzle combines team archery with arrow launching. Your aim is to wipe out every enemy archer before they manage to take out yours. Watch out for enemy melee troops, because if you cannot shoot them down before they reach your castle, they will crash into your tower.

Skins are available, but they only change the shape of your arrows, not their power. Coins earned along the way let you upgrade your team and your castle, and it is smart to spend them on those upgrades first. You play by clicking with a mouse or tapping the screen.
little-big-fighters: Little Big Fighters is a survival action game set in a combat arena. Your goal is to show everyone who the strongest fighter is. You take on rivals, grow tougher with every win, and gather valuable resources that boost your power and dominance. Each victory helps you push deeper into the fight for survival.
Your fighter moves wherever you press the left mouse button. Clicking the left mouse button starts a battle with a boss, and pressing L unlocks the mouse when you need it.
merge-rush-attack: Merge Rush Attack is a quick arcade runner built around tapping and merging. Tap or left click to spawn units, and your crowd marches forward on its own. Fuse three identical units into a stronger tier, then smash through the boss wall at the end of each run before your heat climbs too high. It plays in portrait view, and the walls grow tougher as you advance.

Your squad's power must meet or beat the wall's HP to win the level and earn coins. If it falls short, the run ends and you can try again. Between runs, spend coins in the Shop on higher merges, auto-merge, and power upgrades. From level 5, tapping too fast fills the heat bar and can weaken your squad, so the Overheat Shop lets you buy heat defenses. The Merge button combines matching units when they are available.
classic-limo-car-parking: Step into a classic limo and put your parking and driving abilities to the test across a series of car parks. Your job is to zip around each lot without taking any damage, and you can follow the on-screen markers straight to the space you need. The visuals look lifelike, and the controls are simple to pick up from the start.

Every parking challenge you finish earns cash, which you can spend on upgrades and customize your vehicle to your liking. To begin, click or tap the screen, then steer with WASD or the arrow keys and use the spacebar for the hand brake. Clearing every challenge will prove your parking skill.
cinderella-banquet-hand-spa: The prince is about to host a grand ball, and Cinderella has her heart set on attending. Hoping for help, she goes to her fairy godmother. The godmother has already used her magic to conjure beautiful skirts and carriages for the evening. However, Cinderella has noticed that her hands have turned rough and unsightly from many long hours of tough work, and the godmother's magic cannot be used to make them look good.

Help Cinderella give herself beautiful hands. This fun hand spa game follows the Cinderella story and is played with a mouse click or a tap. Your job is to care for her hands so she is ready for the ball. Enjoy the time you spend helping her.
euro-truck-parking-game: This parking game puts you behind the wheel of powerful European trucks. You test your driving and parking skills across demanding locations, steering a massive vehicle past obstacles and bringing it to a precise stop inside the marked bay. Your route might lead through cramped corners, hairpin bends, slim roads, crowded truck yards, and awkward parking spots.

Move forward with W or the Up Arrow, reverse with S or the Down Arrow, turn left with A or the Left Arrow, and turn right with D or the Right Arrow. Any on-screen button is selected with the mouse. Success depends on precision and patience, the two qualities you need to grow into a professional truck driver.
water-color-sort-game: Water Color Sort is a puzzle that looks simple at first but quickly becomes hard to put down. Its water-sorting challenge asks you to separate colors so each container holds a single shade. It suits anyone who wants to keep their mind busy, pass some spare time, or simply unwind. Players who enjoy working through combinations and sharpening their logic will find plenty to think about here.

There is no clock ticking, so you can take each move at your own pace. The whole game is controlled with the mouse, which keeps things easy to pick up. Whether you want a calm break or a more demanding brain workout, this sorting puzzle fits both moods.
my-eggs-surprise: Eggs Surprise is a fun little game built around a vending machine. Every item in the machine carries a price, and you are given a handful of coins to work with. Look at the amount shown on the display and put in the exact sum. If you get it right, the machine drops the item for you; if not, an error message pops up. Your goal is to reveal every surprise and gather the full collection. Everything is controlled with your mouse.
fantastic-car-parking-3d: Fantastic Car Parking 3D is a follow-up to a popular mobile parking simulator, and it takes the series into a fresh direction. Its visuals are polished and eye-catching, and the parking tasks are set across tough levels that unfold in several stages. Players can also try a live online mode where they connect with others in real time.

The game is played entirely with the keyboard, so you control your car with simple key presses as you work through each challenge. Filed under racing, it is a 3D title built around precise, careful driving and steady progress from one stage to the next.
shooter-assassin: Pick your hero and begin the mission. Shooter Assassin lets you choose from several characters, each with its own set of powers. Across more than 50 levels, you can show what kind of assassin you really are. Your job is to eliminate targets quietly without being spotted. If an enemy catches sight of you, slip through the open areas of the map until they lose track of where you were.
To move, click or tap your destination on the map, then start the assassination. Tags for this 3D adventure title include arcade and shooter elements, and it runs in HTML5 on Android devices.
spin-and-mow: You control a robot that carries a pair of whirling blades linked by a toothed cord. Grass islands float over deep water, and the robot moves between them. Hold one blade in place and the other swings around it at the cord's length. A tap, click or press of space swaps which blade is fixed and sends you flying toward the next island. Mow enough grass to meet each level's target while steering clear of stumps, boulders and crystals. Land on platforms that slide back and forth, and touch the flag to leave the stage.
Upgrades include Sharper Saws, Longer Chain, Reinforced
wizard-io: Wizard.io is an action game set in a world full of magic and mystery. You take on fierce battles inside enchanting arenas, where mystical foes come at you from every side. Fight back with elemental spells and sly enchantments, and mix spells together in many different ways to find what works best.

Gather magical orbs as you go and strengthen your wizard's home base for strategic advantages. Dig up powerful artifacts that can turn the tide in your favor. Move your character by dragging with the left mouse button, or by using the WASD or arrow keys. Use the left mouse button to click through the in-game interface.
pinball-football-champion: Pinball Football Champion blends pinball with football in a mobile game. You flick the players to launch the ball, then steer it through bumpers and pins. Points rack up on the scoreboard as you play. Your aim is to learn the field, score big, and earn the title of champion.
The controls are simple. Click to send the football, then click again to get it right into the goal. It is a one-player game, so every shot and every run through the bumpers is up to you.
zombie-mission-7: The seventh chapter of the zombie series takes players down a fresh path. The heroes are enjoying a break when a message pulls them back to work. Zombies have overrun the space station, so they must rush back and deal with the threat. Across twenty stages, you shoot your way through the undead and face three bosses.

Two players can play together. Player one moves with W, A, S and D, fires with F, throws grenades with G, jumps with W, and switches weapons with Q and E. Player two uses the arrow keys to move, L to fire, K for grenades, the up arrow to jump, and O and P to swap guns. Both players can walk on walls.
micro-gt-racing: Micro GT Racing shrinks high-speed driving down to a compact scale. You pilot small GT cars built for accuracy, quick reactions, and raw adrenaline. Courses wind through sharp bends and tight chicanes while rivals press hard for the lead, and even the smallest slice of time can decide the result.

Build up your racers by customizing them, then get a feel for the realistic handling as you work your way from rookie to champion. The game pairs eye-catching visuals and dynamic lighting with arcade-style action. Controls are split for two players: the arrow keys for player one and WASD for player two.
tile-match-guard-baby: Keeping a baby asleep is the goal in Tile Match Guard Baby, where noisy monsters are the threat. This arcade puzzler centers on matching tiles, and its aim is to keep the room quiet. Its cozy feel and kid-friendly style make it a gentle choice for younger players and for anyone who enjoys match-3 games.
Pressing a tile sends it into the tray. Gather three matching tiles to clear them away. Clear every tile before the tray f
latto-latto: Latto-Latto is an arcade game built around timing. Pressing and dragging with your finger guides a handle that swings two balls so they knock into each other in a steady beat. The smoother your timing and motion, the longer the balls keep moving and the higher your score climbs.

Your goal is to keep the collisions going for as long as you can while staying in sync. Along the way, you can collect coins to unlock new ball skins. Keep the rhythm steady and see how long the balls can keep spinning for a high score.
bally: Bally is a puzzle game that borrows ideas from golf. Your job is to send the ball flying toward the correct hole. The challenge lies in finishing with as few throws as you can manage. Players can use a mouse on a computer, or touch the screen on a smartphone or tablet, to launch the ball.

It is a one-player title that mixes arcade action with logic and billiard-style play, and it runs in your browser via HTML5. Each shot takes a little planning, because the goal is to sink the ball in as few throws as possible. Aim well, launch with care, and see how efficiently you can reach the right hole.
dispatch-panic: You work the mailroom of a chaotic office where every drop-off matters. Sprint across the floor, toss letters and packages toward the desks waiting on them, and weave past obstacles so your boss does not lose patience. String together successful drops to build a combo, take on urgent requests as they come in, and grab coffee and power-ups to keep your shift going.

Move with WASD or the arrow keys, going left, right, forward, and backward. Aim with the mouse, then click or press Space to throw your mail. Press Shift while moving to dash. Each missed delivery or collision makes the boss angrier, so the real challenge is seeing how long you can last.
kids-unicorn-dress-up: Kids Unicorn Dress Up is a relaxed, free puzzle game where four unicorns are ready for a makeover. You choose a fresh look for each one, such as a cute pink peach heart design or a healthy chocolate tone. Hair can be restyled in many different shapes and shades, and the horn can sparkle with glitter or show off rainbow colors.

Extra items like earrings, necklaces, and lovely wings help finish each look. When you are happy with a unicorn, snap a picture and save it to keep your creation. Everything is controlled with a mouse click or a tap.
match-story-weapons: Here you select weapons from a 3D board and place them into a box. When three identical weapons end up together, they match and disappear. Each level has a timer, so you need to clear every match before time runs out. The layouts grow more complicated as you advance, adding more weapon types and tougher arrangements, so you need to observe the board closely.

Expect a bright, colorful look and weapon models you have never seen before. Combining pieces lets you build powerful combos, and merging your weapons helps you unlock new levels. The game is designed to keep your mind sharp, and the challenge increases steadily from one stage to the next.
ww3-tanks-battle: Step back in time with soldiers, guns, tanks, and planes from World War II. Several special effects add to the action as you play with friends from all over the world.

Two heavy tanks and two high-quality World War III weapons are ready to fire shells and bullets at enemies. The explosions look impressive, and the German and United States troop figures are finely detailed. Drive your tank and move your character with WASD, look around and shoot with the mouse, switch guns by scrolling, and press Tab to open the menu.
pop-it-knockout-royale: Pop it Knockout Royale is an arcade game where the bubbles sit on top of your hero's head. Your job is to tap them so they pop, and you need to pop and break every one before anyone else does. The challenge is easy to understand but harder to master, so you'll have to work hard to come out on top.
To play, tap to pop the bubbles, and swipe to move your hero around. Keep an eye on your own bubbles and stay quick, since the race is all about being the first to clear them.
merge-beast-arena: Merge Beast Arena blends an idle merge game with an auto-battler. You begin with a small mouse and tap it to collect coins. Tapping quickly builds a combo, which can reach x5 and bring much bigger rewards. Bigger beasts also pay out more with every tap.
To grow your collection, drag one animal onto a matching one, and the pair will combine to form the next creature in the lineup. The chain
impossible-parkour-3d: Impossible Parkour 3D is a platform game built around tough jumping courses. Each of its 25 levels has its own feel and introduces something new, so you keep meeting fresh challenges as you move along. You could spend an entire day trying the levels, yet the game is designed so that you never quite reach the end.

On a computer, you move your character with the WASD keys or the arrow keys, and press Space to jump. On mobile, you use a joystick and buttons instead, and an in-game tutorial is available to help you learn the controls. Whichever device you prefer, you can start playing with either set of controls.
only-jump-rpg: Only Jump RPG is a fast-paced runner set on one road, where every jump matters. Move left or right, strike foes, activate skills, and dodge traps and enemy attacks. Unlock heroes, gather items, and strengthen your abilities. Minimal buttons keep things simple, since a single jump both carries you forward and lands an attack.

Short runs grow more demanding as your skill deepens, with spikes, chasms, ghosts, and tight timing to handle. Each hero has distinct abilities and perks you can upgrade. On PC, use A and D, the arrow keys, or the on-screen buttons. On mobile, the on-screen left and right buttons handle movement. Skills activate through on-screen buttons, and their cooldowns and energy depend on your hero and perks. Collect coins and complete quests to upgrade skills and unlock new heroes.
princess-back-spa-salon: Princess Back Spa Salon is a casual puzzle game set in a back spa. It walks you through every step of back hydrotherapy, starting with a soak in a comfortable hot bath. After that come back cleaning, back massage, back care, and back cupping. Once all of these treatments are complete, it is time to change into new clothes.

The whole experience is built to feel absorbing, letting you lose yourself in the sensations of a spa visit from beginning to end. Controls are simple, since a mouse click or a tap is all you need to move through each stage of the routine.
catch-the-cat: Catch the Cat is a relaxed puzzle played on sketched lines. You trace a route that takes the child to the kitten of the same color, steering around cars, dogs, holes, and fences along the way. When the kitten gets hungry, you must route the child to food first, then guide them both safely back home.

The game offers 50 hand-tuned levels, and you can collect coins as you go. Coins let you dress up your kitten with items from a wardrobe and improve its mood. At the pet home, you can feed and play with your cat. Controls use just one finger, whether you use a touchscreen or a mouse. The game is available in English, Portuguese, and Spanish.
pixel-color-flow: Pixel Color Flow is a relaxed color matching puzzle with cute pigs. The board is made of colored pixel cubes, and your aim is to clear them all by sending pigs onto a conveyor. Each pig only fires balls at cubes that share its color, so the real skill lies in deciding which pig goes first and keeping the queue moving so the board gets cleared quickly.

Every pig carries an ammo number shown above its head, and each shot lowers it. Once that number hits zero, the pig exits. Pigs that still have ammo can step into one of five waiting slots and be sent back out with a tap later. The conveyor can only hold so much at once, so you need to time your taps well to avoid jamming it.
sway-tower-builder: Sway is a calm, one-tap stacking game where you build a tower as high as you can. There are no long lists of rules or combinations to memorize, so it's easy to learn. You can also test your stacking against other players.

Each round, a block dangles from a crane and sways back and forth. Tap at the right instant to release it onto the pile. A "Perfect" drop lines the block up and lets the tower grow steadily, but a miss sends it toppling. You get three misses before the run ends, so stay steady and aim for a new personal best.
lay-eggs: Lay Eggs is a hypercasual skill game built with HTML5. Your job is to guide a bird that is trying to make its way back home. The path is filled with many obstacles, so the bird needs careful steering to reach its destination in one piece.

Everything is controlled with the mouse, so there is no complicated setup to learn. Keep the bird safe as it moves past the obstacles on its journey. Every obstacle tests your skill, and the bird's safe return depends on how you play.
beadhouse: BeadHouse is a calm color puzzle that asks you to study a picture and notice beads sitting in the wrong spots. Your job is to shift each color back to where it belongs so the original design reappears. Every solved challenge leaves behind a charming bead creation. The game includes 54 hand-made stages, and along the way you gather stars and coins.

Controls stay simple: tap a misplaced bead to send it to the tray, then tap an open space of the matching color to set it down. Because the tray holds only so much, plan your moves with care. When you get stuck, Fix Area, Clear Tray, and Magnet are there to help. Satisfying effects add to the experience, and careful observation is rewarded. Complete the picture before the clock runs out, then visit the Gallery to admire your work, save favorites, and watch the finishing animation again.
mountain-climb-4x4-offroad-car-drive: Mountain Climb 4x4 is a realistic simulation and racing game where you steer an off-road vehicle up steep hills and get past the obstacles in your way. Your goal is to reach the top as fast as you can, collecting every coin along the stage and finishing it successfully. Watch out for cliff edges and barriers, since a fall or a crash can ruin your run. Each stage has its own difficulty and layout, and new ones arrive every 15 days.

Physics governs everything, so the car reacts in believable ways, and repeating the same approach rarely works. Five car models are available, each with its own specifications, and more are added over time. You can upgrade handling, engine, and brakes, or change a car's color, rims, and appearance. If you run out of coins, you can earn more by watching a video or replaying stages you have already finished. You drive with the keyboard, and steering sensitivity can be adjusted in Settings if turning feels hard.
slasty-candy-tower: Slasty: Candy Tower is a shooting arcade game where you control a hero who fires sugary candy at hungry monsters seated on whirling platforms. Each hit feeds one monster, and the spinning picks up speed as you climb. Tap the screen or press the space bar at just the right moment to fire. Accurate shots build combos and high scores, and you can compete with players around the world.

Every level contains several stages that grow tougher, and you must feed every chewbrick in a stage to clear it. New towers open as you advance, each with its own mechanics, cartoon-style look, and platforms. The game needs no internet connection, and your progress is never lost. Controls use just one touch, and the interface stays plain and clear. Patience matters more than speed here.
apple-worm-greedy-puzzle-snake: You guide a famished worm that keeps getting tangled up in its own body. Your job is to gobble up apples while steering clear of walls, and the more you eat, the greedier you become. Every move needs careful thought, since the worm is often its own worst enemy. Planning three steps ahead helps you avoid a fatal mistake.

You steer with the arrow keys or with the buttons shown on screen. Your aim is to reach the apple or find the exit. The worm cannot reverse direction, so a single poor turn may leave it stuck. Use walls, platforms, and clever thinking to wriggle through narrow gaps and get past every obstacle.
mega-ramp-car-racing-stunt-free-new-car-: This offline 3D racing game puts you behind the wheel for daring stunts on mega ramps and steep tracks that seem almost impossible to beat. Set in Extreme City, it lets you choose from a large lineup of sports cars in the garage. When the road tilts sharply upward, hit nitro to give your car a boost. You can also customize your vehicle to suit your driving style.

Your goal is to finish every mission, and each one is meant to be thrilling and tough. Stay steady when obstacles appear, make precise moves, and aim to set fresh stunt records. Along the way, you will work toward winning the race. Controls are handled with the keyboard.
sake-hockey: Set in old Japan, this sports game pits samurai against ninjas in a hockey match on an icy field. The samurai swing their sticks with sharp, precise strokes that resemble swords, showing plenty of skill and determination. The ninjas glide across the ice with smooth, quick movements, moving like shadows in the night. The arena buzzes with the tension of a fierce contest as each side plays with steady resolve toward the climax.
This HTML5 arcade title is built for mobile devices as well as computers. Controls are simple: a mouse click or a tap is all you need to play.
raised-knight: Raised Knight is an endless runner in the Arcade category, and it puts your reflexes to work from the first second. You keep moving through a landscape packed with hazards, aiming to travel as far as you can. Each decision you make matters, so learning how the controls respond will help you go further.

Press A or D to shift left or right, weaving through gaps and finding safe paths when danger appears. Hold Space to jump or float, clearing hurdles or staying airborne to dodge whatever is in your way; timing in the air can decide whether you succeed. Tap Ctrl to slide beneath low barriers and escape tight spots, then get back on your route right away.
math-fun: Math Fun is an educational app that helps young learners work on mathematics. Children can practice addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division, and the game is open to play at no charge. It suits parents who want to build their kids' math skills, since the game turns practice into an easy and enjoyable activity.
The game offers a wide range of puzzles and brain teasers that rely only on basic arithmetic. To play, tap the right answer on screen and keep moving through the challenges.
pocket-tile: Pocket Tile is a colorful puzzle where every placement matters. You drop tiles onto a 5×5 grid and line up three that share both a number and a color, either vertically or horizontally. Once a group glows, you choose where the upgraded tile appears. Clone tiles copy matching-color numbers, and Change Color tiles recolor a neighbor, so planning ahead, making room, and keeping your merges going
time-puzzle: Time Puzzle is a calm picture puzzle where you set every piece in its correct place. Each finished image reveals a lovely photo, and completing one unlocks new puzzles to try. The levels grow gradually more demanding, and you can move through them at whatever speed suits you.

With a mouse, grab a piece and drag it onto another to swap their positions. On a phone or tablet, touch a piece and drag it the same way. Once all the pieces are arranged correctly, the picture is complete and the level ends. Rewards come in as you progress, hints are there when a spot stumps you, and the items you unlock let you decorate your gallery.
red-and-green-2-candy-forest: Red and Green 2 Candy Forest is a two player adventure about the friendship between the red man and the green man. Its ten chapters follow the pair as they press forward together. Collect candies to earn points, and watch out for lasers along the way.
Each player has their own set of keys. One player uses WASD and R, while the other uses the arrow keys and O. The game also supports touch controls on mobile, so you can play on a touch device too.
boom-wheels: Boom Wheels is a 3D kart racer that runs in your browser and is built for one player. You hop into a souped-up go-kart and tear around a series of tracks, each one feeling like its own little adventure to explore and master. Along the way you can grab power-ups: a speed boost for a burst of lightning-fast driving, rockets to blast rivals, a heavy stone to smash opponents, or banana peels to leave on the road. Use them wisely to shoot to the front of the pack.
On a computer, steer with WASD or the arrow keys and press Spacebar to fire off a power-up
retro-run: Retro Run is a free-to-play runner for PC that keeps you moving side to side with the A and D keys. Some hazards you simply dodge, while others you can break apart by hurling your orbs at them. Grab power-ups as you go, since they can pull you out of tight spots.

Your orbs are your lifeline. Run out of them and the run starts over. To refill, press Space to call your orbs back, or smash the special crystals found along the way. Left click throws an orb, keys 1, 2, and 3 change its color, and F triggers a power-up. Learn these abilities well, clear obstacles, and smash targets to get as far as you can.
advanced-blocky-paintball: Battle a swarm of ghost bots from Minecraft, with several maps in play at the same time. Your arsenal offers a selection of powerful weapons, but undead foes keep appearing no matter how well armed you are. Hide behind different objects to stay alive during the fight. The story also includes a tally of weapons, and like most scary games, it gives you a gun so you can defend yourself.
This free online shooter is played with the keyboard and mouse. Use W, A, S, and D to walk, while the mouse lets you aim, look around, and shoot. Press Tab to open the menu and Space to jump.
nugget-man-survival-puzzle: Nugget Man is stranded in the desert, and you have to rescue him. Lift him into the sky with balloons, taking care not to burst any of them. Solve the puzzles and get him to the finish before time runs out. The Gedagedago soundtrack plays along as you go.
Along the way, you'll face desert bandits, cacti, and many other tricky obstacles. Your job is to guide the character safely through each one. You play by clicking the mouse or tapping the screen.
paintball-fun-shooting-multiplayer: Paintball Fun Shooting Multiplayer lets you take part in paintball-style shooting across a map arena. The game offers five modes, including Gun Game. TDM is the default mode, so you can jump straight into matches and play with friends from anywhere in the world.

If you'd rather play alone, you can work through 40 levels in offline mode. The controls are straightforward: WASD moves your character, and the mouse lets you aim, look around, and shoot. You can also change your gun, jump with Space, run with Shift, and open the menu with Tab.
stunsteval-siderollers: Stunsteval Siderollers is an arcade race seen from the side. Your aim is to outrun a helicopter, a biplane, or a fighter jet. The race can take place in the rain or on a dark highway.
On a PC, press D to move forward and A to go back. W shifts up a gear, S selects a low gear, and a double-tap of D lowers the gear. Phone players steer with the arrow keys instead.
baby-good-habits-learn-to-be-a-baby: Parents can pick up useful routines alongside their little ones in this 2D educational game. Each activity teaches a daily habit, from brushing teeth before bed to taking a proper shower and checking that the water temperature is right. The baby also wears a waterproof cap during bath time. Above all, the game shows how to build steady sleep habits by heading to bed on time every night.

Players practice all of these routines directly in the game, which is casual and fun for both boys and girls. You play by tapping or clicking, so anyone can join in right away. Working through the activities together should benefit the whole family.
trash-sort: In this game you take on the role of a trash sorter. Every bottle, can, paper scrap, or piece of food waste you sort correctly helps nature recover. As you keep recycling, the scenes shift from dirty and gray into bright, lively places filled with cheerful animals.

Controls are easy to pick up. Tap an item and drag it into the bin that fits it. Each bin carries a symbol or color linked to one kind of waste, so a bottle goes in the glass bin and a leaf goes in the organic one. The gameplay stays straightforward, yet watching the land heal because of your choices is very rewarding.
panda-go: In Panda Go!, you steer a panda that keeps drifting forward on its own, so your job is all about timing. Tap, or left-click, to flap and lift it upward. Pass cleanly through the glowing rings, aim for the middle of each one to build combo chains that boost your score, and steer clear of walls and obstacles along the way.

Coins can be gathered to upgrade your run. A shield absorbs one collision, while a magnet draws in nearby coins automatically. Each run also gives you one revive if you crash. There is no set finish line, so keep flying, collect loot, unlock new pandas, and try to climb the leaderboard.
cars-vs-blocks: Cars & Blocks mixes color matching with puzzle play and a bit of careful driving. Clear colorful blocks to free the stickmen. Each stickman must board a car of its own color, so open a route that lets every car leave without traffic chaos. The early stages are gentle, but the game grows tougher as spaces tighten, more colors appear, and the puzzles demand sharper logic.
Controls are simple. You can use a mou
russian-taz-driving-3: Russian Taz Driving 3 is a 3D racing game where you take the wheel of a range of detailed Russian automobiles. The visuals look sharp, and each car model is built with plenty of fine detail. Your route runs through a large city in Russia, where the streets are crowded with gopniks.
This is a single-player game, so you play alone. Steer with W, A, S and D, brake with the Space bar, and press C to switch between camera views.
golf-golf: Golf Golf is a sports game that brings the feel of real golf into your browser. Its physics-based puzzles are challenging and ask you to read each shot before you take it. You set your aim, then work through a variety of tasks built around the sport.

Your main objective is to throw the ball into the hole and prove yourself as a golf champion. Controls are simple: a mouse click or a tap is all it takes to play. Lining up each attempt with care is the heart of the experience.
american-truck-driver-game: Climb behind the wheel of powerful American trucks and head out onto demanding roads. In this racing title, you handle massive rigs, complete delivery missions, and explore a range of environments while testing your driving skills. Your route may take you along highways, where you manage your truck and carry cargo safely. The game aims for a realistic truck-driving feel, so it suits truck fans and players who enjoy driving simulators. Its missions are challenging, and the truck controls feel satisfying throughout the road adventure.
Press W or the Up Arrow to move forward, S or the Down Arrow to move back, A or the Left Arrow to move left, and D or the Right Arrow to move right. Use the mouse to click any button.
jade-toss-arrow-challenge: Step into a quiet 3D skill game based on pitch-pot, an old East Asian pastime of tossing arrows into a jar. Grab the arrow, drag down to set your power, then let it go toward the jade pot. Every hit earns points and keeps your five lives, while each miss costs one of them.

As your score climbs, the pot slides farther away, the wind grows stronger, and a small bonus pot appears. Land three hits in a row to enter the zone and double your points, or aim for the centre of the mouth for a Perfect bonus. Drag sideways to fight the wind. Courtyards drawn from Vietnamese, Chinese, Korean and Japanese traditions offer calm settings, with new arrows, pots and scenes to unlock, plus a daily challenge to beat your best score.
adam-vs-sacha: Adam and Sacha were once close friends, but a fight turned them into enemies who each want the other gone. To settle the score, they gather weapons that drop from above on three different maps and use them to shoot one another.

This is a 2D shooter for two players. Sacha moves with the W, A and D keys, while Adam uses the arrow keys. On a mobile device, the touch screen buttons handle the controls instead. The action takes place across all three maps, so both players need to grab the right weapons quickly and aim well. It's a fast arcade-style game with a bit of adventure in its setup.
sweet-supermarket-simulator: Sweet Supermarket Simulator is a simulation and management tycoon game about running a supermarket. You begin by collecting ingredients and stocking shelves, which lets you earn money. That money can be used to unlock new shelves filled with products, hire new staff, and upgrade your character. Later on, you can also unlock new supermarkets.

You move around with the W, A, S, and D keys, or with mouse or touch controls. The core loop is simple: gather, stock, earn, and grow. Each part of the game feeds into the next, so your progress builds step by step.
baby-panda-forest-recipes: Baby Panda Forest Recipes is an adorable cooking game with three playful sections to explore. In the first, you cook tasty rice balls alongside a bunny. Another section lets you whip up a fun coconut jelly with a little monkey, and the last one has you bake groundnut cake with a little mole. Animations run smoothly in HD, and the bright, cheerful colors make every scene pop. Simply follow the on-screen tips to prepare each dish. Controls are easy: use your mouse to click, or tap on a touchscreen.
rich-shopping-3d-game: This 3D title is a calm game about building a fashion collection. Money is never a worry, so you can shop as much as you like. Each purchase adds to your style, and your fashion influence grows the more you collect.

Your path leads from someone just starting out to a person who sets the trends for others. Along the way, people gather and dance alongside you. Play is simple, with a mouse click or a tap being all you need.
money-honey: Money Honey is a running arcade game centered on collecting and dressing up. Your goal is to help a stylish woman find wealthy men who will pay for the clothes she loves, including handbags, shoes, skirts, and pants. Each man has his own value, so every one of them offers a different amount of money. If she wants to switch into a richer suit, you will need to guide her toward better-paying jobs.
The game runs in 3D and is made for mobile play, and it also carries platform and collecting tags. Controls are simple: drag to move left and right, which lets you steer her through the action.
square-sort: Square Sort is a puzzle game where you swipe colorful cubes in any direction to shift them around the board. Your goal is to sort the squares by color and clear the board. Line up cubes of the same color in a row or column and they disappear. Each level has a set number of moves, so think ahead and make every swipe count.

As you move up through the levels, the challenge grows, with more colors and larger grids to handle. The controls are simple, and the bright, pleasing visuals are easy on the eye. A relaxing soundtrack sits nicely alongside the tougher puzzles. It's a great way to exercise your brain while having fun, and a good pick for anyone who loves puzzle games.
motor-royale: In Motor Royale, your main goal is to finish in first place. Along the way you will pass a range of fun props while riding your motorbike, and you can rotate it a full 360 degrees in the air. Vehicle names show up all over the scenery, so there is always something to read as you speed past.

Each time you reach a boss level, a fighting chicken waits for you. It carries a 98K rifle and a frying pan. You steer the bike by sliding left or right, and you tap the screen to shoot. This 3D arcade shooter mixes racing with combat.
princess-social-media-fashion-trend: Many girls spend a lot of their time on social apps, chatting with friends and sharing photos of their everyday lives. A newer craze among them is dressing in a way inspired by app icons, so clothes and hairstyles end up resembling the logos they use. Ariel, Jasmine and Rapunzel have heard about this trend and are keen to try it. Your job is to create fresh hairstyles for them and choose new dresses that match the look.
Playing is simple, since a mouse click or a tap is all it takes. Try different combinations and see how each princess turns out in this trend.
stick-roll-arena: Stick Roll Arena is an action game built around one-on-one battles. Each roll of the dice summons a new group of stickmen, and those fighters automatically push the rival team toward the edge of the platform. To win, you must knock every red opponent off the arena. Strategy matters, and so does timing, because calling in extra warriors at the right moment can turn the fight in your favor.

The stickmen come in a range of bright, distinct colors, and their pushing relies on physics that feel satisfying to watch. Controls are kept minimal: a single tap or click anywhere on the screen rolls the dice. As you progress, the challenge grows, and the vibrant graphics keep every match lively. It is easy to learn, and the one-tap controls make it simple to jump right in.
underground-heroes: In this tower defense strategy game, you use a hook to pull trapped heroes up from beneath the battlefield. Timing your swings and aiming with care decides which fighters you bring out, whether warriors, archers, mages, or others. Every hero you free joins your side and battles enemy troops and towers.

Expect real-time fights against waves of enemies and enemy towers, with a fast pace and room for smart planning. Build a varied army, upgrade your heroes, and improve your hook so you can reach more heroes below. Each hero has unique features, and each arena grows harder than the last, so keep your team strong as you advance.
fashion-battle-catwalk-queen: Fashion Battle: Catwalk Queen is a casual online game made for kids who enjoy fashion. It brings the fun of a catwalk to your screen and invites you to strut your stuff. Each level sets a theme, and your job is to pick outfits that fit it. Along the way, you will need quick reactions as well as a good sense of style.
At the end of the show, the judges award scores, and the party with the highest total wins. It lets you enjoy the glory of standing in the spotlight. Controls are simple: tap or click to play.
eco-block-puzzle: Eco Block Puzzle is a classic block game with an added layer of progression. After an ecological disaster has damaged the land, your job is to clear up the environment by fitting pieces together and finishing tricky boards. Each solved puzzle rewards you with eco coins.

As you clean up, the cleared ground grows, and you can spend your coins on animals and other lifeforms to bring the valley back to life. Its blend of classic block puzzling and eco-friendly play can be enjoyed right on your device.
bicycle-kick-master: Bicycle Kick Master is a soccer game built entirely around the bicycle kick. Every shot you take is this kind of kick, and your goal is to beat both the goalkeeper and a defender. Nothing else gets in the way, so the focus stays on making each strike count and going for the best action on every kick.

Controls are simple. On a computer, move the mouse to position yourself and click to kick. On a phone, move your finger across the screen and lift it to kick. You never need to swipe, so the whole game comes down to movement and timing.
speedmatch-competition: SpeedMatch Competition is a quick-moving contest built around matching tiles and solving puzzles. You race against rivals and decide where to place your stakes: on speed, on accuracy, or on both. Your aim is to finish ahead of every opponent on the board.
Click or tap the screen to stop the tiles, then match and crush them all before your opponents do. Whichever approach you choose, the goal stays the same: clear your tiles before anyone else can.
zasteroid: Zasteroid is a quick top-down space shooter in 2D, with roguelike elements that carry between runs. You fly a starship through waves that never end, facing odd foes such as meteors, speedy interceptors, slow armored tanks, suicide kamikazes, and giant bosses that show up after every fifth wave. Your weapon fires on its own the whole time, so your job is simply to move, slip past enemy shots, and collect XP crystals to climb levels.

Each level-up pauses the action and offers three random upgrade cards, letting you steer your build toward extra bullets, piercing shots, shields, homing missiles, faster movement, a wider pickup magnet, and much more. Coins you gather stay with you even after a crash, and you can spend them in the Hangar on new ships and lasting upgrades. Grazing enemy fire charges a powerful Super Weapon, and every wave offers bonus goals that pay extra coins. Controls are simple: move the mouse or drag a finger, with WASD or arrow keys as a desktop backup.
urban-farm-simulator-game: Urban Farm Simulator is a fun, relaxing farming game set in the middle of a city. You build and run your own farm there, sowing seeds, tending your fields, and gathering fresh produce. Each reward you earn lets you expand your land. Along the way, you manage your farm and finish tasks while a small urban plot grows into a flourishing farming venture.

Getting around is simple. Press W or the Up Arrow to move forward, S or the Down Arrow to move back, A or the Left Arrow to move left, and D or the Right Arrow to move right. Use your mouse to click any button in the game.
ladder-race: Ladder Race is an arcade racing game where you gather sticks and turn them into ladders as you move forward. Each stick you pick up helps you build your own path, so you can keep pushing ahead. Timing matters, because you lay down ladders exactly when you need them. Along the way you must dodge obstacles, and you can pave roads to make your route stronger.

Your score climbs as you get farther and manage your resources well. The real challenge is to hold onto as many sticks as you can, since a bigger stockpile earns you higher rewards. The controls are simple: tap to play and start racing.
sweet-flip: Sweet Flip is a puzzle game where colorful cakes fall from above, and your job is to line them up. Match cakes of the same shade, clear them from the board, and rack up points as you go. React quickly and keep the glass from overflowing, while the bright, tasty desserts keep things cheerful.

As you progress, new flavors unlock and the challenges become tastier and tougher. The game is simple to pick up but hard to put down. On a computer, use the left and right arrow keys to move each cake sideways and the down arrow to drop it faster. On mobile, tap the Left, Down, and Right buttons to do the same things.
mini-moto-speed-race: Mini Moto Speed Race is a motorcycle arcade game with a violent racing twist. Its 3D graphics have a cartoon look, and you must dodge all sorts of obstacles while trying to strike different AI riders. Diamonds you collect let you visit the shop, where you can buy extra weapons and new bikes. Completing more levels lets you pick up the items you like best.

Steering is simple: slide your finger across the screen to move left or right, and hold to speed up. The game is built for mobile play, so you can enjoy it on your device. It combines collecting, avoiding and striking into one ride.
domino-camp: Domino Camp mixes careful planning with quick reactions in a puzzle game built around domino tiles. Your goal is to pair tiles, clear the board, and finish challenges spread across varied levels. The controls are easy to learn, the motion runs smoothly, and each successful pairing comes with satisfying visual effects. Rewards arrive as you advance, and the game suits players of every age.

Use it to sharpen your logic and matching skills, and look for different ways to solve each puzzle. Whether you want a calm session or a tougher brain workout, the game fits your mood. Play with a mouse or touchscreen by tapping or clicking a tile to select it, then matching it with the target number shown at the bottom of the screen. Correct matches clear tiles and carry you forward. Plan each move, and aim for the fewest moves possible to earn the highest score.
perfect-new-years-eve-party-look: Dress up four Rainbow High friends, Skyler, Sunny, Ruby, and Violet, as they get ready for a New Year's Eve party. Your task is to look through each girl's wardrobe and pick the outfit you think suits the night best. Once the clothes are chosen, add some cute makeup to every girl. Each choice you make shapes how the evening looks for them.

Show off your styling skills and make this New Year as memorable as possible, so take your time and try different combinations. Everything in the game is controlled with a single left mouse button click. Enjoy helping these four girls prepare for their celebration.
city-fighter-vs-street-gang: City Fighter vs Street Gang puts you in a karate brawl with a heroic street fighter at the center of the action. It is a fighting game set in a busy arena, packed with fast moments. The story takes you into a city filled with fighting challenges and martial arts contests, where you face different kinds of city warriors.
Controls are simple: click or tap to play. Whether you are on a computer or a phone, you can jump into the fights right away and test your skills against the gang.
pin-fish-escape: Pin Fish Escape is a calming puzzle adventure built around pins. Your goal is clear: pull the correct pin so the fish can reach safety. You play with one hand, so quick, light movements are all you need to get through each challenge.

Every puzzle presents a different pin setup, and no two feel quite the same. You will need to think ahead, work out the right order, and free a path that keeps the fish away from danger. It suits anyone who enjoys rescue stories and likes sharpening their problem-solving skills. Controls are simple: click with your mouse or tap to play.
halloween-is-coming-episode-9: Halloween Is Coming Episode 9 is a point-and-click escape game that puts you in the shoes of John, who has become trapped inside a frightening house. Your job is to search the rooms for hidden objects and work through a set of puzzles so he can find a way out. The creepy atmosphere makes every clue feel important, and each discovery may lead you closer to freedom.

Everything is controlled with the mouse. Click on objects and areas in the scene to interact with them and move the story forward. Take your time, notice the small details, and think carefully about each challenge. With a mix of puzzles and hidden items to uncover, this episode rewards patient, observant players.
paint-sponges-puzzle: Paint Sponges Puzzle lets you express your creative side while working through tricky mazes. You steer a colorful sponge across a grid, and it leaves a bright streak wherever it travels. Success depends on planning ahead and solving each maze with care, and the challenges grow harder as you advance. The game blends logic and artistry, and it can be played on mobile devices as well as computers.

Moving the sponge takes just a swipe in the direction you want it to go. A level is finished once you have painted over all the squares in the maze. Plan your route carefully, because you must cover every square before you can move on.
ball-gradient: Ball Gradient is a hypercasual arcade adventure where you guide a ball along courses filled with dangerous hazards. You slide it sideways to dodge swinging axes, guillotines, and swords, and the tracks call for careful timing at every turn. It suits anyone who enjoys a quick arcade title, and the game comes packed with many features.

Controls are simple: press the arrow keys to move the ball left and right. The tracks blend adventure, platform, and obstacle elements, so staying alert from start to finish is important. Keep your eyes on the path ahead and react to each new hazard as it appears.
colors-and-forms: Colors&Forms is a browser title that puts your reflexes and planning to the test. Its puzzles come in many forms and feature bright, colorful visuals. Several game modes are on offer, so there is a long list of tasks to tackle as you move through the levels.

Your job is to slide the pieces along the bottom of the tracks so they line up with the elements falling down the screen, and each level has missions to finish. Before you start, pick a mode according to its speed. Some objects appear on screen and need a click. The button with the castle icon lets you switch the type of game, and the settings menu lets you change the language or turn off music and sound effects.
extreme-supercar-stunt-drive: Extreme Supercar: Stunt Drive lets you take the wheel of high-performance cars that stretch what physics seems to allow. Top speeds are immense, the handling responds with care, and the cutting-edge technology under the bodywork is impressive. Your aim is to show off your skill with daring stunts, from soaring jumps to tight, sliding drifts, each performed with smooth, careful control. Engines growl with a hungry, animal-like roar as you go.

The game also feels like a live show for spectators, combining the raw strength of modern supercars with the bold creativity of skilled drivers. Use W, A, S and D to drive, and press C to switch camera views. On mobile, on-screen buttons cover the same controls, so you can play without a keyboard.
park-inc: Park Inc is a mobile parking adventure where you try to rescue cars stuck in tight spots. Your task is to drag vehicles out of the way so that the trapped cars can get free.

Each level presents a harder puzzle than the last, so you will need good spatial awareness and clever problem-solving to get through them. Whether you play casually or think of yourself as a parking pro, the game offers many hours of fun that is hard to put down, no matter your skill level. Control is simple: just click with your mouse or tap the screen.
vikings-an-archer-s-journey: Vikings: An Archer's Journey combines a shoot 'em up with an endless runner, all wrapped in a clean, minimalist style. You guide Nott, a skilled Valkyrie archer, through the Underworld on a mission to rescue her wolf, Oder.

Simple controls make the game easy to pick up, and you can gather power-ups as you go. Teaming up with Viking heroes, you battle monsters from Nordic legends in this challenging adventure. Its sleek visuals work on both mobile devices and computers, and the game is free to play on either.
curve-quest: Steer your character along winding curved tracks while dodging obstacles that come rushing at you. Every hit drains some of your health, and once it runs out, the run is over. Along the way you can grab points, coins, and power-ups, and collecting them gives you a boost.
To move, simply click or tap to switch direction. Your job is to keep weaving through the course and keep out of the obstacles' path for as long as you can.
fish-eat-getting-big: Your fish grows larger each time it eats smaller fish than itself. Gather a few friends, since up to three people can play together. The sea is packed with many fish of various types. Your goal is to hunt the smaller fish marked with numbers and work your way up to the biggest size possible.

Every level rewards you with coins, which you can spend at the market on new fish types. You can also dive into different oceans and continue your adventure in new places. Player 1 moves with W, A, S and D, Player 2 uses the arrow keys, and Player 3 moves with the mouse and clicks with the left button.
obby-rpg-slasher-blade-loot: Obby: RPG Slasher Blade Loot blends close-range combat with role-playing growth. You strike foes up close, call on strong abilities, and push through obby courses full of tough trials. Gather weapons and armor, weigh the numbers on each piece, and upgrade your gear to build up your hero. Every item shifts your attack, defense, and health, so smart choices let you shape the way you fight.

Move through levels, open new regions, and face tougher enemies as your character grows. The simple rules are quick to grasp, but the layered progression system offers plenty to explore, which fans of loot, upgrades, and action should appreciate. On PC, W, A, S, and D move your hero, the mouse steers the camera, left click attacks, 1 triggers an ability, and E interacts with objects. On mobile, a joystick handles movement, swiping the screen turns the camera, and dedicated buttons cover attacks, abilities, and interactions.
mermaid-style-dress-up: Adella has been away from her ocean kingdom for a long time, and her friends miss her dearly. To bring everyone together, she decides to throw a mermaid party under the sea and invites the girls to join. The guests have already become mermaids, but none of them has a proper costume for the celebration. Your job is to purchase costumes for them and then help each girl get dressed for the party.

Play the game with a mouse click or a tap. It sits in the Girls category and is tagged with Dress Up, Fashion, Makeover, Mermaid, and Princess, so it suits anyone who enjoys styling characters and sea-themed fun.
capyballra-capybara-ball-collector: This arcade game asks you to spin a maze so your Capyballras roll out and drop into the pipe, which completes the level. On desktop you drag with your mouse, and on mobile you drag with your finger, turning the maze clockwise or counterclockwise. The controls need only one touch, and the quick physics and clever level layouts keep each attempt engaging. Now and then a bonus level appears, where you can gather even more Capyballras to earn extra points.

Coins you collect can be spent on new Capyballra designs. The skin collection includes classic looks, seasonal styles, and rare animated versions to show off. Whether you want a short session or plan to unlock the entire set, there is plenty to work toward.
wingy-wheels: Wingy Wheels is a cozy arcade game about sliding down hills in cars with wings. Build speed by diving down the slopes, then launch off the hilltops and glide through the sky. Chain perfect slides to trigger Fever mode, and grab coins along the way. Spend those coins on five upgrades (Longer Day, Glide Wings, Engine Power, Coin Magnet, and Lucky Coins) to unlock six colorful cars.

Hold the mouse button, tap and hold the screen, or hold Space to dive, then release to fly off a hilltop. Land on downhill slopes to keep your speed, but avoid steep uphill slopes where you lack the speed to climb, or the run ends. Finish three missions to level up and raise your score multiplier. Every run uses a new track, while the Daily Challenge gives everyone the same one each day. Race the sunset by reaching new islands before night falls to earn extra daylight.
sushi-chef: In Sushi Chef, you make all kinds of food and materials, and every prop and material in the game is there for you to use however you like. The adventure runs on a parkour style of play that brings plenty of unexpected moments and gives each player a satisfying simulation challenge. Its new interactive parkour approach keeps things lively, and you will find a range of simulation-based production and design methods to explore as you go.

The game is tagged as cooking, restaurant, adventure, brain and classic, so it mixes familiar play with hands-on food making. The 3D visuals are fun to look at, and the painting style shown in the screenshots gives a fair idea of how the game looks and plays before you start.
mob-control: Mob Control is a 3D arcade game about invading a castle by using the power of numbers. On every level, you launch blue stickmen toward an enemy castle, and each one must be sent past the number area on the way. The stickman models give the game a simple, playful look that is easy to follow from the first level onward.

Controls are straightforward: slide to play. Your goal is to get your crowd through the number area so that you can win the war and take the castle. Each level asks you to think about how your numbers stack up, and that advantage is what carries you to victory.
eye-art-perfect-makeup: Step into this refined makeup game with a strong focus on the eyes. Every part of it revolves around eye styling, so the experience stays tightly on one theme. Across 26 levels, you can choose from 26 different types of eye makeup, which means there is plenty of variety to explore.

Whatever makeup style you prefer, there is a good chance you will find one here that suits your taste. Controls are simple: use a mouse click or a tap to play. Each level offers its own eye look to try, so you can test many options in one place.
stellar-shot-gravity-puzzle: Guide a probe into a portal across space maps where gravity bends every launch. Nearby bodies pull and push your path, including orbiting planets, heavy masses with a stronger tug, repulsion fields that shove you away, and wormholes that carry you across the level. Drag to set direction and power, then release to fire. Finishing in fewer shots earns more stars and unlocks further missions.

Early levels ease you in, while later puzzles grow tough. The game is simple to learn and satisfying to master, and planning ahead while reading the gravity pays off. Mouse users can press R to retry, H for a hint, or Esc for the pause menu, and the on-screen Menu, Mute, Retry, and Hint buttons are also available. On mobile, drag to aim, release to shoot, and tap the buttons.
special-agent: Special Agent puts you in the shoes of a secret operative whose mission is to eliminate hostile targets in a fast-paced combat arcade setting. What makes it stand out is the bounce mechanic: you can aim shots so they ricochet off the ground and strike foes that would otherwise be out of reach.

You control the action with your mouse on a computer, or with touch on a phone or tablet. Since it runs in the browser and is built with HTML5, there is nothing to install before you start. It is a skill-based shooter that rewards careful aiming and clever planning.
adventure-squad: Adventure Squad is a turn-free tactical RPG built around forming a team from 60 distinct classes and guiding it through hard campaigns. You bring in heroes of many kinds, place them on the field, and mix tanks, fighters, archers, and mages into one group. Your party fights waves of monsters on its own, but you decide when to trigger special skills and when to swing the battle back in your favor.

Each victory rewards gold, which you can spend on stronger heroes and new class branches. Every branch reshapes a hero's stats, role, and skills, so your roster can grow in many directions. Enemies come with their own tricks, such as hitting units in the rear, poisoning your party, calling in reinforcements, healing their allies, or wearing thick armor. You will need to rearrange your lineup and change tactics as you go, beat strong bosses, and move forward across the adventure map. Auto mode can cast abilities for you, though each automatic cast uses one AutoCoin. Drag heroes between slots and tap buttons or characters to play.
impossible-car-stunt-races-mega-ramps: Mega Ramps is a stunt-driving simulator where the physics are pushed far beyond the ordinary. Expect crashes, jumps, drifts, and a host of other daring racing car tricks along the way.

Free mode opens up a roaming space full of stunts and obstacles, where you take the wheel of a sports car and try to conquer the giant mega ramp. The challenge races are built to test your skills, with dangerous ramps to clear as you aim to beat each one. Steer with the arrow keys, press F for NOS, and hit the spacebar to pull the handbrake.
fashion-short-hair-studio: Three fashionable friends, Chloe, Bella, and Sofia, are ready for a fresh look, so they visit Zoe's barbershop for help. Your job is to create a trendy short haircut for each of them. This is a dress-up and makeover simulation aimed at girls and kids who enjoy playing with hair and style.

Everything is controlled with a mouse click or a tap, so it works well on most devices. Experiment with different cuts and see what suits each girl best. Zoe's Short Hair Studio is all about having fun while you shape the perfect short style.
bound-to-defend: Bound to Defend is an action looter where you hold one spot and fight off endless waves of enemies. You cannot walk, but you can pan the camera with A and D and aim your focus with the mouse. Your character attacks automatically while you guard the outpost. Gather loot, merge and enhance gear, and choose a starting class before you begin.

Skills grow like a roguelike, so every new run starts at level 1 and your abilities are built again from scratch. Once unlocked, skills fire with Q, W, E, and R, while potions use keys 1 and 2.
