Esc opens the menu for saving and settings, and left click handles menus and NPCs. Press I or the inventory button to open your bag. A monthly leaderboard ranks how far players survive, and the top three each month win permanent exclusive cosmetics through their inbox.
mech-monster-arena: Mech Monster Arena is a turn-based strategy game about robot battles. Unlike typical fighting games, you won't have to master complicated controls or memorize how each move is triggered. Instead, you focus on the basic counter rules and pick your skills as the fight unfolds. Wins in Mech Battle earn you EXP and coins, which let you take on AI opponents and steadily improve your machine.

Once you have gathered enough resources to upgrade your robot in the Mech Warehouse, you can head into the Arena and test it against other players. Play is simple: just click or tap to make your choices. It's a good pick for one player who enjoys planning moves and building up a robot over time.
orc-breach: Orc Breach is a quick tower defense game in which you hold back massive orc hordes before they can break through your defenses. You place turrets, aim them, and combine their different strengths. Powerful support abilities add more options, and you can upgrade your arsenal as you go. The full campaign brings bigger and bigger enemy assaults to survive.

Set your turrets close to the enemy routes and aim them at the approaching horde. Use your weapons and abilities to slow, burn, blast, and destroy the orcs before they reach your base. On PC, the mouse places and aims turrets, the mouse wheel zooms, WASD or the arrow keys move the camera, and Space starts the battle. On mobile, touch controls handle placing, aiming, and activating abilities.
sudoku-number-games: Sudoku - Number Games is a logic puzzle built around numbers. It sharpens your attention and helps you work on memory and reasoning, and it is simply meant to be enjoyable. As you move up through the levels, the puzzles grow harder, but you can always return to earlier levels and play them on an easier setting.

The board is split into 9 squares, each made of 3 by 3 cells. Your goal is to fill every row, every column, and every square, which each contain 9 cells, with the digits 1 through 9. No digit may appear twice within any of those rows, columns, or squares.
unicorn-merge: Unicorn Merge is a puzzle game built around combining. You swipe left, right, up or down, and similar elements merge together. Your mission is to reach the unicorn, which is linked with good luck. Each swipe gives you another chance to match elements and move closer to that goal.

The controls are simple, since swiping is the only action needed to merge. There is nothing else to learn, so you can start right away and focus on planning your moves. Think about each swipe before you make it and watch how the elements line up as you go.
twist-your-path: Twist Your Path is a solo arcade game that tests your reflexes and concentration. Your runner moves forward along a turning trunk, and you must time your turns carefully to dodge obstacles. The longer you last, the higher your score climbs. Pick up coins along the way and spend them to unlock new characters.

Sessions are meant to be brief. The rules are easy to grasp, but shifting speed and changing direction make every attempt nerve-wracking. Tap the screen or click the mouse button to rotate the trunk, and watch the branches ahead. When the way is blocked, turn in time and keep moving. Your score rises during each run, and your best result is saved for next time.
real-pool-3d: Real Pool 3D offers a wide selection of levels to work through. Beginners and experienced players alike will find a challenge that suits them. The difficulty climbs across many skill tiers, from easy all the way to expert, and you can test your aim in a variety of settings. Each level brings its own obstacles and table layouts, so the play stays engaging and keeps pushing you toward mastery.

Controls are simple: use a mouse click or a tap to play. Your goal is to sink the shots and clear the table. Whether you are new to the cue or already feel like a pro, this 3D pool game gives you plenty of room to sharpen your skills one shot at a time.
fruit-matcher: Fruit Matcher is a puzzle game where you swap neighboring fruits around the board. Whenever you line up three or more identical fruits, either across a row or straight down a column, they form a group and get cleared. You keep matching until you have unlocked and removed every tile. When progress feels slow, you can use power-ups to speed things along.

Controls are simple, since a mouse or touchpad is all you need. Select a fruit, then move it into a neighboring spot to build your group. Clearing the whole board takes patience and careful planning, so it helps to look for chances several moves ahead.
discolor-master: Discolor Master is a shooting game that adds plenty of color elements to the action. You aim at targets in different colors and fire with your guns to succeed. Watch out for enemy shots, because getting hit can end your run halfway through. It sits in the puzzles category and carries tags for kids and mobile play.

Controls are simple: hold to shoot. Keep holding whenever you want to keep firing, and release when you want to stop. The game asks you to pay attention to both your targets and the enemies around you, so it rewards steady focus. It is a colorful option for anyone who likes shooting challenges.
block-dancing-3d: Block Dancing 3D takes you along music-driven routes built from lifelike 3D maps and striking special effects. Many scene experiences, dozens of accessories, and a wide range of box effects keep each stage fresh, and dozens of songs give you plenty to move to. You can rotate the camera, scroll through levels, and climb or descend along the path. When night falls, a dance game appears in the dark night mode.
Tap carefully to keep your timing sharp and work your way up to beat master. The game sends you down a new path shaped by music, so stay focused from the first block to the last.
match-master: Match Master is a puzzle game built around pairs, and it rewards careful thinking. Objects are scattered across the ground in three dimensions, and your job is to find matching couples and make them vanish. Each time you finish a stage, new objects appear for you to pair up. Sorting the board, spotting hidden items, and lining up tile twins keep your mind busy, and the relaxing feel of the game makes it easy to unwind while you test your memory.

To begin, pick the first 3D object you want, which might be a glossy shape, an animal, or an emoji. Next, pick up the second object and move both of them to the circle in the middle of the screen. Keep repeating this until the whole screen is clear and the level is won. Then carry on with a new level whenever you are ready.
idle-firefighter-3d: Idle Firefighter 3d puts you in the role of a firefighter who also operates a fire truck. Your job is to save the survivors of a blaze. Emergencies keep breaking out, so you must stay ready and put each fire out as quickly as possible. Your fire extinguisher is the key tool, but its supplies are limited. Once those run out, you can no longer stop the flames.
Everything is controlled with a tap or a click. Stay on standby between calls, since new emergencies keep coming. The faster you respond, the sooner the fire is out and the survivors are safe.
superbikes-racing-2022: SuperBikes Racing 2022 is a free game that you can also play offline, including drag races reaching up to 400 km/h. Finding the best drift route is key, and you may get a chance to race against the subway system. Keep practicing to earn a place among the racing legends of mobile gaming.

If you are new to driving simulations, the game has a driving school to help you learn the basics and how to drift. Once you have those down, you move on to drag racing and become a running master. If you prefer a calmer pace, the driving simulator recreates the feel of a real road, with cars and motorcycles that follow traffic laws and no drag racing or reckless crashes. Steer with WASD or the arrow keys.
dualight-a-reflected-game: DuaLight is a tough 2D platformer with pixel art and a hyper-casual feel. Its levels are built to trick your eyes, so the route forward shows up only in the reflection beneath the screen. Watch that mirrored area closely, because hidden platforms exist there and you need them to keep moving. Spikes are scattered along the way, too, so you have to avoid them.
The game is minimalist and short. To move, use W A S D or the arrow keys. To jump, press W, the up arrow, or the spacebar. Press P at any time to return to the menu.
world-of-alice-first-letter: World of Alice: First Letter is an educational game made for children. Its main goal is to help players complete words by choosing the initial letter that belongs at the start of each one. You can play it on a cell phone, a tablet, or a computer, so it fits whatever device you have nearby. It works well as an educational resource for young learners who want a relaxed way to practice their letters.

To play, click on the initial letter of the word shown on screen. The central idea behind the game is simple: learning can be fun, and children can build their letter skills while they enjoy themselves.
monster-merge-legends-alive: Monster Merge: Legends Alive is a puzzle game where you pair up creatures to rack up points and move forward. It plays online at no cost and centers on mythical beasts. You can enjoy it on a computer or an Android device, and it suits players of any age who enjoy a good challenge.

To aim, hold your finger or mouse button inside the play area, then let go to drop the creature along the path you chose. Merging is easy at the start, but the board gradually fills up as new monsters arrive. Drop two identical monsters onto each other to combine them. When the highest-ranking creature merges, it disappears and you earn more points.
chessvola-puzzles: CHESSVOLA is a chess puzzle trainer built for brief daily practice and steady growth over time. Its library holds 30,000 unique tactical positions across several difficulty levels and themed categories. Daily challenges, streaks, rewards, and leaderboards give each session a clear aim, and a training rating tracks your progress.

For each puzzle, find the best move or sequence from the position shown. Select a piece, then select its destination. Correct moves carry the puzzle forward automatically, while wrong ones let you retry or request a hint. Finish the five Daily Puzzles to build your streak and collect rewards, or work through the full library to raise your rating and leaderboard standing. Reset restarts a puzzle, hint reveals the next correct move, and skip passes a puzzle when that option is available. Mouse and touchscreen controls both work.
baby-care: Your job is to look after a small child who keeps everyone busy. You feed the little one, give a bath, join in with play, and tuck them into bed when the day is done. Each moment brings a new need, so you have to stay alert and respond quickly.

Helpful tooltips appear to show what the baby wants at any given moment, making it clear what the child needs. Everything is controlled with taps or clicks, which keeps the whole experience simple to follow.
puzzle-candle: Every stage in Puzzle Candle ends at a finish point you must reach, but getting there takes work. You'll face tricky brain teasers and jumps that demand careful timing. Along the way, you can pick up useful items that help tip the odds in your favour and open up clever routes forward. The game includes 50 stages across varied settings, and each one brings fresh hurdles and unexpected twists.

Play by tapping or clicking the candles and the puzzle objects around them. Study the clues you're given and place the candles in the correct arrangement to finish a stage. A level is complete once every required candle has been lit, so the real aim is to work out each puzzle and light all the candles.
unicorn-coloring-book-glitter: Browse a big library of unicorn pictures designed for glitter coloring. Fill in each one with care, paying close attention to the small details that make every unicorn stand out. Manes, horns, and unicorn heads are waiting to be decorated, alongside a princess, twinkling stars, rainbows, hearts, and cute animals.
Playing is simple, since you only need your mouse or a tap on the screen. Choose your colors, add that glittery finish to each part of the pic
hair-challenge-rush: Hair Challenge Rush offers two contests, a hair challenge and a hair race. Clever routes and shortcuts can help you win each round. Collect the haircuts you find along the way, try to grow your hair as long as possible, and measure it against a ruler. Your aim is to become the runner with the longest hair.

Movement is simple: slide your finger to steer your runner. The game is built for mobile play and blends puzzle thinking with running, collecting, and avoiding obstacles, so younger players can pick it up quickly.
duo-apple-monsters: Duo Apple Monsters is a two-player adventure game where you collect apples and get past a range of obstacles. Its heroes, Red Apple and Green Apple, live in Appleton, a magical world. One day the evil sorcerer Morula appears and threatens to plunge the land into darkness, so the two heroes join forces to save their world.

The journey covers 13 levels. Along the way you gather apples and overcome challenges until Morula is defeated and peace returns to Appleton. The controls are split between the players: the green male character moves with the arrow keys, while the cherry-colored character is moved with the WASD keys to collect apples.
shadow-forge: Shadow Forge mixes tower defense with action RPG play in a gloomy fantasy world. You control the Forge Master, a hero who can dodge attacks and fire four skills while you build and upgrade ten distinct towers. Across eight maps and twenty waves, you face a steady flood of shadowy creatures and powerful bosses. Gaining levels unlocks strong boons to help you survive the harder fights.

On desktop, move with WASD or the arrow keys, aim with the mouse, and cast skills with Q, E, R, and T. To place a tower, click its icon, then click a tile. On mobile, drag the left joystick to move and tap the skill buttons to cast. Tap a tower icon, then tap the map to build. Starting waves early earns bonus gold, but you must stop enemies from reaching the Forge.
extreme-car-driving-parking: Extreme Car Driving Parking is a 3D racing game where you drive and park a modern car through a series of levels. Unlike many other parking games, here you must follow every traffic rule while you guide your car into the parking zone. Use the arrow keys to steer, accelerate, and brake your way through each challenge.

The game is labeled as a 2024 simulator, and it mixes driving stages with parking stages so you can practice both skills. Tags like drift and drifting suggest the sideways driving style is part of the fun. It is free to play in your browser, and it is a good pick for anyone who enjoys careful, rule-following car control.
veggie-harvest: Veggie Harvest is a quick-paced farming clicker where you grow vegetables and gather them by dragging across the grid. Each ripe crop you pass over gets picked, and harvesting faster earns you more bonuses. As you go, you can discover new vegetables and improve the crops you already have, building the idle farm you want.

To harvest, hold the left mouse button or press a finger on mobile, then drag across the ripe vegetables. Purchases are made with the buttons in the right-hand panel, where you can raise sale prices, speed up growth, or plant more often. Use the buttons along the bottom to switch between crop upgrades, passive bonuses, and crop properties.
lanternward: Lanternward asks you to light up the night streets of Veldrenmar, where every alley has to end up glowing. It works like the classic Akari, also called Light Up. A lantern shines along its row and column until a rooftop blocks the beam, numbered roofs tell you how many lanterns sit next to them, and no two lanterns may light each other. Each puzzle has a single answer that you can reach through logic alone, so you never need to take a random guess.

There are 300 graded puzzles spread over 10 districts, with boards from 6×6 up to 14×14, and then an Endless Night mode. A fresh daily puzzle arrives every day. Difficulty depends on the kind of reasoning a puzzle requires rather than a label. Stars are earned by finishing within a level's target time, and your personal bests are tracked, with no countdown pressuring you. If you get stuck, a hint places one correct lantern, and "Show my mistake" marks the wrong ones; each costs one star. A colour-blind-friendly palette is available, and your progress is saved in this browser.
king-of-pirate: In King of Pirate, you play a brave seafarer who must push back attacking undead enemies. This adventure title with pirate themes works on mobile and features zombie battles and plenty of action. The game tests both dexterity and attentiveness as the foes approach.
Controls are easy to pick up. Tap the left half of the screen to move left and strike in that direction. Tap the right half to move right and attack that way. Stay alert and watch both sides at once.
rescue-from-rainbow-monster-online: In this casual puzzle game, a small Impostor is tied up and locked inside a room. Your job is to slice through the ropes so the character can get loose. Each rescue also lets you collect unique skins. The idea builds on the familiar rope-slicing formula, but it adds its own bright look and a bit of action along the way.

The mechanics stay simple and enjoyable, yet the puzzles can still test people of every age. On a computer, move the mouse to cut the rope and set the character free. On a touch device, tap and slide across the rope to cut it and release the character.
jelly-world: Jelly World is an adventure game that combines platform jumping, collecting, and some fighting. A single mouse click controls your character and makes it jump. Leaping through the air lets you grab diamonds, and the goal is to soar all the way to victory.

Floating tools also appear in the air, and touching them adds to the fun. The game pulls you in fully, and the feeling it creates is very pleasant. It's a relaxed pick for kids and for anyone who wants an easygoing session. To start, just click to play.
cake-ready: Cake Ready is a cozy puzzle game about merging and renovating. Combine matching ingredients and kitchen tools to fill customer orders, earn rewards, and bring a lively cake café back to life. Item chains feel rewarding, the story unfolds as you fix up the shop, and two connected play spaces turn every merge into progress.
To play, drag one item onto an identical one to combine them into a higher-level ingredient or tool. Tap producers to
criss-cross-colors: Criss Cross Colors swaps the letters of a classic crossword for bright colored blocks. You drag blocks from the palette at the bottom onto the grid, matching colors across each row and down each column until every square is cleared. The mood is relaxing yet challenging, with a cheerful cartoon look that suits players of all ages. Daily rewards, hints, and timed levels add extra variety.

Controls are simple. On a computer, click a block, hold the left mouse button while dragging, and release it over the grid to place it. On a phone, tap a block and drag it onto an empty square. No extra buttons are needed.
rescue-2d-princes: Rescue 2D Princes is a touch-only 2D arcade game built for both mobile and PC. You play as a brave hero moving through a dangerous, magical land with one goal: reach and rescue the princess. The journey spans 100 levels, and each one brings its own hurdles and foes to get past.

Progress depends on swiping or tapping, since every gesture moves you a little nearer to the princess. Clever thinking, nimble movement, and fast reflexes matter most as you push forward. You play with a mouse click or a tap, and the realm is depending on you to finish the rescue.
mahjong-magic-islands: The Magic Islands have lost much of their natural charm, and their old cities need magic to bring back a fresh, untamed energy. Mythical beings are scattered across the isles and depend on you. You are their only chance at rescue, and it falls to you to return these enchanted lands to how they once looked.

Mahjong: Tile Match is a classic mahjong solitaire game presented in a distinctive visual format. Gathering parts for magic spells gives you an extra goal to chase while you match tiles, and helping adorable magical creatures adds depth to the varied levels. Just use your mouse or tap the screen to play.
traffic-puzzle-game-linky: Traffic Puzzle Game Linky is a logic puzzle set in a green forest meadow. You join pairs of numbered construction blocks with road pieces, and each link must use exactly the number of segments shown, with no extra and no shortage. Every city has to be connected before the board is cleared.

Each board has a time limit, and a running clock tracks how fast you finish. As you progress, the levels grow steadily harder, and you earn stars and trophies along the way. If you make a wrong move, an undo option lets you step back and try a different route.
not-your-seafood-salad: Tired of being somebody's dinner, you refuse to accept your place at the bottom of the food chain. Armed with odd objects that wash up on the shore, you push back against the hungry waves. Staying alive is the whole point. Each time you evolve and pick up stranger gear, your strength grows. Choose your hero first, then shape how they survive. You can pick from a range of boosts, but you may also need to give up the ones that would drag you down. Choose wisely so your upgrades suit the hero you are playing.
Controls are simple. On PC, use WASD to move and the mouse as a joystick during a match. On mobile, move with the on-screen joystick.
worms: Worms Puzzle is a calm, cheerful game in which you steer adorable, brightly colored worms over little tile grids. Your job is to gather every dot and make it to the goal on each board. Learning the basics takes no time at all, yet the challenge builds steadily as you progress. Its vivid graphics and short stages make it a nice pick for a brief pause or a relaxed way to end the day.

Controls are simple: press the arrow keys on your keyboard, or swipe across the screen to direct the worms. Guide them over the tiles, pick up all the dots, and land on the goal to clear a level. Each new stage asks for more careful thinking, so take a moment to map out your moves before you act.
the-goopies-slime-puzzle: The Goopies: Slime Puzzle is a relaxed 2D puzzle game where you steer slimes to the exit without controlling them directly. You set short commands on a grid, and those commands decide how the slimes move. Slime physics drives their motion, so timing and placement matter.

Four commands are available. Air pushes slimes upward, Glide carries them sideways in midair, Freefall slows their descent so they land safely, and Block turns a slime into a wall that redirects the others. Watch out for fire, water, and electricity, and remember that any fall of three blocks or more is fatal. Collect keys, guide at least three slimes to the exit, and work through levels that grow harder. It suits puzzle fans and anyone wanting a quick brain break.
stackball-io: Your aim is to bring the ball down to the bottom and win the game in this helix-style title. It is built around addictive play, where smashing, bumping and bouncing shape nearly every moment you spend with it.

Controls rely on your mouse or touch input, so you can start right away with a single click or tap. The whole experience stays focused on guiding the ball downward, which makes it a light, easy-to-learn choice for a quick round or a longer session.
merge-car-3d: Merge Car 3D is an arcade game that mixes matching puzzles with battles. Its world is built from three-dimensional vehicles and animals. By combining an animal with a vehicle, you create a new car that carries special skills. Your goal is to be the last one standing inside a circular battle arena, so you must steer carefully to stay alive while the others fight.

Each animal you pick brings its own ability, so trying different pairings matters. Keep an eye on which skills suit your style, and use them at the right moments to claim victory. Controls are simple: drag to move your vehicle around the arena.
rolling-cube-3d: Rolling Cube 3D is an arcade game in which you guide a cube across a long series of stages filled with obstacles. The aim is to bring the cube safely to the finish line while steering clear of traps. Swipe to move the cube through the hazards, and keep an eye out for pitfalls that can send it tumbling off course.

The game asks for quick reflexes and steady hands, so it is a good test of your agility and reaction time. Hold down the mouse button to set the cube rolling, then see how far you can get. The levels are varied and the 3D graphics look sharp throughout, making each run feel fresh.
up-jelly-up: Up Jelly! Up! is a physics-based arcade game in 3D, where tiny jelly creatures keep finding themselves in danger of sinking. You are the only one who can keep them afloat. The game looks pleasing to the eye, and its controls are easy enough for newcomers and seasoned players alike, so people of any age can pick it up without trouble.

To jump, click the mouse in an open area or tap the screen. Timing is important, because a badly timed leap can send your jelly under. Collect the jelly bonuses you find and spend them on starting boosts or to unlock new skins. Your goal is to reach greater heights and stay in the game for as long as possible.
magic-potion-school-for-witch: Step into a school of wizardry where you guide a young witch through bubbling brews. Your wand casts spells that send bouncing balls into a cauldron of numbered bubbles, triangles, and squares. Each strike reduces a number or breaks a shape, and matching pieces connect and pop. The clock is always ticking, so clear every enchantment before time runs out to brew your potion successfully.

Levels grow more challenging as you go, and each one takes you deeper into the mastery of potion brewing. The whole adventure unfolds in a whimsical wizarding academy. On desktop, move the mouse to aim the wand and click to cast a spell and launch your magic ball. On mobile, drag your finger to aim the wand and tap to cast the spell and launch the ball.
how-to-loot: In How To Loot, you work through brain-teasing puzzles to pull out the pins. Along the way, you help a knight defeat a monster, use pins to rescue a princess, and find the treasure. Beauty and riches are waiting at the end of the adventure.

This pin lock game presents tough challenges, such as pulling pins to fight monsters, pulling pins to collect treasure, and pulling pins to save the princess. You need to use your intelligence and logical thinking to solve each problem. Play with a mouse, or simply tap to pull the pins.
let-the-train-go: Let The Train Go is a puzzle game where you clear the way for a metro train. Vehicles sit on the tracks in front of it, and you must move every one of them out of the path so the metro can drive smoothly along the track. Watch which way each vehicle's head is facing, because you cannot change the direction any vehicle points. The lineup includes cars, trucks, ambulances, and many other kinds of vehicles.

The pictures are charming, and the wide variety of cars keeps the experience feeling fresh. The intricate vehicles parked in front of the metro are sure to catch your eye. Controls are simple: click with a mouse or tap the screen to play. Each move brings the train one step closer to the open track.
color-roller-3d: Color Roller 3D is a fun, hypercasual puzzle game built around rolling colors. Each move is made with a click or tap, and your goal is to match the image shown above. The game is meant to be quite addictive, so it is easy to keep going for another round.

Watching the colors roll is a big part of the enjoyment. The game is tagged with Castle, Color, Hypercasual, and Strategy, which hints at its look and the planning it asks for. You play it with your mouse.
dead-faces-horror-room: Dead Faces: Horror Room is a dark 3D horror game that blends object collecting, mystery solving, and tense scares. You play as a woman who finds herself inside a building where strange events keep happening. Following the directions you uncover, you search for objects, explore each level, and work through it without letting fear stop you.

Move with W, A, S, and D, and use the mouse to look around. Left-click fires, and right-click aims. Scroll the mouse wheel to change weapons, and press R to reload. Press E to interact and pick up items. Hold Left Shift to run, press C to crouch, and tap Space to jump.
cosmo-merge: Build a whole cosmos by dropping adorable space objects into a glass jar. Slide your finger or cursor left or right to aim, then let go to release the piece. When two matching objects touch, they fuse into a larger form, climbing from stardust to a comet, a moon, planets, a blazing Sun, and finally a Galaxy. Each fusion earns points, and quick chains of merges count as combos.

When the jar starts to fill up, reach for three helpers: Shake, Pop, and Swap. You can play in an endless mode or work through missions that award star ratings. Keep the stack below the red danger line, because if it stays above that line for two seconds, the round ends. Unlock eight skins along the way to complete your cosmic album.
city-car-parking-3d: City Car Parking 3D is a racing game that offers a realistic driving and parking simulator you can play offline. It is free, and it mixes parking challenges with driving fun in a modern feel. You can take the wheel of cars, buses, and bikes, so there is a good variety for drivers with different tastes.

Think of it as a fresh start for parking games, presented in 3D with action, adventure, and arcade touches. It works well for anyone who wants to learn the basics of driving before heading out on the road. Everything is controlled from the keyboard, so you can jump in right away and keep your focus on the parking.
tankroyale-io: Roll into a playful, cartoon-style arena where tanks battle online against players from around the world. Viewed from above, the action moves quickly on a small battle royale map, so you need to outlast everyone else. Stay in the fight longest to collect medals and gold along the way.

Spend your earnings to unlock new items, and climb the leaderboard to finish at the top of the current Season. On a computer, move with WASD or the arrow keys, aim with the mouse, left-click to fire, and right-click to use your signature move. On mobile, tap and drag to steer your tank around the map.
outfits-woman-rush: Outfits Woman Rush is a 3D parkour game in which you keep sprinting forward along the road and dodging every obstacle in your way. Along the way you can try on many costumes and transform into a fashionable female demon. It sits in the arcade category and mixes its 3D visuals with a collecting element.

The pace feels smooth and relaxed, so you can focus on the outfits and the run itself. Gold coins are scattered along the road to pick up, and each one helps you unlock new skins. Controls are simple: drag to move your character.
cubic-coil: Guide a snake made of green and black blocks through a cube you can turn freely. Spin the cube and the snake together to line up your next moves while you collect the small block-shaped fruit. Rare large fruits are also worth grabbing, since they earn bonus points. The classic rules of Snake carry over, but now everything unfolds in three dimensions against a crisp green backdrop.
On PC, the WASD keys rotate the cube and the arrow keys steer the snake. On mobile, swipe on the left side of the screen to rotate the cube and swipe on the right side to steer the snake.
knife-battle: Knife Battle keeps you hooked as you sharpen your blades and take down foes. Your goal is to level up your knives while fighting through enemies. Each battle hands you new knives to collect, and by blending matching blades together you can forge stronger ones. Your final task is to beat every boss waiting along the way.

Controls are simple. Drag one knife on top of another of the same kind to combine them into a new one. Tap the screen to hurl your knife toward the enemy. Watch out, though, because the knife you threw before is still around, and you should try not to strike it.
fruit-pop: Fruit Pop is a bubble-style puzzle game built around fruit. Your job is to swipe across the board to link fruits of the same kind, which pops them off the screen. Clear every matching group to finish the level and move on to the next one.

The game offers a large set of challenging levels, so there is plenty to work through. Controls are simple: you swipe to connect the fruits, and that single action is all it takes to play. It suits anyone who enjoys matching puzzles.
a-block-too-many: Stack blocks high enough and you can escape a mysterious planet as an alien trying to leave. Each block has its own properties, so careful placement matters, because one mistake can bring the whole tower crashing down. New levels, blocks, and customizations unlock as you progress.
Challenge mode unlocks levels as you go, while endless mode is about building the largest tower you can. For a more relaxed session, sandbox mode lets you stack freely toward the sky. Use the on-
zombie-mission-survivor: Undead creatures and other variant monsters roll toward you in successive waves, and you have to hold your ground. Your heroes are armed with weapons, but the gold you collect from every zombie you destroy is what lets you improve them. Between rounds, you can upgrade your armory, your weapons, and how much gold you earn, so your defense grows stronger with each wave.

Team up with a friend in the two-player mode and protect your lands side by side. Player one moves with W, A, S, and D and upgrades with Z, X, and C. Player two uses the arrow keys to move and B, N, and M to upgrade.
roll-rush: Roll Rush is an arcade runner where you guide a ball along a track at high speed. You dodge obstacles, avoid gaps in the path, and watch out for dangerous traps while staying on the platforms. Coins scattered along the way help you upgrade your ball and unlock new skins, and each run gives you another shot at beating your top score. The farther you roll, the faster and tougher the course becomes, so quick reactions and good momentum are essential.

Steering is simple. On a phone, drag your finger left or right to move the ball. On a computer, slide the mouse left or right to control it. Your task is to stay on the course, steer clear of hazards, collect coins, and survive for as long as you can.
cozy-sort-theme-collect: Cozy Sort: Theme Collect asks you to line up adorable objects by matching three at a time. Its gentle world is full of bright, colorful pieces and simple challenges that reward you with a pleasant feeling when a set clicks into place. Fans of match-3 and sorting games should feel at home here, and the food theme adds a fun flavor.

The art uses a soft cartoon look, and the pace stays calm because there are no stressful timers pushing you along. You can work through each arrangement at your own speed and drop in whenever you want a quiet break. Controls are simple: click with a mouse or tap to play.
climb-the-ladder: Climb the Ladder is a 3D arcade game about climbing a ladder that is anything but ordinary. It has infinite height, so the possibilities feel endless. Quick reflexes help you build more combos, and the game tracks your highscore so you can aim to consistently earn higher grades.

Watch your footing, because the ladder is not very secure. To move up, you need to catch the beat and change hands at the right moments. This casual, point-and-click title is tagged for kids, and everything is controlled with taps.
sum-sum: SUM+SUM asks you to match numbers on a numerical grid. Your goal is to keep only the values that add up to the target totals shown for each row and column, and to remove the extras. It is a logic game built around numbers, so each move helps you work out the reasoning behind the solution.

Every click changes a cell in a specific way: one click keeps a number, two clicks deletes it, and three clicks resets it. Your rows and columns must match their sums exactly. Balance the board by eliminating what does not belong until every total lines up.
2048-hexa-merge-block: In this puzzle, your task is to combine numbered tiles until one of them reads 2048. The playing field is a honeycomb-shaped grid rather than a square one. Each move is made by sliding your finger or pointer in a direction, which pushes every tile along at once. Whenever two matching numbers end up side by side, they fuse into a single tile.

Building up to the 2048 tile is the main objective, and doing so helps you reach a high score. You can play using a mouse or touch. The game is listed under puzzles and tagged as a block game built with HTML5, with mobile play noted as well.
logic-storm-animals-puzzle: This puzzle game asks you to place cute animals on a grid while following a few logic rules. Its soft pastel look and brain-teasing levels blend cozy play with mental exercise. Each level asks for a set number of animals, such as pigs, on a color-coded board. Every row and column holds exactly one animal, each colored area contains exactly one, and no two animals may touch.

Two modes let you choose your pace. Relax Mode has no lives limit and no time pressure. Challenge Mode gives you limited lives, shown as hearts, and a timer to finish before it runs out. A tutorial introduces the basics, including how to cross out cells where animals cannot go. When a layout gets tricky, the Find or Hint features are there to help. Grids grow harder from Level 1 onward, supported by a clean interface and charming animal icons.
world-of-alice-archeology: World of Alice - Archeology is an educational game made for children. It teaches them about the profession of archeology while they try to assemble ancient objects in an interactive, enjoyable way. The game can be played on a cell phone, a tablet, or a computer.

To play, use the tools to find the objects, then put them together to build each ancient item. The game works as a puzzle, so every object you piece back together gives you a new step to take in the process.
cat-snack-defense: Cat Snack Defense is a relaxed tower defense strategy game. You station cats of many kinds to guard goldfish crackers from waves of famished creatures. Each feline has its own talents, attack style, and role, so choosing the team and deciding where each cat stands really matters. You must survive every wave and keep the cracker safe, and you win once all invaders are beaten before they reach it.

Along the way, you collect rewards, unlock new cat cards, and build a tougher lineup. Use mouse clicks or taps to pick cards, buttons, and menus, then drag cat cards onto the battlefield. Tap a placed cat to view its stats, and use the language button to switch between Chinese and English.
minigolf-clash: Minigolf Clash invites you to tee off and let your creativity shine on the course. Each level gives you room to find clever routes, and the different golf balls let you try out a range of approaches. The goal is to get your ball in the hole using as few strokes as possible. Pick the right ball for the job, and you can glide through each course with ease.

Rewards can be spent on more golf balls and on additional levels, which become progressively more difficult. This single-player sports game is built around golf, so every new course tests your technique. Playing through the levels is a good way to hone your skills.
offroad-mountain-jeep-challenge: Take the wheel of a strong offroad jeep and tackle winding mountain routes, slim bridges, near-impossible courses, and hazards that test your nerve. The game offers 15 demanding stages. Your job is to stay upright, keep your vehicle from plunging off the track, and reach the finish point on every one. Pick your path with care, and get a feel for speeding up, slowing down, and turning over uneven ground.
Play on a computer with the W or Up Arrow key to accelerate, S or Down Arr
tiny-arena: Tiny Arena is a quick dungeon crawler you can play with one thumb, filled with rooms full of monsters. Hold anywhere on the screen to steer with the on-screen joystick. Stand still and your hero fires automatically at the nearest foe, so dodging and shooting happen as one move. Wipe out every monster in a room to open its door, then choose one of three upgrades before pressing on. Each of the five themed worlds ends with a boss, and once you defeat it, your build carries into the next world.

Coins let you buy permanent upgrades in the meta-shop. Endless mode challenges you to survive as many rounds as possible, with your results shown on a global leaderboard. After a deadly hit, you can revive and keep going. The game is easy to pick up, and pushing as deep as you can takes real skill to master.
twisty-planet: Twisty Planet is a stripped-back arcade game where the goal is to stay alive for as long as you can. You move around a spinning world, avoiding hazards while grabbing items that push your score higher. It relies on skill and quick timing.

Controls are simple: tap the screen or press a key to twist the planet, which changes where hazards appear relative to your character. As the surface turns, obstacles rotate into your path, so you need to time each tap to avoid a collision. Hitting one will most likely end your run. Along the way you can pick up collectibles, labeled as foods, and each one adds to your score.
motobike-attack-race-master: Motobike Attack Race Master turns motorcycle racing into a much rougher affair. Its 3D game art is animated, giving the action a lively look. While riding, you can pick up weapons and use them to strike rival racers off their bikes on the track, so every race becomes a brawl on two wheels.

The game runs in HTML5 and is set up for mobile play, so you can take it on the go. To get started, simply slide to begin. If you enjoy arcade action with a violent edge, climb aboard and pick a fight with the rest of the pack.
create-youre-obby-skin: Click your way through this clicker game to collect Robux, which keeps coming in with no real limit. Along the way you can claim exclusive codes from special code packs, and unlimited skins give you plenty of looks to try. A wheel spin adds a little chance to every round.

Recruit Robux to grow your stash, then spend what you earn on one-of-a-kind items for the skin editor. Use the avatar creator to design your character in Roblox and style it your way. When you feel lucky, spin the wheel and see if you can land the best Roblox codes.
colortrail-3d: ColorTrail 3D is a hyper-casual arcade title where each of your moves leaves a streak of color behind. You guide a cube along three-dimensional tracks and try to fill every path. Obstacles and traps are waiting along the way, so you have to avoid them while you work through the course.

Good timing, quick reflexes, and careful precision all matter here. As you progress, the levels speed up and become more demanding. Controls are simple. On a computer, hold down the left mouse button to move the player. On a phone or tablet, touch and hold the screen to move the player.
archer-master: Archer Master is a shooting game that lets you practice and sharpen your archery. Your goal is to aim and shoot accurately so you can move on to the next stage. The game includes 40 different levels, and you can choose from 3 bow options. As you keep practicing, your skills grow until you reach the master level and become a capable archer.
Controls are simple: click the mouse to aim, then release to let the arrow fly. Each shot calls for steady, accurate aim, so take your time and focus before you let go.
stickman-party-electric: Stickman Party Electric is an adventure game where players form two groups, either as a team of two or a team of four. Your goal is to defeat every monster so your group can pass through the portal and move on to the next level. There are simply too many enemies to ignore, and they are hiding everywhere, so each one has to fall.

Watch out for the thorns, which you must not touch, and keep an eye out for flying monsters that you need to dodge. A portal lets you teleport to the next location. Four players take part across the two groups, moving with the WASD keys or the arrow keys. A button inside the game switches between groups. You can only destroy the electric-colored monsters that belong to your own group, and the R or P key fires.
mr-gun: Mr Gun puts your aim to the test in this shooting game. It sits in the hypercasual category, and every round asks you to fire accurately and see how good a shot you really are. Keep your weapons in top shape as you progress, since upgrading your gear is an important part of the experience.

New guns can be bought at the gun store, which gives you fresh options for your arsenal. You can also unlock new weapons by completing the boss blacklists. Work through those lists and keep building your collection to get the most out of the game.
bee-colony: This adventure game rewards careful planning and sharp skill, since staying alive depends on both. Choose your weapons, armor, and supplies with care, then manage them well. Your backpack has limited room, so every choice carries weight as you build a gear setup meant to face foes that keep growing stronger.
Waves of monsters keep arriving, and your task is to hold your territory against the invasion. Progress through chapters, each pres
miniature-monkey-market: In this 3D arcade game for one player, you run a small grocery shop for a group of monkeys. Bananas are their favorite food, so you start by growing them. Once they ripen, collect the bananas and set them on the counter. Customers soon begin to arrive. You can also feed bananas to chickens, gather the eggs they produce, and place those on the counter too.

Use your saved money to stock and sell items such as banana puree, canned food, flour, bread, and milk. Control your monkey with the mouse, using a left click to move. As your savings grow, buy new products and stalls to expand the market.
city-constructor-driver-3d: City Constructor Driver 3D is an online game for young players. It runs on phones and tablets of every kind, including iPhone, iPad, and Samsung devices, as well as other Apple and Android systems. It is a freight simulation in which you drive 3D trucks to carry bricks.
Your trucks haul bricks so that more buildings can rise across the city. While you park a truck, keep tapping the screen to speed up construction.
hugie-wugie-jigsaw-puzzle-collection: Hugie Wugie Jigsaw Puzzle Collection gives you a set of puzzles built around a creepy doll. Hugie Wugie has come to symbolize a real nightmare, one that hides nearby and could leap out at any second. Even imagining this monster is enough to keep you on edge. Facing a childhood nightmare is no small thing, and this game lets you do more than endure that fear: you get to play with it.

You can work through the pictures with a mouse or by touching the screen, whichever suits your device. The images are attractive to look at, yet they carry an unsettling edge that keeps you wary of what might appear next.
bloxingfederation: BloxingFederation is a 3D boxing title built largely from blocks. Your aim is to knock out your rival and work your way to victory. You can pick a single-player match against a computer bot, or invite a friend into the two-player mode to face off directly. There is also a Bot vs Bot mode, which is entertaining to simply sit back and watch.

Controls are split between two players. Player 1 and Player 2 both move forward with W or Up and backward with S or Down, and turn left with A or Left or right with D or Right. Player 1 throws a punch with G or 1 and blocks with H or 2. Keep your guard up and time your strikes well to outlast your opponent.
merge-cats-idle-army: This idle merge game asks you to drag two matching cats together to create a bigger, cooler, cuter one. Across 100 levels, cats evolve from tiny fluffballs into legendary feline warriors. Send your army into battle against waves of rival cats and large bosses, and collect Soul Fragments from every hit to recruit stronger cats. Your army keeps fighting while you are away, earning offline loot for up to 12 hours.

Boosts such as x2 Damage, Auto-Merge, faster spawns and Time Jumps can be stacked together. Ascending lets you restart with permanent bonuses. You can also spin the Ascend Wheel, fill your Cat Book, or take a break with the Tile Puzzle mini-game. Daily rewards, quests and missions give you something to claim each day, and VIP levels bring bigger bonuses. On PC you click and drag, and on mobile you tap and drag.
switch-to-red: Switch To Red is a relaxed arcade puzzle with a simple aim: make every block turn red. Clicking a block flips it, and any blocks it touches change color along with it, so each move has knock-on effects you need to plan around. It's a brain-teaser that suits kids and anyone who enjoys skill-based puzzles.

Getting started is easy, since you just tap the screen to begin. Work out which taps will light up the whole grid, and think a few steps ahead as you go. Tags include block, brain, kid, and skill, so it's a good pick for quick, thoughtful sessions.
dead-warfare-zombie-shooting-gun-games: A group of survivors finds itself locked inside a museum, surrounded by swarms of undead. Armed with only a handful of weapons, the shooters must push through the long, dark night. Later on, a hidden truth comes to light and gives the group a firm belief in what they are fighting for, and the real battle begins from there.

This 3D action shooter is played with the keyboard and mouse. Use the A, W, D and Z keys to move your character around, and scroll the mouse wheel to switch between weapons. The game is tagged for Android and carries arcade, adventure, avoid and classic themes.
mine-keeper: In this simulation adventure, you take on the role of a dwarf lord who grows a kingdom from the ground up. Lay out your own town and look after the nation you have built. Gather fruit and sell it to feed your people, then raise better homes and put your money toward new facilities or toward an army of dwarves.

Dig deep into the mines to uncover valuable stones and gems, but bring your troops along, since monsters lurk below. As your kingdom gains a reputation, more people will settle in to live and work, and you can hire farmers and soldiers. Move around with WASD or the arrow keys, or drag with the left mouse button. On mobile, use the in-game joystick.
grid-odyssey-nonograms: Grid Odyssey: Nonograms is a logic puzzle where you reveal a hidden picture by shading the right squares. The number clues along the edges tell you which cells belong in the image. Playing it is meant to build focus, reasoning, and careful analysis, and each solved grid brings a pleasing sense of accomplishment as the pixels come together.
To make a mark, click or tap any square on the grid. Along the bottom you can choose whether your marks appear as crosses or as filled squares, so you can keep track of cells you have ruled out.
the-squared: Meet a cute cube as your hero in The Squared, a side-scrolling arcade game. Your goal is to avoid obstacles along the way and chase the best score you can reach. It's a single-player, 2D action runner made for mobile play, with Android and HTML5 among its listed platforms.

Controlling the cube is easy: just tap to make it jump. Good timing is the key to clearing obstacles and racking up points. Keep your eyes on the scrolling scene and see how high your score can climb.
halloween-stickman: Halloween Stickman is an adventure where you get back at a mischievous friend by turning back the clock. The game takes place in a creepy setting, and its story draws you in, with your choices changing how it ends. It is a 2D horror experience that anyone can enjoy on any device at no cost.

To play on a computer, use a mouse. On a phone or tablet, a stylus or your finger works just as well. Start by watching the story animation, then pick how you want to punish the Stickman. Be sure to click the buttons so you can see every punishment he faces.
4-clues-1-word: 4 Clues 1 Word is a wordplay game that rewards sideways thinking over simple recall. Rather than spotting an ordinary object, you search for a link running through very different scenes. Stock might mean goods in a warehouse, broth simmering in a pan, or shares traded on a market. Your task is to name the one word that ties them all together, a good fit for curious, clever players who enjoy a mental workout.

Each level presents three or four sharp, high-definition photographs, perhaps a physical item, an abstract idea, and an action. Words with several meanings matter here, so Draft could suggest a chilly gust or a rough sketch. Spell the answer with letter tiles. When you're stuck, you can reveal one correct letter or remove tiles that don't belong. Levels range from Casual to Mind-Bending, and the connections grow more abstract across hundreds of stages.
survivor-rainbow-monster: Your guide through this .io game is the Red Monster, and this title is the first mobile version of Rainbow Game. You play as an unnamed child who was snatched during a school trip to an amusement park called Spooky Park. With no time for fun and games, you must last five nights in an eerie place where the only living things are you and the Rainbow Monster.

Each night brings its own special task or challenge, and you have to finish it while dodging the Rainbow Monsters. The Rainbow Game mode lays out your mission. You can play with the keyboard, the E key, a mouse, or a touchpad. The game is tagged as hypercasual and covers action, adventure, brain, monster, and monster truck themes.
riders-travel: Riders Travel puts you on a powerful superbike, where every ride feels like a fight to survive. The routes climb to crazy heights, and your task is to complete missions that seem almost impossible. Along the way, you pull off daring stunts, launching off sky-high ramps and taking on risky jumps.
This racing game is built around motorcycles and sits in the .io games category. To jump, click the up control. Each leap is a chance to show off your stunts, so keep an eye on how you land.
seat-jam-3d: Seat Jam 3D is a puzzle game where your job is to get every passenger into the correct seat. To move someone, tap or click the passenger first, then tap or click the seat you want them in. The early levels are simple, but the challenge grows quickly, and you will need to think carefully before you can solve each bus rush.
Passengers can move up or down and left or right, but they cannot travel diagonally, so the order of your moves matters. The title
breakblock: BreakBlock is a bright, lively take on the brick-breaker style, where one well-placed shot can set off a whole flurry of bouncing balls. Your job is to clear rows of numbered blocks before they drop to the bottom of the screen. Every successful hit keeps the chain going, so stringing together large combos is a big part of the fun, and you can unlock playful ball skins to change how your balls look.

Controls are simple. Press and drag with your mouse or finger to line up your angle, then let go to launch. Pick up extra balls as you go, and when your rocket is charged, use it to stay in the fight a little longer. Each run is a chance to climb past your previous best score.
skyfall-siege: Skyfall Siege drops you into a quick, high-intensity sky battle where every moment matters. Enemies keep arriving from above in endless waves, and staying alive depends on fast reactions, accurate shots, and clever movement. You play as a courageous defender whose job is to stop the falling threats. Turrets and sturdy defensive structures help you wipe out countless foes and keep your base safe.
pop-it-master-antistress-toys-calm-games: Pop it Master brings the popular antistress toy to your screen. In Pop It Simulator, which you can play for free, you can collect the full set of 80 Pop It and Simple Dimple toys. It's a simple way to relieve stress after school or after a day at work.
To move forward, click every bump on the current toy to open the next one. Collect all 80 toys to unlock Secret Mode.
princess-anna-short-hair-studio: Welcome to this hair salon game for girls, where you style the hair of a royal princess. You can trim and shape her locks with a range of tools, from a basic comb and scissors to a curling iron and a straightener. Your job is to design lovely hairstyles for her.

You begin with a spa treatment that leaves her hair smooth, then give her a refreshing bath using high-end products. Next, decorate her look with accessories that suit her style. Pick whatever bold colors you like for her hair, then trim and style it. Try out different hairstyles to show off her look. Play by tapping or clicking.
rich-run: Rich Run is an adventure game built around parkour-style running. You dash along a track and slide your finger across the screen to steer, and the controls are simple enough that anyone can pick them up quickly. The route is packed with traps and obstacles, so you need to stay nimble to avoid them. Several separate games are waiting to be explored, and the whole thing is presented in 3D.

The painting style is simple, which keeps the focus on the running and jumping. As you move into different levels, the scenes and obstacle layouts change, and new ways of playing appear to mix things up. Each stage brings its own set of challenges, so you will need to adjust as you go. Expect a steady run of hurdles that tests your reflexes at every turn.
zombies-cookies-apocalypse: Zombies Cookies Apocalypse is an online survival game that has become popular with players around the world. It is a casual action game set in a post-apocalyptic world where a zombie invasion has destroyed everything. It is free to play, and fans of fighting, survival, and zombie adventures will find plenty to enjoy.

Controls depend on your device. On a PC, use the mouse to aim and shoot. On touch screens, tap and swipe to steer your character with force. The game offers a unique and thrilling experience designed to keep you on the edge of your seat.
cars: Step into the seat of a car driver in this online racing game. Your task is to get past other vehicles while steering clear of collisions. Each run lets you chase a higher total, so every race becomes a test of how many cars you can leave behind before something goes wrong.

The controls are simple. Use the gas to speed up and close in on traffic, and use the brake to slow down and avoid a crash. Keep an eye on your score as you drive, and try to beat your previous top result. It suits players who enjoy car racing and quick reactions behind the wheel.
cutter-woodsman-game: Step into the boots of a forest lumberjack in this adventure title. Your job is to swing an axe at the trees around you, gather the timber you fell, and finish every level along the way. Good timing matters, since you need to choose the moment to strike carefully, and you must keep advancing as the terrain grows tougher.
The controls are easy to pick up, and movement feels fluid from start to finish. Each chop delivers a pleasing wood-cutting feel. Play it with a mouse click or by tapping the screen.
dragon-annihilation: Hellish dragons, bewitched by a witch, are heading toward the village where you live. The only way to drive them off is with the strength of your own defences. Place turrets to wipe out successive waves of attackers. Each wave brings more dragons to face.

Merge two matching turrets to form a tougher unit, a process called turret fusion. You can drag turrets and drop them wherever you like on the grid. Every dragon you defeat pays out gold, which you can spend on more defences. Each new defence you buy helps protect the village.
wednesday-s-battle-monster-symphony: Wednesday's Battle: Monster Symphony is an endless action game that makes you want to jump back in after each loss. Every defeat seems to invite one more attempt. The game draws on the well-known Wednesday theme and throws a mix of different enemy types at you. As you go on, the challenge slowly grows harder, while smooth, pleasing animations keep every fight feeling rewarding.
Controls are simple. On a computer, use the arrow keys to switch lines and change the direction of your shots. On a phone or tablet, tap the right or left side of the screen to switch lines.
roof-rails: Roof Rails is a 3D arcade adventure where you control a young boy. Your task is to gather sticks so the tool you carry grows long enough to be useful. That tool then becomes your way across hanging obstacles where no ground lies underneath, and it also lets you lay a path through a magma zone. Collecting and avoiding danger go hand in hand here, so keep an eye on what lies ahead.
flappycat-crazy-christmas: FlappyCat is back in a festive outfit for the holiday season, and this time the challenge has grown. He now travels with a sleigh and a pair of reindeer. Your job is to steer him past a series of obstacles by timing your moves well and reacting quickly. The aim is to rack up the highest score you can.

Controls are simple: click to keep him aloft, since he sinks if you stop. Every tap matters, because the timing has to be precise. The game is listed as a clicker with aircraft and animal themes, so it suits anyone who enjoys quick, focused play.
angry-boss-2: Angry Boss 2 is a 2D shooting game where you explode, destroy, and smash your way through the action. Freezing, tossing, and firing all play a part, and you wield godlike power without letting up. You get a nearly endless supply of weapons to beat the boss with, including rockets, grenades, automatic rifles, and even a nuclear bomb. It is tagged as an action, bomb, and hypercasual title.

On a PC, click and hold the left mouse button to drag the boss, then left click to fire or throw objects and guns. On mobile, hold and swipe to move the boss, and tap to fire or throw objects and guns.
horse-family-animal-simulator-3d: Your horse is set loose on an island, ready for a memorable journey. As you roam the land, you take on a range of jobs, start a family and raise baby foals, and enter contests where you can claim wins. Along the way you can toughen up and polish your horse, furnish your own home, fend off predators lurking in the woods, and lend a hand to other horses and the local villagers.

The game offers a variety of missions, a horse family, a home you can decorate, and plenty of customization and upgrades. You explore an open world full of different creatures, with mini games and achievements to pursue. Controls are simple: use WASD or the arrow keys to move, click the left mouse button to attack, press space to jump, and hold shift to run.
stunt-car-extreme-online: This sequel to Stunt Car Extreme comes as a light online edition. Finish every stage to earn money, which you can spend on more cars. Each stage has a set time limit, so you must complete it before the clock runs out. Straying from the marked route leaves you wondering whether the stage can still be completed.

Push your car to its top speed while racing another vehicle that is determined to cross the line first. The mouse moves the camera, WASD or the arrow keys drive, the spacebar brakes, and C switches the camera view.
real-drift-super-cars-race: Real Drift Super Cars Race throws you into a series of online drift racing events. Behind the wheel of various iconic drifting vehicles, you progress from the Rookie ranks all the way up to the Pros. Drivers who think they have the skills can take on the ghost multiplayer mode.
Driving is handled with the WASD keys. On mobile devices, you use the in-game buttons instead. The game sits in the Racing category and runs in HTML5 and on Android.
paws-and-pals-diner: In this 2D game, you take on the role of a diner manager, and every customer and worker you meet is an animal. Your job is to keep a busy restaurant running. As you progress, you can bring new animal staff onto your team to help out, and you can discover and serve more dishes to keep your guests happy.

Guests arrive with their own habits and tastes, and new ones open up as you play. You can also change how your place looks by choosing different themes and decorations. The game is played with a mouse or by tapping the screen, which you use to press buttons and interact with items.
extreme-drag-racing: Extreme Drag Racing is a simulation where timing is everything. You shift gears at exactly the right moment to reach top speed and beat your opponents. The game offers several cars, and each one has its own stats and features, so choosing the right machine matters. Pick your car and race to win.
Controls are simple. Press W or the Up Arrow key to gas, tap Space to shift gears, and press N to use nitro.
pim-path: Pim Path is an arcade maze game where your goal is to reach the trophy waiting at the end of each level. You cannot fall off the platforms, but spikes and blades are scattered across the stages to make things harder. A single misstep ends the run immediately.

Success depends on patience, focus, quick movement, and sharp reflexes, along with a steady temper. Clear every level to finish the game. On a computer, use WASD or the arrow keys to move and the Space bar to jump. On mobile devices, tap the on-screen buttons instead.
my-fashion-hair-salon: Fashion matters a great deal to girls, and a stylish hairdo can make them shine. In this salon game, you look after each client so that she ends up with a lovely, trendy look. Your first job is to pamper her hair with a soothing treatment and a good wash. After that, you whip up a homemade hair mask to nourish it.

Once her hair care is complete, it's time to create a dainty hairstyle that suits her. To finish the look, pick out stylish headwear, a necklace, and earrings so she feels like a fashion star. Everything is controlled with a mouse click or a tap, so you can jump right in on a computer or a touchscreen.
hill-climbing: Steer your car across a rough, bumpy road in this Adventure driving title with physics-based handling. Your job is to manage acceleration carefully so you do not crash. Every bump tests your timing, so think before you press. The aim is to travel as far as you can and set a new record.

On a computer, press D or the Right arrow to speed up, and A or the Left arrow to accelerate in the opposite direction. On mobile, on-screen buttons handle the controls instead. Whichever device you use, the goal stays the same: go the distance.
baggage-out: Baggage Out! is an interactive puzzle game about loading baggage onto a bus through a series of simple tasks and challenges. You take on a helpful role, getting every piece of baggage ready before the bus leaves. Each item has to be moved into the right space, and you finish by completing the task in front of you.

Controls are easy to learn. With a mouse or touch screen, drag each piece of baggage and drop it into its correct position. A tap selects an object and lets you interact with it. Your goal is to arrange all the baggage correctly so the level is complete.
fruit-vs-monster: Fruit vs Monster is a shooting game where you launch fruit at a group of monsters. You aim a slingshot, pull it back, and release to send your fruit flying toward the enemies. Your goal is to destroy every monster on screen before they can cross the bottom line.

Controls are simple: aim the slingshot, then pull it to fire fruits. The game is filed under shooting and carries tags like action, fruit, and shoot 'em up. Watch the bottom of the screen, since letting a monster reach that line is the one thing to avoid.
police-car-drive: Police Car Drive is a lively driving game in which you speed along roads packed with other vehicles. As you weave through the traffic, pick up cash and power-ups to reach the end of each track.

Steer your police cruiser with the arrow keys. The game fits the racing category and works well on mobile devices, and it is tagged with car, cars, and police themes for anyone who enjoys those kinds of games.
logic-islands: Logic Islands draws on the ideas behind Nurikabe and Islands of Insight. Your goal is to build islands that match the exact numbers on the grid while keeping the walls connected. Six worlds each follow their own rules, starting with classic Nurikabe and moving toward advanced ideas such as Yin-Yang connectivity. New challenges appear along the way, including ice blocks, one-way arrows, and special orbs, spread across 240 carefully selected puzzles.
On a computer, click to toggle a cell between island and wall
blue-spheres: Blue Spheres is a straightforward puzzle game built around guiding blue spheres through a range of obstacles. Its 2D view and arcade feel are paired with strategy, and its tags highlight balls, blocks and an island theme, so you can expect a blend of those elements in a simple setting.

Everything is handled with a single controller, so the whole experience relies on just a few keys: A, D, S, W, M, R and P. Your job is to plan a route for each sphere and steer it safely past every barrier. Thinking ahead is the key to getting each one through.
fit-master-3d: Fit Master 3D is a three-dimensional puzzle where you sort food pieces into boxes that match them. You play right in your web browser, and it works across a range of devices. Burgers, fries, and more make up the lineup, so you handle a variety of dishes as you go. Each level adds its own twist to the sorting task, so no two stages feel quite the same.

Your goal is to fit every item into the right spot and finish the whole meal. Use the mouse to click and drag on a computer, or use drag and drop by touch on mobile. Puzzle lovers and food fans should feel right at home here.
wander-wild: Wander Wild is a fantasy card game where you win fights by choosing the right cards at the right moment. Each turn, you can attack enemies, defend yourself, and apply effects such as Poison, Bleed, Burn, Stun, and Weaken. Combine attack, defense, and ability cards to gain the upper hand. During battle, charge your energy and unleash your Super Attack when the time is right. Some cards and relics can charge it faster or make it stronger.

Between battles, earn rewards, unlock new relics, and equip up to four at once to build your own combinations. Spend the resources you collect to upgrade your camp, which improves your hero's stats and prepares you for tougher foes. Each chapter spans 15 battles, and every playthrough opens new ways to develop your own style.
blumgi-slime-jump-game: Blumgi Slime is an arcade action game that puts your timing and aim to the test as you jump toward the finish line. You guide a cute, bouncy character that can only get around by leaping. Press and hold the action button to build up strength: the longer you hold it, the higher and more intensely your character will jump. Your task is to pass over different kinds of obstacles and touch down on the checkered platform.

Each stage brings in something playful and quirky, from new colors to new obstacle types, so the challenge keeps changing. To jump, press and hold the left mouse button, then release it. How long you hold it determines how far you go.
oil-wrestling: Oil Wrestling offers an entertaining twist on the wrestling match. Your aim is to get the better of your opponent, and you do that by lunging forward, to the right, or to the left, the approach known as traditional oil wrestling.

The match is split into five games in total, and the first player to score five wins the contest. You can go solo or challenge a friend, since the game supports both single and two player modes. Player one controls the action with W, A, S, D and T, while
drawing-rainbow-rescue: Drawing Rainbow Rescue is a drawing-based adventure in which you sketch objects to protect the Rainbow from bees. The bright, cheerful world is in danger, because the bees are plotting to destroy the Rainbow. Using your imagination, you draw items that pull the bees away and keep them from reaching it.
The levels get harder as you go, and a catchy soundtrack plays throughout the action. The game suits anyone who enjoys drawing and wants a fun, creative challenge.
winged-wheels-2: Winged Wheels 2 is a quick-moving action game that puts your reflexes and focus to the test. You steer a car and a spaceship at the same moment. One vehicle dodges enemies and obstacles while the other collects coins and power-ups, and all of it unfolds in real time. You can unlock new cars and spaceships with distinct looks and improve your abilities after each run. Random events keep things unpredictable, and your results can place you on a global leaderboard.
On PC, the arrow keys move the car and the A and D keys move the spaceship. On mobile, swipe on the left side of the screen to move the spa
mech-frontline-last-stand: Mech Frontline: Last Stand blends roguelike turret defense with gacha pulls and base building. Expect plenty of content and a wide range of turrets, along with sets that each come with unique effects. You can move through menus and make choices with either a mouse or touch input, from creating your character to picking upgrades and entering battle.
Every run asks you to shape your strategy as you go. Improve your mech, select your gear, and respond to enemy pressure as it builds. For the best experience, play with your device in landscape mode.
wheelchair-parkour-no-limits: You roll across a city's rooftops in a wheelchair, building speed and leaping over wide gaps while dodging dangerous barriers. Pull off mid-air stunts and grab coins along the way. The goal is to cover as much ground as you can and beat your best distance. Obstacles grow tougher the further you get, and a single misstep ends your run.

Collect coins to unlock fresh outfits for your character, then return to the rooftops for another go. On desktop, the left and right arrows or A and D move you backward and forward, and the spacebar jumps. Hold the spacebar while airborne to do a frontflip. On mobile, drag the on-screen joystick to move, tap the jump button to jump, and hold it in the air to do a frontflip.
tasty-out-arrow-puzzle: Tasty Out! is a 2D logic puzzle where you clear boards built from food-shaped arrows before your moves run out. Tap an arrow that points outward to launch it off the board, one at a time, until the screen is empty. Look ahead, because an arrow will bounce back if another piece blocks its path, so plan your launches to save steps.

The game includes more than 150 handmade micro-levels shaped like sushi, burgers, and sweets. Finishing a layout in the minimum number of steps earns bonus Gold and Trophies. Each week you can climb a competitive league from Wood to Diamond, ranked against simulated players. Spend Gold in the Elite Vault on VIP stages and rare Food Badges, which you can browse by dragging or scrolling. Beat level 150 to unlock the endless League mode.
draw-rainbow-ninja: Draw Rainbow Ninja is a free casual game where you sketch a path to take out foes. Like other relaxed titles in its genre, it offers simple rules that are easy to learn and a calm pace from start to finish. What sets it apart is its action side. Your ninja slices through enemies, and the cut only works if the line you drew is spot on.

Controls are simple. On a desktop, use your mouse to draw the trajectory. On a touch screen, tap the display to lay down your line. Either way, you aim for the right path to clear each enemy with your ninja skills.
roper-pass-game: Roper is a platform game where a running hero responds to a single tap. He keeps dashing forward on his own and only stops when he crashes into a solid object or a wall. Time your jumps carefully to steer him past obstacles and cliffs across its many levels, which add up to 100 in total.

To swing off a platform, tap again and keep holding while you aim for the brown circle. A level is only complete once you have collected every coin in it. The action key is WASD, and the spacebar or arrow keys work as well.
2048-knights: 2048 Knights adds a fresh twist to the familiar 2048 formula. Instead of plain tiles, you slide knights around the grid and combine matching numbers to build stronger units. Each level is hand-crafted, and your aim is to reach the target number in as few moves as you can. Daily challenges and 60-second time trials give you extra reasons to return.

You can swipe, use the arrow keys or WASD, or tap the on-screen pad to shove every piece in one direction. When two tiles with the same number meet, they merge into one worth double. Beating the par earns all three stars, and fewer moves means more stars. Later packs bring gates, blocks, and enemy units that change how tiles move. If you get stuck, you can undo, reset, or spend a Hint to watch the solution.
driv-boat: Take the wheel of your boat and head out onto the river to collect every passenger waiting along the shore. Once they are on board, sail them to their destination and drop them off. Don't forget anyone, because each passenger counts toward your goal. Keep a close eye on the other boats sharing the water, since you need to be careful around them.

This hypercasual driving game, tagged with traffic, centres on ferrying people across a busy river. Each run asks you to gather every passenger while staying clear of the boats already out on the water. Balancing those two goals gives each trip its challenge, and the straightforward idea makes it easy to jump in and start steering.
samurai-rurouni-wars: In 1701, Lord Asano Naganori, who ruled Ako Domain in Hyogo Prefecture, was caught in a lethal scheme devised by Kira Yoshinaka, a vain official. Kira took advantage of Asano's habit of speaking his mind openly. Two years afterward, Oishi Kuranosuke, joined by his son Matsu No Jou and a group of loyal ronin, struck down Kira to avenge Asano's death.

This Unity-built action game puts you in a samurai war with swords in hand. Move with W, A, S and D, launch the first attack with J, and use K for the second attack. Press Space to roll out of danger.
geometry-tile-rush: Geometry Tile Rush is a rhythm-driven platformer with 30 levels. You guide a square block that keeps moving at a rapid pace, so every obstacle arrives quickly. Your task is to get past each hazard by working out the right moment to leap over the nails and spikes in your path.

Controls are simple: a single click makes the block jump. Because the run never slows down, you need to judge the timing of each jump carefully, and the rhythm of every level shapes when you should press. It is a fast, focused challenge built around precise jumps and steady concentration.
sleepwalkers: Sleepwalkers takes you into a magical world filled with colorful characters who cannot find their way to bed. Your job is to guide them safely past challenges and dangers. This free online adventure can be played on any device, and as you go, it slowly uncovers the secrets of its fairytale realm.
