Controls are simple. On a keyboard, press the WASD keys or the arrow keys to move. On a touchscreen, rest a finger on the screen and move it to lead the sleepwalkers where they need to go.
house-deep-clean-sim: House Deep Clean Sim is a home-themed cleaning game that gives you a strong feeling of hands-on experience. You can clean nine scenes: a fence, a sculpture, a trampoline, a pool, a robot, a fountain, the ground, a car, and a dining table.

The game has a rich set of scenes along with the features you would expect from a cleaning game. It uses full 3D effects, lets you resize the nozzle, and lets you move around freely wherever you want. Controls are simple: use a mouse click or tap the screen to play.
halloween-cooking-run-a-restaurant: Whip up and serve dishes from around the globe in this hypercasual cooking game. You move between different spots, from a classic coffee bar and a Chinese restaurant to a bakery for sweet cakes and desserts, plus a grill for juicy burgers. Each kitchen gives you a fresh challenge, and you can work your way up to running a whole cooking empire. The controls are simple: just tap or click to get things done.

The game carries a Halloween theme, so expect seasonal flair as you cook for hungry customers. It is aimed at a younger crowd and suits players who enjoy quick, light kitchen fun. Keep the orders coming and see how far your restaurant can grow.
bloop: Bloop is a clever puzzle game set on an isometric board. Each stage fits inside a small grid, and you roll Bloop around it. Every red diamond you gather unlocks the exit, so you must collect all of them before you can leave. Energy is the catch: each step drains one unit, and if it hits zero the stage starts over, so the smartest path is the one that wastes nothing.

The adventure spans four themed worlds, named Splash Garden, Frankenstein Lab, Wonderland, and Lost Pyramid, with more than 130 levels to work through. Paths that look obvious are rarely the right ones, so careful thinking pays off. Once the exit is open, step onto it to finish the stage. Move Bloop with the Arrow Keys or WASD.
draw-line-stickman: In this single-player physics puzzle, your lines are the only thing standing between the stickman and disaster. Study each tense scene, then sketch a barrier or a clever workaround to shield the hero from traps, foes, plummeting objects, and other hazards. Each stage brings a new test of your imagination, timing, and problem-solving. Use simple controls to draw as freely as you like, try different tactics, and find the cleverest route to survival.
Once your sketch is in place, let the physics take over. Playful graphics and steadily trickier puzzles keep every level rewarding. Keep the hero safe to finish a stage and unlock new challenges.
mcdonalds-collect-foods: In this 2D arcade action adventure for one player, you take on the role of a McDonald's employee. Your job is to gather the food, drinks and desserts lying around the area and carry them back to your restaurant. Try to collect everything to prove you are a dependable team member, and watch your step, since obstacles lie in your path.
Controls are simple. Press the up arrow to jump, and use the left and right arrows to move in either direction. A double jump is also active, letting you jump a second time while in the air.
idle-island: Idle Island is a 3D adventure game with a stickman hero who sets out to save a princess held by a villain. Along the way you collect resources, build bridges to reach new areas, explore the island, and fight battles. The main aim is to get revenge on your nemesis and bring the princess back to safety.
Controls are simple. You can use either the mouse or the keyboard, and the WASD and arrow keys both work for moving around.
buttons: Buttons blends a plinko-style drop with a hand-made scrapbook setting, where every bounce feels solid and believable. As you move forward, you face off against cranky felt monsters, and the game's distinctive look keeps each stage feeling crafted by hand. Everything is controlled with the left mouse button: you release the ball, choose upgrades along the way, and get used to the mechanics through the built-in tutorials.
legions-way-of-war: Legions: Way of War is a live strategy title where battle planning is put to the test. You guide your forces toward victory by placing them carefully and calling on your Heroes at the right moment. Matches also pit you against other players, so the mix of planning and rivalry works on whatever device you own.

Winning depends on arranging your squads and linking them correctly. As your army develops, you recruit new kinds of fighters: archers, cavalry, infantry, artillery, and Heroes. Clearing all the tests is the way to enjoy the game fully.
happy-farm-1-line-puzzle: Happy Farm 1 Line Puzzle asks you to revive a farm by sketching one unbroken path through every water pipe, so the water can finally flow. The setting is a bright, hand-drawn countryside with flowers in full bloom, friendly animals, and calm scenery. Each puzzle depends on working out how the pipes connect, which gives your sense of space a good workout. As you move forward, the stages become steadily trickier.

On a computer, hold the left mouse button, drag across the board to trace your route, and release when the line is complete. On a phone or tablet, touch the screen and slide your finger to draw the same path. There are no extra buttons to press. A single smooth stroke is all you need to clear each level and enjoy the peaceful atmosphere.
ben-10-endless-run-3d: Ben 10 is back to defend the jungle as invaders threaten the city. In this stickman game, you take on the role of the hero and use the strong powers of a super Ben 10. By tapping at the right moments and staying on the rope line, you clear obstacles and move through the jungle with swings and flights. The smoother your swinging and flying, the more jungle corners you can explore and rescue.

Swipe left or right to dodge obstacles, move your finger up to jump, and swipe down to roll. Tap the screen twice to hit an enemy, and keep an eye out for foes that charge toward you. The game is free to play, with HD graphics, a 3D platform, and an endless runner style. It also includes subway running and surfing, animated action, simple controls, and more new characters. Just be careful not to fall off the subway ground.
dive-deep: Dive Deep takes you beneath the waves on a treasure hunt. You swim through a sunken world packed with hidden loot while staying clear of sharks on patrol and spiky pufferfish. Your balloon gun is the key tool: firing at a chest attaches balloons that make it rise, carrying heavy treasure up toward the surface.
When you need a more direct approach, switch to the hook gun. Hold the right mouse button to grab treasure and pull it toward you, or tap it once to lock a tow rope and drag
dungeon-master-cult-and-craft: In this 3D simulation, you play a dungeon keeper who directs stickmen and grows a cult that backs your rule. Followers can be sent out to dig up ore and minerals, while you keep the flock's loyalty running high. The game sits in the clicker and idle genres, so progress keeps moving along.

The gloomy scenes are rendered in detailed 3D, pulling you into the darkness beneath the surface. Build, upgrade and reinforce your base as the underground world widens. Share out the loot to grow your riches. On desktop, move with WASD, the arrow keys or by dragging with the left mouse button, and pick upgrades with a left click or the E key. On mobile, steer with the on-screen joystick and tap to choose upgrades.
victory-over-the-monster: Victory over the Monster is a fantasy role-playing game in which each battle plays out as a match-3 puzzle. You wander a large map drawn by hand, chatting with villagers, accepting quests, collecting materials, and crafting equipment. Your foes include wolves, spiders, bandits, and boss creatures lurking in the woods. Level up, unlock new spells, and help restore your village.

To move, tap a location on the map and your character will walk there. Tap people or objects to speak with them, open them, or gather from them. When a creature strikes, the battle screen appears: swap two adjacent gems to line up three or more of the same kind. Swords damage the enemy, shields guard against harm, hearts restore health, and mana fuels your spells. Victories reward you with experience points, loot, and progress on your quests.
wild-hunting-clash: Wild Hunting Clash invites you into a lush forest to hunt beautiful animals. The calming sounds of the woods and the lovely graphics make the setting feel inviting. Step into the role of a real hunter in an unconquered wilderness, where the land is still wild and untamed.

Your task is to shoot animals and gather their trophies in each level. Collecting enough trophies takes you to the next region. Along the way, you earn gold as a reward, which you can spend to unlock new hunting gear or upgrade the gear you already have.
combat-pixel-arena-3d-infinity: Combat Pixel Arena 3D Infinity puts you in a long fight alongside an army of ghost robots, moving through several Minecraft worlds. Expect bigger obstacles ahead, since the living dead are a serious threat. Gunfights get far more tense when you use cover, so staying behind walls and objects matters. Your arsenal includes a range of weapons, rifles among them, and the blocky pixel look keeps the action lively. The game also offers multiplayer for facing other players.
Walk with W, A, S and D. Move the mouse to aim and look around, and use the mouse button to shoot. Press Tab to open the menu.
car-driving-master: Car Driving Master puts you behind the wheel of powerful, realistic vehicles in a city setting. Whether you prefer tough missions or long open-road trips, the game has plenty to keep you busy. Your surroundings include crowded intersections, moving traffic, highways, parking areas, and demanding routes.

Each mission asks you to sharpen your driving. You will need to follow traffic rules, avoid collisions, collect rewards along the way, and reach your destination safely. The controls feel smooth, the traffic keeps changing around you, and the visuals add to the drive. To start, hold the steering.
fun-race-on-ice: Get ready for a chilly contest on a winter course filled with hurdles. Here, knowing when to hold back matters more than raw speed, and that timing often decides who wins. Hit an obstacle and you are sent backward, leaving you well behind your opponent and struggling to catch up. Your job is to slip past these hazards, which sometimes means waiting a little longer before you push ahead. Mastering the rhythm of the race is what leads to victory.
Control is simple: tap and hold to run. Watch the track closely, judge each gap, and stay calm under pressure. Patience is the skill that keeps you in the lead.
zombie-hunter-survival: Zombie Hunter: Survival throws you into a never-ending wave of the undead, where you must stand your ground and keep fighting. As the game gets harder, you'll face tougher foes, so it pays to improve your gear and weapons along the way. Collect helpful loot as it drops and call on your special abilities when the pressure builds.

In this bleak setting, staying alive is the whole point. Every upgrade you earn helps you last a little longer against the growing horde. The longer you hold out, the more the odds stack against you, so plan your moves carefully and make every shot count.
ghost-guard: Ghost Guard is a shooting game where your goal is to take out every ghost before any of them get close to you. Some of the ghosts can switch direction partway through, so you need to keep watching where they are headed. On a computer, you aim and fire with the arrow keys. On a phone or tablet, you tap the screen quadrant that matches the direction you want to shoot.

The game is built around quick reactions and steady attention. Each round asks you to keep up with incoming spirits while staying ready for sudden turns. It is a good pick for players who enjoy short, focused shooting sessions that work well on mobile or desktop alike.
mini-chess-3d: Mini Chess 3D turns classic chess into short, puzzling challenges. Each board presents a unique setup, and your task is to study the position, anticipate the enemy's replies, and find a route to checkmate or to capture the target pieces within a limited number of moves. The levels are shown in sleek 3D with smooth animations, and there are hundreds of them, so they suit both newcomers and seasoned players.

Controls are straightforward. Tap or click a piece to select it and reveal its legal moves, then tap a highlighted square or an enemy piece to move or capture. When a puzzle becomes tricky, the Hint button offers help, and the Undo button lets you take back a move and test a different idea.
vampire-survivors-dark: Choose one of four heroes in this online action RPG and step onto a dark battlefield. You meet minions from the darkness and fight them right there on the field. Win by moving with purpose to eliminate each foe. Diamonds drop to the ground when enemies fall, so collect them to fill the level bar at the top of the screen. Your aim is to last against these hunting creatures for as long as you can.
Movement is simple: use WASD or the arrow keys, or move with your mouse. On mobile devices, touchscreen controls take over.
fun-toy-pals: Fun Toy Pals takes you into a snug playroom filled with adorable toys scattered across a bright rug. Your task is to pair up identical toys and push them together, so each match turns into a larger, more advanced toy. Every merge adds to your score, and reaching higher totals earns achievements that open special rewards. You can also see how you stack up against people everywhere on the global leaderboard.

The game has charming artwork and plenty of pleasing pairings, with endless merging to keep things fresh. It suits casual players of every age. On a computer, click a toy and drag it onto its match with the mouse. On mobile, tap a toy and drag it onto a matching one.
zombie-road: Zombie Road sends you into a post-apocalyptic world overrun by the undead. Only the bravest and most experienced drivers, along with the toughest survivors who are still alive, keep resisting endless waves of zombies. It is a racing game built around enjoying the drive and smashing zombies along the way.

Your goal is to keep moving through the outbreak for as long and as fast as you can without crashing. Pass other cars closely at high speed to earn extra points and cash. Driving against the flow of traffic also rewards you with more points and cash. Aim for the highest score you can reach.
build-the-bridge: Build the Bridge is a physics puzzle where you manage both halves of a bridge so an explorer can get over perilous gaps. Timing matters, and so do thoughtful moves, as you shape a route that carries the explorer past obstacles. Each level grows harder than the last, yet the game is simple to pick up while still taking real practice to master.

Your aim is to build a steady path and bring the explorer to the finish flag without slips. Press A to extend the left side and S to pull it back, while L extends the right side and K retracts it. M switches sound on or off, Enter starts the game or moves on, and Space carries you past a finished level. Every adjustment shapes the final crossing, so plan carefully and avoid errors to clear each challenge.
valley-gun-zombies: Zombies have overrun a valley, and your job is to grab a sniper rifle and sweep the land clear of wandering undead. The best approach is to pick off each creature while it is still far away. A red dot from the laser sight marks your aim, so hitting targets becomes easier.

Keep the creatures from closing in, because they leap at you and sink their sharp teeth into your neck before you can respond. Although they shuffle slowly, they strike without warning, so don't trust their pace. To fire, simply click anywhere on the screen.
tower-tap: Tower Tap is a puzzle game where you clear stacked layers of colorful cubes to reach the treasure chest at the bottom. Every tower holds layers filled with cubes in mixed colors. A single tap pops all connected blocks that share that color. Fewer taps bring a bigger reward, so every tap counts.

Look ahead before tapping so you can clear the tower efficiently. Touch groups of same-colored cubes to break them, and remember that bigger groups are better. Keep popping cubes to work through each layer. Once every layer above the chest is cleared, the chest opens.
stickman-race-3d: Stickman Race 3D is a single-player 3D sports game where you join a race against a field of opponents. Your aim is to come out on top, finishing as the number one racer in all three rounds of each level. Eliminating your rivals along the way is another part of the challenge.

You play using only a mouse or touch input, so you can control it with whichever device you have. It carries the race, stickman, and 3D tags, making it a quick, focused pick for anyone who enjoys head-to-head competition.
lane-clash: Lane Clash is a casual 3D tower defense game where you guard your fortress across five parallel lanes. Enemies march toward your wall, and you tap a lane shield to send out warriors whenever its cooldown is ready. When two forces meet, their power cancels out: the weaker one falls, and the stronger one continues with what is left. Any enemy that reaches the wall costs your base HP equal to its power.

Each wave must be cleared by defeating or blocking every enemy before your base runs out of HP. Between rounds, spend coins to raise a lane's tier and power, spend gems to shorten cooldowns, and upgrade or repair the wall. When the pressure rises, Shield can arm a lane, Bomb clears nearby enemies, and Freeze slows a lane. Tap the coins on the field to collect them. There is no joystick and no chasing camera, just tense lane battles.
dinosaur-dig: Head out in search of ancient fossils and step into a paleontologist's shoes. Explore a range of sites, uncover bones hidden underground, and carefully clean each find before rebuilding full dinosaur skeletons. Every stage offers something different, including digging, working with tools, tracking down missing pieces, cleaning fossils, solving puzzles, and playing upbeat mini-games.

Begin by choosing an open location on the map, then travel between sites as you finish activities to unlock new excavation grounds. Use a mouse or touchscreen to handle your tools, strip away layers of soil, and drag each recovered piece into its correct place. Built with children and dinosaur fans in mind, it offers a relaxed, educational adventure for anyone curious about discovery.
dog-and-cat: Dog and Cat is a pixel-style arcade adventure built around the friendship between a dog and a cat. Your job is to gather every fish and bone you can find along the way. The two siblings must hurry to locate three boxes, and each one holds very secret things. Once you find a box, you toss it into the air, then team up with your friend to collect all of them and complete each level.

Be careful, because sharp rotating knives are heading straight toward you. Move with the WASD keys or the Arrow keys. When a wall blocks your path, search for the lever that removes it. Collect all three boxes to complete the mission.
bubble-carousel: Bubble Carousel gives the bubble shooter formula a fresh twist. Rather than simply popping bubbles on a board, you collect them from a carousel. That change makes the game tougher than the classic version, yet it also feels more playful. Filed under Puzzles, it carries the tags Arcade, Bubble, Bubble Shooter, Matching and Puzzle.

Controls are kept simple, and a mouse or touchpad is all you need to play. Nothing else has to be set up before you start. If you enjoy the usual bubble shooter, this take offers a different challenge with extra fun to match.
police-evolution-idle: Crime is spreading through the streets, and it falls to you to restore order. In Police Evolution Idle, you chase down lawbreakers and work to make the city safer. Your search covers cars parked illegally and traffic control points that need checking. Each criminal you punish unlocks new features, including extra suspect types and new kinds of traffic control. Your goal is to reach the latest area and finish the game as quickly as you can.
Getting around is simple. Move with W, A, S and D, the arrow keys, or the mouse, and use left-click to make your selections.
toy-car-gear-race: Toy Car Gear Race is a drag race played with small toy cars, and it rewards quick reactions. To get ahead, you need to change gear at the right moment. Shift too late or forget entirely, and your car will catch fire after a while and start to burn. Watching the Gear Meter closely is the key to keeping your car safe and staying in the race.

The racing is fast and lively from start to finish. You control everything with a mouse click or by touch, so you can play with either. Stay alert, check the meter often, and make every gear change count.
trains-io-3d: Trains.io 3D is an arcade action game set in a three-dimensional arena, where you steer a winding locomotive across the map. Your goal is to become the top train by devouring the rivals you meet, and each one you consume adds to your length. Scooping up screws and toolboxes along the way speeds up your growth, so keep an eye out for them.
Boosting is simple to use. On a computer, click to speed up, and on a phone, double tap to do the same. It is designed as a one-player experience, so you can enjoy it on your own.
foodie-mania: Foodie Mania is a sorting puzzle set around a busy barbecue. You arrange sizzling skewers so that matching ingredients land on the same grill tray, filling orders for hungry delivery riders. The clock keeps running, so you need to finish before time runs out.

To play, tap a skewer and then pick a grill slot, or drag it to another spot. Group three identical ingredients on one tray and it clears automatically, packing the food into a delivery box. Keep an eye on the slots, because if they all fill up first, the puzzle is over. Some trays stay locked until you unlock them, and ice and iron doors block the way until you break through. When you get stuck, the boosters at the bottom of the screen can help: Spatula, Shuffle, Magic Wand, and Freeze. There are 275 puzzle levels to work through.
draw-the-snake: Draw The Snake is a colorful logic puzzle played on a grid. You guide a snake along the correct path so it can collect apples, break through ice blocks, and clear other obstacles on the board. Each level is complete once the objective is met, and the snake must finish without getting stuck.

The puzzles grow harder as you advance, with trickier paths, more ice, and cleverly designed layouts. The rules are easy to pick up, but you will need to plan ahead, since one careless move can trap the snake. Simple controls and bright visuals keep the experience relaxing. Play more levels to unlock harder challenges, and it suits anyone who enjoys brain-training games.
msk-dirt-bike-stunt-parking-sim: Ride a superhero on a huge ramp-filled stunt bike course. You can pick whichever bike you like from a range of heroic motorbikes, and many superheroes are available to choose from. This moto title blends bike tricks with parking, so expect plenty of adventure. Your hero uses powerful moves to finish each parking level while dodging many obstacles.

Controls use the arrow keys or WASD to drive, Space for the handbrake, and Shift to shift the bike. Press C to change the camera view, R to reset the scene, and G to reset the bikes. E turns on the police lights, and Tab opens the menu. Page Up and Page Down keys are also listed. Parking while performing bike feats and avoiding obstacles is a real challenge.
horizon-racer: Horizon Racer is an arcade runner set in space, where a black hole is always closing in behind you. Escape isn't really possible here; the only question is how long you can hold it off. The course isn't a flat path with obstacles placed on top. It twists through full barrel rolls, climbs onto walls and runs across ceilings, and sends hills toward you very fast.

Steer with the A and D keys, or use touch controls. You can switch lanes to avoid obstacles in TAP mode, or pick STEER mode for finer control of the car. The game runs directly in your browser and works with mouse, keyboard, touch, and controllers. A global leaderboard tracks scores, so you can see whether you have beaten a friend.
sheep-simulator-animal-games: You play as a wild, slightly unhinged sheep in this open-world adventure set in a city. Your goals include building a sheep family, roaming the streets, finishing missions, and collecting coins. Dangerous animals lurk nearby, so you must survive them while living the untamed life of a sheep.

On a computer, the AWSD keys move your sheep, and the mouse controls the camera. E attacks, Shift sprints, and F performs actions. P pauses the game, Ctrl opens settings, I shows info, and Tab skips cutscenes. On mobile, use the joystick to move and drag the screen to move the camera.
girl-beauty-salon: Diana, Flora, and May have a party tonight, so they stop by a beauty salon to get a fresh new look. Diana wants her hands made over, May wants her legs treated, and Flora hopes for back skin that feels smooth and looks white. Once the salon work is done, you get to choose favorite outfits for these princesses.
Your goal is to help the three girls look pretty and charming for the party. Play with simple mouse clicks or taps, and enjoy transforming each girl from start to finish.
mine-master: Mine Master blends merging and digging into a laid-back puzzle experience. Pairs of identical shovels can be joined to produce a more powerful tool, and each tool helps you tunnel through the rows of blocks beneath the surface. Along the way you gather coins and work through the goals set for every stage, while improving your gear and earning rewards the deeper you travel.

To play, tap two shovels that match to combine them into an upgraded version. When you want to excavate, pick a shovel and press the "Down" button to break through the blocks below it. Keep collecting coins, finish each level's required tasks, and continue strengthening your tools so you can move on to the next challenge.
burnout-car-drift: Burnout Car Drift is a racing game where sliding through turns and keeping your speed high are both central. You will want to floor the pedal and tear along the roads, since drifting and velocity matter just as much as each other here. Whether it is daytime or nighttime, the streets are yours to explore. You can also tweak your vehicle to suit your own taste. Fans of fast driving may find it hard to put the game down once they begin.

The title is a traffic simulation, and you must learn to handle the difficulties that other cars create on the road. It is a single-player experience, and you stay in full control the whole time. Steer with WASD or the arrow keys, and press SPACE to brake.
helix-hover: Helix Hover puts you at the controls of a hovering ship inside a 3D tube that twists and turns. Your aim is to glide through without touching the walls. Dangerous pink walls must be dodged, while yellow barriers can be cleared with a jump. Along the way, grab shards to build your score and see how far you can get.
As the run continues, the tube grows more challenging, so quick reactions and precise movement matter. On desktop, use the left and right arrow keys or A and D to steer, and press the up arrow, W,
kisiy-misiy: Kisiy Misiy is a 2D arcade adventure for one player. You guide the sister of Ugi Bugi through a risky game, helping her get past many obstacles on the way to the flag. Each run tests how well you can keep her moving through the hazards in front of her.

The adventure has 10 levels, and each one steps up to a new difficulty, building toward a final victory. You can steer her with the WASD keys on a computer or with touch controls on a mobile device. The game is available on Android, so you can enjoy it on a phone or tablet as well.
huskeydoku: Huskeydoku takes the familiar Sudoku format and gives it a charming husky theme with a relaxed, cozy feel. Your job is to complete each grid so that every symbol appears only once in each row, each column, and each colored region. The rules are easy to grasp, yet they offer plenty of challenge as your skills build. Calm visuals and helpful boosters are there whenever you get stuck, so you can enjoy a short break or settle in for a long session.

Controls are simple. Tap or click an empty cell to place a husky, and tap that same cell again to remove it. If you need a nudge, press the hint button at any time. It is quick to pick up, and solving each grid brings a deep sense of satisfaction.
dice-pixel-stealer-3d: Dice Pixel Stealer 3D mixes tactical thinking with physics-driven launching in an arcade format. The 3D dice and stickman characters sit on a platform, and a pixel pattern always occupies the middle of it. Your aim is to take more than half of that pattern.

With each throw, you can fling a die and summon a number of stickman members to join the fight. The dice wipe out enemy stickmen before they come to a halt, so every launch counts. Control is simple: drag to play.
cube-crushers: Cube Crushers is a sorting puzzle where colorful cake slices and cute cube characters share the board. You start by tapping cake slices on the grid, which sends them onto the conveyor belt. Each slice you remove can uncover a hidden cube crusher, and every crusher is tied to one color. It only eats the cake slices that match its shade, so you need to pair the right crushers with the right slices. Since each tap can change the result, it pays to think ahead before you act.

The game is simple to pick up but grows tougher as you move through the levels. Smooth effects, bright visuals, and handcrafted stages give it a calm yet thoughtful feel. Clear every cake slice to finish a level, then keep going to meet new puzzle challenges.
hair-challenge-3d-game: Hair Challenge 3D is a running game built around growing very long hair. As you dash forward, the length of your locks decides how many virtual coins you can earn, so longer hair means a bigger reward. Steer clear of hurdles along the route, and collect hair items that make your locks grow and change color. Jumping is part of the fun, since you need to leap over obstacles to keep your hair intact.

Scissors and blades lie ahead, ready to chop your long hair. A fashion girl makeover adds a stylish touch as you work toward a majestic look. This 3D hair rush game mixes dress up, running, and a bit of challenge.
tile-harvest-3d: Tile Harvest 3D blends tile matching with a merge twist on a three-dimensional board. Clear a tall stack of colorful tiles by gathering matching sets and linking them into stronger merges. The levels are unlimited, the challenge keeps climbing, and special boosters are available for tough moments.

Your objective is to remove every tile from the board to win each level. Tap any reachable tile, and when three of the same type are collected, they slide onto the Factory Belt, a row of slots along the bottom. When three identical items sit on the belt at once, they merge automatically into a higher-tier item, which clears those slots. Swipe to rotate the stack and reveal hidden tiles, and pinch to zoom in or out. Keep an eye on the belt, because if it fills up, you run out of room.
the-musical-instruments: The Musical Instruments is a game made for children who want to discover musical instruments and the sounds they make. Its playful approach turns learning into something enjoyable, so young players pick up names and sounds while they play. It serves as a useful educational resource for little learners.

Playing is simple: listen for the sound, then click on the musical instrument that matches it. The cartoon style and cute visuals keep the experience light and friendly, making it a pleasant way for kids to build their knowledge of music.
bubble-shooter-treasure-rush: Bubble Shooter Treasure Rush is a demanding puzzle game built around targets. You aim, then release a bubble so it joins similar bubbles and forms a group. Along the way you collect bubbles and treasure, working steadily toward the required number.

Keep a close eye on the border, because bubbles must never reach it. The game works with a mouse or a touch-pad, so you can aim and release with whichever you prefer. It is a tough, focused challenge that asks you to plan each sh
creepy-spa-for-little-monsters: Step into a spa tucked away in the land of monsters, where the hostess greets every visitor with a friendly smile. On this particular day, two pals arrive for a treatment: Nefertina, a mysterious mummy, and Draculina, a glamorous vampire. Both clients can enjoy skin care, have their makeup done by a professional artist, and visit a stylist who helps p
hats-mahjong-connect: Hats Mahjong Connect is a block-matching puzzle with a mahjong twist. Your job is to find pairs of identical hats and link them together. A connecting path between two matching hats can bend no more than twice, so planning your route matters. As you make matches, you are also racing against a countdown, which keeps the pressure on every move. Your goal is to empty the whole board before the timer runs out.

Controls are simple, since a mouse or touchpad is all you need to select tiles and form connections. The game runs in the browser and is also tagged for mobile, so it can be played on a phone or tablet. Scanning the layout for matching pairs is the key to keeping your progress moving.
safari-merge: Safari Merge is a small, endless puzzle about food chains. New grass keeps appearing on the board, and you pull two matching creatures together to create the next one up the ladder. Your job is to clear enough room so the board never overflows, because a full board ends the run. There is no final victory, so the challenge is climbing as high as you can while building your score.

The 18 animals follow a real food chain, and each new one you reach comes with a true fact about where it fits in nature. Chaining several higher-level merges in quick succession earns a combo, which multiplies your score and adds a bonus. You can choose from three difficulty levels, earn gems to unlock new backgrounds and board tiles, and play with mouse or touch on a phone or desktop, right in your browser.
crossy-chicken: Crossy Chicken is a 3D arcade game for one player, with gameplay similar to the classic Frogger. You guide a chicken across roads full of traffic, hop across logs, and dodge passing trains while collecting coins. Stay in one spot for too long and your bird is done for, so keep moving.

Steering works with the arrow keys, letting you step sideways or move forward. Watch out for cars and other objects heading your way, and don't stand in their path. A gamepad is also supported if you prefer it. The coins you gather can be spent to unlock new characters, giving you a reason to keep hopping.
zombie-wave-arena: Zombie Wave Arena is a fast, top-down arcade survival shooter where the undead keep coming in endless waves. Blast through each horde to collect coins, then spend them between rounds on guns, armor, grenades, and weapon upgrades. Six firearms can be improved, from a basic pistol up to the legendary Ray Gun. Nine zombie mutations and five rotating arenas keep things varied, and you can grab pickups along the way.

Every fifth wave brings a boss with double the health of the one before, and beating it unlocks tougher threats and bigger rewards. Ten escalating bosses stand in your way. There is no final level. Instead, you measure success by beating your own best wave and high score, with Wave 50 and the Death King marking the conquest of every arena. On desktop, WASD or the arrow keys move you, the mouse aims, and cl
slope-city-2: Slope City 2 is the new episode in the Slope City series, and its city map has been redesigned for a fresh course to explore. You can visit the Shop to buy new balls and change how each one looks.

Special abilities must be bought with diamonds, which you collect across the new city map. Steering is easy: on PC, press A or D or use the left and right arrow keys, and on mobile, swipe your finger left or right. It is a 3D ball game in the hypercasual category, with a classic feel that suits kids.
nummerge-clash: NumMerge Clash is a number puzzle built around matching values. Tap a card to merge it with neighbors that share its value, which raises that card's worth and frees space for new cards falling from above. Energy powers tactical moves, such as swapping adjacent cards or removing obstacles.

Your goal is the highest score possible while lasting as long as you can. Keep an eye on the upcoming card queue, since the board keeps shifting. The game ends once no moves remain and you have no energy for tactics. On desktop, left-click merges a card, long-pressing shows its description and properties, the Swap button lets you trade adjacent cards, the Destroy button removes a selected card using energy, and the plus button beside the queue opens a shop where you buy cards with coins. On mobile, a tap merges cards.
biohazard-z-war: Zombies now control the world, and nothing seems able to stop them. Your task is simply to stay alive. Eliminate as many of the undead as you can while hunting for ammo, fuel, food, and water. The game offers 20 levels, and the coins you earn let you purchase new weapons. It also includes a zombie body dismemberment system.

Movement uses W, A, S, and D, while the mouse lets you look around. Left click fires, right click aims, and the mouse wheel switches weapons. Press G to throw grenades, R to reload, and F to pick up items. Hold Left Shift to run.
farm-clear-the-jam: This relaxed farm puzzler has crowded animals eager to slip out of their pen. A single misstep can seal the route again, so you need to study which way each creature can travel before you act. Cows, sheep, chickens, and piglets all need a clear path to empty the field. The early stages are simple to read, yet the challenge slowly grows into something that requires sharper reasoning
find-the-missing-part: Find The Missing Part features 100 levels of puzzles that grow harder as you advance. Each stage pushes your powers of observation. You study a picture closely, then work out which sections are absent from a set of 15 options. Each round gives you only seconds, so you need quick, accurate choices to finish the puzzle.

Playing is simple: click or tap to interact with the game. Because the challenge rises steadily, the later stages ask for sharper focus and faster decisions than the early ones. Take your time to study each image, but don't dawdle once the clock is running. It's a good fit for anyone who enjoys puzzles that reward careful looking.
dirt-bike-racing-adventure: Speed across motocross circuits full of steep slopes, risky gaps, and tough obstacles. Your dirt bike is yours to command: keep it steady in midair, touch down gently after each leap, and aim for quicker run times. As you advance, new stages open up, and every attempt helps sharpen your riding. The whole adventure is bright, fast, and full of color.

Press W or the Up Arrow to accelerate, and S or the Down Arrow to brake or reverse. Use A and D or the Left and Right Arrows to balance the bike. Tap Left Shift for a boost, and rely on the mouse or touch controls when moving through menus.
2048-drop-merge: In this puzzle game, you drop numbered tiles onto the board and merge them to reach the 2048 tile. As you move along, you need to plan each turn carefully so you can build larger and larger tiles instead of letting the board fill up with small ones.

The game is built for a single player and keeps its rules simple to learn. To shoot a number, drag and release. Its straightforward design makes it a good fit for anyone who enjoys puzzles with a real challenge.
numorapuzzle: NumoraPuzzle is a vivid number-merging game that pairs quick, rewarding matches with some careful thinking about the board. Tap any connected cluster of two or more identical numbers and they fuse into one tile of higher value, while new tiles drop into the empty cells. Your aim is to build the targets listed in the GOALS panel before your moves run out, and to keep your chain climbing all the way to 13. Each level is hand-built with its own challenge.

If a board gets tricky, the hammer and the +3 moves booster can help you out. Prefer no set goals? Endless mode lets you keep merging and chase the highest score you can reach. Space-themed artwork adds charm, and collectible rewards give you something extra to work toward. Play with a mouse or on a touchscreen.
crazy-bob: Crazy Bob is an action arcade adventure that takes place across islands drifting in the sky. You guide him through clashes with dangerous foes, set off bursts of chaos, and work to stay alive in a hostile world. Along the way you hop between islands, get past traps and barriers, complete quests, and open portals that lead to lands still waiting to be discovered.

Combat relies on two attacks. Punch with the red button or right mouse click, and use the purple button or R for a spin attack. Press the spacebar to jump and W, A, S, and D to move. A tutorial is available in the main menu for anyone who wants to learn the basics first.
build-and-run: Build And Run is a 3D arcade game about moving forward, constructing the missing pieces of each track, and coming out on top. You race through levels while building ramps and defeating foes with a range of weapons. You can customize your character with stylish gear, and the game offers endless fun in both of its modes. It plays instantly on many kinds of devices.

On a computer, press Q to build a platform, W to build a ramp, E to build a slope, and R to use your weapons. On mobile, tap the on-screen buttons to do the same things. Your job is to build whatever parts of the level are missing so you can keep racing ahead. It is a skill-based 3D arcade title with plenty of action.
blind-box-master: Blind Box Master is a relaxed clicker with a soft, hand-sketched look. You open surprise boxes to uncover 100 charming collectibles, each graded across six rarity levels and five conditions, from Broken up to Mint. Pick a box from your desk, buy it, and open it to see what you get. Every action works with a mouse click or a tap, so it runs on both desktop and mobile.

Four box tiers, Lucky Charm upgrades, and Legendary items give you plenty to pursue. Sell repeat finds for coins, haggle over prices, and combine three items into one of higher rarity. Twenty themed series are waiting to be filled, while daily and weekly tasks, achievements, and a card-flip mini game add variety. Idle income builds up over time, and you can showcase your best discoveries.
mole-kingdom-defense: Mole Kingdom Defense is a tower defense game where a group of small moles protects their home. You recruit brave mole warriors, and each one has its own strengths. Fearless fighters, sharp archers, and mages who wield powerful magic all bring something different. Arrange your team with care so you can hold back waves of dangerous foes and defeat the bosses guarding the harder stages.

After every battle, you gather coins and other resources to spend on upgrades. Strengthen your heroes, improve their weapons, and build up their skills. Idle rewards and simple progression keep the game moving along, and the bright cartoon visuals and animated characters appeal to players of all ages. Unlock new stages, keep invaders away from the kingdom, and lead the Mole Army to victory as its commander.
save-the-sausage-man: Save The Sausage Man is a free puzzle rescue game that you can play right in your browser. The sausage man keeps running into all kinds of hazards, and it is up to you to think through each one and free him from his trap. Every stage brings its own challenge, so you will need to pick the right tools and use them quickly to finish each task. Your imagination helps a lot here, and clearing stages opens up more levels to try.

The game runs in 3D and is built for kids and anyone who enjoys brain teasers and obstacle courses. Controls are simple: use your mouse or tap the screen to play, which makes it easy to pick up on a computer or a phone.
truck-driver-snowy-roads: Skilled truck drivers take on tough winter roads covered in snow. You can tackle the Missions or join Races to unlock fresh, stronger trucks. The game offers 12 off-road trucks in total, and each one has its own handling, power and feel behind the wheel.

Those who prefer a looser pace can try the Free Drive section, where random missions may appear and let you earn coins. Choose any music you like from the radio to set the mood. Player 1 uses W, A, S and D to drive, Space to brake, C for the camera and R to respawn. Player 2 steers with the arrow keys, brakes with the down arrow and respawns with U.
planko: In Planko, a strategy puzzler, you guide a red ball from its starting spot to a green target. Each stage is a small physics challenge built from balls, planks, platforms, and obstacles. Gravity pulls the red ball downward, but other balls often block its path. Tapping removable balls in the right order makes them vanish.

Removing a ball shifts the level's balance, so the red ball may roll, slide, bounce, or drop onto the planks below. Tapping too soon can send it the wrong way or make it miss the goal, so think before each move. Plan ahead, clear the right obstac
crazy-emoji-blast: Crazy Emoji Blast is a matching puzzle built around bright, colorful emoji tiles. Swap neighboring tiles to line up three or more in a row or column. A trio clears one line, a four wipes out a full row or column, and a five fires a cross-shaped strike that empties both. Six or more triggers a Total Nuke that resets the board and awards big points.

Ten levels get tougher as you progress. Bombs pop up at random, and matching emojis beside one sets off a blast that reaches over 15 nearby cells, which can spark chain reactions. Each level sets a score target you must reach within a limited number of moves. Tap or swipe to swap tiles.
biozombie-of-evil: Biozombie of Evil drops you into a foggy town overrun by wild zombies. You play as a special forces officer whose task is to eliminate a set number of undead on every level. You must survive each day to earn access to new weapons.

Controls are simple. Move with WASD, fire with the left mouse button, and aim with the right button. Scroll the mouse wheel to switch weapons, press R to reload, and use Space to jump. Throw a grenade with G, and press TAB to pause at any time.
catch-it-santa-the-toy-rescuer: Help Santa save falling toys in this casual arcade game. Toys roll in from four directions, so you need to move your basket quickly to catch each one before it drops. If you miss three toys, the game is over.

Controls are simple. Choose where you want the basket to go, then press the matching key: Q, A, E, and D, or Q, A, P, and L on a computer. On a phone or tablet, tap the arrow buttons instead. The more toys you catch, the more points you earn.
drone-vs-tractor-challenge: Take the controls of an agile drone in this unusual rural clash with heavy tractors and tricky barnyard hazards. Your job is to fly with care, finish bold missions, and avoid crashes while exploring the bright, varied landscapes. The game blends 3D action, simulation, and adventure, and it is tagged for mobile as well.

The handling responds quickly, so you will need to adapt to surprises as they appear. Move with WASD or the arrow keys, then use the on-screen controls or the keys shown on screen to change altitude and perform actions. Show that modern flying skill can outmatch the toughest machines on the farm.
robot-unicorn-dash: Step into a glowing, dreamlike place filled with sparkles, shining stars, and rainbow paths. You guide a robotic unicorn that keeps galloping forward without pause through magical scenery. The pace picks up over time, so the challenge keeps growing. Leap across gaps and steer clear of menacing dark crystals.

A single tap makes your unicorn jump, and a second tap in the air adds a double jump. Fly across the rainbow roads, grab the stars you pass, and try to survive for as long as possible. Each run is a chance to beat your previous best score. Since the unicorn never stops, quick reactions and good timing are essential.
hill-dash-car: Hill Dash Car leans more toward stunt-filled arcade action than realistic driving. Rather than handling every detail of steering, the game takes care of keeping your car balanced as it rolls along the platform track. The visuals come in 3D with animated artwork that gives the cars and scenery a lively feel.
Your main goal is to see how many points you can collect on each level. The controls are simple: tap the screen to speed up, and hold to make stunt flips with your car.
mutant-assassin-3d: Mutant Assassin 3D puts you in the role of a special agent equipped with web-launching abilities. You move through bad guys spread across varied terrains, and your goal is to eliminate every foe. You can ensnare enemies with your webs and then finish them off with powerful punches. The game has four levels, and the last one is a boss level that serves as the final challenge. There are no hints, so you must find the best route to victory on your own.
The controls are simple: hold the screen and swipe to aim. This shooting title is a 3D first-person game with arcade, casual, and stickman elements, and it also includes simulation touches.
mystic-blocks-match: Mystic Blocks Match is a 2D puzzle game driven by physics, where keeping everything balanced is the main goal. You carefully pull out colorful blocks one at a time while making sure the structure stays steady. To change your setup, touch the circles to swap them.

The gameplay feels natural from the start, and the puzzles grow tough enough to keep thinking players engaged. It is made for puzzle lovers of all ages who enjoy a relaxed but logical challenge. Listed under Puzzles, it also carries arcade, balance, casual, and logical tags, so it suits a wide range of players.
high-school-summer-crush-date: Jack has planned a romantic evening at the beach for his girlfriend Hannah, and she is thrilled. She wants to look like a beauty queen for the night, so she turns to you for help with her styling. Alongside her best friend Jessica, you join a makeover crew where you can try out different makeup looks, bright hairstyles, and outfits.

This summer crush title is aimed at girls who enjoy dressing up, designing, and styling, and each session is a new beauty makeover adventure. Every choice you make helps shape a high school love story. Use your mouse or tap the screen to play. The game reveals whether Hannah and Jack's beach date ends with a kiss.
picky-parking: Picky Parking is a calm logic puzzle where every move uses fuel. Your goal is to guide colorful toy cars into a flawless layout where all fuel is spent, each row and column holds a single car, and no two cars touch, even diagonally. Five quick interactive lessons explain the rules before the Easy, Normal, and Hard puzzles begin. Stu
stickman-party-parkour: Stickman Party Parkour is an adventure game for four friends, who split into two teams of two. Your first job is to guide one pair to the door, then bring the other pair over after them. Watch your footing, since a wrong step can send a stickman off a cliff, and some obstacles are deadly if you touch them. The level only opens up once all four players have reached the door together.

Players steer with WASD or the arrow keys. A button in the game switches between the two groups, and each player can collect the boxes that match their own color along the way. Mobile play is available as well, so the fun isn't limited to a computer.
mellow-escape: Mellow Escape is a relaxed sliding puzzle where you shift blocks around to open a route for a small, curious character heading for the exit. Each stage is handcrafted, and the challenges grow harder as you move through the campaign. Nothing is rushed: no clocks count down and nothing pushes you to hurry, so you can take your time with every board.
Along the way you collect coins and earn stars, and solving a board in fewer moves brings in more stars. Your rewards open up new color themes and
epicrolla: Epicrolla is a one-tap arcade game played on a diamond grid seen from an angle. Your ball keeps climbing, hopping from corner to corner. Each tap flips its heading to the left or right, and the ball bounces off the edges. Your job is to get past gaps, lava, boxes and spinning portals until you reach the tile goal for the current stage.

Along the way, you can grab item boxes that give you Invincibility, Coin Magnet, Slow-Mo, Dodge or Push power-ups. Coins you bank can be spent on permanent upgrades, ball skins, or a repeatable Second Chance. Controls are simple: click, press space, or tap to change the ball's roll direction. It is easy to pick up but hard to master.
easter-eggs: Do you enjoy collecting surprise toys? This game gives you the chance to do just that. Your goal is to open every chocolate egg, revealing the toys hidden inside. It suits anyone who likes unwrapping surprises and seeing what turns up next.
Step into a world full of cute Lol surprise toys, where each egg may reveal something new. Controls are easy: just click or tap to play. Keep going until all the chocolate eggs are opened.
race-to-sky: Race To Sky puts you behind the wheel of powerful muscle cars as you tear across high, winding roads in the sky. The tracks are built from zigzag ramps stretched over massive heights, so every jump and turn needs careful timing. You perform daring stunts as you go, and one wrong move can send your car tumbling into a long drop, so keep your focus on the road ahead.
Driving here is tough, and the course tests your control at every turn. Steer with W, A, S, and D, or use the ar
balloons-and-scissors: Your goal in this hypercasual puzzle is to pop balloons. The game has 20 levels, and each one becomes more complex than the last, so your logic and precision are put to the test. The core action is simple: you click the scissors to release them, and you need to choose the right moments and order to do it well.

The visuals are bright and colorful, and the controls feel easy to pick up from the very first level. Clearing each stage gives a satisfying sense of accomplishment, and the mix of arcade fun and logic play makes it a good pick for short sessions or longer puzzling.
save-them-all: A young angel is in a dangerous spot, and it is up to you to keep her safe. Strange creatures from distant lands are roaming about, cruel people lurk everywhere, and hazards nobody has seen before are closing in. Your task is to look after the girl and give her the sturdiest shield you can build.
This arcade game is played by slicing to draw. Each line you cut shapes the protection surrounding her, so plan where every stroke goes.
draw-and-drop: Draw & Drop is a puzzle game that combines drawing and physics. Your job is to sketch a path that guides the ball into a basket while you work around tricky obstacles. The game includes many levels, and it runs on both phones and computers at no cost.

To play, draw a line that will carry the ball toward the goal. Then click the ball or the start icon in the top right corner. The ball rolls along the line you made, and a level is complete once it reaches the target.
hyper-neon-ball: Hyper Neon Ball takes you to a variety of settings, each with bins you must hit using a ball. You can pick from many different ball styles, and the game includes a large number of stages, each with several variations. Every stage asks you to land your ball in the bin. You get three shots, and the best result is scoring with a single throw. If you want new balls to try, you can stop by the shop and buy them.
Controls are simple: use your mouse and left-click to draw the path your ball will travel along. It is a single-player 3D puzzle game built to test your thinking.
pomni-maze-shooter: Pomni Maze Shooter is a browser shooting game set inside a maze. You shoot your way through its twisting paths while working out how to find the exit. The action keeps things moving, and the challenges built into the maze will make you stop and think about your next step.

Controls are simple. Use the W, A, S, and D keys to move, and use the mouse to shoot. The game runs in 3D and has an arcade feel. Its Digital Circus theme adds a playful look to the maze and the shooting.
dunjun: Dunjun is a quick dungeon crawler where your character glides in a straight line until it bumps into a wall. The journey covers 60 rooms, each one crafted by hand. The clock is always ticking, so you need to keep moving while avoiding traps and foes. Your goal is to gather the 12 Relics of Power hidden across a cursed dungeon.

Controls are simple. On a computer, use WASD or the arrow keys. On a phone or tablet, swipe in the direction you want to travel. Only the determined make it through, and some adventurers never come back.
hex-mine-2d: Hex Mine 2D is a calm logic puzzle played on a grid of hexagons. Each orange hexagon can be either blue or black, and your task is to work out which. A number on a clue cell tells you how many of its connected neighbors must be blue, so you read the clues together and narrow down each cell one step at a time. The game opens with simple tutorial boards before moving on to 30 harder stages.

Later levels bring overlapping clues, runs of consecutive cells, directional hints, and deeper deduction patterns. Every board is built to be solved through reasoning alone, so guessing is never needed. The visuals are clean and minimalist, and you can use a mouse or touch input. Undo, restart, and hint options are available, along with mistake tracking. There is no time pressure, your progress is saved, and you can pick any level from the selection screen.
one-man-army-battle-game: You play a lone fighter in this casual single-player battle game, where your warrior skills and reflexes are put to the test. The levels are challenging and the fights are intense. You must hold your ground against incoming arrows, cannon fire, and dragon flames, relying on smart tactics to stay alive.

This defensive strategy title asks you to fend off wave after wave of enemy soldiers, so you need to move quickly and outthink your foes. Every battle you win earns points that help you rank up and sharpen your abilities. You can spend them on your armory, which covers everything from new weapons to armor, and you have a range of skills and upgrades to choose from.
stack-swipe: Stack Swipe is a puzzle game built around vivid plates and chain reactions set off by your swipes. Each flick slides whole rows or columns, so matching plates pile up together. Gather at least five identical plates in one stack and they blast away, moving you closer to the target for each level.

A swipe can head in any direction and shifts every plate across the grid at once. Plates only move and stack when a same-colored plate sits somewhere along that swipe path, so think ahead before you act. The Serve button drops new plates into empty spaces, and sometimes they land on top of plates already in place.
sports-car: Sports Car drops you into a wilderness racing challenge where speed is front and center. Instead of leaving acceleration on autopilot, the game puts you in charge of it, which makes it easier to feel like a skilled racing pro. Its 3D presentation and simulator style give the drive a hands-on quality.

Using the controls is straightforward. Click the accelerator, and you manage how fast your car moves from there. Because the speed is in your hands, each race becomes a chance to practice steady throttle work and see how the car responds. Tagged as an action and car game, the title suits players who enjoy action driving in a wild outdoor setting.
match-3d-matching-puzzle: In this 3D puzzle, your job is to pair up objects scattered across the floor and pop them all. It is a single-player game with a casual, brain-teasing feel, and it offers a fresh take on matching pairs. Each level asks you to find matching objects and clear the whole board.

Once you clear a level, a new set of objects appears for you to pair. To pick up an object, hold down the left mouse button on it. Each round brings new objects to match as you work through the puzzle.
prime-snooker-showdown: Prime Snooker Showdown is a sports game that blends accuracy, tactics, and talent into a cue sports title. You move through many stages, and each one is built to test how far your snooker skills can go. Experienced players and beginners alike will find plenty to enjoy, and the challenges are likely to keep you coming back for hours.

The game features levels that change as you progress, along with physics that behave in a realistic way. You can also adjust your equipment and the settings around the table to suit your taste. To play, click and aim, then send each ball into a pocket.
sniper-survival-challenge-456: This sniper shooter draws on the Squid theme and asks you to line up careful shots. It is a tough test that still stays fun from start to finish. How far you go depends on how much you want to win, since you can rise to become the winner and the best player of all.

The game is a 3D title filed under adventure, with shooting and sniper action at its core. You play it entirely with the mouse. The challenge grows as you push for the top spot, so your drive to win shapes how well you do.
top-race-fun: Top Race Fun is a racing game where you steer fast cars along a highway packed with heavy traffic. It offers a range of game features, several missions, and multiple modes to try. Your aim is to bring your car across the finish line while avoiding crashes.
Use W, A, S, and D, or the arrow keys, to drive. Press C to switch the camera view. The game is set in 3D, so you can enjoy its car-focused racing experience from different angles.
extreme-ramp-car-stunts-game-3d: This 3D racing game puts you behind the wheel for daring ramp stunts. Your car tackles tricky tracks with zigzag paths, sky ramps, and city ramp sections, where high jumps and drifts make up most of the action. You can choose from several GT racing cars or a luxury model, then collect checkpoints as you work through custom challenges. Each level is designed to look fascinating, and the mix of jumps and speed keeps things lively.

The controls use the keyboard, so you handle the car with your keys as you move across each track. Before every run, you buckle your seat belt and get ready for the next challenge. The new interface and striking environments add to the feel of a driving simulator, and the game is free for fans of extreme ramp car jumping.
sheep-commotion: Sheep Commotion asks you to lead each sheep to the pen that matches its color. Sketch a route for every sheep, picking up stars along the way while steering clear of wolves, rocks, and puddles. Levels grow harder over time, and the sheep don't all act the same.

White sheep head for the white pen, and black sheep head for the black pen. Greedy sheep must be kept away from apples, so plan your lines with care. Finishing a level quickly earns you more stars, so think ahead and move with purpose.
merge-mania: Merge Mania is a puzzle game where numbers clash and combine. A new numbered tile appears at the bottom of the grid, and you tap a column to send it upward. When two matching numbers meet, they fuse into a single tile worth double the value. Your job is to keep chaining these merges while making sure the grid never overflows.

It is a race against time, so you are trying to see how much you can score before the clock runs out. The game suits anyone who enjoys math and logic, since planning where each tile lands is the key to a higher total. Watch the stack closely, think a few moves ahead, and see how far your score can climb before the board fills up.
hexholm: Hexholm is a quick, turn-based strategy game played on a hex map. You begin with one province and grow it into a kingdom by recruiting troops and seizing hexes, all while rival AI factions push back. Each battle is a compact tactical puzzle that rewards careful spending and well-timed advances.

Place your units on empty hexes within your land, then tap a unit to see where it can reach and either move or attack. Captured hexes widen your territory and raise your income, which depends on the land you hold. Merge matching units to upgrade them, press END TURN to let the AI act, and use UNDO to fix a mistake. Eliminate every rival to win the map. Play through 100 campaign stages, take on the daily challenge, or jump into a random skirmish, and climb the worldwide rankings for stages cleared and daily high scores.
car-stunts-new-mega-ramp-car-racing-game: Take the wheel in this racing title, where the ramps are built high in the sky. Each stunt feels different from the last, and the missions push you to pull off tricks that test your nerve. Fans of car driving and 3D stunt simulators will find plenty of routes to tackle, with several car models to choose from and tracks that vary from one to the next. Mega ramp bike stunts also appear on the challenging courses.

You can play offline, with no connection needed, which makes it handy for passing spare time. Gather friends for multiplayer races, or go solo through the thrilling and demanding modes. A fresh 2021 update arrived for multiplayer lovers. Everything is handled with the keyboard.
bicycle-mountain-xtreme: Bicycle Mountain Xtreme offers a laid-back yet demanding take on mountain biking. You tackle winding paths, pull off tricks, and collect points along the way, with new routes opening up as your skills grow. Its lifelike physics make every ride feel grounded, and the courses are generated procedurally so the terrain never quite repeats. Expect a day and night cycle, plus weather that shifts while you are on the bike.
To do well, keep your rider balanced, manage your speed, and stay steady over bumps and slopes. Because the physics respond to how you handle the bike, smooth technique
big-team: Big Team is a 3D arcade game where you build up a group of people into a bigger crowd. Your goal is to collect supporters wearing the right color so your team grows stronger, then guide them to the spaceship and fly off to another planet. Move your team left or right to gather more people, and steer clear of obstacles so you don't lose any of them.
Play is controlled with mouse clicks or taps, so you can use either a computer or a touchscreen device. It is a casual HTML5 game with a 3D look, and it runs right in your browser.
easter-rabbit-style: The Easter holiday is almost here, and this dress-up game brings a few adorable girls into the celebration. Your job is to track down every Easter egg in the scene. Along the way, choose outfits that fit the holiday theme, and add funny bags or hats with rabbit ears to finish each look. It is also a game you can enjoy together with your friends.
When your design is ready, you can save the result as a PNG image. Controls depend on your device: a computer mouse click works on desktops, while a simple touch is used on touch screens.
pocket-sniper: In this arcade shooter, you play as a professional assassin who is also a well-known sniper. Your boss has handed you a fresh assignment, so get your weapons ready and start working. Bullets are in short supply, which means you should finish the job as fast as you can. Make sure you never harm bystanders while you carry it out.
The game is a 3D title that relies on point-and-click play. To get started, just tap the screen to begin.
jelly-color-sort-3d: Jelly Color Sort 3D asks you to show off your sorting skills. You slide colorful 3D jelly pieces around and drop each one into the right section, grouping every jelly of the same shade together. The clock keeps ticking, so you need to think ahead and finish every level as fast as you can. If you get stuck, three helpers can bail you out: Freeze Time pauses the countdown, Destroy Jelly clears away a tricky piece, and Auto Shuffle mixes up the board for a clean start. Each helper is unlocked by watching a short rewarded ad.

Controls are simple, since a single tap picks up a jelly and moves it. The challenge builds as the levels get harder, so the game is quick to pick up but takes real practice to master. Sort every jelly before the timer hits zero to move on to the next stage.
mochi-mochi-tower: Mochi Mochi Tower is an arcade game where you pile up adorable kawaii mochi sweets to build the tallest stack you can. Timing matters: you need to release each piece at just the right moment, and the tower can wobble as it grows. Keep every drop balanced so nothing slides off the sides.

To play, tap the screen or click anywhere to drop the moving mochi onto the stack. Coins you collect along the way let you unlock fresh mochi packs and charming anime mascots to customize your sweets. It's quick to pick up, but mastering the perfect drop takes practice.
kitty-cat-merge: Cats are tumbling into this puzzle game, and your job is to drop them in the right place. Tap the screen and drag to pick where your kitty will land, then let go to release it. When two matching cats touch, they blend into a new, fluffier breed and you earn points for the merge. The game is easy to learn, and the constant flood of felines keeps things lively.

Stay focused on combining matching cats while leaving enough room for the next drop. Every merge pushes your score higher, so thinking a few moves ahead makes a real difference. Your aim is simple: keep the pile under control and chase the highest score you can reach.
real-cars-epic-stunts: Drive powerful supercars through this 3D stunt game, where you can customize and upgrade your rides before tackling demanding tracks. Each run pushes you to beat the clock as you perform tricks and learn to handle huge ramps. Dozens of stunt courses keep the challenges coming.

Collect coins and diamonds to unlock new cars and improve how your vehicles perform. The physics feel realistic, and the cars are highly detailed. You can play solo or switch to two-player mode, and every race brings a fresh challenge. To play, just click the mouse or tap the screen.
zombie-soldier: Zombie Soldier is an interesting shooting game. Your job is to wipe out the zombies by planning the route your bullets take as they rebound. You only have a limited number of bullets, so every shot matters. If you run out before every zombie is dead, the zombies will catch you and you will be eaten. You play as a superhero whose mission is to save the world.

Plan each rebound with care and look for the path that reaches the zombies. The game rewards skill and careful thinking, so take a moment before every shot, because one wasted bullet can end your run.
slope-car-gradient: Slope Car Gradient is a driving title with charming, cute graphics. Your aim is to head down the track, dodge the obstacles scattered along the way, and reach the finish line. You need to stay careful throughout, because completing a level successfully is what lets you move on to the next one.
Controls are easy to pick up. On a PC, press the left and right arrow keys to move your car. On mobile, swipe left or right to steer. Either way, keep your attention on the road ahead.
miki-oath: Miki Oath is a precision platformer with a strong story, offering 106 hand-built levels spread across ten magical worlds. Miki must dodge spikes and spinning saws while riding moving platforms, bouncing on springs, and passing through teleporters. Her mission is to keep a promise and rescue Luna.

Restarts are quick and the controls respond well, so getting back into a level after a fall is painless. The game is fully translated into nine languages. On desktop, use A or D, or the Left and Right Arrow keys, to move, and Space, W, or Up Arrow to jump. On mobile, use the on-screen touch controls. Reach the flag to clear each level, and use the sound control if you want to mute audio.
lovely-puzzle: Lovely Puzzle brings a cheerful Valentine's Day theme to a set of matching challenges. The game is built around twelve separate levels, and each one has its own difficulties and features, so the stages don't all feel the same. It's a single-player title that relies on clicking, color, and logic, and it appeals to players of all age groups who enjoy a sweet, romantic style.

To play, you match the puzzles within a limited time, using your mouse to work through each one. You'll need to complete every chapter to finish the game. If you want a closer look at the details on screen, you can zoom in with the mouse wheel. Overall, it's a fun and entertaining way to enjoy the holiday.
chaos-arena: Chaos Arena is an action game built around a spinner that you hurl across a crowded field with a single flick. Your aim is to crash into rivals, ricochet off the walls, and clear the arena of every opponent to win. Along the way you can collect skins to customize your spinner and face tough bosses that test your skills. Adjust
draw-and-save: You're the last boat left on the beach, and someone has gone under past the buoys while fins circle the water. You get one shot. Trace a route across the water with your finger, let go, and watch it play out. There's no steering, no brakes, and no takebacks.

Sharks follow loops that won't wait for you, and rocks stay put and never give way. Touching either one wipes out the entire run. Every swimmer has to make it, because leaving one behind fails the level. All the clocks start the moment you release, so a bar that isn't full means that swimmer goes first. Sharks keep moving while you draw, so aim for where they'll be, not where they are.
brawl-gun: Brawl Gun is a two-player war game made for you and a friend to enjoy together. Pick from three maps and three weapons, then customize your fighter with one of nine costumes while working through nine ranks. It sits in the action category and is also tagged as a 2D adventure, so it blends a few genres into one playful experience.

Controls are split between two players. The first player uses W, A, S, D and R, while the second uses the arrow keys and O. On mobile devices, touch controls take over, so you can play on a phone or tablet as well.
santa-fake-call: Santa Fake Call is a playful, hands-on game where you can pretend to phone Santa, start a video call with him, or send him text messages. Tapping the screen reveals a surprise from Santa Claus, so there is always something new to discover. It fits right into the Christmas and winter season and is aimed at players who enjoy festive, interactive fun.

Getting started is simple: just tap or click with your mouse to move through the game. Whether you want a voice call, a video chat, or a quick text exchange, each option lets you enjoy a bit of holiday magic with Santa.
baroho: BAROHO is a 3D arcade game that rewards careful timing and a calm head. You steer a tilting platform so the balls, which do not always cooperate, roll into the correct openings. A single careless tilt sends a ball veering away, and you must begin the round again from the start. It is a test of skill and self-control.
Control the platform with WASD or the arrow keys, or use the on-screen joystick on touchscreens. With a
harvest-haulers: Harvest Haulers is an idle tapping game where you manage a fruit farm. Each tap on the hopper knocks loose a handful of fruit, which falls into the funnel and lands on the trucks rolling along the belt. When a truck is completely loaded, it drives away and hands you gold. You can spend that gold in the shop on upgrades that add more fruit per tap, make trucks hold more, speed up the belt, or open extra lanes.

Keep the flow going by tapping the hopper whenever you like. If you would rather not wait for a truck to fill up, tap it on the belt to send it off right away. Use the upgrade cards in the shop rail to buy improvements and grow your production.
unravel-eggs-puzzle: This Easter-themed puzzle game is made for the holiday weekend. Each level asks you to untangle a knot of eggs so that no line joining two eggs crosses another line. The first stages are gentle, but the tangles grow into much harder knots that will test your logic and focus.

To play, touch an egg and drag it around the screen. Move the eggs until none of the connecting lines cross each other, and every line is untangled. Once the arrangement is clear, the eggs and lines turn green, which means the level is solved. It is a logic puzzle built for mobile devices.
blacktop-police-chase: This low-poly 3D getaway driver puts you in the wheelman's seat in a wide city of alleys, docks, parks, bridges and a monorail. Scoop up a bank robber, lose the police, and bring him to the hideout before your car gives out, guided by the green arrow. Police pressure builds across six pursuit levels, so the longer you stay free, the harder they hit, and every crash damages your vehicle.

Coins collected on the streets can be spent in the garage to unlock 12 cars, each with its own speed, grip, weight and health, plus 12 paint colors. Drive with the arrow keys, WASD or ZQSD, brake with Spacebar, S or Down Arrow, look back with B, and reset with Right Shift. Splitscreen is supported, menus run on the keyboard, and mobile players get on-screen tou
dragon-merge: Dragon Merge is a relaxed puzzle game built around combining dragons. Join two matching dragons to create a new, stronger one, and keep going to uncover more of them. Once you have built up your collection, you can take those dragons into the battle arena to defeat monsters. The main aim is to reach the final dragon, and the game is easy to pick up, hard to put down, and has no set end.
Controls are simple. Use the left mouse button to fire your dragon and to press the buttons on screen.
speed-chaos-crazy-race: Speed Chaos: Crazy Race is an arcade racer inspired by Mario Kart, though it moves faster and feels more intense. You zoom around short tracks, grabbing bonuses as you go and firing them at rivals to pass them and win. Every lap brings a flurry of bright effects and sudden surprises, and the crashes look spectacular. The controls are easy to pick up, so you can start driving right away.

In Race mode, you must beat a time limit that shrinks with every lap. Career mode asks you to finish missions while you race. Logging in on consecutive days earns daily rewards, which can unlock new cars. On a PC, the A and D keys steer while mouse clicks activate bonuses. On a phone or tablet, on-screen arrows steer and taps on icons use bonuses.
bobr-turbo-craft-cars: Bobr Turbo: Craft Cars is a strategy game where you build your own battle vehicles from a large selection of blocks. You can add boosters and weapons, then shape each machine to suit your taste. Parts can be crafted and upgraded so your builds become sturdier, quicker, and harder-hitting. Your aim is to assemble a fighting machine from the blocks in your inventory.

Loot chests give you extra items to strengthen your collection and test how inventive you can be. Adjust your vehicles carefully so they can beat rival builds. Battles run on their own in arena matches, and the goal is to smash your opponents and climb the ranks. Controls are simple: on PC, use the left mouse button, and on a phone, tap the screen.
