xtrem-demolition-derby-racing: Demolition-style car crashes take center stage in this action title, and the focus is squarely on impact. You can push the accelerator to its maximum and slam into any car you spot on the map. Your goal is to destroy every vehicle on the map to complete the mission.

Driving is handled entirely with the keyboard, using W, A, S and D to steer your car around the map. The game is meant to be a playful crash session, so enjoy the chaos as you hunt down the remaining wrecks. Good luck finishing the mission.
crystalia: Crystalia is a block puzzle where you fit colored pieces onto a board. Each piece appears in the bottom panel. Turn it if you need a different angle, then drag it into place. Line up three or more blocks of one color side by side, either horizontally or vertically, since diagonal lines don't count. When a group forms, it bursts apart and you collect points, with longer chains paying a larger bonus.

When space runs short, three boosters can help. The Bomb removes one block along with the blocks touching it, the Laser wipes out a full row or column, and Shuffle mixes up every block on the board. The round finishes once no room is left for new pieces, and your final score is posted to the leaderboard, where you can try to climb toward the top. A useful tip: avoid filling every gap right away. Keeping open channels lets you build long chains, which is how the biggest combos and record scores come about.
snake-and-apple: Guide a small serpent through a confined area by feeding it apples. Each bite makes its body longer, and once it has grown enough, the snake can head for the exit. The idea sounds easy enough, but the puzzles quickly become tricky and reward careful thinking.

The game contains 99 stages, so there is plenty of room to test your reasoning from start to finish. Controls rely only on mouse clicks or taps, so you can jump in on a computer or a phone. Think a few steps ahead before each move, since the puzzles reward careful planning.
tricky-track-3d-2-game: Tricky Track 3D 2 is an arcade parkour game built around direct confrontation. On each level you are pitted against a human-machine opponent, and the first participant to reach the finish line claims victory. The road changes colour: when it is green, you can move ahead, but when it turns red, you will be blocked or slowed down. Watch closely for the balls the other team throws at you, because each hit can stop your progress.

Controls are easy to pick up, since you can use a mouse or simply tap to play. Time your moves around the track's colours, and keep an eye out for incoming throws so you can keep pushing toward the finish. This 3D title blends racing with obstacle-dodging parkour, making it a lively pick for players who enjoy head-to-head competition.
domino-simulator-puzzle: Place dominoes with care in Domino Simulator Puzzle and set off chain reactions that send tiles toppling across the board. Your job is to think ahead about where each piece goes so the whole sequence falls the way you planned. The controls are easy to pick up, and a mouse click or a tap is all you need to make
merge-monster-attack: Merge Monster Attack is an action title where you join weapons together to upgrade your arsenal and hold off waves of incoming foes. Every enemy kind behaves differently, so you will need to plan ahead and think fast as the difficulty climbs. To play, drag items onto one another to combine them, then point the mouse cursor to aim your shots.
kids-cars-games: Kids Cars Games is a playful learning title made for very young children in the early preschool years. Little players pick up the names of different vehicles and the sounds they make while they enjoy themselves. It also serves as a first step into kindergarten-style lessons, giving young minds a gentle start.

The game is meant to be entertaining from beginning to end, so kids can have a good time while they learn. Control is simple: use a mouse or tap the screen, depending on your device. We hope the experience brings plenty of smiles to your little ones.
spa-day-makeup-artist: Step into the shoes of a salon owner in this girls' beauty game. You look after clients who arrive with all kinds of needs, and six different services are available to offer them. The journey starts with a soothing facial spa session, where you wash the face, pluck the eyebrows, and clear away pimples.

Once the skin looks fresh, you whip up a do-it-yourself hair mask using real hair spa tools. Finally, you choose trendy accessories to complete your client's look. Controls are simple: use your mouse or tap the screen to play.
stick-hero-mighty-tower-wars: Stick Hero Mighty Tower Wars is a fighting game built around battles with monsters and enemies. Your goal is to defeat foes while using less power, collecting power-ups along the way, and eliminating every enemy on the field. Build your tower as high as you can. A princess needs your help, and a treasure awaits you.
Each move calls for careful calculation as you w
stickman-fighting-3d: Stickmen settle their differences in this 3D fighting game. You pick from many 3D fighters, including normal, zombie, demon, cyber, and Kyle stickmen, then take on opponents until your foe falls. The game offers 3D graphics and locations, along with realistic 3D physics. There is plenty of fighting to enjoy for hours.

Your goal is to rise up as a stick champion and get revenge on every enemy who wronged you. Move with W, A, S and D, use T, Y, U, G, H and J for different attacks, and press the space bar to open the pause menu. The soundtrack features CzySzy's Paul ter voorde vs zombies, DiePflanze's Fighting Loop and Hanupo's Glitch Bot.
takeover: For many centuries, the Rivadis Empire held sway over the continent and was admired for its splendor. Today, however, necromancers have seized it, and it is slowly fading. In Takeover, you pick one of three nations and fight for control of Rivadis in a real-time strategy game.

The built-in tutorial walks you through the basics, so you can learn how things work before the real fighting begins. Expect a fantasy setting full of castles, knights, kings, and magic, where battle and defense go hand in hand. Each of the three nations is competing for the same prize, so every move counts.
vegas-crime-city: Step into a crime-ridden city where gang battles break out across San Andreas. This realistic title takes its inspiration from GT-style games and drops you into Vegas, a town full of crime and a street that looks like the real thing. You play as a gangster and work your way deeper into Vegas City.

Move with WASD, jump with Space, and use Z to brake and aim. Keys 1 through 5 switch between weapons, and the left mouse button fires your gun. It is filed under shooting and is built with 3D graphics for the browser.
what-a-leg: A race is underway between runners who are still missing their legs. Your job is to sketch legs for them and guide each one to the finish line as fast as you can. The courses pass through different parkours, and each one is full of obstacles. On every block, you need to draw a different kind of leg to help your runner get past what is in the way.

You can face online opponents in single player mode, or compete against a friend in two player mode. In single player, use your mouse and left-click to draw legs. In two player mode, draw your legs at the start of the game, then switch between them with your keys. Player 1 uses W, A, S and D, while Player 2 uses the arrow keys.
time-of-adventure-easter-holiday: This Easter special episode of Time of Adventure brings a seasonal twist to the 2D adventure, made for two players to share. Your mission is to collect the special Easter eggs, then head toward the Ice King and leap through the door to finish. Ten chapters are waiting, and you must complete each one before moving on.
Controls are split between two sets of keys. One player uses WASD along with R, while the other uses the arrow keys along with O. Mobile devices can use touch controls instead.
catch-him: The thief has snatched a visitor's belongings and is making a run for it, trying to get as far away as he can. Your job is to go after him and bring him down before he disappears. The game is an arcade title with a 3D look, and it is built with HTML5 so it runs in a browser. You control everything with mouse clicks or taps, so there is no complicated setup to learn.

Keep your eyes on the fleeing figure and keep the pressure on as he tries to slip away. Every chase is a short, simple test of speed and timing, and the goal stays the same from start to finish: catch the thief before he gets too far ahead.
crazy-pixel-apocalypse-4: Online multiplayer games have come a long way, with monthly battles and battle royale titles offering plenty of options and fun for players online. In Crazy Pixel Apocalypse 4, the extra firepower of its online multiplayer setup helps you turn the tide of a fight. Expect striking visuals, deadly weapons, and intense real-time competition as you reload your gun and push forward.

Join other gamers and take on the online battle royale challenge. Use W, A, S, and D to walk, and move the mouse to aim and look around. Shoot with the mouse, press Tab to open the menu, and press Space to jump.
good-guys-vs-bad-boys-zombie: Monthly battles and team-based battle royale games have given online players plenty of choices and hours of fun. This multiplayer shooter offers stunning visuals, lethal weapons, and fierce real-time competition, so you can turn the tide of a fight and reload your gun when you need to. You can also take part in the cooperative online Clash of Clans challenge with other participants.
Walk with W, A, S, and D. The mouse lets you aim, look around, and shoot.
merging-hexa: Merging Hexa is a puzzle built around hexagon-shaped tiles. Your aim is to join matching hex pieces so they form bigger numbers, working toward the hard-to-get hexagon with the highest value. Each combination brings you a step closer to that top figure, so careful planning pays off.

The game feels relaxing yet hard to put down. You play by sliding across the game screen to move the hexa numbers into place. Beating your own high score gives you a clear reason to keep going, and along the way the game gives your mind a good workout while you enjoy its visually appealing puzzle challenge.
racing-gun: Picture a fast multiplayer shooter where you compete in races and trade shots along the way. The courses keep shifting, so you have to weave past obstacles and dodge incoming fire while you head for the finish. Grabbing power-ups at the right moment can help you get ahead of rivals and cross the line before anyone else.

You can personalize your character and pick from a selection of weapons, then tackle a set of tough maps. Play with a friend on the same team or jump in alone and take on the field yourself. Controls are simple: use your mouse or the space bar.
real-impossible-tracks-race: Real Impossible Tracks Race is a driving game that also helps you build your skills behind the wheel. You navigate tight corners on raised asphalt courses and steer around barriers while piloting a muscle stunt car in race car driving. This 3D off-road drifting simulator lets you practice slides, preparing you for difficult moments on the road.

As you play, you can unlock sports cars you want to drive. Your goal is to show your skill by completing every mission in the game. Controls are simple: use W, A, S and D to move, and press the Space bar to brake.
redmax: Redmax is a 2D arcade adventure where you race to get away from a giant red cube monster that keeps chasing you. Along the way, grab every key and collect the coins you pass. Each level ends with your friends waiting for you, so you need the key in hand before you can reach the end safely. Once you are there, link up with your friends and head on to the next stage.

The game uses WASD to move and supports double jumps to help you clear gaps and dodge danger. Mobile controls are included, so you can play on a phone or tablet as well. It is a single-player pixel-style title that fits well into quick arcade sessions.
unicycle-mayhem: Floppy puppet fighters wobble on top of a one-wheel bike in this battle game. Each ragdoll rider tries to keep their balance while firing at the ground beneath the rival. The arena floor is made of breakable pieces, and every shot that hits the surface makes that section vanish. Your aim is to clear away the bricks or ground under your opponent so they topple off. The first fighter to score five wins the match.

To play alone, press A and D or the left and right arrows to move, and SPACE to shoot. For two players, the first player moves with A and D and shoots with G, while the second player moves with the left and right arrows and shoots with L. This 3D action shooter takes place in an arena and runs on WebGL.
kara-climb: Help Kara scale the mountain until she reaches the very top. The path has plenty of spots where a wrong step sends her tumbling, so you need to move with care. Your job is to hop from stone to stone, or platform to platform, and clear the gaps between them so she never drops. Kara can perform a regular jump or a double jump, and choosing when to use each one is the key to getting further. Keep an eye on the clock too, because the game ends if time runs out.
Control her with your mouse, or tap the screen if you are on a touch device.
motor-bike-race: Motor Bike Race is a racing game for Android where you take a motorcycle out on the track and race for fun. It counts among the racing titles on the platform, so it will appeal to anyone who enjoys driving or racing games. The goal is straightforward: build up speed, keep the wheels moving, and enjoy the ride.

Handling your bike is simple. Press to accelerate, then use the front and rear controls to change the direction of rotation as you travel. The game is tagged with bike, car, motorcycle, race, and world themes, which gives a sense of the variety on offer.
super-john-wick: You take on the role of John, an enigmatic fighter moving through the hidden world of underground killers. He is a skilled marksman whose aim is almost flawless, and he is driven by a fierce wish for payback. This is a single-player 3D action title with a casual feel.
Your goal is to fire and guide the bullet toward the enemies until you have destroyed them all. The controls are simple: click the
baby-taylor-first-spa: Taylor's mom loves fashion and beauty, and she regularly visits a salon for body care. Usually she goes alone, but this time Taylor is eager to tag along and see what a spa visit is really like. You join the pair on their trip to the beauty salon and help Taylor settle in for a calm, pampering session together.
The game includes cleaning, dress up, and makeover activities, and everything is controlled with a mouse click or a tap. Take your time, relax with Taylor, and enjoy the spa day together.
head-soccer-2023-2d: Head Soccer 2023 2D is a playful arcade soccer adventure where your head does the kicking. Instead of using your feet, you aim to send the ball past the opponent and into the net. You can play alone or bring a friend onto the pitch, and either way, every match comes down to scoring enough goals to win.

Solo players move with the arrow keys and hit the ball with the Z and X keys. In two player mode, the first player uses WASD to run around and the N and M keys to strike, while the second player moves with the arrow keys. The controls are easy to pick up, so you can jump into a quick match with a friend and start scoring right away.
fashion-girl-halloween-boutique: Halloween is the peak season for the boutique, and today it's crowded with students from school. The theme leans toward horror, and the girls need outfits for all kinds of outings: a sweet date, trick-or-treating, a birthday party, and an audition. Each occasion calls for its own holiday look.

Your goal is to make every girl look as frightening as you can. Keep an eye out for oddities too, since someone on the street is dressed as a pineapple. Let your imagination guide you as you create outfits that are both horrifying and one of a kind. Use the mouse or tap the screen to play.
impossible-car-stunt-tracks: Race your chosen car along sky-high courses lined with launch ramps, spinning obstacles, slim bridges, and risky leaps. Unlock new stunt and parking stages as you progress, and collect rewards along the way. Reach every checkpoint before the clock runs out. Success depends on precise steering, controlled braking, switching camera views, and bold acceleration.

Press W or the Up Arrow to accelerate, and use S or the Down Arrow to brake and reverse. Steer with A and D or the Left and Right Arrows. Press Space for the handbrake, either Shift key for a boost, and C to change the camera. Escape pauses the game. Touch controls are available for mobile devices.
bmx-offroad-trial-stunts: Hop on a bike and ride through a world full of cycling titles. Some are 3D racers that are fun to play, while others are pure BMX challenges that put your riding skills to the test. This free online version of the popular BMX Crazy Abilities of BMX 3 Motocross brings fast BMX racing and bike riding right to your screen.
Expect real-time action from BMX boy games in this off-road bicycle race, which features touch-screen bikes and newer BMX titles. Drive with W, A, S and D, and press SPACE to jump.
summer-juice-run: Summer Juice Run lets you control a glass of juice that runs through the course. It is a light parkour title that asks for quick reflexes while keeping the handling smooth. The world is bathed in sunny, colorful scenery, and you move through many different stages. Rewards are scattered along the way, and the controls stay easy to pick up, so the game feels both calming and lively for anyone who enjoys a casual session.
To play, press down on the screen, drag your finger or cursor to steer, and then let go to start.
gloves-grow-rush: Gloves Grow Rush is a three-dimensional arcade game built around stickman boxers in a vertical running challenge. Your job is to collect boxing gloves along the way and battle opponents who are weaker than you. Each level ends with a final boss. When a stronger boxer appears, it is smarter to evade than to fight, because a single direct punch means game over.

Gems can be claimed to raise your starting level and your attack power, known as ATK. The shop offers six unique boxing gloves, but none of them grant extra ATK or levels. To move, hold and swipe left or right.
stylish-fashion-challenge: Stylish Fashion Challenge puts you in the role of a designer working for a fashionista who wants to prove her style against a rival. Your job is to choose a flattering costume for every event on the schedule. You can look through her wardrobe, select outfits and accessories that suit each occasion, and then see how her looks stack up against those chosen by other players.
Everything is controlled with the left mouse button, so you simply click to browse and pick items. Think carefully about which pieces fit each setting, then enjoy dressing her up for the challenge.
save-my-girl: In Save My Girl, you guide a girl who has gone astray as she faces one obstacle after another. Each challenge is a small puzzle that asks you to think carefully about what comes next. At every difficulty level, two choices appear in front of you, and only the correct pick lets you advance to the following stage. Her safety depends entirely on your decisions.

Play it with a mouse click or a tap, since those are the only controls you need. It blends adventure with brain-teasing moments, so it appeals to kids and anyone who likes working through puzzles. Every decision matters, so take your time before choosing.
cute-cupid-is-preparing-for-valentine-s-: Cupid is getting ready for Valentine's Day. On this day, people send congratulations to those they hold dear, often with a postcard and a gift. Cupid also wants new holiday clothes, so your task is to help pick a luxurious outfit for the celebration.

The costumes come in cute pink and gold tones and feature plenty of hearts in every size, which is a trademark of Cupid's style. Once the look is ready, you can make a Valentine card to delight the people you care about. Play with the left mouse button or by touch.
new-noob-mommy-long: This single-player 2D arcade adventure puts you in the shoes of a brand-new noob who must keep sprinting away from Mommy Long. She is always on your trail, and the moment you pause, she catches you. Obstacles lie along the route, and if you misjudge them, you cannot clear the level and the chase ends in defeat. Your aim is to get through all 10 levels and prove you are the best noob.

Controls are straightforward. Press W and D or the arrow keys to move, or use touch controls on mobile. Double jump is active, so you can leap higher than a single jump allows. To open the exit door, collect the blue hand and the red hand, then activate the door. Stay on the move the whole time.
crazy-car-drive-road-challenge: In this colorful physics driving game, you sketch the route before your cartoon car sets off. Hold the mouse button or touch the screen and drag to draw a road that carries the vehicle over hills, across gaps, and past hazardous obstacles. Once your line is ready, click, tap, or press W, the Up Arrow, or Space to begin the drive. Gather coins and fuel as you go, and work to avoid dangerous impacts while surviving any crashes.

Between runs, change the paint and wheels to give your car a new look. Each attempt is a chance to beat your best distance and master smoother routes. Press P or Escape to pause and R to restart. The game is suitable for players of all ages.
water-pipe: Water Pipe is a relaxing take on the classic pipe game, with plenty of levels to work through. Each one shows a set of pipes that must be turned so water has a clear route to flow along. To move a pipe, you simply tap it to rotate it, or click it if you are using a mouse.

Every level has a time limit, so you need to finish connecting the pipes before the clock runs out. The game is filed under puzzles and is tagged as brain and clicker, so it suits anyone who enjoys a calm test of planning and quick hands.
ghost-team-shooter: You play as a soldier in a ghost team, and your job is to wipe out a camp where mercenaries train inside ancient ruins. A large arsenal of strong guns is at your disposal, and you must shoot down every enemy force heading your way. Winning means surviving all the waves of attackers that arrive.

This is a single-player 3D shooter with plenty of action. Move with W, A, S, and D, and fire with the left mouse button. Scroll the mouse wheel to switch weapons, press R to reload, and tap Space to jump. If you need a pause, press P.
pure-sky-rolling-ball: Pure Sky Rolling Ball is a three-dimensional arcade title where you guide a ball across each course. Your main job is to pick up the black balls and make your way to the checkpoint. There is also a side goal: grab every coin on the platform. Missing a few is no problem, because before each level you can test free skins and pick your favorite. To buy a skin, you need to earn enough coins first. Collect five black balls and you unlock a special level that pays out even more coins. To move, hold and swipe.
subway-clash-2: Moscow's old metro depot has fallen into the hands of a cult called the Witnesses of the Illyich. Its fanatical leader, Bonch-Bruyevich, plans a radiation attack on the city and wants to topple the constitutional order. You take on the role of a GRU Special Forces commander, ordered to clear these dangerous tunnels once and for all and remove every criminal element. Rally your team, push forward, and pick up new weapons along the way.

The old metro is full of nooks and passages, and some of them hide secret spots or unexpected surprises. Move with WASD, jump with SPACE, and crouch with C. Throw a grenade with G, aim with the right mouse button, and press TAB to open the score table. It is a 3D multiplayer shooter, so you fight alongside and against other players.
drawing-christmas-for-kids-draw-and-colo: Kids who love brushes and crayons will find plenty to do in this Christmas drawing title. It offers painting and coloring activities inside learning games made for kindergarten-age children, along with drawing games built for young players. Animated scenes blend with sketched artwork, giving the coloring app a distinctive look. The game is listed as hypercasual and carries tags such as Educational, Fun, Color, and Draw.
Little artists pick up how to sketch adorable characters in a playful way. Everything is controlled with a simple tap or click.
game-on-cat-vs-rats: Step into the role of a group of brave cats determined to stop the Rat King. This oversized rat is stirring up trouble, and nobody is quite sure how it grew so large. The cats are furious about its wicked schemes, so they set out with a slingshot to reach the king and scratch its face. Each level is cleared by launching the cats at the enemy until it is defeated.
Controls are simple: aim carefully and shoot the mice along the way. This single-player action game belongs to the hypercasual category. Your goal is to take down the Rat King one level at a time.
this-game-about-climbing: In this climbing game, you steer your climber's hands using only a mouse or a gamepad, hauling yourself up a massive, dangerous mountain packed with hurdles and unexpected twists. Slick patches are waiting to catch you out, so keep an eye on your footing as you work toward the summit. Anyone who makes it to the top earns everlasting fame along with a lov
bus-driving-3d-simulator: This coach driving title teaches you how to handle a genuine coach across a range of different scenarios. Your task is to carry passengers from one city to another, passing through places and landscapes worth seeing along the way. An open world map, a selection of vehicles, and well-crafted interiors are meant to give you a lifelike sense of driving a coach bus. The journey takes you through Europe.

The game uses keyboard controls, so every input comes from keys on your computer. Its simulation world is built around the everyday work of bus driving, and it lets you climb behind the wheel and experience that work for yourself.
paper-golf: Paper Golf is a puzzle game with a playful, paper-style look. Your job is to launch goofy, round characters from a sling and get each one into a hole. Every level is packed with obstacles, so you'll need to plan your shots carefully to steer clear of them. Finishing levels opens up new characters for you to try out.
Aiming works by tapping and dragging. The farther you pull back, the harder the character flies, much like a real slingshot. When you're happy with the angle and strength, let go to take the shot.
castle-raid-3d: Castle Raid 3D is a collecting, drawing, and puzzle arcade game. In each level you gather a team and lead it toward the castle. Enemies on the track shrink your army, so you need to find the right area and get past them. Drawing a line is how you slip by those threats and add more members to your side.

The game is controlled by sliding across the screen to draw. It is tagged as 3D, Arcade, Avoid, Casual, Collecting, Draw, and Puzzle, so it blends a playful mood with a bit of planning. Have a good time with it.
poopieman-apocalypse: PoopieMan Apocalypse is a free, casual shooting game where precise aim matters most. A little character called Doodieman finds himself in trouble after a gang of bandits takes over his city, and it is up to you to help him fight back. He fires poo bullets from his body, so you must aim carefully at each enemy while keeping an eye on how much amm
cursed-treasure-1-5: The evil forces' gems are under threat once again. After ten years of calm, the good heroes are back to steal the last three gems that the Overlord guarded. You take charge of defending a treasure that centuries of wicked deeds have gathered. Ninjas, angels, and lizard riders all come your way, and you must bring down every one of them.

Use your mouse or a tap to place towers and cast spells. Build and upgrade your towers, and learn useful skills to make your defenses stronger. Your main task is to stop enemies from grabbing and stealing your gems. This casual tower defense game mixes strategy and fantasy in a classic style.
rise-zombies: Survive a broken-down city in this zombie game, where the undead keep coming in one wave after another. Every zombie you defeat drops gold, which you can use to sharpen your fighting moves, quicken your footwork, and toughen your defenses. Your decisions about when to spend it matter as much as your fighting.

bff-stylish-off-shoulder-outfits: Bff Stylish Off Shoulder Outfits is a dress-up game for girls, built around two best friends and their style. The off-shoulder top is a piece that never goes out of fashion, and this one feels sweet and feminine, making it a nice pick for a day out.
Those two friends are eager to fill their closets with as many dresses as they can, which means a shopping trip is needed. Your role is to help them choose the perfect outfit. The game
fishing-life: Fishing Life is a calm clicker with cartoon-style 2D graphics. You pick the fish you want to catch, then keep tapping the screen to reel it in while watching its energy.

Put your early effort into Strength first. Skins make each tap stronger, outfits raise your damage, and Keepnets help you collect higher prices. Assistants boost your Income, Strength, Damage, and Price. Along the way you can open chests and collect cash from charged drift bottles. Sometimes luck brings a treasure chest, and opening it may reward you with valuable assistants.
gangster-crime-car-simulator-2: Set in Miami, this open world game drops you into a city where the mafia underworld controls every street. Gangsters killed your innocent family, so you set out to take revenge on the real mafia don and his crew. Along the way you can steal cars and other vehicles from civilians, grab weapons from them, and plan how to reach the crime godfather bosses before shooting them down. You can also step into the gang underworld yourself.

Customize your gangster with a range of clothes and accessories, and unlock more locations across Miami as you progress. The realistic 3D world is busy with city crime, and stunning sound effects add punch to every moment. Keyboard controls let you move between map locations, and you keep fighting until the very end.
stickman-climber: Stickman Climber puts you in control of a stickman on the way up. The rules are kept simple. Tap the Up button to jump from one side to the other, and press the Turn button to flip around and dodge a bomb. Both buttons work together as you climb.
Your main goal is to reach a high score, so every jump counts. Keep watch for the bomb while you climb, and try to beat your own score each time you play.
baby-taylor-daily-caring: Taylor's parents are away today, so she will spend the whole day alone at home. She knows how to look after herself in many ways, but she is still a little girl and needs her mom's help with cooking and bathing. Your job is to take care of her and keep her company while she gets through the day.

To play, just click the mouse or tap the screen. Along the way, you will help Taylor with her meals and bathing, and make sure she is well cared for. This girls' game focuses on looking after a little one, so take good care of Taylor.
squad-tower: Squad Tower blends action, strategy, and combat puzzles into one game. Each level presents sturdy towers guarded by many enemies. To take them on, you drag your hero toward an enemy tower and watch the fight unfold. As you progress, you can unlock new skins and weapons, helping you push through foes that never seem to let up.

The aim is to grow into a true champion of this intense battle. Plan your moves carefully, pick your moments, and keep your squad moving forward until every tower falls. It is a good pick for anyone who enjoys tower defense, castle sieges, and heroic showdowns.
melon-jump: Melon Jump is a tough but enjoyable hypercasual game with a clean, simple look. Your job is to guide the Melon from one platform to the next. Grab extra lives along the way to grow bigger, and keep an eye out for foes that approach from every direction.

Play with your mouse on a desktop computer, or use touch controls on a mobile device. Each jump is about timing and positioning, so the controls are quick to pick up. Every platform you reach keeps the run going, while every mistake makes the challenge harder to survive.
prado-parking-game: Test your driving accuracy and sense of space in this Prado parking title. You pilot a sleek Prado SUV through busy city car parks ringed by tall buildings. Weave between bright orange cones, take sharp bends, and practise backing into green target zones with smooth reverse manoeuvres.

The game uses realistic vehicle physics and detailed 3D visuals, and the levels grow harder as you progress. It is built as a simulation to sharpen your steering and car control, whether you are squeezing into a narrow gap or fine-tuning how your car lines up. Drive and steer with W, A, S, D or the arrow keys.
horror-granny-escape: Your aim in this game is to find a way out of each room you are locked in. A key should be hidden somewhere nearby, so take your time inspecting the area. Check the furniture and open the drawers to see what they contain. Expect to repeat this routine often, because the house has many rooms, and each one holds something you need before you can leave. Once you have gathered every required item, you can switch off the alarm and open the front door.
The controls are simple. Use W, A, S and D to move, hold Shift to run, press Space to jump, and tap F to use objects.
mr-bean-funny-jigsaw: Mr Bean Funny Jigsaw is a free browser puzzle game that belongs to the jigsaw family. Start by picking any of six pictures, then choose a difficulty level: easy splits the image into 25 pieces, medium uses 49, and hard uses 100. Control the game with your mouse, or tap the screen if you are playing on a phone or tablet.
Put the picture back together piece by piece and enjoy the playful Mr Bean theme as you go. It works well for kids and for anyone who likes a relaxed challenge built around HTML5 play.
ugi-bugi-and-kisiy-misiy: Team up with a friend in this two-player adventure, where Ugi Bugi and Kisiy Misiy are partners. Your task is to help the person controlling Ugi Bugi get through the chapters one by one. The game sits in the adventure and arcade categories and uses a 2D look, so you know what kind of experience to expect.

makeup-slime-cooking-master: Slime is a favorite toy for many girls, who enjoy it in a wide range of colors and textures. Plenty of them like to make their own at home. In this game, Barbie suddenly wants to mix slime with cosmetics, and she invites you to help her create lovely, one-of-a-kind slimes.

You work alongside Barbie to put together slimes that look pretty and interesting. Everything is controlled with a simple click of the mouse or a tap on the screen. It suits anyone who enjoys cooking, decorating, and simulation games.
red-mini-golf: Red Mini Golf is an adventure-style fun game that calls for plenty of focus if you want to clear every level. The goal is simple: send the ball into the hole. Getting there is the tricky part, since you must travel across several platforms, and each one has its own set of obstacles in the way.
Controls are straightforward. A mouse click works on a computer, and a tap does the same job on a phone or tablet. Just aim and shoot your way through each course, one stage at a time.
mafia-car-driving-3d-simulator: Mafia Car Drive is an endless arcade racer that pushes the genre forward. You weave your car through busy highway traffic while collecting cash along the way. That money lets you improve your vehicle or buy new cars to take out on the road.

Your aim is to climb the global leaderboards and become one of the quickest drivers out there. The game is played with the keyboard, so you steer and manage your run using your keys. Because the racing never stops, every session gives you another chance to push further up the rankings.
easter-egg-arena: Easter brings a bunny rivalry to this two-player arcade game, where each rabbit tries to snatch the egg from the other. The goal is to get free of the egg, because whoever is holding it when time runs out loses as the egg explodes. Quick reactions and clever choices matter here.

The red bunny moves with the W, A, S and D keys, and the blue bunny responds to the arrow keys. Each match lasts two minutes, so every second counts as you keep the egg away from your opponent. The colorful, sweet-looking eggs and pixel-style look give the game a cheerful spring feel.
color-road-ball: In Color Road Ball, you roll your ball toward the other ball that shares its color. Any ball showing a different hue is one to avoid, so look closely at each shade before you choose a path. This single-player 3D game sits in the hypercasual category and blends action with adventure. Its tags also link it to .io games.
You control everything with the left mouse button alone. Good luck as you roll through the colors and head for the ball that matches yours.
world-of-alice-puzzle-numbers: World of Alice: Puzzle Numbers is a learning game made for children. Through a puzzle, young players discover numbers in an engaging, hands-on way. It can be played on a cell phone, a tablet, or a computer.

To play, you drag each piece of the puzzle into place until it forms the number. The controls are simple, which makes it easy for little ones to follow. It works well as a strong learning resource, and it shows that studying can be enjoyable for kids.
valentines-school-bus-3d-parking: Valentines School Bus 3D Parking is a driving and parking game that runs in your web browser, and you can play it online at no cost. Your goal is to guide the love bus into a parking spot and park it properly, which earns you a date. As you drive, gather the love hearts you pass and steer clear of walls and obstacles.
You can control the bus with the arrow keys or the WASD keys. On mobile devices, touch the screen to steer. The game is listed under Girls, and its tags include 3D, Driving, Hypercasual and HTML5.
home-rush-path-game: Home Rush Path Game is a puzzle race where you steer characters down the correct trails so each one gets safely back home. Choosing the right route matters, since some paths are built to mislead you. Every level must be finished in as little time as possible. The game has bright, colorful visuals and smooth gameplay, and its path layouts grow more challenging over time, even though the controls stay simple to learn.
Along the way, you will test your timing, decision-making, and path-finding skills as you race toward the finish. To use any button, simply click it with the mouse.
bff-easter-photobooth-party: Easter comes alive in this BFF-themed photobooth game, where you and your closest friends get to enjoy the holiday together. Pick from bright outfits inspired by the season, then strike a pose for cute snapshots inside the photobooth. Along the way you can create memories to keep, and there are plenty of colorful props to play with.

Festive decorations surround you the whole time, and the mood stays light and full of laughter from start to finish. It makes a lovely way to capture the spirit of Easter and spend a happy day with your BFFs. To begin, simply left-click with your mouse or tap the screen.
drift-boss-supercar: Drift Boss Supercar is a drift racing title that mixes real-time combat with grounded physics. You can collect sought-after sports cars, lay down smoke on the racetrack, and roam freely with friends in free roam mode. The look leans into a retro style, and the design feels classic, though there is a trick you need to learn.

The cars follow realistic physics, which makes them more fun to handle. The game offers no drifting help, no steering help, and no other gimmicks, so every result depends on your own skill. It is still simple to pick up and play. Drive with WASD.
jelly-jelly: Jelly Jelly is a hypercasual arcade game in which you collect the plankton produced by the jellyfish. Stay alert, because touching that plankton costs you one of your lives. Your aim is to gather as much plankton as you can and put your personal score on the scoreboard. Now and then a red balloon floats into view. Grab it to add a 100-point bonus to your total.

The game is simple enough for young children, and it runs on a single tap or click. It features 3D graphics and 3D animations, along with sound effects and a cheerful soundtrack. Its bright, colorful look keeps the screen lively from start to finish.
world-of-alice-parts-of-the-house: World of Alice: Parts of the House is a learning game designed for children. Through a playful format, it teaches young players the different parts of a home and the names for each one. You can enjoy it on a mobile phone, a tablet, or a computer, so it works on whichever device you have at hand.

To play, look for the picture that matches the name you are given and click on it. The game turns vocabulary practice into something that feels more like fun than study. Alice's world shows that children can pick up useful words while having a good time, which makes it a friendly choice for early learners.
count-and-bounce: Count and Bounce is a puzzle game built around a rolling ball. You steer it forward by pulling the ball along the path, and once you let go it keeps rolling on its own. Your job is to rotate the tiles so the ball stays on the track and doesn't tumble off. Some tiles display math problems, and you must pick the right one to bounce on, based on how many balls you currently hold.
Controls depend on your device. On a computer, slide the mouse to turn the tiles and guide the ball left or right. On a phone or tablet, touch the screen and drag left or right to do the same thing.
brawl-star-leon-rush: Brawl Star Leon Rush is a survival race game in which you guide a small Leon through a run that never stops. Your job is to time his jumps well and keep him moving. The journey takes him across several settings, including a sandy desert, a dark night, and a set of dungeons, and each one is full of hazards, obstacles, and enemies hiding along the way.

Your aim is to carry Leon as far as possible and build the highest score you can. Coins collected along the route can be spent on new skins, and those skins come with better abilities. On a computer, use a right mouse click to jump. On phones and tablets, simply tap the screen.
my-cute-puppy-grooming-3d: Step into a virtual pet game starring Louie, a charming pug who has earned his place as the newest royalty of virtual dogs. You can adopt him and enjoy a visit with him whenever you like, and he is sure to lift your mood. Louie does not talk. Instead, he shows his personality by sticking out his tongue and looking laid-back.

Chances to meet a pup quite like Louie are rare, so this game offers something special for pet lovers. On PC, click and drag with your mouse to organize items. On mobile, touch the screen and drag with your finger to do the same.
vehicle-driving-master: Vehicle Driving Master is a relaxed driving simulator for players who prefer patience to high speeds. Forget roaring engines, souped-up racers, and wild wrecks. Here you carefully guide large vehicles through confined spaces while working to avoid scrapes and collisions.

To play, you simply hold the steering control. Each move rewards thoughtful, deliberate driving rather than quick reactions, so take your time and enjoy the quiet satisfaction of a clean, well-judged maneuver. It suits anyone who likes slow, precise driving and enjoys working out a tricky route one small adjustment at a time.
supercars-parking-2023: SuperCars Parking 2023 is a racing game where you sharpen your parking skills in offline 3D driving scenes. You can also test your wilder driving moves in online car games, and completing a straightforward parking task unlocks hidden bonuses. Once you feel comfortable, switch to the simulator's Advanced Car Parking Mode to refine your parallel parking. Use a range of parking controls to guide your car into the garage. Online multiplayer auto parking matches offer several objectives on the way to becoming a skilled driver, and the arcade section lets you prove what you have learned. This free Prado parking game uses WASD to drive, and on mobile devices you can use the buttons shown in the game.
lucky-doll: In Lucky Doll, you put together characters in the look of Korean webtoons, with the goal of making a figure that you feel is the most adorable around. Then bring in extra characters of your own and scatter charming stickers across the screen to decorate each scene.

offroad-bus-simulator-games-3d: Love driving games? This one lets you practice real car handling and sharpen your skills with modified cars. wipe-insight-master: Wipe Insight Master is a free online drawing game aimed at boys. Your finger does the work here: you trace and outline the shapes of whatever pieces a picture is missing. space-prison-escape-2: The story picks up where the first game ended. hedge-maze: Hedge Maze is a one-player puzzle game in which you guide a ball to the blue square to complete each level. You don't choose a level from a list, and you only reach the finish by playing the game through to its end.

catsorter-puzzle: Cats have taken over the seats in this puzzle and are scattered all over the place. gun-strike-runner: Gun Strike Runner throws you into a rush of quick firefights where your weapons keep getting stronger. minicars-soccer: Minicars Soccer puts a fun twist on football by letting you drive tiny cars instead of running. You can pick from seven car models, and each one has its own speed and handling. You can also choose whether the ball is large, medium, or small, which changes how the game plays out.

bus-order-3d: Bus Order 3D is a matching puzzle with three modes to choose from. In the first, passengers must be guided to their own bus, sorted by color, and then sent off on a holiday. The cute design and the variety of challenges keep each mode fresh, and the aim is to complete every level. On PC, a mouse click controls the game, and on mobile, a tap on the screen does the same job.
tank-duel-3d: Tank Duel 3D is a 3D action game about tank battles. You can face a friend in two-player mode or take on the computer on your own. baby-taylor-messy-home-clean-up: Taylor has the house to herself for a while, and it is her favorite part of the day. super-soccer: Super Soccer is a sports game you can open right in your browser at no cost. It works on a computer, phone, or tablet, so you can play on whichever screen is nearby. The game is unblocked, which makes it a handy choice for playing at school or at home.

2020-realistic-tank-battle-simulation: This browser game lets you take control of tanks in a battle simulation that aims for realism. boxing-random: Boxing Random is a pixel-style sports game where every round brings a new twist. brickscape-breakout-adventure: Brickscape: Breakout Adventure is a brick breaker set in a colorful world built from glass bricks. Its core idea stays simple. You control a range of eye-catching balls, and each one changes as you play, shifting to match how well you are doing. stockings-dilemma: Stockings Dilemma is a puzzle game built around sorting. Your job is to organize a set of stockings worn on a girl's leg, grouping them by color and by pattern. The early levels feel easy, but the challenge grows steadily as you move up, asking for closer attention to every detail.

Everything is controlled with a mouse click or a tap, so the game works with either. It suits players who enjoy logic and matching, since each level asks you to spot the right matches and sort the pieces carefully. It is a neat, step-by-step test of your sorting skills.
easter-link: Easter Link is a puzzle game built around Mahjong-style linking. Your job is to pair up two identical blocks at a time. A connecting line between a matching pair may bend no more than twice. This version gives a fresh spin on the well-known tile game. As you link matching tiles, you race against a countdown. The question is whether you can empty the whole board before the timer hits zero.
Control is simple: use your mouse or touchpad to select and connect the tiles.
sprunky-game-mini-fun: Sprunky Game Mini Fun gathers a range of short games into one browser experience. You can work through puzzles, make personal touches with DIY customization, prepare meals while cooking, tidy up in cleaning rounds, and take part in hide-and-seek, along with many other light challenges. 5-minibattles: Five quirky minigames are packed into this title. Your tasks range from catching chickens and scoring goals to serving food to customers. Each game offers its own kind of fun. monster-soccer-3d: Monster Soccer 3D is a silly football game that can be played alone or with a friend. At the start, you pick whichever monster character appeals to you. slope-bike-2: Slope Bike 2 is the second version of Slope Bike, a quick, easy-to-pick-up racer in the arcade style. Its gameplay has been pared back to something simpler, and missions now appear alongside the daily login reward prompt. Your task in this Slope Rider title is to guide a bike and build speed as it rolls down slopes.

A new, minimal theme makes the motion feel more fluid, and this version brings new cities and new platforms into the series. It is a hypercasual, 3D game that also works on mobile. To steer left or right, press A or D, or use the left and right arrow keys.
dino-island-rampage: You play as a dinosaur hunter facing a steady stream of dinosaurs heading your way. Your goal is to shoot them down and keep yourself alive long enough to unlock new weapons. It is a single-player 3D action shooter, so every fight happens in full three dimensions.

The controls are easy to learn. Use W, A, S and D to move, and press the space bar to jump. Left mouse button fires your weapon, and the mouse wheel lets you switch between guns. Press R to reload, or P to pause the game whenever you need a moment.
slice-it-all: Slice It All is a 3D arcade game built around one idea: cutting everything in half. It is a casual title and a comfortable slicing experience, so there is no pressure to rush. Your task is to keep the knife floating in the air by clicking the screen or your mouse, and to stop it from dropping into the sea. Keep that up and you can complete the level.

Controls work the same way whether you tap the screen or click with a mouse. To begin, simply tap to play. Work through the level by keeping the blade airborne until it is finished, and enjoy the relaxed pace the game offers.
my-quarantine-glam-look: Four friends named Skyler, Sunny, Ruby and Violet are bored of staying home during quarantine. To pass the time, they decide to try some funny indoor fashion activities. You can join them and show off your skills.

Your job is to choose pink blush shades, eyeshadows, eye colors and lip colors for the girls. Everything is controlled with a simple left mouse click. Take your time and enjoy creating looks that suit each of them.
dollys-restaurant-organizing: Dolly's Restaurant Organizing is a tidy-up game designed to help you sort things out and let go of some stress. Through its Storage Master feature, you get fresh ideas for keeping items in order. Your aim is to pack everything away neatly and cleanly. You can sort objects by category, by the place where they belong, and by the order in which you clean them.

The game also aims to spark creative storage thinking that you can take into your own home. Much like a jigsaw puzzle, each step asks you to pick the right object and place it in the right spot. On a computer, use mouse clicks or drags to play. On mobile, use finger clicks or drags.
bazooka-hyper: Bazooka Hyper is a casual hypercasual game where you fire a bazooka at stickman enemies. Your goal is to send every stickman off to the pilgrimage without letting your HP drop to 0. You must keep moving and stay away from the stickmen while you work toward that goal. Your gun takes care of aiming and firing on its own, so your main job is positioning. Remember that a target only gets hit when it is within range.

Movement is handled with a slide joystick, and the weapon fires automatically. This 3D arcade battle game also carries the gun and clash tags, so expect plenty of combat. Stay mobile, keep an eye on your HP, and avoid getting too close to the stickmen.
wrestle-online: Wrestle Online is an action game where you hop upward in an effort to send your opponent down for the count. Choose single player, two player, or online multiplayer mode, and face off however you like.

Gather coins as you go to unlock fresh skins for your wrestler. To jump, press the W key or tap the screen. Whether you're battling a friend or a stranger online, this multiplayer title keeps things lively and entertaining, so it's easy to pick up and play.
blocky-swat-shooting-iceworld-multiplaye: Blocky Swat Shooting IceWorld Multiplayer puts you in matches with real players from around the world. The game offers nine guns, and each one can be fitted with twenty attachments. Its maps come in both high-quality block designs and pixelated styles, and the latest addition is an icy pixel world with striking visual effects.

Move with W, A, S and D, and use the mouse to aim, look around, shoot and change guns. Press Space to jump, Shift to run and Left Ctrl to go prone. Tab opens the menu, and Q lets you change your camo.
cuphead-halloween: Cuphead and Mugman Halloween is a classic run and gun action game with a strong focus on boss battles. Players move through a spooky adventure while running, jumping, and shooting their way forward. The Halloween setting gives the whole experience a seasonal flavor.

The game is controlled with a touch pad, so it works well on touch-friendly screens. It fits the arcade and adventure categories and suits anyone who enjoys fast, old-school action. Much of the challenge comes from the boss fights that await along the way.
monster-diy-create: Build a monster from scratch in this dress-up creator, starting with the face and working your way down to the toes. The game lets you pick from a range of trending characters, including Skibidii, Grimacee, and Poppi Playtime, and each one brings its own distinct look. Blend different features together to form a creature that is entirely yours. When you are happy with the result, you can send it to friends and let them see your monster-making skills. Keep an eye out for special parts that can only be found in this game.
Controls are simple: click with your mouse or tap the screen to make your selections and move through the menus.
pet-land-3d-game: This hypercasual 3D typhoon game drops you onto a new island. Your first task is to collect items and create your first pet. As you progress, you unlock more items and more pets to add to your island.

Fruit plays a key role here. Dragon fruit, for example, unlocks a new area, and you carry the matching items to the pet you are working toward. Upgrading lets your island expand, and more surprises are waiting for you to explore.
color-line: In Color Line, you take control of a colorful cube and guide it toward a destination. The road is not clear, so you need to keep an eye out for obstacles that can stand in the way. Filed under hypercasual, this HTML5 title is tagged with action and color.

Your goal is to bring the cube to its destination while steering around every obstacle on the path. Watch where you are heading, since the road can fill up with trouble quickly. It is a game built around movement and color.
crazy-car-impossible-stunt-challenge-gam: Crazy Car Impossible Stunt Challenge takes you through a series of levels, and each one is unique. It is a stunt driving game where you pilot a car through tricky tricks and manoeuvres. You will need solid driving skills and a firm grip on the steering to finish each stunt challenge before time runs out, all while avoiding obstacles along the way.

Control is simple: the arrow keys on your keyboard handle every move behind the wheel. Blending racing, simulation, and 3D graphics, it is a fit for players who like car stunts and driving challenges. Stay focused on the road and keep your timing sharp, since every level asks for a slightly different approach.
sports-car-wash-gas-station: Sports Car Wash Gas Station 3D is a free simulation game made for car enthusiasts. Its washing system takes some learning, but it gives you a different way to clean grimy vehicles. Dusty automobiles roll into a city car wash station, and working through them is where the enjoyment of car cleaning comes through. The 3D city car wash simulator offers a detailed washing service along with a parking zone.
Movement uses the W, A, S and D keys, while the mouse handles setting your parking. Fans of car wash driving games who want a different style may find this one a good fit.
draw-with-santa: Draw With Santa is a Christmas-themed tool for painting, drawing, and coloring, made with kids in mind. Choose a color, then move your mouse across the canvas to make your artwork. Children can let their imaginations lead and try out their own creative ideas. The game is calm and quiet, so it suits a relaxed session at the computer.

Each play brings the feel of the holiday season, with cheerful color and music that carry players into the world of Santa Claus and his friends. A single click or tap is all it takes to start drawing, so even the youngest players can get going right away. Settle in and enjoy the festive atmosphere while you create.
purple-penguin: In this single-player 3D arcade game, your job is to look after a purple penguin and help him survive as long as possible. He lives in a snowy setting, but dangerous orcas are lurking nearby, so you need to keep a close eye on them.

To protect your penguin, tap the orcas. The game sits in the hypercasual category and also carries casual, animal, fish, and snow themes, so its gameplay blends a light, approachable feel with a steady sense of threat.
my-perfect-organization: This relaxed casual title is a small set of mini games built around packing up a home. It includes ten separate puzzle types, and each one brings its own style of packing. Don't expect tricky riddles here. The focus stays on the simple enjoyment of solving each puzzle.
You set out to organize an entire house with your own hands, step by step, through a mix of organizing and sorting tasks. Controls are simple: click with a mouse or tap the screen to play.
bubble-pirates-mania: Bubble Pirates Mania is a bubble shooter puzzle game. You aim and fire colorful bubbles, and whenever three bubbles of the same color line up, they pop. It suits a quick break just as well as a longer session, so you can play for as long as you like.

Your goal is to pop the bubbles that contain coins. Collect those coins to reach the objective and win the game. Power-ups are there to help you along the way, so use them when you need an extra boost.
ambulance-escape-2026: Ambulance Escape 2026 puts you behind the wheel of an ambulance racing through busy streets at a quick pace. Your job is to weave past obstacles and steer clear of dangerous barriers so you can reach the hospital safely. Every challenging level puts your reactions and driving skills to the test.

This 2D arcade title is built for one player. Steering is simple: move your mouse or swipe left and right to guide the vehicle. Stay on the road, keep away from hazards, and make it to the finish line safely to clear each stage.
monkey-mart-game: Monkey Mart is a relaxed idle and management title from TinyDobbins. The player runs a small supermarket owned by an adorable monkey. Your job is to grow fruit, then walk from one station to another to keep the shelves stocked with bananas, corn, and other goods. Shoppers collect what they need and queue up at the checkout counter. As you earn, you can make your monkey stronger or faster, open new work areas, and hire helpers to share the load. Move around with the WASD keys or the arrow keys.
mahjong-solitaire-game: Mahjong Solitaire is a tile-matching puzzle that borrows its ideas from traditional Mahjong. Your goal is to link and remove identical tiles from a board built of stacked Mahjong tiles. Every move has to follow the game's rules, and you win by matching and clearing every pair of identical tiles until the board is empty.

Planning ahead matters, because the order in which you clear tiles can decide whether a level is solved. The game tests your skills and rewards careful strategy as you work through each level. The controls are simple: just tap to play.
santa-fiity-special: Santa Fiity Special is a soccer game built around Santa's skills. You score goals, hit targets, and face off against a Grinch. If you would rather compete with a friend, you can challenge them to a round of soccer tic tac toe.
Kicking works by swiping, so every shot comes from a simple gesture. The holiday theme and the focus on skill make it a fitting choice for two players who enjoy a seasonal challenge.
baby-taylor-eye-care: Taylor often plays with her pet dog, Oreo. During one of their play sessions, sand gets into her eyes. Taylor ignores the little accident and rubs at them anyway, but the next day her eyes feel even more uncomfortable. It is up to you to take Taylor to the hospital so the doctor can treat her eyes.

Controls are simple: a mouse click or a tap is all you need. The game sits in the Girls category and is tagged with animal, baby, cute, doctor, educational, and kids, so it is aimed at young players who enjoy caring for pets and learning about eye care. Have a good time helping Taylor feel better.
merge-hit-weapons: Merge Hit Weapons is a clicker built around throwing knives. Your goal is to combine weapons so that new ones appear, and these stronger blades help you take down the evil planets. Watch your ammo closely, since running dry is an easy way to lose. The game is tough and hard to put down, and it spans multiple levels with weapon upgrades along the way.
Everything is controlled with your mouse, so you can start throwing right away. It is filed under the weapons tag, which suits the focus on arming yourself with stronger gear as you progress.
pizza-challenge: For anyone who adores pizza and refuses to share it, this funny hypercasual cooking game turns dinner into a race. Pizzas arrive at your table one after another, and you and a rival try to grab their slices before the other person does. To snatch a slice, aim for its center. The first player to collect five slices from each pizza claims victory. You can compete against a friend or against the computer.

Player 1 presses the W key, while Player 2 uses the Up Arrow key. Touch-screen devices are supported too, so you can play on a phone or tablet. It is a fun pick for boys and girls who enjoy a lighthearted kitchen challenge.
princess-candy-makeup-game: Princess Candy Makeup is a styling game about learning how to put looks together. This version introduces a fresh idea built around sweets. Candies, ice cream, cakes, chocolate, and lollipops all appear as items you can use in surprising ways. Some become accessories for outfits, while others serve as hairstyle pieces, makeup details, or jewelry.

Playing is easy: use your mouse or tap the screen to make each choice. Mix and match the sugary items however you like, and let your imagination guide the final design. Every style you build can be as playful or as unusual as you wish.
pinny-go-home: Pinny Go Home is a 2D physics puzzle adventure starring an adorable penguin stuck within an enormous bubble of water. Your job is to guide it back to its frozen homeland. You fire small bubbles to build up force, which lets you steer where Pinny heads. Watch out for hazardous obstacles along the way, and look for underwater currents that can carry you forward if you use them well.
Challenging levels reward players who find the perfect angle and timing for each shot. Everything is controlled with the mouse.
home-car-builder: Home Car Builder is a simulation game in which you create your ideal vehicle starting from nothing. You can plan, put together, and tweak cars until they look and perform just right. A range of parts, engines, and accessories is available, so you can build rides that match your own taste and preferences. The game tests your engineering know-how while giving your imagination plenty of room to work.
Everything is controlled with a mouse click or a tap on the screen. Assemble your car, customize it, and then take it for a drive to see what you have made.
supercars-stunt-ramp: Take the wheel of new supercars built for stunt ramps and drive them across tracks that seem almost impossible to finish. Every turn and jump asks for careful control. This crazy-paced stunt driving simulator aims to give you a close look at impossible car track driving, with plenty of danger at every stage.

You play as a stunt driver tackling tricky Supercars stunt ramp tracks. Steer with the W, A, S and D keys, or use the arrow keys if you prefer. Stay focused, study each course, and keep your car under control as the challenges get harder.
shadow-fighters-hero-duel: Shadow Fighters Hero Duel throws you into a series of nonstop brawls between shadowy stick figures. Your job is to land punches and kicks at the right moments and wear down your rival. Once your special strike meter fills up, you can unleash a fiery blow on your opponent. The game supports both solo play against the computer and two-player matches on one keyboard.

Player 1 moves with W, A, S, and D, throws a punch with F, kicks with G, and fires the special hit with R. Player 2 uses the arrow keys to move, L to punch, K to kick, and O for the special hit. Each fighter has its own set of keys, so two friends can face off side by side.
paint-over-the-lines: Painting every line in this game takes more focus than it first appears. The number of runners and the shape of the paths both keep shifting, so you have to stay alert to keep everything on track. Each tiny figure follows only its own route and leaves a trail in its assigned color. Your job is to cover every line with paint while steering clear of any collisions between runners.

This 3D arcade title is built for casual play in the browser and is controlled with a mouse click or a tap. There is nothing complicated to learn, but the changing layout rewards careful timing. Watch the paths closely and act with patience to finish painting without any collisions.
football-brawl: Football Brawl turns the pitch into a rough-and-tumble arena where you write your own sporting story. Step onto the field and knock your rival off balance with a range of strong kicks, while playful, offbeat powerups add surprises to the action. When you want to make a point, the emotes system lets you show your opponent who is in charge.

Controls are simple. Use the arrow keys to move sideways and jump, and press the ball buttons to perform different kicks. Score more goals within the time limit to win the match. As you win, you climb through the divisions and unlock every reward. Random match powerups and player emotes are available during play.
valentine-5-diffs: Valentine 5 Diffs is a puzzle game built around the familiar spot-the-difference idea. It offers fifteen levels, each showing a pair of charming romantic portraits that look nearly identical at first glance. Your job is to study both pictures and find where they don't match.

To play, simply tap the spot where you notice a difference between the two images. It is an arcade-style title that works on mobile devices and runs in the browser through HTML5, making it a fit for kids too.
run-santa-claus-run: On Christmas Eve, Santa's sleigh has gone out of control and scattered presents across the city streets. Your task is to guide him along and gather as many of those gifts as you can while dodging traffic and trash. The game grows harder as it goes, with faster speeds and more hazards to watch for.

Controls couldn't be simpler: a single click or tap is all you need to play. Keep your timing sharp, since getting hit by traffic or trash is the thing to avoid. This racing game has a holiday theme, arcade-style jumping, and a cheerful design that the whole family can enjoy.
shapes-game: Shapes Game is a learning title for children who want to explore geometric figures. It runs on mobile phones, tablets, and desktop computers, so kids can play on whatever device they have. Players move through a bright, multicolored world packed with puzzles, challenges, and activities that test how well they can recognize shapes.

The visuals are eye-catching, and the gameplay is easy for young players to pick up. Players are asked to find a particular shape, and they do this by clicking the images that match the one requested. Along the way, kids build a stronger understanding of core math ideas while having fun.
drag-racing-club: You start as an unknown outsider on the drag racing scene and work your way up through the city's street races. Your goal is to prove you are the best driver in town. Along the way, you buy or win cars from your opponents, then tune them into powerful racing machines.

To win races, shift gears and fire your nitro boost at the right moments. Aim to shift when the indicator sits in the green zone. If you struggle to win, upgrade your car to give yourself a better chance.
driving-service-passenger-bus-transport: This driving simulator puts you in the seat of a bus. Your job is to pick up passengers waiting at different stations, then carry them from one town to another until they reach their destinations. Each trip gives you a feel for handling a large vehicle, so you can test your driving skills on every route you take.

Movement is handled with the W, A, S, and D keys, which steer and drive the bus. The game sits in the racing category and is built with Unity3D for WebGL, so it runs directly in your browser. Take your time with each passenger run and enjoy the chance to try out a bus from behind the wheel.
stickman-counter-terror-shooter: Blue SWAT stickmen and red terror stickmen face off in a shooting battle. You take on the role of an elite stickman shooter and fight from a first-person view. Pick from an M16, a shogun, an AK47, or a machine gun, and keep a pistol ready to strike the enemy team where it hurts.

Controls are flexible: WASD lets you strafe and move, while the arrow keys move and rotate your view. Use the mouse to aim and fire, or press SPACE to shoot, and F to throw a grenade. P pauses the action, and T switches mobile controls on or off. Best of all, the whole game runs offline, so you don't need an internet connection.
my-baby-unicorn-virtual-pony-pet: You receive a unicorn baby as a gift in this virtual pet game, which is meant for kids and toddlers of any gender. You start by hatching a brightly colored egg, and out comes a newborn unicorn with rainbow hair. Then you care for your tiny companion by bathing and feeding it, potty training it, dressing it up, and singing it to sleep. You can also play games with your pet.

Your unicorn's room is yours to decorate in rainbow colors. The game is designed to be played every day, so you can watch your pony pet grow over time. To play, simply use your mouse or tap the screen.
hard-wheels-winter: Take the wheel of a massive monster truck and face a wide range of demanding obstacles in Hard Wheels Winter. Your rig is heavy, so keeping it balanced is a constant challenge as you drive over snowy mountains and pass other cars.

On a computer, you steer with the arrow keys or with W, A, S and D. On a phone or tablet, on-screen buttons handle the driving. This racing game runs in the browser using HTML5 and is also listed for Android, so it works for both desktop and mobile players.
street-food-deep-fried: Saturday or Sunday, it doesn't matter: this game is about heading out with friends to hunt for the tastiest fried snacks on the street. Several fast food stalls are open, and queues stretch out in front of them while customers wait for their orders. On the menu you'll find fried onion blossoms, corn crisps, French fries, chicken popcorn, and the well-known corn dog. If you fancy trying these tempting street treats, you can jump in right away. Controls are simple: just click or tap with your mouse or finger to play.
my-mini-car-service: My Mini Car Service is a 3D arcade game for one player who loves cars. You run your own garage, where you repair vehicles, fix their engines, apply paint jobs, and add modification options that make each car unique.

Your journey begins as an apprentice, and you work your way up to master. Collect coins to unlock levels. As you unlock them, place the boxes in their proper spots and direct materials to the vehicles. Each vehicle needs different materials, so you must supply every one with what it requires.
mini-games-brainy-prank: Mini Games Brainy Prank brings together a set of light, casual mini-games wrapped in adorable cartoon art. Each one offers a new kind of challenge, so you never quite know which task is waiting around the corner. Themed levels let you wander through different settings while you work out clever solutions to each problem.

The whole collection is built around puzzles that test your thinking in a relaxed way. Brain-teasers and tricky setups appear throughout, yet the controls stay simple and the ideas are easy to pick up. Anyone who likes creative thinking and laid-back play should find plenty to enjoy. To get started, click and drag to play.
flying-car-ayn: Enjoy driving supercars in Flying Car Ayn, where you can take to the air above a modern city. Good driving skills matter here, so stay alert behind the wheel. If your attention wanders, your car will drop into the void.

The game includes 15 flying cars and 36 stunt areas to explore. It also has a system for acquiring and developing vehicles. After each race, you can upgrade or customize your car or buy a new one. Press N for a Nitro boost when you need extra speed. Steer with the arrow keys or WASD, switch camera views with C, and use Space for the handbrake. Reaching the finish line is no easy task.
sailor-moon-character-creator: Many young girls dream of having powers and fighting evil for justice and love. Sailor Moon stands out as a heroine who is both beautiful and strong. In this character creator, you can recreate her along with her friends Sailor Mercury, Mars, Venus and Jupiter, then design your own lovely Sailor Moon.

The game is played with a mouse click or a tap. It has a cute, cartoon feel and fits the girls, dress-up and makeover themes, so it suits kids who enjoy playful styling. Fans of the series will find it a charming way to shape the look of these heroines.
blow-kings-game: Blow Kings puts you in a lively contest where every challenger arrives eager to take the top spot. Once the match begins, your attention stays locked on winning, so stay focused from the first moment. Success depends on controlling your breath: push a stronger puff of air into the glass tube than the player you face and you move ahead. The number of rivals you can defeat is up to you to find out, and the crown of the blowing champion could be yours.
This 3D title mixes hypercasual simplicity with puzzle thinking and a war-style rivalry, and it is listed under the boys category. You control everything with a mouse click or a tap on your screen.
princess-pet-beauty-salon: Princess Pet Beauty Salon casts you as a senior designer at a fashion salon. Your job is to create fresh looks for celebrities from both home and abroad. Three princesses are among your clients, and you will also style each of their pets. The animals have just returned from a trip and look rather untidy, so it is up to you to transform them with your refined talent until they look brand new again.

The controls are simple. On a computer, click or drag with the mouse to give the characters a makeover. On a phone or tablet, tap or drag with your finger to do the same. The actions are identical whether you are working on a princess or her pet, so you can focus on the styling itself.
stunt-santa: It is Christmas Eve, and Santa's sled has slipped out of control, sending gifts tumbling across the streets. Your task is to help him gather as many presents as possible. Each level is only finished once every gift has been collected, so keep chasing the parcels until the streets are clear.
Playing takes just one tap or click, so you can start right away. This racing title also falls under arcade, and its tags point to Christmas, decorations, flying, and family fun. It is a fest
zoo-elephant-simulator-city-attack: Take on the role of a wild elephant roaming through both jungles and city streets. You can cover large open areas, look after a growing elephant family, fight off dangerous predators, and finish missions full of nonstop action in this lifelike animal simulation. The game offers three modes, Jungle, City, and Free Mode, so there is always something new to try.

On desktop, move with the W, A, S, and D keys and steer the camera with the mouse. Press E to attack, hold Shift to sprint, and press F to perform actions, though the mouse can also be used for actions. Press P to pause and Ctrl to open settings. On mobile, a joystick moves your elephant, and you drag the screen to rotate the camera.
princess-easter-sunday: Easter is the most anticipated celebration of spring, and this browser game is built around it. A group of princesses is getting ready for a set of holiday activities, including decorating their Easter eggs. Your job is to step in and choose the outfits and egg decorations that suit them.

Every action is carried out with a left mouse click. The title sits in the Girls category and carries tags such as casual, dress up, fashion, decoration, Easter, and kids. It is an HTML5 game, so it runs directly in your browser.
snake-run: Snake Run is a 3D arcade title where you steer a snake toward the finish. A rival that is longer than you is a hazard, so think carefully before you head toward one. Scattered obstacles and other snakes make the route tricky, and you must dodge them as you go. Other snakes you meet along the way can be devoured, which stretches out your run and helps you move past the current level.
my-stylish-ball-gown: In My Stylish Ball Gown, you help three best friends, Dee dee, Willow, and Noah, get ready for a planned get-together. The party is a stylish ball gown event, so every outfit matters. Your job is to pick the perfect gown and costumes for the girls to wear.

Only a left mouse button click is needed to play, so the game is easy to pick up. Browse the choices, mix and match, and see how each look comes together. It is a fun dress-up title for girls who enjoy fashion and styling.
extreme-car-parking-3d: This 3D driving game puts your car on elevated courses where a single slip could send you off the track. You cross narrow platforms, climb steep ramps, and weave past barriers, all while aiming to park with precision. Each run tests how well you can keep control at height.
