Drive and steer with the WASD keys or the Arrow keys, and tap Space to brake. Take each obstacle slowly and watch your position closely. Once you reach the end, bring the car to a complete stop fully inside the marked parking zone.
unicorn-slime-maker: Learn how to whip up slime by following a few simple, easy steps. First, you head to the supermarket and pick up everything you need for the recipe. Once your slime is ready, you can relax by stretching, squishing, and poking it right on your device. It is a calming way to let go of stress, and the poking part is especially satisfying.

Controls are simple: use your mouse or tap the screen to play. Whether you are gathering ingredients or working with the finished slime, every action is handled with a click or a tap. The game is designed for girls and works well on mobile, so you can enjoy it wherever you are.
messy-little-mermaid-makeover: The little mermaid princess has become a grubby mess, and it's up to you to restore her to a lovely, dignified royal look. Your first job is to give her a proper bath so she is clean again. Next, you'll comb out her hair so it looks neat and smooth. Finally, she needs fresh clothes to change into.
santas-mission: Santa needs help getting his presents wrapped before Christmas arrives. Every stage gives you a checklist of items to gather, such as Santa hats, candy canes, and gifts. Line up three or more matching pieces to collect the amount shown and move on to the next stage. The clock keeps ticking, so you'll need to work quickly to grab everything on the list before time runs out.
Control the action with your mouse or your fingers. Nothing else is needed to get started, so you can jump right into the festive puzzle.
brainstorming-2d: Brainstorming 2D is a sliding puzzle game. Each slider puzzle shows a grid with colored borders, and small squares sit inside those borders. Every square matches the color of the edges that enclose it. The number of colors can differ from one puzzle to the next.
Your goal is to clear every block that is trapped within the grid's edges. You move by sliding, so plan each slide carefully. Keep going until no blocks remain locked inside the borders.
growball-feed-to-grow: In this action game built around a black hole theme, you guide a hungry slime through space. The slime's mouth works like a black hole, pulling in and swallowing anything smaller than it. Each item you manage to eat makes your slime bigger, and the bigger it gets, the harder the challenge becomes.

The game features bright, colourful visuals and gameplay that is hard to put down, taking you on a voyage through a cosmos built around eating. It is a single-player experience that runs in HTML5 and can be enjoyed on Android, iPh
subway-bunny-run-rush-rabbit-runner-game: This is a straightforward running adventure with easy-to-learn controls. You play a mischievous little rabbit gathering as many carrots as it can before Easter. The route runs through a deep city packed with obstacles, so you have to keep your footing as you dash along. The bunny starts running the moment the game begins.

Your job is to grab as many carrots as possible while steering clear of rocks, blockers and hurdles, because touching any of them ends the game. Use W to move up, S to move down, D to move left and A to move right. It's a quick, simple game that's easy to pick up and hard to put down.
bull-shooting: Step into a wild bullfighting world with this shooter that is very hard to put down. Bulls have gone on a rampage through the city streets, and fear has spread across the town. The only way to restore peace is to aim carefully and shoot each raging animal in the head. The game equips you with the latest sniper gun to take down the angry bulls one by one.
Move with the W, A, S and D keys, and hold Shift to run. Use the mouse to shoot. Work through the bulls in turn until the streets are calm once more.
baking-cooking-fun: Baking Cooking Fun invites you to make treats one step at a time. The game guides you with gesture, arrow, and icon prompts, so you always know what to do next. You can try a range of tools as you prepare your food, and mixing different ingredients gives your creations new flavors and colors.

When your dessert is ready, decorate it with sprinkles, candies, fruit, straws, balloons, and more. Tasting your sweets sets off rainbow and shooting star effects. On a desktop, click and drag with your mouse. On a phone or tablet, tap and slide.
baby-happy-cleaning: A doll has become very grimy, and it's up to you to scrub it back to shape. You work through a creative cleaning process, step by step, until the doll looks better than new. Once it's spotless, you move on to the other messes waiting nearby, including smelly clothes, grubby dirt bikes, and cluttered kitchens.

Everything is controlled with a mouse or by tapping the screen, so you can start cleaning right away. The game sits in the girls' section and has a light educational side, along with decorating and animal-themed touches. Each mess you tackle is another chance to tidy up in a cheerful way and show what a happy cleaning hero can do.
pets-adventure-a-day-to-remember: Five pals, Midge, Polly, Doug, Cooper, and Luca, each have their own mission in this pet-themed title. Midge wants a glamorous makeover, Polly prepares for Coronation Couture, Doug cleans up mud, Cooper heals wounds, and Luca heads off on an adventure involving dress-up. Along the way things get messy, goofy, and full of giggles as the group chases joy side by side.

You move around and finish tasks with a left mouse click. The game works on both phones and computers, so you can play on whichever device you like. Expect plenty of laughs as you follow these critters
crazy-obstacle-blitz-2-going-ball-3d: Crazy Obstacle Blitz 2 - Going Ball 3D is an arcade game where you guide a ball along a three-dimensional track full of hazards. The controls stay straightforward, and a single click is all it takes to begin. Your task is to keep the ball rolling forward while weaving past barriers. Steer it left and right to stay clear, and roll onto the acceleration belt when you want an extra burst of speed.

The 3D scenery and visual effects look striking, and there is no time limit to worry about. Crazy speeds, several ball skins to choose from, and a relaxing way to unwind add variety. Challenges put your quick reactions to the test, and hitting any obstacle ends the run. Fans of adrenaline-fueled, ultra-casual games will feel at home, and the game also helps sharpen coordination and reflexes along the way.
ice-cream-puzzles: In this puzzle game, your job is to push ice cream blocks across the board until each one meets its matching twin, which makes both disappear. Try to clear each stage using the fewest moves you can manage. Every block you remove earns 100 points, but each extra slide on the same block costs you 10 points.
Clear every block on the screen to finish a level, and work through the 24 tricky stages on offer. You can play with a touch screen or a mouse, so either one works fine.
car-wash-garage-service-workshop: Car Wash Garage Service Workshop is a 3D parking and driving simulator, despite what its name might suggest. Your job is to carry passengers to their stops before the time runs out. Stay away from muddy tracks along the way and you can keep moving riders and collecting money. If your vehicle gets grimy, pull into the garage, where a wash costs 600 dollars.
Control everything with the WASD keys. The game runs in the browser and is built with WebGL, so it works on mobile devices as well.
run-santa-run: Santa is the hero of this Christmas adventure, and his night has taken a bad turn. After a mishap, he tumbled out of his sleigh and the reindeer have bolted. Now it is up to Santa to rescue the gifts and still bring joy to children in every corner of the globe. Your job is to gather presents along the way so they can be delivered to kids all over the world.

Controls are simple. You can tap the screen to play, or press the left and right arrow keys to steer Santa in either direction. It is a collecting game at heart, with a festive holiday theme that fits the season.
santa-ball-fill-3d: Santa Ball Fill 3D is an arcade game that feels brand new, yet its idea is simple enough to grasp right away. Your role is to help Santa get twisted eggs into a bottle, a task that is original and still offers a real challenge. Its 3D presentation gives the holiday setting a lively look, and it sits in the casual and fun corner of the arcade genre.

Everything in the game is handled with the mouse, so there are no extra controls to memorize. The title is tagged for kids and for boys, which suggests it suits younger players who enjoy quick, light challenges. Whether you are a casual gamer or simply want a cheerful way to pass a few minutes, this one provides a playful holiday experience.
hearts-blocks-collapse: Clicking a heart clears it from the board, but only when at least one heart of the same color sits next to it, either horizontally or vertically. Look ahead before each move, since careful planning lets you remove as many hearts as possible from every level. The Projection box shows how much each removal is worth, so you can judge which choice pays off most.

Every level has a Target amount. Reach or pass it to move on to the next level. If you fall short, that's fine, because you can retry the level as often as you like and test a new approach. Matching colored hearts takes a bit of thought, and each attempt gives you another chance to improve.
shoot-the-guy: Shoot the Guy is a weapon aiming game where precision is everything. It is a single-player title in the Adventure category, with tags for killing and shooting. The one rule is to avoid wasting your chance, so every shot matters. Your goal is to land a perfect headshot on the racist guy, and hitting it earns you power shots.
Controls are simple. Touch the screen to adjust your weapon's aim, then lift your finger to fire.
jewel-christmas-story: Christmas is almost here, and this match-3 puzzler brings the festive season to your screen with plenty of presents and treats. Line up at least three identical items to score. Each mission has a goal you must reach, so you will need to think quickly and plan your moves. Chain matches together to build combos and gather game currency along the way.

Boosters give you a helping hand when a level gets tricky. You can spend the currency you collect on new boosters in the shop or try your luck with a loot box. As you complete missions, new paths open up so you can keep moving forward through the story.
indygirl-and-the-golden-skull: Meet Indygirl, a young adventurer who loves hunting for buried riches and taking on new challenges. This time she has tracked down the Golden Skull and needs your help digging her way into a cave. Her mission is to gather every jewel and pile of gold hidden inside, including the golden pieces, diamonds, and jewelry scattered across each level.

Danger lurks along the way, but it does not show up equally on every level, so stay alert. Keep your focus on the gold and keep moving swiftly, because a huge boulder is rolling close behind her. Controls are simple: click to make Indygirl jump. This is a single-player clicker game.
athletics-hero: Pick your athlete and take on three track and field events: the 100m sprint, the javelin throw, and the triple jump. Your job is to hit the on-screen prompts at the right moment so your moves land cleanly. For the throw and the jump, hold to charge the power bar, then let go when it is full, but be careful not to overdo it. Can you claim a gold medal in every event? You can play with a touch screen, a mouse, the arrow keys, or WASD, whichever suits you best.
baby-taylor-ballet-injury-treatment: Taylor loves her weekly ballet lessons and counts them among her favorite things. As usual, her mother sent her off to study today. During practice, though, Taylor fell and hurt herself, and now she needs care.

Your job is to become the doctor and cure Taylor's injury. Everything is controlled with a mouse click or a tap, so you can start right away. The game also gives you a chance to see whether you have what it takes to be a qualified doctor.
city-parking-master-3d: City Parking Master 3D tests your precision behind the wheel across a series of city parking missions. You weave past traffic cones, steer through tight corners, and work your way through busy parking areas. Each mission ends when you bring the car to a stop inside the marked space, and you have to get there without crashing.

Drive and steer with WASD or the Arrow keys, and press Space to brake. Follow the parking guides and make sure the entire vehicle sits inside the highlighted bay. It's a 3D racing game filed under car, driving and parking titles.
age-of-quest: Relentless hordes of monsters and skeletons are laying siege to your castle in Age of Quest. You fight with a sword, draw on powerful magic, and rely on strong super frames as you work to defend your stronghold by any means necessary. Each creature you defeat rewards you with coins, gems, and ammunition that help you grow your powers.
Movement uses W, A, S, and D, while the left mouse button fires. Press Q or click the right mouse button to change weapons. Test your skills and see how well you can hold back the assault.
super-racing-go-go-go: Super Racing Go Go Go delivers an authentic, next-generation driving feel. You can go for pure racing, slide through turns in drift runs, or simply tear across the asphalt. Tune your car to suit whichever style you enjoy most.

The controls are easy to pick up. A left click steers the car left, a right click steers it right, and the up key speeds you up. Use the down key to stop the car. The game is tagged under Racing, Driving, Sports, and .io, so it suits fans of several kinds of driving.
cooking-fever-restaurant-game: Cooking Fever is a recent restaurant cooking game that blends time management with strategy and simulation. You build your kitchen skills by making tasty burgers and toast, working toward the title of master chef. Customers want burgers, toasts and fries, so you prepare their orders while aiming to win every level.

The game offers 150 challenging levels, cute graphics, and satisfying animations and effects. Two different restaurants give you places to cook. You can play with a mouse or by tapping the screen, whichever you prefer.
baby-taylor-learns-dining-manners: Baby Taylor enjoys sharing her meals with friends, but she can be very fussy about what she eats. Sometimes her pickiness goes so far that it becomes rude. At home, she also tends to forget how to behave at the table. Your job is to guide her through proper dining etiquette so she grows into a well-mannered young girl.
The game is played with a mouse click or a tap. Just click or tap to move through the activities and help Taylor along the way. It is a fun, kid-friendly way to learn good table habits.
nuts-and-bolts-screw-puzzle: Nuts and Bolts: Screw Puzzle asks you to clear a board by relocating its bolts into empty bolt holes. Each board comes off the playing area once its bolts are gone, and the round ends when every board has been removed. To move a bolt, tap it to select it, then tap the open hole you want it to go into. If you get stuck and no board can be freed, your task is to take things apart in a different order so the game can still be completed. Play is controlled with mouse clicks or taps.
ultimate-assassination: Set in a luxurious kingdom, this hypercasual game challenges you to destroy the king and take his place as the new ruler. Once you become king, you must stay watchful, because traitors may be waiting for their chance to strike. Explore the various possible scenarios the game offers and experience each one as you master the art of deception.

On PC, click to murder the king or to defend against traitor attacks. On mobile, tap the screen to do the same. Every move depends on careful planning and sneaky thinking, so the more cleverly you act, the closer you get to dethroning the king and beginning your own journey of deception.
catch-the-thief-3d-game: Catch The Thief 3D is a third-person action arcade game built on a 3D game engine. You are hired to catch every thief before time runs out, so each round is played against a limited clock. The game offers thirty levels to take on.
You can also unlock more skins for your character, such as a Hulk look. The controls are simple: hold, then drag. It is a fast-paced chase through a 3D world for anyone who likes arcade action.
knife-run-game: Knife Run is a quick-moving runner in the Adventure category. You steer a character through a series of levels, picking up knives as you go and putting them to use. Dodge obstacles, pick the right moment for each move, and push through the challenges until you cross the finish line. Keep your attention on the track, keep your character moving smoothly, and clear every level.
Controls are simple: click or tap with your mouse to play. The game is tagged as fun, funny, hypercasual, and best games, so it suits short sessions when you want something light and running-focused.
car-drive-city: Car Drive City puts you behind the wheel in a busy urban setting where traffic is part of the challenge. Unlike many racing titles, it lets you customize and upgrade your car. As you weave through the streets, you earn points by pulling away from a stop faster than usual or by passing other vehicles at closer range than usual.

Driving here has rarely felt this engaging. Use the WASD keys to pilot your supercar and settle into the rhythm of the city roads. The drive has no fixed end, so you can keep going for as long as you like, and the experience is quite different from a typical racing game.
offroad-snow-jeep-passenger-mountain-uph: Take the wheel of a jeep in this 3D racing game set on snowy mountain roads, where your job is to transport passengers. The title is presented as an offroad adventure that blends driving with action and adventure elements. It runs in the browser using HTML5 and WebGL, so the snowy scenery appears in three dimensions.

Controls are simple: use the W, A, S and D keys to drive, and press the Space bar to brake. The game is described as full of fun, with a steady mix of action and adventure. Whether you are heading uphill or coming back down, the drive is meant to stay lively from start to finish.
kuromi-maker: Kuromi is a mischievous bunny villain who has charmed anime fans with her sweet look and sneaky personality. As the antagonist of the series Onegai My Melody, she has inspired a kuromikor style, and merchandise featuring her has become a bestseller. Her creators gave her a full set of wicked accessories, including a black Joker-style cape with a pink skull print and a devil tail. Her birthday falls on October 31, the eve of Halloween.
In this game you design your own Kuromi bunny with the builder. A wide selection of outfits suits every kind of occasion,
off-road-bus-transport-driver-tourist-co: Take the wheel of a high-efficiency bus built like a 4x4 mountain climber and head up steep slopes off the beaten track. Real traffic and a passenger AI system add a sense of realism as you carry travelers along rough mountain roads. You can switch between several camera views and choose the one that suits you, simply by dragging with one finger.

Crossing rugged off-road paths is hard enough, but parking the coach precisely there is trickier still, and the game includes a full bus parking simulation to practice it. Levels grow more demanding step by step, and a driving guide at the start helps newcomers learn the basics. The game is designed so players with many different skill levels can enjoy it. Steer with the keyboard arrow keys.
impossible-moto-bike-track-stunts: Impossible Moto Bike Track Stunts asks you to rely on real motorbike stunt driving skills. Its ramp bike action is packed with addictive fun, and the whole experience takes place on an impossible track in a sky road environment that makes every run feel different.
Controls are simple: W, A, S and D drive the bike, Space brakes, and C switches the camera. It is a 3D racing game, tagged with Driving, HTML5, Simulator and WebGL, so it s
mr-dracula: Mr Dracula combines puzzle solving with shooting in a spooky Halloween setting. Physics shape how your shots behave as you work through each stage. This 2D title is made for mobile devices, and it includes weapons to help you clear every challenge.
The game offers 50 levels, and each one is designed to be challenging. The graphics are beautiful and add to the eerie mood from start to finish. To shoot, just tap the screen.
birthday-cake-for-my-boyfriend: Zoe wants to surprise her boyfriend Kris, whose birthday is the next day, by baking him a tiramisu. Your job is to guide her through each stage of making the dessert, following the steps in order. Once the cake is finished, you can turn to the room and add decorations so it feels ready for the celebration.

The game is played with a mouse or by tapping on a touchscreen. Simply click or tap to move through the activities. It sits in the cooking, decorating, design and simulation categories, and it is listed under Girls and Kids for players who enjoy kitchen and style themed play.
dino-squad-adventure-2: This sequel picks up right where the first Dino Squad game left off. A new dinosaur has joined the team, and you can switch to this newcomer with the character switch key to use its skills. Your goal is to complete each level by fighting bad dinosaurs and dealing with traps. A level is only finished once you have collected all of its gold.

Two players can play together. Player 1 moves with W, A, S and D, shoots with F, drops bombs with G, and switches characters with Q. Player 2 moves with the arrow keys, punches with L, and switches characters with U. To wall jump, press the jump key while you are hanging on a wall.
drifty-race-online: Drifty Race Online puts you behind the wheel of a car in a stunt-style racing game built on a three-dimensional engine. Rather than managing how fast you go, your attention goes to nailing the moment to slide through each bend, since acceleration takes care of itself. The core challenge is about rhythm and precision in your drifts.
Controls are straightforward: a tap turns the car at each curve you reach. Whenever you want a calm break, this title offers a low-pressure way to unwind with a bit of skill involved.
fashion-dye-pro: Fashion Dye Pro is a playful DIY game about making shirts. Stay on top of the season's popular looks by tie-dyeing summer clothing and beach accessories. Show off your creative side by customizing tie-dye outfits to suit your taste. Customers send requests, and you can paint garments however you wish. The basic method is simple: tie the fabric first, then dye it. Let your inner crafter loose and leave the rest to the colors.
Playing is easy, since a mouse click or a tap is all it takes to move through the game.
royal-smash-puzzle-game: Royal Smash Puzzle Game asks you to line up colorful pieces, break them apart, and merge them together as you work through a series of tough stages. Every level has its own goals, so you will need to think ahead and choose each move with care. Your aim is to clear the board and build a strong score along the way.

The controls are kept simple, and the mouse is all you need: click any button to move through the game. The levels grow harder as you progress, which makes it suitable for players of every age. Each stage brings satisfying puzzle mechanics and new objectives to complete, so you can keep track of how far you
slap-bridge-race: Slap Bridge Race is a popular arcade game that suits players of every age. You start by sprinting hard to grow bigger, then slap everyone waiting inside the door. You can only move on to the next level after you have slapped all of your opponents.
Various levels await as you progress. Controls are simple: tap to play. The game sits in the Puzzles category and carries tags such as Bridge, Kids, Mobile, Platform, Race, Skill and Unity3D.
princess-doll-house-design: The princess has just received a brand-new dollhouse and needs someone with a good eye to make it feel like home. You take on the role of her chief designer, so the job of decorating each room falls to you. Her wishes guide every choice, and you shape the space around what she hopes to see.

The house includes bedrooms, a living room, a garden, a kitchen, and more areas to furnish. Your aim is a tidy, lovely home where every corner looks inviting. This 2D girls game runs in your browser as an HTML5 title, and you control everything by clicking or tapping the screen.
fun-golf: Fun Golf asks you to send a golf ball into the holes spread across several floors. Watch out, because some obstacles can knock the ball out of play. You aim and shoot with a mouse click or a tap.

The game works well as a light puzzle for kids and anyone who enjoys a bit of logic. Each shot needs a little thought about angles and where the ball will land, so it stays playful without being hard to pick up.
traffic-race-motor: Hop onto a motorbike and weave through busy roads in this action racer. Speed, thrills, and adventure come together as you tear down the track. Collect bonus points along the way and spend them on motorcycles in a range of colors. Your main goal is to keep your speed up while steering clear of other cars.

Controls are simple: use WASD or the arrow keys to steer. Press the left SHIFT key to lift the front of your bike into the air. This one is built for speed lovers who enjoy a bit of silliness with their racing, and it fits right in with fans of cars and motorcycles.
the-ball-bounces: In this arcade game, you guide a ball along busy city streets. Plenty of hurdles lie ahead, and you need to get past each one to keep going. Along the way, you can take aim at the bullies in your path and knock them down as you roll forward. Another challenge is sinking the ball through basketball hoops whenever the chance appears.

This 3D casual title also carries the clicker tag, so its controls stay simple. Everything is handled with a mouse click or a tap. Keep the ball moving forward through each street you reach, and see how far you can roll.
masha-and-the-bear-pizzeria-game: Masha and the Bear are set on baking great pizza and opening a pizzeria of their own. You make pizzas alongside Masha in a cooking game made for kids, and the cute animal characters make the kitchen feel lively. It's a fun pick for anyone who enjoys cooking, cartoons, or learning through play.

Once your pizzas are ready, you deliver them to friends who are waiting to taste them. This game is part of the Masha collection, so fans of these characters will feel right at home. To play, use your mouse or tap the screen.
fruitbattle: FruitBattle is a fruity shooting arcade game with plenty of obstacles to deal with. Anyone can pick it up quickly, since the controls are easy to operate and the core gameplay is simple to learn, whether you are young or older. You get dozens of bullets to use, and the game offers a massive number of levels to work through.
Each game is a fast-paced single battle, so it fits neatly into short breaks in your day. It gives a relaxing sense of letting off steam. To start, just click the turret to launch.
offroad-mountain-driving-2024: Take the wheel of powerful off-road machines and put your driving ability to the test across rugged, untamed land. Every stage throws its own hazards and changing weather at you, from muddy tracks to snowy passes. Success depends on adjusting to whatever comes next and planning your route with care.

The game includes a range of vehicles, and each one offers customization options that sharpen its performance on particular terrain types. Control your car with WASD, and press F whenever you want a burst of nitro.
makeover-run: Warm weather means it's time for a wardrobe refresh, and this 3D hypercasual title challenges you to work out which tops and skirts belong together. Team up with your girlfriends, guide your characters across a platform course, and race toward the finish. Along the way, you'll dodge tough barriers and gather as many garments as you can. Try pieces in different colors and see where your choices lead.

Once you cross the line, you can show off your outfits to your friends and give your boyfriend a kiss. The controls are simple: just tap or click. The game is tagged for boys and girls, along with casual and fun.
extreme-rally-car-driving: In this arcade driving game, you sit in the driver's seat and look out through the windshield instead of watching your car from a third-person camera. Your route leads to the finish line, and along the way you can pick up gold coins. You are stuck on the platform truck for the whole run, so you have to dodge other vehicles on the road.
Steering uses the arrow keys or WASD, and the Space bar brakes. This 3D game also falls under simulation and collecting, and it works on mobile devices.
asmr-slime-maker-diy: A little makeup artist's box holds fashion makeup and a slime simulator, and this game brings both together. You can craft slime and then add crystal slime to girls' makeup, giving each look a bright, sparkly touch. Both parts sit side by side in one fun setup.

Much of the appeal comes from how satisfying the slime is to work with, and every step centers on that hands-on feel. Controls are simple: a mouse click or a tap is all it takes to play. The same approach works whether you are using a computer or a touchscreen.
tap-react-plus: Tap React Plus is a quick reflex game where every tap matters. Your goal is to keep the red square alive by hitting it fast before it shrinks away. Yellow squares earn you bonus points when you tap them, but blue squares are different: touching one ends your run right away.
You can control the game with a mouse on PC or with touch on mobile. It is a single-player 2D title built around timing and skill. Stay focused, react quickly, and aim for the top score.
pretty-box-bakery-game: Pretty Box Bakery Game is a cooking and decorating title for girls, built around a makeup-themed cake baking salon party. You bake and decorate cakes, and along the way you take on the role of a makeup artist. It suits anyone who enjoys designing and cooking games.

Many players dream of owning a makeup kit and becoming a beauty influencer, and this game lets you try that role out in its own colorful setting. You control everything with a mouse or by tapping the screen. The game runs in your browser using HTML5, so there is nothing extra to set up before you start.
xtreme-atv-trials-2021: Xtreme ATV Trials 2021 is a racing game where you ride an ATV through a set of trial courses. The game offers 100 different levels and lets you pick from 5 ATVs. It is a single-player title with an action focus, and it runs right in your browser.
Drive your ATV with either the WASD keys or the arrow keys. Press Space whenever you need to jump. Each of the 100 levels is a new trial to tackle, so there is plenty of riding to do.
tanks-in-space: Set online, this browser game pits tanks against each other on a range of planets. Before a fight starts, you choose your first tank model, then the planet where the battle will happen. Your vehicle appears on screen and rolls across the landscape toward the enemy. Once you spot hostile tanks, line up your cannon and fire. If your aim is true, the shell strikes its target directly.
Controls are simple. Move with the W, A, S and D keys, press Space to switch weapons, and left-click to shoot. On mobile devices, a virtual joystick on the screen handles movement instead.
hyperdoll: In HyperDoll, a sword-wielding superhero made of stick lines takes on a crowd of rivals. You guide the fighter through each clash and aim to bring down every enemy by striking them. The entire game works with just one finger, so it's easy to pick up.

Steering is simple. On a computer, scroll the mouse to set your direction. On a mobile device, slide your finger across the screen to point the stickman where it needs to go. Every move is about getting through the fight.
kitty-drop: Guide a tiny kitten that has tumbled off its perch and needs to reach a safe patch of grass. Your job is to tap or click on boxes, blocks, and other objects to clear them off the screen. Every box apart from the grass has to be removed before you can move on to the next stage. Use the blocks and props available to you in any way that works, so the little cat lands safely on the grass area. If a move goes wrong, you can restart the current level. Work through all 28 different stages to solve this lighthearted physics puzzle.
Controls are simple: a single click or tap is all you need.
slope-extra: Slope Extra is a rolling ball game where you guide a ball down sloping ramps while steering around obstacles. The game never truly stops. The ball keeps gaining speed the longer it runs, and new obstacles keep showing up, so each attempt grows more demanding.

Your goal is to cover the greatest distance you can without hitting anything. Controls are simple: the ball follows your mouse, so move the mouse left or right to direct it along the ramp. Keep an eye on the path ahead as the speed builds.
super-meat-dash: Say hello to Super Meat, a little hero made of a chunk of meat. Your job is to keep him moving across a flat 2D platform while steering clear of hazards along the way. The journey is full of wild moments, so stay alert. Hop over the blocks, watch out for live electrical wires, and avoid the toxic puddles. Play it with a left mouse click, or tap the screen if you're on a phone or tablet.
us-truck-game: Set out on a long-distance haul in this truck simulator, where you take the wheel of a sturdy orange big rig pulling a huge Cargo EX trailer. Your route winds through built-up city streets, highway junctions, and busy crossroads filled with realistic traffic. Handling a jointed rig takes patience, since you must angle the trailer through sharp bends, follow road signs, and squeeze through tight corners.
Expect wide-open environments, industrial zones, and exacting driving tasks that test your abilities as a professional trucker. Use W, A, S, and D or the arrow keys to drive and steer.
city-bus-offroad-driving-sim: Take the wheel of a city bus in this realistic driving simulation, where every turn feels like a real commute. You carry local passengers through busy city streets and out onto long highway roads in this modern take on bus racing from 2019. Each run brings plenty of danger, because the people on board depend on you to
sky-driver-on-ramps: Sky Driver On Ramps is a 3D racing game where you drive cars over sky-high mega ramps. You can play it offline on tracks set in a city, along with routes that look impossible to finish. The garage includes sports, classic, speed, GT and formula-style cars, plus heavy vehicles. Perform risky stunts on the tracks to earn points.

The game offers three modes. Infinity Mode gives you full control of every car and mixes top-speed driving with big stunts. GT Stunts Mode asks you to complete missions by performing GT ramp stunts on a variety of ramps. GT Mega Ramps Mode takes you high into the sky on impossible tracks with very fast cars. You control the action with the keyboard.
car-stunt-master-3d: Car Stunt Master 3D puts you behind the wheel of a fast sports car on tall, sky-high stunt courses. Your route includes ramps, loops, and narrow platforms, so you will need to launch off jumps and cross the track while staying on your feet. Your goal is simple: get to the finish line without taking a tumble.

Drive and steer with WASD or the arrow keys, and tap Space to pull the handbrake when you need extra control. Follow the path, keep the car steady while it is airborne, and aim for the end of the course. It is a 3D racing game with an arcade feel, suited to anyone who enjoys jumps, stunts, and driving.
unicorn-math: If math feels tedious, or your grades in the subject have been slipping, a slow and dull lesson style can make things harder. This title pairs you with a friendly little unicorn who walks alongside you through calculation practice. It throws out problems, offers warm praise whenever you answer correctly, and, when a response misses the mark, gently reveals the right result.

Built for children, the game aims to spark curiosity about numbers and build clear mathematical thinking. Whether you already love math or simply want a stronger score, this one is a strong pick. Controls are simple: click the mouse or tap the screen to play.
ben-10-escape-route: Ben 10 is trapped inside a building and needs to find a way out so he can get back to his grandfather. There is no other exit, so he has to build his own route. Even with his superpowers, he cannot manage it alone, and you may be the only chance he has to see his family again.

Your job is to draw laser routes that guide Ben to the exit gate. The level is only complete once he reaches the gate safely, so plan the best route you can for your hostage friend. This HTML5 puzzle sits in the Puzzles category and is also tagged Drawing, Cartoon, and Family.
rocketto-dash: Rocketto Dash is a single-player arcade runner where you pilot a rocket that keeps gaining speed as you go. Your job is to dodge obstacles in its path while the music shifts to match the action, which makes the game hard to put down. Along the way, gather coins and diamonds, and work your way through each tough level.

Steering uses the mouse: click the right button to slide your rocket one lane to the right, and click the left button to move it one lane to the left. The space theme and rocket focus give the quick, fast-paced running action a clear identity.
island-race: In Island Race, a 3D arcade game, you cut down trees to gather the wood you need to build your own raft. Once it is ready, you ride it and try to be the first to cross the finish line and win. Various characters and cutting tools are also waiting to be unlocked as you go.
Controls are kept simple: a mouse click or a tap is all it takes to play. The game is tagged 3D, Arcade
upgrade-the-cars: Upgrade the CARS is a 3D racing game where each gate on the track can either improve your vehicle or damage it. Green plus gates boost your engine, body and speed, while red minus gates take those gains back. Cross the finish line with the strongest machine you can assemble, then sell it. The earnings pay for new parking spaces, unlock cars in your garage, and buy fresh paint at the texture shop. Each attempt helps fund the next one.

Push further and the road fills with giant kaiju, which you must clear using weapons. Money is collected on every lap. Steer by dragging with a mouse or swiping on a touchscreen to move left and right. Drive through plus gates to upgrade and steer clear of minus gates. Tap the on-screen buttons to buy upgrades, sell cars, and unlock new spots.
treasure-hunter: Treasure Hunter is an arcade game with an escape theme. You take control of a hunter who is trying to get away with his treasure, and the whole experience centers on that goal. It is a fun game with a simple premise that keeps the focus on getting out safely with the loot in hand.

Movement is handled entirely from the keyboard. Press W, A, S, and D, or use the arrow keys, to guide your hunter. Those controls are all you need to get started, so you can jump straight into the chase and make your escape with the treasure in tow.
tractor-farm-farming-simulator: This countryside farming title puts you behind the wheel of a tractor as you travel across rural landscapes to finish a range of jobs. Some missions involve hauling farm equipment from one place to another, while others have you plowing fields. Taking it slow and steady matters, and each mission you complete helps sharpen your handling of the machine.

Driving feels true to life, and the controls are simple to learn and quick to respond. The levels are short, built for quick sessions, and the farm settings feel peaceful. The game is also mobile-friendly, making it a casual experience. Press W to accelerate, S to reverse or brake, A to turn left, and D to turn right.
xtreme-racing-car-crash-2019: Xtreme Racing Car Crash 2019 is a new demolition-style crash game in the racing category. This edition brings a fresh stunt course and a lineup of 20 realistic vehicles. Smash rivals to collect cash, then spend it on nox boosts, paint colors, wheel styles and plenty of other tweaks. Every car has its own set of upgrades to unlock.

You can team up with friends in multiplayer or play alone offline and work through all the levels. In single player, computer-controlled cars head straight for you, driving hard and speeding up to ram into your vehicle. Steer with WASD, press C to switch camera views, and move the mouse to look around. Hold Tab to view the score and list of players.
buggy-drive-stunt-sim: This single-player racing title puts you behind the wheel of a buggy, and you can choose from four different cars. Your aim is to build up speed and pull off stunts with your chosen ride. The controls are explained inside the game, so the details are waiting once you are in.

Driving is handled with the W, A, S and D keys. Guidance for the rest of the gameplay appears in the game itself. The title runs in the browser using WebGL and was built with Unity3D. It is also tagged with car, driving, and truck themes.
half-and-half-celebrity-style: A celebrity is eager to try a fresh look called half and half, a style that has been spreading quickly across social media. Your task is to get the celebrity ready for a night out. Mix and match clothing pieces to build one-of-a-kind half and half outfits that stand out.

Your fashion skill is the key to this challenge, so take your time pairing items until each look feels right for this new trend. Controls rely on a left mouse button click, which keeps selecting and swapping pieces simple. Help the celebrity embrace this new fashion and see how each creation turns out.
matchcandy-io: Matchcandy.io is a match-3 game with a multiplayer twist. Your job is to swap neighboring candies so that three or more of the same kind line up, scoring points and creating special candies while the clock keeps ticking. You compete with players from all over the world, gain points, climb in level, and work your way up the global leaderboard. Along the way you can also unlock achievements.

Controls are simple: use your mouse on a computer, or tap and touch the screen on a smartphone or tablet to pick and swap candies. The game fits the fast, casual style of classic Bejeweled-type puzzles, so you can jump in for a quick round or keep going to see how high you can rank.
crowd-pusher: Crowd Pusher is a hypercasual game full of 3D action, where you gather matching colors, characters, and numbers to defeat a boss. Every warrior you pick up gives you a bigger advantage, so the larger your group grows, the stronger you become. Watch your step, because you need to take care when going after the frightening monster at the end.

The game is played with a mouse or touchpad, so you can steer your crowd with simple pointer movements. Its mix of battle, escape, and island themes, along with math-based collecting, keeps each run lively. It works well on mobile too, making it easy to jump in for a quick adventure.
baby-hippo-dental-care: A little hippo has a serious sweet tooth, but brushing is the last thing he wants to do. This time his mouth has finally run into trouble. While he was chomping on a treat, he suddenly felt sharp pain in his teeth, so he needs a visit to the dentist right away.

You take on the role of the dentist and look after the young hippo's smile. Your job is to treat his teeth and find the dental problem behind the pain. Play with mouse clicks or taps, and see if you can spot what is causing him discomfort.
mega-ramp-car-stunt-race: Mega Ramp Car Stunt Race puts you behind the wheel for stunt driving on very high tracks packed with ramps. You can pick from muscle cars, sport cars, and formula racing cars in the garage, and each one responds to real-time physics as you tackle winding, zig-zag routes. The game blends ramp car driving with GT racing stunt action, so you can test your skills on vertical ramps and rooftop tracks high in the sky.
The adventure spans 20 levels: 10 GT racing stunt missions on challenging tracks,
deer-hunter: Head into a dense jungle and go after deer in this shooting title. Expect plenty of hunting and gunfire as you track your prey through the wilds. It suits anyone who enjoys playing a lethal stalker and takes pleasure in bringing down deer. Along the way, you will run into some intense scenes from nature's wilder side.

Controls are simple. A left click fires your weapon, while a right click zooms in for a closer look. Move your character with W, A, S, D or the arrow keys, and hold Shift with those keys to pick up the pace. Use Page Up and Page Down to zoom the view in or out.
dead-zombie-hunting: Dead Zombie Hunting is a first-person shooter with striking 3D visuals, blended with a survival strategy game set against zombies. Every survivor has the same aim: stay alive for as long as possible.
Play from a first-person view, moving with WASD and firing with the mouse. Hold Shift to run and press Space to jump. Scroll to change weapons, press F to use, and tap T to slow time.
railway-road: Railway Road is a 3D puzzle in which a railway has been broken into many small fragments, so the train has no way through. Your task is to join all of these pieces with rails until they form one complete road. It is a single-player game, and you control everything with the mouse.

The title carries logic, arcade, and casual tags, so the challenge rests on working out how the parts fit together. Think about where each fragment belongs, connect it, and keep going until no gaps remain and the train can pass again.
candy-shuffle-match-3: Candy Shuffle Match-3 is a puzzle game built around sweets. Your job is to swipe candies so that three or more of the same kind line up, then collect them to finish each mission. Plenty of puzzles are on offer, and the game has a playful, magical feel. When a stage gets tough, you can call on power-ups to get through it. It is a fun pick for anyone who enjoys matching games.

Every move comes down to swiping, so the controls are simple to learn and quick to pick up. Each match helps you move closer to your goal for the level. Think ahead, spot the best swaps, and use your power-ups wisely when you get stuck.
run-rich-3d-fun-and-run-3d-game: Winning a huge lottery jackpot is a wish shared by people everywhere, and this game lets you chase that fortune in a playful way. You begin with very little and work your way up in an adventure that takes you from poor to rich. The gameplay is hard to stop playing once you begin.

Your job is to reach the end of each platform while dodging obstacles and grabbing as much money as you can along the route. The more cash you collect, the more sophisticated your outfit becomes, and the closer you get to becoming the top rich character. Controls are simple: just tap or click to play.
wolf-life-simulator: Step into the paws of a wolf in this 3D animal simulation adventure. You live the daily life of a wild wolf, which means surviving, hunting, finding a mate, and standing up to other predators that share the land. It is a wildlife game centered on the everyday struggles of pack life in the wild.
Play is handled with a simple mouse click or tap. The game is tagged as casual and is aimed at kids, along with anyone who enjoys learning how animals get by in their natural environment.
crazyparty-io: CrazyParty.io is a 3D battle royale title that mixes humor with plenty of fun. Your goal is to grab other players and toss them off the area. Every round asks you to stay on your feet, because the final competitor left standing takes the win. The game is quick to pick up and rather addictive.

Everything is controlled with the mouse alone, so there are no complicated commands to learn. It is a casual experience with a cheerful, silly tone. Whether you want to survive the longest or simply enjoy the chaos, the mix of action and laughs keeps every match lively.
snake-wars: Snake Wars is an .io game where you guide a friendly snake through the pit. You grow by eating food, and the bigger you get, the more you rule the playing area. Competition is fierce, because the largest snakes survive while smaller ones become meals for their rivals. To stay alive, you need to steer carefully and avoid crashing into other snakes on your way to the top.
Controls are simple. Move the mouse to steer your snake, and hold the left mouse button or press the Space key to boost. On mobile, tap and drag on the screen to guide your snake instead.
dragon-hunt-jigsaw: Dragon Hunt Jigsaw is a no-cost browser puzzle from the jigsaw family. Start by picking one of 12 pictures, then choose a difficulty: easy splits the image into 25 pieces, medium into 49, and hard into 100. You can control everything with a mouse, or tap the screen if you are on a phone or tablet.

It is a relaxed game that suits kids and adults alike, and it runs in HTML5 so there is nothing to install. Take your time, enjoy putting the dragon scene back together, and see how the larger piece counts feel as you move up in difficulty.
crush-all: This 3D arcade game for the browser challenges you to recycle and destroy as many cars as you can. Each car needs a tow hook, but only a higher-level hook can pull a higher-level car, so you need to match your hooks to the cars you face.

To build a stronger hook, drag one onto another and combine them, which gives you more power for the towing work ahead. The game runs online in HTML5 and uses simple controls: a mouse click or a tap is all you need to play.
stick-warrior-hero-battle: Stick ragdolls clash across several perilous arenas in Stick Warrior Hero Battle, a fighting game. The characters are well-known heroes from the stickman scene, and each one carries a distinct weapon and its own style of combat. Game modes send you through different adventures whether you play alone or head-to-head with a partner.

Keep an eye out for power-ups appearing around the map as you fight. Some are helpful, while others work against you, so choose carefully which ones to grab. Player 1 uses W, A, S, D or the arrow keys, and Player 2 uses the arrow keys. Bringing a friend along makes the stick brawl even more social.
pirate-jack: Jack is a charming little pirate whose ship has been taken over by a crew of hostile buccaneers. All he wants is to make his way across the vessel and reach the treasure chest he cherishes most. Along the route he must dodge a deck packed with dangerous firearms and furious raiders, so every move needs careful timing.

This is a one-player 2D arcade adventure with plenty of action. You guide Jack with the WASD keys, and touch controls are available for mobile play. He can also use a double jump, which gives him an extra leap in mid-air.
long-hair-princess-rescue-prince: A queen gave birth to a daughter whose hair held special healing powers, and the people soon called her the long-haired princess. An evil witch stole the princess because her hair kept the witch from growing old. For many years, the witch held the girl captive in a hidden garden.
One day, a stranger wandered into that garden by accident, badly wounded. The game's title points to a rescue story centred on the prince. You play with your mouse or by tapping the screen.
resolve-images: In Resolve Images, you search for the correct parts and then place each one where it belongs. This arcade puzzle offers 60 levels, and each one shows attractive pictures to solve. The challenges get harder as you progress, so your problem-solving skills are tested along the way.

You can play on your own, or enjoy the puzzles with friends. Controls are simple: click with a mouse or tap the screen. The game is aimed at kids and anyone who wants to build their skills through a series of levels.
duckys-colorful-life: Duckys Colorful Life is a puzzle adventure in which a cute duck sets out to find a precious egg. You steer the little bird through each stage while keeping it away from dangerous traps. Switching colors makes walls of the matching shade disappear, which opens new routes forward. Every level tests your logic, your powers of observation, and your sense of timing.

The game has bright, cheerful graphics and a creative color-switching system that gives each puzzle a fresh twist. Controls are simple, and everything is played with the mouse. The puzzles are designed to be absorbing from start to finish. The duck must reach its goal safely, and each stage rewards careful thinking and quick decisions.
halloween-pumpkin-weighin: In this Halloween puzzle, you add pumpkins to a set of scales so that both sides weigh the same and the scale stays level. You can drop pumpkins onto either side, so you need to judge how heavy each one will be before it lands.

Other objects share the scales too, including weights, cats, heads, and various other things. To control your pumpkin, tap or click to make it grow, then release to let it fall onto the scale. Take your time with each drop, since balancing the scales is the whole point.
flappy-pumpkin: Flappy Pumpkin is a 2D arcade game with a Halloween theme, and you steer a pumpkin through the air. Each tap sends your pumpkin flying upward, so timing your presses is the key to staying aloft. Mechanical poppy hands are scattered along the route, and you need to slip past them without letting your pumpkin touch any of them.

Along the way, you can collect every medal in the game. The title is also a casual pick for short sessions. Each run gives you a fresh chance to beat your own personal best score. To get started, you only need one click or tap, so you can jump straight in.
drawing-puzzle-brain-game: This 2D logic puzzle asks you to sketch lines that work as a bridge, guiding a ball into a glass container. Each level also has stars to collect, and gathering all of them is part of the goal. When your drawing is ready, press the Play button to see the result.

Drawing is simple: hold down your mouse button or finger and drag across the screen to create your line. If your sketch doesn't work out, the Refresh button clears everything you have drawn so you can start over. It's a brain game for anyone who likes working through puzzles step by step.
monster-truck: Take the wheel of a monster truck in this 2D racing game. Your job is to perform stunts while you drive and to collect coins, since grabbing them is what lets you finish the track. It is a light, entertaining experience centered on stunts and coin collecting.

Steer with A and D or the left and right arrow keys. Press W, the up arrow, or the spacebar to jump, so you can choose whichever set of controls feels more comfortable. The game is built with HTML5 and is tagged for mobile play as well.
valentines-love-link: Valentine's Love Link is a puzzle game centered on pairs of matching Valentine-themed items. You draw straight paths between two identical pieces, and a path may bend up to two times along the way. A timer runs in each round, so you need to work quickly to collect every tile on the board. Across 48 levels, the challenge keeps building.

Control is simple: use a mouse or touchpad to link the matching items together. The romantic theme gives the whole experience a warm, cheerful feel, which suits anyone who enjoys matching games with a bit of timed pressure. Players who like testing their skill and chasing high scores will find plenty to keep them busy.
drift-master: Drift Master is a racing game where drifting and speed matter a great deal. You press down on the accelerator and race along the roads, whether it's daytime or nighttime. Your car can be customized to suit your own taste, so you can change its look to match how you want it to feel.
The controls are simple: use W, A, S, and D to drive, tap Space to pull the handbrake, and press F to use nitro. Once you start, you may find it hard to pull yourself away from the game.
knife-throw-halloween: This Halloween shooting game asks you to throw a knife while keeping the clown alive. Every level comes with its own list of goals, and you must meet them to move forward. Aim for the spots marked on the board around the clown, and slice the apples that sit on his head or are flung into the air. Balloons are also targets, but you have to avoid striking the clown himself.
Playing is straightforward: swipe to throw. It is filed under shooting, skill and Halloween, so expect a spooky, seasonal take on knife throwing that tests your accuracy.
amazing-airplane-racer: Fly fast in this airplane racer, where speed meets clever tactics. You steer your plane around demanding courses while grabbing power-ups such as turbo boosts and shields, which help you get ahead of rivals. The visuals are polished and eye-catching, and the game puts skill and planning at the heart of every race.

Playing with a friend is a big part of the fun, since the multiplayer mode pits two pilots against each other in the air. Player 1 steers with the arrow keys, while Player 2 uses WASD to move. Master the courses and time your special skills well to rise above the competition in the sky.
lip-art: Lip Art invites you to treat a pair of puckered lips as a blank surface for creative designs. Within a short time you will be working like a skilled makeup artist, shaping each look as you go. Your toolkit includes lipsticks, brushes, gloss, glitter, sequins and rhinestones, so you can make every pair of lips stand out in your own way.
Control is simple: use your mouse or tap the screen, whichever your device supports. Fans of coloring and design will find plenty to explore, and the game works on both mobile and desktop.
wacky-run: Wacky Run is a 3D arcade game that brings back its odd race with a fresh twist. This round, the barriers you face are rougher and more hazardous than before. Every sprint calls for care, and you'll need to decide how bold to be. If you fall, you can get back up and try to close the distance on your rival.

Your main job is to avoid obstacles while you race forward. The game's tags also suggest it suits kids, as well as anyone who enjoys dodging hazards. Getting started is easy: just tap to play. Each run asks you to balance speed with caution, so pay close attention to every move you make on the course.
rocket-league: Rocket League is a free browser game that mixes futuristic sports with fast-paced action. Players drive cars fitted with boosters and crash them into balls, aiming for goals or big saves. You can customize your car, head out onto the field, and compete against others.

Controls are simple. Use W, A, S, and D to drive, press Left Shift for nitro, and tap the spacebar to jump. Press F to change the camera view. The game offers both one-player and two-player modes in 3D, and it is considered one of the most acclaimed sports games of all time.
makeup-slime-master: Slime is a toy that many girls love, and it comes in lots of different colors and textures. A good number of them enjoy making their own slime at home. This time, a girl named Babara suddenly gets the idea to mix slime with cosmetics. She invites you to join her and create slimes that are both beautiful and interesting.

This game blends cooking, decorating, and simulation play in a cute style. You work alongside Babara as you mix, shape, and decorate her creations. The controls are simple: use a mouse click or a tap to play. Spending time with Babara while you experiment with her unusual slime ideas is the heart of the game.
animal-ice-cream-shop: Summer brings on a craving for cold treats, and children often ask for ice cream, popsicles, or smoothies, especially when they're at the beach. In this browser game, a little panda named Miumiu opens a shop in a bright coastal resort. You can spend the season by the water with Miumiu and her friends while you run the place yourself.

Your job is to manage your own ice cream shop and keep your customers happy. Cooking and decorating are both part of the fun, so you can prepare each order and then add your own finishing touches. Play with your mouse, or tap the screen if you're on a touch device.
santadays-christmas: SantaDays Christmas is a multiplayer 2D adventure with arcade elements. You work through dozens of courses and gather crowns along the way, aiming to become the winner of the day. Outfits can be bought to change how your character looks. In races, 10 to 40 players compete, and the first to finish takes the win.

The adventure leads into the world of Fall Days, where races take place on different maps and you can compete wearing different costumes. Play with touch controls on mobile, or use WASD, the arrow keys, or ZQSD on a keyboard. Your effort can really make a difference.
farming-missions-2023: Farming Missions 2023 is a 3D driving simulator that starts you off in a large village filled with farm vehicles and heavy construction machines. You can choose from free drive, racing, and mission modes. Most of these modes can be played alone or with a friend in two-player mode. Missions include fun tasks such as hauling loads with heavy construction machines. Race mode puts you against other construction machines, and your goal is to reach the finish line ahead of the rivals.

Controls for Player 1 use W, A, S and D to move, SPACE for the handbrake, T to look back, C to switch camera and R to reset. Player 2 uses the arrow keys to move, P for the handbrake, L to look back, K to switch camera and U to reset.
pumpkin-basket: Pumpkin Basket gives basketball a spooky twist, with a pumpkin taking the place of the ball. It is a sports title that people of any age can enjoy. Your goal is to get the pumpkin through the hoop, and how well you aim decides how long you can keep going. Work out the angle and the strength of each throw, then send the pumpkin toward the basket.
The gameplay is endless, so the run continues for as long as your aim holds up. The cute graphics and Halloween theme give the whole experience a festive feel. To play, just tap or click.
box-truck-belt: This fast-paced puzzle game puts you behind the wheel of a box truck as a parcel courier. The obstacles grow tougher as you go, and you must get packages to their drop-off points before the clock runs out. Weave past other traffic, squeeze through cramped streets, and take sharp corners with care. Completing deliveries earns rewards and unlocks new levels.
The controls are simple to pick up, so players of any skill level can jump in. Use a mouse click or a tap to play. The gameplay is engaging enough to keep you coming back for one more run.
cute-panda-supermarket-fun-shopping: You take charge as the manager of a supermarket in baby panda's town and run the shop your own way. Your duties include stocking products, selling a wide variety of goods, serving customers, and upgrading the store over time. The day gets busy quickly, so you begin by restocking the shelves with snacks, fruit, and everyday necessities such as potato chips, candies, apples, and toothbrushes.

This is a single-player game with an animal theme and an educational side. You control everything by tapping or clicking, which keeps the gameplay simple to pick up as you learn how a small shop operates.
sausage-survival-master: Sausage Survival Master asks you to last 30 seconds. Each round throws you into a different randomly generated 3D mini-game, and you'll face a mix of battles and races. As you collect experience, you can take on a wider range of challenges and keep your 3D character in one piece.

The game is built for quick, twitchy fun. You need to stay agile and steer your way through every scenario, moving with the skill of someone who knows the terrain. Control is simple: click or tap to play, so it works on a mouse or a touchscreen.
golf-tour: Golf Tour asks you to guide a golf ball into the hole as it travels across a set of platforms. Working out the best path takes some thought, and you need to steer clear of hazards along the way. You will come across stone blocks that must be smashed, magical blocks that you have to get past at just the right moment, and metal blocks that need to be switched off before you can continue.

Everything is controlled with a mouse click or a tap, so the focus stays on reading the layout and choosing your route. It suits anyone who enjoys a bit of planning mixed into their golf, and it is an easy sports title to pick up.
cute-pet-friends-virtual-pet-care-and-dr: Welcome to a playful game where you look after a cat named Kiki and a dog named Fifi. You can feed them, wash them in a bubble bath or under a shower, tidy up their space, brush their fur, and paint their nails.

Pick clothes and outfits that suit each animal, then build a home and decorate it however you like. It suits children who dream of owning a cat or dog and enjoy caring for virtual animals. Controls work with a tap or a click.
tonkwars-io: Steer your tank around a live arena filled with other players, and fire at rivals to take them out. You can blast through the terrain to carve new paths and grab powerups scattered across the map. Once you're ready, personalize your tank by adding flags and hats to stand out from the crowd.
Movement is handled with your mouse: move the pointer to drive, and click to fire your cannon. Battles are fast and open, so keep an eye on your surroundings and pick your moment to strike.
halloween-games: Halloween season has arrived, and this game lets you enjoy it through a set of spooky puzzles. Twelve different Halloween-themed puzzles are ready to explore. Bright, colorful visuals paired with friendly sounds and effects keep every session lively.

The graphics are cute, and the background music is light and cheerful. The interface is easy to pick up, so everyone in the family can join in. Solving the puzzles helps build problem solving, logic, and cognitive skills, while also strengthening concentration and memory. To start playing, just click or tap.
spooky-tripeaks: Spooky Tripeaks puts a Halloween spin on the classic card game Solitaire. Your goal is to get through all 100 levels. Jokers and other bonus cards can make the process simpler, and you earn them by clicking on ghosts and other eerie characters.

Each turn starts by drawing one card at a time from your stockpile. Then choose a card on the playing field that is higher or lower in value than the card you drew, and it gets removed. To complete a level, you must clear every card from the playing field without running out.
roller-ball-adventure: In this 2D arcade adventure, you guide a red rollerball through 100 levels, rolling, jumping and bouncing as you go. Villainous minions are trying to flatten the planet into a square, and this red ball is here to rescue the world. Your route runs through a dangerous factory where enemies lurk and deadly laser beams sweep across the path.

Use the arrow keys to roll left and right, and press up to jump. Landing on bad guys defeats them, but touching one of their sharp corners is harmful. Collect enough yellow stars along the way and steer the ball to its goal. This is a one-player game.
baby-taylor-wedding-flower-girl: A close friend of Taylor's mother is getting married, and the Taylors have received an invitation to the celebration. The wedding still needs one special touch, a sweet little flower girl, and Taylor has been picked for the job. You will help Taylor and her mom get everything ready. First you head out shopping together, then you dress Taylor up, and last you decorate a pretty flower basket.
Your aim is to make Taylor the cutest wedding flower girl you can. The game is controlled with a mouse click or a tap. Each stage of preparation lets you add more touches to Taylor's
duck-shootingz: Duck ShootingZ is a shooting puzzle where your job is to hit every duck on screen. You line up each shot with care, working out the right angle so your bullets bounce off walls and reach targets you could not hit directly. The surroundings matter as much as your aim, so you use the layout of each level to finish it.

Later levels bring more to think about. Explosive barrels, switches, and tricky obstacles appear as you advance and make each stage a little harder. The game is controlled entirely with the mouse, and its physics-based puzzles reward planning over guesswork. It is a light, casual game with a military-themed setting and a strong focus on strategy.
shaolin-soccer: Shaolin Soccer asks you to make your way downward without harm, and that is the core challenge of this puzzle title. At first it seems easy, but the game hides a surprising amount of depth beneath its surface. Your goal stays the same from the first stage to the last.
Numerous levels lie ahead, and working through them sharpens your intellect while you enjoy the journey. Controls are minimal: a mouse click or a tap is all it takes to play.
fill-the-gap: Fill the Gap is a puzzle game in which you fill the empty spaces of a shape using cute snakes. It is a single-player title with a 3D look and a hypercasual style, which keeps things light and easy to pick up. Your task is to work out where each snake belongs so that every gap in the shape gets filled.

On a computer, you move with the WASD keys or the arrow keys. On mobile devices, you swipe across the screen to move. Both options keep the focus on planning your next move as you work toward a fully filled shape.
mech-battle-simulator: In the year 3070, the mech wars have reached their final clash, and you lead the army. This battle simulator puts you in command of a fleet of combat machines, including tanks, robot spiders, warrior mechs, and desert buggies.

Damage to the machines is meant to look realistic, and explosions show the effects of every hit. The battlefield is rendered in 3D, so the whole scene feels full and detailed. Everything is controlled with the mouse, leaving you free to focus on directing your forces.
ball-jointed-doll-creator: Build your own one-of-a-kind ball jointed doll from scratch. Pick a cute character, dress her up, and then save the finished picture as a lovely wallpaper for your device. You can shape the doll into whatever look you have in mind. Choose the pose you like best, then finish her off with a hairstyle, an expression, and eye colour that suit her. Accessories are available too, so you can match everything to her outfit.
Everything is controlled with a mouse click or a tap, so you can start designing right away.
world-of-alice-pirate-treasure: World of Alice: Pirate Treasure is a learning-focused puzzle made for children. Its main goal is to sharpen logical thinking as players follow a map showing the route to pirate treasure. Despite its educational focus, the experience stays light and entertaining, and it runs on phones, tablets, or desktop computers alike.

To play, you simply click the answer that matches the correct treasure path on the map. Each choice tests how well you can trace the way forward. It serves as a strong educational resource, making it a worthwhile pick for young learners who enjoy pirate adventures.
harvest-io: Harvest.io is a farming simulator built in the io style, where you steer a tractor across a field to gather crops. As you drive, everything you harvest goes into the fodder trailer behind you. That trailer keeps growing, so steering clear of an accident becomes more difficult the longer you keep going.

This hypercasual title is easy to pick up, but the bigger your load gets, the more care each turn takes. Plan your route carefully, since a wider trailer leaves less room for error. The io format gives the farming theme a fast, competitive pace that fans of the genre will recognise.
popcorn-master: In Popcorn Master, you work through a full set of popcorn making levels by bursting kernels and sending the popped pieces flying out of each burst. This 2D single-player arcade title has a light, bouncy feel and runs on Android.

The game is built as a relaxing, ASMR-style casual puzzle, so it suits a calm break. To play, press and hold to fill the bucket with popcorn, and make sure you never drop anything. Advance step by step toward the top as you clear each stage.
drawing-christmas-for-kids: Little ones can paint and color their way through this holiday drawing game, which works as a learning activity for kindergarten-age kids. Festive pictures come alive through a mix of animations and drawings, so every coloring session feels full of motion. Along the way, children learn to draw cute characters in a light-hearted way, including animal friends that fit the Christmas theme.

Play is simple: just use your mouse or tap the screen. Built with HTML5, the game is easy for a child to pick up and enjoy. Whether your young artist is just starting out or already loves making pictures, this girls' game keeps the focus on creativity and gentle skill-building.
puppetman-ragdoll-puzzle: Puppetman: Ragdoll Puzzle is a brainteaser with floppy, doll-like physics and appealing visuals. You guide a character named Poly down toward the ground. Solving each puzzle means working out how to use the objects around him, since everything you interact with affects how the hero moves.

Your aim is to lower the man to the ground while taking as little damage as possible. The surrounding items react in a believable way, so planning your moves matters. You can press the on-screen buttons or use the A, B and C keys on your keyboard. The controls are simple to learn, which leaves you free to focus on the puzzles.
red-flow: Set in a Transylvanian cocktail bar where the pipes carry red liquid, this puzzle challenges you to link a barrel to a glass with a working pipeline. Each piece you add extends the route, and your goal is to finish it before the crimson flow reaches the end. Every level opens with a short quiet spell, but then the pressure rises and the red tide starts creeping along your pipes, so you need to keep one step ahead.

Controls are simple. Tap an empty square to set down the next piece in your queue, and tap a piece you have already placed to turn it. Watch for tougher obstacles. Some pipes are fixed in place with golden rivets and cannot be rotated, while certain tiles are solid stone that blocks the flow completely. Mouse clicks or taps are all you need to play.
funny-animal-faces: Funny Animal Faces is a free online game for kids that is designed to make you smile. To start, pick one of the pictures and turn the animal in it into a goofy face. The game sits in the Puzzles category and is tagged for Android and HTML5, along with Arcade, Animal, Fun, and Funny.
Controls are simple: use your mouse or tap to play. The game is tagged for both boys and girls, so it can suit a wide range of young players. It makes a light, silly break whenever you feel like one.
tank-war-multiplayer: Tank War Multiplayer puts you in a 3D action battle against people from around the globe. You climb into a tank and roam the battlefield, where your main aim is to grab the enemy flag and carry it back to your own base. Destroying as many opposing tanks as you can along the way is also part of the fun.
Movement uses the W, A, S and D keys, while the mouse handles firing. Press Esc whenever you need to pause the match. It is a fast, shooting-focused game built around teamwork and quick reactions.
bus-driving-master-3d: Step into the seat of a professional bus driver in this 3D driving title. Your job is to collect riders at crowded city stops and carry them safely to where they need to go. Your route might take you along highways, through busy streets, or over scenic mountain roads, and you must obey traffic laws while steering around hazards. Each completed passenger run pays out rewards, and as the routes grow harder, your driving skills get sharper.

The controls feel realistic, and the detailed 3D surroundings and smooth performance make every trip feel believable. Use W, A, S, D or the arrow keys to drive and steer. This game suits anyone who loves driving or simulation titles.
my-pets: In My Pets, you feed a dog and a cat using bones and fish. Your path forward is paved by regulating the platforms and deciding how each one gets activated. It is a funny, animal-themed adventure in the hypercasual style, designed for mobile play.

The controls stay simple: click with a mouse or tap the screen to play. Progress depends on managing the platforms and their activation, so you need to think about which ones to switch on and when. The whole experience feels light, cheerful, and easy to pick up, with a playful tone that runs throughout.
color-slice-3d: Color Slice 3D is a hypercasual game with smooth, straightforward gameplay that is easy to pick up and enjoy. Your aim is to slice through colors in a 3D setting while saving characters along the way. Watch out for obstacles and steer clear of them as you go.

You can guide the crowd with the arrow keys or the move controls. Its simple, hard-to-put-down pace keeps each round light and quick to start, so it suits anyone looking for a casual skill game. Keep moving, avoid trouble, and have fun with it.
happy-asmr-care: Happy ASMR Care is a playful browser game about tidying up when things get grubby. It offers four cleaning modes: removing barnacles from a turtle's shell, cleaning a carpet, shaving, and trimming hooves. Each mode gives you a different task, so you can choose the one you like best.
Controls are simple. Use a mouse click or tap the screen, which makes the game easy to play on either a computer or a phone. It is a fun way to pass some time sorting out a mess.
cube-match-logic: Cube Match Logic is a bright puzzle game where you sort and pair cubes that come in many designs. Along the way you meet cute characters and tackle a mix of brain teasers. Your job is to look closely at each cube, spot the features that line up, and finish collection challenges spread across several different modes. It is a relaxed visual logic game that rewards both fast thinking and steady focus.

To play, simply click and slide your way through each puzzle. The game is light and casual, so it suits short breaks as well as longer sessions. Tags for the game include Casual, Matching, and Relaxation.
boxes-wizard: Boxes Wizard is a 2D pixel art platformer with 40 levels. You play as a wizard who carries a wooden staff, and your spells let you teleport and shove boxes around. Each stage grows harder than the last, filled with puzzles and obstacles to get past. Trading places with a box can open paths that were not there before, so planning ahead matters.

The game uses retro-inspired graphics, and every level is designed with care. As you advance, the challenges get tougher, so you will need to rely on your magic and skill to clear them all. Move with the arrow keys or with W, A, and D, and use SPACE for your other actions.
cosmo-pet-starry-care: Step into a starry universe and meet adorable alien pets. Pick the creature you like most and learn what it needs to stay healthy and happy. Your job is to feed your space companions, take them for walks, and keep them entertained with games. Look after them well and they will repay you with loyalty and affection.
