Everything is controlled with a single action: a mouse click on a computer, or a light tap on a touchscreen device. No complicated setup is needed, so you can jump right in and start caring for your new cosmic friends.
zombie-city-master: Zombies have taken over an entire city in this 2D arcade game. A deadly virus swept through the town, leaving its once thriving streets in ruins. Police officers, doctors, and neighbors have all turned into the undead. A woman wakes up alone in a hospital and needs your help to avoid the zombies and escape this dangerous, terrifying town.

Your task is to collect a variety of props, then use them to block the zombies that close in on you. Different props work in different ways, so you will need to decide which one to use and when. This single-player game mixes defense with escape, asking you to stay alive while making your way out of the city.
stack-colors-3d: Stack Colors 3D! is a hypercasual arcade game where you gather colored cubes and build a tall tower as you run down the track. Each matching cube you grab joins your stack, and you need to avoid the odd bricks in the wrong colors. Obstacles along the route can knock pieces loose, so the tower shrinks one block at a time whenever you hit the wrong bricks. At the end of the run, you launch a final kick over the stacking block to pick up coins.

A challenge mode offers tougher tower stacks for players who want a bigger test. The game is 3D and free to play. You can control it with the keyboard, or with a single finger in the app. It also works well as a quick way to pass the time.
forest-adventure: Forest Adventure is a single-player escape game set in a magical woodland. You control a round ball character who roams the trees searching for lost keys, which you use to open mysterious doors and reach new areas. Along the way you dodge obstacles, figure out puzzling mechanisms, and uncover hidden secrets throughout the forest.

There is no score to chase and no clock counting down, so you can move at your own pace and enjoy the calm of nature. Each level opens onto a new journey that goes further than the last. Move right with the D key, move left with the A key, and jump with the W key. Wander the woods, gather the keys, and see where each one leads.
cycle-racing-game: Take to the dirt in this off-road bike racer, where you ride from a first-person view with your hands on the handlebars of a high-performance red and black mountain bike. Your goal is to pedal uphill along steep, craggy trails while testing your endurance and racing against capable rivals on demanding climbs. Green pine forests, rocky slopes, and alpine scenery fill the view, with colorful hot air balloons drifting across a clear blue sky.

Each climb calls for careful balance, smart management of your stamina, and quick reactions if you want to pull ahead of the competition. Use the A and D keys or the left and right arrow keys to move your bike left and right along the trail.
metal-army-war-revenge: The war against the Metal Army picks up right where the last game left off. Deep in the jungle, the robots are plotting something wicked, and in this Revenge episode the heroes must stop them from invading the world. Expect new enemies, new weapons, traps to destroy, and hostages to rescue. Metal collected in each level can upgrade your weapons and health bar at the Market waiting at the end of each stage.
Controls work for one or two players. Player 1 moves with W, A, S and D, fires with C, and throws grenades with V. Hol
ludo-king: Ludo King is built for playing with friends and family. Up to four players can take part at the same time, which makes it a good choice for group sessions. Its tags point to two-player play, puzzle gameplay, and multiplayer fun, and it sits in the Multiplayer category on this site.
The game works on every device, so you can play wherever you happen to be. To begin, choose a category and start playing. Wh
stickman-dash: Stickman Dash puts you in the role of a daring ninja working as an assassin. Your mission takes you into a criminal stronghold, where your job is to take down the people inside. Bouncing off the walls is the key move for dodging incoming enemy strikes, so keep your timing sharp.
You begin with the sharpest sword on offer, and you can upgrade it along the way. This one-player title sits in the adventure and arcade categories and is controlled simply by dragging.
devil-flip: Devil Flip is a 3D adventure built on ragdoll physics. Your character falls straight down from high platforms and tries to land on the marked areas on the ground. Each drop tests your timing and placement, and the goal is to make your way down the platforms to victory.

You can customize the game by buying special items with the money you save. It is designed for players of all age groups. You play by clicking the left mouse button at the right moment and in the right place. If you do not earn enough points, you cannot pass the level.
long-neck-run: What would it feel like to be tall enough to look down on the Eiffel Tower? Long Neck Run puts you in that position in this 3D stickman arcade collecting game. Your aim is to gather as many rings as you can that match your current color while sprinting forward to the finish platform. As you advance, taller buildings and new items come into view, and you may unlock even taller ones.

The game is designed for mobile, and you control movement with a swipe. Its stickman animations are rendered in 3D, giving each run a lively look. Only rings matching your current color count toward your total, so pay attention to the colors you pass through.
jewel-halloween: Jewel Halloween is a puzzle game with a spooky seasonal theme. Your job is to match at least three items, and the more precisely and quickly you do it, the better. Along the way you explore an adventure full of pumpkins, monsters, and skeletons, collecting coins as you go. The challenge is to clear every level without losing your nerve.

Matching four or more items at once earns extra points and gives you useful boosters, such as bombs. If a level starts to feel tough, you can spin the lucky wheel for a bit of help. Your aim is to collect as many coins as you can.
prisonier-transport-simulator-2019: Prisoner Transport Simulator 2019 lets you take on the job of hauling prisoners in a simulation. Across a few levels, you get your chance to handle the transport yourself. Filed under Action, it carries the tags Car and Driving.

Controls are kept simple, with the W, A, S and D keys handling all of the driving. Each level asks you to get your load where it needs to go, so every run is a short simulated trip. If you enjoy car and driving games, this one is worth a look.
zombie-mission-x: Zombie Mission X returns with a winter-themed special episode. Emily and Silver set off on a cold-season trip, but their holiday takes a sharp turn when the undead arrive first and seize control of the area. Several of their friends have also been taken prisoner. Your task is to rescue every captive and wipe out the zombies.

Player one moves with W, A, S and D, hits with C, throws grenades with V, and jumps with W. Player one can also walk along walls. Q and E switch weapons, and pressing both together unleashes a special attack once the SP bar is full. Player two moves with the arrow keys, hits with L, throws grenades with K, and jumps with the up arrow.
boxer-io-fun-io-games: Boxer.io drops you into a stickman brawl where you smash rival fighters and absorb their power as you go. Every kick you land makes your hero bigger and stronger, and the crazy action on the battlefield keeps growing. The arena is a PvE io space, so the chaos starts right away.

Your job is to run, smash, and avoid the other smash heroes until you are the only one still standing. Each round ends with a single winner, the last stickman fighter left in this battle royal. Keep moving and claim the win.
bullet-fury: Bullet Fury puts you in the role of a soldier, seen from a first-person view in three dimensions. It runs on both desktop computers and mobile devices. Your squad has come across a hidden laboratory run by enemy forces, and your job is to grab a gun and wipe out every guard inside.

On a computer, the arrow keys or the W, A, S and D keys move your character, while the mouse turns him, aims, and shoots. On a mobile device, an on-screen joystick handles movement and a fire button takes the shot. Tapping and dragging on the right side of the screen lets you aim and turn the character.
yes-or-no-challenge-run: This run takes you over platforms and through gates toward the next version of yourself, and along the way you answer questions to earn rewards. The game is packed with features, surprises, and clever questions. Helper machines or pets travel with you through the adventure.

You can play alone or team up in two-player mode. In single-player, steer left and right with A and D or the arrow keys, then click your answer with the left mouse button. In two-player mode, Player 1 moves with A and D, and the mouse can also be used to choose answers.
craig-of-the-creek-legend-of-the-goblin-: The Goblin King who lives in the Creek has captured Small Uncle and swiped the kids' treasured book. Craig gathers his crew of forest misfits to set everything right and return things to normal. This adventure is one you can take part in right here, and the fun is there from the start.
The game is controlled entirely with the mouse. It is built with HTML5 and mixes action, arcade, and cartoon elements, drawing on the Cartoon Network show. It sits in the adventure category.
city-car-driving-game: Step into a three-dimensional driving game set across city streets. You can roam the roads in a powerful car that handles smoothly. Your task is to steer through busy urban streets, dodge obstacles, and sharpen your driving skills as you explore the city. The game aims for a realistic feel, so every turn and stop matters.

The game is played with the mouse and arrow keys. Up sends your car forward, down sends it back, and left and right steer it in those directions. Keep your car under control on crowded roads as you tackle a range of driving challenges.
get-lucky: Get Lucky is an arcade game set around a swimming pool, where a 3D girl tries to win her love interest. Despite its setting, it is not a puzzle game. It is a vertical arcade title centered on collecting, with colorful coat hangers to gather. Each level asks you to fill the bar on the left, which rises through a red area, by picking up hangers while steering clear of red blankets.

Every hanger you collect also lets the girl change into new clothes or take off what she is wearing. To move her, drag across the screen. Stay calm, gather as many hangers as you can, and keep away from the red blankets.
perfect-snapshot: Perfect Snapshot is a casual game designed to help you relax and unwind. You control Buddy, a puppet whose limbs can be pulled back in whenever you choose. Your task is to keep his limbs secured so he can hold still and get his photo taken successfully.

Be careful not to stretch him too far. If his limbs stay extended for too long, Buddy shows an uncomfortable expression. Once the picture is taken, though, his face turns into a smile. To move Buddy, slide the screen.
the-cutest-squishy-pet: Meet a soft, cute squishy pet that needs looking after now and then. Sometimes it wants a shower, and other times it needs a trip to the bathroom, so it is up to you to step in and help. Keep your pet clean while you take care of these needs.
There is also a new mini-game made for kids. Play soccer and try to win some cool prizes. Everything works with a mouse click or a tap on your screen, so you can enjoy it on a computer or a phone.
angry-zombies-monstar: In this hypercasual slingshot game, you aim at zombies and launch rock balls to strike them. Every shot is a chance to show your skill and strategy. Mouse controls handle all the aiming, so the game is simple to pick up.

The game is completely free to play and has captured the hearts of millions of players with its fun gameplay. It is tagged as a casual, action-packed fighting title with alien and ghost themes, and it also supports two players.
makeup-art-salon: Makeup Art Salon is a free browser game where you step into a beauty salon as a do-it-yourself makeup artist. Using your own creativity and personal style, you shape a makeup look from start to finish. It sits in the Girls category and carries tags such as makeover, design, fashion, and cleaning.

Choosing color combinations is central to the experience, and you pick the ones you like best in this beauty and fashion title. Controls are simple: a mouse click or a tap is all it takes to play. It is built with HTML5 and is also tagged for kids and mobile play.
cyber-racer-battles: Cyber Racer Battles sends you into space, where racing and fighting happen side by side. Each session mixes fast laps with combat, so a clash is never far away. The racing maps are attractive to look at, and the career mode offers a series of missions to complete. You can play alone or team up with a friend in two-player mode.

Player 1 moves with W, A, S and D and fires missiles with F, while the other weapons and hover fixing sit on the G and R keys. Player 2 steers with the arrow keys, fires missiles with O, and uses P and L for the remaining weapon and hover controls.
advance-car-game-parking: Step into a three-dimensional driving game centered on parking skill. You guide your car through a snowy setting, following icy roads and steering around traffic cones and other obstacles. Your task is to bring the vehicle to a stop inside the marked parking area. Since the surfaces are slippery, every move calls for care and patience.

Work through challenging levels to sharpen your precision and driving skills. Realistic car physics, winter scenery, and smooth gameplay give the experience a grounded feel. Use W A S D or the arrow keys to drive and steer. Fans of driving games who enjoy careful parking will find plenty to practice here.
motor-bike-stunts-sky-2020: Motor Bike Stunts Sky 2020 is a racing game where you perform stunts on a course in the sky. Your mission is to drive upward and complete each level, and every level has its own traps to deal with. It is a bike game built for plain fun, with motorcycle action and tricks at its center.
stair-run: Stair Run sends you over several mountains to reach someone waiting at the very top. Since they sit so high, you need a way to climb further, and springboards are there to launch you upward and bring you closer to your goal. Each jump gets you nearer to the person you came to find.

Obstacles stand in your path, and the hope is that they stay well out of your way so you come to no harm. The game is a 3D Arcade title that mixes avoiding hazards with collecting and puzzle-style thinking. Controls are simple: drag to play.
gunshot-odyssey: Gunshot Odyssey is a 2D platform adventure full of action and challenges. You team up with a hero and move through colorful, intricately drawn surroundings, where precise movement and careful planning both matter.

This single-player arcade title sits in the adventure category. To play, use the left, up, right and down arrow keys, along with the A and S keys. Keep an eye on your surroundings, since success depends on quick reflexes and smart choices.
daddy-rabbit-zombie-invasion-in-the-farm: In this game you play as a rabbit father caring for his little bunnies in a warren hidden beneath a farm. Zombies roam the tunnels, and they cannot stand crying baby rabbits. Your job is to track down every lost bunny in the underground maze.

The little ones nap wherever they are, but they wake up and trail after dad once he walks past. If you want one to stay put, give it a carrot and it will keep sleeping there. If a bunny is awake and dad wanders too far, it starts crying, which upsets the zombies and sends them straight for it. When that happens, dad defends his children with carrot punches. Click a spot in the tunnel to move there, and press the space bar to shoot carrots.
color-stack: Color Stack is a hypercasual game with a stickman at its center. Your goal is to carry as many bricks as you can. Every level brings a new scene and a character wearing a different color, so you need to keep the bricks matching that color on your stack and leave out any that don't belong. Touching a brick is enough to add it, and the bricks pile up by themselves as you go. Move by sliding your finger across the screen.
pixelforces-io: Pixel Forces is a challenging 3D shooter played online with other people. You can pick from five multiplayer modes: RPG, Deathmatch, Team Deathmatch, Explore, and Battle Royale. The five maps feature trampoline platforms, and the environment is laid out as a vertical maze you climb and bounce through. You can create a room with its own room options or enter one that is already open. You can also customize your character with one of 12 skins.

The controls are straightforward. Move with WASD or the arrow keys, jump with the space bar, aim with the right mouse button, and shoot with the left. In night mode, press L to toggle your flashlight. Press Esc or Tab to pause the game at any time.
train-racing: Train Racing puts you at the controls of a locomotive in a driving title with two ways to play. You can work through solo stages on your own, or join multiplayer races and compete against others.

Steering is simple. Press A and D, or the left and right arrow keys, to guide your train. To leap, tap Space, W, or the up arrow. Whether you prefer a calm run through single-player levels or a round of multiplayer racing, the controls stay the same.
star-maze: Star Maze presents a tough maze challenge across 100 levels. Each puzzle is pleasing to look at, and your route paints every tile you pass over. Your main objective is to gather all the stars scattered through the maze.

Controls are easy to pick up: swipe in the direction you want the ball to travel, and it rolls through the winding paths while collecting stars along the way. Think ahead about each route so that every tile gets coloured and no star is left behind. The game is also built for mobile play.
parking-order: Parking Order is a puzzle game built around parking and driving precision. Your job is to park each car in the right sequence, and getting the order right unlocks new levels as you move through an adventure that starts with easy layouts and grows into harder ones. It is a one-player game, and unlocking the next stage is the reward for solving each puzzle.
Along the way you can work through countless levels and collect extra in-game money as you go. When you feel confident, try the challenge and extreme challenge levels to show off your expertise.
kitty-cat: Step into the paws of a brave little kitty on a platform adventure in search of something tasty to eat. Twelve levels stand between the hungry hero and its meal, and each one is packed with obstacles to overcome. The cat has fluffy fur and sparkling eyes, and your job is to help it get past every difficulty until it finally reaches the food it has been waiting for.

Each level brings its own tasks and trials, from tricky puzzles to quick, speeding platforms and big jumps. The soundtrack sets the mood throughout the journey. To play, just click with your mouse or tap the screen.
blob-climbing: Blob Climbing is a 3D arcade game about rubber figures who try to reach the top of a mountain. Its controls are simple, so you can keep playing for as long as you like. Your goal is to help these cute, quirky rubber characters climb toward the summit.

To jump, you drag and then release. Each leap is a chance to reach the next spot, and the challenge grows as you get closer to the peak. Whatever your mood, the rock climbing here is meant to brighten your day.
cute-farm-match-puzzle: Step into a sweet countryside setting where cheerful farm animals take center stage. This light puzzler blends rope physics with animal matching, so you'll need to plan ahead. Players who enjoy clever challenges will find plenty to work through, and each satisfying match brings a sense of progress, much like sort puzzles do.
To play, simply click and drag. Plan your moves carefully, line up matching critters, and enjoy a relaxing session inspired by animal matching games.
brave-soldier-invasion-of-cyborgs: In this side-scrolling platformer with pixel art visuals, you play as a brave soldier whose mission is to defeat every cyborg that has invaded Earth. Your journey spans fifteen stages, and at the end you face the Cyborg Skull, a boss with clever and unusual mechanics you will need to learn to beat.

The retro look of the graphics brings back a warm sense of nostalgia, while the gameplay stays lively from start to finish. Move with the left and right arrow keys, jump with the up arrow, and hold the space bar to fire. A gamepad or joystick is also supported if you prefer one.
slidepark-io: SlidePark.io sends you into a wild water park competition, where the goal is to ride down the biggest slide you have ever seen. The game is easy to pick up and designed to be funny from start to finish. Its gameplay stays simple and entertaining, and the graphics look good too.

Steering works with the A and D keys or the left and right arrow keys, which control your rotation as you travel down the slide. It is a 3D game in the .io category, offering a fun and easy experience for players who enjoy a playful slide.
tile-match-fun: Tile Match Fun is a free, classic-style game that runs in your browser. It was made especially for kids, and the goal is simple: line up matching shapes. Each stage sets a target you must reach before the next level opens. Every level also has its own score, so you can see how well you did and aim to improve it.
Controls stay simple, with a mouse or taps on the screen. That makes the game easy to enjoy on a computer or a phone. Watch how far you can climb through the stages as your scores add up.
bump-io: Sixteen cars meet in this browser-based action battle, and every driver is competing for victory. To win, you must dodge monsters and the arena boundaries rather than crash into them. Hitting rival vehicles charges up your energy, while destroying them makes your car grow in size.

Everything is controlled with the mouse, so no extra keys are needed. This multiplayer car game follows the .io format and is built on HTML5 with a light, hypercasual feel. Each match pits you against a full field of rivals, so every collision matters and every move counts.
us-army-truck-driving: Step into the cab of a heavy military truck in US Army Truck Driving, a simulator built around hauling vital cargo. Your route might lead over open highways, up steep mountain paths, through sticky mud, or across bumpy off-road ground. Each mission asks you to deliver supplies with care, pick your way along tricky roads, and steer clear of hazards. Finishing missions earns you rewards, and the jobs get tougher as you go, helping you sharpen your driving.
The game features realistic truck handling, detailed 3D scenery, and responsive controls that make the journey feel true to life. To drive and steer, use W, A, S, and D or the arrow keys.
puzzle-block: Puzzle Block is a simple puzzle game that is easy to start and hard to stop playing. Your goal is to slide the blocks around until every empty tile is filled. The game keeps your mind busy as you plan each move, and it continues until there are no more blocks left that you can move.
The game has 80 different levels to work through. Move the blocks to cover all the empty tiles in each one. Take your time, think a few steps ahead, and enjoy solving the puzzles one at a time.
farmer-challenge-party: Farmer Challenge Party pits two farmers against each other in a two-player match. The contest runs through four chapters: chicken picking, planting and harvesting, vegetable wars, and fishing. Each chapter asks you to outscore your rival. In the chicken round, strike egg blocks to make chickens appear, gather them, and bring them into your own pen, while steering clear of explosive blocks. The farming round rewards whoever plants and harvests the most, and you can also pick crops from your friend's field.

In the vegetable chapter, grab produce lying on the ground and fire a cannon to hit your opponent. The fishing chapter is won by catching more fish than the other player. Across every chapter, the first farmer to reach 10 points takes the win. Player 1 moves with W, A, S, and D, and acts with S. Player 2 moves with the arrow keys and acts with the down arrow.
pets-master-simulator: Pets Master Simulator lets you roam a wide open world and recruit animals to your team. Some are cute, some are dangerous, some are tiny, and others hit with crushing force. They walk the ground or fly overhead. With more than 100 unique animals, you can build a lineup of your own. Expect enemies of many kinds, raid bosses, varied locations, and plenty of gold and crystals to collect.

Clear each world of its enemies, then teleport onward, since help is needed in the next one too. Upgrade yourself and your pets, or you will not get far. Move with the on-screen joystick or the WASD keys. To attack, stand nearby and wait. In the inventory, choose which pets join your team, and break an egg to get a new companion.
deform-it: Deform It lets you reshape objects by hitting them. You can pick from 13 different ball types and work through 14 levels. The action takes place in space, and the game offers three modes: Level Mode, Free Deform Mode, and Antigravity Mode.

Move the camera with W, A, S, and D, use Q to raise it and E to lower it. Left-click to fire projectiles. Press C to show or hide the crosshair, and V to lock or unlock the cursor. The P key opens and closes the pause panel. Two skills are available: F triggers Doubleshot and G triggers Triples.
mahjong-solitaire-crush-game: This mahjong-inspired title offers a laid-back take on tile matching for anyone who enjoys slow, deliberate puzzling. Your goal is to pair up identical tiles until the whole board is cleared, and each move rewards a bit of forethought. The traditional style keeps things familiar, while the core ideas rely on timeless puzzle mechanics.

Presentation is clean and contemporary, with a layout that suits phones as well as other screens. Controls are simple: use your mouse to click any button in the game. Planning each step carefully is part of the challenge, and the relaxed rhythm lets you think every move through.
catch-the-water: In this single-player puzzle game, your goal on each level is to guide the water flow into a truck. You must get enough water into the truck to reach the minimum level marked on it. Every level asks you to think ahead about where the water should travel.

The grid is filled with barriers, rocks, and twists that stand in the way of your route. You draw the path the water should follow, so the game rewards logic and strategy. It is played entirely with the mouse.
high-school-crush-love-rival: Zoe and Sofia have both fallen for Zack at the same time. Each one wants more of his attention and affection. No matter the occasion, the two keep measuring themselves against each other, yet neither one ever comes out clearly ahead. Zack is worn out by the constant fighting and needs someone to step in.

That is where you come in. Your task is to help Zack and decide which girl wins and which one loses. The game is played with mouse clicks or taps. Its tags point to dress up, fashion, makeover, and shopping themes.
karate-boy: Step into the shoes of a karate champion who must flatten as many trees as possible with a powerful mega punch. This arcade-style casual game is packed with intensity from start to finish. Success depends on sharp timing, because you have to strike each tree at the exact moment to smash it. Every tree you clear opens a way forward, letting you run as far as you can.

The whole game uses a single click or tap, so there is almost nothing to learn before you start. It is built with HTML5 and is also available for mobile play. Keep your reactions quick, time each punch carefully, and see how far your fists can take you.
count-master-3d-game: Count Master 3D is an arcade title that mixes running, obstacles, puzzles, and war into one 3D experience. You play as a leader guiding a growing crowd of followers toward ruling the entire planet. Early on, your first goal is capturing a few castles to get your campaign moving.
To add soldiers to your army, drag the formula shown below. You can also equip your men with weapons to boost their offensive power. The game is controlled with a mouse or by tapping the screen.
multiplarrow: MultiplArrow is a mobile game that puts your number sense and accuracy to the test. You steer an arrow loaded with digits and symbols on a trip through a series of math challenges. To progress, you line up your shots, fire, and work out equations by combining arrows so they strike the target number.

The game includes 80 levels, and each one is harder than the last. It mixes entertainment with learning, so your math skills improve while you spend hours firing arrows. To play, just click with a mouse or tap the screen.
solitaire-15in1-collection: Solitaire 15in1 Collection packs fifteen card games into one place, making it the biggest Solitaire bundle released so far. Well-known favorites like Freecell and Klondike are part of the lineup, alongside many other twists on the format. The visuals are easy on the eyes, the controls are straightforward, and there is plenty to keep you busy. Can you beat your own top score and match the strongest results?

In every mode, the objective is to clear all the cards from the table. You do this by moving them onto the correct piles according to each variant's rules. Cards are organized by suit or by value, depending on the game, and because every variant has its own set of rules, you will need to adjust as you switch between them.
3d-ball-space: Guide your ball through a three-dimensional adventure filled with traps and narrow footbridges that lead to the finish. This single-player challenge is all about balance and careful steering, so one wrong move can cost you. Gather the coins and items you find along the way, since every 50 coins earns you an extra life. Each level you pass brings a reward, and the maze-like stages will test how well you handle each turn.

The controls are straightforward. Use the buttons or the W, A, S and D keys to move, and press Q or E to rotate. Show what you can do, stay steady on the bridges, and see how far your skills can take you through this 3D world.
train-vs-train: Think you can crack this one? In Train VS Train, a brain-teasing puzzle, your job is to time your moves so each train gets off the track before the next one arrives. Get the timing wrong and the trains collide, so think ahead.

Controls are simple: use a mouse click or a tap on a touchscreen to make your moves. The game sits in the Puzzles category and carries tags such as Arcade, Brain, Puzzle, Train and Transport, so it suits anyone who enjoys a quick thinking challenge.
insane-galaxy-ball-2024: In Insane Galaxy Ball 2024, your goal is to move through a series of levels while keeping your ball balanced on tracks floating in outer space. Along the way, you can pick up space coins scattered around each course.

Every level throws different obstacles your way, so you will need to think through how to get past them, much like a puzzle. The challenge grows harder the further you progress. Use the W, A, S, and D keys to move the ball.
pga6-combat-pixel-vehicle-zombies: Blast your way through hordes of undead in this first-person shooter, where you can choose from a range of weapons. Face off against Minecraft-style zombie bots across several maps, either on your own or teaming up with other players. Even when you are armed and joining a zombie battle, you still need to eliminate the other zombies around you.

To stay safe, duck behind the various objects scattered through each map, since cover matters a lot in shooters like this. The controls are simple: W, A, S and D move your character, while the mouse lets you aim, look around and shoot. Press Tab to open the menu, and note that the Enter key is listed alongside the letter C in the control guide.
pixelpool-2-player: Step into this two-player 2D adventure from the PixelPool family, where a blue character and a red character must travel to the same door. Both of them have to avoid danger, leap over obstacles, and reach the finish line without losing a life. You win by getting the blue and red characters through the door together, which is how you claim victory and become the winner.

Move with WASD or the arrow keys, and use the double jump to help you clear obstacles. If you are playing on a phone or tablet, touch controls are available instead. Filed under adventure and arcade, this game is designed for two players to team up and reach the goal side by side.
count-masters-online: Count Masters Online is a 3D running game for anyone who wants plenty of energy and adrenaline. You begin a clash alone, but you will soon find yourself surrounded by company as the battle goes on. The game is built around a city takeover, so your goal is to push through streets and claim territory.

Its colorful visuals sit alongside straightforward mechanics, which makes it easy to pick up. Expect plenty of gang fights and stickman showdowns along the way. Players who enjoy running games can lose track of time in this lively world. You steer your character simply by dragging across the screen.
car-traffic-2d: Car Traffic 2D is an enjoyable driving game centered on racing through heavy traffic. As you push forward, you can collect cash and powerups, and these help you complete your track from start to finish.
Everything is controlled with the arrow keys, so you can start driving right away. Pick your moments to slip between vehic
impossible-tracks-moto-bike-race: Impossible Tracks Moto Bike Race sends you riding motorbikes along daring courses built from rusty shipping containers. The tracks seem to go on forever and climb high into the sky, so every jump and turn takes nerve. It is a stunt racing game for anyone who loves motor riding, presented in 3D and running in the browser.

The stunt areas are difficult, and the race pushes you through one tough section after another in the spirit of GP stunt racing. Crashes cost you no road rash. Use WASD to drive your bike, and hold Shift to activate your nitro boost.
drift-at-will: Drift At Will is a 3D arcade racer where you ride a tricycle through three-dimensional tracks and detailed models. You can drift around corners while charging up your nitro for a quick burst of speed. Grab shields to guard yourself against obstacles and even against crashes.
Steer with the slide control and use Loose to fire up your nitro. Stay relaxed, keep your speed climbing, and aim to set fresh records.
soccer-battle-online: Soccer Battle Online drops you into quick football matches where a single pass, tackle, or goal can settle the outcome. You step onto the pitch, design the jersey your player wears, and face real people in online multiplayer games that reward teamwork and sharp reflexes.

On a computer, WASD moves your player, K sends a pass, and J takes a shot, while switching and tackling are also part of the controls. On mobile, you simply click the buttons that appear on the screen to operate your player.
pomni-math-game: Pomni Math Game puts your arithmetic to the test. Each set of questions sits on tiles that hide a picture of Pomni underneath. To play, drag every numbered block on the left onto its matching tile on the right. The tiles cover the picture, so placing each block correctly gradually uncovers what is hidden. Your goal is to find and reveal all of the Pomni pictures.

This puzzle is as much about logic as it is about numbers, so it suits anyone who enjoys brain teasers. Controls are simple: use a mouse click, or tap on a touch device, to move the blocks. Keep working through the tiles until every Pomni picture has been discovered.
piggy-bank-demolish-run: Piggy Bank Demolish Run is a playful 3D arcade runner with a classic pixel look. As you dash forward, your goal is to collect special game coins so you can smash through the toy walls ahead. Touching any red obstacle or trap ends the run, so keep your eyes on the path. Gold coins gathered during your run add up, and you can spend them in the shop to unlock and equip one of 21 skins. Each toy wall asks for a certain number of game coins, so choose the smallest amount needed to get past.
Steering is simple: touch the screen and drag to move your piggy bank left and right.
lunch-box-ready: Lunch Box Ready has become a crowd favorite, and it's a natural pick if storage puzzles are your thing. Your task is to load your preferred foods into a lunch box in whatever order matches your own routine. Careful planning matters here, since each item needs its own spot and everything has to fit inside the box.
The game suits players who enjoy neat, orderly arrangements and can really satisfy an obsessive-compulsive streak. Controls are simple: use your mouse or tap the screen to play.
world-of-alice-my-dog: World of Alice - My Dog is a learning game for children that lets them experience what it is like to have a pet of their own. Little players can feed their dog, play with it, give it a bath, and provide medical care when it needs it. It is an excellent resource for preschool education, and it shows that learning can be fun. Its clicker style keeps the focus on simple, hands-on tasks.

Controls are easy to pick up. Each activity has its own button, so to eat, bathe, or receive medical care, you just click the button that matches. The game turns caring for a virtual dog into a playful lesson for young learners.
pirate-girls-treasure-hunting: Your job is to get a group of pirate girls ready for a treasure hunt. Each one needs an outfit, so you pick out fitting accessories and swords to complete her look. Dressing them up is the first part of the fun, and it sets the mood for the adventure ahead.

Once the crew is dressed, the hunt begins. You search the scene for the treasure chest, using magnifying glasses to spot where it is hidden. The game mixes dress-up and hidden object play, and everything is controlled with the mouse alone.
ambulance-simulator-2021: Ambulance Simulator 2021 is a driving simulation that puts you behind the wheel of an ambulance. You see the action from above, and the game is listed under racing, driving and simulator titles. It is also tagged for mobile play, so it suits anyone who likes vehicle sims on the go.

Getting started is simple. Use the W, A, S and D keys or the arrow keys to steer and move the ambulance. To try a different perspective, press the C key to change the camera view. Spend a few minutes getting a feel for how the vehicle responds, then switch between views to find the one you prefer.
chat-master: In Chat Master, you talk with a range of characters, and who you speak to depends on the scene. You might chat with a president who is cold on the outside but warm inside, a strict father, or a mischievous girlfriend. Your aim is to get through each dialogue successfully.

This puzzle uses point-and-click play and is aimed at younger players. To begin, just tap the screen. If a conversation doesn't go your way, the game shows what happens next, so each chat is a fresh challenge to finish well.
super-slime-black-hole: Step into the role of a slime hunter that devours everything in its path. Your slime works like a living black hole, pulling in anything smaller than itself. Each object you swallow helps it grow, and your aim is to keep eating and growing until you become the strongest slime around. The feel is similar to Hole.io, so fans of that style will recognize it right away.

Controls are easy to learn: just click and slide to move your slime. Gameplay runs smoothly and the actions stay simple, which makes this casual arcade title a relaxed pick for anyone who enjoys calm simulation games. Growth opportunities never run out, so there is always more to absorb as you level up.
hippo-manicure-salon-game: A hippo who has become a fashion star runs a nail salon in the city, and some of the most talented manicurists work there. Animals everywhere see the salon as their favorite style hub. Today you can learn how to give manicures alongside Hippo.

Pick from a range of nail polishes and stickers to decorate the critters, and you can even add henna tattoos for them. This arcade simulator is cute and animal-filled, with plenty of decorating and design fun. It is a sweet makeover experience full of creative choices.
panda-adventure-2026: Guide a panda through a platforming journey where running and leaping are the main moves. Gather bright coins, smash mysterious blocks, and dodge hazards on your way to the finish of every stage. The scenery shifts between vivid settings, and the game rewards precise timing, so the more you practice, the more treasure you can scoop up while the panda works through each test.
Controls are simple: use W, A, S, and D to move around, and click the left or right mouse button to attack. Pick up as many rewards as you can while keeping your panda safe from danger.
fish-lovers: Fish Lovers is a casual puzzle game built around pulling pins, a style that fans of the genre will recognize. Each stage offers a range of puzzles that depend on how fluids move and how different objects react to physics. Your goal is to save the fish from bombs, lava, and a crab, because the fish cannot live without each other.

To play, click a pin with your mouse to pull it out. You must pull the pins in the correct order to rescue the fish. Pleasant music, sound effects, and bright, colorful graphics accompany you through every puzzle in the game.
football-champs: Football Champs is a sports game featuring cute dogs that you control with a single button. Strike when the ball sits right on the crosshair, and use each kick to score goals. Your aim is to build the highest score you can before time runs out.

A 30 second time limit makes every move count. Precise kicks grant bonus time, while a miss costs you time as a penalty. Balance accuracy with quick play to keep the clock working for you and push your score higher.
the-puppy-paper-cut: Paper crafting meets cartoon fun in this girls' game. Your job is to follow the instructions, cutting out the cardboard pieces that make up each body part. Once they are cut, glue them together so the puppy takes shape, step by step.

Next comes the painting. With the puppy assembled, you get to pick the shades you love most and decorate the little dog however you like. The whole game is controlled with a mouse or by tapping, and its cute, silly style makes it a light, funny way to pass some time.
operation-thunderstrike: Operation Thunderstrike is a demo of a fast shooter, drawing inspiration from classic games such as Metal Slug, Heavy Weapon and Silkworm. You can pilot either a tank or a helicopter, and making good use of the upgrades you find along the way will help you reach the boss at the end of the level.

Tank pilots drive left and right, aim the turret up and down, fire bullets with V, launch cannon shots with C, and jump with X. Helicopter pilots use the arrow keys to move, shoot bullets with V, and fire cannons with C. The game can also be played on a touch screen device.
car-racing-and-burnout-drift: Torque Burnout mixes ideas from many different racing titles into one driving experience. You grip the wheel, press the gas, and throw your car into donuts and drifts with plenty of recklessness. Your aim is to earn the title of BURNOUT KING. That means tuning your car, pushing it until it nearly gives out, getting the spectators fired up, and then seeing how much more it can take.

The burnout effects look convincing, with thick smoke, tires that blow apart, and engines that glow with heat. You can choose from a large range of cars, each handling in its own way, and customize them to suit your style. The engine noises rumble loudly enough to send chills through you. Drive using the W, A, S, and D keys.
princess-easter-egg: This Easter, young artists can let their imagination shine in Princess Easter Egg. The game invites them to paint and decorate eggs using a palette of bright, lovely shades. Along the way, they will also find charming pictures of princesses to add to their designs. Decorating eggs has rarely been this enjoyable or easy to pick up.

Playing is simple: use your mouse or tap to play, depending on your device. The title sits in the Girls category and carries Cartoon, Coloring, Drawing, and Decorate tags, so it suits fans of art and holiday themes. Keep the focus on creativity and enjoy a cheerful session of painting and decorating.
princess-mermaid-coloring-game: This free coloring book features mermaid princesses from the ocean and offers more than 200 pages to color. Each design can be painted in different shades, including the hair and clothing. If you prefer, you can create your own picture or decorate one with stamps and stickers, and you can also add your own text.

Anyone who loves mermaids, whether an adult or a child, will enjoy painting these models. Using the full range of colors, you can give the characters a makeover by coloring their makeup and hair. Everything works with a tap or a click.
scary-monsters-coloring: Scary Monsters Coloring is a free browser game for kids and anyone who enjoys filling in pictures. Players work through eight different monster drawings and try to color each one as quickly as they can, since speed leads to a better final score. A selection of 23 colors is available, and once a picture is finished you can save a copy of it. It sits in the puzzle category and is built with HTML5, with mobile play included.
Control is simple: use your mouse on a computer, or tap the screen on a touch device.
ice-princess-beauty-salon: Spend time with the ice princess as you explore the magical winter world she calls home. In this makeover title, you get to practice inside a beauty salon, where princesses place their trust in you to carry out their transformations. Every change begins with a spa session before anything else happens.

Playing is simple, since a mouse click or a tap is all it takes. Use your mouse to work through each cooking step, then use it again to decorate a banana split. Along the way, you can keep practicing your salon skills.
barbarian-clash: In Barbarian Clash, you battle through a set of contests with rival warriors. These opponents want to take your soul and use it to become stronger. Stay alert to what is around you, since several enemies may come after you at once. Gather souls to grow more powerful, then use that strength to overcome them.

Boosts are there to help you out of rough moments, so use them when things get tough. As you advance through the arenas, you can buy new weapons that are stronger than the ones you have. You also decide which side you will join. Move your character with the W, A, S, and D keys, or use the left mouse button.
draw-brush-running: In this adventure, you guide a pen in the color you choose and work through a series of tests. Every obstacle you meet calls for a sensible route, and the path you draw can bend freely in any direction. Buildings, black holes, and other challenges will appear along the way, and you need to handle each one to keep moving smoothly.

Stay alert at all times, because obstacles can appear suddenly and may pop up straight ahead at any moment. As you play, your pen can also unlock new color skins to change how it looks. This 3D game suits players who enjoy drawing and working out their moves in a mind-focused way.
lightning-mcqueen-hidden: Lightning McQueen Hidden is a free online game that draws on memory and monster truck game styles. You flip tiles over and try to match them into pairs. You win once every tile is paired up, and the goal is to finish in as few moves as possible. The game has 4 levels to work through.

You can play with your mouse by clicking the squares, or by tapping the screen on a touch device. Concentrate and focus on where each picture appears, and keep track of the tiles you have already flipped. Start playing whenever you are ready.
angry-bird-blast: Angry Bird Blast is a free adventure game about slingshot and catapult shooting. You launch stones at bottles and knock them down in a physics-based setting. The game can be played offline, and its story follows a group of lost pirate kids. A sling king hero guides you toward becoming a catapult champion, with the goal of earning the title of the world's top arcade shooter through accurate shots and super power stones.

You control everything with the mouse. It is a single-player 2D game that mixes action and adventure, and it appeals to fans of bottle flip games. The game was recently updated for 2020, and it offers arcade-style shooting for anyone who enjoys breaking bottles.
jungle-bubble-shooter-mania: Shoot bubbles across a lush jungle backdrop in this classic arcade shooter, which is free to play. Your job is to combine three bubbles so they pop. Boosts and power-ups are there to help you along, and daily rewards give you something extra to claim. Cool bubble elements and more features add variety to each session.

Jungle Bubble Shooter Mania sits in the hypercasual category and carries arcade and casual tags. It takes the familiar bubble shooting formula and sets it in a jungle. The rules are easy to follow, so it suits players who want a straightforward shooter with a classic feel.
call-on-duty-sniper-assassin: Call On Duty Sniper Assassin is a 3D shooting game set in modern warfare, built around a battle simulator that aims for high accuracy. Players move through several missions, each asking them to complete a specific gun-based objective. Fighting moments mix in alongside the shooting, so gun battles and combat encounters both play a part.

Everything is controlled with the mouse, which keeps the setup simple. This HTML5 browser game leans into war, killing, and sniper-style action, so it suits anyone who enjoys precise targeting in military settings. Its blend of guns, missions, and fighting gives wartime duty a hands-on feel.
catwalk-battle: Walking a runway may look like an easy job, but real models train for a long time before they can walk with confidence. They must present beautiful clothes while keeping every step graceful. In this game, you play a professional fashion model who shows off a poised posture and new outfits on the catwalk. You decide which clothes she should wear, and with hard work you can grow into a qualified fashion model.

This 3D game is built with HTML and works on mobile devices as well as computers. You control it with your mouse or by tapping the screen. Its tags point to fashion, collecting, and girl-focused play, so it suits anyone curious about the world of modeling.
pga6-zombie-arena-3d-survival-2022: Step into a zombie survival shooter where you can equip a wide range of weapons and face the undead alone or with other players in multiplayer. Across numerous maps, you will battle Minecraft-style undead bots that keep coming. Your goal is to wipe out the zombies, and that stays true even when you are well armed, so the fights can get intense. To stay alive, duck behind the various objects scattered around each area, since cover is essential in this first-person shooter.
The controls are straightforward. Press W, A, S, and D to walk, move the mouse to aim and look around, click to shoot, and tap the Tab key to open the menu.
do-it-up: This 3D action game is all about moving upward. You explore a small town where you can run, jump, and walk your way higher. The main idea is to keep climbing, so every move should lift you a little further. If the scene around you ever feels confusing, the controls themselves are straightforward and easy to pick up.

Controls are intuitive. Tap space to jump, or press space twice to leap higher. Use W to move forward, S to go back, and A or D to step left or right. The arrow keys can also steer your character, so you can pick whichever set feels more comfortable.
phone-case-diy-2-casetify-game: Think you have a knack for art? This game can help you find out. A young girl needs a new phone case for her sister's party, and you are the designer. You can pick from lots of lovely colors, stickers, and phone case models to create the look you want. The game offers three different making processes, so you can try more than one approach.

Stencil art lets you spray many pretty patterns across the case, while Pop it adds its own playful twist to the process. Whatever color you spray and whichever process you choose, the finished case still looks nice. The game is controlled with a simple tap or click.
tanks-of-the-galaxy: Tanks of the Galaxy is a 2D top-down shooter built around tank battles. Your aim is to destroy enemy tanks with a variety of weapons while dodging their projectiles. Shields and the surrounding environment can help you outlast opponents. Coins earned along the way let you upgrade your tank and buy stronger weapons, then improve those too. The rules are simple, and the gameplay is hard to put down once you start.

Controls are easy to learn. Use W, A, S, D or the arrow keys to move, and press Space to switch weapons. Left-click to shoot, and move the mouse to aim. Your goal is to become the most devastating fighter in the tank war.
get-the-watermelon: Get The Watermelon is a bright, cartoon-style puzzle game built around fruit that joins together to form bigger fruit. Its 2D art is full of color. Runs never stop, so you can keep merging for as long as you like and work toward the highest score possible. Each fruit has to be combined in a set order, and you place the one you hold, along with the next one waiting in line, at the bottom of the screen. Larger fruits are worth more than the small ones you start with. You can see the next fruit before it drops, which makes the random arrivals easier to manage. Plan ahead for the merge spots beside the falling tracks.
Controls work the same way on PC and mobile. Swipe to aim, then release to let the fruit land.
msk-trial-dirt-bike-stunt: Dive into a free offline racing game built around bike stunts and fast cycling thrills. Take on new challenging tracks, race in a genuine Moto bike championship, and aim to be crowned champ of the 2021 bike games. Stunts that are out of reach in a regular open world become possible here, delivering a true riding feel. Crazy bike modifications and wild riders add even more variety.

Steer your bike with the arrow keys or WASD, tap Space for the handbrake, and press Shift to shift gears. Press C to switch camera views, R to reset the scene, G to reset your bikes, and E to turn on police lights. Tab opens the menu, and the Page Up and Page Down keys are included as well.
baby-taylor-home-organized: It is time to tackle the chores in Baby Taylor's house, which has become quite messy. The goal is to leave the room cleaner and more orderly, even though many of the tasks are still beyond Taylor's reach. Your job is to step in, sort out the home, and show Taylor how to tidy up. Once the cleaning starts, each mess you handle brings the place closer to being fresh and organized.

This cute, educational game is tagged with animals, dress-up, and cleaning themes, and it is aimed at girls. Helping a little one learn housekeeping habits makes for a gentle, friendly experience from start to finish.
mud-truck-driving: Mud Truck Driving is an off-road truck simulator where you take powerful vehicles over muddy tracks, rocky trails, and uneven ground. Haul heavy loads through woodland, up mountain routes, and along slick paths, keeping your truck steady as you go. Each delivery mission brings tough obstacles to clear, and new trucks become available the further you get in the game.

Every route puts your driving to the test, thanks to realistic physics and terrain that can behave unexpectedly. The 3D graphics look good, the controls respond smoothly, and the off-road action keeps things lively. It is a strong pick for anyone who loves driving trucks. To drive and steer, use W, A, S, and D or the arrow keys.
shoot-your-nightmare-wake-up: You agreed to join a study on controlling dreams, but every night your sleep turns into a nightmare. The only way to end them is to face what lies inside. Along the way you search for clues, battle the enemies that appear, and work toward bringing the experiment to a close.

Mouse 1 fires your weapon, and Mouse 2 aims while also blocking. Move with W, A, S, and D, and hold Left Shift to sprint. Press Left Ctrl to crouch and X to go prone, with Space to jump. Use F for items, R to reload, H to holster your weapon, and G to throw a grenade. V performs a melee attack, and Esc or Tab pauses the game.
shifted-realms: Shifting between forms is the core of this game, and each shape helps you clear a different kind of obstacle on the way to the finish. As a person, you can climb stairs. As a car, you can race across roads. As an airplane, you can soar over wide gaps. Timing matters, because changing form at exactly the right moment is how you outpace your rivals and conquer each challenge.

The pace is quick, and the levels are creative, so every stage asks you to think about which form fits the path ahead. Everything is played with your mouse, which keeps the focus on reading the course and deciding when to transform. It is a fun, fast-moving adventure that mixes racing with clever form changes.
super-cario-world: Step into Super Cario World, a platform game built around a rescue mission. A terrible monster has trapped the princess inside a magic bubble, and it is up to you to set her free. Along the way, you must defeat the monsters you meet, dodge obstacles, and push forward until you reach the final boss.

Gold coins that you collect along the path bring various rewards, so keep an eye out for them. Drinking a magic potion gives you powerful strength for a while. Defeat the dragon to rescue the princess. The game features pixel-style graphics in HD quality and a shocking sound design, and it works as an adventure from start to finish. Move with the arrow keys and press the space key to jump.
halloween-cooking: Halloween Cooking is a fast-paced time management game set in Halloween Cooking City. You run a canteen where hungry customers come in asking for Halloween treats. Each recipe calls for a long list of ingredients, so you must gather and prepare everything quickly to keep up with the rush.

You play as the chef of a food truck, and every customer wants something different. Use your mouse or tap the screen as fast as you can to move through each order. Serve every guest well and show that you have what it takes to become the top chef in this Halloween chef game.
blocky-combat-swat-zombie-apocalypse-202: Blocky Combat: Swat Zombie Apocalypse 2022 gives you a range of tools as you lead an army of ghost robots. Your forces have been fighting for a long time, across several Minecraft universes, and the battle is far from over. You know how dangerous the living dead can be, but the obstacles ahead are much greater. Ducking behind cover during firefights makes every clash feel more thrilling, as it does in the best arcade shooters.

Mobile players can vote for the best nickname to use. An inventory image lists all of your gear, including your rifles, and like many first-person shooters, your character typically carries weapons. Walk with W, A, S and D
red-hair-knight-tale: Red Hair Knight Tale is a 2D adventure set in a medieval world, where you play as a swordsman. Each stage asks you to defeat monsters and make your way to the brown flag that marks its end. Gold coins raise your overall score, though they serve no other purpose in the game. You can find them inside chests or on the bodies of fallen monsters. To reach higher platforms you must jump twice, and you need to race to the finish flag before the monsters can take you down.
On a computer, use A and D or the Left and Right arrow keys to move, Space to jump, and J to attack. On mobile, simply tap the buttons on the screen to control your knight.
demolition-monster-truck-army-2020: Take the wheel of an army-style monster truck built for demolition in this racing game. A new truck model arrives alongside fresh wheels and a range of environments that invite stunts. Smashing through the scenery is a big part of the action, and every crash adds to the chaos on screen.

As you play, you can upgrade your vehicle with better wheels, switch to a brand new car, and add nitro or other more powerful parts. Steer with W, A, S, and D or the arrow keys, and press Space to brake.
stick-soccer-3d: Stick Soccer 3D takes football in a fresh direction. You can pick from several teams, try out different match strategies, and play across a range of stadiums. The game supports both single-player and two-player matches. Speed mode is available for quick games, and there is also a free-play option with no limits. If you win every match in the tournament, you earn the cup. To shoot, left-click a player when it is your turn, drag your mouse to aim, and release to kick.
offroad-truck-driving-game: Climb into the cab of a powerful cargo truck and head out over rough ground and winding mountain roads. Your heavy loads must travel through forests, muddy trails, rocky paths, and steep hills while you keep the vehicle under control. Finish delivery missions to earn rewards, then use them to unlock new trucks and routes.

Every trip tests your driving skills, precision, and balance. The game uses realistic physics and immersive 3D environments, and its controls feel smooth. Press W, A, S, and D or the arrow keys to drive and steer the truck.
mini-tennis-club: Mini Tennis Club drops you into a 3D tennis match built around quick, smooth rallies. You can practice first and then enter a tournament. The basics are simple to pick up, but mastering every move takes time. It is a light, casual game where you face other players one after another, aiming to beat them all. Winning matches lets you unlock new characters.

You can play solo or with a second player. Everything is controlled with the mouse or with touch, so you can start swinging right away. It makes a relaxed way to pass a few minutes on the court while you work on your timing.
baby-taylor-healthy-life: Baby Taylor is a young girl who spends the day playing outside with her friend Tom in the garden. On the way home, a sudden rain shower soaks them, and Taylor arrives with muddy, wet clothes and no umbrella to keep her dry. Her next steps are a bath and a fresh outfit, and it is up to you to lend a hand. Your job is to make sure she washes herself thoroughly and ends up cheerful and content during bath time.

The game teaches simple healthy habits through hands-on play. You control everything with a mouse click or a tap, so it is easy to pick up for younger players. Along the way you will see how cleaning up and changing clothes after getting dirty can help a person stay well.
low-poly-car-racing: Low poly car racing puts you behind the wheel of blocky, three-dimensional cars. You can race alone in a one-player game or challenge a friend in a two-player split-screen match on the same computer or laptop. Before choosing one of the three game modes, you can change your car's color. Earning points lets you buy new cars.

You can also build your own track and store it in one of three save slots, then play it solo or with a partner. Player one steers with WASD, while player two uses the arrow keys. A single button on the screen leads to more games.
happy-birthday-party-with-baby-panda: Plan your own birthday celebration in this game and take charge of every detail. You choose the style of the tablecloth, the tableware, the cake, and the snacks and drinks on the table. The party scene feels like a real gathering, and its warm, cheerful mood invites you and your friends to join a big celebration with kiki, the little panda, and his pals. Delicious cream cakes and cute donuts are waiting for you, and plenty of special gifts are there to find too.

Made for babies and children, the game offers bright, colorful scenes and plenty of cute animals to play with. Simply tap on them to see what happens next. Tap or click is all it takes, so even the youngest players can have fun with kiki and all of his friends.
jail-breaker: Breaking out of a jail is a risky business, and this puzzle asks you to help a boy slip out of prison smoothly. As the prompts appear, you choose the correct items to match them. Your brain gets a workout as you work out which object fits each step.
This 2D puzzle game is built with HTML5 and suits young players who like to use their brains.
brain-test-tricky-puzzles: Brain Test Tricky Puzzles is a two-dimensional quiz game made for young players who like a good mental workout. Each round asks simple questions about math, matching, spotting differences, and other kinds of puzzles, all against a limited clock. Every challenge has clear, specific goals, so you always know what you need to do. If you get stuck, a hint button is there to point you in the right direction.
The game includes 102 levels to work through, and it is designed to challenge your brain while keeping things fun. To play, simply tap the blue buttons.
police-transport-game: This adventure puts you behind the wheel of a car carrier truck, where your job is to move police vehicles safely through the city. Load each police car onto the trailer, then drive it to its destination as you complete transport missions. Weave through crowded streets, dodge other traffic, and treat every load with care and accuracy. As you advance, you can unlock new trucks, carry more vehicles at once, and tackle increasingly difficult levels.

The game features realistic driving physics, detailed 3D graphics, and smooth gameplay, making it a good fit for fans of truck driving and transport simulation. To drive and steer, use the W, A, S, and D keys or the arrow keys.
road-fixer: Road Fixer is a 3D logic puzzle where your job is to clear the path so a car can reach the end of the road. Across several dozen levels, each one brings its own mix of obstacles, and you will need to think strategically and solve problems to get through them. The game also features a wide range of obstacles blocking the car's route.

You operate everything with your mouse or by tapping. Levers and obstacles are matched by color, so pay attention to which lever controls which barrier. The orange twister turns left or right, the blue button has to be pressed and held, and the green stick slides left or right. The attractive visuals make every trip down the road easy to enjoy.
happy-bath: In Happy Bath, you can work through a set cleaning routine one step at a time, or ignore any fixed order and jump between tasks however you like. Either way, young players decide what they want to do and when. The game leaves plenty of room for them to make their own choices as they go.
Parents are encouraged to join in and play together with their children. The game is easy to control, since you only need a mouse or a tap to play.
president-simulator: President Simulator is a clicker game in which you take on the role of a president, and your job is to keep the economy healthy. Plan out your approach, pick up new items, improve your own abilities, and keep clicking to earn money.

Everything is controlled with the left mouse button. Each click helps build your funds, so the faster you click and the smarter you spend, the better your chances of pulling the nation's finances back on track. The game also lists tags such as one player, two player, pixel, strategy, and funny, which hint at the variety of styles you can enjoy.
rainbow-ice-cream-and-popsicles-icy-dess: Rainbow Ice Cream & Popsicles - Frozen Dessert Maker is a cooking game for anyone who enjoys making sweets. It brings together six different games in one place: scoop ice cream, make ice pops, whip up soft serve, assemble ice cream sandwiches, build ice cream bars, and prepare quick popsicles. You play by tapping or clicking.

If you are a fan of frozen treats, ice cream trucks, or dessert recipes, this collection has a lot to keep you busy. Each mode offers a different way to create a frozen dessert, so there is plenty of variety for anyone who likes cooking and dessert-making games.
tiny-fishing: Tiny Fishing is a puzzle game about casting a line and reeling in a catch. You start by clicking a spinner to choose how far your hook will travel. Once it's in the water, press and drag to move the hook from side to side and snag fish along the way. When the line breaks the surface, you collect cash for every fish you landed.
Between casts, you can spend that cash on better skills and new hooks. A handy tip is that your earnings keep building up even when you're no longer playing the game.
taxi-parking-driving: Taxi Parking Driving is a realistic driving simulator focused on parking and finding your way around town. You collect passengers, weave through crowded city roads, and stop your cab exactly on the marked spots while avoiding walls, objects, and other cars. Missions give you rewards, and as levels get harder you can unlock additional taxis. Tight corners and traffic laws are part of the challenge, and the goal is to become the best cab driver in the city.
The game offers smooth handling, detailed 3D surroundings, and an absorbing feel that makes each trip enjoyable. To drive and steer, use W, A, S, and D or the arrow keys.
baby-tiger-care: Meet Lili, a very sweet baby tiger who can become your own little pocket pet. Your job is to look after her: give her a bath, choose outfits for her, feed her, play games together, and make crafts. Remember that she is still a young cub, so she will need plenty of rest between activities.

The game is played with a mouse or by tapping the screen. Tags for this title include animals, cleaning, cooking, decorating, dress up, and educational play, so it suits players who enjoy caring for a pet in a gentle, hands-on way.
trials-ice-ride: Take a motorbike across an icy outdoor trials course filled with tricky obstacles. Your job is to keep the bike upright and avoid tumbling off. Finish the course as quickly as you can to earn higher scores and open up a range of achievements. On a computer, use the arrow keys or W, A, S, and D to steer the motorcycle. On a phone or tablet, tap the on-screen buttons to ride and balance the bike.
chikis-chase: Chikis Chase is a casual game in the clicker category. You guide a small character that tries to survive as long as it can and build the best score possible. Your job is to keep your little hero clear of hazards while helping a brave bird reach its new home. Timing matters, so jump at the right mo
hero-of-archery-games: In this archery adventure, you play the Lone Archer, the one fighter standing against endless hordes of evil creatures that keep coming in waves. Each wave is relentless and never stops, so you must build up your abilities and fight hard to stay alive. Watch out, because a single death sends you back to the very beginning.

Mix and match a wide range of skills, many of them random, to shape how you handle each battle. Travel through lovely, varied worlds with hundreds of maps, facing thousands of monsters and tricky obstacles you have never seen before. As you gain levels, you can equip stronger gear to raise your stats. Everything is controlled with your mouse.
tower-defense: Monsters swarm toward your realm in large numbers, and you must raise defenses quickly to survive every wave. Plain arrows and rocks may fall short, so bring in elemental forces to gain the upper hand and wipe out the attackers.

Place towers on any open ground and they will fire on foes that come close to them. Mix different tower types with elements to see which combinations work for you. When the pressure mounts, cast spells and push your towers to their highest upgrade level.
stickman-merge-battle-arena: This merge strategy title challenges you to outmaneuver the red stickman invaders. Assemble a force of stickmen, arrange your troops carefully, and take down every boss along the way. Only a tiny share of players, under one percent, manage to unlock the full roster of stickmen and finish the game. The game uses 3D stickmen, each stage is tougher than the last, and a boss appears every ten levels.
Controls stay simple. Use the sword-and-arrow button to recruit units and the tile button to add new tiles. Drag units from one tile to another
oil-tanker-game: Oil Tanker puts you in control of a heavy fuel truck in a lifelike driving game. Your job is to haul oil across highways, through busy city streets, and over rough off-road tracks. Each delivery mission asks you to take sharp corners, dodge other vehicles, and drive with care to keep your cargo secure.

Complete runs to earn rewards and use them to unlock new trucks. The routes become harder as you go, which gives your driving skills plenty of practice. The game uses detailed 3D environments and smooth controls. Press W, A, S, D or the arrow keys to drive and steer the tanker.
stacky-run: Stacky Run is a relaxed 3D hypercasual title with simple design, so you can open it and play whenever you have a spare moment. Along the way, you pick up bricks and diamonds scattered across the platforms. The bricks matter most, since they are what you use to build bridges over the gaps between islands. Your aim is to make it to the end in one piece.
Movement is simple: slide or drag across the screen to get where you need to go. The controls are quick to learn, which makes the game easy to pick up for short breaks.
ramp-car-game: Ramp Car Game is a 3D driving adventure built around jumps and tricks. You race over huge ramps, soar through the air, and weave past dangerous obstacles while completing stunt challenges. The sports cars are fast, and the tracks throw moving barriers, loops, and blasts of explosions at you along the way.

Each stage asks for careful timing, accuracy, and steady handling so you can reach the finish. The physics feel lifelike and the controls respond smoothly, which keeps the stunt action flowing. Steer and drive with W, A, S, and D, or use the arrow keys.
stacklands: Stacklands blends card play with city building in a fresh way. Every person, plant, and resource in the game is shown as a card that you stack on top of others to make things happen. Place a Villager card onto a Berry Shrub and the villager starts gathering berries on its own. Then drag those berries over to the Villager to keep them fed. The game offers a large number of quests and plenty of unusual mechanics to explore.

To play, drag cards around the board, or tap to move them. Your job is to combine cards, manage your little settlement, and work through the challenges as you dig deeper into what the game has to offer.
rescue-pins: Two friends are looking forward to a joyful reunion after a long separation. Their path, however, is crowded with obstacles. Players use a variety of tools to take out the villains blocking the way, so the pair can finally meet their loved one. Each stage asks you to think carefully and solve the challenges with your wits.

Rescue Pins is a 2D puzzle adventure with a simple core: remove the pins in the correct order to bring the two boys together. The challenges grow tougher as you move through the stages, so your planning has to keep up with the rising difficulty.
wormeat-io: Wormeat.io is a multiplayer action game where you steer a worm through a shared arena alongside other players. Crashing your head into someone else's body ends your run right away, so every turn needs care. The reverse is also true: when rivals collide with your worm, they burst apart, and you are free to feast on what they leave behind.

Guiding your creature is simple. Move the mouse to change the worm's heading, and hold the space bar when you want a burst of extra speed. It runs in the browser with HTML5 and is also listed for mobile play.
offroad-4x4-heavy-drive: Take the wheel of a heavy four-wheel-drive off-road truck and head out along the trails of a forest. This action game puts your driving skills to the test as you push through rough, uneven ground.

Your mission is to win every level and prove you are the best driver. Steering and movement are handled entirely with the W, A, S and D keys. Made with Unity and WebGL, it runs right in your browser. Enjoy the drive.
crazy-bubble-breaker: Crazy Bubble Breaker is a two-dimensional physics puzzle game built around shooting. Your task is to clear every bubble on the screen by sending falling balls into them. A guide line lets you aim each shot before you release the ball. Walls can be used too, so you can bounce a ball off them to reach bubbles you could not hit directly and take out several targets with one shot.

The game offers dozens of levels to work through. Each one calls for careful thinking, and your real goal is to finish every stage using as few balls as possible. On both PC and mobile, you tap and hold to set the ball in place, then let go to fire it.
blocky-warfare-the-aweper-zombie: Blocky Warfare the Aweper Zombie is a multiplayer shooter where you face real players from around the world. Its 24 guns are ready for you to try, and each weapon can be fitted with its own attachments. The action takes place on high-quality blocky maps and pixelated maps, including an icy pixel world with eye-catching effects.

Move with WASD and use the mouse to look around, aim, and shoot. Press SPACE to jump, SHIFT to run, and Left Ctrl to go prone. Q changes your camo, and TAB opens the menu. Switching guns is also part of the controls during a match.
santa-fright-night: Santa has to track down every missing gift, and the physics engine shapes how he gets there. You move, jump, and rotate him through each puzzle, so every motion matters. This Christmas-themed puzzle adventure rewards careful thinking about where and how he moves.

Controls are simple. Press the Left arrow or A to rotate Santa left, and the Right arrow or D to rotate him right. Press the Up arrow or W to make him jump. The listing also tags the game for family play, magic, snow, and mobile devices, and it is built with HTML.
cube-surfer-online: Cube Surfer Online is a playful 3D runner that drops you onto a track filled with hazards and loose squares. Your character can jump, and by jumping you can stack two cubes on top of each other. The controls are simple: just slide across the screen to dodge obstacles and steer toward the finish line with smooth, flexible movement.

Think about how far you can get through the stages of this arcade title. It is a single-player game built for the browser, with a fun, lighthearted look and a 3D style. Give it a try and see how many levels you can clear.
xtreme-paintball-war-2022: Xtreme Paintball War 2022 is a shooting game that gives you a selection of powerful guns and other weapons. You battle a crowd of ghost bots across landscapes modeled on Minecraft. Zombies also join the fight and can be tough to handle, so you have to stay alert. Ducking behind cover is a useful tactic here, and the main character is usually armed.
