Controls are straightforward. Use W, A, S and D to walk, move the mouse to aim and look around, and use the mouse to shoot. Press Tab to open the menu and the space bar to jump. The game is built with Unity3D for WebGL and is tagged for multiplayer play.
dead-city-zombie-invasion-2023: Dead City Zombie Invasion 2023 is an action-adventure shooter where you play as a heavily armed survivor. Your mission is to wipe out the crowds of zombies that have overrun a city. Staying alert is essential if you hope to last against the undead.

Getting around is simple, since you just tap the spot on the screen you want to reach. When you feel like blasting some zombies, line up your shots carefully and aim at each foe. To start, click or tap with your mouse or finger.
cheese-cake-homemade-cooking: Here is a new cooking challenge where you learn how a homemade cheesecake comes together, including which ingredients belong in it. Start by picking what you need from a list, then pay for the items and head into the kitchen. Before anything else, you clean the space, then use some of the products you bought. Next, you bake the cake. The final step lets you top it off with tasty fruit and other decorative touches.

Everything is controlled with the mouse, so each stage, from the shopping to the finished dessert, is handled with simple clicks. The game is tagged as a cooking title, and it moves through the process one step at a time.
monster-truck-sky-racing: Take the wheel of a monster truck in this driving title, where computer-controlled rivals challenge you on tracks suspended high in the sky. Each course you complete pays out cash, so every win adds to your funds. The game features 10 different trucks and 12 distinctive racing zones to tackle.
Movement is handled with the arrow keys. For an extra burst, press Shift to activate NOS. The game includes 16 language translations, so you can read everything in the one that suits you best.
kitten-hide-and-seek: Kitten Hide And Seek is a free online puzzle game built around hide-and-seek, made with boys in mind. You guide a little girl who needs to slip away without getting caught by the kitten that is searching for her, all while collecting the props she needs along the way. The game has a 3D look, a cartoon style, and a brain-teasing, escape-style feel.

This one is made for fans of Tamagotchi or green light red light. When you beat a level, you earn props that you can use to decorate your room, so each win adds to your space. It is also available on Android. Controls are simple: use your mouse or tap the screen to play.
car-stunt-raching: Car Stunt Racing challenges you to speed through a series of different tracks while pulling off daring jumps and tricks. Expect sharp bends, springboards, swinging hammers to avoid, and loops to drive through, along with other tough car stunts. Sliding the car around tight corners is part of the fun, and you will need to get a feel for how the vehicle really handles to master every obstacle. Coins earned by finishing a track can go toward improving your car or unlocking another course.

Controls use the arrow keys: left and right to steer, up for gas, down for the brake, and C to switch the camera. If you prefer the mouse, move it left and right to steer, press the left button for gas, and press the right button for the brake.
excavator-simulator-3d: Operate lifelike 3D construction machines in this excavator game, a JCB-style engineering simulation. You pick from a selection of trucks, excavators, and pincer jaws, then take on different missions and jobs. Each task might call for digging, clamping, lifting, hammering, or forklifting, and swapping attachments is quick and simple. Realistic physics and graphics make the heavy equipment feel true to life.

Finishing levels faster earns more money for new vehicles and fresh challenges. On a PC, use W to go forward or accelerate, S to brake or reverse, A to turn left, and D to turn right. The left wheel rotates the mechanical arm, while the right wheel accelerates it. On mobile, hold the arrows to steer, hold the pedals to drive forward or back, and swipe the wheels to speed up.
moto-techmique: This single-player racer puts you on a motorcycle in fast, demanding races. Your focus has to stay sharp, since the bike must remain on the course at all times and never wander off the track. Pay attention to how your machine responds, because learning its handling is part of the challenge. Over time you grow comfortable with the bike until rider and machine feel like one unit.

Each race plays differently, so your skills need steady refinement to solve new problems. Steer with the left and right arrow keys and press the up arrow to move forward. For a brief speed boost, click the acceleration pack on the right.
blocky-adventures: Blocky Adventures is a quick platformer where every jump matters. You guide a small block hero through 50 levels spread across five worlds, ranging from icy caverns to blazing volcanoes. A secret mega-level waits for the boldest players. Collect energy orbs along the way, avoid patrolling and flying enemies, and race the clock in Speedrun mode.

Move with the arrow keys or A and D, jump with Space, W, or Up Arrow, and dash with X or Shift. Press jump again in mid-air to double jump, or slide down a wall and then jump to climb it. On mobile, on-screen buttons handle moving left and right, jumping, and dashing. Gamepad is also listed as a control option.
trial-extreme-parkour: Race through more than 40 levels on a dirt bike, aiming for the quickest finish times you can manage. Pull off wild stunts and grab stars along the way. Physics shape how your bike handles, so every jump and rough patch feels real, and the courses are packed with obstacles. Each run can be restarted whenever you want to chase a new record.

Gold you earn in the game lets you upgrade your motocross machine. To unlock new bikes, including motocross and BMX models, you need to perform as many somersaults as you can during levels, which takes serious skill. Over 50 more episodes are on the way, and the goal across every level is to post the highest score possible. Control your rider with WASD or the arrow keys.
zappy: Zappy is a two-dimensional puzzle game in which a smart robot has to carry a mysterious box safely to its goal. Each level is packed with obstacles to get around, dangerous traps to dodge, and enemies you need to outwit before you can finish. Success depends on careful planning and precise steps. The levels are inventive and the controls feel responsive, making it a good pick for people who enjoy thinking through problems.
Players steer the robot with W, A, S, and D or with the arrow keys. Pressing Space or E picks
kawaii-coloring-book-glitter-drawing-boo: Kawaii Coloring Book Glitter offers a set of cute kawaii coloring pages that you can fill with glitter color. It is made for kids, teens, and adults, so people of many ages can enjoy drawing and coloring with it. It fits anyone looking for a casual drawing book, whether they are a boy or a girl.

The controls are simple: tap or click to work on the pictures. Glitter color gives each kawaii page a sparkly finish, making the artwork stand out. It is a cheerful choice for anyone who likes to draw and color in a playful style.
bike-stunts-2023: Bike Stunts 2023 is a racing game built around motocross stunt contests that are hard to look away from. You take control of a daring rider and a jumping stunt machine as you tackle tracks full of zigzag turns and routes that seem impossible to cross. Each course asks you to keep your bike steady on narrow lanes, slanted paths, steep drops, and winding curves, and it takes real skill to get through them.

Your rider can be launched high into the sky, over clouds and across ground set at several different heights. Every run puts your life at risk, yet completing the complex stunt tasks is the goal. Drive with the W, A, S and D keys, and on mobile devices use the button in the game
dream-wedding-planner: Step into a wedding-planning simulation built for kids and girls who love weddings. You work with four characters and handle six parts of their big day, including the dress, the cake, the flowers, and more. Each step comes with various tools, so you can shape every look in your own style.

The pink arrow at the top lets you skip the current scene. After each step, you can print the screen and change your plan whenever you wish. Every character can have a different design plan, so each one gets a sweet wedding. On PC and mobile, tap to select, and drag to move items or tools.
hide-yellow-monster-survivor: In this action game, your goal is to slip away from a multicolored monster and make sure it never catches you. You must gather a variety of items and carry them back to the safe haven. The clock keeps ticking, so you need to finish before time runs out.
Move with the W, A, S, and D keys, and press the spacebar to jump. Press TAB to open the menu. Keep an eye on the monster's position while you search for items, and plan your route back to safety.
super-car-driving-2-simulator-3d: Super Car Driving 2 Simulator 3D puts you behind the wheel of a sports car in a driving simulator powered by an advanced physics engine. Take the car out to drift, feel every movement of a racing machine, and see how it handles at speed. The action unfolds across a large open world city where you can roam freely. Traffic and rival vehicles never force you to brake, so you can attempt daring stunts and hold full speed without police chasing you. Burnouts and fast drifts are the heart of the fun, and you can tear up the asphalt of the city as much as you want.
All of the driving is handled with keyboard controls.
paddle: Paddle is a relaxed puzzle game set in a large-scale scene with a range of styles. Its color matching gives it a fresh look, and the water park setting hosts big water battles. The intense large-scale battle mode tests your reactions and quick hands, and the game is built to stir up plenty of passion in its players.

Players from around the world meet on shared online servers to compete. It works as a classic IO casual game with magical level-breaking play, and several online competition modes offer both an airborne and an underground experience. You control your character and dash toward the end.
miami-car-racing: Miami Car Racing puts you on a 3D track laid out across the streets of Miami. Your goal is to complete three laps and be the first to reach the finish line. The most fun comes from playing with a friend, since the game lets two people race against each other on the same course.

Player one steers with the arrow keys, looks around with J, K and L, boosts with N, and resets the car with P. Space works as the handbrake. Player two drives with W, A, S and D, changes the camera with C, V and B, boosts with F, resets with TAB, and uses Left Shift as the handbrake.
tower-stack-slip: Tower Stack Slip is a 3D arcade casual game with a light, easygoing pace. You guide your little people and collect bricks that match your own color. Touching a brick of a different color costs you a brick from your tower, so every move matters. The higher your pile climbs, the bigger your score becomes.
Controls are simple: slide across the screen to play. Keep an eye on the colors around you as the stack grows, since one mismatched brick can knock a pi
cap-opener: Cap Opener is a quick-moving mobile title that blends adventure with strategy. You travel through a playful, dreamlike world, moving from one stage to the next while working to unlock an assortment of enchanted bottles. Every bottle throws its own obstacles and puzzles at you, so you need sharp thinking to get each one open.

Along the way you can gather special tools and power-ups that strengthen your abilities, helping you handle puzzles that grow more demanding as you advance. The bright, colourful visuals and easy-to-learn controls make it simple to jump in, and the difficulty climbs steadily. To play, just click the mouse or tap the screen.
city-live-bus-simulator-2021: City Live Bus Simulator 2021 puts you in the driver's seat of a bus in a bus simulator built around a series of missions. Your job is to complete every one of them and earn the title of top driver. The game sits in the action category and runs in the browser through WebGL, made with Unity3D.
Driving is controlled with the W, A, S and D keys. Your goal is to finish all the missions and show that you are the best bus driver in the game.
machine-gun-squad: Machine Gun Squad puts you in the role of a brave soldier on a dangerous mission. Your goal is to take out the head of a terrorist group, but he is surrounded by many enemies carrying all kinds of weapons. Supply drops will arrive by airdrop with powerful weapons to help you push through.
This 3D shooting game features bombs and fire alongside its guns. To shoot, simply drag across the screen. It is built with HTML5, so it runs right in your browser.
spill-wine: Spill Wine is a free online game for boys that is all about smashing things. In each level, you throw a limited number of cute balls at the glass, and you must break it all to win. Because your supply of balls is limited, every throw counts.

The controls are simple: use your mouse or tap the screen to play. The 3D visuals come with relaxed, cheerful background music that keeps the mood light. The game runs in HTML5 and works on Android too. Keep working through the challenges and see how far your skills can take you.
ball-puzzle: Give your brain a workout and sharpen your thinking with this straightforward puzzler. Its core idea is an old favorite, but it arrives with a fresh, tougher spin that keeps things interesting. Your job is to slide the tiles around until they form a route the ball can roll along. Try to finish each stage using as few moves as you can. Some tiles are made of iron and stay fixed in place, so plan around them. When you get stuck, you can take back your last move or ask for a hint. With 240 levels spanning Beginner through Expert, there is plenty here to keep you busy for hours.
my-little-car-wash: My Little Car Wash is a cheerful 2D cartoon game where you clean up a range of vehicles. No prior experience is needed. Just follow the on-screen hints and use the tools to bring each ride back to a fresh look. There are 22 vehicles to work on, and each one arrives covered in its own dirt and stains.

Drivers keep an eye on you as you work, so you need to be quick and efficient. Every car you wash earns you yellow stars, and you'll need those stars to unlock more vehicles. Along the way, the game teaches you useful washing skills while keeping things fun. It works on both PC and mobile, and you control it by tapping and dragging.
hole-io: Hole IO is a casual competitive game where you control a void hole that grows by devouring a city. Each object you swallow makes your hole larger, so the aim is to keep feeding it and get as big as you can. It is filed under adventure and arcade, and it carries the kids tag as well as the .io games label.

Everything works with the mouse, so there are no other controls to learn. Move the pointer to steer your hole through the streets and head toward whatever comes next. Because it is a competitive title, you are playing against others who are also trying to grow, which keeps each round lively. It is a simple, easy-to-start pick when you want something light to play.
girl-game-organizing-fun: This puzzle game blends sticker matching with tidying up a cozy room and finishing cleaning tasks. Its sticker challenges use creative matching puzzle gameplay, and the whole journey is designed to feel relaxing from the very first stage onward. You move from one part to the next, so the sticker puzzles, room organizing, and cleaning jobs all fit into a single experience.

The title is aimed at girls and kids, and it carries relaxation and simulation tags as well. To play, simply click with a mouse or tap the screen, which makes it easy to pick up and enjoy at your own speed.
angry-goat-revenge-html5: Step into the hooves of a furious goat roaming a lively, open city. You can tap into untamed goat skills to ram enemies head-first and fling them away with powerful goat moves. Charging through the streets as a true goat, you leap and cause chaos wherever you go.
Move with W, A, S and D, press SPACE to jump, and hit the left mouse button to attack. TAB opens the menu. On mobile browsers, the on-screen buttons handle the same actions.
paper-stick-figures: Paper Stick Figures is a tower defense game set on a notebook page, where every unit looks like it was sketched by hand. Your job is to guard a paper base against waves of enemy stick figures. You can deploy stick soldiers, tanks, aircraft, and heavy weapons to push back each attack. Every level fills the battlefield with missiles, explosions, and tactical upgrades, so things can get chaotic fast.

Earn coins as you play and use them to strengthen your base, improve your troops, and collect rewards. Timing matters, since you need to place your units wisely and stop enemies before they break through your defenses. Each wave tests how well you use your firepower. It is a single-player game with a 2D look.
perfect-slices-master: Chop vegetables into small pieces and turn them into a bowl of soup. You steer a knife through each veggie and make every cut yourself. As you go, watch for chopping boards and other sharp boards that appear and dull your blade, so stay alert. Coins are earned while you slice.

Spend those coins at the shop, where you can pick up different kinds of knives to try. The shopping experience feels satisfying, and seeing your chopped veggies turn into soup is part of the fun. To play, simply slice.
army-sniper: Army Sniper is a 2D sniper shooter that pairs colorful visuals with entertaining gameplay. You take aim as a sharpshooter and line up each shot carefully. The game is built for mobile, so you can pick it up on a phone or tablet and enjoy a solid sniping session.

To fire, simply tap the screen. Each tap releases a shot, so timing and precision are what matter most. Whether you're in the mood for a quick round or a longer run of targets, the controls stay easy to learn and quick to use.
stickman-escape-parkour: In this stickman running game, scientists in a lab have created racers with special abilities, built for running races. Your job is to help these runners escape the laboratory. Along the way you will meet many difficult obstacles, and you must master them to reach the portal.

Up to four players can take part at the same time, each with their own controls: W for player one, SPACE for player two, M for player three, and the UP ARROW for player four. It falls under action and adventure, with a strong focus on running, so timing your moves carefully will help you get through each challenge.
merge-rainbow-friend: Merge Rainbow Friend is a puzzle game where you combine rainbow monsters to make them stronger. Each merge helps you sharpen your fighting skills, which you will need when you face enemies in battles where survival is at stake. Win those fights and you can earn the title of Merge Master champion.

The battles are tough, and matching monsters and building your skills both matter along the way. The game suits players who enjoy brain-training challenges, including younger players. Controls are simple: tap to play, which makes it easy to pick up on a mobile device.
hungry-shark-arena: Dive into an online multiplayer battle beneath the waves, where every shark is fighting for dominance. Your task is to hunt and expand your shark until it becomes the largest predator in the sea. Take down rival players along the way, and work to hold your place at the top of the food chain.

The arena is a harsh underwater place full of dangers, so you must survive as well as grow. This .io title blends arcade and adventure elements into a contest for supremacy. Keep hunting, keep growing, and see how long your shark can last.
dolly-wants-to-play: Step into a deserted toy factory and hunt for six cute animal toys before you can find the exit. The job is harder than it sounds, because the place is crawling with evil toys that have come alive with one goal: to destroy you. Wish yourself luck.

Move with W, A, S and D, and turn your view with the mouse. Fire with the left mouse button, aim down the sights with the right, and scroll the wheel to swap weapons. Press G to toss a grenade, R to reload and F to pick things up. Hold Left Shift to run, Left Ctrl to crouch, X to go prone and Space to jump.
dress-makeover: Dress Makeover is a styling game built around fashion and creative makeovers. You choose dresses, everyday outfits, makeup, hairstyles, jewelry, and shoes to build the look you want. Mix and match different styles, finish makeover tasks, and turn each model into a standout fashion figure. Whether your taste leans toward princess gowns, relaxed clothing, or luxury fashion, there is plenty to explore for players of every age.
Everything is controlled with a mouse click or a tap, so you can start dressing up your models right away. Keep trying new combinations to see how many different looks you can create.
killer-santa: Killer Santa is a 3D action-adventure shooter that puts Santa in the role of a super cop. His job is to take out bad people, and you get to find out whether he can pull it off. It sits in the shooting category and is a good pick for fans of shoot 'em up games.

The controls work like this. The arrow keys move Santa around, the left mouse button fires his gun, and the right mouse button throws a grenade. Switching between gunfire and grenades gives you some control over how each fight plays out.
air-hockey-cup: Lace up your skates and pull on a warm jacket, because this ice sport now comes in a playful browser version. You guide your tokens around the rink like real players and work to keep the puck under control. As you rise through the ranks, your goal is to take down every tournament you enter.

To score, you shoot your tokens at the puck and send it into the goal. Advancing through the league and winning tournaments earns you money, which you can spend on upgrading your tokens, buying rings, or switching to different formations. It is an air hockey game built with HTML5 and set on an icy theme.
monster-connect: Monster Connect is a puzzle game that pits you against the clock. Your task is to find two identical monster tiles, link them together, and clear them from the board. Each successful connection brings you closer to an empty board, but the timer keeps ticking, so you need to think and act quickly before time is up.

The game is built around a set of challenging levels, and you must complete them all to win. Controls are simple: tap or click to select tiles and make your connections. If you enjoy matching puzzles or thinking on your feet under pressure, this game offers a fresh way to test your focus.
stupid-zombies-hunt: The dead are rising again, and you have to fight them off in this free zombie shooter. Set in a post-apocalyptic wasteland, the game asks you to survive by firing your sniper rifle at the living dead, as if today were the last day on earth. Your job is to stop them before they can harm your fellow humans.
Moving around is done with the WASD keys, and holding Shift lets you run. Scroll to change guns, press G to switch to the next gun, and press F to use.
snowfight-io: Snowfight.io puts you in a huge multiplayer snow battle with lots of players at once. Your goal is to grow your snowball as big as you can, then slam it into rivals to knock them off the playing field. Everything is controlled with your mouse, so there is no complicated setup to learn before you start tossing snow.

Jump in with other players and keep rolling your snowball bigger while you dodge and strike. Every hit you land helps you stay in the fight and push others out of the arena. It is a fast, simple browser game that fits neatly into the .io Games and ball-fight style of play.
turbo-racing-3d-html5: Zoom through fast-paced tracks and tight passageways in this HTML5 racer. Your goal is to knock rival cars out of the race by crashing into them. To gain an edge, launch your car off the track and take a quicker route.

If speed is what you want, this game delivers it. Get ready, line up your position, and go. Controls are simple: click the mouse or tap the screen to play, which works on Android, iPhone, and iPad. It sits in the racing category and features driving and car themes.
xmas-bubble-frenzy: Xmas Bubble Frenzy is a holiday game that captures the cheerful spirit of the festive season. Each level asks you to collect a set number of bubbles before you can move on. Be careful that none of them touch the border while you work toward that goal.

Special bubbles are worth extra points, so catch them whenever you can. Aim and shoot with a mouse or touchpad. How many levels can you reach? See how far your skills carry you through the festive fun.
crazy-goat-hunter: In this 3D shooter, you play as a goat hunter with a wild streak, and your job is to track down and shoot every goat hiding in the forest. Use WASD to get around and click the left mouse button to fire. Scroll the mouse wheel to switch weapons, press R to reload, and tap Space to jump. Press P at any time to pause.

Filed under shooting, this game carries tags such as action, animal, gun, and shoot 'em up. Your mission is straightforward: find each goat in the forest and take them all down. Keep moving and aim carefully as you search for your targets.
water-surfer-car-stunt: Water Surfer Car Stunt is a platform-stunt driving simulation built around 3D sportscars. Your goal is to reach the finish area while collecting all three yellow stars, and you can also grab gold coins along the way. Be careful, because driving off the track ends your game immediately.
Controls rely on the W, A, S and D keys to
pixel-battlegrounds-io: Pixel Battlegrounds.IO is a shooting game where you pick from several characters before the match begins. Once it starts, you are dropped onto an island and must hunt down the gear you need while you work to stay alive. Control your character with the W, A, S, and D keys and aim with the mouse, or use touch controls on a phone or tablet.
The game sits in the Shooting category and carries the .io, Pixel, and Shooting tags. Your goal is simple: gather equipment, outlast the other players, and be the last one standing on the island.
trash-sorting-for-kids: This puzzle game is made for kids, and its goal is to help them put each piece of trash into the correct bin. Plastic items go into the plastic recycling bin, while food belongs in the organic waste bin. Players are also reminded never to throw garbage on the ground, because every piece of trash should end up in the trash.

The controls are simple: drag each item and drop it onto the matching bin. It is a 2D puzzle, so young players can focus on one sorting decision at a time. It offers a friendly way for children to learn where different kinds of rubbish should go.
fun-road-race-3d: Fun Road Race 3D is a free racing game where you can run a single mile or take on a longer marathon course. Weave through scenic landscapes filled with buses and other vehicles, dodging traffic and obstacles as you head for the finish line. You move your runner by tapping and holding, and release to come to a stop. Survival mode is also on offer for anyone wanting a different kind of challenge.

Every level feels different, and there are dozens of them with plenty of cars to contend with. You can race the computer or invite friends, aiming to beat records and climb the high score list. The graphics are bright and charming, with lively effects spread across many locations. The game can be played with a keyboard, a mouse, any key, or touch.
fairy-puzzle: Fairy Puzzle is a jigsaw-style game where you complete pictures by piece. To join two pieces, you grab one and drag it onto another so they connect. The game includes 100 levels, and each one shows a different bright, colorful image. It can be played with a mouse, touchscreen, or keyboard.

Your goal is to fit every piece together until the picture is whole. Because the levels vary in their artwork, you will see a new scene as you progress through the set. Tags for this title include Jigsaw and Puzzle, which sum up its focus on putting images back together.
hair-challenge-fun-and-run-3d-game: Hair Challenge is a relaxed racing game in 3D, and the aim is to grow your hair as long as possible. Your character keeps moving forward, and each time you run over a button marked with a plus one, your locks get longer. Keep going and the hair can stretch until it fills half of the display. Control is simple: tap or click to play.

Tags say it suits boys and girls alike, so anyone looking for a light, easy-going run can jump in. Nothing about it is complicated, which makes it a good pick for a short break or a longer session of steady growth.
summer-dessert-party: Summer Dessert Party is a fun cooking game built around stylish chilled treats. You can mix and match plenty of ingredients and decorations, including fruit, candy, sprinkles, milk, flour, salt, butter, eggs, chocolate, ice cream, water, marshmallows, cookies, caramel, and more.

The game runs in your web browser and you control it with a mouse or by tapping the screen. Choose what goes into your dessert, add your decorations, and create cold sweets for a summer party. It is listed in the girls section of the site.
santa-math-game: Good with numbers? This festive puzzle asks you to work through a series of math questions. Each tile you answer about covers a hidden picture of Santa, so every solved question brings another part of the scene into view.

To play, drag each numbered block from the left onto the matching tile on the right that is covering the picture. Your goal is to uncover all of the Santa pictures. Controls are simple: click with a mouse or tap the screen. Tagged for brain training, Christmas, and family play, it is a light way to practise sums with the whole household.
the-last-adventure: Ellie and Joel are the heroes of this game, guiding you through a series of puzzle levels that test how you think. Each level asks you to work out the right path as you move forward. Along the way, you can collect diamonds, which are the key to opening up brand-new adventures to explore.
Controls are flexible, so you can play with the keyboard or tap the touch butt
cyber-cars-punk-racing-2: Cyber Cars Punk Racing 2 is the second game in the Cyber Cars Punk Racing series, bringing newer cars, more engaging graphics, and easier gameplay to the table. New maps give the racing fresh places to test your skills, while a leaderboard, a set of missions, and a free driving range round out the package.

Steer with the WASD keys or the arrow keys. Press N to use nitro for a burst of speed, and press C to switch the camera view. Built as a 3D arcade racer with a casual, hypercasual feel, it suits quick, pick-up-and-play sessions for one player.
find-on-earth: Find On Earth is a one-player 3D trivia puzzle played on a rotating globe. It offers a large number of questions and answers, along with a set of characters and some surprises. To respond, you decide which answer you think is right and fly your chosen character to the matching country. The game blends competition with adventure, so your knowledge of countries is the main tool in this quiz battle.

The controls are simple. Pick your character first, then press and hold the left mouse button while moving the mouse to turn the world. Bring the correct country into position and land your character on it. It is a practical way to test what you know about the countries of the world.
helixjump-io: In HelixJump.io, your goal is to guide a bouncing ball down through a spiraling helix maze. Along the way, you must keep the ball from touching the red tiles that line the structure. This hypercasual arcade game is also tagged as a mobile and .io title.

Controls are simple. Press the A and D keys or the left and right arrow keys to move, or use the mouse instead. Pick whichever method feels more comfortable, and keep the ball heading downward while avoiding every red tile.
bus-parking-city-3d: Take the wheel of a bus in this realistic driving simulator, which is built around 3D gameplay. Each level you finish raises the difficulty and demands more skill before you can move on. The game also tests your abilities as a driver, since a bus is much trickier to handle than a car, and getting it into its spot matters even more.
Steer with the WASD keys or the arrow keys. Whether you enjoy bus simulators or want a racing title with a 3D look, this one asks you to stay sharp from start to finish.
border-clash: Border Clash puts you in charge of guarding your frontier and fighting back the forces that want to cross it. This strategy game rewards careful planning, because the right tactics and well-timed moves decide the outcome. You send in units, each with its own special abilities, to key positions on the map while keeping an eye on your energy so you spend it wisely. The game sits in the adventure category and carries themes of war, battleships and shooting.

On desktop, you use your mouse button to click on what you want to do. On mobile, you touch the target on screen instead. Whichever device you use, the controls keep your attention on your battle plans.
orco-the-dragon-crown: Seven jewels that once adorned the Dragon Crown have been taken by a wizard who commands an army of undead. In this adventure, you guide Orco as he forces his way through the ranks of the undead. Your mission is to track down the dragon eggs that hold the missing jewels and bring the crown back to its full glory. The game blends action, battle and wizard elements.

Movement is simple: tap the arrows on the screen, or use your keyboard's arrow keys to steer Orco through each encounter. Whether you are smashing through foes or searching for the next egg, every step pushes you closer to restoring the crown.
katana-fruit-slasher: Step into the role of a samurai in Katana Fruit Slasher, where a stream of fruit is tossed your way and you have to cut through it with your blade. scribble-grass-cutter: Scribble Grass Cutter is a free, easy-to-learn arcade game for mowing the lawn and blowing off some steam. Beat your opponent to the cut and you earn pet food for your animals, who are waiting at home for you.
To play, just slide your finger or mouse across the screen to draw your blades.
fast-furious-skyline: Fast Furious Skyline is a 3D racing game built around the Skyline, which the game presents as the best of its cars. Across two different survival challenges, you push forward while collecting points. The score you gather decides the rank and hat you earn, and legendary hats are waiting for the players who reach them.
This one-player game is controlled with the arrow keys and the space button on a computer. Touch controls are available for mobile devices, so you can play on a phone or tablet as well.
mini-bartender-game: In this clicker, you steer a bartender's hand across the screen to gather as many glasses as you can. Those glasses are what you use to mix a variety of drinks, and you can dress them up with lots of eye-catching decorations. Watch out, because obstacles appear along the way and may block your path to the goal in every level.

On desktop, you move the bartender's hand with the mouse. On mobile devices, tap the screen and drag your finger to move it. Each level has its own goal to reach, so keep your hand steady and your eyes on the bar.
drive-and-dodge-car-racing-3d: Drive and Dodge: Car Racing 3D is a single-player 3D driving game for Android that puts your reflexes to the test at high speed. Master sharp drifts to fill your Nitro, then use it to smash through obstacles.

Space Bar applies the brakes, E gives you a Time Boost, and Q gives you a Life Boost. Press W to activate Nitro, and use A and D to turn left and right. Press T to buy Nitro. Head to the garage to unlock new cars, each offering special advantages before a race begins.
winter-tiles: Winter Tiles brings a holiday mood to a mahjong-inspired puzzle game. Your job is to find matching pairs among tiles decorated with wintry, seasonal pictures. Click or tap one tile, then select its twin. The link only works when a route between them changes direction no more than twice. Clear every winter-themed tile before the clock runs out to move on to the next level.

Controls are simple: use a mouse or a touch pad. Built with HTML5, the game runs in a browser and suits mobile devices too. Watch the timer closely, since each level must be cleared before time expires.
subway-runner: Hop onto the railway and sprint as far as you can. Dodge the hazards along the line by jumping over them or sliding beneath them. Each level layout keeps changing and grows steadily tougher, so you never know quite what comes next. Finish achievements as you go.

Gather coins during your run and spend them on upgrades that make your power-ups stronger. Grab the DASH MASTER slogan on every run to prove you have what it takes to be the best. Test your skills and try to beat your own highscore each time you return.
scooter-brothers: Team up with a friend in this two-player action game, where you hunt down the keys to your scooter, grab barrels along the way, and slip away from the cops. Staying out of police hands is the main challenge.

To finish a run, you need to collect every badge and switch on the Black Hole. The game works on both desktop and mobile. On desktop, jump by pressing W or the up arrow key. It is filed under action, adventure, arcade, and arena titles, with an animal theme.
grass-reaper: Grass Reaper is a relaxed little game where all you do is steer the reaper and cut down a fixed amount of grass on every level. Your reaper starts out too weak to clear everything in one go, so you gather the cut grass and sell it. The gold you earn lets you upgrade the reaper, which helps you finish each stage more quickly.
Movement is handled by sliding your finger or pointer across the screen. It works well on phones and tablets, and the tags point to a game that is easy to pick up and suitable for kids.
spot-the-difference-seasons: Spot The Difference: Seasons is a puzzle game that gives your focus and observation skills a good workout. Two nearly identical pictures sit side by side, and your job is to spot what has changed. Some differences hide in plain sight, so take your time and look closely, because things that seem identical at first may not be.

Five game modes are spread across the four seasons, and you play without any hints. Across 80 levels, you will study scenes of spring, summer, fall and winter. Think of yourself as a detective as you work through each picture and unlock the levels one by one.
space-prospector: Pilot a jet-powered craft through open space, hunting for gems and gold coins and hauling them back to your base. Every gem you deliver is worth a set number of points, and the value depends on its color. Gold coins are just as important: returning one to base doubles all the points you have already banked. You can spend the points you earn on refueling your ship and repairing it.

Press the left or right arrow key to fire the shunting engine and move sideways. The up arrow or the space bar starts the main engine and sends you upward. On mobile devices, the game uses virtual buttons instead. Your aim on each level is to rack up as many points as you can.
monster-truck-parking: Monster Truck Parking is an inventive driving puzzler where you steer a monster truck and make deliveries. You handle two jobs at once: deciding the route the truck travels and driving it along that route. Each level asks you to gather every gold star and keep your cargo from tumbling off the back of the vehicle.

To build a path, use your mouse to draw lines between the platforms. Once your track is in place, press the arrow keys to send the truck forward or in reverse. Look for clever ways to reach each delivery, and think about which route will work best on every level.
trio-twist-puzzle: Trio Twist Puzzle is a calm matching title in which you group bright items into slots to form sets of three. Piles of balls, donuts, cubes, and more must be tapped and shifted until they clear, and every move should be thought through beforehand.

Levels change their layouts and grow tougher as you advance, putting your logic and sense of timing to the test. Bright visuals and smooth controls make it a satisfying puzzle experience for casual players. Use your mouse to play.
stickman-neon-warriors-sword-fighting: In this neon-styled sword fighter, you play a stickman in 9999AD, a time when humans have evolved into virtual stickmen. A hacking war has broken out, and you must take up your cyber sword to fight the enemy hacker warriors and restore order to the stick internet. Expect plenty of sword fighting and plenty of takedowns along the way.

The game uses 3D stickmen and environments with a glowing "Neon Warriors" look. Move with the arrow keys and attack with A, S, D, Z, X and C. Gamepad support is included. You are the hacker hero, and the whole cyber stickman world depends on you. The soundtrack is a track called Battle_Experiment, and sound effects are included.
black-friday-shopping-mania: Join Kendall Jenner at the mall for this Black Friday shopping game made for girls. The aim is to spend the day buying as much as you can, so bring sensible footwear for all the walking. Discounts are everywhere, so grab every bargain you can find.
This single-player puzzle title also includes dress up, makeover, and fashion themes, with a celebrity touch. Use your mouse on a desktop, or tap the screen on mobile devices to play.
racerking: RacerKing is a contest of nerve and reflexes where survival depends on how fast you can respond. You pilot your car around an arena, weaving past traps that other vehicles have placed in your path. You can also lay down traps of your own to catch rival cars, so every move you make matters.
Your objective is simple: stay alive for as long as you can. To begin, slide your finger across the screen to start playing. Keep your reactions quick, since the whole game hinges on them.
zombie-escape-horror-factory: This survival title drops you into an apocalyptic world overrun by the undead. Your goal is to get every generator running again alongside your teammates. Move your character with the WASD keys on a keyboard, or swipe across the screen to slide around. Stay calm as you work toward the exit. Find out whether you can finish the job and make it out alive.
fire-and-water-island-survival-6: In this sixth installment, Fire and Water find themselves on an isolated island with a brand-new level and a fresh challenge. This 2D adventure is built for two players, so a friend can join in. Player one moves with A and D and jumps with W. Player two has its own separate controls for moving and jumping. Both characters share the same perilous island and the same goal of getting free.
player-vs-zombie: You control a single fighter who can switch between several weapons across two different maps. New stages open gradually as you advance, and the difficulty rises with each one.

Press E to use a medical kit, Tab to choose a weapon, R to reload, G to use a grenade, and K to drop your current weapon. Esc pauses the game.

rabbit-twister: This playful jumping game is a hypercasual endless runner that puts your reflexes to the test. You guide a cute, funny rabbit as it hops from one bridge to the next, and each landing must be on the correct bridge to keep the run going. The puzzle-style challenge never really ends, so you keep hopping as long as you can.

The controls are simple: press the left and right arrow keys to send the rabbit toward the left or right bridge, and keep it from falling down. When you reach a score worth bragging about, share your achievements with your friends. Have fun hopping along!
galactic-traffic: Galactic Traffic is a driving game set in a futuristic world, where your goal is to weave through busy traffic while racing. Along the way, you can grab cash and powerups, and you need to collect them to complete each track. Steering is handled with the arrow keys.

The game is a fun pick for anyone who enjoys racing games with a sci-fi twist. Each run puts your reflexes to the test as you dodge other vehicles and aim for the finish line. Tags on the site list it as a car racing title that works on mobile devices too.
stick-fight-combo: Stick Fight Combo brings back the feel of old-school arcade brawlers. You move through side-scrolling stages filled with lively fights. Pick from several professional roles, each with its own unique skills, and use them to beat enemies and move on to the next level. Winning the game is the goal, and as you go you can unlock stronger skills that boost your combat power and make later levels easier to get through.

Expect a trip down memory lane for anyone who grew up with classic arcade fighters. The game is tagged for one player and fits the adventure, action, battle and collecting genres, with a 2D look throughout. Every new skill you earn gives you more options for handling tough enemies, so it pays to learn what each role can do.
dentist-doctor-makeover: In this simulated dentist game, you run a small clinic where princesses arrive with different problems. Some have tooth decay from eating too many sweets, some dislike brushing their teeth, and others fall and break a tooth. You pick up the right tools and treat each patient with care, and every princess leaves grateful for your help.

Discovering why each princess visits is part of the fun, and you can help every cute and kind visitor who comes through the door. Controls are simple: on desktop, click and drag with the mouse, and on mobile, tap and slide. The game also reminds you to clean your teeth every day, since a trip to the dentist is never a pleasant experience.
queen-bee: Queen Bee is a 3D arcade game about winning the attention of the handsome but troublesome boys who roam the street. Your goal is to gather well-known items and slowly grow into a true queen bee. Since the game is built around collecting, you pick up the items marked with green rings and dodge anything surrounded by red.

Movement is simple: just drag to steer through the action. The 3D presentation adds to the fun as you chase each prize and weave around the risks. Stay relaxed, keep your focus, and enjoy yourself as you play.
squid-gamer-runner-obstacle: Squid Gamer Runner Obstacle puts you on a massive assault course built around parkour. You climb, slide, and flip your way forward, with the goal of becoming the finest dancer in the world. It is a 3D racing game, so you sprint as fast as you can to reach the finish line through fast-paced courses.

The obstacle courses are demanding and visually stunning, and some sections cross dizzying heights. To get through them, you need to learn tricky flips, stunts, jumps, flights, and runs, then perform each one in a timely manner. Controls are simple: use your mouse to run. Expect a strong rush of adrenaline as you tackle each course.
park-them-all: Park Them All is a puzzle game in which you rearrange parking spaces so every car has a place to go and can settle in comfortably. Controls are simple, since you only need to tap to park each car. Sorting the spaces carefully is the key to clearing the congestion, so it helps to plan your moves before you act. It suits players who enjoy sorting puzzles and step-by-step problem solving.
shadow-ninja-warriors: Take on the Shadow Ninja Revenge challenge, a single-player arcade action and adventure game with a ninja theme. snow-drift: Novice drivers usually stick to every road rule and do their best to keep the car safe. muscle-car-robot: Picture your country coming under attack by bandits. In Muscle Car Robot, you respond by morphing into a super robot. everwing: EverWing is a straightforward single-player adventure in 2D. You click on your character to attack enemies, and the challenge is to defeat them without ever touching them. It mixes battle and action into one simple loop.
