Thanks to its advanced suspension, tall ground clearance, and sturdy engine, this vehicle suits adventurers who want a reliable partner for rough terrain. Drive with the WASD keys on a computer. On phones and tablets, use the on-screen buttons instead.
void-city: Void City is an action game with a playful competitive streak. You control a void hole and grow it by devouring a city, so each bite makes your dark mass larger. It runs in the browser using WebGL, and it carries the tags avoid and city.
Steering is simple. Press the W, A, S and D keys, or swipe across the screen, to move the hole wherever you
special-strike-operations: You play as a special forces soldier who must shoot down incoming enemy troops. Each wave brings a new fight, and surviving them is how you unlock stronger firearms. It's a single-player 3D shooter centered on action and guns.

Use W, A, S, and D to move around, and click the left mouse button to fire. The mouse wheel switches between weapons, R reloads, and Space makes you jump. Hold C to crouch, and press P whenever you want to pause the action.
tile-connect-club: Tile Connect Club is a brain-training puzzle that puts your linking skills to the test. Your job is to pair up matching tiles and clear them all before the time runs out. The tiles show a range of pictures, including animals, fruit, flowers, and more.

As you progress, you can play faster and faster, which pushes you to think and react more quickly. Working your way up to tile master status is a big part of the fun. It is a playful, engaging game that challenges both your mind and your eyes. Just click or tap to select and match the tiles.
real-boxing-fighting-game: City Fighter vs Street Gang is a well-liked boxing title known for its striking visuals, a boxer career that grows in several directions, and controls that are easy to pick up. You step into the ring with gloves on and throw yourself into each bout with full force, aiming to claim the crown in the fighting competition.

Everything runs on mouse clicks or taps, so you can jump straight into the action. Your boxer's career develops across several areas as you progress, so every fight helps shape the fighter you become.
k-games-challenge: Step into a 3D recreation of the trials from the Squid Game film. The lineup includes Green Light Red Light, Honeycomb Toffee, Tug of War, Marbles, Stepping Stones, and SP Game, where you face AI opponents. The arcade-style rules and controls are easy to pick up, and your goal is to win every round before the time limit runs out.

In the Marbles round, you get six chances to throw a marble into the hole. Levels can only be completed while you stand in the green areas, so keep an eye on where you are. Movement is simple: tap and slide to control your character.
sudoku: Sudoku Deluxe welcomes everyone, from people who are just starting out to experienced solvers. If you want a gentle puzzle to unwind with, one that lets you enjoy yourself and spend your free time pleasantly, this version of the number game will suit you well. It is also a good way to take a relaxing break from your day.

Choose the difficulty that fits you best before you begin. Easy mode is the place to start, with simple logic and memory work that keeps your mind sharp. When you want more, switch to Hard, Very Hard, or Insane, where the puzzles make your brain work much harder. This classic sudoku game is made for players who enjoy big mental challenges as well as those who prefer a calm session.
cookie-match: Cookie Match is a sliding puzzle where your goal is to pair every cookie with the cutter that fits it. Be careful: a cookie pushed off the edge of the board, or slid into a knife, gets destroyed. Tubs of butter act as barriers, so you can use them to stop cookies from moving too far and keep them intact.

You control the whole board by dragging with a mouse or your finger on a touchscreen, and each drag moves all of the cookies at once. Plan a few moves ahead so every cookie lands on its matching cutter without breaking.
dual: Dual is a one-player arcade game where you steer two orbs, sometimes called vessels, that move together like partners in a tightly linked dance. Your job is to keep both orbs in sync and stay alive, no matter what comes your way. The idea is simple, but it asks you to remain calm while the pressure builds.

Controls are easy to pick up. On a phone, tap the right side of the screen to turn right and the left side to turn left. On a computer, use the right and left arrow keys to do the same. Its tags point to a hypercasual, skill-based game with a high score to chase.
easter-board-puzzles: Easter Board Puzzles is a spot-the-difference style game with an Easter theme. Two boards appear next to each other, and at first glance they seem nearly the same. Your job is to locate one change hidden between them, so you will need to study both carefully.

Every time you spot a difference, a fresh pair of boards replaces the old one so you can keep going. The challenge continues until the timer hits zero, so work quickly. The game is controlled with a mouse or a touchpad, so you can start right away with whichever you have nearby.
my-hungry-fish-game: In this underwater game, you start as a tiny fish and must stay alive by eating and growing. Your aim is to become the largest fish in the ocean. The colorful sea around you holds smaller fish to snack on, larger hunters that can harm you, and hidden surprises waiting to be found.

Chomp on fish that are smaller than you to get bigger, and steer clear of stronger enemies that could end your run. As you progress, new challenges unlock, letting you keep exploring and taking control of the underwater world. Everything is controlled with your mouse, since every button is clicked that way.
utoo-2: Utoo 2 is a 2D platformer centered on gathering blue cubes. While you chase them, you need to dodge enemies, flying creatures, saws, and spikes. Reaching the Exit door sends you on to the next level. The game has eight levels, and the challenge grows as you advance. It is the sequel to the first Utoo game, making it the second part of that series.

You control the character with WASD or the arrow keys. For a double jump, tap W or the Up arrow key twice. Keep these controls in mind as you move through the hazards toward each exit. The game is a cute, single-player arcade adventure built around collecting and jumping.
extreme-car-stunts: Extreme Car Stunts lets you take the wheel of muscle cars and launch them off giant ramps. You can choose from sports cars, racing machines, classic models, and speed cars, each built for stunt driving. The game works like a driving simulator, so every jump and landing tests your control.
It is made for people who love stunts and want to see what their driving can do on oversized ramps. Your goal is to master these ramp runs and grow into a top hero driver.
fall-boys-and-girls-running-multiplayer: Fall Boys And Girls Running is an online multiplayer title where you race against people from all over the world through an obstacle course. Your aim is to cross the finish line first. If you are knocked out along the way, you can watch the rest of the field, and players who make it through move on to the next round.
Move with W, A, S and D, and press the space bar to jump. Use the G key to grab hold of things as you go.
pop-us-3d: Pop Us 3D is a clicker game that brings the soothing feel of pop it fidget toys to your screen. It is made to help relieve stress and anxiety and to bring a sense of calm. You can play with plenty of colorful anti-stress pop its, including shapes like a heart, a lobster, a star, a butterfly, a duck, a rocket, a pineapple, and many more
connect-the-bubbles: Connect the Bubbles is a puzzle game where you join bubbles that share the same color. Build a longer chain and your reward grows bigger. Special boosters are available to help improve your score, and you can use them to try to outdo your friends. On phones and tablets, swipe across the screen with your finger. On computers, hold and drag with your mouse.

The aim is simple: link as many matching bubbles as you can in a single run. Each chain you finish adds to your result, so planning ahead pays off. Boosters give you extra help when you need to push your total higher. Whether you play on a touch device or a desktop, the controls stay easy to pick up.
color-snake: Color Snake is a never-ending arcade experience built around a snake that carries a single hue. You steer it with the mouse alone. The rule is simple: the snake passes safely through objects that share its shade, so a red snake can touch red things and nothing else. Touching anything in a different color ends the run immediately.

Because the game keeps going with no finish line, your goal is to last as long as you can while threading through the objects that match your snake. The title is built with HTML5 and tagged as 3D and WebGL, and it sits in the Avoid, Color, and Snake categories. Watch closely, stay in step with your color, and keep the snake alive.
tank-rush-3d: Tank Rush 3D may sound like a driving game, but it is really a collecting arcade title built on a 3D engine. In each level, you guide your tank over the obstacles in its path until it reaches the finish area at the end of the platform track. For the best results, try to gather more than 10 coins before you go after bullets. This approach can bring in steady earnings while still leaving you with enough ammo.
The game is played by dragging, so you control the tank by moving your input across the screen. It is a good pick for anyone who enjoys collecting items while working through each track.
extreme-pixel-gun-combat-3: Extreme Pixel Gun Combat 3 is a shooting game that you can enjoy alone or with other people, and it can host a large group playing at the same time. You defend yourself against zombie bots spread across a range of different locations. Whether or not you are carrying a weapon, you must destroy any undead creatures you come across. The game gives you access to a wide variety of weaponry, so you can pick the kinds of guns that suit your style.

Taking cover behind different objects gives you a better chance of surviving this first-person shooter. To move, use the WASD keys. Use the mouse to aim, look around, and shoot. The Tab key is also part of the controls. It is a free online game that works well for sharing a session with friends.
save-the-egg: Save the Egg is a car game set on hilly terrain, with an egg balanced on top of your vehicle. Your main job is to keep that egg from falling off while you travel. Every bump and slope tests your control, so smooth, steady driving works better than rushing. The game relies on physics and timing, and it is trickier than it first appears.

On a computer, press A and D or the left and right arrow keys to drive. On mobile, use the on-screen buttons to control the car. Balance your speed with care so the egg stays put, and push your run as far as you can.
pick-and-go: Pick & Go! is a pathfinding puzzle set in calm, grassy meadows and viewed from above. You gather fruit with careful planning, and you can use tools like scissors to clear a way forward and get rid of pesky bugs. The game has 200 levels, and each one challenges you to earn all three stars. It is a single-player title with a casual, hypercasual feel.

You move your character by dragging with the mouse or with your finger on a touchscreen. Think about each route before you act, since the path you choose decides which fruit you reach and which obstacles you clear. Working through the whole collection is how you collect every star.
jewel-treasure: Jewel Treasure is a match-3 puzzle game full of sparkling gems. Swap neighboring jewels to line up three or more of the same kind and clear them from the board. Each level has a target score you need to hit before you can advance. The puzzles are carefully built, so there is plenty to figure out as you go. Your aim is to become the Jewel Master by unlocking every level.

The game offers two modes. Level, also called Campaign, takes you through a series of stages with goals to meet. Endless mode lets you keep matching gems without a finish line. Both modes work well on mobile devices, making this a good pick for brain-teasing sessions whenever you have a few spare minutes.
baby-hippo-care: A baby hippo has been left alone at home, so it's up to you to step in and look after him. Many tasks need your attention: you'll play with him, work to keep him happy, and feed him. He may turn flirtatious, cry, and even wet his pants if you fall behind. Everything depends on how well you tend to him.
Controls are simple, since a mouse click or a tap is all you need to play. The title is filed under girls' games, and it centers on caring for a little animal.
wars-z-zombie-apocalypse-2020: The world has fallen to a zombie outbreak. A virus has spread through the population and turned every human into the undead, so your job is to get through each level and wipe out the enemies standing in your way. Several kinds of creatures hunt you, including crawling zombies, dogs, and fire zombies.

The game is played entirely offline and offers more than one mode. In run and destroy, you push forward and clear the threats around you. In run and survive, you must last for a set amount of time. You can also gather a number of cures to complete a level. Move with W, A, S, and D, aim and shoot with the mouse, and press Tab to open the menu.
gyro-maze-3d: Gyro Maze 3D offers a collection of distinct 3D labyrinths that suit a quick break or a longer puzzle session. You move through each stage while steering clear of obstacles, and collecting powerups along the way opens up new options. The game also lets you personalize your play with different backgrounds, ball skins, and visual effects.

Controls stay simple, so there is nothing tricky to learn: you steer with the W, A, S, and D keys. Early mazes are gentle and relaxing, while later labyrinths bring tougher challenges. It is an easy puzzle choice for kids, and anyone who enjoys a calm, focused game should find it fun.
diamond-painting-asmr-coloring: Diamond Painting ASMR Coloring invites you to create gleaming artwork. Your job is to cover a painting with sparkling gems. Each colorful diamond you add helps the picture look polished and rich, and the more you place, the shinier and more luxurious it becomes. Work through each canvas until it is finished.

Dragging is all it takes to play. The game sits in the Arcade category and carries tags such as puzzle, relaxation, and coloring, so it suits a calm, unhurried session. Take your time with each piece and enjoy the satisfying shimmer as the paintings come together.
wolfoo-memory-sequence: Wolfoo Memory Sequence is a bright memory game for kids that features Wolfoo and his pals. Watch as the characters light up one at a time, then repeat the same order by tapping them. Each round adds another step, so your memory gets a real workout. On phones, tap the tiles. On computers, use the mouse.

There are 15 levels, moving from gentle Easy starts to tough Expert rounds. Clear rounds to collect up to three stars, chain combos for bonus points, and protect your three hearts. When lives run out, a short video lets you revive and carry on. Cheerful music and kid-safe fun make it a good choice for building focus, concentration and short-term memory.
wormeat-io-online: Wormeat.io Online is a multiplayer game in which you steer a worm among other players. If your head bumps into another player, you explode and the game is over. But when other players crash into you, they are the ones who explode, and you can gobble up the remains they leave behind.

Steering is simple: your mouse controls the direction your worm moves. Press the space bar whenever you want to speed up. Stay alert as you slither around, because every other worm on screen is a possible threat or a possible meal.
ragdoll-soccer: Ragdoll Soccer is a soccer game built on physics, so every movement feels loose and unpredictable. You can play alone in puzzle mode or take on a friend in a two-player match. Your aim is to stay in one piece while scoring goals, and the player who scores enough goals wins.

Each player has their own set of controls. The first player moves with W, A, S and D, and releases the launch rope with the space bar. The second player moves with the arrow keys and releases the launch rope with L.
police-simulator-transport-2019: Police Simulator Transport 2019 invites you to take on police transport work. Many missions are waiting for you, and each one gives you the chance to drive a cool car as a police officer. It sits in the action category, and driving is at its core.
Driving is handled with the WASD keys, so W, A, S and D are all you need to get moving. Work through the missions in front of you, and enjoy the ride from start to finish.
shortcut-run-online: You take part in a footrace where you begin at the very back of the pack. Your goal is to work your way up to the front. Running across water makes you faster, but you must lay bricks to build a bridge over it. Gathering those bricks along the way is what decides whether you win.

Watch your footing, because tumbling into the water is something you want to avoid. Movement is handled with a joystick, so you steer your runner with it. Shortcut Run Online is filed under Adventure and carries tags such as 3D, arcade, and collecting.
long-hand-escape: Long Hand Escape is a playful puzzle title where you rely on your wits and a pair of stretchy, bendy arms to grab valuables. Working through its riddles and levels, you can sharpen your thinking the way an IQ test would. Movement is handled entirely by sliding your finger or pointer across the screen.

The game is built around escape-style challenges and sneaky thief puzzles, so each stage asks you to figure out the clever route before you can make your move. It is a lighthearted pick for anyone who enjoys brain teasers, and it fits well with the Hypercasual, 3D, Strategy and Kids themes found on the site.
petzoong: Petzoong is a light arcade take on mahjong built around matching. The tiles show adorable critters against animal-themed backdrops, and the game is easy to pick up. Your job is to find two identical tiles and select them. When a pair lines up, both tiles vanish from the board. Clear every pair on the screen and the level is complete.

This relaxed puzzler sends little jungle creatures peeking out, so your task is to spot the same animals and pair them up. Each match you make removes those tiles, bringing you closer to passing the level.
brick-surfer: Brick Surfer puts you in charge of a lumberjack who picks up the wood that has fallen along his path. Those logs become a bridge stretched between two tall platforms. Once the bridge is in place, he can walk across smoothly and reach his destination.

Watch for diamonds scattered along the road, because collecting them lets you try out more skins for your character. The whole game is controlled by dragging. It is an arcade title with adventure, collecting, and high score elements, and it suits kids and hypercasual fans alike.
hockey-skills: Hockey Skills is a sports game built around the core abilities of the sport. You can practice a mix of skills, including speed skating, shooting on goal, and aiming at targets. Working through each one gives you a clear picture of how skilled you really are on the ice.
Controls are easy to pick up. Swipe on the screen to shoot, and use your keyboard keys or the on-screen controls to skate around the rink. Pick whichever option feels more comfortable and get moving.
jinx-and-minx-tower-escape: It is Halloween, and the spooky duo Jinx and Minx have ended up stuck high inside a deserted tower. Your task is to lead them through eerie corridors and haunted rooms, working through a series of puzzles. Along the way, collect the keys and candy you need to free the bunnies and bring them back together.
This one-player puzzle adventure leans on brainteasers and escape-style challenges, so take your time and think each room through.
deadflip-challenge-2024: Deadflip Challenge 2024 is a relaxed puzzle game where your goal is to touch down safely. On the surface the idea feels simple, but the deeper you go, the more layered the challenges become. It sits in the hypercasual category, so quick, casual sessions suit it well.

Across a wide variety of levels, you will need to think ahead and put your reasoning to work, and you can enjoy every minute of the experience. Controls are easy: just click with your mouse or tap the screen to play.
clever-crow: Clever Crow is a puzzle game built on physics and loosely based on an old tale about a bird with a parched throat. Your crow needs the water in a tall, slender vessel to rise high enough to drink. Pull back on the bird, let go, and fling pebbles through the narrow opening. Each object that sinks pushes the water upward.

Every item behaves differently. Heavy rocks move the most water but can't squeeze through the neck. Ice floats and slowly melts, a cork offers little help, and a sponge soaks up your water. Later stages bring a sideways breeze to account for. Finish under par to earn three stars, and when you succeed, the crow flies over for a drink. There are eight handcrafted levels, mouse or touch controls, and no two solutions are the same.
battle-soccer-arena: Head onto the green battlefield for a fresh take on the football game. You can play against the computer or challenge a friend, with each side made up of three players from a nation you choose. Neither team has a goalkeeper, so you will need to change how you attack and defend. Think about how you position your players, then enjoy the match.
Controls are easy to learn. Use the arrow keys to move around the field and the space bar to kick or slide. Try both actions to get a feel for how each match plays out.
bike-racing-adventure: Choose the motorcycle that fits your style, then ride through varied locations packed with unique obstacles. Your runs can include a range of missions, weaving past traffic, pulling off bold stunts, and reaching checkpoints before the clock runs out. Each session helps you sharpen your bike handling.

The game aims for a smooth, lifelike feel. Responsive controls, shifting camera angles, and detailed bike handling work together so every ride feels connected to the road. Press W or the Up arrow to move forward, S or the Down arrow to move back, A or the Left arrow to move left, and D or the Right arrow to move right. Use your mouse to click any buttons.
babysitter-day: Caring for a baby is hard work, yet it can also be interesting and enjoyable. This game is made for energetic little ones who go to kindergarten or school. Playing it lets a child step back and watch themselves from the side. It also gives them a chance to play mother and discover what a babysitter actually does and what caring for a baby really involves.

The game is part of the Girls category and carries family and educational themes, and it's meant to be fun as well as informative. You control it with a mouse or by tapping, so it's easy to pick up and start playing.
warun: You play as an elite space marine sent to sneak into a bio weapon research facility on Mars. Armed with a powerful assault rifle, your job is to take down thousands of security guards. Keep an eye on your weapon's heat, because overheating will hurt your accuracy, and stay sharp so you can make it through every wave of enemies.
This is a single-player 3D shooter. Move with W, A, S and D, fire with the left mouse button, reload with R, and jump with the spacebar. Press P to pause whenever you need a break.
bts-signature-fashion-style: Step into a dress-up game built around the style of BTS, the K-pop group that has become famous worldwide. You can look over the well-known outfits these artists have worn and see how their fashion choices might fit into your own wardrobe. The game covers everything from polished stage clothing to relaxed street fashion for an ordinary day. Along the way, you are shown ways to borrow their looks and make them your own.
The experience is meant to feel open to fans everywhere, and it puts personal taste first, so players can shape a style that feels like them. Everything is controlled with a left mouse button click.
zombie-killer-truck-driving: On Halloween night, your mission is to steer a monster truck along a road and find the way home. That road is crowded with zombies, so you will drive your truck straight into them as you go. Along the way, gather the money lying on the road and use it to upgrade your monster truck.
The controls work like this. Press W or S, or the Up and Down arrow ke
mommy-long-legs-escape: In this online escape adventure, your goal is to get away from Mommy Long Legs. Each level is its own challenge, and you finish it by finding every picture in that level. The game sits in the clicker category and is tagged as a point-and-click escape adventure, so pointing and clicking play a big part.

Movement uses the W, A, S and D keys. To look around, move your mouse or use the tap controls instead. Each challenge is complete only after you have found all of its pictures, so keep searching the level until none are left.
block-stacking-3d-game: This 3D puzzle game is a relaxing pick for anyone who wants to unwind and ease tension. Its style feels delicate and fresh, and its cute look suits boys, girls and kids alike. You join together many different kinds of fruit as you play.

Finishing the target tasks gives you a chance at rewards. To pass a level, you clear the fruit from the screen. The controls are so easy to operate that almost anyone can pick them up, and the game can be hard to put down.
fashion-lip-art-salon: Fashion Lip Art Salon is a free online game made especially for girls, and it gives you room to show off your artistic skills. The play is easy: choose from the cosmetics that appear during the game and use them to complete the challenges posed by the characters. Think about which unexpected looks you can come up with, then craft one-of-a-kind patterns for your lips.
Everything is controlled with taps or clicks, so you can jump right in. It suits anyone who loves makeover fun and enjoys getting creative with cosmetics.
granny-house: You are trapped inside a deserted asylum while the wicked Granny hunts for you. Your goal is to find a way out and avoid her along the way. Move silently, so you make no noise at all, and keep away from the granny until you reach the exit.

The controls are straightforward. Use W, A, S and D to move, press the Space bar to jump, and hold Left Shift to run. Granny House is a 3D action game in the escape genre, built with WebGL and listed under 3D Games, Escape and WebGL.
the-simple-piano: The Simple Piano is a lightweight piano app meant for learning the instrument, and it comes with lifelike instrument sounds. To play, you simply slide your fingers across the piano keys and perform music in real time, which gives you the feeling of being a working musician. It fits any screen size, offers a full keyboard, supports multi-touch so several notes can sound at once, and is simple enough for young children to pick up. Playing is as easy as a single click or tap on a key.
magic-princess-dressup: Magic Princess Dressup is a dress-up game aimed at girls who love fashion. It offers a wide selection of detailed decorations, and you can test as many combinations as you like until you land on a look you adore. You can also bring friends along to see who has the sharpest eye for style. Control is simple: use your mouse or tap the screen to play.

This is a cute, magical, mobile-friendly HTML5 title that suits kids and anyone who enjoys playing with outfits and accessories. Every choice is yours to make, so take your time experimenting and enjoy the process.
tip-candy-puzzle: Tip Candy Puzzle asks you to line up and merge sweets that share a type so you can rack up points. Every move deserves some thought, since you can set up chain reactions and trigger large combos that push your score higher. As you advance, each stage brings a fresh obstacle and the difficulty rises gradually.

Controls are handled entirely with your mouse, which keeps things straightforward. The visuals are bright and cheerful, and the rules are easy to pick up, so people of any age can enjoy it. Fans of puzzle titles and match-3 games should feel right at home with this one.
driving-forklift-sim: Take the controls of a forklift in this fully manual driving game. Your job is to collect pallets from different parts of a warehouse and carry them to where they belong, all while racing the clock. Some stages send you to a vehicle parking lot to make several pickups within a limited time, so every move counts.

The forklift has several gears. When you need to cover ground quickly, shift into the rapid driving gears to reach your target sooner. In areas where you must lift delicate items with care, switch to the low gear and take your time. Drive with the W, A, S and D keys.
save-my-pumpkin: Save My Pumpkin is the second release of a well-liked Halloween puzzle game that children everywhere have taken to. Your mission is to rescue a creepy pumpkin that has found itself in trouble, and you do it by sketching lines on the screen. These lines act as barriers around the pumpkin, so your drawing skills get tested. Because the pumpkin faces serious danger, you need to be both careful and quick.
Drawing is simple: touch the screen and move your finger to make a line. When bats appear and threaten the pumpkin, keep your finger held down for ten seconds to stop them from harming it.
motor-bike-pizza-delivery-2020: Hop onto a motorbike and take on the job of pizza courier in this action game. You ride through the streets of the town, visiting different clients to deliver their orders. Your aim is to bring the town's best pizza to each one of them.

Steering is handled with the W, A, S and D keys, which drive your bike around town. The game sits in the action category and carries bike and driving tags, so two-wheeled road trips are at its core. Keep your pizzas moving across town and reach every customer on your list.
return-of-evil-granny-the-school: Trapped inside a haunted school, you are hunted by Granny and her sidekicks. Your task is to find 8 keys, and along the way you shoot anything that moves. Granny is more evil than ever, and she has raised the dead to join the chase. Remember to aim for the head.

Move with W, A, S, and D, and look around with the mouse. Left click fires, right click aims, and the mouse wheel changes weapons. Press G for grenades, R to reload, and F to pick up items. Hold Left Shift to run or Left Ctrl to crouch. It is a shooting game with escape, puzzle, and zombie elements, plus weapons, and it runs on WebGL.
basketball-beans-game: Basketball Beans puts you on the court in a 3D basketball title where you take part in tournaments and face opposing teams. Your job is to guide your players as they pass the ball to teammates and steal it from the opposition. When the moment is right, go for a long three-pointer or a powerful dunk.

Rewards you collect let you unlock extra basketballs and new team uniforms for your players. The game sits in the arcade, ball, skills, and sports categories, so it suits anyone who enjoys skill-based ball games.
multiplayer-car-crash-simulator: Take the wheel in this online racing title, where you share the road with other players in real time. Crashing is part of the fun, as you collide with others across the city streets while working through the destructive obstacles that fill the town. The urban setting is packed with detailed landscapes, and interactive social features let you connect with the people you meet on the map.

Steering uses W to accelerate, S to reverse, A to turn left, and D to turn right. Hold the Space bar for the handbrake, press Shift for nitro, and tap C to change the camera view. Everything else is handled through the in-game interface.
halloween-zombie-zone-clear: When night falls, the streets fill with undead wanderers, and it's your job to clear them out. You push through haunted roads and gloomy graveyards armed with a large selection of powerful weapons. Each wave is harder than the last, so your strategy has to keep pace.

Special abilities and well-placed traps give you an edge against the horde. You can also team up with friends for chaotic cooperative battles. Controls are simple: just click or tap with your mouse. Your goal is to survive the night and save the town from the zombie outbreak.
subway-surfers-st-petersburg: Subway Surfers St. Petersburg takes you on a fresh run through the city of St. Petersburg. Your path leads down into the underground metro, where the aim is to stay out of reach of a grumpy inspector who wants to catch you. Played in 3D, this hypercasual title blends action and adventure, and jumping is one of the moves you will use along the way.
Built with HTML5, the game runs right in your browser. The goal never changes: get down into the subway and keep the grumpy inspector from grabbing you.
turtle-hero-animal-rescue: Turtle Hero Animal Rescue is a hypercasual game built around charming 2D cartoon animals. Each level challenges you to pick up yellow stars and make it to the finish line. Along the way, your flexibility and precision are put to the test as you move past a range of obstacles. The stars you gather matter beyond a single level, since the more you collect, the more hearts you can buy to improve your play. It is a title that can hold your interest for hours.
Use W to jump and S to drop down from the platform you are standing on.
beach-rainbow-season: Summer beach days have arrived, and you get to spend them with your best friend. The plan is simple: take a dip, soak up the sun, ride some waves and enjoy yourself. Your job is to dress a pair of trendy social media stars for a beach party. The girls tend to go for bright swimwear and tops, while the boy looks good in athletic clothes or shorts. Finish each look with accessories from famous labels.
Controls are easy to learn. On a computer you click with the mouse, and on a touchscreen device you just tap the screen.
squid-prison-games: This hypercasual running game challenges you to get through ten levels while locked up in a prison. Each level you clear pays out money, and you can spend that cash on items for your character. Before you begin, pick one of three players, then race against twenty other inmates who are also determined to break out.

Steering your runner is easy. Move with your mouse, or use the arrow keys or WASD. Built with WebGL, the game carries tags such as casual, escape, funny, and running, so it suits quick, lighthearted sessions.
formula-car-circuit-racing: Climb behind the wheel of powerful formula cars and feel the rush of fast motorsport. You race against skilled opponents on stunning tracks, passing rivals, handling sharp corners, and working your way toward the championship title. Expect realistic racing, smooth handling, changing surroundings, and fierce competition across several demanding circuits. Improve your skills, chase the quickest lap times, and see whether you have what it takes to win the formula racing crown.

Controls are straightforward. W or the up arrow accelerates, A or the left arrow turns left, D or the right arrow turns right, and S or the down arrow brakes. Press B to look back, C to change the camera view, and click the mouse to interact.
swat-force-vs-terrorists: A group of terrorists is plotting attacks, and your job is to stop them before they strike. You take command of the strongest anti-terrorist force, the SWAT unit, and lead a team of two highly trained soldiers. Your team carries a range of powerful weapons designed to take down the enemy.

Expect a hard fight, because the enemies keep coming and you must hold your ground no matter what. Your goal is to defend your position against these hordes and guide your two-person team to a final victory. Keep watch, use your arsenal wisely, and do not give up the spot.
monster-girls-high-school-squad: Monster Girls High School Squad is a dress-up game where you style supernatural students however you like. You can combine different pieces of clothing in many ways, then add magical charms to finish each look. The game centers on fashion, with friendship and a touch of enchantment running through it. Exploring the wardrobe lets you discover new options for every character.

Everything is controlled with a left mouse button click. Pick items, try them on, and watch your ideas come to life on the characters. There is plenty of room to let your imagination run wild, and every outfit you create is entirely your own.
endless-run: Endless Run is a 3D hypercasual game set in a digital jungle, where you keep running along a track full of obstacles. Your aim is to collect as many coins as you can. Keep an eye out for the cool magnets and surprises hidden along the way. The pace picks up as you go, and the physics keep each run fresh and unpredictable.

Jump high, slide down, or steer away and onto different paths, whatever you like, but stay clear of the blocks. To move, swipe left or right, or use the arrow keys. To jump, swipe up or press the space key.
impostor-beans: Impostor Beans is a multiplayer racing game with an impostor theme, built for both desktop and mobile play. Your job is to overtake many other players and finish first in the opening stage. The second stage tests your memory, so you will need to recall what you have seen to get ahead. In the third stage, the goal is to last as long as you can, and doing so wins you the game. Move with the arrow keys and use the Space bar for actions, or swipe and tap on a touchscreen.
baby-cat-daycare: Baby Cat Daycare puts you in charge of caring for a small kitten in a virtual pet setting. The mood is light and cheerful, with a soothing feel that helps you unwind. Nothing rushes you, so you can set your own pace and enjoy the calm. Fans of pet care games should appreciate how responsive everything feels.

Controls are simple: click and drag to play. This family-friendly title is a gentle, safe pick for kids who want straightforward, joyful fun. It also suits anyone who prefers relaxed, unhurried gameplay. Among cat games, it stands out as one of the sweetest around.
johnny-jump-challenge-online-game: Johnny Jump Challenge is a fast-paced arcade game that is easy to start and hard to put down. Your aim is to climb as high as possible without falling. Obstacles block your way, and they become tougher as you reach higher levels, so you need to leap over them or slip past. The more you play, the higher your score grows.

It also works well as a game to share with friends who want to compete. Keep away from the Boxing, since it can knock you out of the run. Your score builds as you move up through the levels. Getting really good takes a lot of practice, so expect to play many rounds. To begin, just tap to play.
steal-simulator: Steal Simulator puts you in control of a thief competing to grab goods from across the map. Move with skill, choose your targets with care, and haul back as much loot as you can to outdo your rivals. Each level brings new challenges, so you will need quick reflexes and smart tactics to stay ahead.

The game is casual and simple to learn, yet it is easy to keep playing. It offers a light, funny, and engaging experience from start to finish. To move your thief, use the W, A, S, and D keys or the arrow keys.
princesses-beauty-salon: Tiana, Aurora, and Mulan are getting ready for a party tonight. Before heading out, the three princesses stop by a beauty salon to freshen up their appearance. Tiana focuses on her hands, Mulan wants work done on her legs, and Aurora hopes her back will look soft and fair. Each princess has her own treatment to complete.

Once the treatments are finished, you choose outfits for the princesses from the clothing options. Your goal is to make sure each one looks attractive and delightful for the celebration. Controls are simple, since a mouse click or a tap is all you need to move through the game.
impossible-car-parking-master-2023: Impossible Car Parking Master is a single-player 3D racing-category game built around parking. It is described as a mobile parking game, and it asks you to squeeze your car into narrow, tricky spaces. Each level is harder than the last, and you must guide your car into the marked spot while dodging obstacles and other vehicles. The graphics and physics feel lifelike, so every tight manoeuvre demands care. Your aim is to master parking in difficult situations and reach the highest score.

Move with W, A and D or the arrow keys. Press Num 0 or N for neutral, Num 1 or E to accelerate, and Num 2 or R to reverse. The vehicle physics are realistic, and the game also offers different controls.
stickman-archer-assassin: Stickman Archer Assassin puts you in a shooting adventure built around action. You face off against rivals in duels, where your weapon of choice is a bow, and your job is to take down every enemy you meet. Each round tests your aim and timing as you try to come out on top.

Controls are simple: you can play with a touchscreen or with your mouse. Just tap or click to draw, aim, and release your arrows. Whether you are playing on a phone or at a desk, the game is easy to pick up and keep going.
territory-io: Territory.io is an arcade game about claiming land on the map. Your goal is to hold more ground than anyone else, and you do this by drawing loops with your trail to enclose sections of territory. Rival AI opponents are also fighting for dominance, so you'll need to stay sharp. Picking up power-ups grants special abilities that can shift the battle in your favor.

Moving around is simple: use WASD or the arrow keys. A live leaderboard keeps track of who is currently ahead, so you always know where you stand. The pace is quick, and each move you make involves some planning. To start, use a mouse click or tap, then begin expanding your domain.
grimace-night: Grimace Night is a Halloween-themed adventure puzzler where you guide a small Grimace through spooky surroundings. Your job is to gather the keys that open the portals leading to each exit. Along the way you will run into obstacles scattered around a deserted area, though a few of them are there to help you. Use the blocks to climb higher, grab the keys, and make your way to the end point to clear the stage.
Controls are simple: click or tap to play. Keep an eye on your route, because every key must be collected before the portal will open. Thinking a few steps ahead will help you get through each level.
donut-stack: Donut Stack is a free, casual online game aimed at boys. You make and collect many different kinds of donuts, then serve the food to customers. Plenty of obstacles stand in your way, so you'll need to dodge them to keep things moving. Gameplay is easy to pick up, and the whole experience is meant to help you unwind and let go of everyday pressure.

You control everything with either your mouse or a tap on the screen, so the controls are simple to learn. Whether you're on a computer or a touch device, you can jump right in and enjoy the fun. It's a relaxed way to spend some time and clear your head.
classic-chess: Chess is a board game for two players, played on 64 squares arranged in an 8x8 grid. Each side begins with 16 pieces: one king, one queen, two knights, two rooks, two bishops, and eight pawns. The aim is to checkmate the rival king, leaving it in imminent danger of capture.
You can face an artificial intelligence opponent or share the same device with a friend. The game can also solve chess problems. To play, use a mouse click or a tap.
metal-guns-fury-beat-em-up: Grab your heavy weapons and get ready for a shooter built around action. A group of renegade slugs has taken over an island, and it's up to you to call in your soldiers. You lead a squad of four fighters, a mix of commandos and heroes from earlier wars. Choose your weapons, then climb into tanks, mechas, and other vehicles to hit the enemy in destructive battles.

Your job is to blow up the enemy army and save the people on the island. Rescue the hostages taken prisoner by the enemy vanguard, defend the country, and take down the enemy commander in chief. Keep firing.
color-screw-rescue-puzzle: Color Screw Rescue Puzzle challenges your brain with colorful screws, tricky layouts, and rescue missions to complete. Each level blends strategic thinking with the satisfying mechanics of removing screws, giving the game a style of its own. Fans of casual games and color sort titles should find plenty here to enjoy.
Controls are simple: click and drag to play. Use your mouse to grab and move items as you work through each stage, planning every step to complete each rescue.
robots-enigma: Robots Enigma is a shooting game in which you guide a character across a level with rough, difficult ground. Coins lie scattered around the map, and your aim is to gather as many as you can while picking your way through the terrain. To win, you must defeat every enemy unit on the level.
Movement uses the W, A, S and D keys or the arrow keys. A left click of the mouse launches your attack. Keep your eyes on the coins and the enemies at the same time, and enjoy the robot battles.
robot-shooting: Robot Shooting puts you in the middle of an alien invasion. The visitors from space have set their sights on your world, and it falls to you to stop them. Every ounce of your strength is needed to hold the line and push the attackers back.

Controls are kept simple, with the left mouse button doing all the work. Fire away at the invaders and pour your full effort into the struggle. The game sits in the Shooting category and is tagged as a Shooter, so fans of that style will know what to expect.
gun-strike: Gun Strike puts you in the role of a soldier in a 3D first-person shooter made for fans of commando-style games. You fight with a range of light and heavy guns, and you can also throw powerful grenades when a battle gets tough.

The action takes place in two kinds of settings. You can fight in a village, or in a city-like area of buildings, and each environment changes how you move and fight. The controls are simple: use WASD to move, the left mouse button to shoot, and the right mouse button to aim. Hold Shift to accelerate, press Space to jump, tap C to crouch, and press T for time dilation.
candy-match-sagas-2: Step into the enchanted realm of Candy Match Sagas 2, a sequel to the Match 3 puzzler. The game offers many stages and polished visuals. Your job is to guide a young witch through each puzzle so she can find her way out of this magical land. Clever moves and helpful power-ups are your tools for clearing every level.
To play, simply use your mouse or touchscreen to swap and match the blocks. Each match brings you closer to finishing the current stage and moving on to the next challenge.
pga6-pixel-gun-warfare-2-zombie-attack: This shooter lets you pick from a wide range of guns and other weapons, whether you prefer playing alone or teaming up with others in multiplayer. The action takes place across several maps, where you battle Minecraft zombie bots. Even when you are well armed, you still have to defeat other zombies in a zombie battle, and it can catch you completely off guard.

It is played from a first-person view, and you often need to hide behind different objects to stay safe. The controls are straightforward: W, A, S, and D walk your character, the mouse aims, looks around, and shoots, and the Tab key opens the menu.
african-princesses-style-island: On a tropical island, a fashion show inspired by African traditions is about to take place. The two main stars are Princess Tiara, a charming host, and her stylish friend, Princess Zania. Each princess has to pick the perfect look for the celebration. You can change their hairstyles, apply makeup, and try on lovely outfits in African style.

Finish each look with earrings, sunglasses, or handbags with a traditional feel. Your job is to create striking styles for both princesses and explore the world of Afro-fashion on Style Island. You can play with a computer mouse or tap a touchscreen, depending on the device you are using.
xtreme-real-city-car-parking: Xtreme Real City Car Parking is a racing game packed with driving challenges and advanced features. Your job is to park cars inside a supermarket building, which helps you sharpen your parking skills. The game mixes parking, driving, and simulation across multiple levels, and its style of play is unlike what many players have tried before. Every attempt asks you to park without touching obstacles, so you must avoid barriers and other vehicles. Lining up each car accurately is a real test of precision.

Controls are simple. Use W, A, S, and D to move, and press Space to brake. The game runs in your browser and uses 3D graphics, WebGL, and HTML5, with an arcade feel and a modern supermarket parking setting.
squid-craft-online: Squid Craft Online is a 3D arcade game inspired by the popular Squid Game, and it turns the Grandmother's Footsteps idea into a simulation challenge. You move your character forward while a robot girl is talking, since that is when it is safe to advance. The moment she stops, you must freeze where you are or keep moving forward. Anyone caught moving gets shot and eliminated right away. Your goal is to finish all five worlds before time runs out.
The game is built around timing and careful listening, and it is tagged as casual and kid-friendly. Controls are simple: drag to move your character. Stay focused, because one mistake ends your run.
draw-defence: Draw Defence is a straightforward tower defense title in which foes march toward your castle and you have to keep your homeland safe. Your weapon is your pen: sketch different lines to call up several types of soldiers to fight for you. As the waves grow tougher, the enemies get stronger too, so you will need to upgrade your gear to hold them off.
To play, simply tap and slide your finger across the screen to draw each line. Think about which soldiers you bring out and when, because every wave tests your planning.
sky-bike-stunt-3d: Sky Bike Stunt 3D lets you hop on a motorbike and perform daring tricks. The game combines bike racing with stunt riding, so you can move between speedy races and acrobatic moves. It is presented in 3D and sits in the Boys category, with tags pointing to bikes, stunts, and sky-themed action.

You take the controls of a bike and compete against some of the top riders from around the world. Drive with the W, A, S and D keys. Whether you enjoy racing or stunts, this title offers plenty of two-wheeled fun.
martial-arts-fighter-duel: Step into a tournament arena where seventeen martial artists from many different countries and regions are ready to face off. Each fighter brings a personal style, and your aim is to defeat every rival you meet. Pick Arcade to join the tournament solo, or choose 2 Player to settle things with a friend. You can adjust the difficulty in the settings menu before you begin, so choose a level that suits you and start fighting when you feel prepared.
Player 1 moves with W, A, S and D, throws punches with F, G and H, and kicks with C, V and B. Player 2 uses the arrow keys to move, punches with U, I and O, and kicks with J, K and L.
masked-forces-crazy-mode: Masked Forces Crazy Mode is a lighthearted shooter built around its wild Crazy modes. Players can pick from a large arsenal of guns and other weapons, and they can choose between online matches with others or solo play without a connection.

Move with W, A, S and D, and use your mouse to aim and fire. Press Space to jump, and hit T whenever you want to send a chat message to other players. The game runs in 3D through WebGL and is tagged for multiplayer, shooting and 3D fun.
mr-bullet-3d: An enemy is launching an attack, and you must wipe it out right away. Your only weapons are a gun and a single bullet, so every shot has to count. Look around the scene for props you can use, as long as they help you reach your goal. This one should keep you busy for a good while.
Everything runs on dragging, so that is the only control you need to learn. Once you get the feel for it, you will be ready to deal with the attack and reach the goal.
pixel-gun-apocalypse-gui-z-5-2022: Battle your way through a long-running conflict with ghost drones, spread across several Minecraft worlds. You carry a range of deadly guns and other weapons, and the challenge will ramp up as you go. Like most arcade shooters, you can use cover during firefights, and just as a horror hero is typically armed, you'll want to be ready to fight back.
Move with W, A, S and D, and use the mouse to aim, look around and shoot. Press Tab to open the menu and the space bar to jump.
popsy-surprise-valentines-day-coloring: Grab your brushes and step into this Valentine's Day coloring game starring the adorable Popsy dolls. Your job is to fill them in with lively, cheerful shades, the kind of bright hues these dolls seem to love so much. Feel free to experiment with whatever colors you like best.

Play with a left mouse click or by touching the screen on a touch device. When your artwork is finished, take a screenshot and share it with your friends so they can admire your work. This girly, princess-inspired coloring pick is a good fit for anyone who enjoys creating pretty pictures.
flyway-duo-race: Flyway Duo Race puts you behind the wheel of casual-style cars on the Flying Way, with a friend joining in two-player mode. The goal is to cover the longest distance you can with your car. Along the journey, collect diamonds, then spend them in the shop menu to buy new cars.

Launch off ramps, stay in the air for as long as you can, and steer around obstacles on the course. Player 1 uses W, A, S and D or the arrow keys, but those controls apply only in 1P mode. Player 2 steers with the arrow keys.
mob-city: Crime is climbing in Mob City, so you take on missions to help bring the city back on track. Along the way, you can hop into vehicles and drive them around, while using strong weapons to get the job done. The cartoon-style look gives the city a playful feel.

Movement runs on WASD, with space to jump and left Shift to activate slow time. Press Q and E to cycle through your weapons, and use E again to get in or out of a car. Left click fires your gun, right click tosses a grenade, and Tab pauses the action.
spiny-ninja: Spiny Ninja sends you on an island adventure where stealth and planning matter most. You slip past enemy patrols, stay out of their view cones, and take foes down quietly from behind. Slink into the shadows, grab coins, and look for safe routes that lead to save points. Coins can also buy shields that keep you protected during the tougher stages. When your ninja falls, you can bring them back using coins or rewards. Make it to the destination to clear each level and open up harder challenges.
Move with the arrow keys or by swiping with the mouse. Press the spacebar to perform a shadow strike, and tap X to close the tutorial box.
mahjong-chains: Mahjong Chains is a traditional connection puzzle built around mahjong tiles. Your job is to find identical stones and link them together so they disappear from the board. A pair only clears when the path connecting it uses no more than three straight lines, so you need to plan your connections carefully.

You can choose between two game modes: normal and relaxed. Relaxed mode offers easier gameplay, has no timer, and keeps going with endless levels. To play, click or tap a stone to select it, then tap its matching stone to clear the pair.
monster-truck-offroad-driving-game: Fans of monster trucks and off-road driving simulators will feel at home with this title. It was built with younger players in mind, especially children who enjoy stunt-style games. The 3D graphics make the trucks stand out, and even toddlers can join in. Anyone who has already played a truck game should find the driving familiar.

Everything is controlled with the keyboard's arrow keys, so there is no complicated setup to learn. Press the arrows to drive your truck and enjoy the ride. Whether you are an experienced truck driver or a young newcomer, this game is easy to pick up and fun to play.
stick-warrior-action-game: Stick Warrior is an arcade fighting game built around stickmen. Foes charge in from both sides of the screen, and your job is to strike them down before they reach you. Each enemy you defeat helps you chase a higher score, and there are plenty of warriors to beat and blast.

Controls are very easy. Tap the left or right side of the screen at the precise moment to hit whichever opponent is approaching from that direction. Keep fighting without pause, since one stop means your stickman dies and the run ends. Push your timing to see how long you can keep death at bay.
meme-tiles: Meme Tiles is a rhythm game where you hop from tile to tile, and each jump has to land on the beat. Press the left or right arrow keys on a computer, or tap the left or right side of the screen on a phone or tablet, to pick your next tile. Stay on the correct tiles and don't fall off, while funny memes pop up along the way. It's a quick, one-player arcade challenge with a casual feel, mixing music, racing, and plenty of skill.
Your reflexes are the main test here. Keep your timing steady, stay in rhythm, and see how far your run can carry you.
noob-vs-blue-monster: Noob is a character many players find charming and funny, and in this series he is in serious danger. He is running away from a massive blue monster and must leap across cliffs to stay ahead, because falling behind would leave him in real trouble. Your job is to guide him to the statue portal at the far end and help him escape the spot where he has become stuck.

Move with the W and D keys or the arrow keys, or use touch controls on mobile. Double jump is active, which helps with tricky gaps. Get past the obstacles and reach the door while the blue monster keeps up the chase. Jump into Noob's escape and see whether he can outrun the monster.
nullpulse-runner: Nullpulse Runner is a fast-moving arcade title in the hypercasual style. You steer a glowing energy orb through a futuristic world full of neon light. Time your jumps well, dodge the dangerous obstacles ahead, and see how long you can keep going. Each attempt also gives you a chance to beat your own high score.

The controls are kept simple. On desktop, press Space or click the left mouse button to jump, press Esc to pause or resume, and press M to mute or unmute the sound. On mobile, tap the screen to jump. The gameplay is endless, and smooth animations keep the action flowing, so every run becomes a fresh test of reflexes and skill.
street-food-maker: Here you run a food stall on the street, taking on the role of a chef who serves tasty meals. Pick from many dishes that come from a range of different cuisines. You can mix and match a large selection of ingredients and toppings, shaping each order to fit your own taste. Use your mouse or finger to cook up dishes.

dress-up-girls-2025: Step into a range of styling jobs in this single-player dress-up game. Your clients include savvy businesswomen, doctors, healthcare workers, stylish brides-to-be, and many more.

The styling fun has no end, so you can keep dressing people up for as long as you like. Controls are simple: use a mouse click or a tap to play. Pick your items, click through your choices, and build the look you have in mind.
highschool-mean-girls-2: The notorious mean girls are back at school, this time with a new take on their story. In this online dress-up game for girls, you help them pick out looks for the first day of class. Two groups of best friends enter a high school fashion challenge, and your job is to design eye-catching outfits for them. It's a single-player makeover and fashion experience built with HTML5.

Only one group can be named the next fashion queen, so your styling choices matter. The two crews are the supermodels and the singers, and you decide which side comes out on top. Use your mouse on desktop, or tap the screen on a mobile device.
football-superstars-2022: Football Superstars 2022 is a simple, refreshing mini football game that gives the sport a lighter spin. You can start with a Friendly match, choosing any of the seven international teams for yourself and your opponent, and see how your skills hold up. For a bigger test, pick one team and enter the World tournament, where your aim is to beat randomly selected sides and guide your squad through the competition.

As the game reminds players, nobody has ever drowned in sweat, so expect a relaxed, playful kick-about rather than a serious grind. Both modes give you a quick way to play, whether you want a single friendly or a longer run through the world stage.
stone-merge: Stone Merge is an arcade puzzle where you slide a rock onto another rock that shows the same number and color. When two matching stones meet, they fuse into one, and both the color and the number on the new rock increase. Your aim is to keep combining pieces until you reach a much larger number.

To play, drag a block or rock onto a matching one with the same number. If that isn't possible, you can move the piece to another position instead, as long as the space allows it. The game is listed under Arcade and car
the-baby-in-yellow-game: The Baby In Yellow is a horror game that puts you in the role of a nanny caring for a strange baby. Everything is handled with a mouse and keyboard, so both devices play a part in every move you make. Keep your wits about you as the situation unfolds, since you can never be sure how long you will manage to hold things together.
animal-klotski: Your goal in this Klotski sliding puzzle is to help a pink rabbit escape. Cute animals block its path, so every move matters as you slide them into the right spots. Each level places different animal-shaped blocks across the board, and you move them by clicking and dragging.

bus-stunts-game: Bus Stunts Game puts you behind the wheel of a bus in a driving simulator built around crashes and daring tricks. speed-demons-race: Picture oversized, rugged monster trucks lining up for a race. In Speed Demons Race, you build your own truck and aim to leave every rival behind. The courses are packed with hills, slopes, metal jumps, shipping containers to drive through, and wooden crates to smash. Only skilled drivers can handle the whole route.

Pulling off stunts and winning races pleases the crowd and earns coins, which you can spend on upgrades for your truck. To prove you are the best, you must cross the finish line first on every track. save-my-doge: This is the follow-up to a well-liked cute title that many children have grown fond of. basketball-tournament-3d: This 3D basketball game sends you into a free-throw tournament, where every shot brings you closer to your goal.
