Keep scoring in a row to earn a fire ball bonus, and bank your shot off the backboard to collect a backboard bonus. Everything is controlled with a mouse, so you can jump right in.
dilivery-challenge: Delivery Challenge is a puzzle adventure where you guide a young man past a series of obstacles so he can bring a gift to his girlfriend. Study the terrain, pick the path that will work, and watch out for traps along the way. Each level brings a new challenge, and the difficulty climbs as you progress, so you will need both skill and logical thinking to get through.

Controls are simple: use the arrow keys to move and press the space bar to throw. The gameplay is easy to pick up and engaging, making it a good choice for entertainment whenever you have a few minutes to spare.
parking-slot: Parking Slot is a 3D driving game where you take the wheel of an SUV and guide it into a marked parking space. Finishing each parking task quickly earns you more points, and along the way you can unlock a range of achievements. On a computer, the arrow keys or the W, A, S and D keys steer and move the car, while the mouse lets you zoom in and out and spin the camera around. On a phone or tablet, on-screen buttons handle driving, and you can slide your finger across the screen to rotate the view.
rally-car-hero: Rally Car Hero takes you across the world in the Rally Car Championship. You race against other drivers, dodge them on the track, and use boosts to take twisting corners at speed. Collecting coins along the way lets you upgrade your car for the next race.
Steering is easy to learn. On mobile, touch the screen to steer. On desktop, use the cursor keys or the WASD keys. It is a 3D arcade racer with a classic feel, and it plays right in your browser.
pancake-running-game: Cook up stacks of pancakes and deliver them to customers in this 3D running game. You can add toppings such as strawberries, bananas, and blueberries to your creations. Your aim is to pile the pancakes as high as you can while avoiding the traps that line the road.

Moving your runner is easy, since you only need to slide to move. Keep an eye out for the traps ahead. The title sits in the Sports category and is tagged for kids and boys, with labels including food, obstacle, and running.
color-water-sort: Color Water Sort is a puzzle game you control with simple taps. Your goal is to sort liquids of different colors into separate tubes. The idea sounds easy, but the challenges test how well you can plan each move, and you need to complete all of them to finish the game. Tap to pour a liquid from one tube into another and work your way through the puzzle.

As more tubes are added, the puzzle becomes a much bigger test of logic. It suits players who enjoy brain teasers and anyone who likes solving problems one careful step at a time. Stay patient, think ahead, and see how many of the challenges you can solve.
collect-hair: Collect Hair is a hypercasual game with adventure and arena elements, and it features a boy as its main character. The farther you go toward the back, the harder things get. More steps appear along the way, and the hair you gather grows stronger, so the challenge keeps rising as you progress.

The game is designed to appeal to a wide range of players. Its interesting mix of gameplay and steadily growing difficulty can hold attention from start to finish, and anyone who enjoys a fun, layered challenge should find it engaging.
mob-escape: Mob Escape combines action and survival as you try to get away from a dangerous mob and reach a safe place. Along the way you face a series of missions and challenging levels, with obstacles in your path and a quick pace that keeps you moving. Success depends on sharp thinking, careful movement, and good timing, since every escape mission must be completed to get through.

The game is controlled entirely with your mouse, so you can focus on reading each situation and responding in time. It suits players who enjoy running and survival challenges, and its tags include Adventure, Casual, and Best Games. Keep your wits about you and your timing precise, and you might just make it out.
zombie-wars-topdown-survival: Zombie Wars TopDown Survival is a top-down shooter where you fight off the undead and collect treasure along the way. You will need to plan how and when you use your ammunition and the rest of your arsenal. Before heading into battle, load up on ammo and upgrade your firearms so you are better prepared. Keep in mind that the zombies move faster as you go, and a boss waits at the end for you to destroy.

To begin, click or tap to play, and you are ready to go. On a PC, you can move your character with the WASD keys or the arrow keys. Both sets of controls let you guide your character through the fight, so use whichever feels more comfortable to you.
on-air-monster-truck-race: On Air Monster Truck Race is a demanding 3D racing game with a tough course. You choose from a range of huge, modern, powerful monster trucks and compete in an international event. Every track brings adventure, and your aim is to finish first and claim the championship title. Numerous dragon-style trucks are open to drive in this 4x4 water race, making it a striking challenge.
Collect money prizes and spend them to unlock the monster truck you love most. Then dive into the fast, intense missions the game offers. Steer with WASD or the Arrow keys.
train-snake-taxi: Your goal in Train Snake Taxi is to pick up every passenger on the map so you can finish the level. Each person you collect adds another carriage, which means the train keeps growing as you go. Keep an eye on the tail as it stretches out behind you, because running into it will crash your train and end the run.
The game is hypercasual, so it is quick to pick up and easy to enjoy in short bursts. Steer carefully, plan your route around the growing train, and see how far you can take your passenger line.
meme-piggy-adventure: Meme Piggy: Adventure puts you in charge of a pig racing to help Princess Pig. Your job is to get past every hazard in the way and rescue her. You control the pig through a platform adventure where each jump counts. The meme-style animations and sounds are built to get a laugh out of you along the way. As you clear obstacles, grab the stars you pass, and build up your score, you can climb toward the top of the leaderboard.
On a computer, move with WASD, jump with Space, and press Space twice in the air for a double jump. Press ESC to pause. On a phone or tablet, use the on-screen interface buttons to play.
clay-craft-tycoon: Clay Craft Tycoon is a factory management game where you build a clay business from the ground up. Turn raw clay into finished items such as pots, plates, and cups. Store your products in the warehouse, then sell them to outside markets.

Daily tasks give you goals to work toward, and you earn cash at every stage of production. Spend that money on new production units to expand your factory. To interact with the in-game interface, use your mouse or tap the screen.
words-fall: Words Fall is a word puzzle that tests how quickly you can come up with words. Letters tumble down from above, and your job is to spell words from them so they vanish before they pile up. Each level speeds things up, so your word-building skills get a real workout. Along the way you can unlock power-ups and bonuses that give you a helpful boost.

Scores can be compared on a global leaderboard, where you can also try to beat your friends' best. The game blends quick reflexes with careful planning, and it is designed to be enjoyable for players of every age. Controls are simple: click or tap to play.
head-soccer-2022: Head Soccer 2022 brings a fresh take on head-to-head football. You can play alone against the computer opponent, or invite a friend to share one keyboard and test your soccer skills together. Whichever mode you pick, the goal is the same: score more goals than your rival before the match clock runs out. The player with the most goals when time is up takes the win.

Solo matches use the arrow keys to move, with F and G to shoot. For two players, the first player moves with WASD and shoots with F and G, while the second player uses the arrow keys and shoots with K and L.
pixel-gun-apocalypse-6-remastered: Here you play as the last sniper standing in a blocky zombie apocalypse. Endless waves of relentless undead keep coming, including creepy clowns and infected soldiers, and you must hold them back with precise aim. Survive the horde to earn your place on the leaderboards and prove you are the top hunter.

Swipe the screen to look around and spot zombies as they approach. Tap the scope button to zoom in for a steady, precise shot, then press the fire button to eliminate the blocky enemies. Points earned from your kills let you unlock and improve your gear, and upgrading your weapons helps you sharpen your sniping skills over time.
dream-restaurant: Dream Restaurant is a 3D clicker in the hypercasual style where you build a restaurant that fits your own vision. Your cook is ready for duty at the start of January, and you take on the role of waiter, welcoming guests and making their wishes come true right away. You begin by serving burgers and sandwiches, gathering several orders in one go before bringing them to the right tables.
The money you earn can be reinvested to expand
join-and-clash: Two armies are locked in a clash on an open field, and fighting can break out at any moment. Red stickmen and blue stickmen stand apart, and when they meet, every clash turns into hand-to-hand wrestling, the only way to come out ahead. You play as a brave knight who faces many challenges, and you gain more followers along the way.
Your mission is to rescue the princess. The game is played alone in 3D, and you move by sliding your finger across the screen.
baby-taylor-cafe-chef: Taylor has opened her cafe, and today she gets to try a day's work as the manager. The day gets busy quickly, so the first job is taking customers' orders. Your task is to prepare the drinks, sweets, and other dishes each guest asks for, matching what they want. Once people finish eating and leave, you'll need to tidy the table so it's ready for the next visitor.
Play with a mouse click or by tapping the screen. Keep an eye on the guests and see whether Taylor can keep everyone happy during the rush.
zombie-parade-defense-4: Zombie Parade Defense 4 is the fourth game in the series and carries on from where the earlier ones left off. This time the undead attack from two directions at once, which makes holding your castle much tougher. To help you, the game adds stronger weapons, useful boosts, and a fourth player who can join the fight. Your task is to stop the waves of zombies before they break through and your castle falls.

Up to four people can team up. Player 1 moves with W, A, S and D, switches guns with Q, and enters or leaves the base with E. Player 2 moves with the arrow keys. Player 3 moves with Y, G, H and L, switches guns with T, and uses U to enter or leave the base. Player 4 plays from the numeric keypad.
robot-car-transform-2: Robot Car Transform 2 is a simulation adventure where your machines can change shape. You can pilot many different cars and robots, then transform them into robots that each have their own abilities. Before you begin, choose a color from red, black, or blue, and pick the style that suits you.

The missions are the heart of the game, and they call for smart thinking and clever use of both forms your robot can take. The 3D world is bigger than you might expect, so you will need to explore it to see how large it really is. Use a mouse click or a tap to move through the adventure.
unroll-ball-slide-puzzle: Unroll Ball is a sliding tile puzzle that takes a familiar format and adds a fresh challenge. Your job is to shift the tiles so the ball has a clear route to the exit. Watching the ball roll across the linked tiles to the finish is a satisfying reward for each solved stage. The game is said to sharpen visual memory, reasoning, and quick thinking while building your ability to work through problems. It is simple to pick up but takes real effort to master. You control everything with mouse clicks.
hug-and-kis-city: Hug and Kis City is an adventure game in the Hug and Kis series. Your job is to gather gold, avoid zombies, pick up the key, and make it to the door. Both characters have to reach the exit safely, so you will need to guide them together through each stage. Along the way you help them deliver their way home while chasing the highest score you can manage.

Movement uses WASD or the arrow keys, and you can double jump when you need extra height. The game also works with mobile touch controls, and it supports both 1 player and 2 player modes. It is a 2D action title, so it is easy to pick up and sharp to keep playing.
stickman-ninja-way-of-the-shinobi: In this fighting title, you step into the shoes of a stickman ninja from the Black Panthers clan who charges into the fight. Your mission is to push the invaders out of his home. You can land quick lightning strikes and chain together combo attacks to take down foes, while a well-timed roll helps you slip past incoming blows.

As you progress, improve your hero so he becomes strong enough to defeat every enemy and win back his house. Move with WASD, roll with Space, swing your sword with a left mouse click, and unleash a combo attack with a right mouse click. On phones and tablets, use the on-screen interface buttons instead.
crash-war: Crash War is a three-dimensional title where racing machines battle one another. Each car carries a tank cannon, a weapon that hits hard and destroys whatever it strikes. Expect plenty of action as you take on rival vehicles on the track. Drifting through corners and avoiding hazards adds to the challenge.
Steer with WASD or the arrow keys, and hold Shift to use nitro for a speed boost. Use the mouse to control your weapon aim, then press the left mouse button to fire.
dino-puzzles: Dino Puzzles Jigsaw is a free browser game in the puzzle and jigsaw genre, and it suits younger players well. Start by choosing any of the 15 dinosaurs, then work through the pieces until the whole picture is complete. The controls are simple: one click or tap is all it takes to begin, so there is no complicated setup.

The game is designed for shared play between parents and little ones, with a family-friendly feel. Each dinosaur gives you a different image to complete, which keeps the activity interesting for young fans of dinosaurs. Built with HTML5, it is also free to enjoy right in your browser.
the-life-run: In this single-player arcade running game, you take on the role of a determined hero whose mission is to save humanity. The setting is a bleak future where a deadly virus has spread across the land. You must race against the clock, get past the obstacles in your way, and make key choices that shape what happens to the people who are still alive.

The game pairs detailed, eye-catching graphics with a story that unfolds as you go, and it mixes careful planning with fast-paced action. Controls are simple: click the mouse or tap the screen to play. Whether humanity survives depends on the decisions you make along the way.
aquapark-io: Aquapark.io is an arcade game set in the summer, full of splashy action on the water slides. You visit water parks in different places around the world, and your aim is to be the first to reach the bottom of the slide. Rivals who are just as keen to win race right alongside you.

Smashing and crashing into opponents is allowed, so bumping them is part of the game. Everything is controlled with the mouse alone, so there is no keyboard to worry about. It is a casual 3D game that runs right in your browser.
christmas-tom-differences: Christmas Tom Differences is a free online puzzle game with a festive twist, starring a lovable cartoon character named Tom. Each level presents two versions of a scene, and your task is to spot the five changes hidden between them. Once all five are found, the level is complete and you move on.

There is no timer, so you can work through the pictures at your own pace and enjoy the search. Control is simple: use your mouse or tap the screen to make your selections. It suits a quick break as well as a longer session of careful looking.
police-car-chase-online: You play as a police officer who is also a skilled driver. Several criminals have fled the scene in ordinary civilian cars, and it's up to you to catch them. Across ten levels, your job is to arrest these offenders by crashing their vehicles. Stay calm under pressure, then speed up to wreck their rides.
This 3D racing title can be played on mobile and has a simulation feel to its driving. Steer with WASD or the D-pad, and press Space to brake.
bunny-devil: Bunny Devil is a 2D platform adventure about a small, mischievous devil bunny who is prone to fits of crying. You step into a tough, legendary world where survival is the main challenge, and the little rabbit will go to great lengths to get through each stage. Your job is to guide him through a desert filled with enemies and beat the strange foes that stand in his way.

The game is built for one player and sits in the girls and arcade crowd, with a cute, animal-focused look. You move with the WASD keys on a computer, or use touch controls on a mobile device. Help the little devil rabbit make it through his enemy-packed land.
grimace-monster-dop-story: If you enjoy puzzles and want to test yourself against harder ones, this single-player arcade game is built for you. Your creativity and clever problem-solving will carry you through everyday scenes that keep throwing surprises your way. Your job is to pick up an eraser and use it to shift or wipe away whatever blocks your path.
The game uses HTML5 and is also listed for Android. Controls are simple: click the mouse or tap the screen to play.
mighty-party-doge-rescue: This logic puzzle puts a little puppy in a sticky spot, with a beehive stuck on its head. You need to help it get away from the bees by sketching a safe area on the screen where the pup can stay clear of them. The game is designed for mobile devices and is aimed at kids who enjoy rescue challenges.
The controls are simple: slide your finger across the screen to draw the safe zone. Keep the puppy inside that area for ten seconds and you win.
stickman-army-the-defenders: In this shooter, your nation is under attack from rebels and renegades. Bands of stickman fighters have begun storming public buildings and harming civilians. As the country's most skilled army strategist, you take command of a strong force built to halt the uprising and bring the civil war to an end. The fight will be a huge one, and every public institution must be guarded no
army-driver: Army Driver is a racing game with 30 levels to get through. Your job is to steer your vehicle along each course and push ahead of the competition. Between races you can head to the garage, where you can purchase new vehicles and upgrade the ones you already own.
Controls are simple. Use the left and right arrow keys to drive, and press the W key or the up arrow to jump over obstacles.
traffic-escapee: The little red car is caught in a jam and needs your help to get out. Your job is to move the cars that block its route, opening a clear lane so the red car can reach the exit. The game is simple to pick up but takes real thought to finish. Tap a car and drag it to slide it along its lane, then guide the red car toward the EXIT on the right.

There are 124 handmade levels spread over 12 worlds, with settings that run from a snug garage to a crowded harbor. Perfect solutions earn you 3 stars. A fresh Daily Challenge appears each day, and as you progress you can unlock a garage filled with stylish car sk
happy-kids-burger-maker: Ready to whip up some tasty grub? In this game you prepare burgers, fries, and chilled drinks in a kitchen. Each dish lets you sharpen your cooking abilities and pick up new methods, all with the aim of climbing the ranks to become a top little head chef. Once your food is ready, you pack it into cheerful junior meal boxes.
Controls are simple: click the mouse or tap the screen to play. It is a playful cooking title built around kitchen work and food preparation.
subway-surfers-orleans: Subway Surfers Orleans casts you as a runner trying to slip away from an inspector. On a computer, the arrow keys steer your character, and the space bar activates the skateboard. Your aim is to keep running for as long as you can, overcoming obstacles and dodging oncoming trains along the way. One wrong move means you get caught, the inspector catches up, and the chase is over.

Gold coins and assorted bonuses are spread along the route. Gathering them is worth the effort, since they unlock new possibilities in the game. Your goal is simple: get away as far as you possibly can.
commando-sniper-cs-war: Commando Sniper: CS War is the newest entry in a popular series of commando shooters. You play as a commando leading a modern army unit through dangerous missions in enemy territory, winning back battles that were lost, taking part in SWAT actions, and running ops against powerful terrorist forces. It is a 3D shooter for one player that runs in the browser with HTML5, and sniper combat is a big part of the experience.
Use W, A, S and D to move and the mouse to aim and shoot. Press Space to jump and scroll to switch weapons. Press T to slow time, G to open the map, and L to lock your cursor.
unicorn-kingdom: Unicorn Kingdom is a cute adventure for girls where you collect gems and combine them in a minigame to win prizes. Each prize helps you fill your sticker album with silly unicorns. Three worlds are waiting: you can play with Arya in a snowy kingdom, dash through a springtime forest with Canelita, or visit Candy's chocolate kingdom, which has giant glazed donuts.
The controls are simple. Press W to fly, press D to run, and drag the left mouse button to merge. The game carries the tags adventure, cute, horse, pony, and running.
hill-climb-pixel-car: Off-road racing fills this game, where riders speed across rough ground made of dirt, sand, mud, or grass. You need to handle your bike with skill to get past each obstacle and pull off impressive jumps. Go as fast as you can and aim to be crowned the sole champion of this motocross championship.

Hold the right pedal to start the engine, then keep pressing it to build speed, pass your rivals, and reach the finish line quickly. Use the left pedal to slow down or bring the vehicle to a stop. You can also use button A during your run.
sumo-smash: Step into the sumo ring for a wrestling contest with a playful twist. In Sumo Smash!, you battle for supremacy in a 3D arcade arena, and eating sushi helps your sumo grow. It is tagged as an .io style game, so you can expect a fast, lively match.

Growing bigger helps you dominate the ring, and pushing your rivals is how you win. Treasure chests are hidden within the arena, and opening them unlocks unique skins to customize your wrestler. On desktop, move with WASD or QZSD. On mobile, touch the screen to move.
model-dress-up-3d: Model Dress Up 3D is a styling game for girls and for anyone who enjoys makeup, trendy outfits, and creative dress-up challenges. You take lovely models and turn them into stylish looks, choosing from hundreds of clothing items, accessories, hairstyles, and makeup combinations. Each model's transformation is up to you.
It is a single-player casual makeover game tagged as a 2026 release. Every button is operated with a mouse, so you only need to point and click to move through the menus and make your selections.
desire-io: Desire IO is a multiplayer shooter played from a first-person view. It offers several game modes that suit all kinds of players. As you play, you can unlock new fighters and upgrade them, complete tasks, and face other players in tournaments.

Movement uses W, A, S and D, and the left mouse button fires. The right mouse button aims, and the mouse wheel switches weapons. Press Space to jump, C to sit down, and left Shift to run. If these keys don't suit you, you can change the controls in the game settings.
18-wheeler-truck-driving-cargo: Take the wheel of a cargo rig and complete transport assignments across the United States. Your routes take you through city streets and, at times, up a mountain road. Speed counts when you race through the city to reach your freight goals. The game also includes off-road driving, so you can test your skills on rougher ground while hauling cargo, with simulator-style truck driving and trucker-themed challenges along the way.

Controls are simple. Use W, A, S, and D to drive, press C to change the camera view, hold SPACE to brake, and press TAB to open the menu. Whether you enjoy the slow pace of a long haul or the rush of a city race, this title combines truck simulation and racing into one journey.
popcorn-eater-game: Popcorn Eater is a laid-back online game that costs nothing to play. To make popcorn, you press down on the screen and keep holding it. Once the popcorn count meets the marked line on the scale, you earn the highest score possible. The whole thing is casual and quick to pick up, so newcomers can jump right in.

Controls are simple and easy to handle, and the game offers a good number of levels to tackle. Each stage gives you another chance to test your skill. You can play with a mouse or by tapping the screen, and the action stays the same either way. It is meant to bring a bit of joy from start to finish.
supra-racing-speed-turbo-drift: Supra Racing Speed Turbo Drift focuses on high-speed driving, racing and drifting. As you play, you earn points, which can be converted into XP. Spend your progress on new cars, fresh paint colors and additional races. The opponents on track are quick, so you will need solid skill to keep up with them.
Controls are simple: use WASD to drive and steer, press W to brake, and press B to show the view behind you. F activates the nitro boost, and the spacebar pulls the handbrake.
a-survival-legend: Stay alive in a city swarmed by the undead. You will need to keep moving quickly while gathering coins, leveling up your abilities, and strengthening your weapons as hordes of zombies keep arriving from all directions without end. The controls stay straightforward, but the fights are fierce and the pressure never lets up, so each attempt comes down to good timing and careful planning. Pick your upgrades wisely, last longer than before, and use a revival when the moment is right to beat your previous top score.
Along the way you can climb the leaderboard and show that you are the final person left standing. To play, just click the mouse or tap the screen.
blocky-wars-vehicle-shooting-multiplayer: Blocky Wars is a pixel-style vehicle shooter where you can join online matches with other players or choose to play alone. You can practice in offline mode and adjust your setup there before heading into multiplayer. The game offers a wide range of weapons, including Assault, Heavy, Recon, Sniper, Support, Bounty Hunter, and Sapper, and you play the action from a first-person view.

Team up with friends in the in-game mode, where you can switch on different course features. You can also watch other players move around in real time. For a different challenge, enter Battle Royale mode and try to stay alive until the end. Use WASD to drive tanks, helicopters, and cars or to move your character, move the mouse to look around and shoot, scroll to change guns, and press Tab to open the menu.
car-drive-simulator: Car Park Simulator asks you to show off your driving skills across 72 demanding levels. Each one throws you into cramped spaces, awkward obstacles, and parking situations that feel true to life. Success depends on careful precision, good timing, and steady control as you steer toward a perfect park.

The game is controlled entirely with mouse clicks or taps, so there is no complicated setup to learn. It sits in the hypercasual category and carries the tags Arcade, Carparking, Driving, and Simulation.
kawaii-cute-cat: Kawaii Cute Cat is a kids' game full of cute cats and cat-themed charm. You become a cat yourself, collect candies, and add new cats to your collection. Yumi is waiting for you to jump in and become a sweet cat.

The main challenge is a race tour that you can take on alone or with other cats. Keep moving, don't stop, and be quick, aiming to be the best cat in the game and the first one across the line. Along the way, gather the candies. You control the game with a mouse click on a computer or touch on a mobile device.
kids-games-collection: This kids' compilation brings together several playful activities in one place. You can tap on a piano, sketch on a drawing canvas, fill in colouring pages, or bang out rhythms on drums. Pick whichever activity catches your eye and start right away. Each one is a separate game, so you can jump between them whenever you like.

Spend your time trying out the different games, colour a large number of pictures, or make some noise on the drums. Control everything with your mouse or by touching the screen, whichever suits you best. It is a fun mix of music and art that keeps the whole family busy.
fashionistas-pink-vlog: Aurora is a stylish video blogger who adores the color pink. She regularly puts together pink looks for her photos and vlogs. Her followers love seeing her outfits, so they have requested a video all about her favorite pink costumes. Your job is to step in as her assistant and help her get the filming finished. The game is all about having a good time alongside Aurora.
Playing is simple: use mouse clicks or taps to move through the game and make your choices.
home-rush-draw-to-home: Calm and easygoing, this rescue puzzler asks you to guide little friends back to their families. Sketch a line from the house to where each buddy is waiting, and their parents will be able to collect them. As you advance, the stages grow harder, throwing in deep pits, fierce animals, and figures such as Blue Monster, Grimace, and BanBam, along with many others.
Keep your drawn route straight and make sure two people never bump into one another. Watch out for
rotating-grimace: Rotating Grimace is a platform puzzler where you turn the whole world to steer Mr Grimace toward the stars he has lost. Forty challenge levels test your logic, pushing your reasoning skills to their limits. Grimace himself is front and center, and the cute graphics keep the mood light from start to finish.

The game suits children and grown-ups alike, doubling as brain training for the whole family. Precise physics make every tilt and drop feel accurate, and the sound effects add extra charm. You play by clicking the mouse or tapping the screen.
baby-boss-back-in-business: Baby Boss is getting back to work after a short break away. It's a fresh beginning following a brief gap, and he wants to make a strong first impression. Before he heads out, he needs to look his very best, so it's up to you to choose a sharp suit for him. Your job is to support the boss as he gets ready for his comeback.
The only control you need is a left mouse click. This dress-up game is filed under Girls, and it's a light, fun way to spend some time. Have a good time helping him dress for the workday ahead.
aztec-adventure: A father and his daughter managed to pull a treasure out of a mysterious pyramid in the Inca ruins. Inside the haul, they spotted a curious object that caught their attention. It turned out to be a key tied to the Aztecs, which hints that a new adventure is about to begin. Carrying the strange key, the pair heads for the Aztec pyramids, where they must solve puzzles and overcome obstacles to reach the treasure.

The game can be played by two people. Player 1 moves with W, A, S and D, throws a grenade with G, jumps with W, and can walk on walls. Hiding is done with S. Player 2 moves with the arrow keys, throws a grenade with L, jumps with the up arrow, and hides with the down arrow.
demolition-cartoon-car-crash-derby: Demolition Cartoon Car Crash Derby is a racing game where you smash into rivals in solo play or in multiplayer matches. This version adds more speed, a nitro boost, plenty of cars, a refreshed menu, and a newly added feature. Its handling feels steady, which gives the game better stability.
Getting around takes only a few keys. Use W, A, S, and D to steer and drive
easter-nails-designer: In this hypercasual game, you work as a manicurist at a nail salon on Easter, when a large crowd of customers arrives hoping for holiday styling. Your job is to design fashionable Easter nails for them. The first person in your chair is Rapunzel, and she is waiting for your creative touch.

Everything is controlled with taps or clicks. The title is tagged with creation, decorate, decoration, design, Easter, fun, girl, and girls, which reflects its focus on crafting festive nail looks. It is a light, playful pick for anyone who enjoys decorating and designing.
kick-off: Kick Off is a sports game built around physics. You bounce a ball and aim to knock it into the goal set along the top of the screen. To do this, drag your player character around the playfield. Whenever the character runs into the ball, the ball bounces off in response.

You lose a chance whenever the ball falls below the bottom edge of the screen, so keep it in play. A goal counts when the ball bounces into the net at the top. The title is tagged with football, soccer and play, placing it squarely in the sports category.
finger-heart-monster-refil: Finger Heart: Monster Refill is a single-player, 2D cartoon arcade game where you team up your finger with adorable monsters to build a heart shape. You don't need any special talent. Imagination, a good gut feeling, and a bit of luck will take you a long way. Difficulty moves from gentle to demanding, and now and then the action takes an odd, playful detour, yet the game keeps offering fun and a sense of reward.

ninja-jump-hero: Step into the shoes of a speedy ninja in this 2D arcade clicker. The endless run puts rocks in your path, and you can either dodge each one or smash it to pieces. Your aim is to last as long as you possibly can. The game is built with HTML5 and suits casual play.

diy-makeover-asmr-mask-3d: Not everyone has healthy skin, and for those who don't, a transformation is needed. Building a calming, ASMR-style skincare routine at home is an important step. It also helps to understand which makeup and skincare ingredients suit your particular skin type.

gun-master-3d-online: Gun Master 3D may look like a shooter, but it is really a physics-based arcade challenge built around 3D pixel guns and bricks. cs-war-gun-king-fps: CS War Gun King FPS is made with the Unity3D engine and shown from a first-person view that aims for a real-life feel. The action takes place on clear city streets, where you handle a variety of gun weapons and watch powerful explosions erupt around you. Together, these elements show how vast and cruel war can be.
Controls are straightforward. Press A to choose a position, use the mouse to attack, tap G to throw a grenade, and press T to fire the grenade launcher. It is a 3D action shooter built with HTML5.
popular-spa-salon: You have just become the owner of this spa salon, and girls keep arriving with one wish: to change their look. Your task is to show your talent and professional skills as you work with each visitor. It is a simulation-style game about running a busy beauty space.

Control is easy, since you only need your mouse or a tap on the screen. Built with HTML5, the game suits both computers and phones, and its cute, fun makeover theme keeps the experience light from start to finish.
fishing-hunting-game: Dive beneath the surface and put your hunting skills to the test in this underwater spear game. Your job is to line up each shot and launch your spear at colorful fish gliding through clear, lovely waters. Every fish you land adds to your score, but hitting moving targets takes good judgment of timing, sharp reflexes, and a steady hand. The fish speed up and become trickier to catch as you move along, so every round asks a little more of you than the one before. Keep working on your accuracy, chase a new high score, and enjoy a calm yet engaging fishing adventure full of challenges.
Aim with your mouse, then press the left mouse button to throw the spear.
super-girls-fall-fashion-trends: Super Girls Fall Fashion Trends lets you style a group of cute characters who love keeping up with the latest looks. If you want to be on-trend for autumn, this new title centers on dressing up the super girls for the season. Each girl is a dedicated fashion fan, and all of them have recently refreshed their wardrobes with new pieces.

Autumn is here, and the girls are ready to show off their style. Your job is to open their closets and discover which fashionable clothing items are tucked away inside. The whole game runs on left mouse button clicks, so every step is simple to follow.
squid-soccer-game: Squid Soccer Game is a sports title built around free kicks, where waves of soccer balls fly at you one after another. You are in charge of a star keeper from the Squid lineup, and your job is to keep every ball out of the net.

You can leap toward any side and at any height to reach a shot, so quick reactions matter. Stopping the final goal unlocks a bonus stage. Play with your mouse, or tap the screen if you're on a touch device.
waterpark-slide-race-online: Summer gets a playful twist in this 3D arcade racer set around a waterpark. Instead of simply splashing around, you race down slides in a bright, lively world. Its tags point to running, arcade play and 3D graphics, and the game is made for boys, girls and kids alike.

The main aim is to have a good time with a racing game that also offers a spectacular EDM rhythm experience, so the music is part of every run. Controls are easy to pick up: hold your finger on the screen, then drag it to move.
venom-zombie-shooter: Venom Zombie Shooter is a 3D shooter packed with horror-themed action. Your task in every mission is to eliminate all the zombies on the map and leave the area clear. The game offers several missions to work through and presents its scenes with solid visuals.

Move with W, A, S and D, and jump with the Space bar. Fire by clicking the left mouse button, and hold the right button to aim. Press Tab to pause, and use the number keys 1 through 7 to switch between weapons.
my-doll-house-decor-life: My Doll House Decor Life lets you step into the role of an interior designer, where your job is to help guests build the homes they have always wanted. You can furnish and style a range of rooms, including cosy bedrooms, trendy living rooms, and bright, shiny bathrooms, and each one is ready for your own creative touch. The game is aimed at fans of girls' titles and is playable right in your web browser as a free, casual experience.

Fans of decorating, furniture collecting, and seeing lovely rooms take shape will feel right at home here. It shares the appeal that players of dress-up and girls' games tend to enjoy. To play, just click and drag.
matching-pair-game: Matching Pair Game is a calm but tricky puzzle where you need to find and connect pairs of matching cards before the clock hits zero. Turn over cards, keep track of where each one sits, and rely on your memory to finish every board quickly. The levels get harder as you move forward, so there is plenty to keep you busy and a good workout for your brain.
Everything is controlled with the mouse, so just click any button to move through the game.
food-pusher-challenge: Food Pusher Challenge is a hypercasual 3D arcade battle game with a collecting twist. You gather and stack as much food as you can, while keeping close to your teammate, so you can take the win. Each match is a wrestling bout between two teams of two. Grabbing food boosts your partner's strength so they can knock out the rivals. Steer clear of the green items and pick the rich, high-calorie ones to keep your partner growing stronger.
To play, just slide your finger to pick up the food along the way.
girls-nail-salon: Girls Nail Salon is a simulation game that lets you shape your own nail art style. You can move freely between styles and mix and match many kinds of beautiful manicures. Each set of nails can look different from the one before, depending on what you choose.
Everything works with a mouse click or a tap, so the controls stay simple. Pick the pieces you like, combine them in new ways, and see what nail designs you come up with.
make-your-meal-cooking-game: Take on the role of a virtual chef in this food-making title and prepare a variety of meals. It suits players who enjoy cooking games, restaurant games, baking games, food games, and kitchen adventures, so those genres are a natural fit for this one.
Play is controlled entirely with a mouse click or a tap. Every action you take in the kitchen comes from that single input, so you can focus on preparing your dishes.
ww3-2022: Step back in time to a World War III setting filled with soldiers, weapons, tanks, and aircraft. Many visual effects add to the action, and you can share the fun with friends from all over the world. The game offers twenty World War III guns and five heavy tanks that fire projectiles and bullets. Explosions look dramatic, and the characters are detailed soldiers from the German and United States armies.

Use W, A, S, and D to drive tanks, helicopters, cars, or to move your character. Move the mouse to look around and aim, then click to shoot. Scroll the wheel to switch guns, and press Tab to open the menu.
halloween-board-puzzles: Halloween Board Puzzles is a timed game about spotting differences. You are shown two boards that look identical at first glance, and your task is to find the one difference hidden between them before the clock runs out. The Halloween theme gives it a seasonal feel, and it is a puzzle that works well for kids and on mobile devices.

Controls are simple, since you can use either a mouse or a touchpad. Scan both boards carefully, because the change can be easy to miss. Sharp eyes and a steady pointer will help you keep up with the countdown.
park-it: PARK IT is a 3D car parking game for car fans who enjoy a tough challenge. You take the wheel in levels built to stretch your parking skills to their limit, where each spot calls for patience and control. The settings are carefully crafted, and the car handling follows realistic physics, so every maneuver needs accuracy. As you move forward, your technique improves and you gradually become a skilled parker. It is a single-player title tagged as racing, arcade, and adventure, with a .io tag as well.

Steer your car through tight spaces using WASD, and look around with the mouse. Press ESC at any time to pause. An in-game tutorial is included to help you learn the controls and get comfortable before the harder levels begin.
volley-squid-gamer: Tap once to hop, bounce, and smash the ball. Each strong shot can knock your rival off the court, and that is how you win a point. You can jump and spin to set up tricky hits, and the controls stay simple: a single tap with your finger, or a mouse click to jump. This quick, hyper-casual volleyball title is built for short sessions, so you can pick it up whenever and wherever you have a few spare minutes.
ice-cream-stack-runner: Ice Cream Stack Runner blends parkour-style running with a sweet theme built around ice cream. You guide a crew of ten stickmen across a platform course packed with obstacles. Along the way, your group gathers cones and builds them into a taller tower, which you can top with ice cream and candy.
Play with a mouse click or a tap. Keep your stickmen running along the course, lead them toward the cones, and watch your stack grow. It sits in the hypercasual category.
cars-coloring-game: This free game gives you a simple coloring book right in your browser, with pages that feature cars of all kinds. You will find trucks, tractors, and a range of other vehicles waiting to be filled with color. It is easy to pick up, so it suits anyone who wants a relaxed, creative session.

Designed to be enjoyed by the whole family, the game lets you express your artistic side at your own pace. You control it with a mouse or by tapping the screen, so you can get started on a computer or a touch device. Brighten up each vehicle however you like.
angela-trendy-fashionista: Angela is becoming more mindful of her style, and she likes to get ready for a range of different events. She has already written a to-do list to keep track of her preparations. You can step in and help her look perfect for every occasion. Browse through her wardrobe and select outfits and costumes that suit each event. The game is filed under Girls, with tags that include dress up and makeover.
Everything is controlled with a left mouse button click. Have fun getting her ready.
dye-fashion: Dye Fashion lets you show off your creative side and your sense for design. You are offered a selection of dresses, and you can take on the role of a fashion designer by coloring them in bright, one-of-a-kind shades. The range runs from formal evening gowns to everyday casual outfits. The layout is straightforward, so picking a dress to color is quick, and then you can try out different color mixes until your own custom look is finished.
Controls are simple: click with your mouse or tap on a touchscreen to play. Enjoy yourself as you experiment with colors and see what kind of design you come up with.
fashion-new-year-new-hairstyles: With the New Year approaching, a girl named Adella has grown bored of her usual hairdo. She wants to look more charming and lovely when the new year begins, and she is hoping you will lend a hand. Your job is to create a pretty braided style for her hair, then pick out accessories to finish the look.

Play this dress-up makeover game by clicking or tapping with your mouse. It is a good pick for kids and anyone who enjoys design, fashion, and hair styling. Take your time, try different ideas, and enjoy giving Adella a fresh new appearance.
forest-survival-simulator-animal-evoluti: Forest Survival Simulator: Animal Evolution casts you as a tiny, fragile creature trying to stay alive in the woods. Hunger gnaws at you constantly, and predators lurk between the trees, so every move matters. Earn experience and coins each day to grow stronger. Unlocking new animals is the main route forward, and you can raise speed, strength, and defense to handle tougher encounters. You decide whether to slip away from predators or become one yourself, shaping your approach to suit your own play style.
Controls are simple: use WASD to move, use the mouse to control the camera, click the left mouse button to attack, and press F or E to eat. This 3D single-player adventure mixes
supra-crash-shooting-fly-cars: Supra Crash Shooting Fly Cars is a car combat game where you can face off against friends from around the world in multiplayer. Destroying other vehicles earns you money, which you can put toward stronger weapons, faster supercars, fresh paint colors, and new wheels. Then jump into the free-for-all flying mode to battle other players in the air. If you would rather play alone, the offline mode lets you chase enemy AI cars and shoot them down.
Driving uses W, A, S, D or the arrow keys. R makes your car fly, space is the handbrake, B lets you look back, and F activates nitro. The game is built with Unity3D and WebGL for the browser.
park-the-police-car: Take the wheel of a police car and steer it into a marked parking spot. The quicker you park, the more score points you earn, and you can also unlock a range of achievements as you play.

Desktop players drive with the arrow keys or with W, A, S and D. On a mobile device, tap the on-screen buttons to move the car. This is a single-player, 2D driving game built with HTML5, and it fits neatly into a short session whenever you want a quick challenge.
rcc-car-parking-3d: If parking is your thing, this 3D racing game offers a hundred different levels to test your skills. Your job is to steer with care so you avoid crashing into walls, barriers, and other objects. A small map shows where your finish point is, so you always know which way to head.

New parking missions arrive every day, so there is always something fresh to try. Finishing a level earns XP, which you can spend on new colors for your car or on new cars with different physics. The controls are simple: W, A, S, and D drive the car, while TAB, ESC, and P open the menu.
red-and-green-5: Red and Green 5 is a two-player adventure about the friendship between a red man and a green man. Across six chapters, two players guide the pair through the game together. Your goal is to gather candies, which add to your score, while steering clear of lasers. The game falls under the arcade category and includes action and 2D gameplay.

Each player controls one character. The red and green figures move with WASD or the arrow keys, so two people can share a single keyboard. On mobile devices, the game uses touch controls instead. Whatever way you play, the core task stays the same: collect candies, earn points, and watch out for lasers.
water-slide-car-race: Water Slide Car Race is a 3D racing game for anyone who loves boat, yacht, or sailboat games. Your car becomes a vehicle that glides across the water, and the setting imagines life in the next century. You steer it like a boat through deep sea, take on the role of a ship captain, and enter jet boat style races with one aim: become the champion. The car itself is a super car.
Controls are simple. Use W, A, S, and D to move, and press Space to brake. The game runs in the browser using HTML5 and WebGL.
dress-up-sweet-doll: Dress Up Sweet Doll lets you style dolls freely, however you want. You can dress a doll in different looks, such as sweet, cool, or fashion. You can also choose the doll's eyes, mouth, and eyebrows to suit your taste. A large selection of clothes, hats, shoes, and wings lets you mix pieces together and create dolls with your own personal style.

Every new combination you try can bring a surprise, so experimenting is a big part of the fun. The game also lets you enjoy the creations other players have made. To play, just use your mouse or tap the screen.
girls-kaleidoscopic-fashion: Clara and Sophia are getting ready to show off outfits in the Kaleidoscopic style today. Your task is to dress them and pair each look with suitable makeup and accessories. Together, you can help the two girls set the trend for this style.
This is a dress-up and makeover game with a fashion focus, and it is meant to be enjoyable. Everything is controlled with the mouse only, so no keyboard is needed.
mountain-climb-stunt-racing-game: Mountain Climb: Stunt Racing Game mixes the thrill of 3D car racing with the feel of a drift simulator. Players tackle endless mountain roads crowded with traffic, surfing across the slopes and pulling off stunts along the way. The game runs in the browser using HTML5 and WebGL, and its car handling aims for a realistic balance between the chassis and the mountain traffic.

Controls are simple: use W, A, S, and D to drive, press Space to brake, and press Esc to pause. Drifting through mountain bends and weaving past other cars makes up most of the action. Whether you are drawn to the drifting or the nonstop racing, the game focuses on both.
rival-stars-horse-racing: Rival Stars Horse Racing invites you to become a skilled equestrian expert. Your role is to deliver professional horse performances for an audience, and you will face a range of interesting obstacles that put your riding to the test. Each level calls for careful control, so you need to stay focused as the challenges grow.

Playing is simple, because a mouse click or a tap is all you need. Complete the levels to move forward and see how far your skills can carry you. The game sits in the racing category and is tagged for animal, casual, horse, simulation, and stunts. Whether your goal is to master the art of equestrianism or simply enjoy a relaxed ride, the game is meant to be fun from beginning to end.
tricky-track-game: Tricky Track 3D is an arcade running race that is both funny and interesting. You join a steeplechase, where you run through a course of obstacles. Your main move is throwing rocks at the switches that operate those obstacles. You can also aim at an opponent's switch to disrupt their rhythm.
The game is a 3D experience built with WebGL and belongs to the hypercasual style. Its focus is on obstacles and running. Controls are simple: drag to play.
crowd-city: Population is the heart of this 3D arcade game, and every crowd is always hungry for more people. Your crowd keeps running as you search around the city for new people and invite them to join you. A larger crowd can absorb a smaller one, so you'll want to steer clear of groups that are bigger than yours.

You are racing against other players while you grow. Keep an eye out for the big crowds, and look for smaller ones you can take in instead. The controls use a joystick, which keeps things simple to pick up. The goal is to assemble the biggest crowd in town.
cut-grass-game: Cut Grass is a free adventure and leisure game made for boys. You guide a lawnmower through a series of different scenes, steering around obstacles until every weed on the map has been harvested. A simple storyline runs through the stages, and the fresh painted art style gives the game a distinctive look. Operation is kept straightforward, so your attention stays on the mowing.

As you progress, you can unlock a range of props and supplies. Everything is controlled with either the mouse or a tap, making it easy to start right away. It is a light, relaxed choice for players who enjoy a clear goal.
extreme-stunt-car-game: Take the wheel in this 3D racing game built around daring car stunts and tough courses. The tracks are tricky to master, and you can choose whichever vehicle you like from a wide range of cars. Each stunt race brings its own driving challenges across demanding levels that are far from simple.

Your aim is to pull off crazy stunts while climbing to massive heights without falling onto the city below, because a fall there means you lose. Steer with W, A, S and D or the arrow keys, and press Space to use the handbrake. Buckle up and see how far you can go.
hexa-color-sort: Hexa Color Sort is a relaxing puzzle game built around sorting. Your task is to gather hexagon blocks of matching colors together until every group is sorted. The logic in each puzzle keeps your mind busy, so it pays to think ahead and plan each move before you make it.

You control the game with a mouse. Every puzzle asks you to weigh your options and use your problem-solving skills to find the solution. The result is a calm, brain-teasing experience for anyone who enjoys careful thinking.
grimace-commando: The Grimace army is invading, and you are the one who must stop it. Armed with a mini machine gun, you take aim and destroy every Grimace invader that tries to take over the world. There is no finish line here. This is an endless shooter where the enemies keep coming, and your job is to hold out for as long as you can.

The game follows the classic arcade style, so each run is a test of endurance and a chance to set the best record. Playing is simple: a mouse click or a tap is all it takes to get going. It also works on mobile devices, so you can jump in wherever you happen to be.
fall-heroes-guys: Fall Heroes Guys is a 2D multiplayer racing game where you compete against other players. The graphics are bright and polished, and the characters look attractive. Your goal is to cross the finish line faster than everyone else, with dozens of racers running at once. It works as a new take on online running games, and the page lists it under adventure, arcade, battlegrounds, and logic.
You can also face a smaller group of ten people in a race and try to finish first. Play on a computer with the WASD keys, or use touch controls on a mobile device.
top-down-truck-racing: Take the wheel of a range of powerful big-rig trucks in this top-down racing game. Races unfold across a varied set of maps, from desert canyons and bustling cityscapes to slippery ice roads and dense forest trails. Each map has its own distinct characteristics, and learning them is how you gain an edge in races.

Driving is handled entirely with the WASD keys. Keep your eyes on the road from above and adjust to each environment as you go. Whether you're winding through canyon passes or sliding across frozen tarmac, mastering the terrain is what sets you up for success.
murder-io: Murder.io is a follow-up to Killer.io. Your job is to eliminate as many victims as you can before the clock runs out. The game is presented in three dimensions, and you face two other people in a live online match where the single aim is to commit murder.
Movement is handled with the arrow keys. Press Z to attack and X for the action button. This multiplayer title blends action and simulation elements into one short, chaotic round after another.
throw-best: Throw Best tests how steady your aim and timing are. You touch and drag to set up a throw, then release to send the ball flying at targets that keep moving. The direction and power both come from your swipe, so every shot takes precision and a bit of strategy.

Points come from guiding the ball through the matching colored guard and into the target. As you move on, the targets become harder to hit, challenging your reflexes and throwing skills. Aim for perfect shots, sharpen your accuracy, and work toward new high scores in this arcade-style puzzle game.
monster-truck-offroad-driving-mountain: Climb behind the wheel of a well-built offroad monster truck and tackle a simulated mountain course. Your aim is to reach each waypoint in turn and complete every level you face. Each stage gets tougher than the last, so you will need real skill to come out on top.

The WASD keys control your driving, and the Space bar works as the brake. This action title falls under the car, driving, simulator and truck categories, so it suits anyone who enjoys handling a big vehicle over rough, uneven ground. Take your time on the slopes and keep the truck steady as you work through the mountain.
pixel-bubbleman-io: Bubblemen crowd the streets, and whenever two of them meet, they fight on the spot. You are one of these bubbly fighters too, so your goal is to survive as long as you can. Every rival you beat buys you more time, and that is the only way to keep your run going. The longer you last, the more fights you will have to win.

Think carefully before picking each opponent, because a bad choice could bring your run to an end. Controls are simple: slide to play. Take your time, weigh each rival, and remember that one wrong fight might cost you the whole streak.
kick-grimace: Kick Grimace is a physics puzzle brain game for players who enjoy working things out. Your job is to think ahead before you drop the red ball. The goal is to hit the purple Grimace with it while collecting three Grimace Milk Shakes. The game includes plenty of levels to explore.

Controls are simple: tap or click to play. Since the ball moves according to the game's physics, it helps to study each scene before you act. The title sits in the shooting category and is built around the ball, Grimace, and physics themes.
glam-guru-puzzle-collection: Glam Guru Puzzle Collection brings together a set of mini-games centered on fashion and beauty. Each one tests your sense of style, your ability to notice small details, and how well you can match items. Because the games lean toward dress-up and matching, you will spend your time choosing looks and finding the right pairings.

This collection suits anyone who enjoys creative fashion adventures and clever puzzles, and it stays casual throughout. Controls are simple: click and drag to move things around and play. Whether you follow trends closely or simply like a good matching challenge, this collection offers an easygoing way to pass some time.
baby-taylor-puppy-care: It's puppy care day in this game, and Taylor has a dog named Oreo who is adorable and always eager to romp with her. On this Sunday, Taylor has to bring him to the animal clinic for a regular checkup. You get to lend Taylor and Oreo a hand during the visit.

Oreo is still a young pup, not yet fully grown. The vet shares some fresh tips that will help Taylor look after him well. Afterward, Taylor makes up her mind to start preparing homemade meals for Oreo on
surprise-egg-fall-toys: Surprise Egg Fall Toys is a playful collecting game made especially for kids. An egg appears on the screen, and your task is to peel it open. Once the shell comes off, a chocolate treat tumbles out, and after you eat it, the toy hidden inside comes out for you. Every toy you receive becomes yours to own, so each egg adds something new to your collection.

Controls are as simple as it gets: you only need the left mouse button, so anyone can jump in right away. This hypercasual title is 2D and click-driven, and its funny tone keeps things light and cheerful. It is a fun pick for young players who enjoy opening surprises and building up a set of toys.
grimace-vs-police-supercar: In this racing title, you take the wheel of a powerful car and roam a map in search of Grimace. Each level asks you to locate him, chase him through fast pursuits, and ram into him to finish the stage. Between chases, you will also tackle parking challenges and collect coins scattered across the course.

Steering is handled with the WASD keys or the arrow keys. The game is built with Unity3D for WebGL and carries tags for driving, police, and levels, so it runs right in your browser. Several stages await as you work your way through the map.
yes-that-dress: Yes That Dress is a different kind of dress-up game. It uses new 3D visuals with high-quality detail, and it offers a large number of clothing options to choose from. You take on the role of a fashion designer and a styling teacher, transforming each beauty and building the outfits you like best.

The game is played by tapping and dragging. Each change you make is a chance to experiment, so take your time and see how far your creativity can go. Whether you want something bold or something soft, the wardrobe gives you plenty of room to decide.
stickman-warriors-superhero-fight: Stickman Warriors Superhero Fight is an Arcade game built around quick clashes, where dodging, linking hits into combos, and unleashing special moves all shape each fight. It blends hard-hitting combat with a hero path that lets your fighter grow stronger over time. Fans of stickman brawlers should feel at home, especially if they enjoy explosive battles, character upgrades, and a steady pace of action.

On a computer, WASD moves your fighter, J attacks, K raises your defense, and L performs a displacement move. The I, U, and O keys trigger skills, while Space is used for gathering strength. On mobile, you control the action with the on-screen buttons instead.
juicy-fruits-match3: Juicy Fruits Match3 is a puzzle game built around popping juicy, tasty fruit. Swipe to connect three or more matching fruits, and they pop off the board. Challenge yourself by working through every round until you complete them all.

Lining up four identical fruits creates a booster that can help you in later moves. The core action is simple: swipe across the fruits to match them. Fans of match-3 and Bejeweled-style games will find a familiar, fruity twist here, and it suits casual play.
space-war-3d: Fans of sky-based space shooters will feel right at home here. Our beautiful galaxy has come under attack from invading forces, and you are the only hero left to stop them. The mission is demanding, since you must defend the stars from a hostile enemy force. You pilot a starship at the heart of the fighting, holding back hordes of alien creatures. As you advance, your ship receives upgrades that make it fully deadly.

The game looks striking, with strong lighting and special effects that bring each scene to life. Expect power-ups, boss encounters, and a wheel of luck to spin for surprises. There are 100 well-designed levels to work through.
t-rally: In T-Rally, you take the wheel of several rally cars and head out on the track. Your goal is to smash every terrorist you meet along the way, since winning depends on it. Each win unlocks new vehicles, giving you fresh cars to drive.
The WASD keys control your driving, and the Space bar applies
ragdoll-duel-boxing: Ragdoll Duel: Boxing is a 3D action game with plenty of visual effects. Stickman boxers, each with a different body shape, step in to trade blows. Throw quick punches at your opponent, and hold your Super Punch until it is ready so you don't waste it. Win 2 rounds to be declared victorious.

You can face an AI opponent or challenge a friend. Player 1 moves with A and D, crouches with S, throws a regular punch with F, and fires a Super Punch with G. Player 2 uses the left and right arrow keys to move, the down arrow to crouch, L to punch, and K for a Super Punch.
knock-em-all: A wave of puppets is rolling in, and each one is heading straight for you. Pick up your gun and fire at the puppets to hold them back. Every shell you launch pushes a puppet away from you and off the platform, so it can't get close. Your aim is to knock out the whole group and reach the finish line.
This arcade title combines point-and-click play with puzzle elements and shooting, and it is tagged for kids and boys. Starting is as simple as a tap.
commandos-battle-for-survival-3d: In this 3D action game for one player, your mission is to take down enemy troops with quiet, surprise strikes and leave their weapons useless. You sneak through hostile ground and slip past guards while avoiding radar, because being spotted is never an option for your soldier. The game blends military action with commando adventure, offering a fresh take on secret service agent operations.

You play as Agent Shadow Jill, a recruit trained by an army secret service agency to defend the region. As a spy, you move through enemy zones and complete stealth missions while staying hidden under the radar. Controls are simple: use a mouse click or a tap to play.
stickman-doodle-epic-rage: This arcade beat-'em-up pairs lively, realistic physics with a tough, hardcore style of play, yet its controls stay simple to learn. You pull off eye-catching stunts and strikes to knock out your foes. Unknown enemies have appeared across the city, and your stick hero fights them off with a wide range of deadly weapons. Helicopters and robots can also wipe out every enemy on screen at once.

Fans of earlier Stickman games will remember the snappy combat and bold visuals of Stickman Brawl of Rage, and this newer version carries that spirit forward. Move with the arrow keys, jump with the space bar, and use Z, X, and C to attack or defend. It remains to be seen whether this stick hero's revenge will ever come to an end.
couples-yoga: Couples Yoga is a yoga-themed arcade puzzle game built with 3D models. On each level, your task is to move body parts so they match the marked pose. The game recommends moving one part at a time, since that approach gives the highest rate of progress. Keep at it and you can win all three yellow stars.
Controls are simple: you slide to play. Its 3D visuals and puzzle structure give each level a calm, low-pressure feel, which fits its casual and relaxation tags.
duoland: Duoland puts you alongside a pair of siblings who are learning the ways of the sea. Together they hunt for treasure chests and gather riches scattered across an island. Each sibling has their own target, searching for different diamonds and chests, so the two must work through the chests in the right order. A pirate's basic lesson here is to sweep the island clean, collecting everything, coins included.

Once the island has been emptied of loot, a concealed vessel appears in the upper-right corner. Reach that ship to sail away from the island. Move with the WASD keys or the arrow keys, or use touch controls on mobile. Your job is to open every chest, collect all the diamonds, gather all the gold, and run for the ship.
basketball-mania: Basketball Mania is a free online sports simulator designed for children, and its main purpose is sharpening your shooting technique. To take a shot, you line up your aim and then slide upward to send the ball toward the hoop. Every stage asks you to score a set number of baskets, and you can miss only three throws before the level ends. Reach the target number of goals and you move on to the next stage.
Controls depend on your device. On a computer, click the mouse to move, while on a phone you tap the on-screen buttons instead.
geometry-goal-dash-2026: Geometry Goal Dash 2026 is a quick platformer that takes its cues from Geometry Dash. You steer a rolling ball across tough stages packed with traps, jumps, and moments that demand precise timing. Move with the arrow keys or with WASD, dodge deadly obstacles, and keep going as each stage grows harder the farther you get.

A twist makes things messier: Ronaldo is chasing you through the chaotic, football-themed worlds. You need to keep your speed up and your timing precise so he never catches you. The mix of platforming skill and football madness is the heart of the game, and every run tests both.
gem-twins: Gem Twins combines puzzle solving with platform jumping as you guide a pair of brothers through each level. Each brother can turn themselves into stone, and that trick lets one of them help the other get past obstacles. Working out when to freeze and when to move is the heart of the challenge. The game draws its inspiration from classic NES titles, and its colorful pixel art and smooth platform mechanics carry that retro spirit.

Moving is handled with A and D or the arrow keys, and jumping uses W, the up arrow, X, or U. Press Space, U, C, or O to switch between the brothers. On mobile, the controls are shown within the game itself.
ben-10-commander: Ben 10 Commander is a shooting game set in the Ben 10 universe. Its tags point to action and zombies, so you can expect fights against the undead alongside the franchise's alien theme. It suits fans who want to step into the Ben 10 world and join the battles.

The game also draws on Ben 10 Omniverse and the wider range of aliens from the series, so anyone curious about those characters will find familiar names to explore. Whether you have followed the franchise for years or are just discovering it, this free browser shooter combines action, alien characters, and zombie encounters in one place.
like-a-king: Like a King mixes tower defense with deck-building in your web browser. You are a king taking on other kings in fast multiplayer matches. Your card collection holds the units you can combine and deploy. Each card is one distinct unit: some attack, some mine gold, and others lay traps.

To play, tap an empty tile to spawn a unit, then draw a line from it to the enemy you want to attack. Adjust your tactics as the battle unfolds. Your aim is to destroy all enemy units before yours are destroyed. Complete quests, build a strong deck, and
real-drone-simulator: Real Drone Simulator lets you pilot a drone through a 3D world with animated game art. You can choose from three different driving modes, and the game includes a large selection of drones to try out. Your tasks involve scanning parts of buildings and flying through checkpoints.
Controls are simple. Use W, A, S, and D to move in four directions, and the Up and Down arrow keys to climb or descend. The Left and Right arrow keys turn the drone in either direction.
metal-slug-adventure: This newly built side-scrolling shooter takes its spirit from a classic arcade hit and carries it into a modern setting. Its upgraded visuals honor the original's retro roots, while a fresh, appealing art style gives the game a distinctive look. The overall presentation looks beautiful from start to finish.

Expect a wide selection of weapons, a variety of battlefields, and several super-vehicles to take control of along the way. Everything is handled with mouse clicks or taps, so you can jump straight into the action. It is designed for a single player who wants to test their skills.
running-crowd-city-gm: Running Crowd City GM is an arcade game where your goal is to become the biggest crowd in town. As you dash through the streets, you gather people along the way and watch your group swell, using your leadership to crush any opponents standing in your path.

The game is played entirely with the mouse. Move the pointer to steer your crowd through the city and collect as many people as you can. If you enjoy running games centered on growing a crowd, this one puts that idea front and center.
grimace-dead-island-shooting: Set in a wasteland after the collapse of civilization, this shooter puts you in the role of a capable survivor. Hordes of Grimace creatures roam the ruins, and you must hold your ground against them. Each hand holds a gun, so you fire from both sides at once while the grotesque foes keep coming in relentless waves.

Success depends on careful aiming and quick movement. You need to pick your targets with precision and use your agility to stay alive. As each wave grows stronger, the pressure rises and your shooting skills get tested to their limits. Controls are simple: click the mouse or tap the screen to fire.
pass-the-ball: Pass the Ball is a 3D action game with adventure and basketball themes. Your aim is to grow your skills over time and get a real grip on the power of your passes. You need to find the right angle and control how hard you throw.

Opponents will try to interfere, so you must watch them closely and find a clear way to pass the ball to your teammates. Pass Master is a casual passing game that lets you practice your sense of passing while enjoying the joy of the game.
immune-system-command: Immune System Command is a streamlined, modern take on a classic retro favorite. You take charge of the body's defenses and hold back a never-ending wave of creepy viruses. Gameplay stays simple, since everything runs on a single tap.

There is no final victory here. Your goal is to last as long as you can, because a fight like this one always ends in defeat eventually. Just click or touch once to get started and see how long your defense holds.
house-robber: House Robber is a free browser game with a thief theme, made for boys. You play a robber who sneaks into a house and steals all kinds of goods. After you grab something, you have to make your way back out without being spotted by the security guard. Each level has its own scene, so you need to plan carefully before each theft.
The game is in 3D and is listed for both Android and HTML5. You control your robber with a mouse or by tapping the screen. The whole process is fun and tests how well you can avoid getting caught.
join-and-clash-battle: In this casual game, your job is to free warriors who are locked up. Along the way, you'll need to dodge dangerous hazards that can stop you cold. Each episode ends with a monster waiting for you, and you have to defeat it. Freeing the captives and beating the beast are both part of the goal, so keep an eye on both.

The game offers more than 50 levels, so there is plenty to work through. It sits in the hypercasual category and is packed with action. You can control your moves with the mouse, or use W, A, S, D or the arrow keys, whichever feels more comfortable to you.
makeover-studio: Makeover Studio is a popular dress-up title for girls who enjoy styling characters. Two women are going through a rough patch, and they could use a hand from you. You give them a fresh look with a range of cute makeup, clever accessories, and stylish outfits. The goal is to help them shine so they stand out. Some of life's struggles can be faced alone, while others call for a little support, and this game lets you offer that support through makeovers.
Controls are simple: use your mouse or tap the screen to play.
mahjong-link-puzzle: Mahjong Link Puzzle is a calm tile-matching game for one player, made for anyone who has grown bored of dull card games, mindless casino-style sims, or classic tripeaks solitaire. There are no complicated extras here, just a straightforward matching challenge. Clear every tile on the board to move on to the next stage. The game offers a large collection of levels, and a few of them can be tough, so you will need to think ahead. Once the tricky stages start to make sense, the puzzles feel rewarding.

To play, pick two tiles that show the same picture and they will vanish from the board. You can only remove tiles that are uncovered, meaning no other tile sits on top of them. Plan your moves carefully so you don't trap a pair under another tile. Stay patient, look for links across the layout, and keep your mind sharp as the board gets more complicated.
magicbridge: MagicBridge is a puzzle title with a pixel art look and a light, hypercasual feel. The pet partner you pick determines how far you can get, so your choice matters from the start. Gold coins you gather along the way let you summon more pets to join your team.
To begin, simply click to play. Your chosen companion shapes your progress, and every coin you collect brings you closer to calling in another pet.
snowfield-driving: Snowfield Driving is a puzzle game where you draw a path that guides a car or a plane toward its goal. Each time you pass a level, the next one becomes harder, so the challenge grows as you progress. The stages are set in complex, crowded parking spaces, and you need to work out a route through each one.

To play, hold down and slide across the screen to draw your line. Plan the route carefully before you start, since every level asks you to think through the path and pick the right way to reach the goal.
monster-reform: Monster Reform is a 3D survival shooter with a level system. Each stage brings tougher monsters than the last, and every one of them is powerful. You clear the current map by destroying the monsters, which opens the way to a new area.
Move with W, A, S and D. Left-click to fire, and right-click to change the camera view. Press U to fire the bazooka, R to reload, and C to crouch. Use keys 1, 2 and 3 to swap between your weapons.
fairy-wardrobe: Step inside the fairy's wardrobe, a place holding more than a thousand fashionable dresses. Your task is to choose one for your fairy and dress up her in whatever style you prefer. This hypercasual title is easy to pick up, and starting it only takes a click.

Filed under dress up and girl games, it focuses entirely on fashion and personal taste. Browse the collection, mix and match, and build the look you like best. Dressing your fairy is the whole idea of the game. Controls are simple: just click.
gangster-kabali-game: Gangster Kabali Game drops you into a rough underworld of crime and influence, where your goal is to climb the ranks and take control of the neighborhood. You play as a bold street criminal who never backs down from a fight. The city is loud and disorderly, and you'll have to deal with competing gangs at every turn.
