Each mission pushes you to think ahead, stay calm under pressure, and fight well when it matters. You need to balance courage, planning, and combat skills to come out on top. The controls are simple: click the mouse or tap the screen to play, so you can jump in right away.
mini-swim: Mini Swim is a platform game where you swim across every part of a stage, dodging obstacles and enemies as you collect all the treasures on the ocean. If you want a different kind of challenge, the speedrun mode lets you test your skills by collecting coins.
Controls are simple. On mobile, you play with the in-game touch controls. On desktop, use the WASD keys or the arrow keys to move your swimmer through the level.
cad-war-4: Your soldier has just finished a successful mission. Every captive was freed, and the militants were either locked up or taken out. Before there is time to rest, headquarters picks up a fresh distress signal reporting another group of hostages. The soldier must head back out into this 3D shooter.

This time the trouble is in the Far East, where a terrorist organization has seized several peaceful settlements. Fire with the left mouse button and aim with the right. Move with WASD, jump with Space, and hold Shift to speed up. Press R to reload and E to perform actions. Your job is to get the settlements back under control and bring the hostages home.
super-monsters-christmas-jigsaw: Christmas Eve has arrived in Pitchfork Pines, and the Super Monsters have banded together to trim the halls. Their larger goal is tracking down Santa's missing reindeer and saving the holiday. In this jigsaw puzzle game, you rebuild each picture one piece at a time as the festive story unfolds.

Playing is easy, since a mouse or a tap is all you need. Expect cartoon characters and a cheerful holiday mood throughout. The game is built with HTML5, and it suits kids who enjoy puzzles and matching.
hot-pursuit-ayn: In this racing game, you are a driver trying to outrun police cars. The officers try to ram your vehicle and drain its HP meter. Once that meter reaches zero, you are caught and the chase ends. Ten furious patrol vehicles are on your tail, and your job is to shake them off using your driving skills. Keep them from hitting you whenever you can.

A wide free-driving zone gives you room to roam, and scattered spots there let you pull off stunts or drift. Steer with the arrow keys or WASD, use N for nitro, press C to change the camera, and hold the space bar for the handbrake.
rubik-3d: Rubik 3D is a three-dimensional cube puzzle in the style of Rubik games. Every move is made with a swipe, either to the left or to the right. You can shift a single small cube or an entire side at once, so you have two ways to move the pieces. The game is said to have a comforting feel, so it may help you relax while you play. It works on all devices, so you can play on whichever screen you have nearby.

The controls are simple. With your mouse, press and drag to swipe the cube and make each move. The game sits in the Puzzles category and is also labeled casual, hypercasual, HTML5 and HTML, which describes how it was built and the kind of play it offers. Whatever your reason for playing, the swiping setup keeps every turn easy to follow.
candle-run-game: Candle Run is a 3D endless runner where you guide a burning candle that never stops racing forward. Its paths are packed with obstacles and challenges, so you need to stay alert and react quickly. Collecting candle pieces along the way keeps the candle from melting away completely.

Because the levels are randomly generated, no two runs feel the same. Avoid obstacles, gather as many candle pieces as you can, and keep the flame burning for as long as possible. This fast-paced hyper-casual game tests your reflexes and helps you build skills as you chase your highest score. Use the Left Arrow or A key to move left, and the Right Arrow or D key to move right.
chicken-io: Chicken.io is an arcade game from the .io family, where you compete with other players. Your goal is to collect items that spin around your character, then use them to fight your rivals. It is a 2D casual game that suits a short break or a way to pass the time.

Everything is controlled with the mouse alone, so there are no keys to learn. Point and click your way through the action, gathering items and battling others as you go. Whether you want a quick diversion or a longer session, the game keeps things simple and entertaining from start to finish.
slope-cyber: Slope Cyber is an endless slope game in the cyber genre, set in a cyber city. You guide a ball that keeps moving, so you need sharp reflexes to keep it under control. The game is filed under arcade and is tagged with 3D, collecting, platform, hypercasual, and mobile.

Steering works differently depending on your device. On a PC, press A or D, or use the left and right arrow keys, to move the ball left or right. On mobile, swipe with your finger to change its direction. Since the ball never stops rolling, every turn depends on your timing.
only-up-parkour: Only Up! is an arcade title where your goal is to get past hazards and climb to greater heights. The idea draws on a well-known game of its kind. Your character moves through a tall, twisting maze packed with different obstacles, and you need fast reactions, precise jumps, and nimble climbing to keep from smashing into a barrier or tumbling back down. This is a 3D, single-player experience.
Each new level brings harder tests. Expect moving platforms and rotating obstacles that demand better timing. Controls are simple: use W, A, S and D to move, and press the Space bar to jump.
roll-the-ball-3d: Guide the ball by sliding your finger or cursor left and right. Your aim is to reach the circles while keeping the ball away from the borders. Watch out for falling icebergs and other obstacles along the way, since any of them can stop your run.

This 3D arcade title sits in the hypercasual group, so the rules are quick to pick up and the gameplay stays focused on steering. Every move comes down to a simple left or right slide, which makes it easy to start and tricky to master.
merge-ships: Imagine commanding a huge fleet sailing across the open sea. Merge Ships lets you build that fleet and set it loose on the water. Along the way, you can do business with many cities spread across the world, giving you plenty of ports to reach.

The game sits in the hypercasual category and is tagged for both boys and girls. You control everything with your mouse, which is the only input it asks for. Whether you enjoy steady trading or simply like seeing your fleet travel across the map, Merge Ships gives you that experience right in your browser.
monster-truck-race-arena: Monster Truck Race Arena is a racing game where you take the wheel of a monster truck bus and drive it through the arena. The whole experience revolves around handling a large vehicle as you move across the space. It is a light, enjoyable pick for anyone who loves car and truck racing.

Getting started is simple. Press A and D, or the left and right arrow keys, to steer in either direction. Press W or the up arrow to jump. Driving and jumping cover the core controls, and the game is also set up for mobile play.
dress-up-outfit-match: In this playful puzzle game, you sort stylish clothes and then tackle makeover challenges. Each one tests your eye for fashion as you work toward becoming a true fashion expert. Every level feels fresh and satisfying, so there is always something new to try.

The game blends creative styling with clever puzzle mechanics, so strategy matters just as much as taste. It offers a dress up outfit match experience that feels both thoughtful and playful. This charming girl fashion styling game is full of personality and creativity, and getting started is simple: click to play.
death-racing: Death Racing is a 3D car racing game that runs in your browser using WebGL. It offers several game modes and multiple cars to choose from, so you can mix things up from race to race. The graphics look good on screen, and the supercar style adds to the fun.
Steering works with the A and D keys or the Left and Right arrow keys. Press W or left shift to activate your NOS, and press S to use your shield. To activate your HP item, press Space or E.
princess-tailor-shop: Princess Tailor Shop is a free game for kids that casts you as a fashion tailor in a small, playful mini game. Your task is to put together dresses that come out just right, moving through a number of levels and adding decorations to your designs. It is a tailoring and fashion design game at heart, with a girls' focus and a cute, baby-friendly look.

Stitching happens on a sewing machine modeled after the kind real tailors use. You control everything with a simple mouse click or tap, so there is nothing complicated to learn before you start. The game is filed under dress up, decorate, and design, so those themes run through the whole experience.
bubble-shooter-bunny: Bubble Shooter Bunny is a puzzle title where you pop bubbles by lining up three or more of the same color so they vanish. To complete a level, you need to wipe out every bubble on the screen. Aiming and firing are handled entirely with your mouse.

The game sits in the Puzzles category and carries tags for 2D graphics, bubble gameplay, the bubble shooter style, and WebGL. It is a straightforward match-and-clear challenge, so you can pick it up quickly and keep working through the board one shot at a time.
diy-makeup-artist: Start by picking the character you like best in Diy Makeup Artist, a makeup game that is easy to get hooked on. Your first job is to give her a makeover, since she begins the game looking rather messy. Once she looks fresh, you can move on to dressing her up with makeup and accessories that have been carefully picked for this game. Not sure which outfit or accessory suits her? Keep trying different options until you find the right match.
Controls are simple: use your mouse or tap the screen to play, so it works on both computers and mobile devices.
crazy-pixel-apocalypse-4-ui-2026: Crazy Pixel Apocalypse 4 UI 2026 drops you into quick multiplayer gunfights with a pixelated look. You can choose a server, set up your own match or join one in an online room, and take on other players in survival battles. Several weapons are on hand, and each map gives your aim a real test across demanding arenas.

Movement feels like a classic first-person shooter, but the controls stay simple. Aim with the mouse, click to fire, use WASD to move, and press Space to jump. On a phone or tablet, tap the on-screen buttons instead. Rounds are short, the battles get chaotic, and the whole thing is made to be played in your browser.
baby-taylor-doctor-day: With her mother busy in the kitchen, Taylor has to find ways to entertain herself. Glancing over the plush toys nearby, she comes up with an idea: a doctor game with her cuddly companions. You take on the role of the nurse and play games with Taylor as she looks after her toys.
Getting started is easy, because the whole experience works with simple mouse clicks or taps. Taylor is counting on her nurse, so the fun begins as soon as you join her and her toy patients.
jump-dunk-3d: Jump Dunk 3D is an arcade game that combines three-dimensional stickman basketball models with ball-launching rules driven by physics. On each level, your target is to shoot three goals first. Because the ball follows physics, every throw depends on how you handle it from start to finish.

A helpful tip is to concentrate on the position where you release the ball rather than on the jumping stickman. Keep the glass walls in mind as well, since using them can help you make a clean shot. The game starts with a tap.
jet-boat-racing: Jet Boat Racing puts you behind the wheel of a racing boat in a simulator-style game. You can choose between Free Drive and Racing modes, and both are full of surprises. Launch off the ramps into the air or glide across the thin ones, and show off your boat handling to a friend. Both modes can be played alone or with a second player. Finish a race in first place to unlock new racing boats, each with its own features. Every boat carries nitrous, which you can use to ramp up the excitement.

Solo players steer with W, A, S, D or the arrow keys, use F for nitrous, R to restart your position, T to look back, and C to switch the camera. In two player mode, Player 1 uses W, A, S, D, F, R, T and C for the same actions.
speed-run-game: Speed Run Game is a running title where you sprint as quickly as you can, dodge obstacles in your path, pick up rewards, and race toward the finish line. It suits people who enjoy running games, speed challenges, arcade action, obstacle courses, and casual adventure games. The pace stays brisk from start to finish, so you need to keep your attention on what lies ahead.

You control the action with the keyboard arrow keys, using them to steer your runner while you keep moving forward. Each run asks you to balance speed with careful timing so you can slip past what stands in your way. Collect the rewards you come across, stay focused on the goal, and see how fast you can reach the finish.
piggy-escape: Piggy Escape is an unofficial call game with a fresh twist. It blends a quiz about a scary pig with a call feature that lets you frighten friends or neighbors using Piggy. A memory call mode is included as well, and there is a simple classic quiz for checking what you know.

Piggy is a horror creature who lives in a home that looks sweet from the outside. To survive, you must answer all of Piggy's questions, uncover the secrets hidden around the house, and find your way out while staying clear of the pig.
miner-block: Miner Block is a single-player logic puzzle where you steer a wagon loaded with gold out of a mine packed with obstacles. Other wagons block the way, so you must remove them to open a path for the gold-filled one. Every stage has a turn limit, and you need to clear each level within it.

All of the action runs on mouse clicks or taps, so you only need to point and select. Think through each move before you make it, because a wrong step can use up turns you need later. Work your way through the mine one level at a time until the gold reaches the exit.
handbrake-parking: Handbrake Parking challenges you to park a car with sharp focus and well-judged timing. Your car moves by itself, so the skill lies in choosing the exact moment to park in a very narrow space. If your car hits another vehicle, the run ends immediately. The game has no finish line, so you can keep going for as long as you like at no cost, though it takes real practice to get good at it.

Press the left arrow key to park on the left side, or the right arrow key to park on the right side. Each attempt asks you to watch the road closely and react at just the right instant. It is a free racing title with an endless mode, and it is far from simple to master.
rainbow-social-media-influencers: Meet three rainbow-loving friends who spend a lot of their time on social networks, chatting with their many devoted fans. Being a social media influencer means having a large and loyal audience, and that status comes with real responsibilities. The girls need to spend plenty of time creating and refreshing their looks, so they need your help with all of this hard work.

Pick colorful outfits and hairstyles for them, then add bright, fresh makeup. This spring, vivid shades are replacing dull tones, and designers favor cozy fabrics, soft textures, and simple shapes. Sequins are also a big trend on the catwalks, and everyday glitter is expected to become the norm in summer 2022.
bubble-shooter-mania: Bubble Shooter Mania is an arcade-style take on the bubble shooter formula. You line up your shot by sliding left and right, then fire colorful bubbles at the cluster. Matching colors is the key: hit a bubble with one of the same shade and the group pops, which helps you clear each level.
The game offers tons of levels, many of them tricky to finish. Your goal is to complete every one of them. Slide left and right to aim, then release your bubbles.
dragon-merge-master-3d: Dragon Merge Master 3D invites you into a world of dragons, where you combine matching ones to create stronger creatures. Each new dragon you unlock has its own unique powers, so trying different combinations is a big part of the appeal. As your collection grows, you assemble a full dragon army and send it into 3D battle arenas to defeat enemies.

Success depends on planning as well as skill. You decide which dragons to merge and when to use them, and your strategy determines who dominates each battlefield. The game is built around merging puzzles, and it blends casual play with adventure and fighting. All you need is a mouse, which you use to click any button in the game.
archery-world-tour: Archery World Tour is a 3D mobile game built around archery. Its shooting visuals and animations look sharp, and the whole experience feels lifelike, as if you have stepped onto a real sports field. Your goal is to send your arrows toward the targets. The game includes a range of levels, each with its own features and shooting challenges.

Smooth, polished animation and detailed 3D graphics bring every shot to life. The competitive levels are numerous and engaging, giving you plenty to work through. You can also pick from a variety of archery equipment, including striking bows and arrows.
tower-takeover-conquer-castle: Conquer Castle is a simple, enjoyable 3D puzzle game. Click an opposing city to take it over, and at the same time keep your own city from being seized. You win once every city has turned blue, the color that marks your side. To link two cities, swipe your finger between them. If the board looks bad for you, don't panic. Test your skills and keep trying.

You can play with a mouse or by tapping, so it works on both computers and phones. It is tagged for kids, boys and girls, and it mixes battle and collection themes with puzzle play. The main aim stays the same throughout: capture the cities, guard your own, and become the greatest city conqueror.
mycothreememo: You play as a mushroom picker on a quiet hunt through a digital woodland. The fungi change shape depending on where they grow and what time of year it is, so the same kind may appear in different forms. This memory-based puzzle asks you to stay alert and remember what you have seen, because your goal is to gather three mushrooms of one species.

Be aware that a single species does not always look identical, which makes matching them harder. The forest holds plenty of mushrooms, yet the clock keeps running, so you need to move quickly while still choosing carefully. Controls depend on your device: a computer uses a mouse click, while touchscreen devices respond to a simple tap.
hide-n-seek-3d: Hidden somewhere inside a building in this 3D cartoon-style game are several people, and your task is to track down every one of them. Explore the place, check behind doors, and search inside closets until you have found them all. Stay alert, since you must locate everyone before you are finished.
Move with the WASD keys or the arrow keys, and turn your view by moving the mouse. When you spot someone, click to find them. To open the pause menu, press Escape twice.
jeff-the-killer-vs-slendrina: In this third-person horror shooter, you pick either Jeff the Killer or Slendrina. One of them has grown tired of the other's fame, and since people cannot stop the rival, the job falls to you. As Jeff, you collect eight teddy bears belonging to Slendrina. As Slendrina, you gather eight photos belonging to Jeff. Either way, you finish by taking out your target.

The game offers two maps, Jeff's asylum and Slendrina's house. The controls are easy to pick up: WASD to move, the mouse to look around, the left button to fire and the right button to aim. The mouse wheel switches weapons, and other keys handle grenades, reloading, picking up items, running, crouching and going prone. The 3D environments are detailed.
snow-ski: Snow Ski is a single-player 3D arcade game with an endless slope that never really ends. Your skier keeps heading down the hill, and your job is to steer past the trees without crashing into them. Along the way, grab the gold that lies on the snow before it slips out of your reach.

The gold you collect is what lets you earn new outfits for your skier. There are three different costumes to unlock, including ninja-style looks, so you can dress your skier the way you like. Steer with the left and right arrow keys, or use touch controls on a mobile device.
water-sort-puzzle: A group of kids accidentally blended their different colored liquids into one mess. To use the liquid again, you have to separate it so each color is back on its own. Be careful, though: once a liquid has been moved, it will no longer accept liquids of other colors, so every move matters.

The game is simple to get going, since you just tap to play. It suits puzzle fans, brain teaser lovers, and kids who enjoy casual games. Take your time and sort each shade step by step until the colors are all separated again.
animals-halves-match: Animals Halves Match is a board puzzle where your job is to pair each half of an animal picture with its mirror-image counterpart. Study the pattern and the symmetry closely before choosing, so you can be sure you have found the correct partner. Every wrong pick costs you one of your three lives, so take your time.

Playing is simple: click or tap the piece you believe completes the match, using a mouse, touchpad, or touchscreen. Each correct choice moves you closer to finishing the board, while a mistake reduces your remaining lives by one out of three. It is a good fit for anyone who enjoys logic, matching, and spotting patterns.
superior-trial: Superior Trial is a skill-based adventure packed with demanding trials, tricky obstacles, and fast-paced action levels. It is built for players who enjoy testing their timing, focus, speed, and problem-solving abilities. Every level presents a fresh challenge, asking you to finish the mission through clever decisions and quick reflexes.

The game falls under the shooting category, with gun and shooter themes running through its action. Control is handled entirely with your mouse, so you can concentrate on reading each obstacle and moving at the right moment. Expect a varied run of challenges that rewards patience and sharp thinking.
motorcycle-offroad-sim-2021: Race a dirt bike through hills and mountain terrain in this 3D off-road game. You can push your machine to high speeds, and the bikes follow realistic physics. The courses are full of treacherous sections, and you can attempt stunts on the mountain trails along the way.

Steer with WASD, press C to switch the camera view, and hit ESC to bring up the menu. The game is built for a single player who wants to test their riding skills on tracks designed for off-road dirt bike racing. Whether you came to race or to show off some daring tricks, the experience stays rugged and demanding from start to finish.
mermaid-princess-save-the-ocean: Pollution in the sea has long been a serious worry. When Princess Ariel visits her beloved garden, she is dismayed to find it covered in trash, and the sight puts her in a sour mood for the whole day. Your job is to gather up the litter and help her protect the ocean.
Once the cleaning is done, Ariel is ready for a fresh outfit. You can dress her in a new gown and then enjoy some playtime together in the garden. The game is controlled with mouse clicks or taps.
zombie-defence-team: Zombie Defence Team puts you in the role of a special forces soldier facing four large stages crowded with the undead. Your goal is to shoot every zombie along the way. You have a big arsenal of modern weapons to choose from, and the game's graphics are striking throughout.

Controls are easy to pick up. Use WASD to move and Space to jump. Click the left mouse button to shoot and the right button to aim. Scroll the mouse wheel to change weapons, press R to reload, and press T to activate bullet time.
infernax: Infernax follows a brave knight who comes back to his homeland and finds it overrun by dark, unholy magic. As you travel through the land, you piece together the secrets behind the curse, and every choice you make carries its own results. The game is played with a mouse and keyboard.

Your job is to dig into the source of the corruption and deal with whatever your decisions set in motion. Expect a world where the past and present are tangled together, and where the outcome depends on how you choose to act. Both the mouse and the keyboard handle the controls.
cute-dentist-bling: Lilith's teeth have become badly unwell, so a young dentist is called in to help her. In this 2D simulation game, you play as that little dentist and look after a range of intriguing patients. Each visitor needs your care, and your goal is to cure every one of them perfectly. It's a chance to put your medical knowledge to the test.
The whole experience is played with a mouse, using simple clicks or taps. Its cute, casual style makes it a light and friendly experience.
pixel-heroes-runner: Pixel Heroes Runner is a one-player 2D arcade game with action and adventure elements. It is an endless runner, so your hero keeps going, and you need to leap over obstacles while gathering diamonds. Every diamond you collect pushes you closer to becoming the city's hero and saving the town.

Along the way, you can build a collection of 10 costumes. The game works with mouse clicks on a computer and touch controls on mobile devices. Run fast, dodge what stands in your way, and keep grabbing those diamonds.
ninja-rian-adventure: In this skill-based adventure, you set out to defeat Dracula, the villain who has kidnapped the princess. Your task is to destroy a large number of enemies along the way, using all of your master skills. Dangerous foes and powerful bosses stand in your path.

You guide Ninja Rian with the left and right keys, either A and D or the arrow keys. Space or the Up arrow makes him jump, J launches a melee attack, and K throws darts. Press L to dodge. Along the way, he can also glide and use his sword, along with several other moves.
save-the-bear: Save The Bear is a casual game with a cartoon style. Its difficulties arrive gradually, slowly raising the challenge as you go. It is a chance for players to show off their skill and precision.
You control the game with your mouse or by tapping the screen, so it works on most devices. Its tags point to animal, avoid, and cut themes, and it is built in HTML5 with kids in mind.
sand-route-puzzle: Sand Route Puzzle is a calm but mind-bending game in which colored sand comes raining down from above. You catch each color in the matching container, plan ahead, and clear every pattern to win.

One tap on a column places a box on the belt, and each box must match the falling sand. Fill a box completely to finish its pattern, and the level is cleared once every box is filled correctly. The sand physics feel satisfying, so the game suits both a quick play and a long, unhurried session.

When a level gets tricky, you can use the Vacuum, Jumble, and Extra Cart boosters. Daily rewards and endless puzzles give you plenty to return to, and the game is easy to start yet rewarding to master.
micro-tanks: Micro Tanks is a 2D action shooter where you can battle computer opponents or take on a friend in two-player mode. Your goal is to knock out enemy tanks scattered across 15 different platforms, lining up each shot carefully. Some stages feature sliding walls and winding labyrinth layouts, so you will need clever tactics to catch rivals off guard. Keep your own damage low, since the combined score from all 15 levels decides who takes the win.
Player 1 controls the tank with W, A, S and D and uses Q. Player 2 relies on the arrow keys and the M key.
julio-police-cars: Julio Police Cars is a racing game where you take the wheel of one of ten police vehicles, one of which is a limousine. Four different maps are packed with plenty of jump ramps, giving you room to speed around and slide through turns. Pull off stunts as you go.

Drive with WASD or the arrow keys. Hold Space for the handbrake and Left Shift to boost your car. If it gets stuck, press G to free it, or press R to reset the scene. Tap C to change the camera view and E to turn on the police lights.
lucy-dog-care: Lucy is a fancy little dog who quickly becomes a companion, since she depends on you from the start. You will look after her when she gets hungry, when she feels sleepy, or when she simply wants a calming bubble bath. Each job has to be finished carefully, and paying close attention to her needs keeps her happy.

Once her basic care is done, you can focus on her looks. Choose a lovely dress for her, or mix and match a pair of pants with a stylish top. A skirt is another option for her wardrobe. Everything is controlled with a mouse click or a tap, so you can start right away and play with her.
weapon-duel: Weapon Duel is a combat game where you control your character's attacks and throw missiles to knock opponents off the platform. You can play against AI opponents, or take on other players, and it's a good choice for a party with friends.

On a computer, use the A and D keys, or the left and right arrow keys, to control Inhale and Blow. On a phone, tap the virtual buttons on screen to do the same. Stay on the platform and try to knock your rivals off it.
girls-razzle-dazzle-party: Mia, Emma, Ava, and Clara are preparing for a Razzle Dazzle party this evening, and they need your help. Your task is to choose eye-catching outfits and fitting accessories that will make each of these best friends look even more beautiful for the celebration. The title belongs to the girls category and is tagged with dress up and decoration.

Everything is handled with the mouse, so the controls stay simple. Take your time with each friend, pick the looks that suit her, and help the group feel ready for the night. Once they are dressed up, your final step is to wish them a great party tonight.
zombie-parade-defense-6: This sixth installment of the Zombie Parade Defense series asks you to hold your ground across ten separate stages. The zombies grow tougher with each stage you clear. In the Market section, you can upgrade your weapons and buy an extra health bar, among other things. It is a shooter with a two-player option, so a friend can join the fight.

Player 1 moves with W, A, S and D, attacks with C, throws grenades with V, reloads with X, and jumps with W. Q and E switch weapons. Player 2 uses the arrow keys to move, L to attack, K for grenades, J to reload, the up arrow to jump, and P to switch weapons. Walking on walls is also part of the controls for both players.
snake-chain-escape: This puzzle game shows a knot of multicolored snakes, each made of linked circles, all trying to slip free. A black dot marks the head of every snake, so you can see which way it is facing. Your job is to spot the snakes with an open route and remove them in the right order. Each snake you clear can open up new options, but one incorrect pick costs you a life.

Tap a snake to remove it, but only snakes with a clear path can be taken out. Removing one may also let others that were stuck behind it move. If you get stuck, the Hint button reveals a snake you can remove. Plan a few moves ahead, work through the chains, and get every snake out.
baby-happy-fishing: Baby Happy Fishing lets you enjoy a day at the water without leaving the house. The game spans four different locations, and each one is home to its own mix of fish. You are not limited to a single technique, either. You can cut through ice to reach the fish below, scoop them out of ponds with a net, or dive down to the seabed to hunt for them.
Along the way, you join a little Panda as you get your gear ready and set off on an adventure. Controls are simple: use your mouse or tap the screen to play.
ava-mouth-makeover: Ava is ready for a fresh new look, and you get to help her make it happen. Your job is to clear the stains from her teeth, then remove the bacteria in her mouth. Once that is done, you move on to cleaning her throat too. The whole game follows a doctor-style treatment, so you work through each step of her mouth care in turn.

When the treatment is finished, you can turn to Ava's outfit and dress her up. You play entirely with the mouse, pointing and clicking through every stage. It mixes mouth care with dress-up, so it suits anyone who enjoys watching a character's look change from start to finish.
princess-glitter-coloring: Princess Glitter Coloring is a girls' coloring game built around sparkly outfits. Players work through more than 50 pages of drawings that focus on glittery dresses, beauty coloring, kids' makeup, beauty girls, and accessories for girls. Each page offers a new picture to fill with color, so there is always something fresh to decorate.

Use a mouse or tap to play. The game fits the color, design, decoration, and kids themes, and it makes a relaxed pick for anyone who enjoys drawing and filling in pictures. Choose a page, pick your shades, and let the glitter take over.
indian-truck-driver-cargo-duty-delivery: You take the wheel of a rugged off-road cargo truck in this driving simulation. Each route presents its own changing conditions, and tight, risky bends demand careful handling if you want to deliver your load safely. The vehicles you control are mega transporter trucks, built to haul heavy loads across the course.

Much of the challenge comes from hill areas, where the rough terrain makes every climb a true test. Steer with the W, A, S and D keys or use the arrow keys. It suits anyone who enjoys the feeling of working as a hill climb driver.
newborn-twin-baby-care: Step into the role of a babysitter in this game, where you look after a pair of two-year-old twins. These little ones can be quite mischievous, so you'll need to feed them, give them a bath, dress them in fresh outfits, and keep them entertained with play. Think you have what it takes to handle such a demanding job?

The game is controlled entirely with mouse clicks or taps, so you can jump right in on a computer or a phone. Tags on the page point to its themes, including baby care, cooking, doctor visits, dress-up, decorating, design, and learning.
dino-run-game: This dinosaur runner puts you in charge of a powerful dinosaur as it charges through a prehistoric world. The pace builds as you go, and your aim is to last as long as you can. Leap over barriers, slip past dangerous objects, and gather coins while you race across prehistoric landscapes.

Expect traps and plenty of tricky challenges across ancient worlds, so keep your eyes on the path ahead. The run has no set end, and collecting rewards while staying alive is the heart of the game. To press any button, use your mouse.
draw-climber-online: This browser racer asks you to sketch a leg for your block so it can start moving. You compete against another block on the same course, and obstacles lie scattered along the way. You can change the shape of your block's legs at any time, so you can adapt whenever you need to get past a hazard.
The controls are simple: hold and slide to draw. Plan each leg carefully, since a clever shape can be the difference between clearing an obstacle and falling behind.
doll-unbox-dress-up: In this 3D game, you create your own toy doll and then dress it up however you like. You can mix and match different fashion pieces to change its look again and again. It suits anyone who enjoys putting outfits together and making a character feel personal through hands-on customizing.

Fans of collecting and blind boxes will feel at home here too. Everything is played with a mouse click or a tap, so the controls stay simple. Whether you want to craft a doll from scratch or try out new combinations, the whole experience centers on creative, personalized DIY work.
my-new-baby-twins: In this browser game for girls, you put together lovely outfits for a pair of twins, then bring the expectant moms in for their medical checkups. When it's time to pick maternity wear, choose pretty dresses and keep them on right up to the end, turning the look into a princess style.
You can also make the music more relaxing while the mommies are expecting, and you will see how much the baby loves it. The whole game is controlled with a mouse or by tapping.
zombie-royale: Zombies have taken over the world, yet people still find ways to live in this infested landscape. Your job is to race down the road ahead, but it is packed with dangerous undead. Speed matters, since you need to push through the crowds quickly and still arrive in good condition.

Your bullets are limited, so every shot counts when you need to clear a path. Steer with the A and D keys or the arrow keys, and tap to shoot. This 3D arcade shooter gives you only one chance, so stay focused from the first moment until you reach the finish line.
american-boat-rescue-simulator: American Boat Rescue Simulator puts you in charge of a boat whose job is pulling people out of the water. The game offers 100 missions, each sending you to rescue people from a different spot around an island. Completing rescues earns you points, which you can spend on new boats, including flashier models. Achievements are listed in the menu, and unlocking all of them is part of the challenge.

Steer with the WASD keys and look around with the mouse. Press C to switch between camera views. The game is tagged as a 1 player, Unity3D title in the Action, Boat, Collecting, Driving, Rescue and Simulator categories.
backflip-maniac: Backflip Maniac lets you make your character leap through the air. Early stages keep things simple, since you only leap from short distances. As the game moves on, the buildings grow taller, and landing precisely becomes much tougher. To move forward, you must touch down squarely on the red square; any miss keeps you from reaching the next stage. Jumps are controlled with the mouse.
car-race-drag-shift-2023: Car Race Drag Shift 2023 is a racing game where you sprint down a quarter-mile strip at high speed. Your job is to time each gear change carefully, since quick reactions and well-judged shifts decide how fast you pull away from the start. Pick from a range of carefully modelled vehicles, each with its own specifications, and race rivals to see who crosses the line first.
You can also upgrade your vehicles, fine-tune their gear ratios, and plan your shifts to win. Use the buttons inside the game to play.
mahjong-match: Mahjong Match invites you to relax, focus, and give your mind a workout. This tile-matching game turns the classic mahjong experience into a puzzle that feels satisfying to solve. Whether you have a few minutes for a quick brain workout or want a longer, more strategic session, it fits either style. The boards look attractive, and the game rewards your progress as you move forward.
Although the game draws on Merge mechanics and matching play, winning depends on careful observation and smart planning. Use tap and drag to play.
crazy-supercars-sky-stunt-trial: Crazy SuperCars Sky Stunt Trial is a 3D racing game built around daring car stunts. It is endless, so the fun continues for as long as you want to keep driving. If you enjoy stunt driving and want plenty of entertainment, this title is a good match. The game offers varied settings to explore, and its physics-based modern cars and airplanes respond realistically to how you handle them. Car control and stability play a big part, so you will need to stay balanced while you perform tricks.
Controls are simple. Use the W, A, S, and D keys to drive, and use the pause button whenever you need a break.
bus-simulator-ultimate-2021: This arcade title is billed as the first coach driving game of its kind, and it puts you in charge of a real coach. Across a range of different scenarios, you will pick up the skills needed to handle one properly. Each scenario gives you a chance to practise the craft of driving a large coach on the road.
Getting started is simple: the arrow keys are used to control the cars during play. Learning the controls takes only a moment, so you can focus on the driving itself.
beauty-makeover-games: Start by choosing one customer to work with. First, take out her contact lenses and false eyelashes. Then melt the wax to remove the hair on his face. Use the machine to scan for problems and get rid of any bugs. Finally, grab a scraper and clean the dirt from the tongue.
The game is controlled with simple mouse clicks or taps. The mouse handles every cooking step, and it is also used to decorate a banana
dotted-girl-new-era: Dotted Girl returns with a fresh style in this game. At first she is an ordinary girl going through her day, trying on modern outfits and dresses. Then she shifts into a superhero wearing a sharp one-piece suit and a mask. You can mix and match different costume pieces to build either a one-of-a-kind hero or a supervillain.

The game also lets you choose and design an adorable helper to join her. Follow along as you explore the latest adventures of Dotted Girl. Everything is controlled with a left mouse click or a tap on a touchscreen.
puppet-master: Puppet Master is a 3D clicker where you can hurl a knife, fire a machine gun, or launch a rocket at a ragdoll. Damaging the ragdoll is how you unlock new weapons, and the game blends action with clicking in a three-dimensional setting.

All of your input comes from the mouse, so you point and click to pick your attack and watch the puppet respond. The title is tagged as 3D, action, adventure, clicker, and HTML5, so it covers several kinds of browser play.
candy-smash: Candy Smash brings together a group of sweet companions that promise hours of enjoyment. It is a match-3 puzzle game that is easy to pick up and hard to put down. You only need to line up two or more candies to make them disappear. When the target is animals, remove the candies and touch each animal to the ground.
Mouse controls handle everything in the game, so there is no complicated setup to learn. Simply match the candies on the board and keep going until you reach the target.
kitty-drop-3d: A little kitty has become trapped on top of a wobbly tower, and it is up to you to bring her down safely. Tap a block to clear it away, removing just one at a time. Watch out for red blocks, hammers, and other tricky obstacles, since touching any of them will throw off your plan. The grass block is the one piece that never gets removed.

Think ahead about each move, work through the stack, and guide Kitty to a safe landing. The game is easy to pick up, yet it takes real thought to master. Use a mouse click or a tap to control everything you do.
bank-cash-transit-3d-security-van-simula: Bank Cash Transit 3D: Security Van Simulator 2018 puts you behind the wheel of a security van in a 3D city. Your task is to pick up cash from the main bank's truck and take it to the bank's other ATMs, all while keeping the money under tight protection. You step into a police van to secure the load, then drive a van packed with cash through the streets, working like a bank teller on a delivery run.
baby-taylor-pet-care: Taylor and Jessica are keen to try community work, so they head to the Pet Care Center after learning it needs care volunteers. Their visit falls on the weekend. Most of the work there involves looking after rescued animals, and the pair arrives with no hands-on experience. Thankfully, a volunteer named Sophia is on hand to guide them and show them what to do, so they never have to figure everything out alone. Together, the three of them look after cute pets in need.
Use a mouse click or a tap to play.
hamster-maze-online: Help a small hamster find its way out of a maze to reach its food. This browser game shows its world in detailed three-dimensional graphics, and the controls are simple to learn. Your job is to guide the little rodent past the barriers so it can reach the food at the end.

Along the way, you can gather the snacks hamsters like that are placed on the platforms. Each treat you collect helps you unlock cute costumes for your hamster. You can play with a mouse or by tapping the screen.
bubble-shooter-rainbow: Heroes from your favorite Disney shows are waiting for you in this puzzle game. Your job is to pop bubbles on each board and free the characters trapped inside. Familiar faces from shows and movies such as Mickey Mouse, DuckTales, and Disney's Zombies appear along the way. You move from one level to the next, and the full game is large, so it is worth coming back to it often.

Colored bubbles fill the board. Find a group of two or more bubbles of the same color and click it to burst them. Each level requires you to clear bubbles of certain colors, so focus on those, since your number of moves is limited. Special bubbles are power-ups. Click one to pop several bubbles in a single go, regardless of their color. Controls are simple: move your mouse and click the bubbles.
bubble-pop-shooter: Bubble Pop! Puzzle Game Legend is a bubble shooter that millions of people enjoy. Its colorful bubbles keep boredom away, and you can spend hours popping groups of matching colors. Your goal is to shoot every bubble off the board, and each clear earns you coins. When the puzzles get tricky, special boosters help you burst many bubbles at once.

Aim carefully, then tap to fire. Three or more bubbles of the same color must touch to pop. Use fewer shots to score higher and earn three stars. You can also create powerful boosters to pop even more bubbles.
rolling-halloween: Rolling Halloween is a running game that is very hard to put down. Your ball must dodge obstacles such as monster trees and headstones. Gather magic skulls to strengthen your powerup items, which in turn opens up additional Halloween balls. You can also grab shields, magnets, and magical wings to gain extra help. The goal is to keep going as far as you can while staying ahead of the monsters chasing you.

Controls work differently depending on your device. On mobile or with a mouse on desktop, swipe left or right to change lanes and swipe up to jump. On a keyboard, use the left and right arrow keys to move, the up arrow to jump, and the Space bar to start a new run. The game features 3D objects and supports both English and Russian.
giddy-birds: Giddy Birds is a puzzle game where your job is to follow a sequence of birds for as long as you can. It is built around a memory test that checks how well you can recall patterns while things speed up. The graphics are bright and charming, and the gameplay runs smoothly with no loading breaks between rounds.

To play, press the left key for No or the right key for Yes, or simply click the buttons with your mouse. The challenge is to see how far you can keep up with these lively birds before you slip. It mixes quick reactions with careful memory work, so it suits anyone curious about their own recall.
epic-prankster-hide-and-shoot: Prankster Hide and Shoot is a 3D game where you tag and blast everyone while trying not to get caught yourself. Your mission is straightforward: grab your blaster and prank every one of them. It's a lively, playful shooter built around sneaky tricks and surprise attacks.

The game is played by touching the screen, so the controls stay simple. Hide, sneak, and fire your way through each round while keeping your friends guessing. It's a silly, fast-paced pick for anyone who enjoys a goofy showdown and a good bit of fibbing.
princess-favorite-outfits: Each girl has a clothing style all her own, and in this game Elsa, Anna, Ariel, Rapunzel and Belle are no different. Each of them has a distinct taste in outfits. On a shopping day, they decide to show off their favorite looks and switch into matching clothes before heading out. Your job is to ask each princess what style she likes most, then pick the outfit that suits her best.
Play by clicking or tapping with your mouse. Talk with the girls, find the look that fits each one, and enjoy dressing them up.
crazy-intersection: Crazy Intersection is an action game that blends relaxed puzzle play with a range of enjoyable ways to play. Its many levels test your reflexes, and the challenge grows as you clear each stage. Your aim is to see how far you can get by passing as many levels as you can.

Expect to meet all sorts of vehicles in this small, charming simulation game. The controls are simple and easy to pick up, so you can start right away without a long explanation. Keep going and enjoy the lighthearted challenge from beginning to end.
funny-bomber: Funny Bomber is a free-to-play 3D action game for one player that runs right in your browser. You explore a bright, lively level filled with challenges, and it is designed to hold your attention for hours. Your mission is clear: blow up every crystal scattered across the level so the door swings open and you can enter the temple.

Move with the W, A, S and D keys, and left-click to set off your bomb. Each crystal you destroy brings you one step closer to the temple entrance, so choose your blasts carefully. The controls are easy to pick up, which makes it simple to jump in and start playing.
truck-deliver-3d-game: Steer a big rig through a 3D world where your job is hauling different cargo to its destination. The game presents many challenges, and you must get through every level to show off your driving skill. Traffic keeps rolling along the road, so you need to wait for the right moment before crossing. Cross at the wrong time and your truck will be crushed, and you lose.
Play with a mouse click or a tap on the screen. Good timing is the key skill, so watch the cars closely and move only when the road is clear enough.
head-football-3d: Head Football 3D puts you on the pitch for quick one-on-one soccer matches. Winning depends on good timing, sharp skill, and a clever plan. You choose your favorite football character, then aim to put the ball in the net while facing tough rivals. Each match moves at a brisk pace, and the games are built to hold your attention for hours.
Controls are simple: press the left arrow key to move left and the right arrow key to move right. Time your moves carefully and look for openings that lead to a goal.
easter-fun-coloring-book: Easter Fun Coloring Book is a coloring game that gives kids a chance to show off their creativity during the Easter season. They can paint and decorate eggs and rabbits using bright, cheerful colors. Coloring eggs has never been this easy or enjoyable. Pick a design you like, fill it with color, then save it and send it to family and friends with a "Happy Easter" message.
The game is completely free and designed to be safe for children. It is played with a mouse or by tapping the screen. Have fun!
idle-hero-counter-terrorist: Idle Hero: Counter Terrorist is a single-player 3D action shooter built around idle gameplay. You decide which soldiers join the fight, and you need to watch your cash so it doesn't drain too quickly. Each decision affects how well you handle the enemies who keep coming.

Your plan matters as much as your squad, so choose a strategy that fits the situation and stay ready as the battles repeat without end. The controls are simple: a left mouse click is the only input you need to play.
bts-easter-coloring-book: Easter is a great time for young artists to show what they can do. This game lets children paint and decorate holiday pictures using vivid, cheerful shades. Painting Easter eggs has never been this entertaining or simple. Players choose whichever design they like from a large selection, color it in, then save their work and share it with friends and family along with a cheerful Happy Easter message.
The whole game costs nothing to enjoy, and it is suitable for children to use. Controls are simple: use a mouse or tap the screen to get started.
charlie-the-talking-steak: Charlie the Talking Steak is a playful simulation where you spend your time with a steak called Charlie. Your job is to get him ready to eat, bend him into different shapes, or put him through all sorts of odd and messy situations. The humor leans dark and the gameplay takes unusual turns, so expect the unexpected.

Everything is controlled with the mouse, so you point, click, and drag your way through each scene. Tags on the page mention collecting, physics, and point-and-click skill, which hints at how the game mixes puzzles with silly reactions. It sits in the hypercasual category, so it is quick to pick up and easy to try for a few minutes.
baby-hippo-bath-time: Could you make bathtime a happy routine for a little one while also building a habit of regular washing and good hygiene? This game sets out to do just that, helping a young player warm up to the bath. Click or tap to get started.
Baby Hippo Bath Time is a simulation aimed at kids and girls, with a cute animal theme and cleaning as its core activity. Play it with a mouse click or a tap on the screen.
heroes-legend: Two legendary heroes team up in this two-player adventure to rescue a princess held captive at the top of a great tower. Your job is to climb through 16 levels, and to reach the higher floors you must gather keys along the way. Your arsenal includes a sword, an axe, a bow with arrows, and magical weapons for taking on monsters.

Player 1 moves with W, A, S, and D, attacks with F, jumps with W, and switches weapons with Q. Player 2 uses the arrow keys to move, L to attack or shoot, the up arrow to jump, and U to change weapons. Team up with a friend on one keyboard and push through the tower together.
rainbow-girls-nye-fashion: Skyler, Sunny, Ruby, and Violet are close friends who want to ring in the new year in style. They are planning their New Year's Eve fashion and hope to greet the coming year with a striking look. Still, they know they need expert guidance to get the results they want. Your job is to act as the fashion designer for these four girls and help them put their outfits together.

Everything is controlled with a simple left mouse button click, so the controls stay easy to learn. The game has a bright, cheerful feel and suits anyone who enjoys dress-up, makeovers, and fashion. Helping the friends prepare for their New Year's Eve look is the heart of the experience.
euro-truck-heavy-vehicle-transport-game-: Take the wheel of a large trailer truck and haul several vehicles across both busy city streets and rugged hillside dirt tracks. You play as an extreme car transporter, starting your trucking job behind the controls of a big Euro rig. Its trailer carries luxury cars and heavy machines, so you need to keep your speed in check when weaving through city traffic and when climbing steep mountain routes.
Steer with the keyboard arrow keys. This 3D driving simulator is built for HTML5, so it runs straight in your browser and fits the racing and simulation style of play.
popcorn-thief: Quby is a sneaky office worker with a huge glass bowl of popcorn in front of them and an overwhelming urge to eat every last piece. The catch is that a suspicious colleague sits right beside them, eyes fixed on a screen, ready to turn around the moment they notice something odd. This 2D stealth game is fast and played solo, so you'll need good timing to keep snacking without getting caught.

You can choose whichever control style suits you best, either Desktop or Mobile. On Desktop, press and hold the spacebar or hold the left mouse button to slip your hand into the bowl and stuff Quby's face with popcorn. The game rewards careful, well-timed snacking, so think about when it's safe to dig in.
fire-and-water-in-dino-world: Fire and Water are two adventurers making their way home through a land full of dinosaurs. Along the route they encounter dinos, so every step needs care. To get back, they must collect all the gold coins while steering clear of the creatures. This adventure game supports two players, so a friend can share the journey from the start.

Player one moves with A and D, jumps with W, activates invulnerability with S, and attacks with R. Player two has separate controls to move, jump, and use invincible props, while the Num1 key handles attacks for that player. The game is tagged as both a 2 player and an adventure title, so it suits anyone who enjoys exploring with a partner.
tanks-racing: Tanks Racing is a 2D driving game built around tough, entertaining courses. The classic series returns with fresh stages and a new engine, letting you roam the world in your tank and show who rules the track. You can face racers from across the globe, chase the clock, and finish challenges to earn the title of top tank racer. Expect a trip through desert terrain where many kinds of hazards lie in wait and enemies work to slow you down, so watch your path closely.
Controls are simple. Steer with A and D or the left and right arrow keys. Press Space, W, or the up arrow to jump over trouble. Use your brakes whenever you need to slow down and avoid a crash.
duty-call-modern-warfate-2: Your nation is in serious trouble, and you are its last hope. Military vehicles that cost nothing sit close by, equipped with heavy specialist weapons. Plan an assault that uses every asset you have, including air support, in a modern world war setting. Before enemy tanks and helicopters can strike, you must build a way to destroy them.

You play as a Special Forces commando who leads from the front in a dangerous combat zone. Map out your attack, then launch the weapon strike and take part in shootouts. Use every weapon from the war to come out on top. Move with WASD and aim with the mouse. Left click fires, right click activates the scope, R reloads, and Shift lets you run.
kids-mathematics-game: Race the clock in this math puzzle made for young learners. Each equation is missing its arithmetic sign, and you need to choose the correct one by studying the numbers and the answer, then finish the equation. Work through as many as you can before time runs out, and try to be quick.
When the 120 seconds end, your score is calculated from how many answers you got right and how many you got wrong. Use your mouse to play, or tap the screen if you are on a mobile device.
tri-puzzle: Tri Puzzle offers a fresh set of challenges for fans of puzzle games, made with kids in mind. Your job is to pick up each block and move it until it sits in the correct position. It may seem easy at first, but the game stays lively and interactive from start to finish.

To move a block, press and hold the left mouse button, drag the piece across the screen, and release it once it is in place. Every block you drop into the right spot is a small win. The game is built to be a fun, hands-on experience for young players who enjoy solving problems with the mouse.
city-construction-simulator-master-3d: Ever wondered what goes into fixing a damaged road? This game lets you go through the entire repair job from start to finish. Guided by helpful hints and directional arrows, you take control of unusual vehicles and work to get the city's streets back in shape.

Use W, A, S, D or the arrow keys to steer your machine. When you need to slow down or stop, press the Space bar to brake. Follow the tips and arrows as you go, since they show you where to head. Each road you help repair brings the city one step closer to being fixed.
candy-jewel-crush: Candy Jewel Crush is a match-3 puzzle game where you swipe across the board to swap colorful candies. Line up three or more matching sweets to crush them and clear the way. Your goal is to reach high scores using as few moves as possible, complete missions, and get past obstacles across plenty of tricky matching levels.

The game offers many unique and demanding stages, with smooth, clean graphics and sound effects. A high quality soundtrack and background music accompany your play. It is easy to pick up but takes real skill to master. It also suits friends and family who want to compete over who can clear every level and mission.
ridge-racer: Ridge Racer is a highly competitive racing game where you climb behind the wheel, chase down other cars, and try to come out on top. A large selection of maps is waiting for you to explore, so every outing can feel like a new adventure. Event rewards are another reason to keep racing, and there are more of them to earn.
Your car can fire weapons at opponents to slow them down. Use the arrow keys to control and flip your car, and press the space bar to jump. Stay sharp, since the competition is tight.
basketball-goat: Basketball GOAT is a sports game where you can test your court skills and work toward becoming the greatest of all time. The action moves quickly, and the challenges reward skill rather than luck. It is built so that players of any age can pick it up and enjoy it.

Casual players and serious basketball fans alike should find something to like here. The controls are smooth, and the ball follows realistic physics, so each shot feels like it has weight behind it. Gameplay is rewarding, giving you a clear sense of progress as your abilities grow. All buttons are operated with your mouse.
baby-taylor-newborn-caring: Taylor's mom is about to deliver a baby, and the family needs your support. You start by making an urgent call for help. Until the ambulance comes, you can get things ready for the big moment.

Taylor cannot do much to assist right now, but she can still take care of the baby. Everyone in the household is busy, so jump in and lend a hand as much as you can. Everything is controlled with a mouse click or a tap.
superhero-police-speed-hero-rescue-missi: Weave your car through busy city traffic in this superhero driving adventure. You play a super-fast robot hero who first heads to a waiting ambulance, then steers it toward an emergency scene. Once there, you collect people who are hurt, burned, or wounded and load them into the vehicle.

Your next job is to drive the ambulance back to the hospital with your patients on board, all while staying safe on the road. You also take on the doctor's role, helping the injured from accidents and delivering them to care. Use the arrow keys on your keyboard and follow the on-screen instructions to get moving.
sniper-champion-3d: Sniper Champion 3D puts you behind a rifle in a first-person arcade shooter that rewards a steady hand. Your task is to pass 1000 points within sixty seconds, and this goal applies on every level. Stars are earned based on your score, so the more points you collect, the more stars you finally walk away with. Targets appear at random spots, so you have to aim quickly. Shooting the yellow areas is worth the most, up to 500 points.
You never need to track ammo or worry about how fast you fire. Just stay composed and focus on lining up your quick shots. To aim, drag your finger or pointer across the screen, then release to fire.
paint-puzzle: A nice picture is missing some of its color, and your job is to help complete it. The colors you see on screen don't have to be the ones you want, because you mix the shades yourself. Be careful not to blend in the wrong place, since a stray mix can spoil your work.

Getting started is as simple as a tap, so press to begin and start experimenting. Think about which tones you need before you combine them. Patience helps, because each mix brings the picture one step closer to being finished.
move-ragdoll-duel: Move Ragdoll Duel is a 3D casual fighting game with bright, charming visuals and easy-to-follow action. You take on opponents using a selection of weapons, such as basketballs and throwing knives. To throw one, press your finger on the screen and slide it in the direction you want, then lift your finger to send the weapon flying. A tap on the screen moves you right to wherever your weapon has landed, so you can keep the fight going.
astro-chickens: Take the controls of a spaceship and fly through 10 unique environments, blasting away nonstop waves of alien chickens before they reach you. Each kill earns coins, and you can pick up power-ups in the middle of a wave. A boss battle arrives after every fifth wave. There is no end point, so your goal is simply to reach a higher score.

Every ship has its own special ability, which you trigger with Space on a desktop or the right mouse button. Abilities run on a cooldown and recharge over time, which helps you survive tough moments. To start, open the lobby, pick an environment and a ship from their grids, and choose Normal, Hard, or Insane in Settings. Press Launch Mission, then press Space or tap the canvas on the Get Ready screen to begin.
slap-kings: Slap Kings is a 3D game where you build up your skills and grow stronger over time. Your job is to get the timing right: watch the rhythm, then let go of your move at the right moment to land a hit on your challenger. Defeat every opponent and you can earn the title of strongest challenger. Keep upgrading your abilities as you go if you want a shot at winning the whole competition.
Playing is simple. Click the mouse or tap the screen to make your moves.
f1-drift-racer: F1 Drift Racer is a racing game with 20 levels to work through. You can pick from several car skins to change how your ride looks, and the whole game is meant to be fun from start to finish. It sits in the racing category and carries the car tag, so it suits anyone who enjoys getting behind the wheel.
Steering is simple. Use the W, A, S and D keys or the arrow keys to guide your car. Either set works, so choose whichever feels more natural to you. Keep moving through each level and enjoy the ride.
eye-art-2: Step into the role of a beauty professional in Eye Art 2, where your job is to paint eyes with inventive designs. Glide your fingers across the screen to try all sorts of looks, switching from one style to the next. Each time you complete a polished set, fans respond with thousands of likes.

Your growing talent and reputation unlock more creative Eye Art looks to work on. You can play with a mouse or simply tap the screen, whichever suits your device. Keep experimenting to see how far your creativity can take you.
offroad-monster-truck-forest-championshi: Take the wheel of a monster truck and drive through a forest course, where the terrain is rough and far from any paved road. Your rivals are computer-controlled AI opponents, and your goal is to reach the destination before they do. Every turn and bump matters when you are chasing the lead.

Steering and acceleration use the W, A, S, and D keys, while the space bar applies the brakes for slowing down or handling tight corners. This racing game is a driving simulator built around truck handling, so getting comfortable with the controls is part of the challenge. It runs right in your browser and was made with Unity3D and WebGL.
water-sort-puzzle-2: Water Sort Puzzle 2 is the second game in the Water Sort Puzzle series, and this time the difficulty has been raised. You will find more styles to look at and more grades to move through, so the challenge builds as you go. In total there are 300 levels, and the puzzles are harder than before. You can take them on yourself, or ask for help whenever a stage gets tricky.

To get started, just tap to play. This casual puzzle asks you to think and use your skill, making it a good pick for anyone who enjoys brain-focused games. Take your time, test your wits, and enjoy the steady climb through every grade.
merge-commander-battle-game: Merge Commander Battle is a relaxed puzzle game about growing an army from the ground up. You begin by chopping down trees, and each one unlocks more soldiers to join your ranks. Once you have gathered enough troops, you can launch an attack on the enemy. Your main objective is to defeat the opposing side and gain control of their camp.

The graphics are polished and rendered in 3D, and the gameplay is designed to keep you hooked. Whether you enjoy army battles or simply like building up a force bit by bit, this game has plenty to offer. Everything is controlled with mouse clicks or taps, so it is simple to pick up and play.
harmony-tester: Wondering how well you match with your partner? Harmony Tester lets you check how compatible you are and see how your zodiac signs fit together. You can also open a horoscope reading that explains what your sign says. Controls are simple: use a left click on a computer, or tap the screen on a phone or tablet.

The game is meant to be light and fun, so treat the results as a playful look at your love rather than a serious answer. Pick your signs, try different pairings, and enjoy the little surprises each reading brings.
car-craft-race-fun-and-run-3d-game: Car Craft Race mixes block collecting with arcade-style vehicle racing. Its 3D animations have the look of LEGO bricks. First, you gather enough blocks to build up your vehicle, then you head for the finish line. Once you have more blocks than your rivals, you can crash into them, knocking their blocks loose so they fall onto the ground.
The controls are simple: tap or click. The game sits in the hypercasual category and is tagged for both boys and girls, so it suits quick rounds for anyone who likes cars and building.
farming-mini-puzzle: Farming Mini Puzzle is a calm farm adventure that blends brain-teasing puzzles with everyday countryside work. Each farm scene is bursting with bright colors, and clearing a challenge brings a rewarding payoff. The game suits anyone who enjoys puzzle games, farming games, brain teasers, or casual play, since it mixes entertainment with a bit of mental exercise. Spend your time in a peaceful rural setting, solving puzzles, finishing farm tasks, and sharpening your problem-solving skills as you go.
Every button in the game is selected with the mouse, so a mouse is all you need to move through it.
basketball-scorer-3d: Your goal is to get the ball into the basket, which is harder than it sounds. The game has 7 levels, and finishing all of them takes a good amount of time, so expect to struggle a little along the way. Some things in the game will make you fly, while others will make you faster, so you need to be careful on your way to the basket.

Move forward with W, backward with S, left with A, and right with D. This is a single-player 3D basketball sports game, so you control every move yourself. Keep an eye on where you are heading and take your time lining up each throw.
escape-the-temple: Escape the Temple is a two-player adventure where you and a friend work through a temple together. Your task is to survive, but the temple is full of puzzles, poison, and other dangers that can end your run at any moment. Every puzzle has to be solved with your partner, so you will need to collaborate closely and progress only through teamwork.
Player one moves with the WASD keys, while player two uses the arrow keys. The E and L keys are used to open a valve or move a box. On mobile, touch controls are available.
bubble-shooter-valentines: Bubble Shooter Valentines brings the familiar bubble-popping style into a romantic setting, while still adding some newer touches to the gameplay. Heart-shaped balloons drift toward you, and your job is to gather them up before they get too close. When things get tough, you can grab power-ups to help you through the trickier moments.

Playing is simple on any device. Tap or click on the screen to aim and fire, whether you are using a touchscreen or a mouse. It is a light, cheerful pick for a quick round, with a Valentine's Day feel from start to finish.
rolling-balls-3d: Fans of ball games may enjoy Rolling Balls 3D, a hypercasual title for one player. Your reflexes and quickness get tested as you race toward each checkpoint, so move fast and keep your focus sharp. Many people are drawn to its competitive, quick-moving style. You steer a rolling ball and try to get ahead of rival racers, while fresh challenges keep appearing along the way.
Controls are simple: use the W, A, S, and D keys to move the ball. Pick up coins as you roll, and dodge any obstacles in your path. Then set off and start racing.
parkour-run-race-3d: Leap from rooftop to rooftop in this 3D arcade racer. You control a stickman who flips, jumps, falls, and vaults over obstacles while chasing new records. Climb tall buildings across the city and land tricks to build up extra speed. Other players join you in a daily race where winners take home special rewards, and boosters can help you pull ahead. Keep an eye on the racer behind you.

The course runs through famous cities such as New York, Paris, and Tokyo. Wall jumps carry you faster between channels, accelerating props give you a push, and a sidewalk route offers a way around crowded middles. When a barrier is too tall, you can jump onto the wall instead. Win races to unlock outfits, back bling, and special effects for your stickman. All controls work by dragging with the mouse.
pin-out-rescue-game: Pin Out Rescue Game is a puzzle game built around thinking ahead. Each stage asks you to pull the correct pins in the right order so you can free the trapped characters while steering clear of hazards. Fans of brain teasers, logic challenges, and rescue-style puzzles should find plenty to enjoy here.

Controls are simple: use a mouse click or a tap on a touchscreen to move through the game. Every pin you pull changes the situation, so it pays to consider each choice before you act. The game is a light, quick pick for anyone who likes working out a puzzle one step at a time.
keep-clean: Keep Clean invites you to look after your dream home, keeping it spotless while you decorate it with fresh flowers and plants. Along the way, you can bring in a house helper and involve your family members in the work. There is no need to wait for spring before giving your home a proper clean.

The In-House Cleaning Day mode focuses on tidying up the house and getting rid of the things you no longer need. Playing is simple: use your mouse or tap the screen to move through the game. It is a sweet pick for girls and kids who enjoy home-themed games.
ski-jump-2022: Ski Jump 2022 places you in a sporting competition modeled on the Olympic Games, where the goal is to win medals. Alongside the medal chase, you can also work toward your first jump over 200m. Filed under Sports, the game is built around skiing and skill, with a focus on hitting the right moments.
Controls are straightforward. A tap sends your skier down the ramp and into the jump. Once the skier is in the air, another tap or click keeps the skier balanced.
extreme-car-racing: Speed, precise handling, and quick decisions matter most in this racing game. You tear down crowded highways, weaving through moving traffic, dodging obstacles, and staying ahead of police cars that give chase. The pace is brisk, and the controls are easy to learn.

The road never seems to end. Traffic keeps flowing, corners arrive sharp and unexpected, and each stretch brings a fresh challenge. Your aim is to last as long as you can, escape the pursuit, and see how far your driving skills can be pushed. Every button is operated with a mouse click.
emoji-booms: Emoji Booms is a one-player arcade game centred on explosions and emoticons. Your aim is to combine the correct emoticons so they blow up, while making sure no pop-up emoticons get in the way. The game uses five different emojis, so you will need to keep track of which ones belong together.

Moving pieces works by dragging and dropping them, and the game can also be played with touch controls on a mobile device. It is a 2D title tagged as adventure, click, and arcade, which gives it a mix of playful styles. The fun comes from matching the right emoticons
jul-moto-racing: Jul Moto Racing is a two-dimensional driving game built around motorbike racing. Its levels are tough to get through but still enjoyable, so each run feels like a fresh challenge. It sits in the racing category and carries motorcycle-themed tags, so fans of bikes should feel right at home.
Steering your rider is simple. Press A or D, or the left and right arrow keys, to move the motorbike in either direction. When you need to leave the ground, tap Space, W, or the up arrow to jump.
traffic-racer: Traffic Racer is an endless arcade racer set on busy highways. You guide your car through heavy traffic and collect cash as you go. That money can be used to upgrade your current car or to buy new ones. It is a notable entry in the endless racing genre, and it puts its own spin on the format.

The game uses only the mouse for controls. It is filed under Action and Racing and features 3D graphics. If you enjoy driving games where the road never ends and you like improving your ride over time, this one is worth a try.
car-stunts-challenge: Car Stunts Challenge is a racing game built around a heavy, rear-wheel-drive car that slides through plenty of drifts. Each car offers a different amount of drifting power, so you can sharpen your driving and racing skills in this realistic stunt drift simulator. The game also covers off-road driving, where you take a Prado over tricky tracks, and car parking on mountain terrain. Courses even reach into outer space and sky-high routes that feel close to impossible.
Controls are simple. Press the Up Arrow to speed forward, the Down Arrow to reverse, and the Left or Right Arrow to steer in that direction.
waterpark-slide-race: Waterpark Slide Race is a casual game that lets you take in the scenery from the lofty perch of drifting clouds. If you enjoy gazing down at the world below, you will likely have a good time here, since the game is built around chasing height. It lets you rise above life's ups and downs and step into a charming virtual world.

The controls are simple: just tap or click to take part. Each action keeps you moving through the experience, and you can enjoy the feeling of reaching ever greater heights. Whether you have a few spare minutes or a longer stretch of free time, this delightful title offers a light, cheerful escape into its virtual surroundings.
merge-car-idle-tycoon: Running a car empire sounds appealing, and in Merge Car Idle Tycoon you can build a collection of luxury and limited-edition automobiles. Your depot grows bit by bit as coins pile up over time. Spend them to improve your vehicles, and combine idle cars to create stronger models that sit higher on the ladder.

The game is played with taps, so it is easy for kids and casual fans to pick up. It sits in the puzzle category and has a point-and-click feel. Each upgrade adds to your fleet, and watching your depot expand is the main fun of the experience.
stacky-dash-2: Stacky Dash 2 belongs to the same family of 3D stacking cube arcade games. Your goal is to gather as many cubes as you can while following the track toward the final platform. Along the way, you will reach several maze-like platforms linked by narrow bridges. Crossing a bridge costs you some of the cubes you have already picked up.
Movement works with a D-pad or by swiping across the screen. The title is tagged for mobile play and also carries labels for simulation, collecting, maze, platform and stack.
skateboard-lighter: Skateboard Lighter is a sports game with a vertical, cartoon look. You steer your character through a series of tricky obstacles, getting past each one in turn so you can finish every challenge quickly. Along the way you collect a large number of props. The challenges are easy and come with no strict limits, and you can jump into any level you want.
