Watch out for bombs, because setting one off means you fail. The game feels quite magical to play and is simple to pick up, so it suits a wide range of players and becomes more fun as more people join in.
bus-rush-bus-surfer: Bus Rush, also known as Bus Surfer, is a parkour arcade game with 3D animated art. Judging by its cover, it focuses on moving fast and getting away from trouble. In games of this type, you usually gather gold coins while avoiding dangerous moments during running and escaping. Here, the situations you face shift a little because the theme is skateboarding.
Whatever happens, your goal is to dodge every obstacle and enjoy the thrill of riding the board. Controls are handled with a tap or a click.
popcorn-time-game: Popcorn Time is a puzzle game built around the snack that almost always comes with a movie night. Fortunately, you already have a popcorn-making machine. Each press of the mouse sets it going, and it keeps producing popcorn for as long as you keep pressing.
Your aim is to pop the kernels up to the target line. Keep every piece from falling to the ground. Clear all levels to collect them, and remember that plen
animal-simulator-truck-transport-2020: Fans of heavy vehicles will find this game right up their street, since it centers on trucks, cargo haulers, and buses. Your job is to drive a truck while hauling livestock and wild creatures. Before setting off, you load both your cargo and an animal transport cage onto the truck bed.

The animals on board range from cows, bulls, and horses to zebras, lions, foxes, and elephants. Once everything is in place, you carry them to the zoo and unload them there. Control is split between two jobs: the WASD keys drive the truck, while a joystick handles the animal.
children-doctor-dentist: In this dental clinic game, you play a dentist caring for four patients: Brian, Katie, Frank, and Peter. Each one has arrived at the clinic needing help with their teeth. Your job is to clean their teeth, place fillings, or repair teeth that have broken. Kids can carry out these dental treatments and act like skilled dentists themselves.

The game is designed to teach young players about looking after teeth while keeping them entertained. Everything is controlled with taps or clicks. Whether you are cleaning, filling, or fixing, each step is both educational and fun.
highway-traffic-bike-stunts: Climb onto a powerful superbike and race through the crowded lanes of a city highway in this 3D stunt game. It is made for riders who want to sharpen their highway stunt bike simulation skills. The asphalt tracks wind through heavy traffic, so you need to stay alert at every turn and keep your eyes on the road ahead.

Use the arrow keys to move your bike, and press the spacebar to generate a ramp. Throughout the ride you can explore the world of superbike stunt racing, where every trip through the traffic rush tests your control and timing. It runs right in your browser, making it an easy game to jump into.
lazy-jump-online: Lazy Jump Online is a physics-based puzzle game in the arcade category, where you guide a boy through a never-ending series of levels. He is hopeless at moving on his own, so you will be sliding, tripping, flipping and flinging him around just to finish simple tasks.

Quick decisions and a solid grasp of how things move and fall are essential, since every attempt tests your understanding of physics. Tricky obstacles and unexpected mechanics appear along the way, so you will need to stay sharp. The game is online, works on mobile devices, and is tagged for kids.
speedrun-parkour: Speedrun Parkour is a lighthearted running game in which your goal is to clear each stage as quickly as possible. Your clock is the real challenge here, so every jump and step counts toward a faster finish. It belongs to the Arcade category and carries tags such as 2D, Fun, and running.

Control is simple. Press A and D, or the left and right arrow keys, to run in either direction. Tap W or the up arrow to leap over gaps and obstacles. Keep your timing sharp, learn each route, and see how fast you can finish.
trivia-io-2: Trivia.io 2 is the sequel to the first game. Above you the questions cover astronomy, and below you they cover geography. Each checkpoint presents a tough problem to solve. If you answer wrong, you must clear the next pool, and the run continues in the following round. Keep an eye on the clock and reach the platform in time, because otherwise there is a consequence you will want to avoid.

The game is set in 3D and blends brain-teasing puzzles with quiz play, and it is aimed at kids who enjoy learning. It is tagged as an arcade title with educational value. To begin, just tap the screen.
attack-hole-game: Attack Hole Game puts you in charge of a black hole that swallows whatever lies in its path. As it consumes things, it grows larger and stronger. You can move quickly across the arena, collecting weapons, objects, and resources along the way. Once you are ready, you take on powerful enemies and bosses.
Every button in the game is operated with the mouse. The title sits in the Puzzles category and is also tagged for two-player play, with labels such as Casual, Hypercasual, Adventure, and Fun.
bicycle-stunt-racing-game-3d: Hop onto the saddle in this 3D bicycle stunt racer, where you hit the tracks, pedal hard, and work your way to the front. Extreme Cycle Racing mixes speed, skill, and adrenaline into every ride. As you progress, you can unlock new bikes that offer better speed, handling, and control.

Your aim is to beat the other riders and finish each track in the shortest time you can. Press W or the Up Arrow to move forward, S or the Down Arrow to move back, and A or the Left Arrow or D or the Right Arrow to move left or right. Use the mouse to click any button on screen.
stunts-car-speed-trial: Stunts Car Speed Trial lets you choose a car and paint it before you set off. Once you're on the map, you drive at speed and search for the object you need to find to win. Along the way you can collect items such as keys and coins. A minimap shows where the key object is, so you can work out which way to go.
The controls are simple. Use W, A, S, and D to drive, press F for nitro, and hold Space to brake. Tab opens the menu, and C switches the camera view.
my-best-ff-outfits: Dress up Anna, Elsa, Snow White, and Ariel in My Best FF Outfits. All four princesses are fond of FF, and they love wearing FF costumes and accessories. This time they have decided to try out some FF looks, and it is up to you to find a fitting outfit for each of them.
Aim for one-of-a-kind combinations by picking unusual costumes and hairstyles. To make your choices, click or tap on clothing, accessories, hairstyles, and other items on screen to select them.
millionaire-kids-game: Millionaire Kids Game is a quiz that recreates the feel of the well-known TV show, letting you play straight from your device. Your job is to put your general knowledge to the test while racing a countdown. Each question gives you a chance to see how well you can think on your feet, and the experience is built to feel like you are really taking part in the show.
This is a single-player title in the Puzzles category, with a 2D look and a quiz format. To play, simply tap the screen or click with your mouse to choose the answer you think is right.
strawberry-shortcake-bake-shop: Strawberry Shortcake is eager to get baking alongside you. Mix together tasty ingredients to craft the sweet treat you have always imagined. Add colorful food dye, frosting, and an assortment of toppings and decorations to finish it off. You can also invent your own berry-filled recipes that you can try out in your own kitchen. Everything is controlled with a mouse or by tapping the screen.
line-color-3d-fun-and-run-3d-game: Line Color 3D is a 3D arcade game that puts your reflexes to work. It's a good pick when you want something to fill a spare moment. Getting through every level is far from easy, but the game encourages you to keep going, since you can get there with a bit of persistence. As you move along the road, you'll need to dodge obstacles while working through a series of challenges.

Controls are simple: just tap or click to play. Take your time with each level and enjoy the run from start to finish. Whether you want to test your reflexes or simply look for some light fun, this hypercasual game is ready when you are.
hop-ball: Hop Ball is an arcade title that puts your reflexes and jumping skills to the test. Your ball bounces from tile to tile along a colored road, heading toward its far end. The game offers a new experience for fans of ball games who want something different.

Controls are simple: swipe across the screen or move your mouse to make the ball jump onto the tiles. Stay calm, steer carefully, and see how far you can go. This single-player 3D game also tracks highscores, so you can always try to beat your last run.
car-racing-3d-drive-mad: Car Racing: 3D Drive Mad is an arcade racer where you take the wheel of a car fitted with a nitro system. Collecting fuel charges your nitro, so you can decide when to use it. Your aim is to beat the AI rivals on the track by steering around obstacles and grabbing nitro items along the way.

On a PC, press A and D to move left and right, and tap the buttons for the other functions. On mobile, tap the buttons to control the car. The game is set in 3D and sits among the driving, simulation and collecting titles. Have fun!
robo-running-3d: In this arcade runner, you guide an ink figure who moves through the course with parkour-style acrobatics. His special pen can bring your sketches to life, producing things like boats, weapons, and swim rings to help along the way. Keep an eye on your ink supply, since the pen loses its magic once the ink runs out.

Your aim is to get past every obstacle and defeat the final boss. Controls are simple: swipe left or right to move in that direction. Run close to the parts you want to pick up, and grab them as you pass. This online HTML5 game mixes obstacle avoidance with item collection.
drive-hills: Drive Hills is a 3D car driving game where you take the wheel and set off on a trip around the world with an egg on board. Along the way, the road throws obstacles in your path, and you have to get past them to reach the next city. Every obstacle you clear brings you closer to the end of the journey.
Collecting coins lets you unlock new cars and new eggs, giving you more options for the trip. The whole game is controlled with a single input: click the mouse or tap the screen to play.
drive-dead-3d: Drive Dead 3D is a 3D car crash game where you take the wheel and face a rival driver. Your goal is to steer your car over your opponent and destroy them. Battles take place on risky platforms packed with hazards, including spinning sharp wheels, floors that shift beneath you, cliffs, explosives, and plenty of other dangers. Choose your car before the fight begins.

You can play alone or with a friend in two-player mode. Solo drivers steer with the left and right arrow keys. In two-player mode, the first player uses the arrow keys while the second player uses the A and D keys, so both players can take part at once.
birds-connect-deluxe: Birds Connect Deluxe is a traditional puzzle title where your job is to clear every tile that shows up on the board. Matching tiles can be linked together so both disappear, but a single link is allowed to bend no more than twice. The game includes 15 tough stages. Finish a stage ahead of the clock and you earn a time bonus. Control is handled with a mouse or a touch pad.
winter-dash: Winter Dash is a free arcade game that runs online and suits players of all ages. Your goal is to leap and soar past every obstacle in your path, gather as many gifts as you can, and reach the finish line. It is listed under Boys and tagged for Android and HTML5 play, with Collecting and Avoid among its themes.
Each gift you collect gives you the chance to shop for new characters. Controls are easy: use your mouse or tap the screen to play. Have fun playing.
fairy-princess-adventure: This fashion dress-up title is made for kids and suits anyone who enjoys animated virtual games, though it is especially well matched to girls. Inside the Vlinder Club, everything feels calm and relaxing, so you can take your time. Your job is to find a pinky princess and bring her look to life.

You work as both a hairdresser and a super stylist, shaping her hair and picking the outfits that suit her. Dressing and styling her is the whole focus of the game. Controls are easy: use your mouse, or tap the screen on a touch device.
shortcut-run-3d-online: In this 3D arcade race, the easiest route to the championship is a clever shortcut. You build a fast track from planks that come from your phone, then dash toward the finish line. Shortcuts matter most in this race, so every choice you make on the course counts. It is a fun challenge with a simple idea at its heart.

You play by dragging, which keeps the controls easy to pick up. Steady, smooth movements help your track stay fast and your run stay on course. Each attempt is another chance to climb to the top and prove you are the champion of the race.
street-physics: Street Physics is a basketball puzzle where you sketch a route that guides the ball into the hoop. You pick from spray cans in red, blue, or yellow to draw your path. Once the line looks right, you hit the button that switches on gravity, and if your drawing is correct, the ball drops straight into the basket. The game includes 24 levels to work through.
Controls are simple: a single click or tap is all you need to play. Draw with your chosen color, then tap to start the ball moving and see whether your route holds up.
flaggy-reveal: Flaggy Reveal asks you to cut a path through overgrown grass. Your aim is to clear the lawn and uncover the World Cup 2026 flag hidden underneath. The job sounds simple, but the field is packed with surprises, so you need to keep your eyes open. Dangerous obstacles lie in your way, and one careless move can break your cutter and end your run right away.

You control everything with the mouse, moving the pointer to steer your cutter across the field. Each patch of grass you clear reveals more of the flag, so steady progress matters. Stay alert, plan your route, and avoid the hazards that could stop you in your tracks.
dinosaur-hunting-dino-attack-3d: Step into a lifelike 3D simulation where you take on the role of a dinosaur hunter. The game combines sniper shooting with archery, all wrapped in a hunting theme that will appeal to hunting fans. Dinosaurs appear in many different colors, which adds variety to every encounter.

Controls are easy to pick up. Use W, A, S and D to move around, and hold the left mouse button to fire. The right mouse button lets you aim, while the scroll wheel switches between your weapons. Press Space to jump, Ctrl to crouch, H to put your weapons away, and L to lock the cursor in place.
bus-parking-cityscape-depot: Step behind the wheel of a virtual bus in this single-player 3D driving title. Your job is to steer the vehicle through a range of spots and line it up in each one. The simulation aims for a true-to-life feel of handling a bus, paired with eye-catching visuals and sound that pull you into the action.

Parking challenges get harder as you go. Each scenario asks you to squeeze through narrow gaps, dodge obstacles, and bring the bus to rest inside a marked zone, so careful control and accuracy matter. Use WASD to drive, press C to switch camera views, and hit ESC to open the menu.
real-cars-in-city: Real Cars in City is a 3D car simulator offering several game modes. Its vehicle handling follows realistic physics, and the graphics are detailed throughout. The game includes 20 sports cars, and you can buy and develop vehicles within its purchase and upgrade system.

The world features 36 racetracks, a free ride area, a police chase area, and a crash derby area. You can race against artificial intelligence opponents or simply drive wherever you like. Steer with the arrow keys or WASD, use Shift for nitro, and press C to change the camera view.
christmas-makeup-salon: Father Christmas is nearly here, and the whole town is filled with warmth and cheer. This girls' Christmas makeover game invites you to begin with some makeup before you join the holiday fun. Everyone around you seems busy with their own festive plans, and your aim is to look even more gorgeous than they do. Once you start, you get to choose whether a cute or a glamorous style suits you best. Either way, your look can turn you into a princess or a queen, so the final result is entirely up to you.
The game is controlled with a mouse or by tapping the screen. Pick your style, try something new and different, and enjoy the festival in your own way.
talent-girl-art-classes: Zoe is starting her first day at art college, and she has to choose between two lessons: Fashion Design or Art. Your job is to help her pick the class and then get ready for it. Playing is straightforward, and the layout is easy to navigate. The sharp, high-definition visuals make the experience look lovely, and the game suits both girls and boys.

Everything is controlled with mouse clicks or taps, so you can play with a mouse or on a touchscreen. The game is built to unlock your creativity and imagination, and it gives you a chance to sharpen your skills as you go.
royal-girls-fashion-salon: Princess Irene is standing by at the castle and invites you to spend time with her. This stylish princess game lets you explore a wide range of girly activities. You can apply makeup, style hair, and choose outfits, so your creativity sets the boundaries. Everything is controlled with a mouse click or a tap.

Spend some fun time with Princess Irene and see what you can create. Whether you prefer soft makeup, a new hairstyle, or a fresh dress-up look, the choice is yours. Simply click or tap to get started and enjoy every step with the princess.
ice-fishing: Ice Fishing puts you in a frozen winter setting where your goal is to land the biggest catch you can. Finding a good spot and picking the right bait both matter. Wait patiently before pulling the float, because patience is what usually leads to success. The mood is calm and peaceful, yet the fishing feels lively, and the scenery is lovely to take in.

Lifelike 3D graphics make it feel like a real outing as you hold your rod and fight a big fish on the line. Every fish you catch earns money, which you can spend on new bait and new rods. To reel in a catch, use the large arrows in the upper right and lower right corners of the screen. Keep an eye on the warning in the upper left corner, which shows how tight your fishing line is.
garbage-sanitation-truck: Climb into the cab of a garbage truck in this 3D driving action game. Most people rarely see these trucks up close on a city street, so here you get to live the daily routine of a refuse driver. Head to each dustbin, load up the trash, and then carry it to the refuse processing ground, where you unload it at every level.
Keep an eye on the road, because you must not crash into any other vehicles while you work. Steer with the W, A, S and D keys. Built with HTML5, the game is also set up for mobile play.
tank-battle-tank-war: Build your own gear and vehicles, then head out to hilly battlefields where tough opponents wait. Once a fight ends, you gather loot that can be spent on sharper weapons for your armored machine. New tanks come within reach as you progress, and you decide how to tackle every clash.
Each win pays out a generous stash of gold coins and moves you up the ranks toward the top title of war marshal. Control is simple: click or tap with your mouse or finger to play.
variety-mecha: Set in a futuristic conflict, Variety Mecha puts you in control of powerful robots in the middle of a constant battle. Expect heavy firepower and fast, constant action that rarely lets up from start to finish.

Players who enjoy quick robot combat and shooter gameplay should feel right at home here. On a computer, move with WASD, fire with J, and use K for displacement. On mobile, simply tap the on-screen buttons to operate your robot as the battle unfolds.
magic-knife: Magic Knife is a relaxed game where you hurl a knife and it flies back to you after each throw. Plenty of stick-like arms show up during play, so there is always something to aim at. It is a single-player 3D shooting title with an adventure feel.

Playing is simple. Tap the heads of enemies once, twice, or three times in quick succession so that one throw takes down several of them at the same time. Aim well and clear the whole group with a single toss.
dirt-bike-mad-skills: Dirt bike racing kicks off as riders line up on a variety of stunt courses in Dirt Bike Mad Skills. You guide your machine through valleys, canyons, and risky terrain, pulling off thrilling moments along the way. You can tackle the course alone in single-player mode or bring a friend along for two-player mode.

This version adds more bike types and improved bike features, so you can choose the machine you want before your challenge starts. Player one moves with W, A, S, D or the arrow keys in single-player mode. Player two moves with the arrow keys.
skiing-fred: Fred has headed to the slopes to enjoy winter sports in this racing game, and you help him make the most of every run. Along the way, you can earn extra points by gliding past penguins, meteors, and more. Watch for these chances, since each bonus adds to your score as you speed down the course.

Unlocking new equipment lets Fred ski in different ways, which gives you a reason to keep playing. The biggest goal is to keep Death and the Scythe from catching up with the fearless skier. The game runs on a computer and is controlled with the arrow keys and the spacebar.
stunt-simulator: Stunt Simulator is a driving game in the racing category, where you pull off wild tricks behind the wheel of quick cars. It runs in 3D using WebGL, so you get a fully three-dimensional world to explore while you perform your stunts.

You steer and control your car with the W, A, S, and D keys. Use them to accelerate, brake, and turn as you line up your next jump or flip. The game is built around stunts with cars, and its tags point to 3D games, cars, and stunts as its main themes.
nail-master-3d: In Nail Master 3D, you choose from many kinds of nail polish to paint the most beautiful manicure you can. Complete the challenge tasks by following the in-game instructions to unlock more levels. The game offers plenty of fun settings and rich, simple challenges to try.

The game is not hard to pick up, yet it stays interesting the whole way through. You can compare your results with friends. When you create a look you like, take a photo and share it with your circle of friends to show off your skill. The color pairings are a real highlight.
garten-of-rainbow-monsters: In this action battler, you pick either Jack or Sara as your fighter and face a lineup of troublesome creatures: BanBan, Blue, Captain Fiddes, Cat, Huggy Wuggy, Jumbo Josh, and NabNab. Each clash lets you launch strong strikes and knock out monsters as you move forward through a series of stages.

The journey ends with a final stage, where a tough boss waits for you. Your mission is to protect the garden from the Rainbow Monsters, and the outcome rests entirely with you. To play, just click the mouse or tap the screen.
pixelart: PixelArt lets you draw a cute little picture by clicking to add each part of it. The game works as a clicker, so the image slowly takes shape as you go. Along the way you can build your color matching skills and your accuracy, all without any burden to carry.
It is a chance to step away from your daily routine for a while. The game is built around coloring, so it offers a gentle, creative break and a way to take care of yourself through play.
glamour-beachlife: Summer fashion is all about stylish swimwear, and this dress-up game puts it front and center. You can go for a laid-back, girly casual look or aim to stand out at a glamorous beach party. Mix and match cute swimsuits to build summer outfits that look great from morning to evening. Olivia, the game's fashion expert, offers her helpful advice along the way.
Control is simple: use your mouse on a computer, or tap the screen on a mobile device. It runs in your browser as a single-player game and is tagged for girls, casual play, and holiday themes.
friends-rainbow-survival-race: Survival Race drops you into a fast run through a bright, dreamy world where the fearsome Blue Rainbow Monster rules the course. Its vivid blue shade and remarkable powers make it a serious threat. You must cross rough ground and push past tough obstacles while staying a step ahead of a monster that never stops chasing you. The route winds through a striking setting full of rich colors and quirky landscapes.
Controls are simple, since a single mouse click or tap is all you need to play.
find-the-lost-letter-3d: Something has gone missing under the waves, and your dolphin companion needs help tracking it down. Your job is to bring back the lost letters so every word comes out whole again. Each word is missing one piece. Look at the three letter options on offer and drag the correct one into the empty spot. The game has no pressure and no mistakes, which keeps things relaxed for kids and families alike.
Swim through bright, colorful ocean scenes, spot a variety of sea creatures along the way, and grow your word list one term at a time. Play with a mouse click or by tapping the screen.
crazy-gunner: Crazy Gunner is a deliberately old-school action adventure built around relaxed, retro-style shooting. It brings together the enjoyment of several shooting styles in one package. Its vertical shooting mode is paired with a range of levels, which gives the game more depth and variety from stage to stage.

Expect a fast pace as you fire at many kinds of targets, and the challenge grows the longer you keep playing. The targets include various firearms, slingshots, and many other types of objects. The game moves beyond the single-gun shooters many players have tried before, offering a wider mix of action and a fresh way to play.
mr-dragon: Mr. Dragon is a playful puzzle game in which you take on the role of a dragon fighting off an attack from Vikings. The game is casual and light, and it falls under the shooting category with dragon-themed tags. To play, simply tap the screen.

Your goal is to protect yourself from the Vikings while working through each puzzle. Because the controls are just a single tap, anyone can pick it up quickly and enjoy a few relaxed rounds whenever they have a spare moment.
r-ad-turn: Your job in this game is to direct traffic. You keep vehicles from crashing into each other by controlling a car and timing its turns. The car should only move once the cars heading straight have passed by. Watch the flow closely and choose your moment carefully, because a poor call can cause an accident.

This hypercasual HTML5 game is built around cars and traffic. The idea is simple: read the road and respond with careful timing. Keep your attention on the cars going straight, then wait until they have cleared before you steer your car into its turn. Your aim is to avoid traffic accidents.
queen-rescue-game: Queen Rescue: Dragon Puzzle is a casual puzzle game about saving a queen from danger. Your planning, quick reactions, and sense of timing all shape how things turn out for her. Along the way, you set out on a brave quest to rescue the girl and bring peace back to the kingdom.

Everything is controlled with the mouse, since every button is pressed by clicking. It is a light, easy-to-pick-up title that mixes adventure with puzzle solving, so it suits anyone who enjoys a playful challenge. Pay close attention to your timing, think through each move, and see how the story unfolds.
baby-taylor-at-beach: Summer has arrived, and Baby Taylor's mom and dad have treated her to a seaside vacation. She gets to enjoy the sunshine under a clear sky, stroll across golden sand, and swim in the blue water of the sea. Between activities, she can relax and sip exotic drinks, along with other beach pastimes.

Your job is to help her pack the important accessories and gear she will need for the day. You also look after all of her needs during the trip. Play with a mouse click or a tap, and enjoy spending time with Baby Taylor at the beach.
veteran-sprint: Picture yourself behind the wheel of a massive monster car, speeding along tracks built from platforms. The game shows the road through a first-person camera, so you see the route from the driver's seat. Your goal is to reach the final line before the clock runs out.

Control is simple: use the W, A, S and D keys to move your vehicle. For an extra burst of speed, press Shift to fire the nitro. Keep an eye on the clock, since your time is limited from start to finish.
water-bus-driver-2023: Water Bus Driver 2023 is a racing game that asks you to drive a coach bus in 3D, and this version is noticeably tougher than the last one. To do well in Bus New Games 2022: Urban Coach Bus Simulator, you need to approach each run the way a real bus driver would. The 2022 3D bus driver titles also offer a solid range of add-on content that you can get through the in-game shop.

Steer with the W, A, S, and D keys. On a mobile device, use the button inside the game to control the bus. The game is tagged as a simulation with HTML5 and Android support, so it runs in a browser and on phones.
only-up: Only Up! is an arcade title where your aim is to get past hazards and reach greater heights. It takes inspiration from a popular game, and the core idea is to steer your character through a tall, twisting maze packed with different obstacles. Quick reactions, precise jumps, and nimble climbing are needed, since one bad move can send you crashing into something or tumbling back down.

As you move through the stages, the challenge grows and fresh hurdles appear, including moving platforms and rotating obstacles. The game is presented in 3D. On a PC, use WASD to move, Space to jump, P to pause, and R to restart. On mobile, play in landscape
ice-scream-horror: Ice Scream Horror mixes fantasy, horror, and fun into one spooky adventure, with plenty of action and screams along the way. It is a puzzle game with ghostly, house, and ice themes, so you will need to think your way through each challenge.

Picture an ordinary ice cream van, the kind a child runs to without a second thought. Here, the cheerful seller who recommends his best flavors becomes your enemy, a smiling man who turns into a cruel torturer. The horror has already started, and you are caught in the middle of it. Move with A and D or the arrow keys, and use W, H, or the Up Arrow key for the remaining controls.
racing-cars: Racing Cars lets you build up your own car and then drive it toward the front of the pack. You take on computer-controlled rivals, and your aim is to finish in first place. The game includes 30 levels to work through.
Steering and speed are handled with the arrow keys. Tap them to guide your car around each track as you chase the lead.
parking-car-pro: Parking Car Pro is a three-dimensional puzzle in which you guide a car to a green spot. The challenge is reaching it without colliding with any wall or object in your path. Every level is harder than the one before it, so each new stage asks for sharper focus and steadier moves.
Controls are kept simple: a mouse click or a tap is all it takes to play. If you think your driving skills are good enough to beat it, this title will put them to the test from start to finish.
skygarden-siege: In this relaxed arcade shooter, the living gardens of the sky strike back at the Iron Fleet. You pilot a guardian vessel from the Skygarden, weaving past incoming fire while protecting the floating gardens from a swarm of machines. Gather Light Blossoms to earn upgrades for your ship as the clash between living nature and cold metal grows more intense.

Steering is simple. On touch screens, swipe to move, and with a mouse, just move the pointer. Keyboard players can use W, A, S, D or the arrow keys, and press Space to fire. Each stage must be cleared by destroying every enemy before you can advance.
pop-pop-candies: Pop-Pop Candies is a puzzle game built around sweet, bright treats. Your job is to clear the board by thinking ahead and reacting quickly. Lining up three or more matching candies makes them burst, and you need to remove every candy on screen to win the level. The game offers more than 100 tough puzzles along with marathon endurance stages, so there is plenty to work through. It blends match-three play with shooter-style action.

Be careful, though. If candies sink to the bottom, or the clock runs out before you finish, the round is lost. Finishing a level faster earns you extra stars, so speed is worth aiming for. The mix of challenges should keep you entertained for hours.
nubic-stunt-car-crasher: Destroy building blocks made of cube bricks in this one-player crash racer. Choose one of the 3D stunt cars, take your place on the track, and drive down the ramp. Along the way you can only accelerate. At the bottom of the road, many obstacles will slow you down as you fall, so speed matters a great deal.

The home screen lets you pick your vehicle and upgrade engine power, nitro speed and bonus winnings. Press W or the Up Arrow to move forward, and S or the Down Arrow to brake. Smash large building blocks by breaking through cube obstacles to progress through each section. Along the way you will knock down characters and blocks by overcoming obstacles. The fun characters of the game world make the whole experience more enjoyable.
mud-truck-russian-offroad: This driving simulator puts you behind the wheel of a rugged 4x4 mud truck. Your task is to haul the vehicle up steep slopes, getting past cliff-edge hazards and muddy tracks that twist through the landscape. It runs as a 3D experience in your browser.

The uphill routes are sky-high and made of slender ridges and huge muddy mountains. Expect plenty of daring truck stunts across perilous, winding dirt paths. Drive with W, A, S and D, press Space to brake, and use the camera control to change your view.
bounce-big-online: Bounce Big is a tricky but very entertaining arcade title. You move across a series of obstacles while beating rival players, and you gather items that help you get launched high into the air. It may look silly at first, but the gameplay is hard to put down, and the graphics are rendered in 3D. Enjoying it with friends makes it even more fun to pass along.

Controls are simple: a mouse click or a tap is all you need to play. Keep an eye on the hazards in front of you, grab the pickups you come across, and time your jumps to clear each barrier. Its category is Puzzles, and it is tagged as 3D, Avoid, Funny, Kid, and Obstacle.
they-are-coming-3d-game: You play as a brave fighter who faces waves of foes in this title. Set in a lively three-dimensional landscape, the game draws you in with striking graphics and lifelike audio right from the first moment.

Controls are simple: click the mouse or tap the screen to play. The arcade-style gameplay mixes fighting with avoiding danger and moving across platforms. Its tags list it as 3D, arcade, and kid-friendly, with fighting, avoiding, and platform elements.
forklift-drive-simulator: Step into the seat of a forklift in this driving and parking simulator. Your shifts take you through an airport, a seaport, and the city, where you handle transport jobs. The main job is picking up heavy crates and setting them precisely inside airplanes and large cargo trucks. You can also move pallets around and try some daring stunts.

To finish a delivery, grab each crate carefully and carry it to a dedicated drop-off zone. Control your machine with the W, A, S, and D keys, or use the on-screen buttons to steer and operate the vehicle. Parking a forklift is part of the challenge too.
gun-shot: Gun Shot is a fresh hypercasual title where you take aim at bottles and shoot them with a gun. Its twist on the gun game format has you line up each target, then release the bullet. Built in 3D with HTML5 and WebGL, it is a skill-based shooter that runs right in your browser.

Everything is controlled with the mouse, so that one device handles both aiming and shooting. Success depends on lining up your shots carefully rather than on luck. The goal stays simple: aim at the bottle, fire, and see whether your bullet finds its mark.
frog-leap-3d: Hop into Frog Leap 3D, a single-player 3D obby platformer where you guide a nimble frog across floating islands. Your job is to parkour your way over tricky platforms, dodge deadly traps, and grab shiny coins. Jumps need careful timing, so work out each leap and look for checkpoints along the route. Reach the final platform without tumbling into the void.

The adventure includes 15 levels split across three worlds: The Grove, The Deep Forest, and The Volcano. Your frog moves with precise, agile jumping. On desktop, use W A S D or the arrow keys to move, the spacebar to jump, and the mouse to look around and rotate the camera. On mobile, a virtual joystick on the left side moves your frog, and tapping the jump button on the right side leaps.
angry-chicken: A group of young chicks has been snatched by a monster, and the chicken hero is not happy about it. Angered, the hero heads back to the village, ready to set out on an expedition. The mission is to defeat the monsters and rescue the captured chickens.

Aiming is easy. Press and hold your character, then drag to choose the direction. Let go to launch. This Android arcade puzzle game also carries bird and superhero tags, so it suits anyone who enjoys feathered heroes and clever challenges. Each shot matters, so think carefully before you release.
fashion-girl-friends-reunion: Two stylish friends, Jadeand Adella, are almost ready to finish college. Today they are heading to a lovely spot on campus for a party, and they want to celebrate together. Your job is to pick their outfits, choose shoes and other accessories, and take some attractive photos of the pair.

Everything works with simple mouse clicks or taps, so anyone can jump in. Dressing the girls up is the main activity, and each choice you make changes how they look for the day. Think of it as a styling session that finishes with photos to remember.
zombie-area: Zombie Area is an action game where the number of zombies rises day after day until they start to break into your house. Your goal is to find the exit, and to reach it you must clear out every zombie and stay alive. The game mixes shooting, defense, and escape, all wrapped in a zombie theme.
You play by touching the screen with your mouse. The threat only grows, so every encounter matters. Survive the swarm, clear the house, and head for the way out before the undead overwhelm you.
tiny-archer: Load your arrow, pull back the string, and let it fly in this archery game. Targets keep appearing in front of you with no set limit, so the challenge is seeing how many you can hit. Each attempt sharpens your technique, so a missed shot is just a reason to start again and improve.

Timing decides everything. Release at the right moment to hit the target dead center and move on to the next one. Go further to unlock different skins. Your arrows are limited, and every miss costs you one, so make each shot count. Can you beat your own records? Try to top your previous best.
girl-money-rush: Girl Money Rush lets you choose your path from a varied set of professions. You can push forward in the career you already have or switch to a fresh line of work full of possibilities. Your main aim is to make it through to the end of the day.
Along the way, money bills appear for you to collect. Keep your eyes open and take every chance to build up a fortune. You can play with a mouse click or by tapping.
merge-master-dinosaur-fusion: Merge Master Dinosaur Fusion is a three-dimensional puzzle arcade game about dinosaur armies clashing in battle. Before each fight, you customize your lineup of dinosaurs. Your rival fields the same kinds of dinosaurs as you, but the computer can only attack using a restricted formation. Your goal is to win while spending as few resources as possible.
To play, place your dinosaurs on the field, then tap the start button to send them into the fight.
kids-kitchen-cozy-cooking: Step into a warm, comfortable kitchen in Kids Kitchen Cozy Cooking, a light browser game about making food. You build every meal from the very beginning, so each dish comes together through your own hands. It suits anyone who enjoys cooking, and it is especially appealing to children who want fun and room to be creative.

Playing is simple, since everything is handled by clicking and dragging. The game has a cute look, an educational side, and a hypercasual feel that makes it easy to jump into. Whether you are keen on food or just want a relaxed session of cooking play, this title offers a gentle space to spend some time.
rope-man-run-3d: Picture a stickman built from nothing but ropes and sticks. Rope-Man Run 3D is an arcade runner set on a vertical 3D course, created with the Unity game engine. Your job is to guide a bright, colorful rope-man safely onto the finish platform. As the little figure runs past a colorful wall, its color shifts to match that wall. Dodge the obstacles along the way and push through to the end of the race.
Movement is simple: slide your finger or pointer to steer the character. Keep an eye on the path ahead. Reaching the platform in one piece is the whole goal, so stay focused and keep sliding.
poke-the-buddy: Poke the Buddy is a free online game designed for children. The idea is to poke the buddy until he is destroyed, using a long nose as your tool. You guide that nose with the mouse, or by tapping the screen if you are playing on a touch device.

Along the way, you must avoid obstacles and solve puzzles to move forward. The game is controlled with a mouse, as its instructions note. It makes a light, playful pastime for young players. Its gameplay is simple to pick up, so younger players can jump in quickly.
race-monster-truck: Race Monster Truck lets you drive several off-road monster trucks in a 3D truck simulation. Cash rewards can be spent to unlock the truck you like most, and each one takes you through its own set of monster racing missions. The game also centers on a water slide monster truck race.

You can choose from three racing modes: practice, career, and survival. Each one offers a thrilling way to test your driving. Movement is handled with the WASD keys, so you can steer your truck from the keyboard.
car-jump-game: Car Jump Game puts you behind the wheel of powerful vehicles for a mix of racing and stunt driving. If you enjoy speed, daring action, and tracks that seem almost impossible to finish, this one is built for you. You will launch your car over risky hurdles, push through tough settings, and take on chase missions that keep the pace high from start to finish. It can be played offline, so you can enjoy it anywhere.

pop-it-battle-royal: Pop It! Battle Royal is a competitive take on Pop It!, where the goal is to pop all the bubbles faster than your opponent. Matches last either three rounds or five rounds, and winning them earns you new pop-its and status.

On a computer, press the left mouse button to pop a bubble. On mobile, tap the screen to pop them. Since the race is all about speed, the quicker you pop, the better your chances of finishing before your rival.
flying-robot-transform-car-games: You play as a powerful wolf robot in a sprawling futuristic city filled with enemy machines. Shift into a car, bike, helicopter, jet, or tank whenever the situation calls for it. Your job is to finish missions, take down foes, and stop the city from being wrecked.

Free Mode lets you roam the open world at your own pace, change into different vehicles and robots, collect rewards, practice your abilities, and move freely across the city. On desktop, WASD moves your character while the mouse handles menus and actions, ESC pauses the game, and TAB opens settings. On mobile, a joystick controls movement.
heroes-head-ball: Heroes Head Ball is a sports game where every goal is kicked in with your skull instead of your feet. Each match is a soccer contest played with the head, and the aim is simple: find the net more often than your rival. You can face a friend on the same keyboard or challenge the computer's artificial intelligence. Pick one of ten characters, and the match begins. Whoever scores the greater number of goals takes the win.

Controls depend on the mode you choose. In single player, use the arrow keys along with the Z and X keys. For two player matches, one player uses the WASD keys with the N and M keys, while the other uses the arrow keys with the Num1 and Num2 keys. Touch controls are also available for playing on mobile devices.
subway-surfers-havana: Subway Surfers World Tour: Havana is the fifty-sixth entry in the World Tour series and the sixty-first version of Subway Surfers overall. Listed as a hypercasual title, it is a 3D browser game built with HTML5 and tagged with action and adventure. It follows the familiar style of the series and brings it to Havana.
Getting started is easy, since the controls only ask you to move right or left. Your goal is to keep moving and gather as many coins as you can. The more coins you collect, the better your result.
wolf-simulator-3d: In this adventure simulator, you take on the role of a wolf, an animal known for being very fast and strong. Your time is spent hunting animals and looking after your own family. First you design your own wolf, then head out in search of adventure. Along the way, you can start a family and improve both your wolf and the members of your family.

Finishing different tasks makes your character stronger as you play. The controls are simple: press W, A, S and D to move the wolf, click the mouse to shoot, and tap the space bar to jump. Throughout, the game gives you a close look at life from a wolf's perspective.
baby-panda-up: Meet Baby Panda, a curious little cub who loves to wander through outer space. In this adventure, you guide him through the sky and help him soar past the obstacles in his way. Your task is to keep him moving among the stars.

The game falls under the adventure category and is tagged with action, animal, boy, and casual, and it runs as an HTML5 title. Controls are simple: tap or click the screen to make him fly. Each tap lifts him higher, so you can help him clear whatever lies ahead.
physics-puzzle: Physics Puzzle asks you to crack demanding brain teasers by working with real physics rules. As you move through a range of stages, you will meet objects you can interact with, obstacles that seem to defy gravity, and mechanics that take some thought. Use what you know about physics to shift objects around, set off chain reactions, and come up with inventive answers that unlock the next stage.

The controls are intuitive and rely on simple clicks, so the focus stays on the puzzles. The gameplay is built to hold your attention for long sessions of challenging fun, and it suits puzzle fans of every age. Each level tests how well you understand the laws of physics.
flying-superhero-revenge-grand-city-capt: Take to the skies over a city in the USA in this browser game, where you play a caped hero on rescue jobs and combat missions. It suits anyone who has enjoyed earlier superhero adventures, and it mixes flying, fighting, and crime-fighting in a 3D world. The game is built with HTML5 and WebGL.

Move with W, A, S, and D, jump with Space, and run by holding Shift. Use the mouse to attack, press Q for a second attack, and tap F to fly. Your goal is to become the top survival captain in this new hero battle experience, taking on crime and fighting for the city.
put-out-the-fire: Put Out The Fire is a single-player puzzle game where your job is to carry water to plants that are burning. You use a pickaxe to dig through the ground and steer the water toward the flames. Each challenge asks you to think through the layout, and the levels grow harder as you move along. Mouse clicks handle everything: you click to dig and click to guide the flow.

The game has a stylized look with realistic particle effects in its 2D graphics, and it comes with more than ten levels to work through. Arcade-style sound effects add to the feel as you play. Tags on the page describe it as casual, physics-based, and built for logic lovers who enjoy a relaxed brain teaser.
princess-jigsaw-puzzle-collection: Disney princesses are the stars of this cartoon jigsaw game. They have grown tired of looking at their photos on their phones and want something lovelier: portraits they can hang on a wall or fold up and keep. Your job is to piece together the puzzles that turn into those portraits, so that each princess gets her own.

Take your time and pay attention to every princess as you work through the pieces. Fit each part into its place until the full picture appears. You can control the game with a mouse or by touching the screen, so it also works on mobile devices.
stickman-heroes-fight: Stickman Heroes Fight is a fighting game built around more heroes, more skills, and more battles. You take control of a stick-figure superhero and face off against waves of dark enemies. The game is both fun and entertaining, so each clash keeps things lively. Movement and actions are handled with the arrow keys.

Its style is classic, with a .io feel and a focus on stickman fights. Expect plenty of hard-hitting action as you push back the forces of darkness. Each hero brings different abilities to the fight, so there is always something new to try.
bubble-space: Bubble Space is a puzzle game built on the classic bubble shooter format, and it is simple to pick up. Aim with your mouse, then press the left button to fire a bubble. If your shot hits two or more bubbles of the same color, they pop. Your main job is to defeat every enemy and assist a spaceship that is being held captive. Once you start, it is hard to stop playing.

The game also features four special items. A heart restores your health, a helmet increases your stamina, and a gun raises your attack force. A pair of bubbles increases how many spare bubbles you can hold.
real-gangster-city-crime-vegas-3d-2018: Explore a Vegas city full of gangster crime, where your goal is to become one of its most notable gangsters. Along the way, you can use guns, cars, bikes, planes, trucks, and buses to make your mark on the streets. You play as a crime lord who deals with Vegas gangsters on the way to becoming one of the best criminals in the city.

The controls are easy to learn. Press W, A, S, and D to move, and use the left mouse button to attack. Hold Shift to run, tap Space to jump, and press F to get into a car. Whether you prefer fighting on foot or driving through town, this 3D action game, tagged for driving and fighting, gives you plenty to do in Vegas.
baby-boss-photo-shoot: Baby Boss has a big day ahead, with a photo session tied to an upcoming run for office. Eager to make an impression, the little star wants outfits that really stand out. Options range from a laid-back beach look and a skater style to a relaxed casual outfit, a polished office suit, a hip-hop style, or a mini superhero costume. With so many choices, the player steps in to help decide which look works best.

Try on different dress-up and makeover outfits to find the combination that delivers a stunning appearance. Controls are simple: just use the left mouse button to pick and change items as you go, guiding the baby through each choice until the photo shoot looks just right.
let-s-kill-jeff-the-killer-the-asylum: Explore an abandoned asylum and search it for eight photos of the legendary Jeff the Killer, which serve as proof that he exists. You also need to make it out alive, so you'll combine action, adventure, and shooting as you work through the building.

Move with WASD and sprint by holding Left Shift. Left Ctrl crouches, X drops you prone, and Space jumps. Use F for items and R to reload, while H holsters your weapon and G throws a grenade. The left mouse button fires, the right one aims and blocks, and V performs a melee attack. Press Esc or Tab to pause.
monster-school-beach-party: When classes end and summer vacation begins, the Monster School girls plan beach gatherings with their friends from the underwater kingdom. This single-player dress-up game lets you choose outfits for these seaside parties. You can pick from a range of stylish swimsuits, wraparound beach skirts, sarongs, shoes, and accessories.

Once an outfit is ready, you can complete the look with fresh summer makeup and hairstyles. Soak up the sunshine and ocean breeze alongside the girls as you get them ready. Use a left click of your mouse to browse around the game and help each girl dress in unique, trendy swimwear.
jail-drop-3d: Jail Drop is a physics puzzler where your goal is to guide a small captive safely down to the green ground. He starts out trapped beneath a tall stack of boxes, so you need to plan ahead. Removing any block makes everything balanced on top of it tumble, which means the order you pick changes the outcome.

Your job is to clear away every box except the grass, using ramps and planks to soften the landing while keeping him from getting crushed. If a attempt goes wrong, a single tap restarts the level. There are more than 50 levels, and the challenge ramps up quickly. Controls are simple: click with a mouse or tap the screen.
beads-art-design: Take a break and get creative with Beads Art Design, a bead coloring game that's easy to get hooked on. Whether you have a few minutes on the bus or a lunch break, you can fit in a session. Drop colorful beads onto the board to build a pattern, then pass an iron over them so they melt together into one finished piece. The crafting is simple and doesn't take much effort.

The game also offers soothing ASMR sounds and a satisfying feel as you work. Admire each bead creation you finish, then add it to your collection. You can play anytime and anywhere, and it's easy to spend hours with it. Mouse clicks or taps are all you need to control everything.
commander-assualt-duty-2: Step into the boots of a special forces soldier and take the fight to a militant group of terrorists that keeps spreading, seizing one country after another. You are the one who can halt their advance and win back control so that a free society can survive. You are part of Commander Assault, the elite paramilitary team known as SPEAR.
Move with W, A, S and D, and shoot with the mouse. Press Space to jump and hold Shift to run.
veteran-sprint-fun-and-run-3d-game: Imagine piloting a monster truck along a track raised high above the ground. In this driving game, you steer your heavy vehicle past hazards such as a swinging sledgehammer. Sharp bends along the route call for quick reactions, since a late turn means you have to restart. The game has twenty levels, and each one tests your ability to keep moving while dodging danger.
Your goal is to reach the final area of every level in time. Few people ever get the chance to drive a monster truck, and this game lets you try it. The controls are simple: tap or click to play.
direct-water-puzzle: Direct Water is a puzzle game with plenty of different levels to work through. Your goal is to guide the water into the right cup, so you need to think carefully about each route before you act. It is a single-player game, and it asks you to solve each setup in a smart way.

Controls are simple: left-click with your mouse to draw the path the water will follow. Study each layout, decide where the water should go, and sketch the route that fills the cup. Take your time with each challenge, and enjoy trying out different ideas as you move through the puzzles.
gobble-helping-others-game: Gobble Helping Others is an arcade game that puts you in control of a mouth buried in the ground. Your job is to swallow just about everything you find, with one firm exception: people are off the menu. Roam across the ground and chomp on cacti, rocks, trees, and boxes alike. Each puzzle connects to the one before it, so you will keep running into fresh tricks and new problems to solve.

Every new section brings more interesting challenges, so the goal is to see how far you can get. Remember the key rule: eat no people. Controls are simple, since a mouse click or a tap is all you need to play.
angry-gran-run-paris: Sprint through the streets of Paris as you help an angry granny break out of her asylum. Don't underestimate her, because this elderly lady can run surprisingly fast. Race down narrow alleyways, ducking and diving to avoid obstacles with a French theme.

Valentine's Day brings a fresh batch of characters for you to meet, including some romantic and some funny ones. Check them out as you make your way through the city, and enjoy the lighthearted chaos of the escape. Each one adds its own charm to the hectic chase.
snow-plow-jeep-simulator-3d: When winter sets in, snow keeps falling and covers the whole area, leaving the roads in a hazardous state. Accidents happen on them quite often. In this 3D simulator, you join the municipal service of a small town in a mountainous region, and your job is to clear the snow off the streets.

Driving is handled with the W, A, S and D keys, and the mouse lets you press buttons in the game. This racing title centers on a Jeep that works as a snow plow, so you spend your time moving through snowy roads on the job.
snake-run-run: Remember the classic snake game from the Nokia phone? Snake Run brings that memory back in a brand-new 3D version. It can hold your attention for hours and offers a welcome break from the stress of difficult times. The rules are simple to pick up, but reaching a high score is much harder than it looks.

Step into the world of snake adventure and set off on a journey. Collect stars along the way, then spend your rewards to unlock brighter snake styles and power boosters. To move, just slide left or right.
baby-taylor-cute-pony-care: Teacher Doris leads Taylor and her classmates on a trip to a big farm. Along the way they meet many adorable animals and try their hand at sheep shearing and milking. During a stop by the horses, Taylor spots a wounded pony. Taylor, Jessica, and Tom must work together to treat its injury, which includes surgery. Once the treatment is done, the pony gets a bath and a fresh outfit.
You play by clicking with a mouse or tapping the screen. The game sits in the Girls category and is tagged as an animal, baby, simulation, and surgery title.
number-merge-master: Number Merge Master pits you against a quick-thinking number duel where every choice counts. One wrong move can drain your health, but a clever merge keeps you in the match and pushes your score higher. It's built for puzzle players who enjoy rapid choices and a game they can keep returning to.
Fans of puzzle games will feel at home with its fast pace and endless replay value.
candy-bonbon: Candy Bonbon is a match-3 puzzle game with a sweet theme. Tap candies so that three or more matching ones vanish together, and work toward the mission you have been given. As you play, you can collect boosters and use them to finish your level.
The game features many challenging levels to explore. Controls are simple: just tap the candies you want to crush and see how your moves line up.
happy-moving-car: Happy Moving Car is a touch-based puzzle game. Your task is to help each car drive out of a parking lot safely. Touch a car to guide it toward the exit, and keep it clear of anyone on foot. If a car strikes a pedestrian, you fail. Get every car out without a collision and you win.

On a computer, you touch the car with your mouse. On a phone, you touch the car directly on the screen. The controls work the same way on both, so the only thing to focus on is planning each exit path around the people nearby.
police-car-parking: Take the wheel of a police cruiser as it returns from its everyday shift. Your task is to steer it into the parking spot assigned to police cars. This 3D driving game combines simulator and simulation elements, so it rewards careful, steady control.
The game runs in your web browser thanks to HTML5. Parking is the main challenge, and you need to focus on getting the car exactly where it belongs.
bubbles-shooter-squirrel: This bubble puzzler is easy to pick up and hard to put down, and it suits everyone from young people and middle-aged players to the elderly. Your goal is to aim, shoot, and rescue squirrels along the way. It is a relaxed way to pass spare time.

Tap the spot where you want a bubble to go. Group three or more bubbles together to make them burst. Popping bubbles saves squirrels, and hitting a fireball bubble sets off a pop. Rescue all the little ones on screen to level up, and aim for three stars on every stage. The levels are arranged with care and adjust automatically through built-in AI, so each one stays interesting.
supra-drift-3d: Supra Drift 3D lets you take the wheel of a Toyota Supra, a car famous both from films and for its strong performance. It is a good fit for tuning, racing, and drifting. The game places you in a realistic city where you can drive freely, with no fuel to worry about and no penalties for crashing.

Before heading out, you can choose a paint colour, add a body kit, and swap in new wheels. Tuning options are opened through the Gear icon. Controls use the arrow keys or WASD to drive, Spacebar for the handbrake, G for slow motion, L for lights, and Q, E, and Z for indicators. You can also press R to record your gameplay and P to watch it back.
baby-taylor-gets-organized: Over the weekend, Taylor's household sets aside time for a big tidy-up. This time the focus is on the kitchen and Taylor's own bedroom. You join in alongside Taylor and pick up good cleaning habits along the way. Each room offers a handful of straightforward chores that keep the space neat, so you get a real sense of pulling your weight at home.

Playing is simple, since everything works with a mouse click or a tap. Whether you use a computer or a touchscreen, you can move through the tasks easily. It's a playful way to learn how small jobs help a home stay fresh and organized.
stickboy-hook: Stickboy Hook lets you guide a small stickman through brightly colored courses using a magical rope. Hold to fling your hook toward the next anchor, then let go once you are airborne. Catch the following anchor to keep your speed going. With good timing you can jump over gaps, avoid sharp spikes, glide down slopes, and blast through finish lines.

The game offers three ways to play. Classic brings more than 200 hand-crafted levels that grow harder as you advance. Hook Mode is a pure swinging test where you race the clock. Leaderboard lets you chase the fastest times on each level. On a computer, use the left mouse button or the spacebar. On mobile, press and hold anywhere on the screen.
snow-white-hidden-stars: Snow White Hidden Stars is a point-and-click adventure suited to players of every age. Your task is to locate every star hidden in each scene before the clock hits zero. Each incorrect click costs you 20 seconds of your remaining time. There are 12 levels in total, and if you make it through them all, you are able to send in your final score.

Playing on a computer only requires your mouse. On a phone or tablet, a stylus works best, though a very slim fingertip can also do the job. Keep your eyes sharp and your clicks careful, because every wrong guess eats into your time.
unicorn-slime-designer: Girls, here's a fun fact to share: unicorn kids often write slime as "lime." Slimes are also loved as squishy toys that help people relax, and this girls' game lets you let go of stress while getting a high level of satisfaction. It's a free slime game, and it packs so many benefits into one title that it's hard to believe.
Get ready to step into a squishy magic adventure. Controls are simple: use your mouse or tap the screen to play.
stewardess-beauty-salon: Stewardess Beauty Salon is a fun game aimed at girls, offering eye-catching graphics and a good amount of customization. You will find it listed under the Girls category, with the tags Girl and Kids attached to it.

Getting going is easy, since a single tap starts the action. Between its polished visuals and the many ways you can personalize things, this title offers a cheerful way to pass some time. Whether you are new to the game or returning to it, a tap is all you need to jump back in.
mountain-climb-4x4: Mountain Climb 4x4 is a racing and driving simulation where you steer an off-road vehicle up steep hills while getting past all kinds of obstacles. The game aims for a realistic feel, so every climb asks for careful handling. It is filed under 3D, Action, Adventure, Race, and Racing games.
Everything is controlled with the mouse, so there is no keyboard setup to learn. Use it to guide your 4x4 over the rough terrain and keep it moving toward the top of each hill.
scribble-world-platform-puzzle: Scribble World mixes platform jumping with puzzle solving in a world built entirely from scribbles. You guide a unique scribble character through the stages, working out clever puzzles and collecting keys to open your way forward. The levels become more challenging as you progress.

The controls are simple. Use the left and right arrow keys to move in either direction, and press the spacebar to jump. Those two actions are all you need to handle the puzzles and obstacles of this sketchy, hand-drawn adventure.
element-evolution: Element Evolution is a fun-paced farm simulation with a hypercasual feel. You collect resources by planting a range of crops, and each successful planting opens up new plant varieties to grow. The resources you gather can be spent right away to keep expanding your farm. Your crops also bring in money, which you can use to unlock more land.
The controls are simple: tap to play. The game uses clicker-style gameplay and is built with HTML5, so it runs in the browser. It is also available as an Android version.
magic-adventure-school: Welcome to a school of magic, witchcraft, and wizardry, where your studies revolve around brewing. Set up your own magic shop and spend your days making potions until you become a real witch. Potion making is not easy in games like this, since it calls for deep concentration and a great deal of skill.

The whole game is played with a mouse, so that is all you need to get started. It is a hypercasual adventure with school, magic, and adventure elements woven throughout. Take your time, stay focused, and see how far your potion-making skills can take you.
big-fish-eat-small-fish-2: The sea is full of many kinds of fish, and life down there is hard for all of them. Big fish eat small fish, and small fish eat shrimp. You begin as a tiny fish near the sea floor, dreaming of growing up. Those are the rules of the sea, and they shape every move you make.

Your job is to help your little fish grow through this underwater adventure. Player one moves with the WASD keys, player two has its own movement controls, and player three uses the I, J, K and L keys. Each player can take on the journey with their own fish as it gets bigger.
winter-monster-trucks-race: Winter Monster Trucks Race is a racing game designed to suit players of every age. Your goal is to gather as many coins as you can and use them to upgrade your monster truck. You will also need to clear every level in the game.

Controls are easy to pick up. You can steer with the mouse or with the left and right arrow keys. The game is built with HTML5 and is also available on Android. Its themes cover cars, driving, collecting and monsters, so it should feel familiar to fans of those topics.
drifting-3d-io: Drifting 3D.IO is a multiplayer water racing game where you steer a character across the water and race against friends. You can switch between different characters, and as you move through the levels you unlock new props and attributes that strengthen your abilities. Collect gold coins along the way and climb the friend rankings to show who is the best racer.
To play, swipe across the screen to steer your character. The game is built for groups, so gather your friends and race together on the water.
pattern-puzzle-3d: Pattern Puzzle 3D is a brain-training game that sharpens your ability to notice details, reason through problems, and spot repeating structures. It takes place in a colorful three-dimensional setting filled with puzzles that keep your focus sharp, and it is meant for players of all ages. Each level presents its own challenge, so you need to study the shapes, colors, symbols, and arrangements on screen before choosing the answer that fits.

The early levels are simple and teach you how everything works. As you progress, new puzzle elements appear and the designs grow more complex, so the difficulty rises gradually. Controls are straightforward: use a mouse click or a tap to play.
insect-battle: Step into a sprawling 3D arena as a tiny bug among far larger creatures. You can scoop up items lying on the ground and grow slowly over time, or you can chase down smaller insects and eat them to get bigger. Keep an eye out, though, because the giant bugs roaming the map can devour you if you are not careful.

Move your insect with the arrow keys or with W, A, S and D. Press J to split it, and use U, I or O to work with the props you have gathered. Clicking skills can also split your bug, so experiment to see what suits your style.
the-box: The Box is a single-player arcade game where you drive a cube and try to avoid obstacles along the way. Your score depends on how long you manage to survive, so the longer you keep the box in one piece, the better your result. It is a simple, fun test of skill built around that one idea.
Steering is easy to pick up. Use the Left and Right controls, or press A and D, to move the box from side to side. The game was made with Unity3D and runs in your browser through WebGL.
sponge-on-the-run-coloring-book: Start by picking one of eight pages to color. Along the bottom of the screen you'll find a row of colors, and clicking one selects it. To paint, press and hold the mouse button, then drag the cursor wherever you like across the page. Beneath the page is an eraser for fixing mistakes, and you can also change how wide your coloring point is to suit the detail you need.

This is a one-player coloring and drawing game, and everything is controlled with the mouse alone. It suits anyone who enjoys filling in pictures at their own pace, switching colors and tools as they go. All you need is a mouse and a steady hand to make each page your own.
easter-mahjong-deluxe: Easter Mahjong Deluxe is a holiday-themed puzzle game built around egg-shaped tiles. Your goal is to find two similar egg blocks that both have open sides and tap them to remove them from the board. Keep clearing matching pairs until every tile is gone, and you will win the level. It is a matching challenge where you need to think about which tiles are free to pick.

You can control the game with a mouse or by touch, so it works on a desktop computer as well as on mobile devices. It runs in your browser using HTML5 and is classed as a skill-based mahjong and matching puzzle with an Easter twist.
pocket-battle-royale: Pocket Battle Royale is a 3D shooting game packed with action. Small soldiers take part in big clashes, and you are the one in charge of their moves. Your goal is to steer your army all the way to victory.

The fighting spreads across the land, so you push your forces from one area to the next as the battle unfolds. Between skirmishes, you can also explore the beauty of this mystical world. Everything is built to be enjoyed right from the palm of your hand, so the whole adventure goes wherever you go.
extreme-parking-challenge: Park a car using physics-based controls in this 3D driving game built around precise maneuvers. Each stage presents tricky layouts and a crowd of obstacles, and you must weave through them while tackling a steady run of challenges. Money you earn along the way lets you unlock new vehicles, so your collection grows as you go.

The game offers a broad selection of levels that get harder as you advance, and its gameplay is designed to keep you coming back for more. Steer with WASD or the arrow keys, and use the spacebar to apply the handbrake. Press V to switch between camera angles. Aim to master every stage and see how far your parking skills can take you.
extreme-toy-race: Extreme Toy Race is a high-speed 3D car racer that you can play solo or with a friend. Speed is the main focus, and the game puts your driving skills to the test. You can pick one-player or two-player mode, depending on who is joining you.

If you need a way to pass the time, or you want a head-to-head challenge, this game can keep you busy for hours. Its gameplay is simple but still offers a real challenge, so it suits players of every skill level, whether you game often or are just getting started. Player 1 moves with the arrow keys and respawns with H. Player 2 moves with WASD and respawns with C.
mcparkour-noob-and-noob-baby: Two friends team up in this 3D parkour adventure, where your job is to guide them both to the finish line. Expect tough obstacles along the way, and keep moving with the noob player and the baby noob player without pausing. Lava waits for anyone who slips, and touching it means a restart. The goal is simple: play together and reach the end.

Each player has their own controls. The noob player moves with WASD and jumps with Space, while the baby noob player uses the arrow keys to move and the P key to jump. Mobile controls are also available for those playing on a phone or tablet. The game supports one or two players, so you can tackle the course solo or bring a friend along.
ram-the-yoddha: Released for the Dussehra season, this shooting game retells the story of Lord Ram's victory over Ravana, the demon king. It mixes action with role-playing elements. Ravana keeps hatching his schemes, while Ram works to defeat Lankapati's army.

Demons appear across the screen, and your task is to take them down. Drag to pull back your bow, then release to fire the arrow. Each demon is worth a different number of points. Ram can never be harmed, but your bows are limited, so aim carefully and act quickly, since the clock keeps running. Tougher enemies may call for supernatural weapons, which you can collect as power-ups. Gathering bow power can also earn you extra bows.
eating-simulator-physics-food: Eating Simulator Physics Food is a playful hypercasual game built around goofy physics. It blends relaxing, ASMR-style moments with creative gameplay across several modes. You can feed characters, unwind with some spa care, or merge items together to create something new. Tags like cleaning, crafting, matching, and relaxation hint at the variety waiting inside.

The game is made for players who want stress-free entertainment with a good dose of humor. Its relaxation, silly humor, and physics-based chaos come together in one simulator that stays light from start to finish. Controls couldn't be simpler, since you only need to drag to play and jump straight into the fun.
scribble-world-physics-puzzle: Scribble World: Physics Puzzle is a puzzle game built around physics. Your job is to work with the physics-based elements on screen so that Scribball can find its way out. Along the way, you will look for keys, gather coins, and move through a series of challenging levels.

Controls are simple. Use your mouse cursor or touch the screen to interact with objects. Whether you play on a computer or a phone, every move is made by pointing or tapping, so the game stays easy to pick up.
agent-77: This cartoon-style 3D shooter casts you as an agent with one clear goal: eliminate every target marked on the minimap. Any further mission details will come from your immediate superior, and no questions are asked along the way. Built with Unity3D for WebGL, the game runs right in your browser.

Move with WASD or the arrow keys, and jump with the Space bar. Left mouse click or Z fires your weapon, while right mouse click throws a grenade. Left Shift or C activates Smith Time. The mouse wheel, Q, or E changes weapons, and E or Enter lets you enter a vehicle. Esc or P are also part of the control set.
santa-revenge: In Santa Revenge, you step up to protect your gifts from thieves arriving from every direction. Bombs are also in the mix, so keep your distance from them. Your aim is to get through the entire night and save your presents.

Playing alone, you can take on survival mode. You can also invite friends into two player mode to play together. In single player, move with WASD and shoot with G. In two player mode, movement uses WASD and the arrow keys, while G and P handle firing.
frontline-army-commando-war: Frontline Army Commando War is a 3D shooter built around military combat. Its missions draw on army battles and World War-style conflicts, and you play as a special commando joining a targeted assault. The US Army theme gives the action a distinct setting, and the HTML5 build means it runs right in your browser. It is designed for a single player.

You are part of the last commando squad left on the final battleground, so the fight is down to you and your team. Your controls are W, A, S and D to move, the mouse to shoot, Space to jump, and Shift to run. Each of these keys ties into the action, letting you shift position, dodge, and fire while you push through the battle.
3d-funny-shooter: Step into 3D Funny Shooter, a free online shooter set in a virtual world that feels bright, lively, and always on the move. Every part of the level brings its own challenge, and the action can keep you busy for hours.

Your mission is simple to understand but still engaging. Shoot every crystal scattered across the level, and once they are all gone, the door to the temple swings open so you can enter. Use WASD to move and the mouse to shoot, and aim carefully, since each crystal you hit brings you closer to the temple.
roller-runner-3d: Roller Runner 3D is a 3D hypercasual game for kids. You gather cubes to build cylinders as you move forward. Watch out for obstacles and bridges, since they reduce your rollers. Once every cylinder is gone, you must replay the same level before you can move on to the next one. If you want a higher score, you can also pick up diamonds.
The game is controlled entirely with the mouse. Remember that the more rollers you have, the higher your score will be.
rally-road: Rally Road is a 3D racing game where you build up your car as you go. Boost your top speed, improve your engine, and expand your energy capacity, with the goal of becoming the top racer on the course. It is a single-player arcade title centered on cars.

Controls differ by device. On mobile, swipe left or right to switch lanes, tap and hold to brake, and swipe upward to use nitro. On a computer, use the left and right arrow keys to change lanes, the space bar to brake, and the up arrow to activate nitro.
bike-rush: Bike Rush is a three-dimensional racing game where you pick your favorite car and jump into the competition.
