Drive across the accelerate zones on the track to build up a rush of speed, and steer around obstacles so you can keep going for as long as possible. Every moment you survive adds to your total, so you can see how many points you manage to collect.
Controls are simple: slide across the screen to play. The game has an arcade feel, with 3D visuals and a focus on balance and high score chasing.
tall-man-runner-game: In this 3D running game, you guide a man down the track and work to make him taller and thicker along the way. Pass through the correct gates and you can grow into the tallest man in the game. Be careful, though, because even a slight touch on a hurdle will break your runner.

Your goal is to stretch and widen your character while dodging every obstacle to win. Running as a short man brings a reward and a bonus at the end of the game. Use your mouse to click any button in the game.
burger-bounty-game: Ever wondered what it would be like to manage your own burger restaurant? In this simulation, you take on the role of the owner, and at first you are the only person working there. Over time you expand the place by adding tables, new menu items, and more staff, until it runs smoothly and earns a healthy profit. Keep an eye on your guests, though, because anyone who waits too long will walk out, and you won't be paid for them.

Your character can be upgraded as the business grows, and you can change their look so the restaurant begins to feel like your own. On a computer, move around with the arrow keys or the W, A, S and D keys. On a phone or tablet, simply drag your finger to move.
mahjong-quest: Mahjong Quest is a browser-based take on the traditional Eastern solitaire style, built around Mahjong tiles. Your task is straightforward: remove pairs of matching tiles one pair at a time, and keep going until the board is empty or every special tile has turned up. You can only pick tiles that are open on at least one side, so plan each move with care.
Speed matters here. Quick matches earn you awards and medals, along with tools that offer a helping hand. The game is built with HTML5 and blends board, match 3 and solitaire-style play.
stickman-squid-games: Stickman Squid Games is a new survival title that rewards quick thinking and fast movement. Speed matters most, so push yourself to move as quickly as possible while watching the giant doll, which fires at anything that moves. Challenges include Red Light Green Light, Glass Tiles, Tug of War, Honeycomb, and more. Characters tumble around with funny ragdoll physics that add a silly touch to every round.
This 3D action game is controlled with a joystick. Its gun-based danger comes from that giant doll, so you need to stay alert at all times while you tackle each challenge.
car-parking-order: Car Parking Order! is a puzzle game set in busy parking lots where traffic needs sorting out. Your job is to work out which vehicles should leave first so that the whole lot clears without causing a jam. The game tests your logic, planning, and problem-solving as you move through its levels, each one packed with strategic challenges.

Cars are often trapped in crowded areas, so every move affects what you can do next. Study how the parking layout is arranged, think a few steps ahead, and make smart decisions. As you progress, the puzzles become more complex, asking you to clear vehicles in the correct sequence. You interact with the game by clicking the mouse or tapping the screen.
rail-blazers-runner: Rail Blazers is a free 3D running game where you sprint along monorail and subway tracks spanning up to five lanes. Water racing courses add another layer to the action. Along the way, you will run, surf, race, ride a speed boat, fly, and hover.

Use the arrow keys to move, and press Space to use your board. Bonus rounds add a further twist to the run. The mix of modes keeps every run varied, and the hypercasual design makes it easy to pick up and play.
rich-couple-run: Rich Couple Run is a simple puzzle game aimed at younger players, and it's easy to get hooked on. You guide the pair and work to grow their wealth. The main trick is passing the deck back and forth between the two characters so you collect as much cash as possible. Doors matter too, so use them sensibly. Saving up is necessary because building a home for the couple takes money. Shape their future and see how their lives turn out.
On a computer, click the mouse to move. On a mobile phone, tap the on-screen buttons to move.
kick-the-general: Kick The General is a lighthearted clicker built around letting off steam. Its core idea is simple: you get to kick a military general as a way to relieve stress, making it a playful outlet for frustration.

Along the way, you can buy a large variety of weapons and use them against the general, giving you plenty of ways to vent. Getting started is easy, since you only need to tap to play. The army theme and tap controls suit mobile play nicely.
wrestle-online-sports-game: Wrestle Online is a relaxing arcade wrestling game with 2D cartoon-style animation. Over five rounds, your goal is to get your opponent's head down onto the ground. You can choose a one-player game, a two-player game, or multiplayer mode. You can also customize your character with gold coins.

Every action runs on taps or mouse clicks, so anyone can pick it up quickly. The pace is easygoing, which makes it a calm change from faster action titles, while each round still gives you a clear target to aim for.
car-vs-prado-racing-3d: Car vs Prado Racing 3D is a fast-paced racing simulator for players who love to race hard in Prado cars and enjoy drifting. It features 3D graphics, powerful sports cars, and sound that adds to the intensity. Expect a ride that keeps your adrenaline pumping from start to finish.

Here, you compete against some of the world's fastest racers and push your vehicle to its limits. Control your car with the keyboard arrow keys, which keep the steering and movement simple to manage. Whether you want raw speed or sliding through corners, the game keeps the action moving.
gun-shooting-game: Gun Shooting Game throws you onto a busy battlefield where your aim gets tested in combat missions. You fight enemies as you move through dangerous war zones, and you can rely on powerful weapons along the way. Every battle calls for careful aiming, since the fights are intense and packed with nonstop action. It is listed as a .io game with 3D graphics and a hypercasual feel.

Each mission brings fresh challenges, tense firefights, and a fast pace that can hold your attention for hours. The game suits fans of FPS combat, tactical shooting, and action titles alike. Your goal is to lock onto targets, sharpen your accuracy, and take control of the battlefield. On PC, you aim and fire with the mouse. On mobile, touch screen controls handle both aiming and shooting.
dogy-bubble-shooter: Dogy Bubble Shooter is a puzzle game where you aim and fire bubbles at the cluster on the screen. Join three or more bubbles of the same color and they burst away. It is a classic match-three challenge, and your goal is to match the same balls until the board is cleared.

The game can give both your mind and your fingers a workout. People of many kinds enjoy it, including older adults, children, women, housewives, and girls. Its theme includes candy, fruit, and bombs, which adds some variety to the bubble-popping action.
sniper-trigger: Sniper Trigger casts you as a marksman armed with a sniper rifle, and your mission is to eliminate the enemies you have in your sights. The game is split into multiple levels, and each one presents different targets to hit. That variety keeps every stage feeling fresh as you progress.

All of the action is handled with the mouse, so aiming and firing are both done that way. It is a 3D shooting title made for web browsers, and it gives you a straightforward way to test your accuracy against a range of foes.
run-royale-3d: Run Royale 3D gives the usual foot race a fresh twist. Instead of a plain track, you dash through an obstacle course with a regal, royal theme. You line up against seasoned competitors and try to cross the finish line first. Finishing in the top three is what lets you move on to the next race, so every run matters.

There are 30 levels waiting for you to work through. Controls are simple, since all you need to do is drag to play. The game sits in the arcade category and is tagged for racing, puzzle, and obstacle play, which makes it a good pick for kids and fans of 3D games.
sweet-baby-girl-summer-fun: Sweet Baby Girl Summer Fun is a summer holiday game that both girls and boys can enjoy. You spend the season at the seaside with Sweet Baby Girl and her pals, where every day feels like a beach celebration. The girls have plenty lined up, including caring for animals, tidying up the ocean, cooking, and giving themselves a beauty makeover.

Everything is played with a mouse or by tapping the screen, so it is easy to pick up. The game is filed under Girls and carries tags such as Baby, Cleaning, Cooking, Decorate, Decoration, Fun, Grooming.
euro-truck-sim-heavy-transport: Euro Truck Sim Heavy Transport is a driving game about hauling heavy loads along tricky routes. The roads are crowded with large traffic vehicles, including oil tankers, so every turn calls for care. You need to drive very safely and show your skills at transporting cargo, because the level is failed if even one piece of your loaded freight falls off. The game is set off-road, with you playing as a royal cargo trucker.
Steer with the W, A, S, and D keys or the arrow keys. It sits in the action category and is a driving title built with Unity3D and WebGL, so it runs in your browser.
monster-truck-hill-driving-2d: Monster Truck Hill Driving 2D is a fast racing game that takes you across a series of demanding landscapes. You will climb steep inclines, cross rolling hills, and dodge unpredictable obstacles on your way to some of the wildest courses ever built. You play as a bold, capable driver determined to prove yourself on the harshest ground around.

Pick from a large selection of vehicles, each with its own distinct characteristics, so every race feels fresh. This single-player game runs in HTML5, so it works in a browser and on Android and other mobile devices. Steer with the arrow keys and click the on-screen buttons to interact with the menus, and rely on your skill to get through each track.
monster-rash: Monsters on a retro-style planet have been transformed into blocky cubes, and each one must make its way to the end of the level. In cube form, your character hops over obstacles to keep moving forward. Along the way, gather stars, because you need them to unlock 20 different monster costumes. In certain sections, you can climb aboard a rocket and fly. Getting on the rocket returns whatever costume you are wearing to its original state.
This 2D arcade game is built for one player and spans 5 levels. Click or tap to play and to jump. Mobile controls are also available.
super-water-girl-bath-time: Super Water Girl spends her days guarding the city from harm. After she pulled everyone out of the fire monster's grip, she and her sidekick, Super Seal, were left covered in soot from the blaze. Your job is to get Super Water Girl ready for a calm bath, and once she is clean, to give the adorable Super Seal a soothing spa treatment.

The whole game is played with a mouse click or a tap. Follow the steps on screen, pick what you need, and watch the dust wash away as you go. It is a cozy cleaning and dress-up experience aimed at girls and kids who enjoy caring for animals and characters.
hard-parking-pro: Hard Parking Pro offers a long series of tough parking stages, each with its own theme. Young drivers can take the wheel of a range of crazy cars and face many different road conditions, building real parking experience along the way. It is made with fans of demanding 3D parking challenges in mind, and it also includes classic car play.

This game works like a car driving school simulator, where you learn how to actually drive and park. You can play the free game offline, and every session helps you improve your parking skills. Control your car with the keyboard arrow keys: up, down, left, and right.
pac-maze-alphabet-escape: Pac Maze: Alphabet Escape is an escape game with a playful twist. You control a Pac-Man shaped like a letter of the alphabet, and your goal is to reach the finish line while collecting all the coins and stars along the way. Story mode takes you through dozens of original mazes, where you will run into new obstacles and unique power-ups that add variety to the action.
Controls depend on your device. On a PC, use the W, A, S and D keys or click the mouse to move. On a phone, tap the on-screen buttons to steer your letter through the twisting paths.
let-me-out-escape: Someone has parked in a way that traps your car, and you are in a real hurry to leave. Your goal is to guide your vehicle out of the parking lot by moving the other cars that block its path. Some stages can be solved with simple moves, while others demand careful thinking and a close study of each step before you act. A wrong step may send you back to the start of the level, so every decision matters.
This is a classic-style puzzle game shown in a flat, two-dimensional view. Controls are simple: drag the cars to move them around the lot. Your challenge is to see how many levels you can pass.
boat-viking-war: Step into the harsh world of Viking fighters and aim to become the toughest warrior around. This action-packed battle adventure delivers fierce combat, large-scale clashes, and dangerous foes, all built around surviving the odds. Get your weapons ready, hone your abilities, and battle the way a true Viking hero would.
Controls are simple: click the mouse or tap the screen to play. Expect a steady mix of hard-hitting fights and tense survival moments that keep you on your toes from start to finish.
stick-killer: Stick Killer is a single-player fighting adventure starring a stickman. Your aim is to collect as much money as you can. Getting around is no easy task, since the city is a tight, dangerous passage where pedestrians never have the right of way. The police also open fire with live bullets, so you need to stay alert at every moment.

Searching carefully, you can find a weapon to defend yourself. Finding it takes patience, so do not rush past anything that might help. Keep your eyes open and move with caution if you want to last long enough to earn as much as possible.
bus-mountain-drive: Bus Mountain Drive is a bus simulator game for anyone who enjoys driving simulation games and likes buses. Filed under racing, it is tagged for boys, bus, and driving, so it suits fans of those themes. The game centers on driving a bus through a mountain setting, letting you handle a large vehicle on the road.

All the controls use the keyboard: the arrow keys move the bus, and the Space bar handles the other action. Because the controls are few, you can get started quickly and focus on the drive itself. Whether you came for the buses, the mountain roads, or the driving simulation, this game brings
choose-my-summer-style: Choose My Summer Style is a dress-up game with a bright, sunny theme. You help the girls get ready for their summer holiday. They are counting down the days until the season arrives, looking forward to sun tan lines, longer days, and good times with friends. Their wardrobes need a fresh update, so your job is to pick looks that suit their vacation plans.
Playing is simple. Click or tap on clothing items, accessories,
thumb-fighter-christmas-edition: Thumb Fighter returns in a festive form, the X-Mas Edition, built on the well-loved original. You can take on the challenge alone or invite a friend to join in two-player mode. Each round, you strike at your rival to drain their energy until one side runs out.

It is a quick action title in the hypercasual style, so it is easy to pick up in short bursts. The contest pits a left thumb against a right one, and the winner of each round is whichever thumb outlasts the other.
cool-racing-crazy-stunts: Cool Racing: Crazy Stunts puts you behind the wheel of a 3D race where gravity barely matters. You tackle tracks that seem impossible, perform mind-bending tricks, and push your limits. Precise controls let you fine-tune every move, so the more you practise, the sharper your stunts become.

Your goal is to grow into a top stunt racing champion. Steer with WASD or the arrow keys, and press space to brake and bring your car to a stop. Take on each challenge with a steady hand and see how far your skills can carry you.
fliplines-game: FlipLines is a puzzle game that puts your timing, focus, and reflexes to the test. You draw lines, flip them, and move through levels filled with obstacles and tricky paths. Each level also brings its own gameplay mechanics to work out, so you will need to think on your feet.

The controls feel smooth, and the colorful graphics give every level its look. The puzzle action is designed so that players of all ages can enjoy it. To play, just click with your mouse or tap the screen.
candy-plus-candy: Candy Plus Candy is a puzzle game based on match-three play. You move candies toward other candies that look the same, trying to line up three identical candies in a row. Matching the candies early in the game earns you more score, so quick play is rewarded.

You play with a mouse or touchpad. The game is in the Puzzles category and is tagged with Match 3, Match3, and Matching, so it suits anyone who enjoys sorting colorful pieces into groups. Each match you make brings you closer to a higher score.
easter-match-3: Easter Match 3 is a puzzle game built around painted eggs. Your job is to swap one egg with a neighboring one so that a straight line of three blocks in the same color forms, whether the line runs sideways or up and down. Every move is about lining up matching shades on the board.

To finish a level, you must turn every block on the playing field bright. Think carefully about each swap, since the goal covers the whole board rather than a single corner. You can play with a mouse or by touching the screen, so you can enjoy it on a computer or a touchscreen device.
proton-coach-bus-simulator: In ProTon Coach Bus Simulator, you get behind the wheel of a real coach bus and learn to handle it across different scenarios. Your job is to carry passengers from one city to another, showing them scenic places and landscapes along the way. The game is set on an open world map that you can explore as you drive.
The vehicles and interiors aim to give a realistic feel of the ProTon experience, turning every run into a pleasant journey on a public bus. Steer with the WASD keys and press Space to brake.
princess-house-cleaning: A sweet young princess finds herself helpless, worn out by endless housework. Your task is to pull her out of the chaos and make her home beautiful again. The palace is huge and waiting to be cleared, so there is plenty to tidy. Begin with the living room, where every item must go back in its proper place, because dirt is everywhere. Use the brush and mop to sweep away the spiders and dust.

Everything runs on your mouse. A click or tap starts the game, and the same mouse handles each move. You will also use it to finish all the cooking steps and to decorate a banana split. It is a cleaning, decorating, and design simulation with a princess theme.
car-crusher: Car Crusher is an arcade simulation with three-dimensional graphics and smooth animation. Each level challenges you to flatten every car on the field, and the game takes care of the setup for you. The rewards you collect let you unlock new vehicles, so there is always something fresh to crush.

To play, click and hold anywhere on the screen. The game is made with HTML5 and is designed for mobile devices as well as computers, so you can enjoy it on a phone or tablet. We wish you plenty of fun with it.
offroad-climb-racing: You ride a bike over a rugged off-road course that stretches ahead of you. Your goal is to steer clear of crashes and reach the finish line of every stage. The game is built with Unity3D and runs in the browser through WebGL, and it offers a range of levels with polished visuals.

Steering is handled with the W, A, S and D keys, which control your bike. Stay alert, since any collision can keep you from finishing a level. Expect several levels to test your skill as you race across the course.
rocket-cars-highway-race: Get ready for a fast highway race with Rocket Cars Highway Race. You start by choosing one car from a broad set of options, then begin your racing career on the road. Winning races earns you money, which you can spend on brand-new cars or on upgrades for the features of the car you already own. This 3D arcade racer for one player pushes you to drive dangerously, so every run feels like a bold dare.

Steer with W, A, S, D or the arrow keys. NOS gives your car a burst of speed, F sounds the horn and siren, and G applies the brake. Space and C handle the camera view. Take to the highway, keep your nerve, and see how far your career can carry you.
battle-wheels: Battle Wheels is an explosive arcade brawl where two armored cars crash into each other until one driver loses his head. Win three rounds to take the match, and climb through five leagues: Bronze, Silver, Gold, Diamond, and Obsidian. Every win earns coins that you can spend in the garage on faster cars, tougher wheels, and upgrades to your Damage and Health stats.

Customization goes deep, since you can mix different heads, eyes, mouths, and colors to shape your own fighter. Play solo against 1000 unique AI opponents, or invite a friend for local 2 Player battles, red versus blue, where the final head standing takes the win. Use WASD or the arrow keys to move and balance your car. In 2 Player mode, the second player uses the opposite side's controls. On mobile, tap the on-screen buttons. Smash your opponent's head to win each round. The game is simple to pick up and tough to put down.
death-sentence: Death Sentence puts you in the role of a helper for assassins who need targets removed with precision and without being noticed. Your job is to study the layout of each area, pick the right moment to strike, and avoid detection until the level is complete. The tactical action grows harder as you move through the missions, and each one brings a new challenge that calls for quick reactions and smart strategies.
The game is played with the mouse. Expect a tense atmosphere throughout. Careful timing and patience will help you move forward.
tank-rumble: Tank Rumble is made for fans of tank fights. Its split-screen layout lets two people share one display. You can face a friend head to head, battle the computer on your own, or team up with a friend against CPU opponents. Pick the Free Map or the Maze Map, then choose Survival or Deathmatch as your mode. Along the way, grab power-ups and gun upgrades that give you an edge over your rival, whether that rival is a person or the CPU, and aim to come out on top.
Controls are simple. Player 1 drives with W, A, S and D and fires with G. Player 2 uses the arrow keys to move and the L key to shoot.
kawaii-beauty-salon: Kawaii Beauty Salon with Julie is a lively game for girls that offers a fun experience, with eye-catching graphics and plenty of ways to customize things. Its bright visuals and charming look make it a pleasant place to spend some time. Fans of dress up and fashion will find it especially appealing.

Getting started is easy, since you only need to tap to play. The game is filed under dress up, fashion and girl themes. Whether you are a casual player or a style fan, you can enjoy experimenting with the customization features.
cake-art: Cake Art is a well-liked creative game built around the idea that cake decorating is a form of art. You can build 12 charming, detailed cakes, and it's likely that at least one of them will become your favorite. There's no baking involved. Instead, you brush colorful frosting onto the surface in playful patterns and then top the cake with extra decorations. Your own ideas help shape the sweetest designs you can imagine.控制 is simple: use your mouse or tap the screen.
zombies-night-2: Zombies Night 2 is a first-person shooter and the follow-up to the original Zombies Night. The story takes place during a dark night when the undead pour out and strike the city. Your job is to defend the streets and eliminate every zombie you encounter. You aim and fire with the mouse, press R to reload, and throw a grenade by pressing G. The number keys 1 through 6 let you swap between your weapons.

Expect a blood-soaked atmosphere, since the game is tagged with blood and zombie themes. It runs right in your browser using HTML5, so there is nothing to install before you start. Stay sharp, keep your ammo count in mind, and see how long you can hold the city.
christmas-party-girls-with-julie: Christmas Party Girls with Julie is a cheerful game in the Girls category, where you join Julie for a festive get-together. The game leans into Christmas, dress up, and fashion, so you can focus on style and holiday fun. It has lovely visuals and customization options that let you shape the look of each character.

Getting started is simple, since you only need to tap to play. Everything begins with a tap, which keeps the first steps easy. Whether you enjoy picking outfits or simply like seasonal games, this one suits a relaxed session. Its tags point to
ninja-frog-runner: Ninja Frog Runner is a 2D runner for one player that blends quick action with the nimble moves of a ninja frog. You guide your frog through a colorful world filled with risky obstacles, enemies, and helpful power-ups as you press onward. The game looks striking and keeps the pace high from start to finish.

Movement is simple. Press the left arrow to head backward and the right arrow to move forward. Tap the up arrow to jump, and press up twice in quick succession to perform a double jump. Use these skills to get past obstacles and keep your frog running ahead.
smashy-city-monster-3d: This casual adventure puts you in control of a wild, furious giant beast, something like Godzilla, tearing through a city. Your aim is to wreak havoc: wreck, flatten, slam into, and crush everything you meet, while pestering the townsfolk along the way.

As you cause damage, you collect points and experience, which bring bigger rewards and quicker movement. The streets are packed with hazards to smash, including explosive cars, pixel fences, buckets, block lawns, street lights, fire hydrants, and cube trash bins, plus many more. To begin, just tap the screen.
bball-pro-league: BBall Pro League is a sports game where you can go through a full basketball season followed by the playoffs, with the goal of taking home the championship. If you'd rather jump straight in, you can play one-off matches against the computer or against a friend sharing the same touchscreen device. The game is controlled with a mouse or by touch.

Whether you're chasing the title over a long campaign or just want a quick game, the setup is flexible. Season and playoff play give you a longer path to the top, while single games let you settle things fast. Pick the mode that suits your mood and start shooting hoops.
real-construction-kids-game: Real Construction Kids Game is a well-liked truck adventure that appeals to both boys and girls. Players follow the full journey of putting up a shopping mall, from the very beginning to a finished building. Along the way, you discover what each type of truck is used for on a construction project.

The game is made for kids and runs right in your browser as an HTML5 title. Everything is controlled with a click or tap, so a mouse or a touchscreen works equally well. It is also fun to share, so gather some friends and enjoy it together.
bird-obstacle-flappy: In this arcade title, you guide a bird through an unending stream of obstacles. Each tap makes the bird flap upward, and your job is to steer it through the openings between barriers without hitting anything. The pace is quick, the controls respond smoothly, and the challenge grows as you go, so your timing and concentration are tested the whole time.

Your main goal is to beat your previous best score and stay in the air for as long as you can. The game sits within the 2D adventure, platform and survival categories, and it is built around the familiar flappy style of play. Controls are simple: tap to flap.
blocky-combat-swat-desert-storm-zombie: Blocky Combat SWAT Desert Storm Zombie is an online shooter with plenty of computer game atmosphere, made to be played with friends. Weekly matches and a battle royale format give you a regular reason to jump back in. You can turn the battlefield over, reload your rifle, and enjoy striking visuals, deadly weapons, and fast real-time competition. You can also build your own server and bring your friends into online battle royale sessions.
apocalypse-truck: Apocalypse Truck is a 2D racing game that puts you behind the wheel of a truck in a world full of zombies. Driving is the heart of the fun. The game is listed under Racing, and its tags include Truck, Zombie, and Weapons. It is also made for mobile play.
To move the truck left, press A or the left arrow key. To move it right, press D or the right arrow key. To jump, press W or the up arrow key.
satisfying-slime-simulator: Satisfying Slime Simulator is a calming game that many players enjoy. You get to play with lovely slime right in front of you. Stirring it produces soft sounds that help you unwind. If you prefer, you can start by mixing your own slime and then play with it afterward. A large collection of charming decorations is available for you to pick from. Invite your friends to join in and see who can craft the most beautiful slime.
The game works with a mouse or by tapping the screen, so it is easy to pick up on any device.
animal-transform-race-3d: Animal Transform Race 3D is a 3D arcade race built around quick decisions. Each animal you can become offers a different edge, whether that is raw speed, strong power, nimble agility, or flight. Your job is to spot which form fits the moment and switch to it at any time, since the first racer to reach the finish line takes the win. Keep an eye on your opponent so they don't pull ahead.

A helpful hint: the leopard is the fastest animal on land. To begin, simply tap to play. The puzzle side of the game comes from reading each situation fast and picking the right transformation before your rival does.
dress-up-games-1: Dress Up Games 1 lets you style characters in a trendy way. You can pick from three scenes. In the first, you dress a bride beside a romantic lake. Another lets you outfit a well-known actress standing under the spotlight, and the third takes you to a school prom with a well-liked girl.

You can try each scene in turn to see which one you enjoy most. A large selection of outfits and accessories is ready for you to mix and match. Controls are simple: use your mouse or tap the screen to play.
parking-master-school: Parking Master School puts you behind the wheel in a fun, realistic driving simulation built around getting your car into the right spot. Across a variety of detailed levels, you work on sharpening your parking skills while enjoying the challenge. It is a 3D puzzle-style title that rewards careful, patient maneuvering.
The arrow keys drive your car, and the space bar is used to brake. Take your time with every layout, since smooth, precise control is what turns a rough attempt into a clean park.
volley-random: Volley Random brings back the random game series with a volleyball match that feels unlike any other. Characters flop around with ragdoll physics, and each round can look quite different from the last. The court, the ball, and the players are all open to change, so you have to keep adapting. Your aim stays the same throughout: score points no matter what the conditions turn out to be.
It works for two players sharing one keyboard. Player 1 uses the W key, while Player 2 uses the up arrow key. If you are on a phone or tablet, you can control the action with touch instead.
skirt-running-3d-game: Skirt Running 3D is an arcade game in the Puzzles category, played in three dimensions. Slide across the screen to gather yarn balls. Each one you collect makes your skirt longer, and its color changes as you go, so part of the fun is finding the shade you think looks most beautiful.
The game focuses on running, collecting, and avoiding obstacles, and its tags point to a kid-friendly audience. Controls are simple: use a mouse click or a tap to play.
tinytownracing: TinyTownRacing is a three-dimensional driving game about weaving through heavy traffic without smashing into other vehicles. Use the left and right keys to dodge every obstacle on the road. Gather the gold coins lying around the course to upgrade your ride and dress it up in eye-catching new skins. Your car speeds up the longer you keep driving, so quick reactions are essential. How far can you get before you crash? Can you collect all the skins on offer?
Move left with A or the Left arrow key, and move right with D or the Right arrow key.
monster-hero-rescue-city: Monster Hero Rescue City puts you in charge of a monster superhero whose job is to protect the city from villains. Your mission is to take on the gangsters roaming the streets before time runs out. The game is set in a 3D world, and it mixes battle action with tricky, challenging adventures. You can rely on your monster's special powers along with your own game skills to win each fight.
Controls depend on your device. On a PC, use the WASD keys to move and click the mouse to attack. On a mobile phone, tap the on-screen buttons to get around.
squid-jump-bridge: Picture a deadly bridge where every floor is made of molten rock, so one wrong step can end your run. Each leap starts with choosing which glass pane to jump from. Some panes are genuine glass and others are tempered, and you must work out which is which for yourself. Your luck plays a big part in how far you get. To survive, you need to memorize the pane you are about to leap toward. When you land on a piece of glass, you find out whether it is real or tempered.
You can play with a mouse or by touch on a mobile device.
cut-it-fair: Cut it Fair is a puzzle game centered on slicing fruit with a knife. Each level asks you to cut the fruit according to the glasses you see, so watching them closely is part of the challenge. Your cuts need to be precise, because you must slice accurately to complete a level. The fruit theme and the slicing action make the puzzles easy to follow.

Controls rely entirely on touch. To slice, place your finger on the screen and drag it across the fruit. That motion is the only input you need, so your attention stays on where each cut lands and how exact it is.
game-station: Mr. Robot has set up a brand-new Game Station in the city, and you help him expand it. As the station grows, you can unlock a variety of entertaining games, including Fortnite, Forza Horizon and Mortal Kombat. Earn money to hire waiters who lend a hand, open up new areas, and track down more games. Your long-term goal is to build enough wealth to become a millionaire.

This single-player 3D game is meant to be fun, funny and a little crazy, and it can be played on Android. Steer with a mouse drag on a computer or a finger drag on a touchscreen, or use the WASD or arrow keys on a keyboard.
squid-hook-game: Squid Hook Game is an arcade title where you drag a Squid Game character from the far side of the screen toward you using a rope. Timing matters, since you need to send the rope precisely across to the other side. Points collected at the end of each round can be spent to buy any of five different Squid Game characters.

Beyond the characters, you can also buy dolls, players, and workers to make the action more intense. Your hook is ready for battle, so you can grab it and go head-to-head against other players. The game is controlled with a mouse or touchpad.
rocket-punch-online: Rocket Punch Online is an action game where your punches fly through the air in a way you won't find anywhere else. You smash your opponents to knock them over, and you steer where each fist travels as it goes. Keep an eye on your surroundings, since weapons and objects lying around can help you take out several enemies at once. Break through walls, dig down into the ground, set off bombs, and use whatever works to beat your foes.
The controls are simple: tap and drag to play. It is a 3D game that runs in the browser, and its tags include avoid, bomb, and boy.
airplane-io: Airplane IO is a free online game that suits players of every age. Its rules are easy to grasp: you guide your plane across the map and collect the energy points you pass to become stronger. Watch out for rival planes, though, because hitting an enemy means you lose.

You control the plane with your mouse or by tapping, so it works on both a computer and a touchscreen device. Its arcade feel and collecting focus fit the .IO category well. Soar, gather, and keep clear of trouble to see how far your plane can grow.
darts-501-and-more: Darts 501 and More brings the familiar feel of darts to your browser. You can sit down to a traditional game of 501 darts or take on a 9 dart challenge for a different kind of test. Either way, the game gives you room to sharpen your aim and enjoy a round of darts at your own pace.

Playing alone is only part of the fun. Two players can face off in a head-to-head match against a friend, or you can enter a world tournament and compete against AI opponents. Throwing is easy: use your mouse or swipe with your finger to send each dart toward the board, and let your timing and aim do the rest.
spiral-roll: Spiral Roll is a calm 3D title that works well for passing spare minutes. Once you open it, you land in a fresh, different environment. Your job is to dodge the obstacles that lie along your path, and the aim is to clear as many levels as you can. Clicking or tapping the screen is all it takes to play.
Think of it as a light, easy-going way to spend some time. The game runs in your browser and its pace keeps things relaxed while you steer past each hazard. Keep going to see how far you can get.
ragdoll-escape-endless-fall: Ragdoll Escape: Endless Fall puts you in control of a floppy ragdoll figure tumbling down a vertical city glowing with neon. The drop never ends, so your aim is to stay alive for as long as possible. Along the way you must avoid hazards like sharp red spikes and metal saws that keep moving. The faster you fall, the more your quick reflexes matter as you weave between platforms. Every collision sends your character into chaotic, bouncy physics, so no two falls feel quite the same.

Steer with the Left and Right arrow keys on a PC, or use A and D instead. On a phone or tablet, touch and hold the on-screen left and right buttons to guide the character. Try to beat your high score and see how long you can last.
killer-brothers-shoot: Killer Brothers Shoot is a 2D action game about a gunman whose weapon makes him bounce like a ball every time he fires. Each shot requires care. You lock onto a target and shoot the monsters standing in your way, then move on to the next level.

The game supports two players who take turns, so you and a friend can share the monster hunt, with each player responsible for killing their own monsters. Shooting is also how you jump or move, so every shot matters. To fire, click or tap the screen. You travel in the opposite direction of your shot, and the tilt of the gun guides your movement. Press the switch button to pass control to the other player.
girly-house-cleaning: Step into the shoes of a professional house cleaner in this engaging tidying game. Your job is to sort out several rooms in a house that has become messy and disorganized, and you can also decorate them along the way. The whole experience has a girly look, with cute, bright artwork, upbeat music, and playful animations that keep things moving.

Each room throws its own problems at you. Some have cluttered floors, others have dusty surfaces, and a few feature furniture with stains. To tackle them, you grab brooms, mops, and cleaning sprays, then work until each room sparkles. Everything is controlled with your mouse and keyboard.
mad-bikers: Mad Bikers lets you pull off wild stunts on a motorcycle in Gravity Biker, a game that tests how far your riding skills can go. You steer your biker past obstacles while working through tricky tracks, and you can chain together daring jumps and wheelies. If you would rather take it easy, you can also cruise on your chopper through breathtaking scenery. To play, just tap to race.
tricky-track-3d: Tricky Track 3D is a 3D arcade race with a steeplechase twist. Your ball is the key tool: hit your own target with it and the obstacles on your track become easier to get past. Throw it at a rival's target instead, and their track becomes harder to pass. Stay alert, because you must keep the opponent from getting ahead of you while you race to win.
To play, just drag. Every throw can shift the balance between you and your rival, so think about when to help your own path and when to slow theirs down.
strawberry-shortcake-puppy-care: Caring for a puppy is something this browser game lets you try for yourself. You help Strawberry Shortcake pamper her friends' precious pups by giving them a grooming, playing games with them, and dressing them up. Photo shoots full of berry fun are part of the day too, and you can feed the pups all kinds of careful treats.
Your goal is to keep every pup happy from morning until night. The game is played with a mouse or by tapping the screen.
santa-chase: Santa Chase is a single-player 3D arcade game with a festive New Year theme. Your job is to complete missions across snowy levels full of fun. As you play, your gift train keeps growing, and the aim is to make it as long as you can.
To steer, touch the left or right side of the screen on mobile. On desktop, press the left or right keys instead. It is a car game with a Christmas flavor, so it suits the holiday season.
speedy-ball: Speedy Ball asks you to race against both obstacles and the clock, so quick reactions are a must at every moment. Steer the ball along its path and avoid the gaps in the road. Tiles come in different colors with their own effects: green tiles give you a speed boost, red tiles slow you down, and yellow tiles make the ball jump. The platforms become tougher as you move up through the levels, and your goal is to clear them all.
Play as a single player in this 3D arcade game, which also includes collecting and road-themed challenges. Use the left and right arrow keys to move the ball, and press SPACE to jump.
duo-summerbombs: DUO SummerBombs is a two-player arcade game built around a bomb that gets passed back and forth. If you are holding the bomb when the timer hits zero, you lose the match. Your aim is to hand the bomb off as quickly as possible and avoid being stuck with it until the countdown ends. Each round becomes a fast contest of reflexes, with you and a friend trying to outmaneuver one another.

Players move using either the WASD keys or the Arrow keys. The game runs on both mobile devices and PC, so you can face a friend on whichever device you have. Keep your focus sharp, respond quickly, and work hard to keep the bomb away from your own hands.
green-island-land-of-fire-game: Green Island: Land Of Fire is a relaxed 3D game about becoming a skilled animal trainer. Your job is to collect and catch every egg you can reach, then tame the animals you gather. Each level invites you to explore. Slash the grass, open the bushes, and search out the hidden animal eggs as you go.

Progress depends on winning. You must defeat the boss of each level before you can enter the next island. Battles and fights are part of the journey, so stay alert. Your goal is to grow into the finest animal tamer in the land.
chicken-jump: Chicken Jump is a casual title centered on gravity, where you steer a chicken through each stage. Your job is to avoid obstacles while running and jumping across platforms. Speed is part of the challenge, so move fast and collect the diamonds along the way. The adventure is split into 12 levels to complete.
Everything is handled with mouse or touch control. Keep your eyes forward, stay quick on your feet, and good luck as you work through the levels.
beehive-yourself-2: In this puzzle title, you guide a little bee to her hive by moving your mouse cursor. Watch out, because she could smash into barriers and injure herself. Try to collect stars along the way for a perfect finish.

You can play with either a mouse or a touchscreen, since both controls are supported. A single click or tap is all it takes to begin. The game runs in web browsers and is also available for Android devices, making it a casual pick for both desktop and mobile players.
4-games-for-2-players: Four Games For 2 Players packs four separate arcade experiences into one page, all made for you and a friend to share. Each game offers something different, so every round brings new challenges. In the first, you race your friend and try to survive, since the last player to touch an obstacle wins. The second game is a scoring contest where the top scorer takes the win.

The third game is a tank battle where careful moves and well-timed shots help you blast your friend. Controls are simple. Press W or Up Arrow to jump, use WASD or the arrow keys to move, and press Q or Space to shoot. W or Up Arrow can also be used to shoot in one of the games. Mobile controls are supported too.
jetpack-panda-bao: Jetpack Panda Bao is a sideways-scrolling adventure where you fly a panda wearing a jetpack across the sky toward a boss waiting at the end. Along the way you shoot down enemies and steer around obstacles. Coins you pick up can be spent in a shop on upgrades for your panda.
You can play with a keyboard and mouse or with a touch screen, so you can choose whichever feels more natural to you.
jumper-io: Jumper.io is a 3D arcade game built with HTML5, where you test your skill by leaping over obstacles in your path. Rival players are competing against you, and the goal is to beat them and take the title of winner.
Everything is controlled with the mouse alone, so there is no keyboard to learn. Expect plenty of fun, along with a chance to sharpen your reaction. It belongs to the casual and hypercasual genres.
catch-the-snowflake: Catch The Snowflake is a puzzle game that asks for sharp focus. Tiles covered in snowflakes and Christmas trees fill the board, and your job is to pair them up. Can you rack up a high score before the clock runs out?

To clear a pair, pick two identical tiles. They can only be removed if you can draw an imaginary line between them that bends no more than twice. Work through the grid one match at a time, keeping an eye on the countdown as you go. The game is single-player and has a festive holiday feel with a mahjong-style matching twist.
sky-rolling-balls: Sky Rolling Balls is a 3D arcade game that players of all ages can enjoy. The controls are easy to learn: you hold to keep your ball moving forward. On each level, your goal is to collect every circle. Unlocking more levels means you have to gather a larger number of circles.
Skill plays a big part here, and the game suits kids as well as anyone else. It is a platform title with a sky theme and is made for mobile play. To get your ball rolling, simply hold the screen.
hellcopter-online: Your mission is a rescue inside a tall building that a terrorist group has seized. Armed men are posted on every floor, so you pilot a helicopter that starts on the roof and works its way down, clearing out enemies as it goes. Your ammo is ready, and the assault on the tower is about to begin.

Controls are simple. Tap and drag to move the helicopter, press Space to shoot, and press R to reload. Keep your aim sharp and your ammo in check as you clear each level on the way to the bottom of the building.
let-s-be-cops-3d: You begin as a traffic officer at the start of a police career. An advanced scan lets you check whether each passing vehicle is staying within the speed limit. When a driver goes over that limit, you need to catch them in time, before they get away from you.

Each situation can call for a different response, so you decide whether to hand out a fine or make an arrest. The game is played by tapping and sliding, which keeps the controls simple while you focus on the traffic in front of you and the choices you make as an officer.
lob-master-2021: Lob Master 2021 is a soccer game that puts you right in the middle of the action. Your aim is to send the ball high over the goalkeeper, or to pass to a teammate so he can take the shot. Along the way, you must weave past a large number of defenders and avoid a variety of obstacles.

The game is played with a mouse or by touch. It is listed in the Sports category as an arcade title, with soccer as one of its main tags. Each time you have the ball, you decide whether to lob it over the keeper or make a pass to a teammate.
tank-simulator: Tired of cruising around in a regular car or on a motorbike? Here you take the controls of a tank and roll through busy city streets or across the desert. Both maps feature realistic graphics, and pressing F lets you drive whatever car you like. You can also fire your weapon.

The controls are simple. Use the arrow keys or WASD to drive, and click the left mouse button to shoot. Press C to change the tank's camera view, F to get on or off a vehicle, and K to teleport into the tank. Tab toggles pause whenever you need a break.
line-to-goal-draw-the-path: Line to Goal: Draw The Path is a relaxed soccer puzzler built around sketching routes for the ball. You trace a path and let physics carry the ball into the net. Each stage brings its own hurdles, such as bouncing walls, platforms that move, gusts of wind, slippery ice, and stubborn barriers that block your way.

The controls are simple, but mastering the game takes practice. Every shot tests your timing, precision, and planning. To draw, hold the left mouse button and drag the cursor to create the guiding line. If your plan falls apart, the reset button lets you restart the level at any moment and try a fresh strategy. It works well for quick sessions wherever you happen to be.
hole-upper-for-2-players: Hole Upper For 2 Players is a quick, physics-driven arcade game built for two people sharing one screen. Each player controls a hungry hole that seems to ignore gravity, and both holes compete head to head on the same local split-screen. The goal is to swallow a seemingly never-ending mass of colorful geometric blocks while your hole grows larger every second. Size is everything here, so every move counts. When the timer runs out, the player who has eaten more is the winner.

Player 1 moves with the WASD keys or by dragging on the joystick area of the screen. Player 2 uses the arrow keys or the same drag-to-steer joystick option. Bring a friend, pick your color, and plan your route carefully, because the faster you clear the board, the better your chances of outpacing your rival.
foot-doctor: Step into a busy hospital where you act as the doctor for little patients who arrive at your clinic with clumsy accidents. Your job is to cure every injury they bring in, using a variety of treatments to heal all kinds of wounds. The emergency room setting keeps each visit moving, and there is plenty of entertainment in every treatment you give.

This game is a good starting point if you dream of becoming a surgeon and saving lives one day. You control everything with your mouse, so the whole experience stays simple to pick up. Whether you are new to doctor games or already love them, it offers a playful way to practice caring for patients.
rope-hero: Scale the walls and leap across rooftops as you navigate the city. Swift, agile movement is the core of the game, and you will rely on it to move through the streets. A gang of offenders has appeared and now threatens everyone living there. You take on the role of a defender, using high-level weapons to take down the enemies. Your goal is to become a courageous, fearless hero who can protect the city from these offenders.
Move with W, A, S and D, and use the mouse to act. Press Space to jump and C to crouch.
crazy-moto: Crazy Moto is a stunt racer built on motorcycle physics and balance. You twist the throttle, leap off ramps, and speed through 22 hand-crafted levels filled with loops, explosive barrels, spikes, crumbling platforms, and deadly drops. Beat the clock to earn up to three stars per level, and chain mid-air tricks like front
stickman-crash: Stickman Crash is a light, humorous puzzle game built around ragdoll physics. Your job is to work out which mix of poses and movements will get the stick figure to carry out the task it is given. Thinking creatively is the key, since the right combination is rarely obvious at first, and solving each challenge unlocks silly extras along the way. The whole game is controlled with the mouse, so there is nothing to learn beyond pointing and clicking.

It runs in the browser and falls under the fighting category, with tags for 2D visuals, physics and WebGL. Each attempt plays out with the figure tumbling and bending according to its physics, so small changes to your approach can lead to very different results. Experiment, watch what happens, and adjust until the stickman does what you asked.
draw-car-race: Draw Car Race is a racing game built around one simple idea: draw a line and it becomes a car. Different terrains call for different designs, so you sketch a new vehicle for each kind of ground you need to drive over. The game runs in 3D using HTML5 and can be played online.

Everything is controlled with the mouse, so sketching your cars and driving them both happen in the same place. It is a playful way to test your drawing skills against changing terrain. Expect to try a few different shapes before you find the one that suits each stretch of ground.
c-virus-game-outbreak: A new virus called the C-virus has swept across the earth, and more than 90 percent of the population is now infected. You play as a former marine living with PTSD, and your task is to make your way out and stay alive. This shooting game blends escape and combat, pitting you against zombies while you rely on a variety of weapons to fight back.

The controls are easy to learn. Walk with WASD or the arrow keys, and hold Left Shift to run. Hold Left Ctrl to crouch and tap the Space bar to jump. Use the left mouse button to attack or shoot, and the right mouse button to aim. Press F to interact with objects around you.
space-warrior: Space Warrior is a sideways-scrolling arcade shooter where you fly through outer space toward the boss waiting at the end of each level. Your job is to destroy the enemy ships along the way while steering clear of electrified barriers. Coins you pick up can be spent on upgrades at the shop.
You can control the action with a keyboard and mouse or by tapping on a touch screen. The game suits alien-themed shooter fans who enjoy flying through space and battling their way forward.
resource-empire: Resource Empire is a hooked idle mining tycoon game that begins with one small shaft and expands it into a huge mining operation. You can recruit miners, elevator operators, and warehouse workers, then improve how fast they work, how much they carry, and how much money you make. Managers can be brought on to run each mine automatically, so your business keeps earning while you step away. You extract coal, gold, and diamonds, attract investors to boost your profits, dig further down, and open new layers. Your idle income keeps stacking up as you work toward building the largest mining company ever.

Gameplay is calm and easy to pick up, with dozens of upgrades covering miners, elevators, and warehouses, plus managers who handle your mines for you. To play, tap or click the workers to mine, haul, and ship resources. Tap Upgrade to increase speed and profit, and use Hire Manager to put a mine on autopilot. Controls rely solely on mouse or touch input.
sniper-fantasy-shooting: Sniper Fantasy Shooting is a 3D action game centered on precision shooting from a distance. Your mission follows three steps: intercept, eliminate, and extract. You take on the role of a sniper, so patience and aim matter with every shot you fire.

It is time to engage the enemy, and the game puts you right in the middle of that fight. Best Sniper returns in a more powerful form. All of the controls use the mouse, so you handle everything with a single device. If you enjoy 3D shooting games with a sniper focus, this one is worth a look.
baby-taylor-skiing-dress-up: Taylor is a big fan of skiing. Not long ago she had a memorable day on the slopes, and she hopes to go back soon. In this game, Taylor and her friend Jessica join Taylor's mom on a shopping trip to find new skiing outfits. The goal is for both girls to look lovely and become skilled sports girls.

Your job is to pick the dress-up options you like best and style each girl the way you want. To play, click the mouse or tap the screen. Make your choices and watch the girls get ready for their next winter outing.
playoff-basketball: Your journey starts with a play-in game, and winning it is the only way to earn a spot in the playoffs. From there, the goal is to keep pushing forward until you reach the championship. The road to the top is far from easy, because opponents include sharp-eyed shooters and pesky defenders who crowd you at every turn.
Controls are simple to learn. Aim with your mouse or finger, then click or lift your finger to shoot. Mouse and touch players use the same basic routine.
pregnant-pony-check-up: Pony is expecting, and the time has come for her baby to arrive. You start by calling an ambulance so she can be taken to the hospital. Once there, you help the doctor with the check-up, then support the mom as she looks after her little one.

One year later, the baby pony has grown up and loves beautiful dresses. Your job is to pick some outfits for her. You play by clicking or tapping with the mouse, and every step is done the same simple way, so the whole game stays easy to follow.
k-game-glass-bridge-survival: This third-person arcade jumper features 3D characters based on Squid Game roles. Each level requires you to cross a glass bridge and reach the finish platform so you can move on. The correct track is shown before you start, so you need to memorize it and then jump in the same order.

After you clear a level, the number of squares on the bridge increases, making each crossing a bit longer. Controls are simple: tap the screen to jump. The game is built around memorizing the path and jumping in the right order.
snowfall-racing-championship: Snowfall Racing Championship is a fun, hard-to-put-down racing game. You take the wheel of some of the quickest sports cars ever built, and your aim is to become the champion of Snow Fall Racing. It is an adventure-style race that keeps the energy high from start to finish.

Getting started is simple. Move your car with the WASD keys or the arrow keys, whichever feels more natural to you. Both sets of keys work the same way, so you can pick the one you like best and switch between them whenever you want.
super-saving-football: Super Saving Football is a 2D platform game that combines a love of soccer with running, jumping and sliding. The world of football is under threat, and it is up to you to rescue it from a band of dark creatures. The ball is your main tool. You can use it to knock out enemies, trigger hidden mechanisms, and fire special shots that get you past obstacles that seem impossible to cross.

The controls are simple but offer plenty of depth. Move with the arrow keys, jump with space, dash with Z and shoot with X. Expect precise jumps and slides, along with unique boss battles where dashes and jumps help you dodge attacks. The journey takes you through colorful, varied worlds, including an enchanted stadium. If you enjoy a challenge that tests your timing, this game will keep you busy.
snow-plow-jeep-simulator: Winter brings nonstop snowfall that covers the whole area, and the roads quickly become hazardous. Accidents happen on them quite often. In Snow Plow Jeep Driving, you take on the role of a worker for the municipal service of a small town in a mountainous region. Your job is to keep the roads clear by removing the snow from them.
This 3D car simulator puts you behind the wheel of a Jeep. Drive with the WASD keys, and use the camera controls to adjust your view while you work through the town.
masha-and-the-bear-jigsaw: Masha and the Bear Jigsaw is a free online game built around a cartoon picture. Each puzzle shows a scene from the Masha and the Bear series, which you rebuild by fitting its pieces back together. It will appeal to anyone who enjoys jigsaw puzzles or already loves the show.

Along the way, the game gives your skills a useful workout as you work out where each piece belongs. You control it with your mouse or by tapping the screen. Its mix of familiar characters and a classic puzzle format makes it an easy way to test your focus.
cocktail-run: Cocktail Run is a small pixel-art platform game made for fast, casual arcade play. Your character keeps moving forward while you leap over or slip past spikes and plants that fire at you, aiming to get across the finish line without getting hit. Coins scattered along the route can be spent in the shop on alternative character looks, and you can also pick up a reward each day.

The game runs smoothly on both computers and phones. On PC, use A and D or the Left and Right arrow keys to move, and press Space, W, or the Up arrow to jump. On mobile, tap the on-screen buttons to move and jump.
lifetime-running: Lifetime Running is a parkour game about life. A person's time is limited, and how you choose to spend it shapes the outcome. Start by picking a character, then run through gates that display numbers. The bigger the number on a gate, the more energy you lose passing through it. Your blood bar drops over time, and once it reaches zero, your life ends.

Along the way, gather diamonds and food to keep your strength up and push your way to the top. The game is played with mouse clicks or taps, so you can jump right in using whichever device you have on hand.
dinosaurstorm-io: Dinosaurs have returned in a brand-new age, and you are no longer a frail human but a mighty dinosaur. Fierce rivalry is about to erupt among the creatures. To grow stronger, you can gather humans, tear down buildings, and collect gold coins. Once you are powerful enough, you battle other dinosaurs to come out on top.
2-player-games-princess-design-party: Princess Design Party turns dressing up into a friendly style contest for two players. It blends creative freedom with a bit of rivalry, so every look you build has a chance to stand out. The mood stays light and relaxed, which makes it easy to pick up and enjoy at your own pace.

You can take on the fashion challenge alone or invite a friend to compete. Controls are simple: tap and drag to play. Fans of dress up, fashion, and makeover games will find plenty of room to experiment. It sits in the hypercasual category.
puzzle-cute-puppies: Puzzle Cute Puppies is a collection of puzzles built around little dogs with plenty of charm. The scenes show episodes from their everyday lives, including their love of tasty food, their trips into space, and their fondness for ice cream. Each puzzle sharpens your thinking, and your goal is to collect every picture featuring these funny pups.

Try to finish the game as quickly as you can, because speed is part of the challenge. When you complete it, your result can be saved as a picture certificate. You play with a computer mouse click or a simple tap on a touchscreen, depending on the device you use.
traffic-racer-online: Traffic Racer Online is a car driving game where avoiding collisions is the main challenge. It works as a simulation meant to help you relax. On each track, the distance is limited, and you have to steer to the end line safely, without any crash.
A nitro boost lets your car go faster than its top speed. Use the arrow keys to move your car and
diana-s-city-fashion-beauty: Diana's City Fashion Beauty is a game about looks, where you can dress up, give makeovers, and tackle small mini-challenges all in one place. The action unfolds in a lively simulation, and each decision you take feeds into the score you finish with. You can pick trendy clothing, go all in on complete beauty makeovers, and combine different styles however you like. Try out bold ideas and build looks that suit the city streets.
Play moves across several areas, each offering a different mix of activities, so the experience keeps changing as you go. Controls are simple: tap and drag to play.
happysharks-io: Happy Sharks is a multiplayer game where you take control of a shark. Your aim is to hunt smaller sharks while steering clear of the bigger ones you need to avoid. Gems float through the water, and eating them is how your shark grows. You can also personalize your look by choosing colors and hats.

Movement works with your mouse, so your shark heads wherever you point. To speed up, press the mouse button or the space bar for a boost. Balancing hunting, growing, and boosting away from larger rivals is the core of the experience.
drone-pizza-delivery-simulator: You pilot a drone and take on the role of a pizza delivery rider zooming through a big city. The jobs you tackle are harder than handling everyday road traffic, so each flight calls for focus. Flying around the city is fun, and you need to deliver every order on time.

Your goal is to show the skills of a top pizza drone rider by making sure all orders arrive when they should. This arcade simulator runs on mobile devices and is tagged for avoiding obstacles and driving challenges, with kids among its intended players. To move your drone, use the W, A, S, and D keys.
snowwars-io: SnowWars.io is a multiplayer game built around snowmen and the snowballs they throw. Gathering snow makes your snowman grow, so every handful you collect makes your character bigger. Keep an eye out for power ups as you explore the snowy field, since they can help you along the way.

Your mouse controls your movement, and a click fires a snowball. You can pelt other players with snow whenever you spot a rival in your sights. Whether you are collecting snow or aiming at opponents, the controls are simple enough to pick up in seconds.
robot-car-emergency-rescue-3: Hop behind the wheel of a fleet of robot cars and protect the city in this game made for both boys and girls. Your jobs include putting out a fire, searching for a lost cat, repairing a damaged building, and plenty more tasks along the way. This time the trouble starts at a newly opened port, where a typhoon has arrived and needs your attention.
Expect a cartoon style aimed at kids, with car, cleaning, and fun themes running through the missions. It is built with HTML5, so you can enjoy it on mobile devices as well as deskt
bunny-graduation-double: Two adorable bunnies, one blue and one purple, are trying to get out of a forest. The woods keep turning whiter with snow, so the pair has to leave. Each level ends with a guard, and the bunnies must reach that guard before they can move on to the next stage. This is a 2D adventure with action and arcade elements, and it can be played alone or with a friend in two-player mode.
xtreme-offroad-truck-4x4-demolition-derb: Xtreme Offroad Truck 4x4 Demolition Derby 2020 lets you take the wheel of a 4x4 truck and tackle off-road courses first. knock-rush: Knock Rush is a 3D shooter that puts a lot of weapons in your hands. poopy-smash-driver: Speed through a poopy apocalypse in this driving title set in a desert wasteland.
