icescream-horror-neighborhood: An ice-cream seller has rolled into your neighborhood, and you watched him take your friend Charlie away. Using a strange power, he froze your best friend and drove off with him in his van. Charlie is missing, and you cannot shake the worry that other children may have suffered the same fate.

Rod can hear every move you make, so you have to stay quiet, hide, and trick him into looking the other way. Travel between different scenarios with the van and uncover the secrets it holds. Solve the puzzles along the way to rescue your neighbor.
moving-magnet: Moving Magnet is a logic puzzle where you steer and shove magnetic blocks until each one reaches its marked spot. Magnets can pull blocks together or push them apart, so you need both attraction and repulsion to get past the barriers in your way. Working out the best route ahead of time is the key to clearing each stage.

Each level brings a fresh challenge, and the difficulty rises as you move forward, which gives your reasoning and problem-solving skills a good workout. You play with the mouse alone. The gameplay is simple to pick up, yet the puzzles keep you hooked from start to finish.
match-ten-number-puzzle: Match Ten is a number puzzle that challenges your thinking in a relaxed, enjoyable way. Its rules are easy to pick up, but the strategy underneath goes deeper than it first appears. As you advance, the board grows more complicated, so every number you choose carries weight. Think a few moves ahead and work to keep the grid under control.

Fans of number-based puzzles will find plenty to enjoy here. Controls are simple: tap or drag to play. The game offers a calm yet thoughtful workout for your brain, with each level asking you to plan more carefully than the last.
car-driving-speed-trial: In this single-player racing game, you choose a car and paint it before speeding across the globe. Your goal is to locate and collect a target item, which might be a key or a stack of money, to win. A minimap shows where that item is located on the map.
Steering uses the W, A, S and D keys, and F gives you a nitro boost. Press Tab to open the menu, hold Space to brake, and tap C to switch the camera view.
inca-adventure: A young archaeologist finds a secret map about the Incas and shares it with her adventurer father. Together they head to the area around a mysterious pyramid, hoping to uncover its treasure. The search proves harder than they expected. Across 20 mysterious levels, the father and daughter must cooperate to reach the treasure, and each character starts every level with three health.

Two players control the pair. Player one moves with W, A, S and D, jumps with W, hits with F, throws grenades with G, walks on walls and switches weapons with Q. Player two moves with the arrow keys, jumps with the up arrow, hits with L, walks on walls and switches weapons with U. Collect the valuable objects to complete each level.
batting-kings: Batting Kings puts you in the batter's box for fast baseball matches built around strong, precise hits. Your job is to swing at the right moment, connect with the ball, rack up points, and beat your rivals. Every match asks for quick reflexes and steady control if you want to earn the crown. You play it with the mouse, and the rules are easy to pick up.

The action moves quickly and keeps you focused from the first pitch to the final out. It's a good pick for anyone who enjoys baseball, whether you're new to the sport or already know it well. Timing is what separates a weak swing from a home run, so practice your rhythm and see how far you can go.
celebrity-sundance-film-festival: A famous guest has received an invitation to the Sundance film festival, and this dress-up game puts you in charge of getting them ready. The star is excited to take part, so your job is to help them look their best. Browse the wardrobe to find outfits and costumes that suit the occasion.
Choosing items is done with a left mouse button click. Pick cute pieces for the event, then see how the full look comes together. Lend a hand, enjoy the styling, and have fun along the way.
bullet-stop: Bullet Stop is a casual arcade game built around a simple idea: you can grab a bullet right out of the air. Your new job is to catch an enemy's bullet and use it to take the enemy out. The game has a 3D look and mixes shooting with a bit of puzzle-style thinking, so it works well for kids and anyone who wants light, quick entertainment.

Stay alert, because every incoming shot is a threat. If you miss a catch, an enemy bullet can hit you instead. The controls are handled with one gesture: slice to play. It is an easy game to pick up and enjoy for a few relaxed minutes.
mcqueen-cars-jigsaw-puzzle-collection: Fans of jigsaw puzzles and of the Cars cartoon starring Lightning McQueen should find this browser game right up their street. The puzzles here are built from triangular pieces, which makes them an unusual change of pace and much harder to assemble. Your task is to receive these pieces and decide where each one belongs in the picture.

Points come your way as you play. If you want to take the lead, put the picture together quickly, since the faster you finish, the more points you can rack up. Everything is controlled with the mouse.
pretty-cure-2: The Pretty Cure heroes never seem to have a quiet moment, and their next adventure is already on the horizon. Before they set off, you decide what each of the girls will wear. Every choice you make shapes how the team looks as they head into whatever lies ahead.

You control the game with your mouse. It is listed under the Girls category and tagged with .io and Girl. Browse the options at your own pace and see which outfits you like best for the Pretty Cure team.
stack-rider: Stack Rider is a 3D arcade game where you gather balls while racing toward the finish line. It is a relaxed, casual take on obstacle running, and the runner is a boy. Get around each obstacle in your path, because hitting one costs you a ball. Once you have no balls left, the run is over.

You play by sliding, which is how you steer and get going. Collect as many balls as you can while dodging danger, and keep them with you until you cross the line. Each obstacle you get past keeps your stack growing.
prison-noob-vs-pro: Noob, a beginner, and his expert friend Pro bust out of prison together and set off on a 2D adventure. Both are thrilled to be free, so they start by collecting diamonds, then unlock secret doors and dash toward the elevator. Along the way, they sneak through underground passages until the elevator finally comes into view.

Time is short, because the snow is melting and the water keeps rising, so you must reach the elevator ahead of schedule. Move with WASD or the arrow keys, and use the double jump to gain extra height. Mobile players can use touch controls, and two players can team up. Only Noob can collect diamonds, and only Pro can open doors, so the pair has to work together.
fitness-club-tycoon: You run a fitness business from the ground up in this management simulation. You begin with a modest neighborhood gym and gradually grow it into a top-tier health center. Along the way, you add up-to-date machines, hire coaches who know their craft, and keep members satisfied with plush training areas. Every corner of the facility is yours to oversee.

Your goal is to rise to the position of wealthiest owner in the area. Keep an eye on every aspect of the business as it expands. Controls are simple: a mouse is all you need, since every button is selected with a click.
subway-rabbit: Guide a speedy bunny through a forest at full hopping pace in this adventure game. Jump, duck, and swerve your way along the route as you race onward. Gems you pick up along the way can be used to earn upgrades for your rabbit.

Controls are straightforward: move left or right to dodge, and keep running away to climb toward a higher score. The longer you keep the bunny moving, the higher your score becomes. Fans of animal, jumping, and running action games will find plenty to enjoy in this bunny-themed runner.
christmas-crush: Christmas Crush is a holiday match-3 puzzle game built around bright, festive jewels. Your task is to swipe between neighboring elements so that three or more colorful Christmas pieces line up. Each successful match changes the board, so keep an eye on what appears next.

The game offers a large collection of challenging levels and missions to work through. Rocket and bomb power-ups are available, and you will also find more surprising boosters to help you along the way. Every move is made with a simple swipe, which makes the game easy to pick up. Merry Christmas, and happy puzzling!
dreamy-wedding-rush: This light 3D parkour game mixes fast running with a romantic story. You and your partner dash forward side by side, dodging obstacles while collecting diamonds and wedding dresses scattered across the platform. Each dress you gather helps you put together a bridal look, so your own taste plays a part as you go.

Hurdles appear along the way, and the couple has to face them together while the path keeps leading toward the happy ending. You steer by sliding your finger across the screen. The goal is to carry the girl through to her dream wedding.
slingshot-stunt-driver: Slingshot Stunt Driver is a three-dimensional game that blends a slingshot with a car. Rather than rolling along a road, your vehicle is catapulted outward, and you must bounce it so that it touches the finish line with pinpoint accuracy. If the car sails past the mark or stops short of it, it does not count as crossing the border. Every attempt asks you to judge the shot carefully before you commit.

The game is listed under shooting and carries tags such as obstacle, puzzle, skill, and kids, so expect a mix of aiming and problem-solving. It is a clear test of your skills. The controls are simple: drag to play, and that is all there is to it.
police-car-chase: You take the wheel of a police car in this 3D pursuit racer, chasing down street racers who are desperate to escape. Your driving skills are put to the test as you hunt them across the road. Buckle up, press the gas, and hold on tight, because every chase is wild from start to finish. Your job is to take down runaway racers while avoiding civilian cars and weaving through traffic.

Expect fast criminals, sharp rivals, and partner police cars that you need to outdrive as well. You will have to outsmart opponents and keep your speed up as you smash across the road in this dangerous racing game. Use the keyboard arrow keys to steer and control your car.
johnny-trigger-online: Johnny has sneaked into a criminal hideout, and every man inside is armed. Each one must be taken down with a single shot, or Johnny will be the one who gets killed. Keep an eye on your remaining ammo and make every bullet count, because wasting shots will leave you in trouble.
The controls are simple: tap to shoot. This HTML5 shooter runs right in your browser, so you can jump into the action whenever you like.
3d-forces: 3D Forces puts you on a team and pits you against the opposing side in a 3D shooter built around gun battles. Your job is to take down the enemy squad and come out ahead in every match. Because it is a multiplayer game, you fight alongside real teammates while you hunt down rivals.

Movement uses the W, A, S, and D keys. To aim and shoot, you use the mouse, or you can switch to tap controls if you prefer. Whichever method you pick, the goal stays the same: outgun the other team and win each match.
hand-doctor-game: If you have ever wanted to work as a hand doctor, this browser game lets you try the job. You play a little doctor who puts on a stethoscope and looks the part. Your patients are kids who slipped on ice and hurt their hands. Some are boys and some are girls, and each one needs your care to get better.
The game blends lots of playful fun with a learning experience about treating injured hands. You can play with a mouse or by tapping the screen. It sits in the Girls category, and its
candymatch-io: CandyMatch.io is a puzzle game built around match-three play, where you swap neighboring sweets to line up three matching candies. The gameplay is hard to put down, so a quick round can easily stretch into a longer session. Its candy artwork is polished and colorful, and the 2D visuals keep the board clear and easy to follow.
Progress through multiple levels, and switch between several game modes to keep things fresh. The entire game is played with a mouse, so there is nothing else to learn before you start matching.
match-the-shapes: Match The Shapes is a puzzle game where you pair shapes with the ones moving onto the screen. To do this, you change your current shape by clicking the left or right side of the screen, and PC players can use the arrow keys instead. Each incoming shape has to be matched before it reaches the end of the play area.
The game is played entirely with the mouse, so you only need to point and click. If you hit an incoming shape with the wrong one, the game is over, so keep your attention on every shape that appears.
run-royale-knockout: Get ready for a messy obstacle course where a crowd of racers fights for the top spot in a battle royale. Your mission is to weave through wild hazards and leave every opponent behind. Each attempt puts your skill to the test as you push forward through the chaos.

Control your runner by clicking and dragging the mouse. This is a 3D arcade title that runs right in your browser with HTML5. Whether you claim the win or fall behind, the outcome depends on how well you handle the course.
my-tiny-cute-piano: My Tiny Cute Piano is a lively, colorful game that introduces young children to piano keys. While they play, kids practice recognizing different keys and notes, so learning feels like part of the fun. The game also gives parents a handy way to keep little ones quiet for a while.

Bright graphics, pleasant music themes, and cheerful characters keep the experience entertaining. The gameplay is endless, so there is always more to explore. It suits all kids. To start, just one click or touch is all it takes.
beauty-clinic-spa-salon-full-body-makeov: Step into the role of a clinic owner and run your own beauty spa. A long line of guests is already waiting for a fresh spa experience, so there is plenty to keep you busy. Your job is to leave every customer looking wonderful and feeling pleased with their visit.

This 2D hypercasual game mixes fun with dress-up play and is tagged for girls and kids. Everything is controlled with taps or clicks, so you can jump in right away and focus on making each client happy.
cooking-street: Cooking Street is a free cooking simulation game made for boys. Your job is to prepare gourmet dishes that match what each guest wants. Work quickly, since keeping guests waiting too long will leave them unhappy.

When customers leave satisfied and cheerful, they pay you gold coins. Spend those coins to upgrade your restaurant and grow it into the most famous cooking street around. The game plays on mobile, tablet, and desktop, and you control it with your mouse or by tapping the screen.
learn-drive-karts-sim: Learn Drive Karts Sim is a go-kart mini-adventure that gets you racing straight away. Several small cars are available for the races, so you can choose which one to take out. A number of champions are set to take part in the 2020 Kart Games, and you ride as a passionate driver in a buggy among the kart racers.
The game can be played offline. Along the way, you face several tasks that the kart rider must overcome. Steer with WASD or the arrow keys.
super-monster-santa-helper: Santa needs serious help getting all of his presents ready, so the Super Monsters roll up their sleeves to lend a hand. With a bit of monster magic, they work to get every gift out on time. Your job is to finish the jigsaw, and once the picture is complete, you can see what the monsters get up to at Christmas.

You can play with a mouse or by tapping the screen, so it works on both computers and touch devices. The game is tagged as a jigsaw and matching title for girls and kids, and it's a festive pick for anyone who enjoys holiday puzzles.
miners-adventure: A grandfather and his grandchild set out on an underground trip to dig up valuable gemstones buried beneath the earth. Traps and dangerous animals make it hard to gather any other riches along the way. The pair must solve the puzzles inside by working together, and their goal is to find a way out of the mine tunnels.

This is a two-player game. The first player moves with the WASD keys, shoots with F, uses the whip with G, and uses keys with T. The second player moves with the arrow keys, digs with K, throws grenades with L, and also uses keys with T.
melon-sandbox-online: Melon Sandbox Online is an open experiment where your imagination sets the pace. It is a sandbox simulator in which you can work with changing surroundings, and figures respond with realistic ragdoll physics. A responsive physics system reacts to every move, so each action plays out in its own way.

The game uses charming pixel graphics that give it a playful, nostalgic feel. The core loop is simple: create, destroy, test, and repeat as often as you like. Controls are easy to pick up, since you click and drag to play. Think of it as a place to tinker freely.
office-horror-story: Office Horror Story takes you through an office, its stairwells, and a basement, where you piece together a frightening tale about a killer known as the Mad Killer. The game offers 16 levels, two melee weapons, and a mix of puzzles and hidden objects to track down along the way. Horror fans should find plenty here to enjoy.

Movement uses W, A, S and D, while the mouse lets you look around. Left-click fires your weapon, and right-click aims it. Scroll the mouse wheel to switch between weapons, press G to throw grenades, and press F to pick up items. Hold Left Shift to run, Left Ctrl to crouch, and press X to go prone.
recoil-shooter: Recoil Shooter is a single-player 2D action game where you blast your way through waves of monsters. Clear every monster on a level and you can skip ahead to the next one. Each new stage brings tougher foes, and the game has 15 levels, each with its own mix of enemies and a different difficulty. If a jumping ramp is out of reach, fire toward the ground and let the recoil launch you upward. Gusts of wind can push you off course, so keep an eye on them.
Controls are simple: click or tap to shoot. Every shot pushes you in the opposite direction, so the angle of your gun decides where you go. Everything depends on your aim and timing.
sport-car-hexagon: Sport Car Hexagon puts you behind the wheel of a sports car on a hexagon-shaped course where the edges drop off into empty space. The aim is to be the last driver still on the track, because staying up longer than everyone else is how you claim victory. Race to reach the road ahead of your rivals, keep yourself in the game, and collect points along the way to finish at the top. It is a 3D racing and arcade title with adventure elements, and it is listed for both solo play and multiplayer.
Steer with the arrow keys and use the Space bar for the action button. On mobile devices, the game switches to touch controls instead.
lovely-wedding-date: Welcome to Lovely Wedding Date, a game made for girls. Skyler is full of excitement about her dream day with Collin, and yes, the big event is their wedding. Your job is to help the couple get ready for the occasion and make it a more memorable part of her life.
Step in and have fun with them as you prepare for the celebration. The controls are simple, since everything you do works with a left mouse button click.
cars-guys-multiplayer-racing: Cars Guys - Multiplayer Racing puts you on a course with three stages, racing against 20 other people. On the first track, you need to cross the finish line ahead of everyone else, so you have to beat the whole field. The second stage tests your focus, because the picture shown on screen is misleading. If you follow it by mistake, you fall off the cliff and lose the game. The third track calls for patience, since every step counts and you cannot step on the same spot again.
Clear all three tracks and collect the crowns to win the game. Controls use the arrow keys and the space button, and touch controls are available for mobile play.
color-ring-sorting-match: Color Ring Sorting Match turns the act of stacking rings into a sorting puzzle that rewards careful thinking. Each move you make shapes what comes next, so you'll need to map out your steps to empty the board in an efficient way. The game sits in the puzzle category and has a laid-back feel, with a good mix of enjoyable play and real challenge. Its focus stays on the ring mechanics from start to finish.
Whether you have a few minutes free or want to settle into a longer brain-teasing session, this title fits either style of play. To get going, click and drag to play.
my-pet-vet-hospital: Every animal patient deserves kind and fair care, and in this game you get to help them recover from their injuries. The clinic offers many kinds of pet treatment, so you can practice your medical skills on a variety of patients. Your goal is to grow into the best doctor in town. Along the way you will learn how each medical tool works while enjoying a playful doctor simulator.

The game is controlled with a mouse or by tapping the screen. Pick up tools, treat wounds, and look after your furry and feathered friends with simple clicks or taps. It is a cheerful choice for kids who love animals, caring for pets, and imaginative doctor play.
go-monkey-and-banana: Guide your monkey through a skill-based adventure filled with climbing and leaping past obstacles. Your goal is to gather as many bananas as you can along the way. Time your jumps carefully, grab onto ropes with precision, and steer clear of hazards so your journey keeps going.

Every stage brings a fresh test, as the pace quickens and the challenges grow tougher. The design is simple, yet it is easy to pick up and hard to put down, which makes it a good match for players of all ages who enjoy adventure and item-collecting games. To jump, press Space, the up arrow, or W on your keyboard, or tap the screen.
cycle-extreme: Ride a mountain bike in this downhill racing challenge. Your bicycle rushes down from the mountains on a track that is very steep, so every stretch needs care. Several obstacles lie ahead, and there are deadly holes to avoid along the way.

The game has 20 levels, and in each one you race to finish as fast as you can. Finishing quickly earns you all 3 stars. The controls are simple: Up or W speeds you up, Down or S applies the brake, and Left or A and Right or D lean your bike in either direction.
christmas-monster-lastwagen: It's Christmas Day, and you're driving a cool truck toward the finish line. The course is full of tall platforms and plenty of obstacles in your path. Along the way, you'll climb some wild jump platforms. The green light is on, so the race is ready to start.
The game has a festive holiday theme and features several monster trucks across multiple levels. Press W to accelerate and S to stop. Use A and D to rotate the pitch while you drive.
mini-war-clash-z: Mini War Clash Z is a hypercasual strategy game where each level is a war you need to win. Your goal is to move troops with exactly enough soldiers to take over the enemy base. Before each move, you add up the soldiers in every group so you can wipe out the enemies stationed at different points around your base. Timing matters too, since you decide when to fire on your foes.

The game mixes strategy with action and shooting, so you will need to do some quick math while you plan. Learning to add numbers together helps you reach the enemy commanders. On a computer, use the right mouse button to click and control your soldiers. On mobile devices, tap the screen and the game's UI buttons inst
penguin-io: Life at the North Pole is never dull for penguins. They are always busy searching for food, playing various games, resting, or fighting to survive on a drifting ice floe. Penguin.io turns that last struggle into a browser game, and it is a deadly one. Why the story goes this darker way is hard to pin down, but the idea is clear: whoever survives the match becomes the most popular penguin in the flock.

Penguin.io is a 3D action title in the .IO category, built with HTML5 and WebGL, and it blends avoiding danger with fighting. You control everything with the mouse. Your aim is simple: stay alive on the ice and earn your place at the top of the pack.
biker-street: Biker Street is a racing game where you ride a motorcycle as far as you can go. Keep an eye on your fuel and pick up fuel bonuses to top off the tank. After every run you can upgrade your bike so it handles better the next time out. Coins scattered along the streets are what you use to pay for those upgrades.

Controls are simple. On a keyboard, the up and down arrows move you forward and backward, while the left and right arrows lean the bike in either direction. On a touchscreen, you steer with the on-screen buttons instead.
mini-tennis-3d: Mini Tennis 3D is an arcade tennis game where quick reflexes decide who wins. You jump straight into short, lively matches and send back strong shots to keep the ball moving. The pace picks up as the rally goes on, so each exchange asks more of you.

The game is simple to pick up but takes practice to get good at. Every match tests your timing, accuracy, and focus. Land clean returns, chase higher scores, and work your way toward the top of the Mini Tennis rankings. To play, just click or tap.
tripeaks-solitaire-classic: Tripeaks Solitaire Classic gives you two ways to play: the traditional TriPeaks game and a set of 100 separate Tripeaks puzzles. Your aim is to clear every card off the board. You may select any face-up card on the peaks whose value sits exactly one rank above or one rank below the card showing at the bottom of the open pile.

When no playable card remains, click the closed stack to turn up a fresh open card and continue. Every choice affects what becomes reachable later, so think a few moves ahead. Remember that only neighbouring values, one higher or one lower than the open card, can be picked up.
public-tricycle-rickshaw-driver: Climb onto a public tricycle rickshaw and set off on a long highway drive. The game offers a realistic cycle rickshaw driving experience, with plenty of tough levels to work through. Each stage tests your handling as you travel farther down the road.

Steer your ride with the W, A, S and D keys, and press Esc whenever you want to pause. This 3D simulator sits in the driving category and carries bike and city tags. It is built with HTML5, so it runs in your browser.
paw-care: A brand-new pet hospital has opened, and business is booming every day. You join the medical team and step in to treat small animals, including cats, with their health troubles.

This hypercasual title runs in 3D and offers a realistic simulation designed to let you experience real happiness. Its cute animal characters and doctor role make it a fun pick for Android players. To get started, just tap to play.
babysitter-party-caring-games: Step into the babysitter's shoes and make sure the little ones have a wonderful time. Host a teddy bear picnic and invite their fuzzy friends along. In the bedroom, you can put up a tent and then help the kids get dressed for a show.

When the picnic and performance are done, head to the toy room, where plenty of games are waiting. Everything is played with a simple mouse click or a tap. The game mixes dressing up, decorating, design, and food with some educational fun along the way.
transport-dinos-to-the-dino-zoo: Drive a truck through a jungle in this 3D dino transport simulator, where your cargo is an irritated dinosaur headed for a Jurassic zoo. The trip unfolds in wild beast territory, and the setting is built to feel realistic. Handling the truck is demanding, and furious dinosaurs from around the world surround you as you drive.

Control the truck with the WASD keys. This HTML5 game sits in the racing and simulator categories, with 3D graphics and a driving focus, and it suits players who enjoy truck challenges with a prehistoric twist. Expect a tough drive from start to finish.
mighty-christmas-jigsaw: The Mighty Express welcomes a brand-new train that races through a snowstorm carrying Santa's presents. Its mission is to rescue Christmas for the children of Tracksville. This jigsaw puzzle is built around that cartoon, so anyone curious about the story can join in and try putting the pieces together. It is meant to be a cheerful way to spend some time with the characters.

Playing is simple, since you only need your mouse or a tap on the screen. This Christmas-themed brain game is filed under girls' games and also works on Android. It is made with HTML5, so it runs right in your browser.
police-bus-simulation: Step into the driver's seat of a heavy-duty police bus in Police Bus Simulation, where your mission is to hunt down criminals trying to get away. This fast arcade chaser combines pursuit action with careful vehicle handling. You race through city streets in both daytime and nighttime levels, going after thief cars and ramming them to make the arrest.

Unlike a small police car, this bus is massive, so you need smart positioning and good timing to trap speeding vehicles. Each level, you must catch every escaping vehicle before time runs out. Targets include thief cars, vans, or any suspicious vehicle. Finish all the chases in a level to advance, but expect criminals to drive faster and become more aggressive as you progress.
kitten-hide-and-seek-game: Kitten Hide And Seek is a 3D hide-and-seek game built around avoiding the kittens. You take on the role of a little girl whose main goal is to slip out of the kitten's sight and escape successfully. To do this, you need to hide behind objects in the room, since that is how you keep the cat from spotting you.

Along the way, passing bonuses can be used to decorate your room and make it shine. The game blends sneaking around with tidying up your space, so it stays playful from start to finish. Enjoy the mix of hiding and decorating.
merge-gangster-cars: In this idle game about merging cars, you buy vehicles with a gangster theme and combine two identical ones to create a new, improved car. To earn money, drag your vehicles onto the race track, where each pass over the finish line pays out coins. You control dragging with the left mouse button.

Plenty of car types are waiting to be discovered, and you can find ways to boost the coins you collect. Return every day to reach the most expensive car the game has to offer. Your aim is to keep expanding your collection until you have built a gangster car empire of your own.
realistic-street-fight-apocalypse: Realistic Street Fight Apocalypse drops you into brawls across rough city streets during a climate-driven collapse. Your job is to get through 40 stages, each one filled with opponents who react and strike in different ways. Three bosses wait along the way, and they will test everything you have learned so far.

Move your fighter with W, A, S and D, then press Z or X to throw attacks. Enemies are clever, so mashing buttons will not be enough; timing and positioning matter. Your goal is to survive by using your own skills well against every threat the streets throw at you. This is a single-player experience, so the whole fight is yours to handle alone.
ww2-war-tank-2022: WW2 War Tank 2022 is a shooting game that you can play alone or alongside other people. Across a range of landscapes, you battle Minecraft zombie bots, and you can choose from a wide selection of weapons. Even when you are armed or deep in zombie combat, you still need to destroy the other undead creatures.

In this first-person shooter, objects scattered around the environment give you cover that can improve your chances of survival. Move with the WASD keys, aim and look around with the mouse, and use the shoot control to fire. The Tab key appears in the controls list as "me." It is one of the free online games you can enjoy with a friend.
cat-chef-vs-fruits-2-player: Two brave fruits, a broccoli and an avocado, must slip away from a cooking cat and make it to the fridge. You can team up with a friend in two-player mode, or play alone and guide both fruits yourself. Watch out along the route, because cookie monsters that answer to the cat can gobble you up. Leap over obstacles, clear the cookies out of the way, and keep moving until the refrigerator is in reach.

Broccoli is steered with W, A and D, while the avocado responds to the arrow keys. Both fruits can perform a double jump to gain extra height. Touch controls are supported for mobile devices, so the game can be enjoyed on a phone or tablet too.
vegas-revenge: Vegas Revenge blends gunplay with driving, so you switch between shooting and steering as you go. The game has twenty levels, each with different missions. You must finish them within a set amount of time, and doing so lets you level up.

Move with the WASD keys, press Space to jump, and press Q to roll. Press E or the 1 key to change weapons, hold the right mouse button to aim, and left-click to shoot. Tab toggles pause, so you can stop and start the game whenever you need.
sweet-baby-girl-cleanup-messy-school: Built for girls and boys alike, this cleanup game follows sweet sisters Chloe and Katie and their friend Justin as they tidy up a school in serious need of help. Your task is to get through the observatory, the playground, the bathroom, the classrooms, and the chemistry lab, working through each space until the whole place is clean again.

Every room is a chance to do your best and bring the school back to its shiny, fresh state. Controls are simple: use your mouse or tap the screen to move through the messes. The game runs right in your web browser, so there is nothing extra to set up.
angela-insta-fashion-stories: Angela wants more attention on social media, so she is planning how to win over more followers. Her idea is to post photos and stories tagged with trending hashtags, but she could use a hand from someone with a good eye for style. You get to step in and help her put together an eye-catching post. The game is played with simple left mouse button clicks, so anyone can jump in and start creating.

It's a light, cheerful dress-up and makeover game aimed at girls, built with HTML5 so it runs right in your browser. Tags on the page include Cute, Fashion, and Makeover, which give a good sense of the mood. Pick your styles, enjoy the process, and see how Angela's feed comes together.
bff-candy-fever: The princesses in this game are big candy lovers, and their passion has been shaped largely by the world of Candyland. Eager for something new, they have decided to swap their usual outfits for costumes with a candy theme. Your job is to help them choose the best one from the options on offer.
Everything is handled with simple mouse clicks, so picking up the game is easy. This HTML5 dress-up title is built for girls who en
triple-car-jam: Think of this brain-teaser as a logic puzzle set in a detailed three-dimensional traffic snarl. Your aim is simple: move the vehicles that block your car so it can roll out of the jam. The twist is a color-matching mechanic. When three identical cars sit in a row, they are cleared from the grid, so the game blends a match-three puzzle with a classic rush-hour style sliding challenge.

Tap or click any car with an open lane ahead or behind it, then slide it along its track. The visuals look realistic, and you can rotate the camera to study the layout from different angles. Levels become more tangled as you progress, so each move calls for planning and foresight. You are never handling just one car. You are untangling the whole jam, one move at a time.
gear-race-3d: Gear Race 3D is an arcade racer where a fast launch is only part of the challenge. Your car reaches its top speed only when you shift gears at the right moment, so timing your changes is the key skill. Your goal is to win the game by mastering that rhythm.

Getting started is simple, since a tap is all it takes to play. The game is presented in 3D and includes puzzle elements, and its kid-friendly style makes it a good fit for younger players who enjoy car races. Keep your focus on each shift and let your car pick up speed as you race toward victory.
coin-collector: Catch as many falling coins as you can in this arcade game, and steer clear of the bombs that drop alongside them. Your character glides across the screen, and you can drag or tap the left and right sides to move. Every coin you grab adds to your score, but a single bomb hit costs you a life. Quick reflexes and a sharp eye are the keys to earning a high score.

Lives and a score counter keep track of your progress, and the game ends once your lives run out. Bright cartoon graphics, smooth movement, and sound effects make each round lively, while the animated background adds to the atmosphere. Coin and bomb patterns are random, which keeps replays fresh. The game works on both mobile and desktop, and its quick pace and simple controls make it fun for all ages.
water-connect-puzzle-online: The grounds of this old property need some attention. Nobody has looked after the flowers in the garden for ages, and the water pipes that feed them have become tangled and no longer deliver water properly. Your job is to join the pipes back together so the flowers can finally bloom.
This is a 3D puzzle title with a young boy and pipe-themed challenges. To start, just tap. Sort out the tangled pipework and watch the garden come back to life.
dino-squad-adventure-3: Dino Squad Adventure 3 sends the dinosaurs on a new kind of journey. Rather than staying in one small area, you move through a long stretch of level. Your aim is to reach the exit door by collecting gold and destroying the monsters that get in your way. Some parts of the level cannot be passed alone, so you will need your squad's help and must work together to get through.

This is a two player game. Player one moves with the arrow keys and attacks with K. Player two moves with W, A, S and D and attacks with F. Keep an eye on your partner as you go, since cooperating is the best way to lead the whole squad to the exit.
fashion-tattoo-studio-4: Zoe runs a tattoo shop that is currently offering a temporary discount. During this promotion, she is giving free back tattoos to every customer. Three stylish girls have come in, and each one has a different design in mind. Sofia wants a butterfly, Bella has chosen a rose, and Rebecca would like birds. Your job is to help Zoe sketch these pictures and then apply them as tattoos.
The game is filed under girls and carries tags for coloring, decorating, design, fashion, and simulation. You play with a simple mouse click or tap.
disc-battle-ultimate: Disc Battle is a 3D hyper-casual action game built around a stickman who hurls a disc at rivals. Your aim relies on precise target lines, and each throw can knock out defenders or clear a whole field. You need to dodge opponents, judge your timing well, and get through every level in this test of skill. The game is tagged as a two-player title, and you'll need sharp reflexes to win the round and rack up the points.

On a PC, hold the spacebar to aim and release it to throw the disc. Click and drag with the mouse to bend the target line into position. On touch screens, tap and drag anywhere on the display to aim, then lift your finger to let the disc fly.
rock-beauty-fashion: Rock Beauty Fashion is a fun game for girls, known for its appealing visuals and plenty of ways to customize your look. It sits in the Girls category and is tagged for dress up and fashion, and it's built to be played on mobile devices.

Getting started is simple: you tap the screen to play, so there's no complicated setup to learn. Whether you enjoy dressing up or exploring fashion, this title is fun and lets you make choices your own way.
lumber-run: Lumber Run is a 3D adventure where you chop trees, turn the logs into wooden planks, and dash across a river. Each tree you bring down gets processed into planks that form your path over the water. The farther you advance, the more valuable the trees you can cut. Whoever reaches the finish first takes the level.
Control is simple: slide your finger to steer and hold to run. Keep your pace up, gather enough wood to bridge the gaps, and race your way to the other bank.
squid-marble-game: Guide a marble toward a hole by lining up your shot with care, then let it fly. If the marble misses the hole, your run in the game ends right there. Sink it, and the action moves on to a new plane where you must get the marble into the hole again.

Across 50 separate levels, every stage asks you to take aimed shots. Controls rely on your mouse: swipe to launch the marble. This puzzle title sits in the Puzzles category and is built around precise aiming. Each successful shot carries you further through the game.
baby-dolls-surprise-eggs-opening: Surprise toys are fun to collect, and this game brings that feeling to chocolate eggs. Open them in the style of surprise egg games and see the cute surprise dolls waiting inside. It suits anyone who enjoys the thrill of not knowing what comes next.

The game is filed under Girls and tagged with Baby, Baby Hazel, and Kids, so it is aimed at fans of dolls and cute characters. You play it entirely with a mouse, which keeps the controls simple. It is a playful pick for anyone who loves unboxing surprises.
mikas-candy-adventure: Mika's Candy Adventure is a relaxed puzzle game with a sweet 3D look. Your job is to slide cupcakes across the board until each one sits on its proper spot. Once every cupcake is in place, the next level opens up. If a move goes wrong, the undo power-up lets you take it back, so you can think things over and try again. Help Mika rescue her cupcakes one puzzle at a time.
The controls are simple. Use WASD or the arrow keys to move, scroll the mouse wheel to zoom in and out, and make a double swipe when playing on a touch device.
xtreme-speed-stunts-bmx-gm: Xtreme Speed Stunts BMX GM puts you in the seat of a BMX rider who performs tricks on a Moto motorbike. Your goal is to race around every track in the game. The main character is a stick man who loves motorsport, so he spends his time riding over dirt and tar on his motorcycle. Expect plenty of action as you pedal and ride your way toward Bike Heaven.

The courses are narrow and climb up hills and mountains. The zigzag roads are the trickiest part, since mastering bike stunts there means slowing down and riding with accuracy. Drive your bike with the W, A, S and D keys.
cowboys-vs-robots: In this shooting game, a cowboy defends himself with his pistol against a sudden invasion of robots. You take command of a heavily armed gunslinger who stands his ground against the metal horde. Each level is tougher than the one before, so your quick reflexes are put to the test as you progress.

The cowboy hides behind a bar that is secretly stocked with a wide range of weapons, giving you plenty of options at hand. Your job is to shoot down as many walking machines as you can. Destroy your enemies and aim for the best score to collect every star.
friday-night-funkin-match3: Dream of becoming a cool street musician who rocks everyone around? This rhythm arcade game is part of the Friday Night Funkin collection, and it has captivated hundreds of thousands of players across the globe. You could join that fan army right now.
Your goal is to gather chains of figures, three or more at a time, to clear the field. Control everything with your mouse or by tapping the screen.
dr-octopus-darkling: Dr Octopus Darkling is a single-player arcade adventure presented in 2D. Your goal is to help the doctor octopus escape from a forest of darkness. Everything around him is shrouded in shadow, yet with your help he has a real chance of getting through. Be careful, because poison water is spread across the whole area.
Movement uses the WASD keys, and a double jump is available to help you reach higher ground. The game blends action and adventure elements into its single-player, 2D setting.
brain-train-railway-puzzle: Tired of the usual puzzles built from blocks or balls? This one takes a different route. Your job is to set railway switches so every train arrives on time and on the correct track. It may sound easy, but it asks more of you than it first appears.

Clearing levels is fairly manageable, but mastering each one takes plenty of patience and focus. The levels adjust to your skill, so the challenge keeps pace as you improve. Controls are simple: a single click of the mouse button is all you need.
burger-mania: Stack up a juicy burger in this restaurant-themed cooking title. Your job is to serve meals that please the people waiting at your counter, and those guests tend to arrive with demanding tastes. Every topping you add makes the tower taller, so the challenge is to keep layering without letting the whole creation tumble apart.

Play is simple: a single left mouse click is all you need to place each ingredient. Pile on as many layers as you can manage before the stack gives way and crashes down. It is a casual pick in the Girls category, and it suits anyone who enjoys cooking games with a playful, light feel. The messy fun of building towering burgers is the whole point.
monster-popsy-dolls: Monster Popsy Dolls lets you dress up toys that are both beautiful and a little terrible. Pick from many hairstyles and outfits to build a doll that is entirely your own. You can also take on the role of a makeup artist, choosing the right cosmetics for your popsy.

Mix and match dresses, tops, leather jackets, boots, and playful jewelry until the look feels just right. Everything is controlled with the left mouse button or by touch, so you can begin styling right away.
steal-a-fish: Steal A Fish drops you into an underwater world where stealth and chaos collide. This fast-moving adventure with action is built as a simulator, and your job is to slip through the deep sea, grab valuable fish, and get away before danger strikes. The further down you venture, the higher the risk, but the bigger the reward.

Controls are simple. On a PC, use W, A, S, and D to move, and press F to catch a fish. On mobile, tap the on-screen button to operate. Fans of fish-themed simulation games will find a mix of careful sneaking and sudden pandemonium waiting beneath the waves.
topdown-zombie-survival-shooting: This is a top-down shooter that also belongs to the demon slayer style of games. You play as a monster hunter in a small world hit by an outbreak, and horde assault mode is available right from the start. Your job is to wipe out every zombie, survive each horde attack, and hold off each horde defense entirely on your own, like a lone wolf.

Vampires, mummies, and any other creatures blocking your path are targets too. Stay sharp, because zombies and monsters appear everywhere, and every single one has to go down. Walk with WASD, aim and shoot with the mouse, and press Tab to open the menu.
mister-bullet: Mister Bullet blends target practice with brainy puzzle solving. You take on the role of a skilled secret agent whose job is to take out enemies one by one. Precise aim matters, but so does working out how to get your shot to land where it needs to go, since clever thinking is just as important as a steady hand.

The game offers many challenging missions, and its physics make the whole experience enjoyable. Bullets and objects react to the world around them, so you'll need to think about angles and outcomes before you fire. On phones and tablets you aim and shoot with touch controls, while on a computer the mouse handles everything.
gain-tom-coin-run: Tom is eager to dash wherever he can in order to stuff his pockets with gold coins. You join him on this adventure, but watch out, because the paths that lead to the gold are risky. Cars, buses, blocks and other hazards line the streets, so you need to guide him along the road without crashing into anything or getting caught.

Coins you pick up can be used in the shop to buy a vehicle that lets you zoom ahead even faster. It's a fast, hooked-on runner with plenty of tricky moments, so keep your eyes open and enjoy the chase.
easter-nails-design-prep-for-festival-fu: Sofia's fashion nail salon is getting ready for Easter, and the shop has become overcrowded. Every customer wants beautiful nail art with an Easter theme, so the day is busy. You are invited to act as Sofia's assistant and help her create nail art for the customers.

This hypercasual makeover game is made for kids and girls who enjoy makeover games. Everything is controlled by tapping or clicking, so the controls are simple to pick up. The fun comes from helping the salon keep up with the Easter rush.
bombers-io: Bombers.IO is a battle arena game where your only weapon is a ranged one, and you have to use it to take down every opponent. Landing a confirmed kill takes precise, predictive shots, so you need to think ahead about where a target is heading. Successful kills help you unlock more powerful weapons, which adds a sense of progress to each match.
Controls are simple. Use the mouse to aim and shoot, and use the keyboard keys to move around the arena. Timing plays a role in every shot you take.
kinder-egg-surprise: Kinder Egg Surprise is a browser game that people of any age can enjoy, though it is especially aimed at children. Your job is to peel off the wrapper of a kinder egg by clicking on it. Once the wrapping is gone, you bite into the chocolate, then pull open the yellow capsule inside to find a toy. The game hopes every egg brings a different prize, so each round may reveal something new.

Play with a mouse or by tapping the screen, whichever suits your device. It sits in the Puzzles category and is also tagged for Android, Arcade, Collecting, Funny, HTML5, and for both boys and girls. Each egg holds its own surprise waiting inside.
partytoons: PartyToons is a party game for four-player matches, whether you bring along friends or team up with people you have never met. Each mini-game follows its own rules and has its own style. You might gather strawberries while rocks tumble down, hop across conveyor belts packed with obstacles, pop balloons that could burst at any moment, or open mysterious boxes, along with many other challenges. Winning means acting quicker or wiser than your opponents so you collect the most points.

Points and trophies can be spent on upgrading your character and unlocking new playable ones. Each player has their own set of action keys: Player 1 uses the arrow keys, Player 2 uses WASD, Player 3 uses 8456, and Player 4 uses UHJK.
subway-surfers-buenos-aires: Subway Surfers heads to Buenos Aires in this stop on its World Tour. Players explore the city's distinctive buildings and bright seaside areas while running from the inspector. Sofia joins the chase, and collecting enough of her gear unlocks a fresh Tango outfit for her. A ride on the Roto board takes you through the lively, colorful streets. Keep an eye out for sparkling horseshoes, since gathering them can earn rewards from the Weekly Hunt.
Controls are simple: dash as fast as you can and keep moving to stay ahead of the chase.
fight-with-monster: Fight With Monster is an action combat game set in the Adventure category, where you take on tough monsters in heavy fights. You move with care, aim your attacks well, and choose your skills carefully to beat back each group of foes. Every level brings a fresh test, with bigger and more threatening monsters waiting for you. The pace is quick, the combat effects look striking, and the game keeps you hooked from start to finish. Controls are handled with the mouse.
Tags tie it to battle, fighting, monsters, and superhero themes, so fans of those topics will feel right at home.
subway-surfers-beijing: Subway Surfers World Tour Beijing is an HTML5 game that takes the cheeky hero to Beijing this time. He is still up to his usual mischief, so naturally people are out to catch him. Players get to tour the city alongside him as he runs.

On a computer, the arrow keys control movement and the spacebar activates the skateboard. The goal is to run as far as possible, overcoming obstacles and dodging whatever comes your way. Listed under racing, it also carries action, adventure, and jumping tags, and it suits quick, casual play.
fall-animals-racing: Fall Animals Racing is a multiplayer game where you race against people from all over the world. Along the way you can chat with other players and make new friends. The game has 18 maps to race on, and you can choose from 15 comical animal characters.
Controls are simple. Use W, A, S and D to move, and press the Space bar to jump. If you need your mouse cursor back, press Esc to show it on screen.
mega-ramp-stunt-moto: This 3D motorbike game puts you in the saddle as you ride to the finish line on each sky-platform track. The riding is built around simulation, and your goal is to steer clear of every obstacle while clearing all of the levels.

Control your bike with the WASD keys or the arrow keys. Press Space to activate the nitro boost. Stunts and platform elements come into play across the tracks, and the game is also tagged for mobile play.
mine-rusher: Glittering crystals are spread along the twisting paths of a maze in Mine Rusher, and your job is to gather them. Left alone, the hero never succeeds. He can't react quickly enough when the path bends, so he tumbles into the void and wakes up with nothing in his hands. You step in and steer him along the route, picking up pebbles as he goes.

This is a tight-paced arcade game, so you must respond to each turn right away or the game will toss you aside. Your goal is to help him fill his pockets with gems. Controls are simple: use your mouse or tap the touchscreen.
tank-force-battle-game: In this modern tank shooter, you pilot an armored vehicle and try to halt enemy army trucks rolling toward the front lines. Line up your shots carefully and take out hostile convoys before they get past your defense line. The game moves quickly and fills the screen with military vehicles and bursts of explosions, while the controls stay responsive and smooth.
You can boost your tank's firepower and sharpen its accuracy as you progress. Each wave grows harder, so you must surv
blumgi-castle-game: In this skill game, you choose from a set of explosives and special weapons to send your foes sinking into the water. You can blast the monsters directly or knock out the ground they stand on. A ring-shaped marker surrounds your hero and shows where you are aiming. Hold the action key to build up power, then let go to send bombs raining down on the creatures.

A level is cleared once every creature in it has been defeated. Every few levels, a new hero joins your roster, so try each one to see what they can do. Steer your aim with the A and D keys or the Left and Right arrows. To fire, hold the Spacebar and release it when you are ready.
idle-lumberjack-3d: This 3D clicker puts you in charge of a logging operation, and you can pick from several different lumberjacks to play as. It is an endless management game with the same compelling loop that keeps you coming back, and your job is to clear the woods and grow your business one tree at a time.

Spend the money you collect on upgrades for your cabins and the tools your loggers use. Each improvement moves you closer to the big goal of becoming a millionaire. The game is controlled with a joystick, and it is tagged for boys and kids who enjoy hypercasual online games.
vampire-princess-cheerleader-girl: Rebecca is a vampire princess who has grown tired of the dull routine of the Vampire Kingdom. She sneaks out of the castle and takes on human form. In the human world, she meets Mike, a boy who has taken a real liking to her. Now she must decide whether to date him and whether to reveal her true identity, all while hoping to become the school's cheerleader.

The school's cheerleading competition is coming up soon, and Rebecca feels she needs to prepare for it first. Her confusion is piling up, and she is hoping for some help sorting it all out. Dressing up and makeovers are part of the fun. Players control the game with a mouse click or a tap.
sector-01: Far from the city, an old toy factory once churned out servant robots. Flawed units, whether they had scuffed screens or mismatched paint, were shipped to Sector 01 to be scrapped. One day, a robot sent to that sector woke up and became self-aware.

This is a single-player 2D arcade game with action, adventure, escape, and fighting elements. Move with W, A, S, and D, throw punches with the left mouse button, and dash with the right button. Your aim is to get out of the sector as the newly aware machine.
my-newborn-baby-care: A new baby has arrived in the family, and this little one depends on your love and care. Welcome the newborn warmly, then plan a memorable party to celebrate the arrival.

Your jobs include changing diapers, feeding the baby, and giving baths. You can also dress your little one in charming outfits and add accessories to finish each look. Every task becomes a chance to spoil your baby with care. Simply use a mouse click or a tap to play.
lucky-looter: Lucky Looter is a cool 3D stealth game that leans toward the tougher side. You have to dodge the sight ranges so you can get inside without being spotted. Take your time when moving in or out, because a rushed move can ruin the attempt. As you progress, each level grows harder than the last. Your goal is to steal as many treasures as you can. To play, just slide your finger across the screen.
fun-race-3d-crash-bandicoot: Fun Race 3D - Crash Bandicoot is a hypercasual arcade racing game built around a full parkour experience. Across hundreds of unique levels, you race against other players while working to achieve goals on each one. Unlocking new characters gives you more reason to keep going, and every level brings its own distinct kind of fun.
Getting started takes almost no effort. Hold to run and release to stop, which keeps the controls down to one simple action. Your a
chute-board: Chute Board is easy to pick up, so anyone can start racing right away. Expect a rush of speed and enthusiasm, along with the satisfaction that comes from racing. Its 3D visuals look more realistic and help the scene feel lifelike. Everything about the game pulls you in, and the overall experience feels very good.

The road twists around in a curved circle. Your goal is to collect as many gold coins as possible while making sure you never cause a rear-end collision. Every coin you gather raises your score. To do well, adapt to the game's rhythm as quickly as you can.
poly-art: Poly Art lets you build pictures featuring many subjects, including dozens of animals, plants, vehicles, and flowers, plus plenty more. Each illustration is put together from groups of small image pieces, and your job is to finish every segment of the game along the way. It is a hypercasual HTML5 title made for relaxing play.

Begin by picking a visual color mode. Then work through hundreds of shard clusters and complete the sets of images until all the game illustrations come together. Swipe to slide the pieces around, and place each one in the correct spot to finish a picture.
the-words-hardest-game: The Words Hardest Game is a 2D puzzle title for one player that blends action, adventure, arcade, retro, and skill elements. You control a red square, dodge the blue circles, and collect the yellow ones. Arrow keys move your square around the screen.

The game features thirty very hard levels to work through. A failed run does not fix the result for good, because experience counts for a great deal. Keep practicing, learn from each attempt, and enjoy the challenge along the way.
real-car-parking-3d: Real Car Parking 3D is an arcade parking game with lifelike visuals. Your task is to reach the finish line while keeping your car away from walls. Boxes in the way won't damage your vehicle, but they will slow you down, so you still need to drive carefully to avoid crashes. The game features 15 levels, and clearing them all is how you earn the title of top parking master. It can be played on both mobile devices and PC.
Controls use WASD on the keyboard, and touch controls are available on mobile.
cake-protector: Cake Protector is a tower defense title in which your job is to keep hungry ants away from a cake. You place traps and block their routes, and you need to respond fast so none of them reach the treat. As you keep playing, more ants show up and they speed up, so you will need to plan ahead while also reacting quickly. Everything is controlled with the mouse.
The rules are easy to pick up, yet the game is hard to put down. It suits players of every age who want a light but engaging challenge.
flying-wings-hover-craft: Flying Wings Hover Craft puts you behind the controls of a hovering vehicle in a 3D racing simulation set in a cyber-inspired future. Glowing neon streets and sleek machines fill the world, and the game offers several modes to choose from. Across the collection you will find 27 hovercraft and 72 race tracks, plus a single free driving area. You can purchase new craft and develop them over time, then race against computer-controlled rivals or ride hovercraft freely whenever you like.
Steer with the arrow keys or WASD, and press C to change the camera view.
winter-moto: Winter Moto is a lighthearted racing game set in the snow. You ride a motorbike, pick up coins along the way, and spend them on new bikes to try out. Its tags point to a 2D look, a Christmas and winter theme, and play on mobile devices as well as desktop.

To steer your bike, press the A and D keys or the left and right arrow keys. Gather as many coins as you can while you keep moving through the wintry course, then use what you earned to unlock a different motorbike and see how it handles.
rotating-bones-3d: Mr Bones, a rolling skull, is the hero of this 3D puzzle platformer. He is trapped in a floating ancient world of ruins, traps, and magical structures. You never make him jump. Instead, you rotate the whole environment so he can roll toward the next section, and the levels grow more complex as you advance. Along the way, collect the golden stars, work through physics-based puzzles, and avoid spikes and other hazards.

Every rotation changes gravity and opens new paths, so thinking about direction is at the heart of the game. The look is bright and colorful, with a cinematic feel that suits the setting. Controls are simple: click with a mouse or tap the screen to play.
merge-dungeon: Your troop of soldiers has to fight its way out of here. Along the path, a wide range of monsters stands in the way, and you need to defeat every one of them. As the foes grow stronger, you'll have to upgrade your warrior's gear so each battle can be won.

Patience pays off here, because you should hold back until you feel ready for the boss attack. Getting started is easy, since a single tap is all it takes to play. The pace is relaxed, so you can focus on each monster and each upgrade without rushing.
knife-io: Knife.io is a multiplayer io game where you face other players in a sword-focused brawl. Collect blades, knives, and weapons as you go, then use your spin to slay your rivals. Every clash tests your guts and steel, and the fight only ends when someone is left standing.

Mouse controls are all you need, so you can focus on timing your spins and reading the chaos around you. It runs in the browser as an HTML5 title and connects you online with other players. Tagged for action, battle, and PvP, it suits anyone who enjoys sword combat and hypercasual play.
touch-draw-game: This hyper-casual puzzle game asks you to sketch a route with your fingertip so the ball rolls safely to its target. Obstacles stand in the way, and the levels grow trickier as you go, rewarding careful planning. Timing and accuracy both matter, since a slightly off line can send the ball astray.

The rules are simple to pick up, yet mastering every level is a real challenge. Each round is short, so it suits brief breaks just as well as longer sittings. Just drag your finger across the screen to lay down the path and watch the ball head for the goal.
brush-hit: Brush Hit is a calm 3D arcade game made for kids. Your goal is to brush them with color, so you need to handle your tool properly. Every tap switches the tip of your pen, which changes how you paint. Be careful not to let the pen tip hang in the air, because that is something to avoid.
cherry-blossom-cake-cooking: Sofia is a skilled dessert chef who runs her own lovely cake shop. One day, her closest friend Zoe stops by and asks for a cherry blossom cake. Your job is to help Sofia bake that cake just right. When the work is done, the two friends plan to head out together to a flower viewing picnic, and it is cherry blossom season.
You play with a mouse click or a tap on your screen. The story centers on the cake shop, the cake, and a flower viewing outing shared by two friends.
fashion-walk: Fashion Walk is a free dress-up game where you style a model for a runway clash against an opponent. Each match centers on a specific concept, and you win by dressing to fit it well enough to outshine your rival on the catwalk. The game has already been watched millions of times on TikTok and has become a popular trend.

You choose shoes, high heels, clothing, bikinis, night dresses, and accessories such as sunglasses and designer bags. Some concepts call for casual looks, while others are all about luxury. Think of yourself as the designer and the game as your sketchbook, a makeover project where the spotlight is on your model.
lost-pyramid: Two companions set out to uncover a treasure hidden inside the pyramids. Along the way they must dodge mummies and booby traps. The split-screen format lets each player explore their own view, gathering every gem while trying to reunite with the other.

Some walls can be passed by performing a wall jump, and vertical walls can also be crossed. A mini map sits in the centre of the screen so you can follow where you and your partner are. Player 1 moves with the arrow keys and fires with F. Player 2 uses W, A, S and D to move, L to punch and K to toss a grenade.
cricket-2020: Cricket 2020 casts you as the last wicket, the batter who must keep scoring runs to steer your team toward victory. Pull on your helmet and pads, then work on your batting skills to become the match-winner your side needs. Along the way, you can pull off some stylish cricket shots that show off your technique.
Controls are simple: tap to hit a shot. Each tap gives you a chance to add runs, so keep your timing sharp and push your score as high as you can.
offroad-motorcycle-bike-racing-2020: Offroad Motorcycle Bike Racing 2020 puts you on a bike across a rugged off-road course. Your skills get tested as you push for speed over rough ground. To finish a level, you need to pass through every checkpoint marked on the map, so keep an eye on where the next one lies.

Drive your bike with the W, A, S and D keys. The game is built with Unity3D and runs in your browser through WebGL. It sits in the Racing category with Arcade and Moto tags. Enjoy the ride across the course.
car-arena-battle-demolition-derby-game: Car Arena Battle: Demolition Derby is a 3D browser game from 2021 built around high-impact vehicle clashes. Fans of car combat should find this derby-style arena tournament a good fit. Step into the arena of valor and enjoy every collision as you fight your way through the competition.

Everything is controlled with the keyboard arrow keys, so you can start steering right away. The game is filed under Adventure and carries race-related tags, reflecting its mix of racing and combat. Whether you want to win or simply enjoy the chaos, it offers a lively way to spend time with fast car battles.
stunts-car-impossible-car-challenges: Stunts Car - Impossible Car Challenges takes you onto sky-high roads lined with tricky ramps and zigzag tracks. Each level is meant to be thrilling and challenging, and the tracks are built specifically for stunt challenges.

incredible-princess-eye-art-2: This game is a tutorial taught by a makeup artist, and you apply the makeup to the eyes of cute princesses. The styles you can explore include angel makeup, rhinestones, animal prints, and neon effects, which are all popular right now.
You pick up a makeup brush and experiment with new eye art options. The controls are simple: use the left mouse button, or touch the screen on a touch device.
littleyellowman: You play as a small yellow character trying to get away from a group of purple foes. Some of those purple beings are actually your friends, and rescuing them is part of the job. Your mission is to save every one of the men, gather all the coins, and reach victory.

lucky-vs-lou: Lucky is a red toy bat who can never fly, because he is only a toy, yet he has to run for his life in this arcade adventure. Trouble starts when Lou, a handsome blond toy with a wicked streak, switches on a giant machine built to smash toys. Lucky's friends cannot reach out to save him, so he must grab the golden key to free them.

This is a 2D action game for one player, and it is also available on Android. You can move with the WASD keys or the arrow keys, and touch controls are available on mobile devices. Double jump is active during play, so Lucky can leap again while already in the air.
car-factory-for-kids: In Car Factory For Kids, young players put together their own vehicle and then head out to race it. The game blends three things: creative building, careful assembly, and driving. Because it mixes making and racing, it suits children who enjoy car games and like trying something different each time they play.

The controls are simple, so newcomers can get started quickly. On a computer, press D to accelerate and W to brake. On a phone or tablet, touch the button shown on screen to operate the car. Its easy setup makes it a good pick for anyone who loves free car games.
city-cleaner-3d-tractor-simulator: City Cleaner 3D Tractor Simulator puts you in charge of a tractor in a driving simulation that also plays like a 3D truck parking game. Your task is to pass every checkpoint before the limited time runs out. Your goal is to clear all the levels, and have fun along the way.
You move with the WASD keys or the arrow keys. The game runs in 3D using WebGL, and it is also playable on mobile devices, with timing and parking challenges at its core.
fish-parking-parking-master: Fish Parking - Parking Master is a free parking game that puts you behind the wheel of a car in a lifelike setting. The ground feels like real pavement, and the roadblocks you meet are ones you will recognize. A clear steering wheel sits alongside the accelerator and brake buttons, so the controls are easy to pick up while the game keeps you absorbed in the drive.

Your job is to steer your car along a route packed with obstacles. Keep your eyes on the road, avoid every obstacle, and keep going until you reach the end and pass the stage. Controls work with a tap or a click, so you can jump in right away.
dress-up-unicorn: Picture a magical horse with a single horn growing from its forehead. In this game, you look after a pet unicorn, and you can choose from four different kinds. Keeping your companion clean and cared for is part of the job, and the dressing-up is where the real creativity comes in. The wardrobe is huge, so you can mix and match a countless number of outfits.

Try on a sweet princess gown, a cool riding hat, or anything else that catches your eye. Every choice is yours, so experiment as much as you like. Controls are simple: use your mouse or tap the screen. Horse lovers and animal fans should find plenty to enjoy here.
blocky-combat-wars-advanced-swat: Blocky Combat Wars Advanced SWAT is a free-to-play multiplayer shooter for online battles. free-racing-ayn: Free Racing Ayn lets you pull off stunts across a large open zone filled with fast super sports cars. stickman-adventure: Stick War: New Age is a stick fighting adventure where you guide your stickman through a world full of rivals. Arrow keys move your character, and the mouse handles shooting with a left click.
