buddy-kick-archer: Buddy Kick Archer is a lively archery game where you line up each shot, let the arrow fly, and knock out odd foes with accurate hits. Your bow skills get tested as you go, and you can earn stronger arrows to hit targets in inventive ways. It suits anyone who enjoys skill-driven action with a silly streak and a steady stream of challenges in every level.
Controls are simple: use a mouse click or a tap on a touchscreen to play.
arena-wars-io: Arena Wars is an action game in the .io style, where you evolve by picking up gems and eliminating your enemies. Every gem you collect moves your evolution forward, so gathering them while keeping an eye on rivals is central to the experience. Each enemy you defeat adds to your progress as well.
The controls are simple. Left-click to attack, right-click to sprint, and move your cursor to steer your character. Mix these three actions to gather gems and take down enemies as you go.
train-simulator-3d: Step into the cab of this three-dimensional railway title, where your aim is to grow into a skilled engineer at the controls. Over a range of different locomotives, you take the wheel and manage the throttle alongside the brake, easing between the two so the journey runs smoothly.

Learning the handling takes patience, since the inputs respond in a finicky way and it is easy to overshoot. Keep adjusting until you settle on a pace that suits each train. Everything is played with the mouse alone, so no keyboard is needed.
3d-formula-racing-pro-edition: Take the wheel of a high-performance formula car in 3D Formula Racing: Pro Edition, a fast 3D arcade racer made for players who crave a thrill. You will tear through 20 demanding stages, from neon-lit cyberpunk cities to dusty desert canyons and Martian terrain. As you clear stages, the AI rivals grow faster and far more aggressive, so your driving has to keep sharpening.

Learn to slide through tight corners, and hit the Nitro (NOS) button when you want a burst of speed to leave rivals behind. You can play alone or in two-player split-screen mode. On PC, Player 1 uses W, A, S, and D to accelerate, steer, and brake, with Left Shift for Nitro. Player 2 uses the arrow keys to drive and Enter for Nitro. Mobile players get touch controls.
wugy-halloweentower-war: In Wugy Halloween Tower War, you take charge of a team of heroes and head into a spooky battle. Drag your heroes across the map to explore new ground, unlock powers as you go, and bring down strong monsters along the way. Your mission is to rescue the princess from danger.

Between fights, you gather heroes, gold, and skins to use later. Once a battle ends, you can build up your tower with what you have collected. This tower defense and fighting title works on mobile and includes skill-based avoiding and a playful Halloween look. To begin, simply tap to play.
baby-taylor-an-ordinary-day: Many people are curious about how others live, and this game lets you find out. Taylor shows you what a student does over one full day. She eats breakfast at home and then rides the school bus to class. Her teacher, Doris, teaches the children and also plays with them. Today Taylor is on duty, so you can help her clean the classroom. After school, the kids have their own activities, and you can see what they choose to do.
To play, simply click with your mouse or tap the screen.
stickman-sniper-shoot: Stickman Sniper Shoot puts you in long-distance fights where steady aim and quick reactions decide whether you survive. You play as an elite stickman sniper assassin sent on dangerous missions full of enemies, covert operations, and high-risk targets. Each bullet counts, so a single slip can cause the mission to fail.

Every button is clicked with the mouse, which you use to move through menus and take each shot. Patience matters as much as speed, since a rushed decision can end your run. Stay calm, choose your moment, and line up each target with care.
crazy-runner-in-city: Crazy Runner in City is a hypercasual endless runner that is easy to pick up. Your job is to guide a 3D runner as it speeds up across a chain of connected slopes. The runner keeps moving on its own, so quick reflexes are what keep it on track. It is a single-player game built for mobile and PC, and the tags point to a 3D, avoid-style experience that is listed in the site's collection of hot picks.

On a computer, press A or D, or use the left and right arrow keys, to steer. On a phone or tablet, swipe left or right to change direction. The controls are simple, so you can start running right away and focus on staying on the path as the pace picks up.
anti-stress-game: Anti Stress Game is a lighthearted HTML5 arcade title that suits players of every age. It is built for messing around and easing your mind. The whole point is to take a breather and let the tension of the day fade. It is a single-player game, so you can settle in alone whenever you need a little downtime.
Control is handled with your mouse or by tapping the screen. Pick it up whenever you want to unwind, and enjoy a relaxed stretch of time where stress takes a back seat.
shadow-war-idle: Shadow War Idle is a hypercasual endless runner where you release dark power as you race through a realm full of shadows. Enemies stand in your path, so surviving each run is the central challenge. You can control your moves with a mouse, touch, or the keyboard.

Customize your gear to match how you want to fight. Collect diamonds along the way and spend them on new weapons. Each step brings you closer to glory, with running, fighting, and survival blended into one game.
catwalk-beauty-online: Showtime has arrived, and every competitor is picking the finest outfits for the catwalk. Your aim is to work the runway like a true queen and beat your opponent. Select the best outfit pieces for the show, always going for the most chic attire. The better the look you assemble, the higher your score, leaving you polished and hard to beat.

This 3D title sits in the Girls category, and its single instruction is to choose the right object. Think carefully before each pick, because every choice affects how you perform on the runway. Keep building the sharpest looks you can, and you could finish as the unbeatable model on stage.
sailor-girl-battle-outfit: Plenty of girls love sailor style, and the look is especially appealing when it comes as a sailor suit. This dress-up game features five girls, Sofia, Zoe, Adella, Jade, and Bella, who prefer sailor suits to any other outfit. They are all getting ready for a masquerade party, so it is up to you to help each of them transform into a sailor girl.

Everything is controlled with a mouse click or a tap. Take your time working through the dress-up session and enjoy styling each girl. The game focuses on makeover and fashion play, so it is a good fit for anyone who enjoys putting outfits together and seeing the results.
extreme-squidly-survival-game: Inspired by the Red Light, Green Light segment of the Squid Game series, this 3D arcade title challenges you to guide your runner to the finish line before the clock runs down. Timing matters most. The green light and a Korean girl's spoken cues tell you when it is safe to dash forward, so you learn the rhythm of each round as you play.

The real test comes when the voice stops and the light turns red. You must freeze exactly where you are, because any movement at that moment means you get shot. Controls are simple: tap and drag to move your character. It is a quick, skill-based escape run designed for mobile play, where every second of hesitation or hurry counts.
special-forces-x: In this Adventure shooter, you play an elite operative sent on missions to tear down the hideouts of violent criminals. Your arsenal includes modern firearms, and you will need to move with tactics in mind while eliminating foes in heated firefights. pro-puzzle: Pro Puzzle is a free single-player game in the puzzles category. Your goal is to combine vertical and horizontal lines until they form a plus sign. You control everything by swiping, which is how you join the lines together.

ditching-class: You are a student who would much rather skip class than sit through it. Your aim is to slip out of the classroom without being caught. Keep an eye on the teacher, since being spotted by them ruins your plan. When the moment is right, open the door and make your way out. Along the way you will need to use a variety of props, which help you avoid all kinds of traps and stay out of the teacher's sight.
Playing is simple. Tap whatever catches your attention in the room, then use the items you find to work through each puzzle. If you get stuck, hints are available to help you keep moving forward.
carhit-io: CarHit.io is a multiplayer .io title where the goal is to shove rival cars off the platform. You need to stay on the arena yourself while working to knock other drivers out of it. Each opponent you send flying gives you extra hit power, so every later collision lands with more force.
Steering is simple. Use the left and right arrow keys to turn, or hold the left mouse button down to steer with the pointer.
rabbids-volcano-panicp: Rabbids Volcano Panic is a 3D hypercasual game where the floor keeps breaking apart beneath your feet. Your job is to survive for as long as possible while making your way across the crumbling ground. The challenge grows because other Rabbids are running around in a frenzy, and any of them could drag you down with them.

Filed under action, adventure and arcade, this browser game also carries the .io tag. Your goal stays the same throughout: keep yourself out of harm for as long as you're able, and see how long you last before the floor gives way.
school-bus-3d-parking: School Bus 3D Parking is an online puzzle game you can enjoy on both PC and mobile. Your goal is to guide the bus into the parking spot, which opens up the next level. Along the way, avoid walls and other obstacles, and make sure you do not hit them.

smiling-glass: Smiling Glass is a puzzle game where your goal is to fill a glass with water. diamond-paint-art: Diamond Paint Art is a puzzle game where you unwind by filling a canvas with diamonds. Each piece goes in by following the numbers, in a paint-by-number style. You can take your time or work quickly, whichever suits your mood.

adventure-capitalist-hole: Adventure Capitalist Hole is a browser game that has been drawing plenty of attention from players. You set off on a risky journey centered on growing your money and assets. Every move is aimed at building a larger fortune while facing the dangers along the way.

Playing costs nothing, and the game can keep you occupied for hours on a computer or on a phone. To play, just click with your mouse or tap the screen. Its straightforward controls make it easy to pick up, so you can start right away.
punchmaster: Step into the ring as a boxer who throws heavy punches to knock out your rival. master-chess-multiplayer: Master Chess Multiplayer is an HTML5 board game that brings a sleek take on the timeless game of chess. You can choose from three ways to play: face opponents online in multiplayer, take on the computer, or pass the device to a friend for a match side by side.

stormbreaker: Stormbreaker is a 3D adventure game in which you pilot a fighter jet through the sky. grimace-birthday-escape: This adventure sends you through a maze, where your goal is to find the way out before the Grimace monster spots you. Locating the door unlocks the next level, so keep searching as you explore. Along the way, you can collect lives and Grimace shake juice.

tomb-of-the-cat-color: Tomb of The Cat Color is a 2D retro arcade adventure. You play as a cat trying to escape from a cemetery, and as you move around, you paint everywhere you go. ladderrex: Ladderrex is a quick racing game where good timing and careful use of materials decide who crosses the line first. Building too early or holding on too long wastes your supply.
Winning takes more than speed. You need to stay accurate, spend your logs thoughtfully, and get ahead of your opponent. The racer with the most logs remaining at the finish is the one who wins.
high-school-teacher-games-life: Step into the shoes of a high school educator in this 3D adventure. Rather than the usual classroom games, it aims for a setting that feels closer to real teaching work.

Mission Mode presents a series of tasks that put your classroom skills to the test, and each mission brings fresh goals that keep play interesting and rewarding when completed. Quiz Mode focuses on running quizzes and hands-on sessions with students, where you check what they know, review how they are doing, and help them learn through interaction. cs-online: Head into the action across a desert, through ancient temples, around a factory, or among ship containers. The choice of battlefield is yours. trz-pop-it: TRZ Pop It invites you to press every "button" on each of its 80 toys. easter-card-memory: Shift a row of candies sideways or up and down to build a straight line of three or more matching frogs, whether horizontal or vertical. You can slide these rows with a mouse or a fingertip, so the controls stay simple on any device.

transport-sea-animal: In this demanding 3D driving game, you take the wheel of a heavy truck and haul huge sea creatures from a spot on the beach to an aquarium. top-model-dress-up: Want to dress like a supermodel or a superstar? This dress up title lets you style virtual doll characters inspired by the worlds of modeling and celebrity. It is a fresh addition to the site's girls' category, and your own fashion sense drives every choice you make.

zombie-world-survival: Zombie World Survival drops you into a world that the undead have taken over after an apocalypse. crash-derby-ayn: Crash Derby AYN puts eight drivers into a purpose-built arena where every collision counts. The goal is to outlast the rest, since the last car still running takes the win. perfect-slices-2: Perfect Slices 2 invites you to cut like a seasoned pro. Every chop feels deeply rewarding, and the gameplay is so engaging that you will want one more go. The controls are easy to learn, so getting started takes no effort at all.
Everything is played with your mouse. This 1 player title uses 3D graphics built with WebGL and HTML5. It is a funny, skill-based hypercasual game that stays simple and fun from start to finish.
baby-taylor-mermaid-party-prep: Taylor's birthday is just around the corner, and as always, she is hosting a party. This year, she and her mom have settled on a mermaid theme because Taylor adores mermaids. Before the big day, you follow Taylor as she shops for decorations.

Next, you help her mom make a mermaid cake. Once the preparations are finished, you can join Taylor at her party and have fun with her there. The whole game is controlled with a simple mouse click or tap.
jumpy-robot: Jumpy Robot is a single-player arcade game in which you help a small robot climb upward, leaping from platform to platform. Every jump gives him a charge of energy. Your goal is to collect as many batteries as you can.
To play, move left and right until the robot reaches the platform you need for your next jump. Getting into the right spot is what lets him keep climbing and gathering batteries.
taxi-driver-3d: Taxi Driver 3D puts you behind the wheel of a taxi in the city. Your job is to take customers to the destinations they ask for, and you earn money for every trip you complete. It is a racing game built around 3D car driving, so you can enjoy steering through the streets.

Because it is a single-player game, you can focus entirely on your route and your earnings. hole-in-one: This sports title challenges you to flick a ball into a glass bowl, aiming for one successful shot after another. Basketball and shooting fans may find the basic action familiar, though the puzzles add a twist of their own.
mr-bullet-revenge: Playing as John, a determined gunman, you take on a mission from Shangfeng to infiltrate the largest criminal gang in the world and free Natasha, a kidnapped female doctor. Once he gets close to the heart of the gang, something unexpected takes place.

Each level gives you only a limited number of bullets, so every shot counts. Clear every enemy on the screen by thinking carefully about your approach rather than firing at random. New levels unlock as you progress through the game.
cinderella-story-games: Cinderella, one of the most cherished fairy tales ever told, now comes to life as a game you can play on a computer or phone. Instead of simply reading the story, young players take part in it while building useful mental skills. The games are made for children aged 10 and under, especially girls who want a playful way to sharpen their thinking.

Along the way, players can strengthen their memory, their spatial intelligence, and their reading and comprehension. Controls are simple: use your mouse or tap the screen to move through the game. Fans of princess adventures and cartoon-style fun will find plenty here to enjoy.
zombie-road-drive: Zombie Road Drive drops you onto a dangerous highway crowded with the undead. The roads seem to stretch on forever, and your goal is to last as long as you can. Your car keeps rolling ahead on its own, so you must weave around obstacles, avoid crashes, and open fire on the zombies coming at you.

Every zombie that hits your vehicle wears down its health. Once that health reaches zero, the run is over. Use the left and right arrow keys to steer your car, and shoot enemies before they get too close. Stay alert and keep moving as you push through the wasteland.
fun-race-3d-online: Fun Race 3D Online is an arcade racer in three dimensions. You steer your character through a risky course, and your goal is to be the first to reach the finish line while rivals run alongside you. The game offers a large collection of outfits and dance poses that you can unlock and gather as you go. Controls are simple: click the mouse or tap the screen to play.

The race is fast and full of obstacles, so you have to stay alert to get ahead of the competition. Between runs, you can enjoy showing off your different looks and moves. It is a light, colorful game that works well for a quick round of racing fun.
basket-champ: Basket Champ is a sports game built around a single tap. Its visuals look great, and the theme changes every time you clear five levels. Your job is to tap the screen so the ball flies toward the hoop. It may seem simple at first glance, yet it takes real focus to get the ball through. Expect a few tough moments where patience pays off.

Let the bouncy ball drop and you will be kicked out of the game, so stay sharp. Get ready with your flippers, show off your basketball skills, and sink shots on your way to becoming the next basketball star.
commando-sniper: Commando Sniper is a shooting game for mobile devices that puts you in the role of a sniper using long-range weapons. It features 20 unique levels, so each stage brings something different to the mission. The graphics are striking and easy on the eye, which makes watching each mission unfold a pleasure.

Getting started is simple: tap the screen to begin. Whether you enjoy precise shots or like trying out different weapons, this game gives you a focused way to play on your phone. Fans of sniper and weapons games should find plenty here to keep them interested.
panda-dash-auto-shooting: Panda Dash Auto Shooting is a side-scrolling shooter with adventure elements. You take charge of a bold panda fighter who pushes through crowded arenas, where undead foes arrive in a nonstop flood. Each clash is decided by smart positioning and careful planning, so your choices matter. As the game moves on, every round feels faster and more intense than the one before it.

On PC, WASD handles movement, J, K, and L trigger your skills, and the Space bar makes your panda jump. On mobile, you control everything through the on-screen buttons. Whichever device you use, the panda's survival depends on how well you handle the chaos around you.
pencil-rush-3d: Your masterpiece is almost ready, but you are running low on pens. Dash through Pencil Rush 3D to gather more of them. Pick up pens along the way, dodge obstacles, and keep clear of the walls. Every pen you grab lets you finish more sections, until every blank is filled in and your painting is fully colored. Slice to steer and tap to play.
See how many masterpieces you can finish.
dragon-draw-joust: Dragon Draw Joust throws you into a chaotic fight where drawing is the key to survival. Rather than picking equipment from a list, you sketch your own tools to protect your fighter and get through tough battles. Because your plan begins with whatever you create, no two matches play out quite the same. Once you finish a drawing, it becomes part of your character, letting you block incoming blows or strike rivals within the chaotic arena.

To play, just click and drag. The game blends action with drawing, and its cute animal theme keeps the mood light even when the battles get hectic. Let your imagination guide each move and see how your creations hold up.
cinderella-dress-up: Cinderella is preparing for a big evening at the ball, where she will meet a handsome Prince. Before she can go, she has to visit the beauty salon and get dressed up alongside other princesses, fairies, and brides. Games like this one give young players a chance to build their own sense of style and learn how to put together fashionable, polished looks. Every character is ready and waiting for a fan of fashion to step in and create her most beautiful look.
Everything in the game is handled with the mouse alone, so there is nothing else to learn before you start. Choose the outfits you like best and get each guest ready for the special night.
halloween-link: Halloween Link is a puzzle built around removing blocks. Each move clears a pair of identical pieces, but only when a path can join them with one line that bends no more than twice. Your aim is to empty the board of every card in a stage. The game contains 21 stages, and clearing all of them is how you win.

Controls are simple. You can use a mouse or a touch pad. Look over the grid for matching pieces that a route with at most two corners can connect, then select both pieces in quick succession by clicking or tapping each one.
city-police-cars: City Police Cars puts you behind the wheel of a police car in a driving game that spans 30 levels. The visuals are polished and eye-catching, giving each stage a lively look. In the garage, you can purchase new vehicles and upgrade the ones you already own.

Controls are simple. Press A and D, or the left and right arrow keys, to move the car in either direction. Press W or the up arrow to make the car jump. The game is filed under racing and tagged for mobile play.
stickjet-challenge: Stickjet Challenge is an arcade action game about a stickman who must dodge obstacles as he moves along. Your goal is to collect every star you come across so you can finish the game in royal style. It is tagged as a jump and platform game, so timing matters just as much as quick reactions.

The controls are simple. Touch and hold to make your stickman fly, then release to send him back to running. Switching between flying and running is the key to avoiding obstacles and grabbing every star. Good luck on your run.
goalkings: GoalKings puts you on the penalty spot in a football match where every kick is a duel with the keeper. Line up each shot carefully, control how hard you strike, and pick the right moment to beat the opposing goalkeeper. When you stand in front of the net instead, you need to react quickly to block dangerous shots before they go in.
The gameplay stays simple, yet the penalty experience feels lifelike and absorbing. You play entirely with the mouse, and the same skills of aiming, timing
water-sort-puzzle-color-sorting-game: Water Sort Puzzle gives you a set of glasses filled with mixed colored liquid. Your goal is to sort the water until every glass holds only one color. It is easy to get hooked on this brain teaser, yet it feels calm and relaxing while still making you think.

To move water, tap a glass to pour it into another one. You can only pour when the colors match and the receiving glass has enough room left. If you get stuck, don't worry, because you can always start over and try a different approach.
school-bus-simulator-3d: Step into the driver's seat as a professional city bus operator in this game. You pick up and drop off riders, follow school routes, and practice parking your vehicle with care. The game includes city driving and off-road bus modes, plus coach bus gameplay, so you can try different kinds of routes. Detailed 3D surroundings change with shifting weather and a full day and night cycle, and the controls feel smooth from start to finish.

Keep an eye on your fuel as you go, and switch between several camera angles to see the road from whichever position suits you best. Sound effects add to the feel of being behind the wheel. Controls are simple: use WASD or the arrow keys to move, or tap to start playing.
mermaid-princess-dress-up-salon: Mermaid Princess Dress Up Salon lets you style two mermaid princess sisters. You can pair a lovely top with each mermaid and pick the tail you like best. Every clothing piece you add changes how the look comes together, so you can try many different styles. The game also helps young players build a feel for matching outfits and shows them how to put together a prettier look. You play by clicking or tapping on the screen.
popcorn-brust: Popcorn Burst is an arcade puzzle game where you fill containers with tasty popcorn, and the goal is to get every piece in without spilling any. The gameplay runs smoothly, and the bright, colorful visuals paired with satisfying popping effects keep the mood light. It is a calm, casual experience built for players of all ages.
If you enjoy puzzles, brain games, or arcade-style challenges, this popcorn simulator should suit you well. To press any button in the game, just click with your mouse.
stickman-weapon-combo: In this action shooter, you mix different weapons together to build stronger guns. Once your gun is ready, head to the shooting range, where enemy stickmen are waiting. Prepare your arsenal, upgrade your pistol, and collect every bonus you can along the way. Your aim is to become the best shooter in the city.

The fun comes from seeing how far you can push a weapon before it faces the enemy stickmen. Every combination you test shows what your arsenal can really do, so trying out different mixes is a big part of the game. Your goal is to find out how powerful a weapon you can build for facing off with foes.
perfect-pipes-3d-pull-the-pin: Perfect Pipes 3D is a free arcade puzzle game in which you connect pipe pieces. Touch a piece to turn it, or use drag and drop with a mouse click, until every piece forms one complete pipe. Choose a level package to begin, with options ranging from easy play to brain-teasing puzzles.

Every board must be filled with no empty squares, and each matching pair of dots has to be joined. No connection may cross another. A hint button is available whenever you feel stuck, and a tutorial appears the first time you start. The game suits the whole family, works on a tablet or phone, and helps sharpen logic and reasoning for beginners and experienced puzzlers alike.
belt-it: Belt It is a 3D arcade puzzle game that asks you to use your brain carefully. Cargo chests keep sliding along, and you use colorful ropes to block them. The trick is timing your blocks to match the moment the truck starts or stops. It is a clever workout for your mind, and it suits kids and casual players alike.
You can also challenge yourself by trying to finish with fewer ropes. The controls are simple: slide to play, and let each move bring the chests to a stop.
hero-wars-rescue: Hero Wars Rescue mixes arcade-style simulation with puzzle solving. You play as a knight who rescues beautiful princesses, defeats wicked orcs, and finds treasure along the way. Fans of adventure will enjoy the journey. Your job is to guide the hero to the princess and help him win the treasure. Each level is split into sections separated by pins, and a quick swipe across their tips lets you pull them out. Pull the right ones to clear a safe path.

Most stages ask you to defeat enemies, collect treasure, and save the princess. Think through each pull before you make it, because every choice shapes how the hero reaches the goal. By the end of this latest rescue game, you will have grown into a rich hero. The puzzles also carry an educational side, so casual players can enjoy working through each move.
surprise-egg-dino-party: Dinosaurs once roamed our planet, but they died out long ago. Most of us only meet them through pictures and books. This game is a chance to get to know them in a fun way. Their bright, varied skins and colors are meant to catch your eye. The idea is simple: click the egg to crack it open and uncover a dinosaur toy inside.

To see every dinosaur you have found, open the Dinosaur Room by pressing the "Toys" button. Controls are easy, since everything is done with a left click. Enjoy meeting these prehistoric friends and have a good time.
deer-hunter-2d: Deer Hunter 2D puts you behind the scope of a sniper rifle as you track down deer. Your job is to hunt them from a distance, using precise aim. Its shooting action centers on these animals, so every shot counts.

The game includes 30 levels to work through. Controls are simple: tap to play, so a single touch is all you need to get started. It is built with HTML5, works on mobile devices, and sits in the shooting category with an animal theme.
red-and-green-christmas: This is the final chapter of the red and green game series, and it has a holiday twist. Instead of the usual setup, the New Year's special section includes a portal that you jump out of to begin. From there, you clear the obstacles, rescue your friend, reach the door, and finish each section.

Move with WASD or the arrow keys, and use a double jump to gain extra height. Mobile touch controls are also available for phones and tablets. It is a 2D arcade game with a Christmas theme, built for two players.
city-gas-station-simulator: City Gas Station Simulator is a 3D casual simulation game where you take charge of a station and handle all of its details. You pump fuel for passing vehicles and also keep a small convenience store running. Every decision about how the place operates is yours. The casual management play is light, enjoyable, and easy to get hooked on.
Blending store sales with fueling service is the key to getting the most out of your business. On PC, use WASD to move and press F to interact. On mobile, click the on-screen button to operate.
princess-makeup-salon: Princess Makeup Salon is a free makeup game made for girls. The beautiful princess is a fashion idol, as she usually is, but this time you take on the role of the fashion maker. Your task is to dress her from head to toe for a Fashion Party.

Everything is controlled with a mouse or by tapping the screen, so you can play on a computer or a phone. Every outfit choice is yours to make as you get her ready for the party, which makes for a fun and relaxed dress-up session.
spaceguard-io: SpaceGuard.io is a sci-fi first-person shooter played against other people online. Portals and jump pads add some unusual twists to the action. The game includes four custom-built space maps, a fast, Quake-style feel, and selectable character skins. You can choose between deathmatch and team deathmatch.

Move with WASD or the arrow keys, fire with the left mouse button, and aim down the sights with the right. Press C to crouch, R to reload, and Space to jump, while holding Left Shift lets you run. The number keys 1 through 5 switch weapons, and Tab brings up the scoreboard.
crazy-car-stunts: Crazy Car Stunts puts you behind the wheel and lets you perform all sorts of wild tricks. Ramps are placed across the maps, giving you plenty of chances to launch your car and pull off daring jumps. The game sits in the sports category and blends driving with race and stunt action.

Steering works with WASD or the arrow keys. Use Shift to activate your nitro boost for a burst of speed, and press the Space bar to brake. If you want to leave the action and return to the main menu, press R.
offroad-police-cargo-transport: In this offroad driving game, you take the wheel of several different vehicles as you wind along curvy tracks. Your job is to carry goods from one spot to another across the city. City residents rely on you for food, medical supplies, and other necessary items, so each delivery counts.

Steer your vehicle with the arrow keys or the A, S, W and D keys. Press Shift to lift your helicopter into the air, then use the same movement keys to fly it. Hold the Spacebar to brake your vehicle, or to bring the helicopter back down.
super-monster-halloween-jigsaw: Super Monster Halloween Jigsaw is a free puzzle game built around fitting pieces together. It is easy to learn and simple to use, so the whole family can enjoy it. You can play by tapping or clicking, and the Halloween setting brings in monster, ghost, and candy imagery.

Beneath that straightforward surface, the game offers plenty of variety. It includes several distinct features, different game types, and a choice of modes. A large selection of jigsaw themes keeps things fresh, and the whole package is designed to entertain players of all ages.
breaking-fall: In this 3D arcade game, you control an elevator that keeps dropping toward the ground. Numerous obstacles stand in its way, and your job is to keep the cabin from touching any of them. It belongs to the hypercasual genre, so the idea is easy to grasp right away.

Your goal is to bring the elevator down safely, which also rescues the character who is falling. Every action is handled with the mouse alone, so there is no need for a keyboard. Fans of simple, casual games with a clear
subway-surfers-london-2021: Snowy London is the setting for this New Year's edition of Subway Surfers, where you head down into the city subway. In this endless runner, your job is to keep running for as long as you can while collecting coins and dodging obstacles and trains. Watch out for the grumpy inspector in a Santa suit, because he is trying to catch you.
Use the arrow keys to control your character, and press the space bar to activate your skateboard. The goal is to run as far as possible, overcoming obstacles and dodging whatever comes your way.
subway-surfers-san-francisco: Jack is a famous yet elusive street artist who has arrived in San Francisco. He draws pictures on building walls with paint cans, while the police hunt for him. Your job is to help him slip away from the officers chasing him.
The hero dashes down the road, gradually picking up speed while officers follow close behind. Watch the screen closely, since obstacles lie ahead
offroad-car-race: Offroad Car Race is a three-dimensional racing game set on a mountain track. You take part in a race with a group of powerful sports cars, and staying in control on this demanding route calls for good driving skills. The game is built around that challenge from start to finish.

The game includes multiple levels and good-looking graphics. Steer your car with the W, A, S and D keys. Press C to switch the camera view, and press Escape to pause or resume whenever you need a break from the action.
archery-training: Archery Training is a sports game that helps you sharpen your aim. You shoot test arrows and try to land them in the center of the target. The challenge grows over time because the wind gets stronger, so you have to adjust your aim to deal with it.
It is an HTML5 browser game in the shooting category. You control it with a mouse or a touch screen. Keep practicing and see how well you can handle the wind as it builds up.
pop-it-fidget: Pop it Fidget is a fun title that lets you slow down and unwind. Your aim is simple: tap every circle on each toy. Relaxing is the main idea, so you can take your time as you move from one toy to the next. The collection is varied, with options such as Among Us, unicorn, fruits, and animals, along with several more waiting to be discovered.

Interaction is easy because you only need your mouse or touch input to work with everything on screen. It is a single-player game presented in 2D, and its tags include candy, clicker, coloring, and design, so there is plenty of cute variety to enjoy.
bigmonsterz-io: You step into a sprawling world packed with monsters, some weak and some powerful. You begin as the feeblest of the bunch, and your task is to climb your way toward the top. The end goal is to become the biggest monster in the Big mon world.
Your mouse controls all movement, so you steer your creature simply by moving the pointer. Work up from the bottom, growing stronger as you go, until you reach the very top of the pack.
ambulance-rescue-driver-simulator-2018: Take the wheel of this 3D ambulance simulator from 2018 and head to people hurt in road accidents. Your job is to pick up the injured and carry them to a hospital, where a doctor can give them the urgent medical care they need. Sound your siren as you race toward each emergency.

Speed matters here, because every patient is waiting for help. Steer and drive with WASD, press Space to brake, and use the camera control to change your view. Saving a human life is a powerful thing, so each trip carries real weight.
craft-number: Craft Number is a math puzzle where you join numbers together until they reach a set target value. You drag numbers around the board, merge them, and plan your moves ahead to build the perfect combinations.

Each level brings a new challenge, and the difficulty climbs as you progress, so you will need both careful logic and quick mental arithmetic. The gameplay stays simple, which makes it a good way to train your mind or fill a few spare minutes each day. Everything is controlled with the mouse.
friday-night-funkin-full-week: This fan-made expansion of Friday Night Funkin puts you in a rap battle against Chara. Three brand-new songs form the heart of the challenge, so anyone familiar with the original will find fresh material to work through.
Listed in the puzzle category, the game is tagged with music, dancing, and boy and girl characters. It suits players who enjoy songs and dance-driven challenges with a bit of puzzling mixed in.
delicious-breakfast-cooking-game: Delicious Breakfast Cooking is a game about preparing morning meals, and it is easy to get hooked on. You can cook four different breakfasts, from the familiar pairing of fried bacon and eggs to a fancier rain latte. Each one gives you a rich cooking session. Start with whichever dish appeals to you, or work through all four at your own pace.

Follow the on-screen steps and use your creative touch to plate attractive, tasty breakfasts, with the goal of becoming a top chef. This HTML5 cooking title is aimed at girls and kids who enjoy food. It works with a mouse or by tapping the screen, so it is simple to pick up. If you want a light way to pass some time, this one fits the bill.
street-fight-space-station: Have you ever wanted to be a famous ninja or join a battle across the galaxy? This browser game sends you on a fresh adventure as a stickman warrior in sharper outfits, armed with powerful blades like swords and lightsabers. You collect weapons, upgrade them, and use them to take on foes while shaping your fighter into the character you prefer. It is one of the newer 3D fighting games you can play online, with a warzone full of brawls, mischief, and mayhem.
Controls are simple. Use the arrow keys to move and the spacebar to jump. Press Z or X to attack and C to defend. To run, double tap A or D.
chillpaths: In this calm puzzle adventure, you explore a chilly, frozen landscape where the goal is to guide a small boat to its destination. Shove the icy bars out of the way so the boat has a clear route. Each stage is built around a clever arrangement that tests your reasoning, forward planning, and ability to solve problems.

Work through frosty grids, sliding blocks in the correct sequence to open up a path. Controls feel smooth, the visuals are soothing, and cracking a tricky layout brings a satisfying moment of insight. It is easy to start playing, yet there is plenty to master as you go.
dora-rush-water-park: Dora Rush Water Park is a 3D hypercasual game where you ride a water slide alongside other racers. Your aim is to reach the bottom before your rivals do, so speed matters. You can also knock opponents off the slide to clear your path, or escape the slide yourself to drop into a nearer landing point.
The controls are simple: just click the mouse to move. The game is very addictive, so expect to keep coming back for another run. Stay focused on the slide and pick your moves carefully.
tangled-hook-twister: Tangled Hook Twister is a physics-based puzzle game where accuracy matters most. Its look is clean and stripped back, and everything is shown in 3D. Your task is straightforward, though the path is full of twists: steer a group of colored rings through a knotted network of wire. No propellers or boosters are involved, so the only forces at work are gravity and your skill at turning the whole scene around.

Play on a touchscreen by swiping across the display to spin the hook. On a computer, press the left and right arrow keys to rotate it. Both methods let you test your sense of space and logic, and they reward patience as you work through each tangle.
sugar-cookie-battle: Sugar Cookie Battle is a clicker game built around dalgona, the Korean honeycomb candy cookie. Your job is to shape each piece without breaking it, and the game mixes this with survival-style challenges. Along the way you perform tasks in your own custom candy game, and the levels are full of addictive twists. Fans of squid-themed games will spot nods to green light, red light and the 456 candy cookie challenge.
You play the whole game with your mouse. It blends arcade, logic and avoid-style play, so each level
smart-hand-doctor: You are doctors on a special mission to cure the hand injuries of your clumsy patients. This hypercasual 2D title offers a virtual surgery experience meant to make you feel like a real doctor working in a hospital. Its listed tags include casual, doctor, baby, and girl.

Everything is controlled with the mouse alone, so there are no other controls to learn. The game is built with HTML and WebGL and runs right in your browser. Your goal is to treat each patient's hand and get them healed.
baby-fashion-tailor-shop: Step into a little tailor shop and take on the role of a young fashion designer. If a dress in the shop window doesn't match your taste, you can change it right away and give it your own look. A steady line of customers is waiting, eager to see what you create next.

Your job is to keep up with them by making fresh designs. The game is played with a mouse or by tapping, so you can dress up and decorate in whichever way suits you best. It's a good pick for anyone who enjoys baby and girl-themed design and fashion play.
animals-guys: Animals Guys is a 2D racing game with an arcade feel and multiplayer play. You pick one of seven different animals to control, then work toward claiming the top one. Each round you need to finish, and along the way you gather crowns that help you climb toward the best animal in the lineup.

Movement works with the WASD keys or the ZQSD layout, so players on either keyboard can jump in. Touch controls are available for mobile, letting you race from a phone or tablet. Choose your favorite critter, keep competing through the rounds, and see how far your crown collection can take you.
skydiving-iron: Step into the role of an iron-suited hero in this 3D flight game, where you manage his every move as he soars across the sky. Your goal is to keep him in one piece by dodging the enemy missiles that come his way. Everything is controlled with the mouse alone, so you only need one hand to fly.

As you play, collect points that go toward improving the hero's own equipment. The game is built with HTML5 and runs right in your browser. It combines avoiding danger, collecting, and flying, and it sits in the Boys category for superhero fans.
shinecool-stunt-motorbike-moto-racing: Plain motorbike racing can feel a little dull, so this 3D stunt game adds some fresh twists to the track. During a race, you can make use of battle moves, rockets, bombs, and a pan. Kicking and attacking rivals is allowed, and knocking opponents out is a big part of the action. Be careful, though, because other riders can strike back at you.
Your aim is to dodge their attacks and win the race. Controls are simple: just tap or click to play. If you enjoy moto racing, this one blends speed with plenty of chaos.
mini-camping-adventure: Mini Camping Adventure invites you into a calm camping simulator where you wander through natural scenery and take part in outdoor pursuits. The game lets you feel what camping is really like, all inside an adventure-style simulation.

You begin in a lovely wild landscape and set off on your own path. Along the way you tackle a range of small tasks, roam around to discover new spots, and express your creativity. Control everything with your mouse by clicking any button you need to move through the game.
magical-unicorn-grooming-world: Your adventure begins with finding a unicorn that will be all yours. First, you clear out her stable so she has a clean place to live. Then you give her a refreshing bath and change her horseshoe, looking after her one step at a time.

Once she is clean and well cared for, you can dress her up and turn her into your very own magical unicorn. The whole game is played with simple mouse clicks or taps, so you can jump right into the grooming and styling. Enjoy watching your unicorn take on her enchanting new look.
trading-master-3d-fidget-pop: Trading Master 3D Fidget Pop is an arcade game about striking good bargains. You play a trading business simulation with 3D objects laid out on a table. Pick the items you want to use in a deal with your rival. A deal works out when the marker lands in the green and yellow zone on the left-hand measurement of the item. Clear every level to finish the game and show off your dealmaking skills.
Controls are simple: tap the screen to play.
miami-taxi-driver-3d: Earn a steady income behind the wheel of a taxi in this racing game set in the inner city of Miami. Your job is to pick up passengers and drop them off at their destinations. Try to keep your cab in one piece, since you want to avoid damaging it along the way.

With more than 90 levels waiting, there is plenty of road to cover. Drive with the WASD keys or the arrow keys, whichever you prefer. Each trip brings you a new set of streets and a new passenger to deliver.
shoot-your-nightmare-space-isolation: You wake up on planet ML-397 in the year 2299, with no memory of who you are or how you got there. The place seems deserted, as if nobody else lives here, and you feel alone. That feeling does not last, because the truth is far more dangerous. This sci-fi horror shooter uses a first-person view and realistic 3D visuals, and only you can stop the apocalypse.

Expect nonstop alien combat and futuristic weapons, with gameplay built on simple controls. W, A, S, and D move you, the mouse looks around, left click fires, and right click aims. The scroll wheel switches weapons, G throws grenades, R reloads, and F picks up items. Shift runs, Ctrl crouches, X
merge-brick: Merge Brick is a puzzle game where you combine blocks of the same type to form a single block. Drag pieces, merge them, and work out the best positions to make the most of your space and reach high scores. Each level offers a new challenge, with difficulty increasing as you progress. Logical thinking and strategy are key, so every move matters.
The gameplay stays simple yet addictive, making it a good pick for quick daily entertainment. Everything is handled with the mouse, so you only need to click and drag your blocks into place.
steveman: Steve is the hero of this 2D adventure, and he needs your help to stay alive. The journey is packed with monsters built from blocks, so dive in right away if that sounds fun. Some foes walk along the ground while others fly overhead, and you must keep an eye on both kinds.

Monsters are not the only danger. Thorny obstacles spin on wheels along the way, adding another hazard to dodge. This is a single-player game, and you can control Steve with the WASD keys or with mobile touch controls.
royal-rebellion-punk-magic: Two determined young heroines turn their backs on dull customs and shape a look of their own, borrowing from the raw spirit of punk rock. The game immerses you in a mood of anarchy and freedom, where medieval tales meet punk rock. You can outfit each character in a black leather dress studded with spikes and rivets, then add bright touches that make her stand out.

Hair is where things get wild. You can style bright, spiky locks or weave braids and frame them with chains and flowers. Makeup completes the look with vivid lips, bold eyeshadow and daring piercings. Everything is controlled with a mouse click on a computer or a simple tap on a touch screen, so you can focus on building energetic, rebellious images.
spring-magic-enchanted-wardrobe: Step into a realm of fairies and centaurs, where two heroines are waiting for you: a centaur princess and a fairy princess, each with a distinct sense of style. Build new looks for them by picking makeup, hairstyles, accessories, and spring outfits inspired by nature. Let your imagination run free and shape your own fairy tale in a world that blends fashion and magic.

Spring has arrived in this magical land, and you take on the role of fashion stylist to make the season bright and memorable. When you finish, you can save your creation as a PNG image. Controls vary depending on the device you are playing on.
street-of-gangs-2d: Step into a retro-style 2D brawler where your martial arts moves are tested against a rowdy street gang. Your fighter draws on karate, taekwondo, Muay Thai, kickboxing, and boxing, so you can show the gang exactly what you can do. Expect close-range trades of punches and kicks, while you also use your body to block and deflect incoming strikes. The gang members are skilled street brawlers, so you will need to stay sharp.

Your toolkit includes punching, striking, catching, throwing, and dodging. Your job is to punch, kick, and smash your way through every opponent until they are all knocked out. Set amid the chaos of a city street, the battle heats up from the first blow. Move with the arrow keys, press Z to punch, X to kick, C to defend, and Space to jump.
lets-kill-jane-the-killer-don-t-go-to-sl: Jane the Killer is no longer much of a threat, though the first ninety seconds of her transformation brought some homicidal urges. She has since calmed down into a sharp-tongued, merciless yet warm-hearted character who is willing to help the forces of evil. When she gets irritated, her powers can make her violent and furious, and she simply has to be stopped.
Your mission is to hunt down eight bottles of liquid hate and then take on Jane herself.
nekomi-recuse: Nekomi Rescue puts you in control of a courageous warrior whose task is to free cats that have been trapped. Along the way you must overcome obstacles and defeat enemies while searching for a safe route that lets you save every kitten. It is an action adventure at heart, and your aim is to rescue all the little cats.

Each level brings a fresh challenge, so you will need quick reflexes as well as careful planning to get through. The gameplay is kept simple, yet it stays absorbing from start to finish. Everything is played with the mouse, so you can get straight into the rescue.
target-hit-shooting-range: Target Hit Shooting Range drops you into a 3D setting that mixes gunplay, aiming, puzzles, and collecting. You take charge of a sharpshooter and line up careful shots to knock down as many targets as you can, all while working with a fixed supply of bullets. Every stage tests how well you judge timing and plan your moves, with tricky puzzle layouts and tense combat situations. Sniper rifles and shotguns are included, and you earn them by collecting rewards during play rather than paying for them.

The game runs offline on a phone or tablet and is light on storage, so it loads and moves smoothly. Controls are simple: click the mouse, swipe, or tap the screen to aim and fire. Keep your focus sharp and you can work your way toward being a true master of the range.
tropical-slasher: Tropical Slasher is a puzzle game where your job is to slice every fruit before it gets away. The blade has to be hooked onto the trees at the sides to make its cuts. Bombs also appear, and hitting one ends the game straight away. The clock is always running, so aim to collect as many points as you can before time is up.

Play with your mouse or by tapping the screen. This fun, skill-based title suits kids and is made with HTML5, so it runs right in your browser. Fans of fruit-themed puzzles will find plenty to keep them busy.
blondie-bride-perfect-wedding-prep: Blondie has said yes, and the big day has finally arrived. In this wedding game, you help her choose an outfit and put on makeup for the special event. Professional makeup products are at your disposal to highlight the bride's natural beauty, and your goal is to make Blondie look dazzling from head to toe.

Playing is simple, since a mouse click or a tap is all you need. The game sits in the girls category and suits fans of decorating, dressing up, and makeover fun. Take your time with each choice to help the bride shine on her wedding day.
pixel-us-red-and-blue-2: Pixel Us Red and Blue 2 is a two-player adventure starring a blue alien and a red alien. Together they must reach the blue and red impostor flag, and doing so earns them the right to pass into a new level. Be careful, because many challenging creatures lie along the way.
Players steer their aliens with WASD or the arrow keys, and both aliens share the same goal. A double jump is also available, giving you an extra bit of height when you need it.
cargo-jeep-racing: Your job in this driving game is to carry your cargo to its destination without dropping any of it. Every bump and bounce tests how carefully you handle the vehicle. It belongs to the racing category and is tagged for multiplayer and trucks, so expect a truck-based race against others.

Steering is simple. Press A or D, or use the left and right arrow keys, to control the truck. To jump, tap W or the up arrow. Keep your balance and your load in one piece as you head for the destination.
pop-fidget: Pop Fidget is a calm, hypercasual clicking game built around pop-it fidget toys. Each bubble you press makes an ASMR popping sound, and the toys come in bright rainbow colors and a range of shapes. You can also explore tik tok-style fidget ideas, so the variety keeps coming.

It's designed to help you unwind and ease stress or anxiety in just a few minutes. The point-and-click controls stay simple, so you can tap away and let the soothing rhythm do the rest. It suits anyone who enjoys sensory toys and wants a quiet break from the day.
endless-castle: Endless Castle is a 3D hypercasual arcade game about balance and bounce. Your ball travels along a narrow wall, and your task is to keep it going through as many zigzag turns as possible. A single tap flips the ball's heading, so timing each tap matters. Steer clear of the drop-offs on either side, because one slip ends the run.
Controls are kept simple: a tap on the screen changes the ball's direction. Keep your timing sharp and see how many zigzags you can chain together before the ball tumbles off an edge.
music-battle-game: Music Battle Game is a rhythm title built around sound and tempo. Your success depends on precise timing, sharp focus, and quick reactions, since those qualities decide who comes out on top. Tap in step with the beat, and push yourself to test your abilities as the rhythm picks up speed.
Your aim is to grow into a top music champion. Every button is operated with a mouse, so a single click is all it takes to select any option. See how far your sense of rhythm can carry you.
head-ball-merge-puppet-soccer: In this football merge game, you combine players to build your squad. Buy heroes, score goals, and collect tokens along the way. As your soccer team grows, you can climb toward the top of the leaderboard. A coach boosts the speed and performance of your players.

animal-daycare-game: Animal Daycare Game lets you run your own daycare center filled with adorable pets. This simulation feels warm and gentle, and your job is to look after each little animal and show it plenty of affection. You can serve meals, wash and tidy up your guests, and spend time playing together so that everyone stays cheerful.

All of the actions are handled with your mouse, since every button is clicked with a single press. Simply point at the option you want and click to carry out the task. Keep an eye on your furry visitors and make sure none of them feels left out or unhappy as the day goes on.
arrow-jamescape: Arrow JamEscape asks for strong focus. Each arrow on the board slides in the direction it points, and your job is to tap the arrows so they leave without bumping into one another. You keep going until every arrow is gone. A special golden arrow sits among them, and if you can guide it off the board, you win the round. The challenge is not only about careful thinking, though, because the clock is running. Each attempt gives you just 1 minute to finish. Every mistake takes away one heart, and you start each level with only 3 hearts.

Playing is simple: click with your mouse or tap the screen. Everything else depends on how quickly you read the board and choose which arrow to move next. Keep an eye on the timer and protect your hearts, since a few bad taps can end the level early. Fans of the Clicker and Casual tags will likely feel at home with its quick, one-touch controls and its steady build of pressure.
moto-rush: Moto Rush challenges you to build a high score by riding a motorbike in 3D for as long as you can keep going. Along the way, you can soar over ramps, collect speed boosts that push you forward faster, and work to avoid crashing. Lasting longer is the whole point of this high score game.

Controlling your rider is straightforward. Touch the screen and hold to drive, then keep holding to pull off flips in the air. Balancing jumps, boosts, and flips while staying in one piece is the heart of the challenge.
basketball-swooshes: Basketball Swooshes is a one-on-one basketball game in which you face a single opponent. Winning depends on being quicker and more precise than your rival, so you need to move fast and place your shots carefully. On a phone or tablet, touch the screen and drag to aim, then lift your finger to send the ball. Pay attention to your angle, since a well-judged throw can make the difference against a quick opponent.
animal-fashion-hair-salon: Little ones can dive into a jungle-themed hair adventure in this follow-up to our popular salon game. real-garbage-truck: In this browser game, you guide a garbage truck along highways and through city streets, handling the heavy vehicle the way a professional truck driver would. stickdoll-god-of-archery: Stickdoll: God of Archery pits Flame, who commands the power of fire, and Gargle, who commands the power of poison, against Ophelia, the figure of goodness in the Stickdoll universe. pop-it-coloring-book: Pop It Coloring Book is an online coloring game you can enjoy for free. Inside, you color pictures of pop it toys and a variety of shapes. horseshoeing: You run your own horse stable in this 3D hypercasual game, and your job is to keep your horses feeling good and active. Everyday barn life becomes a set of short mini-games. You might clean and shoe hooves, brush their hair, take them out for rides, play with them, and plenty more.

To finish each mini-game, hold down the left mouse button or press your finger, following the instructions that appear on screen. It is a single-player title, tagged for boys and girls who enjoy animals and horses.
baby-taylor-sushi-cooking: Every day, Taylor's mother cooks dinner for her, and the meals are almost always homemade. Today is different, because the two of them are preparing something special: sushi. Sushi is a traditional Japanese dish, most often made with rice and raw fish. Its fresh, cool taste has made it more and more popular over time.

In this game, you join Taylor and her mom as they learn to make several different kinds of sushi. You play with simple mouse clicks or taps. The game invites you to cook alongside them, one dish at a time.
seaweed-aqua: Seaweed Aqua is a calm puzzle game set on the ocean floor, where your job is to pull apart seashells that have become tangled in rubber bands. Watch closely, then free them one at a time in the right sequence, since the wrong move can tie things up even more. Every stage presents a new arrangement, and the challenge grows as you move along, so logic and patience will serve you well.
The game is easy to pick up and hard to put down, with bright underwater scenery that makes each session pleasant. All you need is your mouse to control the action.
multigun-arena-3d-zombie-survival: MultiGun Arena 3D Zombie Survival is a free online multiplayer shooter set in a large open globe. After leaping from a survival plane onto a dead island, players start unarmed and spread out, so they must find weapons and items to remove their challengers. Movement uses WASD, while the mouse lets you look around and shoot, and the scroll wheel swaps guns. Tab opens the menu, Q and E handle gun attachments and camo, and Enter opens chat. Each battle helps you sharpen your shooting abilities and test new PvP tactics.
city-taxi: City Taxi is a three-dimensional adventure set in a busy metropolis, where you take on the role of a cab driver. Your job is to pick up riders and deliver every passenger to the spot marked on the map. The game offers pleasing visuals and several levels to work through.

Steer your taxi with the W, A, S and D keys. Tap the Space bar to engage the handbrake when you need to slow or turn sharply. Press Escape at any time to pause or resume your run. Built with Unity3D for the web, the game is tagged with driving, taxi, WebGL and Unity3D.
love-pins-online: Today should be a joyful one for a pair of lovers heading out on a date, yet their path is blocked by many obstacles. Your job is to use the available tools to get rid of the villains and bring the two together. Each stage asks you to think carefully about how to clear the way, so this is a good pick if you enjoy puzzles that reward a clever mind.

The game is played with a mouse click or a tap on the screen, which keeps the controls simple to pick up. It is a 3D puzzle game with an animal theme, and it is listed under brain games for boys and girls alike. Can you guide the couple safely to each other? Give Love Pins a go and see how far you can get.
paw-puppy-kid-subway-surfers-runner: Puppy Dog Runner: Decorate Home is a running game starring puppies. You can build and decorate a house at no cost. Rooms such as the living room and bedroom, along with many others, are yours to arrange, and you can style everything to match your taste.

Start by choosing your favorite puppy, since his pals and other dogs will appear in future updates. Press start, then jump and dodge obstacles while collecting gold. Use that gold to build a house for your puppy dog, and keep gathering more as the home takes shape.
super-burger-2: You run a burger shop where plenty of customers come in hungry for a good meal. Your job is to get each burger order out on time. There is also a time trial mode that challenges you to beat your own high score by preparing as many burgers as possible. The whole game is played with only the mouse, so every order is handled with simple clicks.
adorable-girls-valentino-fashion: Two inseparable friends have heard about a brand-new contest, and they have decided to try out the latest Valentino fashion trends. Your job is to lend them a hand and make sure they enjoy the experience. The game sits in the Girls category, so it is a good fit for anyone who likes this kind of theme.
Everything is controlled with the mouse alone, so there are no other inputs to learn. You can jump right in and start helping. The main idea is simple: support the pair and have fun along the way.
hangman: Hangman is a word puzzle that leans toward the tricky side. Your job is to work out each hidden word one letter at a time. Every wrong guess adds another piece to the little stickman, so you need to solve the word before he is fully strung up. The word list covers many different terms, giving you plenty of variety to work through. See how many of them you can crack.
Tap to begin, and the first word will appear right away, ready for your first guess.
mr-tomato-vs-zombies: Some jealous zombies have snatched a group of little tomatoes, and it's up to Mr Tomato to get them back. regular-agents-2: Regular Agents 2 is an arcade game for two players who work together to get through each stage. Your duo faces a series of obstacles while collecting eggs, and the aim is to pass each level. The cast is made up of hedgehogs and jays, and the whole experience is played in 2D.

angry-chickens: Angry Chickens is an arcade game about birds that have no love for each other. Each chicken wants to grow as large as it can, and you steer your own bird through a harsh environment to make that happen. Getting longer means eating the other chickens around you.

master-blender: Take on the role of a skilled bartender, where every drink you prepare marks a new step in the game. It is more than a simple pastime. It is a puzzle journey built around sorting, matching, and solving, so each stage asks you to think through how the pieces fit together.

gun-master-3d: Gun Master 3D is a single-player 3D shooter where you draw from a large arsenal to take on swarms of enemies. Your aim is to survive these hordes, and doing so unlocks new guns to try.

tank-parking-3d-sim: Tank Parking 3D Sim mixes precise parking with tank combat. Its Classic mode starts you off with obstacle courses where you guide different military tank types through a base. charge-through-racing: Charge Through Racing casts you as a driver on a car stunt assignment. Each level asks you to pick up gold coins while getting past the obstacles in your path. princess-coloring-book-glitter: Princess Coloring Book Glitter brings royal illustrations to life with a sparkly touch. pet-doctor-caring-game: You take on the role of a caring pet doctor, helping sweet animals that are hurt or unwell feel better. pumpkin-monster: Pumpkin Monster is a relaxing game built around one simple idea: giving a pumpkin a good kick. It works well as a way to let off steam after a long day. angry-granny-run-india: Your job in this 3D runner is to help a speedy granny get away from a psychiatric hospital as quickly as you can. santa-rush: Santa is dashing across a winter landscape, and it is your job to keep him moving as far as he can go. Keep him away from slippery ice, since a fall ends the run. park-your-wheels: Park Your Wheels is a puzzle game built around getting a car into its parking spot. It has 30 levels, and each one is packed with tricky puzzles that make the spot harder to reach than it first looks. Your job is to work out how to park the vehicle in each layout.

draw-the-bridge: In this arcade game, your task is to sketch a path that the vehicles can travel along. You draw by tapping the screen, so each tap shapes the route ahead of them.

sweet-bite-idle-game: Sweet Bite Idle Game is a calm, easygoing tycoon adventure where you run your own sweet business from the ground up. alien-invasion: Earth is under threat in Alien Invasion, an online arcade shooter where a hostile alien force has arrived and your job is to defend the planet. hard-wheels-2: Hard Wheels 2 puts you in control of a heavy off-road vehicle that has to get past many tough obstacles. Keeping the monster truck balanced matters just as much as moving forward. tomato-bounce: Guide a cheery tomato from platform to platform with just one tap. Press and hold to charge your power, then aim and release to send it flying. dora-happy-easter-differences: Dora Happy Easter Differences is a puzzle game built around Dora the Explorer, with an Easter theme. amazing-bubble-connect: In this arcade puzzle game, you connect bubbles that share a color to collect points. draw-love-story: Draw Love Story is a free drawing puzzle aimed at boys, offering plenty of entertainment. time-of-adventure-finn: Time of Adventure Finn is a legendary adventure game that sends you across a snowy land. car-parking-pro: This hardcore 3D action title is a car parking simulator built for players who trust their driving skills. police-vehicles: Police Vehicles is a puzzle game built around six pictures of police cars and other emergency vehicles. happy-balls: Happy Balls is a fun puzzle built around love-struck balls. Its approach feels fresh and unusual: two balls are drawn to each other, and your job is to help the male ball reach his girlfriend. Expect to use your brain as you work out how to get the pair together.

block-push-game: Block Push Game is a logic puzzle built around nudging blocks into their correct places. cut-it-all-challenge: In Cut It All Challenge!, you slice everything into equal pieces. Only a split of 53% and 47% clears the current level. To make a cut, use the mouse to draw a line across the object.
christmas-bricks: Christmas Bricks is a holiday twist on the classic brick-breaking formula, with festive visual effects added throughout. Your job is to bounce a ball off a paddle and clear the wall of bricks. Levels are plentiful and get harder as you go. Each time you destroy every brick, Santa rewards you with coins. You can spend those coins on boosters, such as the Fire Ball, to help you through tougher stages.

To move the paddle, slide your finger or mouse left and right. On a desktop computer, the arrow keys do the same job. The game fits well into a short break, and the Arcade, Clicker and Casual tags reflect its simple, pick-up-and-play feel.
silent-asylum: You are locked inside a quiet asylum, where dark corridors are crowded with frightening monsters. Your task is to shoot your way through these shadowy halls and gather every key so you can unlock the exit. It is a 3D shooter built for one player, so you face the horrors alone.

Move with W, A, S and D, and fire with the left mouse button. Scroll the mouse wheel to switch weapons, press R to reload, and press C to crouch. Use the space bar to jump, and press P to pause the game.
two-wheel-stunts-super-car: Two Wheel Stunts SupeR Car is a racing game in which you handle a car as it travels across sloped terrain. The main challenge is driving through the corners of each slope, so your car has to tackle every one of them along the way.

Score matters here, and the game rewards players who refuse to skip any slope, since skipping one keeps your total from climbing high. Movement is simple, because the W, A, S, and D keys control how the car drives. It sits in the racing category and is tagged with car and driving.
stick-merge: Stick Merge is a casual action game built around merging. Your job is to join different kinds of weapons together so you end up with more powerful guns. Those upgraded firearms are then turned on moving stick figures at a shooting range.

Building up your arsenal comes first, and your pistol can be upgraded along the way. Explore every power-up you come across. The goal is to earn the title of best shooter in town, and the game leaves you to discover just how strong your guns can become.
wild-wolves: In Wild Wolves, you play a wolf on its way to becoming the alpha of its family. Your duty is to lead like a true leader, protecting your pack and making sure it gets fed. This adventure asks you to grow into that responsibility one step at a time.

The game offers multiple levels and graphics that look good on screen. Steer your wolf with W, A, S and D, and press Space to jump or attack. Keep your pack protected and fed as you move through each level.
gorilla-monster-fight: Gorilla Monster Fight puts you in charge of a strong gorilla running through a jungle. Steer your gorilla with the mouse, moving left or right to dodge trouble. Grab bananas along the way to push your score higher, but watch out for hurdles and enemies that block your path. The pace keeps picking up, and the challenges get tougher the longer you last.

This is a test of quick reactions, where the goal is to survive as long as you can and top your previous best. The game runs smoothly and features bright, colorful graphics along with controls that are easy to pick up. Players of all ages should be able to jump right in and enjoy the run.
smash-cars: Smash Cars puts you on a track where you go head to head with some of the top drivers around. Your job is to steer clear of obstacles and other threats that crop up along the way. Expect the whole road to be scattered with traps, so you will need to weave out of their path to stay in the race.

The game is played entirely with your mouse, so there are no keyboard keys to learn. It is a 3D racing title built on HTML5, which means it runs right inside your browser. Keep your eyes on the road ahead and react quickly as you dodge what lies in front of you.
stickman-heroes-fight-super-stick-warrio: You play as a Super Stick Warrior who takes on a dark stickman across a city. Your aim is to gather as much cash as you can along the way. The streets are in a rough state: people on foot never step aside for you, and the cops open fire with live bullets.
Steering your stickman is simple, since you can use a mouse or your finger. The game sits in the Adventure category and also carries the Action, Defense and .io tags.
puzzle-draw: Puzzle Draw asks you to sketch the outlines of the pieces each picture needs. Every drawing is a puzzle, and once you work out what it calls for, the game colors and fills in the rest so the picture is complete and you move on to the next challenge. The drawings are often funny, but solving them depends on logic and lateral thinking.

Hints are there if you get stuck, though you may be annoyed with yourself for peeking at them. The controls are simple: use your finger to draw and outline each shape, then watch the game do the coloring. It is a single-player 2D puzzle game with a drawing focus, and its tags list it as one aimed at kids.
mermaid-cake-cooking-design: Ariel hopes to enter a contest for sweet creations, and this round's theme is mermaids. She will do her best to prepare the treat. Baking is simple, but the decorating takes more thought. If you help her pick the right decorations, she will have a better chance of winning the top prize.
Playing takes only a mouse click or a tap. The game also mentions a drink to enjoy alongside the cake, so you can finish the treat together with Ariel.
fat-fit-3d: Fat Fit 3D is a sports game built around a splashy water challenge. It highlights how much a healthy body matters to everyone, and how diet and exercise both shape whether we stay fit. As you run along the course, you need to clear basic obstacles to reach the finish line, and you earn rewards when you get there.

The path is packed with tempting treats, and grabbing a few too many could slow you down enough to miss the end. Move carefully and think about each choice you make. Use a sliding motion to move your runner.
chef-twins-summer-dessert-cooking: In this cooking game, you join George and Emma, two young twins who are both good chefs. Today they each prepare a dessert for a summer dessert contest. George believes colorful desserts are the most appealing to children in summer, while Emma feels that a cool feeling matters most of all.

Throughout the game, you can follow the complete process of making each dessert and learn the recipe along the way. Decorating is part of the fun as well. To play, just use a mouse click or tap the screen.
foot-doctor-hospital-game: Foot Doctor Hospital puts you in the role of a foot specialist working in a hospital. It is a medical simulation, so you get a feel for the work of treating patients who have all sorts of foot problems. Each patient arrives with a different issue for you to examine and handle.
Every button is clicked with the mouse, so that is the only control you need. The game is listed under casual and puzzle titles, and it is meant to be fun to work through one case after another.
tricky-impossible-tracks-car-stunt-racin: Step into the role of a stuntman in this 3D racing game, where pulling off daring moves behind the wheel is the main goal. You start by driving a fast car across tricky courses that test your nerve. The vehicles are built for mid-air stunts, so every jump depends on good timing.

Rivals race alongside you, keeping the pressure on as you tackle each track. Use WASD to drive and press Space to brake when you need to slow down. Prove your skills by mastering each run and earning the title of a true car stunt hero. The game runs in your browser using HTML5 and WebGL.
princess-super-spy: Here you dress up a princess who moonlights as a super spy. She is prepared for tough situations, and her wardrobe suits the demanding routine of a special agent. She can wear tactical overalls designed for different kinds of ground. When she needs to blend in, her closet also offers everyday office clothes and a stylish dress.

The game works with the left mouse button or with touch controls, so you can use a mouse or a touchscreen. Each look helps get her ready for a covert assignment. Switching between rugged field gear and polished city outfits is part of the fun, and the whole experience is built around preparing her for a secret mission.
amazing-bubble-breaker: Looking for a real test of skill? This 2D bubble puzzler offers three difficulty settings: easy, medium, and hard. Casual players can start gently, while those who want a tougher challenge can move up. The gameplay keeps the classic fun of a bubble-breaking game, so it stays entertaining from the first round onward.

Four visual themes let you change how the game looks, and two backgrounds give the playing area a different feel. In-game statistics show how you are doing as you play, and an online ranking system lets you compare your results with other players. It is a simple, friendly way to enjoy a puzzle game at your own pace.
princess-ariel-fitness-plan: Summer is just around the corner, and Princess Ariel has her heart set on a beach vacation. The problem is that she has overindulged and put on a few extra pounds. Arriving at the shore with that extra weight is far from ideal, so she needs a quick turnaround. A good eating plan can help, but a skilled, demanding coach can make a real difference too, and that coach is you.
