As the trainer, you decide which workout mode she follows, which exercises she performs, and what healthy meals she eats. The games offer a variety of fitness challenges to keep things fresh. Controls are simple: just click with your mouse or tap the screen to play.
tank-attack: Tank Attack is a shooting game where your goal is to take out every enemy tank on the battlefield. Keep an eye on your tank's health, since it decides how long you can keep fighting. You have three ways to attack: a standard gun, a machine gun, and a napalm bomb. Walls are there to shelter you, so duck behind them when things get dangerous.
Move with the arrow keys and use the mouse to aim and fire. Each shot needs careful timing and positioning, so think before you act. Clear the field of rival tanks to win.
baby-taylor-spring-allergy: Taylor adores pretty flowers, so every spring she visits the park with her friend Jessica to enjoy them. One outing takes an unwelcome turn when Taylor suddenly gets a spring allergy. Rashes break out across her skin and leave her feeling very uncomfortable.
You take on the role of her doctor and must cure her allergy. The key rule is to keep the rashes from leaving scars on her face or body. The game is played with a mouse click or tap.
super-car-stunts: Super Car Stunts is a racing browser game built around daring car tricks. You rev up your vehicle inside a 3D setting filled with demanding stunt courses. Lively animations and real-time driving make every run feel dynamic, and there are plenty of car stunts to attempt along the way.

Your goals are to stay on the track, land your jumps at precisely the right moment, and complete each challenge. Use W, A, S and D to move, and press Shift to activate nitro. Handle these runs well and you can grow into a skilled driver in the stunts arena.
slenderman-must-die-underground-bunker-2: Set deep inside a military underground bunker, this single-player adventure sends you searching for eight tables that hold details about Slenderman. The military once struck a bargain with him: they would bring him victims, and in return he would grant them the strength of the dark realm. Your job is to uncover real proof and put an end to Slenderman along with his helpers.

Controls are straightforward. Use W, A, S and D to move and the mouse to look around. Left click fires, right click aims, and the scroll wheel switches weapons. Press R to reload and F to pick up items. Hold Left Shift to run, Left Ctrl to crouch, X to go prone, and Space to jump. Expect plenty of shooting and zombies along the way.
ultra-crash-car-simulator-2026: Ultra Crash Car Simulator 2026 is a single-player 3D racing game built around lifelike crashes. Damage is modeled in detail, so each vehicle reacts to impacts in its own way. You can pick from several cars and jeeps, then explore open-world maps. Fans of smashing vehicles, severe collisions, and true-to-life driving will find plenty to enjoy here.

Controls are simple. Press W or the Up Arrow to move forward, S or the Down Arrow to move back, and A or D (or the Left and Right Arrows) to move sideways. Buttons on screen are clicked with the mouse. Step on the pedal and let every trip spiral into total mayhem.
cookie-rush: Cookie Rush is a puzzle game where you trade places between candies to line up three or more in a row, setting off blasts. Each group of three matching candies earns you points. Lining up four creates a special candy, and these can be used to gain special advantages. Every stage asks you to complete a mission within a set number of moves. Missions and obstacles change as you go, so each level brings something different to handle.
stunt-car-driving-pro: Stunt Car Driving Pro puts you behind the wheel and challenges you to go as fast as you can while performing a variety of stunts. Your route features loops, sliders, and sloppy roads, so you will need to keep your speed up and stay in control through each section. Every attempt gives you another shot at the stunts.

Getting around is simple. Use the arrow keys or the W, A, S, and D keys to move your car. Both sets of controls work, so you can choose whichever feels more comfortable. Once you have the basics down, the challenge is timing your moves through each stunt while keeping the car steady.
pixel-forces: Pixel Forces is a tough 3D online shooter for multiplayer matches. Players pick from five multiplayer modes and several maps, and they can change how their character looks. Each level is built like a tall maze with trampolines that help you bounce between sections. You can set up your own room and invite others to join, or step into a room that someone has already opened.

Moving around uses the WASD keys or the arrow keys, and the Space bar makes you jump. Hold the right mouse button to aim and press the left button to fire. In night mode, the L key switches your flashlight on and off. Press Esc or Tab at any time to pause the game.
kart-karting-puzzle: Six pictures make up this jigsaw game, and every one of them features the same anime girl with her kart. Your goal is to complete each puzzle, which is a good way to keep your brain sharp. Each picture comes in four modes, with 16, 36, 64, or 100 pieces, so you can start small or take on a bigger challenge.

This HTML5 browser game is played with the mouse. Pick a picture, choose a piece count, and work through the puzzles until all six are solved. It is a car-themed game, with the kart at the center of every image.
subway-egyptian: Subway Egyptian is an endless running and racing game set in subway cities, including Cairo in Egypt and New York. You rush as fast as you can while riding buses and scooters through the underground streets. The cast includes male runners as well as graceful princess characters. The main character is a cat who lives in an alley and faces the street dangers, with a guard dog of the streets among its challenges.

The game offers HD graphics, several locations, special characters, and bonus characters that appear as surprises. Mission modes are packed with action, and special abilities and powers can be developed. Daily tasks bring surprise gifts, bonus gifts appear in the game, and the game is available in several languages. Controls use the mouse or the arrow keys.
soldier-shooting: Soldier Shooting puts you in charge of special forces troops who must take down a group of dangerous thugs. You can move with flexibility, line up precise shots, and make smart use of the surrounding terrain to get the upper hand. Every level feels tense, so quick reflexes and careful planning both matter.

The gameplay is simple, yet it delivers an action-packed combat experience that keeps you engaged. The whole game is played with the mouse. It suits anyone who enjoys army-themed shooters with a bit of adventure mixed in.
amazing-sticky-hex: Sticky Hex is a single-player puzzle game built around hexagon blocks. It works as a brain trainer for anyone who wants a fresh challenge, and its levels get your mind working through shape and tile matching. Pick a level to start, then slide each hexa block onto the correct spot until every block on the board is filled.

Because the game asks you to read the layout before you move, it rewards careful planning. Think through your options before placing a piece, and try to clear the board in fewer moves to advance. It is one of the more difficult shape matching games, and it offers a relaxing way to spend free time while sharpening your focus.
run-blue-imposter-run: Run Blue Impostor Run puts you in charge of the blue impostor, and your job is to help it survive. Flying creatures are very dangerous, so stay alert whenever they appear overhead. The adventure spans 22 levels, and the hazards you face grow with every difficulty level you reach.

Movement uses the W, A, S and D keys. Enemies can show up at any point, so watch them closely as you move. You can climb on top of monsters to kill them, and double jump is available to help you get past tricky spots. This 2D action game is a one-player arcade title for Android devices.
cake-masters: Cake Masters puts you in charge of a brand-new cake shop, so you can practice baking and running a store at the same time. If you are unsure how to keep customers happy with their treats, this game lets you test ideas in a relaxed setting. You can set up a pretend bakery and work your way toward making tasty cakes, with the game guiding you along the way.

Everything is played with a mouse. Use left-click to select ingredients, tools, and menu options as you go. The game mixes cooking, shopping, and puzzle-style challenges, so it appeals to fans of management and baking alike. Its tags also point to a playful, funny tone throughout.
master-hole-battle: You steer a black hole that keeps growing as it swallows troops, pulling in orange stickmen to swell your force. Swipe across the screen to move it, since every control uses just one finger. Your growing crowd can then charge into red hordes and crush them across the battlefield. Giant bosses wait as well, including a meme-style Skibidi Toilet.
sweet-baby-girl-christmas: Sweet Baby Girl and her closest pals are busy preparing for the festive season in this Christmas game set in Santa's village. Along the way you can bake ginger cookies, dress Santa up, enjoy a round at the Santa spa, and make frozen ice sculptures. Rudolph the reindeer also needs rescuing, and several more holiday tasks are waiting to be discovered. The game sits in the Girls category and is tagged with cleaning, cooking, decoration, design, dress up, and fun.

Controls are simple: use a mouse or tap the screen to play. Each activity gives you a different job to complete, so there is always something new to try in the village. Whether you enjoy cooking, decorating, or dressing up, this title brings all of those jobs together in one holiday adventure.
perfect-jump-puzzle-game: Perfect Jump tests your reflexes and sense of timing. You guide a ball across a route of floating blocks, where every leap must be well judged. Quick decisions and careful aim decide whether your run carries on or ends in a fall.

The world never ends, so the path keeps stretching ahead, and each block brings its own challenge. Tap or click to make the ball hop from block to block, timing each jump so you land on the next one. Dodge obstacles and gaps, earn points for every successful jump, and try to beat your records. The controls are simple enough for players of any skill level, but getting really good takes finesse and practice.
popular-spa-salon-wax-and-spa-fascinatin: You now run this spa salon, and the girls who visit want to change the way they look. It's your chance to show your talent and professional skills as you work with each client. Every visit lets you shape someone's appearance from start to finish.
This hypercasual dress-up and makeover game is a fun HTML5 title that runs in your browser. Control is simple: tap or click is all you need to move through each step of the makeover.
crazy-car-parking-stunts: Crazy Car Parking Stunts is a racing title that offers a lifelike driving simulator experience. You get behind the wheel of supercars and sports cars to practice parking. The game is meant to build your driving skills and take them up a level.

The game teaches a variety of parking techniques using its supercars and sports cars, and a video walkthrough is available to show the action first. To control your car, use the WASD keys to drive. Push gear up to start the engine and get moving.
doll-dress-up-game: Dress up a doll with a wide range of clothing, hairstyles, accessories, and makeup. Mix and match pieces to build looks for any occasion, whether that means a relaxed day out or a glamorous evening party. Bright, colorful visuals make every change feel lively.

Controls are simple: a mouse click or a tap is all you need to pick items and make changes. Because it is easy to learn, players of every age who love fashion and creative design can jump right in. Let your imagination guide you as you shape the doll into a true fashion designer.
tortas: Tortas are a popular sandwich from Mexico, and this cooking game lets you prepare one. Each sandwich is large and packed with flavor, served on a crusty white roll called a bolillo or a telera. A telera is a soft, round bread, so you'll be working with that style of roll too. The filling combines grilled chicken, refried beans, and avocado relish, all bursting with Mexican flavors.

Making these sandwiches is quick and simple, and they are just as easy to eat once they're finished. Playing only takes a click or a tap, so anyone can jump right in. It's a family-friendly pick for fans of food and cooking games.
the-route-digger: The Route Digger is a single-player puzzle game with arcade and clicker elements. Across its 20 challenging levels, your main goal is to send the ball into a tunnel. Obstacles get in the way, but the controls are easy to pick up, so anyone can get going quickly.

To carve a route, click and drag the mouse to remove the sand. Each level asks you to clear a path through the sand so the ball can reach the tunnel. It is a fun challenge, so take your time and enjoy working out each route.
drag-racing: You step into the seat of a drag racer in a flat world, where regular night races are the main event. Each race lets you test your skills against other cars and see how your machine performs. This online racing game runs on fuelled cars, so every run is a fresh test of speed and control.
Everything is handled with your mouse alone, so you can concentrate on driving from the start. Car lovers and racing fans alike can jump straight into the action with this browser-based title.
crossy-miners: Crossy Miners is an arcade game with gameplay similar to a classic hopping game, themed around mining. You dodge goblins, hop across logs, and steer clear of mining wagons while collecting coins. Lingering in one spot too long is a mistake, because it will catch up with you. The coins you gather can be spent to unlock new characters.

The controls are simple. Use the arrow keys to move sideways or forward, and avoid standing in the path of approaching goblins or other incoming objects. A gamepad is also supported, and tapping to click works as an alternative. This 3D single-player title belongs to the hypercasual category and carries the .io Games tag.
amsterdam-truck-garbage-gm: Amsterdam Truck Garbage GM puts you behind the wheel of a garbage truck in a realistic driving simulation set in the city of Amsterdam. Your job is to roam the streets, pick up trash from different spots around town, and haul it to the drop-off point. Time is limited, so you need to hurry between pickups. Be careful, though: if you crash into buildings or other vehicles, the mission is failed.
Driving is handled with the W, A, S, and D keys. Use them to steer and move your truck as you collect the garbage and deliver it to the point.
weight-adjust-game: Weight Adjust Game is a puzzle where you balance weights so that each level can be solved. The stages grow trickier as you go, so you will need to think ahead and work out the right moves. Success depends on a mix of logic, good timing, and a clear plan for each stage.

Every button in the game is clicked with a mouse. Balancing the weights correctly and cracking the harder levels both call for careful thought, so the game rewards players who take their time and test their ideas step by step.
design-dollhouse-for-princess: Princess Nana recently picked up a fresh duplex home, and now it needs a complete makeover. Your job is to work out how to decorate and dress up the house. Try out different ideas until you have designed a duplex room that feels just right to you.
This 2D puzzle game has dress-up, girl and princess themes. Everything is controlled with simple clicks. Experiment as much as you like and enjoy shaping the space your own way.
tiles-layer: Tiles Layer is a puzzle game built around planning and strategy. You steer your route with the mouse, laying down tiles one at a time as you head for the goal. Each step you take adds to your trail, so it pays to think ahead before you move.

Once you arrive at the end point, you click to drop the first tile and set off a chain reaction. Every tile has to fall in sequence all the way to the finish for you to win. If even one tile gets left behind, the level is lost and you need to try again.
tailor-kids: Step into the world of fashion, style, and design with this browser game, where you run a dressmaking salon. Your job is to meet the needs of each customer who comes in. Then you improve their looks with stylish makeovers.
Playing is simple, since you control everything with a mouse or by tapping the screen. Along the way you get to explore design ideas and see how a salon works from behind the counter.
candy-blocks: Candy Blocks is a puzzle game that is easy to pick up but hard to put down. Your task is to slide the blocks around so they fill the empty tiles, and along the way you gather block pieces that help you advance to higher levels. It is a good workout for your thinking skills. Everything is handled with the mouse, so you simply click and move the blocks where they need to go.

The game is listed under the Action category and carries the tags Boy, Girl, and Puzzle. Even though it is labeled as action, its core play is all about planning your moves carefully and solving each board one step at a time. Whether you enjoy quick, light challenges or slower, thoughtful problem solving, this title offers a straightforward experience that rewards patience and sharp thinking.
lol-surprise-insta-party-divas: The LOL girls have heard about a surprise Insta party, and they plan to try out some new trends there. First, though, they need a helping hand to look perfect. Your job is to browse the girls' wardrobe and choose outfits and costumes for them. Before that, you can pick a cute makeover for each girl.
This is a girls dress up and makeover game built with HTML5, and it uses only a left mouse button click for its controls.
pancakes-balance: In Pancakes Balance, your job is to build a stack of pancakes. Getting each one to sit neatly on top of the others is harder than it sounds, but with a steady hand you can succeed. Each attempt gives you a chance to set a new personal best, so you can keep working toward a better score.

This hypercasual arcade title suits kids and casual players who want a light break from their usual games. It is controlled entirely with the mouse, so there is nothing extra to learn. Pick it up whenever you want some fun and a change from the everyday routine.
tasty-jewels: Tasty Jewels is a playful match-3 puzzle game. To clear each level, swipe to line up matching jewel candies so they pop off the board.

When a board stops giving you moves, boosters are there to get you unstuck. The game offers plenty of tricky stages to work through, and you can keep matching jewels and candies from one to the next. It's a light, cheerful pick for anyone who enjoys puzzles like this.
ww1-battle-simulator: This 3D battle simulator drops you into a World War One conflict. The fighting has just begun, and your job is to battle your way through it and save the world. Winning will depend on careful strategy and smart tactics, so think ahead before you act.
Forget about muddy trenches, because this battlefield is all about tanks and gu
dinosaurs-scary-teeth-puzzle: Dinosaurs Scary Teeth Puzzle is a free online game from the world of puzzle and jigsaw games. It includes six jigsaw puzzles, which you complete in order, beginning with the first image and then moving on to the next. Every picture can be played on one of three difficulty levels: Easy, Medium, or Hard.

The whole game is controlled with the mouse, so no extra equipment is needed. Its dinosaur theme makes it a lighthearted choice for anyone who enjoys prehistoric creatures. Take your time with each picture and enjoy working through the full set.
drift-racer-2021: Drift Racer 2021 puts you behind the wheel for a racing challenge across 20 levels. You can choose from several car skins to change how your ride looks. The game is built around drifting, so expect plenty of sliding turns as you tear around each track.

Control is handled with the WASD keys or the arrow keys, so you can choose whichever set feels more comfortable. Between the 20 levels and the range of car skins, there is a lot of fun to be had behind the wheel.
kingdom-of-ninja-7: Kingdom of Ninja 7 is the final entry in the Kingdom of Ninja series, and it brings the most extreme challenges and levels the series has offered. Its stages are far harder than anything before them, so you should expect a demanding ride from start to finish. This is the toughest game in the series, and it can wear you out quickly. Keep a close eye on monsters, balls, cannonballs and sharp thorns, since each one can hit you.

It is a single-player 2D arcade adventure with action gameplay, and it runs on Android. Press Z to jump and use the arrow keys to move. On mobile devices, touch controls take over both jumping and movement.
real-simulator-monster-truck: Real Simulator: Monster Truck is a 3D driving game built around monster trucks. You can take the wheel of any of its 10 trucks and roam four open maps called Forest, Desert, Hill, and Moon, where free driving is always available. Along the way you can buy new vehicles and develop them through a development system.

If you want something more structured, Racing mode pits you against artificial intelligence opponents, while Stunt mode asks you to drive monster trucks along its stunt roads. Together, the two modes offer 12 levels. Drive with the arrow keys or WASD, press N for nitro, and press C to switch the camera view.
mechanic-master-run: Mechanic Master Run is a well-liked puzzle game with simple gameplay. You control it by sliding to move, and as you go, you gather the parts scattered along the way. Each level has a target, and you pass it by collecting the same parts that the target shows. Don't worry too much, but you will fail unless you collect none of them.
The game is tagged for collecting, avoiding, running and platform play. It is aimed at kids and can be played on mobile devices.
multi-storey-modern-car-parking-2019: Put your driving skills to the test in this browser game, where you must find a parking spot and line up a perfect park. The challenge takes place in a parking garage spread across several floors, and it is built with difficulty levels in mind. It is a bit like a parking frenzy, and the game is designed to humble anyone who thinks they have already mastered tricky parking. Expect to sharpen your precision as you maneuver through a busy public lot.
Controls are simple. Use W, A, S and D to drive, press the spacebar to brake, and tap L to switch your lights on or off.
clone-ball-rush: Clone Ball Rush blends dodging with collecting in an arcade-style game built around 3D models and platform tracks. As you move along the course, green walls boost your group by enlarging or adding to your balls, while red walls shrink it by reducing or taking away balls. Your goal is to clear each level by getting at least one ball across the finish flag.

Controls are simple: slide to play. Keep an eye on the wall colors, since each one changes how many balls you have to work with. Keeping your group moving toward the finish is the heart of the challenge.
draw-legion: Draw Legion asks you to raise your own army and send it out to defeat an invading enemy. As the game goes on, you work to strengthen your forces, with the aim of becoming an excellent king. Your soldiers are at the heart of every battle, so the kingdom's fate rests on how well you build and improve them.

This hypercasual title carries puzzle and skill tags, so you can expect a mix of problem-solving and careful play. It is a fitting pick for anyone who enjoys shaping an army from the ground up and watching it grow stronger. Keep your forces in good shape, and see how well you can rule when an invasion is at your door.
penguin-dinner-2: Penny the Penguin wanders off course on a trek across Antarctica and ends up far from home with no money at all. Your job is to help her earn enough cash to reach her family again. Penny is back in the icy south to open a diner, and she needs you to run it and keep a crowd of hungry penguins fed.

The game includes four diners to work through, a shop full of upgrades, and themed diner party packs to unlock. You can also dress Penny in cute uniforms. A comic-style story follows her journey and introduces you to the adorable residents of Antarctica. Control Penny with the mouse, or tap the touch screen if you are playing on a phone.
hide-find-seek-2023: Hide Find Seek 2023 is an arcade take on the time-honoured childhood game of hide and seek. As the seeker, you can use everyday objects like automobiles and desks to construct forts. It runs in the browser and works on Android phones and other mobile devices, so you can play almost anywhere.

If you are one of the hidden players, you have your own options, such as slipping into the river, a haystack, a cornfield, or the boss's office. Move your character with the arrow keys or by touching the screen. Try to stay civil toward the other players as you search and hide.
water-sort-puzzle-3: Water Sort Puzzle 3 asks you to sort colored liquids, and it blends that simple idea with a calm, clever challenge. Every move takes a little thought, so the game keeps your mind busy while still feeling soothing. It is a good pick for anyone who likes gentle puzzles that reward careful planning.

The game is built for casual play, so it fits well into short breaks or a few spare minutes. Your logic gets a workout along the way, yet the pace stays relaxed and enjoyable. To play, click and drag to move the liquids between containers.
456-sniper-challenge: Your job in 456 Sniper Challenge is simple to describe: aim, fire, and keep going. You are not one of the contestants this time. Instead, you take the executioner's seat and eliminate every player who has failed, just as you are ordered to. Finishing each mission takes complete focus, fast reactions, and precise shooting.

The game sits in the Shooting category and carries the tags Action and Adventure. Expect a tense, high-stakes experience where one lapse in attention can cost you the round. Every shot counts, so stay calm and make each one count.
tasty-jewel: Inside this candy box you will find gems made of sweets. Swap neighbouring pieces to line up three or more of the same colour in a row. Lining up four or more gives you a special exploding piece that can smash through obstacles blocking your path. This is a turn-based match-3 arcade game packed with tough levels and several game modes to work through.

Tasty Jewel is filed under puzzles and tagged with arcade, bomb, candy, jewel, logic and match-3 themes. Every move is taken one turn at a time, so you can plan ahead before you swap. Think about where each explosive piece will land and how it can clear a path for you.
ice-pet-match: Ice Pet Match is a puzzle game built around linking tiles, and it offers a set of demanding levels. It follows the classic block puzzle format, so you can clear away stress while testing your focus. Each round is designed to be quite addictive and to sharpen your concentration.

Your goal is to collect every item on the board before the timer runs out. Look for two identical items, then tap them to connect. A connection can use up to three straight lines, as long as no other tile sits in the path between them.
house-painter: Plain white houses can look dull, so this hypercasual game lets you bring in color. Each level is a bright, cute challenge in 3D, and you can cover a whole house in seconds. Your goal in every level is to paint over each white area until none are left.

You move by swiping left, right, up, or down, sweeping across the surfaces to reach the empty spots. You can steer with the W, A, S, and D keys or with the arrow keys, whichever you prefer. The casual, arcade-style pace is easy to pick up, but the layouts also ask you to think a little.
cooking-burger-maker-chef: Step into the shoes of a street food chef who runs a burger shop and dreams of working in a busy restaurant kitchen. Your job is to cook each order, plate it neatly, and keep building your cooking skills along the way. Customers from the city's burger restaurants want to try different kinds of burgers, so you make them from scratch while watching the clock as orders pile up. Strong time management is the key to keeping every foodie happy.

The game also brings new junk food recipes to try, and it is made for both girls and boys. Chicken burgers are on the menu too, so there is plenty to cook. Each order you finish keeps the kitchen moving and adds to the fun of running your own burger stand in town.
battle-of-orcs: Battle of Orcs is a real-time strategy game centered on sending units into the field. Your goal is to bring down the enemy base by placing orcs on the battlefield. Mixing different unit types lets you build an attack force that works well, and picking the right unit at the right moment is the key to winning. To deploy a unit, just tap its card.

This title sits in the Action category and carries the tags Balance, Battle, Card, and Timing. Those tags fit the gameplay well, since you need to weigh which cards to use and when to use them. Good luck with your battles.
parking-space-html5: Parking Space is a browser driving game where you steer a car into a marked parking area. You must keep the car on the road, since driving off it is not allowed. Each attempt has a time limit, so you need to park carefully and still finish before the clock runs out.

On a computer, you drive with the arrow keys or with W, A, S and D. On mobile devices, you use the on-screen buttons to drive. Whichever way you play, the goal is the same: park the car in the marked spot, stay on the road, and complete the task within the given time.
bike-rush-xtreme: Racing along winding canyon paths as the evening light fades, you take the saddle of a fast bike. Your story starts humbly, on a used machine that has seen better days, but growing skill, quicker speeds, and sheer grit carry you toward a lasting reputation. Tight corners demand careful handling, and every race pushes you to go further than before.
Controls are simple to learn. Press W to accelerate and S to ease off. Tap A or D to lean left or right through turns, and hit the Spaceb
moto-beach: Moto Beach Ride is a light, straightforward racing title that anyone can pick up quickly, and it takes little time to learn. Your goal is to gather as many rings as possible by steering your bike through them while performing various stunts. Pick whichever game mode suits your mood and enjoy the ride.
Steer your motorbike with the W, A, S and D keys. Press C to switch between camera views, and hold Left Shift to use a boost.
march-madness: March Madness puts you on the court in a basketball title with two ways to play. You can enter a tournament against computer-controlled rivals, or pick the shootout and try to rack up the highest score you can within a one-minute window. Four achievements are waiting for players who reach their goals along the way.
Controls are simple. Use your mouse or finger to aim, then release to shoot. The same method works whether you are moving through a tournament or chasing a high score in the shootout.
love-baby-fashion-makeover: Step into a charming salon belonging to a lovely baby, where you design and style your own avatar. You can choose hairstyles, outfits, and other finishing touches to build the look you want. Your avatar takes its inspiration from the Princess of Play and her pets, so the whole experience has a sweet, animal-loving feel.

Playing is easy: just click with your mouse or tap the screen to get started. Whether you enjoy decorating, dressing up, or experimenting with hair, this girly game gives you room to try new combinations and see what you create. It is a cute pick for anyone who loves making characters look their best.
supercars-crazy-racing-2023: In SuperCars Crazy Racing 2023, you join a series of online drift racing tournaments. Across these events you pilot many well-known drifting cars and climb from the Novice ranks all the way up to Pro.

If you feel ready for a bigger challenge, you can switch to the ghost online multiplayer mode and compete against others. On a computer, you drive with the WASD keys, while players on phones and tablets can use the button built into the game.
army-war-cs: Army War CS is a browser shooter built with Unity3D and WebGL. Your goal is simple: eliminate everyone in each mission. The game includes 15 levels and several weapons to pick from, and its graphics are a visual highlight.

You move with the WASD keys or the arrow keys. The left mouse button fires, and the right mouse button aims. Press the space bar to jump, Ctrl to crouch, and hold Left Shift to run. Press G to throw a grenade, and Tab to pause the game.
muscle-race-game: Muscle Race Game brings together pace, power, and planning in one contest. You pick up items along the way to build your muscles, then race against opponents to be the first to cross the end point.

Every button in the game is operated with a mouse, so you simply click to move through the action. The title is filed under Puzzles and carries the tags 2026 games, Casual, and Fun, making it a relaxed choice for a quick session.
dirt-bike-racing-duel: Dirt Bike Racing Duel takes you across seven continents, with rides through many different countries, lands, and locations. Each track is prepared for dirt bike duel races, and your aim is to bring your bike to the finish line without crashing. You can race solo or play in two player mode, where a friend can challenge you head to head. The levels contain plenty of surprises waiting inside them.

The shop lets you buy new bikes or upgrade the one you already own. Player one uses W to gas, S to brake, and A or D to balance. Player two uses the up and down arrow keys to gas and brake, with the left and right arrow keys for balance.
narrow-passage-game: Narrow Passage Game is a puzzle in which you guide a ball through tight gaps and around the obstacles that block its route. These obstacles keep turning, so you must choose the right moment to slip through each one. Your challenge is to pass as many shapes as you can without crashing into them.

Playing is simple: click or tap on the screen to move the ball along. Timing is what counts here, because a single crash ends your attempt. Stay patient, watch how the shapes rotate, and see how many you can get past.
undead-warrior: Undead Warrior is an action game built around growth. You become stronger by collecting gems and defeating the enemies that come your way. Every gem you gather pushes your progress forward, so each battle feels rewarding.

Controls are kept simple. Move your character by pointing the cursor wherever you want to go. A left click launches an attack, while a right click sends you sprinting. Keep these three inputs in mind and you can focus on the fight itself, whether you are chasing gems or clearing enemies.
paint-them: Paint Them is a puzzle game with plenty of levels to work through. Each stage offers a lot of enjoyable moments that you can come back to whenever you like. It delivers a painting experience that stays lively from start to finish.
You can take on the challenges alone or team up with a friend. The painting tasks are rewarding to complete, and the whole game is controlled with the mouse, so you can start painting right away.
ultimate-bus-simulator-game: Pick the bus you like most, grab the steering wheel, and fire up the engine. The game tests how precisely you can drive and park inside a lifelike city setting. You can choose from three modes: pick and drop, bus parking, and free mode.
Use W or the Up Arrow to move forward, S or the Down Arrow to move backward, and A or the Left Arrow and D or the Right Arrow to steer left and right. Buttons on screen are selected with the mouse.
messy-little-mermaid-makeover-makeup-and: Our little mermaid princess has become quite messy and sloppy. Your job is to turn her back into the beautiful, noble princess she once was. She needs a bath to get clean, her hair needs combing, and she needs new clothes, so each step depends on you.
Once she is clean and tidy, it is time for the fun part. Choose lovely outfits and jewelry, then dress her up until she looks her best. The whole game is played by tapping or clicking.
jelly-dye: Jelly Dye is a free online coloring game for kids, built as a simulation. You choose from a large range of dyes and drop each one into the jelly plate it matches. After coloring the plates, you complete your own masterpiece. It is a small, interesting game that invites you to test what new tricks you can come up with.

You can play with a mouse or by tapping, so it works on both computers and touch devices. The game runs in the browser using HTML5 and is also listed for Android. Its tags point to color, coloring, fun and brain games, which makes it a lively pick for young players who enjoy creative activities.
baby-color-crafts: This educational cartoon game for girls invites you to decorate a crystal ball. Start the machine first, then fill the crystal ball with sequins until it is full. Next, add colored stickers to the surface so the ball looks even more sparkly.

Another project is a shell necklace you can decorate too. Place shells of the same color on both sides of the gem pendant, and the necklace becomes even prettier. You can play with a mouse or by tapping the screen.
blocky-combat-swat-2: Blocky Combat Swat 2 is a multiplayer shooter where you can play with friends from around the world. Chat with other players while you unlock new weapons and explore ten maps made for hiding and shooting. The maps have a pixel look, and the game includes 24 new guns and more than 40 outfits to choose from.

Controls are simple. Use W, A, S and D to walk, and move the mouse to look around and shoot. You can switch guns with the mouse scroll wheel or the 1 and 2 keys. Press Tab to open the menu, and press Q to open attachments.
dune-surfer: Dune Surfer is a hypercasual arcade game in which you send a ball flying into the air, all the way out to the cosmos. To get there, you need steady precision and clean slides across the waves. It is simple to pick up but takes real skill to master, and the goal is to get as far as you can.

Aim to land on each wave as smoothly as possible. A gentle landing launches the ball higher and earns you more score and coins. The smoother your touchdowns, the bigger the multiplier you build, and the faster you move. The game is endless and built with HTML5, with the tags Arcade, Ball, Casual, and Fun describing its style.
bus-school-driving-2023: Bus School Driving 2023 puts you behind the wheel of a coach bus in a three-dimensional world. The challenge is higher this time, since the current difficulty is far tougher than the previous one for coach bus drivers. Players who know Bus New Games 2022: City Coach Bus Simulator will need to act like real-world bus drivers to avoid the many obstacles in the game.

An in-game store offers a wide range of items meant to improve the experience, whether you are new to 2022 3D games or already enjoy bus driver titles. To drive, press the W, A, S and D keys. On a mobile device, use the buttons inside the game instead.
zombie-mayhem-online: The streets are crawling with more undead than anyone can handle, and you're the one who has to thin them out. Your goal is to wipe out as many zombies as possible, and every kill earns coins. You can spend those coins to unlock new guns. The game includes three maps with ten levels each, six weapons, over twenty kinds of zombies, a dismemberment system, and plenty of gore.

Move with W, A, S, and D, and look around with the mouse. Left-click to fire and right-click to aim. Scroll the mouse wheel to switch weapons, press G for grenades, R to reload, and F to pick up items. Hold Left Shift to run and Left Ctrl to crouch.
blocks-puzzle-2: Blocks Puzzle 2 is a classic puzzle built around dropping pieces onto the board. Your aim is to fill complete rows and columns so they clear away, working both horizontally and vertically. Be careful not to let the blocks fill up the screen, because that is the main danger in this game.
Every level brings a new challenge, so the puzzles keep changing as you progress. Your goal is to get through all of the levels. The controls are simple: drag a block, then drop it where it belongs.
neon-tank-arena: Two futuristic tanks face off on a single platform, each ready to battle the other. You can play alone in single player mode or face a friend in two player mode. Every level begins with a race to smash your opponent's wall. Collecting bonuses that appear in the middle of a level can give you the edge you need.

The fight is split into five chapters: Laser, machine gun, death cogwheel, missile, and bonus challenge. Defeat your opponent in each one to win the war. Player 1 steers with W, A, S and D, while Player 2 uses the arrow keys.
glam-dress-up: If you enjoy browsing shops, glossy glamour, and fashion magazines, this game was made for you. It lets you imagine a life as a famous top model who marries a millionaire, and you can chase that fantasy by styling virtual girls.

Dress each character in chic outfits, then pick a model-style hairdo to complete the look. The collection of clothes is very large, so there is plenty of room to show off your talent as a true fashionista. Every action is controlled with the mouse alone, so you simply point and click your way through each choice.
masha-and-the-bear-dentist-game: Step into a dental clinic that brings together the cartoon characters Masha and Bear. This tooth care game is made for both boys and girls, and it puts you in the role of a pet doctor. Working alongside the characters, you treat tooth decay in a range of animal patients. The main character looks after every animal that comes in, so there is always someone new to help. Because the whole family can join in, it is a good pick for anyone who wants to learn why clean teeth matter.
Controls are simple, since a mouse or taps on the screen are all you need. Whether you play alone or with the family, the goal stays the same: bring every patient back to clean, healthy teeth.
ben-10-alien-force: Ben 10 Alien Force is the follow-up to Super Slime Blitz, a free-to-play hit. This time the challenges are larger, improved, and even slimier. You take on the role of all ten of Ben's superpowered aliens, and your goal is to climb as high as your abilities allow.

Along the way you must steer past obstacles and gather coins. Your skill alone decides how far you get. It falls into the arcade category and carries adventure, running, and jumping themes. Controls are handled with a touch pad.
towing-train: In this 3D browser game, you climb into a farm tractor and use it to drag a train along the tracks. Your goal is to pull the train more than 300 feet until it reaches the station. Built with HTML5 and WebGL, it blends arcade action with simulation-style driving. The rail rush theme keeps the trip moving, and the tractor pull idea gives the train a rather unusual starting point.
Movement is simple. Press the W, A, S and D keys to move your tractor. Keep the train rolling until you get a full pull toward the station, and enjoy the mix of farm machinery and rail travel.
stacky-maze-game: Stacky Maze Game is a puzzle title that tests your strategy and planning. You gather blocks, pile them into a growing stack, and guide your character through winding mazes toward the final box. Watch out for obstacles and tricky paths along the way. Picking up more blocks lets you build taller stacks, which helps you handle harder challenges.

Movement works by swiping to send your character where you want it to go. Each level is complete once you reach the end point. The game offers a range of levels and runs smoothly, so it holds your attention as you work through one maze after another.
basketball-papa: Basketball Papa is a single-player 2D sports game centered on free throws. You get one shot at a time, and your grandfather, a basketball legend who has no patience for failure, expects you to make it. Finding the right angle is the challenge. The goal keeps moving, and the wind pushes the ball along the way, so you have to predict where the hoop will be when the ball arrives.

The game is played with drag and click controls. Each throw asks for the same careful reading of the moving target and the breeze, so every attempt tests your aim. If you enjoy basketball games that reward patience and accurate judgment, this one will keep you focused on getting the shot right.
moto-maniac: Moto Maniac is a physics-based sports game where you ride a motorbike past a series of obstacles, and the quicker you clear them, the better. Your route runs through port docks, so you have to keep your bike from tumbling into the water. You also need to keep your head from smacking into things along the way.
The controls are simple. Press Up or W to drive forward and Down or S to drive backward. Press Left or A to tilt your bike left, and Right or D to tilt it right. Press P to pause the game.
popular-hair-salon: This fresh, well-liked haircut game puts you in charge of your own barber shop as a seasoned barber. Customers arrive all day long, and many have been waiting a long time, so they need your help without delay. Your first job is to wash each person's hair, then design a hairstyle for them. Once the style is finished, you move on to choosing outfits. A large selection of fancy clothes is available, so you can try different combinations and find the look that helps each customer stand out from the crowd.
Everything is controlled with a mouse or by tapping, so you can start right away.
animals-party: Animals Party is a knockout game packed with playful and unexpected traps. Monster racers compete on the track while hidden hazards and obstacles can appear without warning. Your goal is to move forward through every race and avoid being knocked out. It sounds simple, but expect plenty of obstacles, traps, and rival racers standing in your way.

You steer your character with W, A, S, and D, or with the arrow keys, and press SPACE to jump. Quick reactions and careful timing will help you dodge trouble and keep your place in the pack. Each race brings new surprises, so stay alert and keep your eyes on the path ahead.
wedding-salon-marry-me-dress-up: Get ready for a big day in this dress-up game, where you help a lovely bride-to-be prepare for her wedding. Start with her hair and features, then pick from many options, including long skirts, short skirts, pants, shoes, hair, eyes, mouth, and eyebrows. You can also design the wedding itself. Your groom can be styled too, with his own outfit and hairstyle.

The game offers more than 400 items, which can be mixed into millions of combinations. Your aim is to help her reach her dream of a sweet wedding. When the look is ready, you can snap a wedding photo of the bride and groom together.
russian-cyber-car: Russian Cyber Car is a 3D racing game for one player with an arcade feel. Seven Russian cyber cars race against each other on the track. The contest is decided by falls, and the car that falls last survives and wins the race.

You steer with the arrow keys and jump with the space bar. Mobile controls are included too, and the game runs on Android. It is also listed under adventure, so it mixes its racing action with that style.
escape-from-soul-hunter-halloween-escape: This Halloween-themed point-and-click escape game follows a schoolgirl who has been seized by a Soul Hunter, a ghostly creature that strikes at night and grows weak when daylight returns. Your task is to track her down and rescue her before the sun goes down. Along the way you will search for hidden objects, solve puzzles, and work through each room to reach the way out.

Start by working out what you are trying to achieve, then study the setting and the objects around you. Piece together the why and how behind each goal, solve the puzzles in your path, unlock doors, and find the exits. The whole adventure is controlled with the mouse, so you simply click to explore and interact with everything you find.
fast-food-cooking: In this restaurant tycoon title, you act as both cook and manager, beginning with a modest food stall and working toward a larger restaurant business. Tap to prepare and hand out burgers, pizzas, desserts, and other dishes so your guests leave happy. Keep up with incoming orders so your customers stay satisfied.
As profits grow, you can upgrade your kitchen and unlock new food items and restaurant types. Manage your time wisely, speed up your service, and build your
incredible-princess-eye-art: Step into a guided lesson led by a talented makeup artist. You will paint the eyes of charming princesses, using bold and unusual techniques to build a look that stands out from the crowd. Pick your character from three styles: a sweet doll, a glamorous vamp, or a sleek cyber princess. Take up your makeup brush and begin, then explore every eye design on offer. Control everything with a left mouse click or by touching the screen.
happy-go: Happy Go keeps you on the lookout for new companions as you move. Each one you find can join your group, and your goal is to bring everyone together so the team can slip past the obstacles waiting ahead.

Steering works with the mouse alone. Press and hold the button, then drag to guide your group wherever it needs to go. The title belongs to the hypercasual category and carries the tags action, casual, and skill.
best-emergency-ambulance-rescue-drive-si: This browser game puts you in the seat of a city ambulance driver. Your job is to prove your worth by providing efficient rescue service at all hours, day and night. You get behind the wheel of a city ambulance and take on a driving challenge that asks you to show what you can do on the city stre
x-parkour: X-Parkour is a hypercasual stickman action game where you steer a character away from danger. Each obstacle asks you to think carefully about which skills to use so you can keep advancing. The challenges may seem tough at first, but you will eventually overcome them all. Its funny, casual tone makes it an easy pick for anyone who enjoys action games.
Your moves are jump, squat, back, and forward. Combine them to dodge threats, stay on course, and keep your run moving ahead.
ninja-jump-kids: Ninja Jump Kids is a hypercasual game made for young children who want a bit of challenge. It is a single-player, casual title and a kid-friendly version of the earlier Ninja Jump Xtreme, which came before it.

Your ninja leaps across platforms, so you need to judge each jump. Collect coins as you go and work your way through the levels. The controls are simple: tap the screen to jump. It is a lighthearted pick for anyone who enjoys a fun, straightforward challenge.
muscle-race-3d: Muscle Race 3D is an arcade game in which you must find a way across a course that has walls and swimming pools in its path. To get over these obstacles on every level, you need to collect dumbbells and grow stronger along the way. Speed counts, since you are up against three AI players, and the goal is to gather dumbbells faster than all of them.
Dragging is how you play. As you go, keep an eye on the rivals and keep collecting dumbbells so you can stay ahead of them and clear each stretch of the track.
the-puppet: One day, you and your brother went into town to watch a puppet show. When the performance ended, you hoped to meet the puppet artist and get his autograph. Instead, a gang of puppet artists kidnapped you both and took you away.

Now you must escape from the puppet artist's home. This is a clicker and escape game built around point and click play, and you control everything with the mouse. Click through the scene and work your way toward freedom.
ace-air-fighter: Ace Air Fighter is a demanding arcade game that delivers a battlefield-style experience. Its 3D visuals and overall theme pull you into the action. Your task is to pilot a fighter and shoot down the enemy aircraft heading your way. The game is built with WebGL.

Steering works by swiping or touching the screen to move your plane, and the game is controlled with the mouse only. Your bullets never run out, so you can keep firing at the enemy fighters for as long as you need. Dodge and destroy your way through each battle.
pull-my-tongue: Pull My Tongue is a 3D puzzle game in which you need to bend the rules and find a shortcut to get ahead. Each level is packed with obstacles and traps, so you must work out how to get around them. Along the way, your job is to feed a cute reptile with tasty gum.
Controls are simple: drag the tongue to grab the gum. The game is tagged as animal, arcade, and click-based, and it is built with HTML5 for play in your browser.
pixel-car-crash-demolition-v1: Pixel Car Crash Demolition v1 is a racing game about smashing pixel-style vehicles. It has ten difficult levels, and each one gives you chances to wreck the cars. Every crash you cause earns points, and those points unlock new cars you can take out for a drive.
You control your car with the W, A, S and D keys. Steer into the other vehicles to send them flying, and keep going through all ten levels to collect more points and unlock more cars.
evil-granny-horror-village: This horror title casts you as someone trapped in a village where a terrifying granny wants to find you and put an end to you. Your goal is to locate all the treasure boxes and then escape from the Horror Village. Watch your back at all times, because the granny is determined to catch you.
perfect-slices-online: Food preparation is the most important part of cooking, and this game puts you right in the middle of it. Your job is to cut up every vegetable you see. Be careful, though, because the spikes are not meant to be sliced. Cutting is the foundation of any good kitchen, so this title gives you a fun way to practise it.

The controls are simple: press to cut. Keep your slices clean, chop the vegetables, and steer clear of the spikes. This 3D arcade game mixes cooking, food, and fruit into a playful challenge that rewards a steady hand.
unblock-the-ball: Unblock The Ball is a straightforward puzzle title that is easy to pick up and hard to put down. The board is packed with pipes made from several different materials, but only the wooden ones can be shifted. Your task is to rearrange them so every section joins together smoothly, creating a route that carries the ball all the way to the end. Along the way you can gather stars, and the more you collect, the better your result.

Controls are simple: use your mouse or tap the screen to play. Take a moment to plan each move, since the path only works when every connection lines up. Whether you are focused on reaching the destination or grabbing as many stars as possible, the game keeps the action clear and the goal easy to follow.
pet-clinic: Pet Clinic is a puzzle game in which you move a character with the joystick and care for sick animals. Each pet suffers from a particular illness, so you need to treat it in the way that illness requires. Every patient shows its own symptoms, and those symptoms call for different medical approaches, so one method never fits all of them.

Getting started is simple, since a mouse click or a tap is all you need. The animal theme runs through the whole game, and the puzzles center on matching the right treatment to each pet. Watch each patient's signs closely to decide what to do next.
supernova: Supernova is a skill-based hypercasual game in which you steer a spaceship and weave past objects that get in your way. The visuals look sharp, and you can unlock several different vehicles as you play. Each stage is generated on the fly and filled with bright colors, and your speed picks up the further you travel. Your goal is to keep your streak alive by getting past every obstacle without a collision.
To move your ship, use the WASD keys or the arrow keys to change its direction. Both sets of controls work, so pick whichever feels more natural to you.
christmas-santa-bunny-run: A small rabbit living in a deep city wants to get rich by picking up carrots along risky routes where the surroundings can be deadly. This adventure run game has simple controls and is hard to put down. The bunny is a playful troublemaker who hopes to collect a large stash of carrots for Easter.

Your task is to lead the young bunnies as they dash through the city, grabbing carrots and avoiding the many obstacles that could make them fall. Press W to move up, S to move down, A to go left, and D to go right.
soap-cutting-3d-game: Soap Cutting 3D Game blends a calm arcade feel with a cutting simulator. Its lifelike 3D visuals and smooth animations make each slice satisfying to watch. Your job is to slice through every bar of soap until you uncover whatever is hidden inside. Nothing pushes you along, since there is no score to chase and no clock counting down, so you can take your time.

Progress feels rewarding as well. Collect 500 gold coins and new knife styles open up for you to try. Controls are simple: drag to move your knife. The game is a hypercasual title with 3D and physics elements.
cat-family-educational-games: This game is made with preschoolers in mind. Players follow the cheerful adventures of a group of kittens, and the story is built to support children's social and emotional growth. Friendship, family life, and the habit of thinking before acting are at the heart of the experience.

Getting started is simple, since you can play with a mouse or by tapping the screen. The game is tagged as animal, educational, and family fun, and it is aimed at girls and young kids. It also works on mobile devices and is built with HTML5.
open-fire: Open Fire is a shooting game where you defeat thousands of enemies coming at you from all directions. These foes are well-armed, which makes for a strong test of your skills. Tagged as arcade, casual, gun, and hypercasual, it blends quick shooting with an easy-going feel.

Everything is controlled with the mouse, so all you need to do is click. Keep track of the enemies surrounding you and stay on target as they close in from every side. Stay focused as the crowd pushes in.
papa-cherry-saga: Papa Cherry Saga is a candy-themed match-3 puzzle game for anyone who loves sweets. You play as chef Papa Cherry, who steps in to help you win each level. Your job is to swap neighboring cookies with your mouse and line up three or more of the same kind. Every successful move brings you closer to the next stage, and cascades and combos can bring extra rewards along the way.

Lining up four or more cookies creates power-ups. When you get stuck, boosters are there to give you a nudge. If you still fall short at the end, five extra moves give you one more chance. Along the way, you smash through chocolate blocks and marshmallows to gather cookies across dozens of levels.
pixelkenstein-ottoman: Pixelkenstein Ottoman is a platformer that balances entertainment with difficulty, set against a backdrop that recalls the old Ottoman era. Your main goal is to collect diamonds, which you need in order to advance through the levels, and gathering them also helps you reach the highest score. Each level has an oil lever to pull, and you must pull every level's lever to complete it.

This is the third entry in the series, so returning players will recognize its style, while newcomers can start right away. Move your character with the WASD keys or the arrow keys on a computer, or use touch controls on a mobile device.
violent-race: Violent Race is a relaxing arcade car racer built around 3D models. Your aim is to cross the finish line in first place while steering clear of the obstacles along the track. Two computer-controlled rivals chase you the whole time, so you need to keep an eye on them as well as the road ahead.

Controls are simple: tap to move your car. The game is built with HTML5 and tagged for mobile, so it works well with touch taps. Its easygoing feel is balanced by the pursuing opponents, which keep every race tense.
subway-boys-multiplayer: Subway Boys Multiplayer is a never-ending runner in which rowdy characters sprint along the tracks. While they dash forward, players collect gold coins floating through the air and steer clear of oncoming railway cars. The run keeps going with no finish line, so the challenge is simply to last as long as you can.

Control is handled with either the mouse or the arrow keys, so you can pick whichever feels more comfortable. The game is built in 3D, works on mobile devices, and supports multiplayer, letting several players join in together.
crime-scene-cleaner-mobile-3d: Forget watching from the sidelines. In this game you step into the shoes of a professional cleaner whose job is to tidy up after a crime. There is no rush, so each task is handled carefully and with precision. Every mission takes place in a detailed crime scene, presented as an immersive simulator where hands-on work and managing your tasks matter most.
Controls are simple. On PC, use WASD to move, press Space to jump, and press F to shoot. On mobile, tap the buttons on screen to carry out each action.
master-plumber: Master Plumber is a puzzle game where you link water pipes so the water can flow through them successfully. Each level asks you to connect the pipes, and hints are available within the level if you need a nudge. The early stages seem fairly simple, but the pipes grow harder to connect as you progress.

You can play the water pipe game online, and the controls are easy, since you mostly just click. The real challenge is in your head, as you work out how each connection should go. With a very large number of water levels, each one offers a unique puzzle to solve. It's a good fit for anyone who enjoys brain teasers and logic games.
pixel-rush-online: Pixel Rush Online is a 3D arcade game where you guide a small blocky boy through a tricky course full of obstacles. Every time he bumps into one, he loses some of his pixels, so keeping him whole is the key. Race forward and cross the finish line without losing any pieces to earn a flawless run.

Along the way, you can grab pixels and stars, which help rebuild the body parts he has lost. Be careful, though. If he crashes into too many obstacles, every pixel disappears and you must begin again from the start. The game is played by dragging.
miami-city-crime-simulator-city-mafia-wa: In this Miami crime simulator, you fight the city's mafia through a series of battles, and smart tactics are key to helping the city survive. Your main target is the powerful gangster Vegas, and defeating him is how you win the rope hero war game title. Missions come one after another, each aimed at pushing back the city mafia.
The game is built in 3D with HTML5 and WebGL, and it is filed under boys' games with superhero and rescue themes. For controls, use W, A, S, and D to move, Space to jump, Shift to run, and F to fly.
spa-day-makeup-artist-makeover-game-for-: Step into a salon where you are the owner and every decision is yours. Your clients arrive with different needs, and the game features six services to work through. Each visit starts with a relaxing facial spa, where you wash the face, tidy up the eyebrows, and take care of any pimples. Next, you prepare a do-it-yourself hair mask using genuine hair spa tools. Once the hair looks its best, finish the makeover by picking fashion accessories for your client.
Everything is handled with a tap or a click.
glitch-dash: Glitch Dash shows the action from a first-person view, and your job is to keep moving without getting caught by hazards. Diamonds scattered along the way can be gathered and spent on checkpoints. Each stage puts your reflexes to the test.

On a computer, you steer with the keyboard arrows and use the space bar for the remaining control. To pass a level, you must reach its end without running into any of the obstacles in your path. It is an action title with 3D visuals, jumping, and collecting.
color-maze-puzzle-2d: Color Maze Puzzle 2D is a logic maze with 80 tough stages to work through. Your job is to roll the ball around the grid until every block has been painted. Clearing certain stages unlocks new balls that can help you get to the exit. The game runs in the browser and can be played with one touch or with the keyboard arrow keys. Press R to restart the current layout if you get stuck.

Swipe or tap to move, and use the arrows on a keyboard for precise steps. Plan each route carefully so you don't leave any squares unpainted. It's a relaxing puzzle for kids and logic fans alike, and the unlocked balls add a fun reward along the way.
road-fury: Road Fury is an arcade game set on a busy highway, where your job is to blast away anything that moves. If you can't destroy something, grab it instead, because those pickups are power-ups. Spend the cash you collect on upgrades so your car can survive a longer trip, and take on bosses as you go. Push as far down the road as you can, then see how your best score compares with other players'.

Every enemy vehicle behaves differently and drops its own items, so experimenting is the best way to discover what the game allows. Blast away vehicles, gather power-ups and cash, and keep improving your ride.
easter-coloring: Easter Coloring is a full-featured game built around charming holiday sketches with an Easter theme. Every drawing sits beside colored examples to guide your choices, and a selection of colors lets you pick the shades you want.

You paint the outlines by clicking with a mouse or tapping on a touchscreen, and those same inputs handle the other actions in the game. Choose a sketch, pick your hues from the palette, and create your own version of each Easter scene from start to finish.
squirel-steps: Squirrel Steps is a puzzle game where you map out a route for a squirrel so it gathers every pine nut on the board. Each move needs to be thought through ahead of time, since traps lie in wait and you must make good use of the surrounding terrain so that no target is left behind. The rules are easy to pick up, yet the planning behind each route is strategic.

Use the W, A, S and D keys to move the squirrel. Along the way you will sharpen your logical thinking and your ability to notice details. Clear every level to finish the game, and try to reach high scores as you go.
stickman-sniper: Stickman Sniper is a fighting game where you guide your stickman around the screen to dodge incoming enemy fire. Patience matters here, because you need to hold your position until the right moment arrives to take your own shot at the foe. It is a tough challenge, but you can give it a try. To begin, just click anywhere on the screen.
christmas-coloring-game: Christmas Coloring Game lets you bring holiday artwork to life with your own colors. With the season on its way, it's a cheerful way to get into the festive mood. You can pick from a collection of pictures with a Christmas theme and paint each one however you like.

Your artwork can be personalized further. A large selection of stickers is ready for you to place on your picture, and charming backgrounds and filters let you change its look. Controls are simple: use your mouse or tap the screen to play.
2d-car-racing: This 2D racing game is built for two players who want to compete against each other. Along the tracks, you can pick up nitrous gases to speed up, along with maces, missiles, and other power-ups. Player one moves with W, A, S, and D and uses power-ups with T, while player two steers with the arrow keys and uses power-ups with P.

Every race earns you coins, and once you have enough, you can unlock different cars. You can also spend the gold you have to buy new cars, so there is always something new to aim for. It is a funny and lively way to challenge a friend.
bottle-taps: Bottle Taps is a puzzle game built around simple, quick actions. You click, collect stars, and pop your way through it. Its hypercasual style means there is very little to learn before you start, and the experience stays light and easy to follow.

Everything is handled with the mouse, so a single click is all the control you need. The game is listed under casual and fun, which makes it a relaxed pick for anyone who enjoys short, playful puzzles. Its straightforward design keeps the focus on tapping and gathering stars from start to finish.
hero-merge: Hero Merge is a tower defense game in which careful planning and firepower work together. Merge your heroes to create stronger units, then place them on a grid wherever you think they will be most useful. Your task is to defend your wall against waves of different enemies. The waves keep coming without end, and you can gather plenty of perks along the way. Many different units are available to try.
Everything is controlled with the mouse, or with touch on devices that have a touchscreen. Whether your heroes hold their ground or the enemies break through depends entirely on how you arrange them.
fire-balls-shoot-3d: Get ready, line up your shot, and smash. This shooter turns the simple pleasure of firing into a fast test of timing and nerve. Your cannon is loaded and waiting, a stack of targets stands in front of you, and plenty of moving obstacles keep getting in your way.

The feeling is somewhat like popping bubble wrap, except every pop comes with an explosion. Whether you have 30 seconds or 30 minutes to spare, the game can pull you into a focused rhythm where the rest of the world fades and only your aim and the pace of each shot remain. The tower is waiting and the barriers are moving, so line up your next shot and fire.
bubble-shooter-hero: Bubble Shooter Hero is a puzzle game centered on shooting bubbles. Many players around the world already enjoy this style of play, and this version is built for puzzle fans who want to sharpen their thinking. Your job is to match colors and pop bubbles. Each level is completed by popping bubbles and gathering diamonds, so you have two goals to work toward.
Controls are straightforward: aim your shot, then fire the bubbles. The overall feel is relaxing yet absorbing, so it suits quick breaks as well as longer stretches of play.
merge-cyber-racers: In this idle merging game, you buy high-tech vehicles and combine two matching ones to produce an upgraded model. Each car you place on the racing track earns coins whenever it crosses the finish line. The roster includes many different futuristic designs, and there are chances to boost your coin earnings along the way.

Daily visits are needed to eventually obtain the most costly car on offer, which helps you grow a cyber racing empire of your own. Moving pieces around is done with the mouse on a computer, while touch screen devices use a swipe gesture.
long-hair-princess-hair-salon: In a fairyland kingdom, Prince Christos and Princess Juliet were loved by everyone. Juliet had golden, magical hair that flowed far past her shoulders. Just before their wedding, a witch broke into the castle, carried Juliet off, and hid her in a tower deep in a faraway forest. The witch is terribly ill and draws her strength and power from Juliet's enchanted locks.

Now Juliet is waiting for you to break the curse so she can return to Prince Christos. This cartoon-style girls game is also a hair salon with dress up and decorating in it, and it has a cute, fun feel. Control it by moving your mouse or tapping the screen.
blocks-and-car: Blocks and Car is a laid-back puzzler that mixes the falling-shape handling of a classic block stacker with a passenger sorting challenge. Blocks of different shapes appear on the board, and you clear them much as you would in Tetris. Once blocks disappear, passengers in matching colors appear and walk to the waiting area. Your job is to steer each group onto the bus that matches their color while keeping everything tidy.

Controls are easy to pick up: tap or swipe to place and move blocks. Planning ahead keeps the waiting area from getting overcrowded. The game suits players of every age, yet it still offers strategic challenges for those who enjoy a bit of thinking.
archer-hunter-king-game: Archer Hunter King is a 3D arcade game built around confrontation. You can choose between two modes. Parkour hunting challenges you to survive until the end using your skills, all within a time limit. Endless breakout works differently: your task is to protect the king, and if the king falls, you lose as well. Rewards earned by passing a round can be used to unlock new characters and skills. When you're ready to begin, the game is waiting for you.
truck-loader-4: Truck Loader 4 mixes forklift driving with truck loading. In a future where robots have taken over, you teach them how to fill trucks. Use your magnet to pick up cargo, then place it on the truck so it can be shipped. It is a simple physics game built around that single task.
Move with your mouse, or use the W, A, S and D keys. On mobile devices, the on-screen buttons handle the controls.
power-rangers-commander: Power Rangers Commander is an arcade action game where you play a brave ranger battling zombies both in the air and on the ground. Your main weapon is a shotgun, and you can also call on special powers: firestorm, lightning, and cold ice. Your goals are to collect every item, upgrade, and coin, and to prove you are the best hero in the world.
Press Space to shoot and the up arrow to jump. If you would rather not use the keyboard, the virtual button on the screen handles both actions.
pizza-craft-game: Pizza Craft Game is a quick cooking puzzle where you play as a pizza chef. The order you need to fill appears across the top of the screen, and the ingredients you can use are lined up along the bottom. Tap each item in the correct sequence so your pizza matches the recipe, and choose carefully, since every pick counts. A clock on the left shows how much time is left, so each pizza has to be finished before it runs out.

Stages grow tougher as you go, introducing fresh ingredients and more involved orders. Quick reactions, a good memory, and careful accuracy all matter here. Selecting items takes a simple tap, and finishing a pizza correctly is what moves you on to the following level.
soldiers-fury: War has broken out, and you take on the role of a crack soldier with a string of missions to complete. Charge forward, grab weapons and power-ups along the way, and open fire on every enemy you meet as you try to stay alive. Coins you collect can be spent to upgrade your firepower and ammunition, so your arsenal grows as you go.

Enemy troops keep arriving in waves, so you will need to think on your feet. Look around for objects in the environment that you can use to blow foes up with little effort. Plan your moves carefully and rely on good tactics to get through each wave.
public-bus-passenger-transport-game: Test your quick hill driving in this mountain simulator, where you steer large vehicles along winding, uphill roads. The off-road bus driving feels true to life, with routes that climb through hills and up to mountain peaks. In Mountain Tourist Bus, a 3D simulator, you take the role of a bus driver on mountain paths and need to deliver your passengers to their destination on schedule and without accidents.

Control everything with the keyboard's arrow keys. The game is built for one player and focuses on careful handling of a heavy vehicle over rough terrain. Each trip rewards steady driving as you aim to arrive on time while keeping everyone safe.
pingu-and-friends: Pingu & Friends is a charming, easy-to-learn hypercasual title with a cute look and a light touch of adventure. Your job is to guide Pingu and his pals upward, leaping from platform to platform while keeping your balance. Collecting the golden egg shakes things up, because it changes both the character you control and the theme of the game.
Desktop players press the Up arrow key to jump, while mobile players tap the screen. The goal is to help the group reach the top of the platforms, one careful jump at a time.
sorting-nuts-puzzle-game: Sorting Nuts is a puzzle game built around colorful nuts and bolts. Your job is to group nuts by color so that each bolt ends up holding only one shade. Tap to select a nut and move it between bolts. Since you need to think a few steps ahead, plan your moves carefully so you don't get stuck with no room to work. Each stage presents a new arrangement, and the challenge grows as you move forward.

The game is bright and smooth to play, which makes it easy to settle into. Puzzles like this can sharpen your focus and thinking skills, and they also offer a calm way to unwind when you want something gentler. Work through each level with patience and care, sorting every nut correctly. Complete all the levels to win.
blacksmith-clicker: Blacksmith Clicker casts you as a smith whose job is to forge weapons for the King. Your goal is to keep clicking until you have unlocked every item. It sits in the clicker category, so the play is built around steady, repeated input.

Controls are simple: you click or tap to interact with the game. The tags for this title are gold, strategy and weapons, which point to the themes you will find along the way. If you enjoy a patient, focused rhythm aimed at completing a full set of unlocks, this one keeps that at its center.
monster-trucks-jigsaw: Pick a favorite from five Monster Truck pictures to start this jigsaw adventure. After selecting your image, decide how you would like to play and whether you want 25, 49, or 100 pieces. Your job is to slot each piece into its correct position, and once everything fits, the complete truck picture appears for you to admire.
Controls are simple: drag each piece with a mouse, or with your finger on a phone or tablet. Whichever piece count you pick, the goal stays the same, so take your time and enjoy the game.
magic-pony-jigsaw: Magic Pony Jigsaw is a whimsical cartoon puzzle for anyone who enjoys animated shows, movies, and their colorful characters. The game includes 12 pictures to piece back together, along with several background scenes to choose from. It is meant to be a relaxed experience, so you can take your time and enjoy each piece as it fits into place.

You control everything with your mouse or by tapping the screen. Whether you play on a computer or a touch device, the controls stay simple. We hope you enjoy solving the pony puzzles and find plenty of fun along the way.
match-colors-game: Match Colors Game puts a new spin on the familiar match-three formula, relying on a drag-and-drop mechanic to play. There is no clock ticking away, so you can take your time, study the board, and plan each move before committing to it. The main goal is to chase the highest score you can manage.

To play, drag shapes onto the board and line up three or more blocks of the same color so they disappear. Bigger groups of matching blocks reward you with more points, so setting up larger combinations is the way to climb the scoreboard.
advance-car-parking-game-car-drive: Advance Car Parking Game: Car Drive is a free racing title where you park and drive cars in city settings.
