Parking lots and city streets serve as the playground, and you can keep practicing until you feel confident behind the wheel. The game aims for a realistic simulator feel, with steering that demands precision and a gearbox that gives a high-level sense of real driving. Its graphics are high quality, and it is presented as a new 2021 parking experience.

Camera control is simple: swipe up, down, left, or right on the screen to change the viewing angle, and double-tap to zoom in or out. Keyboard controls are also supported. Beyond parking, the title offers plenty of driving entertainment and is tagged as fun, funny, and racing.
limax-io: In this playful io game, you control a slug that gets chunkier the longer you survive. You begin as a tiny slug, so you'll need to gobble up the food orbs scattered nearby to expand. Each bite makes your body wider and lets you zip around faster. The mouse steers your slug, and a left click sends it into a quick dash.

Other players are everywhere, and you can take them out by speeding past so they slide into the slime you leave behind. Once they're gone, you can eat them to bulk up even more. Your aim is to climb higher than everyone else and claim a spot at the very top of the rankings.
1010-easter-tetriz: 1010 Easter Tetriz is a block puzzle with an Easter theme. Your job is to grab a group of blocks and place them onto the board. Whenever you complete a horizontal or vertical row of 10 blocks, that row clears away. Clearing several rows in a single move earns you more points. Keep the board from filling up, because the game continues only as long as the blocks you have can still find a place on it. Control everything with your mouse or touchpad.
monster-truck-mountain-climb: Monster Truck Mountain Climb is a driving game in the Racing category, where you take charge of a truck making its way up a mountain. It is tagged for mobile play, and trucks are at the center of the action.
You steer with the A and D keys or the left and right arrow keys, which lets you move the truck in either direction. Press W or the up arrow to make it jump. Keep these controls handy as you climb up
draw-weapons-rush: Draw Weapons Rush is an arcade game in which you must defeat your enemies to reach the end of the course. You are not limited to a fixed set of arms, since you sketch the weapon yourself and can draw almost any shape. Two weapon types are available, and you can switch between them at any time to suit the situation.

Controls are simple. Drag across the screen to draw your weapon, and use the joystick to move your character. The game is tagged as 3D, Arcade, Avoid, Draw and Fun, which points to a 3D experience built around drawing and dodging.
picnic-with-cat-family: Picnic time has arrived in this browser game for children aged four and up. You take food along on the outing and feed a cat, and the activities are meant to entertain both girls and boys. Begin by choosing the cat you want to look after, then get ready for the day out.
The game is tagged with collecting, education, family and fruit, so it mixes simple play with a little learning. It runs in HTML5, and you control everything with a mouse or by tapping.
superhero-dentist-1: Step into a dental clinic built for superheroes, where you are the one in charge of their teeth. Every patient is a hero who spends their days fighting crime and protecting the public, often battling supervillains, so their whereabouts must stay a closely guarded secret. Your job is to treat them with some unusual gear, such as a mouth spray, dental tweezers, and braces.
Controls are simple, so you can play with a mouse or
pop-it-roller-splat: Pop It Roller Splat is an arcade game inspired by classic painting games. Your goal in each level is to move the ball so it covers every blank spot on the track. Once the ball starts rolling, you cannot stop it. It keeps going until it crashes into the wall at the end of the line.

You control the ball by sliding, which keeps the controls simple. No timer hurries you, so you can work through all the levels at your own pace. The 3D look, puzzle elements, and relaxed feel make it a casual pick for kids and anyone who enjoys a gentle challenge.
rocket-bikes-highway-race: Rocket Bikes Highway Race takes place on a fast highway where riders compete on many kinds of motorbikes. The bikes are sorted into categories such as speed bike, cross moto, and supersport, along with others. Each category offers its own type of machine to ride.
Two modes are available: One Way Traffic and Two Way Traffic. Three maps can be selected: Forest, Des
kingdom-defense-chaos-time: Kingdom Defense: Chaos Time is a castle defense adventure where you protect your fortress from wizards, ghosts, demons, and many other monsters. The game includes five different castles, fifteen monster types, and more than fifty levels, along with many extra features. Each level brings more challenging monsters than the last.

Your four general skills can be improved up to six times each, helping you aim to become invincible. You earn gold for every monster you kill, and that gold can be spent on upgrading your castle or building new ones. To place a castle, grab it with your mouse or touch and drag it to the drop area.
kick-the-cowboy: Kick The Cowboy is a lighthearted stress-relief game in which your job is to kick a cowboy around. Along the way you can purchase a wide range of weapons and abilities to make things more interesting. It is built for mobile play, and the whole game is controlled with taps.

Getting started is simple: just tap to begin. Each tap keeps the action moving, so there is no complicated setup to worry about. It is a quick, playful pick for anyone in the Action category who wants a bit of fun to blow off steam.
rck-cars-arena-stunt-trial: In this racing game, RCK Cars Arena Stunt Trial, your goal is to collect coins. A minimap on screen shows you where each coin object is, so you can plan your next move. It is a single-player game built around cars, stunts, and simulation-style driving that rewards skill.

Drive with the WASD keys and press Space to brake. Press G to reset your car, and press Tab to open the menu. The controls are simple to learn, so you can spend your time practicing your stunts and working toward every coin.
fall-heroes-guys-io: Fall Heroes Guys.io puts you in a multiplayer race where you work through dozens of courses and gather crowns along the way. Your aim is to finish on top and be the winner of the day. Racing against anywhere from 10 to 40 other players keeps every round lively, and taking the win in each race is what counts.
You can also buy costumes and change how your character looks. Each map lets you race in a different outfit. The game is played with WASD, ZQSD, or the arrow keys, and it offers mobile control too.
rise-up-balloon: Guide your balloon upward in this hypercasual arcade title. Slide one finger across the screen to move your shield and keep the balloon safe from harm. As you climb higher and higher, you'll need to clear obstacles out of your path. The game is tagged as a fun ball game, and you control everything with the mouse.

Your goal is simple: keep the balloon rising and stay protected for as long as you can. Each move of the shield matters, so track where danger is coming from and respond quickly. The experience is light and easy to pick up, making it a good fit for short bursts of play whenever you want a quick arcade challenge.
gym-stack: Gym Stack is a 3D puzzle game where you sort colorful dumbbells to solve each challenge. You also stack colorful doughnuts, which adds a fresh layer to the puzzle. The game asks you to look ahead, plan your moves, and work out how each step affects the next one.

Use your fingers to move the dumbbells into place. Since every move can change what comes next, take a moment to think through your strategy before you act. It suits anyone who enjoys careful, thoughtful puzzles that reward planning.
pin-and-balls: Pin And Balls is a casual puzzle game where you pull out pins to clear a path for colored balls moving through a pipe. Your goal is to get enough of them to drop into the bucket at the bottom to meet the required number. The pipe is full of obstacles, so you need to pay close attention, since hitting one can cost you a ball.

To start, simply tap to play. The game sits in the Arcade category and carries tags such as Avoid, Casual, Kids, Point And Click, and Puzzle, which reflect its mix of puzzle solving and careful dodging.
lol-dress-up: LOL Dress Up is made for doll lovers and for anyone who enjoys trying out new dress-up titles. Your job is to pick outfits, add accessories, and adjust eye color so your character turns out one of a kind. The avatar maker is brand new and ready for you to explore.
Only the mouse is needed to play. Click through the choices and watch your character take shape as you go.
sling-kong: Sling Kong is an arcade game where the goal is to climb as far as you can. You pull back on your character with the mouse, then let go so it moves up and clings to the next round ledge. The route is full of dangerous hazards, including flamethrowers, saws, and crushing walls, along with other obstacles. Your aim is to reach the top.

Playing in your browser, you guide a cute animal upward while avoiding every trap in its path. Along the way you can also meet a variety of wild characters, each one ready to carve a path to success. Everything is controlled with the mouse, and the game is designed for a single player.
train-driver: Train Simulator is a realistic driving game that offers three different modes to choose from. Your job is to operate the train with care and get it through each run within a set amount of time so you can advance to the next level. The game includes multiple levels and a focus on true-to-life simulation, so every journey feels grounded in the mechanics of rail travel.
You control the train with your mouse and the arrow keys. Hop aboard, pick a mode, and take the controls to see how smoothly you can keep the train moving on schedule.
crazy-racing-master: In Crazy Racing Master, you take the wheel of a car and compete against other racers. Your main goal is to keep your vehicle from rushing off the track, so stay focused on the road ahead. It is a car racing game built around that simple challenge.

Several kinds of props appear during the race, and you can make use of them. Keep in mind that they may also come back to affect you. Completing the race is a significant milestone, so there is no need to hurry. Take your time and move through each event at a steady pace. Controls are simple: just tap or click.
baby-panda-care-2: Baby Panda Care 2 offers a fresh experience with more interactions. In this babysitting game, you look after three baby girls with different skin tones. It sits in the Girls category, and you can play with a mouse or by tapping the screen.

One baby is hungry, so you need to work out what she wants to eat from options like rice paste, milk powder, and apple puree. If she asks for apple puree, cut the apples into pieces, steam them, and mash them until the tasty puree is ready. Each step is handled through simple taps or clicks.
run-rich-3d-online: Head down a 3D track toward the finish line and grab as many cash bills as you can along the way. Each bill you collect improves how your outfit looks, so the richer you get, the sharper you dress. Be careful, though. Picking up too many bottles, trash cans, or bills will make you poorer and could cost you everything.
The controls are simple and easy to remember. Just drag to move. This arcade and puzzle game is built to be intuitive, so you can jump in and start right away.
bullet-fury-2: Bullet Fury 2 is a first-person 3D shooter that continues the story of the original Bullet Fury. Your squad has found where a new enemy laboratory is hidden, and your job is to take out every guard stationed there.

On a computer, use the arrow keys or W, A, S and D to move your character, and move the mouse to turn, aim and fire. Press L to lock the pointer. On a phone or tablet, an on-screen joystick handles movement, a fire button shoots, and you can tap and drag on the right side of the screen to aim and turn.
city-coach-driving-games-3d: Start in Easy Mode, which covers five levels. Each level gives you one of five different buses, and every bus offers its own driving feel. Your job on each mission is to collect passengers at one spot and carry them safely to their destination. The city driving is designed to feel true to life, and a seat belt safety feature adds another layer to the experience.

The third level shifts to nighttime, where visibility drops and you need to take extra care while keeping everyone on board safe. On a PC, drive with the WASD keys or the arrow keys. On a phone or tablet, tap the on-screen buttons: the race button speeds you up, and the brake button brings the bus to a stop.
halloween-mahjong-deluxe: Halloween Mahjong Deluxe is a mahjong game with a Halloween theme. Your goal is to clear the board by eliminating matching tiles, and you can only remove two identical tiles at a time. Not every tile is open to you, though. You can select a tile only when at least two of its sides are open, so it pays to think ahead about which moves will free up the rest of the layout.

Playing the game is simple, and you can use either a mouse or a touchpad. Select one tile, then select its matching partner to remove both from the board. Keep an eye on which tiles are still blocked and work through the arrangement one pair at a time.
crazy-car-impossible-sky-tracks: Take the wheel of a powerful sports car and race along sky tracks that wind through the air above the clouds. Your job is to pull off daring stunts on ramps while keeping the car from tumbling into the void. Choose from several high-end luxury cars, and pay attention to how the braking responds to realistic physics as you tackle the zigzag ramp routes. pixel-us-red-and-blue: Pixel Us Red and Blue is a two-player arcade adventure in which a blue alien and a red alien race to reach the flag. stunt-car-crash-3d: Stunt Car Crash 3D is a skill racing game built around car stunts and trials. Its tracks are meant to be both entertaining and impressive to watch. squid-gamer-buggy-raging: Take the wheel of a buggy on a seaside course in this straightforward racing game. Your goal is to cover as much ground as you can. princess-halloween-makeup-halffaces-tuto: Three princesses, Harlequin, Snow White, and the Tropical Princess, want to give their friends a Halloween surprise. offroad-prado-parking: Offroad Prado Parking puts you behind the wheel of luxury Prado jeeps as you navigate eerie landscapes. ear-doctor: Ear Doctor puts you in the role of a skilled ear specialist, and the goal is to build your reputation as the very best in the field. Play with just your mouse. You begin treating patients right away, working through each job as the most well-known ear doctor around.

red-and-green-candy-forest: Red and Green: Candy Forest is a platform adventure for one player or two. fast-decode: Fast Decode is a quick-paced escape room puzzle game in which speed matters. Your job is to work out how mechanisms function and crack them so you can get out. bus-crash-stunts: Step behind the wheel of a bus in this driving simulator built around demolition. You can steer into the arena, smash your vehicle into obstacles, and perform stunts. car-defender: In Car Defender, you upgrade your vehicle so it can hold off every wave of enemy attacks. Gold is the key resource: the more you save up, the more you can spend on upgrades. Each upgrade raises the level, which brings in more revenue and lets you build more vehicles.

noob-guys: Noob Guys is a 2D running race pitting a noob against a crowd of friends. A single fall sends you back to the start, and nobody wants that. Your aim is to finish first and claim the win. Earn crowns along the way to unlock noob costumes, and try to buy the best outfit available.

pin-pull-3d-game: Pin Pull 3D is a classic puzzle title drawn in a three-dimensional style. Your aim is to fill a pool with water. The ramp works like a mini ramp stunt, a flat surface tilted at an angle with one end sitting higher than the other. Inclined planes like this are used to raise or lower a load.
Controls are simple: press W to drive forward and S to reverse. It is a 3D arcade skill game that runs right in your browser.
gear-race-car-game: Gear Race Car Game is a racing title where timing, speed, and smooth gear shifting decide who wins. It asks you to test your driving skills while you work toward one goal: becoming the racing champion by beating the competition.

Controls are handled entirely with your mouse. To click any button, just move the pointer over it and press the mouse button. Keep your eyes on the road and your timing sharp, since the right gear at the right moment is what
car-traffic-sim: Car Traffic Sim puts you behind the wheel in a lifelike driving experience. You navigate a busy street packed with vehicles, and you must manage your fuel or race the clock. If you prefer a calmer pace, an endless road lets you wander wherever you like.

Keep an eye out so you don't crash into other traffic. The game offers three modes and multiple levels to work through, along with solid visuals and believable handling. Steer with WASD, toggle the headlights with L, and sound your horn with the Space bar.
chinese-and-asian-cooking-game: Step into a hands-on kitchen simulator centered on Chinese and other Asian cuisines. Players learn to prepare a range of popular dishes, from noodles and fried rice to tasty street food. Each recipe unfolds in stages, so you can follow the process from beginning to end.

Every action is handled with the mouse, which you use to click any button in the game. Work through each stage at your own pace and enjoy watching a meal come together. It is an interactive experience built around the simple pleasure of making food.
supermarket-empire: Supermarket Empire puts you in charge of a grocery store and asks you to grow it into a successful chain. You run the daily operations, and every sale brings in cash you can reinvest. As your business gets bigger, you add more goods to the shelves so shoppers find what they came for. Movement is handled with the WASD or arrow keys, and you can also hold the left mouse button and drag to look around the store.

This 3D management game is filed under hypercasual and touches on cooking and food themes. It is a simulation with an arcade feel, aimed at players who enjoy building something from a small shop into a bigger operation. Keep an eye on what customers want, and keep your stock varied to keep them coming back.
challenge-the-runners: Dash through bright, cheerful courses spread across different tracks in this racing title. Your goal is to keep moving forward in every race without getting knocked out. Expect plenty of obstacles, traps, and rivals along the way. You can take on computer-controlled runners or online opponents, or challenge a friend in two-player mode.

Controls are simple. Solo players move with W, A, S, and D or the arrow keys, and jump with the space bar. In two-player mode, the first runner moves with W, A, S, and D and jumps with G, while the second runner uses the arrow keys and also jumps with G. Coins earned from game achievements can be used to unlock new skins and characters.
truck-simulator-offroad-driving: Step into the seat of a professional truck driver in this 3D transport simulation. On every level, your job is to deliver the cargo to its destination completely intact. Staying steady on the track is essential, since the truck must never tip off balance. Each mission also has to be finished on time.
On a computer, press W to go forward, A and D to turn the wheel, and S to back up. Phone and tablet players can simply tap the buttons shown on the screen to drive.
ultraman-monster-island-adventure-3: This HTML5 adventure takes place around a newly discovered island in the Pacific Ocean. Its shores are said to hold many valuable sapphires, so villagers rush there to seek the treasure. Unfortunately, none of them ever return. Ultraman sets out on the road to this monster island to face the danger himself.

The game is 2D and includes a two-player mode. Player one moves with A, D and W, while the keys P2, P3, J, L and I make up the other listed controls. It is a quick way to explore a mysterious island and find out what happened to the people who went before.
super-phantom-rabbit: Super Phantom Rabbit is a 2D adventure for one player, with action and arcade elements. You guide a handsome bunny who is convinced he has superpowers. His journey leads to the guards waiting at the end of the episode, and in the final episode he hopes to join the guardian army. Along the way he must protect his own life and defend his forest, all while dodging a host of powerful, dangerous monsters.
The WASD keys control movement, and mobile players can use touch controls. A double jump is available to help you reach higher ground.
resist-zombie: Resist Zombie is a shooting game where you keep picking up new weapons. You can combine them to create stronger ones, which helps when enemies pour in. Your main job is to hold your ground and fight off every attacker that comes for your territory.

The game is controlled with mouse clicks, so there are no complicated inputs to learn. It carries the .io tag, placing it among io-style titles. Your goal stays the same throughout: keep building stronger weapons and protecting the land you hold.
city-metro-bus-simulator: You play as a bus driver whose job is to carry passengers to every station they need to reach and drop them off there. Your route can run through the busy city or out along the countryside. Several bus skins let you change how your vehicle looks, and the game spans two environments across multiple levels.
Steering is handled with the W, A, S and D keys. Press C to switch the camera view.
zoo-pinball: Zoo Pinball takes you back in time to a dusty old pinball saloon. Each time the metal ball knocks against the bouncers, you can hear it, and you can watch the score climb. The game is meant to feel like a real pinball table, and it runs right in your phone's browser. The table carries a zoo theme throughout.

Your aim is to send the ball into the jaws of a lion, a tiger, or a hippo, since each one can earn you a lot of points. Before playing, swipe to shoot the ball into the table. Then tap the left or right side of the screen to work the flippers and keep the ball in play.
fruit-slice-classic: Fruit Slice Classic is a hypercasual slicing game about making juice. Your main job is to slice the fruit so it turns into juice. As you follow the on-screen instructions, you build up your juice supply and mix together a special blend. Then you serve customers who want different flavors of fresh, juicy fruit.

Every cut counts, because the juice you make is what keeps your orders moving. Keep your customers satisfied by serving the flavors they ask for, and keep your supply growing as you play. The game is part of the Fruit Slice Games collection, and it is a simple, playful take on fruit slicing.
rop-help: In Rope Help, a group of stickmen is caught in a huge blaze, and you must use a rope to pull them to safety. You control the rope, work your way past the obstacles in the path, and solve a series of tricky, one-of-a-kind puzzles. This hypercasual HTML5 skill game features stickman characters.

Your goal is to get every stickman away from the fire. Each puzzle asks you to think carefully about how the rope moves and where it needs to go. Because the puzzles are built differently from one another, you will need to adjust your approach as you go. Keep at it until every stickman is out of the flames.
real-taxi-driver-3d: Climb into the driver's seat of this 3D taxi simulator and pick up fares around a well-ordered city. You can choose from several taxi driver models and play in task mode, free mode, park mode, or multiplayer. Passengers move with lifelike animation, a level system tracks your progress, and an intelligent traffic system keeps the streets busy around you.

Vehicle physics feel realistic, and you can drive in either night or day mode. Sound and visual effects, a navigation system, and two language options round out the experience, along with an improved market system and more than fourteen vehicle models. Use W, A, S, and D to steer and drive, C to change the camera, F for nitro, and E or Q to give signals. Only one play counts toward comments and evaluation.
fire-storm: The city has erupted into open war, and only a handful of elite fighters have taken to the streets. Almost nobody makes it out alive. Gangs now control the city, and your job is to get rid of them to save humanity. This 3D shooter, built with WebGL and HTML5, also features cars and driving.

The game is split into several levels, and in each one you must reach your goal without dying. Your targets include shooting 100 enemies and destroying their cars. The controls are simple: use WASD to move, the left mouse button to shoot, and the right mouse button to throw a grenade. Press Space to jump and Shift to slow down time.
fire-dragon-adventure: Set in the past, a brave hero and his loyal dragon set out on a journey through a land full of monsters and dangerous traps. Along the way, they must gather gold, precious stones, and treasures.

The game can be played in split-screen mode, letting you and a friend each steer one character. In certain levels, puzzles can only be solved when both players work together. The hero moves with W, A, S, and D, jumps with W, and attacks with F. The dragon moves with the arrow keys, jumps with the up arrow, and fires with L, P, or S. The hero can also jump off walls by pressing W, and some levels require this wall-jump.
top-fun-burger-maker: Top Fun Burger Maker casts you as the head chef in a busy kitchen. Clients arrive with different requests, and your task is to prepare their burgers. Speed matters here, since you need to finish each order as quickly as you can.

This arcade game mixes cooking with skill, so you have to stay quick while handling each client's burger. Everything is controlled with your mouse. It is a simple, focused way to test how fast you can work in the kitchen.
domino-legend: Domino Legend brings the classic tile game to your browser. Whether you are a seasoned player or have not picked up a set since childhood, it should be easy to get back into. The game includes two popular styles, Block and Draw, so you can choose the version you enjoy. It is also a good fit for a quick two-player match.

Each round continues until one player has placed every tile or the board is blocked and neither player can make a move. At the start, both players are dealt seven tiles, and the player holding the higher double begins. Each round is a fresh chance to test your strategy against your opponent.
jeep-wheelie: Jeep Wheelie is a simple 2D driving game with 10 levels. Your goal is to keep the Jeep on its rear wheels as you drive through each one. Every level has various obstacles. Some can be ridden over, while others must be cleared with a jump. Collecting dollars adds to your total score.
Use the Right arrow key to wheelie the Jeep, and press the Space key to jump and avoid the obstacles.
unblock-puzzle: Sharpening your reasoning is worth the effort in this brain teaser. Work through each board with fresh ideas, and you can grow your skills while chasing a top score. Keep returning to it, since repetition builds ability.

This challenging puzzle suits players of every age. Your goal is to free the red block from the board by moving the other blocks out of its path. Plan a route that takes the fewest moves possible. If a level stumps you, a hint is available to help.
legendary-soccer: Legendary Soccer is a free online soccer game you can play right in your browser. You can test your skills against the computer as a single player, or challenge a friend in a two-player match. It suits people of every age and skill level. Your job is to control three soccer players, make passes, and score goals.

To shoot, hold a player and pull back toward the ball, then let go. The cartoon-style artwork gives the game a light, playful look. Sides take turns, so each move matters. To move a player, grab one of the three, drag the cursor to where you want them to go, and release it. Once the goal is scored, the match goes on, and you can see who wins.
traffic-io-control: You take the role of a traffic controller at a busy crossroad, where your job is to keep vehicles moving smoothly and prevent accidents. Cars arrive from two directions, and you choose which side gets through and which must hold back. This title works as a realistic traffic light control simulator, letting you act like a traffic conductor who keeps the city flowing.

Fans of traffic jam puzzles should find plenty to test their timing here, and the game can also be enjoyed with friends. Controls are simple: a left mouse click starts and stops the cars. Think of it as directing city traffic the
ben-10-power-surge: Tap into the Omnitrix and become HeatBlast in this Ben 10 game. You play as Ben Tennyson, who has to stop Billy Billions and his wicked drones. Gather Omnitrix energy to shift into a far stronger alien form. The mission is to beat Billy Billions along with every other villain you meet.

Switch between aliens such as Heatblast and Stinkfly by drawing on the Omnitrix's power. That energy matters in everyday life too, so keep an eye on it and don't let it drop too low. To play, move the ball with your finger or with your computer mouse.
train-surfers: Train Surfers is a hypercasual 3D arcade game packed with action. You keep your character moving through a never-ending course, where you sprint, leap, swerve, and slide to stay ahead of trouble. The police are hot on your heels, so escaping them is the main challenge, and much of the chase takes place on railway tracks. Your goal is to get away and claim the win.

The controls are simple and flexible. Press W, A, S, or D, or use the arrow keys to move. If you would rather steer with your mouse, that works too. Tagged as a fun, strategy-friendly subway runner, the game keeps a lively pace from start to finish.
worm-stack: Worm Stack is a puzzle game filled with colorful worms that are knotted together across the screen. Your job is to tap them in the correct sequence so they slide off the field one by one. Choosing the right order takes care, because a wrong tap can leave the others stuck.

Playing is simple: just click with your mouse or tap the screen. Each worm you free clears a little more of the tangle, and the challenge lies in untangling the whole mess without rushing. It is a good pick for anyone who enjoys thinking through a puzzle at their own pace.
stickman-fighter-epic-battle: If you enjoy fighting games and stickman games, this one was made with you in mind. You step into an arena as a heroic stick figure and face a long line of rivals. Mercy is not an option, because your goal is to defeat every opponent. Watch out, since you will meet numerous warriors, one after another.

To strike, tap or click the left or right side of the screen, or press the arrow keys. Stand in front of an opponent to begin the combat. Each enemy is unique, so no two fights feel the same. A life bar keeps track of your health as the battle goes on.
blocks-of-color: Blocks of Color is a single-player puzzle game that tests your eyes and reflexes. Obstacles come toward you, and you get rid of them by clicking at the right moment. As your score rises, the challenge grows, because the objects move faster and you need more focus and precision to keep up.

Be careful, since one careless click or a brief lapse in attention can set off an explosion and end the game. The controls are simple: you only need to click the mouse. Stay alert and steady, and see how far your score can climb before one mistake stops you.
the-untitled-happiness-project: You play as an employee of the Happiness corporation, sent to the town of Phaseolus. Your job is to cheer up two residents, Jonathan Perry and Rachel Portland. You follow each of them through their daily routine, explore the town, and talk with the locals. The information you collect in these chats helps you untangle their case and bring back their good mood.

Movement uses W, A, S and D. Press F to interact, and Tab to open the mindmap, where you can review what you have found. P resets the game, and Esc opens the menu. This is a single-player 3D adventure built with WebGL and set in a city.
lol-surprise-preppy-fashion: Meet the LOL Surprise doll, who is ready to try a fresh look in the preppy style. Your job is to browse the wardrobe and choose the best outfits for her. Show off your fashion sense and style her so she ends up with a dazzling appearance.

Everything is controlled with the left mouse button, so each choice takes just a click. This girls' dress-up makeover game is part of a new collection of titles, and it's built to be played in your browser. Take your time, experiment with different combinations, and enjoy the styling.
dora-spot-the-difference: In this spot-the-difference game, you study two images side by side and search for the mismatches between them. Your goal is to find the differences so that Dora ends up very happy. The cartoon fun is aimed at young players who enjoy a lighthearted puzzle.
Controls are simple: use your mouse or tap the screen to pick out each change. The game runs in the browser and also works on Android devices, so you can enjoy it on the go. Good luck
sweet-baby-beauty-salon: Step into a girls' beauty salon where you work your way up to become a top stylist. You can handle hair and nails, and the whole visit feels like a relaxing spa day shared with friends. Run your own hair salon and make sure every girl leaves looking polished.

Alice is ready for a manicure and a facial, while Emma needs a cool new hairstyle. Princess Kitty is due for a pedicure, and Emily is up for some creative experimentation as you try a brunette look on her. Everything is controlled with a mouse click or a tap, so you can jump right in.
bts-dora-coloring-book: BTS Dora Coloring Book is a set of online coloring pages made for kids. It features Dora the Explorer, one of the most recognizable cartoon characters of today. Dora is Latina, and she speaks both English and Spanish.

Pick any of the Dora images in the collection and color it however you like. Your pictures are yours to shape, so take your time and let your creativity guide each stroke. Control is simple: use your mouse, or tap the screen if you are on a touch device. Bring each Dora picture to life in the colors you cho
basketball-shooter: If you enjoy basketball, this 2D sports game puts you in the player's seat as you compete against the other team. You can choose the challenge mode, a 1 player option, or a 2 player match, so you can play alone or with a friend. Your goal is to shoot for high scores and enjoy the win when you get there.

On PC, the controls are simple. Hold the mouse click to set the distance of your shot, then release the mouse click to shoot. Judging the distance well is the key to scoring, so keep practicing until your shots start landing.
super-ducks-world: Super Ducks World is a two-dimensional adventure with 45 demanding stages. You steer a duck through brightly colored settings, dodging tricky hazards and getting past dangerous traps. Gather rewards, hop from platform to platform, and put your abilities to the test on every stage. The controls feel smooth and quick to respond, and each level introduces something new. It's a cheerful trip packed with action and strategy, suited to players of every age.

On a computer, the left and right arrow keys move the duck, and the up arrow makes it jump. The layout is simple and responsive, which keeps play flowing. On phones and tablets, touch the on-screen buttons to move and jump with ease.
angry-zombies: Angry Zombies is an arcade game that plays much like the well-known bird-slinging puzzler. You work through its levels one after another, finishing each before moving on. It is a single-player 2D title built on physics, with plenty of action and a silly zombie theme.

To play, click or tap the skull, drag it toward the left, and release. The controls are simple to grasp, so you can try a few launches and see how the physics respond. The game suits anyone who likes funny, lighthearted action with a monster twist.
mr-bean-jigsaw: Mr. Bean Jigsaw is a free online puzzle game built around putting pictures back together. First, select one of six images that catches your eye. Next, pick a mode with 16, 36, 64, or 100 pieces. Your target is to finish the jigsaw in the least amount of time possible.

Playing is simple because you can use a mouse or touch the screen. Pick the 16-piece mode for a quick round, or the 100-piece one for a longer test. Either way, your favorite scene is waiting to be completed.
stamp-it-puzzle-game: Stamp It Puzzle puts you in the role of an airport security officer. Your job is to steer a cube-shaped stamp, gather ink along the way, and press accurate stamps onto passports. The game mixes logic, planning, and fun, so it suits anyone who enjoys solving puzzles.

Brain training challenges are built in to sharpen your logic and critical thinking. Movement is handled with the four arrow keys: Left, Right, Up, and Down. Choose your path carefully, plan a few moves ahead, and aim to stamp every passport correctly.
idle-ants: Your goal is to become the greatest ant king. Ants are the true experts of underground life, living in a neat and orderly way. Take charge of your colony as it grows, commanding it with the power of a god. Your ants can devour bugs, eggs, exotic foods, airplanes, and practically anything else in their path.
Send your army to destroy everything in front of it, and earn money along the way. The controls are simple: tap or click to play.
speed-bumps: Speed Bumps is a 3D car driving game built with HTML5 and WebGL. Its main challenge is taking your vehicle across more than 300 speed breakers. Rather than following the usual racing pattern, it is a different take on the genre, with simulation and stunt elements mixed in. The focus stays on each bump you meet.

Driving is handled entirely with the keyboard. Press W, A, S and D to move your car across the road and over the breakers. The setup is simple, so you can get going quickly and concentrate on the crossings.
fail-run: Meet a young robot, one of the first of its kind, that is just taking its first steps. Every attempt to move forward ends with it losing its footing, so it needs a guiding hand. Your job is to help this little machine keep its balance as it learns to walk.

The journey begins on a level, flat stretch of ground, but the path grows tougher as it goes, with a variety of hurdles and obstacles waiting ahead. Whether the robot manages to master walking rests in your hands. The only control you need is to press to walk.
army-cargo-transport-driving-online: Driving a military truck is not the same as driving an ordinary car on a normal road. In this 3D simulation, your job is to carry infantry soldiers safely to the battlefield. The route to the parking area is scattered with obstacles and rocks, so you need to steer with care. Be warned: your truck will blow up once you have crashed three times.

Movement is handled with the arrow keys. Press the down arrow or the space bar to brake, and tap R to change gear. Keep your passengers in mind and take each turn patiently, because one more bump could be the last.
real-excavator-simulator: Real Excavator Simulator puts you in charge of cartoon-style construction machines, all built in 3D. Each level gives you a set of vehicles and a job to finish within the time limit. In most missions the real challenge is steering to the marked areas steadily, so you will need a calm hand on the controls. It is a simulation focused on driving and trucks, and it runs in your browser and works on mobile devices too.
Move your vehicle with W, A, S and D, and press the Space bar to brake. Every mission asks for careful driving, so take each machine through the course patiently.
wedding-makeover-salon: Wedding Makeover Salon is a free dress-up and makeup game made for girls and kids. Inside the salon, you do your own makeup and pick your clothes to transform yourself into a stylish, beautiful bride. Every girl pictures her own wedding, and this game lets you turn that picture into something you can see.

Your goal is to become the most beautiful bride in the world. Controls are easy: play with a mouse or by touch, whichever suits your device. Experiment freely until the look feels just right. It is completely free for anyone who enjoys dressing up and trying out different styles.
russian-niva-hexagon: In this 3D racing game, you take the wheel of a Niva car on a hexagon-based course. Victory goes to the driver who survives the longest, so you must be the last one to tumble off the cliff. Reach the road to victory first, stay in the lead as long as you can, and gather scores along the way to claim the win.

Steer with the arrow keys and use the Space button for the other control. Players on phones or tablets can use touch controls instead. Tags for this arcade-style title include adventure, multiplayer, and race.
fish-love: In Fish Love, you save fish from dangers such as bombs, lava, and a crab, then give them love. These fish cannot live without each other, so keeping them together is the heart of the game. Pleasant music and sound effects play throughout, and bright, colorful graphics accompany you through all of the puzzles.

Everything is controlled by touch, so you simply touch the screen to move through each challenge. The game is tagged as a puzzle, brain, and fishing title, and its cheerful style makes it suitable for kids as well as anyone who enjoys puzzles.
clown-park-hide-and-seek-game: Clown Park - Hide And Seek pits one camp against another in an arcade-style match. The visuals are attractive, and the game takes place in a three-dimensional space. Players choose from three modes: Survivor camp, Chaser camp, or a random option that assigns the lineup for you if you cannot decide or want a surprise.

Survivors must gather enough keys to open the escape door before the clock runs out, and reaching that door wins the round. Pursuers have the opposite task, working to slow the survivors down. Plenty of skins and skills can be unlocked, and finishing missions is how you unlock new characters.
billiard-and-golf: Billiard and Golf mixes two classic games into one. You aim on a snooker-style table and plan your angles so the ball drops into a golf-style hole. Use the mouse to swipe and set the direction and force of your shot. Sink the ball with a precise hit to unlock the next stage. Chaining successful shots one after another helps you earn the highest score.
The game offers more than 30 levels, each with its own pool table layout. Every new table asks you to think about bank shots and careful planning, so the fun stays fresh from start to finish.
turn-over-master: Turn Over Master is a 3D arcade car game in which you take the wheel with a stickman riding along as your passenger. You join a stunt race and must get past different terrains and tracks by rotating your car as you go, so every run calls for careful control of its angle.

Playing is simple. Tap and hold to speed up or to perform stunts, and use that single control to keep your car moving through each section. Whether you are crossing rough ground or following a winding track, the goal stays the same: get over every stretch of the course and keep the race going.
stickman-maverick-bad-boys-killer: You play as a stickman soldier whose job is to wipe out every bad boy. Plenty of weapons are at your disposal, along with new stickman characters, huge mecha, and other devastating weapons of mass destruction. Enemies come at you from both sides, so you have to fight hard, because the only other option is dying.
At its core, this is a pure destruction game, and a skilled player can take down thousands of stickmen. Upgrade your weapons and buy items to get stronger, then tap to kill them all.
wild-island-quest: Wild Island Quest is a 3D hypercasual adventure where you explore, collect materials, and build your way forward. Your story begins on a secluded island, and every bit of material matters. Swing at trees to gather wood and break apart rocks to get stone. Bring those supplies back to unlock new tools and abilities, then use those tools to reach fresh materials. Finish missions by crafting items such as berry jam, and collect coins to buy upgrades for your gear and str
boom-chain: Boom Chain is a one-player hypercasual game built around chain reactions. You begin with a group of firecrackers, and you must pick which one to light first. That single blast sets off a chain that can reach the rest of the crackers, so the order you choose really matters.

Think carefully before each move, because a poor choice can leave some crackers unbroken. Your aim is to burst every cracker on the screen. The game is labeled casual and bomb-themed, and it carries the Best Games tag on the site.
squid-challenge-honeycomb: Squid Challenge Honeycomb is inspired by the Squid Game series and asks you to copy well-known shapes using a small stick. You can play it for free for hours on end. The goal is to prove your skill, come out on top, and win the entire prize pool in this survival contest. Begin by choosing the character you like best, then work through each stage.

The game has more than ten levels. The first four focus on basic shapes, while the later stages demand much more precision. Be careful, because a single mistake sends you back to the very start, and your character is eliminated. When that happens, pick another character and try again. Controls are simple: tap or click.
wave: Wave is an online puzzle game for kids that works as a single-player 2D title. It plays on phones and tablets, including iPhone, iPad, and Samsung devices, as well as other Apple and Android systems. Its hypercasual style is fast-paced and cool.

A single ball is always in motion, and obstacles of many kinds appear at random along its path. You have just one action: tap the screen to change the direction the ball travels. Your goal is to avoid the obstacles and earn a high score.
run-santa: Run Santa asks you to guide him as far as he can go while he hands out gifts along the way. The route is full of traps, so you will need careful timing. Leap over the gaps between houses, and dodge the icicles that fall from above. When you pass a chimney in mid-jump, throw a present down it. Knocking into a chimney slows you down, so keep your movements precise.
The goal is a merry Christmas with many presents under the tree, and the outcome is entirely in your hands. This jumping game runs in your browser and rewards quick reactions and steady focus.
whimsy-workshop-easy: Whimsy Workshop Easy is a simpler take on the original Whimsy Workshop. Your task is to get the balls bouncing and steer them into a holding box, where they need to stay put. To do this, position the guiding objects carefully so each ball follows the right path.

The game is filed under Sports and is tagged with Ball, Physics, and Science, which fits its focus on bouncing balls and how they move. Your main job is to set up the guides in the right places so the balls land in the box and remain there.
shoe-outlet: You run your own shoe shop in this retail-themed game, working your way up to become a business tycoon. Your job is to look after customers, keep the store running, and grow a shopping empire from a modest storefront. Timing matters here, so you will need to weigh your options and make fast calls to come out ahead. The game mixes id
baby-good-habits: Baby Good Habits is a girls' game that teaches little ones everyday routines through play. It covers eating without being fussy about food, brushing teeth after meals, and heading to bed at a sensible hour. Parents and children can work through these habits side by side. Along the way, you help the baby keep teeth clean and get ready for bath time, adjusting the water temperature, filling the tub, and fitting a waterproof cap before a fun bubble bath.
The game is tagged as cute, educational, and family-friendly, with themes of baby care, cooking, cleaning, and food. You control everything with a mouse or by tapping the screen.
my-angela-talking-coloring-book: Paint your way through a large collection of hand-drawn pictures in My Angela Talking Coloring Book. Most of the artwork centers on Angela Talking, and you will also find drawings of famous characters to fill in. Each picture is yours to brighten with whatever colors you choose.

Coloring works by dragging across the area you want to fill. Whether you feel like taking your time with a sketch or experimenting with different shades, the pictures give you plenty to work with. Every drawing has its own look, so there is always something new to try. It is a cheerful pick for anyone who enjoys drawing and adding color to characters they already know.
beauty-makeup-salon: A wicked witch placed a curse on a lovely young princess, and she slept inside the castle for many years. Then a courageous prince slew the dragon guarding the castle and rescued her. To celebrate her awakening, the king arranged a lavish feast. Eager to look her best for the prince who saved her, the princess heads to her dressing room, which is full of stunning outfits, shoes, and jewelry.

Your job is to pick the makeup and costumes that will make her the most beautiful princess at the party. Control her with a mouse or by tapping the screen. This girls dress-up makeover simulation lets you style her from head to toe.
battle-cars: Battle Cars mixes racing with survival and explosive action. You drive your car around the track and gather equipment along the way, and these pickups become your secret weapon once you enter the arena. Inside, you must defeat every opponent to win. Expect blasts and tense moments as you fight for the extreme survival that the game is built around.
Steering is simple: tap and slide to move your car. The title is a 3D game with driving, collecting, bombs and defense elements, so there is plenty to keep you busy from start to finish.
rainbow-girls-christmas-outfits: Four rainbow girls, Skyler, Sunny, Ruby, and Violet, are getting ready for their Christmas festivities. They want to try on cute holiday outfits and go through some wild makeovers. Your job is to browse their wardrobes, choose outfits for each girl, and pick accessories that match.
You play by using a left mouse button click. Spend some time with these girls and help them make this holiday season one to remember.
floppy-bird: Guide little Red Bird across the sky as it dodges obstacles that would otherwise end its flight, steering it safely through the gaps. The game is simple to pick up but tough to master. Each tap makes the bird flap upward, and when you stop tapping it drops back down under gravity, so timing is everything.

To play, tap the screen to flap and keep the bird clear of the pipes. Only a single click or touch is needed to get started. It is a great pick for children who want to keep themselves busy for a long stretch, and anyone who enjoys a light, flapping challenge can jump in and have fun.
easter-egg-search: Easter Egg Search is a skill-based puzzle that tests how sharp your eye is. A board full of different Easter eggs fills the screen, and your task is to find the exact match for the egg shown in the panel on the left. Search each block until you locate that matching egg, and keep moving through the blocks to finish the game.
You can play with a mouse or with touch controls, so tapping and clicking both work. Take your time, compare each egg with the one in the panel, and work your way across the board.
combo-slash: Combo Slash is a puzzle game with controls that are simple to operate, so you can jump right in. Every level has its own carefully designed setup, and you must try different needle-drawing sequences to solve each one. Some levels add dangerous restrictions that make the challenge tougher and keep you eager to either win or give it another go after a loss.

Your task is to help the little princess escape danger by getting past a wide variety of barrier problems. These obstacles push your brain to think hard as you search for a way through. The small, fresh cartoon pictures are pleasant to look at, and the well-built puzzles give your thinking a full workout.
black-thrones: Black is an assassin on one final mission, hoping to make amends and protect the people he loves. The journey takes place on top of a never-ending wall, where legions of undead rise to stop him. You leap over some obstacles and slide beneath others to keep moving.

Your dagger is your main weapon, and you cut down any enemy standing in your way without showing mercy. Each kill pushes your score higher. Coins are scattered across the wall, so gather as many as you can and spend them on upgrades for the power-ups you find, which help you survive longer and multiply your loot. It is a 2D, HTML5 endless run game with slicing and undead themes.
hugie-wugie-slide: Hugie Wugie, the plush monster, is collecting pictures today, and he chose this task on purpose. His goal is to take a break while giving his brain a gentle workout. You are invited to tag along on his lighthearted adventure.

This cartoon puzzle game runs in your web browser and works on phones as well as computers. Control is simple: use your mouse, or tap the screen if you are on a touch device. Pick it up whenever you want a relaxed mental challenge with a friendly furry character.
python-io: Can you grow into the longest snake around? In this game, if your head runs into a rival, you blow up and the round ends. Yet if a rival slams into your body, they are the ones who explode, and you get to feast on what they leave behind. Size is not everything here, since a small python can still beat a much bigger foe by cutting across its path.
Steering is simple. On a phone, touch and hold the screen to choose where your python heads. On a computer, move the mouse to point the python in the direction you want to go.
cube-rush-3d-survive-the-rush: Cube Rush 3D is a fast, physics-based runner where you race forward at full speed. You glide across a bright world made of simple low-poly shapes, gathering glowing cubes so your tower grows taller. A taller stack helps you leap over barriers, while lava pools can end your run. Along the way you can grab coins and unlock new skins, and your main goal is to build the tallest stack you can. Levels are generated as you play, so no two runs feel the same, and the smooth 3D visuals keep everything moving.

Controls are simple. On desktop, click and drag the mouse left or right to move. On mobile, drag left or right with your finger. Collect the yellow cubes to make your stack grow, and steer clear of the red ones. Keep your balance, reach the finish line, and stack, slide, and survive through every rush.
hyper-stunt: Hyper Stunt is a racing game where you drive across impossible tracks built around sky ramps. Your goal is to perform wild car stunts as you launch off each jump. The races are endless, so the track keeps going for as long as you want to keep driving. The game runs offline and costs nothing to start playing. Its car simulator is built based on your recent activity.

Expect a realistic environment, a selection of expensive racing cars, and stunning graphics. Fans of simulation and racing games should find plenty to enjoy, especially anyone who loves jumping through big ramp courses. Steer your car with the arrow keys.
zombie-survival-escape-usa: Set out through a city overrun by the undead in this shooter. You keep moving and firing at the same time, because the zombies are quick, dangerous, and will chase you without letting up, aiming to devour you. The outbreak has begun, and surviving it is the only goal. This is a 3D title with detailed, lifelike visuals that can give you a real sense of dread about being caught.

Your job is to keep running and find an open spot where you can make a stand. From there, take down every zombie before they reach you and grab hold. Move with W, A, S and D, press the spacebar to jump, and use the mouse to aim and fire.
fashion-girl-fitness-plan: Adella is getting ready for a beach holiday as summer approaches, but after eating a lot she has picked up some extra weight. With such an important trip coming up, shedding those pounds quickly matters to her. A change in diet can help, but a strict personal coach can make a real difference too, and in this game that coach is you. Drawing on your experience, you choose the training style, the exercises and a healthy meal plan for her.
Each session offers different activities, so the routine never feels repetitive. Click or tap to play, and guide Adella toward a fitter figure before she leaves for the coast.
happy-cat: Happy Cat is a physics puzzler where your imagination is the key to getting past each obstacle. Sketch shapes and objects directly on the screen, then watch how they respond to the environment as you steer the playful cat toward its destination. Every stage presents its own riddle, and cracking it takes sharp reasoning, well-judged timing, and a willingness to try different ideas. Gravity plays a key role, and clever construction lets you finish a level in more than one way.

Controls are kept simple, so the focus stays on thinking through each setup. Pacing is calm and unhurried, giving you room to experiment without pressure. Because you decide what to build, every solution feels personal, and the variety of levels keeps the game engaging from start to finish.
the-bottle-flip: Your goal in The Bottle Flip is to toss a plastic bottle into the air so it lands a clean flip, or even a double flip. The trick is timing: tap the screen at just the right moment to launch the bottle. You move through a variety of rooms and bounce off furniture such as shelves, tables, chairs, sofas, and even subwoofers. Strength and distance both depend on how long you hold your tap, so you need to judge each jump carefully to reach the finish line.

The game asks you to build up your agility and coordination as you go. Each stage brings new obstacles and fresh challenges, so the flips stay varied and interesting. Keep practicing to perfect your favorite tricks and see how far your bottle can travel.
ultimate-boxing-the-boxing-king: Step into the ring with this online boxing game, where every bout is a tough fight from start to finish. Your aim is to defeat your opponents before they manage to defeat you. Winning takes real boxing skill, and the game itself is where you can learn those skills as you play. It is a sports title with plenty of action for fans of the genre.

Controls are simple: you only need to tap or click to play. Keep improving your technique, because every match will test how much you have learned. Your goal is to come out as the winner and claim the crown of the Boxing King.
spot-the-differences-halloween: This spot the difference puzzle wraps its challenge in a Halloween theme, so every picture carries a spooky seasonal mood. Your job is to study two images that look nearly alike and track down the changes hidden between them. The goal is to find five differences across the pair, so take your time and check each detail carefully.

Controls are simple. Tap the place where you spot a difference between the two images, and keep scanning until all five have been found. It is a light, seasonal puzzle that rewards sharp eyes and careful looking.
bts-ladybug-coloring: This free online coloring game is brand new and lets you pick your favorite shades from a palette. Your job is to fill in the pages featuring the LadyBug characters from BTS, bringing each drawing to life one color at a time.

The pages are a fun way for kids to get creative, and the game asks you to keep your colors inside the lines. You can control everything with a mouse or by tapping the screen, so you can begin painting with either input.
crazy-sea-battle: Crazy Sea Battle drops you onto the water in a battle royale against players from all over the world. You sail the ocean to pick up loose raft pieces, widen the area you control, and grow your team. Before the clashes begin, you choose your team's color, gather the parts floating on the waves, and reinforce your raft.

Once you feel ready, you join quick-moving fights against rival rafts, all trying to take control of the sea. Drag to steer your raft, and move into a floating piece to collect it. Enemies within range are engaged automatically, so you can concentrate on positioning. Plan your route carefully to expand your territory and avoid danger. Only the most robust raft keeps afloat.
subway-spider-kid-game: Subway Spider Kid is a quick endless runner where you guide a young hero with spider powers through busy subway tracks. The pace stays high from start to finish, so you need to keep moving, weave past hazards, and get away from trouble before it catches you.

Steer with W or the Up arrow to head forward, S or the Down arrow to step back, A or the Left arrow to shift left, and D or the Right arrow to shift right. Any buttons on screen are selected with a mouse click. Expect plenty of action and speed as you dash along the tracks, all wrapped in a lighthearted, fun-filled run.
speedboat-challenge-racing: Speedboat Challenge Racing puts you behind the wheel of fast powerboats for a high-intensity race. You can enter competitive races or head out in Free Drive mode to try stunts and cruise wherever you like. Both modes can be played alone or with a friend in two player mode.

Controls for single player use W, A, S, and D or the arrow keys to steer and move. Press F for NOS, R to restart your position, T to look back, and C to switch the camera view. In two player mode, Player 1 uses W, A, S, and D along with F for NOS, R to restart, and T to look back.
impossible-car-stunts-mega-car-ramp: This game takes you across endless, extreme tracks floating high in the sky. If you love fast driving, you can join a rally high in the air and race rivals on beautifully built tracks. Pull off drifts and wild mid-air flips as you go, and aim to become a true stunt master. Pick your favourite car first.

Narrow, sharp routes are built over a city beneath a blue sky, so every mission needs careful driving. Use the nitro boost to clear hurdles and obstacles, and fly over ramps or clear rusty containers while keeping control of your car. Reach the finish line before time runs out. Each mission must be completed to unlock the next, and switching between camera views helps you avoid crashes and falls. The game is played with the keyboard.
baking-pizza: Making a pizza shaped like a heart is a lovely way to surprise your friends. You prepare your own tomato sauce, grate the cheese, chop the vegetables, and then present a tasty homemade pizza that you cooked yourself. Give it a few tries and you could be cooking like a skilled Italian chef and a true pizza expert.
The game is controlled with a mouse or by tapping the screen. It runs in your web browser and is aimed at girls who enjoy cooking and decorating food.
sky-burger-online: Sky Burger Online is a 3D arcade game about piling up a burger as high as it will go. Beef, cheese, eggs, lettuce, other vegetables and meat are all available, so you choose what goes into your stack. The main challenge is balance: keep adding ingredients for as long as the stack stands and watch the tower climb. Each attempt gives you a chance to beat your previous highscore.

Getting started takes just one tap. Tap to play, then keep building for as long as your burger holds together. Your aim is to create a tall, delicious stack that stays upright, and you can keep trying new tall builds whenever you want to chase a better score.
car-jumper: Launch your car off the ramp and see how far it can fly. Along the way, smash into the obstacles in your path, since the more damage you cause, the higher your score climbs. Spend your earnings on new vehicles, improve the ones you own, and prepare for the following stage. To jump, press the Up arrow key.
euro-cargo-transporter-truck-driver-simu: Step into the role of a cargo carrier in 2019 and haul heavy loads to their destination. Your job is to pilot oversized or overloaded freight trucks, along with their trailers, and keep them moving in a careful, professional manner. The game puts your steering skills to the test across rough off-road terrain, with big machines that take real focus to control.

It is a public transportation driving game from 2019 that asks how well you handle a large vehicle. Use the WASD keys to move your truck and press the Space bar to brake. Each run is a chance to show your skill behind the wheel as you deliver every cargo load.
fashion-valkyries-saga-of-style: Step into a mythical realm of the far north, where valkyrie fighters are waiting for a makeover. Your job is to dress up a set of bold young heroines and give each one a striking look. Pick warm fur garments, gleaming metal armor, and quirky accessories drawn from old Nordic legends. You can also play with tribal-style hairdos and fierce, battle-ready makeup. The goal is to put together a heroic appearance for every girl that suits these tough warriors of the cold lands.
Controls are simple. On a desktop or laptop, use your computer mouse to click and select items. On a touchscreen device, a tap does the same job.
football-strike-freekick-soccer: Football Strike - FreeKick Soccer offers a realistic free kick game in 3D. You try to win soccer matches by scoring goals with flick shots. Later, you take on the role of goalkeeper and stop the goals that come your way. It is an arcade and sports title.

All of the action is controlled with a mouse. Flick to kick the ball toward the net, then switch to defending as the keeper and block incoming shots. Whether you are attacking or defending, the game keeps football at its center.
ben-10-match-3-puzzle: Ben 10 Match 3 Puzzle is a single-player game for anyone who enjoys puzzles. It takes the match 3 style and fills the board with superheroes from the world of Ben 10, so fans of the show will recognize the characters. Your goal is to line up matching pieces, and the match 3 format keeps every round focused on that task.

Playing is done entirely by dragging. You move your pointer across the board to make your matches, so the controls stay simple from the first moment. Whether you follow the Ben 10 franchise or simply like match-3 challenges, this title offers a light and approachable way to test your puzzle skills.
princess-sailor-moon-casual-outfit: Many young fans love the Sailor Moon anime, and its costumes are especially popular with girls. In this game, five famous princesses, Elsa, Anna, Ariel, Snow White, and Rapunzel, are heading out shopping. They also enjoy the retro style that the anime characters wear, and many of their own outfits already look a lot like those costumes.
Your job is to pick beautiful clothes for each girl so that her outfit matches the Sailor Moon style. To play, just use a mouse click or a tap.
dead-zombie-target-shooting-game: This free 3D shooter puts you in a first-person view as you hunt zombies through a forest. If you enjoy zombie shooting games or action titles with assault-style weapons, this one offers a similar kind of fun. The woodland setting adds an adventure feel, and the undead lurking among the trees bring a sinister, evil atmosphere.

Move your character with the arrow keys. Press the left mouse button to shoot, and use the right mouse button to zoom in when you need a closer look at your target. The game sits under the Shooting category and carries tags such as Undead, Killing, and Adventure.
stickman-war: Stickman War is an action shooter where your goal is to eliminate every stickman on the battlefield to clear each stage. Aim with your mouse and click to fire. On touch screens, simply tap an enemy to shoot at them.

The game asks you to wipe out all the stick figures to finish it, so keep your aim steady and take them down one by one. It is a quick, straightforward shooter that fits the Action and Shoot categories, and it is easy to pick up for anyone who likes stickman-style battles.
cooking-alike: Cooking Alike is a puzzle game set in a kitchen. Your job is to spot items that look the same and link them together to earn points. The board is filled with picture pairs, including vegetables, cooking tools, and ingredients, and you need to notice them quickly and pick the right matches until nothing is left.

The rules are easy to grasp, but the challenge rises step by step as you progress. Along the way you'll give your memory and reaction speed a workout. Everything is controlled with the mouse, and chasing a top score gives you a reason to keep coming back.
stunt-car-impossible-track-challenge-3d: Take the wheel on a sky road built from impossible stunt tracks, where zigzag ramps climb to massive heights. Every jump, drift, and acrobatic mid-air flip tests your driving skill. Endless tracks let you race rivals up in the sky, much like a real car rally with no limits. Whether you are a quick racer or a stunt fan who loves cars, this free game offers plenty to enjoy.

Each level is thrilling and challenging, and the tracks are designed specifically for car stunt challenges. The car physics give jumps a convincing feel, so you need to stay careful on every run. This 2019 title is controlled entirely with the keyboard keys.
color-connect-3d: Color Connect 3D is a puzzle where you pair up balls that share the same shade. The catch is that your routes must never cross, so each line needs planning before you commit to it. What seems like a simple task quickly becomes a test of how far ahead you can think.

Every level presents a new arrangement built to challenge your concentration, reasoning, and problem-solving. You draw connections by tapping the screen or using a left mouse click. Played as a brain-training session, the game offers a colorful way to keep your mind sharp.
hill-climbing-2: Hill Climbing 2 is an adventure game about driving a car over bumpy roads. Your main task is to control acceleration so you avoid accidents as you go. The goal is to cover as much distance as you can and set a new record. It also fits the car, driving, and physics tags, so expect a game built around vehicle handling.

On a computer, press D or the Right key to accelerate, and press A or the Left key to accelerate in the opposite direction. On a phone or tablet, use the on-screen buttons to control your car. Both setups let you steer the same run, so you can switch devices and keep working toward a longer distance.
ninja-defender: Your job in this shooting puzzler is to guard the area behind you. Monsters head your way, and you need to destroy them before they get through. Throw a ninja star at each enemy, then make sure you catch it when it comes back, because a missed catch costs you a life.
Keep destroying monsters so you can move through all the levels with the lives you still have. Tap the left or right side of the screen to play, and tap the screen to get started.
coin-master-runner: Coin Master Runner keeps things simple, with no tricky systems to learn. You can jump into a run quickly, and each session is short enough to fit into whatever time you have. Getting started is just a matter of clicking the mouse or tapping the screen.

Whether you want to beat your previous record or just need something light to pass the time, this running game offers an easygoing and pleasant experience. It is designed for anyone who wants a quick, uncomplicated run without a steep learning curve.
fire-balls: Fire Balls 3D is a relaxed, casual balls game. Your task is to knock down a tower built from different geometric shapes by hurling fire balls at it, all while steering clear of obstacles along the way. It sits in the action category and draws on shooting and skill, with colorful visuals and an HTML5 build.

The game is played entirely with the mouse, so every move you make comes from pointer input. Keep an eye on the obstacles as you work through each tower, since they can get in the way of your shots. The mix of shapes and colors gives each tower its own look as you take it apart piece by piece.
city-coach-bus-simulator-2018: Take the wheel of a tourist coach in this browser game and learn what it takes to run a bus through a busy city. Your route can lead through crowded streets or out onto open highways. The maps are built for both settings, the vehicles are varied, and the graphics are sharp, so the whole experience feels close to sitting behind the wheel of a large bus.

Driving is handled with the keyboard. Use W, A, S and D to move the bus, press Space to brake, and tap I to start or stop the engine. If you want a different view of the road, press C to switch the camera.
fish-parking: Fish Parking is a driving lesson where you practise bringing your car into a marked spot. It is built for fish drivers who want to train their skills. The idea is that a real professional must park in designated zones no matter what the ground is like or what conditions they face, so the training ground lets you rehearse those situations before they happen.

Controls are simple. On a computer, move with the WASD keys or the arrow keys. On a phone or tablet, tap the on-screen buttons to move. It is a 3D driving game sorted under racing, with obstacles to work around as you go. Enjoy your time behind the wheel.
cute-rainbow-unicorn-puzzles: Get ready for a set of puzzles starring unicorns that are both adorable and goofy. In these scenes, the unicorns zoom around on a motorcycle, soar off into outer space, and have a real fondness for donuts. Your aim is to gather every picture in the collection.

Playing is simple: use the left mouse button, or tap the screen if you are on a touch device. Each puzzle lets you enjoy the unicorns' silly antics while you work toward completing the whole set. It is a light, cheerful pick for anyone who likes puzzles with a bright, playful theme.
dino-meat-hunt-dry-land: Summer is here, and the dinosaurs are out hunting for meat once again. This round brings a tougher adventure than before. The small dino can leap up to high places, while the big dino can smash through dangerous monsters. Watch out for unfamiliar enemies and hidden traps, and work through the puzzles together with a friend.

Each dino has its own set of keys. Play the big one with the arrow keys and press L to attack. Steer the little one with W, A, S and D, and press G to attack. To double jump, tap W twice. Coordinate with your partner, since each dino has different strengths.
horse-run-3d: Horse Run 3D is a free 3D running game in the action genre. Your first task is to get acquainted with a horse, and then the two of you set off on a run together. The game is endless, so the running can carry on for as long as you want.
You can control the game with either a mouse or a keyboard, so you can pick whichever feels more comfortable. Either way, the aim is the same: make a new horse friend and enjoy the run together.
neon-circuit: Neon Circuit is a puzzle game where you turn pipe pieces to link a power source with every terminal on the board. Each click or tap rotates a segment by 90 degrees, so your job is to line the pieces up into one unbroken, glowing circuit before your patience runs out. The game offers 40 hand-built levels spread over 8 zones of increasing difficulty. Early boards are small 4×4 grids, while later ones become large 8×8 networks with up to 5 terminals lit at the same time.
Every level can earn 3 stars, and you get them by finishing in fewer moves than par. Controls are simple: use a mouse click or a tap to rotate pie
extreme-winter-oil-tanker-truck-drive: Surviving winter depends a lot on oil, which people need for both their vehicles and their homes. In this 3D driving game, you take the wheel of a tanker truck and deliver that fuel to those who are waiting for it. The road surface is icy, the route is full of hazards, and snow falls on and off throughout the drive, so you will need to take each turn with real care.

Steer with the WASD keys or the arrow keys, and use your mouse to click the buttons that appear on screen. Keep your speed under control and stay alert, because one careless move on the slippery road could make the job much harder.
baby-preschool-learning-for-toddlers-and: Baby Preschool Learning is an educational game made for toddlers and young preschoolers. It poses simple prompts about everyday things: what color an apple is, what a kitty enjoys eating, and what the number one looks like. Children can work out the answers while they explore, which makes learning feel like discovery rather than a test.

Controls are easy to pick up, since everything is handled with a tap or a click. The game suits small children who are just beginning their early learning, and it encourages curiosity about colors, animals, and numbers. Think of it as a gentle first step into preschool lessons, with plenty of room for little minds to wander and find answers on their own.
stickman-archer-bow-fight: You stand alone against a crowd of enemies in this archer defense title, shooting arrows from a bow in a spooky forest where the battle is about to begin. Each stickman duel tests your aim against enemy archers, and every stage is packed with bow combat. There are more than 35 levels so far, with more on the way.
You have a chance to earn plenty of coins, which you can spend in the shop on four boosters: a shield, three arrow combos, arrow rain, and med
f1-racing: F1 Racing lets you tune up a formula car and drive it toward the front of the pack. Your goal is to cross the line in first place while racing against computer-controlled opponents. The game has 30 levels to work through, so there is plenty of track to cover.

Steering is handled with the arrow keys, and you can press the space bar to give your car a burst of speed when you need an extra push. Fans of racing and supercars will find the car-focused gameplay right at home. It is also built with mobile play in mind.
pop-it-fish-jigsaw: Pop It Fish Jigsaw is a free online puzzle game in the jigsaw genre, with a fish theme. Six different images are available, and you can play them across three separate modes. Select the mode you want, then start the round to begin.

Your goal is to rebuild each picture by dragging the scattered pieces into their correct spots until the full image appears. Everything is controlled with the mouse, so click and hold a piece, then move it where it belongs. It is a simple way to
sniper-pixel-shooting: Sniper Pixel Shooting puts you behind a pixel-style scope as you pick off enemies across small city battlefields. Accuracy matters most here, since every shot has to count and your ammo supply is limited. You will need to judge range and choose the right moment to fire as the missions grow more demanding.
