As you move through the stages, the layouts become more complex and enemies appear in new places. Each level also gives you less time to react, so you have to keep your aim steady and think ahead about your position. Controls rely on the mouse.
huggybros-christmas: Join the Huggy brothers for a festive journey full of Christmas cheer. Gather points as you go and spend them on charming outfits, with the goal of owning every costume. Along the way you'll pick up Christmas candies, but watch out for sharp thorns and rapidly spinning wheels.

Both brothers must reach the door together, but grab the key first, because the door stays shut without it. Move with WASD or the arrow keys, use the double jump when you need extra height, and switch to touch controls on mobile.
murder: You play as an assassin whose mission is to take out the king and claim the throne. Whether the attempt succeeds is up to you, and the story does not stop there, because holding onto the crown after the deed is another challenge. Each assassin reaches a different ending, so the game invites you to see how many of those endings you can play through.

The controls are simple. While you are an assassin, click or hold the screen to start shooting. Once you have become king, turn back to continue. This is a single-player stealth game with a fun, light feel, and it suits short sessions as well as longer runs.
advance-car-parking-simulation: If you enjoy driving, this game is a good fit. It helps you build your driving and parking skills and gives you realistic feedback from your car. Puzzle-style levels and obstacle courses test your precision across several stages, with parallel parking, reverse parking, and other smart driving challenges. You can practise in city streets, urban districts, and multi-storey car parks, where traffic and horns add extra pressure.

Its 3D physics make every turn and stop feel grounded, so careful control matters. Watch out for barriers as you manoeuvre through each area. Along the way, you learn classic parking techniques, including parallel parking, without attending any parking school. Drive with the UP, DOWN, LEFT, and RIGHT keys.
princess-salon: Three princesses are getting ready for a glamorous evening ball, and each one hopes to catch the eye of her chosen prince. Before they can dance, they need help with a few troubles: breakouts, under-eye shadows, and skin that has lost its glow. Your job is to step in with a full makeover, apply makeup, and pick outfits that suit each girl.

There is a large selection of makeup looks and gowns to try, and you can combine them in whatever way you like until each princess looks like a little masterpiece. The mood stays gentle and playful throughout. You control everything with a mouse or by tapping the screen.
rolling-ball-race: Rolling Ball Race is a speed challenge built around a rolling ball. You steer it along tracks that keep shifting, which puts your reflexes to the test. The game has an arcade-style feel throughout.

Your job is to keep the ball moving, dodge the obstacles in its path, and cross the finish line as fast as you can. Press the left and right arrow keys to move the ball in either direction. Any on-screen button can be clicked with the mouse.
space-roll: Space Roll is a 3D arcade game where you guide a ball across a galaxy or neon platform. Your aim is to keep it rolling safely for as long as you can. Obstacles and gaps appear along the way, so you need to steer carefully to get past them.
Gems you collect can be spent on new colorful balls. The game runs on WebGL and HTML5, and you control everything with your mouse. It is filed under running and avoidance titles.
best-friends-sleepover-party: A stylish girl is hosting a big sleepover tonight, and she needs your help getting the house ready for her friends. Decorate and design the space so it feels welcoming before the guests arrive. Once the fun begins, you can enjoy a spa day together with her best friends, then head to the makeup room to apply the newest beauty trends. Finally, dress up and find out whose pajamas are the prettiest.
This is a girls' game in the dress up, fashion, and makeover style, and it is played with mouse clicks or taps.
craft-island-3d-game: Craft Island 3D is an idle game set on islands with distinctive landscapes. You spend your time logging by cutting down trees, then use the wood to construct buildings and gradually grow your own wealthy island. Stores, rings, and other structures open up as your efforts pay off.

Once the rings are unlocked, you can enter Breakout mode. There, you collect trees to build your own weapons camp and choose either an archer or an artillery soldier. The goal is to declare victory once your island and camp are in place.
car-mechanic-2017: Car Mechanic 2017 is a good choice if you have never tried a career-focused game before. It offers much more than a career, since there is plenty to learn along the way, and it stays fun while you do. The game aims for a realistic feel and puts you in the role of an auto mechanic, so you get a sense of the trade as you play.

You move around with the W, A, S and D keys. This 3D title is built with HTML5 and WebGL and is tagged as a simulator, which fits its hands-on approach. If you are curious about what fixing cars involves, this game lets you explore that side of the work in a playful way.
knife-hit-challenge: Knife Hit Challenge is a hypercasual game where you throw blades and collect diamonds while climbing a ladder of levels. Each level gives you only a limited number of cutting weapons, so you need to plan every throw. Avoid other swords, people, and obstacles, and never waste a knife for no reason.
Diamonds you pick up can be spent in the store to buy new knives. The game is designed for one player and is tagged as adventure and punch. To throw a knife, simply click or touch the screen.
bullet-bender-overload: In Bullet Bender Overload, your job is to turn rotating parts until the gun lines up with the mafia boss. Every enemy must be wiped out to win. The controls are easy to pick up: just tap the elements to spin them into position.

Once the puzzle is solved, the Shoot button starts to blink, so tap it to send your bullet flying. If you get stuck, a hint is available to help you move forward. Collecting cash lets you unlock more along the way.
apocalypse-highway: Apocalypse Highway is a driving game set in a post-disaster world, where you speed down a road packed with traffic. Your goal is to reach the end of each track, picking up cash and power-ups along the way. Steer your car with the arrow keys.
The tags point to a racing title with zombie themes that works on mobile too. Every run asks you to weave between vehicles while gathering money and boosts to get across the finish line.
fruit-tower-drop: In Fruit Tower Drop, a ball bounces nonstop as it makes its way down a column of spinning fruit slices. You steer it through the openings in each slice to keep sinking, and the farther down it travels, the more points you collect. It's a quick arcade experience that rewards sharp focus.

Dangerous areas are colored turquoise, and touching one ends your run, so keep well clear of them. Good timing is essential, since you need to pass through gaps without hitting the wrong spot. Keep the momentum going and aim to descend as far as you can.
bus-simulator-city-driving: Take the driver's seat in this realistic bus simulator, where you operate a bus through a crowded city. Every trip requires you to follow the traffic rules, so stay alert as you weave through the streets. Your route centers on picking up passengers at certain bus stations and dropping them off at their destinations. You are only given a set amount of fuel, so plan each run carefully.
Steering works with the arrow keys or with A, S, W, and D, which move the bus around. Press the spacebar to brake when you need to slow down or stop.
fastlane-road-to-revenge-master: Fastlane Road To Revenge Master blends dodging and shooting into one arcade experience, built from two-dimensional animated artwork. Each level asks you to shoot down a set number of enemy cars, so keep track of your target as you play. Your main focus should be the oil tank trucks moving along the road.

Controls are easy to pick up: press and slide the car to move it across the screen. The game runs in HTML5 and is tagged for mobile play, so it suits phones as well as larger screens. Whether you enjoy avoiding danger or taking aim at rivals, this title offers a bit of both.
onet-fruit-tropical: Onet Fruit Tropical is a puzzle game with a classic feel, built as a deluxe version of Onet Connect. Your task is to find two matching fruit pictures and join them with a line that bends no more than three times. When the link works, both pictures disappear and you earn points. The gameplay is simple and familiar, and it is easy to get hooked on.

Everything is controlled by tapping. Tap one picture, then its match, to link them. The game is tagged for both boys and girls, and it fits the classic and fruit categories. It is an HTML5 title, so it runs right in your browser.
bumper-io: Bumper.io is an .io-style action game set in an arena, where you battle again and again. Your goal is to defeat everyone, including the swallowers. You level up by taking out weaker opponents, so each victory helps you grow.

If you get the chance, become a hunter and keep eliminating swallowers one after another. The fighting is extremely brutal, so your task is to survive while you take down the others. Slide to move, and use the mouse to attack.
atm-robbery-escape-game: ATM Robbery Escape Game is a puzzle title that puts you in charge of a sharp-minded schemer. Your task is to plan a cash machine heist while staying one step ahead of the police. Every choice you make shapes how the plan unfolds, so you will need to think ahead before you act.

Controls are simple: click with a mouse or tap the screen to play. Whether you use a computer or a phone, you can jump in right away. Take your time, study the situation, and make sure your escape is well planned.
incredible-stunt: Incredible Stunt is a 3D racing game that mixes two kinds of driving challenge. In one, you steer past obstacles without hitting them, and in the other, you drive along and collect things as you go. Both styles appear across the game, giving you a good chance to see how sharp your driving really is.

Your goal is to get through every level and show what you can do behind the wheel. You control the car with the WASD keys or the arrow keys, so you can pick whichever set feels more comfortable. The game runs in your browser and is also made to work on mobile devices.
slice-it-3d-game: Slice It 3D is a hypercasual game about cutting everything in half. It is a 3D title built around physics, and it offers a light, easygoing slicing experience. Your task is to keep the knife up in the air so it never drops into the sea. A click or tap on the screen or mouse is all it takes to do this, and your aim is to complete each level.

To begin, tap to play. Keep clicking or tapping to hold the knife above the water as you move through the levels. It is a calm, enjoyable way to pass some time, and the goal stays simple: finish the level you are on.
monster-truck-racing: Monster Truck Racing is a 2D racing game with striking graphics that can also be played on mobile devices. Your goal is to beat the AI-controlled racers on the track and claim first place. It's a straightforward truck race that puts the focus on competing against the computer's drivers.
The game uses just a few keys. Press A or D, or the left and right arrow keys, to drive your truck in either direction
offroad-racing-monster-truck: This long-awaited monster truck racing simulator has finally arrived. You take the wheel of some of the most powerful monster trucks around and race fast 4x4 offroad vehicles across the map. Along the way you can set things ablaze in fiery style while taking in the breathtaking scenery.

Driving is handled with the WASD keys on a computer. On a phone or tablet, you can use the on-screen button built into the game instead. Whether you want to chase the quickest times or just enjoy the views from behind the wheel, the game lets you tear through the offroad action in a big, rugged machine.
snake-war-game: Snake War Game puts you in control of a snake that moves through a maze. You must stay alive while your snake grows longer. The main goal is to collect as many points as you can. Other snakes share the maze, so you can either avoid them or try to defeat them.

The game uses an arcade style, and you use the mouse to click any button. It is a good fit for players who enjoy puzzle games, since the maze layout calls for careful movement and planning as you try to outlast the rival snakes.
robo-battle: Robo Battle puts you in control of a war robot and challenges both your logic and your quick thinking. Your job is to bravely take on rival war robots armed with lasers, saws, and thermometers. You will face a wide variety of enemies and obstacles, so your bot needs to be ready for anything. Winning a fight depends on a mix of careful planning and good personal skill.
The game is free to play. To begin, simply tap to start. Each battle calls for smart thinking as well as skill, so you must pl
basketball-hero: Basketball Hero is a sports game for fans of the court, whether you enjoy watching intense matches or just want to jump in and play. You get to take the floor alongside famous players you have admired for years. Choose your team, work toward unlocking every achievement, and try to land your name at the top of the high score list. The art style blends cartoon charm with realistic detail, and you can pull off a range of moves and shots, including slam dunks over your opponents.

Controls are simple. The arrow keys move your player around the court, and two skill buttons let you show off your professional abilities. Shooting and moving feel easy to pick up, so you can focus on the game itself.
spinner-io: Spinner.io is a 3D .io game where you battle against other online players on a shared platform. You control a spinning top and try to strike your rivals. When two tops touch, they bounce off each other. Knock opponents off the platform and stay on it until the end to become the winner.

Movement is handled with a joystick, so you steer your top around the arena with that control. Watch where rivals are heading and time your hits, since a well-aimed bump can send someone flying. Keeping your own top from slipping off the edge matters just as much.
thrilling-snow-motor: Thrilling Snow Motor is a 3D driving simulation where you ride a snow motorbike toward the finish line. Gold coins are scattered along the route, so try to collect them as you go. Watch out for the gaps between platforms. If you touch the controls while leaving a ramp, your motorbike falls and the game is lost right away.

Movement uses the WASD keys. Besides reaching the finish line, you can unlock more skins. The game is listed under action, with driving, collecting, and platform elements, all set against a snowy backdrop, and it is playable on mobile devices as well.
cowboy-runner: Cowboy Runner is an endless runner with striking visuals. The goal is to gather as much cash as possible before your run ends, and the longer you keep playing, the more enjoyable it becomes. Steer with your mouse as you race onward through the course.

The game is built for browsers using HTML5 and WebGL, and it sits in the Boys category with tags such as 3D, run, running and Skill. Because the controls rely only on the mouse, it is easy to pick up and start sprinting right away.
home-scapes: Your partner, who lives with you, has been seized by robbers, and it's up to you to bring him home. Clever thinking is needed to unlock the many layers of shackles holding him, and once he is free, you can offer your flowers.

Defeating the dogs and the robbers is the only way to win. To play, just click to open the door, and you win by opening it. Tagged with escape, helicopter and rescue, this puzzle game sits in the Puzzles category.
blob-opera-real: Blob Opera Real presents an experimental way of creating opera music using the voices of a real singer. Its central aim is to shape a composition with the help of the machine complex, aiming for something similar to the work performed in an opera house. The whole experience revolves around blending real vocals with this unusual method.

To get started, try working through the machine complex and see what kind of piece you can build. The goal is to come as close as possible to the opera house sound you have in mind. Experimenting with the machines is the main way to explore what this method can do.
jungle-highway-escape: Jungle Highway Escape is a straightforward driving game where your goal is to keep your car from drifting onto the wrong side of the road. You steer with the arrow keys or the W, A, S, and D keys on your keyboard. If you prefer, you can also guide the car with your mouse or by touching the screen.
Along the way, pick up coins to build up your score. The game is filed under sports and racing, and its tags include car, collecting, driving, HTML5, mobile, and race.
4x4-easter: 4x4 Easter is a jigsaw-style puzzle with an Easter theme. Its pieces come from Easter cartoons, and your job is to move them until they form the complete picture shown on the right side of the screen. Each piece must land in the correct spot to finish the image.

Controls are simple, since you only need a pointing device to pick up and move the pieces. Built with HTML5, the game runs in a browser and is also tagged for mobile play. It suits kids who enjoy puzzles with cartoon artwork.
high-heels-online: Get ready for a catwalk race in this 3D arcade game, where a model contest is almost underway. The competitors are finishing their last sprint practice on the runway. Taller heels earn you more bonus points, so reaching for the highest pair pays off.

The runway is not an easy path, though. Different obstacle blocks stand in your way, and you must gather more heels to climb over them and push your score higher. Control is simple: just drag to play. It works well for both boys and girls who enjoy avoiding obstacles and collecting items.
fruit-master: Fruit Master is an arcade game where you throw knives at fruit and try to juice every piece to finish each level. Missing a fruit is something to avoid, since you want to juice them all. Along the way, you earn coins for your juicing.
As you progress, you can unlock new knives, and there are 100 different levels to complete. To play, just tap to shoot a knife. It is a game built around fruit, skill, and steady aim.
sweet-shapes: Sweet Shapes is a puzzle game where candy shapes fall from the sky. To complete a level, you pop two or more shapes of the same color. Some pets are trapped between the sweet shapes, and your job is to bring them down to the bottom to help them. The levels get challenging, and the goal is to finish them all.

Popping shapes is done with a simple tap or click. It belongs to the match-3 and matching style of games, so spotting groups of matching colors is the key skill. Each level asks you to think ahead and clear the board in your own way.
impossible-ramp-car-stunts-3d: Impossible Ramp Car Stunts 3D puts you behind the wheel of powerful cars for daring driving in the sky. You will tackle zigzag tracks set in the city, pulling off jumps and testing your skill as a stunt driver. Luxury cars and supercars are available, and the racing includes top speed runs across ramps and jumps.

Your goal is to collect checkpoints while handling one tricky car challenge after another. Every level is designed to be engaging, and a fresh interface and striking environment add to the experience. You also wear a seat belt as you work through the challenges, and the whole game is played with the keyboard.
rise-egg-up: Rise Egg Up is an arcade game where you guard a fragile egg from a crowd of hazards. Your main tool is a shield, and the trick is moving it with care so the egg stays out of harm's way. Realistic physics govern how everything moves, so each movement feels grounded. The game throws many different kinds of obstacles at you, which keeps the challenge varied.
The world is packed with bright,
hopping-boy: Hopping Boy is an arcade game where you guide a cute boy through hop after hop with no end in sight. Your task is to time each jump well and avoid the obstacles in his path. As you move on to harder levels, the speed rises and the obstacles become trickier, so your timing, reflexes, and precision are pushed to their limits.

Controls are as simple as they come: a mouse click or a tap makes him hop. Don't let that easy setup fool you, because staying alive takes steady focus and quick reactions the longer you keep going. It suits anyone who enjoys a good test of timing, and it sits in the Puzzles category on I Love Web Games.
classic-jeep-parking: Classic Jeep Parking puts you in control of a 4x4 jeep in a 3D driving and parking challenge. You steer the vehicle around corners, obstacles, and the boundaries of a parking lot, aiming to finish with both high speed and accuracy. Each run asks you to balance quick driving with careful placement.

It is one of the more recent titles in the parking and driving genre. Controls are simple: use W, A, S, and D to drive, and press the Space bar to brake. The game is built with HTML5 and WebGL, and it is made for players who want to test their driving skills against tight parking spots.
rock-paper-scissors-exclusive: Rock Paper Scissors Exclusive turns the familiar hand game into a head-to-head duel. Each round follows the usual rules: paper covers rock, scissors cut paper, and rock smashes scissors. The game gives this old favourite a fresh take, and it suits anyone who enjoys classic games and encounters. Its structure and music add energy to every match.

You can play with a friend or go up against the computer. Player one uses the A, S and D keys for rock, paper and scissors. Player two uses the left, down and right arrow keys for the same three moves. Read your opponent, anticipate their next move, and see who comes out on top. May the good win.
cartoon-escape-prison: In this arcade skill game, you plan a breakout from a prison while keeping an eye on the guards. You sketch the route the escapees should take and use it to guide the prisoners to freedom. Your plan is the key to getting everyone out.

Everything runs on mouse control, so a single device is all you need. Think carefully before you draw, since a poor route could leave the prisoners caught. Watch the guards closely at all times. This free browser game rewards careful thinking and a clever scheme.
neon-dash-survive-the-dash: Neon Dash is a fast 2D platformer built around rhythm, where precise timing decides everything. You run through a gritty, dark-pop landscape packed with deadly spikes, spinning sawblades, and shifting gravity. Your aim is to stay alive as the pace ramps up across several levels glowing with neon light.

Tap the screen or press SPACE or UP to jump over obstacles. When you are close to a cyan or yellow ring in mid-air, tap again to perform a second jump. Yellow and pink pads launch you automatically at high velocity, and portals let you pass through a Speed Gate. The cinematic visuals and pulsing style are made for players with very quick reflexes.
ragdoll-shooter: Ragdoll Shooter is a shooting game built around a fresh take on ragdoll physics. Its duel-style action pits you against an opponent in a head-to-head contest, and physics-driven destruction lets things break apart as you play. Each figure flops and tumbles in a way that feels both playful and lifelike.

Aiming and firing depend on timing, so you tap to line up your shot and need to pick the perfect moment to fire. The game is controlled entirely with the mouse, so there is little else to learn. Its physics feel fun yet realistic, and the duel format keeps the back-and-forth going.
rabbit-skater-game: Rabbit Skater Game puts you in charge of a lively bunny riding a skateboard through demanding courses. Your job is to dodge hazards along the way while picking up rewards. It follows the endless runner style, so the run keeps going for as long as you can keep up. Smooth controls, bright and varied surroundings, and plenty of thrilling moments work together to hold your attention for hours at a time.
Steering the rabbit is simple. Press A to make it jump and D to move. Use your mouse to click any button in the game.
turbo-skater-race-stars: Turbo Skater Race Stars is an arcade racing game where you gather cubes and stack them into a tall, multicolored tower. Each cube you pick up adds to your stack, and you can sort the colors as you go. The game is built in 3D and can be played offline, with a stickman character running along the track while you collect cubes.
Watch out for the hurdles and wrong bricks along the way. Hitting one knocks blocks off your tower, one by one
dice-push: Dice Push is a funny arcade match game set on a platform, with 3D stickman figures and dice at its center. To win, you need to send as many of your stickman members as you can toward your opponent's side, where they push a green wall across the field. You can also throw dice to destroy enemy members, so a single throw can shift the whole match.

The game is controlled by sliding, so you simply swipe to play. It is a casual pick that mixes puzzle-style thinking with a bit of skill, and its lighthearted 3D stickman characters keep each match playful.
classic-tertis: This tile-matching classic traces back to 1984, when Alexey Pajitnov, an engineer from Russia, first made it. Several companies went on to publish the game, and the most visible of those releases came amid a dispute over who held its rights in the late 1980s. Now it has arrived in your web browser.
The game works on any device, so you can enjoy it on whatever screen you have handy. Use the keyboard arrow keys to steer your moves, or touch the on-screen controls if you are on a touchscreen.
rambo-legend-game: In Rambo Legend Game, you step onto a battlefield as a fearless hero, a powerful warrior built to take down enemies and complete dangerous missions. Intense combat arrives in waves, so you must keep fighting, dodge incoming attacks, and use your skills to survive each round.

Controls feel smooth and the gameplay is fast-paced, so the action rarely slows from one moment to the next. To click any button, use your mouse. It is an action shooting game that keeps you moving and firing from start to finish.
diy-keyboard: Diy Keyboard is an art game about creating your own keyboard designs. If you enjoy imagining keyboards in a personal style, this one lets you bring that idea to life. You can pick from five manufacturing methods: Resin, Acrylic, Pop it, Stencil, and Decor. A large collection of attractive ornaments is included to decorate your creation.

Your drawing and design skills get plenty of room to shine. You can paint a keyboard white, blue, or red, and you can also make it see-through if that suits your taste. The game is played with a mouse or by tapping the screen.
impostor-game-console: A space impostor sets out to search the world for the woman he loves. This 2D arcade adventure has 20 levels, and each one brings its own challenge, so you will face 20 different tests along the way. Pass each level to get closer to her.

Controlling the hero is simple because jumping is all you need. On a touchscreen, tap the screen, and on a computer, click the mouse to jump. Keep going through every level until you finally reach the woman you love.
snakefalls: Snakefalls is a puzzle game built around creatures with bird heads and snake bodies, and their movement follows its own mechanics. Your job is to keep your character away from sharp objects while eating fruit so it grows larger. The levels are attractive to look at and become tougher as you move through them.
Movement uses buttons on PC and in the HTML5 version, and mobile devices
amazing-superhero-new-york-gangster: Step into the role of Spider-Man in this online adventure, which borrows the feel of GTA. A full city stretches out before you, and you can do almost anything you want within it. Steal cars, scuffle with residents, or clash with police as the chaos unfolds around you.

Your options include firearms and heroic abilities, which you can use to finish tasks or simply wreck things for fun. If you want something heavier, find a tank and crush everything in its path. Like other sandbox games, the choice of how to spend your time is entirely yours. Play with your mouse, or tap the screen to control the action.
stick-archery: Step into the shoes of a stick figure who has mastered the bow and must bring down wicked rival archers. The core idea is simple: line up your shot and let the arrows fly. A precise hit to the head wipes out the foe entirely. Keep in mind that the opposing bowmen practice constantly, so sharpening your accuracy is the way to keep up.
Controls are easy to learn. On a computer, move the mouse to aim and click to release an arrow. On a phone, press your finger on the screen and drag to aim, then lift your finger to fire.
ninja-warrior-game: Step into a world of shadows and take on the role of a ninja warrior. This action adventure has you sprint, leap, battle foes, and stay alive through demanding stages packed with lethal traps, strong enemies, and missions to complete.

Controls are simple. Press W or the Up Arrow to move forward, S or the Down Arrow to step back, A or the Left Arrow to go left, and D or the Right Arrow to go right. Use your mouse whenever you need to click a button on screen.
frenzy-farming-simulator: Frenzy Farming Simulator lets you tend your fields and look after your chickens. Plants need to be watered, and when your supply runs dry you can draw coin water from the water well. Gather the eggs your hens lay and sell them for cash. As you advance to later levels, cows join your farm and give you milk. Combine milk and eggs to bake cakes, then sell those for extra money. Control everything with mouse clicks and swipes.
educational-games-for-kids: This free browser game offers fun, learning-focused activities made for toddlers and pre-k children. Its lessons are designed to make learning feel natural for little ones. Young players can enjoy connecting-the-dots activities alongside puzzle games, including jigsaw puzzles, which make it a playful way to build early skills.
Playing is simple. Use your mouse or tap the screen to get started, so kids can jump in quickly and enjoy every activity.
stack-maze-puzzle: Stack Maze Puzzle is a free, relaxing game that asks you to pick the right path through each layout. As you slide toward the exit, try to gather as many boards along the way as you can. The title offers a lot to explore, with several game modes, a large number of levels, and a range of maze styles that keep the challenge fresh.
Control is simple: use your mouse or tap the screen to move through the puzzles. Whether you like to plan ahead or move fast, this browser title brings plenty of maze fun in one place.
superstar-hair-salon: Superstar Hair Salon asks you to work out which hairstyle fits a celebrity best. Your task is to draw on your creativity and build a look that catches attention and lifts her mood. The game leans on coloring, styling, and dress-up, so you can experiment until the result feels right.

Play it with a mouse or by tapping the screen, whichever suits your device. It sits in the Girls category and runs in HTML5, so it opens right in your browser. If you enjoy hair design and cheerful makeovers, this one is a fun pick.
stencil-art: Stencil Art is a hypercasual drawing game where you spray paint within the outlines to build new pictures. Your aim is to cover every stencil quickly so the hidden photo appears. Press and hold anywhere on the screen to start painting, and let go to pause your spray.

The game asks for a steady hand and a quick pace, since speed is what helps you finish each stencil. Its tags point to drawing, fun, and skill, so it suits anyone who enjoys creating art while testing their reflexes. Keeping your strokes neatly inside the lines is the challenge, and each completed design rewards your effort with a clear picture.
monster-man-rush: Monster Man Rush is an endless runner where the pace never slows down. Monsters are on the prowl, and your job is to keep running, dodge whatever comes your way, and hold out for as long as you can. The bright, varied backdrops give each part of the run its own look.

Controls feel smooth and are simple to pick up, while the game's mechanics keep pulling you back for another attempt. Everything is handled with the mouse, since every button is selected by clicking it. The action stays nonstop, so people of all ages can enjoy it.
drag-racing-3d: Desert drag strips are where you get to smoke the rubber off your tires. Your aim is to win every race and earn the title of drag racing legend. Each win pays out cash, which you can spend on a brand-new car or on upgrades for the one you already own. To come out on top, launch quickly off the line, keep an eye on the tachometer, and shift gears at the right moments.

The controls are simple. Hold W or the Up Arrow to keep your speed high when you first enter a race. Press E and Q to shift gears. For a burst of extra speed, tap the N key or use the nitro buttons on the screen.
jumping-buddy: Jumping Buddy is an arcade title that players of any age can pick up and enjoy. You guide a character named Buddy, whose main goal is to climb as high as possible. While rising, you should also collect as many burgers as you can, but keep an eye out for obstacles that block your way.
Playing is simple because a mouse click or a tap is all you need to control the action. Watch the path ahead and time each leap carefully. Have fun bouncing upward from start to finish.
pancake-master: Pancake Master is a quick, nimble hypercasual game with a 3D style. You cook pancakes by tapping and holding, and you must control your own strength so each pancake moves from one pot to the next. The goal is to carry every pancake smoothly into the next frying pan.
The game steadily raises its difficulty as you go, so the control you need keeps growing. It is built with HTML5 and can be played with a mouse click or by tapping the screen.
wobble-man-online: Wobble Man Online is a 3D puzzle adventure where your goal is to get through a door and reach the next stage. Pay close attention to the sight zones, which show up as red areas on the map. Move carefully around them and you can avoid trouble. Don't forget to grab the key first, because the door won't open without it and there's no other way out.

To play, just slide your finger or mouse across the screen to move your character. The game is built for browsers and runs in 3D, with a focus on careful movement and brain-teasing escapes from a house.
the-impossible-game: The Impossible Game is a side-scrolling platformer built around rhythm. You move through the level in time with the beat, leaping, soaring and flipping past risky stretches and sharp spikes. Its challenge is so steep that few players clear it on the first try, and it tests your reflexes to their very edge.
Everything is controlled with the mouse. The title runs in your browser as an HTML5 game and is also listed for mobile play. It appears in the hypercasual, arcade and casual categories.
zilda-legend: Zilda Legend is a role-playing adventure in which you take on the role of a hero named Linck, battling the devil across the game world. The game encourages you to keep faith in yourself, since victory is within reach.

To move, use W, A, S and D, and press the spacebar to sprint. Clicking the mouse throws your weapon. Tags for this title include adventure, ninja, RPG, run and superhero, and it is listed under the Boys category.
jetspire: Jetspire is a quick arcade title in which a runner strapped into a jetpack climbs a tall course that never seems to end. Gates slide open and shut along the way, and each screen you get past adds a point to your score. The gates speed up the higher you travel, so your timing and reflexes get tested more and more. Keep your focus sharp, respond fast, and try to climb as far as you possibly can.

Controls are simple. Press and hold the mouse button to fire the jetpack and rise, then let go so the character drops back down. Steering your height means switching between holding and releasing at the right moments. Touch a gate or misjudge a move and the run is over.
cute-pet-friends: Care for two friendly companions in this game: Kiki, a cat, and Fifi, a dog. You can give them a bubble bath or a shower, tidy them up, comb their fur, and paint their nails. Dressing them is part of the fun, since you can design outfits for each pet.

Beyond pampering, you can build a house for your animal friends and decorate their home to your taste. This title suits young players who dream of owning a cat or dog and enjoy looking after adorable digital animals. Controls are simple: use your mouse or tap to play.
animal-dental-hospital: Dreaming of a career as a dentist? This game lets you try the job at Baby Panda's dental salon. You get a close look at the everyday work of a dentist while you manage the salon itself.

Your task is to clean and care for the teeth of little animals who visit. You can play with a mouse or by tapping, so getting started takes only a moment. Your goal is to grow into an excellent dentist by treating every patient with care.
bus-simulator-ultimate-2021-3d: Take the wheel of a bus and head into unknown territory in this driving game. Build your own stations with new parking tools, design your own levels, and enjoy visuals that look better than before. You can try both city buses and passenger buses, drive on real roads, and cruise through city parking lots in a big tourist bus.

Smooth, realistic controls help you learn to drive and park a giant bus like a professional. Challenging parking zones and arena-style parking tests will push your skills, with varied transport routes and parking tracks to tackle along the way. Obstacles stand in your path, and the whole game is played with the keyboard.
baby-taylor-summer-dessert-shop: Taylor is a big fan of summer, with its pretty dresses, holiday trips, and tasty ice cream and sweets. Making desserts is one of Taylor's favorite hobbies, and ice cream is something Taylor often whips up to share with pals.

Now Taylor has opened a summer dessert shop, and the goal is to figure out which treats shoppers are hoping to buy. Players take on the role of helping Taylor manage the store. The game is played with a mouse click or a tap.
pony-run-magic-trails: Ride a pony through a race full of obstacles in Pony Run: Magic Trails. Your task is to leap over each hurdle and get past the obstacles to complete every level. Start by picking the pony you want to ride, then guide it all the way to victory. This hypercasual arcade racer has a family-friendly, casual feel and centers on horses and jumping.

If you love ponies and have always pictured yourself on a real obstacle course, this game lets you chase that dream with a pony race of your own. It gives you a lighthearted way to experience a parcours, all within your browser.
hoppy-stacky: Hoppy Stacky is an arcade title that tests how well you time your moves, how steady your aim is, and how sharply you can keep your attention. Controls are a single tap or click, so anyone can pick it up quickly, though getting good takes practice. The job is to drop moving blocks so they land squarely on the blocks beneath them. Every clean landing adds to your score, while a small error trims your tower and pushes you nearer to the end of the round.
voodoo-doll: Voodoo Doll is a 2D clicker built for letting off steam. Its central idea is giving a doll a good kick, which makes it a relaxing pick for anyone who wants to vent frustration in a playful way. Its Halloween theme and physics-driven action add to the mood.
You can purchase many different weapons and turn them on the puppet, including guns and
candy-makeup-fashion-girl: Step into a candy-themed beauty salon where you give clients a sugary makeover. Your model can wear marshmallow hairdos, glossy cherry lip color, and candy cane hats. Grab your magical candy tools and help customers from all over the world look their best. Apply tasty face treatments and sweet hairstyles, then finish the look with professional beauty equipment.
Everything is controlled with simple mouse clicks or taps, so you can jump right in and enjoy the sugary styling session from start to finish.
candy-burst-online: The sweets in this arcade title look tempting, and a customer is eager to buy some. You play a candy salesman whose job is to pack the candy to the specified location. Too little and the customer walks away unhappy. Too much and you lose money instead of earning it. The game is presented in 3D and carries tags for avoiding, puzzle play, and relaxation.

Getting started is simple, since you only need to tap to play. Portion out each batch carefully, because the amount really matters. It suits younger players and anyone who wants a calm, casual session.
jewel-duel: Kartucia was once a lovely land, until two fiery wizards seized it with black magic. Even the oldest residents cannot recall a time before the shadows, and for ages the people have lived in darkness and hardship under the wizards' servants. An old legend promises that a hero will arrive to bring peace back to the realm. That hope is fading, though. The wizards are preparing to open an abyss of horror that would release thousands of demons, and everything would be lost. Everyone believes you are the hero they have been waiting for.
Controls are simple: click or tap to play the game.
nina-the-killer-go-to-sleep-my-prince: Meet Nina, the newest killer making trouble in town. She was once an ordinary fan of Jeff The Killer, but her school years turned dark. Bullies kept harassing her and her brother, and after one fatal incident, she snapped. She killed the bullies and bleached her skin until it turned pale.

The game has two story levels. You can play as Poisonguy and hunt Nina down, or become Nina herself and try to escape the asylum. Left mouse fires, right mouse aims, and a block action is included too. Walk with WASD, sprint with Left Shift, crouch with Left Ctrl, go prone with X, and jump with Space. Press F to use items, R to reload, H to holster your weapon, G for grenades, and V for melee attacks. Esc or Tab pauses the game.
real-city-car-stunts: Real City Car Stunts takes you through a realistic city full of busy traffic. You launch your car off ramps and perform jumps while cars keep moving around you. There are fifteen levels, and you need to finish each one without slowing down. Along the way, search for hidden Coins and spend them on new vehicles, including five sports cars to unlock.

If you prefer a looser pace, free mode lets you drive anywhere you like across the city. You steer with W, A, S, D or the arrow keys. Press F for nitro, Space for the handbrake, L to turn your lamps on, and C to switch cameras. The game is brand new and needs no outside link to play.
pickup-driver: Pickup Driver puts you behind the wheel of a pickup truck in this 3D driving simulator. You can take on tough parking missions that test your precision, or simply cruise through the scenic mountain landscape at your own pace. Whether you prefer focused challenges or relaxed exploration, the game offers both.

Driving is handled with WASD or the arrow keys, so you can use whichever layout feels natural. Press C to switch between camera views, and hold the spacebar to engage the handbrake while you maneuver.
two-tunnel-3d: Two Tunnel 3D is an endless tunnel game with a soundtrack that runs alongside the action. Your job is to steer past the gaps so your ball stays inside the tunnel. As you go, the balls speed up and the controls become harder to manage. Each stage also brings a new tunnel color, so the scenery keeps shifting.

You move with the A and D keys or with the left and right arrow keys. Good control matters because the pace only climbs. Watch for each gap ahead, react quickly, and the tunnel keeps going without end.
bouncy-stick: Bouncy Stick is an arcade game about a wild spring that kicks off an adventurous sprint across a 3D track. You can keep playing for as long as a point remains, so every bit of progress matters. Your aim has to stay steady, since the direction must hold well. Try to reach the destination as quickly as you can. Obstacles stand in the way, and rewards lie along the track for you to collect.
The game blends bouncing, launching, collecting, and puzzle challenges into one simple experience that suits younger players. Controls are easy to pick up: drag to play.
robe-challenge: This brain-teaser asks you to pull rubber bands off the nails that have caught them. Each removal needs careful thought, because a careless pull can tangle the strings even further. Study the layout, decide which band should come off first, and keep going until every string is gone. The level is complete once the whole system is cleared.

The rules are easy to grasp, but solving each arrangement takes real logic and patience. It is a classic point-and-click puzzle, and you play it with your mouse. The experience feels calm and rewarding, giving you a satisfying sense of accomplishment as the tangle slowly comes undone.
snowboarder-freestyle-jigsaw: Snowboarder Freestyle Jigsaw is a free puzzle game that runs in your browser. It belongs to the jigsaw style and offers six winter-themed pictures to work through. Before you begin, pick one of the three available modes, then start the round. Your task is to move each scattered piece into place by dragging and dropping it until the full image appears.
Everything is controlled with the mouse, so you only need to click and drag the pieces. Take your time with each of the six scenes and have fun putting them together.
type-run: Type Run is an arcade race where your typing speed decides the outcome. Sentences appear on screen, and you need to type them quickly. The faster you type, the faster your villain runs, so keep your fingers moving. Your goal is to stop the opponent from catching up with you.

The rival grows stronger with every level, so the challenge keeps rising. The real test is how many levels you can hold on to. Controls are simple: you only need to type. It is a casual kids' game that blends racing with letter practice and puzzle-
drive-in-car-city-3d: Drive in Car City 3D is a racing simulator from 2022 built around an advanced physics engine that makes every turn and slide feel grounded. You take the wheel of a sports car, drift through corners, and feel how it handles, all for free.

The entire open-world city is yours to explore. You never need to slow down for traffic or rival cars, so you can try unlawful stunt moves and hold full speed without police chasing you. Drifting and burnouts are a big part of the fun, letting you tear up the asphalt across the whole map. Play is controlled entirely with the keyboard.
pixel-slime: Pixel Slime is an auto-platformer where your character keeps moving on its own. Your aim is to finish with the lowest score you can manage. Along the way you jump, twist, and glide through 40 levels while trying to avoid dying. The design is meant to make you want to come back again and again.
To jump, click the mouse or tap the screen on a touch device. Timing each leap is what keeps your run going, so every attempt is a fresh chance to improve your score.
jet-ski-racing-games: Fire up your jet ski and cruise across three separate worlds, each with three courses that get harder as you go. Your goal is to dodge obstacles along the way and finish every lap while the clock is still ticking.

Use the up arrow to speed ahead and the left or right arrows to steer through turns. When you need to slow your ride, press the down arrow. Stay sharp, because each new track asks more of your reflexes than the last.
nurse-run-3d: Nurse Run 3D is widely seen as one of the most engaging new arcade titles of the year. Its gameplay is hard to put down, and it uses a 3D look throughout. You take on the part of a nurse facing a tough situation. Your job is to grab medical gear as you go, including syringes, needles, medicine, and bandages, while dodging a range of obstacles along a winding track. Control is simple: tap or click to play.
endless-path-twist-and-turn: Endless Path is an arcade title where fast reflexes and well-timed moves decide how long you can keep going. You move along a path that twists forward without end, and you must change direction at just the right instant to avoid tumbling off the edge. As you progress, the pace picks up, so your focus and agility are tested more and more.

Controls are kept very simple: a single tap on the screen is all it takes to follow the route. Bright visuals and smooth movement make it a pleasant pick for players of any age. Your goal is to stay on the track for as long as possible, set high scores, and see how far your run can stretch.
tie-dye-master-3d: This 3D tie-dye title is a satisfying pick for the whole family. You color T-shirts, pants, and many other clothing items by dyeing them in a range of hues. Instead of mixing your own dyes, you try a frozen approach where melting ice spreads the color across the fabric, leaving watercolor patterns that look different every time.

Each piece you finish comes out unique, so experimenting is part of the fun. The whole game is played with your mouse, so there are no keys to learn. Click through each step to create your own colorful designs from start to finish.
super-racing-super-cars: Super Racing Super Cars throws you into online drift racing contests, where you take the wheel of a lineup of famous drifting machines. You start at Rookie status and climb toward the Pro level one race at a time.

When your skills feel sharp enough, you can switch on the ghost multiplayer mode and test yourself at a higher level. Steering and driving use the W, A, S and D keys. Mobile players can rely on the buttons built into the game instead.
fashion-coloring-book-glitter: Fashion Coloring Book Glitter puts you in charge of a stylish set of drawings. You get 12 lovely pages to fill with bright, sparkly shades. Every page can be painted with vivid and glittering hues, so your artwork shines on screen.

Decorating is part of the fun, since a large selection of adorable stickers is included. Placing them on a page gives it a livelier look. Only one finger is needed to build your own masterpiece. Control it with a mouse or by tapping the screen.
water-sort-online: Water Sort Online is a puzzle game that is both fun and hard to put down. Your job is to pour the colored liquids between glasses until every glass holds just one color. It is a challenge, but it is also a calm way to give your brain a workout.
To play, simply tap a glass to pour its water into another glass. Plan your moves carefully, since each pour brings you one step closer to a sorted set of glasses.
famous-cartoon-characters-eggs: Famous Cartoon Characters Eggs is a jigsaw puzzle game with six pictures, each showing a well-known cartoon hero shaped like an egg. The heroes include Dora, Peppa Pig, Masha, Cars, OddBods, and Angry Birds. You can pick from three different modes before you begin.

Once you have chosen a mode, you build the picture by dragging the pieces into place. Every move is made with drag and drop, so the puzzle is simple to handle. Have fun piecing together these cheerful egg-shaped characters.
risky-rescue: Risky Rescue is a single-player arcade helicopter game with more than thirty levels to work through. It blends flappy-style mechanics with gentle flying rules, so every climb and drop requires careful timing. Your aim is to clear every level and collect all the stars along the way.

Controls are simple: tap to lift the helicopter and release to sink back down. The game is demanding, so steady control will help you through the trickier levels. Its focus is on action and avoiding obstacles, with a touch of adventure added in.
squid-gamer-city-destroyer: Squid Gamer City Destroyer is a 3D action game of skill that belongs to a larger group of gorilla games. It mixes smasher-style play with giant alien and giant spree themes, along with city destruction. Your task is to tear through cities in a smasher city sequence. It also serves as the final stop in the collection, Bigfoot Monstrous Rampage.

Your first priority is making sure the genuine gorilla gets out of the lab and returns to its family in the forest. Move the character with the A and D keys. The free browser game is built with Unity3D and runs on WebGL.
anime-couples-dress-up: Pick one of four anime pairs, each with a different skin tone, and get them ready for a date. Both partners appear on the same screen, so you can style the girl and the guy together. The collection holds more than 250 items, with 150 for the girl and 100 for the guy. Everything is free and nothing stays locked, so every option is available from the start. Hunt for the finest and most one-of-a-kind looks for each couple, then take a screenshot to show your favorites to friends. Controls are handled entirely with the mouse.
sailor-moon-cosplay-show: Rapunzel, Snow White, and Anna are set to perform in a costume show. For the event, the three princesses will act out roles from Sailor Moon, a classic animated series. In the story, the sailor soldiers are a team of brave girls who battle wicked villains and protect the planet. Many people admire them, and the princesses are among their devoted fans.

Before the performance, you need to get the princesses ready. You will change how each one looks, step by step, until their outfits are complete. Simply click or tap to make your selections and dress them up for the show.
draw-racing: Draw Racing is a hypercasual game where your goal is to clear each level by painting over every path. Your car only starts moving once you draw a line from it, so your drawing is what sets the race in motion. Watch out, because some obstacles are invisible, and hitting one will make your car collide. Part of the challenge is remembering which road is the correct one.

To play, touch the car and drag across the screen to draw the path it will follow. Plan each line carefully, since the obstacles stay out of sight and you need to recall where they are. The game rewards both your sense of direction and your memory as you work through its levels.
public-park-differences: Public Park Differences is a spot-the-difference puzzle. Two pictures look almost the same, and your job is to find at least five changes hidden between them. Each change you catch is a small win that keeps the search engaging.

You can play with a mouse or a touchpad. Click or tap directly on each spot where the two images disagree. Scan both pictures carefully, take your time, and see how many differences you can locate. It is a simple setup that rewards sharp eyes.
coach-bus-simulator: Coach Bus Simulator lets you learn how to handle a full-size coach in a range of situations. Your job is to carry passengers from one city to another, passing through scenic spots and wide landscapes along the way. The game offers an open world map to explore, several impressive vehicles, and detailed interiors that aim to give a lifelike feel for driving a bus. The route takes you across Europe.

You steer with the keyboard arrow keys. Tags point to driving, parking, racing, drifting, and general simulation play, so it suits anyone who enjoys careful vehicle handling and realistic road experiences.
violet-doll-my-virtual-home: Step into a virtual house and get to know Violet, a doll you can spend a whole day with. Plenty of activities wait inside her home, and as you go, you'll learn the daily habits she follows. Look after her with care and do your best to make all of her wishes come true.
Her world offers baby care, cooking, decorating, design, dressing up, and fashion, along with an educational side. To begin, just click with your mouse or tap the screen.
jewel-monsters: Jewel Monsters sends you wandering through a forest where foes lurk between the trees. To strike a monster, line up three or more gems of the same color alongside it. Clear enough gems to defeat the creature and move on to the next stretch. Be quick, though, because a slow move gives the monster a chance to hit back.

Your health can be restored during the battle. Making a match of four or more gems causes a heart bonus to appear inside one of them, and collecting that heart returns some of your lost health. To play, drag a gem onto a neighboring gem to swap their places and form your lines.
snowboard-girl: If you enjoy riding a board down the snow, this game puts you on the mountain and sends you racing down the slopes. Your job is to dodge dangerous obstacles, stay steady on your feet, and push your speed higher as you go. Carve your path down the hill and keep going until you claim victory.

The controls are easy to pick up, so players of any age can jump in. Don't expect a stroll, though, because some challenging obstacles stand in your way. Take the jumps, tackle each run, and aim to win on every descent.
goods-sorting-shopping-master: Goods Sorting Shopping Master asks you to tidy up cluttered products by moving them around and grouping like items together. It is a puzzle title that blends clever planning with a calm pace. Your shelves are packed with a mix of goods, including beverages, treats, and everyday essentials. Whenever you line up three identical items, they disappear, which opens room and lets you move on in line with what shoppers want. Space is limited, so you need to plan each move and keep your shelves in order to keep going.
Play with a mouse click or by tapping the screen.
hair-stylist-diy-salon: In this educational game, you run your own beauty salon and look after young clients. The salon gives you a wide selection of tools for curling hair, washing curls, and combing hair the way you like. You can cut, dye, and curl hair, then dress your client up as you wish. Your aim is to create a colorful, fashionable look that would make even skilled stylists jealous, because the finished hairstyle becomes a work of art.
Start by choosing a model from the salon, then make her the star of a fashion show. You can play with a mouse or by tapping the screen.
christmas-maze: Christmas Maze is an online game that costs nothing to try. It is a straightforward arcade title that still proves tough to master. Your one job is to guide the gift box to the green one. Succeed and a fresh level opens up for you. As you go, pay close attention to the walls along the route.

You can steer with mouse taps or the arrow keys on your keyboard. Watch the walls closely, because they demand your full attention on every turn. It suits anyone who likes skill-based puzzles with a festive theme.
super-dash-car: Super Dash Car puts you behind the wheel and gives you full control of your ride. Launch off jumps for a wild burst of fun, and look for chances to overtake other vehicles on the road. Every pass keeps the action moving.

The game is all about feeling the speed and the passion of the open road. Whether you are weaving past rivals or soaring over a jump, each moment centers on fast driving. It runs right in your browser as an HTML5 racing title, so you can jump straight into the rush whenever you like.
dotted-girl-wedding: Louis has been in love with Marie for a long time. In a parallel universe, the two are destined to be together, and this game invites you to imagine that story and plan their wedding. Start with the bride by choosing a sweet dress in pink, white, or lilac, then add a veil and a festive bouquet. Apply light makeup and give Marie a wedding hairstyle.

Next, turn your attention to Louis. Pick a stylish hairstyle for him and a suit in turquoise-blue, his favorite colors. To finish his outfit, add a cute boutonniere that matches the color of the bride's dress. Once everything is ready, the couple is set to marry. Controls are simple: use the left mouse button or touch the screen.
box-brothers: Box Brothers is a fast reaction game where boxes display arrows, and you must press the matching arrow key each time. Every correct press raises your score, but hitting the wrong key causes you to take damage. Play carefully and keep your timing sharp.

Chaining correct arrows together builds a combo streak that earns you extra points. The quicker you react, the more points you collect. Be aware that staying idle for too long will cost you points. Use the Left Arrow key when a box shows a left arrow, and the Right Arrow key when it shows a right arrow. Get ready, stay focused, and aim for the highest score you can reach.
monster-truck-repairing: Plenty of children enjoy car games, and that holds true for boys and girls alike. Titles like this one let young players picture themselves behind the wheel of a real vehicle, whether it is a tiny toy car or a fast sports machine. In Monster Truck Repairing, the work involves washing vehicles and fixing them up, with cleaning, coloring, and decorating all part of the fun in this HTML5 game aimed at kids.
Use a mouse or tap to play, and you can jump straight into the work. The game sits in the Girls category, and its tags point to cleaning, coloring,
fire-and-water-in-zombies-world-2: Fire and Water are back in the zombie world with their brother for a second adventure. This sequel features all new levels and more props to explore. Your goal is to keep the brothers safe from zombie attacks while collecting every diamond.

It is a 2D adventure with controls for up to three players. Player one moves with W, A, S and D and shoots with R. The second player uses a separate movement setup and fires with Num1. The third player moves with I, J, K and L and shoots with U.
simple-football-kicking: Simple Football Kicking is an arcade game that puts real football kicking in front of you. It gives you the chance to test your skill with a ball and see how well you can shoot. It is tagged for football fans and kids alike.

Controls are simple: drag the mouse forward to take your shot. That single motion is all you need to start kicking, so the game is quick to grasp for anyone who wants to give it a try. No extra steps are needed.
ball-adventure-2: In this platform game, you guide a ball through its courses with one goal: gather as many stars as you can. The game offers 20 levels to work through, and each one asks you to navigate platforms while collecting stars along the way.

A weather system changes the conditions as you progress, adding variety to every stage. The graphics look good, too. Movement uses the W, A, S, and D keys, and you can press Escape or Tab to pause whenever you need to.
mr-spy-3d: In Mr Spy 3D, you take on the role of an undercover agent who works as a sniper. Your task is to aim at enemies and fire at exactly the right moment, since every shot depends on perfect timing. The game puts a strong focus on precise shooting, so patience is just as valuable as a steady hand.

The 3D action experience is built around a set of missions and targets, each one testing your accuracy. Every mission asks you to find your mark and take your shots carefully. All controls work with the mouse alone, so you can focus fully on lining up your aim.
car-stunt-driver: Car Stunt Driver is a 3D stunt simulator centered on driving. Your goal is to keep your vehicle on course along a route cluttered with obstacles, which demands real skill. The game includes multiple cars and several demanding levels to work through.
Controls are straightforward. Move with W, A, S, and D, use the Space bar for the handbrake, press C to switch the camera view, and press R to reload.
fashion-nail-salon-manicure-game: Stylish clothes are only part of the picture, since many girls also dream of gorgeous nails. In Fashion Nail Salon, those dreams become reality. You play as a professional nail designer who must get creative and let imagination run free. Craft colorful, patterned nails for your clients, show off your talent, and put your creativity to work. Along the way, you treat each pair of hands to an indulgent manicure that gives them the care they deserve and helps them shine.
The game is controlled by tapping or clicking.
fab-tattoo-design-studio: Fab Tattoo Design Studio lets you watch your own artwork turn into real tattoos. It's a calm experience, so you can relax as you work. Your precision matters, because you point and aim the needle to fill in the shapes.

Listed under puzzles, the game also carries adventure and drawing tags, so it mixes a few styles of play. Each shape you fill brings your design closer to the finished piece. Seeing the tattoo come together is the main reward.
gymnastics-dress-up: Gymnastics Dress Up is a newly released dress-up game for girls, especially those who enjoy sports and rhythmic gymnastics. Players browse bright costumes and pick outfits to build stylish looks, so it suits anyone who loves fashion and creating fun images.

Everything is controlled with the mouse alone. You point and click your way through choosing clothes and styling your character. The game is a good fit for fans of colorful outfits who enjoy trying out different combinations.
m3-power-3d-city-racing: M3 Power 3D City Racing puts you behind the wheel of a BMW M3 across seven different survival games. You must be the last car standing, yet also the first to reach victory, and collecting points along the way helps your run. Win, and the day's top car becomes yours.
You steer with the arrow keys and use the space button, or on a
soldier-spy-hunter: Step into the boots of Bullet Man in this 3D shooting game, where your rifle is the tool for sharpening your aim and taking down as many wicked men as you can. Obstacles stand between you and your objectives, so every shot needs careful thought before you pull the trigger. Your sniper skills come into play as you weigh how many enemies one bullet might bring down.
A large number of targets await, and the mouse controls your shooting. Click to fire, choose your moments carefully, and see how well you can save the day as Bullet Man.
impossible-train-game: Take the controls of a locomotive that runs on rails floating just above the ground in this driving simulator with an adventure theme. Once the game starts, follow the on-screen prompts that guide you through the journey. Your goal is to bring the train to a safe stop at the final station. Along the way, you will need to slow down at crossings, sound the horn, and switch tracks when the route calls for it.
Everything is controlled with one bar: drag it to speed up or to brake. Made with Unity3D and running in the browser through WebGL, this title tests your timing and steady hands from start to finish.
chicken-egg-challenge: Chicken Egg Challenge is a clicker game built around friendly rivalry. You and your friends race to fill your basket with 10 eggs, and the first player to reach 10 wins. The loser has to take on a forfeit: sniffing a friend's socks, eating an onion, or doing the chicken dance. To dodge that fate, you need to press your key quickly.

The game supports one, two, or three players. Solo players use J. Two players share W and the Up Arrow. With three players, the controls are W, J, and the Up Arrow. The game also works on mobile devices.
roof-rush-3d: In Roof Rush 3D, you guide a pole-vaulting athlete across the rooftops of a dangerous city. The runner moves forward automatically, so your job is steering left and right by clicking and dragging or by sliding across the screen. Pick up cylinders to lengthen your pole, then use it to slide along parallel rails. The key is staying centered between the rails, because losing your balance sends you tumbling.

Watch for saws and other obstacles that shrink your pole, and steer clear of the red blocks that could break it completely. The levels are colorful and change color as you progress. You can unlock skins such as the Ninja or Zombie, dive into the endless mode, or race to the finish line for a victory celebration.
fun-soccer-3d: Fun Soccer 3D is a sports game with physics-driven ball play and a bright 3D pitch. Matches are light and easy to pick up, so you can jump in and enjoy a full dose of football. You can play with two, three, or four players, and local multiplayer for two to four players is also available, with everyone taking part at the same time.

Inside the settings, you can choose from four button modes to suit your style. The gameplay stays simple, yet it still lets you score some crazy goals. Best of all, you can play the whole game with just one finger. Follow the on-screen instructions to get started.
tap-basket: Tap Basket is a basketball game where you tap the screen to bounce the ball and try to reach the hoop before time runs out. Each tap pushes the ball upward, so timing matters if you want to score. Clean dunks earn bonus points, and a streak of baskets builds up fire for much bigger totals. After every basket the hoop jumps to the other side, so you need to stay alert.
As you move along, the hoop begins to travel and the clock counts down faster. Play with a mouse click or a tap on your device. How many baskets can you sink before the timer wins?
truck-loads-simulator-3d: Truck Loads Simulator 3D gives a fresh twist to truck games for fans of cargo hauling. Its soundtrack features the Rabab, a traditional guitar that is hugely popular across the Middle East, East Asia, and Central Asia, especially among Pashto and Persian speaking communities. The whole concept was shaped by a group of very talented truck artists.

This truck simulator casts you as a cargo truck transporter driver, so you spend your time behind the wheel of a big rig. Move your vehicle using the W, A, S, and D keys. Whether you are a longtime fan of cargo truck games or simply enjoy driving simulations, this title has plenty to offer.
simon-says: This browser title recreates the classic memory game Simon Says in a simple form. It belongs to the puzzle category and is a flat, two-dimensional experience driven by clicking. The original electronic device produced a run of tones and lights, and players had to repeat the pattern back.
To play, watch first as the computer clicks some buttons. Then follow along and click those buttons yourself. It is a memory skill game, and it is tagged as a brain and clicker title.
little-pandas-food-cooking: Food City has just had its grand opening, and the foodie Qiqi invites you to cook and taste dishes together. Candy, juice, snacks, and oden are all waiting for you to prepare. Juice comes first: aim at the fruit on the cutting board and slice it quickly. One swift cut through watermelon, apples, bananas, and oranges completes a rainbow-colored juice that looks and tastes wonderful.
Other recipes are waiting to be explored in the game, so there is plenty to make beyond the juice. Control is simple, either with your mouse or by tapping the screen, whichever suits your device.
fighting-club-2: Choose any one of the six members of the Fighting Club and let your scrappy side take over. Each win makes your next opponent stronger, so you will need to stay sharp. Prefer company? Invite a friend and settle once and for all who is the coolest fighter. Either way, you will test your power, stamina, and quickness against a crowd of tough guys.

Player 1 moves with WASD and punches with G. Player 2 steers with the arrow keys and uses NUM 1 for the punch and kick controls. Pick your fighter, learn the moves, and see how long you can keep standing.
draw-the-bike-bridge: Draw The Bike Bridge is an arcade game where you sketch a route for passing vehicles. Your job is to create the path they travel along, shaping the crossing as you go. Tagged as casual and aimed at kids, it puts bikes at the heart of the action.
Controls are simple: swipe across the screen to draw the bridge. Your finger does all the work, so the game is quick to pick up and easy to follow.
fruit-bubble-shooters: Fruit Bubble Shooters is a fresh take on the bubble shooter style that is very hard to put down once you begin. Your job is to aim and fire fruit bubbles at the spot you choose. Line up three or more matching fruit bubbles to clear them from the board. Each level rewards you for finishing with fewer shots, and you can aim for a full three-star result on every stage.

The game is a casual puzzle experience that mixes brain-teasing planning with quick, satisfying matches. Controls are simple: just aim your shot and fire the fruit. It suits anyone who enjoys match-3 puzzles or classic bubble popping.
jul-parking-simulator: Jul Parking Simulator is a driving game centred on parking cars. It is split into several levels, so you have a range of challenges to work through as you go. Expect plenty of enjoyment from manoeuvring a vehicle into its spot.

Controls are simple. Use the W, A, S and D keys or the arrow keys to move around. Press F to climb into a car and press it again to step back out. Whether you enjoy car games or just want something playful to pass the time, this title offers a relaxed way to practise your parking skills.
cute-dinosaur-differences: Cute Dinosaur Differences is a playful puzzle title made for young children. Little ones who adore dinosaurs will feel right at home here. Aimed at toddlers, preschoolers, and kids between 2 and 12 years old, it uses animation to keep the action lively. The game is split into 5 levels, and every one is packed with dinosaurs to spot and explore.

Control is simple: use your mouse or tap the screen to play, so it works on computers and touch devices alike. The focus stays on spotting what is different in each picture. It suits a relaxed, happy session with a dinosaur fan.
off-track-jungle-race: Fearless, fast drivers take on this course even though there are no city highways to follow. Instead, the route is full of rough terrain and bumpy tracks, creating a demanding setting for off-road parking and car driving. Your goal is to defeat rivals in time attack mode while pushing aggressively toward the destination.

Pickup trucks used for delivery and transportation also wander around the off-road parking environment, so keep an eye on them. The controls are simple: use the WASD keys to move and the Space bar to brake. This 3D racing game is built with HTML5 and WebGL.
bulldozer-crash-race: Bulldozer Crash Race puts you behind the wheel of a bulldozer in a driving simulation built from 3D game art. Each level takes place on a track where other vehicles are waiting to be hit. Crashing into them charges your nitro, so smashing into rivals becomes part of the strategy rather than something to avoid.
Your goals are to unlock every skin and complete all of the levels. Steer with the arrow keys and press space to use your nitro. The game runs in HTML5 and is also tagged for mobile.
little-panda-space-kitchen: Picture yourself preparing tasty meals inside a space capsule. In Little Panda's Space Kitchen, kids take on the role of a space chef and explore a wide range of recipes. Along the way, they get to work with a set of unusual space kitchen machines that make the cooking feel out of this world.

Cooking is only part of the fun, because players can also dress up as a space chef and complete the look with a chef's hat. Everything is controlled with a mouse or by tapping the screen, so it is easy to pick up and start cooking right away.
galactic-shooter: Galactic Shooter is a 2D shooter that weaves puzzle elements into its gameplay, so each stage asks you to think as well as aim. Its graphics add to the experience, and the title is made for mobile play. Your main goal is to complete all 50 levels, working through the full set until the final one is cleared.

Getting started is simple because the game is controlled with taps. Just tap to begin, then keep moving through the levels as the shooting and puzzle parts combine. It is a fun pick for anyone who enjoys shooting games with a puzzle twist, and it offers plenty of stages to work through.
christmas-salon: Christmas Salon invites you to give animals and a cheerful Santa a festive makeover. You can style their hair, fur, and even Santa's beard, then dress everyone in cozy winter outfits. The game also lets you bake cookies, whip up frozen ice cream, and decorate a Christmas tree, with more activities along the way.

Everything is controlled with a mouse or by tapping the screen. It sits in the Girls category and carries tags such as animal, Christmas, cleaning, cooking, dress up, food, and fun. It is a wintry makeover journey for anyone who enjoys holiday styling and kitchen play.
horse-racing: In Horse Racing: Derby Quest, you step into the boots of a young jockey hoping to make a name for yourself. Rivals from across the globe are ready to challenge you as you work your way toward stardom. Every ride brings a fresh contest, and every win moves you closer to the top.

Your duties go well beyond the saddle. You will manage your stable, boosting how well your horses perform, and look after them in their haven. Then you take them to 40 different tracks and derbies spread around the world. Beat every opponent and every other star to complete your quest and see whether you can claim the title of racing champion.
truck-stunt-on-the-sky-way: Take the wheel in this 3D racing game, where your car rides across towering mega ramps high above the ground. You can choose from sports, classic, and speed cars, along with heavier vehicles, and race them over tracks that seem to defy logic. Pull off daring jumps and stunts to earn points. The game runs offline, and you control everything with the keyboard.

Three modes are available. Infinity Mode gives you full command of every car, letting you reach high speeds while mixing in big stunts. GT Stunts Mode presents challenging missions that ask you to perform ramp tricks on a variety of ramp setups. GT Mega Ramps Mode sends you soaring across sky-high tracks with super fast cars.
princess-cheongsam-shanghai-fashion: Anna and Elsa are inseparable friends who love passing their days creating fresh looks together. After trying every outfit they can imagine, their curiosity pushes them to look beyond the present century. As they travel through different periods of history, they settle on the Cheongsam, a fashion style from Shanghai.

Along the way, they discover many costumes, from Qing-style pieces to modern Qipao with high-slit cuts and a mini dress option. Your job is to choose the colors and dresses for each look, then present the finished outfits in majestic imperial fashion. The whole game is played with a left mouse click.
prison-gates: In this stickman runner, you sprint forward while criminals chase after you. Two gates appear ahead as you run, and only one of them lets you through. The other is shut, so if you pass through it, the criminals catch you and the round ends. Choose the open gate, and the pursuers can't reach you, so you escape safely.
Steering is simple. On a computer, press the left and right arrow keys to move between paths. On a phone, swipe your finger left or right to change position.
