hospital-inc: Hospital Inc is a management simulator set in a busy medical setting. You build your own hospital, grow it over time, and keep it running smoothly. This idle tycoon game keeps earning you money even when you step away from the screen. Everything is controlled with a single mouse click or tap.

The game falls into the hypercasual category and is tagged with business, hospital, simulator, and strategy. Its pace is quick, so you can jump in for a short session or leave it running in the background while you do other things.
blob-runner-3d: Blob Runner 3D is a parkour game that has become one of the most talked-about titles of the year. Its gameplay keeps players coming back, and its three-dimensional art style gives every run a fresh look. You follow slimy blobs through a range of adventures, watching them leap, climb, and race across the course.

Steering is simple: drag across the screen to move your blob. Along the way you can collect items and steer clear of obstacles, so timing and focus matter. The game is built with HTML5 and fits the Arcade category, making it a good pick for anyone who enjoys 3D runners.
fort-builder-sandbox: Fort Builder is a simulation game centered on constructing forts while practicing with different weapons. You can choose from three types of structures, along with a variety of weapons and projectiles. There are no fixed rules on what to build, so you can let your imagination shape whatever stronghold you have in mind.

Move with the W, A, S and D keys, and jump with the spacebar. Hold the right mouse button to aim, then click the left button to place a fort piece or shoot. Press E to cancel a build or pick up a weapon, and use keys 1 through 4 to switch between weapons. Keys 5, 6 and 7 select the structure you want to build.
doctor-kids-learn-to-be-a-doctor: Step into a children's hospital where medicine and kindness go hand in hand. You can work your way up to chief of medicine and learn to show more sympathy to the people in your care. Families choose this clinic for the experience it offers and the quality of its pediatricians. Controls are simple: just tap or click.
As a doctor, you will deliver professional treatment and take care of the little patients who come in. Everything you do centers on looking after these young people with skill and compassion.
flippy-bottle: Flippy Bottle is a hypercasual game built around one goal: climb as high as you can. The climb is not guaranteed, because you can fall at any point, so every platform calls for care. The game carries the avoid, highscore, and platform tags, which sum up its focus on dodging mistakes, chasing a best score, and hopping across a series of ledges.

Controls are simple: a touch or a click is all it takes. Move up through the platforms one at a time, keeping an eye on each landing, and see how far up you can get before a fall brings you back down.
racing-cars-coloring: Racing Cars Coloring is a free online game for children that lets them color in pictures of race cars. It suits anyone who enjoys racing and admires beautiful race machines, and it is a relaxed way for young players to get interested in cars and motor racing while they learn. Players control everything with a mouse or by tapping the screen.

The game is meant to be fun, and it invites visitors to return for more free games. Its race car coloring pages give kids a gentle introduction to the world of cars and racing, combining creativity with a bit of education along the way.
car-transporter-truck-simulator: This 2019 release puts you behind the wheel of a big transporter truck pulling a heavy trailer loaded with luxury cars, with the feel of European truck driving. Your job is to move modern vehicles from one city to another. You start by collecting cars from a multi-story parking area, driving each one up onto the trailer, and then hauling the load out of the city toward an offroad route.

Once the cars arrive, unload them from the truck and enjoy driving the luxury cars yourself. Despite the transport theme, the game is less about delivery missions and more about testing your car parking skills. Steer the truck with the keyboard arrow keys.
penguin-cafe: Somewhere in a chilly, snow-covered region, penguins, polar bears and walruses share the same neighbourhood. You step in to help Berta, a worn-out cafe owner whose business is going through a rough patch. Her cafe rests on a floating iceberg, so adventure is never far away.
This cooking and restaurant game is controlled with clicks or taps. Tap to choose dishes and tables as you go.
ruler-survival-game: Ruler Survival Game puts you in a world where strategy and staying alive go hand in hand, and every choice you make affects your fate. Your task is to build an empire, keep your resources under control, and show what you can do as a ruler.

Players who enjoy tough challenges can test their thinking, while those who prefer creating a world at their own pace will find plenty to like. The game blends action, careful planning, and adventure into one experience. Controls are simple: use a mouse click or tap the screen to play.
cow-jam-farm-puzzle: Cow Jam Farm Puzzle takes a calm countryside setting and turns it into a knotted traffic snarl. Crowded lanes leave cows boxed in, and the only way out is to think through each move. Your job is to guide every cow to safety, one tangle at a time.

Playing is simple: just use a mouse click or a tap to make your moves. Every puzzle asks you to work out the right order before the paths clear. It is driven by logic, so the challenge comes from thinking ahead rather than moving fast.
squid-dentist-game: In this dentist office game, you look after a group of squid patients. You play the dentist and care for your squid patient, but the aim is to stay calm and treat them properly rather than acting wild. The game includes six different squid characters to treat.

Along the way, you'll find a range of dentist tools and eye-catching visual effects, with sounds that are amusing to hear. The graphics are bright, and the game is designed as a light, casual pick for kids. Control is simple: use your mouse, or tap the screen if you're on a touch device.
ball-color-smash: Ball Color Smash is an arcade game that puts your reflexes and color-matching skills to the test. You guide a bouncing ball and smash through obstacles that share its color, so quick timing matters from the very start. As the speed climbs and the patterns grow more intricate, each stage asks more of you.

All buttons are operated with a mouse click. The game sits in the Puzzles category and carries casual and hypercasual tags. Watch the colors closely and react fast to keep smashing through whatever matches your ball.
pizza-ninja-mania: Pizza toppings are tossed high into the air in this ninja-style arcade game, and you need sharp slicing skills to cut them down. Customers want their orders served quickly, and they also enjoy a bit of entertainment, so pick up a knife and get to work. Each game mode offers its own challenge, and your aim is to be the best.

Your main job is to slice every ingredient you see. Endless arcade mode lets you keep pushing your limit for as long as you can. Watch for shiny bonus ingredients and don't let any of them slip past. In Trial mode, keep playing until you drop three ingredients, which ends the game. In Queue mode, you only slice the ingredients. New types of bonuses are waiting for you, too.
orc-invasion: In Orc Invasion, your castle is under attack from a wave of invading orcs, and it is up to you to hold them off. This shooting game casts you as the defender, using a bow to fire at enemies as they approach. Power-ups are there to help you stay alive, so make good use of them when the pressure builds.

Aiming and shooting are handled with a mouse, or with your finger on touch screens. Point at the orcs, then fire to stop them before they reach your castle. This arcade-style battle game with a war theme keeps the tension high from start to finish.
air-battles: Take the controls of a fighter jet in this shooting game set in the skies. You will weave through shifting scenery, avoid incoming gunfire, and take part in quick aerial duels with capable rivals. Missions grow harder as you progress, so careful planning, accurate aim, and fast reactions all matter if you want to come out on top.

Choose from a range of planes, each carrying its own weapons and abilities. You can tailor your fighting approach to suit your taste and strengthen your arsenal over time. To fire, press the Spacebar or click the left mouse button; your shots can be bullets or missiles.
offroad-oil-tanker-truck-drive: Take charge of a heavy-duty oil tanker in this 3D truck game and transport your load to its destination. The off-road course sends you up steep hills, so every delivery tests your control as you drive like a tanker driver in an oil tanker simulator. It is built for players who love oil tanker games or truck driving games.

Move with W, A, S and D, and press Space to brake when the slopes get tough. This free browser game has a racing and driving feel, with road and simulator elements, and it is tagged for a boys audience. Keep the tanker moving up the climbs and bring the oil to its target.
run-royale-knockout-ultimate: If plain foot races have lost their appeal, this 3D arcade game adds a challenging obstacle course with a royal theme. Today's event pits you against seasoned pros, and everyone is racing to reach the finish line first. Only players who place in the top three can move on to the next race.
The game features 30 levels, each one a fresh stage in the royal contest. It suits kids who enjoy 3D, puzzle, and running games. Controls are simple: you play by dragging.
bubble-witch-saga: Bubble Witch Saga takes the classic bubble shooter formula and sends it on a fresh journey. Your job is to fire bubbles and transform them into fruit, which earns you more points. Each stage brings its own challenges, so you will need to adjust your approach as you move through the adventure.

Controls come down to two actions: aim, then shoot. Think about each shot before you fire, since careful aiming helps you earn points. The game offers many levels, and each one presents different challenges to overcome.
design-it-fashion-salon: Tailor Lucy has finally opened her very own tailor shop, but she is feeling a bit swamped and cannot manage everything by herself. Your job is to get the shop ready and prepare for the first customers. Some of them are quite picky, and you may even need to sew glamorous gowns for famous VIP guests.
The game is played with a mouse click or a tap. Give the shop a friendly, well-stocked look so Lucy can welcome every visitor with a smile.
cut-for-cat-game: This free cartoon puzzle game is aimed at boys and asks you to cut ropes so a cat can get to its candy. You can use helpful props such as balloons, bubbles, and magnets. Each one creates its own reaction force, airflow, or other effect, so you need to think carefully about how to use them.

The game runs online on phones, tablets, and computers. On a PC, click the mouse to move. On a mobile phone, click the on-screen buttons to move. It is built to test how well you can reason through each setup.
popsy-surprise-school-soft-girl: Meet the fashionable Popsy dolls, who head off to school without ever letting go of their softgirl style. This dress-up game lets you choose school outfits in gentle pastel pinks, with pale blues and lilacs added for contrast. You can braid the dolls' hair into romantic styles or dye it in unusual colors, then decorate it with large beads and hairpins.

Cute accessories and trendy Japanese drinks help finish each look. Softgirl schoolgirls are set to be the biggest trend of the new school year. Everything is controlled with a left mouse click or a touch.
pocket-racing: Pocket Racing puts you behind the wheel of a motorbike, a wheelchair, a tractor, a quadricycle or a scooter. Each vehicle races across rough off-road circuits, where you can catch air over obstacles. Your goal is to beat all 60 levels, and the attractive, well-made tracks give every stage a distinct feel.
You can control your vehicle with the arrow keys or with tap controls. These let you drive forward, brake and rotate, so you can handle jumps and turns as you move through each course.
stickman-ninja-warriors: In Stickman Ninja Warriors, you play as a stick-figure ninja whose job is to rescue a princess from an evil ninja. Your hero has become highly skilled with the shuriken, and each puzzle is solved by hurling these throwing stars at the cage that holds the princess captive.

This 2D fighting title runs in your browser with HTML5 and WebGL, and it is tagged as cool and crazy. You control everything with the mouse alone, so every throw is made with your pointer. Work through the puzzles one at a time, using your shuriken to break open the cage and free the princess.
carrom-2-player: Carrom is a striking and pocketing game, much like billiards or pool. Also called karrom or carom, it asks you to flick pieces across the board and sink them into the pockets. Everything is played with the mouse, so you aim, pull back and release to send the disk on its way. The controls feel natural, even if you have never touched a board before.

Give yourself room to get creative with angles. Bank shots and zig-zag routes from your own carrom sessions work here too, so try to recreate them on screen. This two-player title is a fun way to challenge a friend or test your own aim.
chicken-jumper: Chicken Jumper is a puzzle game set in a landscape built from odd, blocky shapes. Your job is to hop across the structures and make your way through 30 demanding stages. Every block you land on breaks apart, clearing the path so you can move on to the next level.

Controls are simple. Tap or click the right side of the screen to send your chicken leaping right, or the left side to send it hopping left. The game is listed for mobile, so a finger works just as well as a mouse. It is a good pick for anyone who enjoys brain teasers, chicken-themed fun, and jumping challenges.
zipline-rescue: Zipline Rescue is a physics puzzle you control with a single mouse click. Hazards and traps keep each challenge fresh, so this brain-training game stays engaging. Its minimalist, distinctive look and a large set of free puzzle levels can hold your attention for hours.
Everything depends on how you draw the line, so think ahead about the coins and keys as you sketch it. Collecting them brings gifts your way.
garbage-truck-sim-2020: Garbage Truck Sim 2020 puts you behind the wheel of a garbage truck. Your job is to roam the town, pick up the trash you find, and haul it to the drop-off point where you unload it. The game is built with Unity3D and runs in your browser through WebGL, and it sits in the Action category with tags for driving and trucks.
Steer with the W, A, S, and D keys. Use them to move around the streets and make your rounds. It's a laid-back game meant for a bit of fun, so take your time and enjoy the drive.
hidden-object-easter: Hidden Object Easter is a point-and-click puzzle game with a spring holiday setting. Your job is to scan each scene and spot the items shown in a list along the left side of the screen. Finish the level before the timer runs out to earn a bonus, so you need to search carefully and quickly.
You can play with a mouse or by touch, simply pointing at the hidden objects to select them. This traditional hidden object game works on both desktop and mobile devices.
dream-head-soccer-game: Dream Head Soccer is a quick-moving football game built around matches that are won through skill, sharp timing, and smart strategy. You take control of your favorite players, who have oversized heads, and guide them across the pitch. Use your moves to outplay the other side and show off your best tricks on the field.

Playing is simple, since a mouse click or a tap is all it takes. Think ahead about when to act and where to send your team, because timing and planning decide who comes out on top. It is a casual sports title with a football focus, and it is easy to pick up for a quick match.
piggy-on-the-run: Piggy On The Run is a 2D single-player action adventure in which you guide a cute pig through a forest and jungle. Your goal is to pass each level and rule the jungle. Along the way you need to watch out for enemies and obstacles, since you have to stay careful the whole time.
Move with the W, A, S and D keys, and use the double jump when you need an extra boost in the air. Keep your eyes open as you go, because the jungle has plenty of hazards waiting for a wrong step.
fighting-club: In this action brawler, you pick one of six members of the club and set out to prove your fighting spirit. Each victory makes your next opponent stronger, so you will need to keep sharpening your skills. Your strength, endurance, and dexterity all get tested along the way, against tough fighters.

Prefer a head-to-head match? A friend can jump in, and you can settle who is the coolest fighter in the room. Player 1 moves with WASD, attacks with G or the left mouse button, and dodges or blocks with H or the right mouse button. Player 2 moves with the arrow keys, attacks with K or numpad 1, and dodges or blocks with K.
plane-runner-3d: Take to the sky in this action game centered on fighter jet combat. It offers modern gameplay, striking graphics, and sound effects that draw you into every dogfight. It is built for anyone who enjoys airplane combat games.
Steering is easy. Use the W, A, S, and D keys or the arrow keys to move left and right, or press the left and right sides of the game screen if you prefer clicking or tapping.
real-tractor-farming-simulator: This modern farming simulator puts you in charge of cultivating your fields with the help of drone technology. Its 3D setting is built to mirror the real world, so working the land feels like running a farm of your own. It also tackles the seasonal chore of cutting crops, making harvest time far less of a struggle.
Every modern farming technique is available for you to try throughout the game. Cultivate your farm in the 3D world from start to finish. Control your movements with the keyboard arrow keys.
draw-master-3d: Draw Master 3D is a new drawing puzzle game where your job is to sketch the piece that is missing from a scene. Once you have added a part, you can bring the scene to life by making the action happen and moving the objects and characters around. The game centers on drawing, so each puzzle asks you to think about what belongs in the picture and how it should fit.

Along the way you will find many more challenges to work through, all built around drawing-based puzzles. It is a brain puzzle game that is meant to be fun to play. Everything is controlled with the mouse alone.
flippy-hero-jump-game: Flippy Hero Jump Game is a quick arcade adventure where split-second timing, sharp reflexes, and accuracy decide the winner. You enter the arena and steer your hero through flips and leaps, dodging trouble while you aim for goals in a football-style contest with a twist that sets it apart from ordinary matches.

It falls into the hypercasual group and is simple to pick up. Mouse clicks or taps are all the controls you need. Get a feel for the rhythm of each jump, then work on landing your shots with more precision.
trials-ride: Take the controls of a trials motorbike and steer it through a hangar filled with tough obstacles. Each section tests your focus as you work to keep the rider and machine steady. The goal is to reach the finish in the shortest time possible, so every wobble costs you valuable seconds.

Use the arrow keys on your keyboard or the on-screen buttons to ride forward and balance the motorcycle. The on-screen buttons also make the game suitable for mobile play. Keep the bike upright through every challenge to finish the course as fast as you can.
fall-boys-ultimate-race-tournament-multi: Step into a multiplayer race tournament where you run, jump, and fall your way along the course. Traps are waiting on the maps, and they will catch you if you are not fast enough. Qualify first to move on to the next round, and aim to finish in first place when it counts.

More maps and characters are on the way, and new maps are being worked on every day. In-game multiplayer chat lets you talk with other players while you play. The controls are simple: use WASD to move, press Space to jump, and hit Esc to bring back your mouse cursor.
superhero-city-bike-parking-game-3d: Many players who enjoy driving simulation games have found the genre can feel dull and repetitive over time. Superhero City Bike Parking Game 3D offers a fresh idea: parking a bike in extreme situations. Riding a motorcycle through its 3D world gives the familiar parking challenge a new twist.

The controls are simple, since you play with the keyboard arrow keys. This arcade title combines bike and motorcycle themes with simulation gameplay, and it runs in your web browser. Whether you usually stick to cars or are new to parking challenges, the focus stays on handling a bike in difficult spots.
wood-shop: Wood Shop is a calm, easygoing 3D hypercasual game that people of any age can enjoy. It gives you a relaxed way to spend spare time while working with wood. Your job is to craft a range of wooden pieces in different shapes. When you shape one precisely, you earn money, and that money opens up new shapes to try.
To play, just slide your finger or mouse across the screen. The controls are that simple, so you can jump right into the woodworking and take it at your own pace.
motorcycle-racing: Hop onto a motorcycle in this 3D parkour game, where balance and bouncing are the main challenges. Tapping the screen sends your bike forward, and releasing it brings the bike to a stop. When obstacles appear, swipe left or right to dodge them, or you will crash and the run ends.

Once the motorcycle bounces up into the air, tap the screen to flip it over. If the rider's head hits the ground, you lose, so timing each flip matters. WASD is also listed as a control option. The game is tagged as action, adventure, arena, avoid, and car.
candy-2021-game-2021-gratuit: Candy 2021 is a sweet match-3 puzzle game, so you can expect a board full of tasty treats. Your main task is to match yummy candies and clear them away. Each move is about lining up sweets in the right way, which keeps the puzzle engaging from start to finish.

The game is free to play and has a candy-themed adventure at its core. Its full name, Candy 2021 jeux 2021 gratuit, points to that free access. If you enjoy puzzles with a sugary twist, this one should suit you well.
nail-stack-run-challenge: Nail Stack Run Challenge is an ASMR nail salon adventure. You collect nails as you go, then decorate them with bright polish, unique designs, and gorgeous acrylic nails. Watch out for obstacles such as nail-biting saws. There are endless beauty care options to explore, so you can let your creativity guide every design.

Customize long nails with stylish pigments, patterns, and lengths until you reach the perfect manicure. Follow the latest trends and build fashionable looks. The challenge tests your speed, style, and precision in a fun, colorful, fashion-inspired setting. To play, click with your mouse or tap the screen.
mega-ramp-car-stunt-racing-mania: This free 3D game puts you behind the wheel for mega ramp car stunts and racing. It offers an endless range of driving challenges and suits fans of stunt driving who want something more engaging than typical offline titles. If you love car stunts, this car simulator is a strong pick. Race across tracks that look nearly impossible to finish, pulling off wild stunts along the way.

A garage full of sports cars awaits, so choose whichever vehicle you like best. Hit the nitro to boost your speed on the mega ramp tracks. Each mission is designed to sharpen your stunt driving skills, and all of them are fun and demanding. Complete every one to prove your skill and become a champion in this 2020 simulation game. Controls use the keyboard arrow keys.
shoe-designer: Shoe Designer High Heels lets you create a pair of shoes exactly the way you picture them. You shape the design and pick whichever colors you prefer, so each result can look completely personal. The game is part of a set of shoe design titles, and this entry centers on high heels.

Wanting a nice, fancy pair of shoes is a wish many girls share, and this game gives you a way to build one yourself. Everything is controlled with the mouse alone, so there are no extra keys to learn. Click, experiment, and adjust until your heels look just right.
talking-ben-coloring: Talking Ben Coloring is a children's coloring picture that you can color right in your web browser. Filling in its pages is a pastime that appeals to kids of any age, and it makes a worthwhile way to spend time.
You can play with a mouse or by tapping the screen, so it works on a computer or a phone or tablet. The controls are simple, and the game is designed to be easy to pick up and enjoy.
gun-of-janissary: Two cute janissary soldiers face off with guns instead of the swords, axes, and bows they once relied on. Wind and trees can push your bullets off course, so you need to work out where each shot will land before you fire. Grab the bonuses scattered around the battlefield to gain an edge over your opponent. The game is built for two players, and you can aim and fire with touch controls or with the W key and the up arrow key on a keyboard.
ninja-jump-fighting: Slip into a dark, shadowy world where your ninja must move quickly and act at the right moment. Quick reflexes, precise timing, and solid fighting skills will decide how long you last. Smooth leaps flow into hard-hitting clashes, so every jump needs careful thought.

The controls are easy to learn. Press Space, W, the up arrow, or the right arrow to jump, and use K or J to attack. Its addictive pull makes it a good pick for players of every age. Whether you are new to this style of game or already a fan, it offers plenty to enjoy.
backflip-parkour: Backflip Parkour lets you act like a true acrobat inside a 3D parkour simulator. You can pull off flips and backflips, and drop from high spots or leap across gaps as part of the fun. The game also teaches the basics of parkour, so you can build up your skills step by step. Everything is controlled with the mouse.

Think about the wild stunts you have always wanted to try. Here, leaping from great heights feels less daunting, and you can mix jumps with flips and backflips whenever you like. It is a relaxed way to practice your moves and get comfortable with parkour movement.
drift-race-3d: Drift Race 3D is a hypercasual 3D racing game where every race is about winning, though the races also include some stunts. Above all, it is built for enjoyment. Your goal is to push your drifting beyond what seems possible and still take the win.

The only control is a click, which you use to drift. Pull off stunts and let the finish line see exactly who you are. Whether you are chasing victory or just having fun, the game keeps the focus on playful, stylish driving.
crazy-traffick-racing-2026: This arcade racer rewards both quick speed and careful timing. You steer through crowded city highways, weaving between unpredictable vehicles and dodging dangerous obstacles to keep your streak alive. As you get better at handling the chaos, you earn rewards that can be spent on new cars.

Visit the shop to unlock a varied fleet of powerful cars. Each one handles differently, so finding the right match can help you survive the rush of traffic on the asphalt. Use the game's on-screen buttons to move left and right.
run-imposter-run: In this 2D arcade action game for one player, your mission is to help the impostor survive. Keep an eye out for flying creatures, since they are very dangerous. The journey includes 20 different levels, and each one brings its own level of hazards, matching the difficulty you face.
Control the impostor with the WASD keys and watch out for enemies along the way. You can climb on top of monsters to take them down. A double
beauty-race-3d: Every girl hopes to be beautiful and stylish, with a great figure and the finest cosmetics. Wanting these things is completely understandable, but wishes alone are not enough, and something has to be done to reach them. This game follows virtual girls as they pursue these goals and shows the trials they encounter along the way.
unicorn-drink-maker: Kids tend to adore both shakes and unicorn-themed treats, and this browser game brings those two loves together. You step into the role of a shake creator, building a rainbow-colored unicorn drink from the ground up. Your workspace is stocked with pots, blenders, and cat's claw cups, so you can mix and match tools as you please.

Built-in recipes show you how to combine milk, fruit, and ice cream into a tasty base. Once the drink is ready, you can finish it with a wide range of fruits, several styles of unicorns, plenty of bright colored particles, and sugar. Playing takes nothing more than a mouse click or a tap. It is a do-it-yourself way to put together your own unicorn shake.
baby-taylor-farm-tour-caring-animals: Taylor sets off with her dad to visit their uncle James, who lives on a farm packed with animals. She is thrilled, since many of the creatures there are ones she has never seen before. Under her uncle's guidance, Taylor learns how to look after each animal, and you can learn alongside her.

Along the way you will meet a pig, sheep, duck, turkey, and shepherd. Everything is controlled with a simple mouse click or tap. The game blends animal care with dress-up fun and farm simulation, making it an educational pick for anyone who wants to spend time on a farm with a friendly family.
wizzard-adventure: Wizzard Adventure puts you in charge of a wizard who sets out on a trip filled with tough hurdles. Your spells help you get past them, and you need to dodge traps and take down foes to move ahead. Every level brings different ground and new problems, so you will need good timing and fast reactions.
Moving your wizard is done with the arrow keys, and the space bar makes him jump. The controls are easy to pick up, and the game stays fun and charming from start to finish.
rope-bawling-2: Rope Bawling 2 is a casual puzzle game that mixes bowling with line-drawing physics puzzles. Instead of simply rolling a ball down a lane, you cut a rope so the ball drops and knocks over every bottle. Each stage grows harder than the last, so you need to judge exactly when to make your cut.

The game is played with a mouse or by tapping the screen. It is built for Android devices and suits kids and anyone who enjoys brain-teasing challenges. Later levels push your timing further, so you will need to act quickly and accurately to clear them.
stickman-fighting-2-player: Stickman Fighting 2 Player lets you brawl solo or with a friend. The stickman warriors move with realistic ragdoll physics, so their bodies tumble and react when they get hit. Your aim is to test your skill, wear down your rival's health, and keep fighting until they fall. You can throw boxing punches, grab opponents, and kick, all while keeping your reflexes sharp.

The fights blend a western cowboy theme, a ninja-style atmosphere, and a doodle-style survival feel. In one player mode you steer with the arrow keys, and in two player mode the WASD keys control the second fighter. Expect fast, action-packed bouts.
us-army-vehicle-transporter-truck: Fans of car driving simulators will feel at home with US Army Vehicle Transporter Truck, a 3D game about hauling military vehicles. Each level gives you a truck, and your job is to carry both tanks and cars to the marked military base.

Before each delivery, you first need to drive the tanks and cars onto the truck, or off it again. Move with WASD or the arrow keys on PC, or tap the buttons on screen on mobile. Stay calm and keep your driving steady.
grand-mega-ramp-stunts: Grand Mega Ramp Stunts is a car stunt simulator where the physics are pushed to the limit. Expect hard crashes, big jumps, sliding drifts, and plenty of other racing car tricks to pull off. The races are built to be tough but enjoyable, so you can test your driving in a variety of tricky situations.

Your job is to launch off risky ramps and clear the challenges placed along the way. Steer and control the car with the keyboard arrow keys. Give it a try and see how far your stunt skills can take you.
soccer-caps-game: Step into this international take on the World Cup, built as a soccer caps table game. Start by choosing the team you want to lead, then move your players across the field to find the back of the net. Keep pushing toward the goal of lifting the champion cup, and stay sharp as you fight for every win.
Controls are straightforward. Tap the cap player you want to use, then drag to set the direction and the shooting power. Both aim and force come from that one drag, so plan each kick carefully.
superhero-violet-summer-excursion: With the weather growing sweltering, Violet is eager to head to the seaside and unwind. Before she gets there, she starts with a facial beauty session, then tries out some creative face painting and a few hairstyles. Next, she picks out an outfit and accessories she finds ideal.

The final stage lets you customize and decorate her bicycle, and after that she rides off toward the beach. Everything is controlled with a left mouse click. This HTML5 girls' game falls under dress up, fashion, and bike themes, and it suits young kids who love cute styling.
farming-town: Farming Town lets you plow, sow, and harvest your fields with a wide range of machines. Once you sell your crops, the money goes toward buying new tractors and combine harvesters. The game is a farming simulator set in an open-world career mode, where you can enjoy driving farm vehicles and work your way up to becoming a professional farmer.
Steering your vehicles is simple: use the WASD keys or the arrow keys to move around the game world.
join-and-clash-2: Join and Clash 2 is the sequel to the well-known Join and Clash 3D. This hypercasual title comes with a fresh look and new stages. Expect a long, fun run. Your job is to rescue your companions along the way, then defeat the beast waiting at the far end of the path. Rescuing them takes care, because hazards along the route are working to take you out.
You steer using a mouse or swipe gestures. Stay alert as you gather your allies and push toward the final confrontation.
fast-jump-3d: Fast Jump 3D is a lively action title where the aim is to hop from one block to the next at a steady pace. Speed matters here, since each block vanishes after just a few seconds if you stay on it too long. Grabbing diamonds along the way raises your score. This browser version is based on the Android game of the same name, so the core experience carries over to your screen.
You control the jumps with a screen tap on touch devices or a left click of the mouse on a computer. Keep your timing sharp and your moves quick to stay ahead of the disappearing platforms.
ben-10-drone-destruction: Ben 10 Drone Destruction is a free adventure game that runs in your web browser. Based on the animated Ben 10 cartoon, it puts you in control of Ben as he works to destroy the alien drones that are coming to attack. Using the power of the Omnitrix, Ben transforms into the aliens Heatblast and Stinkfly to fight back.
Your goal is to wipe out every drone, including the evil ones called Z, X, and Arrows.
bullet-bender: Bullet Bender puts you inside the projectile itself. You steer a bullet through a 3D arcade puzzle, moving it left and right as well as up and down once a gun has fired at its targets. Obstacles appear along the route, so you need to dodge them while you guide the silver bullet, or another upgradable item, toward the spot where it will do the most damage.
The game is played with a mouse or by touch. It is tagged as a one-player title with action, puzzle and .io elements, and it sits in the Arcade category.
subway-stone: Subway Stone asks for both patience and skill. It is a nonstop arcade game with a fast pace and plenty of action. Your goal is to race through each course while staying on your feet, dodging explosions, and keeping clear of the edges of every platform. Falling off or getting blown up ends your run, so focus matters. Whether you can reach the end is up to you.
Use the arrow keys to move left and right and to jump. Each course calls for quick reactions and careful timing, so keep your eyes moving and stay alert from start to finish.
easter-triple-mahjong: Easter Triple Mahjong brings the tile-matching puzzle into a spring-themed setting. Instead of pairing tiles, you clear them in groups of three identical pieces at a time. A tile can only be picked when at least two of its sides are free, so you need to plan which tiles to uncover first.

Your score depends on speed, and the less time you take, the more points you earn. Play with a mouse or a touchpad, selecting matching sets and working through the arrangement. Try to finish as quickly as you can, since shorter times bring higher scores.
spike-rush: In Spike Rush, you dodge spikes, leap over walls, and try not to tumble into holes. It starts off easy enough, but the pace steadily picks up and the layouts grow harsh, so a quick session can easily stretch into twenty minutes before you notice. Along the way you can grab four kinds of power-ups: a speed boost, invincibility that breaks through obstacles for points, a double score bonus, and a magnet that drags everything toward you. Ten skins and twenty-two achievements give you extra goals to chase. Controls are simple: click the mouse or tap the screen.
gangster-city-crime: You arrive in an unfamiliar city and must learn how its streets work. Before long you are caught up in brawls between rival gangs, and you have to prove yourself through their dirty dealings. If fighting isn't your thing, you can take a break and cruise the city instead. Plenty of cars and motorcycles are available, and you can drive whichever one you like, with or without a driver behind the wheel.

The adventure offers two game modes and multiple levels to work through. Movement uses W, A, S and D, while Space makes your character jump. Left-click to attack, right-click to block, and press Escape to pause at any time.
offroad-jeep-hill-climb: Mark Stim is a young off-road hopeful who dreams of becoming a top asphalt racer. His path leads him on a wild quest where nothing holds back his hill climbing. Players tackle intense, high-powered hill courses while choosing from eight different vehicles.

Stunts and strong hill climbing skills earn you a free hill climb race license, and cash collected along the way lets you upgrade your ride. This 2016 driving adventure is all about becoming the best 4WD hilltop driver. Steer the jeep with the keyboard arrow keys.
princess-ella-hand-care: Cinderella has an important meeting with a prince today, but her hands are not looking their best. Daily housework has left them dirty and covered in dough. You need to help her fix the problem quickly. The job is more than a quick clean, because a full makeover is part of it too. Finish the look with nail art for her hands. She will be delighted and will thank you for your help.
The game is played with a mouse click or a tap, so it is easy to start right away. Each step brings C
fall-beans-ultimate-knockout-race: Fall Beans is a 3D game set on brightly colored platforms. Your goal is to get to the finish line without tumbling off. Each map has its own layout, so you will need to adapt your skills from one course to the next. Time your moves carefully to take first place.
You steer your bean with the arrow keys and leap with the spacebar. Expect every course to test you in a different way. It is a lively game that is easy to pick up and enjoyable to play.
car-shooting-rival-rage: Car Shooting - Rival Rage combines sci-fi gunplay with driving in this 3D single-player arcade shooter. The rule is simple: cross the finish line first, and stay alive while you do it. Every race is a deadly contest, and you need to be a sharp shooter to come out ahead.

You can craft and upgrade weapons, then fit them to your car. The arsenal runs from powerful assault rifles to devastating plasma guns. To fire, press the ruler button, and steer with W, A, S and D. The game is tagged as an .io title and sits in the shooting category.
flex-run-3d: Flex Run 3D is an arcade game built around yoga poses, using cartoon-style 3D characters and pieces of furniture. Your aim is to dodge every furniture obstacle on the way to the finish wall. Because your pose shifts in real time, you have to keep reshaping your body as you run.

You can choose between a single girl and two girls, and your drag movements produce different motions for each. Tap and drag to change positions. After reaching the finish wall, you can keep changing your pose so you attach to the numbered circles on the incoming purple walls. The game also offers six skins to try.
impossible-car-stunts: Take the wheel of a car and head out onto sky roads made of impossible tracks. Your goal is to pull off stunts on tall ramps, including zigzag routes that twist through the air. Jump off ramps, slide through drifts, and perform wild mid-air flips while racing against rival drivers. Massive heights and endless tracks in the sky make every run feel like a real car rally.
This free 3D game has levels that are both thrilling and challenging. Whether you prefer fast racing or stunt driving, the jumps and t
time-to-park-2: Time To Park 2 puts you behind the wheel for a series of parking challenges. Your job is to guide the car into the marked spot, and the quicker you get it done, the more points you pile up and the better your chance of earning all three stars.

On a computer, use the arrow keys or W, A, S and D to steer and move the car. On a phone or tablet, the on-screen buttons handle the driving. This racing title is built with HTML5 and is tagged with car, driving, mobile and parking, so it runs right in your browser.
head-basketball: Head Sport Basketball puts you on the court for a lively game of hoops. Your rivals are computer-controlled opponents that present a tough challenge, so every point you score has to be earned. Your aim is to outscore them and come out ahead when each match ends.

Getting around is simple. Use A and D, or the left and right arrow keys, to move across the court. Press W or the up arrow to jump, and tap Space to take a shot. The visuals are attractive, and the whole experience is a fun take on basketball.
extreme-jelly-shift-3d: Extreme Jelly Shift 3D is an arcade game in which you steer a soft, wobbly blob of jelly. Because jelly can flow and change its shape, you can bend it through tight gaps as you move. Your goal is to race through every level at high speed, driving like a Formula One racer, while keeping your jelly from getting bashed.

Controls are simple: you slide your finger to play. The game moves fast, so quick reactions help you avoid obstacles and protect your jelly along the way. It is a 3D challenge made for mobile play, and it suits anyone who enjoys fast-paced obstacle courses.
arrow-swipe-game: Arrow Out is a puzzle title built to put your logic, focus, and problem-solving skills to work. The board is filled with arrows, and your job is to move them off the board one by one. Each arrow has to leave in the correct order and direction, so you need to plan before you act. Every level brings a new challenge that calls for smart thinking.
Precise moves matter here, so study the layout carefully before each step. Controls are simple: use your mouse to click any button on screen.
dino-squad-adventure: Two adorable dinosaurs form a team in Dino Squad Adventure, combining their strengths to defeat a set of enemies. Throughout their journey, the pair completes missions and gathers gold along the way. One dino can slip through walls with no hesitation, while the other uses a gun to take out foes. They can only succeed by working together.

Controls are split between two players. Player 1 moves with W, A, S and D, fires the gun with F, and drops a bomb with G. Player 2 moves with the arrow keys and throws a punch with L. The game is categorized under adventure and collecting, and it supports two-player play.
nuts-color-sorting-game: Nut Sort Puzzle is a no-cost sorting game built around nuts and bolts in a range of bright colors. Each stage asks you to group pieces by hue, so your thinking stays sharp while the challenge remains pleasant. Every level offers its own color-matching task, and solving them feels satisfying from start to finish.

It works equally well as a way to unwind after a busy day or as a way to sharpen your focus. Because the game is casual and easy to pick up, it suits a wide range of moods. All you need is a mouse, since every button is clicked with it.
fortress-defense: Fortress Defense is a tower defense game where you protect your castle from waves of creatures. Across 100 levels, you face 15 different enemies while commanding 5 archers who fire back at them. After each mission you collect gold, which you can spend in the Shop to improve your archers and upgrade the castle. Three bonuses also help you fight back: freeze, poison, and lightning, each offering a different way to defeat the foes.
The game is played entirely with a mouse or touchpad, so there is nothing else to set up. The gold you earn after every mission funds your progress, so each win matters.
street-driver: Street Driver is a racing game set on a never-ending highway full of other vehicles. The riskier your driving, the more cash and points you collect. You can spend that cash on faster, better cars, so you can keep upgrading as you go.

Your goal is to keep driving for as long and as fast as you can without crashing. Pass nearby cars at high speed to earn extra points and cash, and drive against the flow of traffic for more rewards. Aim for the highest score you can reach. The game is also built for mobile play.
tennis-open-2020: Step onto the courts of the world in this tennis title. You grab a racket and work your way through the important tennis events held across the globe, aiming to serve aces along the way. The game also asks whether you can come out on top and beat every challenge you meet. Training and competing both matter, since you need to push yourself to rise through the ranks and leave your mark on the
ski-king: Carve your way down mountain slopes, weaving around trees and rocks while sliding over icy snow. Every slope is there to be explored, and the goal is to find the quickest path to the bottom. Your run is judged by the best times you can post as you finish the adventure.

Watch the flags closely, since passing one from the wrong side resets the level. Spend upgrade points to improve your skills, and remember that each skill changes how your skier handles the hill. Plan your line, avoid every obstacle, and aim for the shortest track down.
pga6-blocky-combat-swat-apocalypse-2022: Escape the undead in this shooter, where you can choose from a range of weapons and play alone or with others in multiplayer. The action takes place across several maps, and you'll battle blocky zombie bots inspired by Minecraft. Even when you're armed, you still have to defeat the zombies in every clash.

Because the game is played in first person, you need to hide behind different objects to stay protected while you shoot. Controls are simple: use WASD to walk, the mouse to aim, look around, and fire, and press Tab to open the menu.
pop-it-crabs-jigsaw: Pop It Crabs Jigsaw is a no-cost online puzzle that lets you rebuild pictures one piece at a time. The game includes six images, and each one can be tackled in any of three modes. Pick the mode you want, then launch it to begin assembling.

To finish a round, grab each piece with the mouse, drag it to the right spot, and drop it into place. As the pieces come together, the full image takes shape. Take your time, enjoy the process, and have a good time along the way.
ludo-wizard: Ludo Wizard is a multiplayer board game you can enjoy with friends. Click to roll the dice, and each roll decides how far your tokens travel around the Ludo board. Your goal is to move your tokens all the way to the center.

The game has three modes. Vs Bot lets you play against the computer offline. Online pairs you with randomly matched people. For a private game, choose the With friends mode, share a private code, and connect with each other.
dark-runner: You play as THE RUNNER, a fast racer crossing the galaxy. Keep moving and leap across a range of places, from lush forests to busy cities and plenty more. Expect a steep challenge, but the game costs nothing to play.

Dark Runner is a jumping and running arcade title with classic clicking-style fun. Its tags point to action, humor, and simple jump-based gameplay, so it suits players who enjoy quick reflexes and a bit of silliness along the way.
morph-racers: Morph Racers is a quick racing contest where raw speed won't carry you far, since you need to adapt to what lies ahead. You compete against other racers on side-by-side tracks that change as you go, moving from open roads to stretches of water, steep climbs, and tricky obstacles.

To handle each section, you can switch right away between a car, a runner, a boat, and a helicopter. Pick the form that suits the terrain and time your transformations so your speed holds steady. Special obstacles add another layer, so stay alert along the route. The first player to cross the finish line takes the win.
bullet-john-wick: This arcade action game puts a gun in your hands and challenges you to sharpen your aim while taking down as many bad guys as you can. Obstacles stand between you and your targets, so landing a clean shot takes care. Line up your aim before you pull the trigger and let each shot count.

Approach every round like a sniper and ask yourself how many enemies you can bring down with one shot. It is a single-player title with 2D and 3D styles, and you control it with the A and D keys. Stay patient, keep your focus, and make every bullet matter.
martian-driving: Take the wheel of a vehicle rolling over the wide, rocky ground of Mars. As you cross the red terrain, your goal is to crash into the alien creatures that get in your way. It is a racing title that also leans toward simulation, with 3D visuals and a mix of car and truck driving.

Use the W, A, S and D keys to steer and move your vehicle. Press the space bar to apply the brakes when you need to slow down or stop. To look around, press C to switch between camera views. The controls are simple, so you can focus on driving and tackling whatever comes at you across the planet.
coconut-volley: Set on a tropical island, this sandy volleyball match replaces the usual ball with a coconut. Armed with an umbrella, you keep the coconut bouncing until it drops onto your opponent's side of the net.

Move around and jump to hit the coconut, and make sure it never lands on your own side of the court. You can play alone against a computer-controlled rival or challenge a friend in two player mode. Controls work with the arrow keys or WAD keys, and you can also select another control method.
petits-chevaux-small-horses: Petits chevaux, also known as small horses, can be played by one to four people in this free game. If you grew up with the board game, you can now bring those little horses to your phone or tablet. It is a classic that is easy to pick up, yet it ranks among the best board games ever made.

You can face the computer or team up with friends, and keep playing for as long as you like. On your turn, roll the dice and move your pawns toward the end. The goal is to be the first to get all of your horses into the central box.
pet-subway-surfer: Pet Subway Surfers is a running game set in some of the wildest scenes of the Pet Subway Train City. With your mouse, drag to jump or slide, or drag sideways to move left or right. Steer clear of trucks, buses, and subway trains as you race along.
Your run takes you through the city, the subway, a forest, and a beach, so the scenery keeps changing. Along the way, try to gather as many coins as you can. The whole game is played with the mouse.
fishing-io: Fishing.io is an easy-to-pick-up casual game where you set out as the very first angler to reach the bottom of the ocean. Every catch you haul up, whether it's a fish or a buried treasure, adds to your score. Spend what you earn on net upgrades, which let you catch more fish, raise their value, and carry you into deeper waters.
Along the way you'll find characters trapped beneath the waves, and each one you discover helps fill your trophy room. The whole game is wrapped in a lovely, eye-catching art
crazy-3d-moto-racing: This 3D racing game puts you on an off-road motorcycle as you ride through a course packed with many obstacles. Each new stage is harder than the last, so the challenge keeps climbing. Riding well takes real skill, and one careless moment can end your run, so steady focus is essential from start to finish.

Along the way, gather the gold you find, because it lets you buy a better motorcycle for the trials ahead. The game is built to push your limits and test how far you can go on two wheels. Its operation details are listed in the instructions, so you can review them before you begin.
waterpark-slide-io: WaterPark Slide.io drops you onto a 3D water slide inside a bright, cheerful aqua park. This arcade title is part of the .io family and suits boys and girls alike. Your aim is to outpace every rival sliding alongside you, avoiding blocks and making sure you don't lose your water on the way down.

The finish line waits at the far end of the park, and whoever gets there first becomes the top io player. Along the route, you can also push other racers out of the way during the waterpark race. To steer, press and hold the left mouse button, then move side to side to guide your player down the slide.
adventure-hero-2: Adventure Hero 2 is the next chapter in the Adventure Hero series, offering a new batch of levels to work through. This platformer asks you to grab as much fruit as you can and to collect the trophies along the way. Enemies and obstacles are waiting, so you need to avoid touching them. The game puts a serious test on your skill, and it may prove tougher than you expect.
Controls are simple: press the arrow keys to move, or tap the buttons on the screen if you are playing on a touch device.
stickman-army-2: Stickman Army 2 is a war game built around stick figures. You step into an arena and take on an opposing army in a series of assaults. You can join the campaign bootcamp, where you face foe after foe. Whether you see yourself as a challenger or a contender, the crusade gives you plenty of chances to prove your nerve.

Your main goal is to shoot down the guerrilla fighters one at a time. You can also build a base with strong defenses, then strike back with a bloody campaign of attacks. Tagged as an army, fighting, gun, and jumping game, it mixes action with humor, so expect a fun and funny experience.
gtr-drift-and-stunt: Take the wheel of a GTR car in this driving simulator, set in a city you are free to roam. Explore the streets, perform stunts, and drift around town as you chase the highest score you can. Keep sliding and landing your tricks to build up your total.
Steer with the arrow keys. Press F to boost your speed and G for slow motion. Press C to switch camera views and Y to change the colour of your car.
miraculous-hidden-stars: This free online puzzle belongs to the Miraculous Ladybug and Cat Noir collection. Ladybug has put together a new hidden stars game built around Disney-style superhero artwork. Your task is to help her track down every star concealed in the scenes, which calls for sharp focus and quick eyes.

Each picture Ladybug has prepared on this site hides stars for you to find, so you need to scan every image carefully and keep a steady pace. The game is controlled with a mouse or by tapping, so you can start right away. Enjoy the search.
stickman-fighter-training: Stickman Fighter Training is a good pick if you enjoy fighting games and stick figure adventures. Your goal is to build speed and become the quickest stickman brawler around. You smash through a column of iron that never seems to run out, and the pace is quick. Your reflexes get tested as you go, and you can unleash your moves to rise up the leaderboards and aim for worldwide dominance.
Tags on the page include Action, Ben 10, Click, Clicker, Fight, Fighting, Fun, and Funny, so expect clicking and fast-paced fun with a bit of humor.
formula-car-stunt-3d-mega-ramp-2021: Take the wheel of a range of police vehicles, including sports, racing, classic and speed models, and tackle mega ramps built for daring jumps. The game runs offline and is free to play, so you can practice stunts whenever you like. Your goal is to finish every mission on twisted, winding tracks full of hurdles and ramps, with smooth steering and controls that are easy to handle.

Choose from police monster trucks, muscle cars, formula cars and sports racing cars. The ramps point in several directions, and the large environments offer many options to explore. Race against other drivers in multiplayer mode, and work through action-packed levels using the keyboard controls.
roll-run-3d-tap-to-roll: Roll Run 3D offers a fresh twist on rolling games. You tap the screen to roll a ball and run along 3D paths toward the destination, all while watching out for obstacles. The motion feels smooth, and the ball can be colored as you play.

This free puzzle title sits in the casual running and tapping category, blending rolling and adventure into one simple experience. It is a newly released game for anyone who enjoys ball games with a bit of challenge. The rolling adventure is designed to be a unique experience from start to finish.
bff-princess-back-to-school: Classes are about to start again, and a few princesses need a hand getting ready. Each of them wants the ideal outfit for her first day, but time is short and they have trouble picking what suits them best. You can browse a wide range of hairdos, clothing pieces, and accessories, then mix and match until each look feels right.

Everything works with simple clicks of the left mouse button, so there is nothing complicated to learn. Work through each princess and help her put together a school-ready style she likes. The game is a dress-up title with a princess theme.
waterpark-super-slide: Waterpark Super Slide is a 3D water slide game that sends you racing down a course full of bends and curves. The movement follows physics-based motion, and the camera shows the ride from your own point of view, so every drop and turn feels close and personal.

It's a free sports and adventure game for anyone who enjoys speed and a splash of fun on the water. Slide with the W, A, S, and D keys or the arrow keys. Keep going and enjoy the ride through each twist.
aircraft-flying-simulator: Aircraft Flying Simulator is a fun, hard-to-put-down arcade adventure built around 3D flight. You lift off in a lifelike plane and cruise over the countryside stretched out below. Your challenge is to bring the aircraft back down safely once you have enjoyed the view.

The arrow keys handle most of the work. The down arrow starts the takeoff, the up arrow lands the plane, and the left and right arrows steer you in different directions. To change speed, click the speed bar, then drag upward to speed up or downward to slow down. The speed can also be managed with an additional aid mentioned in the instructions.
forklift-real-driving-sim: In ForkLift Real Driving Sim, you control a forklift and clear a realistic city of cars that have been parked illegally. Each vehicle has to be moved to its proper lot. Work carefully, since a careless lift can cause problems. You can adjust the camera angle to get a clearer view before carrying each car across town to its drop-off zone.

The game is built in 3D and runs in the browser, with support for Android and other mobile devices. On a computer, drive with the W, A, S, and D keys. On a phone, use the buttons shown inside the game to steer and operate the forklift.
impossible-cars-punk-stunt: Impossible Cars Punk Stunt is a three-dimensional driving title where you take the wheel of one of eleven racing machines. Each car handles with refined physics, and the vehicles look flashy as they reach high speeds and launch off jumps. You can buy new cars and develop them as you go.

The game offers two ways to play. Career mode asks you to race against time across 22 racing tracks, while Free mode gives you a huge open area to show off your skills. Beyond the races, the world is open for exploring, where you can carry out many different actions. Steer with the
baby-taylor-first-aid-tips: Baby Taylor First Aid Tips is an educational simulation that teaches you how to handle burns and how to respond to heat stroke. Taylor invites you to pick up these basics as she and her friends gather for a day together. Kids are always tumbling about, so bumps are bound to happen, and it falls to you to use your first aid knowledge to help them.
tulip-back-to-home: Tulip has enjoyed a happy stretch at the factory alongside the storks, but now she is ready to head back to her own home. She is getting set for the trip with plenty of energy and eagerness. Before she leaves, she wants to fill her bag with a selection of stylish outfits to take along. Casual looks, pastel shades, and denim pieces are the styles she loves most. Your job is to help Tulip try on different outfits and gather the best of her dresses for a happily ever after journey.
Everything in the game is controlled with a left mouse click, so you can pick outfits and collect dresses with one button. Each choice you make helps Tulip pack for the road ahead.
basketball-run-shots: Fancy a few rounds on the court? This arcade title invites you to grab a ball and start dunking right away. It is simple enough for almost anyone to enjoy, no matter how much basketball experience you have. Your goal is to shoot the hoops and rise to become the next basketball star.

Controls are easy to learn. Drag the ball, then release it to take your shot. The game is called Dunk Shot Runner, and it is built around that simple shooting loop. Keep shooting and see how far your skills can take you.
funny-pixel-adventure: Funny Pixel Adventure is a 2D arcade platformer designed to keep boredom away. Its visuals are cute and colorful, and the controls are simple enough to learn quickly. The levels are demanding and hard-hitting, so there is always a fresh challenge waiting ahead.

Your journey takes you into a magical world made entirely of pixels. Press the left arrow to turn left, the right arrow to turn right, and the space bar to jump. The tricky stages are built to hold your attention, which makes this a good pick for anyone who enjoys platform games.
american-fast-police-car-driving-game-3d: Here you step into a police officer's shoes and take control of a quick patrol car on the streets of a big city. Roam wherever you like, race around at speed, smash into other traffic, launch off large ramps, climb up the sides of buildings, pull off stunts, and wreck your own car along with the others. Nothing stops you from doing whatever you feel like in this police driving simulator.

Steering and everything else is handled with the keyboard's arrow keys. The game is built for HTML5, so it runs directly in your browser, and its tags include drift, action, and adventure for anyone who enjoys car-focused fun.
mermaid-princess: Picture an underwater city where a lovely mermaid princess makes her home. This free game for girls takes you on an adventure beneath the sea and lets you experience life as a mermaid across a series of levels. Along the way you can clean up, play doctor, try on different outfits, and search for hidden objects.
Only the mouse is needed to play. The game is built with HTML5 and WebGL, and it is aimed at girls who enjoy dress-up, cleaning, and hidden object activities under the water.
tiny-planet: Tiny Planet is a casual hypercasual game with 3D visuals that run in the browser through HTML5 and WebGL. You keep rotating the planet to avoid danger, and the route changes shape as you go, so you need to watch those shifts closely and plan each move to dodge what lies ahead.
The game is played entirely with the mouse. Its skill-based challenge depends on quick reactions and steady focus, and the fun comes from staying one step ahead as the route keeps changing.
lion-hunting-3d: Lion Hunting 3D puts you in the role of a hunter in a simulation that tests your hunting skills in a lifelike setting. The game takes place in a jungle crowded with many different wild animals. Your goal is not to shoot whatever you see. You must go after the one specific animal you are told to hunt, because firing at any other creature means you fail the round.
Getting around is simple. Move with the WASD keys or the arrow keys, and hold Shift to run when you need to cover ground quickly. Aim with the mouse and shoot when your target is in sight.
gun-shooting-games-sniper-3d: Gun Shooting Games: Sniper 3D drops you onto a battlefield where accuracy is everything. Seen through your own eyes in first-person view, this fast-paced FPS keeps the action coming from start to finish. You step into the boots of an elite sniper, armed with powerful weapons and facing demanding missions. It sits in the Adventure category, with battle, shooting, sniping, and strategy themes running throughout.
Play with a mouse click or a tap. Each mission puts your precision to the test, so take aim carefully and make every shot count.
eggle-shooter-mobile: Eggle Shooter Mobile brings the familiar bubble shooter formula to your screen. It keeps all the classic features you would expect and adds a set of new power-ups. The game carries on only while the bubbles stay above the danger line.

Playing is simple. Use touch on a phone or tablet, or use your mouse on a computer. To activate a power-up, tap or click it. If you want to see what a power-up does first, press it and release your touch somewhere outside the power-up icon.
farm-animal-sort-puzzle: Farm Animal Sort Puzzle is a relaxed, easygoing casual puzzle set on a busy farm. Your job is straightforward yet hard to put down: pair each customer with the animal or vegetable they want. Place the cute farm creatures into the right slots and find satisfaction in neat, well-planned arrangement.
Control is simple. Use your mouse or tap the screen to move through the game and make each choice.
candy-match-3-jelly: Candy Match 3 Jelly is a casual puzzle game where you move candies around the board to line up three or more of the same color. Each match you create clears those sweets, bringing you closer to clearing all of the dynamic levels. Your goal is to connect the sweet candies and finish every stage.

Along the way, you will see a beautiful visual effect as your matches come together. The game fits the Bejeweled, candy, and casual puzzle styles, so anyone who enjoys swapping pieces to form matches should feel right at home.
ragdoll-heroes-war: Ragdoll Heroes War puts you into battles with floppy, rag-style fighters. Pick the character you like and jump straight into the action. Each battle rewards you with mines and diamonds, and you can use mines to produce new weapons or strengthen the ones you already have. Different characters offer their own strengths, and improving your fighter gives you an advantage in battle.

There are four ways to play: multiplayer, story, survival, and training. On a PC, use the W, A, S, and D keys or the arrow keys, together with the mouse. On mobile, rely on touch controls and the on-screen buttons to handle your fighter.
wedding-artist: Jennifer and her fiancé will hold their wedding ceremony in one month, and her to-do list is packed with planning tasks. Your job is to help her get ready for the dream wedding she has in mind. You pick one of three girls to design, then work through the preparations, which include cleaning, decorating, and dressing up.
The game is controlled with a mouse or by tapping. It runs in the browser using HTML5 and is filed under design, decoration, cleaning, and dress up, with a focus on fun for girls and kids.
goods-sorting-shopping-master-2: Goods Sorting Shopping Master 2 is a puzzle game where your job is to tidy up cluttered products. You move each item and match it with others of its kind, so everything ends up grouped neatly. The mix of quick thinking and calm, easygoing play makes it a pleasant way to pass some time.

Each round puts you in front of shelves crowded with a jumble of things like beverages, treats, and everyday household goods. Controls are simple: just click with your mouse or tap the screen to pick up and place items.
incredible-city-monster-hunk-hero-surviv: Step into a superhero adventure where a story centered on a true hero unfolds as you play. Your path leads through genuine three-dimensional surroundings, letting you roam the streets, soar into the open sky, and discover every corner of a sprawling city. Along the way you will meet wicked villains, launch into fights, and push forward on missions that test your resolve.

Battles are fought head-on as you strike your foes and bring down the criminals who threaten the streets. Each victory moves you closer to rising to legendary status and restoring the city's pride, along with that of the other monster heroes. Your hero is steered with the on-screen buttons, so every move comes down to simple presses.
offroad-vehicle-simulation: Step into this three-dimensional parking simulator, where you take the wheel of contemporary vehicles. Your task is to steer your car across the course and reach the finish line before time runs out, all while keeping it free of collisions. Small slips along the way are allowed, though you should still look after the condition of the car you are driving, since its durability matters.
Every car you unlock is stored in your garage, so you can gradually build up the models you like best. Steering is handled entirely with the arrow keys.
perfect-turn: Perfect Turn is a puzzle game built around blocks and color, and it fits the hypercasual style. You steer a sponge through the board, and each square it reaches gets painted in a different shade. It is not an easy game, so expect your early attempts to take some trial and error.

Finding a route means slipping past tricky obstacles, so every turn needs some planning. Your mission is to paint complete levels from start to finish. Movement is simple: use the WASD keys or the arrow buttons.
hyper-life: Hyper Life is a life simulation game where you follow a character from birth all the way to old age. Each decision you make along the way shapes what happens next, so the path you end up on is largely up to you. Whether your character becomes a genius or lives an ordinary existence depends on the choices you pick, and the outcome rests in your hands.

The game is played by dragging and clicking. A single session takes only a few hours, which is enough time to live through a very different life. It is a casual 3D title that works well for kids, and it suits players of any background who enjoy seeing how small choices add up over time.
drift-racer: Drift Racer is a racing game built around drifting, so you can slide through corners on five tracks made for it. You can customize your car to suit your taste and choose from 12 sports cars. The visuals are eye-catching and give the whole game a polished look.
Controls are simple. Use WASD or the arrow keys to drive, press Space for the handbrake, and tap Left Shift to boost your car. Press C to change the camera view, and Esc to return to the main menu.
flip-skater-idle: Flip Skater Idle puts you on a skateboard and asks you to ride safely, avoiding every obstacle in your path. Each stage has hurdles to get past, and you can gather stars as you go. The twist is that another player joins in, so you two work together to collect the stars and clear the course.

The game offers 50 separate levels to work through, each one a fresh challenge to roll across. Movement is simple: press A or D, or use the Left and Right arrow keys, to guide your board. Whether you enjoy puzzles or steady skateboarding action, this title gives you plenty to explore across its full set of stages.
pet-trainer-duel: Shoppers searching for a skilled pet trainer have landed here. Your job is to guide cats across the trainer platforms and help them slim down as much as possible. At the end of the platforms, a weigh-in decides how well you did. You can play solo to advance through levels, or team up with a friend in two-player mode to see who trains the better pet. The whole aim is to turn chubby cats into fitter ones.
Steer with the left and right arrow keys, or use A and D.
space-wars: Space Wars is a free browser game that mixes skill with hidden object searching. Your job is to spot the stars concealed inside each picture. Every level hides 10 stars, and there are 6 levels to work through. A countdown runs the whole time, so you need to move quickly and uncover every star before it hits zero. Each time you click in the wrong spot several times, you lose an extra 5 seconds from the clock.
Play with your mouse, or tap the screen if you are on a phone or tablet. Get ready, take a breath, and enjoy searching the skies.
wood-block-journey: Wood Block Journey blends woodblock puzzling with the grid of a sudoku board. It feels calm yet challenging, and it's easy to get hooked fast. In Endless mode, you set blocks on a 9x9 board and fill rows, columns, or squares to clear them. Keep going as long as you have room, aiming to beat your best score.
Level mode uses the same placing and clearing idea, but your goal is to finish the mission in each level. Drag shapes onto the grid, and
head-football: Head Football is a head soccer game in the sports category, with a 2D arcade style and support for mobile devices and WebGL. It stands out with strong graphics and an opponent controlled by a capable AI, so you always have a worthy rival on the field.
Move your player with A and D, or with the left and right arrow keys. Press W or the up arrow to jump, and hit Space to shoot. The controls are simple to learn.
hill-climb-moto: Hill Climb Moto is a racing game from 2020 in which you steer a motorbike and try to pick up coins along the way. You can play it with the arrow keys or by tapping the screen, so it works on both a computer and a phone. The game is a 2D title in the Moto and Motorcycle style, and it is built for quick, easy fun.

Your job is to keep your bike moving over the hills while gathering as many coins as you can. Use the arrow keys on a keyboard, or tap on a touch screen to control the bike. Each run is a fresh race, so you can try again and see how many coins you manage to collect.
water-slide-cars: This racing game puts you in charge of a car that skids across water. Step into the seat of a reckless driver, then choose between the survival and stunt game modes. The game is all about having fun behind the wheel, whichever mode you pick.
Driving is done with the WASD keys. To pause at any moment, press the Escape key, and press it again to carry on.
pixel-factory-battle-3d-io: Pixel Factory Battle 3D.IO is a shooting game built around team battles. Your goal is to help your side claim more wins than the opposing team. Each match keeps you busy, and the fun comes from working toward that shared victory.

To play, move around with the WASD keys and fire with a mouse click. Right-click lets you zoom in for a closer look at your target. On touch devices, you can control the game by tapping the screen instead.
kisan-smart-farming: Kisan Smart Farming is an Arcade farming simulation game that starts each morning with you at work in an agricultural career, which includes an insurance mobile app. You take charge of your farm and its fields, leading a group of farmer boys as you work toward your dream harvest. The game is built for both mobile phones and tablets.

It is a single-player title with 2D and 3D visuals, and it blends adventure, driving, and puzzle play into its farm setting. Its tags also include farm, so expect the game to focus on the daily work of running a farm.
black-friday-shopping-spree: Step into a Black Friday sale day in this dress-up shopping game. A young princess is eager to buy clothes on this busy day. Her wish list includes new brands of prom outfits, urban styles, and sportswear, but she can't decide which pieces fit her best. Your job is to guide her choices and enjoy the process.

Controls are simple: you only need the left mouse button, clicking to pick and try items. It's a fun pick for kids and anyone who enjoys collecting outfits and dressing up characters. Just click, compare the looks, and see which option best fits her.
brain-tricky-puzzles: Brain Tricky Puzzles looks like it asks for something easy, yet the challenge usually turns out to be sneakier than it first appears. Questions appear on screen and you need to respond fast. The clue for each one can be found inside the image itself, so keep your eyes sharp. If you feel like switching your choice, go ahead, since a different choice can lead to another outcome.
The game is a puzzle title in the casual, arcade style. To begin, just tap the screen and you are ready to go.
ice-cream-summer-fun: Ice Cream Summer Fun is a cooking and baking game aimed at kids who love making food. It comes packed with lifelike kitchen gear to try out, including an oven, a decorating bag, a spatula, bowls, plates, a cream mixer, a food processor, an induction cooker, an ice cream maker, a knife, a cutting board, a mud maker, straws, cake molds, and more.

You control everything with a mouse or by tapping the screen, so it works on both computers and touch devices. It is a bright, cheerful pick for anyone who enjoys mixing, baking, and decorating treats from start to finish.
join-and-clash-3d: Join and Clash 3D is a single-player, 3D action game with a cartoon look, and it sits in the hypercasual category. Its adventure has no set end. Your friends have been trapped by a cursed, deadly leopard, and you must rescue them before defeating the wild beast itself. The path to the leopard crosses some broken roads, so you need to move with care, and your friends must never get hurt along the way.

You can steer with the mouse, the W, A, S and D keys, or the arrow keys. The game includes more than 50 levels to work through, so there is plenty to explore as you press on toward the leopard. Take each step carefully, because one careless move could put your companions in danger.
sandy-balls: Sandy Balls is a casual puzzle game for boys that you can play online for free. Its moves are straightforward, and the design feels fresh and cool. You will face a wide variety of tasks, and the game offers hundreds of levels, so there is plenty to work through whenever you have some spare time.
