Your aim is to free up space so the ball can move, and then to finally catch it. It works as a relaxing way to wind down after a long day, and it also helps sharpen your logical thinking at the same time. You can play with a mouse or by tapping the screen.
sid-and-ginny-y2k-glam-clash: Step into the Y2K fashion scene, where two lively heroines are waiting for your styling. You can dress them in trends borrowed from the 2000s. Makeup options include lip gloss, glimmering eyeshadow, and a glossy finish on the skin. For hair, pick anything from sleek straight looks to cheeky ponytails, and add fashionable hairpins for extra flair.

Wardrobe choices include low-cut jeans, crop tops, mini skirts, and shiny fabrics, and you can mix them into bold combinations. Once the look comes together, finish it with accessories typical of those years. Everything is controlled with a mouse click or a simple tap on a touchscreen.
fashion-sewing-shop: Fashion Sewing Shop is a girls' game for young fans of stitching and outfit design. Everything happens on screen, so no real fabric or thread is needed. You cut pieces with digital scissors, stitch them together on a sewing machine, and pick shades from a color palette to decorate garments and accessories. The aim is to craft a stylish designer outfit for a doll.

The game is played with a mouse or by tapping the screen. Every cut, stitch, and color choice is made with a click or a touch. It suits anyone who enjoys dress up, decorating, and creative fashion design.
fashion-girl-spa-day: Step into the role of salon owner in Fashion Girl Spa Day. Your job is to keep every customer comfortable and relaxed during her visit. Treatments include squeezing out acne, plucking extra eyebrow hairs, shaving legs, and dyeing hair. Each guest has her own wishes, so you will need to meet a range of different needs.

Everything is controlled with a mouse click or a tap, so you can move from one service to the next with ease. Whether you prefer caring for skin, hair, or grooming, there is plenty to keep you busy. Take your time, pay attention to each customer, and make sure everyone leaves with an enjoyable spa experience.
crosswalk-chaos: Busy city streets are the setting for this game, where your task is to lead a group over lanes of fast-moving traffic. A tap or click sends one person across at a time, so every move needs thought. Good timing matters, and so does spotting safe gaps between vehicles before you commit.

As you go, more people join your group and the traffic speeds up. Collect power-ups to slow the cars and build safer crossings, and plan each step with care. Simple to pick up but tough to master, the game asks you to get everyone to the other side before the road becomes too dangerous. New lanes and power-ups appear as you progress.
zombie-massacre: The Wild West has been overrun by the undead in this shooting game. Your job is to pick up a weapon and keep the townsfolk safe from the shambling horde. Those you rescue return the favor by lending you a hand later on. Whatever happens, you must keep both the civilians and the wagon out of harm's way until reinforcements finally show up.
Weapons are central here, so you will need to learn each one and improve it as you go. To last longer, you can recruit allies and escorts
minesweeper-mania: Plan each move with care to uncover every square that hides no mine, and aim to finish as quickly as you can. This old-fashioned logic puzzle sharpens your reasoning and your reaction speed. For a bigger test, try the higher difficulty levels.

Each safe square you open shows a number telling you how many of its eight neighboring squares hold a bomb. Hit a mine and the game is over, so study the clues before you open anything. This version also lets you build your own level layouts, switch between visual themes, and ask for hints when you get stuck.
elite-ghost-sniper: You play as an elite sniper with one clear objective: take out every enemy soldier on the battlefield. This is a 3D shooting game that puts you in the role of a stealthy marksman, so every shot matters. Aim carefully, pick your targets, and clear the field one enemy at a time.

Controls are simple, since everything runs on the mouse. Move the pointer to aim your rifle and use the mouse buttons to fire. Tags like action, sniper, and shoot 'em up give a good sense of the fast, precise gunplay you can expect.
reflex-shot: Reflex Shot is a quick-moving action game where your hands act as your main weapon. You catch bullets in mid-air and send them back at enemies, and the timing has to be spot on for every catch and return to count.

As you play, you sharpen your reactions and work on precision. You must survive intense waves of attacks in a sleek, adrenaline-charged battle of speed and skill. Controls are simple: click your mouse or tap your screen to start playing.
mind-games-for-2-player: This title gathers a set of thinking and tabletop favorites that two people can play together in one shared game. The lineup includes eight classics: Chess, Tic Tac Toe, Checkers, Ludo, Connect 4, Snake and Ladders, Mancala, and a range of math games. You can play all of them for free inside the game box.
If you can't decide which one to try, press the Spin button and the game will pick one for you. Everything is controlled with the mouse, so you simply click to move pieces and make your choices.
kisan-smart-farmer: Kisan Smart Farmer is a simulation game made for players who enjoy driving tractors. Your job is to move many different kinds of cargo over to the farm, putting you in the seat of a farmer on the go. It suits anyone with an interest in tractors and the work that keeps a farm running.

Driving is handled with the keyboard, where the W, A, S and D keys control your tractor. The mouse handles every action you take in the game, so you can keep your attention on hauling cargo to your farm.
winter-aesthetic-look: Skyler and Sunny, two Rainbow High students, are stuck at home during their winter break and feel restless. To pass the time, they plan to look through a wardrobe for the winter collection and try on the best pieces. Since the cold weather calls for something warm, an outfit with an overcoat is the top choice for keeping them cozy. Your job is to pick the perfect look for the pair and enjoy the process along the way.

The game is played with the left mouse button, so every choice is made with a simple click. It's a cute, fashion-focused dress-up game with a winter theme, made for anyone who enjoys putting outfits together and seeing how they turn out.
christmas-runner: Christmas Runner is an action game with a 3D look and a festive holiday feel. You take on the role of Santa Claus, and your job is to gather the presents meant for children this Christmas.

The game is played entirely with your mouse, so there is no complicated setup to learn. Collecting the gifts is the heart of the experience, and the Christmas setting makes it a cheerful pick for the season. Its tags, 3D and Christmas, sum up the look and theme.
cookie-blast: Cookie Blast is a puzzle game built around the classic match-3 format, featuring sharp HD visuals and eye-catching effects. Your job is to swipe so that three or more matching cookies line up and disappear. The board is filled with many colorful candy pieces to work through.

As you clear matches, you move forward and open up new levels to play. Each stage gives you a fresh set of cookies to sort through, so you can keep progressing and aim for the top result. It is a casual, easy-to-learn game for anyone who enjoys matching candy and cookies in a quick puzzle session.
castle-defense: Your castle is under attack from waves of frightening foes, and it is up to you to hold the line. You can play as several different heroes, including Severidric the wizard and Gendra the princess. Your job is to stop orcs, trolls, bats, and other sinister creatures from breaking through your walls.

As you fight, gather coins and spend them on power ups such as magical staffs, fireballs, and poison. Cast your spells to destroy enemies and increase your magical powers. The fate of the kingdom rests in your hands, so draw on every spell you have to drive the evil forces away.
crowd-stack-3d: Crowd Stack 3D is a puzzle game that is free and suitable for players of every age. Your goal is to gather as many companions as you can so the whole group can pass through customs together. Along the way, grab as many diamonds as possible, since they help you unlock a variety of skins.
To begin, simply tap the screen. The game is listed under arcade and carries tags such as stacking, collecting, skill, and platform, so it blends several styles of play into one mobile experience.
word-up-challenge: Word Up Challenge is a word puzzle where you build hidden words by sliding your finger or pointer across a set of letters. It is designed to stretch your vocabulary and give your brain a workout, and it suits players of every age. You begin with simple stages and move on through hundreds of word tasks that help sharpen memory, concentration, and spelling. Each new puzzle is a small step up, so the challenge grows at a comfortable pace.

Along the way, you can explore travel-inspired scenic backgrounds and unlock new destinations to visit. The gameplay is soft and soothing, which makes it easy to unwind. Whether you have a minute to spare or want a longer, restful session, the game fits your schedule. You can enjoy it whenever and wherever you like. Controls are simple: use a mouse click or tap the screen.
ice-cream-cone-maker: Summer heat can make anyone crave something cold. In Ice Cream Cone Maker, you prepare an ice cream cone with your own hands and then get to taste it. This 2D cooking game sits in the girls and food categories, and its tags describe it as fun and educational.
Everything runs on simple taps or clicks, so there is nothing complicated to learn before you start. It is a light, playful choice for a hot day, and it suits anyone who enjoys cooking-themed games.
subway-suffer-impossible-run: Subway Train: Surf Run is an endless free running game set on busy subway tracks. You race through a city and a forest while escaping inspectors and a chasing monster. With mouse controls, you turn, jump, and slide to avoid obstacles, barriers, and trains. Each run lets you push your limits and see how far you can get.

Collect coins and buy power-ups along the way. A rocket makes you fly to gather more coins, shoes help you run faster and jump over trains, and a skateboard keeps you moving quickly and safely along the track. A gold star doubles your coins, while keys buy in-game items. You can also unlock new characters with unique skills, and enjoy bright, colorful graphics with smooth, easy controls.
modern-offroad-uphill-truck-driving: Take on the role of a truck driver hauling freight up steep mountain roads. You grip the wheel of a heavy trailer loaded with goods, aiming for a true-to-life driving experience. Your job is to carry the cargo from one place to its destination.

Along the way you will meet winding, risky hill routes, so easing off and moving slowly is the smart choice. The load includes barrels, timber pallets, gas cylinders and other freight. Control the rig with the W, A, S, D keys or the arrow keys.
car-demolition-parking-place-multiplayer: Car Demolition Parking Place Multiplayer is a racing game built around crashing and smashing. It takes its inspiration from a Demolition title and from Destruction Derby contests held in many parts of the world. Your aim is to rely on hard hits and bold moves to get ahead of the other cars.

The game supports multiplayer, so you can compete against other players. Steer with the W, A, S and D keys. On a phone or tablet, use the on-screen buttons inside the game instead. It is listed for Android and HTML5, was made with Unity3D, and its tags include cars and supercars.
the-sniper-code: The Sniper Code is a shooting game built around a sniper who has been sent out on a mission. Your goal is to complete the task laid out in the task description, which explains exactly what you need to do. Fans of sniper and shooting games will find the theme familiar, since both tags sit at the core of the experience.

Getting started is simple: click to play and the mission begins. Keep the task description in mind as you go, because each step should move you closer to finishing it. Whether you are a long-time fan of sniper games or someone looking for a new shooting challenge, this one gives you a clear objective from the first moment.
kids-movie-night: Kids Movie Night brings you six mini-games, all set inside a movie center. While you explore, you will meet a variety of things waiting for you there, and you can also choose which foods to buy. The whole experience is meant to be fun, and we hope it keeps you entertained from start to finish.

Controls are simple: use your mouse or tap to play, so you can move through each mini-game with ease. Your visit to the movie center is ready whenever you are, so pick a game and see what awaits you inside.
princess-midnight-royal-ball-adventure: This game retells the well-known Cinderella fairytale through the eyes of Ella, a lovely young girl who lives in hardship. Her stepmother and stepsisters treat her unkindly and mock her with the nickname "Cinderella." Still, Ella stays brave and keeps a hopeful outlook, even when her stepmother forbids her from attending the royal ball. Refusing to give up, she decides to go on her own.
Ella is busy cleaning the house, and she has no beautiful makeup or dress-up outfits. Your job is to help her solve these problems. Her life will change at midnight. Play with mouse clicks or taps.
masked-forces-dark-forest: Masked Forces: Dark Forest drops you back into the role of a member of an elite masked strike team, this time in a first-person shooter. Your job is to take on waves of evil skeletons that wield dark magic. The game offers several missions, a set of weapons you can unlock, skins to customize how your guns look, and armor pieces that each come with their own abilities.
To move around, use W, A, S, D or the arrow keys. Left click fires your weapon, and the number keys let you swap between arms. Hold Shift to slide and press the space bar to jump.
hard-truck: In Hard Truck, you drive a monster truck along tough tracks with one aim: becoming a pro monster truck racer. Each lap brings you a step closer to that goal, and the rugged courses are where your skills get tested. Good luck is part of the fun, so wish yourself some before you roll out.

Handling the truck comes down to two actions. Tap to accelerate, and release to brake and reverse. Learning when to ease off and when to press forward takes practice. Keep working on your rhythm until the controls feel natural, and the track will start to feel famil
run-ninja: Our ninja has a task to finish, but a band of wicked demon samurai is determined to block his path. Luckily, he cannot be harmed, so he keeps pushing forward no matter what they do. Your job is to help him complete the challenge by leaping into the air and hurling stars.

The controls are easy to pick up. Tap the left side of the screen to make the ninja jump, and tap the right side to throw a star. Those two actions are all you need to guide him through each moment of the run.
angela-design-with-me-winter-sweater: Angela Design With Me Winter Sweater invites you to step into a cozy winter wardrobe. Angela has just refreshed her closet with adorable sweaters, and now she wants to create one of her own. Your job is to help her design the best possible piece. You begin by picking the shape of the sweater, then add lovely colors and patterns to finish the look. Everything is controlled with a left mouse button click.
Give it a try and enjoy the creative fun of dressing Angela in a sweater you made together.
hidden-objects-dreamy-realm: Step into a dreamlike world where appearances can be deceiving. Your task is to locate every hidden object in each scene before the clock runs out. The game spans 16 stages, each crowded with items that need to be tidied away, so keep your eyes sharp.

The list of things to find sits along the left side of the screen. If you get stuck, a hint button can point you toward something you have missed. For closer inspection, switch on the magnifying glass to enlarge the scene, and while zoomed in you can drag the view to explore different corners. This browser-based HTML5 puzzle blends logic and problem solving with a calm, relaxing pace.
grand-hotel-mania: Step into the role of a hotel owner in Grand Hotel Mania, a hotel management game where you construct, run, and expand a hotel of your own. Your job is to build up the property into a thriving business in this tycoon-style simulator, which puts you in charge of the daily challenges that come with running a hotel business.

Keeping guests content is at the heart of the game. Watch over their comfort and satisfaction while you work to grow your establishment. Controls are simple: use a mouse click or a tap to play, so you can start managing your hotel right away.
angry-bull-attack-wild-hunt-simulator: In this wild bull city attack simulator, you control an angry bull who is trying to swallow the city, while its people and police are trying to kill him. The game centers on demolition and building destruction, a kind of fun that many players find hard to walk away from.

Destroy-style games like this are a great way to make yourself stress free, letting you release tension with no pressure at all. You steer the bull using the on-screen buttons. Work your way toward swallowing the city while staying ahead of the people and police hunting you.
sky-hero: Sky Hero puts you in control of an airplane that you steer simply by moving your mouse. As you fly across the sky, your goal is to hit other aircraft, and each hit earns you gold coins that you can collect along the way.

The game is split into different levels, so each one offers a new challenge to face. Since the only control is your mouse, it is easy to get started. It is a shooting title that blends careful aim with the feel of flying.
farmer-tractor-cargo-simulation: Farmer Tractor Cargo Simulation was the most popular tractor cargo simulator of 2017. You test your skills by driving a heavy tractor and an off-road cargo truck simulator. Your tractor carries a full load of goods and crops across muddy farmland.

Your modern transport truck has to reach each destination with its cargo intact. Your goal is to become the world's top cargo transport driver. Move with W, A, S and D, and press Enter to turn on the light.
tank-battle-3d-war-of-tanks-2k20: Tank Battle 3D: War of Tanks 2k20 puts you in the fight for a futuristic nation. Your war tank is armed with machine guns, and you play a real tank commander who must defeat enemies through force, powerful strikes, and strategic choices.
Move with the W, A, S, and D keys. Shoot by clicking the mouse. Smart decisions matter just as much as firepower, so plan your moves carefully before you charge into battle.
speed-traffic-2021: Speed Traffic 2021 is a racing game built around weaving through busy roads. Your job is to get your car across the track while dodging the vehicles around you. Along the way you can pick up cash and power-ups, which help you reach the finish line.

Steering is handled entirely with the arrow keys. Press them to move your car left, right, forward, and back as the traffic speeds past. It is a light, easy-to-learn driving game that works well for quick sessions, and it is tagged for cars, driving, and mobile play.
robot-ring-fighting-wrestling-games: Want to bring down your rival in the robot wrestling arena? This 3D fighter lets you build your own dream wrestler, equip it with destructive moves, and chase the wrestling belt championship. Aim for a knockout with the hardest robotic iron punch you can land.
Controls are simple. Press Z to punch, X to hit with your leg, and C to defend. Use the Space bar to jump and the arrow keys to move your player around the ring.
archery: Archery is a sport built around the skill of firing arrows from a bow. In this browser game, you take aim and shoot at targets placed at different distances from where you stand. Each target you hit can earn you coins, which you spend on new bows, new arrows, and upgrades for the gear you already own.

Everything is controlled with your mouse, so there are no complicated keys to learn. The game sits in the arcade and skill side of the sports category, and it rewards steady aim as you save up for better equipment. Patience and careful shooting are the keys to building up your collection.
party-io-2: Party.io 2 comes with refreshed backgrounds that give the arena a new look. Start by picking one of the playful characters on offer, then jump straight into the action. Your goal is simple: bump into other players to push them off the arena.
A kill counter sits on the left side of the screen so you can track how many you have knocked out. The last player still standing in the arena takes the win. Controls are handled with a left click.
subway-princess-runner: Subway Princess Runner blends a subway, a bus route, and a forest into one endless runner. You sprint as fast as you can, weaving past oncoming trains and buses while watching for rolling wood in the forest. Your controls let you run left or right, leap high to grab extra coins in the sky, or slide to safety. The mouse steers the prince, who must help his beloved princess escape the police.
pizza-master-chef: You start out as a new trainee working in a pizza restaurant. Every guest arrives with their own pizza order, so you need to make each one exactly the way they ask for it. Complete orders correctly to earn rewards. Watch closely for small details, and you will grow into a skilled pizza chef. Everything is controlled with the mouse.
airplane-simulator-island-travel: Airplane Simulator: Island Travel is a flight simulation where you take the controls of your own aircraft and soar over a range of beautiful islands. Three different airplanes are available, and you can unlock them by collecting coins as you play. It is a single-player title that runs in your browser, built for anyone who enjoys flying.
The game features 10 levels spread across its island journey. You can take off, land, and turn left or right using the Arrow Keys or ASWD. To tilt the aircraft's nose down or up, use the mouse wheel.
party-io: Party.io is a 3D arena game where you battle tough rivals. Your job is to bump into other players and knock them off the platform. The goal is to be the final player still standing inside the arena. Before the match begins, you pick a character from a fun lineup. Controls are simple: just use a left click.

Expect lively, chaotic rounds where every shove counts. Sharpen your timing, watch your opponents closely, and aim to outlast everyone else. It is a playful, fast-paced take on the .io format, and it's built for quick fun with friends or on your own.
robot-car-emergency-rescue-help-the-town: Team up with a group of robot cars to rescue a town in this game built for both boys and girls. Your missions include putting out a fire, searching for a missing cat, and repairing a damaged building, plus many other tasks waiting to be finished.

The adventure begins when a typhoon hits a newly opened port, leaving the city in need of help. Controls are simple: tap or click to act. It falls into the hypercasual category, so the rules are easy to pick up.
kitty-house-escapist: Kitty House Escapist puts you in the paws of a playful cat that refuses to stay indoors. You roam through detailed homes, avoiding the humans who share the space with you. Agility is your main tool, helping you leap and squeeze past the obstacles in your path. Each stage introduces new puzzles, hidden routes, and challenges to work through.

Success depends on staying quiet and moving quickly, so watch where people are and plan each move carefully. Your goal is to escape every house you explore. Controls are simple: a mouse click or a tap is all you need to play.
mafia-city-driving: Mafia City Driving is a 3D racing game built around supercars. Choose from several different super cars, then set out to complete a variety of missions across the streets of Mafia City. Tagged as a simulator and a driving title, it keeps the spotlight on fast cars and the road ahead.
Controls use the keyboard. Drive with W, A, S and D, brake with the Space bar, and press C to change the camera view. Those three inputs make up the full control set, so you can focus on the road.
need-for-supercars-speed: Many motorsport fans watch races on TV and wish they could feel the same thrill the drivers do. This 3D racing game lets you climb into the cockpit for a while, whether you imagine yourself in an IndyCar or in any other competitive race. You take on the world's fastest and most skilled drivers on smooth asphalt circuits. It is a single-player game, and drifting is one of its main features.

Use W, A, S, and D to steer and drive, with S also serving as the brake. Press B to look behind you and F to fire your nitro boost. Hold the space bar to pull the handbrake, and press Tab to open the menu.
commando-fps: Commando Attack is a classic shooter built around commando-style missions. Your main job is to eliminate every terrorist on the map while making sure you stay alive. Each level comes with its own mission briefing, so read those carefully if you want to finish the game.

Move with WASD or the arrow keys. Hold the left mouse button to fire and the right button to aim. Press Space to jump, Ctrl to crouch, and Left Shift to run. Tab pauses the action, and the C key lets you swap between third-person and first-person views.
gt-mega-ramp-car-stunt: Gt Mega Ramp car stunt puts you at a city parking stand, where your stunt car race begins. Along the way you can take in the natural scenery. Your goal is to race your car and attempt clever stunts that seem almost impossible, putting your driving to the test.

This 3D title blends racing with adventure and arcade action, and it plays as an intense stunt simulation. It suits anyone who wants to prove their driving skills behind the wheel. Everything is handled with the keyboard, so you can get into the action quickly.
truck-loader-master: Truck Loader Master puts you in charge of packing a truck with cargo blocks in a loading simulation. The scenes use two-dimensional art, and the animation gives every move a lively look. Your job is to place boxes into marked spots before the clock runs out, so quick timing and careful planning matter from the very start.

This is a tough, hardcore challenge for players who want a real test of skill, and your goal is to clear every level. It is an HTML5 game filed under puzzles and arcade, and it runs well on mobile devices. The controls are simple: tap to move, and the rest depends on how well you plan each load.
drive-buggy-3d: Drive Buggy 3D puts you behind the wheel of an off-road buggy in a 3D racing game for one player. Before you head out, you can adjust your vehicle. The engine can be tuned to match your mission goals, so a diesel setup might suit mountainous terrain. You can also change the tyres to grip better in bad weather, gain more traction on muddy ground, and improve overall performance.

Nitro is a big part of the action. Save it for tricky turns and steep uphills, since it can also take out hostile buggies. Steer with the W, A, S and D keys, and follow the in-game instructions for everything else.
air-combat: Air Combat sends you into the sky for intense battles in the air. The game centres on aerial warfare and tactical dogfights, where every manoeuvre matters. Filed under adventure, this 2D title moves you through multiple levels as you fight your way forward.

The visuals are beautiful, so every flight is a pleasure to watch. You can also apply upgrades to strengthen your aircraft as you go. Mobile support means you can take the action with you on a phone or tablet. To begin, just tap to play.
bubbles-blast: Bubbles Blast takes the classic bubble shooter into deep space, where every bubble glows in neon colors. You aim and fire at the grid, and when three or more bubbles of the same color touch, they pop and add to your score. Chaining combos brings in big points, and some pops set off chain reactions that send floating bubbles crashing down. Three power-ups can turn a tough shot around: the explosive Bomb, the row-wiping Lightning, and the color-copying Rainbow.

The game includes 40 hand-built levels that grow harder as you go. Each stage can earn up to three stars, and 18 achievements are waiting to be unlocked. A leaderboard lets you see how your best scores compare. The grid descends over time, so you need to stay quick, or the round ends in game over. Controls are simple: click or tap to play.
stormy-kicker: Stormy Kicker is a football game that asks whether you could be the world's top striker. Your goal is to lead your squad all the way to the World Cup title. Gameplay is very straightforward: tap at the right instant to strike the ball and send it into the net. Only a single touch is needed for each kick, yet getting it right is far from simple.

The fun lies in judging timing, since a single tap can decide whether your shot finds the back of the net. Every match tests how well you can read the moment and react to it. It looks easy at first glance, but staying sharp under pressure is what separates a good striker from a great one.
marinet-winter-vacation-hot-and-cold: Now that every villain has been beaten, Marinette gets a full week away from her superhero duties. The big question is where she should spend it. Pick a holiday spot for her: a ski resort where she can tackle steep runs, or a sunny beach if warmer weather sounds better. At the mountains you dress her in a fashionable ski outfit, then choose skis or a snowboard, a hat and goggles. Makeup and hairstyle matter too, since you never know who might be waiting around the corner.

If you would rather soak up some sun, head to the beach. There you can give her a stylish swimsuit, sneakers or sandals, a hat, sunglasses and an inflatable ring. Whether you go for cold or heat, the choice is entirely yours, and there is always something to keep you busy. Control her with a left mouse click or a tap on the screen.
big-wheels-monster-truck: Meet the Big Wheels Monster Truck, a powerful and well-known machine with oversized tires. Your job is to crush cars along the way and make it all the way to the finish of the track. These trucks are nearly unbeatable, so you can plow through obstacles with confidence. The game supports single-player action and works in 2D. You can steer with the WASD keys or the arrow keys, or use touch controls on a mobile device.
egg-fry: Egg Fry casts you as a chicken defending his egg farm from alien invaders who want nothing but eggs. This 2D arcade game blends action, clicking, and cooking. You need to cook eggs fast, because if one gets burnt or cracked, the run is over. Rodents and roosters are also after your eggs, so stay alert and respond quickly.

There are no levels in this game, so the goal is to keep playing and beat your highest score. Controls are simple: tap the screen to start, then tap to make your main character act. The whole experience is built around quick reflexes and a playful breakfast theme.
disk-io: Disk.io is a hypercasual game built around discs. You take part in a disc-throwing showdown, aiming each throw to break through your opponents' defenses and clear them away. Timing matters, too. If you throw a disc straight back right after it reaches you, a special throw activates.
The game is played entirely with the mouse. It is tagged as fun for both boys and girls, so it suits anyone who enjoys quick, simple action.
zombies-rush: Zombies Rush casts a lone survivor in a fast top-down survival shooter against a horde of undead that never seems to end. This 2D arcade shooter is built for smooth, fluid action, so every escape feels tense. Weave through the trees to outmaneuver the crowd. Each new wave brings zombies that are faster, smarter, and more deadly. The clean, stylized graphics and kinetic combat give a modern twist on the classic zombie survival genre.

Controls are simple. On desktop, hold the left mouse button and drag, and your character moves in the direction of the cursor from wherever they stand. You can also use WASD or the arrow keys for classic directional movement. On mobile, touch and drag across the screen to steer. It is a single-player hypercasual shooter with a survival focus.
ladybug-cooking-cupcake-cooking-games-fo: In Lesson 7, Ladybug teaches you how to bake new cupcake desserts, and each recipe brings something fresh to try. You may find that cooking quickly becomes a new favorite pastime, since every cupcake is charming and delicate. As you work, you'll use all of your senses: the treats should look appealing, the kitchen should smell wonderful while they bake, and the finished cupcakes should taste delicious and feel smooth to eat.

The whole session is designed to feel calm and enjoyable, a relaxing and fun cooking experience from start to finish. Lesson 7 combines pleasing visuals, lovely aromas, and tasty results into one cupcake-making session, with Ladybug guiding you throughout.
elevator-breaking: Elevator Breaking is an arcade game built around one simple action: a left mouse click is all it takes to break things. It is split into several levels, so you move through a series of stages as you progress. The visuals stand out, with graphics that look good for a browser game.

Expect a real challenge, since the gameplay is demanding and tests your skill. Each level pushes you to keep trying when things get tough, so patience pays off. It suits players who enjoy difficult arcade titles with a clear goal.
sky-roller: Sky Roller is a light, hooked-from-the-start hypercasual game. You tap to change your angle and switch direction, which is the core of its fresh take on play. Your skater runs, jumps, and rolls, and you can pull off stunts along the way. To play, press and hold the left mouse button, and everything is controlled with the mouse.

Tags for this title are Casual, Hypercasual, Skateboard, and Skating, so it suits anyone who enjoys quick skateboarding action. Its simple controls make it easy to pick up, and the mix of running, jumping, and rolling keeps each run feeling lively.
police-chase-thief-pursuit: Police Chase: Thief Pursuit puts you in the middle of car races, where cops chase down thieves. Each run delivers a rush of adrenaline as the hot pursuit heats up. You can play as the criminal or as the officer, and each side of the chase brings its own challenge.

As a thief, you begin as a tiny pickpocket and work your way up to an almost unstoppable criminal. On the police side, you can grow into a skilled future officer and earn the title of master thief catcher by winning pursuits. The game is handy when you are bored in a car with no internet, since you can play without a connection. Follow the on-screen instructions to learn the
domino-online: Domino is an arcade puzzle game built around careful placement. Your job is to line up the card so it reaches the endpoint, and then you decide what happens next. You can push it all the way to the end, break it halfway, or turn it upside down and start again. The game is presented in 3D and suits casual players who enjoy skill-based challenges.

As you progress, the difficulty rises gradually. The platform where you place the cards brings in more obstacles and trickier setups over time. Controls are simple: drag to play, and every move is made by dragging.
maze-survivor-platform-adventure-game: Maze Survivor is a 2D platform adventure in which you wander through twisting, maze-style stages. Your aim is to track down the hidden key and then reach home safely. Watch out for hazards such as dangerous animals, swooping birds, and lava traps. The game offers more than 30 demanding stages, so you will need good timing and careful moves to get through each one and unlock the next.

On a computer, press the left and right arrow keys to walk in either direction, and press the up arrow to jump. On a phone or tablet, touch the left or right side of the screen to move, and tap the center to leap.
bff-in-fairy-style: Two best friends are getting ready for a fairy cosplay contest. They are thrilled but a little unsure which costumes suit them best. Your job is to step in and help the princesses pick the right outfits for the event. Once they have their clothes sorted, you can attach magical wings to each girl so that they actually look like real fairies.
Everything is handled with a left mouse click. It is a cute dress-up game with a girly feel, so it suits anyone who enjoys styling characters and watching the finished look come together.
pizzaiolo: Pizzaiolo! puts you in charge of a pizzeria that has just opened for business. Customers are waiting, so you need to work fast to complete each order. Do it well and you will earn plenty of praise. This casual cooking game also includes decorating, and its relaxed pace and family-friendly feel make it a good fit for kids.
To start, just tap to play. From there, you can jump straight into making pizzas for your hungry guests.
poor-to-rich-who-is-lucky: Poor to Rich - Who is Lucky is a 3D arcade life simulation in which you race down a long runway and steer your character left and right with the mouse. Along the way, you pick up money bags to climb from poor to rich, and each bag also makes your character look more stylish. The more money you gather, the better your outfit becomes.

Watch out for furious obstacles, since hitting them can cost you a level, drain your cash, or drop you from rich back toward poor. If you stay poor for too long or miss the items that build your wealth, you may lose before reaching the finish line. Compete with yourself to get richer, and aim to reach the end of each level trail while avoiding unwanted things.
super-drive-fast-metro-train-game: In this racing title, you take the controls of a metro train and carry passengers to their destinations. The job carries real responsibility, since every trip has to be finished on time. The game uses 3D graphics and is built with HTML5, so it runs right in your browser.

Play with a left click of the mouse. Keep the train moving, watch the clock, and do your best to bring every passenger to their destination on time. The main aim stays the same throughout: get everyone where they need to be, when they need to be there.
princess-wedding-cleaning: A princess is almost ready to marry her prince, but the royal wedding cannot take place until the castle is tidy and sparkling. Three rooms have become a terrible mess: the dressing room, the wedding hall, and the banquet hall. Without your help, the princess cannot hold her celebration, so your job is to clean all three rooms and keep the big day on track.

Control is simple, since a mouse click or a tap is all you need to work through the cleaning. Each room you finish brings the castle closer to being ready for the couple. It is a bright, playful way to help a princess prepare for her wedding.
cinderella-fashion-dress-up: Cinderella has a hard time at home, where her stepmother and stepsisters treat her unkindly. She owns no lovely clothes and has no makeup for the royal ball. Your job is to get her ready so she can catch the eye of Prince Charming.

Along the way, you use a bit of magic to turn a pumpkin into a carriage and transform the mice into helpers. Pick a delicate makeup look and a stunning gown for her. Finally, add a pair of glass slippers, which are sure to draw the prince's attention. The gameplay is simple, and the controls are efficient and easy to learn, so anyone can jump right into the dressing fun.
frontline-commando-survival: Frontline Commando Survival is a classic-style shooter built around commando missions. Your main objective is to eliminate every terrorist you meet while making sure you don't get taken down. Each level has its own mission description, so read those carefully if you want to finish the game.

Move with WASD or the arrow keys, fire with the left mouse button, and aim with the right. Space makes you jump, Ctrl lets you crouch, and Left Shift makes you run. Press C to switch between third-person and first-person views, and Tab to pause. The G key is also part of the control set.
cake-art-3d: Cake Art 3D is a relaxing cake decorating game in which timing is everything. Hold down the button and the decoration starts flowing onto the cake on its own, covering it with tasty toppings, creamy frosting, and sweet little details. Let go at exactly the right moment, and your creation stays neat and lovely.

Controls are simple: a mouse click or a tap is all you need to play. Because each cake depends on when you release, the game rewards patience and a steady hand. It sits in the cooking, casual, and relaxation categories, making it a calm pick for players who enjoy decorating.
dungeon-ro: Dungeon.ro takes the shooting genre into a flat, two-dimensional world and layers in some role-playing ideas. You gain levels as you play and can spend them on upgrades, so your character gets stronger over time. Expect a mix of fast gunplay and light character growth.

Movement is handled with the W, A, S and D keys. Your mouse does double duty: it aims your weapon and fires it on click. When you need a quick burst of speed to slip out of trouble, tap the Space bar to dash.
color-genious: In this puzzle, you draw colorful lines and try to match them with the target. If you get stuck, tap the help button for tips on color fusion and other helpers. The game is a handy way to learn how colors blend together.

To play, slide your finger across the screen to draw. Each stroke you make becomes a colorful line, and your goal is to match those lines to the target. Whenever you need a nudge, the help button is there to guide you.
ice-biker: Ice Biker is a new side-view driving game where your goal is to get to the finish line on every level as quickly as possible. Along the way, you can pick up gold coins. The game includes 8 levels spread across two different locations, so there is plenty of ground to cover.

Controls are handled with the arrow buttons on the touch screen, so you can steer and ride using just your fingers. Keep your speed up and try to beat the clock as you race across the icy tracks. Good luck, and have fun!
drive-to-wreck: Take the wheel of a truck fitted with a wrecking ball and make your way past every obstacle on the course. Along the route you will meet various buildings and structures blocking your path, and you can swing the ball to smash through them and clear the road ahead.

You steer with the arrow keys or with W, A, S and D on a keyboard. On a phone or tablet, a set of on-screen buttons lets you drive the truck instead. Tagged as a racing, driving, HTML5, mobile and truck game, it runs right in your browser.
construction-set: Fans of toy bricks will feel right at home here. Small pieces snap together to form three-dimensional builds such as cars, bicycles, and houses. The shelves are stocked with sealed Lego boxes, and your job is to open each one, empty out every piece, and join them together by following the instructions.

You can pick whichever Lego set you like best, and you can share the game with friends so they can join in too. Getting started is simple, since a click is all it takes. It's a hypercasual 3D block game that mixes hands-on construction with a little learning about how parts fit together.
birdflying: In this hypercasual title, you guide a little bird across a series of land squares. Your job is to leap from one square to the next and make it back to the nest without falling. Good timing matters, because a jump that is even slightly off can send the bird tumbling. Some distances are tough to cross, and every level calls for a steady hand and quick reflexes.

The controls are simple. Press Space to switch the bird's direction, and tap the Up Arrow key to jump. The rules are easy to pick up, yet the challenge keeps you coming back, which makes this an addictive little game for a quick break whenever you have a few spare minutes.
zombie-shooter: Zombie Shooter is a shooting game where your goal is to destroy every zombie. Your bullets can score direct hits or rebound off targets to reach zombies you could not hit straight on. The faster you clear the zombies, the better you show what you can do.
The controls are simple, and you can use either one touch or the mouse. Try to take down all the zombies as fast as possible and see how quickly you can finish.
geometrical-dash: You steer a little square toward the finish, and that is the whole goal. Don't let the simple idea fool you, because the route is harder than it looks. Each stage is a pixel-perfect maze designed to put your reflexes to the test. Your main job is to keep leaping in time with the music.

Jumping happens when you tap the screen or press the space bar, so timing matters a lot. Keep your finger pressed or hold space down to jump again and again without stopping. If you are flying a rocket, you climb upward instead. Watch out for spikes, because touching one is dangerous for your square.
battle-of-aliens: Battle of Aliens is a strategy game about deploying units. Your goal is to defeat your opponent by sending alien ships into the fight. Timing matters, because choosing the right ship and launching it at the right moment is what decides the battle.

On both desktop and mobile, you deploy units by dragging cards into play. The game is listed under the action category and is tagged with alien, battle, card, clash, and timing, so it suits anyone who enjoys card-based clashes with a space theme. Good luck.
santa-s-quest: Santa took a nasty spill, and now he has wandered off course and misplaced every one of his presents. Your job is to slide road pieces around until they form a path that carries him safely to his destination. This classic puzzler turns out to be trickier than it first appears.

A large set of levels spread across three modes will keep your mind busy. Stone tiles are fixed in place and cannot be shifted, so plan each move carefully. Try to finish every stage in as few moves as you can. If you ever get stuck, a hint is there to nudge you forward.
star-battles: Star Battles is a simple, fun arcade shooter that runs in your browser. Your ship orbits in circles, and your job is to keep it clear of the enemy ships that circle alongside you. The longer you survive without crashing, the better. You can speed up or slow down to control how your ship moves through each run.

Beyond dodging, you also fight enemy ships and complete missions that take you through the galaxy. Every spaceship in the game can be unlocked and flown, so there is a whole fleet to collect. Accelerating and braking are your main tools for staying out of trouble while the battle plays out around you.
cool-goal: Cool Goal is a physical soccer game in which you play as a forward. Its main purpose is to train your shooting skills. You need to get past the defender and shoot the ball into the goal, and your skill decides whether you win the next competition.

Aiming is done by dragging, so you can focus on lining up each shot. The 3D graphics and bouncing ball give the game a lively look, which makes it a fitting pick for anyone who enjoys sports games built around shooting.
squad-tower-game: Squad Tower is a free online tower battle game that mixes math into its action, and it suits both children and grown-ups. You move around each level and take on foes in the correct order. The trick is to keep your numerical total above the value of every enemy you face during a fight.
Opening treasure chests along the way rewards you with a good number of coins. As you climb to higher levels, the number of enemies grows. Control is simple: use your mouse or tap the screen to play.
spherix: In SPHERIX, you guide a golden ball through a 3D maze across 25 different themed worlds. Each stage is a twisting labyrinth packed with foes, so you need to pick your route carefully. Gather golden coins along the way to earn bonus points, then locate the green exit to move on. As you progress, the mazes grow larger and the enemies become more dangerous, bringing fresh challenges at every level.

Steer the ball with the arrow keys or WASD. Press SPACE to jump over enemies, and press I to show the instructions. Each coin is worth 10 points, while red enemies cost you lives, so keep clear of them. Jumping helps you get past threats that block your path.
bus-parking: In this 3D adventure, you take the wheel of a bus and steer it through a course full of obstacles. Your goal is to guide the vehicle into the parking spot without hitting anything. You must get through every level to finish the game, so test how precise your driving really is with a large vehicle.
Drive using the W, A, S and D keys, and press C to switch the camera view. The game is built with Unity and runs on WebGL, so it plays right in your browser.
bff-foodie-cosplay: Best friends reunite after a short break, and they want to mark the moment with a party. Their plans include a lively spread of tasty dishes, sweet ice creams, juicy fruits, and a wide selection of food. To make the night even more fun, the girls choose to dress as charming, scrumptious treats, including crunchy cakes.
This free browser game is full of bright colors and princesses enjoying themselves, turning the gathering into a dining experience worth remembering. Everything is controlled with a left mouse click.
super-drift-3d: Head onto the track behind the wheel of a super car you pick yourself. Before each race, customize your machine to suit your taste, then take it out and see how it handles every corner. This 3D racer gives you room to make the car your own.

Do well in your races and you will earn stars. You can spend those stars to unlock other cars, so every good result gives you a reason to try something new. Steering and control are handled with the WADS keys together with the mouse.
battleships-armada: Battleships Armada brings the familiar naval board game to your browser. You start by placing your fleet on a grid, then work out where your opponent has hidden their vessels. Taking turns, you and your rival each fire three missiles per round. Pick a square, release a shot, and see whether it splashes into the sea or strikes a ship. The side that sinks every enemy ship first claims victory.

This turn-based strategy shooter is built with HTML5, so it runs straight in the browser. Its tags point to battle, board play and classic gameplay, and it rewards careful thinking as you narrow down your rival's positions. Each round asks you to weigh your three missiles carefully before committing.
grenade-master: Grenade Master is a new puzzle arcade game made for kids. It is very simple to play, yet it will really put your thinking level to the test. Your task is to drag the bomb and release it at the perfect angle, so every attempt means judging the shot before you let go.
Everything is controlled with the m
shoe-race-fun-and-run-3d-game: Shoe Race is a relaxed 3D game about matching footwear to the right moment. Each kind of shoe has its own purpose: heels belong on a glamorous stage, trainers are built for running, and boots suit mountain climbing. Wearing the wrong pair at the wrong time leads to awkward and tricky situations. The game gives children a playful way to learn how these shoe types differ, so you can see whether they pick the correct one each time.
Controls are simple, since you only need to tap or click to play.
knife-smash: Knife Smash is a shooting game where you hurl blades at targets that keep spinning. Every throw takes just one tap, so the controls are easy to learn, but getting good takes practice. Time your throws well and line up your aim, because each knife must avoid hitting other knives or obstacles along the way. Precision matters more than speed, so take your time before every release.

Your goal is to work through all the levels and become a true knife master. Along the way, you can also collect every outrageous knife in the game. The simple one-touch play is tricky to master, which makes it a satisfying test of patience and accuracy for anyone who enjoys throwing things.
hide-or-seek: Hide Or Seek is a free puzzle action game for boys, played online. You start a competition against other players inside a small maze. When you are the one searching, study the dust and footprints around your character, since these clues help you track down the others.

If you take the hider role, your goal is to stay out of the seeker's sight for as long as you can. Choose an appropriate route right away so you are not found before the specified time runs out. You can play with a mouse or by tapping the screen.
toon-infinite-runner: Toon Infinite Runner is an arcade game about cartoon runners who keep going with no set finish. Your main goal is to beat the record by running as far as you can. Along the way, you can collect money from the map, so keep an eye out for it as you run.

Controls are simple. Press the A key to steer one way and the D key to steer the other. Each attempt is a chance to push your distance further than before. The game sits in the Arcade category and carries the tags run and running, so it suits anyone who enjoys quick, endless runners.
pop-pop-jingle: Enjoy the holidays with Pop-Pop Jingle, a puzzle shooter where you pop winter gems using quick reflexes and smart strategy. It is a Match-3 game that is easy to learn and hard to put down. Over 100 festive levels give you plenty to work through.

Each time you connect three or more identical baubles, they pop away. Clear every bauble to win the level. Be careful, though, because you lose if baubles reach the bottom or the timer runs out. Finish a level faster to earn more stars, and see whether you can collect all of them.
armour-clash: Armour Clash is a real-time strategy game built around tanks. Your goal is to take down the enemy base by sending your tanks into the fight. Every tank brings its own strengths and weaknesses, so picking the right one and choosing the moment to send it in is the key to winning. To deploy a unit, drag its card onto the battlefield; this works the same way on desktop and on mobile.
Keep an eye on how the enemy is moving and adjust your choices as the battle unfolds. Timing matters just as much as the tank you pick, so think before you commit. Good luck out there.
baby-taylor-check-up-doctor-game: Baby Taylor is heading in for her routine checkup. Children keep growing, so regular medical exams help confirm they are staying healthy. At the doctor's office, you help Baby Taylor through a set of playful mini-games that cover how the body works. You can measure her height and weight, check her vision, and use fun doctor gear such as a stethoscope, along with plenty of other tools.

It is a light, friendly way to learn what happens during a visit to the doctor. Everything is controlled with a mouse click or a tap, so it works on most devices. Enjoy a fun day out with Baby Taylor.
cook-up-yummy-kitchen: Cook Up! Yummy Kitchen is a cooking game where you get to run your very own kitchen and work toward becoming a top chef. Every recipe from the cookbook is available for you to try, so you can prepare a wide variety of tasty dishes from start to finish. It is a lighthearted pick for anyone who enjoys the fun of making food.

All of the play is handled with your mouse, so you simply point and click your way through each step of the cooking process. Gather your ingredients, follow the recipe, and serve up meals in your cheerful kitchen. The game sits in the Girls category and is tagged as cooking, fun, and funny.
pool-buddy: Pool Buddy is an arcade title that suits this season well. Anyone of any age can pick it up and enjoy it. Your goal is to guide the lovable Buddy into the pool, and fifteen levels are ready to test you along the way.
You play with the mouse or by tapping. The game sits in the puzzles category and carries arcade, funny, and fun tags, and it is also tagged for Android and HTML5.
prison-twins: In this 2D arcade platformer, two brothers are locked up and must work together to break out. Their time behind bars has left them restless, and the prison is covered in puzzle buttons that need solving. Each button switches on a different platform, so you will move platforms around to find the three golden keys. Once you have all three, the brothers can escape together.

The brothers have different strengths, and you will need both. The heavier brother can break through doors, while the slimmer one can pass through narrow tunnels and snow. Control either brother with WASD or the Arrow Keys. Double jump is enabled, which helps you reach higher ledges.
overloaded-transport-bus-passagers: Overloaded Transport Bus Passagers puts you in the driver's seat with one main task: keep the bus from getting too full. Your skill determines how passengers are placed inside, so each decision counts. Before you add anyone new, consider how crowded the bus already is, because packing in too many people will overload the vehicle.

This action game is all about using your skill to manage the load. The controls are simple since you only need your mouse to play. If you enjoy a straightforward challenge that tests your abilities, this one is worth a look.
cut-rope-2d: This logic puzzle opens the first chapter of the well-known Cut the Rope series and follows Om Nom, a little monster. A mysterious package arrives, and the creature inside has just one wish: candy. The game is free to play, and players from around the world have joined in.

Your task is to guide the sweets toward him by cutting ropes, using only your mouse. Along the way you can collect gold stars, find hidden prizes, and unlock new levels. This award-winning game is built on physics.
crazy-lumberjack-cut-them-all: Crazy Lumberjack: Cut Them All puts you behind the wheel of a tractor as a lumberjack. Your job is to take down trees one at a time across a clearing, and the lineup includes everything from firs to palms. As you move through the levels, you can improve your tractor's saws, how much wood its trunk can hold, and how fast it drives. You can also go head to head with other players.

Steer with your mouse or your finger to aim the tractor and bring down trees. When you'd rather gather firewood, switch to collecting mode. Sell the wood you gather, then spend the money on upgrades to keep your tractor running better as the game goes on.
tinkerbell-jigsaw-puzzle-collection: Tinkerbell and her fairy friends gather in an open glade for a stroll and some games with butterflies, who seem to adore the fairies. Soon insects, birds and animals hurry over to the glade to join them. The finished scene is shown to you at the start, but you have to put it together from a collection of scattered parts. The number of pieces changes depending on which level you pick.
Everything is controlled with the left mouse button, so a mouse is all you need. Work through the pieces until the whole picture is complete.
rooftop-royale: Rooftop Royale puts you on a building top with a simple goal: stay on your feet while knocking your three rivals off the edge. Four players face off in every battle, so each round becomes a tense scramble for space. You can switch between several maps, dress your character in different skins, and pick from a range of weapons to outlast the others.

Getting around takes only a few inputs. Tap the screen or press W to jump, then press E whenever you want to shoot. Whether you use taps or the keyboard, the controls are easy to learn, which leaves your attention on timing your jumps and lining up your shots near the ledge.
stickman-run-shadow-adventure: Long ago, color began to drain from the world, and the light was slowly fading away. Stickmen now survive only as shadows in dark villages. A strange girl named Beauty lives in a cottage, and people say she is still breathing, which keeps the light shining. She is always sick, though, and her fragile life is what holds the dark back.

This one-player 2D game mixes fighting and running with arcade-style action, and it runs in your browser through HTML5. Press the spacebar to jump, then press it again in midair for a double jump. Use A, S, and D to unleash three different attacks: A for the first, S for the second, and D for the third.
angry-fun-zombies: Imagine loading a catapult with stones and sending them flying at a horde of undead. That is the core idea behind Angry Fun Zombies, a free arcade game built around destroying zombies. Your catapult and its stones are your weapons against every enemy you face.

Each stage is packed with objects you can knock down, and the zombie enemies are wild and ready to be hit. Everything is controlled with your mouse, so aiming and firing feel simple. Whether you enjoy zombie-themed games or quick arcade action, this title offers plenty to smash.
princess-pet-castle: The princess and her animal friends have been invited to a Christmas Eve party, but none of them are dressed for it yet. Kids are asked to step in and lend a hand. The kitty also dreams of a beautiful party look, so this girls' game centers on grooming and decorating.

Your task is to fit the kitty with cosmetic contact lenses and then apply a lipstick in the "Christmas red" shade. Once the kitty's makeover is complete, she is extremely happy. The game is played with a mouse or by tapping the
strike-hit: Strike Hit is an arcade title where your goal is to destroy every block on the screen. You take aim, then fire, and the path of your shot depends on the physics at work, so a bit of skill helps. It is a 3D game built around a ball and the obstacles it has to get past, and it has a calm, relaxing feel that suits younger players too.

Getting started is simple: just tap to play. Work out your angle, release your shot, and watch how the blocks react. Clearing every block is the challenge you are up against, and each shot is a fresh chance to finish the job.
idle-sprint-race-3d: Idle Sprint Race 3D is a 3D track racing game where pure speed matters, but staying in control matters just as much. Tap or click quickly to push your runner ahead and pull away from the other racers. Keep the pace too high for too long, though, and you pass the critical limit. Your runner loses balance, tumbles, and the race is gone.
Mouse clicks or taps are all you need to play. Speed alone will not win it, since control carries the same weight as the sprint itself.
car-stunts-sky-driver: Step into a superhero city in this car stunt racer, designed with younger players in mind. Pick a hero from the garage, where each one shows off its own dance moves, then pair them with a GT racing car from a selection made for every hero. Hit ramp jumps and wild stunts on the track, speed up, use nitro for a power boost, and collect coins along the way.

Four modes are on offer: multiplayer, challenge, training, and a toddler mode for the smallest players. A free practice round lets you warm up your engine and try out flips before the real race. Levels mix reckless stunts, city stunts, mega ramp stunts, and racing stunts on impossible tracks with vertical ramps. The game is controlled with the keyboard.
sky-racing-drff: Sky Racing Drff is a racing title that feels a bit like a parking challenge, except the action takes place on a winding overpass high in the sky. The ride has the thrill of a roller coaster, and the difficulty climbs steadily as you move forward, so each new stretch asks more of you. Steering is easy to pick up: hold the arrow keys to guide your car, and use your skills when you need them. Scattered along the course are some strong items that can help smooth out a tough run.
chopsticks: Chopsticks is a strategic finger battle game played with two hands. Each side begins with two hands, and every hand shows one raised finger. Your aim is to wipe out both of your rival's hands while holding on to at least one of your own. The rules are easy to pick up, yet there is plenty of depth to explore.
This 2D casual title sits in the hypercasual category and carries Math tags, and it can be played as a 1 Player game. You control it with mouse clicks or touch input.
princesses-dazzling-goddesses: Princesses get a glow-up and become radiant goddesses in this dress-up game. You can pick from a wide range of heavenly outfits and accessories to style them. One route leads to fierce ancient deities or charming nymphs. Another takes you into Egyptian mythology, where shimmering gold garments recall Queen Cleopatra. The game also travels east to India, offering gold-embroidered sarees and light, flowing skirts for local goddesses.

Hair can be arranged into a divine style, and you can add wings and other accessories to finish the look. Every princess can end up as a one-of-a-kind goddess of your own design. Use the left mouse button, or touch the screen on a touch device.
adjust-in-the-wall: Adjust in the Wall is an arcade game built around timing and quick reactions. Your job is to move a free block into the correct position before it reaches the wall. Only one position is correct, so no mistakes are allowed.

On a computer, press the Left Arrow or the A key to move the block left, and the Right Arrow or the D key to move it right. On mobile, touch the left or right half of the screen to shift the block in that direction. Judging when to move is the core of the challenge.
beat-em-up-street-fight-2d: This action title puts you in street brawls against a crowd of nasty opponents. Its 2D presentation keeps the spotlight on close-quarters combat, and the whole experience follows the street fighting style. It is a beat-em-up at heart, so expect plenty of punching, kicking, and blocking as you push through each scrap.

Movement is handled with the arrow keys. Press Z to punch and X to kick, while C lets you defend against hits. Space makes your fighter jump. Keep these controls in mind from the start, because they cover every move you need to face the enemies on the street.
pj-masks-kids-car-racing-3d: Pj Masks Kids Car Racing 3D is a racing game designed for young children and toddlers. Players pick one of three funny cars and take control of a Pj Masks car to race around the course. The title also carries tags for drifting, driving, and adventure, so expect sliding turns along the way.

The controls are kept deliberately simple, so even very young players can pick the game up without trouble and start playing right away. Because the steering is straightforward, the focus stays on the cars and the track. It is a cartoon-style experience built for quick, easy play for the youngest gamers.
knife-ring-io: Knife Ring IO is a quick arcade game where you steer a ring of knives that spins around you while you fight other players in an arena. Pick up knives to make your ring bigger, then aim your attacks at rivals and dodge their blades. Controls are simple: click or tap to play. The aim is to last longer than everyone else and climb to the top of the leaderboard.

Matches move fast and reward careful timing, so each move counts. Use your growing ring to press your advantage, but stay alert, because one wrong turn can cost you your spot. It is a Unity3D WebGL title that runs right in your browser, and it fits neatly into the .io Games, Action, and Arcade collections.
disk-king: Disk King drops you into a 3D frisbee tournament, where throwing discs against rival opponents is the heart of the action. You flick the disc to launch it, and you can swing it as well. When rivals get in your way, you swipe to strike at the opponent's blocks, keeping the competition moving.
Every move is played with the mouse. The title sits in the hypercasual category and is tagged as fun for both boys and girls, which makes it a relaxed pick for a casual session.
red-monster: This action game places you in a city that monsters have struck. Drawing on your superhero strength, you defend innocent bystanders from the wicked creatures. The adventure is split into several levels, and your hero can wear one of three different skins.

Move around with W, A, S and D. Press E to hurl vehicles at your foes, and tap X to launch a special attack. Left and right mouse clicks handle your standard attacks. When you want a break, press Tab to open the pause menu.
hoverboard-stunts-hill-climb: Hoverboard Stunts Hill Climb challenges you to ride a hoverboard up a steep course and see how far you can get. The track is a tough road arena where things can look impossible, but your hoverboard can make the climb possible. Your route runs along paved highways through a mountain landscape, and you must keep your balance while swerving past flying roads, beach areas, traffic lights, and other obstacles without tumbling into the water.

Along the way, you can launch off boardwalk ramps, soar past palm trees, and pull off tricks on your customized balancing scooter. Choose the hoverboard you like best and get ready for a risky ride. Use the arrow keys to speed up, brake, and make left-side ride movements, and keep climbing until you reach the end of the road.
maya-adventure: Two explorer pals return to the pyramids, this time following the Maya trail after earlier journeys through Inca and Aztec sites. The pyramids are crawling with enemies, so every room needs careful handling. To open the doors, you must gather the diamonds. Sixteen levels await, and working together with a friend makes the challenge easier to tackle.

Player one moves with W, A, S and D, strikes with F, throws grenades with G, jumps with W, and switches weapons with Q. Player two moves with the arrow keys, strikes with L, jumps with the up arrow, and switches weapons with U. Both players can walk on walls. Old-style weapons help you fight back against the foes standing in your way.
rescue-the-fish: Decorating an aquarium for your lovely fish is part of this puzzle game, and you'll work through challenging, interesting puzzles along the way. The main attraction is a one-of-a-kind pin puzzle, where you pull the pins to free the fish. If you enjoy rescue-style games about saving fish, this one will feel familiar.

Your goal is to guide the fish to safety while keeping them away from lava. At the same time, water has to flow into the fish tank. It's a 2D casual puzzle with a funny, light-hearted feel that suits kids and anyone who wants a relaxing game. To play, pull the pins.
stickman-tennis-3d: Step onto the court in this 3D tennis game, where you take charge of a stickman athlete. The title lines up a variety of demanding tennis competitions, and you take on each one solo. Every match tests how well you can meet the challenges ahead.

Move around the court with the arrow keys to chase down the ball. When you need to return a shot, press C to volley, X to slice, or Z to lob. These three buttons, combined with the directional keys, let you steer your stickman through every rally.
monster-family-jigsaw: Monster Family Jigsaw is a puzzle game built around jigsaw pieces, made with fans of the Monster Family movie in mind. Its twelve pictures are drawn from the film, so anyone who enjoys the story should feel right at home putting them together. Each one is a picture to rebuild, piece by piece.
You can play with a mouse or by tapping the screen, so it works on a computer or a phone. It is meant to be a light, fun way to pass some time, and we hope you enjoy every puzzle.
soccer-masters: Pick the squad you like best and enter a competition where only the strongest sides compete for the crown. You steer a player of your choice on the pitch. Want to go it alone? Face computer-controlled rivals solo, or team up with a friend or challenge them head to head. It's a chance to prove your football skills. Follow the in-game instructions to learn the controls before kicking off.
bubble-shooter-planets: Bubble Shooter Planets keeps the familiar feel of a traditional bubble shooter while swapping the bubbles for planets. You aim, then release your planet so it can join others of its kind. Along the way you will find a range of new items and power-ups that add variety to the game.
Power-ups help you get past the challenges that come your way. The game can be played with a touch device or a mouse, so you can pick whichever control style suits you best.
hyper-cakes: Hyper Cakes is a single-player 3D game about making cakes in a relaxed, low-pressure way. You slice cakes into the shapes you want, spread cream across them, and add textures to the surface. Once the base looks right, pile on toppings to finish your creation. The sound effects are ASMR-style, and the eye-catching visuals add to the experience.

It works well for casual players and dedicated cake fans alike. Every step relies on interactive controls, and the final move is one precise cut that completes your masterpiece. Expect a stress-free, creative experience from start to finish.
horror-baby-in-yellow-vs-granny-scary-si: Step into a tense survival horror experience where puzzles are part of the challenge. You will survey your surroundings, look for a way out, and work to get David away safely. Your main goal is to flee with him and escape.

When danger closes in, you can squeeze into the closet or slide beneath the bed to stay hidden. Be careful, though. An evil ghost keeps moving toward you without pause and tries to kill you. This is the Granny Horror Grandpa Chapter, an evil scary simulator that blends hiding, escaping, and problem solving.
reversi-mania: Reversi Mania pits you against an opponent in a battle of double-sided stones, where each piece flips over to reveal the other side. The rules are easy to pick up, but the game rewards players who plan several moves ahead. Every turn asks you to weigh what your rival might do next, which makes each match a real test of focus.

To win, you need more stones showing your color once every square on the board is filled. You flip an opponent's stone by placing one of yours beside it. Each new stone must line up with a stone you already have on the board, forming a connected line. You can also play with friends through the multiplayer mode and compete face to face.
blackpink-dress-up: Four Blackpink members, Jisoo, Jennie, Lisa and Rosé, are preparing for an upcoming concert. Each one is trying on her new costumes, and it is up to you to pick the most beautiful skirts, trousers, socks, shoes, jewelry and bags. Once you have chosen the pieces, you can dress each member in her outfit.
This is an HTML5 dress-up game filed under Girls and Fashion. To begin, tap the screen. Mix and match the items however you like until every look feels right.
ludo-legend: Ludo Legend brings the classic board game to your browser. You can play alone or invite friends to share one device, passing it along as each person takes a turn. The bright, colorful look and easy rules make it simple to pick up, and it can keep you playing for hours.

Each player moves their tokens from start to finish based on die rolls. You need a six to release a token onto the board. After every roll, you choose which token to move. The goal is to get all of your tokens into the safehouse first to win. Watch out, though, because your opponents can kick your tokens back.
penguin-deep-sea-fishing: The sun is shining over the water as Happy Penguin sets off on a fishing trip. He hopes to catch cute sea animals and fish to fill his small aquarium. The whole outing is meant to be a joyful one for him.

Penguin Deep Sea Fishing is a 2D hypercasual game, and it is played entirely with the mouse. Players guide the little penguin through his fishing trip using only mouse input, so there are no other controls to learn. It is a simple, pleasant simulator focused on gathering sea creatures for a home tank.
bullet-man-3d: Bullet Man 3D is a hypercasual shooter where you control a gunman and try to hit as many enemies as you can. Your aim matters most here, so take your time lining up each shot before you pull the trigger. Tricky obstacles stand between you and your targets, which makes every hit feel earned.

The game is played entirely with the mouse. Move the cursor to aim and click to fire. It suits players who enjoy shooting games with simple controls and a clear goal: sharpen your accuracy and clear the bad guys.
stickman-hit-3d: Stickman Hit 3D is a single-player 3D platform game with a shooting focus. You guide a stickman hero through a fantasy realm, where his mission is to protect the world from sinister forces. The adventure runs from the first moment to the very end, so you will need to stay focused the whole way.

Along the route, you can pick up bonuses and extra features. These give you more powerful weapons and extra energy, which helps you keep pushing forward. Movement is handled with the W, A, S and D keys, while the mouse controls the rest of the action.
physics-knife: Physics Knife lets you handle a blade much as you would in real life. You can grab your knife, spin it around, and throw it, with its movement governed by realistic physics. If a knife doesn't suit you, you can switch to an axe or a shuriken instead. The game describes itself as the first title with realistic physics for knife throwing.

Controls rely on the mouse or touch input. It is filed under the action category and carries arcade, physics, air, and shooting tags, which reflect its focus on throwing and on how objects behave in the game world.
at-the-end-zombies-win: Grab whatever you can find and turn it into a weapon, because the living dead are closing in. This game drops you into a ruined, post-apocalyptic world where you face huge crowds of grotesquely silly zombies. Your reflexes, your speed, and your ability to manage what you have are all tested as you fight to stay alive.

The challenge never ends. Waves of undead keep coming, each one more intense than the last, and the creatures grow stronger as you go. Your goal is simple: destroy as many zombies as you can and show that you are the true king of survival.
infinity-battlefield-ops: Step into the boots of an army commando in this first-person shooter (FPS). In special ops missions, your aim is to take down targets with a range of military firearms while you work to survive each action-packed fight. Success depends on planning a solid strategy against enemies, and the goal is to come out on
ladder-rush-build-race: Ladder Rush: Build Race is a hypercasual arcade game for one player. You gather ladder pieces as you run and use them to lay down a path. Your ladder helps you climb over walls and get past obstacles, and the goal is to reach the finish line before anyone else.

To build stairs on a phone or tablet, tap the screen. On a computer, press the left mouse button to place each step. The game is simple to pick up, so you can focus on timing your builds and keeping your pace through every race.
anime-halloween-jigsaw-puzzle: In this HTML5 puzzle, you rebuild anime-style Halloween scenes by moving every piece onto its correct spot. Eight different images are waiting to be assembled, so you can work through the whole set one picture at a time.

Choose from three grid sizes: 2x3, 3x4, or 4x6, with the larger grids giving you more pieces to place. Everything is controlled with the mouse, so you just click, hold, and move each tile into position until the picture is whole.
