kids-farm-fun: Kids can explore a farm full of adorable animals in this puzzle game. Each jigsaw shows the farm creatures caught up in cheerful scenes that are likely to make young players grin. The pictures are meant to teach as well as amuse, so children pick up something new while they play.

The aim is to put together every piece of the picture shown on screen. There are three difficulty settings, and the harder ones add more pieces to each image. Because the challenge grows this way, the game suits both children and parents, so grown-ups can join in too.
hamburger-2020: Hamburger 2020 is a hypercasual game that is easy to pick up but takes time to truly master. Your goal is to build the biggest hamburger you can. Tap at just the right moment to smash the meat down onto the bread. It is tagged as Burger, Casual, Hypercasual, and Strategy, and it is very hard to put down.

You play the whole game with your mouse. Timing is the key skill, so the simple rules hide a challenge that rewards patience and practice. Each well-timed tap moves you closer to a towering stack, so try to make your hamburger as big as possible.
frenzy-chicken-shooter-3d: Frenzy Chicken Shooter 3D puts you in the role of a hunter tracking down chickens. The game is split into several stages, and each one sets a specific shooting goal to complete. Your main tool is a pistol, so your job is to aim carefully and take down the birds needed to clear every mission.

Controls are simple. Move the mouse to turn your character, and click the left button to fire. Scrolling the mouse wheel lets you swap weapons, while the right mouse button zooms the view in or out for a closer look at your targets.
venom-adventure: Venom Adventure picks up where the legend left off, this time below the streets of a city. Your character is stuck in the underground tunnels and must clear each obstacle to find a path back to the surface. The game offers story mode, hard mode, and survival mode, so you can choose the kind of challenge you want. There are 15 levels to work through, each one building on the last.
Move with W, A, S, and D, or use the arrow keys. On a mouse, click and drag to steer, and on touch screens, swipe in the direction you want to go.
ben-10-hill-car-racing-alien-boy: This free racing game puts you in the role of Ben 10, who has to race across hilly tracks as fast as he can. Your job is to destroy the alien cars you pass along the way. Collect power-ups as you go, then shoot at enemy vehicles to take them out. It is a very enjoyable pick for anyone who likes adventure games with the Ben 10 theme.
Four characters are available to play: Four Arms, Way Big, Diamondhead, and XLR8. More characters will be added soon, so the roster should grow over time.
subaru-brz-slide: This sliding puzzle features the Subaru BRZ car. Three different car pictures are included, and each one can be split into a grid of pieces that you slide around until the picture is complete. You can pick from three modes: a 3x3 grid, a 4x4 grid, or a 5x5 grid.

Everything is controlled with your mouse, so you only need to click the pieces you want to move. The game is made with HTML5 and runs right in your browser. It is listed under Puzzles and tagged with Car and Cars for anyone who likes vehicles.
bird-simulator: Bird Simulator is an adventure game where you steer a bird whose movements follow physics. The cartoon art gives it a light, playful look, and the simulation gameplay keeps the focus on how the bird handles. Bird sounds fill the game as you explore.

To take off, hold the Space bar and the S key together. Once you are airborne, use W and S to pitch the bird up or down, and A and D to yaw it left or right. Space makes the bird flap, while Left Shift sends it rushing down. The Tab key is also part of the controls, and Escape pauses the game.
zooba-fun-differences: The Zooba spot-the-difference game is back with a new set of puzzles. Each level shows two pictures featuring Zooba characters that look almost the same at first glance, but they are not. Your task is to find the five differences hidden in every challenging scene. Built with HTML5, this funny cartoon title keeps the mood light while the search gets tricky.

Playing is simple: use your mouse or tap the screen to move through each level. Keep your eyes sharp, because the differences only show up when you examine the pictures closely. Every stage asks you to track down the same five changes, so patience will serve you well.
popverse-bubble-shooter: Popverse puts a fresh spin on the bubble shooter formula, with twenty different special bubbles to work with. Your goal is to line up shots that match colors, and when things go right, one pop can set off a string of linked reactions. Bombs, Rainbows, and Lightning bubbles can blow up a cluster in dramatic fashion. You will also meet tougher blockers such as Frozen, Stone, and Portal bubbles that make each board trickier.

There are more than 500 levels to work through, plus random puzzles for variety. A props system, daily rewards, and 3-star ratings give you extra reasons to keep coming back. To play, click and drag to aim your shooter, then release to fire the bubble.
goblin-run: Guide the cute green goblin through an endless runner and see how far it can go. Collect the bonus gold you pass along the way, and grab pieces of meat to earn extra jumps while in the air. Your task is to hop from one platform to the next, and you must avoid tumbling into the mud below.

color-vs-snake: In Color vs Snake, you steer a chain of colorful balls by sliding your finger across the screen. kill-the-buddy: Kill the Buddy is a playful arcade parody with a simple goal: drop the piano onto the Buddy's head to finish each round. Keep experimenting and enjoy the silly chaos as you go. Control is handled with a mouse click or a tap on your screen.

kids-animal-fun: Kids can enjoy a fresh set of jigsaw pictures featuring adorable animals caught in all sorts of everyday situations. As they piece each image together, they build thinking skills, hand control, patience, and focus. Best of all, there's no mess to clear away afterward.

sweet-princess-dress-up-queen-growth-pla: In this dress up game, you help a young princess look her best by choosing from a wide range of outfits. toy-cars: Toy Cars lets you drive a range of vehicles rendered in three dimensions. Before you start, pick the style of play that suits you. mega-ramp-stunt-cars: Mega Ramp Stunt Cars is an adventure-style driving game where you take the wheel and tackle tricky, dangerous tracks full of seemingly impossible stunts. Pick the vehicle you like, then gear it up so you can show off your racing skills on the massive ramps.

easter-patterns: Easter Patterns is a puzzle game with an Easter theme that tests your logic and skill. creative-cake-bakery: Creative Cake Bakery is a cooking game where you make treats by mixing different ingredients. Each mix gives your food its own flavor and color. 3d-stacky-dash-craft-run: Stacky Run combines an arcade feel with a rare three-dimensional art style, all built around parkour. You guide a stickman as it moves between platforms. blob-giant-3d: Blob Giant 3D sends you wandering along a seaside course as a blob that keeps swelling. Soak up the tiny jelly figures to get larger. skateboard-boy: Skateboard Boy is a sports game where you take on a wide range of challenges, each offering a fresh kind of experience. pop-it-fidget-now: Pop It Fidget NOW is a calm, playful title where you pop every bubble in each level. Clearing all the bubbles is how you unlock every figure. Along the way, you can touch the bubbles, change their colors, and switch up the sounds they make, which keeps things light and pleasant.

mermaid-rescue: This puzzle game is both tricky and relaxing, and it packs in plenty of amusing stages. Far below the surface, a secretive community of mermaids makes its home. driv-taxi: Behind the wheel of a taxi, your job is to pick up every passenger waiting on the road and drive each one to their destination. Nobody can be forgotten, so keep an eye out for anyone still waiting for a ride. Your goal is to get every rider where they need to go.

soccer-trainer: Soccer Trainer is a relaxed football title built around quick reflexes and fast hand movements. It is a single-player, 2D arcade game made for phones, and it challenges how quickly you react and how fast your hands can move. Every round gives you a playful take on the sport.

You steer two players at the same time, using two fingers. Your task is to move both of them through a range of obstacles. The game takes you into a new version of the football world, and you can play it freely on your mobile phone.
green-chick-jump: Green Chick Jump is a running and jumping game built around a small, energetic chicken. You control its leaps with a mouse click or a tap on a touchscreen. new-truck-parking-2020-hard-pvp-car-park: Many parking games feel alike, but this truck parking title stands apart with realistic, physics-based handling. ricochet-arena: Ricochet Arena is an arcade shooter built around tense moments, where every shot you fire matters. terrorist-attack: Shooting fans will find this title hard to put down. Hostile forces have swept into your city, and your job is to locate every attacker and take them out before the damage spreads. The action is simple to pick up, yet it keeps pulling you back.

fluttershy-fly: Fluttershy Fly is a side-scrolling arcade game in which you guide Fluttershy through the air. buggy-race-obstacle: Steer a buggy along a beach track in this racing game, where the goal is to go as far as you can. You must dodge other buggy cars and obstacles scattered along the course. 18-wheeler-impossible-stunt: Climb into the cab of a big rig in 18 Wheeler Impossible Stunt, a racing game that offers a fresh way to drive a truck. Throughout the run, you must keep your heavy vehicle steady, because even a small wobble can throw the whole journey off course.

santa-claus-winter-challenge: Santa Claus Winter Challenge is a free online puzzle game that suits players of every age. Watch out, because obstacles are scattered across the route and you must avoid them.

The game is played entirely with the mouse. It sits in the Arcade category and is tagged with Christmas, Draw, Avoid, and Fun, so expect a festive mix of sketching and dodging. It's a light, seasonal puzzle that works for anyone who enjoys a bit of winter cheer.
pole-vault-jump: Pole Vault Jump is a racing game set on a fresh track, with a different way of playing. fun-colors-coloring-book-for-kids: Fun Colors is a coloring book made for kids. It offers several groups of coloring pages to choose from, along with a free drawing mode. bubble-wipeout: Bubble Wipeout is a shooting game where your goal is to clear as many bubbles from the board as you can. Aim, line up your shot, and fire at bubbles of the same color so they burst together. Each match helps thin out the cluster, so plan every shot before you release it.

run-wall-jump-2020: Run Wall Jump 2020 is an arcade game where you leap off walls to finish each level. Jumping is the core action, so timing every bounce is what gets you through. It is a browser game tagged with jumping and running, and it runs in WebGL.

pool-buddy-2: Pool Buddy 2 is a fun arcade game that fits well with this time of year. It suits players of all ages, so everyone can join in. jake-vs-pirate-run: Jake is a young sailor on the run in this running game, where he must tackle a tough obstacle course. nail-salon-3d: Nail Salon 3D puts you in charge of a busy nail salon where you color nails and add glittery, glossy patterns. It is a girls' makeup game centered on nail art. Customers keep arriving, so you need to finish each person's nails in no time while keeping every nail in a perfect shape.

The whole game is played with a mouse, so every coloring and decorating step is handled with simple clicks. Everyone who walks in is looking for a perfect nail shape, which keeps the salon lively. It is a light, casual pick for players who enjoy coloring, decorating, and makeover games.
ben-10-difference: Ben 10 Difference is a free online spot-the-difference game. It tests how sharp your eyes are. The game has five levels, and each one shows two pictures that look almost identical. Your job is to find the differences between them. Each pair hides five or more changes, so you will need to look closely.

Playing is simple. Use your mouse or tap the screen to pick out the spots that do not match. It works well for a quick round of focused searching, and it suits players who enjoy Ben 10 and cartoon-style artwork. Give it a go and see how many differences you can catch.
traffic-mayhem: Traffic Mayhem is a driving game for anyone who likes being behind the wheel. It takes attention and skill, so you'll rely on your reflexes as you try to reach the finish line without hitting other vehicles. Clear a level and the next one opens up.

The controls are simple: tap or click to drive. Quick reactions help you weave past other cars on the way to the end of the road. Stay alert, time your moves carefully, and see how far your reflexes can carry you.
paintball-gun-pixel-3d-2022: Paintball Gun Pixel 3D 2022 is a blocky, pixel-style shooter with a 3D look. You take part in a large battle across many Minecraft-style maps, where you can pick from a range of deadly weapons. A horde of ghost bots is coming for you, and the zombies add another layer of difficulty. The game is also tagged for multiplayer play.
Move with the W, A, S, and D keys, and use the mouse to aim, look around, and shoot. Press Tab to open the menu and Space to jump. Ducking behind cover is a smart move when the fighting gets heavy.
santa-clause-ice-breaker: Santa Clause Ice Breaker is a 3D arcade game designed to run smoothly on all mobile devices. It is a one-touch role-playing title that is fun and very hard to stop playing. Your job is to guide a falling ball down the screen by pressing and holding the window. Black blocks break when you hold for as long as you can.

To release the ball, you simply let the helix stacks drop. Players smash, bump, and bounce their way across a series of rotating platforms to reach the finish line. The task is challenging, and the game is played with a mouse.
earth-dunk-physics-arcade-game: Earth Dunk is a physics-driven arcade game built with HTML5 in Construct 3. You guide a spinning Earth ball and aim to drop it through rings that keep moving. Each successful pass adds to your score, and grabbing stars along the way earns bonus rewards. The challenge is endless, so your goal is to last as long as you can.

Tapping steers the Earth ball, and careful aim is what gets it through the rings. The game features smooth physics, satisfying sound effects, and both day and night themes. It suits web portals, mobile browsers, and casual gaming platforms.
sniper-shot-3d: Sniper Shot 3D casts you as a stickman marksman whose goal is to take down targets as quickly as you can. Every second matters, so you need to act fast and hit each mark cleanly. The game is built in three dimensions and centers on gunplay, which makes it a good pick for fans of sniping, shooting, and weapon-focused titles.
Getting around is simple. Use the W, A, S, and D keys to move your character, and fire with the mouse. If you prefer, tap controls are available as another way to shoot.
day-at-school-my-teacher-games: The new school year has arrived, and the students are eager to return to their classroom and their favorite teacher. This time, though, you take the front of the room. You get to teach a class of adorable students and guide them through their day.

The game is divided into levels that let you experience the school day from both the students' side and the teacher's side. Everything is played with the mouse alone, so you can focus on the classroom from start to finish.
tilt-it-addictive-arcade-skill-game: Tilt It is an arcade skill game inspired by classic bar-balance mechanics. A ball rests on a horizontal stick, and you tilt the stick left or right to guide the ball upward toward the green goal hole at the top. Keep the ball rolling through each level, and reaching the green hole completes it. Avoid letting the ball fall into any black hole along the way.

You can play an endless, skill-based arcade mode or take on a high-score challenge. Levels feature dynamic obstacle patterns, and the speed and difficulty increase as you progress. The controls use smooth physics and stay simple and responsive. Sound can be switched on or off, and you can pause or restart at any time. The game is optimized for both mobile and desktop, and it suits players who enjoy reflex-based skill games and high-score chasing.
woodoku-online: Woodoku is a casual puzzle game where you place blocks into a box and fill it. When a horizontal or vertical line is completely filled, it is cleared from the board. The game tests your patience and carefulness, so you need to think about whether the leftover pieces can fit later and whether there is enough room for the next round of material.

There are three modes to choose from, so you can pick the one you like best. The controls are simple: slice to play. Its casual style makes it easy to start, while the planning each move requires keeps you engaged.
halloween-princess-holiday-castle: Our favorite princesses are getting their castles ready for Halloween, and you get to help. Pick new furniture and fun decorations that match the spooky theme. Fill the rooms with candles, pumpkins, cobwebs, and mysterious accessories. Don't forget the guests, who arrive in all sorts of costumes, including vampires, werewolves, ghosts, fairies, and more.

Everything is controlled with the left mouse button or by touch, so you can click or tap your way through each decorating step. It's a cozy pick for anyone who enjoys dressing up spaces and designing a seasonal look, especially for Halloween fans in the Girls category.
cool-arabian-princess-dress-up: If you enjoy fashion, princesses, and dress up games, this browser title is made for girls who love Arab and Oriental culture. Its theme covers Oriental clothing styles, the Arabic language, and Arabic dances. You can step into the world of Arab princesses and see what modern Arabic style looks like.
Only the mouse is needed to play. It suits anyone who likes dressing up characters and feels drawn to Arab and Oriental culture. The focus stays on clothing, language, and dance within that setting.
hamster-coloring-book: Hamster Coloring Book is a free online coloring game for kids that runs in all modern browsers. You pick one of the pictures and fill it in with whatever colors you like. Controls are simple: use your mouse or tap the screen to play.

Because it works on phones, tablets, and computers alike, it suits school time or a quiet afternoon at home. Kids can explore their own color choices and make each hamster picture their own. The game is aimed at children who enjoy drawing, painting, and animal themes.
bridal-boutique-salon-wedding-planner: Your big day is almost here, and this casual browser game lets you organize a complete wedding from start to finish. First, search for the most beautiful wedding dress, then refresh your look with makeup. Next, prepare a delicious wedding cake for the celebration. Finally, give a real groom makeover to your loved one. Each stage adds another layer to the day.

This hypercasual title is aimed at girls who enjoy dressing up, and it is built with HTML5 and WebGL. Every action is handled with the mouse alone, so you only need to point and click to move through each part of the planning.
hose-money-robber: In this single-player arcade game, you play a sly thief who uses a pressurized hose to pull off bold robberies. The police are closing in, so you need to stay one step ahead. The game is presented in 3D and carries action and police themes.
Clever plans and unexpected turns keep the tension up, while the story makes you think about trust, greed, and what crime really costs. Move with the W, A, S, and D keys or the arrow keys.
quack-quest: This 2D maze game is a browser experience that tests your mind, your reflexes, and your sense of direction. You guide your character through winding mazes, steer clear of dead ends, and try to reach the exit as fast as you can. The idea is easy to grasp, but each stage asks for careful problem-solving, patience, and strategic thinking.

As you advance, the mazes become more intricate and bring new challenges, obstacles, and surprises. The game is designed for players of all ages, and you control your character with mouse clicks alone. Every level builds on the last, so the route to the exit never feels quite the same.
neon-slimes: Neon Slimes is a two-player arena fighter where the goal is to knock your rival off the stage. Land a jump on your opponent's head to shrink them and leave them weaker. You can also perform a double jump to add some style to your moves. The game is played with keyboard and mouse controls.
It is filed under the 2 Player, Arena, Fight, Fighting and IO categories. Grab a friend, take turns trying out your moves, and enjoy the bouncy battles.
car-parking-game-3d-car-drive-simulator-: Park as often as you like in this 3D parking game, a follow-up to an earlier release that aims to be bigger and sharper. Rather than just passing time, you learn real parking skills while maneuvering through a range of interesting lots. Each mission asks you to drive around the lot and finish as quickly as you can. The game includes 300 challenging levels, high quality graphics, and a driving experience meant to feel realistic.

Three control styles are available: steering, arrow buttons, and tilt. Parking is kept simple to manage, and a reverse camera is included to help you see behind your car. This version is played with the keyboard.
clean-house-3d: Clean House 3D is a hypercasual cleaning game that runs in your browser using HTML5. Your task is to steer an eraser and decide which way it travels across a wall. The aim is to clean the entire surface, so every part of the wall needs to be wiped before you finish. It is a house-themed title that puts you in charge of the cleaning.

Movement comes down to controlling the direction of the eraser, so the controls stay simple. Each pass brings you closer to a fully cleaned wall, and you keep going until the whole surface is done. It suits anyone who wants to tidy up a house in a quick, low-key way.
regular-agents: Regular Agents is a 2D cartoon-style adventure in which a pair of agents push through difficulties, gather eggs, and move on from one level to the next. It is designed for two players, so you tackle the challenge together with a friend. The characters are hedgehogs and jays, and both of them appear as agents in suits.

Your goal is to reach the end of the chapter. The controls are shared between the two players: WASD and the arrow keys are used for movement, while the R and O keys are also part of the setup. The game sits in the action and adventure categories, so expect a mix of both as you progress.
daily-street-racing-3d: Daily Street Racing 3D is a merge racing game where you combine two matching cars to create a stronger, quicker model. Each merge upgrades your vehicles, so your garage gets more impressive over time. Outside of races, you can shape your collection and earn plenty of rewards.

During a race, grab helpful power-ups that boost your performance and help you pass your rivals. You can also take over their cars and add them to your own collection more quickly. Controls are simple: click or tap to start, then steer with the WASD or arrow keys. Keep merging and competing until you reign as a road champion.
football-legends-2021: Football Legends 2021 is a sports game where you pick the team you like best and enter a tournament in which only the strongest squads compete for the crown. Once you have chosen, you take direct control of your preferred player and guide them across the pitch.

You can face computer-controlled rivals on your own, or invite a friend to join you for a match, either as teammates or as opponents. For the controls and how to get going, check the game's own instructions before you start.
rope-cut-and-boom: Rope Cut and Boom is a physics-based arcade game that mixes 3D bombs, ropes, platforms and chests. Your job is to detonate a bomb so that it blows up every chest in a level. You'll achieve this by slicing the correct ropes at the right moment. Remain composed as you work through each stage until all of them are cleared.
Controls are easy to pick up: you simply drag to play. Test how your physics skills hold up as you line up each cut. Keeping a cool head helps you finish every level.
get-it-right: In this 3D arcade puzzle, your goal is to crack the code that comes from a ball. You build each guess by choosing both the color and the position of the ball, and you start with no idea what the answer is. After every placement, the game shows feedback for each spot: green means that spot is completely correct, red means it is completely wrong, and yellow means the color is right but sits in the wrong position.

Use those clues to work out the correct answer before you run out of guesses, since the number of tries is limited. This casual guessing game begins with a simple tap to play, so you can start testing your ideas right away.
paper-plane-2: Paper Plane 2 is an arcade game with a flat style and very beautiful graphics. It is available as an HTML5 game and as a mobile version, and it is ideally suited for mobile devices. The 2D setting puts you in the air as you guide a paper plane through the sky.

Controls are easy to pick up. Press and hold to make your plane fly up, then let go so it flies back down. Clicking or touching is all the game asks of you, and the simple back-and-forth motion keeps it interesting to play.
cute-panda-cooks-food: Food City has just opened its doors, and you can cook alongside the foodie Qiqi. Candy, juice, snacks, and orders are all waiting for you to prepare. To make juice, aim at the fruit on the cutting board and slice it quickly. A single cut through watermelon, apples, bananas, and oranges gives you a colorful rainbow juice that looks as good as it tastes.

Beyond juice, you can learn how to prepare other foods, so there is plenty to discover in the kitchen. Everything is controlled with taps or clicks. The title is tagged as a fun, animal-themed cooking game with a business side.
bullet-shooter: Bullet Shooter casts you as a bullet, and your job is to destroy the red enemies. It belongs to the action category and is built in 3D with WebGL, so it runs right in your browser window. Its tags also point to shooter gameplay, so fans of aiming and targeting will recognize the style.

Controls are handled with swipes. Swipe across the screen to rotate the bullet and decide where it heads next. Every turn matters, since your aim determines which red enemies you hit. The core idea stays simple: rotate, aim, and clear the reds.
shift-run: Shift Run is a 3D hypercasual runner built around a fresh idea: swipe to adjust your angle and shift your direction. You can run, jump, and roll, use skater moves, and make stunts as you go. Its concept feels new and addictive, and it is a trending pick right now.
The whole game is played with the mouse alone, so no keyboard is needed. It is built with WebGL and HTML5, so it runs directly in your browser. It is tagged as casual and c
aqua-man-sea-fight: Aqua Man Sea Fight is an action game where you play as Aqua Man, swimming through the water toward a destination. Your task is to pick up whatever items the mission calls for. Hungry fish are hunting you, so you'll need to keep moving quickly to stay ahead of them.
Move with W, A, S, and D, press F to swim, and use the mouse to look around. The game was built with Unity3D and runs in a web browser through WebGL.
moto-x3m-bike-racing: Moto X3M is an online bike racing game where you guide a motorbike through levels packed with massive, moving obstacles. You have to leap over these hazards or find a way to avoid them. While you're in the air, you can flip to shorten your final time and earn a perfect score. Knowing when to hold back is part of the challenge, because a bad move can send you crashing and respawning.

Each level asks you to finish in as little time as possible, so every second counts. The controls are simple: tap or click to play. Whether you're chasing a flawless run or just exploring the tracks, the game keeps the focus on fast, careful riding.
color-screw-3d: Color Screw 3D is a puzzle game about twisting apart mechanical objects in three dimensions. Your job is to loosen the colorful bolts and drop each one into the box that matches its color. Every box holds only three bolts, so the order you work in matters a great deal. Think ahead, because once a support piece is removed, the parts above it fall away with realistic physics, uncovering layers and secrets you could not see before.

On a computer, hold the right mouse button and drag to rotate the object, then click a bolt to unscrew it. On mobile, swipe to rotate the object a full 360 degrees and tap a bolt to unscrew it. The aim is to clear the structure and bring chaos back into neat order.
pandemic-simulator: In this clicker-style simulation, you release a disease onto the world and work to spread it across the globe. Your goal is to infect every human on the planet. Along the way, you can upgrade your disease's symptoms and its resistance, giving you more ways to push your illness forward. Strategy plays a big part as you plan your outbreak.
Beyond the entertainment, this title is designed as an educational game that can help explain how diseases travel around our world. Controls are simple: just
tangle-puzzle-3d: Tangle Puzzle 3D is a logic-based puzzle game where you untangle cables. The jumbled wires belong to many electronics, including a TV, a PC, music players, a tape recorder, a bread toaster, and a microwave. Each tangle is a fresh challenge to pick apart.

Your goal is to untangle all the cables, working like a master electrician would. The game is designed to be fun and to give your brain a workout as you go. Everything is controlled with the mouse alone, so you never need the keyboard.
ludo-online: Ludo Online is a board game you can enjoy with friends or other players. It offers three ways to play. In Vs Bot mode, you face the computer without needing an internet connection. Online mode pairs you with random people from around the world. Private mode lets you team up with friends by sharing a private code so you can connect directly.
To play, click to roll the dice, then move your tokens across the board until they reach the center. Each turn depends on your roll, so plan your moves carefully.
off-the-road-otr-open-world-driving: Off The Road is a free 3D racing game built around car stunts. Pick your favorite sports car from the garage and take on endless driving challenges. Your runs cross tracks that seem almost impossible to finish, with mega ramps to launch from and plenty of wild tricks to pull off. Nitro gives you a burst of speed on those ramp-heavy cour
halloween-running-adventure: Halloween Running Adventure is a free browser game with a spooky theme. You keep moving forward while tapping the screen to jump over hazards. Watch out for dynamite lying along the road, because touching it ends your run. Grab the star to gain an extra life. Your aim is to gather as many pumpkins as you can and reach the finish line.

The game plays with a mouse or by tapping, and it fits the Arcade category with tags like Avoid, Collecting, and Hypercasual. It also runs on Android and uses HTML5. Its mix of quick reactions and pumpkin hunting makes it a light, scary pick for a Halloween mood.
screw-out-3d-relax-unwind: Screw Out 3D is a 3D puzzle game built around taking things apart. Its main purpose is to help you relax, focus, and unwind. When you feel tense or overwhelmed, you can take a break and enjoy the simple pleasure of removing screws one at a time.

Each step begins with tapping to pick the right screwdriver. Then you rotate your finger to loosen the screw. As you go, you can watch objects dismantle smoothly, since the game uses realistic 3D physics. The result feels calm but still keeps you engaged, making it a gentle puzzle for a relaxing session.
chocolate-cookie-maker: Zoe is a young girl who loves chocolate more than anything, and her favorite treat is the chocolate cookie. Her best friend Sofia wants to bake a batch of these cookies all by herself and give them to Zoe as a surprise. Sofia has never baked before, so she has bought a recipe and is eager to begin right away.
The method is laid out clearly in the recipe, so your task is to help Sofia follow each step and bake some wonderful chocolate cookies. To play, just use your mouse or tap.
fallender-ball: Your goal is to guide the ball down through a twisting helix and win the game in this habit-forming arcade title. Along the way, you hit, push and bounce the ball to keep it moving toward the bottom. The core idea is simple, but it is easy to find yourself coming back for another try.

The game is a 3D physics experience built on WebGL, so the ball's motion follows the rules of physics as it travels down the course. Everything is controlled with the mouse, which keeps the controls easy to learn. It is filed under Arcade
car-parking-simulator-3d: Think you have what it takes for tough car parking simulators? In this game, you steer a sports car into a marked parking spot. Reversing is only needed now and then to fine-tune where your car sits. The game offers roughly fifty stages to take on. Use WASD to control the car, and collect new vehicles to add to your garage as you progress.
Pro tip: keep an eye on your angle before you commit to a spot, since a clean approach saves you from extra maneuvering.
realistic-car-stunt: Realistic Car Stunt puts you behind the wheel on giant vertical ramps, where every run prepares you for harder jumps. Buckle up and work through the formula-style racing challenges one by one. The controls feel smooth and true to life, and the pleasing sound effects add to the mood while the surprising scenes of daring car stunts keep the action coming.

Expect a fast mix of driving, drifting, and jumping as you move through the tracks. Some routes run over water, so every launch and landing matters. The game is played with the keyboard, and it suits anyone who enjoys wild stunt cars and tough formula challenges.
supercars-drift: Supercars Drift is a fresh 3D racing game built around drifting. You choose from a wide range of sports cars and take them onto the racetracks, trying to drift as much as possible. Leveling up unlocks new racing cars, and you can also try to beat your friends' high scores.
Controls are simple. Use W, A, S, and D or the arrow keys to move, and press SPACE to brake. If you love drifting, this one is a chance to put your skills to the test.
princess-coloring-by-number: Princess Coloring By Number offers lovely, cute princess pictures to color in by following the numbers on each page. It is made for kids and adults alike. Although it is aimed mainly at girls of all ages, anyone who loves princesses is welcome, whatever their age.

To play, you only need a mouse click or a tap. Each page is a chance to bring a princess picture to life, one numbered section at a time. It is a creative and educational pastime for anyone who enjoys decorating and painting.
impossible-truck-driving-simulator-3d: Impossible Truck Driving Simulator 3D is a racing game where you pilot large trucks along tracks that climb to massive heights, reaching up toward the sky. These sky-high routes are risky, so you will need real truck driving skills to get through them. Anyone who enjoys big trucks or heavy vehicles should find this simulator a good fit.

Movement is handled with the WASD keys, so W, A, S, and D steer your truck along the course. The game runs in 3D and is built with HTML5 and WebGL. Stunts are part of the challenge as you push through each impossible track.
bubble-shooter-blast-mania: Set on a sunny tropical island, Bubble Shooter Blast Mania asks you to line up your shots with a bright, colorful cannon. Fire at groups of matching bubbles and pop them until the whole board is cleared. Special boosters can help when a tricky layout gets in your way, and well-timed shots can set off big chain reactions that send bubbles tumbling. With hundreds of vivid levels to work through, the arcade action keeps coming.
Playing is simple, since a mouse click or a tap is all it takes to get started.
caramel-popcorn-maker-factory-crunchy-po: Caramel Popcorn Maker Factory lets you run your own popcorn business, from the farm to the store. You start by digging the soil, planting corn seeds, and watering them regularly until the crops are ready. Then you carry the harvested corn into the factory, where you add the grains to the popcorn machine and pop them into snacks.

Once the popcorn is made, it moves along a conveyor belt so you can add flavors such as salty, cheese, or crispy caramel. Seal each batch into containers and supply supermarkets to earn cash. This 3D game also offers a two-player mode, and everything is controlled with the mouse.
stunt-car-impossible-track-challenge: Hop behind the wheel and drive along sky-high roads packed with stunts. The course is made of ramps that look almost impossible, and its zigzag tracks twist across the air, so every turn takes care. You can jump, pull off mid-air flips, and drift through the bends. This 3D racer takes you to massive heights, where the endless tracks keep going and the sky is the only limit.

Race against rival drivers on beautifully designed routes and try to beat them. Each level is thrilling and challenging, so the action stays fresh from start to finish. Everything is controlled from the keyboard, which lets you focus on the road. If you love stunt cars and want to test your driving skills on tough, unusual tracks, this game offers a lot to try.
jewel-pop: Jewel Pop invites you to pop a rainbow of balloons. Your job is to smash through blocks and other obstacles that stand in your way. This turn-based take on the match-3 style keeps things traditional while offering plenty of tricky stages to work through.
To play, aim your move, swap neighbouring balloons, and link three or more of the same col
voxel-crusher: Voxel Crusher is an arcade game about breaking apart blocky, pixelated worlds in whatever way you like. Your arsenal includes laser guns, giant gears, energy bombs, and other explosive weapons, all aimed at colorful pixel blocks that you can smash, crush, or demolish. Every level has its own voxel structures, towers, and creatures, and the wreckage responds with physics
snow-patrol: Snow Patrol is a 3D arcade title built with WebGL, and it leans on skill and fun. Your goal is to gather as many balls as you can and nudge them into the hole. When you have collected enough, you advance to the next session. Keep moving from one session to the next until you reach the end of the level.
The whole game runs on mouse input alone, so a mouse is all you need to get started. Keep in mind that you must gather enough balls in each session before you can continue.
roof-rails-online: Picture running along a rooftop while balancing on a long wooden pole. That daring sport is the core of Roof Rails Online, a 3D arcade game with a parkour theme. Each block you gather from the platform makes your pole longer, which helps you stay upright. Snow covers the surfaces, so you need to keep your body steady and avoid stepping off the edge of the roof.

Gems are scattered along the way too, and you can collect a good number of them. How many you end up with depends on how much you have built up by the time you near the end. The game is controlled with a simple drag to play.
samurai-flash: Samurai Flash mixes parkour movement with combat. You guide an adorable samurai who keeps charging forward, defeating every enemy that crosses his path. The game encourages you to stay ruthless as you go, so be ready to fight at every turn.

Along the way, you can upgrade your weapons and build up your character's strength. Powerful skills give you extra help when you need it, and completing tasks becomes easier as you progress. Movement works by sliding your finger across the screen to steer the samurai through the course.
neon-race-retro-drift: Pick your glowing neon car and tear around a never-ending track at breakneck pace. Skidding, sliding, and spinning are all part of the fun as you collect power-ups along the way. Your goal is to find the perfect retro racing line, dodge rival cars and traffic cones, and push toward victory in this top-down retro racer that gets your pulse racing.

Steering is handled entirely with the arrow keys, so you can concentrate on taking each corner just right. The challenge is to see how fast you can go without losing control, and every run is a chance to beat your last one.
corona-virus-io: In this multiplayer game, you take on the role of a Saviour Virus, deliberately put into a patient infected with Covid-19. Your job is to fight the Corona Viruses and wipe them out. The aim is to grow the biggest nose of any virus in the game. Each time your nose touches and kills a Corona Virus, it bursts and you earn an extra point.

Be careful, though, because if another virus runs into you, you are beaten and the game ends. You steer by moving your mouse wherever you want to go: left, right, up, or down. Press the Space bar to dash and speed up.
truck-amazing-parking-impossible-parking: This street racer is the first mobile edition in the Need for Speed series, and it drops you into the underground scene. Choose from real-world models by brands such as Bugatti, Lamborghini, McLaren, Pagani, Koenigsegg, and Hennessey, then customize them at the Mod Shop and Black Market. The combinations reach over 2.5 million, and you control everything with the keyboard.

Head into the streets of Blackridge, where you can leap jumps, dodge debris and traffic, scrape walls, and fire up Nitro Zones for a rush of speed. Challenge rival crews, stay ahead of the police, and drift your way to the finish across more than 1,000 races. Winning builds your reputation and opens up more races, cars, and customizations. Purchases inside the app are optional and can be turned off in your device settings.
nail-salon-for-animals: Many girls enjoy changing their look over time. Some prefer experimenting with makeup, while others love spending an afternoon at hair salons or beauty parlors. This game invites you to dream a little and step into a nail salon, but with a twist: the clients are animals.

It is part of a series of educational games made for young children, and it can be played with a mouse or by tapping the screen. Inside, you can pick colors, add decorations and create your own nail designs for each furry customer.
circle-ninja-2019: In this arcade game, you guide a ninja who is trying to free his girlfriend from a group of wicked ninjas. You must defeat every evil ninja, because the key that opens her cage is only found once they are all gone. Jumping is the main action. Tap the screen, then drag in the direction you want him to leap.
The game is played entirely with the mouse, so each tap and drag is how you move him through the stage. Take the foes down one at a time, collect the key, and use it on the cage to save the girl.
ladybug-differences: Ladybug Differences invites you to study a set of pictures featuring Ladybug and spot what has changed between them. Each image hides a handful of small differences, and your job is to track them all down. The game counts ten levels, and every level includes seven differences to locate within a time limit of one minute. Because it asks you to look closely and stay focused, it doubles as a helpful exercise for sharpening your observation and concentration.

Playing is simple: click the mouse or tap the screen to point out each difference you see. The game works on both desktop computers and mobile devices, so you can pick it up wherever you like. Take your time, look carefully, and enjoy the cheerful designs as you work through each puzzle.
zombie-hunter-lemmy: Zombies have invaded our planet, and the world is now in serious danger. Your job is to help Lemmy, the hero at the center of the fight. This single-player 2D shooting game mixes action and adventure with a funny tone, and it gives you guns and other weapons to fight off the undead.

To begin, press the PLAY button and the game starts. The controls are simple: use a left click with a mouse, or tap the screen if you are playing on a mobile device. Stay focused and keep Lemmy alive as the zombies close in.
sweet-crush-match-3: Swap neighboring jelly pieces so that three or more of the same color line up, and those jellies disappear to clear the level. Each stage has its own goal you need to reach before moving on. As you advance, you earn free game boosters and unlock new features. The game includes many levels, bright and charming artwork, and power-ups that can help you out when a board gets tricky. Everything is controlled with your mouse.

This puzzler sits in the Puzzles category and carries tags for 2D, Arcade, Puzzle, and WebGL. It runs right in your browser, so there is nothing to install before you start matching colors and climbing through the levels.
sea-animal-transport: Sea Animal Transport is a truck game with several levels to work through. Your main goal is to transport sea animals to their destination, so each stage gives you a fresh chance to get your cargo where it belongs.

Driving is handled with the W, A, S and D keys. Press C whenever you want to switch the camera view and see the road from a different angle. It is a 3D game you play right in your web browser, and it suits anyone who enjoys trucking challenges.
star-art: Creative work can do more than inspire us; it can also be deeply calming. The game is meant to be enjoyed again and again, with a relaxing rhythm that never gets old. Controls are kept simple: use your mouse or tap the screen to play. Whether you want a brief moment of peace or a longer session to unwind, Star Art gives you a calm, thoughtful puzzle experience.
alice-crazy-adventure: Alice Crazy Adventure follows a young explorer named Alice who is trying to get back home. Along the way she runs into a series of obstacles and wild zombies that stand between her and her destination. Your job is to guide her safely to the end of her journey and keep her moving forward.

Controls are simple: use the arrow keys to move Alice around, or tap the on-screen buttons if you are playing on a touch device. It is a cute, light-hearted escape game aimed at kids and anyone who enjoys a bit of playful adventure.
harlequin-is-preparing-an-april-fools-ra: Princess Harlequin is a big fan of pranks and jokes, and April 1st is her favorite day of laughter. Dress her up for the April Fools party and enjoy the fun with your friends.
greedy-rabbit-platformer: Greedy Rabbit Platformer is an arcade game where you guide a rabbit through a series of stages. gun-mayhem-io: Gun Mayhem.IO brings the original Gun Mayhem game into a 3D shooting arena that runs right in your browser. Your main objective is to remain on the island and avoid being thrown off. pixel-art-stealer: Pixel Art Stealer mixes numbers, tiny squares, and images into a calm way to fill in pictures by matching colors to numbers. vehicle-wars-multiplayer-2020: Vehicle warfare takes center stage in this shooter, where you can build a custom character, choose from many weapons, and change the camouflage on your look. fun-snake: Fun Snake takes the spirit of the classic snake game and gives it a bright, modern look. princess-candy-makeup: Dress up a princess in this sugary styling game. This time the twist is sweets of every kind, including candies, ice cream, cakes, chocolate, and lollipops. Those treats can be used as accessories for outfits, hairdos, makeup looks, and jewelry.

mexican-master-chef: Mexican Master Chef is a browser cooking game for fans of street food. one-touch-drawing: One Touch Drawing is a puzzle game with glowing light and shadow visuals and a science and technology feel. baby-happy-cleaning-game: A doll has become very grimy, and your job is to scrub it back to sparkling condition. Once that task is finished, you move on to the next mess waiting for you.

Plenty of other messes need your attention too. Smelly clothes, a grimy dirt bike, and cluttered kitchens all need a thorough clean. You can play with a mouse or by tapping the screen, and you take on the role of a cheerful cleaning hero who rescues the day from dirt.
gaint-run-color-switch: Step into this mobile arcade challenge, where you guide a character through a series of obstacles. Success depends on matching your character's color to the color of each obstacle you meet. The bright, eye-catching visuals make the experience engaging, and the challenge puts your reflexes and problem-solving skills to a real test.

Although the idea sounds simple, it proves harder than it looks. Controls are straightforward: hold the left mouse button, then drag left or right to steer your character. Its addictive pull makes it easy to keep trying one more time.
us-commando: US Commando puts you into a military shooter built around special commando assaults in battle war missions. If you enjoy army battle games and world war themes, this one is made for you. Movement uses WASD or the arrow keys. A left mouse click fires your weapon, and a right mouse click lets you aim. As a member of an elite commando group, you take on war missions where quick reactions and steady aim make all the difference.
halloween-zombie-jigsaw: Halloween Zombie Jigsaw is a free online puzzle game where you rebuild a picture by fitting its pieces together. The goal is to arrange all 64 pieces in the right order. You move each piece by clicking and dragging it with the mouse, then dropping it into its spot. It is a relaxed way to pass some spare time with a spooky theme.

Each puzzle asks for careful placement, so take your time and check where each piece belongs. The game runs in your browser and suits a quiet break whenever you feel like a little brain work with a Halloween twist.
power-boat-racing-3d: Power Boat Racing 3D blends daredevil stunts with a solid dose of challenge. You take the seat of a water motorbike and steer it around circles laid out across its levels. Your boat handling is what unlocks new levels, so every run counts. Stay inside the circle the whole way, because leaving it before you finish marks that level as incomplete.

The game aims to capture the feel of a real water motorbike race, with ramp-filled courses that test your control at every turn. Steering uses WASD or the arrow keys. It is listed under racing, with adventure and boat themes as well.
streets-of-anarchy-fists-of-war: Crime is running wild in the streets, and it is your duty as a hero to push it back. Your job is to clean up the city and stop the villains causing trouble on every corner. This 3D arcade street fighting title is built with Unity3D and WebGL.
Controls are simple. Use the arrow keys to move, press the spacebar to jump, and use Z or X to attack your foes. When a hit is coming, press C to defend yourself. Good luck, crime fighter.
fashion-doll-dream-house-decorating: Making a home reflect who you are is a big part of the fun in this game. You can shape each room to suit your own taste and style. Since only you decide how the house looks, every result is uniquely yours.

snow-driving-car-racer-track-simulator: Hit the snowy streets and ice tracks in this fast-paced city racer, which leans on realistic physics for its drift racing. Drifting is the main focus, so you can show off your skills behind the wheel of a speedy car while you race through the snow. Plenty of tough street races are on offer, and the frosty track layouts keep the drifting going from start to finish.

The game puts you in control of a car on icy roads, where every corner is a chance to slide. Steer with the keyboard arrow keys to handle the car as you tear through the city and across the ice. Expect fine animation and convincing handling as you chase each run.
halloween-coloring-book: Halloween Coloring Book is a free puzzle game with a Halloween theme, and it suits players of all ages. soccer-physics-online: Soccer Physics Online lets you take on another player over the internet or challenge a friend in two-player mode. helix-spiral-jump-3d-2021: Helix Spiral Jump 3D 2021 is an arcade game about a bouncing ball dropping down a twisting tower. balls-and-bricks: Balls and Bricks is a relaxing puzzle title for anyone who wants straightforward entertainment with nothing extra added. You line up each shot, then sit back as the blocks crumble. The one real catch is that your aim has to be sharp, so precision decides how things turn out.

The objective is to wipe every block off the screen, using whatever approach works best. If even one block sinks all the way to the bottom, the round is lost. For anyone who enjoys testing their accuracy and having a good time doing it, this game delivers exactly that.
dodge: Dodge offers a different kind of ball game for anyone who wants to try something new. You need to keep your full attention on the screen, since the ball can suddenly strike the gears of an incoming wheel, and that ends your run. Controls are simple: use a left click or a touch to play.

bouncy-rush: Bouncy Rush is an endless platform game, so there is no final stage to reach. Spinning wheels appear along the way, and hitting one can hurt your character badly, so stay alert. Your job is to guard the platform from danger, because you need to protect it to complete it.

Collect gold as you go and unlock new talented characters to play as. The controls are simple: a left click or a touch is all you need, so it works with a mouse or on a phone. The fun doubles the longer you keep going.
offroad-mania: Offroad Mania is a physics-driven racing game built around rough, off-road driving. If you enjoy challenging trails and 4x4 machines, this one was made with you in mind. amusement-park-tycoon-game: Step into a park management and simulation title where you run your own amusement empire from the start. The game suits fans of tycoon titles, business simulators, and park-building challenges, rewarding both imagination and strategy. Every button is operated with your mouse, so you simply point and click to make your choices.
fruit-drop: Fruit Drop is a puzzle game about combining fruit inside a jar. You release cute, kawaii-style fruits one at a time, and when two matching fruits touch, they fuse into a bigger one and push your score higher. Realistic physics make each fruit tumble and settle naturally.

dead-fight: Two squads, one in blue and one in red, clash inside a strange arena. Your aim is to shatter the energy stone guarded by the other side or to take out every fighter on their team. christmas-defense-for-gifts: Christmas Defense For Gifts is a shooting game where you fire arrows to stop zombies before they reach your castle. Each stage gives you three lives. trace-learn: Trace Learn is a puzzle game where young players practice letters, numbers, and words by tracing them. ball-jointed-doll-creator-makeover-game: Build a one-of-a-kind ball-jointed doll from scratch. Pick any look that appeals to you, then dress up your character as you see fit. Strike a pose you like, then finish her style with a hairstyle, an expression, and eye color of your choice. Top it all off with accessories that suit her outfit.

table-tug-online: In Table Tug Online, you pull on the table to drag your opponent across the finish line. You can compete with a friend on the same device in local two player mode. If you'd rather test yourself against strangers, you can also challenge players from all over the world online.

snake-to-eat: Snake to Eat is a classic arcade-style game in which you steer a hungry snake. Food items are scattered around the map, and each one you eat makes your snake longer. car-runner: Car Runner is an online racing game where your aim is simple: drive as far as you can before crashing. Every attempt gives you a chance to climb higher on the scoreboard. The game's mode is called Street Racing: Car Runner, and it is where you keep racing to build a high score.

easy-coloring-valentine: Easy Coloring Valentine is a free coloring game for kids, with a love and Valentine's Day coloring book full of pages to choose from. Filling them in is a calm way to unwind.

halloween-differences: Celebrate the Halloween season with this spot-the-difference puzzle. Small changes are hidden within the pictures, and your job is to track them down. The designs are playful and themed for the holiday, so searching through them stays enjoyable from start to finish.

breakfast-prepare-online: Breakfast in this 3D arcade title is all about deciding what ends up on your plate. traffic-io: In Traffic.io, your job is to stop vehicles from crashing into each other. Tapping a car brings it to a halt, and tapping it again gets it rolling once more. city-parking: City Parking is a 2D parking game built around clever, tricky levels, and it looks nice too. You steer your car with the WASD keys or the arrow keys, lining it up carefully to park in the right spot. It is a racing title, and it works well on mobile devices as well as on a computer.

glam-doll-salon: Glam Doll Salon - Chic Fashion puts fashion, glamour, makeup, and models front and center. blade-thrower-master: Blade Thrower Master puts you in charge of a nimble, dangerous fighter who prefers to attack from afar. gun-simulator: Gun Simulator Shooting Range puts you on a firing range where you can handle semi-automatic and modern firearms in a realistic setting. amgel-easter-room-escape-2: Trapped inside a room decorated for Easter, you need to look closely at your surroundings, gather useful items, and solve the puzzles standing between you and freedom. hill-climb-driving: Hill Climb Driving is a driving game that mixes adventure with a bit of addictive fun. It won't be a walk in the park, since plenty of hazards stand in your path and you need to steer around every one of them.
Control is simple: the arrow keys handle all the driving. Use them to move your vehicle, keep an eye on the timer, and keep your passengers on schedule.
donuts-cooking-challenge: Donuts Cooking Challenge invites you to learn how to make tasty doughnuts. You start by taking out flour and milk, then prepare a chocolate sauce and a cream. cute-zoo: Step into the zoo, where tigers, elephants, penguins and many other adorable animals are waiting.
