motorbike-racer: Motorbike Racer is a 3D motorcycle racing game. Before the action starts, you choose the race you want to enter and the bike you'll ride. Then you line up in a demanding contest that puts your driving skills to the test.

Control your bike with WASD or the arrow keys, and hold Left Shift to fire up the nitro. Press V to switch between camera views and see the race from a different angle. The game is built with WebGL, so it runs right in your browser.
3d-car-rush: 3D Car Rush is a racing game that adds fresh, up-to-date vehicles to the mix. Speed is the main focus, and you race against rival drivers in a 3D city full of traffic on the road. It is tagged as an arcade and hypercasual title, so it keeps things simple and direct.

Steering works entirely with the mouse. Click and swipe to move your car left or right and dodge what is ahead. The game is presented as a 2020 take on car racing, letting you go head to head with competitors at high speed.
superhero-race-2: Superhero Race 2 is a parkour-style game that puts you in a race as you switch between different superheroes. Villains have taken over the world, so it falls to the heroes to clean up the mess they have made. Each hero has abilities of their own, so every character plays a little differently.

Controls are simple: a mouse click or a tap is all you need to play. The game is filed under racing and tagged for running and superheroes, so expect a title built around movement and getting from one point to the next.
super-star-body-race: Super Star Body Race is a racing game that blends collecting with running. You dash along a bright, multicolored course, gathering all sorts of beautiful objects as you go. Each one helps you customize your superstar runner, so your character can look exactly the way you like.

The fun really picks up when you race against friends on the lively track, which is packed with playful obstacles and surprises around every corner. It is a casual, hypercasual title with an easy feel. To play, just click the mouse or tap the screen.
cliff-diving-3d: Cliff Diving 3D invites you to leap off a cliff and dive into the water. Your goal is to slip into the water as straight as you can. Along the way, you collect a stack of money, and gathering it helps you unlock every level.
The game is filed under Sports and carries Arcade and Sport tags. Controls are simple: click to jump. Click once to take off from the edge, then foc
hook-jump-up: Hook Jump Up is an arcade game where you guide a cheerful, bouncing ball that has an emoji face. Your main tool is a hook that latches onto obstacles, letting you swing and climb upward. The towers never seem to end, so there is always another height to reach.

Getting higher depends on mastering the physics of your hook. Time your release well to launch farther, and avoid the dangerous drops that can send you back down. Your goal is to conquer the snowy mountain peaks and reach the very top without falling. Controls are simple: use a mouse click or a tap to play.
strawberry-shortcake-bake-shop-desserts-: Strawberry Shortcake is eager to get into the kitchen with you in this baking game. Your job is to whip up the sweet treat you have always pictured. Pick from a range of tasty ingredients, then add color with food coloring, spread on icing, and finish with toppings and decorations.
city-stunt-cars: City Stunt Cars puts you in a big urban city where your stunt driving skills get tested. You can choose from many sports cars, and each one can be used to pull off cool stunts. Every ramp and loop along the way gives you a chance to show off your moves.

The game includes many big jumps. You can try to clear the houses or aim to land on top of them instead. It is a 3D racing game, and you move with W, A, S, and D or the arrow keys, while SPACE brakes.
hail-control: Hail Control is a fast color-matching arcade game set during a stormy sky. Colored hail blocks fall from above, and you move the baskets so each block lands in the basket of its matching color before it reaches the ground. As the storm grows stronger, the blocks speed up, and you need to make quick decisions to keep pace.

You can unlock upgrades such as lane changers and speed boosts to help you handle the growing chaos and stay in control. The game is simple to understand, but it demands sharp reflexes, and every moment tests your focus and coordination. Avoid missing blocks, and see how long you can survive the storm while keeping the baskets perfectly sorted.
cotton-candy-shop: Cotton Candy Shop is a sweet cooking game where you step into the role of a candy maker. You whip up delicious desserts and aim to wow the people who visit your store, leaving them pleasantly surprised. It is a 2D title in the Cooking category, with candy and restaurant themes.
Everything is controlled with the mouse, so every step is a click away. Make your desserts, serve your customers, and see how they react to your creations. The simple controls keep the
anti-aircraft-3d: Unidentified aircraft have pushed into our territory and already damaged our ships, so stay on standby and be ready to fire. Your mission is to defend the area. Bring down the unknown planes as soon as possible, because our battleships depend on you to keep them from being destroyed.

This 3D arcade shooter places you behind an anti-aircraft gun on a boat. The controls are simple: just slide to play. Keep watching the sky, track each intruder, and respond quickly to protect the fleet.
marinett-freaky-black-friday-sale: Money doesn't always stretch far enough for pricey items, so many people look forward to Black Friday instead. This sales event started in America, and stores and malls mark the day with discounts. For bargain lovers, it feels like a holiday, a chance to grab clothing, gear and other goods at a pleasantly low price.

In this game, you head out with Marinette to shop in Paris, where the fashion hub is a dream for any girl. Pick colorful outfits, shoes, accessories and branded cosmetics. Gifts are waiting for you, too. Use the left mouse button or touch to play.
pixel-blocky-combat-the-sandstorm: In this blocky, pixel-styled shooter, Earth has been overrun by a zombie apocalypse. You can team up with players from around the world in multiplayer matches, or work through the campaign and finish every level. Several game modes are on offer, along with a selection of solid guns and a range of characters to pick from.
Movement uses WASD, SHIFT lets you run, and SPACE makes your character jump. The mouse handles aiming, looking around, shooting, and switching weapons. Press TAB to open the menu.
princess-pastel-fashion: Pastel shades are the big trend this season, so a group of fashionable princesses has set out to create outfits full of these soft hues. Their wardrobe already holds several sweet pastel dresses, but they need your help picking the finest combination.

Everything in this dress-up game is done with a mouse click, so you can make your selections quickly. It suits anyone who enjoys designing stylish looks in gentle colors and deciding which outfit works best.
cannon-surfer: Cannon Surfer is an arcade title in which you steer a rolling ball cannon toward the finish line. Blocks stand in your path, so you need to steer clear of them as you go. Be sure to link up with the tank, since a stronger tank makes the boss fight much easier to win. If the boss proves too tough, look for the rainbow shell on your right, as it can offer a helping hand.
Controls are simple: drag to move. The game runs in 3D in your browser, is built with HTML5, and sits in the arcade and avoid categories.
princess-earth-chan: Earth is said to have a soul of its own, and this game brings that idea to life through a sweet anime character called Earth-chan. You turn a princess into the planet of your choice, giving it the look of a cute anime girl. The worlds to pick from include Mars, Venus, Earth, Jupiter, the Moon, and others from our solar system. If you prefer, you can also create a Sun-chan.

Once your character is ready, you can dress her in costumes styled after Japanese school uniforms. This fun game is made for girls, and it asks you to take care of your planet along the way. Everything is controlled with the left mouse button or by tapping a touchscreen.
romantic-k-pop-transformation: Pick one of the K-pop stars getting ready for a dreamy, lovely makeover, and shape her into a look that feels soft and sparkly, ready for the spotlight. Test out makeup in shades of red and pink, and try different haircuts and hair colors on your chosen girl. When it comes to clothing, you can browse charming dresses, stylish tops, f
doll-designer-game: Doll Designer Game is a fashion game where your creativity gives dolls a fresh look. You will style and personalize cute figures using stylish clothing, add-ons, and mix-and-match pairings. The goal is to grow into a skilled designer who makes standout doll looks. Choose from a range of hairdos, gowns, footwear, makeup, and extras to build eye-catching outfits. Each new doll gives you another chance to show off your sense of style and inventive flair.
Controls are simple: use your mouse to click any button in the game.
pro-billiards: Pro Billiards is a sports game that brings a contemporary take on pool. You can practice solo against a countdown clock, or invite a friend to share the same device and take turns. The match follows the familiar rules of 8 ball pool, so anyone who knows the classic version will feel at home right away.

Aiming and shooting work with the mouse on a computer. The game also responds to touch, so it runs in all major browsers and on phones and tablets. Good luck, and may the best player sink the eight ball first!
atv-quad-bike-traffic-rider: ATV Quad Bike Traffic Rider is a racing simulator built around quad bikes. It blends elements of shooting games and quad bike driving games, so you get both road speed and shooting while you ride. The game is aimed at fans of ATV racing and bike shooting titles who want a realistic feel for riding a quad.

The main draw is the traffic. You shoot at cars and other highway racing vehicles, which adds a new layer to the ride. The action brings together the intensity of motorbike shooting and real bike racing in one ATV experience. To steer your bike, use the arrow keys on your keyboard.
clash-blade-io: Clash Blade IO is an action game with two ways to play. In Rank mode, you take part in a rank war against more than 50 other players in a single room. Each round lasts 90 seconds, and finishing in the top three earns you coins and experience. Endless mode is the no-pressure choice: you share the map with hundreds of players from around the world, but you won't collect coins or experience because it is purely for fun.

A few tips: collect orbs while you are still at a low level. Keep in mind that higher levels slow your movement, but your sword grows bigger. Use your skill to chase a high score. You can control everything with a mouse or touch input.
parking-master-3d: Parking Master 3D puts you in charge of guiding cars into their spots. You sketch a route for each vehicle to follow, aiming to park every car neatly. It's a casual hypercasual title with an arcade feel, and it's all about enjoying the parking challenge.

The whole game is played with your mouse. Click and drag to draw the path each car should take, then let it roll into place. Tags for this one include arcade, car, cars, casual, hypercasual, and parking.
super-jeep-mega-ramp-driving: Super Jeep Mega Ramp Driving lets you sit in the driver's seat instead of following your car from a third-person camera. Your goal is to reach the finish line while collecting gold coins along the way. You cannot leave the platform truck, so you must keep it moving forward and steer clear of other vehicles on the road.
Controls are simple: tap and slide to change direction. This 3D racing game is tagged as a driving, car, and simulation title with platform elements. It is available on WebGL and Android.
super-jesse-pink: Super Jesse Pink is an arcade platform adventure where you set out to recover his power crystal. Along the way you face a lineup of monsters, sudden ambushes, and dangerous traps that keep you on your toes. Gather coins to earn extra lives and keep moving forward.

Everything is drawn in charming pixel art, giving the game a retro feel that is both lovely and fun to play. The controls are simple: use the arrow keys to move, press Z to jump, and press X to shoot when that ability is available.
moana-first-day-in-big-apple: Moana, a princess from Hawaii, has traveled to New York City to chase her dream of working in fashion. It is her very first visit to the city, and several locals poke fun at the outfit she arrived in. Your job is to give her a new look, starting with a facelift, and turn her into a stylish young woman who can go after what she wants. Help her make her fashion dream come true.
Controls are simple: click or tap with your mouse to play through each step of the makeover.
weapon-master: Weapon Master is a 3D fighting game aimed at boys. Your task is to bring down every opponent you face, and the game is built to keep you entertained from start to finish. It also includes running, so you will be on the move as well as fighting.
Playing is simple because the whole game works with the mouse alone, with no keyboard needed. The game is meant to give you a lot of enjoyment, and its straightforward controls keep
riddles-of-squid: Riddles of Squid draws its inspiration from a well-known South Korean television show. You control a brave young girl who is aiming for the grand prize, and success depends on a mix of good fortune and personal ability. Once you finish the challenges, you earn a reward that lets you pick out clothing, hairstyles and makeup for your character. The game is addictive, and it asks you to work through every one of its riddles.

Play is simple: use the left mouse button or tap the screen on a touch device. The title falls under the Girls category and carries tags such as Dress Up, Hair, Makeover, Puzzle, and running. It runs in HTML5, so it works directly in your browser.
soldiers-combats: Soldiers Combat is a 3D fighting game made up of several levels, each full of nonstop combat. To clear a level, you need to find its hidden keys. Some are tucked under a box, while others drop from enemies, so it pays to collect as many as you can. Coins you gather along the way unlock new guns and characters.
Your weapons include a machine gun, a bazooka, a heat gun, and a cold gun, which you can use to take down enemies. The game supports both 1 player and 2 player modes. To begin, just tap the screen.
army-cargo-drive: Army Cargo Drive is a three-dimensional military driving game that puts your truck handling to the test. Pick one of the three army trucks, then carry your load to the next military base on schedule. Obstacles lie along the route, so steer carefully and keep your cargo from falling off. The game includes ten levels to work through.
Controls are simple. Use W, A, S, D or the arrow keys to drive, press SPACE to brake, and press C to switch camera views.
baby-taylor-house-cleaning-and-decoratin: Taylor's parents have decided to clean up part of their house and give it a fresh new look. Taylor is delighted, because she wants to help with the tidying and to pick the style of furniture for the rooms. In this girls' game, you join the family's renovation team and help them choose the best-looking pieces.
baby-taylor-pet-care-save-cute-animals: Taylor and Jessica are eager to try out community service, so they head to the Pet Care Center after learning it needs volunteers. Their weekend shift centers on looking after animals that have been rescued. Neither of the girls has done this kind of work before, but a volunteer named Sophia is there to guide them step by step. This is a tap-or-click game, so you control everything with simple taps or clicks.
Could you lend a hand too? Come along and help look after the adorable animals who need a caring home for a while.
pixel-fps-swat-command-blocky-combat: Pixel FPS SWAT Command drops you into blocky first-person combat alongside real players from around the world. Nine guns are waiting for you to try, and the battles take place on high-quality maps built from blocks and pixelated scenery. It is a shooter made for having a good time, so jump in and enjoy yourself.

Your mouse handles shooting, aiming, looking around, and changing guns. WASD moves your character, Space makes you jump, and Shift lets you run. Press Tab to open the menu, and press Q to change your camo.
vehicle-stunt-mayhem: Vehicle Stunt Mayhem is a fast-moving arcade driving game where you pull off bold tricks and ignore the rules of gravity. Launch your car off towering ramps, spin and flip through the air, and weave past dangerous hazards on wild courses. Every jump is a chance to show off, but you need sharp timing to land cleanly.

Unlock powerful vehicles and test how far you can push them. Each new challenge becomes more chaotic than the last, and the action rarely lets up. Steer left and right with the A and D keys or the arrow keys.
super-neon-ball: In this arcade skill game, your glowing ball is always dropping toward the bottom of the screen, and your job is to keep it from falling away. Beneath it, a platform stands between the ball and the abyss, and you knock out its blocks to clear a path. Watch for panels sliding across the top of the screen. When one lines up, you can bounce the ball off it to stay aloft.

Along the way, small money icons drift past, so grab them as they go by. Controls are simple: on a phone, touch the left or right side of the screen to steer, and on a PC, use the left and right arrow keys.
marshmello-monster: You play as an adorable marshmello in this one-player 2D arcade game. Your mission is to get across each course and reach the finish line before the clock runs out. Every attempt starts from the beginning, so you need to move quickly and keep an eye on the timer.

The game includes many different levels to work through, each one a new challenge to complete. Move your character with the arrow keys on a computer, or use touch controls on mobile. It is tagged as arcade, action and adventure.
dancing-hop-tiles-ball-edm-rush: This rhythm game is built around EDM, with a distinctive soundtrack and design. Every stage presents its own musical path and test of timing. You bounce from island to island toward the horizon, and each press of the mouse button on the screen makes your ball leap onto the beat tiles. The track library covers a range of trending genres, so there is plenty of variety to hear.

Each tap lines up with the rhythm, so the music becomes something you can feel as you play. Fast beats and melodies guide your movement, and a click at the right moment sends the ball into a sharp turn. Gather stars and go as far as you can. Control is simple: just click on the screen with your mouse.
gunshoot-gang-blocky-combat: In this blocky shooter, you fight to survive as part of a pixel-style gang. The jungle map gives the action a fresh setting, and the campaign offers a long list of missions. Each campaign has its own difficulty and a different map. If solo play gets old, you can team up with players from across the globe online, and choose from a wide range of game modes.
Chatting is simple: press Enter to open the chat box, type your message, and press Enter again to send it. Controls are split between keyboard and mouse. Use WASD to move and Shift to run, while
london-taxi-driver: Take the wheel of a taxi in London, the capital of Great Britain. Your job is to collect passengers from bus stops and carry them to their destinations, which appear on the GPS screen inside your car. Drive carefully, since your passengers are counting on a smooth ride, and enjoy the trip.
Steering is simple: use the arrow keys or WASD to control your car as you weave through the city streets.
race-master-3d: Race Master 3D is a mobile racing game where you never know what waits past the next bend. You can tune your vehicle to suit your style, keep the accelerator pressed down, and weave through a constant stream of different hazards while steering clear of rivals who drive just as recklessly. Each psychedelic race brings something fresh and unexpected, so no two runs feel quite the same.
Expect plenty of speed, drama, and eye-catching cars along the way. It's a casual driving game that is easy to pick up yet delightfully over the top, and it is controlled entirely with the keyboard.
perfect-ninja-slices: Perfect Ninja Slices challenges you to make clean, precise cuts, and the aim is to slice with the skill of a true master. The chopping itself feels wonderfully satisfying. All of the action is handled with your mouse, so the controls are simple from the very first move.

This hypercasual slicing game is endless and funny, and it runs in your browser using HTML5 and WebGL. Cutting sits at the centre of everything, so each slice you land is where most of the fun comes from.
monster-attack: A monster invasion has hit the city, and you are the superhero who can stand up to it. Your job is to shield the innocent residents from the wicked creatures roaming the streets. The game spans several levels and lets you choose from three different character skins, so you can pick the look you like best.

Move around with W, A, S and D. Press E to throw vehicles, X to unleash a special attack, and use the left or right mouse button to strike. Hit Tab whenever you need to bring up the pause menu. This adventure runs in your browser via WebGL.
zombo: Zombo is a 2D arcade shooter for one player, set on a street where zombies roam. Your goal is to kill the zombies and collect coins to earn score. Each coin you grab raises your total as you play.

The controls are easy to learn. Click button A to shoot the zombies, and press the up arrow to jump. The game is tagged as endless and falls into the action and adventure categories. Built with HTML5, it suits anyone who enjoys quick, gun-based fun.
scary-vending-machine: Scary Vending Machine is a math game designed to help kids practice their arithmetic while having fun. You pick one of three machines, which sell toys, sweets, or food. Every item inside carries its own price, and your job is to pay it. A set of coins is at your disposal, and the amount you need appears on the display. Insert the correct sum and the machine releases the item. Get it wrong and an error message appears instead.
The whole game is played with the mouse, so there are no other controls to learn before you start. It gives children a playful way to work with prices and sums.
real-bike-simulator: Real Bike Simulator puts you on a dirt motocross bike for some beach stunts. Tear through spectacular courses built across striking scenery and pull off wild tricks along the way. You can race against aggressive rivals, launch off jumps, and wipe out on the xtreme trial tracks, all within this adventure.
To steer your bike, use the WASD keys or the arrow keys.
fairy-dress-up: In this dress-up game, you style fairy dolls with a wide range of outfits. Pick gowns, skirts, jackets, shoes, wings and jewelry to build the look you want. You can also try different hairstyles, hats, magic wands and more accessories as you go.
This game is aimed at girls and goes beyond clothing alone, since every fairy also has a cute pet of her own. Mix and match pieces to make each fairy look different. Controls rely only on the mouse.
love-tester: Love Tester is a fun game that gauges your feelings by looking only at names. It asks how much you love someone, then gives you a playful answer based on the names involved. Filed under the girls category, it carries the love and mobile tags, so it is made for play on a phone.
Getting started is easy, since the only instruction is to tap to play. It is a light, romantic diversion for anyone curious about how much affection they feel toward someone special.
sky-car-stunt-3d: Sky Car Stunt 3D is made for players who love fast racing and car games. Rather than staying on the ground, you join a car rally high in the sky, with no limits holding you back. Race like a daring stunt master across beautifully designed tracks that seem almost impossible, and work to beat your rival racers in this adventure.

To play, use WASD or the arrow keys. Speed through each course, perform stunts, and try to leave the rival racers behind. Whether you enjoy speed, stunts, or both, this game gives you plenty to keep you busy.
city-ball: City Ball puts you in control of a rolling ball on the streets of a city. Success depends on overcoming the obstacles that appear along the way, so staying alert is essential.

Move left and right to steer clear of trouble, and jump over obstacles as well as the smaller balls positioned beneath them. As your rolling time goes on, the ball picks up speed, which makes each decision quicker and harder. You are allowed to hit three obstacles in total, and every collision counts toward that limit.
gun-mob-stickman-run: You start with a single Commander and grow your force into a large army. Drive through the blue plus-sign gates to bring extra soldiers into your squad, since each gunner you add speeds up the attack on the enemy base. Watch the road, though, because it is trapped with explosive landmines. Dodge them or you will lose soldiers.

Enemies fight back with heavy military machines, including attack helicopters overhead, armored jeeps with machine guns, giant tanks blocking the way, and rocket launcher soldiers. When you cannot break through, call
time-to-park: Time To Park is a driving game where you guide a car through the streets of a city. Your task is to bring the vehicle into a marked parking spot. Keep your car on the road at all times, and avoid crashing into other cars or obstacles along the way.

You can steer with the arrow keys on your keyboard or with the on-screen buttons, which also makes the game playable on mobile devices. Built with HTML5, it runs directly in your browser and falls into the racing category.
pinball-vs: Pinball.VS is a one-on-one pinball match that pits you against a pretend opponent, with the battle modeled on players from around the world. Six themed scenes hold more than twenty pinball layouts, and random phalanx formations give you targets to challenge. The rules are simple: shoot down all the opponents, and you can play the whole thing with one hand.

Kick-offs are random, which keeps each start unpredictable. Winning earns upgrades, and as you go, you face harder layouts and tougher phalanx formations. It is a casual 3D game built around ball play. To shoot, drag.
funny-hasbulla-face: Funny Hasbulla Face is a free online game made for kids. Its main goal is to create the funniest face possible for Hasbulla. You do this by grabbing the yellow dots and dragging them around until the result makes you smile.
Everything is controlled with the mouse, so the game is easy to pick up. Dragging the dots is all it takes to shape each expression, and it makes for a light, cheerful pastime for younger players.
christmas-connect-3: Christmas Connect 3 is a puzzle game where you link together matching items by tapping or clicking on them. Select a group of three or more identical pieces that sit next to each other side to side, up and down, or on the diagonal, and the blocks they belong to turn red. Your aim is to turn every block red so the current level is complete.
The game has 24 levels, and finishing all of them wins the game. You can play with a mouse or a touch pad, and touch input works as well.
kids-go-shopping-supermarket: Supermarket Mania Kids Go Shopping is a girl-focused game that shows how grocery stores and shopping malls operate. It turns a visit to the store into a virtual shopping trip that feels close to the real thing.

The whole experience runs on mouse input alone, so you point and click your way through each store. The game runs in the browser and uses 2D graphics, and it is tagged with cleaning and cooking as well as kids themes. Take your time moving through the aisles to see how shopping works from start to finish.
happy-easter-memory: Before you appear on the screen, a set of cards shows up, and each one carries a different Easter egg. The cards start out lying face down on the playing field. On each turn you can flip any two cards to reveal what they hide, and then you need to remember what was shown on them.

This is a memory puzzle with a holiday theme, and it's aimed at kids. It is built with HTML5, so it runs in a web browser. You can play with a mouse or by touching the screen, which means it works on both computers and mobile devices.
panda-magic-drawing-rescue: A tiny fairy is looking for a helper to join her. Together, you use a magic brush to aid the residents of the forest. You learn to draw by following the lines of each sketch, and the set includes a birthday cake, a Christmas gift box, a round sun, and a little princess's bubble skirt.
Beyond these lessons, the game offers many other creative sketches to enjoy. You can use them to make paintings of your own. Everything is controlled with taps or clicks.
gate-rusher-2-game: Gate Rusher 2 is a fast action runner where speed, timing, and quick choices decide how far you get. You race forward, slip through the right gates, dodge obstacles, and aim for the finish line. It is a casual arcade game that is easy to pick up and hard to put down.

Your goal is simple, though the challenge grows as you go. Keep your pace up, select the correct gates, and survive levels that get harder over time. Each gate can change your route, your speed, or the difficulty ahead, so no two runs feel the same. A single wrong move can halt your progress, so you need to stay focused and react quickly. All controls use the mouse, so just click any button to play.
mahjong-tiles: Mahjong Tiles is a puzzle game about the traditional tile game. Your job is to pair up Mahjong tiles and keep clearing them until the board is empty. The design follows the style of a Chinese board game, so the tiles and setup feel true to the original game.

As you finish boards, new levels unlock for you to tackle. You can zoom into the playing field for a closer look, and moving quickly through the levels is part of the challenge. Everything is controlled with the mouse. Your goal is to become a true Mahjong Ace.
tangram-puzzle: Tangram Puzzle is a brain-training game where you place tangram pieces onto a square platform. The shapes you build can take many different forms, and the game offers more than 500 levels, so there is plenty of variety as you move from one challenge to the next.

It is a single-player 2D casual title with an educational side that suits kids as well as anyone who enjoys matching games. You control everything with a mouse or by touch. Its main aim is to sharpen your thinking while you play.
jelly-cube-adventure: Jelly Cube Adventure takes you through a world made of candy, where your jelly cube has to find its way. Race across bright, tricky stages, gather sweet treasures, and solve complicated puzzles by building up speed with your jelly body. Swipe, dash, and crush candies across hundreds of sugary challenges, and enjoy the detailed visuals along with gameplay that adjusts to how you play.

The game also includes a Jelly Level Editor that makes it simple to design your own candy stages. Add sneaky traps and twisting routes, then share your creations with players around the globe. It is free to play. Play with a mouse click or a tap.
fall-rush-fun-3d: Picture yourself balanced on a platform made of blocks that keep falling away beneath you. Fall Rush Fun 3D is a survival arcade game featuring 3D stickman figures and blocks. On each level, your goal is to outlast every other player and remain the final one standing.
If you feel confident, you can wander over and knock rivals off their footing. Yet you may also win by simply str
airshoot-wars: AirShoot Wars is an arcade title that puts you in control of a spaceship. Your mission is to destroy every enemy ship you meet. All ships are free from the moment you start, so you can choose any of them right away. Tagged as fighting, spaceship, and war, the game puts battle front and center from the first moment.

Control is handled with the mouse. A left click moves your ship, so you point and click to steer through the action. The goal stays clear the whole time: wipe out the enemy ships one by one. It is a simple, easy-to-learn game for anyone who enjoys a straightforward arcade battle.
solitaire-grande: Millions of people around the world play this card game every day, and it offers a calm, relaxing pace. You can choose standard draw-one or draw-three dealing. Completing challenging achievements earns coins, which you can use to unlock beautiful themes. You can also personalize the table with different card faces, backs, and backgrounds.

Newcomers can rely on beginner instructions, which come with unlimited hints and undos for a worry-free start. To win, you must move every card from the waste pile and tableau onto the foundation slots in ascending order. Each foundation pile begins with an ace and is built up within a single suit, from ace to king: ace, 2 through 10, jack, queen, king.
sailor-warriors-new-era: Evil never rests, and now a fresh danger is approaching from deep space. Modern Sailor Warriors keep watch over Earth, and the heroines in this game are strong as well as lovely to look at. You design your own Sailor Warrior of the New Era and take her into the fight against Evil.

cartoon-retro-car-parking-2019: Cartoon Retro Car Parking 2019 is an action game built around driving missions. Each mission lets you test your skills behind the wheel, with parking at the heart of the challenge. Its cartoon retro look gives the car handling a lighthearted feel.

The controls are simple. Move your mouse to change the camera direction around your car. Use the W, A, S and D keys to drive. Take your time and get a feel for how the car responds before you tackle each mission.
rope-hero-rescue: In Rope Hero Rescue, your job is to get the hostage safely across by sending them along a rope to the far end. Time is tight, since the fire is spreading and you must hurry. As the superhero, you'll need to put in real effort to pull off the rescue.

To play, tie the rope to the other end, then send the hostages over it. Getting them to the other side is how you win. It is a casual puzzle game with arcade and adventure elements, and its superhero theme ties the whole mission together.
raft-royale: Raft Royale is a multiplayer game where you keep building your own raft while trying to destroy the rafts of your rivals. rescue-plan-flight-control: Air traffic at this airport has gotten out of hand, so it's up to you to step in and set things right. chain-cube-2048-3d: Chain Cube 2048 3D takes the familiar number-merging idea of 2048 and gives it a three-dimensional twist with cubes instead of flat tiles. stop-the-lock: Your goal in this puzzle game is to open the lock by hitting your target at just the right moment. enchanting-animal-spirits: Deep in a magical woodland live fabulous creatures called animal spirits. Each one is a fairy who watches over a particular element. Your task is to work through the mysterious puzzles hidden across the forest and uncover its secrets. Solving them rewards you with wonderful outfits and hairstyles for the fairies.

icing-on-the-cake-online: Icing On The Cake Online is a calm cooking game set in a kitchen where the cake is already baked and only the decorating remains. Your task is to paint tasty cream onto it. super-3d-world-adventure-gm: Super 3D World Adventure GM is a simple 3D platform game for Android. You move through the level, dodging obstacles and picking up coins. The coins can be used to buy new characters.

jetpack-race-arena: Take off in Jetpack Race Arena, a racing game where bullet-powered jetpacks, wild vehicles, and a wave-rider to surf carry you through thrilling arenas. Finish daring missions to climb in rank, unlock high-tech gadgets and power-ups, and charge into arenas piloting giant mechs.

Make your character stand out with stylish outfits, collect achievements, and challenge friends in endless high-flying action. The controls stay simple: swipe to move along the rope, and tap and hold for a speed boost. Special events bring new free game modes to try.
bottle-flip: Bottle Flip is a casual puzzle game built around one skill: flipping a bottle through the air so it lands standing upright on a table. Your goal is to keep flipping and build up a high score. The idea is easy to grasp, but landing the bottle cleanly takes practice.

crazy-climber-3d: Crazy Climber 3D is a hypercasual game played in three dimensions. Your aim is to reach the finish line while steering clear of barriers. mrs-bullet-perfect-gunshot: Mrs. Bullet: Perfect Gunshot is a shooting puzzle game where you play as a sharp-eyed agent on a secret mission. You aim with your mouse and fire with a right click. Can you clear every level with three stars?
flag-football-game: Flag Football Game puts you on the field for a quick, lively version of the sport. Winning depends on a mix of speed, smart planning, and teamwork. Your success comes down to skilled running, well-timed passes, and fast flag pulls that decide who takes the victory.

dragon-city-destroyer: Dragon City Destroyer is a 3D flying game in which you take control of a dragon above a city. Its many episodes offer a long run of flight-based challenges. Your mission is to launch a fierce assault on the city and prove that your strength still commands respect.

tricky-bike-stunt-vs-train-racing-game: Tricky Bike Stunt vs Train Racing puts you on a highway where bikes and trains compete in a fresh storyline. Your goal is to complete every racing mission successfully, testing your skill on the open road.

rainbow-girls-christmas-party: Rainbow Girls Christmas Party puts you in charge of getting two close friends ready for a holiday celebration. Everything in the game is controlled with the left mouse button, so you only need to click. The whole experience has a cute, festive winter feel, with plenty of fun to be had along the way.
fire-balls-online: Fire Balls Online is a 3D arcade game built around shooting balls. Your job is simply to steer your ball so it strikes a tall stacked tower. Playing is easy: click the mouse or tap the screen. Keep your eye on the tower and the hazards around it, and try to beat your own best score.
swing-man: Swing Man is a 3D hypercasual race in which you hang on to ropes and swing your way toward the finish line. The aim is to reach victory first by beating every opponent in the field. Holding on to every rope is the core of the challenge.

paintball-wars-gui-2022: Paintball Wars GUI 2022 is a shooting game where you use a variety of deadly weapons in a blocky, pixel-style world. You find yourself in the middle of a large fight across several maps, battling an army of ghost bots. Zombies join the fight too, so being well prepared doesn't make things easy. gohan-dress-up: Gohan is a well-loved character from the Dragon Ball cartoon series. He is the first son of Goku and Chi-Chi, and this game lets you take charge of his look. Here, the aim is to dress up this hero and decorate him however you like. To start, simply tap the screen. Its cartoon look and fashion focus suit anyone who enjoys choosing outfits for a character.
connect-puzzle: Connect Puzzle is a casual puzzle game meant to be relaxing and pleasant. You join pieces together to reveal a surprise at the end. curvy-punch-3d: Curvy Punch 3D is a 3D arcade game where your opponent starts the fight with the heaviest fist he has. Your goal is to find the most accurate angle to knock out his life. Before you can reach him, the fight is full of obstacles, so break through them to get a shot at the enemy.
Keep an eye on the enemy's fists and shift your position to dodge each swing. Tap to punch, and use the W, A, S and D keys to move. The challenge is to see how many hurdles you can get through.
draw-happy-puzzle: A little girl is in trouble, and something always seems to be missing from her world. foot-doctor-1: Ouch, these feet hurt badly, and the patient is pleading with the doctor for a cure. In this girls' game, you take on that role and treat each sore foot with the medical tools on hand. You choose from a lineup of cute patients, and there is a large supply of free tools to work with.

footyzag: In FootyZag, you move the ball along to a teammate and then finish with a goal. As you clear tougher stages, you can unlock wilder and more powerful squads. Watch out for opposing players, because a pass that lands with the other side will cost you.

drifty-race-challenge: Drifty Race Challenge is a racing game centered on sliding your car through corners. anime-girl-dress-up: Anime Girl Dress Up invites players into a dreamy world full of characters with different looks. street-fight-beat-em-up: In this free browser game, a hero steps forward to end a war fought over shadow energy. baby-hazel-annual-day: Hazel's preschool is holding its Annual Day, and she has decided to go dressed as a clown. Your first job is to help her and her mom shop for the outfit and the accessories she needs. After that, you dress her in the clown costume and pick out some eye-catching makeup shades.

push-bl-ck: Push Block is a hypercasual HTML5 game built around one simple idea: use your finger to push every block toward its destination. floating-water-surfer-car: Imagine a car that can ride the waves. In Floating Water Surfer Car, you get to take the wheel of exactly that. billiards-city: Billiards City is an HTML5 version of the well-known Pooking - Billiards City game, so you can play it right in your browser. Its focus is 8 ball pool, and it includes many levels to keep the table action varied and fun.

cartoon-battle-sky: Cartoon Battle Sky is an arcade shoot 'em up set during the Second World War. johnny-trigger: Johnny Trigger is an HTML5 shooting game built for mobile play, where you step into the role of a hero, a spy, and a legend. egg-splash: Egg Splash is a puzzle game built around linking eggs in a match-3 style. Join three or more fruits to blast them away and chain together extra eggs, which sets off a range of special effects. The casual title also draws on bubble, mahjong, and matching ideas.

crazy-switch-color: Crazy Switch Color asks you to guide a bouncing ball through a series of moving obstacles. real-world-cricket-game: Step into a surreal take on cricket in this 3D game made for mobile devices. Its striking graphics and motion-capture animations give every movement a lifelike feel, so each swing and delivery looks convincing on screen.

You can relive some of the most memorable moments from cricket history in this championship-style game. Every button is operated with a mouse, so navigating menus and actions takes just a click.
bullet-man: Bullet Man is a shooting game where you aim a gun and take down as many enemies as you can. 3d-royale: 3D Royale throws you into a three-dimensional battle royale where every other player is a rival. Your goal is to defeat all of them and be the one who survives until the end. Take aim, fire, and keep your eyes on the competition as the match unfolds.

super-monster-halloween-jigsaw-game: Halloween is almost here, and the Super Monsters are getting ready to host a party in honor of the holiday. They have invited their friends to join them in the backyard, where the monsters plan to share their own Halloween traditions.

park-the-taxi: You take the wheel of a taxi in this racing game and steer it into marked parking spots. Driving quickly earns you three stars, but you need to avoid crashing into other vehicles and keep the taxi on the street, since driving off it is not allowed.

ben10-jumping-challenge: Ben 10 Jumping Challenge is a free arcade game that suits players of every age. flow-mania: Flow Mania is a straightforward puzzle game where you link matching coloured dots with pipe. spiders: Spiders is simple to pick up but takes practice to get good at. Your job is to move through a blocky landscape by swinging from the ceiling and from the blocks. Dodge the obstacles, grab the gems you pass along the way, and use them to unlock new heroes. Good luck!

magical-unicorn-pet-care: Fans of unicorns, baby animals, and dress-up games will find plenty to enjoy here. In this baby care pet simulator, you look after baby unicorn pets. It is a game for anyone who enjoys looking after little ones.

face-paint: Hanna has to be ready on time, and it's up to you to help her get there. Start by choosing her dress, then move on to her makeup. The game encourages creativity, so feel free to experiment and see what combinations you like best.

Your challenge is to become the highest rated stickman fighter. The jailbreak is your main mission throughout this parkour adventure.

snowboard-game: Strap in for a winter sports run in SnowBoard Game, where you carve down snowy slopes and make your way to the finish line. Along the route, you'll dodge obstacles, perform smooth moves, and keep your balance over icy tracks. Every run tests your reflexes in a fast-moving setting.

The game pairs smooth controls with engaging challenges and snowy scenery for a fun, immersive experience. It suits fans of sports games, winter adventures, and fast-paced action alike. To press any button, simply use your mouse.
