la-car-parking: Parking a car could be more entertaining than you'd expect. LA Car Parking puts your driving skills to the test as you try to park your vehicle in a variety of different locations. Each spot brings its own challenge, so you'll need to stay sharp to get your car exactly where it belongs.

Controls are simple: use the arrow keys or the WASD keys to steer your car into position. It's a casual racing title with an adventure feel, and its quick, skill-based gameplay makes it easy to pick up and keep trying.
crazy-kick: Crazy Kick! is a lighthearted soccer title where you take on the role of the ball itself. Your goal is to launch yourself toward the goal and score. Along the way, you need to dodge kicks from the defenders as well as various obstacles blocking your path.

You move the ball with a joystick, so the controls are easy to pick up. The whole experience is silly and playful, a fun twist on soccer where you are the one being kicked around. Expect plenty of laughs as you look for a clear route
blackpink-k-pop-adventure: K-pop is a style of music that comes from South Korea. Performers in these groups are rarely called soloists. People use the respected term idol instead. The scene expects a lot, since singing, dance moves, appearance, costumes, and accessories all need to be flawless and match South Korean beauty ideals.

In this game you meet the idols of Blackpink. Your job is to style them for the stage, picking out eye-catching outfits and accessories, and to apply bold makeup for each performer. Control everything with the left mouse button or by touch.
ragdoll-warriror: Ragdoll Warrior is a stick-figure fighting game in which you vent your rage on waves of enemy stickmen. To come out on top, you need to keep fighting until your last drop of blood, proving your combat skills in battles where the odds are stacked against you. Everything is controlled with the mouse.

The game is 2D and has a funny, casual feel, with a hypercasual pace that makes it easy to pick up. Each round throws another group of stickmen at you, so the challenge is to stay standing and win the unequal fights ahead.
animal-tiles: Animal Tiles asks you to match three blocks that share the same element. Each level is cleared once every tile on the board has been matched, which sets it apart from Mahjong and other block puzzle games. To make a match, you tap the blocks you want to pair up.

The game includes a large number of levels, and they grow progressively more difficult as you advance. Because the challenge rises step by step, every new stage asks a little more of your attention. Keep matching blocks until the last tile on each board is gone, and you can move on to the next challenge.
power-wall: Step into a laboratory where a science experiment is underway and see how far you can beat your own best. The ball keeps moving and bouncing off the walls that limit its path, and your job is to stop it from flying out of the lab. Activate the power wall on screen at exactly the right moment. As the speed rises, your precision, attention and quickness get tested.

Special abilities add extra fun and challenge to a visually pleasing setting built around perception. It is a simple, attractive game meant for everyone. Your goal is to keep the ball inside the laboratory for as long as you can.
monster-truck-speed-race: Step into a three-dimensional world of oversized trucks, where monster effects add punch to every race. The courses feature detailed 3D tracks that look lifelike, and the action leans toward rally-style competition. Behind the wheel, you get a truck driving simulator experience that rewards careful handling.

Routes wind through dirt and desert terrain, climbing hills and crossing open desert ground that only 4x4 trucks can conquer. Some uphill sections are risky, so every climb demands attention. Drive with W, A, S and D, and press the Space bar to brake when you need to slow down.
goal-the-answer: Goal the Answer is a puzzle game that blends clever thinking with precise aiming. You work through tricky math problems, then kick the ball toward the goal that carries the correct answer. It's a playful way to practice math while you chase a higher score.

Controls are simple: you tap the mouse on the soccer net you believe is right. Taking a moment to work out the problem before you shoot can make a real difference. Along the way you pick up new skills, enjoy the challenge, and watch your points add up.
stickman-shooting-survival: Stickman Shooting Survival is a shooter where you fight to stay alive. As you go, you can improve your gun and strengthen your character's abilities, giving you a way to grow stronger over time. The game leans on role-playing elements, so progression matters as much as aim.

Along the way you gather allies who join your side, and together you keep firing to survive. It is a 3D casual title with a hypercasual feel, and it runs on Android and PC. Its stickman look and survival focus make it easy to jump into.
offroad-grand-monster-truck-hill-drive: Offroad Grand Monster Truck Hill Drive is a racing game built on realistic physics, where you handle a 4x4 over hill terrain. You get to take the wheel of a hill climb truck you have never driven before, and the game invites you to develop your skills until you can handle monster truck offroad runs with confidence. Before you set off, pick a heavy engine vehicle from the garage, which is the core of this monster derby style truck racing experience.

Drive with the W, A, S and D keys, and press Space to brake. Whether you are new to off-road driving or already comfortable behind a big truck, this free browser game gives you a hands-on challenge in hill racing.
live-aqua-hero-adventure: Live Aqua Hero Adventure is not about finding a way out. It is about becoming a true water hero. Your character battles an underwater nation during a dark, busy struggle against the kings of monsters. Every fight is a chance to prove that you are a genuinely incredible hero.
Move with the WASD keys, jump with Space, and hold Shift to go faster. Press F to swim. Each control has its own role, so it helps to learn them before the monsters close in.
draw-master-2: Draw Master 2 offers a calm, low-pressure way to unwind while still giving your brain a workout. Designed as a free, casual title for children, it works as a little online mental exercise. Your task in each stage is to fight off every character on screen before you can move forward. With dozens of levels to work through, there is plenty of puzzling to keep you busy, and the pace stays relaxed throughout.

Controls are simple: use your mouse or tap the screen, depending on whether you are on a computer or a phone or tablet. That makes the game easy to pick up for younger players who want a peaceful break. Anyone who enjoys quiet, thoughtful challenges should find something to like here.
snakez-io: In SnakeZ io, you glide through a world shared with other snakes, and your goal is to survive. Eat whatever you come across on your path. You can also attack rivals by blocking their route so they crash their heads into your body. Once a snake has collided with you, you can feast on everything it leaves behind.
Steering is done with the mouse, so point wherever you want to go. Press the space bar to boost. The game sits in the Arcade category, with Action and WebGL among its tags.
shadow-combat: Step into the role of a shadow warrior in this free online 3D fighting game. You can challenge other players in two-player duels, join a casual brawl with friends, or train offline against smart bots. The setting is a ninja realm, and the game was named Best Mobile Game of 2020 at the DevGAMM Awards.

The realistic 3D graphics and animations pull you straight into every clash. Your hero handles like one from the best classic fighting games, giving you a console-level battle experience on your mobile device. A story mode pits you against AI opponents. Move with WASD, then use Y, U, I, G, H, J, K, and T to attack and chain Tekken-style combos.
fascinating-puzzle: This game gives a fresh spin to the classic jigsaw. Its pieces come in many different shapes and sizes, so no two boards feel quite the same. Your task is to assemble many online jigsaw puzzles, one after another, fitting each piece into its place.
Everything is controlled with the mouse alone, so there are no keys to learn. It is a 2D browser title built with HTML5 and W
knight-rider: This fictional motorcycle racer will appeal most to anyone who enjoys games inspired by movies. It offers plenty of challenges, and the key to getting through them is managing how fast your bike goes and how quickly it picks up speed. At full acceleration, you can enjoy some stunning visual effects.
On a keyboard, press W or the Up arr
happy-hockey: Happy Hockey is a 3D hockey game with a playful twist. Its levels are unusual and crazy, so each stage has its own feel. You play by landing happy hits and shots, and the whole experience is designed to be fun from start to finish.

The game sits in the Action category and is tagged 3D, Fun, and hockey. All of the play is handled with your mouse, which is the only control you need to know about. If you enjoy hockey games with a silly edge, this one is worth a look.
crazy-stunt-3d: Crazy Stunt 3D drops you into stunt car racing across mega ramps and tracks that seem impossible to finish. You can speed through a city packed with huge ramps or explore an unusual setting that includes space and special ramp roads built for stunts. Choose from a wide variety of cars, then launch off the ramps and pull off wild moves in the air.

Each race asks you to complete missions within a set time, so you need to drive quickly and stay focused to reach your goal. Beat the other ramp racers, show off your driving skills, and drive safely on the impossible tracks. The game is made for fans of car stunt driving and GT-style racing, and it aims to sharpen your extreme stunt skills more than other stunt racing games. Controls use the keyboard.
valentines-day-dress-up: Valentine's Day arrives on February 14, and this game follows a couple getting ready for their meeting on that day. Lovers often meet, stroll through parks, and receive lovely presents, so our pair has chosen their most refined clothes. When they meet, they will hand over gifts to each other. Your job is to style them for the occasion.

This is a girls' title with a fashion focus and a romantic mood, built with HTML5 and tagged with dress up and love themes. To start, simply tap the screen. From there, you can shape the couple's look for their Valentine's Day outing.
8-ball-billiard-pool: 8 Ball Billiards Classic is a sports game that lets you step up to the table and play billiards right in your browser. You can compete against an AI computer opponent, and whichever mode you pick, the gameplay aims for a realistic feel. Each shot behaves in a way that will feel familiar to anyone who has played the real thing.

The game follows the standard billiards rules, so you need to pot the balls in the correct color sequence. Every action is handled with the mouse alone, and the controls are straightforward to pick up. It suits anyone curious about billiards who wants to try the game without any extra setup.
pac-game: Fans of the classic Pacman game will feel at home with Pac Game. It is made for anyone who enjoys that style of play, yet it brings a new challenge to the table. Guide your character through the action, see how far you can go, and enjoy this HTML5 title that suits casual sessions.

Controls are easy to learn. On a desktop computer, use the arrow keys to move. On mobile devices, a set of virtual arrow keys appears on screen so you can steer with your fingers. Whether you are at a desk or on the go, you can start right away and keep the fun going at your own pace.
ok-parking: Take the wheel of a red sports car and weave through busy city streets. Your job is to guide it into a marked parking space before the clock runs out. Other vehicles and obstacles are scattered along the way, so keep your eyes open. Bumping into anything will damage your car, so take it slow and steady.

On a desktop, use the arrow keys or the W, A, S and D keys to steer and move. On a phone or tablet, tap the on-screen buttons to drive. Every parking attempt tests your timing and precision, so aim for a clean park with no scrapes.
zombie-defense-last-stand: Stand firm and build strong defenses against an endless stream of undead. Each round brings zombies that are craftier, sturdier, and quicker than the last, so the waves never let up in this fast tower defense title. You place your towers, upgrade them over time, and mix different kinds of damage to handle heavy brutes, speedy runners, and armored monsters. Choosing where everything goes matters, since a single poor spot can collapse your lines.

Each victory rewards you with resources, which you can spend on new towers and power-ups. Slowing enemies, hitting groups with splash damage, and pairing high damage-per-second setups all help you build a deadly trap. Controls are simple: just click with your mouse or tap the screen to play.
little-panda-chinese-recipes: Little Panda's Chinese Recipes lets you cook three traditional Chinese foods: tofu, roast duck, and hot pot. Each dish looks appealing and tastes tempting. The game is very popular among cooking fans. Simply follow the step-by-step directions, and you will end up with a finished meal. You play with your mouse or by tapping the screen.
Spend some time with each recipe and see which Chinese food ends up being your top pick.
woodturning-3d: Woodturning 3D asks you to shape a wooden piece from beginning to end. You work through the whole turning with three different types of knives, using each one in turn to bring the wood into its final form. Once the shaping is finished, you can paint the piece in any of eight colors.
You control the game with a mouse or by tapping the screen. Each cut shapes the result, and you can then see how the finished piece looks in the color you choose. Enjoy this 3D woodturning title.
halloween-island-running: Get ready for a spooky seasonal special. This Halloween-themed game is simple to pick up, so anyone can jump in and enjoy a lively run across the island. Your mission is to kidnap the character who was taken by the islanders during their Halloween celebration. Dodge the obstacles that stand in your way, and make sure you never end up as the locals' dinner.

You can choose from three characters, each with its own distinct features. The game has a 3D look, an endless style, and plenty of funny moments that keep the mood light. Steer with a mouse swipe or use the arrow keys. It is built with HTML, so it is ready to play in your browser.
police-chase-car-simulator: Step into the shoes of a police officer in this driving simulator, where your patrol car is your main tool for keeping the streets in order. The missions are straightforward to grasp and enjoyable to tackle. You race after suspects through crowded roads at high speed and bring them to a halt. Other assignments send you to roadside parking areas to check vehicles and enforce traffic rules. At border checkpoints, you inspect cars to help keep the area secure. You also escort the president's convoy safely through the city, and you hunt down terrorists to restore peace.
Use WASD to move your car, and tap the screen to start playing.
wrestling-revolution-arena: Wrestling Revolution Arena 3D brings pro wrestling into three dimensions and joins both sides of the industry in one world. In the wrestling career, you step into the ring and take your swings. In the booking career, you work behind the scenes, deciding who faces whom and planning matches that draw viewers each week to build ratings. Switching between the two gives you a deeper respect for what the other side involves, and it should keep wrestling feeling fresh.
Both modes can be played at no cost, and an optional Pro version unlocks the complete experience without limitations. Move with WASD, and use mouse clicks or taps to play.
princess-fashion-flatforms-design: Flatforms are the most popular shoe this year, and nearly every girl wants a pair. Elsa, Anna and Ariel are big fans too, but they are hoping for something with a difference. Your task is to design beautiful flatforms for these three friends so they can head out shopping in stylish, one-of-a-kind shoes.
The game is played with a mouse click or a tap. Use it to create each girl's footwear and enjoy the process of making every pair feel special for the character who will wear it.
astronaut-us: You play as a red astronaut trying to survive out in space. Along the way you must get past a series of obstacles and complete every level to reach the spaceship at the end. Be careful when you jump, because a bad landing can send you falling.

A rope lets you climb up to the upper platform. This single-player 2D action adventure lets you move with W, A, S and D, jump with the Space bar, and throw your rope with X. Mobile touch controls are also available, so you can play on mobile devices.
little-panda-world-recipe: Little Panda World Recipe puts you in charge of a young panda who becomes a skilled chef. The panda's job is to prepare dishes from around the globe. You get to show what you can do in the kitchen, and your goal is to finish every challenge the game throws at you.
Controls are easy to pick up: a mouse click or a tap is all it takes to play. The game blends animal charm,
they-are-coming: Picture a crowd of red stickman soldiers hunting you down without a break. In this 3D arcade game, a swarm of enemies keeps chasing you through every stage. Your job is to collect guns along the way while steering clear of obstacles on the platform tracks, and this holds true on all levels.

Once you cross the finish line, a machine cannon becomes available so you can wipe out the enemies behind you. Movement is controlled by sliding your finger or cursor, which keeps your attention on dodging and collecting. The goal throughout is to stop the pursuers from ever getting close to you.
geometry-road: Geometry Road puts you in a world built from shapes, where every stage throws tricky barriers in your path. Your job is to get past each barrier so you can unlock the following level. As you progress, the stages keep growing tougher, so quick thinking matters more with every step forward. It is filed under Arcade and carries tags such as Action, Adventure, Fun, and Funny, and it runs in HTML5.

You move with the arrow keys or the mouse. Press the Left Arrow key or make a left mouse click to move left, and press the Right Arrow key or make a right mouse click to move right. Keep your eyes on the path ahead and adjust your position in time to avoid the obstacles scattered across the road.
rotate-ring-game: This arcade title puts your timing, concentration, and accuracy to work. The objective is straightforward: steer the moving piece along the ring track while keeping it away from the borders. It looks simple at first, yet getting the timing right takes practice and focus. Gameplay feels quick and fluid, with mechanics that give satisfying feedback and levels that grow harder as you advance.
Fans of reaction-based games and those who prefer relaxed skill challenges can both find something to enj
boat-driver: Boat Driver is a relaxed driving simulator that puts you at the helm of a boat. Your aim is to speed through the course and reach the finish line before the clock or your rivals do. The game plays well on phones as well as computers, so it suits quick races wherever you are.

To steer, use the W, A, S and D keys or the arrow keys. Each press changes how the boat moves across the water, so you can practice your turns and find the fastest line around the track. Tap into the racing feel and see how smoothly you can handle the boat.
fashion-flowers-diy: Some flowers are edible, and blossoms can be turned into all sorts of creative projects. In this game, you follow each step of preparing tasty treats and dainty crafts made from petals and blooms.

A panda who runs a well-liked flower store has just started offering a do-it-yourself flower service. Animal customers are especially fond of flower cakes, flower perfume pouches, and flower lipsticks. Since the service has only just opened, the panda is kept very busy, so you get to help her make these lovely pieces with your sense of style. Use your mouse or tap the screen to play.
dora-kids-puzzles: Dora Kids Puzzles is an online game that players of every age can enjoy, though it is especially suited to very young children. Before you start, choose between two modes: jigsaw, where you assemble the picture piece by piece, or dot to dot, where you join the marked points. Either way, you get to play around with Dora and have a good time doing it.
Controls are simple. Use your mouse or tap to play
fabulous-cute-unicorn-coloring-book: Grab your crayons, little artists, because this time the job is coloring lovely unicorns. A slider on the right lets you pick whatever shade you want. The palette is filled with soft pastel tones. To move the palette panel, hold the left mouse button and drag it. You can play with a left click or by touching the screen.
poly-jumper: Poly Jumper is a fast-paced arcade platformer where well-judged timing decides almost everything. You hop across colorful, low-poly landscapes that include platforms in motion, awkward gaps, and unexpected obstacles. As you advance, levels speed up and demand greater accuracy, so your reflexes are tested throughout.
Your aim is to master perfect jumps and smooth landings. Move between lanes with the left and right arrow keys, and press the up arrow to jump. Each jump should be planned with care.
zombie-fun-doctor: Halloween is near, and zombies need to be prepped for their spooky work. In Zombie Fun Doctor, a silly medical game, you step into the role of a doctor and put your skills to the test by treating a zombie who is in rough shape. Pull out nails, set broken bones, drain infected sores, deliver electric jolts, and close up open gashes with staples.
Once every injury has been dealt with, you can pick a bold, frightening outfit so the undead can scare everyone they meet. Tap and hold to move your tools around the screen. Have fun!
draw-puzzle-sketch-it: Put your creativity and sketching ability to the test in this drawing puzzle game. Solving each puzzle takes sharp focus and quick thinking, since speed and cleverness decide who comes out on top against rival players. The scenes are fully animated and carry themes of romance, tension and dramatic moments, and the fast pace will keep you hooked from the first round.

The gameplay is simple to pick up. Hundreds of words give your imagination plenty of room to wander, and there are over 300 levels and scenarios to draw. Time is limited, so you need to work quickly to test your drawing skill. You control everything with your mouse or by touch.
underwater-odyssey-of-the-little-mermaid: Dive into an underwater world where you guide Ariel on a mission to trick Ursula, the sea witch. It is a race against the clock: gather every treasure before the sea witch can reach it, and collect all the items before time runs out. Ariel can take three hits, so every mistake counts.

The second level shifts the focus to caring for the ocean. Ariel must clear away all the garbage drifting through the water. Controls are simple, and you can use either the left mouse button or touch on a touchscreen.
chat-master-2: In this 3D arcade game, you guide a snake-like ball that grows longer by gathering smaller balls. It cannot stay still. It has to keep moving or it will be eaten. Every move costs you some of the balls you have collected, so keeping a long body is a constant challenge. Your task is to hold onto that length while dodging obstacles with quick, careful steering.

The game is casual and built around collecting and avoiding. To start, just tap the screen. Simple controls make it easy to pick up, but staying out of trouble while your snake grows takes steady focus.
pretty-cure-1: Pretty Cure 1 stars a group of legendary warriors who are set to defend the planet from monsters. Before they can step into battle, though, their outfits need fixing, and that is where you come in. Your job is to get the costumes repaired so the heroines are ready for the fight ahead.

Everything in the game is controlled with the mouse. Once the outfits are sorted, the warriors can head out to protect the planet, so take your time and make sure their gear is in good shape before the monsters arrive.
my-lovely-baby-care: Morning has arrived, and it is time to wake the little one up. Bring the baby to the feeding chair in the kitchen, then serve up tasty meals such as colorful cereal, egg, milk, and other foods.

Next comes a bubbly bath to get ready for the busy day ahead. Blow up some bubbles, wash the baby's hair with shampoo, and rinse everything off before the day gets going. Controls are simple: a mouse click or a tap is all you need to play.
run-panda-run: Run Panda Run is a straightforward runner where a panda keeps moving forward and you control its leaps. A single tap on the screen makes the panda jump, and your goal is to gather as many coins as you can along the way. Watch out for obstacles such as penguins, snowmen, and rocks, which you must clear by jumping over them.
The game uses cute graphics and funny sound effects that add to the fun. Jumping across platforms is the key to building a high score, so time your leaps carefully and see how far your panda can go.
cube-shape-up: In Cube Shape Up, the pictures of the animals have been scrambled, and their squares have been turned around. Your task is to rotate the pieces so each animal returns to its original look. It is an arcade-style 3D puzzle with a jigsaw feel, so you need to think carefully about how every tile fits.
To get started, just tap to play. The game has a relaxing feel, so you can take your time studying each picture and working out how the squares should sit to bring the animals back.
moto-pizza-delivery: Could you picture yourself as the top pizza courier in town? In this game, you bring hot pizzas straight to hungry customers' front doors, all from the seat of a motorbike. Riding a heavy, powerful bike and pulling off daring stunts along the way is the core of the fun, making it a strong pick if you enjoy a city delivery simulator with plenty of risk.

Steer with the keyboard arrow keys to handle your vehicle as you weave through the streets. Tags also point to 3D graphics, adventure, arcade action, and a classic feel, so it suits a wide range of players.
tractor-farming-simulation-3d: Tractor Farming Simulation 3D offers a realistic take on Indian vehicles. You can drive and personalize tractors, cars, bikes, buses, trucks, cranes, harvesters, and DJ vehicles. Your travels lead through farm fields, busy cities, desert off-road tracks, jungles, mountains, villages, airports, and varied terrains. Paint colors, tires, and number plates are all open to customization.

Beyond driving, you can modify your character, ride animals, take buggies, meet roaming NPCs, and spot flying birds. The weather shifts between rain, snow, fog, storms, and sandstorms. Players can also take part in tochan, light Diwali crackers, try farming mods, and drive through mud effects. Control your vehicle with WASD or the arrow keys, and use a left mouse click or tap to play.
run-rich-challenge: Run Rich Challenge is a 3D arcade game about a struggling young man who wants a better life. His only route to a brighter future is gathering money items such as bills and money bags. Each pickup brings him closer to wealth and gives him a more polished look, so your progress is easy to see as you play.

Even a character who has already become rich can keep collecting, since every money item lets him swap his outfit for a new one. The game is built around this steady cycle of gathering and upgrading. To start, just slide to play. Wishing you luck as you collect, and hoping you enjoy the ride.
backgammonia-online-backgammon-game: Backgammonia brings the classic board game to your browser, letting you face the computer or challenge a friend in two-player mode. There is no need to dig out an old board and set of pieces, since you can enjoy backgammon online right away. Grab the dice and get started.

Controls work with either a mouse or touch input, so you can play on a desktop computer or a phone. The game is tagged as a board, classic, and HTML5 title, and it is listed under both one-player and two-player categories.
little-cat-doctor-2026: Step into the role of a caring vet in this game, where your job is to nurse a sick orange kitten back to health. The little patient has big, wide eyes and needs careful attention. As an interactive medical simulation, you use tools such as a thermometer and medicine to treat your patient step by step.

The graphics are colorful and kid-friendly. Controls are easy: just click with your mouse or tap to pick up tools and treat your furry friend. Caring for a sick animal and watching it get better is the heart of the experience.
limousine-hill-drive: Limousine Hill Drive puts you in the seat of a limo chauffeur inside a driving simulation adventure. Your route winds along a mountain track filled with twisty curves, and your job is to collect every passenger waiting at the required destination. Each level brings its own challenges, so you will need sharp driving skills to finish them all.
Stay focused, because leaving the road sends you back to the start of the level you were playing. Steer the limousine with the W, A, S and D keys.
double-streetfight: Double StreetFight is a street fighting action game with a multiplayer campaign and a single player campaign. In the campaign, two people can play together against enemy bots across all three missions and their levels. Knock enemies down to collect coins, then spend them on new costumes. Team up with a friend to finish every level and win the match.

Free for all mode supports up to eight players, and you can also set up a one-on-one fight there. The controls are simple: arrow keys move, Z punches (hold it for two seconds for a power punch), X kicks, C guards, and V grabs. Escape handles breaking out of a grab, and Space jumps. To run, tap left or right twice, then punch or kick while running.
car-parking-3d: Drive your way through a course full of obstacles and put your driving skills to the test. Your goal is to bring the car into the parking spot while avoiding traffic cones and barriers along the route.
Steer with the W, A, S and D keys. This arcade title is built in 3D, so you can see the layout from behind the wheel as you maneuver around each hazard.
mr-bean-puzzle: Mr. Bean Puzzle offers 16 puzzles, each built from a picture of Mr. Bean. Your task is to rebuild every image by shifting its pieces into the right places. To move a piece, drag it up to another position on the board. Finish a level and you can advance to the next one.
Each level has a limited amount of time, so you need to complete the picture before the clock runs out. Controls are simple: a mouse click or a tap is all you need to play.
monster-rampage-city: Monster Rampage City puts you in a huge city where you control a giant dinosaur or monster on a wrecking spree. Tear through streets and buildings, take on other creatures, and show off the destruction you can cause. This single-player arcade action adventure is free to play. Your monster can grow stronger through evolution, and the journey also reaches a monster island.

Movement uses the WASD keys or the arrow keys, and a left mouse click launches your attack. Your goal is to become the strongest monster destroyer in the giant world, fighting your way through each battle and building your power as you go. Whether you enjoy smashing up a city or testing your fighting skills against massive rivals, the game is built around big, chaotic clashes.
thor-king-pig-2: In Thor King Pig 2, you play as Thor, who hurls his axe at spots that hold the power of the worlds. Your job is to reach the door before anyone else, because getting there is how you win. Your rival, King Pig, is waiting for you. Stay away from the water, since Thor can die there, and King Pig's soldiers can also defeat him. Collecting diamonds along the way is an option, but the door always comes first.
This single-player 2D action adventure with arcade gameplay uses WASD keys to move. It also supports mobile touch controls, so you can play on a phone or tablet.
dinosaurs-survival-the-end-of-world: Picture the final days of the world, but set far back in time, where dinosaurs face a volcanic eruption that threatens their whole era. Your task is to make it through the disaster. You can team up with friends to hold out through survival waves, or you can follow a longer campaign that offers several game modes and a range of different dinosaurs.
Here are the controls. Use W, A, S, and D to move your character, while the mouse lets you aim and shoot. You can also change your gun, open the menu with Tab, and jump by pressing Space.
house-paint-puzzle: House Paint Puzzle is a free game made for boys who enjoy puzzle and painting games. Your task is to steer the brush so that all the white roads get coloured in. After the roads are finished, you paint the house to complete one building.

Controls are simple: use your mouse or tap the screen to play. Mixing puzzle-solving with colouring makes it a fun pick for anyone who likes both. Watching a plain building take on colour is a satisfying way to pass some time.
build-castle-3d: Build Castle 3D gives you the feel of a traditional driving simulator, presented on a clean and uncluttered screen. Steering your truck is straightforward, so you can pick it up within moments. Your path is full of obstacles, and you need to dodge them while also setting off the mechanisms that stand in the way.

On your way, you gather bricks, and every one you collect helps you advance. As you move through the stages, you use those bricks to raise different kinds of castles. The mix of driving, collecting and building keeps each level feeling fresh.
i-show-running-2d: I Show Running 2D is a quick endless runner where fast reflexes matter most. You sprint along a busy running track, avoiding tough obstacles by leaping over hurdles or sliding beneath barriers. The pace increases the longer you keep going, so you have to stay sharp.
Controls are simple: tap or click, or press the SPACE bar on your keyboard to make your runner jump or slide.
cartoon-cat-scary: Cartoon Cat Scary is a puzzle game with two modes. The main puzzle, shown in the screenshot, tests your logic as you fill animal shapes with silver balls. The menu buttons open special features that add a spooky touch. Tapping Sounds plays a scary cat's chilling cry, and pressing CONTACT lets you call the mysterious feline directly.

The game is a 2D cartoon with a click-based design. Controls are simple, since a mouse click or a tap is all you need. Expect a mix of logic challenges and eerie surprises as you move between the puzzle and the menu options.
blocky-combat-swat-vehicle-desert: Blocky Combat Swat Vehicle Desert is a shooting game where you battle zombies in both single-player and multiplayer modes, with a wide range of weapons at your disposal. You've been pushing back against blocky Minecraft-style bots across many maps, and in this zombie war you'll have to watch out for other undead even after you've armed yourself. Taking cover behind objects is key to staying alive in these first-person shooters.

Controls are simple. Use W, A, S and D to walk, the mouse to aim, look around and shoot, Tab to open the menu, and the spacebar to jump. The game is tagged as a two-player, multiplayer shooter with cars and helicopters, so you can play with a friend in a desert setting.
4wd-race-legend: Fans of the anime Bakusou Kyoudai Let's & Go MAX may recognize the spirit of this 3D arcade racer. You build mini race cars from separate pieces and then enter small-scale races against other drivers. Many tiny vehicles can be unlocked over time, and you can spend rewards you have already collected on them. It is a nostalgic trip back to younger days.
To play, simply tap the buttons on screen. The game runs in your browser with HTML5 and works on mobile devices, so you can jump in wherever you are.
star-idol-animated-3d-avatar-and-make-fr: Star Idol is a virtual world where you can change up your look and meet new friends. Build the character you have in mind and explore endless ways to be yourself. The game is tagged as both a dress-up title and an .io game.

Start by picking the life you want to live and customizing yourself to match. The 3D avatar creator lets you design your character from top to bottom, down to the smallest detail. Once you're set up, roleplay your virtual life however you like. Get weird, get wild, because it's all up to you.
archero: Archero is an archery adventure with a charming, hand-painted look. You set off on a journey filled with dangerous creatures, and as a brave hero you must defeat each one on your path until the evil dragon has been slain. Along the way you can spend scrolls to improve your gear, which makes your character stronger.

The treasure chest holds many rare pieces of equipment, so it is worth reaching for them. Movement is handled with a joystick, so getting around the game is straightforward. Whether you are facing a monster or heading for a chest, every step of the quest is controlled the same simple way.
animals-memory-xmas: Animals Memory Xmas is a Christmas-themed puzzle with a board-game feel. To begin, click or tap the cards to reveal the animal hidden on each one. Your task is to memorize where each animal appears, then find its similar card so the two can be matched. Since every move depends on what you already saw, the game keeps your memory busy from start to finish.

The game is built with HTML5, so it opens right in a web browser. It also works on mobile devices, letting you tap through the cards on a phone or tablet. Its festive holiday theme and straightforward memory play make it a good fit for kids who enjoy matching games.
fruits-scramble: Fruits Scramble is a puzzle game built around fruit pictures and jumbled letters. First, you work out the name of a fruit from its scrambled letters. Then you tap the picture that matches that name.
You can play with a mouse or a touchpad. The game suits kids and school use, and it also works on mobile devices. It is a simple way to practice spelling while learning the names of different fruits.
woodventure: Woodventure sends you on a weekend trip through a forest full of cute animals. At its heart it is a mahjong connect puzzle. The idea is simple: two tiles can be linked when the route between them bends no more than twice. Your goal is to clear the entire board.

To make a match, click two tiles that show the same picture, as long as a path with at most two turns joins them. Three bonuses can help you along the way. The hint shows you one of the next possible matches. The bomb blasts a random pair of tiles off the board. The reshuffle rearranges every tile still in play.
deadly-dinosaur-hunter: Dinosaurs have escaped from their park, and it is up to you to stop them with your sniper skills. Take them down from a distance so the Jurassic period never gets the chance to happen. This shooting game rewards careful, precise aim as you pick out each target.
The game offers multiple levels and features good graphics. Move with the W, A, S and D keys, fire with a left mouse click, and right-click to aim. Press Tab to toggle pause.
realistic-parking: Realistic Parking is a traditional car parking simulation built on a 3D game engine. You play as a professional driver whose job is to park the car in the pointed yellow square. Every maneuver matters, so take your time and line up each move carefully.

You can also unlock more vehicles in the garage, which gives you new cars to try out. Move your car with the WASD keys or the arrow keys. It is a simple setup that rewards careful driving, and it is built to be fun from the first park to the last.
lanechage-3d: LaneChage 3D is a driving simulation game in the racing category. You start the challenge and face endless traffic on the road, so every move calls for careful control of your car. The game is built in 3D and shows a simple Q-version style on screen, giving it a light, charming feel that is easy to take in at a glance.

Your aim is to keep completing one new level after another through your own challenges. Each run offers a more interesting way to play and brings more joy with every attempt. Expect a clean, cheerful screen that lets you focus on your driving from start to finish.
ludo-wars: Ludo Wars puts a fresh spin on the classic board game Ludo. You can challenge an online player or sit down with a friend in local two-player mode. The goal is simple: be the first to move all of your pieces to the end. Watch out for trap spaces along the way, and keep an eye on enemy pieces that can get in your path.

Controls are kept simple. A click or tap rolls and moves your pieces, so you can start a match right away. Whether you face an online opponent or a friend beside you, each turn depends on your rolls and how carefully you choose your moves.
package-deliver-game: Package Deliver Game puts you in the role of a professional delivery driver who moves parcels around. Your job is to collect packages and bring each one safely to its destination across different locations. The simulation focuses on smooth handling and interactive play, while its missions test your driving skills and how well you manage your time. You will carry both small parcels and large packages, and every run calls for focus, careful driving, and smart route planning.
All buttons in the game are operated with a mouse click, so you only need one hand on the mouse to move through the menus and missions.
match-card: Match Card is a single-player memory game where you turn over cards and search for identical pairs. Each round asks you to remember where every face appears, which gives your recall a good workout. It falls under the clicker and card game category, so it suits anyone who likes a focused puzzle.

Play it with your mouse or by tapping the screen. Stay alert, because one careless guess could leave you feeling a little muddled, though the game is meant to be lighthearted and fun. Test how well you remember the layout and see how many pairs you can uncover.
cute-road: Cute Road sends you along a demanding route where your car can hop over hazards. While driving, you'll learn what this vehicle is capable of and figure out what kind of driver you are, whether a veteran or a newcomer. Stay alert for barriers and other cars that cross your path. Your aim is to earn the highest score you can.
You play with a mouse or by touch, so you can pick whichever suits your device. Every attempt gives you another chance to test the jumps and push for a better result.
camp-arrange: Camp Arrange is a light but tricky puzzle game in which you slide colorful blocks into the spots assigned to them. Every stage shows a new arrangement, so you have to study the board, work out your moves, and act with purpose to finish the task. As the levels get harder, they give your logic a good workout, and each solved stage brings a satisfying feeling of achievement.
The game is controlled entirely with the mouse. Tags for this title include brain, logic, point and click, and puzzle, which sums up the kind of thinking it asks of you.
green-and-blue-cuteman: Green and Blue Cuteman is a 2D arcade adventure made for two players. Each person takes charge of either the green or the blue character and works through every level side by side. Obstacles stand in the way, and enemies must be beaten before you can move ahead. Your goal is to get to the flag and clear the level.
Controls are easy to learn. One player uses the W, A, S and D keys, while the other uses the arrow keys. Touch controls are available for mobile devices, and you can press P to pause the game.
roller-splat-halloween-edition: Roller Splat Halloween Edition is a casual, hypercasual game with a spooky seasonal twist. You steer a bright paintball through a white maze using the arrow keys, moving up, down, and in every direction. As the ball rolls, it leaves splashes of vivid color across the empty corridors. To clear each puzzle, you need to paint every passage and corner until the whole maze is covered in bright paint. The game is a satisfying one to play, and watching the fresh coat of color spread is part of the fun.
dominoes-3d: Dominoes 3D is a puzzle game played in three dimensions. You aim a ball and strike a single domino so the whole line topples in a chain reaction. Along the way, you must steer clear of several kinds of obstacles and hit the correct domino to knock them all down. A large collection of levels keeps the challenge going.
Everything runs on mouse control, so you aim and shoot with your pointer. Its classic
fun-escape-3d: Fun Escape 3D is a 3D adventure where you take part in a running race. Along the way you can knock other racers off their feet, but they can also shove you. Moving obstacles come at you from every direction, so you need to stay on your feet and avoid being pushed into the river. The game has a playful, silly look that makes it easy to jump right in. Your score climbs the farther you get.
You control your runner by sliding your finger or mouse to move left and right across the track.
easter-eggs-collection: This HTML5 puzzler asks you to gather a batch of Easter eggs. Start by pressing any egg, then slide your mouse pointer or fingertip across neighboring eggs that look the same, whether they sit side by side, stacked, or on a diagonal. You need to link at least three eggs before letting go, and releasing the button makes the chain match.

Every sixth egg you collect brings a bonus, and matches of more than seven eggs add time to the clock. Gather the eggs you are asked for within the time limit, or the game ends. Test how many levels you can reach.
assault-fury: Assault Fury puts you in the middle of a battle where enemy troops have wiped out most of your squad and closed in around you. Your goal is to fight your way out. Nearby oil cans can be thrown at enemies as improvised weapons, and they can also serve as cover when you need to hide. The game offers several weapons, 40 levels, and different kinds of non-player characters, along with an upgrade system to strengthen your gear as you progress.
To aim, hold the right mouse button. Use the left mouse button to fire, and press R to reload. If you need a break, press Tab to pause the game.
burger-chef-restaurant: In Burger Chef Restaurant, you aim to become the finest burger cook around, preparing and serving tasty hamburgers in a restaurant of your own. You are in charge of managing that restaurant as you go. The cooking game offers 180 levels to work through, a big burger chef championship to take part in, and a time attack mode.
Everything is controlled with the mouse. The game is filed under the Girls category and tagged burger, cook, cooking and restaurant.
fill-line: Fill Line is a free puzzle game that asks you to connect blocks in a single unbroken path, giving your brain a workout along the way. The idea is easy to pick up, yet it's hard to put down once you start trying to solve each board.

You play by touching the screen and dragging your finger to draw the line through the tiles. It's classified under Puzzles and carries the Arcade and Puzzle tags, so you can expect a mix of quick, focused challenges that reward careful planning.
checkers-legend: Checkers Legend brings back a board game most of us first learned as kids. Its basics are simple, but the game comes in many versions, so it includes rule settings you can adjust. You can test your skills against a straightforward computer opponent, or invite a friend to take turns on the same device.

Your stones move diagonally forward, and you capture by jumping over an enemy stone. It is a well-known two-player game, so the basic rules are easy to track down if you need a refresher. Because the variants differ, check the rule settings before you begin so everyone agrees on how to play.
moto-speed-gp: Moto Speed GP is a racing game built around the thrill of speed. You ride a motorcycle along a variety of different roads, and the whole experience is presented in 3D. It suits anyone who enjoys motorbike racing and likes the feeling of going fast.

The game is played with the W, A, D and S keys together with the mouse. Get comfortable with those controls, then take your bike across each road at full throttle. Its mix of 3D visuals and motorcycle racing makes it a fun pick for a quick session.
scary-helix: Scary Helix is a 3D arcade game with a Halloween theme. Your task is to bring the ball down to the bottom of the Helix maze. You need to do this without touching the colored tiles, and succeeding wins you the game.

The whole game is played with your mouse. Move the pointer to guide the ball along the twisting path, and take care around each colored tile along the way. Keep your movements steady and patient. Reaching the bottom without a single touch is how you claim victory.
dual-car-racing-games-3d: Dual Car Racing Games 3D sends you into a challenging 3D car race where your vehicle is chained to an AI car. This stunt driving game offers an immersive experience, with jumps and crashes that feel more realistic and keep your mind engaged. Each run asks you to stay alert and pay close attention to the road ahead.

Your task is simple to learn: steer your car while matching the speed of the chained AI car that moves with you. Maintain a proper, steady speed to avoid aggressive crashes. The game is easy to play, so the real challenge lies in finding the right pace.
highway-drive-2d: Highway Drive 2D is a relaxed racing game in which you pick the car you want and then head out onto the highway to rack up as high a score as you can. It's built for quick, easy sessions and works well on phones. You play by tapping the screen.

The game is a 2D driving experience with a casual feel, so there's no steep learning curve to get through before you start having fun. Choose your ride, take the road, and see how well you can drive. Each run is a chance to beat your previous result.
jewel-puzzle-blocks: Jewel Puzzle Blocks is a puzzle game made for anyone who loves the style of Tetris. It offers a new challenge built around that familiar feel, so fans of the classic get something fresh to try. Listed as a casual, brain-teasing arcade title, it is an HTML5 game that works on mobile devices.
Controls are simple: tap or click, then drag and drop the pieces into place. This approach works the same way whether you are on a phone or a computer, so the game is easy to start right away.
princess-tattoo-master: In this cartoon-style game, you choose which tattoo designs suit each princess, then bring them to life in various colors. Getting every tattoo just right brings a bit of suspense, and your coloring style earns you recognition. The game is played with a mouse or by tapping the screen, so it works on mobile too.

You can also try tattoo designs on your own photos in a painless way, with no needles or ink touching your skin. When you finish, share your tattoo effect with friends and let them believe you really have one.
unity-mini-games-hub-relax: Unity Mini Games Hub Relax gathers a large set of calming little games designed to ease stress and pass the time. You can slice fruit, carefully carve Dalgona candy, defuse bombs, or work through block puzzles, so there is something for whatever mood you are in. The bright visuals and simple controls make it easy to settle in and enjoy instant fun.

Everything is played with a mouse click or a tap, so one input is all you need to move between activities. Whether you want a short break or a longer stretch of relaxed gaming, this collection gives you plenty of ways to unwind.
christmas-chicken-shoot: Get ready for a festive round of chicken hunting in this Christmas-themed arcade shooter. Your job is to take aim at every chicken that appears on the screen. Flying chickens are worth extra points, so they are the ones to watch for when you're keeping score.
Steer your crosshair with the arrow keys, press Space to fire, and tap R whenever you need to reload. Only one player takes part, and the game is built in 3D and runs in your browser using WebGL.
ludo-online-xmas: Ludo Online Xmas is a festive board game you can enjoy with friends over the holidays. Roll the dice, then move your tokens around the board until they reach the center. Clicking is all it takes to roll the dice and make your moves.

town-bus-driver: Learning to drive is hard, and parking a brand-new car without scraping or denting it is often the toughest part. This 3D game sends you around a parking lot to practice the skills you need to park safely in the correct spot. Your goal is to park every car without leaving a single scratch.
Move with the W, A, S and D keys, use the mouse, and try the C and P keys as well. It is filed under racing and tagged with bus and car, so you can practice with a bus as well as with regular cars.
wheel-smash: Wheel Smash is a calm, easygoing game that is simple to learn. You can control it with finger taps or clicks, and the controls stay straightforward throughout. The screen is neat and pleasant to look at.

Your goal is to crush many kinds of objects, some crunchy and some soft, and each smash feels very satisfying. The game offers a wide range of things to flatten, which keeps the play varied. It is a 3D hypercasual title that works on mobile too.
dalgona-candy: Dalgona Candy takes you into a honeycomb-style sweet with a squid hidden inside. Your goal is to carve the figure out while keeping its shape intact, which takes a steady hand and real patience. This is a demanding challenge, and the game is also grouped with Match 3 titles.

Across many levels, you cut out a range of figures, including hearts, flowers, animals, and other pictures alongside the squid. The 3D gameplay feels calm and relaxing, and it suits anyone who enjoys sweets and candy-themed challenges. Carve each design with care, then admire the finished piece. Honeycomb treats shaped like hearts, squid, and other images sit at the heart of the game.
santa-gravity-run: Santa Gravity Run asks you to flip the direction of gravity so your Santa can dodge hazards and make it to the door. There are 12 levels waiting to be cleared, each one testing your timing and sense of direction as you move through the snowy setting. The game sits in the hypercasual category and carries the tags Adventure, HTML5, Platform and Snow.

You play with a mouse or on a touch screen, so there is no complicated control scheme to learn. Every tap or click changes how gravity pulls on Santa, letting you climb, drop and slide past the obstacles in your path. It is a short, simple challenge that works well for quick sessions.
tap-em-up: In this 3D game, your goal is to wrap boxes with tape until they are perfect, all while making sure none of the tape goes to waste. It is a laid-back experience meant for relaxing, and its calm, satisfying gameplay is designed to chase away boredom.
The controls are simple: press the Space bar to tape the boxes. Take your time and enjoy the easygoing pace.
monster-hair-salon: Step into the Monster Hair Salon, where you style creatures with the spookiest hair you can imagine. You can curl or straighten strands, trim them with scissors, add color, and try plenty of other looks. The salon stocks a range of professional gear, including curling irons, blow dryers, scissors, and a spray that makes hair grow fast. Once the hair is done, you can also change a monster's appearance using a large selection of eerie makeup.
Controls are simple: use your mouse or tap the screen to play. Your goal is to make every monster look wonderfully strange and ready for its close-up.
run-race-3: Run Race 3 is a free browser game where you tackle a sequence of tough obstacle courses. Your goal is to reach the end ahead of everyone else. Good timing is the key, since you need to hit your jumps at just the right moment. The game is controlled with the mouse.

It is a 3D multiplayer title that sits in the hypercasual and racing crowd, with a lively .io feel. Each run is quick and simple to pick up, so it suits short breaks as well as longer sessions. Keep your eyes on the track and your reactions sharp.
reckless-getaway-2-car-chase: Take the wheel in Reckless Getaway 2, an arcade racer where you play the driver making a run from the police. The chase takes you through city streets and across off-road terrain, and you must outrun cop cars, SUVs, SWAT teams, helicopters, and even tanks. Each pursuer raises the stakes, so you need to keep moving and stay ahead.
This action racer is designed for mobile. You control the car with the keyboard arrow keys. Keep your eyes on the road and see how long you can keep the getaway going.
arcade-basketball: Think back to the days when a single coin bought you a few minutes at a basketball cabinet, with the clock ticking down the whole time. Arcade BasketBall brings that beat-the-clock challenge to your browser. Each round is short, so you can squeeze in a game whenever you have a spare moment.

The game uses 3D graphics built on HTML5 and WebGL, and it is controlled entirely with the mouse. Its simple controls make it easy to pick up, and its arcade style suits anyone who enjoys sports games with a retro feel.
princess-ariel-dress-up: Meet Ariel, the seventh child of King Triton and Queen Athena, who rule Atlantica, an undersea kingdom of merfolk. She holds the honor of being the first princess to become a mother. This cartoon-style game puts her wardrobe in your hands.

Here you can dress up and decorate the little mermaid in a girls' fashion game. Getting started is easy, since you only need to tap the screen to play. Explore the styling options and see how she looks with each new outfit you choose.
pregnant-mommy-care-games: This time you take on the job of looking after a mother through her pregnancy and caring for her newest baby once it arrives. You stay with her across the full length of the pregnancy, from the early days to the very end. Along the way you carry out basic medical checkups, treat injuries she suffers by accident, and watch the baby take shape. The game focuses on the strength of motherhood and the importance of passing on life to the next generation.
Controls are simple, since everything works with a mouse click or a tap. Use your mouse to finish each cooking step, and use it again to decorate a banana split.
minigolf: Minigolf runs online in a browser on computers, tablets, and smartphones. It features 19 levels, and the goal is to avoid going over the minimum number of shots, since fewer strokes lead to a higher score. Use the mouse on computers and notebooks, or your finger on touch devices.

perfect-sniper-3d: Perfect Sniper 3D is a hypercasual shooting game with an addictive pull. Your job is to line up your aim on a target and then fire at the enemies you see. Take your time before you pull the trigger.

pink-cuteman: Meet Pink Cuteman, a sweet and cuddly fellow with a chubby build, a single eye, and a bright pink color. You can defeat them, or you can simply push on and finish a level late. Each stage is cleared by reaching the flag at its end.
This is a single-player 2D action adventure for Android and mobile. Use the WASD keys to move, or switch to touch controls on your phone. Press P to pause the game.
perfect-sniper-3d-2: Perfect Sniper 3D 2 is a fun, addictive hyper casual shooting game. Your task is to aim at a target and fire at the enemies in your sights. You can also set off explosives to wipe out enemies, which gives you another way to take them down.

The game is played entirely with a mouse, which handles both aiming and shooting. Because there is only one input to learn, the focus stays on lining up each shot and enjoying the action from start to finish.
jewel-pets-match: Jewel Pets Match is a cheerful puzzle game built around cute animal friends. You swap neighbouring pets to line up three or more of the same colour. Lining up four or more earns you explosive power-ups, and bigger groups clear more of the board at once. These blasts can break through blocks that stand in your path.

The game follows classic turn-based match-3 rules and offers a good number of tricky levels to work through. Each move is a careful choice, since your aim is to clear the board with smart swaps. Its animal, arcade, and logic themes make it a fun pick for anyone who enjoys puzzles.
pinball-block-shooter: Picture a classic pinball table where your job is to keep a ball in play and knock out as many blocks as you can. You use the flippers to launch the ball up into the blocks, and every hit adds to your score. The aim is to stay in the game as long as possible while chasing higher scores. The design is clean and old-school, and two buttons are all you need to control the flippers.

The rules are straightforward, so anyone can pick it up quickly, but getting good takes practice. It makes a fun time killer that tests your reflexes. Expect a healthy dose of classic pinball nostalgia with every session. Mouse clicks or taps are all it takes to control the game.
456-survival-game-challenge: In this survival game, you take on the role of a player from 456, facing a series of dangerous contests. The lineup includes Red Light Blue Light, Dalgona Candy, Tug Of War, and Jump on Glass. Each one tests your nerve and quick reactions, and every round carries the risk of death, with a big cash prize waiting for those who win.

Playing is straightforward, since the only control you need is to tap to run. Keep your focus on each challenge as it comes, because one wrong move can end your run. Whether you make it through or not, the experience is built around tense, high-pressure moments from start to finish.
combo-color-unlocker: Combo Color Unlocker is a quick-moving puzzle title where good timing and a sharp eye for color decide how well you do. You match and link bright hues to open up new shades and strong combinations. Keep a streak going and the payouts grow, but a single misstep ends the run. Along the way you can unlock special color powers, tackle tough stages, and aim for top scores as the challenge steps up. It is easy to pick up but takes practice to truly master. Expect satisfying visuals and smooth play, with combo-driven puzzles that suit short breaks or longer sessions. Control is handled entirely with a mouse click or a tap.
real-school-bus-driving: Step back into your school days with this realistic take on driving a school bus. It is your chance to impress your friends with your professional handling and to prove you always arrive on time for high school. Your goal is to become the best driver among high school bus games by combining punctuality with strong highway driving.

Control the bus with the arrow keys on your keyboard. Both your off-road handling and your highway driving help show how skilled you are behind the wheel, so take care with every turn and keep your timing sharp.
stickman-3d-wingsuit: Stickman 3D Wingsuit is a free skydiving simulator in which you play a stick figure in a wingsuit. Soar through three-dimensional levels while avoiding deadly lava, spikes, and saw blades. Remember to open your parachute in time, because this game is bloody and unforgiving for anyone who forgets. For the best flying feel, the game is built to use a gyro.

The controls are simple: the arrow keys move you, space opens your parachute, and X throws a grenade. Press Esc to pause. If you enjoy skydiving or base jumping, this one is made for you, and it lets you take on the role of a daredevil stickman.
dummy-speed-bridger: In this quick reflex title, timing decides everything. You sprint ahead while bridge sections appear under your feet just in time, then vanish almost as fast. A single misstep sends you tumbling into a long drop. Your reaction speed, memory, and steady nerves all get put to the test, because the pace picks up as you advance through each level.

Controls are kept simple: a mouse click or a tap is all you need to get started and keep moving. The momentum never lets up, and there is no leniency for slow players. Only the speediest dummies reach the other side.
rx7-drift-3d: Among the many well-known tuner cars, the Rotary-powered RX-7 stands out as a true favorite. It has built a strong reputation on both race tracks and drift courses. In this game, you get to take the wheel of one yourself, with no penalties to worry about, just open driving. Steer with the arrow keys or WASD, and use the spacebar to pull the handbrake. Press G to toggle slow motion, and L to switch the lights on. Q, E, and Z control the indicators, while R starts recording your run and P replays what you captured.
car-modified-master: Car Modified Master lets you take plain cars and turn them into eye-catching custom builds. It is aimed at anyone who enjoys working on cars, personalizing them, and putting together creative designs. Your job is to build up a car one step at a time. You can repaint the body, swap in upgraded wheels, bolt on spoilers, fit new body kits, and fine-tune small details until the car looks just the way you imagined.
Every change you make gives the vehicle a sharper look, a more distinctive feel, and a stronger presence. Controls are simple: use your mouse to click any button in the game.
block-master-polygonal-puzzle: Block Master: Polygonal Puzzle replaces the familiar squares with a collection of polygons. Your job is to fit these shapes across the entire playing field to win. The levels are sorted into categories, moving from the easiest to the hardest to think through, so the game keeps things fresh. As you complete levels, you can also climb a leaderboard and compare your results with other players.

The aim is to clear as many stages as you can. Stages are grouped by difficulty, so pick whichever group suits you and start there. Once you choose a stage, fill the whole board with the shapes it gives you. Place each piece next to the others so they fit together neatly.
head-soccer-pro-head-ball-2: Head Soccer Pro, also called Head Ball 2, is a football game that rewards quick movement and skilful play. You test your agility and skill in a cup tournament with 32 teams, which opens with a group stage and then moves into elimination rounds. You pick either national sides or club teams and work your way up to prove you have what it takes to be a champion.

zombie-shooter-sniper-game: Zombie Shooter Sniper Game blends lifelike first-person shooting with sniper gameplay set against fresh 3D zombie scenes. fruit-jam-master: Fruit Jam Master is a logic puzzle game with an adventure feel. Your goal is to help every animal leave the grassland, and you win once they have all made it out. funny-hair-salons: Georges is having a rough time with his hair. His scalp is full of mites and pimples, and the only way to get his locks back in shape is a visit to the salon. There, you clean up his scalp and grow fresh hair, so he can finally show off his true inner beauty.

cooking-korean-lessons: Cooking Korean Lessons puts you in the kitchen to learn how to make two well-known Korean dishes, kimchi and bibimbap. Your goal is to cook them and serve the best versions you can. It is a cooking and dress-up game made with HTML5, and it is aimed at kids and girls.

doodle-car-race: Doodle Car Race is a racing game built around the car you draw yourself. Before each match, you sketch a car shape, and it appears on the track right away, ready to roll. zero-g-wind-escape: Zero G Wind Escape is a puzzle game set in weightless space, where you drift through tight spaces in search of a way out. 3d-maze-control: 3D Maze Control is a relaxed puzzle game built on physics. You never steer the ball directly. Instead, you tilt the whole board so the ball rolls toward its target. escape-maze: Escape Maze is a two-dimensional puzzle game built around logic, concentration, and a good sense of direction. head-volleyball-sport-game: Head Volleyball is a stripped-down take on classic volleyball. trail-rider: Trail Rider is a puzzle game built around drawing. You sketch a line to create the road your jeep will follow, then send it toward the finish while steering clear of hazards on the way. wars-island-commander: A worldwide outbreak has turned many people into zombies, leaving you among the survivors. Your main aim is to hold on to your humanity while staying alive. warplane: WarPlane puts you in command of a warship and throws you into intense clashes with hostile forces. bone-doctor-shoulder-case: Our cheerleader slipped and injured her shoulder, so it's up to you to treat her. head-basketball-arena: Head Basketball Arena is a streamlined take on basketball, where the game is built around heads rather than hands. mountain-truck-simulator-3d: Mountain Truck Simulator 3D puts you behind the wheel of a truck on steep, risky mountain roads. Your job is to haul cargo safely to its destination. space-diamond-miner: Space Diamond Miner is a relaxed arcade title that draws on the feel of older Gold Miner-style games, played across a bright, colorful cosmic mining world. tall-man-run-3d: Tall Man Run 3D is an arcade runner where you sprint along a track and pass through gates that change your character's height, width, and build. plumber-world-pipe-puzzle: In a fantasy realm, you are the head of the plumbers, and towns across the land call on you to build their water systems. tap-out-gallery: Tap Out Gallery is an arcade puzzle built around blocks that each carry an arrow showing a direction. crazy-math-quick-test: Crazy Math Quick Test is a free puzzle and math game built around a collection of tricky riddles and brain teasers. underdogs-puzzle-odyssey: Underdogs Puzzle Odyssey is a casual puzzler that combines brain-teasing challenges with a charming, story-led adventure. You guide a small underdog hero who must get past one barrier after another, working out each obstacle with inventive problem-solving.

wonder-coloring: Wonder Coloring is a relaxing game for anyone who loves making colorful pictures with soothing sounds. Getting started is simple: draw, fill in the colors, and unwind. human-leap-evolution: Human Leap: Evolution sends you from a caveman all the way to a futuristic super warrior. destroy-the-ragdoll-sandbox: This single-player 2D clicker drops you into a sandbox where you pick a weapon and start attacking ragdoll characters. rolly-vortex-puzzle-game: Rolly Vortex Puzzle Game takes you through twisting, turning mazes in a 3D world called Vortex 3D - Ball Run 2024 Maze. blocky-champions: Blocky Champions is a quick HTML5 arcade runner built mainly for computer players. couple-wedding-race-game: Get ready to organize every detail of a dream wedding, from the top of the head down to the shoes. house-build-puzzle-game: Build House Mini Puzzle Game is a relaxed puzzle title where you construct houses by working through small, clever challenges. catch-insect: Catch Insect is a skill puzzle that tests both your thinking and your reflexes as you chase clever bugs. racing-master-3d: Racing Master 3D puts you behind the wheel of a 3D driving simulator that gets your heart racing almost right away. You take control of sleek cars and push them hard along the road. traffic-jam-car-puzzle-game: Traffic Road Jam is a logic puzzle set on a road that has become completely clogged with cars. Your aim is to remove every blocking vehicle so your main car can escape the jam. The controls are kept simple, and to click any button, you just use your mouse. This traffic car game puts your logic and strategy skills to the test from start to finish.
mini-art-puzzle-game: Mini Art Puzzle Game offers a calm puzzle experience where artwork and imagination meet. long-hair-rush-challenge: Your hair takes center stage in this long-haired runner, an adventure built around a super long, majestic mane. new-years-eve-makeup: Get three best friends ready for a New Year's Eve party in this makeup game. merge-miners-3d-puzzle: Merge Miners 3D Puzzle takes the familiar merging formula and adds its own spin.
