You start with one miner tool and dig downward, smashing pixel blocks as you go, to grow a mining operation from the ground up.

Every level gives you the chance to buy a fresh miner tool. Combine it with a tool you already own to upgrade it into a stronger, more advanced version. You play with the left mouse button: click, drag, and merge shovels to unlock the Ice Breaker Shovel.
mafia-sniper-crime-shooting: Mafia Sniper Crime Shooting casts you as a sniper working across the city, one of the coldest and deadliest in the streets. It is an FPS action shooting simulator built around high-risk missions. Your job is to eliminate dangerous mafia targets using powerful guns.
Controls are kept simple, since a mouse click or a tap is all it takes to play. The game suits anyone who enjoys a tense, focused sniper experience set against a criminal underworld.
dress-to-impress-new-years-party: Get ready for New Year's Eve in this dress-up game, where you outfit four close friends before their big celebration. You can pick from shimmering gold glam looks, sky-themed blue outfits, sleek black styles, and lively pink showgirl costumes. Each friend has her own vibe, so you will choose combinations that suit her personality.

Build every look by swapping dresses, tops, shoes, hairstyles, and accessories until the outfit feels right. Once everyone is dressed, the group is ready to welcome the new year. Use your mouse to play on a desktop computer, or tap the screen to play on mobile devices.
paint-pop-3d-2026: Paint Pop 3D is a shooting game you control with a single tap, and it is easy to pick up for a quick session that can run much longer. Each tap paints a target on the ring, and your goal is to cover every slice to finish a level. Holding your finger down adds more fun, so try mixing quick taps with longer holds. Keep an eye out for obstacles, because hitting one ends the game right away.

The game includes more than 1000 levels, along with a lot of challenging missions to work through. You can also explore various characters and themes, all shown with beautiful graphics. It is a one-player experience, so you can enjoy it on your own at any time.
gold-miner-classic: Step into a traditional gold mining game that keeps things old-school. Gold Miner Classic lets you experience what it is like to work as a real gold miner, with plenty of the excitement that comes with the job. It falls under the hypercasual category and carries tags like Classic, Gold, Miner, and Relaxation.

Gold Miner Classic is designed for unwinding, offering a calm, casual session that is easy to settle into. Its mission is simple, yet it delivers a real sense of satisfaction when you get it right. You control everything with a mouse click or a tap on your screen.
hop-masters: Hop Masters is a hypercasual jumper for one player. Your job is to keep your character climbing by tapping the left or right side of the screen to land on the next platform. Be quick, because platforms may shift, crumble, or vanish before you get there. It's an endless challenge where survival is the goal.

As you play, you can collect chests and piñatas that hold plenty of costumes for your character, along with items you can use to decorate your home. Control is simple: use either the touch screen or your mouse. Each new outfit and decoration gives you another reason to keep hopping.
sky-invader-impossible-track-game: Mega Ramp Car Stunt puts you behind the wheel for a run of daring car tricks. Your goal is to tackle tough tracks that seem almost impossible, pulling off eye-catching moves as you launch off ramps that rise high into the air. Fans of racing and stunt driving should feel at home, since the game offers fast, high-energy action with plenty of adrenaline.

Controls are simple. Press W or the Up arrow to move forward, S or the Down arrow to move back, and A or the Left arrow to move left. Press Esc to pause, then press it again to pick up where you left off. If you want to start over in the middle of a session, you can restart during play.
skate-xmas: Imagine riding a skateboard across the rooftops of buildings during Christmas time. You need to keep your footing and stay alert, because a fall from a great height means you lose. Steer clear of high places where a tumble could end your run, and move carefully from one building to the next. Objects float in the sky along the way, so you must jump over them as you head for the finish.
Controls are easy to pick up. Use the WASD keys to move and the W key to jump. The game works on both mobile devices and PC, and touch controls are available for mobile players.
prince-of-demons-dark-flame: Take up infernal flames, push back the shadows, and become the Prince of Demons in this role-playing adventure. Your goal is to escape a cursed destiny tied to your half-demon blood. Combat is quick and hard-hitting, blending dark sorcery with savage abilities.

Expect showdowns with monstrous demons and kings who have fallen into corruption. The controls are simple: arrow keys move your character, Z performs a standard attack, and X launches a fire attack. Press the space bar to jump, and move the mouse to rotate the camera.
merge-weapon-run: Race down the track and pick up weapons marked with numbers such as 2, 4, 6, and 8. Merging works much like the 2048 puzzle: when two identical weapons meet, they fuse into a stronger one. Two 2s become a 4, two 4s become an 8, and so on. Your aim is to build the largest and strongest chain of weapons you can before you reach the end.

When you reach the finish line, the run turns into a tactical tower defense battle. The game is presented in 3D and is built around collecting, merging, and strategy. Controls are simple: click with your mouse or tap to play.
animal-racing-idle-park: Animal Racing: Idle Park is a racing game about changing animals that can keep you hooked for hours. Your task is to train a varied group of racers, including lions, eagles, orangutans, dolphins, and more. Watching these creatures transform is a big part of the appeal.

Playing takes only one input: a mouse click or a tap on the screen. That simplicity makes it easy to jump in on a computer or a phone. The game is also tagged with running, racing, and multiplayer themes, so the races have a lively, competitive feel.
anomaly-content-record: Anomaly Content Record is a horror adventure with one clear aim: escape and survive. You play a field investigator sent into a restricted research facility that fell silent overnight. Its tags point to escape, room, and survival gameplay, so the focus stays on getting out alive.
Controls are simple. A mouse click or a tap is all you need to play, whether you are on a computer or a touchscreen device.
tractor-farming-3d: Tractor Farming 3D is an arcade driving game built around farm work and tractor simulation. You take part in everyday village life, join in tochan battles, and grow crops across scenic 3D landscapes. Powerful tractors and cinematic missions feature in several modes, and each one offers a fresh farming adventure.

This Indian-themed tractor driving game is made for fans of 3D tractor titles. If you enjoy driving a realistic tractor trailer through farm simulation, it's a good fit. Controls work with the mouse: tap and hold the left button, then drag to move.
survival-on-raft-multiplayer: Survival On Raft Multiplayer is a survival adventure set on an island, and it plays as a simulation at heart. Your time is spent collecting a range of foods, stones, and other items. Out on the ocean, you can also gather resources like wood and leaves, along with some rare items worth seeking out.

Because the game supports multiplayer, you can share the experience with others. Controls are kept simple, as a mouse click or a tap is all it takes to play. It belongs to the Arcade category and is tagged with food, multiplayer, simulation, and survival.
last-z-survival-shooter: Last Z: Survival Shooter places you in a world that zombies have overrun, and your aim is to escape the coming chaos. The undead strike from every direction, so you need to keep moving, dodge with care, and never stop running.

Shooting the digital doors can bring you extra helpers or make your attacks faster, along with other boosts. Plan your route carefully, since choosing which door to go through is part of the strategy. To play, just click the mouse or tap the screen.
gun-upgrade-rush: Gun Upgrade Rush is a quick, enjoyable swipe runner in which you steer a gun through levels packed with action. Move left or right to grab upgrade pickups along the way. These pickups make your gun shoot faster, give you access to shotgun blasts, and transform it into more powerful weapon forms as you keep running.

The game is played with a mouse click or a tap on your screen. Everything is in 3D and falls under the arcade and shooter style, with tags such as bullets, obstacles, and running. It is a casual, hypercasual experience that's easy to pick up and keep going with.
farm-land-farming-life-game: Farm Land , Farming Life Game is a calm simulator in which you set up a farm of your own, starting with bare soil. You sow seeds, keep your plants watered, and wait for them to mature so they can be picked. The fresh harvest can be sold for coins, and those earnings let you buy more land and keep growing your farm.

The game is controlled entirely with mouse clicks or taps, so it is easy to pick up and play in short sessions. Tags for this title include casual, farm, grow, island, and simulation, and it sits in the hypercasual category.
christmas-bubble-shooter-game: Step into a spooky holiday twist on the bubble shooter genre with this offline Christmas game from 2025. Set in a haunted world, it keeps you popping, matching, and blasting bubbles in an endless stream of fun. Whether you need a break or simply want some festive cheer, you can enjoy it anytime and anywhere.

Hundreds of levels are waiting, each one a nightmare-inducing Christmas challenge that tests your skills. Use your mouse to click any button you need. It is a casual shooter that fits well with the scary, seasonal mood of the game.
dance-on-hotsteps-mobile: Dance On Hotsteps Mobile lets you dress your superstar in stylish suits and dresses before she takes the floor. You keep her moving to the beat of the music, build out the dance steps, and aim to surprise the crowd at the dance show. Everything runs on a simple mouse click or tap, so you can start right away.

It suits anyone who loves dancing or enjoys giving someone a makeover. Fashion fans can try out different looks and show their creative flair with outfits while the performance stays in step with the song. Think of it as a dress-up session that ends with a full dance show.
smashmetal-car-wrek-wars: SmashMetal: Car Wrek Wars puts you behind the wheel for fast, crunching car battles. Your score climbs with every wreck, so the more you destroy, the higher you rank. You can drift, ram, and smash rivals to take control of the arena. The game works as a car destruction simulator built around playful, funny crashes. The crash physics feel
capybara-mukbang-asmr: Step into a tasty playground where you prepare burgers, pizzas, and ice cream treats. Once your meal is ready, dress up your capybara and enjoy each dish, bite by bite. Then go live for a mukbang broadcast, where you eat and drink for your viewers and try to collect as many likes as possible.
Everything runs with a single input: click or tap to play. Cooking, dressing up, and eating all happen with that same simple action, so anyone can jump in and start munching right away.
survive-the-night: Survive The Night is a horror survival game set in a dark, creepy room. You are trapped there with something lurking in the shadows, and your goal is to make it through the night. Before you start, choose between Normal Mode and Horror Mode, depending on how much of a challenge you want. Normal Mode gives you more hints, fewer rooms, and standard monsters.

The game is controlled with a mouse click or a tap. It belongs to the puzzle category and carries escape and room-based tags, so expect puzzles built around the escape theme alongside its tense, frightening atmosphere. It suits anyone who enjoys horror, survival, or room-escape games and wants a spooky experience from start to finish.
moto-bike-extreme-hill-stunts: Strap into this motocross ride, built on physics. You steer powerful stunt bikes through demanding obstacle courses, handle tricky terrain, and pull off flips, jumps, and tricks. Timing and precision decide how well you do, and only the most skilled riders will make it through every stage.
Courses take you across mountains, factories, and floating platforms. Stunts let you defy gravity with backflips, air time, and nearly impossible
black-hole-io-3d-game: Your job in this city battle is to steer a hungry black hole and become the largest hole in town. Pull in buildings, cars, and even rival players to grow, all while the clock keeps counting down. Each thing you absorb makes your hole stronger, so every catch helps it stretch further across the arena. The game is built for mobile play, and you take on the role of the Hole Master, whose task is to devour entire cities.
The controls are straightforward. Tap and hold the left mouse button, then hold it down and drag to collect items. Your aim is to outgrow the competition before time runs out.
ambulance-rescue-hospital-game: You start your career as a rescue ambulance driver in this emergency simulator. Your job is to reach people in need, including those in cars, and carry them to the hospital. The controls feel smooth, which keeps your attention on the rescue work. A highlight of the game is its environment, which gives you a city to drive around in.

Getting around uses the keyboard. Press W or the Up Arrow to move forward, and S or the Down Arrow to move back. Use A or the Left Arrow to move left, and D or the Right Arrow to move right. Any button on screen is clicked with the mouse. These controls are all you need to start driving your ambulance through the city.
cosmos-404: Cosmos 404 sends you through space, where you run across tiny planets that the game builds as you go. Along the way you can gather coins while dodging hostile aliens. Two power-ups, Speed Boost and Magnet, help you last longer. The whole world uses a low-poly style that suits its space theme.

Controls are simple. On desktop, you can move with the arrow keys, the WASD keys, or your mouse. On mobile, an on-screen joystick lets you run in whichever direction you need. Either way, the aim is to survive as long as you can while exploring the galaxy.
mission-santa-deliver-the-gifts: In this single-player 2D flight game, you guide Santa's sleigh through the Christmas night sky. He has a huge list of children to visit and only one night to reach them all, so every delivery has to happen quickly. Drop presents down chimneys to make each child happy while you soak up the feeling of the holiday season.

Controls are simple. On a PC, press the left mouse button or the spacebar to release a gift. On a phone or tablet, tap anywhere on the screen. Landing a gift in a tricky chimney earns you more points, so take your time with the harder shots and try to beat your own high scores.
dino-t-rex-3d-run: Dino T-Rex 3D Run is a new spin on the endless offline runner many people know from Google Chrome, now rebuilt in three dimensions. Your dinosaur keeps running while you dodge 3D obstacles, and the scene shifts between day and night as the speed steadily climbs. You can play in black and white or full color, and switch between 3D and 2D views to suit your taste.

Cheerful music, silly sound effects, and eye-catching visual effects add to the fun during each run. Controls are simple: press the Up Arrow to jump and the Down Arrow to duck, or use the on-screen UI buttons instead. The first version of the game came out in 2019 on other platforms.
annoying-uncle-punch-the-meme: Annoying Uncle Punch the Meme is a silly, hectic game built around internet meme humor. Uncles keep popping up from every direction, and your task is to hit them before their goofy faces wear down your patience. Quick reflexes help you rack up a high score, and the gameplay is easy to pick up, entertaining, and hard to put down.

You can switch the sound on or off from the settings menu, choose a level from the level selection screen, and keep an eye on the score display to see how many punches you have landed. Controls are simple: click the mouse or tap the screen to throw each punch.
sniper-shooting-offline-games: Sniper 3D casts you as a deadly assassin who eliminates targets from long range. The game is free to play and includes offline missions full of high-pressure moments, so you can jump in without an internet connection. Each mission puts your accuracy and composure to the test as you work through tense situations.

The controls are straightforward. Press the left mouse button to fire, and use the mouse wheel to zoom in or out for a closer view of your target. A right click toggles the zoom on and off, which helps you line up a shot quickly. The game rewards careful aim and steady focus, so every shot counts.
arcanoid-side-guns: Fly across the galaxy in a ship that can finally fire back. This Arkanoid-inspired arcade game keeps the bouncing-ball action, but your craft now carries side-mounted guns. Angle your ball carefully to chip away at the brick barriers hanging overhead, then use your guns to take down enemy starships and collect power-ups.
Your goal is to clear every brick from the screen while surviving a constant wave of cosmic attackers. Controls are simple: click with your mouse or tap the screen to start playing.
pro-builder-3d: In this 3D simulation, you run a building business by turning rough logs into homes that bring in a healthy profit. Your character moves around a busy construction yard, carrying logs to the work zone where they get dropped off. You can also bring in workers to speed things along, and it's satisfying to watch a house take shape one stage at a time.

Once a home is finished, you send it to auction, compare the offers, and accept the one you like best. The money you earn goes toward growing your property business. The controls are simple: just click or tap to play.
castle-island-clicker-game: Castle Island Clicker is an arcade game built around dice. You fling them, and the results decide how many woodcutters you get. Those woodcutters chop wood for you, and your mission is to be the first to complete your cannon. The title brings together castle building, number play, and tower defense themes.

Once your cannon is finished, aim it at the enemy's tower, since hitting that tower is how you win. Every button in the game is operated with a mouse, so click whatever you need to move forward. Keep an eye on your dice results, because they control how many woodcutters you gain.
escape-from-hell-crazy-runner-game: Race through a fiery inferno in this 3D action runner for one player. Your only goal is to reach the finish line alive along a single blazing road. Devils and glowing coins appear at random on every level, so no run plays out the same way and there is nothing to memorize. Dodge the devils, and if your health falls below 10, the game is over.

Collect coins to upgrade three boosts: Fire Coin Earnings, Starting Health Points, and the + Health Multiplier Gate. These help you push your run further. There are 18 hidden achievements to unlock. Nine come from slaying devils, and the other nine come from reaching huge point totals.
crazy-christmas-fun-2: On Christmas Eve, Santa's presents have tumbled out of his sleigh, and a crowd of balloons has swept across the North Pole. Santa has to chase the falling gifts. He has also rebuilt his sleigh, so it now races along quickly and wildly. He and his reindeer are counting on you to lend a hand.

Your job is to guide the kart across the sky, dodging obstacles and gathering presents along the way. Reach the Christmas tree and you advance to the next level. This second version has easier levels that are better organized, which makes the game more engaging and more fun. To make the kart rise, just click.
memory-lane: Memory Lane is a one-player puzzle platformer with a pixel-art look. Each level challenges you to reach the Goal Platform without falling or touching enemies. Every level opens with a short preview in which all platforms are visible, but you cannot move. Use this time to study the layout, paths, traps, and pickups, then keep that picture in mind.

When the preview ends, most platforms disappear unless they are marked to stay visible. Touching a hidden platform reveals it permanently. Move with the A and D keys or the left and right arrow keys. Tap space for a standard jump, or hold it for a higher arc. Double jump only works once you have been powered up. On mobile devices, touch buttons appear automatically.
perfect-tidy: Perfect Tidy is a simple, relaxing cleaning simulator that costs nothing to try. It sits in the hypercasual category and carries tags for cars, casual play, cleaning, and relaxation, so it suits anyone looking for a light break from stress. Instead of a single chore, the game offers several tidying jobs, including washing a car, caring for your skin, fixing teeth, looking after pets, and more.

Controls are straightforward: a mouse click or a tap is all it takes to move through each task. The game works well for a few quick minutes or for a longer, unhurried session. For players who find hands-on cleaning calming, it offers a gentle way to spend time.
balanceduel: BalanceDuel is a fighting title built around the idea of balance. You swing weapons and face your rival head-on in matches that often bring plenty of giggles. Attacking is only half the job, since you also have to keep your own footing steady. Choose your moments carefully, landing a hit at the right time so your opponent tumbles before you do. No two clashes play out the same way, so every round feels tense and a bit silly at once. Whoever stays steadier on their feet comes out on top.
Controls are simple: press A or the left arrow to step back, and D or the right arrow to move forward.
oil-tanker-truck-parking-game: If you enjoy simulator games about hauling heavy oil cargo, this 2021 title offers a lifelike feel behind the wheel. You take charge of a large oil tanker and its cargo trailer, which is far from easy to handle. To manage these big off-road trucks well, you need to master the rules taught at driving school.

Getting started is straightforward. Press W or the Up Arrow to move forward, and S or the Down Arrow to move back. Use A or the Left Arrow to move left, and D or the Right Arrow to move right. Any buttons on screen are clicked with the mouse.
diy-ugly-christmas-sweater: Step into a cheerful holiday workshop where you help three best friends get dressed for a festive party. Each pal wants a one-of-a-kind jumper with a playfully clashing style, so your job is to pick the base color and then add your own touches. Trees, reindeer, snowmen, globes, twinkling lights, bows, and many other decorations are ready to be placed.

Once the knitwear is finished, move on to the rest of each look. You can give the girls new hairstyles and add accessories that match the season. The game is built for one player. Use your mouse on a desktop, or tap the screen on a mobile device, to create a cozy, over-the-top sweater that shows off your holiday spirit.
us-coach-bus-simulator-game: Step into the driver's seat of a coach bus in this free browser game. Your missions involve picking up passengers in one city and dropping them off in another, and the supply of missions feels endless. Race opponents along city highways while you move your bus through the streets. A story-based parking and simulation section gives you more to explore.

Driving uses the keyboard. Press W or the Up Arrow to move forward, S or the Down Arrow to move back, A or the Left Arrow to move left, and D or the Right Arrow to move right. Any button on screen can be clicked with the mouse.
idle-cave-story: Idle Cave Story is a simulation and strategy game that takes place in a small village of early cavemen. You grow your settlement over time by putting up new buildings and expanding the land around them. Assign villagers to jobs and keep an eye on your supplies as your tribe becomes more powerful. Recruit people who each fill a different role, improve your structures, and open up fresh regions to discover.

Your warriors can be sent into hazardous caves to fight foes and return with valuable loot for your people. You'll need to keep your food, materials, and fighting force in balance so the tribe stays protected and prospers. You can click or tap to play, actively managing each step, or simply let the village carry on by itself. The game is a calm but tactical idle experience either way.
drift-x-driving-car-game: Drift X is a game all about sliding and steering cars. You rev up, floor the gas, and try to powerslide like a seasoned driver. It goes further than a plain driving simulator, with screeching tires, billowing smoke, and a style of play that pushes your car handling to new levels. Players who enjoy careful precision driving, freestyle drifting, or simply cruising a big open world will all find something to do here.
Controls are simple. Use W or the Up Arrow to move forward, S or the Down Arrow to move back, and A or D (or the Left and Right Arrows) to steer left and right. To click any button, use your mouse.
slash-blitz-master: Slash Blitz Master is a quick, casual action game in the hypercasual style. You grab a blade, line up your shot, and slice through bouncy rubber opponents. Watch out for the weapons they throw back at you, and hurl your knife to knock them down. As you progress, you can unlock sharper, more dangerous blades to use.

The action takes place on bright stages such as tropical beaches and busy crate docks. A large helicopter hovers overhead, and it may be either a bonus or a danger to you. Advance in rank to earn the Slash Master title by gathering upgrades and defeating tough foes. Many fights end in a single hit, and every round is controlled with simple taps or mouse clicks, so it is easy to pick up.
ants-io: In this quick arena title inspired by the .io format, you steer a seasoned ant that wants to rise to the top of the jungle. Roam across the map, track down rival ants, and use your signature ability to gain the edge. Every ant variety brings a special skill and a distinct style of play, and the in-game shop lets you unlock many others.

Four modes are available to put your abilities to the test. During each run, three random skills are offered to pick from, so you can assemble strong combinations. Keep surviving, get stronger as you go, and aim to be the final ant still standing so your name lands in first place on the leaderboard. To play, just click or tap.
runaway-fish-runner-game: Dive into Runaway Fish Runner, an adventure game where you race through the sea with no finish line in sight. The action moves quickly as you swim forward through a world hidden below the surface. Every scene is drawn with lovely underwater colors and details, and the levels just keep coming, so there is always more water ahead.

Steering your fish feels smooth and responsive, which makes the constant running easy to pick up. The gameplay is simple to learn yet hard to put down. Fans of endless runners and underwater journeys will find plenty to enjoy here. All buttons in the game are selected with your mouse.
1945-air-force-space-shooter: Get ready for a game of constant motion in 1945 Air Force: Space Shooter. Drawing its spirit from the classic shooter era, it pairs vintage-looking visuals with fast, bullet-heavy action that calls for quick reactions and careful aim. Enemy planes arrive in waves that never seem to end, so you are always on the move.

Your job is to weave through those attacking aircraft and dodge the dense sheets of gunfire they send your way. When the moment is right, open up with heavy firepower from your Force fighter. Controls are simple: click the mouse or tap the screen to play.
quad-bike-racing-game: Ride a quad bike through a 3D world where racing and shooting come together. Shooting in traffic and fast city driving sit alongside the race, so you get two experiences in one game. It is built as a full-featured ATV quad simulator, with plenty of features on both the riding and shooting sides.

Steering uses the keyboard. Press W or the Up Arrow to move forward, S or the Down Arrow to move back, A or the Left Arrow to move left, and D or the Right Arrow to move right. Use your mouse to click any button on screen. Fans of quad bike, ATV kart, and city driving games should find plenty here that feels familiar.
k-wedding-dream: Step into a dreamy Korean-inspired romance in this dress-up title. Bright K-Pop idols are getting ready for the biggest day of their lives, and you help the couple put together a wedding look in the Korean style. Blend old customs with contemporary fashion as you design outfits for both lovers.

Pick makeup, hairstyles, and jewelry that bring out each character's personality and charm. Every decision you make can express the feelings and hopes the pair carries into their celebration, so the day feels like a storybook moment. When you finish a look you like, you can save it as a PNG screenshot. Controls work with a mouse click on computers or a simple tap on touchscreen devices.
street-war: Street War is a street action game in which you pick a fighter with special skills and jump into fierce battles. Every warrior has a different mix of strengths and weaknesses, so timing and strategy matter just as much as raw power. Your mission is to prove your courage and become the strongest fighter on the street.

This game is built for one player. Use W, A, and D to move, press J to punch, and press K to kick. Getting comfortable with these controls and reading your opponent's moves will help you rise through the fights.
antistress-relaxing-game: Antistress Game: Mini Fan Games offers a calm space to slow down and clear your head. It gathers a set of small, cheerful mini games built around pure relaxation. The experience is meant to help you leave a busy day behind and let tension melt away through hands-on, responsive play.

It's a good fit if you're searching for stress relief that delivers quick comfort and good vibes. Everything is controlled with a mouse click or a tap, so you can start right away on a computer or a phone.
career-run-ramp-game: Career Run Ramp Game puts you behind the wheel for fast car stunts on tracks built for daring drivers. Each course throws up tough challenges, including jumps that seem to defy gravity and ramps that launch your car high into the sky. It works as a ramp car simulator, so every run tests your stunt driving skills.

The routes feature 3D racing tracks with twisted roads, and the missions focus on ramp car work. You can attempt flips, tricks while airborne, and big jumps over giant ramps. To play, hold down the left mouse button and move the mouse left or right to control your car's movement.
hand-or-money: Hand Or Money is a quick game of reflexes and timing where every move carries a gamble. Watch for the perfect instant, then click to reach your hand toward the cash resting just past a deadly guillotine. Strike too early or too late and the blade takes your hand. Hit the timing precisely and you pocket the money, chaining successful grabs into combos that pay out bonus rewards.

Between rounds you pick one of three random buffs to strengthen your run. Stack different effects together and see how far your nerve and quick reactions can carry you. Controls are simple: use a mouse click or a tap to play.
piano-kids-music-and-songs: Piano Kids Music And Songs offers a lively, true-to-life musical experience. Players tap their keyboard or screen to build tuneful songs, then share their creations with friends and family. Because it teaches as it entertains, it suits young children who are developing hand coordination, a feel for music, and an awareness of colors.
Your keyboard can become a playful instrument, letting you make music freely whenever and wherever you like. To play, click with the mouse or tap the screen.
prime-ball-adventure-game: Prime Ball Adventure is a 3D casual adventure from 2025 built around prime-numbered balls. Players head out on a journey of brain-teasing puzzles and strategic gameplay that asks for careful thought at every step. Pulling the pin is central to the design, where fun and logic come together. The game mixes tough mental tests with rewarding progress and a calm, stress-easing mood, so it feels more like a workout for the mind than a simple distraction.
Controls are easy to learn, since every button is selected with the mouse. Whether you enjoy ball games, adventure titles, or relaxing puzzles, this one offers a clear route through its challenges.
go-golf: Go Golf is a sports game in which your goal is to sink the ball into the hole using only a set number of shots. The course changes from level to level, with different types of ground that call for careful observation and precise aiming. A small mistake, whether you aim off target or hit too hard, costs you one of your limited turns. Plan each move, play cleanly, and work your way through every stage.
The whole game is played with the mouse, so you point, aim, and take your shots with a click. Its casual pace and puzzle-like layouts make it easy to pick up and enjoy in short sessions.
harvest-glam: Harvest Glam is a fall-inspired makeup and dress-up game for girls. You can build autumn looks with warm color palettes, golden highlights, and seasonal outfits. Earthy shades, layered hairstyles, and country-style accessories are all available to help you shape a fall style. The game lets you enjoy sweater weather while trying out many different glamorous combinations in a relaxed makeover experience.

It is tagged as a shooter, a shoot 'em up, and a simulation, so it mixes combat with a grounded sense of what flying a warplane feels like. Everything is shown from the cockpit, which keeps you right in the middle of the action.
Your time in the air is spent strafing while steering clear of enemy bombing attacks. Getting started is simple: click the mouse or tap the screen to begin, and then take control of the aircraft.
race-traffic-crazy: Race Traffic Crazy drops you onto fast roads filled with careless drivers, sharp bends, and constant close calls. Your job is to weave past other cars, squeeze through tiny openings that seem almost impossible, and push for fresh high scores. Every run keeps your nerves on edge, since a single slip ends the attempt right away.
You drive with the W, A, S, and D keys. Stay sharp, keep your foot down, and see how long you can last through every nerve-wracking run.
dog-racing-master-game: A huge dog racing tournament opens in a mighty stadium filled with a large crowd. This 3D dog racing simulator lets you become a wild racer and compete in a championship with many racing dog breeds. It is an interesting contest that feels more entertaining than a simple chase race.

To begin, click or tap to start playing. Press W to make your dog run, and press Shift to give it a boost. If you have tried dog chase racing games or other dog race games before, this simulator will feel familiar, but with its own championship style.
mashup-hero: Mashup Hero is a mecha parkour game where you put a robot together while you race toward the finish line. Traps lie along the route, and you swipe to slip past them. In the final arena, you release a powerful shockwave that flattens your opponents.

Cores you collect let you improve your robot's speed, armor, and strength, and you can unlock new skins as you go. The courses get trickier as you progress. Controls need only one finger, and each stage is short. A mouse click or tap starts the game.
autumn-glam-gala: Get three best friends ready for the season's most anticipated gala in this fall beauty game. Your job is to create their makeup, moving from gentle, natural shades to bold, glittery colors. You can also choose hairstyles and chic outfits, mixing in fall-themed looks and current fashion ideas so that every friend stands out at the event.

This is a one-player game controlled with a mouse click or a tap. Click through the options, try out different combinations, and keep experimenting until each of the three looks is just right for the big night.
highway-traffic-racerr: Dodge busy highway traffic at high speed in this 3D racer. You take the wheel and compete with other players along the road, pushing for position while enjoying the thrill of extreme driving. The game can be played offline, and you can choose from a wide range of stunning cars, including endless racing cars and sports cars, to suit your style.

Controls are easy to pick up. On a keyboard, press W or the Up arrow to move forward, S or the Down arrow to move back, A or the Left arrow to move left, and D or the Right arrow to move right. Mobile controls are also available, so you can race on your phone or tablet as well.
furry-wedding-proposal: Step into a sweet story about an unusual couple: a rugged fox and a dainty bunny who are deeply in love and getting ready for their wedding. They hope to look dazzling at the celebration, and you become their main helper along the way. Your task is to dress both characters in lovely wedding gowns, pick stylish hairstyles for them, and apply a little light makeup so they feel their best.
celebrity-thanksgiving-prep: Thanksgiving has arrived, and famous faces are busy getting ready for the holiday feast. Your job is to give your chosen stars a fresh new look before dinner. You start with eye-catching makeup, then style their hair and pick an autumn outfit that fits the occasion.

Once the looks are ready, you can head into the kitchen and try your hand at holiday cooking. Wardrobe options run from warm knitwear to elegant evening gowns, giving you plenty of room to show your sense of style and imagination. Everything is controlled with a single left mouse click or tap, so this is a simple makeover game for dressing up the autumn holiday.
bubble-man-runner-game: Bubble Man Runner is an adventure game built around running through a world of bright, colorful bubbles. You steer a small, adorable bubble character as it rolls, leaps, and sprints across tracks that seem to go on without end. Movement feels smooth and responsive, and the bold visuals and straightforward gameplay make it approachable for players of every age.

Movement uses the keyboard. Press W or the Up Arrow to move forward, S or the Down Arrow to move back, A or the Left Arrow to move left, and D or the Right Arrow to move right. Any on-screen button can be selected with a mouse click. The game is filed under the 2025 games, bridge, and running tags.
tractor-parking-and-driving-game: This tractor parking and driving title is a simulator made for players who enjoy realistic parking tasks. You take control of powerful tractors on a scenic highway, where the roads are smooth and the surrounding spaces are wide open. The gameplay feels simple and calming, yet its interesting levels will test your patience, timing, and driving ability.

Through the game, you practice handling a tractor in narrow spots, reversing into a space, and steering through turns on even roads. Movement uses W, A, S, and D or the arrow keys: W or Up moves forward, S or Down moves back, A or Left moves left, and D or Right moves right. Buttons are selected with the mouse.
pusha-pusha: Pusha Pusha is a puzzle game in which you shove boxes onto a marked target zone to clear each stage. A single careless step can end your run, so planning ahead matters. Controls use the keyboard.
The game is designed for one player and carries the tags Action, Adventure, and Puzzle-style challenge. Think carefully before every move, because each push counts toward the goal.
rocket-fest: Rocket Fest is an arcade game where you pilot a rocket and control its flight. Along the way, you can gather energy and other useful props to help you on your run. At the end of the course, you bomb the target. It is a casual game built for stress relief.

Getting started takes only a mouse click or a tap, so there is nothing complicated to learn. Use that input to control your rocket as it heads toward the finish. Whether you want a light break or a relaxed session, this title is easy to jump into.
dragon-warrior-tower-defense: Defend your land in this tower defense game against a huge, twisting, serpent-like foe. Its long body is made of separate segments, and each one shows a visible health total. Your job is to plan carefully, deciding where to build and how to use your towers so the creature cannot push through and cause damage.

Towers go down on suitable spots across the map. Once placed, they attack the snake's segments on their own. When needed, you can change which segment a tower focuses on. Action and battle elements run through the whole experience, which places it in the fighting category.
goldrush: In this 2D endless runner, you play a cranky little dwarf who digs for gold deep underground. Hop over wobbly platforms, collect sparkling nuggets, and step out of the way of rocks tumbling down before they flatten you. The cave is full of sneaky traps, sharp spikes, and bottomless holes, so every step needs care. As you descend, the action speeds up.

On PC, use A and D to move left and right and press the Spacebar to jump. On Android, touch the lower left part of the screen to steer with the built-in dynamic joystick, and tap the right side to jump. Your goal is to keep going as long as possible and show that you are the sturdiest miner in the mine.
eventide: Eventide is an adventure game for one player. You control a character on a large piece of ground, and your job is to protect that ground from enemies. Every 30 seconds the game becomes harder, so the challenge keeps growing the longer you last. It is also a good one to share with friends so you can enjoy it together.
Everything is controlled with the keyboard. Watch for enemies closing in and act quickly to keep your ground safe as the difficulty rises.
sokoban-push-the-box: Sokoban: Push The Box is a classic puzzle game that rewards careful thinking. You work through a winding maze filled with crates, narrow corners, and awkward layouts. Your goal is straightforward: shove every crate onto its correct spot. Each stage tests your logic, patience, and planning, since one poor shove can block the way forward. Pause and map out your next push before you commit, and keep an eye on how many moves you have made.
Controls are simple. Play with mouse clicks or taps. Work through each layout one step at a time, and watch your move count as you go.
fruit-drop-puzzle-game: Furitrot Merge is a puzzle game with an Italian twist, where careful planning meets plenty of satisfying moments. Your task is to merge well-known Furitrot characters so you can finish customer orders and advance through a long run of levels. Whether you have a few minutes or want to settle in for an extended session, the quick pace and unexpected character drops keep the action coming.
Every character brings its own personality and a wild streak. Your aim is to collect every single one of them. Use your mouse to click any button in the game.
railways-train-simulator-game: Step into the cab of a locomotive in this realistic train game, where your job is to bring trains to a stop in exactly the right place. Each mission asks you to park your train carefully, and some also involve carrying passengers from one point to another. The whole experience unfolds in detailed 3D scenery, and you play as a genuine train driver handling powerful engines on a variety of tracks.
Your aim is simple: halt each train safely
city-defense: City Defense combines real-time strategy with tower defense. You place troops and obstacles to hold off incoming enemies, then improve them with carefully chosen upgrades so you can clear every wave that approaches. It is a 3D war-themed title built around smart planning on the fly.

Controls are simple: click the mouse or tap the screen to play. Think ahead about where to station your forces and when to strengthen them, since your goal is to eliminate each wave before it gets past your defenses.
cargo-truck-transport-game: Step into a cargo hauling adventure where you take the wheel of a heavy truck and deliver freight. The journey climbs steep, risky mountain paths, then rolls through daytime landscapes and busy city streets. Expect rough offroad sections and hilly terrain, and you will drive logging cargo trucks through them. The game aims to feel like the real job, so you get a clear sense of what life behind the wheel of a cargo truck is like.

Controls are simple. Use W or the Up Arrow to move forward, S or the Down Arrow to move back, A or the Left Arrow to move left, and D or the Right Arrow to move right. Any buttons on screen are selected with your mouse.
fashion-makeup-and-dress-up-game: This hypercasual dress-up game puts you in charge of fashion design. You take on style challenges and create looks for superstars, supermodels, brides, and more. Your goal is to build outfits that impress a fashion show and carry you to the top of the challenges. A large selection of outfits, accessories, and bridal makeup gives you plenty of ways to mix and match.
Every choice is made with the mouse, since clicking any button is how you move through the game. Pick your pieces, combine them as you like, and shape each look until it is ready for the runway.
farm-simulator-township-game: Take on the role of a modern farmer in this calm farming simulator. The countryside is lively and always changing, with rich soil, up-to-date machinery, and neighbors who respect hard work, commitment, and careful planning. You can build a large farming operation in career mode, or focus on growing top-quality cotton in cotton mode. Both options offer plenty of detail, realistic play, and enjoyment.

Your journey begins small, with limited resources. You start with a modest patch of land, a basic tractor, and a handful of tools. Use W or the Up Arrow to move forward, S or the Down Arrow to move back, and A or the Left Arrow to move left. D or the Right Arrow moves you right. Use the mouse to click any button.
nivra: Endless wars have reduced the world to a dry, empty wasteland, where armored tank factions hold the power. Cities lie in ruins and supplies are hard to come by, so staying alive depends on how tough your armor is and how well you can aim. Rival groups battle over the last fuel and metal that keep their machines running. This one-player arena action game follows the .io style.

You begin as a lone survivor who discovers an old war factory buried beneath the sand. Deep inside waits a powerful tank that time has forgotten. With little left to lose, you repair it one piece at a time before heading out to face the dangers beyond the ruins. Use A to move left, D to move right, and W to move forward.
mud-offroad-jeep-game: Take the wheel of a rugged jeep in this off-road driving adventure. You will climb steep slopes, splash through muddy tracks, and bounce over rocky trails. The vehicles handle with realistic physics, and the landscapes are scenic. Each mission puts your driving skill to a real test, especially on the roughest ground.

Your garage holds a range of monster trucks and powerful jeeps, and you can unlock more advanced models with better traction, suspension, and horsepower. Steer forward with W or the Up arrow, reverse with S or the Down arrow, and turn with A and D or the Left and Right arrows. Use the mouse to click any button on screen.
crowd-battle-gun-rush: Crowd Battle Gun Rush mixes parkour-style movement with shooting in a 3D setting. While you run forward, you must steer clear of harmful objects along the route, and you should keep upgrading your weapons. The aim is to wipe out the enemies that rush toward you. Expect obstacles, sliding, and plenty of action along the way.
Controls are simple: click the mouse or tap the screen to play, so it works on both desktop and touch devices. Keep an
hoard-master-online: In Hoard Master Online, you play as a black hole and use it to swallow everything you want. Getting started takes just a mouse click or a tap. The game is a fast decompression experience, so it suits short breaks when you want to unwind for a little while. It also appears among the best games in its category, making it a handy choice when you want something simple and relaxing.
airplane-simulator-game: Climb into the cockpit of this airplane flying game, where you lift off from one airport and aim to land safely at another. Press W or the Up arrow to move forward, S or the Down arrow to move back, A or the Left arrow to move left, and D or the Right arrow to move right. Use the mouse to click any button.
arcanoid-shooter-defence: Arcanoid Shooter Defence sends you on an arcade trip through deep space, with a sci-fi twist on the classic Arkanoid brick-breaking style. You pilot your spaceship and keep a bouncing ball in motion, aiming it at rows of bright green blocks. Each well-planned hit helps you break through the layout one section at a time.

Along the way you can unleash power-ups, and precise aim matters if you want to clear the board and overcome the cosmic challenge. The aim is to zap those bricks into stardust. Playing is simple, since a mouse click or a tap is all it takes to begin.
my-tiny-market: You run a supermarket that belongs entirely to you. Your job is to divide your attention wisely among several duties: stocking the shelves, looking after customers, and keeping the whole operation moving at full speed. Every choice about where your time and resources go affects how smoothly the day unfolds, so you have to keep an eye on everything at once.

You begin with a modest store and expand it gradually as it grows. Along the way you handle small chores, such as gathering tomatoes or feeding the chickens, as well as restocking shelves and ringing up shoppers at the checkout. Once things get busy, you can hire employees to speed up the work and help you expand further. This single-player hypercasual title blends shopping with action, adventure, and idle gameplay.
alien-space-shooter-game: Alien swarms are closing in, and your mission is to protect the whole galaxy before they reach it. You must save the universe from brutal invaders while flying through a space flight simulator style setting. The game blends fast arcade shooting with modern combat, giving you a sense of freedom among the stars.
Fans of arcade shooters with modern combat who want freedom in the galaxy will feel right at home. Controls couldn't be simpler: move your mouse to play. Tagged as cas
planet-hero: Planet Hero is a single-player, top-down shooter played in 3D. Your job is to hold back waves of alien monsters that keep attacking your worlds. The enemies never seem to end, so you must keep rescuing the planet while you survive each round. Every new wave hits harder, but it also brings fresh power-ups, helpers, and upgrades to collect.

Recruit heroes with unique abilities who will fight alongside you. Gather coins, unlock boosters, and grow your team so it can handle the stronger threats from deep space. Move with WASD or the arrow keys, or use the on-screen joystick with a mouse and aim in any direction. On touch devices, use the joystick to move, and your shots fire automatically. Save the universe and become the Planet Hero.
horse-kart-runner-game: Horse Kart Runner mixes classic cart racing with the pace of a level-based runner. You steer a horse-drawn cart through a large number of demanding stages, where you dodge obstacles, collect coins, grab power-ups, and keep up with fast-moving action. It suits fans of racing games, endless-style runners, horse simulators, and adventure titles alike, and its forest setting gives each course a natural backdrop.

Movement is straightforward. Press W or the Up arrow to move forward, S or the Down arrow to move back, A or the Left arrow to steer left, and D or the Right arrow to steer right. Any on-screen button can be selected with a mouse click.
ace-drift-3d: Ace Drift 3D is a racing game in which you need accurate control to reach the finish line. The car has no reverse, so every move counts. Although the game is casual at heart, it offers a surprising amount of content to explore.
You can start by clicking or tapping, and you steer with the W, A, S, and D keys on your keyboard. It is a 3D title in the hypercasual style, with cars, driving, and a space theme.
seafloor-racing-3d: Seafloor Racing 3D is a racing game themed around the seafloor that works on both mobile devices and PC. You need to stay alert for sudden obstacles, and sometimes the thing in your way is a whale. Quick reactions matter from start to finish.

The game also includes a rich shopping mall system where you can pick out items to match your racing car. It is a good way to make your ride look like your own. Whether you are on a phone or a computer, the controls stay simple: use a mouse click or a tap to play.
animal-world: Animal World drops you into a wide open land where you can roam freely. Capture and domesticate Brainrots, Palmons, and adorable companion critters. Build your own base, collect materials from the surroundings, and hold out when monsters appear after dark. The world cycles between day and night, and you can forge blades, protective gear, and healing remedies to stay alive.
Treasure can be found inside chests or taken from defeated foes. Tamed creatures will help gather res
bus-park-3d: Bus Park 3D is a realistic truck-parking challenge where you guide a rig through tight corners and into narrow docks. Cones stand in your path, and moving traffic keeps you on your toes, so every maneuver needs care. Precise steering, the swing of the trailer, and your momentum all affect whether you reach the spot without hitting an obstacle.
As you progress, you can unlock new yards and trucks and switch between camera views. The game suits fans of driving simulators and skill-based challenges. You play with a mouse click or a tap.
crazy-rocket-man: Crazy Rocket Man is a puzzle game made for young players who enjoy both action and creativity. The idea is straightforward: study the puppet on the left side of the screen, then pose the puppet on the right to match it. Each pose you copy correctly earns you a rocket part. Keep matching and collecting until the whole rocket is assembled.

Once every part is in place, the rocket is ready to blast off into space. Each round asks you to use memory, coordination, and imagination, which makes it a good pick for anyone who likes interactive challenges and playful adventures. Everything is controlled with the mouse.
tanks-of-war-halloween: Get ready for a clash of armored vehicles in this two-player game, where you and a companion join forces. Pick the red side or the blue side, then aim to wipe out the rival tank directly ahead of you. The quicker player comes out on top. A spooky Halloween skin is also available to dress up your tank.

Power-ups are dotted across each of the four maps. Grab them to gain invincibility or a firepower boost. Move with WASD or the arrow keys, and fire with Q or P. Timing your shots matters as much as speed. This never-ending battle has no finish line, so the fight keeps going.
cargo-bike-and-car-game: Three different ways to drive come together in this browser game. You can take the wheel of heavy cargo trucks on long roads, weave a fast delivery bike through the city, or handle cool cars on special transport missions. The gameplay is easy to pick up, so you can focus on the road ahead. Loads of wood, boxes, fuel, and other items must cross highways and mountains. Take sharp turns slowly to keep the cargo safe.
Move forward, back, left, and right with W, S, A, and D, or with the arrow keys. Click any button on screen with the mouse.
animal-runner-safari-game: Animal Runner Safari is an endless runner set in a city you can surf through. You pick from a cast of colorful characters, and each one can grab power-ups such as jetpacks and hoverboards to help them get ahead. The city itself is bright and detailed, and it's free to explore. You can also invite friends to play along, and the game includes fun knockout challenges that work offline. Your aim is to become the top hero by running through the levels and beating every one of them.

Controls are simple. Use W or the Up Arrow to move forward, S or the Down Arrow to move back, and A or D (or the Left and Right Arrows) to shift sideways. Buttons on screen can be clicked with the mouse.
epic-runner-parkour-game: You begin with a tough survival test, where you must dodge and fight off waves of foes. Success depends on quick reactions as well as careful planning, since every lane throws its own hazards and adversaries at you. Teaming up is central here: you can join forces with people from around the world to take on the enemy. Be cautious with others, though, because alliances are tangled and some survivors you meet may not be on your side.

Build your group by recruiting heroes, choosing from three military branches. Each hero brings a special set of abilities, and mixing different heroes makes it simpler to win battles. To get started, click with your mouse or tap the screen.
monster-city: You play as a Godzilla-style monster whose job is to protect the city. Along the way, the game lets the city itself be destroyed as you take down the enemies threatening it. It is a 3D simulation set in a city-based world built with WebGL.
The mission is a heavy one. Guarding the city can mean accepting the blame, and tearing things down is something you are bound to do. Controls are simple: click the mouse or tap the screen to play.
magic-beauty-makeup: Magic Beauty Makeup is a hypercasual title that offers a laid-back makeover experience. The heroine has lost some of her natural glow, and it is up to you to bring it back. Begin with skin care routines, then move on to applying facial makeup, all while working as a makeover artist inside a virtual fashion salon. Once her face looks refreshed, you can design a complete look.
The game keeps a casual and relaxing pace throughout. Controls are simple: a mouse click or a tap is all you need to move through each step. Its tags are beauty, dress up, makeover, and relaxation.
fish-hunting-frenzy-shooter-game: Step into a murky, intense underwater setting where you play the hunter, and the fish is no longer the one being hunted. For many years people ruled the seas with nets, boats, and harpoons. Now the sea has produced a fearsome mutant fish, armed with razor teeth and a constant craving to go after humans. You are that creature, and you feed on people.

You begin as a little fish, though it still has real strength. Your swimming route takes you along the shoreline, close to the sand, and past passing vessels. Move forward with W or the Up arrow, back with S or Down, left with A or Left, and right with D or Right. Use the mouse to press any on-screen button.
crowd-runners-3d: Crowd Runners 3D puts you in charge of a growing band of stickman fighters. At the start, you pick whichever gate looks most promising and run through it, which lets your group swell in size. Your troop then charges through a busy city, smashing obstacles and clashing with rival crowds along the way. Picking up coins lets you raise your level and strengthen your team.

The run ends with a showdown against the King-stickman, and winning that fight means capturing the castle. The whole adventure is played in a race-like format with a survival edge, so keep your crowd large enough to keep going. Steer your stickmen with the mouse or by touch, whichever suits your device.
two-player-red-hands-game: Pit yourself against a friend in this two-player hand game and find out who gets the hot hands first. It is built on one of the more entertaining clapping games and falls into the reaction genre, though anyone with a competitive streak can take part. Because the rules are simple and easy to grasp, it suits players of all ages, and it is a natural pick if you enjoy two-player titles.
Your reflexes and speed are put to the test, so a moment of distraction can leave your hands turning red. Every button in the game is clicked with the mouse.
tank-wrestle: Step into a world centered on tank clashes, where you steer your own tanks against enemy opponents spread across several different maps. A broad range of tanks is waiting for you to choose from, so there is plenty of variety to explore.

Getting started is easy, since a single mouse click or tap is all it takes to play. Pick whichever tank suits your style, then dive into the fights on each map and see how well you hold your own against the enemies you meet.
halloween-bubble-shooting-game: Step into a spooky bubble-shooting game themed around Halloween. Pumpkins and ghosts appear throughout a haunted setting where you can pop bubbles for as long as you like. Because it runs offline, you can take it along for a quick break whenever the mood strikes, wherever you happen to be.

The game offers hundreds of frightening stages. Each one asks you to pop, match, and blast bubbles through a run of eerie Halloween challenges that put your skills to the test. Controls are simple: use a mouse click or a tap to play.
offroad-jeep-driving-game: Take the wheel of a rugged 4x4 in this mountain off-road experience, where impossible tracks put your driving skills to the test. The game runs offline and features a powerful engine. Reach each target without wrecking your vehicle, climbing steep slopes and keeping your grip on winding mountain hill roads.

Your missions cast you as a professional uphill driver, mixing rough climbs with stunt-style racing in a Jeep Wrangler. Press W or the Up Arrow to move forward, S or the Down Arrow to move back, A or the Left Arrow to move left, and D or the Right Arrow to move right. Use the mouse to click any button.
real-advanced-monster-truck-simulator: In this monster truck title, you pull off wild racing stunts and wreck things with a derby car. As a stunt driver, you can smash through a realistic 3D world and destroy whatever gets in the way. The truck takes believable damage as you go, and reckless driving lets you flatten everything on your path.
Expect plenty of collisions, as cars slam into one another, bump, and crash in every direction. Move your vehicle with the W, A, S and D keys to control your ride.
floof-my-pet-house: Floof - My Pet House is a relaxed pet simulation game for kids, playable online. You can feed your companion, dress it up, and play minigames together.
As you play, you collect coins that help you upgrade your pet's home and buy new furniture for it. The whole game runs on simple controls, so a mouse click or a tap is all you need to get started.
nut-sort-color-puzzle-game: Nut Sort: Color Puzzle Game is a logic puzzle about organizing. Your aim is to shift the colored nuts until every bolt holds just one shade with nothing mixed in. It seems straightforward at first, but the difficulty climbs fast. Later stages bring extra bolts, additional hues, and more awkward arrangements that keep your thinking busy.

Controls are simple. Left-click a nut to select it, then click another bolt to move it there. Each move matters, so it pays to plan a few steps ahead, since a careless choice can box you in and leave the board stuck. With its colorful look and sorting focus, it suits anyone who enjoys brain teasers and a calm, unhurried pace.
box-magician: Box Magician is a physics puzzle set in a Halloween world, where a small witch hopes to gather treasure. Certain objects blow up, while others roll or knock the balance off, so every stage works like a neat arrangement that you solve through good timing and careful thinking.
The spooky artwork looks lovely, the animations flow smoothly, and the layouts grow more intricate as you advance. You play with a mouse click or a tap, and it is a one-player game
emergency-ambulance-driving-game: Step into the driver's seat of a lifelike ambulance in this emergency rescue title. You need to keep up your speed while staying level-headed, since every run is about saving lives. Flip on the sirens and put your emergency driving to the test.

monster-truck-racing-game: Monster Truck Racing Game puts you behind the wheel of powerful 4x4 trucks built for rough terrain.
