lion-family-sim-online: Take on the life of a lion in this animal simulation game set on the savannah. You build your own family and watch it grow, while roaming wide open landscapes and meeting a range of challenges along the way.

Staying alive depends on hunting for food whenever you need it. You also have to defend your territory and guide your pride with both strength and strategy. To play, simply click with a mouse or tap the screen.
machine-city-balls: Machine City Balls puts you in charge of a rolling ball as it travels along roads that are far from flat. Expect the path to twist and bend, with obstacles appearing now and then to slow your progress. One careless move can send the ball plunging into the abyss, so steady control matters throughout.

Clearing a level earns a generous reward, giving you a clear reason to keep going. Playing is simple, since a mouse click or a tap is all the game asks for. Its 3D look and hypercasual style make it an easy game to pick up.
passenger-city-taxi-game: Step into the driver's seat of a city cab and take on the role of a taxi driver who wants to earn a reputation for dependable, skilled service. Your job is to weave through crowded streets, collect passengers, and deliver them safely to wherever they need to go. Each trip brings its own problem to solve, putting your driving and your sense of direction to the test. Missions offer extra rewards for service that stands out.

Choose from a variety of vehicles, from traditional yellow cabs to sleek, modern luxury taxis. As you move forward in the game, new taxis unlock for you to drive. Control your car with W, A, S and D or the arrow keys, and use the mouse to press any button.
fish-royale-io: In Fish Royale io, you dive into a messy reef where the strongest bite wins. You begin as a small, scrappy guppy and grow by swallowing fish smaller than you. Along the way you can grab wild power-ups such as laser bursts, drill dashes and toxic wakes, and you can dress your fish in slick skins with a comic book look. The ocean is crowded with predators, so you need to weave through patches of kelp, time your speed boosts well,
dirt-bus-simulation-game: Take the wheel of a large bus in this off-road simulator, where the path ahead is muddy and uneven. Fans of driving games who want something different should find this one worth a try. Each level brings its own adventure and new challenges as you climb hills, follow dirt roads, and cross rocky paths. The ground is far from smooth, so you need to drive carefully to avoid falling or crashing, and you must watch out for obstacles that could get in your way.

Controls are simple. Press W or the Up arrow to move the bus forward, or S or the Down arrow to move it back. Use A or the Left arrow to move left, and D or the Right arrow to move right. Any buttons on screen are clicked with the mouse.
flipxy-the-bat: Flipxy is a quick arcade game built around a bat that keeps bouncing across the screen. You cannot steer it freely, since your only choice is when to reverse its direction. Gather coins, avoid the monsters, and snatch bananas to keep yourself alive. The action climaxes in battles with eerie bosses on a Halloween night.

Flipping is handled with two buttons. On the keyboard, Player 1 presses A to flip X and S to flip Y, while Player 2 uses O and P for the same moves. A gamepad works too, whether a physical controller or an on-screen virtual one. The game supports both solo and two-player play, and it rewards good timing and sharp reflexes.
k-pop-halloween-dress-up: Step into a spooky makeover inspired by K-Pop Demon Hunters in this Halloween dress up title. Your job is to style the Huntrix members in eerie, fashionable looks, including a Witch, a Pumpkin Queen, a Vampire Idol, and several others. You can combine costume pieces, accessories, and creepy face paint to build daring Halloween outfits for your favorite performers.
This game lets you show off your fashion skills and celebrate Halloween in K-pop style. Use your mouse on a desktop, or tap on a mobile device.
crowd-evolution-3d: Crowd Evolution 3D is an arcade game that blends fast, real-time fights with a bit of strategy. As you move through each stage, you can buy extra troops or upgrade your weapons and gear, while steering around hazards on the way to the final boss.
Control is simple: click or tap to play. Whether you are on a computer or a phone, a single click or touch is all it takes to keep your crowd moving and fighting.
coffee-business-tycoon-game: Step behind the counter of your own cafe in this coffee shop simulator, where a growing number of customers want their drinks served as tall, careful stacks. Your first task is learning the art of the coffee stack, because every perfect pour earns you money. That money can help you grow the shop, upgrade your equipment, and hire skilled baristas to keep up with the coffee rush.

Keep practicing and refining your stacking technique to impress your customers and bring in even more cash. Move around the cafe with W, A, S and D or the arrow keys: W or Up moves you forward, S or Down moves you back, A or Left moves you left, and D or Right moves you right. To click any button in the game, use your mouse.
formula-car-racing-games: Formula Car Racing puts you behind the wheel of several fast cars, each ready to tear around challenging circuits. Your run begins in a stadium filled with motorsport fans. Watch out on tight bends, since pushing speed too hard can lead to skids and collisions. The physics feel true to life, and your goal is to rise to legendary status by claiming victory in a tournament built around top speed.
car-cargo-ship-game: Step into the role of a car transport ship operator in this cargo simulator. Your job is to drive, park, and load vehicles, then steer a large cargo vessel through deep harbors. You will work as a professional car carrier, moving cars onto big freighters and sailing them to faraway islands and modern docks. If you have ever wanted to run a high-tech fleet of jeeps, ships, and cars, this title lets you do just that.
Your driving, parking, and ship handling will be tested closely, and good time management matters too. Move with W, A, S, and D or the arrow keys, and use the mouse to click any button.
brain-puzzle-tricky-quest: Brain Puzzle: Tricky Quest is a free game built around a run of sly brain teasers. Each round brings new riddles and clever tests that stretch your thinking, and some may turn ordinary common sense on its head. You can share the fun with friends, since it works as a funny IQ challenge that offers a fresh kind of mental workout.

Brain, IQ, and mind games are often seen as a good way to sharpen your thinking, and this one leans into that idea. You will need to think outside the box, crack each puzzle, and get ready for the quiz. The game is new, it runs offline, and it is counted among the best games in the world. Controls are simple: just click the mouse or tap the screen to play.
monster-evolution-demon-dna: In Monster Evolution Demon DNA, you guide a creature through a fusion sequence. Along the way you face a series of obstacles, and the path ends with a showdown against the final boss of the computer's fusion. This arcade title blends running, action, and fighting in a 3D world, and swiping also plays a part.

Controls are kept simple, with a mouse click or a tap serving as the only input needed to play. If you enjoy action games that mix running, swiping, and fighting, this one brings all three together in its 3D setting.
draw-action-freestyle-fight: Step into an arcade-style brawl with Draw Action: Freestyle Fight, a game that blends fighting, action, and street fighting with a touch of adventure. Rather than pressing buttons, you sketch your attacks by swiping a finger across the screen, so every battle takes shape from the moves you draw.
The game leaves behind older remote-sensing controls and introduces a fresh pick-up style of play that feels new from the first round. To get started, simply click with a mouse or tap the screen.
city-drift-car-racing-game: City Drift Car Racing Game is a driving title where you slide your car through the streets. It goes well beyond a plain driving simulator, offering a rush of screeching tires and drifting smoke that pushes your handling to a higher level. Players can focus on precise driving, try freestyle drifts, or simply cruise across an open world, so there is room for every kind of car fan.

Steer with W or the Up Arrow to move forward, S or the Down Arrow to move backward, A or the Left Arrow to move left, and D or the Right Arrow to move right. Use your mouse to click any on-screen button.
bootiful-princess-match: Bootiful Princess Match is a puzzle title set against a spooky Halloween backdrop. Three princesses are waiting for a dark makeover, and your job is to flip over cards and find matching pairs. Every pair you uncover reveals a fresh piece of each girl's future look, bringing you one step closer to a one-of-a-kind costume, makeup style, or hairdo. Only observant players can give their princesses a truly spooky yet lovely finish.
Controls are simple and depend on the device you use. On a computer, a click of the mouse does the job, while on a touchscreen a simple touch is all you need.
monster-truck-stunt-game: Monster Truck Stunt Game puts you behind the wheel of a powerful monster truck made for racing and stunts. You can launch off big ramps, pull off daring jumps, and push your truck through fast courses that test your driving. Each track challenges your car control while you race and perform stunts along the way.
Use W or the Up arrow to move forward, S or the Down arrow to move back, and A or the Left arrow to move left. Press D or the Right arrow to move right. Any button on the screen can be clicked with
neon-collider: Neon Collider is a brick breaker set in a glowing, futuristic world made of light and energy. You steer a paddle to keep a charged ball in motion, smashing every shining brick on screen. The game offers 100 levels that grow harder as you go, with bright neon palettes, a pulsing synthwave soundtrack, and bursts of flashy visual effects.

Collect power-ups to change how each round unfolds. Multiball adds more balls to the field, slow motion eases the pace, and Fire Mode lets you shoot plasma energy to blast through blocks. Clear each stage to move forward and unlock new ones. Your progress is saved automatically, so you can pick up where you left off whenever you return. Use mouse clicks or taps to play.
soccer-guantone: Face off against Guantone, a cheeky goalkeeper with plenty of attitude, and the Hungry Giant. This quick, silly football game has you scoring penalty kicks, dodging blockers, and collecting diamonds. Reach twelve goals to win the cup, earning 7000 points and a celebration with balloons and donuts. It suits kids, teens, and anyone who loves big laughs alongside soccer.
To shoot, stop the aiming reticle at just the right moment, then click on your favorite ball. Keep watch for Guantone and the Hungry Giant, since they can get in your
bike-stunt-racing-game: This bike stunt racer puts you on a motorcycle built for trick-heavy riding. You'll attempt daring flips across impossible tracks, with challenges that test your nerve. It suits newcomers and seasoned stunt riders alike, and it's built to keep you hooked. As you go, you can unlock fresh bikes, sharpen your technique, and test how far you can push your riding.

Much of the fun comes from soaring through the air and sticking clean landings. You can conquer impossible tracks or race down mega ramps. Controls are simple: press W or the Up Arrow to move forward, S or the Down Arrow to move back, A or the Left Arrow to move left, and D or the Right Arrow to move right. Use your mouse to click any button.
sand-blast: Sand Blast is a puzzle title that mixes the planning of old-school falling-block games with the fun of smashing blocks apart. Your job is to slide, pile up, and pair up blocks of various shapes so they fill complete rows or form specific patterns. It's easy to pick up, yet it keeps you thinking about where each piece should go next.

Everything is handled with a mouse click or a tap, so you can jump right in on a computer or a phone. Keep an eye on how your stack grows, and aim to clear as much as you can before the board fills up.
city-tuk-tuk-rickshaw-game: Set in an open city, this tuk tuk rickshaw game puts you behind the wheel of an auto rickshaw. Your job is to complete pick and drop missions, moving passengers from one spot to another. You can choose from ten different rickshaws, each with lifelike controls and detailed interiors. City rides and a range of tuk tuk challenges keep the driving varied.

Movement is simple. Press W or the Up arrow to move forward, S or the Down arrow to move back, and A or Left and D or Right to move left and right. Use the mouse to click any button. The game runs smoothly and features detailed 3D graphics, with environments that look great and pull you into the action.
car-parking-simulator-offline: Car Parking Simulator Offline is a 3D adventure that mixes parking challenges with school driving simulation. It presents itself as a 2025 parking jam title and begins with easy setups before moving on to tricky puzzles. As you advance, you must squeeze through tight spaces and steer around obstacles along the way.

Some parking attempts take place in adverse weather, which adds another layer of difficulty. You can play with mobile controls or on a keyboard, where W or the Up arrow moves you forward, S or the Down arrow sends you backward, A or the Left arrow moves you left, and D or the Right arrow moves you right.
car-stunt-racing-3d: In this racing title, you pilot powerful race cars across a series of tracks where speed and skill go head to head. Nitro boosts help you overtake rivals, and sharp drifts through corners let you protect your lead. Dodge obstacles, collect turbo boosts, and keep your position in this high-speed run.

The handling feels smooth, and the challenges keep every race engaging from the first corner to the final stretch. You play with simple mouse clicks or taps, so getting started takes only moments. Expect a fast, constant rush of speed from start to finish.
army-truck-driving-game: Take the wheel of a military transport truck in this offline driving game, which blends 3D visuals with adventure, action, and simulation. You play as an army truck driver on missions where the roads are dangerous, so every turn calls for care. Driving through snow adds an extra challenge, and steady, careful driving is the way to get through.

Steering is simple. Use W or the Up Arrow to move forward, S or the Down Arrow to move back, and A or the Left Arrow and D or the Right Arrow to move left and right. Buttons on screen are clicked with the mouse. Fans of truck, car, and simulator games will find plenty to handle in this army driving experience.
toco-teens-halloween-party: Toca Teens Halloween Party is a spooky dress-up game built for anyone who loves fashion. You help the Toca teens prepare for the most glamorous Halloween celebration of the year. Your job is to pick out outfits that feel eerie but still elegant, along with haunting accessories and bold makeup looks. Mix these pieces together to find a look that is both creepy and chic.

Everything is controlled with a simple left mouse button click, so you can make your choices with ease. Browse the options, click the ones you like, and see each teen's style come together. The game is a fun way to explore dark, glamorous fashion while getting ready for the big night.
slime-farm: Slime Farm is a laid-back but hard-to-put-down game in which you steer a suction truck and hoover up wild slimes, converting each one into money. You glide across sticky, gooey fields and suck up slimes with careful timing. Once you have gathered a load, you sell it to improve your truck and grow your farm into a large slime kingdom.
Move with the W, A, S, and D keys or the arrow keys, or hold the left mouse button and drag to get around.
human-playground: Human Playground: Battle Arena puts you in charge of a fighter who must land hits on precise spots of an opponent's body. Each move needs some thought, because every strike is meant to break and crush your rival. Instead of swinging wildly, you plan your attacks and watch how your enemy responds. All the action takes place in one arena.

The coins you earn can be spent to unlock new characters or improve your skills. Controls are simple: click with a mouse, or tap the screen on a touch device, to play. Keep experimenting with your attacks and you'll get a better feel for the battlefield.
balloon-shooter-archery-game: This archery title puts you behind a bow, where you aim and fire arrows at balloons drifting through the air. Your aim, accuracy, and quickness all get a workout as you try to burst as many balloons as you can. Blending old-school arcade enjoyment with contemporary shooting systems, it offers an immersive experience for players of every age.

Each stage grows harder than the last, and every level brings its own curveballs, barriers, and unexpected turns that call for quick thinking and planning. Grab your virtual bow, take careful aim, and let your arrows fly toward the
dandys-world-marathon: Dandys World Marathon is a single-player, hypercasual arcade runner. You control characters you may already know from Dandys World as they move through odd, unusual stages. Your job is to gather the mysterious black droplets placed throughout each course.

Controls are simple: tap the screen to make your runner jump or turn. You must collect every droplet on a level before you can finish it, so keep an eye out for them. Watch your step, because obstacles and chasms are waiting, and those chasms never rest. As you play, you can find new characters to run with.
car-parking-3d-pro: Car Parking 3D Pro is a lifelike driving simulator set in 3D. You take the wheel of different vehicles and test your skills at driving and parking them. Three modes are on offer: Arrival, Parking, and Truck, so you can pick the style of challenge you want.

Your goal in tight lots is to show what you can do behind the wheel. Steer through a range of obstacles until you reach your destination. Be careful with the gas and brake, since a collision means you fail. To play, just use a mouse click or tap.
iconic-halloween-costumes: Iconic Halloween Costumes is a spooky-meets-stylish dress-up game for one player. You help three best friends choose their ideal Halloween looks. The options range from a regal Glinda style and outfits inspired by Bridgerton to bold Beetlejuice-influenced looks and cowgirl-chic designs.
Mix and match tops, bottoms, accessories, and makeup to build each costume from the ground up. Use your mouse on a desktop, or tap the screen on a mobile device, to make your selections.
blow-king: Blow King is a silly 3D clicker with arcade fun, physics-based action, and plenty of timing challenges. Its premise is that sickness sneaks in through the mouth, so you'll want to puff with plenty of force to clear the way.

Every level throws up a new spread of tasty-looking foods, yet the golden rule is to leave them alone and never take a bite, no matter how tempting they look. Playing is simple: just click with your mouse or tap to get going.
super-football-fever: Super Football Fever packs quick, fast-moving football matches into short rounds. You can pass the ball, take a shot at goal, and tackle opponents, and you can also challenge friends to local duels. Expect a lively, no-holds-barred kind of contest, since there is no referee around to blow the whistle.

Playing is straightforward: just click the mouse or tap the screen to control the action. Whether you're looking for a quick match on your own or a head-to-head challenge with a friend, the pace stays brisk from kickoff to the final whistle.
battery-run-3d: In Battery Run 3D, you guide a small battery down a racing track. Dodge dangerous obstacles along the way and grab energy pickups to build up your charge. Your goal is to reach the finish line so the device you're powering can switch on. The lanes move quickly, so you'll need sharp reflexes to keep going.

This arcade title runs in 3D and works on phones as well as computers. Controls are simple: a mouse click or a tap is all you need. Tagged for collection, running, and touch play, it puts quick reactions at the center of every run.
car-and-truck-parking-game: Step behind the wheel of either a regular car or a huge truck in this parking title. The simulation aims for a lifelike feel and lets you test your driving with both kinds of vehicle. Each session offers a complete driving experience packed into one game, and it is easy to keep coming back for more.

Success depends on accuracy, calm nerves, and steady control. Your aim is to line up your vehicle neatly in its space while steering clear of obstacles. Work through dozens of levels that grow harder as you go. Move forward with W or the Up Arrow, reverse with S or the Down Arrow, and steer with A and D or the Left and Right Arrows. Use the mouse to press any button.
deer-hunting-jungle-game: Deer Hunting Jungle Game is an adventure built around hunting animals in the wild. It is designed as a realistic hunting simulator, with settings full of wildlife and a focus on sharpening your sniper aim. Players can roam through lush green woodlands and thick tropical jungles, whether they are experienced marksmen or newcomers eager to explore the animals that live there.

Movement uses either the W, A, S, and D keys or the arrow keys. W or Up moves you forward, S or Down moves you back, A or Left moves you left, and D or Right moves you right. Any buttons on screen are selected with the mouse.
black-pink-halloween-concert: Get ready to dress up a group of K-Pop stars for a Halloween show with a haunted twist. Your job is to pick outfits for the performers, with choices that include costumes that are creepy yet adorable, along with bold hairstyles and festive accessories. Every pick helps the members look their best when they take the stage.

Everything in this game is handled with the left mouse button, so each choice comes down to a single click. Its tags point to cute visuals, fashion, Halloween fun, and dress-up play. Mix and match different looks until the performance styling feels just right.
modern-bus-driving-game: Step aboard a modern bus in this simulation game, where you sit behind the wheel of a lifelike, absorbing vehicle. Your route might lead through busy city streets, up winding hill roads, or across rough off-road ground. You can pick from several contemporary bus models, finish each assigned route, and carry passengers safely to where they need to go. Expect crowded traffic in some stretches and scenic highways in others, since each level offers its own style of driving.

Controls are simple. Press W or the Up Arrow to move forward, S or the Down Arrow to move back, A or the Left Arrow to move left, and D or the Right Arrow to move right. Use your mouse to click any button on screen.
mega-car-stunt-game: Mega Car Stunt Game is a racing title where you drive your way up to the top of the Mega Ramp. Its sharp 3D visuals and engaging gameplay are designed to hold your attention for hours. The stunt driving aims to feel true to life as you launch from one ramp to the next, pushing your skills to their limits.

Move forward with W or the Up Arrow, back with S or the Down Arrow, left with A or the Left Arrow, and right with D or the Right Arrow. Use your mouse to click any button. The original also names several similar stunt titles and claims that some players find those less fun.
food-jam: Food Jam is a puzzle game built around sorting. Your job is to move fruits, vegetables, and drinks into the correct takeout carts. The title offers more than 500 levels, and as you progress you open new themes, including desserts and juices. Special power-ups help you break through difficult jams so your customers stay satisfied. The game is played in 3D and mixes in match-3 style gameplay.
Controls are simple: a single tap is all you need, which makes it easy to pick up and play in short bursts. It suits casual players who want a relaxed, satisfying challenge without complicated input.
hero-transform-run: Hero Transform Run is a 3D adventure game in which a superhero steadily gathers energy by changing and improving again and again. Once a level comes to an end, the hero must swiftly overcome several different foes. It is a casual mix of combat and parkour, so it feels light and relaxed to play.

The whole experience uses one input: a mouse click or a tap. Fans of superhero adventures, running games, and battle titles should find something to enjoy here. Each run is built around powering up and then facing the enemies waiting at the stage's close.
city-police-car-chase-game: Step into a city where you take the wheel of a patrol vehicle. This police driving simulator lets you roam the streets, race after suspects at high speed, and tackle a range of missions. If you enjoy pursuits, careful parking, or simply cruising without a set route, there is plenty to try. You handle powerful law enforcement cars and work your way up to becoming the top cop in town.

Your jobs include going after criminals, completing missions, and mastering parking challenges that demand accuracy. The detailed open world is yours to explore freely between objectives. Drive with W, A, S and D or the arrow keys to move forward, left, back and right, and use the mouse to click any button.
bottle-rush-3d: Bottle Rush 3D is an arcade game where you guide a matryoshka, the traditional nesting doll, through each level. To pass a level, you must match its colour, so you need to watch closely. The game is in 3D, carries action and adventure tags, and is listed for mobile play. It may have origins in Russia, though that is not certain.
Controls are simple: a mouse click or a tap is all you need. Keep your eyes open and keep moving forward. Good luck to everyone who tries it.
racing-bulldozer: Racing Bulldozer is a 3D racing game where you take the controls of a bulldozer and push your way down the track. The main goal is to gather gravel, which clears the road ahead and helps your sandballs grow larger than those of the other players. It is a wild take on car-style racing, and the race itself is presented as the best way to find skilled operators.
Steering is handled with a joystick, so moving your bulldozer around the course feels direct. Your aim is to outdo the competition and earn the title of Bulldozer Master.
kick-the-chicken: Our fragile little hen can't travel far on her own, so she needs you to build up as much momentum as possible. Swing with full force to send her soaring across the farm, aiming for the longest flight she can manage. This hypercasual 2D arcade title is a bird-launching game with a flight theme, adventure elements, and an endless format where you chase a high score.

Every chicken in the game dreams of flying far away, and your hits help make that dream real. You can play with a mouse or by touch. Keep an eye on how far your hen travels and see whether you can beat your own best result.
save-pilot-ryan: Pilot Ryan needs your help to stay in the air. A steady stream of missiles comes his way, and your job is to steer his plane through dangerous skies and avoid every deadly collision. Quick reactions and sharp focus matter most, since the pressure keeps building as the battle goes on. Will you bring Ryan to safety, or will the missile onslaught bring him down?
Steering takes only a moment to learn. Click and drag to change the direction of the plane. Push your reflexes as far as they go and aim for the highest score you can reach.
pickle-ball-clash: Pickle Ball Clash is a quick sports game where every round rewards skill, speed, and strategy. You can give your character a personal look and unlock stronger paddles as you progress. Climb the competitive ladder, starting with casual matches in the backyard and working up to professional leagues.

Along the way, you can land clean winners or try flashy trick shots, and the court belongs to you. The controls are simple: swipe a longer distance to send the ball far across the court, and swipe a shorter distance to hit it close to you.
prado-car-parking-game: Prado Car Parking Game is a realistic simulator made for fans of luxury cars and players who enjoy demanding parking tests. Parking is the main goal here rather than open-ended driving. Success comes from careful technique, good timing, and steady control as you guide your favorite Prado models through a wide range of parking challenges.

You move your car with the keyboard. Press W or the Up Arrow to move forward, S or the Down Arrow to move back, and A or the Left Arrow to move left. Use D or the Right Arrow to move right. Any on-screen buttons are operated by clicking with the mouse.
slidex: In SlideX, you guide a sleek cube left and right, timing each move so it slips through the dashed lines. Solid blocks are the obstacles to dodge, and one wrong move ends the run. The pace picks up with every cut, so you need to stay focused, react quickly, and keep your rhythm. The instructions say to cut the ropes and never hit a solid block.

The game has a minimalist look that is easy to pick up but takes real skill to master, and it tests both your reflexes and your accuracy. Controls are simple, with one tap for each quick shift to the left or right. Slicing through dashed lines earns points, so every clean cut counts toward your score.
tactical-conquest: Tactical Conquest is a 3D arcade game that mixes casual play with defense-style strategy. Your aim is to seize the ground your opponent holds by planning clever moves. Rather than simply reacting, you need to anticipate the rival's next step so you can claim spots that give you a greater advantage. In the end, the strongest side is the one that wins.
Getting started is quick and simple. Just click with your mouse or tap the screen to play, so the controls stay easy to pick up from the first moment.
soda-block-jam: Soda Block Jam offers a fresh take on traditional puzzle games. Each colorful level challenges you to steer soda crates with continuous swipes, gathering soda bottles and carrying them to the exits they belong to.

Swipe a crate and it will travel in any direction you pick. While it moves, it gathers every bottle matching its own color. Bottles of other colors, along with other crates, can block its path, so think ahead. Once the crate is full, it leaves through the gate that matches its color.
long-neck: Long Neck is a 3D arcade game with a casual, running style. The goal is to stretch the character's neck as high as possible. You do this by picking up rings that match the character's own color, and the more of them you gather, the better your final result will be.

Play with a mouse click or a tap. Keep an eye on the colors as you move, since rings in any other shade won't help your height. Aim to collect as many matching rings as you can and see how high the neck can reach.
cowboy-runners-dash: Cowboy Runners Dash is a 3D arcade runner that sends you racing through subway tunnels and busy city streets. You dodge oncoming trains, vault over barriers, and collect coins along the way. You can also upgrade your power-ups as you go.
Controls are simple, with touch on a phone or tablet and the keyboard on a computer. To begin, click the mouse or tap the screen. The challenge is to see how far you can run.
truck-delivery-simulator: Truck Delivery Simulator is a 3D racing game about driving a big truck. Your main job is to keep the cargo on board, because anything that falls off is gone. The clock never stops, so you are always racing against time. Even so, this should not feel too difficult for most players.

Getting started is simple. Click or tap with your mouse to begin, then use the W, A, S, and D keys to control your truck's movement. Whether you enjoy truck driving, car games, or a good race against the timer, this one gives you a direct way to test your focus and steady handling.
precise-shooting: Precise Shooting is a 3D arcade basketball game with a casual feel. Your job is to line up each throw carefully so the ball drops through the hoop. Every level asks you to sink a shot into every basket, so steady aim matters more than speed.
Mistakes are costly here. If you miss twice, the level restarts from the beginning, so you need to stay focused. Controls are simple: click with your mouse or tap to play.
merge-archers-bow-and-arrow: Find the right angle, draw the bow, and release the arrow in Merge Archers Bow and Arrow, a 3D shooting game. Careful planning helps you grow your army, so think about each move before you fire. Keep an eye on the enemy, because they will try to wipe out your soldiers if you let them gain the upper hand.

The game is controlled entirely with mouse clicks or taps. Every shot gives you a chance to strengthen your ranks, and each decision on the battlefield matters. Stay sharp and strike the foe before they can overwhelm your troops.
thief-stick-puzzle-man-escape: Thief Stick Puzzle: Man Escape blends silly stick figure humor with puzzle levels that make you think. You control a crafty stickman burglar who keeps landing in sticky spots and has to get out of each one. Staying alive means working out clever brain teasers. In one case you might trace the right route through a maze to grab a stash of treasure, and in another you have to get past a cutting machine to rescue a puppy. Expect the escapes to keep you occupied for a good few hours.
You play by clicking with the mouse or tapping the screen.
passing-master-3d: Passing Master 3D is a casual 3D arcade running game with a basketball theme. Your goal is to complete the obstacle course from start to finish. Along the way you will find items on the track, but only the useful ones are worth collecting, since they enhance your skills. Each level brings new obstacles, so whether you reach the end depends entirely on you.

space-shooter-war: Space Shooter War is a classic arcade shooter where you take the controls of a spaceship. coral-adventure: Coral Adventure is a hypercasual game that sends a charming Barbee fish on an underwater trip past obstacles, bubbles, and coral reefs. Your aim is to guide it through narrow openings and steer clear of the hazardous bars ahead, all while seeing how far you can get in one run.

numeral-crawl: A cheerful young witch races through enchanted lands full of danger and mystery. endless-fall: Endless Fall is a puzzle game in which a ball drops without end, and your task is to guide it safely as it goes. Along the way, you will encounter tricky obstacles that must be shifted, turned, and placed just right to open the route. Quick reactions help, but planning ahead matters too, since the game asks for accurate timing and clever thinking.

Each level speeds up and becomes more demanding than the last. To play, slide or tap on the screen to move and rotate the objects. Fans of ball games, brain teasers, and logic puzzles should find plenty here to test their focus.
euro-truck-driving-simulator: Take the wheel of a powerful truck and head out along motorways and winding mountain routes in this lifelike trucking game. royal-match-tile-family: Royal Match Tile Family is a brain game that rewards careful thinking. It is more than a standard matching puzzle, since it blends logic, strategy, and quick decisions. tropical-tidy: Tropical Tidy is a casual puzzle game with a hypercasual feel, set in a sunny tropical paradise where fruit turns up everywhere. Your job is to bring order to the mess by sorting, matching, and organizing colorful fruits into their correct places before the board overflows.

runaway-the-truck: Runaway The Truck is a racing game that is light and easy to start, yet it still offers a good amount to see and do. transform-battle: Transform Battle is a 3D adventure game centered on Autobots. Your main job is to collect parts that let you upgrade your Autobots and help them evolve as you move along. Gathering enough of these pieces keeps your team growing for the challenges ahead.

parking: Parking Panic is a puzzle game that tests your reasoning across one hundred stages, and each one is tougher than the last. color-3d-bump-it-up: Color 3D Bump it Up is a hypercasual game for one player, and it leans heavily on running. mega-car-stunt-ramps-games: Sharpen your driving skills with this racing title, a set of carefully crafted stunt games. arcanoid-space-defense: Arcanoid Space Defense is an arcade game that takes the classic block-breaker and gives it a cosmic spin. little-bubu-fillz: Little Bubu Fillz is a calm puzzle game where each step you take counts. fashion-heroes-academy: Step into a school where fashion and superpowers mix. Three courageous young women have enrolled, hoping to discover what their abilities can do and to shape a personal look that feels like their own. Your job is to guide them through that journey.

fit-runner: Fit Runner is a racing game where your runner's body changes as you play. Every food item you collect adds to your shape, so you can make your character fat or fit almost instantly. kpop-puzzle-hunters: Kpop Puzzle Hunters takes its inspiration from the K-Pop Demon Hunters universe. Your task is to rebuild twelve images that feature Huntrix, the Saja Boys, and Derpy Tiger. people-tower: People Tower is a 3D arcade game with a hypercasual feel, and your goal is simple: reach the finish line. The route is full of obstacles, so you have to find ways around them. Along the way, gather people and add them to a tall pyramid that keeps growing as you go.

running-in-foam: This 3D arcade runner puts you in charge of a girl who runs through foam. Various bathing tools are there for you to use as you guide her, and you need to wash her successfully along the way. She wins the game once she has been cleaned and reaches the end.

You can combine outfits, accessories and crowns to build the look of your own regal character, then enjoy a magical story set in a fairy tale world. Along the way, interactive activities keep things lively, and you can shape your own castle tale while wandering through every room.

There are plenty of outfits and items to choose from, ranging from elegant gowns to sparkling accessories, so you can get your princess ready for different occasions. Set her against stunning scenes, customize her appearance to your liking, and explore the whole kingdom. The game also encourages young players to use their imagination as they picture and design their perfect princess characters.
motorcycle-stunt-racing-2025: Motorcycle Stunt Racing 2025 is a fast arcade bike racer where you lean, boost, and fly off ramps. Races take you through a city, a canyon, and a coastline, with jumps that get bigger and tricks that can be linked into longer combos as you weave between cars. The stunt system puts tricks first, so you chain manuals and flips and slingshot out of the action while the weather shifts and rush-hour traffic gets in the way.

You can pick Career, Trick Attack, Time Trial, or 8-player Online Freestyle. Leaderboards track your best runs against ghost racers, and weekly events give you new goals to chase. Customize your bike with performance parts, liveries, and neon trails. To drive, use the W, A, S, and D keys.
long-nails: This 3D hypercasual arcade game asks only that you move your mouse to steer your character left and right. As you go, you collect resources scattered across the field, and you work on increasing the length of your nails.
Your goal is to stretch those nails far enough to reach the finish line and earn the maximum reward. It is a casual experience that you start with a mouse click or a tap.
sweet-paper-doll-dress-up-diy: Sweet Paper Doll: Dress Up DIY lets you enjoy the classic paper doll dress-up idea on your computer. You get a doll of your own, and each day you can pick new outfits that fit wherever she is heading next. Start by building a theme for your project, then shape the doll's appearance to match your vision. Select lovely garments and makeup, and give her a full makeover from head to toe.

Everything in the game is designed for hands-on creativity. As you play, you can unlock every item and steadily sharpen your design skills. Tags for this title include Dress Up and Makeover, and it sits in the Girls category.
pga-toons: PGA Toons unfolds in a colorful world built from blocks, where every spot can become a battleground and a well-timed leap might decide the round. It combines the feel of classic arena gunfights with fluid movement and responsive controls. You can run across rooftops, slide through narrow alleys, bounce off jump pads, and fire a jetpack to meet opponents in midair.

Whether you're holding on to a lead in Team Deathmatch or dashing for the flag at the last second, the action stays sharp, easy to read, and charmingly cartoonish. Click to shoot, aim, and change your gun as needed, and press Tab to open the menu.
pga3-zombie: PGA3 Zombie puts you in a voxel world where waves of zombies keep coming. You can hold the line or join the horde, and you can play alone or team up with three others in 4-player co-op. Rounds are quick and the zombies never seem to stop, so you will need to board up openings, upgrade your guns, and trigger traps on the map. Earning cash lets you buy perks, while craftable gear gives you more ways to fight back.

Watch out for the deadly traps spread across the map, and expect boss fights to grow more intense as the waves escalate. Controls are simple: click the mouse to shoot, and move it to aim. Press Tab to return to the menu whenever you need to step away.
travel-with-me-asmr-edition: Lisa is a fashion-loving vlogger, and in this game you get to pick her looks as she travels the globe. Each stop calls for its own style, so you choose outfits that suit the place she is visiting. Your first destination is the peaceful temples of Thailand, followed by the deserts of Dubai and the tropical beaches of the Maldives. Use the mouse on a computer, or tap the screen on a phone or tablet, to get started.

Every trip is a chance to test your sense of style and put together memorable outfits for different occasions. The game is for one player and runs in the browser with HTML5, so there is nothing to install. Mix and match pieces, dress Lisa for each new scene, and see how each look fits the setting.
bloons-battles: In Bloons Battles, you face off against monkeys and a crowd of colored balloons. Your skill is put to the test as you try to pop every balloon on the current level. Each level you clear unlocks the next, so you can work your way through the whole set.

Lining up each shot takes care, since you must steer clear of obstacles and still hit the target. Aiming and firing work with a mouse or with touch, so you can use whichever suits you. Have fun trying to clear every level.
army-of-soldiers: In this shooting game called Army of Soldiers: Worlds War, Earth is under attack from creatures arriving from other worlds. The invaders have begun spreading across the planet, and their goal is to wipe out every human being. Your task is to defend the planet and hold back their advance.

Humanity's final hope rests on a huge cannon named ALPHA DESTRUCTOR 1. It is a powerful weapon designed to destroy the invaders and bring the war to an end, but it is not finished yet. You must protect this unfinished cannon from the invaders.
tomb-of-the-mask-color-maze: Tomb of the Mask Color Maze is a puzzle game that tests how many levels you can clear across its 25 mazes. Your task is to paint the whole maze while staying clear of the obstacles heading your way. Each level brings new twists, turns, and hazards, so the mazes become progressively harder to complete.
You can play with the arrow keys, or switch to your mouse or touch input if that suits you
breakit: BreakIt puts you in charge of a block that falls downward. Each floor has breakable platforms, so you smash your way through them while avoiding obstacles along the route. Your goal is to reach the bottom safely. This 3D adventure with arcade elements is made for one player and is a 2025 title.

Controls are simple, since a mouse click or a tap is all it takes to play. Whether you're on a desktop or a touchscreen, one input is enough to get started. Stay focused as you descend through the floors, clear the hazards in your path, and aim to finish your fall at the bottom in one piece.
lastwar-survival: A worldwide zombie outbreak has turned large numbers of people into the undead, and the world you knew is falling apart. You play as a survivor whose main aim is to keep your humanity while staying alive through the collapse. The game challenges you to see how long you can last in this apocalypse.
LastWar: Survival invites you into a gripping journey that combines survival with strategy, so the choices you make along the way matter. You can play with your mouse or by touch.
dontmove: DontMove is a 3D hypercasual game for one player, and its whole premise is tension: keep still. A non-player character keeps turning around, and if he looks over and spots you moving, the machine gunner standing beside him will shoot you dead. The challenge comes down to staying frozen while he watches.

Playing takes only a mouse click or a tap, so anyone can jump in right away. Its squid-game-style mood and suspenseful setup make every small motion feel risky. Fans of adventure games that test nerve may find it a gripping pick from the 2025 lineup.
card-quest-solitaire: Card Quest: Solitaire takes the familiar card game and gives it a fresh twist. Every choice on the table counts, so you will need to think ahead. The classic solitaire rules stay in place, while several visual themes let you change the look of your games. You can also pick from different scoring modes, which offer new ways to test your skill.

Whether you want a calm session or a run at the top score, the game suits both moods. Its controls feel smooth, and the backgrounds are attractive to look at. Since there is no limit on how many games you can play, you can keep returning to the cards whenever you like. To play, simply click with your mouse or tap the screen.
paws-off-my-clues: Dive into a set of distinct places packed with concealed objects and surprising puzzles to crack. You can wander from sunny seashores to the old ruins of Persia, and each spot feels alive as you dig for buried treasure. Cats roam around doing their own thing, bringing charm and humor to every scene, all while you sift through their cheerful clutter.
Pick a level from the colorful, rich
space-surfer: Space Surfer is a 3D arcade game that sends you racing through a fast hyperspace tunnel filled with bright light and color. Your goal is to survive the cosmic turmoil, avoid the hazards in your path, and collect as many rewards as you can, so you can earn a reputation as a legend of the vortex. The whole run is about staying alive while the high speed keeps you on edge.

Getting started is easy. Click or tap to begin, then click and drag with your mouse, or move your finger across a touchscreen, to glide your ship around the tunnel. Your ship follows your input instantly, so you can react quickly to whatever comes next.
aha-world-dream-town: Aha World Dream Town is a relaxed life simulation game you can play right in your browser. It suits fans of simulator titles as well as anyone who simply wants a calm break from everyday routines. The game lets you step into a world that feels nothing like your own daily life.

Expect a wide mix of places to explore, such as supermarkets, restaurants, shops, and a game center. Wander through a range of pleasant settings and design new characters along the way. Controls are simple: use a mouse click or a tap to play.
billiard-diamond-challenge: Billiard Diamond Challenge is a free browser game that suits both younger players and grown-ups. The aim is to pot every ball on the table except the white one. Along the way you can pick up blue diamonds, which help you unlock a new cue. You can pick between level mode and time mode, depending on the kind of challenge you prefer. Aiming and shooting are handled entirely with the mouse.
Expect a relaxed but focused round at the billiard table as you work out your angles and sharpen your skills. Each shot is a chance to clear more balls and gather the diamonds that open up new gear.
marble-zuma-shooter: Marble Zuma Shooter is a marble game where you fire colorful balls at a chain of marbles that keeps rolling along a track. Your goal is to line up shots so that three or more balls of the same color meet and disappear. The marbles keep moving toward the end of the track, so you need to clear them before they get there. The action is fast, and the levels are beautifully designed.

Controls are smooth and simple: tap to shoot. The puzzle is made for players of all ages and rewards quick reflexes and careful planning. Each stage is harder than the last, so the challenge keeps growing as you progress.
xtreme-good-and-bad-boys-2-2025: Two brothers who have drifted far apart find themselves on the same side. One wears a police badge, while the other has spent his life on the wrong side of the law. Their history is still unresolved, and to bring down a powerful drug cartel, they must face it together. Expect daring stunt sequences and plot turns you won't see coming.
Controls are simple. W, A, S and D let you walk and run, and the mouse handles both firing and aiming. Press Tab to switch between your guns, and the same key also opens the menu.
terminal-master-bus-tycoon: You run a bus depot that starts as a modest stop and grows into a worldwide transport empire. Your job is to expand stations, add more buses to the fleet, and hire staff to keep everything moving. Each upgrade improves how well your operation works and how much money it brings in. Newer buses unlock over time, and they are quicker and more stylish than the ones you began with.

Earnings keep coming in while you are away from the screen, so there is no pressure to stay glued to it. The whole game is controlled with a single mouse click or tap. Your aim is to keep building until you hold the title of the number one bus tycoon on the planet.
pull-the-pin-fish-rescue: Pull the Pin: Fish Rescue is a calming puzzle game with plenty of clever challenges to work through. Each puzzle shows several niches divided by partitions. A fish sits in one niche, while water waits in another. Your job is to study the layout closely and decide which pin to pull. Once you pull it, the partition opens and the water can reach the fish.
You control the game with your mouse or by swiping across the screen. Take your time, look at every detail, and plan your moves carefully so the water gets to the fish.
pga1: Pixel Gun Apocalypse 1, also called PGA1, is a first-person shooter with chunky pixel visuals and fast online matches. Players hop onto various servers and compete in familiar formats such as Team Deathmatch and Free for All. Your arsenal spans pistols, rifles, and long-range sniper weapons, so quick reactions and careful planning both matter if you want to last.

The blocky, voxel-based environments look a lot like Minecraft, yet the focus stays on intense, adrenaline-charged firefights. You can take on the role of a soldier or put your aim to the test against zombies. Move with W, A, S, and D, use the mouse to shoot and aim, and press Tab to open the menu.
rocket-adventure: Rocket Adventure sends you toward the stratosphere in a game built around physics. Your goal is to get your rocket as high into orbit as you can. You only need a few taps to decide when each stage of the rocket separates. Each good launch rewards you with in-game currency, which you can use to buy new parts and different looks for your ship.
The game is a single-player clicker with a flight theme, and you play it with your mouse or by touching the screen.
jellymerge: JellyMerge is a 3D puzzle game where you slide the screen to push jelly blocks of the same color together until they fuse. A level is only finished once every block of that color has been combined, so each move needs some thought.
The game includes several finely designed levels, each one a fresh test for your mind. It is a single-player casual title, and you play with a simple mouse click or tap.
neon-ball-slope: Neon Ball Slope is an arcade game for anyone who enjoys sliding down slopes. You guide a glowing neon ball down a three-dimensional incline that never ends. Quick reactions, careful positioning, and a feel for the physics all matter. The track starts gently, then grows steeper and trickier, so you need to stay alert the whole time.

Coins you collect can be spent on upgrades, enhancement packs, and stronger gear. Experience points raise your level, improve drop rates, and open special chests containing unique equipment. You can also complete missions, compete on daily leaderboards, and aim for the highest score you can reach. The neon visuals and ranked competition give you plenty of reasons to keep rolling.
Controls: Use the left and right arrow keys to move sideways. On mobile, tap the left or right side of the screen to move in that direction.
pin-away-puzzle-tap-it-out: Pin Away Puzzle: Tap It Out is a puzzle game built around logic and problem solving. Each stage offers a new test, and the pin layouts vary from level to level, so every board looks different. You clear pins by tapping them, and the simple motion stays relaxed while still rewarding careful thought. Planning ahead and clearing the board with precision is the heart of the game.

Pins come in several shapes, and some are blocked by others, so you need to consider each move before you make it. The game works well if you want a calm break or a way to sharpen your thinking. It blends tactics with a peaceful pace, which makes it suited to quiet, focused sessions.
hexamatch: HexaMatch is a number puzzle game in the Puzzles category, with tags for logic and matching. Your goal is to get every number back into the right order. The board has just one empty slot, so each move means sliding a neighboring tile into that gap. You can tap a tile or swipe it to make the move. Keep shifting tiles around until the whole sequence is correct.

The difficulty rises as you go, and the game mixes its puzzles with a fresh take on classic number games. It suits players of any age who want to sharpen their thinking or simply unwind. Expect a simple setup that still takes some careful planning to solve.
2048-space-mission: 2048 Space Mission is a number puzzle game inspired by the 2048 format, with a 3D look and math-based gameplay. Players work through a large set of demanding levels and try to complete them all. Each level has its own mission, so the challenges vary from one stage to the next.

Coins gathered along the way can be used to unlock new game boards. Alternatively, a hammer can be used to get rid of discs. Follow the game instructions to learn how everything works before you start.
zippy-bird: Guide Zippy through the gaps between pipes in this fast-paced arcade game. Each tap or click makes the bird flap, so timing matters as you steer past every obstacle. The rules are easy to grasp, but getting really good takes practice.

Your goal is to keep the bird flying without hitting the pipes, because one collision ends your run. The longer you survive, the higher your score climbs. It is a one-player game and it can be played on Android devices.
3d-puzzle: This puzzler is entertaining and hard to put down. It takes place on a 3D isometric grid made of tiles. Your goal is to uncover a hidden route that lets you clear every stage. Guide your character from one isometric block to the next. Each yellow tile drops downward the moment you step off it, so plan your moves carefully.

A stage is complete only when every yellow tile has dropped to the ground and your character is standing on the purple block. Controls are simple: click with a mouse, tap the screen, or swipe across it to play.
pga4: PGA4 is a first-person shooter that pairs fast combat with blocky pixel graphics. You can jump into intense multiplayer battles against other players online, choose from a range of powerful weapons, and test your skills in survival arenas. Whether you fight as a soldier or a zombie, you will need careful strategy and good aim to come out on top.

Controls are easy to pick up. Click or tap to play, and use the W, A, S, and D keys to walk around. The game is designed to feel smooth and responsive, with plenty of adrenaline-fueled action packed into every match.
cool-girl-aesthetics: Mia wants a trendy look, and you help her build it in this browser dress-up game. Start with her Stanley cup, where you can choose bright colors, prints, and accessories. Next, turn to her headphones and give them a one-of-a-kind feel. Then work on her nails, adding cool shades, rings, and temporary tattoos for a sharp finish.

Once those pieces are done, you can complete the style with makeup choices such as face stickers, colorful braces, and more. This makeover title offers plenty of aesthetic combinations to explore. Your goal is to leave Mia with a look people will remember. Use your mouse on a desktop, or tap the screen to play on a mobile device.
asmr-makeover-and-makeup-studio: Step into a space where beauty and imagination meet. In this makeover game, you work on a virtual model and give her a brand-new appearance. What makes it stand out is its use of ASMR, which blends relaxation with a lively sense of fun.

Begin with skin care, where you can pamper your doll's complexion with a range of products until it has a bright, glossy finish. Then move on to makeup, choosing from many styles and colors to shape whatever look you have in mind. Fans of dress-up and makeover games should feel right at home here.
mysterious-elevator: You are locked inside a skyscraper with 100 floors, and its sarcastic ruler, the Keeper of Numbers, is a master of mathematical riddles. The only way out is to solve logic challenges while an old, creaky elevator carries you downward.

Swap number and sign blocks to assemble equations, and face extra puzzles along the way. Floors range from simple arithmetic to tricky logic traps, and one mistake could crash the elevator. Each solution brings you closer to freedom
hill-racer-2d: Hill Racer 2D puts you behind the wheel of a car driving over hilly terrain. Your goal is to keep the vehicle balanced so it doesn't flip, and to reach the finish before your fuel runs out. The tracks are challenging, so timing and control matter as you climb and descend the slopes.

On a computer, press A and D or the left and right arrow keys to control the car. On mobile, use the brake and gas buttons shown on the screen. This single-player arcade racer is a 2D take on driving that rewards careful balance.
cuteslicesball: In CuteSlicesBall, you arrange slices of different shapes into the circular containers around them. A level is cleared only after every slice has been placed. The game has several levels, and each one calls for a sharp mind, so it suits anyone who enjoys a good brain teaser.

Controls are simple: use a mouse click or a tap. It is a single player puzzle game with a casual feel. Think about how each shape fits before you place it, and see how far your little brain can carry you through the levels.
connect-em-all: Connect Em All is a colorful browser puzzle where you link dots to finish each board. Every level asks you to join all the dots that share a color, and the idea is easy to grasp. Things get tougher as the boards grow larger and more tangled, so you will need to think ahead and plan your paths carefully to get through them.

The game runs for free in your web browser and is controlled entirely with the mouse. Just click and drag to draw your connections from one dot to its matching partner. It is a relaxing brain teaser for anyone who likes working through tidy, colorful problems one level at a time.
dr-parking-2: Dr. Parking 2 is a hypercasual car simulator built around parking. You take the wheel of several different kinds of vehicles and steer them through a parking lot full of obstacles, turning corners as needed until you bring your car into the marked space. Collecting keys along the way is part of the challenge, so watch for them as you drive.
Every level checks your accuracy, your patience, and your sense of how a car moves. The game is aimed at players who enjoy a real driving test. You control everything with mouse clicks or taps.
match-factory: Match Factory is a calm, never-ending casual puzzle game built around matching triples. You wander through a bright factory filled with lively objects and take on the job of a skilled matcher. Your task is to line up three identical objects so they vanish from the board, box them up, and help the production line keep humming along.

Each stage has a uniquely designed layout, with tricky arrangements and challenges to work through. When a puzzle gets stubborn, you can call on power-ups to get past it. Controls are simple: just click with your mouse or tap to play.
guess-words-fast: Solve each puzzle by working out the word hidden behind its clues while the clock keeps moving. Every correct answer earns points, which adds a friendly competitive edge. Your vocabulary and thinking skills get a workout as you go, and the quick pace keeps things lively from start to finish.

Controls are easy to learn: click with your mouse or tap the screen to play. You can try to beat your own previous scores or challenge friends and family to see who gets the highest total. The shifting pace of the game keeps each round feeling fresh.
vowels-vs-consonants: Vowels Vs Consonants is an educational title that gives kids and new English learners a playful way to tell vowels from consonants. In every round, a random letter appears on screen, and you must pick the correct label before time runs out. Regular practice like this can sharpen memory, quicken your reactions, and build confidence with the English alphabet.

Playing is simple. On a computer, use your mouse to click the "Vowel" or "Consonant" option. On a mobile device, tap the matching choice on the screen. The rounds keep coming, so there is always another letter to identify and plenty of learning to enjoy.
eastern-star-vs-city-style-icon: Step into a blend of old eastern palaces and busy modern city streets. Two lovely heroines await you: an oriental beauty dressed in elegant clothes inspired by an Ottoman fairy tale, and a trendy city fashionista strutting down runways in a big town. You take on the role of stylist, shaping a distinctive look for each girl through dress-up, hair, and makeover fun.

At the center of the game is a cultural dispute, and you decide which side to back, then see that choice come to life. Controls are simple: use a mouse click on a computer, or tap the screen on a touch device.
retrohero-the-last-stand: Step into a legendary world of pixels, where ancient guardians rise to defend their realm from invaders. You play the chosen defender, facing endless waves of alien forces, merciless robots, and demon creatures that all want to seize your land. You fight with mystical powers and storied relics, so every encounter tests your skill and your will to survive.

The game mixes bright, old-school pixel graphics with fast-paced action and a clash between myth and science fiction. You must adapt, crush your foes, and show that the ancient spirit can hold out against any outside threat. Move with the left, up, right, and down keys, and use the A and S keys as well. The fate of the world is in your hands.
pretty-sheep-run: Pretty Sheep Run is a light arcade game where you steer a cute little sheep that keeps dashing across platforms that never seem to end. Your job is to keep it moving while dodging the dangerous traps along the way. As the sheep runs, you aim its shots at numbered doors. Hitting a door changes its number into a positive value, which boosts your gun's damage, attack speed, and other stats.
The game is easy to pick up. Just click or tap to play, and let the sheep do the running while you focus on lining up your shots and staying out of harm's way.
drag-race-x: Drag Race X puts you behind the wheel for quick runs on long, straight tracks where skill decides the outcome. It is a single-player racing title that covers cars, monster trucks, motocross bikes, and trucks. Each race is a short sprint in fully three-dimensional drag racing, shown with realistic graphics that make every launch
mr-hero: Mr Hero is a puzzle game built around a super hero with plenty of power to spare. Your task is to defeat deadly enemies by using those abilities. When opponents block your way, you can lift them, burn them, or freeze them. Nothing stops you from pursuing justice, and your team of heroes is ready to back you up.
Controls are handled entirely with the mouse or touch, so there is nothing complicated to learn before you begin. The title blends action, fighting and puzzle elements into one package.
back-to-school-uniforms-edition: Back to School: Uniforms Edition is a single-player dress-up game for girls that takes you through school clothing from around the world. Spin the wheel to unlock uniforms inspired by Japan, the United States, the United Kingdom, India, France, and South Korea. Each one comes with its own outfits, accessories, and hairstyles drawn from that culture, so you can build a varied look for your character.

As you browse the designs, you'll see how school dress changes from one country to the next and sharpen your eye for style. Seven uniform styles are waiting to be found, and you may end up with a clear favorite. On a desktop, use your mouse to play, or tap the screen on a mobile device.
btc-clicker: Every press on the Bitcoin adds to your total, and you can spend that total on upgrades such as an autoclicker or a boost to the amount earned per click. Milestones also unlock as you go, including reaching 100 Bitcoin, so there is always a new target to chase. The game is controlled entirely with mouse clicks or taps, so there is nothing to learn beyond pressing the coin and choosing your upgrades.

It fits neatly into the clicker and idle category, with tags for clicking and idle play. Whether you want to build up slowly or push for the next achievement, the goal is simple: keep clicking and watch the count climb.
screw-nuts-bolts-wood-solve: Solve a wood-based puzzle built around nuts and bolts, designed to give your IQ and brain power a workout. It suits people who enjoy hardware-themed challenges and fresh, inventive gameplay.

To begin, tap to take out the nuts and bolts that hold wooden plates fixed to the board, so the plates drop down in a cascade. The nuts and bolts are arranged in tricky ways that will test your cleverness. Your goal is to work out the right order for removing them so every wood plate falls.
dead-zone15165: Dead Zone is a light 2D shooter where a lone survivor faces waves of zombies in a cartoon-style world. It is made for instant play in the browser. You dodge the undead and shoot back as they come, all with simple one-button mechanics. The game suits quick reflexes and short sessions, and it runs smoothly even on low-end devices.
Move with WASD or ZQSD, and hold Shift to run. Left click to shoot, press R to reload, P to pause, and I to restart. If your mouse gets stuck, press Tab to recover mouse control.
tapsync-blocks: TapSync Blocks is a hypercasual arcade game that tests how quickly and accurately you can react. A moving color travels toward the block sitting in the middle, and you need to click when the two line up. Each correct match adds points to your score, but one bad tap costs you a life. Every round starts you off with just three lives, so each move matters.

As the game speeds up, staying focused and keeping everything in sync becomes harder. This is a single-player title with blocky visuals. The rule is simple: click when the matching block is nearby, and avoid tapping too early or too late.
sky-bus-mega-ramp-drive: Sky Bus Mega Ramp Drive is a racing game built around big bus stunts on very tall ramps. You take the wheel of huge buses and push them hard as you tackle steep sky-high ramps, looping courses, and tracks that seem to ignore gravity. Your aim is to master the mega bus and pull off stunts far above the clouds. Leap across massive gaps, roar through vertical loops, and conquer some of the most extreme ramps you'll find.

The controls are simple. Use the arrow keys or WASD: Up or W accelerates, Down or S brakes or reverses, and Left or A and Right or D steer. Press Space Bar to activate the Nitro boost when you need extra speed for a big jump. Keep your bus on course across ramps, loops, and narrow sky roads while dodging obstacles.
fireegg: Take charge of a chicken that shoots bullets at obstacles coming from every direction. Each obstacle you break drops gold coins, so the more you smash, the more coins you collect. You can spend those coins to boost your firing rate, the damage your bullets deal, and how quickly your shots rotate. Controls are simple: click or tap to play.
It's a lot of fun, so jump in and see how far you can get with your upgrades.
rgb-shooter: RGB Shooter is a quick 2D action game built around matching colors, with plenty of arcade chaos. You switch between red, green, and blue bullets, and each one can only take out enemies of its own color. Your reflexes decide how long you last against waves of colorful attackers that never seem to end. Each level you gain makes the action faster and tougher.
When a fight gets heated, you can activate your Ulti ability
gun-match-screw: Gun Match Screw is a puzzle game split into levels, mixing screw-matching play with a firearm theme. Each stage shows a board shaped like a gun or one of its parts. To clear it, you must open every panel by pairing up colored screws, which appear on the board as bullets.

The game offers two modes, and both revolve around filling bullet magazines that hold six rounds each. When you line up bullets of one color and complete a magazine, it gets swapped for a fresh empty one. You also get five extra slots for storing bullets that don't match yet. Use the left mouse button to make your moves.
apple-worm-2: Apple Worm 2 is an arcade-style classic puzzle game with straightforward controls. You guide a small, adorable worm toward an apple, and each bite lets it grow stronger. The levels are tough enough to make you think hard, which is a big part of the appeal.

Upgrades unlock more cute skins for your worm to wear. Finishing challenges also brings rewards. Along the way you can unlock features such as Auto ATK and Summoning, with more to discover. Just click or tap with your mouse or finger to play.
wednesday-light-academia: In this single-player dress-up game, you take on the role of a talented stylist with a clear mission: give Wednesday Addams a complete makeover. She starts with a dark e-girl look, and your job is to turn her into a stunning, girly-girl fashionista. Along the way you explore makeup, hairstyling, and fashion-forward wardrobe choices, all in a casual, engaging setting.

Controls are simple. On a desktop, use your mouse to play. On a mobile device, tap the screen to play. Fans of beauty, fashion, and light academia style will find plenty to enjoy as they experiment with each part of the transformation.
help-sprunky: Help sprunky is a puzzle game that tests your wits and attentiveness from start to finish. Your job is to guide characters through levels filled with mazes, work out the problems in your path, and collect the important items needed to finish each stage. The difficulty runs high, but the controls are easy to pick up.

To move a character, tap and hold its head, then pull. When you let go, the head returns on its own to its starting position. Each level is packed with obstacles and traps, so you need to steer clear of them while heading for the item you need. Use a finger on a phone or a mouse on a PC.
cloneup-stack-yourself: In this side-scrolling pixel-art platformer, your best helper is a copy of yourself. Clones can be stacked into makeshift platforms that help you cross risky gaps, escape spikes, and climb toward the exit door. The reason you can make copies is never explained, yet this power sits at the heart of the game.

Each level asks you to reach the exit door using reflexes, logic, and clever clone placement. Move with A and D or the left and right arrows, jump with W, the up arrow, or Spacebar, and press F to create a clone. Press R to restart a level or P to return to the menu.
pixel-gun-apocalypse-2025: Pixel Gun Apocalypse 2025 is a first-person shooter with blocky, pixel-style visuals. You get access to modern weapons and can explore a variety of maps. Its competitive multiplayer modes pit you against other players online. Before each match, you pick a side, either SWAT or mercenaries, and then fast-paced firefights decide who wins. Victory depends on mastering your tactics.

This edition brings updated graphics, smooth gameplay, and new maps. To look around, move the mouse, and to walk, use the W, A, S, and D keys. The result is a fast, block-style online shooting experience.
fish-merge: Fish Merge takes you under the sea, where colorful fish combine in an engaging pattern. Relaxing underwater effects and soothing visuals set the mood, and matching items join together to reveal surprises and raise your score.

Playing is simple: drag matching fish onto each other to merge them. Higher-level fish give more points and coins, and the more you combine, the more rare fish you can discover. The mix of strategy, fun, and calming ocean vibes suits casual players of every age.
stickman-slash: Stickman Slash reimagines a fighting action game you may already know, this time with a stickman as the main hero. Advanced physics and immersive graphics bring the experience to a new level. It is an arcade-style title with multiple levels and sliding moves woven into the action.

Blood and killing are part of the combat, so the tone is rough and violent. You fight using only your mouse or touch input, which keeps the controls simple. Physics shape how each clash plays out from one moment to the next.
macho-man-go: In Macho Man Go, you control a brawny hero who sprints, leaps, and throws punches to come out on top. Each level is a platform course filled with traps, enemies, and demanding challenges, and you race through it from start to finish. The game combines racing, fighting, and running into one experience.

Dash through obstacle courses while dodging deadly traps, walls, and spikes. Grab gems and power-ups along the way, and collect body parts to boost your strength. You can also unlock new skins and abilities. Controls are simple: just click or tap to play.
vemon-run-3d: Vemon Run 3D is an arcade running game set in a lively three-dimensional platform world. You play as Vemon, a quick runner who dashes down the track while steering around hazards. Shift your character left or right to weave past obstacles, and push your speed to move at a very fast pace.

Gems you pick up along the way help you power up your runner, and passing through doors marked with positive numbers gives you an edge. Defeating enemies also brings upgrades, and these can transform Vemon into a superhero. To play, just click the mouse or tap the screen.
tricky-planner: Tricky Planner is an arcade puzzle game that tests how well you think ahead, time your actions, and map out a strategy. You steer colorful fish through underwater mazes while keeping away from hungry sharks. To succeed, you must collect every target before the clock runs out. Bright, lively visuals and levels that make you think hard give it a free online puzzle feel that suits fans of strategic games, undersea adventures, and skill-based arcade action.
On a computer, click with the mouse to plan your moves, interact with objects, and move through the menus. On touch devices, tap to select a move and interact with the game environment.
princess-run-3d: Dash through colorful three-dimensional worlds as a bold princess in this 3D platform arcade runner. Along the way, gather lovely outfits, footwear, hairstyles, and other finds. As your charm grows, you earn a maid of honor who helps you fend off enemies ahead, along with dirty mud, rain, and similar hazards.
Keep an eye out for unflattering clothes, costumes, and rough weather, since these can slow your progress. The controls are simple: just mouse click or tap to play.
smash-sprout: Grab your hammer and step into this silly world where moles keep popping out everywhere. Your job is to bonk each one back down its burrow at just the right moment. Every accurate strike raises your score, but letting too many slip by ends the round right away.

The action moves quickly, your chances are limited, and the mole invasion keeps growing, so only the sharpest reflexes will come out on top. To play, simply click a sprout with your hammer as it appears. It's a hypercasual pick, built for short, casual sessions.
burst-it-right: Burst It Right is a bright popping game built around careful aim. Balloons drift across the screen, and your job is to guide each one into position. Then you push the pin in the direction of the matching color, because a balloon only bursts when its color matches the pin. A mismatch counts as a failure, and your chances are limited.

As the game goes on, the balloons move faster, so you need to judge your timing and plan ahead. Each successful pop extends your streak, and staying accurate under that growing speed is the main test. Keep your eyes on the colors and your aim steady to build your precision.
marble-snap-color-puzzle-game: Marble Snap is a relaxed logic puzzler that challenges your mind and helps keep your reasoning sharp. Your job is to pair up, position, and organize marbles across the board until each level is cleared. The controls feel smooth, the visuals are bright and three-dimensional, and the animations give every move a pleasing payoff. The game offers hundreds of brain-teasing stages. The early ones are simple, but they gradually become trickier, so you could easily lose a few hours to them.

There is no clock ticking in the background, so you can take as much time as you like. Players who enjoy casual puzzles, match-and-place challenges, or brain-training games should find plenty here. Use it for a short mental warm-up or settle in for a long, unhurried session. To connect matching marbles, click with your mouse and drag.
flowers-vs-zombies: Flowers vs Zombies puts you in a garden under siege, where careful plant placement is the key to holding the line. You position flowers, and they fire bullets on their own at the undead heading your way. Combining two flowers creates a stronger, higher-tier bloom with more attack power, so smart merging can make a real difference.

Every zombie you take down adds to your score, and the higher your total, the better your ranking. This 2D shooter has a garden setting and a zombie theme. You play with a simple mouse click or a tap.
pixel-legyfare-wars: Pixel Legyfare Wars mixes turn-based strategy with retro pixel graphics and a modern warfare theme.
