Sound is a big part of the experience, with the soft noises of teeth being polished, cut, and trimmed. Its many visual effects aim to ease pressure, making it a light and enjoyable break. To play, simply click with your mouse or tap the screen.
wavytrip: WavyTrip is an arcade game where you steer a plane through a run of obstacles. As the aircraft flies on, more hazards come up, so you need to judge your force and timing carefully to get past each one safely. Along the way you can collect gold, and that gold can be used to unlock other planes to fly.
Everything is controlled with a mouse click or a tap, so it is easy to start. It is a single-player 3D game with an adventure feel, and it suits anyone who enjoys flying through tricky sections.
baby-panda-dentist-care: Healthy teeth matter more than many people realize, since they help create a bright, confident grin and keep the mouth in good shape. In this game, young animals arrive with a range of tooth troubles. Your job is to find out what problem each little patient has and then give the right care. It is a relaxed doctor simulation where you play the dentist and welcome every adorable creature with a dental issue.

The controls are simple, so a mouse click or a tap is all you need to play. Each animal has its own situation, so take a close look before you start treating it. Your patients can leave with cleaner, whiter teeth.
stickmanhook: StickManHook is a single-player 3D adventure in which you guide a hero through a series of levels. Each level is packed with anchor points, and you use inertia to carry the hero from one anchor to the next until it reaches the end. Timing matters, because the motion you build up keeps the hero moving forward.
Finishing a level rewards you with gold. You can spend that gold to unlock new heroes to try. The controls are simple: click the mouse or tap the screen to play.
fish-evolution-3d: Fish Evolution 3D is an arcade title that blends running with collecting. You begin as a tiny fish and swim across a bright, three-dimensional platform course, changing as you go. Each fish you gather helps yours grow bigger, faster, and cooler, and the transformation happens live while you swim.
The route is full of hazards, such as a hook and a lazy door. Steer clear of them to keep your fish moving forward. Controls are simple: a mouse click or a tap is all you need to play.
animalrush: Guide your animal companion safely across the finish line in AnimalRush. The course bends through several corners, and your pet has to make each turn at the exact right moment, so timing matters. Along the way you can collect coins, and those coins can be used to unlock new pets, giving you more animals to race with.
Controls are kept simple: a mouse click or a tap is all it takes. Time each corner carefully and work your way toward the finish.
twisted-auto-metal: This single-player 3D battle game drops you into a broken, lawless future where vehicles are battered, armed, and built for fighting. Explosions and wreckage are part of the chaos, and only the most ruthless drivers make it through. Fans of the classic Twisted Metal series will spot its influence right away. One of the cars you can take behind the wheel is the Nissan Skyline, rebuilt into a steel-plated, deadly machine.

Rules barely exist here. Your goal is to keep up speed, outlast the other drivers, and destroy them. Move with the W, A, S, and D keys. The game sits in the shooting and driving categories, so you can expect both kinds of action.
soldier-run-evolution: Soldier Run Evolution is a platform runner with a mix of soldier upgrades and puzzle moments. You guide your soldier through a series of levels, where you can fire at and take out enemies along the way. Passing through doors lets you add more soldiers to your group, so your ranks keep growing. As your weapon gets stronger, your soldier moves up through new stages of evolution.
Controls are simple: just click or tap to play.
doll-game-diy-fashion-star: Step into DIY Fashion Star, a relaxed do-it-yourself simulator aimed at anyone who enjoys fashion and getting dressed up. Your job is to figure out what each customer wants and then deliver clothing made just for them. Draw on your taste and eye for style to design the right outfit for every person who walks in. The process runs from picking the fabric shape, through cutting, to stitching, so you can watch a plain piece of cloth turn into a finished suit.

Everything is controlled with a mouse click or a tap, so you can jump right in on a computer or a phone. Each client brings a different request, and it is up to you to keep their needs in mind as you work. Take your time, experiment with the pieces, and enjoy seeing your creations come together.
diy-paper-doll-diary: Paper Doll Diary is a relaxed do-it-yourself game where you design your own house in a range of themes. Because every room starts out empty, you furnish it from scratch, which tests your imagination, logic, and sense of space.

There is no need to worry about running short of ideas, since plenty of items are ready for you to choose from. Watch an empty room slowly turn into a lively, cozy place. To play, just click with your mouse or tap the screen.
graduation-makeup-trends: Explore current makeup styles in this one-player dress-up game built around graduation day. Pick outfits from floral-print dresses, then finish each look with gold jewelry and holographic accessories. Your aim is to help every girl make a memorable impression as she walks across the stage. Use your mouse on a desktop, or tap the screen on a mobile device.
legends-john-wicked: Called into action on short notice, John lands in serious trouble after a slip-up during his mission. Now he's furious, and he has loaded himself up with every weapon he owns, ready to fight his way out. His goal is to gun down the bad guys standing in his path, reach his car, and escape the scene.

Enemies are spread across the area, and there are far too many to face at once, so he has to take them down one by one. Use the WASD keys to move, shoot down each attacker that comes at you, and keep pushing until you reach your car safely. The game can be played on both mobile and PC, so you can pick whichever device suits you.
fnf-girlfriend-multiverse-fashion: Girlfriend from Friday Night Funkin' has grown bored of music and wants to try something new. Her plan is multiverse fashion, and she needs your help picking the right look. Each level opens a wardrobe full of different costumes, and your job is to choose the best one for her.

The game is played entirely with the left mouse button, so every choice comes down to a simple click. It sits in the Girls category and carries the tags Cute, Dress Up, and Fashion. Look over the outfits carefully and see which combinations you prefer.
doodle-dash: Doodle Dash is a hypercasual physics game where you sketch the route for a bouncy ball. Your goal is to guide it as far as it can roll by drawing clever lines and timing your moves carefully. The farther the ball travels, the more ink you collect, and that ink opens up more room to experiment.

Spend your ink on upgrades for your current ball, or unlock different ball types to try. Every attempt encourages you to plan a little further ahead. The hand-drawn, doodle-style visuals and offbeat mechanics give the game a light, goofy feel, mixing creativity and planning with a relaxed challenge you can keep returning to. To draw each line, hold down the left mouse button or use your finger.
commando-shooting: Commando Shooter puts you in the role of an elite soldier who must push through hostile ground while waves of enemies come at you from every direction. Your goal is to move through dangerous areas, pick up strong guns along the way, and wipe out opposing troops in this fast arcade shooter viewed from above.

The game offers a range of weapons to find and learn to use, from quick-firing machine guns to heavy rocket launchers. Difficulty rises as you advance through many tough levels and sectors. Larger encounters await in the form of boss fights against armored vehicles, bunkers, and gun positions, and an upgrade system lets you improve your arsenal. Aim and fire with your mouse or by tapping the screen.
build-a-queen-2025: Build A Queen 2025 invites you to work your way toward becoming a true royal. Along the route you will cross platform stages while racing against rival players. Choose clothing and skin tone, plus other options, to shape your character around the goals you set.

Once you have dressed up in the most dazzling queenly outfit, you can head off to meet the prince and aim to come out on top. Money gathered during play can be spent to open new dance steps. Controls are simple: click with a mouse or tap the screen.
blocks-stack-rush: Blocks Stack Rush is a stacking game with a pixelated style. You guide a small block character as it runs through a journey, gathering blocks and piling them high. The clock never stops, so you have to work quickly. Each block must be lined up carefully, because your goal is to assemble a complete picture one piece at a time.
Playing is simple: click the mouse or tap the screen. Keep your stack steady, place every block in the right spot, and finish the full image before time runs out.
dirty-home-cleaning-fix: Dirty Home Cleaning Fix is a light hypercasual game about tidying a cluttered room. Maybe you love keeping things neatly stored, or tidying up tends to irritate you, or a messy space leaves you unsure where to begin. This cute title, tagged with cleaning and room themes, is built around those moments. Your job is to bring order to a chaotic home by thinking clearly and staying patient as you work.

Controls are simple: click with your mouse or tap your screen to play. You can start sorting and cleaning right away, with no extra steps needed. Each room you tackle becomes a little more organized as you go, turning a messy space into a tidy one.
summer-runway-challenge: Summer Runway Challenge is a dress-up game for fans of fashion and style. You pick outfits for models, using the newest summer looks, and then send them out onto the runway to show them off. car-dealer-idle: Car Dealer Idle puts you in charge of your own vehicle business. You buy and sell cars, expand your showroom, and work your way up to becoming a true tycoon. Each management decision you make affects how quickly your profits climb, so choose wisely as you go.

As your dealership grows, you can upgrade it and unlock more booths for selling cooler vehicles. Repair areas and test drive areas are also there to unlock, along with other additions. To play, just click with your mouse or tap the screen.
crazy-parking-jam-car-jam-game: Parking Jam is a puzzle game about sorting out a packed parking lot, one vehicle at a time. Your job is to think ahead and move cars in the right sequence so the path stays open and nothing turns into a mess. Every new level brings more vehicles and trickier obstacles, so the puzzles grow harder as you go.

To play, click a car and drag it slightly in the direction you want it to leave the lot. Each car you clear is pulled out onto the street, and the satisfying part is working out how to escape the tangle in the first place.
extreme-mega-ramp-car-stunts: Stunt driving takes center stage in this racing game. You control powerful cars and speed down towering ramps that rise high above the ground. Each run ends with daring leaps, spins, and flips, and you must keep the car steady as it floats through the air. Your goal is to touch down cleanly on tracks that look very hard to master.

The game combines fast, flexible gameplay with bold stunts and striking visuals. It works as a proving ground for daring drivers, and only the most fearless ones make it through. Steer with WASD or the Arrow Keys.
pengu-pengu: Pengu Pengu is a 2D arcade platformer with a snowy, cute theme. You guide a penguin named Pengu through each level, gathering every fish while the penguins grow hungrier and food becomes harder to find. Once all the fish are collected, you must make your way to the mother penguin and her egg.

The journey is risky. Polar bears roam the icy paths, and deadly traps are scattered everywhere, so you need to avoid them while you search for fish. Movement uses the WASD keys, and mobile controls are available as well. Remember that you need to collect all the fish in the level before reaching the mother penguin.
balloon-boom: Balloon Boom is an arcade game about matching colors, and fast reactions will carry you furthest. Your pin has a single color, and your job is to burst only the balloons that share it. Every correct pop adds to your score, but a single mistaken tap ends the run. As time goes on the balloons move faster, so the pressure keeps building.

The game has bright graphics and smooth motion, and its controls are just one tap, so people of any age can pick it up quickly. On a computer, left-click the balloon that matches your pin. On a phone or tablet, touch the matching balloon on the screen. See how long you can last in the popping frenzy.
rainbow-frontline: Rainbow Frontline is a fast 2D pixel shooter where a vivid rainbow galaxy is under attack. You pilot a retro spaceship through waves of battle, weaving past falling meteors while taking down brightly colored alien foes. Each level has its own color theme, running from red to violet, so every stage of the spectrum feels different.

Coins you collect can be spent on ship upgrades, including extra lives, timed shield invincibility, and powerful damage boosts. Expect colorful boss fights and a steady stream of meteors that never seems to end. Controls are simple: use the arrow keys or WASD to steer, press Space to fire, or use the virtual joystick on mobile. Your high scores and survival time are tracked so you can compare your results.
ultrahero-vs-monsters-royale-battle: Ultrahero Vs Monsters Royale Battle puts you in control of a powerful Ultrahero who takes on endless-feeling waves of wicked monsters across a three-dimensional landscape. Each fight brings its own new challenge, so no two battles play out quite the same. The game mixes fast, jittery arcade combat with tower defense strategy. You will need to beat back the monsters with your own attacks while also setting up defenses to keep your base safe. Use a mouse click or a tap to play.
tung-tung-sahur-big-stick: Help Tung Tung Sahur reach his favorite and most powerful stick by guiding him through a city full of obstacles. Leap over every barrier, dodge each trap, and make it safely to the end of the level to claim the mighty weapon. At times he takes on the role of a superhero, and at other times he becomes a ninja, so the challenge keeps shifting.

Move him with the WASD keys while you gather all the Tung Tung coins on the way. Visit the shop to pick from four different costumes. Your job is simple: keep him alive, collect the coins, and get him to the stick.
agent-hunt-shoot: Agent Hunt Shoot puts you in the boots of a top-tier agent caught in a tense firefight. Pick up a strong weapon and take out your foes with careful, accurate aim. Move him with the W, A, S, and D keys, or use the mobile controls if you are playing on a phone or tablet. Collect all the eggs first, then head for the chest. Speed matters, so try to reach it as quickly as you can and slip out of the castle.
christmas-cooking-chef: The holiday season is nearly here, and this cooking simulator invites fans of the kitchen to prepare festive dishes. Step into an enchanted digital cookhouse filled with seasonal spirit, where every corner feels ready for celebration. The game is so easy to pick up that newcomers can begin making holiday meals straight away.

Controls are simple: a mouse click or a tap is all you need. Expect silly, lighthearted moments and a restaurant-style setting as you cook. It sits in the hypercasual group, so it suits quick play sessions. Whether you are a seasoned cook or a complete beginner, you can jump in and start creating Christmas treats.
blob-hero: Step into the role of a courageous blob fighter in Blob Hero, an arcade battle game where foes keep coming without end. Your task is to survive as wave after wave of enemies and monsters rushes in. Each run plays out like a rogue-style adventure, so the challenge stays fresh from start to finish.

You steer your blob hero yourself, choosing basic skills and upgrading along the way to keep going. Controls are simple, since everything works with a mouse click or a tap. Think of it as a survival challenge where each choice you make decides how long your hero can last.
word-it-up: Word it UP is a puzzle game where you drag letters around to spell words and finish each stage. Many levels are waiting for you, and each one tests your vocabulary as well as your strategy. The puzzles grow steadily harder as you move forward, so you will need to plan a few steps ahead.
Your goal is to prove yourself a true word master by solving every challenge along the way. Controls are simple: a mouse click or a tap is all you need to play.
dog-and-cat-sweet: Set out on a demanding trip with a dog and a cat in this adventure game. Hazards are scattered across the route, so you will need to keep your eyes open at every step. The two animals act like siblings and only succeed when they cooperate, because if they split up, the finish line and its dog house stay out of reach. Along the way, grab all the food you come across so neither companion goes hungry.

Your path includes a bridge and an iron gate, and only the dog can open them. Steer with the WASD keys or the arrow keys. The game runs on both mobile devices and PCs, so you can play on whichever you prefer. Your goal is to collect all the cat and dog food and bring both animals safely to the dog house.
food-merge: Food Merge has you blending various ingredients into appealing dishes for customers who are waiting impatiently. Speed and planning both matter, because the timer keeps running while you work. Each level introduces new hurdles, faster orders, and more involved combinations, so you will need to keep sharpening your approach.
This casual puzzle game supports one or two players, and every action is handled with a mouse or touch controls. Because the orders keep getting fa
go-chicken-go: Lead a group of chickens from the left edge of the screen to the far side, where each bird needs your help to reach safety. Every chicken has to cross busy multi-lane roads where fast cars and trucks zoom past, then make its way over a broad, hazardous river.

Your job is to weave around vehicles and hop onto logs and lily pads to keep moving forward. Good timing decides whether the whole flock makes it through. You can steer with the keyboard or with the on-screen controls.
fish-pot: This arcade title asks you to gather bright, multicolored fish and drop them into a pot. You tap and aim so each fish travels along winding routes, steering around obstacles until it settles safely inside. Controls are easy, since a mouse click or a touch screen tap is all you need.

Underwater scenes glow with color while soothing music plays in the background. The game feels calm but still offers a fair challenge for players of any age. As you advance, you can unlock new kinds of fish, improve your pots, and explore different sea-themed worlds.
healthy-hero: Healthy Hero casts you as a courageous hero who battles monsters made of junk food. Your job is to keep your character in good shape by grabbing fruits and vegetables while steering clear of sugary treats. Fast reactions and clever choices are what carry you through each challenge. Bright visuals and a quick pace keep things lively, and the game carries a helpful reminder about living well, so it suits players of every age.

On a desktop, click the left mouse button to leap over gaps and junk food monsters. One click makes a single jump, and a double click performs a double jump. On mobile, tap the screen to jump in the same way: one tap for a single jump and a double tap for a double jump.
perfect-cake-maker: Perfect Cake Maker lets you bake tasty cakes in a relaxed simulation. When the game begins, the kitchen is already stocked and hungry guests are waiting for their orders. Your first job is to pick a cake base that suits what your guests want. After that, you move on to the enjoyable stage of blending everything together.
The game is played with a mouse click or a tap. It sits in the hypercasual category and is tagged with baby games, cake, and food, so it suits anyone who enjoys a light, easygoing cooking challenge.
tung-tung-tung-sahur-jigsaw-puzzle: Tung Tung Tung Sahur Jigsaw Puzzle invites you into the world of the Tung Tung Tung Sahur series. You rebuild striking pictures by fitting their pieces back together, which gives your mind a fun workout. The images are drawn from the series itself, so every finished picture belongs to that world.

Whether you love puzzles or follow the series closely, this game offers plenty of entertainment. You can play with a touchpad or a mouse, and a single click or tap is all it takes to begin. Piece together each captivating visual at your own pace and enjoy watching the full image take shape.
number-order: Number Order is a puzzle game built around logic and quick thinking. Your job is to arrange numbers in the correct sequence by sliding, tapping, or swapping tiles. The boards come in different grids and difficulty levels. Early rounds are gentle, but the patterns become trickier and time limits start to press on you.
It suits players of every age and is simple to pick up, yet it is easy to keep coming back to. The game
planetary-plunge: In this browser game, you tumble through the galaxy in a fast free-fall. You must steer through asteroid fields, avoid alien obstacles, and sink deeper into mysterious planets while racing to survive. The action moves quickly, and the space settings are striking to look at. The controls are simple: use the arrow keys on your keyboard to move up, down, left, and right.

Gather cosmic power-ups along the way and unlock new astronaut suits. Each world gets tougher than the last, so you will need to master the perfect fall to become a skilled space explorer. The journey takes you into the unknown, one plunge at a time.
swipe-runner-quest: Swipe Runner Quest is a coin-collecting adventure where quick reactions and careful timing matter most. You move with the arrow keys, dodging obstacles while grabbing every coin along your route as you head for the final gate. A single careless step can end your run, so staying focused is essential.

The game offers smooth controls and challenging levels that put your reflexes and planning to the test. Your aim is to gather all the coins and cross the finish line without taking any damage. It combines running, collecting and swiping into one quest.
smoke-man-runner-2d: Smoke Man Runner 2D is an endless runner where every jump you make matters. The action never really pauses, so you stay busy from the first moment to the next. The visuals are clean and easy on the eyes, and the catchy music gives the run a lively feel. The controls are simple to pick up, so newcomers can start right away. It is a fun, addictive experience that players of all ages can enjoy.

You play with a touch controller, so every input comes from touching the screen. There are no complicated commands to memorize. Whether you are a young child or an adult, you can jump in and enjoy the run. Keep your timing sharp, because each leap counts.
target-master-2d: Target master 2D drops you into a quick arcade run where every shot matters. You steer a glowing ball, work out precise arcs, and smash through awkward obstacles set against bright, colorful lights and smooth, steady movement. Success depends less on simply leaping and more on good timing, accuracy, and a bit of flair.

Bounce, fire, and glide through 3D stages that grow tougher the farther you advance. A single slip ends the round, yet landing a perfect jump feels wonderfully rewarding. Whether you want a relaxed session or are going after top scores, this addictive shooting ball game offers a fresh test. To play, just click the mouse or tap the screen.
weight-gain-diet-cooking-recipe: This arcade title is a cooking simulator built around the pleasure of preparing food in a calm way. Rather than a typical kitchen challenge, it leans into relaxation, with food sitting at the heart of everything you do. Ingredients come in a broad mix, ranging from fresh produce all the way up to gourmet-style meals.

Recipes are varied and enjoyable, and the game walks you through each one stage by stage so you can follow along and finish tasty dishes. Controls are simple: a mouse click or a tap is all you need to play.
ring-master-legends: Ring Master Legends is a boxing game that puts your speed, reflexes, and precision to the test. You step into the ring and throw punches at falling balls, making sure each glove matches the ball color: the Red glove hits red balls, and the Blue glove hits blue ones. The more accurate your hits, the more points you earn, so every clean connection counts toward your score.

The game moves quickly, with lively animations, and it gets harder as you keep going. Your aim is to chase a high score and become a true legend of the ring. To play, click and break the balls as they fall. It is a sports title built around clicking.
carnival-shooter: Carnival Shooter recreates the feel of a fairground game, right in your browser. You aim at a bright, fast-moving shooting gallery where balloons float by, cans get knocked off their perches, and moving targets zip across the screen. Every hit boosts your score, and piling up points can win you prizes.

The game looks and sounds like a day at the amusement park, with colorful carnival graphics, satisfying sound effects, and a range of quirky challenges in each level. As you go, you can unlock new levels, power-ups, and custom blasters while working your way up the high score board. Whether you are a sharpshooter or just looking for some light fun, the game is played with your mouse.
capybara-go: Capybara Go! invites you into a world built around capybaras. You begin a journey driven by strategy, recruiting a small group of these creatures and taking command of them. Your aim is to defeat your rivals and conquer everything in your path, relying on smart thinking as much as on combat.

Each capybara has its own strengths, so the key is to position them thoughtfully and make the most of what each one does well. Careful planning helps you defeat powerful enemies. The game sits in the arcade category and carries tags for armies, battles, strategy, and fun. Controls are simple: use a mouse click or a tap to play.
starry-style-dorama-of-dream: Step into the world of Korean drama. You work as a stylist for two young film hopefuls: an actress whose heart follows romantic tales, and a charming actor whose grin could warm even the chilliest heart. Pick clothing, accessories and hairdos to build looks that show off each character's personality.

Working with fashion and style, you help these rising stars stand out on screen while exploring your own creative side. Design images inspired by your favorite dramas. Control is simple: click with a mouse on a computer, or tap the screen on a touchscreen device.
power-slap: Slap battles come down to good timing, careful aim, and quick reactions. Each duel is short, and the goal is to land more slaps than your rival so you climb the leaderboard. The controls are as simple as it gets: one tap on the screen is all you need. Smooth animations and an arcade style keep every round moving.

Along the way, you can collect power-ups, pick up upgrades, and unlock special abilities that give you an edge in the fight. It suits quick, casual sessions whenever you have a spare moment. You can play solo or challenge friends to see who has the stronger hand.
retro-pong: Retro Pong brings the classic arcade feel back to your screen. Two paddles face off while a ball of pixels zips back and forth in quick rallies. You earn a point each time the ball gets past your rival, and the first player to reach 5 takes the win. It suits a short break or a head-to-head match with a friend, and its plain design shows how a basic idea can keep you coming back.
Play can be solo or with two people, and both modes run on the keyboard. Think you have the reflexes to come out on top?
chinese-cuisine-chef: Chinese Cuisine Chef is a hypercasual idle simulation about cooking Chinese food and running a lively restaurant. You start small with a bun shop, then add tables, a reception desk, a kitchen and more as you go. Over time your place grows, and you can open up takeout and bring on extra employees.
The game is played with simple mouse clicks or taps. It's a funny, light-hearted pick for anyone who enjoys restaurant management and watching a business expand step by step.
node-fusion-frenzy: Node Fusion Frenzy is a puzzle and strategy game that keeps your mind busy. Your playing field is a futuristic grid filled with glowing nodes. You combine them to clear the board, setting off chain reactions and earning combos along the way. Matching nodes are dragged together to form higher-level fusions, and each chain reaction can push your score up sharply. Since your number of moves is limited, every choice you make carries weight.

The game offers bright graphics, responsive controls, and tricky mechanics that challenge your thinking. It will appeal to people who enjoy merge games, logic puzzles, or fast-paced problem solving. Controls are simple: use a mouse click or tap to play.
candy-chain-master: Candy Chain Master is a puzzle game played on a board of blue tiles, with a candy sitting on each one. To begin, choose a candy and move across nearby tiles that show the same candy to build a chain of three or more. Every tile has to turn golden once at least one candy on it has been matched, so each connection you make counts toward the full board.
The clock keeps running, so you need to think ahead and act quickly to turn every tile golden before time runs out. You control the game with a mouse or touchpad.
mysterious-doors: Step into a puzzling kingdom where every stage is packed with traps, brain teasers, and surprises. Success depends on both careful planning and sharp skill, so you will want to get comfortable with the controls before pushing deeper. As you advance through the kingdom, keep an eye out for hidden secrets waiting to be found.

This 2D game works on mobile and PC. On a phone, tap the on-screen buttons to move and to jump. On a computer, use the WASD keys or the arrow keys to move, and press the space bar to jump. Your speed and wits will both be tested as you overcome obstacles and solve the puzzles along the way.
radiation-zone: Radiation Zone is a first-person shooter that mixes military combat with zombies. Your task is to clear a restricted radiation zone of every terrorist. Around the area you can find and use many kinds of weapons and ammunition. Everything you collect goes into your inventory, which holds the loot you need to survive. Building a tent takes four pieces of clothing and four branches, and you must also find water and food to keep your character going.

Move with WASD, crouch with Ctrl, and sprint with Left Shift. Q and E lean left and right, while F picks up items or inspects a weapon box. Switch weapons with keys 1, 2, and 3, throw grenades with G, fire with the left mouse button, and aim with the right. Press Tab to open the inventory, double-click an item to use it, and double right-click to drop it. The mission is complex, so expect a real challenge.
kitkat-fun-puzzle: Kitkat Fun Puzzle is a pin-style puzzle game that tests your planning and creativity. Your job is to clear the holes in each Kitkat bar so the chocolate pieces drop down in the right order. It sounds easy at first, but the layouts grow more complex as you go, and the game offers an unlimited number of levels to work through.

Every stage is a brain teaser, so think carefully about your moves before you act. The game is built for one player and belongs to the puzzle and block categories. Controls are simple: you play everything with mouse clicks.
gravity-climb-girl: Gravity Climb Girl is a vertical adventure built around the pull of gravity. You guide a bold young woman who ignores the normal rules of physics as she climbs up walls and jumps from one platform to the next. The journey takes place in a futuristic setting filled with dangerous traps that you must avoid along the way.

Flipping gravity, sidestepping obstacles, and getting your timing right are the keys to getting through each climbing stage. The visuals look stylish, the controls respond smoothly, and the pace stays quick, so every ascent demands sharp reactions. As you progress, you can unlock fresh outfits and tackle tougher levels. Play is controlled with mouse clicks.
tung-tung-sahur-midnight-terror: In a tiny, forgotten town where the clocks seem frozen, every night of Ramadan is broken by a strange noise calling out "Tung Tung Sahur!" It is not a typical wake-up call, though. This horror-comedy adventure, with survival and stealth elements, casts you as an ordinary villager locked inside a decaying, abandoned house where unexplained forces lurk.

Your goal is to gather 10 packs of instant noodles hidden around the haunted home before sunrise. Once you have them all, the exit unlocks and you can escape. Keep in mind that you are not alone in there. Move with WASD, hold Shift to run, and press space to grab items.
bottle-solitaire: In this single-player puzzle, your goal is to clear as many bottles as you can. The best result is finishing with just one bottle left, sitting right in the centre of the board. Its casual, hypercasual style keeps the pace light and easy to pick up.

To move a bottle, click or tap it first. The spots it can jump to appear automatically, so your options are always visible. Click the spot you want, and the bottle moves there. The whole game is played with mouse clicks or taps.
mystic-flower-match: Mystic Flower Match is a match-3 puzzle game where plants and spellwork share the spotlight. Your journey leads through enchanted gardens filled with shining blooms, carved runes, and friendly critters. To move forward, line up three or more flowers of the same kind. Along the way you unlock strong boosts and uncover hidden secrets within every stage.
The game offers hundreds of brain-teasing puzzles, backed by soothing music
panda-kitchen-idle-tycoon: Panda Kitchen: Idle Tycoon invites you to run a restaurant with a cute panda theme. You build a food empire of your own, and it earns idle profits. Your task is to manage the business wisely so you can reach success. This hypercasual title mixes food, restaurant, and idle gameplay.

As your business grows, you can unlock new dining tables and kitchen equipment to work more efficiently. You can also recruit chefs and servers to form a highly efficient restaurant team. To play, just click or tap the screen.
bunnies-get-ready-for-easter: Bunnies Get Ready for Easter is a bright, playful dress-up game in which you get a pair of cute bunny lovers ready for the spring holiday. You pick festive clothing, accessories, and backdrops to build a fresh Easter look for each bunny. Pastel styles, flowery outfits, and classic eggs and baskets are all available, so you can mix and match as you like.
Everything is controlled with a single left mouse click. Click to select items and make your choices, and enjoy styling the bunnies at your own pace.
zombie-city-rescue: In this action-strategy title, you are humanity's final hope. The undead have overrun the city, and your job is to track down survivors, wipe out the zombies, and bring calm back to a world that has spun out of control. You lead a rescue squad through streets crawling with the infected, freeing people who are trapped and guiding them to safety.

Fighting large groups of the undead takes a mix of weapons, handy tools, and careful tactics. Missions bring dangerous enemies and plenty of intense action. Between runs, you can strengthen your squad and unlock stronger gear. Plan each rescue with care, because any single move could decide who survives. Everything is controlled with a mouse click or a tap.
stunt-witch-2: Step into the shoes of a brave young witch who soars across the nighttime heavens on her faithful broomstick. As you fly, you'll need to weave past hazards, pull off bold tricks in the air, and gather glittering stars scattered throughout the sky. The game pairs simple controls with a whimsical cartoon look, delivering quick, lively flight action that suits players of every age.

Sharpen your spellcasting talents while exploring enchanted skies, and work toward earning the title of top stunt witch. Steering is handled with the left and right keys, which rotate your broom in each direction.
paper-ball: Paper Ball is a puzzle game built around drawing lines. Your job is to sketch a route that guides a playful paper ball into a waiting trash can. You can trace the path with your finger, or hold down the left mouse button and drag to draw. Various obstacles stand in the way, so you need to decide how to steer around them and plan the best course.

Every challenge depends on your imagination and a bit of cleverness. Draw the right track, then watch the physics shape how the ball moves toward its goal. The challenges get tougher as you go, yet the game stays relaxing while still making you think hard.
truck-simulator-extreme-park: Truck Simulator Extreme Park asks you to think carefully before every move. Instead of steering the vehicle yourself, you sketch a line from your truck to the finish point and then watch it follow your route. Sharp bends, cramped gaps, and tricky obstacles stand in the way, so your plan has to account for every one of them.

Each level tests your logic and planning, and the challenge grows as new twists appear. The environments aim for realism, and the truck models are detailed. Everything is handled with the mouse alone.
defense-designer: Defense Designer is a tower defense game for one player, where your job is to keep your castle safe from waves of enemies that never seem to stop. You place and improve several kinds of towers, put up walls, and spend your resources carefully so you can hold out as the challenges grow harder.

To play, tap or click to pick the building type you want, then tap again to put a tower on the field. To upgrade a tower, simply click on it. The game focuses on planning and strategy, so every choice about where to build and what to improve matters.
human-stickman-gun: Human Stickman Gun begins with a tiny, basic gun. Moving forward, you pick up stickmen who hop aboard and make the weapon stronger. Every stickman fills one slot, so the gun grows bigger and more powerful as you go. Shoot the barrels to collect cash, steer clear of obstacles, and keep improving your weapon.
The game includes a good number of inventive and challenging stages to work through. Control is simple: tap or click to play.
mobile-legends-slime-3v3: Mobile Legends Slime 3v3 drops you into a battle arena where three-on-three PvP matches take center stage. You can unblock many slime characters along the way. The fights take place across a range of brightly colored battle scenes, giving every match a fresh look.
Each slime has its own special skills and fighting style, so you can experiment to find the one that suits how you like to play. Controls are easy to pick up, since
zipline-people-rescue: In Zipline People Rescue, you ride along a cable through routes that you map out yourself. Each run is about getting people to safety, so every route you choose matters. Along the way, you work through challenges and keep clear of hazards that try to get in your path.

At its core, the game is a puzzle that gives your mind a workout as you plan each move. Controls are simple: click the mouse or tap the screen to play. It is a hypercasual title meant to be a fun way to pass some time.
monsters-of-easter-eggs: Easter has arrived, but the eggs have come to life and turned into monsters. Your mission is to destroy every last one of them. Grab your weapon and start shooting, eliminating each egg monster you encounter. Every enemy must fall before the level can be completed.
When the field is clear, make your way to the forest portal waiting at the end of the level. Step inside to confront the boss egg monster. Easter's future depends entirely on you. You move with the W
move-n-hit-space: Guide a spaceship through waves of enemy vessels in this Adventure title, where every move counts. Dodge incoming attacks, weave between enemy aircraft, and gather power-ups as you go. Your ship fires at foes while it travels, so you need to track their positions and stay clear of danger at the same time. Each level grows tougher than the last, rewarding quick reflexes and careful planning.

Points come from two sources: how long your ship survives and how many enemies it eliminates. The longer you last, the higher your score climbs, so staying alive matters as much as shooting. The game is tagged with aircraft, battle, space, and spaceship, which reflects its focus on combat among enemy craft. How far a single run can go depends on your skill at the controls.
identify-quick: Identify Quick is a speedy arcade title that tests both your eye for color and your reaction time. The screen shows a colorful background that keeps switching shades, and somewhere within that busy scene a box appears in the same color as the background. You have to find it before it disappears.

The goal is to click the colored box quickly while it is still on screen. Because the background changes so often, you need to stay alert and react fast. It belongs to the hypercasual category and fits the block, color, and matching theme.
fun-farm-wonderland: Fun Farm: Wonderland blends puzzle play with a farm setting. It is a light, easy-going title designed to leave players feeling relaxed while they work through its challenges. Since it is a single-player experience, you take on each puzzle on your own.

Everything runs on mouse clicks, so you simply click to play. Its hypercasual style keeps things simple to pick up and easy to enjoy. Whether you have a spare minute or an hour, it fits right in, and fans of farm-themed puzzle games will find it a cheerful, gentle way to pass the time.
farm-frenzy: Farm Frenzy is a match-3 puzzle game where you link three or more fruits to finish a different task on each level. The bright, colorful graphics make the fruit easy to spot, and every stage brings its own challenge.

The rules are simple enough for players of any age to pick up, but the harder levels are built to be rewarding. With hundreds of colorful fruit puzzles to work through, there is plenty to keep you going. Beginners and experienced puzzle fans alike can enjoy it. You play with a mouse click or a tap.
the-cave-escape: In this puzzle adventure, you wander through a gloomy, intricate cave and watch it from behind your character. Hazards and snares block the way at every turn, so you need to think carefully and work out clever solutions to get past them. Each time you crack a puzzle, you move on to the next stage.

Your aim is to make your way through the risky passages, tackle tough brain teasers, and descend into the cave's lowest areas to discover what it hides. On phones and tablets, touch buttons on the screen handle movement, jumping, and sliding. On a computer, use W, A, S, and D to walk, move the mouse to look around and steer, press Space to leap, and hold Shift to run and slide.
number-puzzle-war-game: Use swipes or the arrow keys to shift numbered tiles across the grid. Whenever two tiles with the same number collide, they fuse into one tile with a bigger value. Your goal is to create the 2048 tile, a target that stays out of reach until you have merged many pieces together.

Every number appears in its own distinct, bright color, which makes the board easy to read at a glance. You can also choose the font style you like best for the tiles. This puzzle is a quick brain teaser for anyone
coffee-craze-sorting-game: Coffee lovers who want to test their barista talent will feel at home in this café-themed title. Your job is to arrange colorful boxes into neat coffee packs, and speed matters, so work quickly. Each finished pack helps you prepare drinks for waiting guests, and you can also tidy up the shop while keeping your customers content.

The game plays at a calm pace and is designed to be easy to pick up, yet its brain-training puzzles give your mind a workout. To finish a box, you match coffee of the same color together. Controls are simple: use your mouse to click and point, and you are ready to go.
word-dropping: Word Dropping asks you to type letters on your keyboard, then press Enter to send them down onto a target point and finish the level. At other times, you'll need to press the spacebar to line the word up exactly on the same line as the dot, and only then will the letters drop and the level be complete.
Controls are simple: click with a mouse or tap the screen to play. Typing is the core skill here, so it's a good fit for anyone who wants to practice their keyboard while working through each level.
monster-truck-beginning: Monster Truck: Beginning is a racing game that tests your reflexes and driving skill. The ride never ends, so you keep going for as long as you can, and you choose the difficulty before you start. The road can have traffic moving in one direction or traffic running both ways.

Money unlocks new maps to drive on. The same money also pays for car upgrades, such as the type of wheels, better control, more speed, or a new paint color. Steer with A and D, press S to brake, and hit Esc to open the menu.
tappy-tower: Tappy Tower asks you to build a tower of houses, stacking one floor on top of another. If even one floor is placed incorrectly, the game ends and you must start over. You control everything with taps on the screen, and it is designed for a single player.

The game also includes a hidden object puzzle. Each level shows a bright, detailed picture and a list of items tucked somewhere inside it. Locate every object on the list to advance, and keep going until all the levels are finished. Anyone who finds all the hidden items can call themselves a skilled puzzle solver.
piggy-corn: Piggy Corn takes you on a magical journey with a brave little pig who sports a horn. You guide Piggy, a cute and quirky pig-unicorn, as it fights off the invading crocs. The world is full of danger, so you'll need to hop over spikes and dodge tricky traps.

Each level mixes bouncing over obstacles with battles against crocs. The controls feel smooth, and the colorful graphics keep things bright. There are plenty of levels to explore and master. To play, just click the mouse or tap the screen.
waterdown: You take charge of a faucet in this quick, hyper-casual puzzler, firing powerful jets of water to send kitchen waste tumbling into a drain. Dragging your finger across the screen steers the stream, and lifting it brings the flow to a halt. Each level must be cleared before the clock hits zero, so every moment matters.

Trash reacts to realistic physics as it gets shoved around, and you need to herd every piece into the hole to finish a stage. Expect several kinds of debris, with layouts that are shuffled each time, plus combo scoring and smooth visual feedback that reward well-timed shots. The pace stays brisk throughout, and controls work with a mouse click
snake-eat-food-game: Steer a colorful rainbow serpent through an arcade-style take on Snake. Your goal is to eat apples, grow longer, and survive while chasing a high score. Built with HTML5, it offers smooth controls and vibrant visuals.

Each apple you eat makes the serpent grow, so staying alive becomes a bigger test as you go. Start a round with a mouse click or a tap. It brings back the classic arcade feel with a modern, colorful look, and it asks how long you can last.
draw-logic-puzzle: Draw Logic Puzzle is a two-dimensional puzzle title made with Unity. You work through each stage by sketching lines, shapes, and paths. In every level, the marks you make become the answer: you might lay down a bridge, change the course of a falling object, or steer the character safely to its goal.

The controls are easy to pick up, and the mechanics will keep your brain busy as you test ideas. The visuals are charming and pleasant to look at. Players of any age should find it approachable. To play, just click the mouse or tap the screen.
jumpycat: JumpyCat takes the flap-and-dodge idea of Flappy Bird and swaps the birds for cats. You steer a cat through a run of randomly generated pipes, and the level design is endless, so the journey never reaches a set finish. The game features a range of hand-drawn cat breeds, so each feline looks distinct. Background layers slide past at different speeds, which gives the scenery a sense of depth.
Controls are simple. Click the mouse or tap the screen to make your cat jump, and that single input is all you need to keep it moving.
color-hoop-sort-puzzle: Color Hoop: Sort Puzzle is a puzzle game centered on sorting. Your goal is to organize many kinds of colorful hoops across its vibrant, challenging rounds. The game is designed to keep you engaged for hours at a time.

To move a hoop, tap one hoop on a pillar, then tap the other pillar you want it sent to. A move is only possible when the top hoops on both pillars share the same color and the destination pillar has enough room to take the hoop.
tic-tak-to: This browser version of the classic strategy game lets two players face off against each other. Each player takes a turn marking an X or an O on a 3x3 grid, with the goal of lining up three of their symbols in a row, whether across, down, or on a diagonal. tanks: Tanks is a 2D top-down shooter with a quick pace, where you pilot powerful tanks through intense battles and only the strongest make it through. You outmaneuver rivals by dodging, raising shields, and using the terrain to your advantage. A range of weapons lets you destroy enemy tanks before they can take you down.

Stay in the fight by weaving past deadly projectiles and keeping your shield ready. Earn coins to upgrade your tank, unlock more destructive firepower, and grow stronger as you go. The fast, addictive gameplay is designed to keep you coming back. Controls are simple: mouse click or tap to play.
candy-doll-dress-up: Candy Doll Dress Up is a fashion game built around styling a princess doll of your own. You act as the stylist and decide how your character looks from the very start. A large selection of outfits is available, so there is plenty to experiment with as you put each look together.

Building a doll begins with a blank slate. You choose the hair, the makeup, and the clothing, letting your own taste guide every decision. Everything is controlled with a mouse click or a tap. It's a playful choice for anyone who enjoys dressing up characters and seeing how a new style comes together.
karate-fighter: Karate Fighter puts you in the role of a shadow karate master, a fighter who moves quietly and strikes with purpose. Your moves come from the full collection of karate katas, the discipline known as KARATE-DO. Boxing and battling are both part of the action, and your enemies will answer you in kind, so every clash demands your full attention.

The game asks you to transform into a fighting tiger if you want to last. Each encounter tests how well you use your katas and your boxing against foes who fight back. Treat every battle with care, because survival depends on it.
penalty-shooters: Take to the pitch alongside cartoon characters you already know in this football title. The matches are lively, and you can test your ability while facing other characters in a range of challenges. Your job is to put the ball in the net, pull off clever passes, or hold back the opposing side when they attack. Football fans of every age should find something to enjoy here.
Controls are simple: click with a mou
candy-balls: Candy Balls is a 3D puzzle game that offers a relaxed break after a busy workday. Its actions are simple to pick up, and its fresh, stylish design keeps the mood light and easygoing.

Inside, you'll find a wide range of tasks spread across plenty of levels, so there's always something new to try. Everything is controlled with a mouse click or a tap, which makes it easy to jump in on a computer or a touchscreen for a few enjoyable rounds whenever you have a spare moment.
dice-puzzles-new-year: This New Year themed puzzle is trickier than it first appears. You launch balls onto the playing field and merge matching ones together, working toward a large, striking sphere. Every merge adds to your points, so keep an eye on your score as you go.

Early on, connecting balls is simple, but the number of balls grows over time, so the challenge steadily builds. This single-player 2D game runs on Android, and you can challenge friends and co-workers to see who comes out on top.
my-fashion-nail-shop: This hypercasual game is made for fashion lovers and beauty fans. You become the owner of a trendy nail salon, and you decide how it runs. Plenty of nail polishes are at your fingertips, along with glitter, stickers, and gems. Combine them as you wish to craft nails that look lovely and fashionable.
Playing is simple, since the game is controlled with a mouse click or a tap. Whichever way you prefer to interact, you can keep designing your nail creations as you go.
baby-hospital-dentist-caring: Baby Hospital: Dentist Caring is a playful dental simulation adventure set in a hospital. Rather than a typical game, it offers a cheerful experience where you take on the role of a young dentist. Cute cartoon characters are lined up and need your help. You get to slip into a smart doctor's outfit, pick up professional tools, and set out on a delightful journey through dental care.
Controls are simple: use your mouse or tap the screen to play. It is a good fit for fans of adventure, baby games, cartoons, and simulation titles, and it is listed under the Girls category.
astral-escape: An astronaut has slipped away from the enemy and reached the door of the mothership, only to find it locked. The lock is made up of several puzzles, and each one must be solved before the door will open. This is a puzzle escape game built around getting the astronaut inside.

Your job is to rotate the pieces until each puzzle is solved. Turn them carefully and think through each arrangement so the lock gives way. Your progress keeps the astronaut moving toward safety, so keep working through the pieces until the way is clear.
toka-boka-home-clean-up-design: A new family has just settled into town and needs your help. This is more than a quick favor, because the game is a simulator for transforming and running a home. You will dust surfaces, clean the rooms, and put clothes back in order. You can also design the house and repair anything that has been damaged.
Play with a mouse click or by tapping the screen. Your goal is to help this household turn a neglected home into a place they can comfortably manage.
toca-teens-cozy-couture: Toca Teens Cozy Couture is a dress-up game built around fashion and self-expression. You can browse outfits that look trendy and feel comfortable, then mix pieces together to create a personal style. The game suits players who enjoy cold-weather fashion as well as relaxed, everyday looks, so you can focus on whichever mood you prefer.

Everything is controlled with a left mouse button click. Choose pieces, try different combinations, and see how your ideas come together. It is a simple way to practice your styling skills and show off the outfits you design, with a cute winter fashion theme throughout.
endless-cyberpunk-runner: Dash through a future city of glowing neon streets in this cyberpunk endless runner. Your character never stops moving, so you must weave past robot foes and avoid the bullets they fire. Grab coins along the way, since each one adds to your total and pushes your score higher.

The goal is to post the highest score you can while lasting as long as possible in this two-dimensional world. You can play with a keyboard, a mouse, or a touchscreen, so you can choose whichever control style feels most comfortable.
draw-2-save-stick-man-puzzle: Draw 2 Save Stick Man Puzzle mixes brainteasers with sketching. You help a stickman out of a string of silly predicaments, such as feeding fish or staying clear of getting soaked. Each stage pushes you to think sideways, because the answer is rarely the obvious one.

The game includes a large number of levels, each with its own odd situation and plenty of humor. It sharpens logic and imagination, and it works well as a light break after a long workday or a study session. Every puzzle follows one simple rule: you may draw only a single line. Controls are easy, since you just click the mouse or tap the screen. It is fun for players of all ages.
bubblehead-ball: Bubblehead Ball is a soccer game for players who have strong skills and quick speed. You take on opponents in a fast-moving football match and get to show what you can do on the field. None of the characters belong to the football world, and their funny personalities add charm to every match. The art has a striking look, and the menus are easy to reach.

Controls are simple. Use A and D to move left or right, W to jump, and J or K to take a shot. This single-player sports title is built for anyone who enjoys testing their ability and speed on the pitch.
snakebit: SnakeBit brings back the classic Snake game for your device. You steer a snake and eat food so it grows longer. The challenge is to avoid crashing into the walls or your own tail, since either one ends the run. Your goal is to see how long you can survive. It is a single-player, 2D arcade title with endless play.

The design is minimalist, and the controls are simple to learn. You can move with the arrow keys or with W, A, S and D: W or the up arrow moves up, A or the left arrow moves left, S or the down arrow moves down, and D or the right arrow moves right. Press Tab to pause. Aim for the highest score you can and test your reflexes.
tank-z: Tank Z is a shooting game where you take aim at tanks and fire away. Your targets come in two colors, blue and green, and each color has its own firing button. On a touchscreen, you tap the blue button to hit blue tanks and the green button to hit green tanks.

If you prefer a keyboard, that works too. Press A to fire at the blue tanks and D to fire at the green ones. You can play with either the keyboard or tapping, so pick whichever feels more comfortable to you.
room-sort-floor-plan: Room Sort Floor Plan is a relaxed puzzle game that blends sorting with interior design. Across its casual levels, you sort items and tidy up spaces, working out the best arrangement for each room. You move the pieces of a floor plan around until you have a home that feels like your own. Every level is built as a jigsaw puzzle, so each one asks you to fit the parts together correctly.

The game is played entirely with the mouse. Click or tap to pick things up and place them where you want. It suits anyone who enjoys tidying, planning layouts, or piecing together puzzles at an easy pace.
english-training-book: Pick an English letter or a full English sentence, then fill it with colour as you go. Along the way, you can refresh what you know about the language. This single-player puzzle game also has a drawing side, so you get to create while you learn.

Your tools include a colour brush, a particle tool, and several others, including a printer you can use to take pictures of your work. Everything is controlled with a simple mouse click or tap, so you can start right away. Whether you are sorting out letters or building sentences, the game keeps the focus on colouring and practice.
dress-up-party-boy: Dress Up Party Boy mixes a Match 3 puzzle with a styling game. Each level is packed with clothing pieces, accessories, and makeup products, and lining up matching tiles is how you gather them. Every successful combination adds a new item to your character's closet and changes how they look, so their style keeps evolving as you go.
Pull off more matches and your choices expand, letting you shape your character's look however you like. To play on a phone, tap the screen. On a desktop, click it.
turkish-draughts: This board game breaks from the usual checkers rules in one key way: pieces move and capture in straight lines, side to side or forward and back, never on the diagonal. Because of that change, the starting setup is different too. Each player's sixteen pieces fill the second and third horizontal lines of the 64-square board.

You can face the computer, share one device with a friend, or join an opponent online. Watching is also possible, since you can observe matches as a spectator or follow other players. Spectators can also suggest their own next move by placing it on the board. Controls are simple: click with a mouse or tap the screen.
hit-and-run-solo-leveling: In Hit And Run: Solo Leveling, you step into the shoes of a bold adventurer who works your way up by clearing levels. Every stage is riddled with traps and obstacles, so you must keep moving and avoid hazards along the way. It is an arcade title built around running and dodging.

The game mixes parkour with adventure to deliver a thrilling yet casual experience. Playing is simple: use a mouse click or a tap to control your hero. Jump right in and enjoy the action, with a relaxed pace that never asks too much of you.
2d-fantasy-tower-defence: Enchanted Battlements is a 2D fantasy tower defense game set in a colorful world. Its storyline mixes old legends with tactical play, and each tower carries its own tale. Waves of foes test both your cleverness and your determination.

You take on the role of a protector of the magical realms. Your job is to call on the elements, bring forth mythical beings, and cast potent spells to keep your kingdom safe from the shadowy forces hiding past the enchanted woods. You play by clicking the mouse or tapping the screen.
one-plus-two: One Plus Two is a casual puzzle game that tests how well you handle arithmetic. Its simple layout makes it easy to pick up, and the time limit keeps every round moving. You work through basic math operations, each one shown as an expression you need to solve before the clock runs down.

Each question gives you three possible answers, and your task is to pick the correct one. Whether you consider yourself a math whiz or simply want to sharpen your skills, the game offers an educational and entertaining way to exercise your brain. It suits anyone who enjoys practicing sums.
merge-fruits-2048-new-in-2d: Merge Fruits: 2048 New in 2D is a puzzle game about joining fruit together. Fruits drop into a play area, and when two of the same kind touch, they combine into a larger one. Your goal is to link as many fruits as you can until a watermelon forms, and every point you earn adds to your score. You can also challenge friends and coworkers and try to reach the top of the leaderboard.

The game starts out easy, but more and more fruits arrive as time goes on, so the board gets busier. When you finally connect a watermelon, it disappears and gives you the most points of all. It is a single-player title made for Android, and it is a good choice when you want to relax with a few rounds.
the-grid: The Grid is a quick puzzle where you copy the pattern shown on the board. You have only a few seconds to reproduce it correctly, and a right answer lets you move on to the next round. As you go further, the tasks get tougher, and some ask you to shift how you look at the board before you respond.

Your aim is to rack up as many points as possible before the clock hits zero. Once a run ends, you can start over and try to surpass your best score or climb to the top of the leaderboard. The game also works well on mobile devices, and it needs nothing more than clicks or taps to play.
plumber-and-pipes: Puzzle fans will find plenty to enjoy here. You take on the role of a young plumber heading out to fix a broken line, since someone is waiting for the water to start moving again. Your job is to turn the pipes until they connect into sturdy routes that run from the water source all the way to the target point.

Each stage also includes valves, and using them well is part of the challenge. Plan how the water should travel before you start turning pieces, because every route has to hold together. The game suits anyone who enjoys brainteasers and classic puzzles.
toca-avatar-my-hospital: Many people have arrived at the town hospital needing care, so it is time to step in and help. You work at the town medical center alongside doctors, using equipment to examine each patient. Once you have worked out the cause, you can give the right treatment.

Choose the role you like best, then drag that character between the different consulting rooms to treat patients. Controls are easy, since a mouse click or a tap is all it takes. Keep working through the patients as they arrive.
carve-cookie-candy: Carve Cookie, Candy is a 3D puzzle game about shaping cookies. You handle several cookies, each needing its own treatment, so the challenge keeps shifting as you move forward. The gameplay runs in real time, which keeps every move feeling quick and immediate.
The game is divided into different levels, and each one offers a fresh experience. It is listed under action, so expect active play. Everything is controlled with a simple mouse click or tap.
live-star-doll-dress-up: Live Star Doll Dress Up puts you in charge of a doll inside a fashion-filled makeover world. The game unfolds in an interactive princess setting with a magical feel and an anime style. Your job is to choose trendy clothes and style your doll however you like. You can also experiment with makeup, so each doll ends up looking distinct and cute.
Controls are simple: a mouse click or a tap is all you need. The experience is light and style-focused while you build a doll that reflects your own taste. It falls under the h
twisted-form-rope-puzzle: Twisted Form puts you in the role of different characters with a demanding job: linking threads that run across pieces of leather. You must do this within a set number of moves, and each time the goal is to produce a specific shape. Every stage works like a new stop on a creative trip, and getting the intricate designs right takes care and a sharp eye.

The game looks polished and is easy to get hooked on. Beyond testing your reasoning, it offers a distinctive kind of fun. To play, tap the buttons, then drag toward the correct point to solve the puzzle. It is a single-player experience with a physics-based twist.
mergemushrooms-2048: Set in a woodland scene, this single-player puzzler has you drop mushrooms into a play area, where matching colors merge when they touch. Each merge creates a bigger mushroom, and the goal is to link as many as you can to build the largest one while collecting points. It has a 2048-style feel and runs on Android. You can also compare your score with friends and coworkers, aiming to climb to the top of the leaderboard.
Joining mushrooms is easy at the start, but over time more and more of them arrive, so the play area becomes busier. It is a relaxing way to unwind while you play.
royal-prince-tailor-master-2025: Royal Prince Tailor Master 2025 puts you in charge of a tailor shop that makes custom outfits for members of the royal family. Customers come in with requests, and you help them pick the styles they want. Your work involves measuring each customer, selecting fabrics, cutting them into shape, and sewing the final pieces together. You can mix colors and clothing designs, add beautiful accessories to your creations, and dress princesses or princes with your own hands. You can also decorate your store as you go.

The game is built for anyone who dreams of becoming a fashion designer. Each order gives you a chance to create interesting clothes and test new combinations of royal dresses. Along the way you learn what it takes to run a tailoring business, from working with customers to managing the flow of orders.
boy-ping-pong: Step into the shoes of a skilled young player who has nothing but a trusty ping pong paddle. Your job is to strike the balls that come your way, launched at random from the bottom of the screen toward the top. Quick reactions are essential, since every ball must be returned to keep the action going. As you clear each level, the next one brings a tougher challenge.

Controls are simple: click with your mouse or tap the screen to play. This sporty skill game suits kids and casual players who enjoy testing their timing and reflexes across a series of growing challenges.
doto: Doto is a 2D puzzle game built around a single yellow dot. You tap the screen to move it, and your task is to steer it without colliding with the other dots on the board. It sits in the hypercasual category.

The game asks for patience, since every click needs to be made with a calm mind. One careless move can cause a collision, and then all of your effort goes to waste. Think before each tap, keep your focus, and move carefully to protect your progress.
money-ping-pong: Money Ping Pong is a laid-back idle title in which you carefully set up money blocks and use them to shrink the room left for the balls, which helps you earn extra in-game cash. The game offers many different maps along with dozens of functional blocks to try. Its pace is calm and easy to settle into.

To play, you place money blocks on the field and build your own pinball strategy for making game money. Buy upgrades to complete each level. The 3D physics and ball bounces give every round a fresh feel.
muscle-bridge-race-3d: Looking for a light, easygoing race? Muscle Bridge Race 3D lets you compete against other opponents on a 3D track. As you run along the course, collect muscle items to grow your muscles. The bigger your muscles get, the stronger your bridge becomes, and that bridge helps you cross gaps on the way to the finish line.

Controls are simple, since a mouse click or a tap is all you need. Keep grabbing muscle items as you race, build up your bridge, and aim to reach the end first. It makes for a fun and relaxing race from start to finish.
tile-fruits: Tile Fruits is a 2D tile-matching puzzle filled with bright colors and cheerful challenges. Your goal is to line up three matching fruits so they vanish from the board, and each level grows harder than the last. Keep an eye on the count, because if more than seven different fruit kinds sit on the board at the same time, you lose.

The artwork is lively, the fruit designs are adorable, and the sound effects are endearing, which together make the game feel immersive and enjoyable. Playing is simple. Tap a fruit to select it, then find two more of the same kind to clear all three. As you finish levels, you will meet new challenges and unique layouts that call for careful strategy.
additive-fun-2048: Here, you slide numbered tiles in any of eight directions across the board. Whenever two tiles bearing the same number collide, they fuse into a single tile. Every move asks you to think about where the next collision might happen, so each turn becomes a small decision of its own.

The visual style is clean and minimalist, built around simple graphics and soothing sound effects that keep the atmosphere calm. It is a title that puts your logical thinking and strategic planning to the test, offering a demanding yet absorbing experience. Controls are straightforward: use a mouse click or a tap to play.
dice-puzzle-fruits: Don't let the simple look fool you, because this one is trickier than it appears. Your job is to toss fruits onto an open playing field and pair up the identical ones. Keep merging them until you create the largest and most attractive fruit you can. Every match helps you collect points along the way.

Early on, joining fruits feels straightforward, so you can settle in comfortably. As time goes on, though, more and more fruits pile up on the field, and the challenge steadily grows. You can also measure your score against friends and coworkers to see who claims the title of top player.
mini-chef-overcooked: Mini Chef Overcooked puts you in charge of a tiny kitchen, where you face cooking simulation challenges that move at a rapid pace. Expect a mix of different ingredients and cooking requirements, from tomato soup to lemonade. Every round of play keeps the focus on quick, fast-paced cooking.

Controls are kept simple: a mouse click or a tap is all it takes to play. The game sits in the hypercasual category and carries the tags food, fun, and simulation, so it suits anyone who enjoys light cooking games.
tabla-drum-kit-music: Tabla Drum Kit Music is a music game built around a drum set, so you can learn the instrument and rehearse whenever you like. Every hit comes with realistic sound and a natural feel, whether you are using a phone or a tablet. It suits people who are just starting out as well as experienced drummers who want to refine their skills.

Using the app, you can build your abilities step by step and work toward a stronger, more confident performance behind the kit. Controls are simple: click the mouse or tap the screen to play. Think of it as a practice space where you can keep improving at your own pace.
titans-defense-run: Titans Defense Run is an arcade game that mixes parkour with strategic attacks. You keep running through demanding levels while gathering bombs along the way. Once you hand those bombs to your helper, you can turn your attention to shooting the monsters that stand in your path.

The game is built around a stickman, bombs, and nonstop running, and it is played entirely with mouse clicks or taps. Because there is only one input to learn, you can focus on where you are on each course and when to make your next move. Each run asks you to balance movement with timing, which keeps every level feeling fresh.
bad-cat-simulator: This quick-moving casual title rewards fast hands and keen eyes. Your job is to scoop fish out of a bowl before anyone else can, moving like a hungry feline. Beware, though: fish bones are in the mix, and grabbing one earns you no points at all.

You can play alone, take on friends in local multiplayer, or add smart bots so up to four players compete. Each player has their own grab key: the left mouse button for Player 1, W for Player 2, the Up Arrow for Player 3, and J for Player 4.
blob-dash-endless-runner: Blob Dash is an endless runner set in a bright, colorful world full of traps and barriers. You steer a small, adorable blob through stages that grow harder as you go. Your moves include running, jumping, ducking under danger, and sliding, all used to get past spikes, holes, and other hurdles.
The game is played with mouse clicks or taps, so it works just as well on a computer as on a phone or tablet. Keep your timing sharp and your reactions quick as the pace picks up along the way.
mergesweets-2048: This puzzle takes place in an unusual setting. Sweets fall into a play zone, and any matching ones that touch join together. Your goal is to connect as many treats as you can so your points keep piling up. You can compete with friends and coworkers and aim to claim the top spot on the leaderboard.

At the start, combining sweets is straightforward, so it is an easy way to ease in. As time goes on, more and more sweets appear and the board becomes busier. It is a single-player logic game with a 2048 twist, and it is meant to be a calm, relaxing pastime.
jump-race: Jump Race pits you against other players in the same room, and the goal is to reach the finish line before anyone else. The course is full of obstacles, so you need to watch where you land. Hitting one hurts you and resets your position to the start, which can wipe out your progress in a tight race.

Your moves are controlled with the mouse. The game combines jumping and platform challenges with multiplayer racing, and it is tagged as a .io game, a two-player game, and an adventure. Each run pushes you to stay focused on the path ahead while the other racers keep pace.
merge-fruits-3d: Merge Fruits 3D! asks you to join matching fruits together. Fruits drop into the game zone, and whenever two of the same kind touch, they combine into a bigger one. Your goal is to keep linking fruits until you create a watermelon, and every merge earns you points. You can also compete with friends and colleagues, aiming to reach the top of the leaderboard.

The game opens gently, with merging feeling simple at the start. As time goes on, though, more and more fruits fill the zone, so each move matters more. It is a calm way to unwind while still giving your thinking a workout. Each round can be a relaxing break whenever you need one.
5-night-at-green-head-monster: Green Head Monster 2 is a 3D horror adventure that asks you to get through five frightening nights inside a compact, dimly lit hotel. The place is run by a mysterious and menacing figure known as the Green Head Monster. Your stay begins like an ordinary night away, but before long strange events start happening and the evening becomes a tense struggle to survive.

Controls will feel familiar if you have played a first-person shooter or a first-person adventure before. On a PC you steer with the mouse, while mobile players use a joystick. The setup is easy to pick up, so you can focus on the dread building around you.
fish-sort-puzzle: Swap bubbles for fish in this underwater sorting puzzle. You pick fish out of floating bubbles and steer each one into a tank of its matching kind. Three matching fish fill a tank and clear it, opening room for more. Plan ahead, because any fish without an open matching tank must wait in a small holding tray. Keep that tray from overflowing, and use boosters when a level gets stubborn.

As you advance, you can discover new fish, unlock aquarium scenes, and expand your underwater collection. The game works with a mouse on desktop or with touch controls on mobile. On desktop, left-click to select fish and click buttons to use boosters or move through menus. On mobile, tap to select and interact, and swipe to scroll through shop items and collections. Your progress is saved locally in your browser.
ice-scream-horror-adventure: An ice cream vendor has rolled into your neighborhood and snatched your close friend Bob. You saw the whole thing. Somehow he froze your best buddy in place, and now you must track down where the van carries him. The man is named Rod. He acts sweet toward little ones, yet he is planning something sinister for them, and that is the secret you need to uncover. All you know is that Bob will be taken inside his van, but the destination is a mystery.

Rod can pick up on every move you make, so you have to hide and trick him to stay unseen. The game takes you through the van into a series of different settings, where you explore and uncover all of its hidden secrets.
bomb-banana: Bomb Banana is a 3D puzzle adventure featuring three monkeys: one deaf, one blind, and one mute. Each brings a different skill, so you switch between them while searching a house, solving puzzles, and trying to defuse a bomb before time runs out.
