The blind monkey finds the device, the deaf monkey reads the manual, and the mute monkey handles the bomb.

On desktop, WASD or the arrow keys move, the mouse lets you look around, and keys 1, 2, and 3 swap monkeys. Left click or E interacts, holding when needed; M opens the manual, A and D or the side arrows turn its pages, Z zooms, and P
pro-football-eleven-2027: Pro Football Eleven 2027 is a 3D football game where two full sides of eleven take the field in a packed, floodlit arena. You choose from 10 European and American clubs. The controls are assisted, so you can pass, play a through ball, cross and shoot with a power gauge. The match includes offside, fouls, cards, set pieces, goal replays, ragdoll tackles and a smart team AI.

There are two modes. Exhibition is a quick match against the CPU, while the cup is an 8-club knockout tournament where drawn games go straight to penalties. Move with WASD or the arrow keys, and hold Shift to sprint. J makes a short pass, K or Space shoots, L plays a through ball, and I lobs or crosses. Hold E with K for a finesse shot,
aura-clicker: Aura Clicker is a colorful idle game where you climb from Noob to GOAT. Tap or click around your hero to earn aura, then spend it on Click Power, Auto Click, Aura Multiplier, and Crit Chance. Holding a purchase button buys several levels at once, and better crit odds make your clicks hit harder. Pick one of six heroes to start, and watch their look change across six ranks. It works with a mouse or touchscreen.
Summon pets in the shop to build a collection of 52 across five regions. Every
cat-hotel-24-7: Manage a cat hotel seen from an angled, three-quarter view, with you as the person in charge. Ring the yellow bell above arriving cats to welcome them, and head to any room whose broom bubble appears to tidy it up. Once a guest leaves, you collect the payment.

Put your earnings toward new rooms on empty plots, a receptionist, a housekeeper, and extras like a cafe, spa, or pool. Restyle the lobby in one of three looks, refresh rooms with new floors and wallpaper, and collect all 24 cat guests for your album. Chat with the residents and help nearby neighbors with story requests that arrive by letter.
Tap or click the floor to walk, hold and drag to steer, or drag quickly
crocodile-online-draw-and-guess: Crocodile Online is a relaxed multiplayer party title where one participant sketches a word while everyone else races to name it. You can gather friends in a private room or jump into a fast match with other players. The built-in chat lets you talk over your guesses and keep the mood light, and the leaderboard tracks your progress and highlights the best guessers.

Everything runs directly in your browser and works with keyboard and mouse, so it suits short sessions after school or work. Log in, enter your name, then pick a quick game for automatic placement or create a private room and share its ID. The artist draws on the canvas with a pencil, marker, or eraser. The first correct guess earns a point and moves you up the rankings, while rounds switch automatically under a timer.
mahjong-lines: Mahjong Lines is a logic puzzle in the mahjong connect style. You tap two identical tiles to link them with a route that bends no more than twice, forming up to three straight lines. The route can be drawn freely, but it may only pass through empty cells. All tiles sit on a single level.

Clear the board by removing every tile, one connected pair at a time. Classic tiles, a calm mood, and clear rules suit both quick breaks and slower, strategic sessions. Difficulty grows gradually, so beginners and experienced players can both enjoy it. If you get stuck, use hints or shuffle, and play in full screen across a large collection of unique levels.
fragbyte: FRAGBYTE is a quick 3D first-person shooter about surviving waves of enemies, and it runs right in your web browser. You play alone, offline, inside an arena sketched in ink by hand. The waves never end, and each one arrives tougher than the last, so the real challenge is seeing how long you can last. Foes include stickman soldiers, shield brutes, blade runners, and laser snipers, and every run finishes with a brutal arena boss.

Your arsenal covers an assault rifle, a pump shotgun, a marksman sniper, a katana, ink grenades, and a grapple hook. You can wall-jump, crouch-slide, and swing on the grapple hook to move across the battlefield, and chaining headshots raises your score. Controls use WASD to move and the mouse to aim and fire, with right-click for aim down sight, keys 1 to 4 to switch weapons, G for grenades, Q for the grapple, Space to jump (press again to double-jump), Shift to sprint, and Ctrl or C to crouch-slide. Touch controls work in landscape mode on mobile.
solitaire-the-collection: Solitaire The Collection brings together 33 card game variants in a single place. You can play well-known solitaires or try rules you have not seen before, and choose a difficulty that suits you, from a relaxed deal to a proper challenge. Klondike can be played with a draw of one or three cards, while Spider can use one, two or four suits. Other options include FreeCell, Pyramid, Vegas, Yukon, Russian Solitaire, Alaska, Scorpion, Forty Thieves, Josephine, Tri Peaks, Golf, Eight Off, Double Klondike, Easthaven, Spiderette, Simple Simon, and Memory on a normal or large board.

Beyond the games themselves, there are daily challenges and journeys built around quests, where you can gather keys, postcards and achievements. You can change the look of the cards, their backs and the table background, switch on dark mode, or set up a left-handed layout. Hints, undo and auto-collect are available when you get stuck, and your progress is saved automatically. Finishing a deal is marked with sounds and a little card dance.
chess-online-multiplayer: Chess Online Multiplayer brings the classic board game to your browser and follows standard chess rules. Your aim is to checkmate the opposing king, leaving it under attack with no legal way to escape. You can face the computer across 21 levels, from Beginner up to World Champion, or take on people from around the world online. You can also invite a friend and share a single screen.

Five time settings let you choose your pace: Unlimited, Bullet, Blitz, Rapid, or Classic. Helpful tools include highlighting possible moves, taking back a move after a slip, using interactive hints, and reviewing your game afterward to learn from mistakes. You can change the look of the pieces and board, set handicaps, and track your rating, points, and statistics. Cartoon emotions let you send playful reactions to your opponent.
valetpro-parking-rush: You run the valet stand at a luxury hotel, greeting arriving drivers and taking their keys. Each guest expects their car placed neatly in the correct bay, and every one has a patience timer ticking. Follow the arrow, steer carefully, and park before anyone loses their temper. Scratches reduce your tips, and some visitors return later wanting their car brought back quickly.

The game offers 50 levels across 10 chapters, from Boutique Hotel and Downtown Tower to Night Gala, Grand Palace, and more. Boss stages bring picky VIP guests, where a single scratch ends the attempt. Bonus
siren-city-ambulance-game: Time matters in Siren City, where you drive an ambulance to emergency calls through a crowded 3D city. Switch on the siren, slip between cars and reach the crash site. Your paramedics leap out, wheel a stretcher to the injured person and load them into the vehicle before you head to the hospital.
Drive carefully on the way, since hard braking and collisions drain the patient's St
arrows-escape-tap-puzzle: Arrows: Escape is a calm logic puzzle with a clever twist. Each level forms a picture, such as a heart, a star, a cat, or a house, built from colorful, winding arrows. Tap an arrow and it shoots off along its route, but only when the way ahead is open. Hitting another arrow costs you one of your three hearts, so think about the order before you act.

Clear every arrow to finish a level and collect coins. Keeping all three hearts earns a perfect score. The game offers endless solvable boards, harder and extra-tough layouts, a daily challenge, and seven themes to choose from. Stuck? A hint reveals one free arrow, and the laser can remove any arrow you pick. Controls are simple: tap or left-click with the mouse.
domino-online-multiplayer: Domino Online Multiplayer brings the classic tile game to your screen, and you can play for free without registering. Test your skills against computer opponents on nine difficulty levels, from Beginner up to World Champion, or face real people in real-time online duels. Send a link to invite a friend, even from far away, or use the one-screen mode for matches with someone at home.

Each player starts with seven tiles, and the lowest double (not counting the blank) opens play. If you can't match the open ends, you draw from the bazaar until you find a fitting tile. Pick Bullet, Blitz, Rapid, or Classic time controls, undo a slip, or ask for a hint that suggests the best move. Track your rating and statistics, review your move history, customize the tiles and table, chat and exchange stickers, or make bets to win gold from your opponents.
escape-from-wave-for-brainrots: A huge tsunami is rolling toward the area, and the Brainrots need someone to pull them out of its path. You grab them, race away from the water, and carry them back to the base before the wave arrives. Acting quickly gives you more chances to rescue the rarest and most valuable Brainrots, and boosting your speed lets you carry them farther and faster.

Brainrots range from ordinary ones all the way up to truly legendary finds. Every one you deliver to the base grows your collection and brings you new opportunities and more action. Reaction, strategy and speed all count, since the tsunami will not wait for anyone. On a computer, WASD or the arrow keys move you, holding the right mouse button and dragging rotates the camera, E interacts
bingo-mania: Bingo Mania is a relaxed bingo game with a cooking theme. In Kitchen Quest, you play through 100 solo levels where numbers are called one at a time, and you mark the matching squares on your card. Complete a line, a corner set, or a themed shape, and the game automatically calls BINGO. Each win brings ingredients and moves your recipe through gathering, prep, cooking, decorating, and serving.

Your dishes rise through five kitchen tiers, from cupcakes to pizza, burgers, cake, and a grand feast. Your first dish arrives in just 5 levels, and later recipes bring more cards, tighter timers, and special tiles. At level 25, Bingo Battles unlock. These are timed, head-to-head duels against rival chefs where
road-chase-shooter-realistic-guns: You are being chased down the road in a car that is far from sturdy. Luckily, you carry a large arsenal, including an AK47, a minigun, a crossbow, a stationary gun, a machine gun, and a flamethrower. Target your pursuers' wheels, car parts, and bodies, land headshots, and string together combos. Your mission is to shake off the chase by destroying every pursuer.
Enemies arrive as motorbikes, quads, race cars, drones, jeeps, and helicopters. The game offers over 50 unique levels, and you can unlock new locations and every weapon type as you go. You
hydro-rush: Pilot a speedboat over water that really moves. Three rivals share each of the 12 courses: a tropical lagoon, a neon marina at night, an alpine lake, a storm bay, a sunset canyon, a coral coast, and the reverse route of every one. Drift past buoys, leap off ramps, grab nitro, and hurl torpedoes, oil, or depth charges at your opponents.
cook-soups-3-in-a-bowl: Cook your way through 125 authentic soup recipes, including borscht, shchi, fish soup, solyanka, kharcho, and tom yum, plus dozens more from many countries. Each finished level adds a new dish to your recipe book.

Ingredients drift around inside a pot, and tapping one lifts it out. Gather three of the same kind and they land on a plate as a finished portion. An ingredient without a matching plate waits in one of the few extra slots along the bottom until its match appears. If those slots fill up with no room left, the soup is ruined and the level is lost. Clear the whole pot and your soup is ready. Compete on the leaderboard by soups cooked, customize your avatar, background, and pot, and enjoy a relaxed, warm home-kitchen mood with no rush.
ola-solitaire: Ola! Solitaire is a take on the classic Klondike card game, designed with clear rules, big cards, and easy controls that suit older players. Each of its 999,999 deals has been checked by a solver and can be finished in both Draw 1 and Draw 3 modes. You can begin a fresh deal or pick one by its number, then move cards by dragging them or with one tap. If your plan changes, you can undo a move, let Auto move carry safe cards up to the foundations, or request a Hint based on the current layout.

Beyond single games, there are Daily Challenges, a Journey to travel through, and collectible cards to unlock, along with monthly trophies to earn. Each win adds experience and coins, raises your level and win streak, and is logged in Statistics, which tracks time, moves, score, and personal bests. The table can be arranged for either your right or left hand, and the game runs on phones, tablets, and computers.
word-search-offline-puzzle: Word Search: Offline Puzzle asks you to swipe across a grid of letters to uncover hidden words. It runs without any internet connection, so you can play anywhere. As you clear levels, you climb an evolution ladder that starts at atom and molecule, moves through cell, fish, dinosaur and human, and ends at mind.

To trace a word, drag across touching letters. Paths can bend around corners instead of running only in straight lines, which gives the classic format a fresh twist. Release to submit. Correct words lock in with color, and a wrong try costs you nothing. The hundreds of hand-crafted levels range from easy to hard, with big, clear letters and no timer. Stuck on a word? A hint reveals one letter, and tapping a solved word shows its meaning. It's a relaxing daily brain workout that sharpens focus and builds vocabulary.
no-i-m-not-a-plankton: Step into a lively version of Bikini Bottom, where every shift brings its own difficulties. Original music, familiar characters, and an unpredictable storyline set the mood. You take the role of Mr. Krabs, proud owner of the Krusty Krab, and decide who gets in and who gets thrown out.

Some customers are not what they seem, since robots are mixed in among the visitors. Use your observation skills and the usual warning signs to unmask them, because a mistake can have nasty consequences. Expect unexpected events, inspections, and surprises, as even an underwater business can sink at any moment. Your goals are to finish the game, unlock all characters and endings, and beat the record for the most successful shifts. You can play with a mouse or by tapping the screen, and a short tutorial covers the basics.
jigsolitaire-puzzle: Jigsolitaire is a browser jigsaw game where you rebuild a scrambled picture. Drag a tile onto another one to swap their spots, and keep going until every piece sits in the right place and the full image appears. Collections cover Classic, Travel, Animals, and Fun themes, and you can upload your own photos to make custom puzzles.

You can play through levels in your current collection, with difficulty rising as you go, and earn coins and points for each one. The Daily Puzzle offers a new challenge every day, worth 50 bonus coins, and tracks your streak. Seven difficulty settings run from a 3x3 grid up to a 9x9 Legendary board. Quests, leaderboards, a gallery of finished pictures, hints for when you get stuck, and support for English, Russian, and Turkish are also included. VIP Mode offers uninterrupted play, and progress saves automatically
tall-noob-man: Tall Noob Man is a 3D runner with a simple, quick pace. You steer a blocky hero that stretches taller and wider as it passes through number gates. Blue and purple gates make it taller, green gates make it wider, and red gates are ones to avoid. Ram blocks cut away the height printed on them, so pick the smaller number. Dodge saws, hammers, boxing gloves and bowling balls along the way.

Every level ends with a physics-based boss fight in a boxing ring. Tap or press Space to punch, and swipe or press A/D to hop back from his wind-up punch. Knock him into a pile of crates to win coins, which you can spend to raise your starting height and income. Between runs, unlock outfits, faces, hats, trails and pets, claim daily gifts, and spin the wheel.
flow-blast-shooter: Flow Blast Shooter is a fast puzzle shooter where good timing and careful color handling decide how well you do. Colored blocks keep rolling along a conveyor, so you place your shooters, line up your aim, and fire at just the right moment to keep everything moving. You guide numbered units, which are colored characters, to either fill or empty the colored sections of a closed track.

Sessions are short and easy to pick up, but the challenge grows steadily. New block patterns, faster flows, and tricky color combinations arrive as you progress. There are no bosses and no leaderboards, and the story takes a back seat to the steady stream of levels. Boosters can be bought with the in-game currency. The music suits the action well, though you can finish the game without it.
bmg-crash-test: BMG Crash Test is a lifelike simulator where you can put a range of vehicles through their paces, from everyday sedans to modern sports cars. You drive them along demanding courses filled with spinning hammers, bouncy springboards, and other hazards. Each car is checked for toughness against rotating hammers, heavy presses, and wild jumps.

Crash tests are at the heart of the game, and you can aim to beat your own marks and set new records. Pick the cars you like best and enjoy wrecking them. The large maps are packed with hammers, crushers, ramps, presses, and obstacles, and your job is to destroy various wheelbarrows along the way. Use WASD to move, the Spacebar for the handbrake, C to change the camera, B to slow down time, and N to switch to the next car. Press TAB to pause. On mobile devices, use the game interface.
1-strength-for-escape: Train to build your strength in this 3D arcade game, then use that power to smash through the walls standing between you and freedom. Heavier weights and better training efficiency help you grow stronger over time, so tougher barriers become breakable. Each new zone is harder but offers bigger rewards. Earn wins and spend them to push your progress further.

Rebirth resets your current progress in exchange for permanent bonuses, so every new cycle begins stronger. On PC, move with WASD, interact using the left mouse button, hold the right button to rotate the camera, press Space to jump, and use the Train button to exercise. On mobile, a virtual joystick moves your character, swiping rotates the camera, and on-screen jump and Train buttons handle the rest.
kalulu-tanhulu-asmr-mukbang: Kalulu is a mukbang streamer you help turn into a popular name online. You cook desserts such as crisp Tanghulu skewers, coating strawberries and grapes in sugar syrup until each bite gives a satisfying crunch. You can also brew aromatic tea, add tapioca pearls, and mix refreshing boba drinks, unlocking new variety as you progress.

Go live and watch Kalulu eat the dishes you prepared, while relaxing eating sounds draw in more viewers. Fulfill their requests to collect donations, and decorate the streaming space with wallpapers, a new desk, and stylish outfits for Kalulu. Stop by the shop for ready-made food whenever you would rather skip cooking. The more varied the food on your stream, the more people will join, so your goal is to attract as many viewers as possible.
duckling-rush-io: In this pond arcade, you play a mother duck racing to gather the longest line of ducklings. Glide across a wide pond, scoop up the lost babies you find, and cut through rival mothers' lines to steal their followers. Watch out for the hungry pike, and use your QUACK burst to speed ahead and make nearby rivals wobble. Each round lasts 90 seconds, and whoever finishes with the longest conga line wins bread. The ducklings come in several personalities, including sleepy, brown, punk, and rubber types, along with rare golden ones that are worth extra.

Controls are simple. Hold and drag with your mouse or finger to steer, since the duck always swims forward. Tap the QUACK button in the bottom right corner for a speed burst and shockwave. On a keyboard, the arrow keys or WASD steer the duck, and Space makes it quack.
the-secret-of-the-toy-factory: This first-person horror adventure drops you into a deserted factory where you piece together its hidden history. You will solve puzzles, gather items that might help, and check shadowy rooms carefully, since trouble can strike without warning. Expect fast pursuits, sudden scares, and run-ins with Plush and BOTY. You can hide, run, and use your surroundings to survive.

Each hallway holds something new to discover. Scribbled notes and old traces slowly reveal what happened in the factory and why its toys came to life. On PC, use WASD to move, E to read notes, and Tab to return to the main menu. On mobile, use the on-screen joystick to move, the Main Menu button to return to the menu, and the Read Note button to read notes.
kick-the-zombie-ragdoll-sandbox: In this silly ragdoll physics sandbox, you spend time with Gus, a courteous cartoon zombie who doesn't mind being tugged around, tossed, kicked, or knocked about. The setting is a graveyard lit by the moon. Drag him with your mouse or finger to grab him and send him flying toward bouncy tombstones and walls.

Your tools let you mess with him in many ways. A giant sneaker can boot him, a frying pan can smack him, and you can freeze or zap him. A pumpkin cannon blasts him, and tied balloons carry him off to float away. When his head pops off, it hops right back on, so the mood stays playful. Tap or click to use the selected tool, tap the toolbar to switch tools, and tap the door to change rooms. No keyboard is needed.
check-wednesday-phone: Step into Wednesday Addams' phone in this spooky, slightly unsettling adventure inspired by the Netflix show. You can read emails sent by students at Nevermore, work through puzzles, and dig into the academy's hidden secrets through point-and-click exploration. Tap the phone to get started, then swap its look for moody gothic wallpapers whenever you like.

Beyond the messages, you'll play eerie mini-games and earn coins by completing jobs Wednesday would likely scoff at. Those coins matter, because they open up the next mystery. Look closely at her dorm room, click on odd objects, and crack passwords to uncover what is h
deepglow: Deepglow is a cozy pixel-art clicker set in a night world that glows with living light. Each phase is a countdown, so you must gather quickly. Tap the luminous trees, berry shrubs, springs, stones, and crystals to collect materials, then invest them in a branching upgrade tree offering sharper tools, bigger yields, and longer days.

Keeping your hunger and thirst up matters. An empty stomach weakens your hits, and going thirsty cuts your materials in half. Travel through six biomes toward the heart of the Deepglow. There is no game over, since every phase moves you forward. Between phases, spend your resources to grow stronger and unlock new biomes. On desktop, use the mouse, or the arrow keys or WASD with Space to move and harvest, and press P or Esc to pause. On mobile, tap resources and upgrades, and use the II button to pause.
nubik-in-the-monster-world: Nubik once saved the kittens and wiped out the monsters, but they came back, and the evil Huggy kidnapped the kittens again. This time Nubik is better armed, with an AK-47, an M16, a grenade launcher, a machine gun, and two powerful shotguns. Find the kittens to claim a one million coin reward. Along the way, you can open loot chests, upgrade your character, blow up TNT blocks, and help break Nubik's friend out of prison.

Turn on auto-shoot in the settings menu, which works well on mobile. The main menu lets you adjust mouse sensitivity for PC and swipe sensitivity for mobile. Use the radar to find your way around each level. On PC, move with WASD, rotate the camera with the mouse, shoot with the left button, and press F or E to interact. Tab or Esc pauses the game. On mobile, swipe to rotate the view, use the joystick to move, and tap the screen to shoot.
homeowner-3d: A calm first-person game about fixing up run-down houses. Your jobs cover cleaning, renovation and interior design: haul away trash and dirt, scrub surfaces, take apart old items, paint walls, hang wallpaper, replace flooring and arrange furniture. The money you earn goes toward furniture, pets and real estate, so you can decorate your own home and unlock new goals.

On PC, walk with WASD, run with Shift and look around with the mouse. Hold the left button to clean or take things apart, press E for doors, the laptop and the van, and use F for tools and Tab for the catalog tablet. Q, E or the mouse wheel rotates furniture, and a left click places it. On a phone, the joystick at the bottom left walks, swiping looks around, and holding
catcha: Catcha is a cozy pixel-art game about collecting cats. Fill your room with them, and whenever two cats feel a spark, they leave behind a mystery gift box. Open the boxes to find cats in six rarities, from Common to Super, shown on collectible cards such as HOLO, R-HOLO, G-HOLO, STAR, and the rarest FULL ART.

Your goal is to gather as many cats as you can and finish the Album. Buy and sell boxes and cats at the Auction, level up, and let your favorites roam the Garden. Over 100 cat skins are available, and the room shifts from morning to night. Progress saves automatically. Click or tap to open boxes, buttons, and menus. Drag a cat to move it, release to drop it, or fling it to toss it. Bring two cats with hearts above their heads close together to make a gift box.
break-the-egg-and-run-away: Break the Egg and Run Away is an arcade egg heist with a Roblox-style look. Giant blocky animals guard the eggs, so you swing your pickaxe until one cracks, grab the pet inside, and run it home before the guard catches you. Pets in your pen earn coins, which you can spend on pickaxes, treadmill speed training, or a bigger pen. Speed matters, since guards catch anyone slower than their plot's recommended pace.

Farther locations hold rarer eggs and stronger guards, with ten lands from the Forest onward. Fill the Index with 84 unique blocky pets, hatch rare mounts, and crack the Titanic egg during the luck event, when nearly every egg is a big one. On a keyboard, WASD moves, Space jumps, right-drag turns the camera, scrolling zooms, E holds a pet, and Q drops it. On phones,
fish-eggs-for-animals: Launch your line across a vast 3D ocean in this idle fishing game with tycoon touches. Each cast is a timing test: press CAST and halt the moving meter near its glowing tip, since a closer stop sends your line farther. The spot where your bait lands decides which fish you can hook, and deeper zones hold pricier catches and better luck. Rare fish and unusual mutations are waiting to be found.

Choose your catches from the hotbar and place them in your aquarium, where visitors pay to watch and your money grows every second, even while you're away. Spend earnings on upgrades such as better bait for rarer fish. Practice casts at the TRAIN station to boost your Cast Power and unlock
almost-infinite: Almost Infinite is a relaxed game about crafting and discovery. You begin with Fire, Water, Earth and Wind, then blend them into new things. Fire and Water make Steam, and soon you're shaping volcanoes, dragons, galaxies and microwaves. More than 23,000 items are waiting to be found. Each pairing always gives the same result. Some finds are Relics, final forms that can't be merged further, and collecting them all is the challenge.

Drag an element onto the table, then drop one card onto another to combine them. New discoveries land in your inventory, and some pairs produce nothing, so try another. Search helps you find a card, and you can sort your collection by discovery time or depth. The Relics filter shows your final forms. Undo reverses your last move, Clear Table tidies up, and Hint suggests an untried pair that makes something new. The game works offline, saves your progress, and
run-the-electricity: Run The Electricity is a puzzle game built for calm and mental wellbeing. Instead of fast action or a countdown, you tap the pieces to turn them and link wires, lamps, and power sources into a closed loop so the lights glow. The minimal look, gentle motion, and relaxing soundtrack create a peaceful, yoga-like mood, and it can serve as a way to meditate and ease anxiety.

You can enjoy it at home, on the road, or at work to take your mind off things. Each puzzle takes only seconds, so it suits short breaks or waiting time. Nothing rushes you, since levels have no time limit and you move at your own pace. Later stages grow more varied and interesting, training logic, imagination, focus, and attention, while the simple rules let you have fun right away.
big-bob-s-burger-truck: Create your own burger recipes and sell them from a food truck that travels from town to town. Mix beef, chicken, veggie, or mac and cheese patties with bacon, pineapple, jalapeños, fried eggs, onion rings, and six sauces. Name each creation, set its price, and post it on the menu board. When the window opens, grill the patty and stack every layer in the correct order before waiting diners lose patience. Your notebook records what customers say, helping you shape a menu that suits each crowd.

Three towns hold three crowds, each with its own tastes, such as simple-loving Grandma Pearl, two-patty Trucker Tex, and meat-free Willow. Earn enough stars in one town to unlock the next, then win over all three. Spend your earnings in the Shop on new ingredients and upgrades. Play with a mouse or touch, and press P to pause.
crowd-titan: Crowd Titan is a 3D runner powered by genuine ragdoll physics. You lead a group of people to the finish, passing through plus and minus gates, steering around traps, and outnumbering enemy squads to push past them. Fill the energy bar and your crowd fuses into a giant Titan that smashes whatever blocks its path. Every fifth level ends with a boss.

On desktop, drag with the mouse or use A, D, or the arrow keys to steer, press Space or the Titan button once the bar is full, and hit P to pause. On mobile, drag a finger left or right and tap the Titan button. Coins can be spent on upgrades, and the shop holds more than 150 cosmetic items. You can also spin the wheel and claim a daily gift. In boss fights, your crowd throws people at the boss automatically, so stay out of the red circle where they land and use the Titan to fight back.
deadly-catch: Drop a line with a single tap in Deadly Catch!, a fishing game where you wait for a bite and then reel in your prize. Targets range from small coastal fish to rare deep-sea creatures, and every success brings rewards. The more you play, the more species you'll find across several fishing zones.

Sell your catch for coins, then spend them on stronger rods and floats that speed up fishing and improve your odds with rare species. Buy a boat to sail to other islands, each with its own fishing spots, fish types, and challenges. Your goal is a complete fish collection. On PC, the arrow keys or WASD move your character around the island, and left-clicks handle casting, hooking, and reeling. On mobile, a virtual joystick on the left moves you, while the Cast button on the right throws your line and a second tap hooks and reels in your catch.
mini-golf-battle: Mini Golf Battle is a laid-back putting game where you aim to sink your ball in the hole using as few strokes as possible. Swipe toward the direction you want to travel, then pull back and release to set the power. The further you drag, the harder the shot. Walls, ramps, and barriers can knock your ball off track, so use angles to bounce smartly around corners.

Levels gradually get trickier, packed with slopes, angles, and obstacles that test your timing and precision. Two bonuses can help. Fire Power gives your ball a flaming speed boost, ideal for long straight shots or crossing a large gap in one strike. Wing / Glide Power lets the ball glide with less friction, covering more distance with better control. It suits precise shots where overshooting is a risk. Easygoing but hard to put down, it fits well into quick play sessions.
a-deadly-car-crash: A Deadly Car Crash lets you take the wheel of cars that wreck with lifelike damage. Hard impacts can knock doors, hoods, and wheels clean off. Only one percent of people have ever finished this deadly descent. You can also build your own cars by choosing body colors, swapping parts, and changing the size and placement of the wheels.

Explore a vast open world, race rival cars along the roads, and compete in spectacular crashes. Special crash test areas are there for smashing things on purpose. Controls use WASD to steer, Space to brake hard, Shift for nitro, C to switch the camera, N to change cars, R to put your car back in service, K to repair it, B to slow time, and Tab to open the pause menu. On mobile, on-screen buttons handle everything. Your goal is to drive, crash, and tune however you like.
dragon-hunter: Pick your hero, roll the dice, and set off on a lighthearted journey. In this idle clicker RPG, you tap monsters to keep your fighter alive and work toward defeating the legendary dragons. Your fate depends partly on luck and on how sturdy your phone screen is, so expect some chance along the way.

Your hero grows by defeating foes and opening chests, and each level-up gives random skills that you pay for with money. The story is simple and direct, as is typical for this kind of game, but few games match its quality and its leveling system is engaging. Bosses are far tougher than ordinary enemies. You will also find mini-games, plenty of weapons and armor to buy, and spins. A journal tracks your tasks and achievements. The goal is to visit every location, defeating monsters as you pass through. Everything is controlled by touch or click, and sound is recommended for the atmosphere.
crown-guard: Crown Guard blends fast action with tower defense in a 3D world. You play as a king who must hold off waves of invaders attacking his castle. Pick up the gold that drops, then pause on the marked plots to build or upgrade your towers. You can also recruit knights to fight alongside you, and a royal strike is ready for moments when enemies crowd close.

You can steer with WASD, the arrow keys, or by holding and dragging with a mouse or finger. Stop moving and your king shoots automatically. Press Space or tap the strike button to hit enemies nearby. Survive five waves to unlock the next map, and choose a reward after each wave. Crowns earned along the way can be spent in the pause menu on lasting upgrades for your king. Across 100 maps in 10 biomes, you can unlock new defenses as you go.
car-inspection-tycoon: Run a used car inspection shop in a true-to-life city. Check each customer's vehicle with real equipment: measure paint thickness, open the hood, run an OBD scan, raise the car on a lift, and test the tires, brakes and suspension. Then hand over an honest report. Your earnings pay for new tools, lifts, staff and businesses, helping you grow. You can also take tow truck jobs, open a Bavarian food stand, drive a tuned car, race at the Street Meet, jump mega ramps and challenge players in the Arena.

On a computer, use WASD or the arrow keys to walk and drive, the mouse to look and click, E to interact, Space for the handbrake, C for the hood camera, M for the map and Esc to pause. On a phone or tablet, use the left joystick to move, tap the on-screen buttons to inter
snowtail-peaks-3d-bubble-pop-adventure: Picture a classic bubble shooter set in a shiny three-dimensional landscape. You aim by dragging, and a glowing guide line traces your path, including any bounces off the lane walls. Let go to fire. Three or more matching bubbles pop together, and any left unattached to the top drop away. Tap the launcher to sw
tidy-up-satisfeel-asmr: Tidy Up: Satisfeel ASMR is a soothing game designed to help you unwind and ease stress. Each level presents a cluttered room full of loose items, and your job is to restore order by sorting everything into its proper place. Group items by color, size, type, or category, and enjoy the minigames and organizing puzzles at an easy pace. The controls stay simple: clean, sort, fill, drag, drop, touch, slide, and draw, all with one finger.

Puzzles become more creative and challenging as you advance, rewarding careful thinking and attention to detail. On desktop, click and drag items with the left mouse button to pick up, move, and place them, and use the scroll wheel to zoom or navigate where supported. On mobile, tap and drag items into position, tap to select or place objects, and swipe to move around the scene where supported.
frogtress: A frog lives in a pond where bugs keep arriving without end. The frog licks bugs on its own, so your job is to choose mutations and fuse them into unusual combinations. There are 38 mutations and 20 fusions to find, plus 10 ponds, each with a boss such as the Queen Wasp or the Croc King. The deep waters run all the way to wave 100.

Click or tap a bug to lick it right away. When the belly is full, press CROAK or Space for a big blast. After each wave, pick one of three mutations with a click or the keys 1 to 3, and collect four of the right ones to unlock a fusion. Beat the boss at wave 30 to purify a pond and move deeper. Rebirth is available, a skill tree can grow large, and every pond can be purified. Press P to pause.
pearl-paws: Step into a relaxed seaside shop and tend the shelves alongside adorable animal companions. Lift goods from the crates, carry them to the shelves, then ring up shoppers at the till and gather the cash they leave behind. With those earnings, you can expand into a full beach resort with snack stalls, a beach club, a pier with jet skis and boats, a surf school, and more. Hire helpers along the way.

Watch for sneaky raccoon thieves and catch them by running into them. Finish daily quests, collect pearls, and dress your hero in dozens of outfits. Move with WASD, the arrow keys, or by dragging with the mouse, or drag anywhere on a phone screen. Step onto dashed pads to build or buy, and ride the waves at the surf school.
throw-foods-for-pets: Toss food across 18 different biomes to lure in any of 220 collectible pets. Timing matters: click THROW, then click again when the marker hits the glowing end of the power bar, since better timing sends the food farther. Once a pet trots over to the food, press COLLECT. Pets found at greater distances earn you more money.

Place your catches on your plot from the hotbar, and they generate money every second, even when you step away. Spend it at the glowing circles: Train raises Throw Power, the Food Shop offers food that draws rarer companions, and Upgrades provides lasting boosts plus extra plot room. Once you have earned enough, you can rebirth for permanent bonuses. There is no single ending, but aim for The Last Garden, the final biome, and completing the Pet Index.
meow-squad-zombie-defense: Zombies are shuffling down the street, and a squad of cats is all that stands in their way. Merge two matching cats to create a tougher fighter, starting with small rookies armed with blasters and working up to massive legends carrying rocket launchers. Drop cats onto the barricade boxes and they will fire at the undead on their own. You can also tap zombies directly to bonk them.

Between waves, you choose power-up cards such as lightning storms, meteor showers and frost nova. Each area ends with a huge boss, and the hordes keep growing. Spend coins to recruit new cats and patch up the barricade, and tap add-ons like TNT, spikes or rapid fire when zombies crowd in. Upgrade your cats, barricade and firepower, open chests and climb the campaign. The game works with mouse or touch: drag to merge and place cats, then click or tap to bonk and press buttons.
octo-stickers-merge-and-stick: Octo, a baby octopus with eight busy arms, keeps your board supplied with stickers all by itself, so you only need to merge them. Drag a sticker with a left mouse click onto its twin, moving it from outline to pale to full colour to complete the puzzle. Chain eight quick merges to fill the combo and win a free upgrade, and full combos add bonus stickers to your album.

Every album has set spots for its stickers, plus bonus ones you can place, turn and resize with two fingers. Finished pages are saved as postcards you can share, and then stickers rain through bouncing starfish, bubbles, gems and co
tower-clash: Tower Clash is a bright, real-time strategy game where the routes you draw can swing the battle. Blue towers are your launch points. Connect them to send squads toward enemy or neutral strongholds, take those over, and expand a network of towers, factories, and artillery. Plan carefully, reroute your troops, and push through battlefields that grow harder as you advance.

Victory means capturing every building on the map, neutral towers included, while holding at least one blue building. On desktop, hold the left mouse button and drag from a blue tower or factory to another building. On mobile, touch and drag with one finger. Swipe across one of your own routes to remove it. Drag the artillery ring to aim, and use an airstrike when it's available. Pause with the on-screen button or Escape to adjust music and effects, and use the speaker button to mute or enable sound.
sky-ball-adventure-3d: Sky Ball 3D is an arcade game where you steer a powerful 3D ball along floating sky tracks. You roll, jump across gaps, and dodge obstacles on your way to the finish line. Press left or right to move, up to jump, and down to slow down or brake. Boost pads give you a quick burst of speed.

Each level gets tougher, with moving platforms, traps, sharp turns, and surprise speed boosters. Collect coins to unlock new balls and skins. The beautiful sky-themed 3D levels, smooth controls, and fast-paced action suit players of all ages, and fans of ball rush, rolling, or reflex games should feel at home. The game runs fully offline and supports Fire TV Remotes and game controllers.
delete-it-erase-one-part: Something is hidden within these pictures, and this erase puzzle game invites you to uncover it. Each scene looks ordinary at first, but a closer look reveals odd details. Drag your finger across the screen to wipe away one part and expose the secrets beneath. Every puzzle carries its own story, with unexpected objects, funny touches, or secret endings waiting below the surface. The real challenge is deciding what to erase, since a single stroke can transform the whole scene. Controls use one finger on touchscreens or a left-click drag on desktop, so the game is easy to start but takes skill to master.

Your logic and observation skills get a workout as you hunt for hidden clues and decide whether an answer sits behind an object or in plain sight. Fans of hidden object games and tricky picture puzzles should find this relaxing brain training enjoyable. Study each scene carefully, then erase the correct area to reveal the hidden clue and complete the level.
pets-and-paints-logic-puzzle: Place every animal on the grid and give each one its color in this logic puzzle. Move clue pieces onto the board, merge what they reveal, and complete the gaps. A clue might mention animals, colors, or both. Select a single animal or color tool, then tap or click a cell to place it by hand. Arrows help you browse clues, undo reverses a move, and the cross tool clears a cell.

Every clue must hold true, and each animal-color pair may appear only once. Hundreds of carefully checked puzzles spread across six forest trails, so you can test arrangements and reach the answer at your own pace. Enjoy visual drag-and-drop play, bright animals, nature sounds, and lively effects. Nothing ticks away, and optional extra hints are there if you need them.
container-auction: Step into a simulation where you bid on mysterious containers while rival bots compete against you. Pick a location first, since higher levels offer more valuable containers. From three options, inspect each one and choose the one you want to auction. Look through the gap in the door to judge what might be hidden inside, then decide how much to offer. Rivals will keep pushing the price, so you can raise your bid or pass.
Win the auction and open your container to uncover finds ranging from old books to gold watches and diamond brooches. Each item has a rarity
roll-tycoon: Roll Tycoon is a 3D idle game built around dice. You toss batches of dice with real physics onto an isometric-style tray, read the number on each top face, and collect the payouts. Dice that land on their highest face trigger a JACKPOT and fill the FEVER meter, which doubles payouts for a short stretch. Tap or click the board, press Space, or hit the ROLL button to throw everything waiting. Buy bigger dice across five tiers, from d4 up to d20.

Progress comes from artifacts, mystery chests that drop payout-boosting statues, and a ladder of 30 contracts that always shows your next goal. The ladder continues after your first Rebirth, which also grants permanent star multipliers. Twenty-two trophies pay out when unlocked, while daily and weekly missions and a 7-day Daily Drop give every visit a clear target. Soft pastel visuals, synthesized audio, auto-tuned graphics, rewarded boosts and cloud saves complete the package.
the-hustler: The Hustler is a simulation game where you begin with no money and work your way up to the top. You start out poor, so your first job is to build some wealth. As you get quicker, you can open businesses of your own. You will rush around stocking supplies, keeping long lines of happy customers moving, and gathering piles of cash. The more you work, the larger your empire becomes.

Spend your earnings to move faster, carry more items, and unlock new shops. You manage each shop, lead your workers, and aim to make the most profit you can. The game is a constant race to see how much you can build. Use WASD, the arrow keys, or drag the mouse to move around the restaurant and complete tasks. On mobile, swipe your finger across the screen to move.
hot-diggity-dogs: Hot Diggity Dogs is a relaxed cooking game about running a small hotdog van in the park. You can grill or boil your sausages, then slide buns into a paper boat. Ketchup, mustard and toppings respond to real physics as you squeeze and drop them onto your food.

Each customer has hidden tastes, so pay attention to what they enjoy and what they avoid. You can follow their orders or experiment with your own recipes and surprise them with extras. When a hotdog is ready, swipe it up or tap the green arrow to serve it at the window. Each shift earns coins and stars, which you can spend in the shop on ingredients, upgrades and van decor as your stand grows. It works with mouse or touch.
survival-tycoon-city-of-zombie: Survival Tycoon: City of Zombie is an idle strategy game set in the middle of a zombie outbreak. You lead a group of survivors, keeping the barrier standing against the horde while gathering resources. It suits anyone who enjoys running a camp and wiping out waves of enemies.

Research deadly gear, from spikes to huge decoy bombs, then drag it from the bottom panel onto the marked spots. Move between motels and farms, upgrade your camp, unlock new areas, and send scavengers out for fuel. Follow the quest list, build facilities, and automate your income. Click buildings to boost their durability, damage, or income, and click zombies or map objects to help directly. Use the mouse: drag to place traps, and left-click for menus and actions.
mahjong-pirate-plunder-quest: Sail the Caribbean as a daring pirate captain in this Mahjong solitaire take on the classic puzzle. Your aim is to spot matching free tiles and remove them until the board is bare. Instead of traditional symbols, the tiles show seafaring images such as treasure chests, gold coins, parrots, cannons, ships, anchors, and skulls, all drawn in bright, adventurous art.

Every level awards up to three stars: one for finishing, one for doing it without hints, and one for beating the clock. Over 4,000 levels await, and you can unlock fresh backgrounds and join daily challenges as you move along your plunder quest. On desktop, a left mouse click selects a free tile so you can match it with its identical twin.
zombie-mission-6: The sixth episode of Zombie Mission opens with a fresh storyline. Once a map is seized, the crew heads out into the desert, where the undead team has taken several prisoners. You and a friend work together to rescue them. Expect a mini boss and a mega boss to stand in your way, and you'll need to defeat both.

Coins you earn can be spent on better weapons and a bigger health bar. Check the market icon between levels to see your options. Player 1 moves with W, A, S, and D, strikes with F, throws grenades with G, jumps with W, and switches weapons with Q. Player 2 uses the arrow keys to move, L to strike, K for grenades, the up arrow to jump, and P to switch weapons. Both players can walk on walls.
king-rugni-tower-defense: You place and upgrade towers that shoot at incoming enemies. King Rugni leads the defense through several territories, facing hordes of elemental foes. There is no storyline, so the focus stays on the battles. The maps range from forests to snowy winter settings, and the design, music, and effects are a highlight.

Some enemies walk directly along the path, while others fly straight at their target, so you must prepare for both. Defeating foes earns gems for building new towers, and winning levels brings gold for upgrades and new purchases. You must finish all waves to win a level. You start with 10 lives and need to keep at least one to complete each stage. Beware the final boss of each zone, because if it makes it through alive, you lose. Playing with sound is recommended.
super-car-soccer-arena: Powerful sports cars take the place of soccer players in this high-speed take on football. Drive into the arena, boost across the field, and smash a giant ball into the opposing goal. Drifts, aerial flips, and turbo bursts help you outplay rivals. Matches are fast, the controls feel smooth, and the dynamic arenas keep every game unpredictable.

Use W, A, S, D or the arrow keys to drive forward, reverse, and steer. Shift fires a Nitrous Boost for attacks or defense, while Space brakes for sharp stops or controlled drifts. Move the mouse to look around, tap C to change camera views, and press R to reset your car instantly if it flips or gets stuck. Score goals, unlock new cars, and outscore the enemy before time is up.
magic-princess: Magic Princess is an offline dress-up and character maker with a fashionable, ultra-casual simulation feel and a bright anime chibi look. Girls of every kind can design a sweet little doll, building an avatar or a memoji-style character. You can make your doll resemble an international star or a charming gothic figure. More than 1000 dress-up items, skin tones and hairstyles are available.

Some clothes and items feature high quality animation, and you can take striking photos or videos of your dolls. Share a painted doll with friends, and every creative design is recorded so you can revisit it. Touch the screen with your finger to give your doll a makeover, apply suitable cosmetics, dress her in many outfits, arrange a scene, and create a unique photo memory.
toybox-pixel-world-sandbox: Toybox: Pixel World Sandbox is a 2D physics playground where you build with pixel blocks and fill the space with ragdoll characters like cats, rabbits, and pigs. Add weapons and objects, then watch everything react. Set up red-versus-green team battles, switch bot fights on or off, or take control of a character yourself.

Gather wood and crystals to craft new equipment, then reshape your creation and try another idea. There are no set missions or single winning path, since your next experiment is the goal. On desktop, use the mouse to place and drag, pan by dragging empty space, and zoom with the wheel or the plus and minus keys. Control a character with A and D or the arrow keys, W to jump, Space or right click to attack, and G to drop items. On mobile, tap to place, drag to interact, and use the on-screen controls.
doggydoku: DoggyDoku is a sudoku-style puzzle duel with a cartoon dog theme. You and a rival race through logic grids against a five-minute clock. Each board is split into colored regions, and you must place one dog in every row, column, and region without any two dogs touching, even diagonally. Double-tap a tile to place a dog, and illegal placements are rejected.

Single-tap or swipe across empty tiles to mark them with an X as you deduce. When you're stuck, the lightbulb hint costs 50 coins and reveals one forced dog, updating after each move. Solve more boards than your rival before time runs out to climb the Pup Ladder, earning coins, rank points, and unlocks like cosmetics, daily tasks, and season pass rewards. Matches feel online, but everything runs locally with no real backend.
bow-brawls: Bow Brawls is a top-down archery survival game where you fight off endless waves of foes. Drag the control opposite your target, then release to loose an arrow, much like a real bow. Enemies attack from every direction, including melee fighters and ranged shooters. Bosses appear every few waves with unique moves like dashing, leaping, or launching projectiles, so stay alert. Keep an eye on your health bar.

Defeating bosses earns gems that unlock new bows and armors with different abilities, while higher scores open new arenas. Points come from enemy kills, and each enemy type is worth a different amount. Five bows, five armors, and five arenas await, and each one changes how you play. Compete on
bonk-islands: Bonk Islands is a bright physics brawl for four oddball combatants fighting on small floating islands while lava creeps upward beneath them. Rockets fly, terrain breaks apart under your shots, and unusual weapons can launch rivals into the air. Your goal is to stay on solid ground, avoid hazards, and be the final combatant still alive.
Pick a weapon, drag backward and let go to aim
grazing-giraffe: Grazing Giraffe is a relaxed sliding puzzler about a famished, very long giraffe. Swipe to send it gliding across the savanna. It keeps going until a wall, tree, or pond halts it, its neck trailing behind. Fill every square of the trail to eat all the leaves and clear the level. Your own neck can block you, so plan each move and rewind when you corner yourself.

The game has 64 hand-built levels across eight savanna chapters, from Grassland to Starlit Savanna, with new mechanics introduced as you progress. On touch devices, swipe and tap the rewind button. On a keyboard, use the arrow keys or WASD to slide, and press R or Backspace to rewind. Space or Enter also rewinds when you're
lighthouse-mage-idle-defense: Lighthouse Mage: Idle Defense places you on a small island where your lighthouse does the shooting on its own. Its magic bolts strike crabs, jellyfish, eels, pirate rafts, and giant sea bosses that arrive from all directions. Every tenth wave brings a boss. During a run, you can spend gold on damage, attack speed, health, armor, and income by tapping the upgrade cards along the bottom of the screen.

Pearls and relics gathered along the way unlock lasting upgrades, and four spells can be unlocked and cast with the buttons on the right. You can also sail on to icy, volcanic, and abyss seas. For extra punch, press and drag across the water with your mouse or finger to steer the beam yourself, which deals double damage. When the lighthouse falls, spend your pearls at the Harbor and try again to reach a higher wave.
smashsite-io: SmashSite.io is a 3D slapstick brawler set on a busy construction site, where over 90 fighters try to knock each other flat. You begin as a small rookie with a shovel, munch snacks to grow, and can eventually become a huge Titan boss. A single hit can launch someone across the arena, and the hazard zone keeps shrinking.
Single hits knock opponents out instantly, and swin
snowboard-knockout-race-game: Eight riders race down the same mountain, and only one of them reaches the bottom first. Carve through the gate flags, launch off kickers, and spin 360s or 720s while holding a grab. Each clean trick adds to your combo. Rivals can get in your way: a snowball flips a rider onto his back, and a hard hit sends him tumbling down the slope. Rails to grind, coins to collect, and a snowmobile speed boost are also on the mountain.

Three cups hold twelve stages, from the bunny bowl and pine run up to the summit, set in golden hour, night shift, and whiteout. Once those are done, an endless run keeps the slope going while the riders keep speeding up. On mobile, drag to steer and tap a kic
obby-parkour-crazy-descent: Obby Parkour: Crazy Descent is a 3D arcade game that tests your speed and reactions. You drop downward through a series of generated platforms, trying to get as deep as you can while avoiding obstacles that keep moving. One mistake sends you tumbling into the void. As you get lower, every platform you clear makes the game faster, so each run becomes more hectic.

Along the way, you can grab gold coins sitting on the platforms and spend them in the shop. There you'll find pets, viral meme characters such as Six-Seven, Ballerina Capuchina and Tralalero, and accessories ranging from glasses and capes to the legendary Dominus. New levels unlock as you travel further down.

On PC, use WASD or the arrow keys to move, and hold the right mouse button while moving the mouse to turn the camera. On phones and tablets, drag the virtual joystick to move and swipe across the screen to look around.
little-city-merge: Little City Merge is a relaxed building game with a hand-drawn pencil look. Tap open plots to place homes, shops, and civic buildings, then drag two matching ones together to combine them into something larger. A small hut can grow into a towering skyscraper, and a market stall can become a huge megamall. Shops make coins, homes bring residents, and civic buildings unlock new land.

Spend coins on upgrades that raise earnings, speed up construction, and add energy. Each city asks for a civic building of a certain level, so reach that goal and travel to the next city. Every stop has its own architecture and twists, and your town keeps earning while you're away. Use mouse or touch: tap to build, drag to merge, move, or swap, and drop items on the trash bin to remove them. Building uses energy, which refills over time, and merging civic buildings requires enough residents.
cooking-in-the-city-of-winds: The culinary festival in the City of Winds opens today, and cooks from across the magical land have arrived to make their favorite dishes for the citizens. You can try smooth pudding, tapioca bubble tea, and the well-known Hocus-Pocus marmalade dessert, a real treat for anyone with a sweet tooth.

A dish has to taste good and look lovely, so decorate yours as gracefully as you can, and victory awaits. The Windy City is famous for exotic cuisine with many complex recipes built from unusual ingredients, but you can still recreate a few from its cookbook. Save your finished creation as a PNG image. Control works with a mouse click on a computer or a simple touch on a touchscreen.
restore-lab: Restore Lab is a relaxed idle game about running a repair shop. You begin with a single workbench and a pair of grimy sneakers, then grow them into a full restoration business. Tap objects to fix them faster, upgrade your benches in bulk with x1, x10 or MAX, and hire helpers who keep working even when you step away. Eight kinds of treasure wait to be restored: sneakers, mugs, teddy bears, pocket watches, vintage cameras, toy trains, music boxes and
shoot-the-blocks: Shoot The Blocks is a laid-back 3D shooter about wrecking blocky islands. You blast houses, forests and towers apart piece by piece. Dynamite and lightning blocks can set off chain reactions that spread across the whole island. Spend coins on new guns, upgrades and artifacts, and any gun that reaches level 10 starts firing on its own.

Ammo is limited, so every shot counts. Destroyed blocks stay gone, so when you run dry, visit the shop, upgrade your weapons and head back to finish the job. On keyboard and mouse, hold the left button to fire, use A and D to rotate the camera, W and S to tilt it, plus and minus to zoom, and F to reset the view. Switch weapons with 1 to 9, Q,
night-torque: Night Torque puts you in drag races where timing matters as much as raw speed. You need accurate starts and shifts that land at the right moment, whether you're racing through 10 districts or facing 60 career rivals. Collect 20 cars and fine-tune their engines, gearboxes and tires as you go.

Make each car your own with paint, wheels, spoilers and decals. An interactive opening teaches the controls, and practice mode lets you sharpen your technique before you tackle 60 mastery challenges that use fixed loan setups. Optional rewarded videos grant extra in-game coins. On desktop, hold Space, Up Arrow, Enter or the on-screen control before the start to keep the revs in the launch zone, then tap to shift when the indicator reaches green. On mobile, hold the on-screen control to launch and tap it to shift, and turn your phone sideways to race.
rocket-bloom: Press and hold anywhere, or hit SPACE, to fire the engine and send your small rocket up off the pad. The craft has actual mass, so when you let go it loses speed, pauses and drops, and a fresh hold lifts it back into the air. Steer with a swipe or the arrow keys to collect coins, pass through rings, burst balloons and pick up fuel cans. Snag ten coins without a break to trigger AFTERBURN, which also gives you triple coins. Time a stage separation so the ring glows green and tap for a PERFECT boost.

Your coins buy upgrades: a stronger engine, a larger fuel tank, longer fins, richer coins and a tractor beam. Build a second rocket and merge the pair into a new, tougher model, with twelve to unlock. Your main target is SPACE at 100,000 m, and beyond that you can keep going until you reach the Moon.
mushroom-hunting-forest-search: Head into the woods for a calm search through a forest full of mushrooms. This hidden object simulator is made for people who love them. Read each mushroom's description, then look for it among the leaves and grass. Some are poisonous, so choose carefully. The forest includes birch groves, spruce woods, and meadows tangled with growth.

Tap doubtful patches of grass to uncover mushrooms, then decide whether each one goes in your basket or gets passed by. More than 30 species are waiting to be found. Finish quests for the villagers, sell your harvest at the market, and open new forest locations. Eating the wrong thing means finding the village healer. It suits slow walks, searching puzzles, and a peaceful break from daily life.
100-doors-puzzle-box: 100 Doors Puzzle Box is a puzzle and escape room adventure with dozens of levels, each offering its own challenge, mysterious doors, and hidden secrets. You explore rooms, search for concealed objects, combine items, and work through clever puzzles to unlock the next door. Some tasks call for logic, sharp attention, and creative thinking.

The game draws on the spirit of classic door-opening and escape titles, but it adds modern 3D graphics and smooth animations. Its interactive mechanics are fun to explore, and the escape room atmosphere gives every room a distinct mood. The controls are simple: use the mouse to interact with objects and doors, and press A or D to move your character. Your goal is to open every door and get through all the challenges.
try-to-count-the-boxes-brain-training: This brain game tests how well you remember, how quickly you react, and how steadily you focus. A group of boxes flashes on screen for a moment, and your job is to hold the total in your head. Once they disappear, tap to raise your guess or type the number directly, then hit Done. Each round rewards you for being both quicker and more precise.

Play solo in focus mode to beat your own time and accuracy, or compete against a friend on the same device or in multiplayer. In local or multiplayer matches, 20 rounds are played and the most accurate player wins. Controls are simple taps, rounds are short, and it runs on desktop and mobile. It is a quick way to train memory, logic, agility, and reaction time.
fruit-mahjong: Fruit Mahjong brings classic solitaire matching into three dimensions. Colorful fruit tiles sit in stacked layers before an old jungle temple, and the twin you need might be hiding on the far side. Drag to spin the board, spot two identical tiles, and clear them. A tile is only available when one of its sides is open. Tiles blocked on both left and right, or on both front and back, stay locked until the tiles around them are gone.

All 50 levels share one six-minute clock, and each finished board adds ten seconds. Chain matches quickly to build a combo: every pair scores more than the last, the chime rises as your streak grows, and one slip resets the multiplier. Stuck? Use a hint to reveal a pair or shuffle the remaining tiles. When you run out, a short video grants another. Your best score is saved, so each run gives you a fresh try at beating it.
mine-and-rush-survival: You are a dwarf miner trapped in a bug-infested cave in this fast, top-down survival shooter. Each mission asks you to collect a target resource, defeat enough enemies or beat a boss, then reach your ship. Your gun and pickaxe work automatically, so you mostly need to stay close to foes and rocks. Dig into glowing rocks for gold and crystals, and grab blue elixir to fill your XP bar.
six-seven-count-fast: Can you tell six from seven at a glance? Apples, stars, coins, or hearts flash on screen for about a second, and each correct answer makes the next flash shorter. Count by eye and pick 6 or 7 before the timer bar runs out. Longer streaks bring harder piles with mixed sizes, overlapping heaps, drifting groups, and decoys in a different color and shape that don't count. One wrong answer ends the run.
Reach a streak of 67 to face the final boss, a giant 67 built from 67 items. Pick how many you saw with the buttons or keys 1 to 4
snow-plow-inc: Snow Plow Inc. is a calm plowing game where you steer an orange plow truck through deep drifts and thick ice. Scoop up snow blocks until your truck bed is full, then drive back to the yard and onto the selling pad to turn your load into coins. On a keyboard, use WASD or the arrow keys. On mobile, drag anywhere on the screen to steer.

The game has 15 carefully crafted levels, and the snow gets tougher as you advance, moving from soft powder to packed snow and finally solid ice. Clear the field to earn up to three stars and unlock the next level. Spend coins on plow count, plow teeth, plow power, engine, earnings, or capacity. The Shop also offers fuel and boosters, and logging in each day brings rewards. Your progress saves automatically.
farmers-vs-aliens: You guide livestock toward their pens, which are marked with green arrows and show matching pictures. Your job is to keep everyone within the green area, since stepping out with yourself or any animal lets a UFO swoop in and carry them off. As time goes on, the game eases off at one point, but if the herd isn't collected quickly enough, invaders show up to grab the animals.

The round ends when more than two animals have been taken or when the aliens catch you. Controls vary by device: on PC, left-click so your character follows the pointer; on mobile, drag the on-screen joystick toward where you want to go; with a gamepad, push the left stick and your character runs in that direction. Stay quick and keep inside the green zone to survive.
solitaire-tile-match: Start by tapping tiles on the board to send them down to your dock. Gather three identical tiles and they disappear. Tiles sit in layers, so removing the top ones uncovers the pieces beneath. Each stage brings new arrangements and a tighter dock, so one rushed tap can end your attempt.

The game offers hundreds of hand-made levels across several chapters, each with its own tile patterns and difficulty curve. When you get stuck, four power-ups can help: Undo a pick, Shuffle the board, request a Hint, or add an Extra Slot. Coins and Gems can be collected and spent, and daily login rewards are waiting whenever you return. The bright, cl
tug-pull-crash-challenge: Tug Pull Crash Challenge is a racing game set in a pulling contest where modified cars fight to gain the upper hand. Your goal is to drag your opponent toward dangerous crushing machines while keeping your own car out of their reach. Keep an eye on engine temperature, since pushing too hard will make it overheat. You can upgrade wheels and body parts, and unlock new worlds to explore. Explosive hazards are scattered across the arena, so stay alert.
Controls are simple: press and hold Space, W, the Up Arrow, or
pop-it: Pop It! takes the well-known Minesweeper formula and adds playful extras. Special cells can hand out bonuses or trigger effects, and successful moves are rewarded with bright fireworks and sound effects. Random events bring surprises along the way, and several difficulty levels let you pick your challenge. Both newcomers and seasoned fans should find it approachable.

On a computer, left-click to open a cell and right-click to plant a flag on a suspected bomb. Drag and drop places a popper. On a phone or tablet, tap to open a cell, and use drag and drop to flag a bomb or place a popper. Your goal is to open every safe cell and flag every bomb without setting one off. Numbers show how many bombs touch a cell, so use that information to reason carefully. One wrong move can end the round.
animal-basketball: Animal Basketball is a sports game where cute kittens, chicks, and crocodiles each take shots in their own style. Some moves make the screen pulse with a heartbeat-style warning. More than 100 special basketballs, including pizza, fishbowl, and baseball designs, add plenty of variety.

Four courts, a seaside beach, a sunset countryside, a deep forest, and dangerous cliffs, each bring their own surprises to every basket. Arcade Rampage is a 60-second challenge with stacking combos and full-screen blasts, while Road to the Championship counts how many shots you can make without missing. Achievement Miss
thousand-suns: Thousand Suns is a short space strategy game that lasts about five minutes. You and four computer-controlled rivals begin with a single home world, and the goal is to bring the whole galaxy under your control. Boosting your output, staying ahead in technology, and moving fleets between stars packs a full empire war into roughly the length of a coffee break.

Your home planet builds ships on its own. Send the growing fleet out to seize neutral worlds or strike enemy territory. Each planet you capture adds production, options, and pressure on the four bots chasing the same goal. Left-click a planet you control to select it, then left-click a target to send your fleet. Drag from one of your planets to another to create a ferry lane, which makes new ships flow to the destination automatically. Click a lane to remove it. Click the pulsing arrow above a upgraded planet to choose Industry, Agriculture, or Research. Press Tab to return to the main menu.
colorpicker: ColorPicker is a colour-perception puzzle built from voxel art. Each board is a grid of chunky, rounded 3D cubes in one colour, except for one (later two or three) that is a shade off. Spot the odd ones before time runs out. Every cube you find shatters into voxels, which assemble into pixel-art pictures cube by cube across a growing set of albums.

As you advance, the boards grow larger and the colour gaps shrink, testing how sharp your eyes really are. Tap or click the odd cube: a correct pick adds a little time and loads the next, harder board, while a wrong tap costs 3 seconds. Each level fills the ADD TIME bar, and a full bar grants 5 seconds. Hold BUILD on the home screen to spend your voxels on album pictures. HINT removes some wrong cubes, and a second chance keeps you going when time runs out. It works with touch or mouse only.
mutant-zone-zombie-merge-fighter: A dangerous zombie virus has spread across the world, and mutant hordes now crowd the city streets. Wield a machine gun and push through risky routes in many places, including cities, factories, military bases, and laboratories. You win each area by clearing it of undead. Merging drives your progress: combine two identical items to raise their level, and mix weapons and armor to shape a fighter with special abilities. The character editor lets you build a look that is entirely your own.

Weapons range from bats and knives to grenade launchers, flamethrowers, and plasma guns. Expect zombies, mutants, and powerful bosses, plus treasure chests and enemy outposts to capture. The game blends merge, strategy, fighting, and sandbox play. Buy a loot box with the button that shows its price, open it by clicking it in your inventory, and send your fighter out with the "TO BATTLE" button.
stonks: Stonks! follows an amoeba with big evolutionary dreams and a shaky strategy: keep leaping upward until nature gives in. Cling to platforms, gain height, and try not to find out how deep the abyss goes. Higher runs bring trickier stages, with shifting platforms and tighter routes, so every clumsy jump becomes a short, unhappy experiment.

Press and hold with your finger or left mouse button, pull in a direction, and release to jump. The length and angle of your pull decide the direction and power. Collect biomass to strengthen your jumps and unlock new evolution stages. Once the mid-air jump is available, you can push the amoeba one extra time while airborne to adjust course or reach a platform. Each run is a chance to beat your personal records for height, time, and biomass, and gravity still has the upper hand.
police-drift-escape: Police Drift Escape is a top-down survival game where you play a getaway driver. Police cars come at you from every direction, so you must slide, dodge, and grab cash while staying out of their reach. The open surface has no roads, no traffic, and no complicated rules, just arcade chase action.

Your car keeps moving, so smooth steering lets you turn, slide, and escape at the last instant. Police cars are faster, but they cannot corner as sharply as you, so you can use that to make them miss. No weapons are needed. Lure pursuers into crashing together for extra score. Cash bundles appear mid-chase: golden ones pay more, but some sit in risky spots, and survival always comes first. The longer you last, the more police arrive and the tighter the screen becomes.
bite-club: BITE CLUB drops you into a late-night TV eating show that has gone badly wrong. Every set is flooded with giant desserts, and you chew your way out from a first-person view. Each bite opens a real tunnel through jelly, sponge cake, chocolate, and candy.

Once your stomach is packed full, head to the WEIGH-IN scale (an arrow points the way) to collect your cash. Spend it on bigger bellies and better utensils, build HYPE combos, and search for hidden rooms and 24 props. Reach the green EXIT door at the back of each set to escape all six TV sets. Hold the left mouse button to eat, use WASD or the arrow keys to move, the mouse to look, Space to jump, and B for the shop. On mobile, your left thumb moves, dragging on the right looks around, and the EAT and JUMP butt
kinetic-puzzle: Kinetic Puzzle is a brain teaser played on a grid of sliding blocks. Once you push a block, it keeps going in that direction until it hits a wall, an obstacle, or another block. Your goal is to clear every red, yellow, and blue block through the orange portals on the edges, while gray blocks stay where they are. Red blocks can slide any way and leave through any portal, yellow blocks move and exit only along their arrow, and blue blocks stay locked until their prerequisite block is gone.

The game includes over fifty handmade levels that grow from gentle slides to longer chains of dependencies. Its bold, chunky art style gives each move a satisfying feel, there are no timers, and your progress saves automatically. You can undo moves, ask for a hint, restart, or pause. Swipe with a mouse or your finger, or drag a block through an aligned portal to remove it. It works on mobile, tablet, and desktop, and suits anyone who enjoys thinking before they move.
duohex: Duohex is a pixel-art auto-battler built around magic. You purchase spells and place them on a two-page spellbook, where neighbouring spells connect and boost one another before each duel plays out on its own. You can face AI mages solo, or team up with an AI partner in a two-mage squad and compete through an eight-entry tournament.

Your goal is to collect 10 trophies before your lives run out. In the shop, drag spells onto the book using a mouse or your finger on a touch screen. Buying a second copy of a spell merges the two together. You can reroll the offers for 1 gold, lock an offer you want to keep, or sell spells you no longer need. Spells on the same page that sit side by side link up, and once you have arranged everything, the battles run automatically. In Duo mode, your AI partner handles shopping and fights at your side.
crazy-racing-in-the-sky: Race through a range of different levels and collect money as you go. Use your earnings to buy the car you really want. The game has two modes. Career pays you once you finish a level, while Free driving drops you onto a large map where you can test your car and learn how it handles. More than ten cars are available, and each one differs in speed, acceleration and braking, so your choice affects how quickly and easily you clear a level. The graphics and car physics are designed to feel realistic.
Steer with WASD or the arrow keys, pull the handbrake with Spacebar, and press Tab to change the camera view. Press P to pause and R to respawn. See how many levels you can unlock.
starweave-star-puzzle: Starweave is a space puzzle that feels calm yet still makes you think. The sky has gone dark, so you reconnect hidden constellations by linking stars until they glow again. Each level hides a different constellation. Click or tap and drag to weave a glowing trail while staying clear of stellar hazards, orbits, and cosmic friction. Crush floating obstacles before they block your path, and use hints when you need the correct connection.
There are no timers, no lives, and no high-score pressure, just you and the stars. Plan your route carefully, since one wrong connection means rethin
