crush-hour: Rush hour now belongs to the dead, and your truck is the only thing pushing through it. The rig steers itself down an endless highway while you smash zombies for score and combos. Weave past traffic or hop onto the sidewalk when the lanes get messy. Clipping a car costs a little health for a few points, while hitting a truck hurts more but pays out more.

Grab fuel cans before the tank runs dry, and collect the orange Rampage pickup to set off a smash frenzy. Clean driving that slips close to other vehicles earns rewards. There is no finish line: the wreck ends the run, and the high score is the win, so beat your best and climb the leaderboard. On desktop, the left and right arrows or A and D change lanes, and Spacebar retries after a wreck. On mobile, swipe left or right.
hero-evolution-endless-power: You play as Ratmir, the last archer of the Storm Guard, trying to survive an endless Horde. Hundreds of enemies press in while you loot chests and level up your skills across a massive tree of abilities modeled on Path of Exile. Six bosses each bring their own trial phases, and every run leaves you a little stronger.

Move with WASD, the arrow keys, or a joystick on mobile, and your attacks fire automatically. Dash with Space or Shift to slip through projectiles, use skills 1 through 4 or F, open the map with M, and pause with Esc. Collect XP crystals, pick upgrades when you level up, and avoid red circles and lines on the ground. Defeat the lord before the timer runs out, staying inside the shrinking zone. Choose from Story, Endless, Daily Run, or Armageddon modes. Between runs, open chests, equip better gear, and spend gold to upgrade your skills.
2048-cube-shooting-merge: 2048 Cube Shooting Merge is an online puzzle game made for people who enjoy challenging brain teasers and logic-based merge games. It is presented in 3D, and its physics are wild and fun to watch. The squares never stay in one place; they pop up as you play. Shooting is part of the mix, yet the gameplay is much simpler than the premise suggests.
obby-mine-build-launch: Obby: Mine, Build, Launch is a browser clicker built around a simple idea: dig up resources, improve your gear, and grow your mining empire. Pick up a tool, break blocks, and gather the loot that drops, turning each run into progress. Better tools let you mine faster and carry more, while a stronger base processes what you collect and unlocks bigger boosts. Hired workers handle routine farming so you can aim for larger upgrades, and your income climbs as you go.

Add cute pets that help you mine and speed up your progress, and collect skins to customize your character. New tools and upgrades keep the grind smooth and rewarding. On PC, move with W, A, S, and D and mine or harvest with the right mouse button. On mobile, use the joystick to move and tap the right side of the screen to mine.
harbor-dispatch: Harbor Dispatch puts you at the controls of a brightly colored helicopter on rescue missions. You fly over coastal roads and island waters, searching for stranded people and carrying them safely to the hospital. Upgrades let your helicopter hold more passengers and move faster. Each run is a five-minute shift, and the goal is to see how many people you can save before time runs out.

Steer with WASD or the arrow keys, or hold the mouse toward where you want to go. On touchscreens, drag your finger instead. Releasing the control applies the brakes. To pick someone up, stop inside a rescue circle, then land on the H to deliver them. Fuel pads refill your tank, and service pads are where you buy upgrades. Rescue as many people as you can before the shift ends.
hooked-panya-fishing: Hooked! Panya: Fishing is an arcade game built around timing. You cast your line, then tap to reel in while the indicator sits inside a moving green zone, landing the catch before it escapes. Thirteen fish swim in Bamboo River, and each one fights in its own style: calm, brisk, aggressive, heavy or erratic. Chain catches together to enter Endless Mode, where rarer fish appear and the diffic
color-match-rush: Color Match Rush is a very fast arcade game you play with one thumb, made for short sessions and chasing a high score. A glowing ring of colored segments turns at the center of the screen while colored dots speed inward toward a fixed gate at the top. You spin the ring so the segment under the gate matches the color of the incoming dot. A correct match raises your score, but a single wrong color ends the run, and there is no room for a second try.

Controls are simple. On desktop, click with the cursor to rotate the colors, and on mobile, tap to do the same. The challenge grows as you play. You start with four colors at a calm pace, and every 10 points brings a new level that adds another color. Keep in mind that a ball can only pass through a portal of its own color, so you must match the portal to the ball in time or lose the game.
orbital: Orbital is a quick reflex test. Rings squeeze toward a glowing core from all directions, and your spark has to weave around it and find a way through the openings. Crystals appear in the most dangerous gaps, so collect them one after another to grow your combo.
Stay alive to collect stars and open new worlds: Neon, Lava, and Ice, each with its own twist. Crystals bu
red-blue-forge: Red-Blue Forge is a fast-reflex arcade game built around a spinning central core. Your job is to rotate its orbs so they match the embers heading toward it, and to keep going for as long as you can. The classic mode uses two colors, Red and Blue. Unlocking four-color mode adds Green and Yellow, which raises the intensity and offers a x3 score multiplier. Touch and mouse both work, and each session stays short.

Tap or click left or right to turn the core and line up with each ember before it reaches the middle. Every correct match builds your score, while a mismatch ends the session. Press Ready to begin each run. Materials gathered between runs feed the Forge Tree
mem-brawl-merge-simulator: Mem Brawl is a merge puzzle game where you combine Brainrot meme characters. You can recruit fighters such as Skibidi Toilet, Gugugaga, and Granny, along with other legendary brainrot figures. Pairing two identical fighters creates a stronger version, and higher levels bring bigger income. Clicker mechanics and arena battles are both part of the game.
tic-tac-toe-paper-note: Many people have already played plenty of Tic-Tac-Toe, but this version feels different. It is built to look and play as though you were marking a sheet of paper in the real world. Game sounds and effects add to the experience and make each move feel more lively.

To start a match for two players, pick the PLAYER VS PLAYER option, choose the mark you want, and press the GO button. Everything is controlled with a left click of the mouse. This classic logic and brain game suits anyone who enjoys a puzzle that sharpens thinking.
samurai-survivor: In ancient Japan, a strange gateway has appeared and begun releasing monstrous creatures across the land. A band of brave samurai stands as the final barrier between these beasts and their homeland. Each warrior carries special abilities passed down through many generations. Together, they must seal the gateway and bring peace back to the realm.

Expect to face hundreds of enemies as you gain levels and strengthen your skills. The arrow keys move you up, down, left, or right. You can also hold the left mouse button and drag to head in any direction. On mobile, touch the screen to move in every direction.
smash-and-merge-balls: In this skill-based arcade game, you steer a character who kicks off a chain of fusions among colorful balls. Strike the balls to set them in motion. When two balls of the same color crash together, they merge and award points. Build long runs of merges to push your high score as high as you can.

The game is framed as a showman's Arena of Fusion, where you wield a merger mallet on the arena floor. Move with WASD or the touchscreen joystick, dash with Space or the touch button, and hit with the left mouse button or the touch button. Each merge creates another ball of random color, so the chain can keep going.
cards-in-fool: Cards in Fool is a turn-based online card game for multiplayer play. A trump card is revealed at the start, and its suit outranks every other suit for the whole match. The player holding the lower trump goes first. The attacker leads with any card, and the defender must answer with a higher card of the same suit or with a trump. If the defender cannot answer, they pick up the cards, and the player who failed to defend then takes the lead.

Your aim is to outwit opponents and force them to draw cards. You win by getting rid of your hand once the deck is empty. If every player runs out of cards at the same time, the match is a draw and no points are gained or lost. Each win and draw is tracked on the leaderboard, so you can watch your standing rise as you earn points.
bmx-xtreme-3d-stunt: BMX XTreme 3D Stunt is a single-player arcade game about riding a bike through a 3D world and performing stunts. It includes 100 levels to work through, and it runs in the browser thanks to Unity3D and WebGL. Each level gives you a new course to tackle, so you can keep building your stunt skills as you go.

Driving is handled with the W, A, S, and D keys, and the spacebar makes you jump. If you need to open the menu, press Tab. The controls are easy to pick up, so you can start riding and trying tricks right away.
slap-champ: Slap Champ is a slapping contest where your goal is to earn the crown. You can face the computer or switch to two-player mode and challenge a local friend. In India the game is called Crow Fly Sparrow Fly, and it is also known as Salt Pepper. In each exchange, you either land a slap on your opponent or take one and then try to defend yourself.

A power meter sweeps back and forth from left to right. If you stop it when it reaches the middle, your slap carries maximum power. The controls are simple, since a mouse click or a tap is all you need. It takes little effort to pick up, yet it's easy to keep coming back for one more match. The mood is casual and relaxing, and anyone who enjoys slapping, smacking or hitting should find it fun. The difficulty rises with every level.
brain-coloring-puzzle: Brain Coloring Puzzle invites you into the viral world of Italian Brainrot meme characters. Over thirty silly creatures wait to be painted, with no numbers or hints to lean on, so your sense of color and playful mood do the work. Standouts include Bombardiro Crocodilo, the trickiest color-matching boss, Tung Tung Tung Tung Sahur, a viral favorite, and Shimpanzinni Bananinni, Boneca Ambalabu and Tralalero Tralala.
Choose from four or five bright shades, then apply them to outfits, shoes, hair and more. Surreal figures like Fake Trippi Troppa will keep you guessing, and you have
tricky-queue-logic-puzzle: The festival is about to begin, but the animal guests have ended up out of sequence. Each puzzle gives clues about who must lead the line, who needs to stand ahead of someone else, and which animals must share a spot side by side. Weigh the hints against each other and rearrange the line until every rule fits. There are 60 levels spread across six festival areas, stars to collect, and a daily puzzle to try.

Read the clue cards beside the queue to learn where each animal belongs. To swap two guests, drag one onto the other, or tap or click them one after another. When the line matches every clue, press Check Order. Undo takes back your last move, Restart lets you begin again, and Hint offers help when you feel stuck.
sol-coalition-force: Fight through rounds that keep coming as enemies swarm the asteroid fields of the Sol system. Foes include long-range snipers, ramming ships, suicide drones, mine-layers, and fleets flying in tight formation. Every fifth round brings a giant boss that uses ground-pounding slams, energy barriers, clones of itself, and dense bullet storms.

Between rounds, choose an upgrade such as spread shot, homing missiles, a wing drone, piercing rounds, or shields. Shoot crystals to collect energy, shield, and overdrive boosts. Twelve ships can be unlocked, 36 achievements await, and you can chase your top wave and score. Use WASD to move, the mouse or arrow keys to steer, click or Space to fire, Q and E to roll, and P or Esc to pause. Touch controls use a left stick to move, a right stick to aim, and a FIRE button that auto-fires when locked on.
elska-dog-vs-zombies-multiplayer-co-op: In this fast, top-down cartoon shooter, Elska is a dog and the only survivor of a lab explosion that turned every animal around her into a bloodthirsty zombie. The blast unleashed Promethium Kyanite, an energy source gone wrong, and now rats, cats, wolves, raccoons, and foxes roam the ruins and beyond, attacking anything in sight. Elska refuses to run. She arms up instead, determined to save the world.

Survive round-based zombie waves across two maps, each harsher than the last. Pick a class, since each one brings its own set of abilities, then use unique weapons and unlockable skills. Team up in multiplayer co-op. Move with WASD, aim with the mouse, shoot with left click, and switch guns with keys 1 to 5. Abilities use E, Q, or G depending on your class. You can also customize your dog with accessories that have different effects.
square-crusher: Square Crusher is a puzzle game about smashing cubes and boxes. You can only tap cubes or boxes that are unlocked. A tapped piece drops into the crusher, which breaks it apart and releases colorful balls onto the board. Those balls roll toward the conveyor belt whenever there is room.

Your aim is to match the balls with the crate at the front of the queue. When balls pass close to a crate, the matching ones slide in automatically. A full crate makes way for the next one. Avoid tapping without a plan, since mismatched balls can flood the belt and leave no space. If the belt fills and no ball can match, the game is over. Fill every crate and clear every box before that happens.
snaky-jam: Snaky Jam is a bright 3D sorting puzzle where each move opens up room for the next one. Pick a container, drop it into a free slot, and line up its colors with the twisting snake. As boards grow trickier, you need to plan a few steps ahead and work around frozen, locked, and burning containers. Boosters like extra slots, freezing, hammers, keys, and cooling can help when the jam gets crowded.

Controls are simple. Click or tap a container to select it, then click or tap an open slot to place it. Clear every colored layer from each snake to finish a level. Keep space available and protect the rabbit by finishing before a snake reaches the end of the path or the timer runs out. On desktop, use the left mouse button. On mobile, just tap the screen. Playful animations make each level easy to pick up. The gear menu lets you adjust music and sound.
braveward: You wear the crown in this voxel kingdom strategy game, but the heroes you depend on have minds of their own. You never order them around on the battlefield. Instead, you set up guilds beside your castle, recruit warriors, rangers, rogues, healers and mages, and post bounties on monsters or dens to have them attack, scout or guard. Each hero weighs the reward against the danger and decides whether the gold is worth it.

A Market and a Tavern help your treasury, since the gold heroes spend flows back to you as taxes. Each day moves through five phases, from dawn to night, and you can explore ruins for loot. When a messenger warns of a siege, raise watchtowers on that side. After dark, every den wakes and the Troll Warlord marches on your castle. Keep it standing until sunrise to win the day, and a tougher one begins.
gun-shooting-cs: This multiplayer shooter drops you into a desert battlefield where fast, intense fights take place against other players. It suits younger gamers who enjoy quick rounds and outsmarting rivals. Choose from four modes, including team deathmatch and capture the flag, and mix weapons and gear to build a loadout that suits your style.

Vehicles add another layer. Armored trucks and powerful helicopters help you flank enemies, launch surprise attacks, and climb the leaderboard. Immersive sound effects and striking graphics make the desert feel real, and challenging levels and objectives keep every match fresh. Controls: WASD moves, the mouse aims and sho
breachfall: You play a pastry chef who dashes off the safe chocolate edge and carves a path through the sticky syrup. The goal is to turn back and reconnect with solid chocolate before a monster cuts your line. String together bold slices, rescue stranded sweets, and take on candy bosses across 336 stages in six worlds.

Try the one-cut challenges, face a computer rival in Duel, or chase new high scores in Daily Breach and Weekly Cup. Steer with the arrow keys or WASD, or swipe. Leave the edge, turn, and reconnect to claim a shape, and the first stage walks you through each step. Watch for attack warnings and check the target percentage or special objective at the top of each stage. Press P or tap Pause to take a break.
capybara-let-s-go-zombie-rush: This relaxed strategy title blends merging with tactical auto battles. You begin with a squad of cute pets and place them on the battlefield grid, where space is limited, so layout matters. Combine two pets of the same level to create a stronger upgraded version, and refresh the pool whenever you want new companions. When your team is set, press Start and the pets fight on their own. As foes fall, your team levels up and gains random skills such as damage boosts, critical hits, healing, and area attacks, so pick them thoughtfully.

Progress through dozens of regular stages, tough Boss fights, and surprise bonus stages with good rewards. Gather more pet varieties, then raise and star them up for extra power. Tap a deployed pet to trigger its skill once the bar is full.
funny-obbys: Two Obby brothers are trapped in a crimson forest that is creepy and full of hidden secrets, and they must get out. Each brother has his own key to track down. Finding those keys makes the golden key appear, and each brother must reach his matching key and pass through the doors. Opening the doors and finding the golden key unlocks the door that leads onward, so you can move to the next stage.
Each stage gets more challenging. To grab the keys, you climb by leaping from one wall to another. Move with
mutant-mash-merge-garden: Drop goofy crossbreeds of fruit and animals, then watch them bump and fuse into bigger, stranger creatures. Any merge can transform into a shiny Golden, Rainbow, or Glitch version. Every creature you find goes into your Album, and rare seeds are available at the Seed Stand. A round takes about two to three minutes, and the pile must never reach the top line.

Aim with your finger or mouse and release to drop. Touch two matching fruits to join them. Once per round, tap Swap to switch to the next fruit. If you prefer the keyboard, the arrow keys move, Space drops, S swaps, and P pauses. Your Mega Mutant plant grows a little more every day, so come back tomorrow to see which new part appears.
palkovil-the-way-home: Palkovil: The Way Home drops you into a strange little world full of New Year cheer. Hundreds of monsters and creatures roam this place, alongside beloved animals, puzzling riddles, and plenty of quests. Along the way you can gather gifts, toys, and sweets, and explore enormous laboratory halls where you can uncover the terrible secrets hidden there.

Your mission is to carry the Christmas tree back home before the aliens ruin the holiday. Switch on the lights in the correct rooms to find your way through the laboratory, and complete the aliens' requests to earn toys. You can feed squirrels, dogs, and cats, swing your sword in battles, defeat bosses, and collect cards by studying paintings and spotting links between them. Gather the full set of unique souvenirs to surprise your friends with lovely gifts.
paper-life: Paper Life is a territory-capture strategy played on a giant book of squared paper. Even while you are away, the world keeps going: 24 AI powers and growing cities carry on with their own plans. Tap a cell to build there, choosing a Generator, Transformer, Fortress, Emitter, Void, or Trap.

Make suppressors, then send a squad along a path of cells to win fights and capture rival cells one by one, with each capture costing absorbers. Fog of war and scouting are part of the game, and a tutorial plus four opening goals help you start. Play in English or Russian, on a phone or desktop, in portrait or landscape. Two rating boards track your best single-player world and the online server. Watching a video boosts your matter income by 50%.
hex-mine-3d: Hex Mine 3D pairs a calm pace with real strategy, so every move you make matters. Each level presents its own pattern of hexagonal tiles wrapped around a three-dimensional globe. Spin the sphere to view the board from every side, then study how the tiles are laid out before you choose your next step. Your task is to clear the correct tiles and finish the puzzle without slipping up.

As you advance, the patterns grow larger, the tile placement becomes trickier, and the planning requires more depth. Work through the handcrafted stages at whatever speed suits you, thinking ahead and learning each pattern as you go. The controls are simple and the visual style stays clean, so the game is easy to pick up yet takes practice to master. It works well for quick sessions as well as longer stretches of focused puzzle solving.
yenemy: Yenemy blends survival, farming, base building, crafting, and large clan conflicts into one game. You collect materials, set up and guard castles, and take on both monsters and rival clans. Your team's aim is to bring down the enemy clan's Temple, which means crafting weapons, protecting your own Temple, and attacking the opposing castle.

Between fights, you develop your own Farm Island. Grow crops, produce goods, trade through ports, hire workers, and expand your production chains. Success in battle feeds directly into your farm, so combat and long-term progress are closely linked. Move with W, S, A, and D, attack or gather with the left mouse button, use the right button for automatic attacks, and press Space to jump or dash.
island-survival: Island Survival blends match-three puzzling with survival and crafting, all drawn in colorful pixel art. Your task is to clear six stages, construct a raft, and get off a deserted island. You start with basic tools and gradually raise a shelter, furnish it, smelt ore, set up workbenches, and forge iron tools before assembling your raft. Every stage brings new challenges and recipes.

The board is an 8 by 8 grid with six tile types: stone, wood, food, water, leaves, and fire. Matching three or more in a row collects that resource. Four in a row grants a bonus resource, while five creates a wild tile that can replace any material. Raw materials reset at the end of each stage, yet everything you craft stays with you, so you must decide which items to make now and which to save.
tanknarok: TANKNAROK is a top-down arena shooter for multiplayer battles that run right in your web browser. No installs or complicated setup stand between you and a fast, head-to-head tank fight. Expect explosions and destructible surroundings as you face rivals in player-versus-player matches.
Use WASD to steer your tank forward, backward, left, and right. Move the mouse to
dungeon-shop-rush: Warriors, mages, rogues and nine other kinds of heroes queue at your counter, and each one is in a hurry. Drag the right sword, potion or scroll onto the hero who ordered it, or tap the item and then the hero, before their patience runs out. Serve heroes one after another to build combos and open combo chests. Enchanted orders need the glowing station first: drop a pl
star-rank-heroes: Star Rank Heroes is a 3D clicker adventure with an anime look. Knock out foes to collect Yen, then call forth a growing band of allies from glowing World Stars. Eight colorful realms await, including Bamboo Hollow, Corsair Isles, Runeheart Kingdom, and Pixel Beach. Fallen enemies can join a Spirit Legion, and you can guard the crystal through wave and boss challenges. Work your way up from rookie to Stellar.
Get around with WASD or the arrow keys, and click enemies to strike or switch on auto-click. Space makes you jump,
hand-daily: Hand Daily is a daily card roguelite in which everyone worldwide is dealt the same 52-card deck. You choose between one and five cards from your hand to play as a poker hand, aiming to beat each ante's target score within four plays. Discards let you swap up to five cards to improve your mix. Winning an ante earns coins, which buy jokers that boost every play after. Joker effects chain and stack, adding chips, mult, or suit and rank bonuses.

Each run lasts five minutes, and you get one chance per day, so every decision matters. Clear all five antes to win the day and grow your daily streak. Endless mode opens up once you finish. It is free, needs no install, and
pirates-merge-war-path: Pirates Merge: War Path is a strategy adventure where you blend swashbucklers into a strong fleet of ground and flying fighters. Across three regions, you face 50 missions, collecting coins and unlocking upgrades along the way. Keep training, combining, and growing your crew until you have a pirate force ready to rule the seas.
Training and merging units gives you tougher versions. On the battlefield, destroy every defense to
binary-drop: Binary Drop is a falling-blocks puzzle built around binary numbers. Each row is a line of lights worth 1, 2, 4, 8 and up, and the column values appear above the board. Lime rows show a target, so you tap lights on or off until they add up to it. Violet rows start out lit, and you add their values and type the total on the on-screen keypad or your keyboard.

From level 3, rows drop down the board like Tetris, so you need to solve them before they land. Each level adds more lights and more speed. A landed row costs you a heart, and losing all three ends the round. Clear 40 rows to finish a level and unlock the next one on the level path. The gentle opening level teaches everything by watching, while streaks, rising melodies and confetti keep you going. You pick up decimal-to-binary conversion without noticing. Press P or Esc to pause.
lanternbloom: In Lanternbloom, you pick out fireflies and guide each one toward the glowing lantern string. Gather three of the same colour and they light a lantern. If seven fireflies end up waiting, though, the night is over.

Mouse and touch players click or tap a firefly to launch it, then use the buttons around the string to undo, restart or ask for a hint. The top-right sound button opens the Music and Effects switches, and the top-left menu button returns you to the start. Keyboard players move a highlight with the arrow keys or W, A, S and D, then press Enter or Space to launch. U, Z or Backspace undo, R restarts, H gives a hint and M mutes. On the title screen, Enter or Space plays, L opens the levels and D opens the daily meadow. In level select, the arrow keys turn chapters and Backspace goes back.
get-off-my-farm: Mutant pests are swarming your quiet farmland, and your guns and sharp timing are the only things standing between them and your crops. Blast through the incoming enemies and grab temporary boosts along the way, including rapid fire, explosive ammo, health refills, or extra energy for your electric fence.

Survive enough waves and the stage ends, letting you choose from random upgrades such as new weapons, a crop duster airstrike, slowed enemy hordes, or a magnet for power-ups. New heroes with unique styles and abilities unlock as you advance, and the randomized upgrades keep every run feeling fresh. Move with the arrow keys or WASD, or swipe the screen on mobile. Your weapon fires automatically, so you can focus on dodging and aiming.
turbo-horizon-racing: Turbo Horizon Racing is an old-school arcade racer that draws on the racing games of the 1990s. Back then, before true polygonal 3D became the norm, clever pseudo-3D visuals did the heavy lifting, and this game keeps that spirit alive. Expect quick, snappy driving on bright, colorful courses, with arcade-style racing at its core. Modern polish has been added to give the retro formula a fresh feel.
Controls are simple. Use the W, A, S and D keys to move your car, and press Shift to activate nitro when you need a burst of speed.
kawaii-realm-adventure: Step into a dreamy trip to the Kawaii Realm with Sarah, Emma, Lily, and Mia. Their school basement hides a secret portal, and passing through it transforms the four girls into cute 2D characters. Your time in this single-player game is spent dressing them up and trying out makeup looks.
To begin, pick one of the characters, then choose her outfit and do her makeup. Once she is ready, you can wander through the Kawaii Realm and enjoy exploring its charming surroundings.
mosaicat: Split the board into rectangles to uncover the picture hidden underneath. Each number gives the size of its rectangle: a 6 needs six squares, such as 1x6, 2x3, 3x2 or 6x1. Drag across the grid and release to place one. The tiles it covers become part of the picture, which builds up a piece at a time into a cactus, a teapot or a small orange cat. A rectangle that does not belong is refused, so you simply try another.

There is no timer, no lives and nothing to lose, so the game waits while you think. The collection holds 757 puzzles, each checked by machine to have exactly one solution, starting small and growing with you. When they run out, they return as new puzzles on the same pictures. Pick from ten colour themes, in light or dark. Stuck? A hint opens one rectangle. You have
dash-hero: Dash Hero is a casual adventure in which you play a courageous hero determined to rescue a princess. Your path leads through demanding levels where you must deal with hostile foes and prove what you can do in intense battles. Danger lurks at every turn, and each move you make pushes you toward the final aim of saving the kingdom.

You steer the hero by holding the left mouse button and dragging. This platform title uses physics and was made with Unity3D. Its tags include superhero and princess themes, which match the rescue at its heart.
noodlemanparty-io: Picture a three-dimensional multiplayer brawl where everyone shares one platform. Anyone who gets knocked off the edge is out. Getting struck leaves you dazed, and a dazed player gets tossed off the platform. Your best approach is to go after rivals while keeping them from landing hits on you. Quick reflexes are the key to coming out on top.
Controls are simple. Slide your finger across the screen to move, and press the space bar to hold up your opponent.
drift-fury: Drift Fury is a 3D driving game built around sliding your car through corners. You can tackle drift challenges and head-to-head races while sitting behind the wheel of some of the world's most exotic sports cars. Each event centers on keeping your car sliding through the turns.

The tracks wind along scenic routes lined with pine trees, and mountain views stretch out around you as you drive. Steering uses WASD or the arrow keys, Spacebar pulls the handbrake, Left-Shift activates nitro, and C switches the camera view.
jet-fighter-pacific-war: Set during World War II, this game puts you in the cockpit of a fighter jet over the Pacific Ocean. You battle enemy aircraft in close dogfights and make precise strikes on ground targets. Dodging fire from anti-aircraft installations and naval vessels is a major part of the challenge, since you must push through it to win control of the skies.
The game offers immersive visuals and dynamic gameplay, so every mission presents its own demanding test of skill. Controls are simple: mouse click or tap to play.
snakearmydefense: Snake Army Defense is a 3D tower defense game with a bright, colorful look. Groups of soldiers stand against huge, twisting snakes. You place fighters across the battlefield, mix different weapons with support units, and keep your base safe as enemy waves arrive one after another. Each level begins with a short tutorial, and the levels take place in varied settings.

Spend your battle gold carefully and pair attacking soldiers with support units. Your units fire automatically once enemies enter their range. Between battles, use your coins to unlock new soldiers and upgrade their stats. You win a level by defeating every snake wave while your base still stands. On desktop, use the left mouse button to select menus, units, and deployment spots, drag to move the camera or browse the map, and use the Pause/Resume button. On mobile, tap to select and deploy, and drag to move the camera.
space-obby: Drifting through the stars, you join other astronauts as you explore a destroyed space station. Your jetpack helps you travel across the floating wreckage to reach the far corners of the ruins. The tone stays lighthearted, and every jump has room to be playful.

Your main goal is to collect power cells, which open doors to new levels and unlock characters. The battery cells are spread across four large levels, and six characters can be unlocked in total. On a keyboard, use WASD or the arrow keys to move, the spacebar to jump, and hold it midair to fire the jetpack. Move the mouse to rotate the camera, scroll to zoom, and press P for settings. On mobile, drag the joystick on the left, tap the button on the right to jump or hold it for the jetpack, swipe to rotate, and pinch to zoom.
guardians-of-the-dark-dungeon: Guardians of the Dark Dungeon is an action game that mixes war simulator gameplay with the world of dungeons and dragons. Your shooting skills are put to the test as you face enemy assaults, and you must stay alert at all times. Each battle asks you to gear up and push through the dark. The whole adventure centers on combat.
Controls are straightforward. Click the mouse to attack, and use the other buttons to launch special attacks by clicking with the mouse. Walk around with the WASD keys.
ultimate-plants-td: In this hypercasual tower defense game, you lead an army of plants that guards your garden from countless zombies. Your task is to hold off waves of zombies that grow more challenging as you go. Strategy and puzzle elements run throughout, so every decision matters.

Success comes from testing different plant combinations and deciding where each one should go. Experimenting with these choices is the key to boosting your defenses and overcoming the toughest challenges. The controls are simple: click with your mouse or tap the screen to play.
lovely-cat-dessert-bakery: If you adore animals or enjoy hands-on crafting, this casual online game from the DIY category could be a good match. It mixes cats, pets, fashion, and do-it-yourself creativity into one title, so you get a bit of each in every session.

Your main activity is dressing up your furry companion. You can try different outfits on your pet, then build a look that feels just right for your little kitten. Controls work by clicking and dragging.
slenderman-history-wwii-faceless-horror: Slenderman History puts you in World War II, where the Nazis ran secret medical experiments on their soldiers to create a super soldier. They also dabbled in the occult, and with a powerful ancient artifact they summoned the devil himself, a faceless figure named Slenderman. Your mission is to sneak into the Nazi base, find the hidden bunker, and recover two briefcases holding documents on the experiments.

The 3D game has many levels, a WWII story, and controls that are easy to learn. Jump scares and creepy sounds keep the tension high. Use W, A, S, and D to walk and the mouse to look around. Left click
santa-claus-lay-egg: This free winter game asks you to guide Santa past a series of obstacles so he can deliver his Christmas gifts. Everything takes place on a snowy stage, and you can enjoy the whole experience without paying anything.

Using only your mouse, you click anywhere on the stage to drop an egg. Each egg lifts Santa up and over the obstacles in his path, so you can keep him moving toward his deliveries. It's a cheerful little challenge for a relaxed holiday session.
american-boat-rescue-2022: You step into the role of a member of an American beach rescue squad, building survival skills for open-water emergencies. A storm sends a crowded ship off course, and many people jump into the sea to stay afloat until rescuers arrive with the gear they need. The game focuses on fast emergency driving while following official lifeguard standards, with a rescue boat driver and other transport getting help out quickly.

Swimmers and boaters are advised to wear swimsuits so lifeguards can reach a disaster scene as fast as possible. You play as a rescue hero, since rescue boats, beach sensors, rescue cans, lifeboats, rescue tubes, rescue boards, and above all rescue teams are urgently needed. Rescue buoys sit along the beach, and spinal boards help with the rescue. Drive your boat with WASD.
ww2-cold-war-game-fps: Step back into World War II with this browser shooter, where you can take control of soldiers, weapons, tanks, and aircraft from the conflict. Visual effects are plentiful, and you can have fun with friends from around the world. The game offers twenty WWII guns and five heavy tanks that fire projectiles and bullets. Explosions are striking, and the characters are detailed models of German and US army soldiers.

Controls are simple. Use W, A, S, and D to drive a tank, helicopter, or car, or to move your character. Move the mouse to look around, click to shoot, and scroll the wheel to switch guns. Press Tab to open the menu.
flip-hero: Flip Hero is a 3D sports game set in a gym, where you aim for gold with daring somersaults. Each routine you perform on the different tracks earns points, and the artistic quality of your flips counts. Begin by jumping as high as you can, then start spinning in the air. A green line on the outside marks the zone where your forced landing happens. Inside it you will spot two more colored fields: a yellow one that gives points, though not enough if you move on to the next section, and a small red spot, which is where you must land. Your character waits farther up the trail, and timing is everything. You can flip backwards or forwards.
Everything is controlled with the left mouse button. The first click starts levitation, and the second click sends you into the somersault and landing.
princess-house-cleanup: Our little princess has a real problem on her hands: the castle is covered in trash and dust, and plenty of furniture is damaged. Her friends are on their way for a visit, and her favorite prince is coming along, so she has to tidy everything before they show up. Players step in to help her scrub the place and repair the broken pieces. Each room comes with its own messes, so you can work through them one at a time.

The horse stable is worth a special stop, since after cleaning it you can dress up the stable and the horse with adorable accessories. The garden is another highlight, with a lovely fountain and a striking sculpture you can take in while you clean. Control is simple: use your mouse or tap the screen. If you have some free time and want a light, cheerful challenge, this one is a great pick.
sword-master: Sword Master is an entertaining, hard-to-put-down hyper casual action game. The idea is straightforward: your rival wants you gone, so you have to eliminate them first. To do that, you line up an arrow and let it fly, taking down the opponent before they can take you down.

Everything is controlled with the mouse, so there are no complicated inputs to learn before you start. Simply aim, release, and watch whether your arrow finds its mark. The whole experience is built around that one clear goal of defeating the opponent first.
draw-motor: Draw Motor puts you behind the wheel of a vehicle you choose at the start. Your aim is to pull off wild tricks, including flips, while covering as much ground as you can. The whole look is built to resemble a sketch on paper, so every track and machine appears hand-drawn.
You can play through the levels or switch to endless mode and keep going for as far as you can. Controls are simple: tap to run and roll, and every move you make comes from that one action.
super-wash: Super Wash is a hypercasual game that is both fun and hard to put down. Your goal is to scrub away the mud coating a variety of objects, using a pressure washer that delivers a deeply gratifying blast of water. Watching the grime slide off never gets old, and every cleanup feels rewarding.

The whole game runs on your mouse, so there are no complicated controls to learn. Simply aim the washer and keep cleaning until nothing is left behind. It is an addictive experience built around one clear task. The game is tagged as Adventure, Arcade, Casual, Fun and Hypercasual.
battling-zombies: Battling Zombies is a single-player 2D adventure where you combine plants to create new synthetic ones. Once placed, these plants fire at monsters on their own, so your job is to plan which ones to grow and where to put them. Many different plant types show up as you go, each with its own way of handling the undead.

Along the way you will face a series of bosses, each one a tougher test than the last. Your mix of synthetic plants has to hold up against them if you want to keep moving forward. It is a good pick if you enjoy strategy games that reward careful planning.
fireman-frenzy: A firefighter rips a hydrant out of the ground and uses it to douse flames. Now he can roam freely and head wherever blazes pop up. The hydrant is very weighty, so his aim wobbles and shakes, which makes shooting tricky. Your task is to put out every fire on each level by hitting it with a strong blast from his hose. Blasts can bounce off objects to reach fires, but a bad bounce can knock the firefigh
vegetables-match-3: Vegetables Match 3 is a puzzle game where you swap neighboring blocks to line up three or more matching flowers in a row, either across or down. Each match clears tiles from the board, and you keep matching until every tile has been unlocked and removed. When progress slows, you can call on power-ups to speed things along.
The game includes 36 levels to work through. You control it with a mouse or by touching a screen, so you can use whichever input suits you best.
alien-survival-shooter-2022: In this 2022 shooter-driver, your goal is to get through an alien invasion. Hop into cars, trucks, or supercars to ram creatures and alien soldiers, park your ride, and gather coin canisters along the way. Missions across the apocalyptic maps include surviving enemy creatures, dodging gunfire from aliens, and crushing foes with your vehicle.

The setting mixes many threats: an undead and alien army now controls the globe, a blizzard brings its own survival challenges, and dinosaurs add another danger for people hiding in underground bunkers. Humanity has answered by forming small squads of highly skilled fighters. Controls: Tab opens the menu, WASD moves, the
billiard-challenge: Billiard Challenge is a single-player billiards game with stages, several table layouts, and simple controls. Each stage asks you to sink the required balls while staying within your attempt limit. Pick a cue, study the angle, and set your shot strength as you work through the challenges one at a time. Built for short sessions and relaxed skill practice, it has no multiplayer, so your results depend on your choices, accuracy, and picking the right shot.

To begin, select a level and give the table a moment to appear. Aim the cue, adjust the power, then release to strike the cue ball. Try to pot the balls without wasting attempts, and keep an eye on the lives left on the level. If you run out of attempts, you will need to restart that level.
mini-zombie-shooters: Mini Zombie Shooters is a 2D shooter in which you can hold several weapons at once while fending off large groups of zombies. It belongs to the shooting genre and is all about surviving against relentless undead crowds. Keep your aim steady as the horde closes in.
Movement is handled with WASD or the arrow keys, and the mouse lets you aim. A left click fires your weapon, the space bar picks up a weapon, and scrolling the mouse wheel zooms the view in or out.
car-stunt-race-2022: Car Stunt Race 2022 is a racing game that aims for a lifelike feel and pushes your driving skills to new levels. You can test your handling across many settings, choose from a broad mix of vehicles, and find your way through large cities. Parking is a big part of the fun, and sensors and road signs are there to help you line up your car. The graphics come in sharp high definition.

You can pick hatchbacks, sedans, SUVs, or supercars, then tweak them with a build kit to suit your taste. Stunts are controlled with the WASD keys, so you can race and perform tricks with ease. Take extra care in the underground garage, because a careless move there could cause an accident.
pixel-time-adventure-2: Pixel Time Adventure 2 is a two-player arcade adventure with a 2D cartoon style. Friends can team up to make their way through six different parts of the story. It is built for sharing the experience with a partner from the first part to the last.

Controls are simple. Players can use the WASD keys or the arrow keys, so two people can each have their own set at the same time. A double jump is also available, giving you an extra leap when you need to move further through each part.
basketball-league: Basketball League is an arcade hoops game with one-on-one and two-on-two matches. You can dribble, sprint, block shots, and finish plays with slam dunks or three-pointers. Take on the computer alone, or grab a friend for local two-player games.

Climb through the Bronze, Silver, and Gold Cups, and try to win tournaments along the way. Unlock achievements and learn to use powerful supershots. In single-player mode, the arrow keys move your player, X shoots, and Z performs a supershot dunk. For two players, Player 1 uses WASD with V and B, while Player 2 uses the arrow keys with L and K. Move into position for a shot or dunk, hold the button to charge, then release to score.
jeep-driver: Jeep Driver is a lively driving game with 30 levels and vivid graphics. In the garage, you can buy new vehicles and upgrade them over time, so your collection grows as you play.

Steering is simple: use the A and D keys or the left and right arrow keys to drive your jeep. Press W or the up arrow to jump. Work your way through all 30 levels, and switch between the vehicles in your garage whenever you want to try something different.
taxi-tycoon-urban-transport-sim: Taxi Tycoon: Urban Transport Sim puts you behind the wheel of a city cab and challenges you to grow it into a taxi business. You build and run your own fleet, weighing choices as you go and steering through crowded city roads on the way to becoming a successful tycoon. It is a simulation at heart, with plenty of driving and parking.

The keyboard handles every action in the game. You use the keys to drive your vehicles and to control other players, so you can take part from your seat. Whether you are planning your next move or weaving through traffic, careful thinking and steady driving both matter. Set your plans, press the right keys, and see how far your taxi empire can go.
angela-christmas-dress-up-game: Angela is counting down to the holidays and can't wait to celebrate with her friends, maybe even more than the player. She has come up with some unusual plans to make the season livelier. Your job is to help her bake and decorate cakes, cookies, and a Christmas tree, and to dress up her house for the occasion.

Everything is controlled with a simple left mouse button click. The game is filed under Girls and is tagged Christmas, Decoration, and Dress Up, so it suits anyone who enjoys festive styling and dress-up play.
fall-days: Fall Days: Atlantic Man is a racing game set in a lively game world. You work through dozens of courses, gathering crowns along the way, and aim to be the winner of the day. You can buy costumes to change how your character looks, and each race can include anywhere from 10 to 40 players, with the goal of crossing the finish line first. The game has 10 maps, and you can race in different costumes across them from a set of 20 uniform outfits. It also features a completely different mechanic waiting to be discovered.
Controls use WASD or ZQSD on a keyboard, and touch controls work on mobile devices.
car-stunt-racing-stylized: Car Stunt Racing Stylized is an arcade racer with a playful look. Bold colors, cel-shaded graphics, and exaggerated speed effects set it apart from realistic racing games. You can whip along twisting tracks, slide through bends, and pass rivals to cross the finish line first. Several cars are available to unlock, and each one handles differently.
The cartoon style pairs with smooth physics, boost pads, and tight cornering. Beat rivals to win races and unlock new tracks. Your car accelerates on its own, so
tanks-for-the-nation: Tanks for the Nation is a quick 2D tank battle set in the World War II era. You can choose from dozens of famous war machines, from light Pz. I and T-26 models up to the heavy Tiger, Panther and IS-3. Between fights, you can upgrade your garage, buy new models, and collect coins. Battles take place across four different battlefields.

Vehicles fall into four classes: heavy, medium and light tanks, plus tank destroyers. Each has its own armor, speed, fire rate and penetration. Shells can ricochet, every tank has weak spots, and the rear is the most vulnerable. Wrecked tanks can block your line of fire, so positioning matters. Each battle mixes careful strategy with plenty of adrenaline. Move with W, A, S, D or the arrow keys, aim, then tap Fire. On mobile, use the on-screen joystick and fire button, and pinch with two fingers to zoom in and out.
forest-survivor-challenge: After a plane goes down in the Amazon, you find yourself in Forest Survivor Challenge. Push through thick woodland, chop down trees, and collect materials as you head toward the marked points. Along the way you will face wild animals, changing weather, and ground that is hard to predict. Craft your own tools and shelter from what you gather, then hunt and plan your moves carefully. It is a jungle adventure built around survival and action.
Controls are simple. Use W, A, S and D to move forward, left, back and right. Press K to attack, and tap E to switch the camera view.
world-war-3: World War 3 is a 3D real-time strategy game set after a global conflict, where you are one of the last commanders left standing. You lead armies of tanks, warships, and soldiers across a battlefield, fighting for control of War Zones. Your base needs defending, and your units can be customized as you go.

Team up with other players in an open-world PVP mode to form an alliance, or take on enemies alone in individual battles. Launch rockets and missile strikes, call in your air force, and even use nuclear bombs to push into enemy territory. Gain levels to unlock stronger units such as riflemen, heavy gunners, and rhino tanks. You control each tank, helicopter, and infantry unit directly with the keyboard and mouse.
special-alien: Special Alien puts you in charge of an unusual alien character who must make its way past tough obstacles and risky routes. It is an adventure that calls for quick reactions, good timing, and steady concentration. The gameplay follows an arcade style, so each run keeps the pressure on.

Every button is operated with a mouse, so you simply point and click to use any control. Keep your eyes sharp and your timing precise as you move along each path. Anyone who enjoys testing their reflexes in a lively arcade setting should find plenty to try here.
monster-truck-stunts-sky-driving: Monster Truck Stunts Sky Driving is a racing game that tests your skill as you steer your truck up into the sky. Stunts are the heart of the action, and you can choose from three monster trucks as you work through stunt levels set high above the ground. Each run gives you a chance to show off your moves and push your driving a little further.

Controls are simple. Use W, A, S and D to drive, and press the Space bar to brake. The game sits in the racing category and is tagged with monster, stunts and truck, so it suits anyone who likes big trucks performing tricks in the air.
happy-fun-rider-wheels-2019: Happy Rider Wheels is a free arcade title that is fun and fairly simple to grasp, so getting into it takes little effort. It is an obstacle-packed extreme sports game with a rag-doll twist, and your mission is to guide your rider across the finish line.

Only two keys do the work. Use the left and right arrows to drive, and press Space to jump. Because the game is tagged as a skill challenge, sharpening your timing and control is a big part of the fun.
motocross-22: Motocross 22 is a dirt bike racing game built around lifelike physics and pleasing graphics. The rider's pose changes with each move, so the animations shift to match what you are doing. You can pull off a range of tricks, including 360 spins, wheelies, front ends, and more. You keep control of the bike while you perform them, and you can also attempt stunts in mid-air.
When you crash, the game detects it and plays a matching animation, backed by several physics chec
tanking-tanks: Tanking Tanks is an action game for anyone with a soft spot for armored vehicles. Your goal is to wipe out your opponents, and the battles are meant to be tough, so every fight tests you. Fans of tanks will feel at home in its challenging matches, where destroying enemies is the main focus from start to finish.

The game is played with a keyboard and mouse. It falls under the action category and carries the tags tank and tanks, which makes it easy to find if you want more games about armored machines. Whether you are new to these vehicles or have loved them for years, the difficulty of the battles keeps things interesting.
dodge-blast: This playful bone surgery simulator mixes humor with medical care. Leah was out on the street with her skateboard when a moment of distraction sent her straight into a car. The crash left her with a nasty broken arm and a broken foot, and now she needs someone to treat her injuries and mend those bones.

That someone is you. Work through her treatment and repair the damage one injury at a time. Items are used with a click of the left mouse button, so you can choose what you need and apply it exactly where it belongs. Take your time and see how her recovery turns out.
dice-helix-drop: Dice Helix Drop is a 3D arcade game you control with one touch. Your job is to guide a falling ball down through spinning helix stacks. Press and hold to smash through the platforms, dodge obstacles, and link hits into combos that break black blocks. The longer you keep holding, the faster and stronger your drop becomes.

Expect plenty of bouncing, crashing, and blasting as you work through more than 300 levels with bright, colorful visuals. The game is built for smooth performance on all devices. Letting go stops the ball, so timing matters. It is easy to pick up but takes real skill to master, and it can hold your attention for hours.
subway-surfers-pro2: You start trapped inside a metro station and must sprint as fast as you can, dodging oncoming trains, barriers, and other obstacles to run farther and raise your high score. A grumpy policeman keeps chasing you and never gives up. Power-ups and boosters appear along the way to help you collect more coins, run further, and enjoy the chase.
public-transport-simulator-2021: Drive a bus that carries passengers from one city to a terminal in another, passing scenic places and wide landscapes. Follow the traffic rules, load and unload riders, and sound the telolet for children. Longer trips earn more money. You can personalize your bus with liveries, horns, telolets, bumpers, and rims, and add a strobe light to stand out on the road.
Realistic maps, detailed buses including double-deckers, and lifelike interiors make the drive feel authentic. Open and close the doors, watch animated
amazing-run-3d: Picture a young hero who suddenly discovers he has a special power: he can slow down every obstacle around him. In this 3D arcade game, that ability is the key to slipping through the openings ahead. Your job is to use it at the right moment so you can get safely past each hazard, which means paying close attention to the road and reacting with care.

Getting started is easy, since you only need to tap to play. The controls are simple, so the real challenge lies in knowing when to use your power. Timing is everything here, and the game suits kids and anyone who enjoys dodging obstacles in a bright 3D world.
beauty-clinic-spa-salon: Welcome to this girls' game, where you run your own beauty clinic. Many customers are waiting to try a brand-new spa experience, so there is always someone new to serve. Your aim is to help every client look stunning and leave feeling pleased. The title is filed under Girls and carries tags such as dress up, fashion, makeover, and simulation.

Controls are simple: use your mouse or tap to play. Work through each visit carefully so your guests walk out happy with their new look. The whole game centers on giving clients a satisfying spa day, one appointment at a time.
halloween-multiplayer-shooter: This Halloween-themed shooter lets you choose between multiplayer and single-player gameplay, so you can face other players or go through matches on your own. Several game modes add variety, and an in-game shop lets you buy weapons and armor to equip your character before the action starts.
Movement uses WASD or the arrow keys. A left click shoots, C makes you crouch, and R reloads your weapon. To pick up a gun, press F.
duck-dash-pro: Duck Dash Pro offers upgraded graphics and lively action in a shooting game about birds. Your job is to catch flying ducks by shooting them, and then the dog gets to collect them. It is listed under Action, with tags for animal, bird, casual, and shoot themes, so it suits quick, relaxed sessions.
Controls are simple. Press SPACE to shoot, and use the arrow keys to move your aim point around the screen. Enjoy a munchy run as you chase down the ducks and keep the dog busy.
the-plumber-game-mobile-friendly-fullscr: This single-player 2D puzzle works on phones and tablets and supports fullscreen play. A plumber sets out to tackle a run of challenges, each one a set of complex pipe arrangements that have gotten badly scrambled. Your job is to rotate and place the pipes so they point the right way, arranged from top to bottom.

Watch out for leaks, because any leakage will submerge your setup. Keep an eye on the timer as you work through each layout. You can control the game with touch, a tap, or a left click of the mouse. It suits players who enjoy brain teasers that also call for good timing.
amaze: Amaze!!! is a puzzle game with a classic, simple style, made for relaxed and entertaining play on mobile devices. Your goal is to guide your ball so that it colors the whole area. The game offers a real challenge that keeps you thinking as you go. If you enjoy 3D puzzle games, this one is worth a look.
Controls are easy to learn. Slide your finger across the screen to move the ball and cover the board, step by step, until every part is colored. It is a light, fun way to pass some time.
rubberband-cutting: RubberBand Cutting is a 3D arcade game built around decompression, the calming feeling of unwinding something tense. Young players meet an object wrapped tightly in elastic bands, and the job is to take those bands apart quickly so the item is freed. Each cut is made with a knife, and a single stroke of the blade is enough to make the rubber line open up easily.

Controls are simple: you drag to play, guiding the blade across the bands to slice through them. The game is made for children, and speed matters, so the fun comes from working quickly to watch the bands fall away.
bike-blast-bike-race-rush: Jump on a BMX and weave, leap, duck and sprint your way toward the finish line in this fast, high-speed bike racer. The game is an endless runner where you race through a subway, along city streets, through tunnels, over bridges and across a park. You can grind rails, slide beneath barriers, pull off tricks from a big ramp, and glide across the sky on a hang glider. Upgrade your powerups, use a helicopter and a rocket to raise your score, collect coins, finish missions, and climb weekly leaderboards against friends and players worldwide.

Max and Amy need your help to build the biggest score they can. You can pick from many characters and unlock different bikes, then unlock achievements to show off your skills. Play with the keyboard, using the listed keys to control your rider.
chibi-sup-color-game: Calling all young artists! Halloween, that mysterious holiday, is just around the corner, and this game lets you design a one-of-a-kind card. Pick the characters you love most and use them to make a special greeting for your friends. The cast includes adorable chibi superheroes and goofy animals that are hard to resist.
When your card looks just right, capture the result with a screenshot and send it to your friends so they can see what you made. It's a fun way to bring a bit of seasonal spirit to your group.
city-rescue-fire-truck-games: If you have a talent for handling vehicles, this 3D truck driving simulation gives you the job of carrying firefighters to fire zones. Ten levels are waiting, and each one challenges you to reach the accident area and put out the blaze before the limited time runs out.

Keep the truck rolling and get to the scene before the clock beats you. Movement is handled with the W, A, S, and D keys. Every stage tests how quickly and steadily you can drive, so keep your eyes on the road ahead.
nap-time: Nap Time lets you doze off and wake within a set window of time. It offers a quick way to set an alarm for an ideal power nap, and it claims such naps sharpen thinking, boost output, and leave you refreshed. A NASA study reportedly found that a 26-minute power nap lifted performance by 34% and alertness by 54%
space-combat: Space Combat is a spacecraft simulation where you fight against AI enemy opponents. The game offers three game modes, and its realistic space setting pairs with smooth maneuvering, so every flight feels like a true space battle. It is built to feel grounded, with ships that respond the way you would expect in a simulation.

Controls are easy to pick up. Press W to boost, and use Q and E to rotate your ship. Z and X throttle up and down, while a left or right mouse click fires your weapons. Press Escape at any time to pause the game and step away from the action.
car-driving-3d: Hop into this 3D driving game and take the wheel of a stunt car. Your goal is to drive as fast as you can while performing a variety of stunts on loops, sliders, and sloppy roads. The challenge is to keep your speed high while you attempt each trick along the way.

The game is played entirely with the keyboard, so every move comes from key presses. Use those controls to guide your car through the loops, across the sliders, and on the sloppy roads, pushing yourself to pull off stunt after stunt.
car-parking-2: Car Parking 2 is an action game where you play a driver with one main job: getting your car into a backyard. This backyard parking simulator gives you a long list of missions to work through, each one a test of whether you can handle the wheel and fit your car into the right spot. It is a good pick for anyone who enjoys car and driving games.

Movement is simple, since you steer and drive using the W, A, S and D keys. Everything you need is on the keyboard, so you can focus on lining up each parking attempt. The game is built with Unity3D and runs on WebGL, which means it works directly in your browser. Tags such as car, cars and driving sum up what the game is about, and the missions give you plenty of reasons to keep practicing.
ball-2048: Ball 2048 is a 3D arcade game you can play online in your browser, built with HTML5. The goal is to combine balls of matching value, and when you gather the same amount of points, your total grows even larger. The game uses a three-dimensional setting, so you can see your progress from a fresh angle while you play.

Steering is simple. Use your mouse to tap the screen, and the ball moves left or right in response. Keep the ball in the right position so you can line up your matches and keep your points adding up. The title is filed under 3D games, ball games, and online games, so it fits neatly among other browser-based titles in the arcade category.
ellie-and-ben-christmas-preparation: Ellie and Ben are a newly formed couple who are looking forward to celebrating the coming Christmas together. They have a few plans in mind, starting with decorating the inside of their home with lovely holiday touches. They also want to trim their Christmas tree so it looks its best.
Your task is to lend a hand so this season becomes one they will remember for years. Everything is handled with a single left mouse button click.
neon-striker: Neon Striker is a fast arcade shooter in the spirit of classic Galaga games, set against a glowing cyberpunk backdrop full of neon color. You pilot a bright fighter ship through 33 waves of enemies that grow tougher as you advance. Along the way you face 11 different bosses, each with its own attack moves and habits.

Pick up power-ups during the fight to help you hold out: rapid fire, double shot, triple shot, a laser cannon, homing missiles, time slow, shields, and the Flower spin attack. The campaign ends with NEMESIS, a huge geometric crab boss that fires in several phases. Use the left and right arrow keys to move and the spacebar to shoot. Your goal is to survive the alien assault.
kong-hero-2019: Kong Hero 2019 is an arcade title where you guide its hero through a course full of hazards. Your main goal is to gather as many coins as possible while steering clear of every danger along the way. Fruit is scattered along the route as well, so picking up as much of it as you can is worth the effort.

Controls are straightforward. Press A to move left, D to move right, and Space to jump. The F and X keys fire. Timing your jumps well matters a lot, since it helps you dodge threats and reach more coins and fruit. Keep an eye on what lies ahead and try to collect as much as you can.
chicken-love-1: Chicken Love 1 tells the story of a brave chicken whose sweetheart has been kidnapped by evil trolls. In this arcade-style adventure, he sets out on a determined search to find her.
You can control the game with either a mouse or a touch screen, so it works for both desktop and touch play. Every step of the quest centers on one goal: finding the one he loves.
quiz-runner-io: Quiz Runner.io blends trivia with head-to-head play. Practice solo to sharpen what you know, build custom quizzes around topics you love, or upload your notes and PDFs to create interactive learning games. For company, join real-time quiz battles, challenge friends to duels, or enter tournaments against players worldwide. Track your progress through levels and achievements, use power-ups, and take on daily quiz challenges.
bus-driving-3d: Bus Driving 3D lets you revisit your school days from behind the wheel of a school bus. It is a realistic simulation of off-road school bus driving, so it feels like the real job. Use the game to show off your offroad driving skills and let your friends see that you always get to high school on time.

Your goal is to become the top driver among high school bus games by showing how punctual you are and how well you handle the highway. You control everything with the keyboard. It belongs to the racing category and is tagged as a 3D game.
make-up-cosmetic-box-cake-maker-best-coo: Step into the kitchen and become a cake baker worth remembering. This game lets you bake make-up themed cakes, from round ones to fancier shaped cosmetic designs. Crack eggs, use a mixer, and rely on professional baker tools to bake, design, and decorate. Follow a wide range of recipes, from rainbow birthday cakes to strawberry cupcakes, and build your skills across different settings and cooking methods.

Top your creations with frosting, decorations, and cute toppers, then snap photos to show off your designs. You can also enter a cake in a contest or serve it at a cake party for your friends. Design a makeup box decorated with items such as eyeliner, mascara, lipstick, and nail polish, and try different kitchen appliances and chocolate cake recip
cat-girl-skater: Step into a sunny park and take control of a feline skater full of lively energy. She wears a bright yellow t-shirt, blue shorts, and protective knee pads, and she rides a blue board fitted with red wheels. Her hair has red streaks and is held back by a green headband that suits the playful outdoor backdrop.

Her arms stretch wide to keep her steady as she glides along, wearing a self-assured grin. The whole scene carries a cheerful sense of adventure. Steer with the arrow keys and press the space bar to control her moves.
cyber-smash: Cyber Smash offers a classic brick-breaking challenge with a bright neon style. Success depends on fast reactions and knowing when to use your power-ups. Your glowing paddle sends a ball into layered cyber bricks, and you must break through them. Collect Multi-ball or Fire Mode, which gives you laser guns, to cause heavy damage and build big combo scores. Finish all the levels to win.

Levels are generated dynamically, and the game includes several power-up types, a demanding combo system, and persistent high scores. With a mouse or touch screen, drag the paddle sideways and click or tap to launch the ball and fire lasers. On a keyboard, use Left Arrow or A and Right Arrow or D to move, and press Spacebar, Up Arrow, or W to launch the ball and fire.
big-supermarket-simulator: Big Supermarket Simulator is a relaxed business sim where you begin with a tiny grocery store and grow it over time. Your duties include restocking shelves, running the checkout, keeping things clean, and stocking new items. The gold coins you collect can be spent on upgrades. Once your operation gets larger, you can branch out into coffee shops and flower stalls, building a whole commercial street of different businesses. You can bring on staff, set up automated production lines, refine how people move through the space and how goods are stored, and work on customer happiness and pricing. Income keeps building up while you are away, so you can step back and return to find your shop has grown. Control is simple: click or tap to play.
tractor-drift-3d: Tractor Drift 3D puts you behind the wheel of a farm vehicle that slides sideways at speed. The game mixes the weight of heavy machinery with fast, sideways action. Your goal is to link smooth drifts together and rack up high scores on carefully built tracks. Real physics shape every turn, so precise timing and steady throttle control matter when you handle these heavy machines.

As you progress, you can unlock other tractors, each with its own handling, so you can find the setup that fits your driving style. Scores appear on leaderboards, where players climb by chaining large combos and clean lines. The controls are easy to understand, but getting good takes practice. Everything runs on mouse clicks or taps, and the game shows that a tractor can drift just as hard as a race car.
tank-shooting-simulator: Step into a 3D tank battle where you defend your homeland. You can choose from a selection of tanks and head into combat against the enemy in this offline game, which costs nothing to play. Your goal is to wipe out every enemy tank and tear down the opposing bases spread across the territory. In this simulator, you must shoot all the enemy tanks before they reach your army base, while keeping your own vehicles safe.
Driving works with the arrow keys or WASD, and the mouse lets you look around. Press C to switch the camera view, and hit the left mouse button to fire. Tab opens the menu.
wednesday-halloween-cave: Gothic girls from a wizard school need to escape a dangerous mine after venturing in to find a magic book they have been hunting for. Inside, they run into a zombie that nobody in the group has ever seen before. Team up with your friends to help the girls reach the book and bring it back safely. Watch out for the dangerous spiders, and keep away from the giant zombie that lurks in the cave.

The characters run forward on their own, so your job is to time the jumps. Press the Up Arrow or W key to leap over obstacles. Touch controls are available for phones and tablets. Escape the giant zombie and reach the magic book at the end of the level.
space-brawlers-tds: Space Brawlers TDS! is a nonstop sci-fi shooter seen from above. You pick one of four classes, each with tactical counters, health, speed, and three cooldown skills. The Mercenary Gunner is a sharp marksman who hits foes from range, and his aim-bot makes him a great fit for beginners. The Blitz Scout moves at light
super-zombie-shooter-2: Super Zombie Shooter 2 drops you into a risky research facility crawling with groups of zombies. You'll make your way through gloomy labs, deserted hallways, and concealed rooms, all while staying alive. Every level asks you to locate the way out and push further into the compound. As you progress, you can open up weapons, from handguns to strong rifles and test-stage guns. Hunt for ammunition and supplies, take down tougher foes, and piece together what caused the outbreak as you battle toward freedom.

Controls are simple: use WASD to move, left click to fire, and right click to aim. Hold the flashlight, reload with R, use items with F, and throw grenades with G. H handles melee attacks, C lets you crouch, and Space makes you jump. Shift sprints, keys 1 through 9 switch weapons, M mutes the sound, and TAB pauses the game.
obby-grow-with-every-step: This obby game draws inspiration from Roblox and has your character grow taller with every step. Each run lifts you higher, and the challenges ahead get tougher as you rise. Along the way you'll leap across gaps, scale high platforms, and dodge traps while testing how far you can go.

Levels blend parkour, puzzles, and obstacles that become harder as your hero gets bigger. Sharpen your agility, speed, and precision to become the tallest and most skilled obby hero. It suits fans of Roblox-style adventures, parkour, and reaction-based challenges. On PC, use WASD to move, the mouse to adjust the camera, and Space to jump. On mobile, use the on-screen controls and drag anywhere to move the camera. Bright graphics and endless growth round out the experience.
cozy-kitchen-merge: Cozy Kitchen Merge is a cute cooking puzzle. You set dishes onto a tray one at a time while keeping an eye on the queue. When three or more matching dishes touch, whether side by side or at the corners, they combine into the next recipe and your score goes up. Each 100 points earns an Eat Token, and tapping the fork munches one dish to free up room when the tray gets crowded.

Always leave at least one open spot, because a dish with nowhere to go ends the run. Climb the recipe ladder from 1 to 10, unlock achievements, and try to beat your best score. The soft art and cozy sounds make each quick round a relaxing break. In the main menu, you can tap and drag the decor, but be careful, since things may fall.
road-crosser: Road Crosser is a three-dimensional casual game with a hypercasual feel. You guide a little bird across the road, gobbling up coins while steering clear of passing cars. Each coin you collect adds to your total, and those coins can be spent on new, cuter skins for your character.

The game is controlled with the keyboard. Keep an eye on the traffic, collect as many coins as you can, and use them to unlock fresh looks for your bird. Its straightforward idea makes it quick to pick up for a short round.
balloon-blitz: Balloon Blitz is a colorful arcade game about popping as many balloons as you can. You launch darts at red and blue balloons, so quick reactions and careful aim are key. Pick your targets wisely, chain hits together for combo points, and work your way up the leaderboard. The game is simple to pick up and suits players of all ages.

Bright, cheerful graphics and responsive controls keep things light, while the challenge steadily grows as you go. Whether you want a relaxed session or a competitive push for high scores, there is plenty here for you. Watch the clock, since the round ends when time runs out. On desktop, left-click to release the matching dart. On mobile, tap the dart to launch it and pop the balloons.
cosmic-strike-2-0: Explore space in this 3D action game, where you battle spaceships from start to finish. Three lengthy stages await, and each one ends with a boss that plays differently from the rest, so you will need to adapt quickly. Destroying enemies and bosses brings in money, which you can spend on new ships. Every vessel has its own damage output and firing style, so switching ships changes how the game feels. The final boss may seem unbeatable, but it has one weak spot you can target.
Controls are simple: press W to accelerate and S to slow down, move the mouse to steer, and left click to fire. Be careful, because if your ship crashes into another ship, you die.
residents-evil-tariff-war: Amid a global trade conflict, the world is nearing collapse. When a hostile country kidnaps the president and holds them in a secret biological laboratory, a former special operations agent is sent behind enemy lines to bring the leader home. Your path leads through a labyrinth of contaminated hallways, where you must solve puzzles and survive encounters with grotesque, lab-made creatures. Viewed from over your character's shoulder, the action plays out as a survival shooter.

Each bullet matters, and every decision you make shapes how the mission unfolds. Along the way, you will uncover what really lies behind the conflict and race the clock to rescue the president. Click with your mouse or tap to play.
battle-tung-tung-sahur-2player: Battle Tung Tung Sahur 2Player is a 2D action arcade game for one or two people, where you and a friend face off in a clash between Tung Tung Sahurs. Each side swings sticks at the other, and the goal is to get to the chest first and hold a spot beside it. Whoever remains nearby the longest takes the victory, so beating your friend is the only route to winning.
Player one moves with the WASD keys and strikes by pressing S. Player two uses the arrow keys and hits with the Down Arrow. To claim the win, stay close to the chest for 20 seconds.
drago-sky-quest: Drago Sky Quest sends you soaring across misty skies and floating kingdoms. You control Drago, a young dragon with a brave heart, who sets out to recover the lost sky crystals and bring balance back to the clouds. Your route winds through tricky aerial courses where you must weave past magical traps, face flying foes, and uncover ancient secrets. Bright visuals and smooth flight handling make every level feel like a journey high above the clouds.

Gather upgrades to strengthen your dragon, unlock new powers, and explore charming sky worlds. Boss battles add a bigger challenge along the way. Steer with the arrow keys, or use the mouse or a touch screen, whichever suits you.
dragon-island-idle-3d: Dragon Island Idle 3D is a casual idle game set in a three-dimensional world. Players raise their dragons and grow an island empire step by step. Each facility you unlock brings in income. For instance, opening a new pasture lets you raise more dinos, while synths can be unlocked for the new area. The incubator is another unlock, and it supplies you with dinos for your collection.
Playing is simple, since a mouse click or a tap is all you need. The hypercasual style keeps the focus on steady growth and collecting dragons and dinos across your island.
anti-stress-mind-relax-games: This 3D puzzle collection is designed to help you unwind and ease everyday tension. Anyone searching for stress and anxiety relief will likely enjoy the gameplay, which offers a calm way to pass the time. The lineup includes anti-stress games, a pop it game, and several other relief-style titles meant to soothe your mind.
Controls are easy to pick up, since a mouse click or a tap is all you need to play. Built with Unity3D, this free browser game is ready whenever you want a quick mental break.
connect-one-line: Connect One Line is a hypercasual game in the Click and Skill groups. Controls are simple: a mouse click or a tap is all you need to play.

The description presents the title as an entry point to many kinds of games, where players can meet others and read recent news and content. It also mentions an active community and virtual journeys meant to be memorable, and says that gaming here should feel easy and enjoyable from the very beginning.
